Company Description

Set in the heart of Burleigh Heads on the Gold Coast, Mondrian Gold Coast is a bold, design-led luxury hotel that brings a fresh and playful energy to the Australian hospitality scene. Part of the global Ennismore collective, Mondrian is known for its distinctive design, vibrant dining, entertainment and experiences that are anything but ordinary. We’re a team that values individuality, creativity, genuine connections and having fun while delivering exceptional experiences for our guests.

Job Description

Mondrian Gold Coast is a luxury lifestyle hotel positioned at the intersection of design, culture, wellness and modern hospitality. The hotel houses elevated accommodation, Ciel Spa, premium event spaces and destination dining, attracting both leisure and corporate audiences. Recent winner of the QHA Awards Best Meeting & Events Venue in Queensland

This is not a basic social media coordinator role. You'll own digital content and campaigns across Rooms, Ciel Spa and Conferences & Events — creating content, managing paid media, building EDM campaigns and tracking SEO performance across the hotel's digital ecosystem.

THE ROLE

  • As Social Media & Digital Executive, you'll take hands-on and onsite ownership of:
  • Social media management and content creation across @mondriangoldcoast and @cielspaburleighheads
  • On-site content capture (photo and video) — you'll be on the floor regularly, shooting and directing
  • Paid advertising campaign management across Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads
  • End-to-end EDM creation and deployment via Revinate
  • SEO monitoring, reporting and optimisation
  • Weekly performance reporting across all digital channels
  • Supporting visibility and lead generation for Conferences, Events and Weddings
  • Creative support for special events/onsite activations

What You Will Do

  • Build and manage monthly content calendars
  • Capture on-site iPhone content with a professional, aesthetic edge
  • Write captions aligned to luxury tone of voice
  • Schedule and publish content; manage community engagement
  • Monitor competitor brands and emerging platform trends
  • Film and photograph across guest rooms, spa treatments, event setups and wedding styling
  • Edit short-form vertical video in CapCut or equivalent
  • Plan shoots, develop concepts, source styling props and direct staff or models
  • Build and manage Meta and Google campaigns across Rooms, Spa, Events and Weddings
  • Create paid ad creative — static and video
  • Monitor performance, optimise delivery and reallocate budgets across sub-brands
  • Build, segment and deploy EDM campaigns via Revinate
  • Monitor organic search performance, keyword rankings and traffic trends
  • Weekend content creation across the asset

WHY MONDRIAN GOLD COAST

  • Work in one of Australia's most visually striking luxury hotels — your portfolio will show it
  • Real creative ownership across multiple premium brands from day one
  • A collaborative, design-forward team that values ideas and execution equally
  • Burleigh Heads location - one of the Gold Coast's most desirable coastal addresses
  • Opportunity to grow with a globally recognised hospitality brand (Ennismore)

dnata is one of the world's largest air services providers offering ground handling, cargo, travel and flight catering services across five continents.

Our Financial Planning & Analysis team has an exciting opportunity for a highly motivated, outcomes focused individual with strong analytical skills to join our team as a Financial Planning Analyst in a full-time capacity.

This purpose of the FP&A role is to support the FP&A Manager and wider team in the execution of various value-added activities of dnata’s FP&A function allowing the dnata to make well-informed commercial and profitable decisions.

A day in the life

  • Responsible for the production of timely and accurate weekly and monthly reporting for the business.
  • Assist managers to understand and control labor spending to drive better commercial decision making.
  • Analysing financial data and building financial models to support in the decision-making process.
  • Partnering with the business on financial modelling in support of CAPEX.
  • Assist commercial team in new business development, tender creation and retrospective review.
  • Review Customer Tender submissions to assess their financial feasibility.
  • Liaise with Category and Sales teams to ensure volumes related to Customer Tender initiatives are robust and commercially viable.
  • Ensure governance framework around Customer Tenders is achieved and adhered to.
  • Assist the FP&A team in the preparation of budgets and forecasts.
  • Identify opportunities to develop and enhance the reporting suit for evolving business needs, whilst reducing any duplication of work.
  • Evaluate financial performance and KPI’s by comparing and analysing actual results with budget and forcasts and recommend actions for optimisation.
  • Work closely with the accounting team to ensure accurate financial reporting and decision support.
  • Complete and assist all ad-hoc analysis requirements by management

To succeed in this role, you will need:

  • CPA, CIMA or equivalent is desirable (or working towards).
  • Demonstrated experience in a similar role.
  • A high level of proficiency in the use of Microsoft Excel.
  • Desirable experience in financial modelling will be highly advantageous.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Proven ability to work as part of a team and also work independently achieve work objectives.

Does this sound like you? If so, Apply Now!

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, which values diversity and inclusion. We support applicants from all backgrounds, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islanders, people with disabilities, people from culturally diverse backgrounds and all ages. We also have a solid focus on gender balance within the organisation and encourage women to apply.

job.job_description:
#FCB ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY...

Join Flight Centre Travel Group as our Global People Services - APAC Team Lead in Brisbane and play a key role in supporting our people through Workday and HR administration. You’ll lead the day-to-day operations of a regional Global People Services team, guiding and developing team members while acting as an escalation point for People Experience stakeholders. You’ll work across HR, Payroll, Finance, IT and Workday functional teams to resolve issues, strengthen processes and improve the employee experience. This is an opportunity to combine people leadership, HR operations and systems expertise in a global environment.

DAY TO DAY YOU WILL...

  • Lead the day-to-day running of the regional Global People Services team.
  • Provide support, guidance, coaching and feedback to team members.
  • Undertake quality assurance activities and identify opportunities for training and development.
  • Act as an escalation point for team members and People Experience stakeholders.
  • Build strong relationships with regional People Experience, Payroll, Finance and Workday functional teams.
  • Liaise between the regional Global People Services team and functional teams to resolve issues.
  • Identify opportunities to improve knowledge articles, processes and the user experience.
  • Oversee data accuracy across Workday, Core and Payroll systems.
  • Provide reporting and analytics on team metrics and process effectiveness.
  • Ensure appropriate team coverage across extended global time zones.
  • Partner with HR, Payroll, IT and Workday functional resources to drive continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive.

YOU'LL BE PERFECT IF YOU HAVE...

  • A minimum of 3 years’ experience in a process-oriented HR role.
  • Strong knowledge of FCTG People Experience processes and systems.
  • Knowledge of HR, Payroll and Finance business processes.
  • The ability to understand system dependencies within a complex, non-standardised IT environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy when processing data.
  • Excellent problem-solving and stakeholder communication skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office.
  • Experience working with remote teams.
  • Leadership experience involving coaching, mentoring or managing team members is preferred.
  • Transactional experience with Workday HCM is preferred.
  • A tertiary qualification in HR, Business or a related field is preferred.
  • The flexibility to participate in meetings with stakeholders across locations from India through to New Zealand when required.
  • Minimum of 3 years' leadership experience preferred

What you'll Enjoy:

🙋🏾‍♀️Culture: you will be employed by an inclusive company that offers a team culture like no other in the industry - Flight Centre Travel Group Australia is proud to be a certified Great Place To Work® Australia New Zealand Pty Ltd

👐🏽 Our People: FCTG is an Equal Opportunity Employer and encourage all suitably qualified applicants to apply, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander People and people from racial, ethnic, or ethno-religious minority groups and people with disability

🎉Development: Individualised Learning & Development pathway options

🔧Access to 'LinkedIn Learning' for ongoing skills development: over 24,500 courses in over 20 languages

🏆Exclusive Staff Discounts: Accessible via our employee-only portal with 350+ of Australia’s leading retailers, health and wellness discounts, financial planning advice, employee share plan and more

🌏Travel Discounts: Including family and friends - flights, hotels, tours, cruises, travel insurance and more

💎Brightness of Future: Career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses across the globe - we promote from within  

🥦Corporate Health Discounts: Access exclusive discounts on health insurance plans for you and your family with our partner, BUPA, access to internal gym

🌞Mental Health: Support and Employee Assistance Program for staff and family

🎉Social: Regular awards nights, social team-building and industry events, with the opportunity to attend global conferences (Bangkok in 2026)  

🙏🏼 Giving Back: Corporate Social Responsibility program supporting nominated charities through Workplace Giving, volunteering and fundraising; paid parental and volunteer leave

💚Sustainability: The protection of our environment is essential to the future of tourism, as a leading travel group, we have made efforts to affect positive change to the environment

💛 Be part of a workplace committed to reconciliation through our Reconciliation Action Plan - we proudly support Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander inclusion, cultural safety, and dedicated cultural leave

job.job_description:
Manage the Property Improvement Plans (PIP) process and documentation for all IHG brands. Manage a team of Renovation Managers throughout the Americas, who are responsible for deploying the PIP process to applicable hotels, consulting with hotel management on construction and property improvements, and documenting hotel performance vs. their individual plan. Review correspondence from staff to franchisees, render decisions on milestone extensions and other requests of franchisees, monitor and control the schedules of property visits, and train new Renovation Managers. Enforce standards with franchisees and serve as first level of appeal above the Renovation Managers.

Your day to day

  • Implement and manage the Property Improvement Plan (PIP) process to ensure that hotel evaluations, documentation and reports are completed in a consistent, timely, cost-effective, and professional manner. Review for accuracy and compliance all PIPs for all brands in assigned region.. Ensure PIPs are written to address market position, brand standards, guest satisfaction feedback and Company Tier Guidelines (regulations for levels of service in franchise hotels) in order to facilitate compliance from franchisees. Coordinate and resolve any discrepancy with managers prior to sending to applicant.
  • Design, implement and maintain a PIP process to ensure that evaluations and reports are completed in a consistent, timely, cost-effective, and professional manner. Prepare and issue employee communications, in written or oral form, relative to new or changed policies and procedures, department objectives, or standards. Plan and conduct a minimum of two yearly training events to ensure on-going consistency of the Renovation department.
  • Coordinate with Renovation Managers to prepare PIP documents for Franchise Approval Committee meetings.
  • Responsible to make sure that all renovation milestones are monitored on a pro-active basis and that the Renovation team is providing information to the Openings, Design Review, Quality, and Franchise Performance Support teams to speed openings or enforcement.
  • Track all ongoing plans, and prepare written reports and/or summaries for management as needed using the Salesforce systems
  • Operate the unit within budgetary parameters.
  • Coach and develop team members; hire, fire, assess, discipline, document performance, recommend salary and classifications changes. Act as an advisor to subordinate staff to help meet established schedules and/or resolve technical or operational problems. Train new consultants as needed. Travel with direct reports at least twice a year for consistency checking and personal development planning.

What We Need From You

  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Architecture, Design, or Construction Management, or a relevant field of work, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience.
  • 6 to 10 years progressive work related experience in architecture, design, or construction management, to include experience in hotel industry developing property improvement plans.
  • Demonstrated project management experience in organizing, planning and executing large-scale projects from conception through implementation.
  • Demonstrated effective verbal and written communication skills for the purpose of providing information to clients, vendors, senior management and staff.
  • Sound knowledge of computer applications.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of the Company’s license agreement and related regulations
  • Proficient knowledge of building construction codes (i.e. requirements, etc.)
  • Demonstrated experience in architectural and construction design and renovation for large commercial or industrial facilities.
  • Demonstrated understanding of building codes, performance plans, technical specifications and brand standards for all Company property types.

Travel – 10-15%

Location – Atlanta, GA: Our hybrid work structure is an expectation of three (3) days a week in office. This expectation may be adjusted to evolve with the changing needs of the business; OR Remote: **candidate must reside in a major city in the US and must be within 1 hour proximity to a major US airport**

The salary range for this role is $106,000.00 to $135,000.00. This role is also eligible for bonus pay (as applicable). We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, 401K, and other benefits to employees.

At IHG Hotels & Resorts, we work together to deliver True Hospitality for Good on a global scale. With corporate offices and over 6,000 hotel destinations worldwide, a career at IHG is the perfect way to broaden your horizons. You’ll experience our unique culture and brilliant colleagues who will support and inspire you. With a host of corporate opportunities to choose from, wherever you are on your career journey, and whatever you want to achieve there’s Room for You at IHG.

Over recent years, we’ve transformed our company. We have bold ambitions to drive performance and maintain our relentless focus on growth in order to be the hotel company of choice that guests & owners love.

We are a hospitality business at our core and value connections and being together helps us foster a unique sense of belonging that also supports productivity. That’s why here at IHG, we give our colleagues flexibility and balance – working in a hybrid way, blending office and remote working collectively. We recognise that every role is different, that’s why leaders work with teams to determine how and when they collaborate.

We provide a wide range of benefits designed to help you live your best work life. These include impressive room discounts across our many properties, recharge days and volunteering days throughout the year. Through our myWellbeing framework, we are committed to supporting wellbeing in your health, lifestyle, and workplace. We offer a unique and inclusive culture, where there is always Room for You to belong, grow and make a difference.

Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams where we celebrate difference and encourage colleagues to bring their whole selves to work. IHG Hotels & Resorts provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other category protected by applicable laws. We promote a culture of trust, support, and acceptance. Always welcoming different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

Important information:

  • The salary range listed is the lowest to highest pay scale we, in good faith, believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee’s pay position within the pay range will be based on several factors, including relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, and business or organizational needs.

job.job_description:
Description de l'entreprise

Accor Tech & Digital est le moteur de la tech, des solutions digitales et de la transformation au sein du Groupe. Nos 5 000 talents s'engagent à offrir les meilleures expériences digitales et tech à nos clients, nos hôtels et nos équipes dans 110 pays, et à façonner l'avenir de l'hospitalité.

Accor Tech & Digital, des métiers où l’intelligence est d’abord humaine !

Description du poste

Accor Tech & Digital, c’est le laboratoire d’innovation et de transformation technologique du leader mondial de l’hôtellerie.

Nos équipes, appelées Heartist®, concentrent le meilleur de l'hospitalité et le meilleur de la tech & du digital.

Notre ambition : offrir à nos clients des expériences personnalisées, mémorables et durables.

Ici, nous faisons naître de nouvelles façons de voyager dans chacun de nos 5 500 hôtels, au plus proche de nos 100 millions de clients dans 110 pays.

Ici, nous sommes au cœur d’un formidable terrain de jeu de transition technologique et de conception de produits digitaux et de services, pour nos clients et nos équipes en hôtels.

Ici, votre champ d’application ne connaîtra aucune frontière.

Alors, avec nous, osez avoir un impact sur le monde !

C’est ici que vous attend votre plus grand défi :

En tant que Responsable Stratégie & Opérations GTM, vous piloterez le moteur d'activation stratégique de notre écosystème mondial de partenariats de fidélité. Votre mission est de développer l'usage et la rentabilité des programmes de partenariat grâce à une approche GTM et opérationnelle optimisée, des parcours clients améliorés et l'exploitation de l'IA et de la donnée.

À la tête d'une équipe spécialisée de managers (couvrant les Opérations Business, le Marketing et Marketing Ops, ainsi que les Opérations Finance), vous ferez le lien entre vision stratégique et excellence opérationnelle, en veillant à ce que nos offres de fidélité B2B2C soient rentables, scalables et fortement engageantes pour les membres.

Votre Mission

  • Direction stratégique, Finance & Planification :
    • Définir et exécuter la stratégie GTM et Opérations Partenariats à l'échelle mondiale.
    • Piloter les processus de planification annuelle et à long terme afin d'aligner objectifs business, budget et ressources avec les parties prenantes internes.

  • Stratégie Data & Business :
    • Être garant(e) de la stratégie data des partenariats, des modèles économiques et de la gouvernance avec les parties prenantes internes (Data, Media, Marketing), et piloter le suivi de la performance sur l'usage, la rentabilité et l'économie des partenariats.
    • Superviser l'architecture et les flux de données, ainsi que l'infrastructure juridique et de reporting, afin d'améliorer la prise de décision, la monétisation et la performance des partenariats.

  • Opérations Business & cycle de vie des partenariats :
    • Être garant(e) et exécuter les étapes clés du cycle de vie opérationnel des partenariats (onboarding, GTM, croissance, renouvellement ou offboarding) en collaboration avec les partnership managers, afin d'améliorer le time-to-market, la qualité de service et de réduire les risques business (ex. KYC et audits).
    • Automatiser les opérations et processus dès que possible.

  • Merchandising & optimisation UX :
    • Co-piloter avec l'équipe Produit la mise en avant des partenaires et les parcours clients digitaux sur l'ensemble des écosystèmes digitaux Accor et partenaires (web, app, CRM), afin d'améliorer la découverte et l'usage des offres de partenariat, tout en garantissant une stricte conformité à la marque.

  • Standards opérationnels & activation :
    • Définir, exécuter et mettre à disposition des standards opérationnels centralisés (finance, marketing, juridique, conformité et opérations), des guidelines et des templates, ainsi qu'un support opérationnel aux équipes centrales, régionales de partenariats et marketing, afin d'assurer une cohérence globale.

  • Outils scalables, Automatisation & IA
    • Piloter la conception et le déploiement de la stack d'outils internes et d'automatisation nécessaire pour scaler les opérations de partenariat, incluant les fonctionnalités PRM/CRM, l'automatisation des workflows, les solutions de reporting et les cas d'usage IA.
    • Conduire la simplification des processus et l'adoption des outils afin de réduire la charge manuelle, améliorer le time-to-market, renforcer la qualité d'exécution et permettre aux équipes de scaler efficacement.

  • Leadership d'équipe :
    • Recruter, accompagner et diriger une équipe performante.
Qualifications

Et vous?

  • Expérience : 6+ ans d'expérience en Revenue Operations, GTM Operations ou fonctions opérationnelles connexes dans un environnement B2B2C, incluant une expérience de management ou d'accompagnement d'équipe.
  • Workflows IA : Expérience concrète dans le déploiement de workflows IA dans un contexte GTM, avec des exemples précis d'impact mesurable.
  • Opérations : Avoir conçu des cadres opérationnels de A à Z avec des partenaires externes, incluant l'activation commerciale (sales enablement) et l'optimisation post-lancement (suivi des KPIs).
  • Communication stratégique & clarté : Présence exécutive affirmée, communication claire et capacité à challenger les hypothèses établies.
  • Influence : Capacité à faire adopter des processus aux équipes transverses, même non sollicités au départ, grâce à une argumentation solide.
  • Obsession client : Compréhension du fait que les décisions opérationnelles se répercutent directement sur l'expérience client.
  • Langues : Français et anglais courants.
  • Formation : Master en Administration des Affaires, Finance, Marketing ou domaine connexe.
  • Data & Media : Bonne connaissance des modèles économiques de monétisation de la donnée et du media.

Informations supplémentaires

Et nous, quels sont nos engagements ?

  • Sur le monde
  • Accor s’engage pour le monde qui nous entoure, avec une culture employeur forte centrée sur le développement de nos 300 000 talents.
  • Nous adoptons une approche d'amélioration continue pour réduire l'impact du digital sur l'environnement dans l’ensemble de nos projets.
  • Sur votre carrière
  • Nous permettons à tous nos collaborateurs de maîtriser leur équilibre vie-perso / vie-pro et leur offrons les moyens de façonner leur environnement de travail à leur image.
  • Les parcours de formation et d’évolution sont définis à la fois individuellement et collectivement pour que nous grandissions ensemble, au quotidien.
  • Concrètement, chez Accor Tech & Digital :
  • Télétravail possible plusieurs jours par semaine depuis la France et options de travail flexibles : travaillez depuis chez vous, nos bureaux, ou même nos hôtels et espaces de coworking grâce à Worklib.
  • Chaque mercredi après-midi, consacrez votre temps à du travail de fond et à votre développement personnel.
  • Travail dans un environnement multiculturel et anglophone.
  • Amélioration continue & formations : Hackathons, partenariats technologiques d’exception, talent management dédié, certifications et plateforme de formation spécifique.

et aussi,

  • Programme ALL - Heartist® : tarifs préférentiels et offres flash pour des séjours et expériences inoubliables dans toutes nos adresses Accor et chez nos partenaires, dans le monde entier.
  • Programme de volontariat Heartist® for good : 1 jour offert sur votre temps de travail pour vous engager en faveur d’une association.
  • Un CSE qui vous accompagne dans le financement de vos activités culturelles et sportives.
  • Forfait Mobilité durable pour l’utilisation d’un moyen de déplacement « vert » ou un dispositif « vélo de fonction » en partenariat avec Zenride
  • Prise en charge des abonnements de transports publics urbains entre le domicile et le lieu de travail, à hauteur de 75%.
  • Tickets restaurant de 11€ en valeur faciale.
  • Une mutuelle obligatoire financée à 50% par Accor sans frais supplémentaire en cas d'adhésion de vos ayants droits.
  • Sans oublier des conditions de travail attractives avec des espaces de travail collaboratifs, des restaurants, espaces de jeux ou encore des espaces de bien-être et de Sport sur site ou grâce à Gymlib.

Votre talent et votre motivation sont nos seuls critères de sélection.

Nous valorisons la richesse des diverses nationalités, personnalités et parcours professionnels.

Nous savons nous adapter aux besoins spécifiques de nos collaborateurs, notamment ceux en situation de handicap.

Nous encourageons toutes les candidatures, sans distinction de genre, alors osez postuler !

Pour nous, le recrutement est avant tout une histoire de rencontres.

Cette mission vous attire ? Postulez et nous vous proposerons :

  • Un échange avec notre équipe recrutement pour vous présenter les lignes essentielles du poste ou vous orienter vers le rôle qui peut vous correspondre,
  • Un ou des entretiens avec les managers et les membres de l’équipe,
  • Pour certains postes, vous pourriez également être amené à effectuer un test ou une étude de cas, ainsi qu’un questionnaire sur votre personnalité et vos motivations.
  • Un entretien final avec notre équipe des Ressources Humaines pour échanger sur la culture de notre Groupe, l’environnement de travail, notre programme de formation et les perspectives de carrière, ainsi que les différents avantages du Groupe.
  • Un feedback personnalisé.

Reporting to the Front Office Manager, you will play a key role in overseeing hotel operations during the night shift, ensuring exceptional guest experiences, operational efficiency, and a safe and secure environment for our guests and Heartists.

Working hours are primarily 11:00 PM to 7:00 AM, including weekends and public holidays as required.

Located just moments from Mascot train station, Pullman Sydney Airport offers a supportive, inclusive, and engaging workplace where you can grow your hospitality career with Accor.

Job Description

  • Support and lead the Night Audit and Front Office operations during overnight shifts.
  • Deliver exceptional guest service and handle guest enquiries, requests, and complaints professionally.

  • Manage guest arrivals, departures, and room allocations.

  • Act as the senior hotel representative overnight and make operational decisions as required.
  • Coordinate with Housekeeping, Engineering, Security, and Food & Beverage teams to ensure smooth hotel operations.

Qualifications

  • Previous Front Office supervisory or leadership experience within a hotel environment.
  • Experience using Opera PMS (preferred).
  • Strong understanding of Night Audit procedures.
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and confidently manage overnight hotel operations.
  • Strong attention to detail and financial accuracy.
  • Full working rights in Australia.
  • Flexibility to work overnight shifts, weekends, and public holidays.
  • Immaculate grooming and professional presentation.

Additional Information

At Accor, we believe Hospitality is a Work of Heart.

By joining Accor, every chapter of your story is yours to write, and together we can imagine tomorrow's hospitality.

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

Be the leader who keeps our hotel running smoothly while the city sleeps. Apply today and become part of the Pullman Sydney Airport family.

DAY TO DAY YOU WILL...

  • Support users of the People Systems data auditing tool, helping them understand audit findings, flagged records and required actions.
  • Coach HR, Payroll and business users on running audits, interpreting results and resolving exceptions.
  • Investigate data exceptions, identify root causes and determine where corrections need to be made.
  • Guide users through Workday corrections using appropriate business processes, or action corrections where required and permitted.
  • Support bulk data corrections, testing and approvals under the guidance of senior team members.
  • Help align data across Workday, local payroll systems and Core by identifying where corresponding corrections are needed.
  • Build and maintain basic Workday reports to support auditing and validation.
  • Identify recurring data quality trends and root causes to support process and training improvements.
  • Support validation and regression testing for Workday releases and system changes, including logging defects.
  • Create and maintain user guides, job aids, FAQs and knowledge resources.
  • Build strong working relationships with HR, GPS, payroll and other stakeholders, and contribute to workshops and requirements-gathering activities.

YOU'LL BE PERFECT IF YOU HAVE...

  • 0–2 years’ experience working with HR, payroll or HRIS data, with Workday experience preferred, or demonstrated aptitude for learning complex systems.
  • Hands-on experience working with data using Microsoft Excel or similar data analysis and reporting tools, including reviewing, comparing, validating and identifying issues within datasets.
  • Confidence using Excel to work with structured data, with experience using functions, filters, sorting or other features to investigate and validate information.
  • Exposure to HR processes, payroll, HR technology, data analysis or business analysis in a professional environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to data quality and accuracy.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify data anomalies, investigate discrepancies and trace issues to their root cause.
  • Ability to follow established processes and work effectively with guidance.
  • A proactive approach to learning and a genuine interest in developing Workday and HR data expertise.
  • Confidence explaining data and system concepts to non-technical users and coaching others.
  • Experience in a support, data analyst, payroll or HR operations role is advantageous.
  • Qualifications in Human Resources, Business Administration, Information Systems, Data Analytics or a related field.
  • Workday training or certification is advantageous but not essential, with the opportunity to develop this capability in the role.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

The Opportunity:

As the Head of Strategic Account Management for Japan, your main objectives will be to develop and deploy Agoda’s Japan strategy, provide guidance and leadership to ensure the successful account management of Agoda’s major partners, and deliver on targets and growth expectations that are key to Agoda’s business goals. To succeed in this role, you will bring excellent analytical skills, strong account and client management experience, a proven record of sustainable performance, and the capacity to lead, motivate, coach, and mentor teams. In addition, the ability to establish and develop valued long-term partnerships will be essential.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement strategies to accelerate Agoda’s business in Japan.
  • Demonstrate outstanding team leadership to grow the local business and consistently deliver on plans.
  • Implement strategies with top partners to enhance productivity and maintain a competitive advantage.
  • Establish and maintain robust relationships at senior levels, including C-level with key partners—driving partnership expansions and identifying significant opportunities.
  • Has the ability to lead a company-wide project with a few multidisciplinary teams.
  • Coordinate with top management on strategic planning and objectives.
  • Lead, coach, develop, and manage multiple teams through upskilling and coaching.
  • Modify the organizational structure by bringing in top talent, supporting recruitment, or assisting in restructuring key organizational components.
  • Conduct market research on industry and Japanese market trends to ensure Agoda’s competitiveness.
  • Attend and participate in relevant industry events.

What You’ll Need to Succeed:

  • More than 8 years of professional experience at multi-national companies.
  • 3–5+ years’ experience in leading, coaching, and developing teams, with a proven track record in rapidly changing environments.
  • Relevant experience in account management, business development, or general management. Travel industry experience is not required.
  • Strong numerical and analytical skills with keen attention to detail.
  • Ability to effectively communicate proposals to potential partners and internal stakeholders.
  • Strategic thinker; management consulting experience highly valued.
  • Professional “get it done” attitude and strong work ethic.
  • Resourceful, energetic, and self-driven personality.
  • Ability to move quickly, adapt well to change, and thrive in dynamic environments.
  • Experience in online or e-commerce business preferred.
  • Fluency in English and Japanese is required.

Company Description

Accor Tech & Digital is the power engine of Accor technology, digital business and transformation. Our 5,000 talents are committed to deliver the best tech and digital experiences to our guests, hotels and staff across 110 countries and to shape the future of hospitality.

Accor Tech & Digital, jobs in the tech field where intelligence is above all human!

Job Description

Accor Tech & Digital is the innovation and technological transformation lab of the world leader in hospitality.

Our teams, known as Heartists®, bring together the best of hospitality with the best of tech and digital. Our ambition is to provide our customers with personalized, memorable, and sustainable experiences.

Here, we create new ways to travel within each of our 5,500 hotels, connecting closely with our 100 million clients in 110 countries.

Here, we are at the heart of an incredible playground for technological transition and the design of digital products and services for our customers and hotel teams.

Here, your scope will know no boundaries;

So join us and dare to make an impact on the world!

Here Is Where Your Greatest Challenge Awaits You

As the Head of GTM Strategy & Operations, you will lead the strategic enablement engine for our global loyalty partnerships ecosystem. Your mission is to drive partnership programs usage & profitability via streamlined GTM & operations, improved customer journeys and AI/ data usage.

Leading a specialized team of managers (covering Business Ops, Marketing and Marketing Ops, and Finance Ops), you will bridge the gap between strategic vision and operational excellence, ensuring our B2B2C loyalty offerings are profitable, scalable, and highly engaging for members.

Your Mission

  • Strategic Direction, Finance & Planning:
    • Define and execute the global Partnerships GTM & Operations strategy.
    • Lead the annual and long-range planning processes to align business goals, budget and resources with internal stakeholders.
  • Data Strategy & Business:
    • Own the partnerships data strategy, business models and governance with internal stakeholders (Data, Media, Marketing), and lead performance management across usage, profitability and partner economics.
    • Oversee data architecture, flows, legal and reporting infrastructure to improve decision-making, monetization and partnership performance.
  • Business Operations & Partnerships lifecycle:
    • Own and execute key steps of the Partnerships Operational Lifecycle (Onboarding, GTM, growth, renewal or offboarding) in collaboration with the partnership managers to improve TTM, service quality and lower business risks (e.g. KYC and audits).
    • Automatize operations and processes, when possible.
  • Merchandising & UX Optimization:
    • Co-Own the partner showcasing & digital customer journeys with the Product team across ALL Accor and partners digital ecosystems (web, app, CRM) to improve partnership offerings discovery and usage, ensuring strict brand compliance.
  • Operating Standards & Enablement:
    • Define, Execute and provide centralized operating standards (finance, marketing, legal, compliance & ops), guidelines and templates and operational support to central, regional partnership and marketing teams to ensure global consistency.
  • Scalable Tools, Automation & AI
    • Lead the design and rollout of the internal tools and automation stack required to scale the partnership operations, including PRM/CRM capabilities, workflow automation, reporting solutions and AI-enabled use cases.
    • Drive process simplification and tool adoption to reduce manual workload, improve time-to-market, strengthen execution quality and enable the teams to scale efficiently.
  • Team Leadership:
    • Hire, mentor, and lead a high-performing team.
Qualifications

And you?

  • Experience: 6+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, GTM Operations or adjacent operational roles in a B2B2C environment, including experience leading or mentoring others.
  • AI workflows: Have hands-on experience deploying AI workflows in a GTM context and can point to concrete examples with measurable impact.
  • Operation: Have designed operating frameworks from scratch with external partners, including sales enablement and post-launch optimization (KPIs monitoring).
  • Strategic Communication & Clarity: Have a grounded executive presence, you communicate clearly and challenge assumptions.
  • Influence: You get cross-functional teams to adopt processes they did not ask for, because you have made the case.
  • Customers obsession. You understand that operational decisions show up in the customer experience.
  • Language: Fluent in French and English.
  • Education: Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Marketing, or a related field.
  • Data & Media: Being familiar with data monetization business models and media.

Additional Information

Accor Dares To Impact

  • the world
  • Accor is committed to the world around us, with a strong employer culture focused on the development of our 300,000 talents.
  • We adopt a continuous improvement approach to reduce the impact of digital on the environment across all our projects.

job.company_description:
Delta Air Lines (NYSE: DAL) is the U.S. global airline leader in safety, innovation, reliability and customer experience. job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

At Delta Air Lines, connection is at the heart of everything we do and guides our every action. We strive to welcome and care for all of our customers during their travels with us and aim to deliver an elevated experience.

Delta's brand is built on industry-leading operational reliability and customer experience. Within Operations Planning & Performance (OP&P), the OCC Planning team serves as the analytical engine supporting the OCC Strategy organization. OCC Strategy acts as the strategic thought partner to operational leadership, helping the airline identify opportunities, improve decision-making, evaluate performance, and prepare for future operational challenges.

The Analytics Leader plays a critical role in this mission by transforming operational data into actionable insights that support strategic planning, operational performance management, and continuous improvement efforts across the Operations Control Center (OCC). Working in close partnership with OCC Strategy leadership, the Analytics Leader leads analytical efforts supporting critical initiatives such as After-Action Reviews (AARs), seasonal planning, performance measurement, operational readiness assessments, and strategic operational studies.

While OCC Strategy serves as the primary customer, the role requires maintaining a broad understanding of airline operations and collaborating across Flight Control, Operations Management, Crew, ACS, TechOps, Meteorology, and other operational stakeholders to connect operational execution with future planning and strategy. Through data-driven analysis and storytelling, the Analytics Leader helps leaders understand operational outcomes, identify underlying drivers of performance, evaluate strategic initiatives, and develop recommendations that improve future reliability and operational effectiveness. Successful candidates are naturally curious, highly analytical, and comfortable operating in ambiguous environments. They seek to understand not only operational outcomes, but the underlying drivers that influence those outcomes and the opportunities available to improve future performance. This position requires strong communication skills, strategic thinking, and the ability to influence decision-making through data-driven storytelling and analytical rigor.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary analytical partner to OCC Strategy by leading analyses that support OCC strategic planning, operational readiness reviews, performance evaluations, and executive decision-making
  • Lead analytical support for Winter Planning, Summer Planning, and station planning efforts by evaluating historical performance, weather impacts, operational constraints, network vulnerabilities, and recovery outcomes
  • Measure the effectiveness of seasonal planning initiatives and operating strategies and translate findings into recommendations that improve future seasonal execution
  • Partner with OCC Strategy to lead Post-IROP After-Action Reviews (AARs), seasonal retrospectives, and operational scorecards used to evaluate operational effectiveness
  • Develop performance frameworks and measurement methodologies that convert lessons learned into actionable improvements for future planning, operating procedures, and OCC strategy.
  • Build deep understanding of OCC operational processes, technologies, decision-making frameworks, and business challenges through close partnership with Flight Control, Operations Management, Crew, ACS, TechOps, Meteorology, and other stakeholders to ensure analytical recommendations are operationally feasible and aligned with future strategic needs.
  • Independently lead projects from business problem definition through implementation, including methodology design, data acquisition, analysis, recommendation development, and executive communication.
  • Conduct strategic studies related to topics such as delay propagation, proactive cancellation effectiveness, resource fragility, recovery effectiveness, diversion performance, and future operating strategies.
  • Build datasets, scorecards, dashboards, models, and decision-support tools that improve OCC Strategy's ability to measure performance, evaluate operational strategies, and make informed decisions.

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, operational analysis, strategy, consulting, or a related field
  • Demonstrated experience independently leading analytical projects from problem definition through recommendation and implementation
  • Experience working with large and complex datasets to solve business problems and support decision-making
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and critical thinking skills
  • Experience developing and delivering presentations and recommendations to leadership audiences
  • Proficiency with SQL and data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, and projects in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency.
  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Economics, Computer Science, Data Science, Business Analytics, or a related quantitative discipline
  • Advanced degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Economics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field
  • Experience applying statistical techniques, forecasting methodologies, experimental design, optimization, predictive analytics, or other quantitative methods to solve business challenges
  • Proficiency with Python, R, or other analytical programming languages
  • Experience building analytical datasets, automating reporting processes, and developing scalable analytical solutions
  • Familiarity with data engineering concepts including data modeling, ETL processes, data transformation, and data quality management
  • Experience developing performance measurement frameworks, KPIs, and operational scorecards
  • Experience supporting strategic planning, performance management, continuous improvement, or operational excellence initiatives
  • Experience translating ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches and actionable recommendations
  • Airline, transportation, logistics, or operations-focused industry experience preferred

Benefits And Perks To Help You Keep Climbing

Our culture is rooted in a shared dedication to living our values – Care, Integrity, Resilience, Servant Leadership, and Teamwork – every day, in everything we do. At Delta, our people are our success. At the heart of what we offer is our focus on Sharing Success with Delta employees. Exploring a career at Delta gives you a chance to see the world while earning great compensation and benefits to help you keep climbing along the way:

  • Competitive salary, industry-leading proﬁt sharing program, and performance incentives
  • 401(k) with generous company contributions up to 9%
  • Paid time off including vacation, holidays, paid personal time, maternity and parental leave
  • Comprehensive health beneﬁts including medical, dental, vision, short/long term disability and life beneﬁts
  • Family care assistance through fertility support, surrogacy and adoption assistance, lactation support, subsidized back-up care, and programs that help with loved ones in all stages
  • Holistic Wellbeing programs to support physical, emotional, social, and financial health, including access to an employee assistance program offering support for you and anyone in your household, free financial coaching, and extensive resources supporting mental health
  • Domestic and International space-available flight privileges for employees and eligible family members
  • Career development programs to achieve your long-term career goals
  • World-wide partnerships to engage in community service and innovative goals created to focus on sustainability and reducing our carbon footprint
  • Business Resource Groups created to connect employees with common interests to promote inclusion, provide perspective and help implement strategies
  • Recognition rewards and awards through the platform Unstoppable Together
  • Access to over 500 discounts, specialty savings and voluntary benefits through Deltaperks such as car and hotel rentals and auto, home, and pet insurance, legal services, and childcare

  • Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You’ll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.


Wanna take a peek into what it’s like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

IATA (International Air Transport Association) represents some 360 airlines comprising over 80% of global air traffic. The organization also represents, leads and serves the airline industry in general. IATA's Director General is Willie Walsh.
job.job_description:
Employment Type: Internship

Contract Duration: 6 months

Why you will love working here

At IATA, we represent over 350 airlines worldwide, striving to make aviation safer, smarter, more sustainable, and inclusive.

  • Our Values are not just words on a page - they are the energy behind everything we do: ONE IATA - We collaborate across teams, TRUSTED - We do the right thing, INNOVATIVE - We make tomorrow better, INCLUSIVE - We embrace diverse perspectives.
  • With over 30,000 courses available, we believe in continuous learning and support your growth in an ever-changing industry.
  • Diversity, equity, and inclusion are our priorities. We are certified by the Equal Salary Foundation, offering equal pay and family-friendly policies.
  • We encourage community involvement through volunteering and strive to make tomorrow better for aviation and our communities. We offer time off so you can support causes important to you.
  • We promote work-life balance with flexible work options, including remote and hybrid work, a generous 'work from abroad' policy, and you get your birthday off!

About The Team You Are Joining

Grasp an opportunity to expand your horizons in a global industry that is Aviation. If you are an individual that can work very hard under very little supervision, make smart decisions under pressure, maintain focus in the eye of several storms and display a determination to succeed against all odds. You will be working in several markets across Asia Pacific in a fantastic learning environment and “people first” culture.

What Your Day Would Be Like

  • Responsible for support of the Regional Banking Manager in execution of the Banking Management process according to the global Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs);
  • Update Banking Management Database in terms of (IATA bank accounts details, bank contact details, signatories and documentation/ agreements);
  • Responsible for collecting and preparing of supporting documents for all banking processes in the region and liaison with IATA HQ on documents tracking (new bank accounts, signatories update etc.);
  • Provide banking management support to other departments (Quality, Settlement Operations, Corporate Finance, Agency Participation, Settlement Risk
  • Management, Customer Service and etc.) as well as Local Country Office in Asia Pacific;
  • Support Banking Manager in solving of operational issues related to banking management;
  • Support Banking Manager in the follow up of banking reviews and bank information updates;
  • Support Banking Manager to engage with major multi-national banks and fintech providers to troubleshoot operational issues and deliver project outcomes.

We would love to hear from you if

  • You have a University graduate in any field of Finance, Economics, Business Administration or any related field (the degree should have been achieved within the last 12 months);
  • Attention to details with strong reporting and documentation skills;
  • Strong analytical skills and communication skills;
  • Be an effective team player in a multicultural working environment;
  • Experience in Banking Environment would be an asset;
  • Excellent PC skills, particularity with MS Office Programs (Word, Excel, Power Point Outlook) and SharePoint;
  • Experience in ERP systems (Salesforce, SAP) would be beneficial;Proficient in English.

Important

  • For this internship, only applications from Singapore residents (Citizens and PRs) will be accepted. Applications from foreign students who are currently residing in Singapore and are authorized to perform an internship as part of their university program can also be accepted.
  • This internship is a full-time commitment; the selected candidate must be available on a full-time basis.
  • The selected candidate is required to commit to a minimum 6-month period.
  • More information about IATA’s internships can be found here: https://www.iata.org/en/careers/internships

Travel Required: N

Learn more about IATA’s role in the industry, our benefits, and the team at iata/careers/ . We are looking forward to hearing from you!

job.job_description:
日本＆ミクロネシア地域におけるラグジュアリーブランドのローカライズ、定義、展開、およびパフォーマンス向上を共同で主導します。本役職は、地域の営業、オペレーション、D&E（ダイバーシティ＆インクルージョン）、開発の各チームと緊密に連携し、イニシアチブの「ホテル対応」展開を確保するとともに、ブランドおよびホテルのパフォーマンス向上を推進し、当社の成長戦略を支援します。

消費者のインサイト、競合分析、およびシステムの適応性を活用して意思決定を行い、ゲスト体験の競争力、一貫性、品質を確保するための継続的改善システムを設計・実施します。

日々の業務

グローバルフレームワークに基づき、担当地域に合わせて適宜調整したブランド戦略およびブランド計画のローカライズと実施を管理します。

各ブランドの製品・サービスイノベーションの開発、パイロット実施、およびホテルへの導入を支援し、ブランドの健全性／属性に対する認識を強化するとともに、地域内でのブランド認知度とブランドエクイティを高めます。必要に応じて、グローバルプロジェクトグループと連携して展開を行います。「ホテルレディ」プロセスの採用を確実にします。

コーポレートオフィスおよびホテル従業員向けのブランド導入プログラムの展開を管理する。

New Hotel Opening（新規開業ホテル）のエンドツーエンドでの提供を確実にするため、ホテルブランドの開業前プロセスを遂行する。

ホテルの品質管理チームのメンバーと連携し、ブランド基準およびゲスト体験基準の策定・実施・評価を管理・実行する。これにより、関連するすべての製品・サービスの改善がブランド基準に反映されるよう確保するとともに、ブランド基準が常に最新かつ正確な状態を維持されるようにする。

高品質かつ一貫性のあるホテルブランドマーケティングを支援するための地域向けツールキットおよびリソースの開発を主導し、効果的な導入を確実にする。また、その他のステークホルダーチーム（開発部門、D&Eなど）向けのブランドツールについても同様の支援を行う。

プロジェクト予算、コスト見積もり、請求書を監視・追跡し、地域内で制作されたすべてのブランド資料のファイリングシステムを整備する。

ホテル運営チームおよび地域マーケティングチームが、ホテルにおけるブランドマーケティングのコンプライアンスを達成できるよう支援する。

すべてのブランドにおいて一貫したグローバルブランドコミュニケーションガイドラインを維持するため、サブリージョンのコーポレートオフィスに対するブランドガーディアンおよび窓口としての役割を果たす。

すべてのブランド投資の成果を定量化するための適切な追跡・測定システムが整備されていることを確認し、事業上の優先事項に対して投下資金から最大の成果が得られるよう責任を負う。

ブランド／カテゴリーディレクターと連携し、マーケティング・シェアード・サービス・チームに対してブランドコミュニケーションのニーズや目標を説明し、同チームが関連する地域ブランドキャンペーンを策定・実行できるようにする。

カテゴリー、ブランド、および消費者インサイトチームと連携し、市場、ブランド、およびビジネスチャンスを徹底的に理解するための調査要件を特定・策定する。

担当地域のブランドを強化するため、既存データを分析し、必要に応じて追加調査を実施し、現在および将来の消費者ニーズ、製品・ブランド認知度、価格・価値に対する認識、ならびに消費者および仲介業者の動向に関する知見を最大限に深める。

地域ステークホルダー向けコミュニケーションプログラムの策定および実施を支援する。

応募要項

学歴

マーケティング、コミュニケーション、またはビジネス関連の学位を有することが望ましい

経験

ラグジュアリー・ホスピタリティ業界、またはその他の消費者向けラグジュアリー分野において、5年以上の実務経験（特に大手多国籍企業での経験が望ましい）。マーケティングおよび／またはブランドマネジメントに重点を置いた職務経験があること

アジア地域における多国籍企業での実務経験

必須スキル

プレゼンテーションスキル、人前で話す能力、グループでの意思決定のファシリテーションを含む、優れた口頭および書面によるコミュニケーション能力

自主性があり、自発的に行動できること

優れたプロジェクト管理能力およびステークホルダー管理能力

責任感を持ち、厳しい納期に対応し、マルチタスクをこなせること

社内のステークホルダーに影響を与え、確かな成果を生み出す強固な協力関係を効果的に構築できる能力

代理店との関係を自発的に行動し、自主的に業務を遂行し、効果的な提案と実行ができること

チームワークに長けていること

ブランド基準およびブランドマネジメントについて深い理解があること。

市場調査のプロセスについて確かな理解があること

日本のラグジュアリー業界および日本の消費者に対する経験、情熱、理解があること管理し、費用対効果が高くタイムリーな方法で品質を向上させる能力

ビジネス英語＆日本語（読み書き話す）

Manager, Luxury & Lifestyle Brands, Japan and Micronesia (Tokyo Corporate Office)

Role Purpose

  • Co-lead the localization, definition, delivery and performance of Luxury brands in the assigned region. The role works closely with the regional Commercial, Operations, D&E and Development teams to ensure ‘Hotel Ready’ deployment of initiatives, drive brand and hotel performance and support our growth agenda.
  • Design and implement a system of continuous improvement to ensure competitiveness, consistency and quality of the guest experience, utilizing consumer insights, competitive analysis and system appetite to drive decisions.

Key Accountabilities

  • Manages the localization and implementation of brand strategy and brand plans, based on the Global framework, adapted where appropriate for the assigned Region.
  • Supports development, piloting and hotel implementation of product and service innovations for each brand to strengthen brand health/attribute perception and raise brand awareness and equity within the region. Integrate roll-out with global project groups as appropriate. Ensure ‘Hotel Ready’ process adopted.
  • Manage rollout of brand induction programme for corporate and hotel employees.
  • Delivers the hotel brand pre-opening process to ensure end-to-end delivery for NHOPs
  • Manage and execute implementation and measurement of brand standards and guest experience standards, working with local quality team colleagues to ensure all relevant product and service enhancements are reflected in the brand standards and ensure brand standards are up-to-date and accurate at all times
  • Lead development and ensure effective implementation of regional toolkits and resources to support high quality and consistent hotel brand marketing and brand tools for other stakeholders teams (e.g. Development, D&E etc.).
  • Monitor and track project budgets, cost estimates and invoices and provide a filing system for all brand materials produced in the region
  • Support hotel operations and regional marketing teams in achieving brand marketing compliance in hotels.
  • Serve as brand guardian and contact point for sub regional corporate offices in order to maintain consistent global brand communication guidelines for all brands.
  • Ensures proper tracking and measurement systems are in place to quantify the returns of all brand investments and be accountable for ensuring maximum returns on dollars spent against business priorities.
  • Work with Brand/Category Director on briefing brand communication needs/targets to the Marketing Shared Services team, in order for them to develop and execute relevant regional brand campaigns.
  • Work with Category, Brands & Consumer Insights team to identify and develop research requirements for thorough understanding of the market, the brands and the opportunities.
  • Analyze existing data and field additional research as is required to maximize knowledge of current and future consumer needs, product and brand awareness, price/value perceptions, and consumer and intermediary trends in order to strengthen the brands in the assigned region.
  • Support development and implementation of regional stakeholder communications programme.

Key Skills & Experiences

Education

  • Marketing, Communications or Business degree preferred

Experience

  • Min 5 years in luxury hospitality or other consumer-focused luxury sector, preferably within a large multi-national company, with roles focused on marketing and/or brand management
  • Experience in a multi-national operating environment within Asia

Required Skills

  • Superior oral and written communications skills including presentation skills, public speaking ability, and group decision facilitation
  • Independent, self-starter
  • Strong project management and stakeholder management skills
  • Demonstrates accountability and is able to meet tight deadlines and multi-task
  • Ability to influence internal stakeholders and effectively establish strong working relationships that produce solid results
  • Ability to manage agency relationships to drive quality in a cost-effective and timely manner.
  • Ability to take initiative, work independently and propose and implement effective.
  • Proven team player
  • Strong understanding of brand standards and brand management.
  • Demonstrated understanding of the market research process
  • Display experience, passion and understanding of Luxury industry in Japan and Japanese consumer
  • Business English must and prefer Business Japanese skills

Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

More than 50,000 supply partners leverage GetYourGuide’s easy-to-use platform to grow their businesses, offering 200,000 experiences to travelers around the world.

job.job_description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

The Analytics department's mission is to enable the organisation to take action based on data. We work on a variety of problems and datasets as members of cross-functional mission teams. We take ownership of the entire analytics funnel, from exploration through recommendations to impact measurement and take pride in the insights we generate.

In this analytics role, you will be a key partner to the RevOps and Sales organization, helping leaders and reps make sharper, faster decisions across the full revenue funnel. You will tackle complex and ambiguous questions, helping to quantify pipeline health, forecast performance, and build the business case for go-to-market initiatives. A major part of your role will be to guide the sales planning and execution cycle through rigorous analysis, from territory and quota design to performance tracking and the delivery of recommendations. You will play a crucial part in providing the insights needed to prioritize opportunities, evaluate rep and channel effectiveness, and create a more efficient, data-driven sales motion.

Your mission

  • Develop quantitative analysis to drive sales strategy, forecasting, and pipeline decisions.
  • In collaboration with sales leadership, identify growth opportunities, bottlenecks, and risks across the funnel.
  • Collaborate with Sales, RevOps, and Finance leads to develop a comprehensive understanding of the end-to-end revenue cycle.
  • Design and implement data models, dashboards, and KPIs to guide territory planning, quota setting, and team performance.
  • Contribute to a learning and experimentation culture by promoting hypothesis-driven testing of sales plays, incentives, and processes.
  • Answer the big questions to push our understanding of what drives sales performance and customer conversion.
  • Contribute to the strategic thinking of the team by being a thought partner to Sales and Revenue leadership.

Your toolkit

  • 5+ years of relevant experience interpreting data in an analytics, sales operations, or data science role.
  • Excellent stakeholder management & communication skills, including presenting to senior sales leadership.
  • Strong knowledge of SQL and Python.
  • Strong experience with sales funnel, pipeline, and forecasting analysis, ideally in Salesforce.
  • Strong statistical background and proficiency with advanced methods (e.g. cohort analysis, forecasting models, causal inference, or quasi-experimentation).
  • Ability to understand rep and customer behavior and the meaning behind the numbers, translating them into actionable insights.
  • Practical, solution-oriented mindset with a focus on driving revenue and business impact.
  • Desire to work in an international environment, with minimal direction in ambiguous situations and with highly engaged individuals.

Extras that give you an edge

  • Experience working with CRM systems (e.g. Salesforce) and processing large-scale sales/event data.
  • Familiarity with sales forecasting models or compensation/incentive design is a plus.
  • Experience with data visualization and reporting tools (e.g. Looker, Tableau, Jupyter Notebooks).
  • Experience with revenue attribution and financial modeling.
  • Experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic).

How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary

  • Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
  • Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
  • A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.
  • Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events
  • Monthly transportation and fitness budget
  • Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
  • Language reimbursement program
  • Health and wellness benefits

And more…

How To Apply

Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘how we hire’ and ‘life at GetYourGuide’. If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to get in touch at jobs@getyourguide.com.

We’re an equal opportunities employer

Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with your application.

job.company_description: Hilton (NYSE: HLT) is a leading global hospitality company with a portfolio of 27 world-class brands comprising more than 9,100 properties and over 1.3 million rooms, in 143 countries and territories. Dedicated to fulfilling its founding vision to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality, Hilton has welcomed over 4 billion guests in its more than 100-year history. Named as the No. 1 World’s Best Workplace by Great Place to Work and Fortune, Hilton aims to create the best culture for its 500,000 team members around the world. Hilton has introduced industry-leading technology enhancements to improve the guest experience, including Digital Key Share, automated complimentary room upgrades and the ability to book confirmed connecting rooms. Through the award-winning guest loyalty program Hilton Honors, the nearly 250 million Hilton Honors members who book directly with Hilton can earn Points for hotel stays and experiences money can't buy. With the free Hilton Honors app, guests can book their stay, select their room, check in, unlock their door with a Digital Key and check out, all from their smartphone. Visit stories.hilton.com for more information, and connect with Hilton on Facebook, X, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube.
job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You will manage designated corporate accounts, develop and solicit new business, drive total hotel revenue from rooms, catering, and F&B outlets, address business needs, explore new opportunities, and expand existing business through promotional efforts and sales channels. As a International Sales Manager, you’re not just generating and managing group sales – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

As the International Sales Manager, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:

  • Complete the relevant Hilton University courses promptly and pass the tests.
  • Be familiar with hotel product knowledge and related activities in both local and international markets.
  • Responsible for the promotion and sales of all hotel products to international markets, including but not limited to rooms, catering, banquets, and MICE business.
  • Complete international sales targets and related tasks set by the hotel.
  • Develop international sales plans and obtain approval from the Director of Sales or Commercial Director, maintaining and developing overseas clients and accounts according to the plan.
  • Understand international customer needs through overseas sales trips, virtual meetings, telephone sales, and face-to-face visits, achieving sales.
  • Produce quotations efficiently, send contracts to international clients and follow-up promptly.
  • Show international clients around the hotel.
  • Operate the hotel reservation system to book rooms, banquet venues, and group business for overseas clients.
  • Send the team’s work order promptly and ensure that relevant departments receive accurate information.
  • Establish strong relationships with international customers, maintain updated client databases, and promptly report customer needs and feedback to the hotel.
  • Promote and recommend other hotels within the global Hilton network to international clients.
  • Proactively collect global market and industry information and share it with the Sales team to capture business opportunities and convert them into confirmed business.
  • Understand competitor information in international markets, including key clients, room offerings, catering, conference promotions, and provide timely feedback to the Commercial Director / Director of Sales / Senior Sales Manager.
  • Welcome key international customers, overseas group leaders, and VIPs upon arrival.
  • Motivate and train department employees and ensure strong performance in handling international business.
  • Ensure effective communication between the Sales team and Operations team through regular meetings and assist relevant departments with international events and group business.
  • Handle feedback or complaints from international guests with professionalism and cultural awareness.
  • Maximize international sales opportunities at all times and effectively forecast team and banquet revenue from overseas markets.
  • Provide necessary supervision and guidance to the Sales Director or sales representatives in handling international accounts, quotations, and contracts.
  • Actively participate in the development of global marketing plans and collaborate to achieve budget targets.
  • Conscientiously perform assigned tasks and special projects.
  • Design new hotel products targeting international markets based on demand, set sales targets, and be responsible for related promotion and sales.
  • Organize customer engagement activities such as FAM trips, client events, and networking sessions for international or potential clients, maintaining and strengthening relationships.
  • Regularly analyze international source markets and develop expansion strategies and channels.
  • The department reserves the right to change or supplement the job description if necessary.

Qualifications

What are we looking for?

Skills

A Senior Sales Manager serving Hilton Brands is always working on behalf of our Guests and working with other Team Members. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:

  • Hospitality: Volunteer to provide unparalleled hospitality.
  • Integrity: Do what you should do all the time.
  • Leadership: Strive to be a leader in both your industry and your community.
  • Teamwork: Actively promote teamwork spirit in all work.
  • Ownership: take responsibility for your actions and make decisions.
  • Now: Operate with urgency and discipline.
  • College degree.
  • 3 years or above hotel sales and related experience.
  • Good English and Japanese reading and writing skills to meet business needs.
  • Good communication, organization and presentation skills.
  • Able to work under strong pressure.
  • Understand local customers and have strong market analysis ability.
  • Have certain customer resources.
  • Able to lead by example.

What will it be like to work for Hilton? Hilton is the leading global hospitality company, spanning the lodging sector from luxurious full-service hotels and resorts to extended-stay suites and mid-priced hotels. For nearly a century, Hilton has offered business and leisure travellers the finest in accommodations, service, amenities and value. Hilton is dedicated to continuing its tradition of providing exceptional guest experiences across its global brands. Our vision to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality unites us as a team to create remarkable hospitality experiences around the world every day. And, our amazing Team Members are at the heart of it all!

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

job.job_description:
Job Description

The successful candidate will be part of the Human Resources Division and will drive the design, implementation and governance of Singapore Airlines’ enterprise On-the-Job Training (OJT) framework across Business Units (BUs). He/she will partner stakeholders to identify capability needs and strengthen workforce capability through operationalisation of OJT programmes. He/she will also provide learning analytics and reporting to support workforce planning and continuous improvement initiatives, as well as manage government training grants and funding where applicable.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement and enhance the enterprise OJT governance framework, policies, standards and procedures.
  • Partner BUs to develop OJT programmes and build workplace learning capability by training supervisors, workplace trainers and assessors on OJT methodology. governance requirements and best practices.
