job.job_description:
• Challenge yourself with a senior cross-functional leadership role, at the intersection of data, AI and digital capabilities
  • Lead the personalisation and experimentation capabilities for Qantas Loyalty
  • Permanent role based at our Head Office in Mascot


Qantas Loyalty is an integral part of the Qantas brand, with a vision to be the most valued and trusted Loyalty ecosystem that makes every day more rewarding. With a focus on rewarding loyalty and fostering lasting relationships, our business is dedicated to providing unparalleled value and benefits to our members. From earning points on flights, shopping and everyday purchases to enjoying exclusive perks and privileges, Qantas Loyalty is committed to delivering exceptional service and rewards. With a rich heritage and a forward-thinking approach, we continue to redefine loyalty in the aviation industry, setting the standard for excellence and innovation.


The Head of Personalisation & Experimentation is responsible for defining and leading the enterprise-wide strategy for personalised customer experiences and experimentation across Qantas Loyalty and Qantas Airlines. The role focuses on accelerating the design, deployment, governance and measurement of customer-centric initiatives that strengthen engagement, loyalty and overall business performance.


As a senior business leader, this position partners closely with executive stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Customer, Technology, Data and Analytics to shape and deliver sophisticated, data-enabled capabilities. By combining customer insights, AI, advanced analytics, marketing practices and emerging technologies, the role drives innovative solutions that enhance customer experiences and address complex business challenges.


A key focus of the role is building alignment across diverse stakeholder groups, ensuring initiatives support the broader strategic direction of the Qantas Group while maximising value for customers and the business. The role also leads the development of new processes, experimentation frameworks and digital capabilities that enable continuous improvement and evidence-based decision making.


In addition, the Head of Personalisation & Experimentation is accountable for establishing and leading a high-performing team focused on delivering personalised experiences, strengthening customer loyalty, enhancing brand perception and maintaining competitive advantage. The role promotes innovation, automation and experimentation at scale, fostering an agile culture that enables teams to adapt quickly and respond effectively to evolving customer and market needs.


What You’ll Bring To The Role

  • 10+ years’ experience in Senior Strategic, Commercial and Governance roles.
  • Significant demonstrated experience in a similar, large/listed, complex data led organisation.
  • Developing innovative data strategies that lead to growth in revenues (direct and indirect) with appropriate governance, in a complex consumer focused organisation.
  • Expert in best practices for data commercialisation and data-enabled value optimisation.
  • Involvement in strategy development and implementation.
  • Redesigns business practices to deliver breakthrough results.
  • Identifies emerging customer and commercial digital opportunities.
  • Contributes to strategy beyond own area and to the development of segment strategy.
  • Acts as a functional business partner; contributes to broad business perspective.
  • Builds partnerships and strong stakeholder management.
  • Excellent people management and team development skills.
  • Excellent stakeholder relations and influencing capabilities with experience presenting to and influencing through to CEO and senior executive levels.
  • Customer driven leader with the ability to drive change, challenge the status quo and passion to succeed.


Why Qantas?

At Qantas, your career can take you further than you imagined. You’ll join a team where creativity and passion drive success. Together we dream big and deliver even bigger.


You’ll find diverse opportunities to grow, personally and professionally. From day one, you’ll be supported with hands-on training, coaching, and formal learning programs designed to help you excel. Your development is our priority because we know that when you thrive, so do our customers.


The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.


  • We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave and the option to purchase additional paid leave for eligible employees.
  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.
  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.


Applications close on Sunday the 1st of November


Qantas is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity and inclusion. By coming to work for us, you’ll be part of an organisation that encourages diversity, supports charities and environmental initiatives. We encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, and people of all backgrounds to apply. If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at time of application. Your personal information will be kept confidential in compliance with relevant privacy legislation.

job.job_description:
Social Video Creative & Editor | Tripadvisor

About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

Tripadvisor Group is seeking a Social Video Creative & Editor to join the Tripadvisor Creative team. Reporting to the Creative Director, this person will work primarily with the Creative and Social teams to create and edit social-first content across Tripadvisors channels on platforms including but not limited to TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube. As well as support any additional creative needs as appropriate.

The ideal candidate is comfortable producing short-form videos and other social media posts, capturing original content or leveraging existing content, creator content, stock footage and UGC. They are a social native that understands platform nuances, has a great eye for social trends and is passionate about all things travel. We're looking for a self-starter with excellent judgment and communication skills. This is a fulltime, paid position.

Job Location: Hybrid in London, Boston, or New York.

You Will

  • Operate at the forefront of social creativity with a creator first mindset and a strong instinct for what cuts through on platforms. You live and breathe internet culture, spotting emerging trends and turning them into brand storytelling that feels timely and part of the conversation.
  • Work closely with Tripadvisor Groups Creative and Social teams to develop social media content for TikTok, Instagram and YouTube with potential for Facebook, Pinterest and Reddit.
  • Lead production and execution of a range of social videos and posts, leveraging trends and placing Tripadvisor at the heart of the cultural conversation.
  • Use AI and emerging creative tools to supercharge production, experimenting with new workflows that allow us to ideate, produce and scale high quality video content faster while keeping the craft and originality of the work front and centre.
  • Appear on-camera or voice videos; in partnership with the brand team, hone Tripadvisor’s unique voice on social.
  • Participate in brainstorms, proactively bring new ideas to the table, take direction and feedback from Social and Creative team leads.
  • Manage workback calendars and production needs to meet deadlines with the social media team.
  • Find creative ways to adapt relevant archival Tripadvisor Group footage to support the social media calendar.
  • Assist the Creative team on diverse video editing projects, demonstrating flexibility and readiness to assist across video and photo production tasks as needed.

You Have

  • 4+ years video editing experience, preferably with a focus on native social formats e.g. TikTok, Reels.
  • Experiencing capturing social first videos and photos, specifically short-form video content (30-90 seconds).
  • Experience creating specifically for social media for a brand either at an agency or directly with a brand.
  • Ability to script, storyboard and contribute during creative development.
  • Proficiency in editing and design software such as the Adobe suite, Premiere, After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva and in-app editing tools.
  • Experience using AI creative tools such as Runway, Midjourney, ChatGPT or Adobe Firefly to enhance ideation, editing and rapid content production.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to articulate creative concepts and strategic thinking to cross-functional teams. Ability to work independently and under close direction
  • Consistent attention to detail including project structure and asset organization
  • A genuine love for and excitement about all things social and travel

To Apply

  • Provide any links to your public social media accounts.
  • Attach a resume
  • Attach a portfolio of your previous work

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!

job.job_description:
Bei der TUI Deutschland GmbH bieten wir ab August 2027 eine äußerst interessante und vielseitige Ausbildung Tourismuskaufleute (m/w/d) mit dem Schwerpunkt Reisevermittlung in unserem Reisebüro in Eschborn an.

Die TUI Deutschland GmbH ist der führende Reiseveranstalter auf dem deutschen Markt und eine Tochtergesellschaft der TUI Group. Sie steuert von Hannover aus nicht nur die Entwicklung, sondern auch den Vertrieb und die Vermarktung von TUI-Reisen in Deutschland. Neben der Kernmarke TUI gehören auch Spezialisten wie airtours, ltur und Gebeco zur Unternehmensgruppe. TUI Deutschland verantwortet außerdem die Geschäfte in Österreich und der Schweiz, um das zentraleuropäische Geschäft zu bündeln.

UNSER ANGEBOT

Deine Entwicklung

  • strukturiertes Onboarding
  • Schulungen, Seminare und Workshops
  • Seminarreise und ein mehrwöchiger Auslandseinsatz
  • umfangreiche Unterstützung bei deiner Prüfungsvorbereitung

Deine Vorteile

  • 30 Urlaubstage
  • Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld
  • attraktive Ausbildungsvergütung (1.082 € / 1.193 € / 1.337 € / Monat)
  • Reisevergünstigungen
  • Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket/Jobticket
  • Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft

Deine Perspektiven

  • Netzwerkaufbau
  • internationale Zusammenarbeit
  • Übernahmemöglichkeiten in der gesamten TUI Welt, bei herausragenden Leistungen eine Übernahmegarantie

ZUR POSITION

Du liebst Reisen, bist kommunikativ und möchtest anderen zu unvergesslichen Urlaubserlebnissen verhelfen? Dann starte deine Ausbildung bei TUI! Im Reisebüro bist du die erste Anlaufstelle für unsere Kund*innen und unterstützt sie dabei, genau die Reise zu finden, die zu ihren Wünschen passt. Du berätst zu Reisezielen weltweit, vergleichst Angebote, organisierst individuelle Urlaubserlebnisse und stehst vor, während und nach der Reise als Ansprechpartner*in zur Seite. So wirst du Schritt für Schritt zum Reiseprofi und machst aus Reiseträumen echte Erlebnisse.

Freu Dich Auf

  • Einblicke in die Abläufe eines Reisebüros
  • Planung und Verkauf von Reiseerlebnissen
  • Kleine Teams und Zusammenarbeit mit tollen Kolleg*innen
  • Kennenlernen unserer unterschiedlichen Hotelkonzepte, Marken und Reiseprodukte
  • Übernahme eigener Verantwortung und aktive Mitgestaltung
  • Verständnis dafür, wie aus einer Idee ein unvergessliches Urlaubserlebnis entsteht

Bei uns bekommst du vielfältige Einblicke, übernimmst Verantwortung und entwickelst dich Schritt für Schritt zum Profi der Touristikbranche.

ZU DIR

Du passt zu uns, wenn...

  • du Reiseträume wahr werden lassen möchtest.
  • du gerne mit Menschen arbeitest und Kommunikation zu deinen Stärken zählt. 
  • du offen für Neues bist und Veränderungen eher spannend als anstrengend findest. 
  • du digital unterwegs bist und moderne Tools selbstverständlich nutzt. 
  • du im Team aufblühst und Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest. 
  • du (Fach)Abitur oder einen erweiterten Realschulabschluss mitbringst.

Noten sind wichtig. Noch wichtiger ist uns aber deine Persönlichkeit, deine Motivation und deine Begeisterung für die Touristik.

Lade deine Bewerbung einfach online hoch: 

  • Anschreiben (oder erzähl uns auf kreative Weise, warum du zu uns passt) 
  • Lebenslauf 
  • Deine letzten zwei Schulzeugnisse bzw. dein Abschlusszeugnis 
  • Optional: Praktikumsnachweise, Zertifikate oder weitere Unterlagen, die zeigen, wer du bist 

Bereit für deinen Start bei TUI? ️✈️

  • Bewirb dich online und sende uns deine Unterlagen. 
  • Zeig uns, wer du bist – im Auswahlprozess möchten wir dich und deine Stärken kennenlernen.
  • Lerne uns persönlich kennen – ab November laden wir dich zu unserem Bewerberauswahlverfahren ein.
  • Willkommen an Bord! Wenn alles passt, erhältst du dein Vertragsangebot und startest im August 2027 deine Reise bei TUI. 

Von einem Arbeitsplatz zu einem Ort, an dem man dazugehört. Bei TUI schätzen wir Vielfalt, Gleichberechtigung und Inklusion und ermutigen alle, so zu sein, wie sie sind. „Come as you are“ – das ist unsere Vision, denn nur durch Vielfalt ist unser Potenzial grenzenlos. Wir ermuntern Menschen mit Behinderung, sich zu bewerben.

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction to the Team

Our Technology Team partners with teams across Expedia Group to create innovative products, services, and tools to deliver high-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction.

This Senior Software Development Engineer role is part of the Air Supply team which sits within our Technology division. Air Supply unifies and elevates Expedia Group’s air supply platform across brands and partners, deepening integrations with airline and distribution systems (such as NDC and aggregators) to deliver a trusted, high‑converting, and cost‑efficient air shopping and booking experience. In this role, you will own and evolve complex, mission‑critical air supply services end to end—from technical design and implementation through deployment, monitoring, and ongoing optimization—to improve reliability, scale, and traveler outcomes across our global air marketplace.

In This Role, You Will

  • Design, build, and evolve backend services and customer experiences in Java, including system design (LLD), API design, and data modeling for scalable, secure, and reliable solutions.
  • Implement high‑quality backend code and supporting service components in Java, ensuring maintainability, observability, and operational excellence across multiple services and domains.
  • Collaborate with product, design, and partner engineering teams to translate business and customer requirements into robust backend solutions and reusable service integrations.
  • Own and improve the end‑to‑end lifecycle of backend services and features, including development, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, and incident resolution.
  • Apply data‑driven approaches to prioritize work, validate hypotheses, and continuously optimize service performance, reliability, and user experience across Java-based systems.
  • Safely integrate and operate AI/ML‑enabled solutions that improve outcomes, including familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or Equivalent related professional experience.
  • 8+ years of relevant professional experience building and operating production backend or full‑stack software services in a team environment, with substantial experience in Java.
  • Proven ownership of backend services or components, including responsibility for design, implementation, quality, deployment, and operational health within a product or domain area.
  • Proficiency in core software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, system design (LLD), API design, and data modeling, with hands‑on application in Java-based systems.
  • Hands-on experience with modern web technologies, frameworks, and service architectures on the backend (e.g., microservices, RESTful APIs), and familiarity with using AI-driven tools or workflows to enhance developer productivity or service capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing and evolving multi‑service or multi‑component backend architectures in Java, including well‑structured APIs, data models, and integration patterns across systems.
  • Demonstrated track record driving technical improvements at scale for Java services, such as performance tuning, resilience hardening, or reliability engineering for high‑traffic, latency‑sensitive workloads.
  • Strong focus on operational excellence for backend services, including instrumentation, observability, alerting, and participation in on‑call or incident response to improve long‑term service health.
  • Ability to leverage experimentation, A/B testing, or analytics to make informed technical and product decisions and to validate the impact of delivered backend features and service optimizations.
  • Experience integrating or extending AI/ML‑enabled capabilities into backend services, including responsible use of AI-driven components in Java-based solutions and guiding teams on effective, safe adoption of AI tooling for code quality, testing, and operations.

The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $184,500.00 to $258,000.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $295,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Benefits And Perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life.

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

job.job_description:
Employment Type: Fixed Term Contract

Contract Duration: 1 Year

Why you will love working here

At IATA, we represent over 350 airlines worldwide, striving to make aviation safer, smarter, more sustainable, and inclusive.

  • Our Values are not just words on a page - they are the energy behind everything we do: ONE IATA - We collaborate across teams, TRUSTED - We do the right thing, INNOVATIVE - We make tomorrow better, INCLUSIVE - We embrace diverse perspectives.
  • With over 30,000 courses available, we believe in continuous learning and support your growth in an ever-changing industry.
  • Diversity, equity, and inclusion are our priorities. We are certified by the Equal Salary Foundation, offering equal pay and family-friendly policies.
  • We encourage community involvement through volunteering and strive to make tomorrow better for aviation and our communities. We offer time off so you can support causes important to you.
  • We promote work-life balance with flexible work options, including remote and hybrid work, a generous 'work from abroad' policy, and you get your birthday off!

About The Team You Are Joining

As a member of the SIS Operations Team reporting to the Senior Manager, Industry e-Invoicing, the position is responsible for analyzing, managing and resolving business and technical matters related to IATA’s Simplified Invoicing and Settlement (SIS) application. This includes, but not limited to, providing customer support for SIS participants and internal IATA business units, monitoring the SIS application’s performance, taking appropriate actions to identify and resolve operational issues, perform user-acceptance testing (UAT) testing for the SIS application, and promote the use of SIS with new and existing participants.

What Your Day Would Be Like

Provide high quality L3 support to SIS participants in collaboration with IATA Customer Service teams.

Monitor SIS’ system performance, update reference data master tables, perform scheduled system reconciliation and monitoring (SRM) activities and take corrective actions as per documented SOP’s and best practices.

Coordinate with internal and external teams to resolve operational issues.

Raise and manage incidents with application vendor when required.

Maintain compliance with all operational controls and SOP’s.

Perform comprehensive user-acceptance testing (UAT) for the SIS application’s new enhancements and bug fixes as per scheduled major and maintenance releases.

Contact SIS participants by email or phone for special cases which may include data quality issues, input file failures, late submission requests, promote the use to SIS, and any other appropriate matters.

Prepare accurate and detailed SIS operational reports on a weekly, monthly, and annual basis.

Create, distribute, and publish SIS-related communications through internal and external channels.

We would love to hear from you if

Bachelor's degree in IT or business-related discipline.

Strong skills in Microsoft Office applications; must be highly proficient in Excel.

Technically oriented with the ability to work independently, under pressure to strict deadlines.

Highly numerate and detail oriented with excellent organizational and administrative abilities.

Good written and oral communication skills in English with a strong commitment to customer service.

Able to adopt a creative and flexible approach; must be detail-oriented and a fast learner.

  • Good to have knowledge of or experience with:
  • IATA’s SIS or similar e-invoicing application.
  • IATA’s various divisions, systems, and business processes.
  • Industry interline or supplier billing rules and standards.
  • System user-acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Power BI.
  • XML standards.
  • Salesforce / CRM application.
  • SAP
  • Any other languages in addition to English.

Travel Required: N

Learn more about IATA’s role in the industry, our benefits, and the team at iata/careers/ . We are looking forward to hearing from you!

job.job_description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

The Business Operations & Strategy team at GetYourGuide is the engine behind our commercial growth — turning strategic ambition into operational reality. We work across the full supplier acquisition lifecycle, combining data-driven insight, process excellence, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure GetYourGuide offers the world’s most compelling inventory of travel experiences. From scaling our fastest-growing acquisition channels to optimising vendor partnerships, we move fast, think big, and hold ourselves accountable to measurable impact.

Within Business Operations & Strategy, the Inside Sales mission team is responsible for the strategy and economics of our outsourced Inside Sales channel — our highest-velocity route to acquiring new suppliers and activities. As Senior Revenue Manager, you will own the strategic direction, financial performance, and scalability of this channel: building the forecasting and unit-economics framework that governs it, designing the systems and processes that drive its growth, and ensuring our vendor partnership operates as one well-governed lever within a much larger machine.

Your mission

You will define the strategy and economics behind GetYourGuide's fastest-growing supplier acquisition channel — building the models, forecasts, and processes that let us scale it predictably and profitably. You will work closely with Commercial, Data, and Finance to turn channel performance into clear strategic decisions.

  • Own the channel's financial and operating model — building forecasts, tracking unit economics (cost per acquisition, ROI, lifetime value), and using them to guide investment and resourcing decisions
  • Identify and act on opportunities to improve channel efficiency through data analysis, tooling, and automation — including the application of AI tools where relevant
  • Translate complex operational and commercial questions into clear, actionable plans, and communicate progress and priorities to senior stakeholders
  • Set the channel's targets and KPIs, and build the analytical frameworks (funnel conversion, cohort performance, benchmarking) needed to track and improve them
  • Act as the analytical backbone connecting Commercial, Data, and Product — translating channel performance into clear recommendations and trade-offs for senior stakeholders

Your toolkit

  • 5+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Strategy, or Analytics in a fast-paced environment — ideally in a marketplace, SaaS, or platform company
  • Data-driven and analytically rigorous — you build forecasts, unit-economics models, and business cases using tools like Excel, SQL, or Looker (or similar), and use them to guide investment decisions
  • Strategic thinker who can break down complex problems into clear, actionable plans and bring others along with a compelling narrative
  • Strong operational acumen with a test-and-learn mindset — you iterate based on data and hold yourself accountable to outcomes
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Demonstrated ability to apply AI tools to improve the quality and efficiency of your work, with concrete examples of impact

Extras that give you an edge

  • Experience working alongside an inside sales or outbound sales function
  • Familiarity with the travel, experiences, or marketplace industry
  • Exposure to BPO or outsourced operations models

How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary

  • Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
  • Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
  • A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.
  • Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events
  • Monthly transportation and fitness budget
  • Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
  • Language reimbursement program
  • Health and wellness benefits

And more…

How To Apply

Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘how we hire’ and ‘life at GetYourGuide’. If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to get in touch at jobs@getyourguide.com.

We’re an equal opportunities employer

Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with your application.

job.job_description:
Job Description

Welcome to Andamanda Voyage Phuket, Curio Collection by Hilton

Andamanda Voyage Phuket, Curio Collection by Hilton is a 246 key upper upscale resort located within the Andamanda Waterpark complex in Kathu District Phuket, which is a major leisure destination for both domestic and international travelers. The property features an all day dining restaurant, a lobby lounge, an outdoor pool with pool bar and a kids corner.

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You are responsible for developing a commercial strategy covering all segments and channels to maximize total revenue and profit performance, as well as market share penetration of the hotel. As a Commercial Director, you’re not just leading commercial strategy across multiple segments and revenue streams – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Own commercial strategy and execution: Develop and implement integrated commercial strategies across all revenue streams — including Group, Conference, and Events (GCE), Rooms, Food and Beverage, Leisure, and Spa — to drive top-line performance and market share growth
  • Maximize revenue and profitability: Partner with General Managers and Finance to ensure commercial decisions support revenue goals, optimize cost of sales, and deliver profit and margin targets
  • Lead pricing and forecasting strategy: Oversee revenue management practices, including pricing, rate strategies, demand forecasting, and business reviews, to optimize revenue across all segments
  • Align sales and marketing efforts: Coordinate on-property and regional sales, marketing, eCommerce, and public relations activities to support brand positioning and drive demand
  • Adapt to market dynamics: Monitor trends, assess competitive landscape, and adjust commercial strategies to stay ahead in evolving market conditions
  • Strengthen stakeholder relationships: Build trusted relationships with owners, operators, Hilton corporate teams, and external partners to align goals and create long-term commercial value
  • Cultivate a high-performing team: Drive engagement and retention through performance management, professional development, and recognition programs

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • Minimum 8+ years in a revenue-generating or commercial role within hospitality or travel.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience leading and managing sales or commercial teams.
  • Proven experience presenting strategic plans to senior executives and stakeholder groups.
  • Strong background in cross-functional collaboration within matrixed environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze financial data to inform strategic and tactical decisions.
  • Track record of identifying and evaluating new business opportunities.
  • Experience in multi-complex hotel or travel industry operations.
  • Cross-disciplinary exposure to Marketing, E-commerce, and Finance functions.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

The successful candidate will be part of the Revenue Accounting Projects department in the Finance division.

Key Responsibilities

Key change agent for Revenue Accounting for all commercial, servicing and industry (IATA) projects/initiatives or enhancements.

Review and evaluate commercial, servicing and IATA initiatives comprehensively

Identify the revenue accounting system changes required to support the commercial project.

Social Video Creative & Editor | Tripadvisor

About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

Tripadvisor Group is seeking a Social Video Creative & Editor to join the Tripadvisor Creative team. Reporting to the Creative Director, this person will work primarily with the Creative and Social teams to create and edit social-first content across Tripadvisors channels on platforms including but not limited to TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube. As well as support any additional creative needs as appropriate.

The ideal candidate is comfortable producing short-form videos and other social media posts, capturing original content or leveraging existing content, creator content, stock footage and UGC. They are a social native that understands platform nuances, has a great eye for social trends and is passionate about all things travel. We're looking for a self-starter with excellent judgment and communication skills. This is a fulltime, paid position.

Job Location: Hybrid in Boston, or New York.

You Will

  • Operate at the forefront of social creativity with a creator first mindset and a strong instinct for what cuts through on platforms. You live and breathe internet culture, spotting emerging trends and turning them into brand storytelling that feels timely and part of the conversation.
  • Work closely with Tripadvisor Groups Creative and Social teams to develop social media content for TikTok, Instagram and YouTube with potential for Facebook, Pinterest and Reddit.
  • Lead production and execution of a range of social videos and posts, leveraging trends and placing Tripadvisor at the heart of the cultural conversation.
  • Use AI and emerging creative tools to supercharge production, experimenting with new workflows that allow us to ideate, produce and scale high quality video content faster while keeping the craft and originality of the work front and centre.
  • Appear on-camera or voice videos; in partnership with the brand team, hone Tripadvisor’s unique voice on social.
  • Participate in brainstorms, proactively bring new ideas to the table, take direction and feedback from Social and Creative team leads.
  • Manage workback calendars and production needs to meet deadlines with the social media team.
  • Find creative ways to adapt relevant archival Tripadvisor Group footage to support the social media calendar.
  • Assist the Creative team on diverse video editing projects, demonstrating flexibility and readiness to assist across video and photo production tasks as needed.

You Have

  • 4+ years video editing experience, preferably with a focus on native social formats e.g. TikTok, Reels.
  • Experiencing capturing social first videos and photos, specifically short-form video content (30-90 seconds).
  • Experience creating specifically for social media for a brand either at an agency or directly with a brand.
  • Ability to script, storyboard and contribute during creative development.
  • Proficiency in editing and design software such as the Adobe suite, Premiere, After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva and in-app editing tools.
  • Experience using AI creative tools such as Runway, Midjourney, ChatGPT or Adobe Firefly to enhance ideation, editing and rapid content production.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to articulate creative concepts and strategic thinking to cross-functional teams. Ability to work independently and under close direction
  • Consistent attention to detail including project structure and asset organization
  • A genuine love for and excitement about all things social and travel

To Apply

  • Provide any links to your public social media accounts.
  • Attach a resume
  • Attach a portfolio of your previous work

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

The salary range for this role in the U.S. is $80,000 - $100,000. This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. An employee’s pay position within the wage range will be based on several factors including, but limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs. This compensation range may also be modified in the future.

Agoda is a travel booking platform and accommodation is at our core. As our accommodation partners are a key to our success, we work hard to ensure their success.   • Deliver on country KPIs, growth targets and country strategic initiatives
  • Support the Area Manager in preparing country reporting for senior stakeholders

  • Minimum 3 – 5 years of experience in business development and/or account management
  • Strong interpersonal skills & ability to influence both external / internal stakeholders
  • Experience in internet/e-commerce preferred
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Team player with a professional “get it done” attitude and work ethic
  • Proven success in acquiring, building & maintaining long term customer relationships
  • Adapts well to change and able to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to create new, innovative ideas

  • MBA or Master’s degree

Employment Type: Permanent

Contract Duration

Hiring Base Salary Range:

Why you will love working here

At IATA, we represent over 350 airlines worldwide, striving to make aviation safer, smarter, more sustainable, and inclusive.

  • Our Values are not just words on a page - they are the energy behind everything we do: ONE IATA - We collaborate across teams, TRUSTED - We do the right thing, INNOVATIVE - We make tomorrow better, INCLUSIVE - We embrace diverse perspectives.
  • With over 30,000 courses available, we believe in continuous learning and support your growth in an ever-changing industry.
  • Diversity, equity, and inclusion are our priorities. We are certified by the Equal Salary Foundation, offering equal pay and family-friendly policies.
  • We encourage community involvement through volunteering and strive to make tomorrow better for aviation and our communities. We offer time off so you can support causes important to you.
  • We promote work-life balance with flexible work options, including remote and hybrid work, a generous 'work from abroad' policy, and you get your birthday off!

About The Team You Are Joining

The Industry Conferences and Standards department leads the development, governance, and adoption of global airline industry standards. Within this structure, the Passenger Standards Conference (PSC) brings together airlines, industry partners, and subject matter experts to define and maintain standards that support passenger retailing, servicing, operations, and interoperability across the air transport ecosystem.

As PSC continues its transformation journey, IATA is strengthening its leadership capabilities to drive greater industry engagement, improve governance, accelerate standards delivery, and ensure standards provide measurable value to the industry. The Head Passenger Standards reports to the Director, Industry Conferences and Standards and is responsible for leading the PSC standards portfolio and associated governance activities.

What Your Day Would Be Like

  • Lead the strategic direction and execution of the Passenger Standards Conference (PSC) work programme.
  • Partner with airline leaders, Board Chairs, Working Groups, and industry stakeholders to identify, prioritize, and deliver standards initiatives.
  • Drive standards lifecycle management, ensuring standards remain relevant, adopted, and aligned with industry needs.
  • Monitor industry trends and emerging business requirements, translating them into standards development opportunities.
  • Strengthen member engagement and participation across the PSC ecosystem.
  • Oversee governance processes and ensure effective collaboration between Boards, Working Groups, Secretariats, and subject matter experts.
  • Promote transparency, accountability, and execution discipline across the standards portfolio.
  • Support the delivery of key industry transformation initiatives, including modern airline retailing and servicing capabilities.
  • Represent IATA and PSC in industry forums, conferences, and strategic stakeholder engagements.
  • Lead continuous improvement efforts to enhance the effectiveness, adoption, and value of passenger standards.
  • Act as Working Group or Board Secretary as required.

We would love to hear from you if

You are an experienced people leader with a track record of building, developing, and motivating high-performing teams. You bring deep aviation industry knowledge and a passion for driving industry change through standards, collaboration, and innovation. You have successfully led complex programmes, engaged senior stakeholders, and translated industry needs into tangible outcomes. You thrive in global, member-driven environments and are comfortable balancing strategic vision, people leadership, governance, stakeholder management, and execution excellence

Travel Required: Y: 5%

Learn more about IATA’s role in the industry, our benefits, and the team at iata/careers/ . We are looking forward to hearing from you!

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You will lead the sales team and ensure that the hotel’s revenue targets are met. This role involves developing and implementing sales strategies, building relationships with key clients, and overseeing the daily operations of the sales department. As a Director of Sales, you’re not just driving revenue growth across all hotel segments – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Shape and execute sales strategy: Develop and implement revenue-driving sales strategies across group, business transient, leisure transient, and catering segments, aligned with the hotel’s commercial goals and strategic plan
  • Drive revenue performance and profitability: Contribute to achieving revenue targets and profitability goals by optimizing pricing, improving business mix, and guiding forecasting accuracy
  • Lead business reviews and planning: Facilitate regular strategy and performance meetings while contributing to long-range commercial planning through analysis of performance trends, market shifts, and revenue opportunities

job.job_description:
Paid Media Manager, International | Tripadvisor

About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

We are looking for a strategic and highly analytical Paid Media Manager, reporting to our Director, Paid & Owned Media, to lead our advertising efforts across the UK and Europe. Based in London, you will be the driving force behind our ad buying strategy for both Tripadvisor and Viator. Because we believe Execution is Our Edge, we need a leader who can move fast, experiment, and scale winning campaigns. You will manage agency relationships, execute high-level media plans, and leverage AI and automation to ensure our media buying is as efficient and impactful as possible. Above all, you will use behavioral insights to ensure our advertising puts the Traveler First.

Job Location: London Hybrid

This role is a hybrid position that requires 1-2 days per week in our London office.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop, execute, and own the comprehensive paid media strategy for the UK and European markets, utilizing behavioral data to build campaigns that resonate with and prioritize traveler needs.
  • Manage day-to-day relationships with external media buying agencies, setting clear expectations, and driving a We Succeed Together culture rooted in shared accountability and collaborative success.
  • Champion production efficiency by integrating AI tools, automated bidding strategies, and machine-learning solutions into media planning, creative testing, and campaign optimization workflows.
  • Allocate and manage regional media budgets, constantly experimenting, learning from failures, and iterating to maximize ROI and efficient customer acquisition.
  • Lead campaign execution from ideation through launch, acting with agility and taking total ownership of media performance across channels (Social, Programmatic, Video, App, etc.).
  • Act as the internal subject matter expert on the UK and European media landscapes, advising cross-functional teams on regional nuances while keeping execution scalable and data-driven.

Skills & Experience

  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to improve efficiency, quality, and decision-making in day-to-day work.
  • Proven ability to operate effectively with a global-first mindset
  • 7+ years of experience in paid media, digital advertising, or media planning/buying (agency or client-side experience welcome).
  • Deep, nuanced understanding of the UK and European digital marketing ecosystems and regional consumer behaviors.
  • Proven experience successfully managing external marketing or media buying agencies with a focus on shared goals.
  • Strong background in managing complex, high-budget campaigns with a track record of agile execution and meeting or exceeding performance targets (e.g., iROAS, LTV, etc.).
  • Expert-level knowledge of major digital ad platforms (Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok, programmatic DSPs, etc.) and a proactive approach to adopting new AI marketing technologies.
  • Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to translate behavioral data sets into clear, actionable strategic improvements.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in traditional/offline media buying (OOH, TV, Radio, Print) within the European market.
  • Previous experience in the travel, hospitality, or global marketplace sectors.
  • Familiarity with advanced marketing attribution models and media mix modeling (MMM).

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

The North Asia Regional Management Office partners closely with Agoda’s regional leadership to deliver actionable insights, align cross-functional objectives, and drive high-impact strategic initiatives. Our mandate is to translate top-level priorities into operational excellence, transforming early-stage concepts into scalable business opportunities that accelerate local and regional growth. 

Why Join Us? 

This is a unique opportunity to drive strategic impact at scale, working at the intersection of analytics, strategy, and operations in one of the most dynamic regions for Agoda. If you are passionate about solving complex business problems and thrive in a collaborative, high-performance environment, we invite you to join our team and shape the future of travel in North Asia. 

The Opportunity:

As Regional Manager, RMO, North Asia, you will play a pivotal role in shaping Agoda’s strategic direction across the region. You will lead mission-critical projects, working alongside senior leaders in product, supply, marketing, and finance to deliver on our most important business objectives. Your expertise in market and data analysis will inform executive decision-making and unlock new avenues for growth. 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Planning: Design and implement long-term strategies that drive sustainable business growth and competitive advantage. 
  • Performance Management: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the impact of strategic initiatives and ensure accountability. 
  • Program Execution: Lead the end-to-end delivery of strategic programs, ensuring alignment with business goals, timely execution, and continuous improvement. 
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, facilitating clear communication and cross-functional collaboration to advance shared objectives. 
  • Market & Competitive Analysis: Conduct rigorous market research and competitor benchmarking to identify emerging trends and inform strategic priorities. 
  • Data-Driven Insights: Leverage advanced analytics to evaluate business performance and guide data-driven decision-making. 

What We’re Looking For:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, or a related field; MBA or equivalent advanced degree strongly preferred.
  • Experience: Experience in strategy, management consulting, or a related discipline, with a proven record of leading complex, high-impact initiatives.
  • Analytical Acumen: Exceptional quantitative and analytical skills, with the ability to distill complex data into actionable insights.
  • Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive projects to successful outcomes in a fast-paced environment.
  • Communication: Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence and engage senior stakeholders.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong strategic and creative problem-solving capabilities, with a track record of addressing complex business challenges.
  • Project Management: Advanced project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results under tight deadlines.
  • Stakeholder Management: Experience building and maintaining relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.
  • Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in data analysis tools (e.g., Excel, SQL, Tableau) and financial modeling.

  • With over 30,000 courses available, we believe in continuous learning and support your growth in an ever-changing industry.
  • Diversity, equity, and inclusion are our priorities. We are certified by the Equal Salary Foundation, offering equal pay and family-friendly policies.
  • We encourage community involvement through volunteering and strive to make tomorrow better for aviation and our communities. We offer time off so you can support causes important to you.
  • We promote work-life balance with flexible work options, including remote and hybrid work, a generous 'work from abroad' policy, and you get your birthday off!

About The Team You Are Joining

IATA’s Operational Compliance Solutions (OCS) and regulations in Cargo and Safety, are the primary source of information for air transport standards, helping to inform and deliver safety, flight & technical operations and dangerous goods transportation standards, best practices and guidance material, whilst seeking to improve operational performance and reduce risks.

The Product Manager Safety & Dangerous Goods Operations will report to the Assistant Director – DGR Solutions. The successful applicant will be part of a strategic product portfolio that is fundamental to the Safety, Flight/Technical and Cargo Compliance operations in aviation covering delivery of commercially licensed content and digital solutions in Safety and Audit programs, Flight Crew Training, Maintenance, Fuel Efficiency and Dangerous Goods operations.

The Product Manager, Safety & Dangerous Goods Operations is responsible for driving revenue growth, optimizing costs, managing existing products, and leading the development of new digital solution. A key focus will be accelerating adoption of IATA’s digital software platform among large enterprise customers, supporting industry-wide digital transformation, and delivering data-driven insights through business intelligence and competitive analysis. The position will also help shape customer engagement strategies and identify opportunities to enhance and expand the product portfolio.

What Your Day Would Be Like

  • Portfolio product management including Lifecycle Management, new product development and ideation, launch and end of life activities, pricing, budgeting, forecasting and administration of the portfolio.
  • Applying your subject matter knowledge and experience, develop and execute strategic business plans and develop new products for the Safety and Dangerous Goods portfolio.
  • Cultivate strong relationships with clients, understanding their unique needs and goals.
  • Manage and achieve/exceed the Revenue and Profit targets of the portfolio.
  • Define and execute the overall marketing and sales strategies in collaboration with the Sales and - Marketing groups to drive portfolio growth and new customer acquisition.
  • Project Manage the commercial renewals and assigned Product enhancement feature development to a timely delivery, ensuring revenue bookings are kept in line with forecast.
  • Work with cross-divisional Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to ensure delivery of planned content, as well as development of potential new products and associated commercial marketing collateral (webinars, white papers).
  • Manage competitive and market intelligence studies as required to support objectives.
  • Customers/prospects engagement – analyze prospects, creating a list of key accounts with products from the entire portfolio using data, to create synergies and identify revenue and new product opportunities across the portfolio.

We would love to hear from you if

  • Passionate about the aviation industry with a keen airline operational knowledge and a strong interest in digital transformation.
  • Ideally have direct aviation industry experience and a proven track record in civil aviation operational roles
  • Knowledge of safety, audit, flight and technical operations of airlines and new technology related matters considered ideal.
  • Ability to speak to operational and technical aviation concepts and technologies
  • Strong commercial marketing or direct sales experience within the operational aviation environment
  • Project and product management knowledge essential
  • Familiar with data visualization and analysis tools. Proficient in using MS excel and PowerPoint.Knowledge of Salesforce, SAP and basic API considered a plus.
  • Capable of presenting data in a visual manner.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Detail-orientated.
  • Team player and can work under pressure.
  • Being open and also willing to collaborate and learn from others
  • Availability for travel

Travel Required: 5%

Learn more about IATA’s role in the industry, our benefits, and the team at iata/careers/ . We are looking forward to hearing from you!

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You will manage designated corporate accounts, develop and solicit new business, drive total hotel revenue from rooms, catering, and F&B outlets, address business needs, explore new opportunities, and expand existing business through promotional efforts and sales channels. As a Sales Manager, you’re not just generating and managing group sales – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Represent the hotel to prospective clients: Serve as the primary point of contact for customers seeking group rooms, meeting space, and food and beverage services
  • Drive new business opportunities: Respond to inquiries, initiate outreach, qualify leads, and solicit potential clients through proactive sales efforts
  • Manage the full sales cycle: Conduct site visits, entertain clients, prepare proposals, determine rates, negotiate contracts, and service accounts through fulfillment
  • Develop strategic sales plans: Create and execute strategies to achieve or exceed revenue and room night goals, adjusting based on performance and market conditions
  • Analyze sales performance: Evaluate lost business reports and identify opportunities to strengthen conversion and competitiveness
  • Support exceptional service delivery: Collaborate across departments to coordinate the fulfillment of contracted services and uphold the highest standards of client satisfaction
  • Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • Diploma or degree in Hospitality, Business, or related field
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in hotel Corporate, MICE, or Group room sales
  • Proven track record in driving revenue and managing key accounts
  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills
  • Technical proficiency in hotel systems (e.g., Delphi, Salesforce, OnQ, Market Planner Survey)
  • Ability to analyze sales data and market trends to inform strategy
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills with a collaborative mindset

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

About The Team

How We’ll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40 USD/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program

Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future

Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones

Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care

Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Health & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family covered

  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

job.job_description:
Job Description

The successful candidate will be part of Finance Division, Financial Planning & Control Department. He/She will be responsible for ensuring proper budgeting, correct accounting, timely processing, analysis and reporting of expenses/recoveries, as well as budgeting, forecasts and cost savings initiatives for Head Office Divisions (Fixed Cost) and Variable cost items under his/her responsibility.

Key Responsibilities

Operating expenditure accounting for Divisions under his/her charge:

  • Review and ensure that accruals/J ournal Vouchers (JVs) put through for accuracy and completeness. Check for omissions/errors in invoices raised/JVs put through.
  • Accounts Receivable and Account Payable invoice approvals. Review and ensure correct accounting allocation by Divisions.
  • Monitor and review monthly accounts variance analysis. Review and monitor Divisions’ expenditure against budget and forecast. Work with users on explanations for budget overruns and supplementary budgets. Ensure that users comply with Finance Manual procedures on budgetary control.
  • Discuss and liaise with Divisions on accounting treatment for their business process/initiatives.
  • Compile and analyse material monthly expense variances. Submission of monthly, quarterly and yearly reports to Corporate Accounts & Projects department as per reporting timelines.
  • Monitor and clear suspense accounts to ensure that balances are within timelines set. Work with users on explanations for balances exceeding stipulated timelines.

Annual operating budget/Long term projection exercise

  • Assist with preparation work for roll out of budget/long term projection exercise.
  • Assist/Support Divisions on queries regarding budget/projection. Work with Divisions to identify and achieve cost savings/efficiencies.
  • Assist with preparation of budget paper as per timeline.

Monthly rolling forecast exercises

  • Assist with user queries and carrying out of preparation work for roll out of forecast exercises.
  • Analysis of significant variances for forecast figures for preparation of forecast materials.

Understand the business processes of the different divisions and how it relates to the accounting treatment of their expenses. Work closely with the various divisions to have a better understanding of their operations and be able to provide value-added advice whenever necessary.

Work with internal and external auditors during their audits of the section’s processes and controls. Follow up on recommendations given.

Handle ad-hoc projects, such as implementation or enhancements of IT systems, to improve processes. Department’s representative for ad-hoc projects/exercises or administrative matters.

Provide guidance to staff on work procedures relating to the use of systems and resolution of work-related problems. Monitor and assess staff performance.

Requirements

  • University Bachelor's Degree in Accountancy or an equivalent professional qualification recognised by ACCA.
  • Good attention to details.
  • Good numerical and analytical skills.
  • Effective time management skills.
  • Effective communications skills.

The end date of this position is in December 2027.

We thank all candidates for your interest in Singapore Airlines, and regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.
