job.job_description:
CX Project Manager | Tripadvisor

About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

Job Location: Hybrid

This role is a hybrid position that requires 2 days per week in our London or Oxford office.

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for an experienced and forward-thinking AI Project Manager to lead the design, deployment, and optimisation of AI-powered projects within our Customer Service Operations. This role sits at the intersection of technology and customer experience driving value for our Travelers across our global experiences catalog.

As part of the Service Excellence team you will work closely with our AI Automation Lead working cross-functionally with our R&D, Technology, Service-Operations, Data and Supply teams to ensure AI implementation projects are delivered on time, driving measurable value to our Travelers.

Key Responsibilities

AI Strategy & Project Delivery

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of AI and automation projects within the customer service function, from discovery and scoping through to deployment and review.
  • Develop and maintain a roadmap of AI initiatives aligned with customer service OKRs and business priorities.
  • Manage project timelines, budgets, risks, and stakeholder communications across multiple concurrent workstreams.
  • Coordinate with external vendors and internal engineering teams to ensure seamless integration of AI solutions with existing CRM, telephony, and other platforms.

Operations & Performance

  • Monitor AI system performance (e.g. chatbot containment rates, CSAT, deflection metrics) and drive continuous improvement cycles.
  • Partner with Quality Assurance and workforce planning teams to assess the impact of AI on agent workload, skill requirements, and scheduling.
  • Identify manual or repetitive processes within customer service operations that are suitable for intelligent automation.
  • Ensure AI tools comply with data protection regulations (e.g. UK GDPR) and internal governance frameworks.

Stakeholder Engagement & Change Management

  • Act as the primary point of contact between the customer service leadership team and AI/tech delivery functions.
  • Lead change management and communication efforts to ensure frontline agents and team leaders understand, trust, and effectively use AI tools.
  • Facilitate workshops, training sessions, and feedback loops to capture agent insights and refine AI behaviour.
  • Present project updates, performance data, and business cases to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.

Governance & Ethics

  • Champion responsible AI practices, ensuring fairness, transparency, and customer trust are embedded into all solutions.
  • Maintain clear documentation of AI model inputs, outputs, decision logic, and escalation pathways.
  • Work with Legal, Compliance, and Data teams to conduct impact assessments and ensure ongoing regulatory compliance.

Essential

Required Experience & Skills

  • 3+ years of project management experience, ideally within customer service, contact centre, or CX environments.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering AI, automation, or digital transformation projects (e.g. conversational AI, RPA, NLP, knowledge management tools).
  • Strong understanding of customer service operations, including contact centre metrics, workflows, and team structures.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.
  • Proficiency with project management methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid approaches).
  • Analytical mindset with experience using data to track performance and make evidence-based decisions.
  • Familiarity with data privacy obligations relevant to AI, including UK GDPR.

Desirable

  • Experience with AI/CX platforms such as Salesforce Einstein, Zendesk AI, Google CCAI, Genesys, or similar.
  • Awareness of large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and generative AI use cases in a service context.
  • Project management certification (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2, APM, or SAFe).
  • Background in change management, employee engagement, or learning & development.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team: 

In the age of technology, things are constantly changing. The travel market is much the same, being more dynamic and complex than ever. Agoda’s Legal team is well suited to take on the challenges presented, adopting a proactive mindset to tackle challenges and solve problems. We are quick on our feet, decisive, and collaborate with multiple departments. We hire out-of-the-box thinkers that are well grounded with ethics and legal knowledge to ensure that Agoda achieves the right results, the right way. 

The Opportunity:

This is an exciting opportunity to lead, develop and grow a role within the Commercial and Corporate Team. Seeking a senior, seasoned, able, confident, curious and self-motivated lawyer (to be based in Bangkok) to join the Agoda Commercial and Corporate Legal team who will work closely with other stakeholders in the Booking Holdings group and particularly with colleagues across the Group brands.

This is an important role, reporting to the VP of Commercial and Corporate, leading and owning the relations with the Supply team that manages 100% of Agoda’s property relationships. There is a high focus on supply contracts, B2B relationships, all matters relating to hotel/property relationships, general commercial matters and Supply Team operational improvements. You will have an opportunity to be the sole POC for what is one of Agoda’s most dynamic and important teams – right at the heartbeat of the Agoda model.

  • This role is based in Bangkok, with relocation and work visa provided for those who aren't yet based in-market
  • No full-remote options

In this Role, you'll get to: 

  • Be the key decision maker for certain legal decisions in conjunction with business stakeholders and escalates other key decisions. You will ensure collaborative engagement with teams across the Agoda Legal Team and manage escalations to senior management (including GC and CEO).
  • Draft and negotiate international, commercial agreements with a focus on strategic partnerships, B2B, supply distribution, new initiatives, marketing, and public relations.
  • Own and lead the legal support with a critical business partner that covers 100% of all supply relationships for Agoda. With a small team you will help develop junior team members coaching and mentoring.
  • Actively engage with Agoda senior management at a C-suite level.
  • Provide well-reasoned, practical legal advice on a wide-range of legal and business matters and processes. You will be the “go to person” for the Supply team and will dovetail your priorities with their priorities and strategy.
  • Be fully autonomous for management of the legal Supply team together with the creation and delivery of departmental and team objectives.
  • For Supply stakeholders – lead the provision of advice, strategic direction and commercial solutions relating to litigation and disputes. Managing these with smart, innovative and P&L focused solutions. Draft key agreements with hotel partners, manage disputes and drive continual improvement and innovation.
  • As a true business partner, to maintain regular communication with key business teams, including senior level management, global legal team, finance and tax, and external counsel.
  • Drive and implement contract standards and controls, including that which happens at the holding company and/or sister-brand level.
  • Be the lead contact to drive new policies, procedures, training, and templates with the goal of fostering efficiency and compliance – with a lens on efficiency and innovation.
  • Influence senior stakeholders on innovative implementation of key legislation across broad legal areas specific to Supply.
  • Support the VP of Commercial and Corporate in ideation and implementation of pan team strategies, initiatives and innovation. You will work across the Agoda legal team driving collaboration, efficiencies and a deep level of cross team engagement.

What you'll Need to Succeed:

  • 12+ years post qualified experience with a high level of impact.
  • Demonstrable ability to work autonomously with proven management and leadership experience of small-medium sized teams. High level of commercial awareness and business acumen.
  • Autonomous ability to manage and lead a multitude of complex and strategic legal matters and demonstrates a broad vision for the function. Ability to create, drive and own a strategy for the Supply legal team ensuring that vision and strategy is aligned with the annual business goals.
  • 1st class communication (verbal and written) and organization skills with high level of English proficiency. Exceptional legal drafting skills.
  • Experience in negotiating and influencing high complexity and risk matters externally (including government authorities).
  • Have the ability to provide commercial, innovative legal solutions to a fast paced and challenging business partner. A passion to drive efficiencies and process improvement – including the use of Gen AI.
  • Qualified lawyer/attorney with current entitlement to practice. Strong academic credentials, top-tier law firm experience plus prior in-house and significant contracting and commercial experience.
  • History of providing simple, concise & pragmatic advice for legal matters with high complexity and risk or strategic importance, always ensuring communications cut through complexities, are simple, avoid jargon and appropriate for the target audience. Making the complex simple with a wide range of stakeholders.
  • Deep experience in dealing with general commercial contracting matters, B2B relationships, procurement and disputes – ideally within the travel or B2B space. This role will be the sole contact for all supply related matters (including disputes) for the Agoda One Supply division.
  • Proactively anticipating issues that are yet to come for the business supported areas with holistic awareness across the organization. Create innovative solutions that take account of risk appetite and business goals.
  • Interact with colleagues, both legal and commercial, from the Supply/Key Accounts teams as well as Product Team to drive collaboration, consistency and alignment of operational practices.
  • Ability to work independently from intake through execution and work closely with business partners on solutions and innovative process improvements.
  • Aligned with the Agoda values and in particular Legal Teams “Values in Action”.
  • A demonstrated can-do, roll up your sleeves, collaborative approach, coupled with a strong work ethic and sound judgment.
  • Experience with travel industry/technology.
  • Ability to forge trusted relationships with colleagues around the world.

job.job_description:
Employment Type: Permanent

Contract Duration

 Why you will love working here

At IATA, we represent over 350 airlines worldwide, striving to make aviation safer, smarter, more sustainable, and inclusive.

  • Our Values are not just words on a page - they are the energy behind everything we do: ONE IATA - We collaborate across teams, TRUSTED - We do the right thing, INNOVATIVE - We make tomorrow better, INCLUSIVE - We embrace diverse perspectives.
  • With over 30,000 courses available, we believe in continuous learning and support your growth in an ever-changing industry.
  • Diversity, equity, and inclusion are our priorities. We are certified by the Equal Salary Foundation, offering equal pay and family-friendly policies.
  • We encourage community involvement through volunteering and strive to make tomorrow better for aviation and our communities. We offer time off so you can support causes important to you.
  • We promote work-life balance with flexible work options, including remote and hybrid work, a generous 'work from abroad' policy, and you get your birthday off!

About The Team You Are Joining

At IATA, we speak for the airlines of the world, serving and supporting over 300 of them across all continents. We are passionate and knowledgeable about the aviation industry, and we strive to make it safer, smarter, more sustainable and more inclusive. We celebrate diversity and inclusion in our workforce, and we respect and value the different backgrounds, perspectives and skills of our employees. We also care about our employees’ wellbeing, and we provide flexible work arrangements, travel benefits, family-friendly policies, equal pay and a day off on your birthday. We believe in giving back to the community and encourage our staff to participate in volunteering activities that support causes they care about. We encourage you to join our global community of aviation enthusiasts, and we will do our best to make you feel comfortable during the interview process. IATA is more than a trade association; it is a vision of a better future for air travel.

Reporting to Executive Director, BSP & CASS, the Head Billing Operations & Data Processing will lead the Global Delivery Center (GDC) Data Reporting, Data processing and Billing Operations, whilst providing business systems support for the BSP and CASS. The incumbent will work directly with the Head, IATA Data Processing Center, the Assistant Director Billing Reporting and the Senior Manager Standardization Data Processing to develop data processing strategies as well as business and operational processes.

What Your Day Would Be Like

  • You will be responsible for the overall performance of the department with the following functions:

Lead the development and execution of the DPC strategy in partnership with the GDC team, the I&D team, and the Regional Process Managers. Ensure the timely delivery of the DPC roadmap and the successful implementation of approved projects, including IBSPs, NFE, ADM, and IDPC initiatives.

  • Responsible for the operational management of BSP and CASS data processing systems (for ticketing and orders), ensuring achievement of the 99.98% on-time settlement KPI and the timely delivery of all critical ISS reporting.
  • Responsible for ensuring the production and availability of dashboards and reports for ISS stakeholders, both internally and, where applicable, externally through BSPLink
  • Ensure systems effectively interface with dependent and interdependent systems to meet end-to-end operational and business requirements, in close collaboration with the I&D team.
  • Contribute to, facilitate, and coordinate the implementation of new BSP and CASS operations, as well as the enhancement and expansion of existing services and functionalities. When required, support the suspension or withdrawal of facilities within existing BSPs and CASS operations.
  • Provide input into vendor contracting and service definitions for providers supporting ISS data processing and sales reporting activities, working closely with the I&D team.
  • Attend industry group meetings and lead the team in influencing discussions and outcomes in alignment with IATA's strategic objectives and agenda items
  • Prioritize and coordinate system enhancements and change requests in collaboration with the I&D team
  • Act as an interface between other business stakeholders, I&D, GPOs, and regional teams working on all data processing and collection of sales from ISS participants.
  • Actively support the Executive Director, BSP & CASS in identifying and implementing business and vendor solutions that enhance system efficiency and help maintain or reduce ISS unit costs, thereby preserving the free-of-charge nature of BSP and CASS services for participants
  • Play a key role in reviewing financial services projects, assessing their impact on DPC operations and initiatives, and prioritizing the required system developments in collaboration with key stakeholders.
  • Support the team and industry initiatives related to Agency Debit Memos (ADM) by contributing to the development and implementation of business solutions.
  • Ensure a high level of service in support of billing operations, providing assistance to third-party partners, including GDSs, acquiring partners, and other service providers.
  • Lead, recruit, coach, and manage the Data Operations and Reporting team, with a strong focus on data governance, operational excellence, and the promotion of best practices across the GDC.
  • Oversee NDC operations, support compliance among participating airlines and agents, and collaborate with stakeholders to develop strategies and capabilities for reporting sales from carriers transitioning to NDC and modern retailing models, including order-based transactions.
  • Ensure the team provides top level support on several key applications such as BSPLINK, CASSLINK, IBSPS, servicing APIs such as the ones in NDC and eventually Settlement with Orders.
  • Oversee and ensure the timely capture of sales records within ISS to enable settlement services, including maintaining the continuity and integrity of data feeds from airlines, GDSs, and other sources, as well as the delivery of data to settlement service consumers and their financial partners.
  • Develop and drive the strategy for sales processing and data enrichment services, including commission calculation and validation, tax reporting, and other value-added reporting requirements, ensuring these services continue to differentiate ISS and support its long-term sustainability within the collection and settlement landscape.

We would love to hear from you if

  • Significant experience (minimum 10 years) managing systems operations and reporting within an airline or another aviation industry organization operating in financial, settlement, distribution, or data-processing environments;
  • Strong people management skills, with experience leading teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) responsible for Data Processing Center operations;
  • Proven track record of successfully delivering global projects and implementing business system solutions supporting airline distribution, settlement, and supply chain processes:
  • Experience engaging with C-level stakeholders, coupled with the leadership skills required to manage industry working groups and drive consensus;
  • Excellent teamwork, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work effectively in international and cross-cultural environments;
  • Ability to perform effectively under pressure and manage multiple priorities within tight deadlines;
  • Ability to think innovatively, challenge existing ways of working, and drive continuous process improvement.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and logical-thinking skills.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills in English.

Travel Required: Y

Learn more about IATA’s role in the industry, our benefits, and the team at iata/careers/ . We are looking forward to hearing from you!

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You are responsible for overseeing the entire hotel’s operations, ensuring the highest standards of guest service, operational efficiency, and profitability. As a Director of Quality, you’re not just managing the day-to-day operations - you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Lead and oversee all quality management and service excellence initiatives across the hotel.
  • Monitor guest satisfaction metrics, online reviews, and internal quality audits, and implement improvement plans.
  • Ensure compliance with Hilton brand standards, policies, and operating procedures.
  • Analyze guest feedback and operational data to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
  • Facilitate quality review meetings and communicate action plans to department leaders.
  • Develop and deliver training programs to enhance service quality and guest experience.
  • Support departments in preparing for internal and external audits.
  • Collaborate with departmental leaders to drive continuous improvement projects.
  • Track performance against quality-related KPIs and prepare reports for hotel leadership.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, engagement, and service excellence throughout the organization.

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • Leadership experience in Quality, Operations, Guest Experience, or a related area within the hospitality industry.
  • Strong knowledge of hotel operations and quality management principles.
  • Experience with guest satisfaction measurement tools and quality auditing processes.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.
  • Strong communication in English and Japanese

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

About The Team

How We’ll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40 USD/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program

Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future

Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones

Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care

Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Health & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family covered

  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

Join our Movement and Champion Restaurant Culture! 💚

At TheFork we believe that the best things in life happen around the table.

As the leading restaurant booking platform in Europe, we connect the broadest community of loyal diners with the world’s favorite restaurants. Powered by innovation and a deep passion for the restaurant industry, we create unique dining experiences across 11 countries.

We’re part of the Tripadvisor Group and proud to be building a diverse, people-first culture where “respect”, “ownership”, “growth” and “better together” values thrive.

If you’re passionate about food, technology, and making a real impact, your seat at the table is ready.

👉 Discover life at TheFork

SALES REPRESENTATIVE - BELGIUM

As part of TheFork’s international growth strategy, we are building a dedicated Inside Sales team focused exclusively on selling our restaurant reservation and management system in new international markets. This is a unique opportunity to join a newly launched division within a high-growth tech company, combining startup energy with enterprise scale.

You’ll report to the Sales Manager New Markets and play a critical role in driving the success of new markets expansion.

What You’ll Do

  • Identify and contact in-scope restaurants across Flanders, using cold calling and lead follow-ups from our CRM.
  • Pitch and sell our restaurant reservation and management system - TheFork Manager- that includes among other features: online reservation tools, table management, marketing and visibility services.
  • Educate and engage restaurant managers on the benefits of adopting TheFork Manager.
  • Own the full sales cycle — from outreach to successful onboarding and activation.
  • Collaborate with your team to continuously test and learn, shaping the go-to-market strategy and supporting future scale-up.

Who You Are

  • Fluent in Flemish and English (other languages like French, Spanish, Arabic are a plus but not required).
  • Proven experience in B2B outbound sales, ideally in SaaS or a fast-paced commercial environment. A background in hospitality is a plus.
  • Target-driven and proactive, with a genuine love for closing deals and exceeding KPIs.
  • Strong communicator and influencer, comfortable handling short sales cycles and fast decisions.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset — excited by the idea of building something new, working in ambiguity, and iterating fast.
  • Organized and autonomous, able to manage a pipeline efficiently while staying resilient in a test-and-learn setting.
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM tools is a plus.

Why Join This Team

  • Be part of an early-stage team with global ambitions and the backing of a trusted brand.
  • Work cross-functionally with marketing, operations, and product to bring new markets to life.
  • A chance to learn fast, grow fast, and make a real impact on the company’s future.

What We Offer You

😄 An awesome team (not everybody like our jokes, but we try our best)

🏠 A Permanent contract (that can be useful in life)

⚖️ Flexible working environment (2 days home office per week)

💸 Competitive fixed salary and bonus

🍕 Lunch vouchers available for each working day (because yes, we like to try our best restaurants)

🌎 International teams - More than 30 nationalities and 16 offices worldwide

🏳️‍🌈 Highly inclusive working environment

🤸‍♀️ Lifestyle benefits that can be used to reimburse physical, leisure activities, family support, travel etc

🎓 Continuous learning and development programs

😌 Free access to the Calm app

⏳ A program dedicated to help you have the best work/life balance

🏥 Health insurance fully covered by the company

👩‍🦽 Life Insurance and Disability at no cost to the employee

🍴 Amazing offices with dining, coffee point on each floor, and leisure area

🎤 Team building events (we love karaoke. A lot. A lot.)

If you are the right person and you are thrilled to join TheFork don’t miss this chance and apply.. we are waiting for you!

We believe that we are better together, and we welcome you for who you are. We endeavor to ensure that everyone - regardless of ability, age, socio-economic & cultural background, ethnicity, faith, gender, gender expression, gender identity, ideology, national origin, race, sexual orientation, marital status, or any characteristic protected under applicable law -has the opportunity to reach their full potential. About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Role #1 Finance Operations Excellence Manager

The Opportunity

Are you an experienced finance transformation and continuous improvement professional who enjoys solving complex operational problems and delivering measurable results?

Agoda’s Finance Operations Excellence team is looking for a Manager to lead finance and accounting process-improvement initiatives across our global operations. The role will focus on analyzing existing processes, identifying root causes, redesigning workflows, strengthening controls, and implementing sustainable improvements across areas such as Accounts Payable (PTP), Accounts Receivable (OTC), General Ledger (RTR), payments, reconciliations, and financial close.

You will own improvement initiatives from problem definition through implementation and stabilization. The ideal candidate combines strong finance-process knowledge with advanced Lean Six Sigma skills, structured problem-solving, data analysis, project ownership, and the ability to communicate recommendations clearly to finance and non-finance stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Finance and Accounting Process Improvement
    • Lead end-to-end improvement initiatives across AP, AR, GL, payments, reconciliations, and financial close.
    • Conduct process mapping, value-stream mapping, Kaizens, and future-state design using Lean Six Sigma methodologies.
    • Identify waste, bottlenecks, rework, process variation, and control gaps, and implement measurable improvements.
  • Data Analysis and Reporting
    • Analyze finance and operational data to identify trends, exceptions, root causes, and improvement opportunities.
    • Develop KPIs, dashboards, and reports to monitor process performance, quality, cycle times, and control effectiveness.
    • Translate findings into clear recommendations and prioritized action plans.
  • Project Ownership and Implementation
    • Own projects from problem definition and analysis through implementation, stabilization, and benefits tracking.
    • Lead cross-functional teams across Finance, Technology, Operations, and business functions.
    • Manage project plans, risks, dependencies, stakeholder alignment, testing, training, and rollout.
  • Documentation and Knowledge Transfer
    • Create and maintain process maps, SOPs, work instructions, and control documentation.
    • Use BPMN standards where relevant and support training and knowledge transfer to operational teams.
    • Ensure improvements are embedded into standard processes and governance routines.


  • Quality & Controls:
    • Identify and support the implementation of internal controls and quality assurance measures to mitigate risks and ensure compliance.
What You’ll Need To Succeed

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Engineering, Operations, or a related field.
  • At least 6 years of relevant experience in finance transformation, finance operations excellence, continuous improvement, or finance and accounting process improvement.
  • Solid understanding of finance operations processes, including Order-to-Cash (OTC), Procure-to-Pay (PTP), and Record-to-Report (RTR).
  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification or higher.
  • Strong practical experience applying Lean Six Sigma methodologies, including:
    • DMAIC
    • Process mapping
    • Value-stream mapping
    • Kaizen
    • Process reengineering
    • Structured root-cause analysis, including Fishbone and 5 Whys
    • Excellent communication, articulation, interpersonal, and stakeholder-management skills.
    • Strong ownership and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
    • Adaptability and resilience, with the ability to work effectively in ambiguous and changing environments.
    • High attention to detail, particularly regarding accounting accuracy, controls, documentation, and quality.

    It’s good if you have

    • Familiarity with finance systems such as SAP, Oracle, or similar platforms.
    • Experience with automation tools such as Macros, RPA, Alteryx, UiPath, or similar technologies.
    • Experience with automation tools such as Macros, RPA, Alteryx, UiPath, or similar technologies.
    • Professional accounting qualifications such as CPA, ACCA, CA, CMA, or equivalent.

    What You’ll Get

    • A relocation package including visa-sponsorship to help you and your family get here comfortably. 
    • Medical insurance, mental health support line, annual leave, travel discounts, sick days, and the AgodaChoice flexible spending benefit 
    • Employee resource groups for every culture and background
    • Flexibility to help you work in the way that’s best for you with a work from home allowance, 30-day work from anywhere benefit, and hybrid working options. 
    • Professional growth and learning budget, including several in-person development programs for each stage of your career.
    • The chance to live in Bangkok, one of the best cities in Southeast Asia, and a central hub for travel. Within 3 hours, you can hit any of the most popular countries like Vietnam, Singapore, Laos, Malaysia, and Hong Kong, just to name a few.

job.job_description:
Organization- The Standard, Mexico City

Summary

Marketing Coordinator

The Standard, Mexico City is landing in the historic Tabacalera neighborhood—and we're not coming quietly. With 206 guestrooms, 27 branded residences, restaurants and bars with plenty to say, and a rooftop overlooking the Monumento a la Revolución, we're bringing a new kind of energy to Latin America.

Now we need a Marketing Coordinator to help make sure the right people hear about it.

We're looking for someone who knows that even the best ideas need a deadline, the right file name, and someone who actually follows up. You'll be organized, proactive, culturally curious, and ready to turn creative briefs into sharp content, smooth productions, memorable experiences, and very clear next steps.

Reporting to the Marketing Experience Manager, you'll work closely with the Marketing & Culture team and collaborators across the hotel to keep campaigns, partnerships, content, and events moving—from the first idea to the final recap.

The Opportunity

At The Standard, marketing isn't about making noise for the sake of it. It's about knowing what's worth talking about—and giving people a reason to join the conversation.

As our Marketing Coordinator, you'll be at the center of the action: supporting campaigns, social media, cultural research, creative production, partnerships, events, and all the behind-the-scenes details that make the visible parts look effortless.

You know the city—or can't stop trying to. You pay attention to what's happening in contemporary art, music, design, fashion, film, food, and nightlife, from major institutions to the independent scenes shaping what comes next. You don't need to know everyone, but you should know how to look, listen, ask the right questions, and spot something interesting before it becomes obvious.

This is a hands-on role for someone ready to grow within lifestyle hospitality while helping shape the opening of a hotel that was never meant to blend in.

What You'll Do

  • Support the Marketing Experience Manager and Marketing & Culture Director in bringing campaigns, content, partnerships, events, and special projects to life.
  • Keep the department's master calendar, project trackers, timelines, deliverables, and approval workflows accurate and moving.
  • Turn briefs, meetings, and conversations into clear action lists—and make sure deadlines, owners, and next steps don't disappear into the ether.
  • Request, review, and organize photography, video, design, and copy assets, keeping folders, file names, and versions under control.
  • Write, edit, and proofread Spanish and English copy for social media, newsletters, websites, presentations, invitations, and hotel materials.
  • Prepare and schedule approved content, monitor interactions, and direct questions or issues to the right team.
  • Stay close to Mexico City's cultural pulse by researching emerging trends, conversations, collaborators, audiences, and competitive activity.
  • Support photo shoots and content production, coordinating call sheets, products, permits, talent, suppliers, transportation, and on-site logistics.
  • Help run events and experiences from invitation to aftermath, including RSVPs, guest lists, run of show, talent requirements, setup, hospitality, and follow-up.
  • Keep agencies, creatives, talent, partners, and suppliers on track with the information, schedules, materials, and deliverables they need.
  • Work across Food & Beverage, Rooms, Sales, Events, and Operations to keep hotel communications, promotions, and priorities current.
  • Maintain organized databases of contacts, partners, creators, talent, and suppliers, along with campaign, content, and event archives.
  • Support the less glamorous—but very necessary—side of marketing, including quotes, vendor onboarding, purchase orders, contracts, invoices, and budget tracking.
  • Gather metrics and materials for reports, recaps, and postmortems, helping identify what worked, what didn't, and what we should do next.
  • Be ready to support the moments that don't happen from nine to five, including selected evenings and weekends.

Qualifications

What You'll Bring

  • One to three years of experience in marketing, communications, culture, hospitality, events, content, creative production, or a related field. Strong internships and relevant projects count.
  • A bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Hospitality, Cultural Management, Production, or a related field—or equivalent hands-on experience.
  • Excellent Spanish writing, editing, proofreading, and editorial judgment, plus professional English for working with international teams.
  • An almost suspicious level of organization and the follow-through to keep multiple tasks, deadlines, and stakeholders moving at once.
  • Familiarity with social media, content calendars, collaboration platforms, and Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.
  • Basic knowledge of Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, content capture and editing, or email marketing platforms is a welcome plus.
  • The ability to research widely, make sense of what you find, and present it clearly without overcomplicating it.
  • Genuine hospitality, good judgment, and discretion—especially when the pace picks up.
  • A sharp eye for details, inconsistencies, and potential problems before they become actual problems.
  • Resourcefulness and confidence: you know when to figure it out, when to ask, and when to escalate.
  • A collaborative, ego-free way of working across creative and operational teams.
  • Calm under pressure, adaptability when plans change, and a sense of humor when they change again.
  • A real interest in Mexico City's cultural landscape and the wonderfully unpredictable world of lifestyle hospitality.

If you're culturally curious, relentlessly organized, and know how to turn a good idea into something people want to be part of, we should talk.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

The Opportunity

The Finance Transformation Manager (AI/Task Mining) will lead AI-enabled process transformation across Finance Operations, with a strong focus on Record to Report (R2R), Order to Cash (O2C), and Procure to Pay (P2P).

This role will combine finance process expertise, continuous improvement, task and process mining, intelligent automation, and emerging AI capabilities to improve efficiency, scalability, control, and data quality within Finance. You will identify high-value transformation opportunities, translate finance pain points into practical digital solutions, and work cross-functionally with Finance, Product, Data, Engineering, and Technology teams to deliver sustainable outcomes.

The successful candidate will help establish a scalable transformation pipeline—from opportunity identification and business-case development through solution design, pilot, implementation, adoption, and benefit realization.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead end-to-end finance transformation initiatives across R2R, O2C, and P2P.
  • Assess processes using process mining, task mining, value-stream mapping, and data analysis to identify inefficiencies, risks, and automation opportunities.
  • Identify, prioritize, and evaluate use cases for GenAI, machine learning, OCR/IDP, RPA, workflow automation, and analytics.
  • Translate Finance pain points into scalable AI-enabled solutions with Finance, Product, Data, Engineering, Technology, Risk, and Compliance teams.
  • Develop business cases, transformation roadmaps, pilot plans, and benefits-tracking frameworks, and project-manage the implementations.
  • Evaluate AI tools, automation platforms, and vendors based on business value, usability, data requirements, scalability, integration complexity, cost, risk, and controls.
  • Lead proofs of concept and support the implementation, adoption, and scaling of successful solutions.
  • Establish appropriate controls for AI-enabled processes, including human oversight, auditability, data quality, privacy, and compliance.
  • Design Finance process-management standards, including process inventories, L3/L4 documentation, ownership models, SOPs, controls, and governance.
  • Define process KPIs, baselines, targets, dashboards, and reporting frameworks in partnership with Data and Technology teams.

What You’ll Need To Succeed

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
  • At least 8 years of relevant experience in finance transformation, finance operations excellence, process improvement consulting, intelligent automation, or a similar role.
  • Solid understanding of finance operations processes, including Order-to-Cash (OTC), Procure-to-Pay (PTP), and Record-to-Report (RTR).
  • Practical knowledge of relevant technologies, including:
    • GenAI and Agentic AI
    • OCR/IDP
    • RPA
    • Process and task mining
    • Workflow automation
    • Finance analytics
  • Proven knowledge of Business Process Management, including building process inventories and L3/L4 process documentation.
  • Understanding of finance controls, data quality, auditability, privacy, and risk in automated or AI-enabled processes.
  • Experience partnering with cross-functional teams such as Product, Data, Engineering, Technology, Risk, or Compliance.

It’s good if you have

  • Experience in e-commerce, travel, technology, fintech, or other digital-first industries.
  • Experience implementing AI use cases specifically within Finance, Accounting, or Controllership.
  • Professional qualifications or certifications in Finance, Accounting, Project Management, Process Excellence, Data, or Technology.

What you’ll get: 

  • A relocation package including visa-sponsorship to help you and your family get here comfortably. 
  • Medical insurance, mental health support line, annual leave, travel discounts, sick days, and the AgodaChoice flexible spending benefit 
  • Employee resource groups for every culture and background
  • Flexibility to help you work in the way that’s best for you with a work from home allowance, 30-day work from anywhere benefit, and hybrid working options. 
  • Professional growth and learning budget, including several in-person development programs for each stage of your career.
  • The chance to live in Bangkok, one of the best cities in Southeast Asia, and a central hub for travel. Within 3 hours, you can hit any of the most popular countries like Vietnam, Singapore, Laos, Malaysia, and Hong Kong, just to name a few.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

The Opportunity

The Finance Transformation Manager (AI/Task Mining) will lead AI-enabled process transformation across Finance Operations, with a strong focus on Record to Report (R2R), Order to Cash (O2C), and Procure to Pay (P2P).

This role will combine finance process expertise, continuous improvement, task and process mining, intelligent automation, and emerging AI capabilities to improve efficiency, scalability, control, and data quality within Finance. You will identify high-value transformation opportunities, translate finance pain points into practical digital solutions, and work cross-functionally with Finance, Product, Data, Engineering, and Technology teams to deliver sustainable outcomes.

The successful candidate will help establish a scalable transformation pipeline—from opportunity identification and business-case development through solution design, pilot, implementation, adoption, and benefit realization.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead end-to-end finance transformation initiatives across R2R, O2C, and P2P.
  • Assess processes using process mining, task mining, value-stream mapping, and data analysis to identify inefficiencies, risks, and automation opportunities.
  • Identify, prioritize, and evaluate use cases for GenAI, machine learning, OCR/IDP, RPA, workflow automation, and analytics.
  • Translate Finance pain points into scalable AI-enabled solutions with Finance, Product, Data, Engineering, Technology, Risk, and Compliance teams.
  • Develop business cases, transformation roadmaps, pilot plans, and benefits-tracking frameworks, and project-manage the implementations.
  • Evaluate AI tools, automation platforms, and vendors based on business value, usability, data requirements, scalability, integration complexity, cost, risk, and controls.
  • Lead proofs of concept and support the implementation, adoption, and scaling of successful solutions.
  • Establish appropriate controls for AI-enabled processes, including human oversight, auditability, data quality, privacy, and compliance.
  • Design Finance process-management standards, including process inventories, L3/L4 documentation, ownership models, SOPs, controls, and governance.
  • Define process KPIs, baselines, targets, dashboards, and reporting frameworks in partnership with Data and Technology teams.

What You’ll Need To Succeed

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
  • At least 8 years of relevant experience in finance transformation, finance operations excellence, process improvement consulting, intelligent automation, or a similar role.
  • Solid understanding of finance operations processes, including Order-to-Cash (OTC), Procure-to-Pay (PTP), and Record-to-Report (RTR).
  • Practical knowledge of relevant technologies, including:
    • GenAI and Agentic AI
    • OCR/IDP
    • RPA
    • Process and task mining
    • Workflow automation
    • Finance analytics
  • Proven knowledge of Business Process Management, including building process inventories and L3/L4 process documentation.
  • Understanding of finance controls, data quality, auditability, privacy, and risk in automated or AI-enabled processes.
  • Experience partnering with cross-functional teams such as Product, Data, Engineering, Technology, Risk, or Compliance.

It’s good if you have

  • Experience in e-commerce, travel, technology, fintech, or other digital-first industries.
  • Experience implementing AI use cases specifically within Finance, Accounting, or Controllership.
  • Professional qualifications or certifications in Finance, Accounting, Project Management, Process Excellence, Data, or Technology.

What you’ll get: 

  • A relocation package including visa-sponsorship to help you and your family get here comfortably. 
  • Medical insurance, mental health support line, annual leave, travel discounts, sick days, and the AgodaChoice flexible spending benefit 
  • Employee resource groups for every culture and background
  • Flexibility to help you work in the way that’s best for you with a work from home allowance, 30-day work from anywhere benefit, and hybrid working options. 
  • Professional growth and learning budget, including several in-person development programs for each stage of your career.
  • The chance to live in Bangkok, one of the best cities in Southeast Asia, and a central hub for travel. Within 3 hours, you can hit any of the most popular countries like Vietnam, Singapore, Laos, Malaysia, and Hong Kong, just to name a few.

The team will be growing to five and made up of three people in Geneva and two in Montreal. You will be based in Montreal, reporting to IATA’s Manager, Corporate Taxation.

The Corporate Tax department is responsible for IATA’s direct and indirect tax planning and compliance worldwide. This includes providing support to all of IATA’s lines of business to ensure IATA’s global advocacy, products and services are delivered in accordance with IATA’s NPO status, while ensuring IATA complies with all tax filing obligations. The Corporate Tax team enables tax-effective business decisions, defends IATA’s tax positions and tax status worldwide, and is responsible for all tax reporting and compliance.

What Your Day Would Be Like

  • Tax Compliance, Reporting & Analytics
  • Support the Corporate Tax Manager with monthly GST and U.S. Sales Tax compliance filings and reports.
  • Assist in conducting annual campaigns with U.S. customers to collect Sales Tax exemption certificates and maintain them in IATA’s U.S. sales tax tool (Vertex).
  • Assist with the preparation and running of SAP tax control reports.
  • Tax Systems, Tax Technology & ERP Support
  • Gain exposure to tax technology systems such as SAP and Vertex, and learn how they support tax compliance and reporting activities.
  • Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) on tax-related systems, including SAP, Vertex, the IATA Online Store, and other billing platforms.
  • Assist with verifying customer data and updating master data in ERP systems as needed.
  • Tax Research
  • Assist with gathering legislative and background information on tax topics (such as U.S. sales taxes) to support team planning discussions.
  • Business Advisory
  • Support the delivery of tax-optimizing advice to internal stakeholders on topics such as IATA events in new markets, launching training centers, and opening new offices.
  • Documentation & Stakeholder Support
  • Provide tax documentation—such as registration, clearance, and exemption forms—to IATA product managers, customers, vendors, banks, and other partners.
  • Assist in managing global tax residency certificate applications and notary processes, ensuring documents are properly stored, accessible, and up to date.

We would love to hear from you if

  • Recent university degree in a relevant field such as Taxation, Accounting, Finance, or Business (within one year of graduation).
  • Authorized to work in Canada.
  • Strong attention to detail, with the ability to multitask and manage deadlines accurately.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Proficiency in English (spoken and written); other languages are a plus.
  • Willingness to relocate to Montreal for the duration of the internship.

Travel Required: N

Learn more about IATA’s role in the industry, our benefits, and the team at iata/careers/ . We are looking forward to hearing from you!

Job Title

External Job Title: Facilities Operations Analyst

About Your Business Area/Department

The Real Estate, Building & Facilities team supports our workplaces across North America, helping ensure our offices operate effectively, safely, and consistently. We partner with local office contacts, Finance, Procurement/Sourcing, vendors, and corporate teams to coordinate facilities operations, financial processes, workplace data, and service delivery.

In This Role You'll

  • Support the NORAM Real Estate Regional Manager / Building & Facilities Manager in the coordination and follow-up of facilities operations across NORAM, including maintenance activities, service requests, vendor interventions, operational issues, risks.
  • Act as a coordination point with local office contacts across NORAM, maintaining visibility on open actions, recurring topics, risks, dependencies, and improvement opportunities.

  • 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in Facilities Management, workplace operations, business operations, or a related multi-site corporate environment.

  • You have practical experience with budgets, purchase orders, invoices, accruals, forecasts, operational trackers, reports, or dashboards.
  • You bring strong Excel skills and are confident in organizing, validating, analyzing, and presenting operational and financial information.

  • You are proactive, service-oriented, detail-focused, and able to manage multiple responsibilities with a good level of autonomy and follow-through.
  • A bachelor’s degree in Facilities Management, Business Administration, Finance, Real Estate, Engineering, Operations Management, or related field is preferred.

Company Description

HOTEL OVERVIEW

Strategically located in the heart of Singapore’s shopping, dining and entertainment districts and with the City Hall and Esplanade Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) train stations and other major transportation nodes at its doorstep, Fairmont Singapore and Swissôtel The Stamford are the gateway to explore Singapore’s landscapes at your convenience. With a total of 2,030 well-appointed guestrooms, both hotels also offer a distinct collection of 12 lifestyle and dining choices including Michelin-starred fine dining restaurant JAAN by Kirk Westaway, cutting-edge meeting space at Raffles City Convention Centre with 34 meeting rooms and one of Asia’s largest spas, Willow Stream Spa.

About Our Company

At Fairmont Singapore and Swissôtel The Stamford, we design career plans and unveil new professional perspectives through our various development programs. We shine when YOU shine. Come and be part of our dynamic team and experience immerse growth and career opportunities with us.

Job Description

The Executive, Marketing Communications develops and leads communications strategies for assigned revenue streams and lifestyle-led portfolios across Fairmont Singapore and Swissôtel The Stamford. This role has a strong focus on campaign management, public relations, media relations, content development, influencer engagement, media planning, partnerships, F&B storytelling, spa and lifestyle campaigns, while supporting broader hotel, brand and corporate initiatives. The role supports the Director of Marketing Communications in managing campaign execution, agency coordination, media hosting and team workflow.

COMMUNICATIONS & MEDIA PLANNING

  • Formulate communications and media calendars for assigned portfolios, ensuring timely and accurate execution of initiatives with relevant business units and stakeholders.
  • Develop Public Relations angles, media materials, influencer briefs and content narratives that generate positive and relevant coverage across local, regional and international channels.
  • Develop media plan for campaigns and dedicated business units for brand positioning and/or to meet campaign objectives
  • Review communications materials including press releases, media pitches, social copy, sales decks, in-house collaterals, ad copy and campaign assets to ensure accuracy, tonality and brand alignment.
  • Lead assigned awards submissions, canvassing of votes or nominations, and post-award amplification with relevant stakeholders.
  • Identify partnership opportunities with lifestyle, luxury, F&B, wellness, cultural and corporate brands to create differentiated guest experiences.

LIFESTYLE, PUBLIC RELATIONS & PORTFOLIO MANAGEMENT

  • Lead or support lifestyle and Public Relations -driven portfolios such as selected F&B venues, spa, wellness, partnerships, IP-led collaborations, festive campaigns and hotel stories.
  • Manage media, blogger, content creator and influencer hosting to drive positive coverage and beneficial commercial outcomes.
  • Coordinate media familiarisation stays, F&B tastings, chef interviews, partner activations and hosted experiences in line with approved strategy and budgets.
  • Support restaurant and bar positioning by developing story angles around culinary concepts, chefs, menus, events, awards and collaborations.
  • Maintain active awareness of hospitality, lifestyle, dining, wellness and media trends to identify relevant opportunities.

CAMPAIGN & EVENT MANAGEMENT

  • Conceptualise, plan and execute integrated communications campaigns with the Director, internal team, Public relations agencies, digital partners and business unit stakeholders.
  • Support marketing and promotion of hotel-led events, ensuring strong attendance, media relevance, guest experience and post-event reporting.
  • Prepare campaign briefs, timelines, content requirements, photography or videography briefs, creative references and partner deliverables.
  • Coordinate cross-channel launches across website, social media, email, in-house displays, press outreach, partner platforms and advertising placements.
  • Monitor campaign performance and prepare updates with recommendations for optimisation.

MARKET RESEARCH & ANALYSIS

  • Conduct market research to identify consumer preferences, competitor activity, hospitality trends and relevant lifestyle or dining developments.
  • Analyse public relations , campaign, media monitoring, social and stakeholder feedback to develop informed recommendations that support business goals.
  • Review competitive communications to identify opportunities for differentiation and stronger positioning.

PARTNER, AGENCY & VENDOR ENGAGEMENT

  • Manage day-to-day agency, partner and vendor coordination for assigned projects, ensuring clear scopes, timelines, deliverables and approvals.
  • Host partners and industry contacts for ongoing engagement and potential collaborations.
  • Support negotiation of value-added partner arrangements that enhance brand relevance, reduce costs or improve guest experiences.

BUDGETING & ADMINISTRATION

  • Manage campaign and assigned business unit budgets and forecast.
  • Monitor campaign-level budgets, quotations and supplier costs for assigned projects, ensuring forecast accuracy and procurement compliance.
  • Support annual budget planning by gathering scopes, historical costs and proposed activity requirements.
  • Work with the Coordinator to ensure agreements, purchase requests, invoices and accruals are submitted accurately and on time.

Others

  • Comply with hotel and department policies and procedures at all times.
  • Assist with Sales & Marketing projects and carry out other duties as assigned by Management.

Qualifications

  • Degree or Diploma in Hospitality, Tourism, Marketing, Communications, Public Relations or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 1 to 3 years of marketing communications or public relations experience, preferably within hospitality, travel, lifestyle, luxury, F&B or agency environments.
  • Excellent spoken and written English. Fluency in a second language is preferred.
  • AI-enabled marketer, proficient in Claude, ChatGPT, relevant tools for content creation, presentations, project management
  • Strong knowledge of marketing communications (Branding, Public Relations , Events, Advertising), hospitality trends, media//KOL connections locally/regionally
  • Excellent writing, editing, media pitching and content planning skills.
  • Strong stakeholder management with the ability to work across multiple business units and senior stakeholders.
  • Ability to brief agencies, designers, photographers and vendors with clear objectives and timelines.
  • Strong analytical skills with comfort using media monitoring, influencer analysis and campaign performance data.
  • Creative, proactive and commercially minded, with a passion for hospitality and guest experiences.
  • Collaborative, adaptable and able to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

  • Native/Fluent Japanese Language Level Required for this Position*

The team

Agoda is a travel booking platform and accommodation is at our core. As our accommodation partners are a key to our success, we work hard to ensure their success. That is why the Strategic Accounts Management (SAM) team in Agoda specializes in account management. We serve as consultants, offering strategic advice on how best to excel on Agoda’s commercial platform. We are direct contributors to what makes Agoda one of the market leaders because we understand accommodation needs and offer innovative solutions. From Bangkok to London and beyond, our team has footprints in over 50 locations around the world. With the help of industry-leading technology, we work and collaborate globally to bring together the best ideas from diverse perspectives. The SAM team invests in long-term relationships that spans borders and cultures and results in incredible value for Agoda, our partners, and our customers.

The Opportunity:

As a Strategic Partnerships Manager, you will be the main contact between our accommodation partners and Agoda, with the responsibility of nurturing the relationship with our key supply partners and driving mutual growth. A key responsibility in developing our business is the ability to identify and acquire new sources of supply and product offerings within an assigned territory while maintaining existing relationships.

In this Role, you’ll get to:

  • Develop long lasting relationships with key supply partners to enable Agoda’s growth in the region
  • Maintain regular and meaningful engagement with Agoda’s key supply partners
  • Analyze large datasets to propose tailor-made solutions to Agoda’s supply partners
  • Leverage analytical and problem-solving skills to identify new opportunities to grow Agoda’s business
  • Train and inform clients of both new and existing technologies, tools, and models
  • Prepare materials to aid in growing our business during partner meetings
  • Respond to partners requests in a timely and effective manner
  • Gain buy-in from relevant stakeholders to execute strategies and help launch promotional campaigns to enhance productivity and maintain Agoda’s competitiveness
  • Leverage product offerings to match market demands to maximize our ability to convert passive customers into active ones
  • Deliver on country KPIs, growth targets and country strategic initiatives

Support the Area Manager in preparing country reporting for senior stakeholders

What you’ll Need to Succeed:

  • Experience in business development and/or account management
  • Strong interpersonal skills & ability to influence both external / internal stakeholders
  • Experience in internet/e-commerce preferred
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Team player with a professional “get it done” attitude and work ethic
  • Proven success in acquiring, building & maintaining long term customer relationships
  • Adapts well to change and able to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to create new, innovative ideas

job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

Delta Air Lines' Operations & Customer Center (OCC) is seeking undergraduate co-op students for a minimum of three alternating work terms. The OCC serves as the operational command center for Delta's worldwide network and is responsible for both tactical and strategic decision-making during operational disruptions.

This co-op opportunity supports the Business Strategy, Emergency Response/Business Continuity, and OCC Safety & Compliance teams. Students will contribute to employee engagement initiatives, communications, learning programs, emergency planning, business continuity efforts, safety campaigns, and compliance activities that help the OCC operate effectively in a 24/7 environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support project management activities related to employee engagement, learning initiatives, emergency response planning, safety, and compliance programs.
  • Document and analyze operational processes and the technology used to support decision-making.
  • Assist with evaluating learning and training products to identify opportunities for enhancement, maintenance, or retirement.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams on continuous improvement initiatives and strategic projects.

Business Strategy & Employee Engagement

  • Support the OCC Business Strategy team by managing and coordinating employee engagement initiatives.
  • Assist with event planning, logistics, and execution for divisional activities.
  • Develop internal communication campaigns that promote engagement, learning, and organizational initiatives.
  • Create and maintain communications materials, including:
    • Marketing brochures
    • OCC portal content
    • Departmental bulletins, announcements, and memos
Emergency Management & Business Continuity Planning

  • Support Emergency Management (EM) and Business Continuity Planning (BCP) initiatives for the OCC.
  • Conduct Business Impact Analysis (BIA) updates by interviewing application and product owners to assess operational criticality.
  • Update, maintain, and ensure accessibility of contingency and recovery plans.
  • Assist with the migration of OCC operational applications to cloud-based environments.
  • Support Corporate Emergency Command Center (CECC) planning and response activities.
  • Contribute to technology enhancements that improve emergency response and business continuity capabilities.
  • Design and develop micro-learning content to support emergency preparedness and business continuity awareness.

Safety, Compliance & Facilities Management

  • Update and maintain departmental Emergency Preparedness Plans (EPPs) and Fire Prevention Plans.
  • Develop and improve processes that support real-time reporting and response to facility failures.
  • Create storyboards, training materials, and videos supporting evacuation, relocation, and continuity-of-operations procedures.
  • Validate the accuracy and currency of emergency planning documentation and related resources.
  • Monitor Automated External Defibrillator (AED) locations to ensure equipment readiness and functionality.
  • Conduct periodic reviews of first aid stations to verify supplies are available and properly maintained.

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Currently enrolled in an accredited College, University, or Institution and pursuing a bachelor's degree in:
    • Project Management
    • Aviation Management
    • Aviation Science
    • Business
    • Or a related field
  • Available for three alternating semesters.
  • Willing to relocate to Atlanta, GA for each work term.
  • Strong organizational, project management, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Experience with Adobe products.
  • Comfortable working independently and in team settings.
  • Demonstrates a commitment to safety, integrity, respect, and continuous improvement.
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency.
  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States.
What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Academic concentration or experience in project management, aviation management, or marketing and communications.
  • Familiarity with project management tools.
  • Leadership experience through school, community, or extracurricular organizations.
  • Strong interest in aviation and Delta Air Lines' operations

Ideal Candidate Profile

The Strongest Candidates Will

  • Learn quickly and adapt to new challenges.
  • Thrive in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.
  • Work effectively with individuals from diverse backgrounds and perspectives.
  • Take initiative and drive results.
  • Demonstrate a team-first mindset.
  • Be passionate about operational excellence, continuous improvement, and support Delta's customers.

Core Competencies

  • Project Management
  • Communication
  • Business Analysis
  • Process Documentation
  • Continuous Improvement
  • Teamwork and Collaboration
  • Adaptability
  • Leadership Potential
  • Safety and Compliance Awareness
  • Aviation Industry Interest

This role is particularly well-suited for students interested in operations management, business strategy, aviation operations, emergency management, organizational communications, learning and development, or project management careers.

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Director, Data Engineering

Introduction To The Team

Expedia Group B2B connects partners across the travel industry to our leading technology, supply, and services - helping them deliver seamless travel experiences to their customers. From airlines and hotels to financial institutions and other travel platforms, we power smarter, faster, and more impactful travel solutions through the most connected marketplace in the world

Make An Impact!

As the Director, Data Engineering, you will lead the Data Engineering, Software Engineering, AI, and Innovation capabilities supporting Expedia Group’s Marketing Automation and MarTech organization. You will set the vision and execution strategy for the platforms, products, and services that connect customer, marketing, product, and operational data and enable responsible, scalable use of AI.

Reporting to the head of Digital Operations, you will ensure that data, software, and AI capabilities are trusted, secure, scalable, and easy to use. You will partner with Marketing, MarTech, Analytics, Product, Technology, and responsible AI stakeholders to improve customer engagement, campaign effectiveness, operational efficiency, and the speed at which the organization can bring new ideas to life.

Leadership Approach

You are strategic, outcome-oriented, technically credible, and comfortable operating across business and technology. You create clarity, make thoughtful decisions, hold teams accountable for reliability, responsible AI, and customer value, and develop an inclusive environment where people can do their best work. You are curious about what’s next while remaining pragmatic about risk, cost, scale, and trust.

In This Role You Will

  • Set and execute a multi-year data and technology strategy aligned to Marketing Automation, MarTech, personalization, customer engagement, and Digital Operations priorities.
  • Lead three interconnected capabilities: data engineering and platform ownership; software engineering and integration services; and AI, innovation, experimentation, and emerging technology.
  • Define architecture standards and make pragmatic build, buy, partner, and platform decisions that balance speed, scale, reliability, security, and cost.
  • Build and evolve scalable data pipelines, data products, APIs, integrations, services, workflow automation, and developer tooling across the MarTech ecosystem.
  • Establish strong practices for data quality, observability, lineage, access, governance, privacy, security, service ownership, and incident response.
  • Partner with Analytics and business stakeholders to create trusted metrics, semantic models, and self-service capabilities that support better decisions.
  • Enable advanced analytics, experimentation, machine learning, generative AI, and intelligent automation through fit-for-purpose data and engineering foundations.
  • Establish the foundations for AI adoption, including model and prompt evaluation, data readiness, monitoring, cost management, access controls, human oversight, and responsible AI guardrails.
  • Lead an innovation portfolio from problem discovery and prototyping through evaluation, productionization, or intentional shutdown—ensuring successful experiments become supported and measurable products.
  • Create alignment across stakeholders on roadmaps, priorities, dependencies, investment choices, risks, and trade-offs, and communicate progress clearly to senior leadership.
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing organization of engineering leaders and individual contributors across data, software, and innovation.
