job.job_description:
Summary of Position

The Sales Enablement & Effectiveness Manager, North America is responsible for advancing sales effectiveness and execution across CTM North America by equipping the sales team with the methodologies, skills, content, technology, coaching, and insights required to win. The role will lead the regional sales enablement strategy, including sales methodology and process adoption, BAS onboarding and development, manager-led coaching, strategic opportunity planning, sales technology adoption, and performance measurement.

Working closely with Sales Leadership, Sales Support, Marketing, Product, and other cross-functional partners, this position will translate CTM's go-to-market strategy into consistent, repeatable seller behaviors. The role will leverage platforms including Gong, CRM, ZoomInfo, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator to identify performance opportunities, strengthen coaching, and improve sales productivity, pipeline quality, conversion, and revenue outcomes.

Schedule / Shift

Standard

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Develop and execute the North America sales enablement and effectiveness strategy aligned with CTM's regional and global go-to-market priorities.
  • Lead implementation and ongoing adoption of CTM's sales methodology, including MEDDICC, discovery, qualification, value selling, competitive positioning, account planning, and opportunity strategy.
  • Embed consistent selling practices, required activities, and coaching expectations across CTM's defined CRM sales stages.
  • Own the business strategy and adoption roadmap for Gong, including scorecards, coaching programs, call libraries, AI insights, best-practice identification, and seller and manager adoption.
  • Partner with the Sales Systems Manager, Sales Operations, and IT to ensure sales platforms are configured, integrated, governed, and supported in alignment with enablement priorities.
  • Design and deliver a structured regional enablement curriculum covering onboarding, sales methodology, discovery, executive selling, objection handling, negotiation, competitive selling, vertical expertise, and CTM solutions.
  • Develop a formal 30/60/90-day onboarding program and ongoing learning, reinforcement, and certification programs for BAS and sales leaders.
  • Equip sales leaders with coaching frameworks, deal-review tools, scorecards, and insights that embed enablement into weekly management and pipeline cadences.
  • Partner with sales leadership to improve qualification, pipeline velocity, stage progression, forecast discipline, win rates, and conversion through data-driven coaching and targeted interventions.
  • Establish repeatable frameworks for sales plans, key account acquisition plans, discovery sessions, pursuit strategy, and war rooms for priority Enterprise and Strategic opportunities.
  • Partner with Marketing and Sales Support to translate CTM's value proposition, competitive intelligence, vertical strategies, product capabilities, and market insights into seller-ready plays, talk tracks, content, and buyer-facing messaging.
  • Develop and maintain a scalable repository of sales plays, best practices, training resources, call examples, tools, and content mapped to buyer journeys and sales stages.
  • Establish a voice-of-the-field feedback loop across Sales, Marketing, Product, Operations, and leadership to identify buyer objections, competitive trends, content gaps, and emerging market needs.
  • Define and report enablement KPIs, including methodology adoption, Gong engagement, stage conversion, pipeline quality, sales cycle, win rate, ramp time, certification, and training effectiveness.
  • Continuously assess BAS and manager capability gaps and use performance data, field feedback, and business priorities to shape enablement programs.
  • Manage assigned enablement initiatives, vendors, budgets, timelines, risks, and communications to ensure effective delivery and measurable business impact.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on sales execution, capability, technology adoption, and performance improvement opportunities.
  • Create presentations and other documents as needed.
  • Other duties as assigned.
  • Domestic (and global) travel may be a requirement for this position. An accommodation may be considered under the Americans with Disabilities Act, but a bona fide reason must exist. The company will engage in the interactive process as necessary.

Leadership Responsibilities

  • This position is expected to provide direct leadership to the Sales Systems Manager and may have additional direct and/or indirect reports. Responsibilities include overall performance management, hiring, training, coaching, feedback, development, and effective alignment of sales systems administration with the regional enablement strategy.
  • Models the way for employees and sets a positive example by demonstrating our core values.
  • Provides ongoing feedback and supports team member growth by working with employees and encouraging growth plans.
  • Drives employee engagement. Facilitates regular and ongoing conversations about employee engagement and takes action to improve team and organizational culture.

Required of all CTM Positions

  • Embrace CTM’s core values of Connect, Deliver and Evolve.
  • Professional, collaborative & supportive interaction with employees, clients, suppliers or vendors
  • Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
  • Appropriate and professional written and verbal communication.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines, handle and prioritize simultaneous requests.
  • Creative and analytical thinking with strong problem-solving and consultative skills.
  • Demonstrates calm under pressure – is a proactive contributor and eager to learn.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Ability to do basic math.
  • Ability to read and interpret information.
  • Attention to detail.
  • Regular and reliable attendance.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in business, sales, organizational development, learning and development, marketing, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in B2B sales enablement, sales effectiveness, sales operations, sales leadership, or a related commercial role, preferably supporting complex enterprise sales organizations.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing and reinforcing structured sales methodologies such as MEDDICC/MEDDPICC, Challenger, Miller Heiman, Strategic Selling, Value Selling, or similar.
  • Demonstrated ability to design and facilitate sales training, onboarding, workshops, reinforcement programs, and manager-led coaching.
  • Experience leveraging conversation intelligence, CRM, and sales productivity platforms to improve seller effectiveness, coaching, and business performance.
  • Strong understanding of complex B2B and enterprise sales cycles, including discovery, qualification, executive engagement, competitive differentiation, opportunity strategy, and negotiation.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and driving measurable change across a geographically dispersed organization.
  • Experience in the corporate travel, travel technology, or business services industry preferred.
  • Prior experience in a quota-carrying sales or sales leadership role is strongly preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Strong commercial acumen and a practical understanding of the behaviors, disciplines, and coaching required to improve sales performance.
  • Ability to translate go-to-market strategy into scalable sales plays, learning experiences, tools, and measurable seller behaviors.
  • Strong facilitation, presentation, coaching, and instructional design skills, with credibility across sales professionals and senior leaders.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to connect CRM, conversation intelligence, pipeline, and performance data to actionable recommendations.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels and across functions.
  • Strong program and change leadership skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and sustain adoption in a fast-paced environment.
  • Working knowledge of sales methodologies, adult learning principles, coaching practices, and enablement measurement.
  • Proficiency with Gong or similar conversation intelligence platforms, CRM systems, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively with regional and global teams across time zones.
  • Flexible, adaptable, resourceful, and comfortable navigating changing business priorities.
  • Ability to have fun with a collaborative and winning mindset.

EEO Statement

CTM NA is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce. All qualified applicants applying for job openings posted in the U.S. will receive consideration for employment without regard to, and will not be discriminated against on the basis of, race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic or status protected by applicable law.

Flexible work arrangements are available. Depending on role, location, and business needs, colleagues may work onsite, hybrid (combination of in-office and virtual) or fully virtual.

Click https://www.dol.gov/general/topic/discrimination to view EEO and Other Legal Notices.

Benefits Program

We provide competitive and comprehensive benefits programs, tailored to each part of the globe our people work in. From walking and fitness challenges to volunteer experiences, flexible work environments, generous leave programs and retirement plan options, we offer ways to support you in every stage of living your best life.

job.job_description:
Organization- Hyatt Corporate Office

Summary

The Opportunity

At Hyatt, we’re working to Advance Care through data-driven decisions and automation. This mission serves as the foundation for every decision as we create the future of travel. We can’t do that without the best talent – talent that is innovative, curious, and driven to create exceptional experiences for our guests, customers, owners and colleagues.  

Hyatt seeks an experienced Senior Full Stack Software Engineer who will be an exceptional addition to our growing engineering team. Senior Full Stack Software Engineer will work closely with engineering, product managers and data science teams to meet data requirements of various initiatives in Hyatt.

As a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer, you will take on big data challenges in an agile way. In this role, you will build data pipelines that enable engineers, analysts and other stakeholders across the organization. You will build data models to deliver insightful analytics while ensuring the highest standard in data integrity. You will integrate different data sources, improve the efficiency, reliability, and latency of our data system, help automate data pipelines, and improve our data model and overall architecture. You will be leading multiple data projects with planned and coordinated execution and on-time delivery of quality products.

You will be part of a highly visible, collaborative and passionate data engineering team and will be working on all the aspects of design, development and implementation of scalable and reliable data products and pipelines.

Applying the latest techniques and approaches across the domains of data products, and machine learning engineering isn’t just a nice to have, it’s a must.

This candidate builds fantastic relationships across all levels of the organization and is recognized as a problem solver who looks to elevate the work of everyone around them. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list since 2013. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

  • Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on-site fitness center
  • A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption
  • Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

The Role

Hyatt is seeking a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer joining the Data and AI organization, working on new, innovative systems for Hyatt colleagues and Owners & Operators. This individual will work closely with back-end services teams, front-end designers, and product management to create scalable applications on the web. As a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer, this individual takes a direct hand in the performance of the team while remaining directly involved with development efforts. They apply DevOps tools and culture to deliver software to production early and often, with highly automated and reliable procedures

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design, Develop and Operate Full Stack Cloud Solutions and Services in an AWS Cloud Environment using a serverless-first and managed-service-first approach (React, TypeScript, AWS Lambda, NodeJS, Serverless Framework).
  • Write Clean, maintainable and efficient code following industry best practices and coding standards.
  • Develop UI interfaces with React (hooks, functional components, context) with strong command of component composition, state management patterns, and render lifecycle.
  • Define application infrastructure using an Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) approach, primarily with Terraform.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership throughout the development lifecycle, with a strong focus on delivering high-quality solutions.
  • Lead technical discussions to share knowledge and build consensus among engineers to develop the best possible solutions.
  • Maintain DevOps processes and deployment pipelines to support the implementation and release of applications and new features.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and UX designers to align engineering efforts with business goals and user needs.
  • Participate in product planning and roadmap discussions, contributing technical insights to influence product direction.
  • Take ownership of end-to-end feature development — from ideation and prototyping to deployment and continuous improvement.
  • Leverage analytics and user feedback to iterate on features and improve the overall product experience.
  • Mentor engineering team members in technical decision-making, code reviews, and adherence to engineering practices and standards.
  • Foster a diverse and inclusive team culture while demonstrating a strong commitment to Hyatt’s core values.
  • Design and build AI-enabled product capabilities using approved large language model (LLM) services and APIs, integrating them with web applications and backend services.
  • Develop retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and other grounded AI patterns where appropriate, using enterprise data sources and suitable embedding or vector-search technologies.
  • Apply responsible AI practices, including evaluation for accuracy and relevance, grounding and citation checks where applicable, privacy and security safeguards, human review for higher-impact use cases, and monitoring for quality and cost.
  • Use approved AI coding assistants (such as GitHub Copilot, Amazon Q Developer, or equivalent) to support implementation, testing, documentation, and code exploration; review and validate generated output before use and follow company policies for confidential data and intellectual property.

Qualifications

Experience Required:

  • 8+ years of experience architecting and developing full-stack solutions, with hands-on use of software build and deployment tools (e.g., Jenkins, Git, GitLab, CI/CD pipelines).
  • 8+ years of experience in application and backend API development using object-oriented programming (Java, Go, TypeScript/JavaScript).
  • 8+ years of web application development experience (HTML, CSS, React, Node.js, TypeScript/JavaScript/Python).
  • Strong understanding of AWS serverless solutions (AWS…S3, CloudFront, API Gateway, Lambda, SQS, EventBridge).
  • Experience working with cloud database services (DynamoDB, Snowflake).
  • Experience with containerization (Snowpark Container Services, Docker, AWS ECS/Fargate).
  • Experience with cloud build and deployment tools.
  • Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools and frameworks, such as Serverless Framework, AWS CloudFormation, and Terraform.
  • Base understanding of cloud services and infrastructure in AWS.
  • Knowledge of event-driven and service-oriented architectures.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments and tools.
  • Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skill
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Experience designing and implementing automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests, and applying application security and accessibility best practices.
  • Demonstrated experience integrating AI/LLM capabilities into production applications, including prompt design, API integration, and at least one grounded approach such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
  • Ability to evaluate AI-generated results for correctness, relevance, safety, and bias; understanding of privacy, security, and responsible-use considerations for AI systems.
  • Experience using an AI coding assistant (for example, GitHub Copilot, Amazon Q Developer, or an equivalent tool) in a software development workflow, with the judgment to review, test, and secure AI-generated code.

Experience Preferred:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Finance, or a related quantitative field
  • Professional certifications in AWS, Snowflake
  • Experience with Hospitality is also preferred.

The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all-encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary.

We welcome you:

Company Description

HOTEL OVERVIEW

Strategically located in the heart of Singapore’s shopping, dining and entertainment districts and with the City Hall and Esplanade Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) train stations and other major transportation nodes at its doorstep, Fairmont Singapore and Swissôtel The Stamford are the gateway to explore Singapore’s landscapes at your convenience. With a total of 2,030 well-appointed guestrooms, both hotels also offer a distinct collection of 12 lifestyle and dining choices including Michelin-starred fine dining restaurant JAAN by Kirk Westaway, cutting-edge meeting space at Raffles City Convention Centre with 34 meeting rooms and one of Asia’s largest spas, Willow Stream Spa.

About Our Company

At Fairmont Singapore and Swissôtel The Stamford, we design career plans and unveil new professional perspectives through our various development programs. We shine when YOU shine. Come and be part of our dynamic team and experience immerse growth and career opportunities with us.

Job Description

The Graphic Designer – Lifestyle Portfolio develops visual communications and creative assets for lifestyle-led portfolios across Fairmont Singapore and Swissôtel The Stamford, with emphasis on selected restaurant and bar brands, PR-led campaigns, IP collaborations, social and digital assets, in-house promotions and guest-facing materials. The role supports the Marketing Communications team by translating campaign briefs into brand-aligned, commercially effective creative across print and digital channels.

Responsibilities

CREATIVE DESIGN & BRAND CONSISTENCY

  • Design and adapt creative assets for hotel, F&B, lifestyle, spa, events, partnerships and internal stakeholder requirements across print, digital and in-house channels.
  • Ensure all artwork follows Fairmont, Swissôtel, Accor, restaurant brand and partner/IP guidelines, including typography, logo usage, imagery, layout, colour treatment and tone.
  • Develop visual concepts, layout directions, campaign key visuals, digital assets, menus, posters, social templates, display materials, EDM visuals, website banners and presentation assets.
  • Support visual storytelling for PR-led campaigns, lifestyle collaborations, restaurant launches, guest activations and special events.
  • Maintain strong version control, file organisation and artwork archiving practices.

LIFESTYLE, F&B & PUBLIC RELATIONS CAMPAIGN SUPPORT

  • Provide creative support for assigned lifestyle and F&B portfolios, particularly restaurant and bar campaigns, culinary events, collaborations, festive promotions and media-led initiatives.
  • Develop mood boards, design references and visual directions to support photography, videography and campaign concepts.
  • Work closely with Marketing Communications leads to interpret briefs, clarify objectives and recommend effective creative solutions.
  • Adapt approved campaign visuals across multiple formats and dimensions for digital screens, social media, websites, email banners, in-house displays and printed collateral.
  • Support quick-turnaround artwork requirements while maintaining brand quality and accuracy.

PRODUCTION, ARTWORK & VENDOR COORDINATION

  • Prepare print-ready and digital-ready files according to supplier specifications, platform requirements and internal production standards.
  • Coordinate with printers, production vendors, photographers and internal stakeholders on artwork specifications, proofs, colour checks and delivery timelines.
  • Review proofs and final outputs to ensure quality, accuracy and brand compliance before production or publishing.
  • Maintain knowledge of design, hospitality, F&B, social media and digital content trends to keep creative output fresh and relevant.

TEAM COLLABORATION & WORKFLOW

  • Work collaboratively with the Director, Assistant Manager, Senior Executive, Coordinator and fellow Graphic Designer to manage workload, priorities and design handovers.
  • Participate in creative discussions and provide design recommendations that balance brand requirements, guest appeal, readability and production practicality.
  • Support maintenance of creative templates, editable files, asset banks and approved design systems.

Others

  • Comply with hotel and department policies and procedures at all times.
  • Perform any other design-related duties as assigned by Management.

Qualifications

  • Diploma or Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Multimedia Design or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 4–5 years of graphic design experience, preferably in hospitality, lifestyle, F&B, retail, FMCG, luxury or creative agency environments.
  • Strong proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly InDesign, Illustrator and Photoshop; motion graphics or video editing skills are an advantage.
  • AI-enabled designer with the ability to leverage relevant AI tools and technologies to enhance creative workflows and efficiency.
  • Strong understanding of design principles including layout, typography, colour, visual hierarchy, image selection and brand guidelines.
  • Proven ability to develop creative assets across print and digital channels, including social media, web banners, EDMs, menus, posters, sales materials and event collateral.
  • Excellent attention to detail, file management and ability to manage multiple projects and meet tight deadlines.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to interpret creative briefs and work effectively with marketers, business units and external suppliers.
  • Creative, adaptable and service-oriented, with a strong interest in hospitality, lifestyle and dining.
  • Good command of spoken and written English; proficiency in a second language is an advantage.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Agoda is a leading global online travel platform connecting millions of travellers with accommodation, flights, and activities across 2 million+ properties in 200+ countries. As part of Booking Holdings, the world's largest online travel group, we combine the agility of a tech startup with global scale, investing heavily in data science, machine learning, and product innovation to make travel easier for everyone.

The Opportunity

Agoda's Customer Experience Group (CEG) is a large, globally distributed operation serving millions of customers through thousands of agents across owned sites and BPO partners. This role leads the Enablement Team Engine at the heart of CEG, the three interconnected functions that detect performance gaps, build capability, and drive adoption at scale. Talent Development, Quality Assurance and Change & Communications teams are all part of this function.

With generative AI reshaping how we learn and work, QA automation raising the bar on insight quality, and major platform migrations underway in 2026, this is a pivotal moment to shape how 3,000+ agents and leaders grow, perform, and change.

What You'll Do:

Strategic Leadership

  • Set the vision and multi-year roadmap for Talent Development, Quality Assurance, and Change & Communications, ensuring they operate as one integrated Enablement engine aligned to CEG business priorities and OKRs.
  • Champion the adoption of generative AI across learning, QA, and communications workflows, and lead the function through significant platform migrations and operational transformation.

Talent Development

  • Own the end-to-end learning architecture, onboarding, continuous learning, leadership development, and specialised upskilling, and drive measurable capability uplift using data from QA and operations to iterate fast.
  • Embed coaching frameworks that empower leaders to develop their teams day-to-day, and partner with HR, Operations, and Product to build capability ahead of demand.

Quality Assurance

  • Lead a QA function that goes beyond scoring, build frameworks that generate actionable behavioural and performance insights, drive automation at scale, and establish calibration processes that ensure consistency across owned sites and BPO partners.
  • Use root-cause analysis to influence process, product, and policy decisions upstream, not just to report scores.

Change & Communications

  • Lead CEG's change management capability for major transformations, build structured frameworks covering impact assessment, adoption tracking, and resistance management as standard practice across the organisation.
  • Own CEG's internal communications strategy: leadership messaging, channel management, engagement programmes, and knowledge architecture that keeps a distributed global workforce informed and aligned.

People Leadership

  • Lead, develop, and inspire a team of 140 across three sub-functions, coaching direct reports to operate with strategic independence and building a high-performance culture with clear accountability at every level.
  • Drive team engagement and retention; advocate actively for your people's growth and next career moves.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Act as a trusted partner to CEG Operations, HR, Product, and Technology leadership, translating Enablement outputs into business impact and representing the function at senior leadership level.
  • Manage BPO partner relationships to ensure Enablement standards are consistently embedded beyond Agoda's owned sites.

What We're Looking For:

Required Experience

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in Learning & Development, Quality, or Organisational Effectiveness, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role managing multi-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated track record leading at least two of the three disciplines (TD, QA, Change & Communications) in a large, complex, customer-facing environment.
  • Experience designing and scaling learning programmes, QA frameworks, or change initiatives in a contact centre, BPO-managed, or global operations context.
  • Strong data orientation, you use metrics to make decisions, evaluate impact, and challenge assumptions, not just to report activity.
  • Proven ability to lead through ambiguity and deliver in a high-velocity, iterative environment; comfortable with fast change and imperfect information.
  • Excellent communication and influencing skills, able to engage credibly at C-suite level and on the contact centre floor.
  • Experience managing or partnering with BPO / outsourced operations is strongly preferred.

Preferred / Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with generative AI tools applied to learning design, QA automation, or communications.
  • Background in travel tech, e-commerce, or other high-volume digital consumer businesses.
  • Familiarity with knowledge management systems and content governance in large-scale operations.

Why Agoda

  • Scale that matters, your work shapes the capability and performance of thousands of customer-facing professionals across a global operation.
  • A data-first, fast-iteration culture where ideas are tested, results are measured, and good work is recognized, no politics, no bureaucracy for its own sake.
  • Access to the resources, best practices, and talent networks of Booking Holdings, one of the world's leading technology companies.
  • A genuinely diverse, collaborative team spanning dozens of nationalities, with a Bangkok Operational HQ that is a hub of energy, innovation, and opportunity.
  • Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and real scope to grow into broader CEG, Agoda or Booking Holdings leadership.

Please review our Hiring Process Guidelines before your interview — click here to learn how interviewing at Agoda works.

Discover More About Working At Agoda

  • Facebook https://www.facebook.com/agodacareers/
  • LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/agoda

We prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and innovation. We partner closely with teams across Expedia Group to achieve growth and results for our customers and company.

n This Role, You Will

  • Identify opportunities to optimize the vendor footprint and outsourcing spend.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of global Contact Center outsourcing partners, including their capabilities, footprint, pricing models, and regional needs.
  • Facilitate discussions and drive resolution related to disputes, performance challenges, and other contract-affecting situations.

  • Produce content requirements, facilitate executive performance reviews, and manage action items.
  • Coordinate, schedule, and facilitate all facets of Partner Business Reviews.

job.job_description:
As Performance Benchmarking Analyst, you will play an important role in ensuring that IHG has accurate, reliable and accessible data to understand hotel and market performance. You will support the Director, Performance Benchmarking in managing relationships with external data providers and will coordinate the regular exchange, validation and reconciliation of data with these partners.

You will process and check industry benchmarking, pipeline and rooms data, investigate differences between data sources and help maintain consistency across IHG’s databases. Drawing on your understanding of data structures and analytical tools, you will also help design reliable data models that make information easier for colleagues to access, interpret and use.

A key part of the role will be supporting hotel and corporate teams with benchmarking data and digital products. This will include responding to queries, providing guidance on areas such as RGI and competitive-set composition, developing documentation and best practice, and helping colleagues use data with confidence. You will work with teams across Technology, Commercial, Operations, Revenue Management, Finance, Development and Competitor Intelligence.

This is also an opportunity to help shape the future of IHG’s performance benchmarking processes. You will contribute to the review of external data products and help modernise existing ways of working by applying automation and AI.

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You are responsible for selling hotel rooms, event spaces, and other services to potential customers. This role involves identifying and prospecting potential clients, making sales pitches, and closing deals to maximize revenue. As a Sales Executive, you’re not just supporting sales operations and lead generation to help drive new business – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Perform daily sales operations: Provide administrative support including data entry, invoice distribution, Salesforce activity tracking, and recordkeeping to ensure efficient team operations
  • Support sales documentation and reporting: Assist with preparing contracts, proposals, RFP responses, client call summaries, and booking and loyalty reports
  • Generate and qualify new business leads: Research, identify, and evaluate unmanaged and prospect accounts to build and maintain a qualified pipeline
  • Build collaborative relationships: Partner with Hilton Worldwide Sales peers, customers, and hotel partners to identify and qualify new opportunities, conduct discovery calls for unmanaged accounts, and deliver tailored solutions
  • Assist with special projects and events: Support departmental initiatives, customer engagement activities, and participation in meetings and conferences as needed

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • Diploma or degree in Hospitality, Business, or related field
  • Minimum 1 year of experience in hotel sales preferred
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to build and maintain client relationships
  • Basic understanding of sales processes and revenue generation
  • Proficient in hotel systems (e.g., Delphi, Salesforce, OnQ, Market Planner Survey)
  • Self-motivated, goal-oriented, and able to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Language Skills: Business level proficiency in both Japanese and English required
  • Experience: Sales experience preferred but not mandatory (around 2years is acceptable)
  • Strong team player with excellent communication skills
  • Cooperative and adaptable in a multicultural environment
  • Positive, proactive personality suited for sale

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

job.job_description:
We are seeking a Vice President, Associate General Counsel – Corporate to join our global Legal team, where innovation knows no borders. This team protects enterprise value, ensures rigorous regulatory compliance and enables strategic corporate initiatives that accelerate global business growth. It provides high-impact legal strategy and governance frameworks to keep our business moving forward safely and decisively. With an inclusive culture and flexible work environment, we work together with boldness, curiosity and commitment so we can all win together.

Reporting to our Chief Legal Officer, you will oversee Sabre’s SEC compliance program, lead its corporate governance efforts, capital markets/financings, partner with executive leadership and the Board of Directors, and provide strategic legal support for our equity programs and corporate transactions. This is a highly visible leadership role ideal for a proactive, tech-savvy attorney with securities law and governance experience.

What You'll Do

SEC Compliance

  • Lead Sabre’s 1933 Act and 1934 Act filings (registration statements and reports), including annual, quarterly and current reports, proxy statements and Section 16 filings.
  • Partner closely with Accounting, Tax, Investor Relations, and the People team to meet reporting and disclosure requirements.
  • Provide advice on applicable SEC regulations and Nasdaq stock exchange listing standards.
  • Support debt and equity offerings, credit facility administration, and capital structure transactions in partnership with Finance and Treasury.

Corporate Governance

  • Serve as legal lead for all corporate governance matters, including Board and committee operations, charters, and policies.
  • Oversee global corporate secretarial functions and manage board and stockholder meeting logistics and documentation.
  • Lead legal strategy and logistics for annual stockholder meetings and the preparation of proxy materials.
  • Oversee legal entity management and intercompany governance across global subsidiaries.

Equity and Executive Compensation

  • Advise on the design, implementation, and regulatory compliance of equity plans and short- and long-term incentive programs.
  • Partner with the People team on employee grants, executive compensation disclosures, and stock plan administration.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Work closely with Finance, the People team, Investor Relations, and other teams on broader enterprise compliance and disclosure strategies.
  • Provide legal training and thought leadership on governance and securities law compliance topics.
  • Manage outside counsel relationships and optimize legal spend.

What You'll Bring

  • J.D. from an accredited law school and active admission to at least one U.S. state bar.
  • 10+ years of legal experience, with a background combining a major law firm and in-house public company practice (technology or SaaS company preferred).
  • Deep expertise in corporate governance, U.S. securities laws, and equity compensation structures.
  • Proven experience working directly with or advising public company boards of directors.
  • Strong communicator and relationship builder with sound commercial judgment and uncompromised integrity.
  • Experience in the travel or business tech industry is a plus.
  • Exposure to international corporate structures, global equity plans, and debt/equity capital markets transactions.

Benefits That Support You

We know support looks different for everyone. That is why Sabre offers benefits beyond medical and financial coverage, with programs designed to support your well-being, growth and life outside work:

  • Competitive pay and performance-based bonuses
  • Flexible work options
  • Comprehensive healthcare coverage
  • Generous PTO and holidays
  • Strong retirement planning support
  • Family-friendly benefits
  • Professional development opportunities

Social Video Creative & Editor | Tripadvisor

About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

Tripadvisor Group is seeking a Social Video Creative & Editor to join the Tripadvisor Creative team. Reporting to the Creative Director, this person will work primarily with the Creative and Social teams to create and edit social-first content across Tripadvisors channels on platforms including but not limited to TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube. As well as support any additional creative needs as appropriate.

The ideal candidate is comfortable producing short-form videos and other social media posts, capturing original content or leveraging existing content, creator content, stock footage and UGC. They are a social native that understands platform nuances, has a great eye for social trends and is passionate about all things travel. We're looking for a self-starter with excellent judgment and communication skills. This is a fulltime, paid position.

Job Location: Hybrid in Boston, or New York.

You Will

  • Operate at the forefront of social creativity with a creator first mindset and a strong instinct for what cuts through on platforms. You live and breathe internet culture, spotting emerging trends and turning them into brand storytelling that feels timely and part of the conversation.
  • Work closely with Tripadvisor Groups Creative and Social teams to develop social media content for TikTok, Instagram and YouTube with potential for Facebook, Pinterest and Reddit.
  • Lead production and execution of a range of social videos and posts, leveraging trends and placing Tripadvisor at the heart of the cultural conversation.
  • Use AI and emerging creative tools to supercharge production, experimenting with new workflows that allow us to ideate, produce and scale high quality video content faster while keeping the craft and originality of the work front and centre.
  • Appear on-camera or voice videos; in partnership with the brand team, hone Tripadvisor’s unique voice on social.
  • Participate in brainstorms, proactively bring new ideas to the table, take direction and feedback from Social and Creative team leads.
  • Manage workback calendars and production needs to meet deadlines with the social media team.
  • Find creative ways to adapt relevant archival Tripadvisor Group footage to support the social media calendar.
  • Assist the Creative team on diverse video editing projects, demonstrating flexibility and readiness to assist across video and photo production tasks as needed.

You Have

  • 4+ years video editing experience, preferably with a focus on native social formats e.g. TikTok, Reels.
  • Experiencing capturing social first videos and photos, specifically short-form video content (30-90 seconds).
  • Experience creating specifically for social media for a brand either at an agency or directly with a brand.
  • Ability to script, storyboard and contribute during creative development.
  • Proficiency in editing and design software such as the Adobe suite, Premiere, After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva and in-app editing tools.
  • Experience using AI creative tools such as Runway, Midjourney, ChatGPT or Adobe Firefly to enhance ideation, editing and rapid content production.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to articulate creative concepts and strategic thinking to cross-functional teams. Ability to work independently and under close direction
  • Consistent attention to detail including project structure and asset organization
  • A genuine love for and excitement about all things social and travel

To Apply

  • Provide any links to your public social media accounts.
  • Attach a resume
  • Attach a portfolio of your previous work

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

The salary range for this role in the U.S. is $80,000 - $100,000. This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. An employee’s pay position within the wage range will be based on several factors including, but limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs. This compensation range may also be modified in the future.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction To The Team

The Product Team creates high-quality end-to-end experiences for travelers, partners, and Expedia Group. Our focus on customer-centric innovation enables us to develop products that build loyalty and repeat business. We partner closely with teams across Expedia Group to drive growth and achieve results for our customers and the company.

Search and Recommendations are the front door to every trip travelers plan on Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo: from the ranked results on a search results page to the recommendation modules that suggest the next property, destination, or add-on. The ranking and relevance decisions made across these surfaces in a fraction of a second shape whether a traveler finds the right option, and whether that moment converts into a booking. As Search & Recs grows in scale and complexity across brands, our ability to measure relevance and engagement quality, diagnose regressions, and benchmark against the competition becomes essential to protecting and growing that value.

The Search & Recs Quality team defines how Expedia Group measures and improves the health of search ranking and recommendation surfaces. We build the metrics, evaluation tooling, and operating cadences that tell Search, Recs, ML, and Engineering teams whether ranking and recommendations are working for travelers, for suppliers, and for the business and where to focus the next improvement.

In this role, you will own product quality and relevance measurement across all Search and Recommendations surfaces, partnering closely with Ranking and Personalization ML Science, ML Engineering, and Search Engineering to turn ambiguous relevance and engagement questions into clear, defensible metrics and roadmap decisions. Your work will directly influence how travelers experience search results and recommendations across brands, and how confidently the organization can ship ranking and personalization changes.

In This Role You Will

  • Own the product vision and roadmap for search and recommendations quality measurement, mapping target outcomes and KPIs (e.g., relevance, ranking quality, recommendation engagement, search-to-booking success) to delivery milestones
  • Partner with ML Science and ML Engineering to define and evaluate ranking and recommendation model quality including offline metrics (e.g., NDCG@10) and online proxies (e.g., Average Booking Position, recommendation click-through and conversion) and to facilitate technical tradeoff decisions on model changes
  • Own and scale evaluation system for search relevance: a curated query corpus, human relevance annotation, and LLM-as-judge scoring, reported through our larger Search Health program and extend these methods to evaluate recommendation surfaces (e.g., destination recs, cross-sell, rebooking recommendations)
  • Define and own product metrics for search relevance and recommendation quality, running regular metric reviews and holding the roadmap accountable to measurable outcomes across both surfaces
  • Lead competitive relevance and recommendation benchmarking against key players in the marketplace, translating findings into a prioritized set of product, ranking, and personalization investments
  • Coordinate experimentation and win-loss analysis on ranking, relevance, and recommendation changes, recommending strategies to optimize quality across brands
  • Coach and influence PMs and stakeholders across the broader Search & Recs organization on relevance and recommendation quality measurement best practices

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical, quantitative, or related field, or equivalent practical experience; 8+ years of product management experience (6+ years with a Master's degree)
  • Experience owning product metrics, experimentation, or evaluation frameworks for a ranking, recommendations, personalization, or search system
  • Strong technical depth and experience partnering directly with ML Science/ML Engineering teams on model evaluation and tradeoffs
  • Demonstrated ability to independently design product experiments, interpret ranking, relevance, or recommendation engagement data, and translate findings into a defensible roadmap
  • Track record of driving milestone and release planning for complex, cross-functional initiatives, including proactive risk mitigation
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to and influencing senior stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with search ranking and/or recommendation systems (e.g., learning-to-rank models, collaborative filtering, NDCG, engagement and conversion metrics)
  • Familiarity with LLM-as-judge or other AI-assisted relevance and recommendation evaluation methods
  • Experience in a marketplace or travel/e-commerce search and recommendations context, balancing traveler relevance with supplier and commercial considerations
  • Experience running or contributing to competitive benchmarking programs across search and/or recommendation surfaces

The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $173,000.00 to $242,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $277,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You will lead the sales team and ensure that the hotel’s revenue targets are met. This role involves developing and implementing sales strategies, building relationships with key clients, and overseeing the daily operations of the sales department. As a Director of Sales / Assistant Director of Sales, you’re not just driving revenue growth across all hotel segments – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Shape and execute sales strategy: Develop and implement revenue-driving sales strategies across group, business transient, leisure transient, and catering segments, aligned with the hotel’s commercial goals and strategic plan
  • Drive revenue performance and profitability: Contribute to achieving revenue targets and profitability goals by optimizing pricing, improving business mix, and guiding forecasting accuracy
  • Lead business reviews and planning: Facilitate regular strategy and performance meetings while contributing to long-range commercial planning through analysis of performance trends, market shifts, and revenue opportunities
  • Ensure commercial alignment: Collaborate with revenue and marketing leaders to align sales tactics with pricing, distribution, and promotional strategies, and to support forecasting and rate strategies
  • Foster stakeholder relationships: Engage with Hilton Worldwide Sales, Convention and Visitors Bureaus (CVBs), third-party travel partners, and key clients to drive demand, improve conversion, and support high-impact site visits and pre-convention meetings
  • Develop data-informed strategies: Track market and competitor activity to inform strategy and help maintain competitive positioning in group and transient segments
  • Cultivate a high-performing team: Recruit new talent while driving team growth and engagement through performance management, professional development, and recognition programs

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • Degree qualifications in Business Management or equivalent.
  • At least 5 years of experience in managing a hospitality proactive sales role preferred.
  • Minimum 5+ years in a revenue-generating or commercial role within hospitality or travel.
  • Proven experience managing and developing high-performing sales or commercial teams.
  • Skilled in creating and presenting sales strategies to senior executives and stakeholder groups.
  • Proficient in analyzing departmental financial data to inform strategic decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify and capitalize on new business opportunities.
  • Experience working in matrixed environments across departments.
  • Experience in multi-complex hotel or travel operations.
  • Technical Proficiency in hotel management software (e.g., Delphi, Salesforce, OnQ, Market Planner Survey systems) is a plus.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Role #1 Finance Operations Excellence Manager

The Opportunity

Are you an experienced finance transformation and continuous improvement professional who enjoys solving complex operational problems and delivering measurable results?

Agoda’s Finance Operations Excellence team is looking for a Manager to lead finance and accounting process-improvement initiatives across our global operations. The role will focus on analyzing existing processes, identifying root causes, redesigning workflows, strengthening controls, and implementing sustainable improvements across areas such as Accounts Payable (PTP), Accounts Receivable (OTC), General Ledger (RTR), payments, reconciliations, and financial close.

You will own improvement initiatives from problem definition through implementation and stabilization. The ideal candidate combines strong finance-process knowledge with advanced Lean Six Sigma skills, structured problem-solving, data analysis, project ownership, and the ability to communicate recommendations clearly to finance and non-finance stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Finance and Accounting Process Improvement
    • Lead end-to-end improvement initiatives across AP, AR, GL, payments, reconciliations, and financial close.
    • Conduct process mapping, value-stream mapping, Kaizens, and future-state design using Lean Six Sigma methodologies.
    • Identify waste, bottlenecks, rework, process variation, and control gaps, and implement measurable improvements.
  • Data Analysis and Reporting
    • Analyze finance and operational data to identify trends, exceptions, root causes, and improvement opportunities.
    • Develop KPIs, dashboards, and reports to monitor process performance, quality, cycle times, and control effectiveness.
    • Translate findings into clear recommendations and prioritized action plans.
  • Project Ownership and Implementation
    • Own projects from problem definition and analysis through implementation, stabilization, and benefits tracking.
    • Lead cross-functional teams across Finance, Technology, Operations, and business functions.
    • Manage project plans, risks, dependencies, stakeholder alignment, testing, training, and rollout.
  • Documentation and Knowledge Transfer
    • Create and maintain process maps, SOPs, work instructions, and control documentation.
    • Use BPMN standards where relevant and support training and knowledge transfer to operational teams.
    • Ensure improvements are embedded into standard processes and governance routines.


  • Quality & Controls:
    • Identify and support the implementation of internal controls and quality assurance measures to mitigate risks and ensure compliance.
What You’ll Need To Succeed

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Engineering, Operations, or a related field.
  • At least 6 years of relevant experience in finance transformation, finance operations excellence, continuous improvement, or finance and accounting process improvement.
  • Solid understanding of finance operations processes, including Order-to-Cash (OTC), Procure-to-Pay (PTP), and Record-to-Report (RTR).
  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification or higher.
  • Strong practical experience applying Lean Six Sigma methodologies, including:
    • DMAIC
    • Process mapping
    • Value-stream mapping
    • Kaizen
    • Process reengineering
    • Structured root-cause analysis, including Fishbone and 5 Whys
    • Excellent communication, articulation, interpersonal, and stakeholder-management skills.
    • Strong ownership and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
    • Adaptability and resilience, with the ability to work effectively in ambiguous and changing environments.
    • High attention to detail, particularly regarding accounting accuracy, controls, documentation, and quality.

    It’s good if you have

    • Familiarity with finance systems such as SAP, Oracle, or similar platforms.
    • Experience with automation tools such as Macros, RPA, Alteryx, UiPath, or similar technologies.
    • Experience with automation tools such as Macros, RPA, Alteryx, UiPath, or similar technologies.
    • Professional accounting qualifications such as CPA, ACCA, CA, CMA, or equivalent.

    What You’ll Get

    • A relocation package including visa-sponsorship to help you and your family get here comfortably. 
    • Medical insurance, mental health support line, annual leave, travel discounts, sick days, and the AgodaChoice flexible spending benefit 
    • Employee resource groups for every culture and background
    • Flexibility to help you work in the way that’s best for you with a work from home allowance, 30-day work from anywhere benefit, and hybrid working options. 
    • Professional growth and learning budget, including several in-person development programs for each stage of your career.
    • The chance to live in Bangkok, one of the best cities in Southeast Asia, and a central hub for travel. Within 3 hours, you can hit any of the most popular countries like Vietnam, Singapore, Laos, Malaysia, and Hong Kong, just to name a few.

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

As Senior Product Manager in Loyalty, you will own how loyalty value is communicated to members across the full journey, from pre-trip through shopping, booking, and post-trip engagement. You will define the messaging hierarchy, simplify a fragmented experience into one that is clear and personally relevant, and ensure that every member touchpoint reflects what loyalty is worth to them, not just how it works. Your focus will be on BEX while designing scalable solutions that can be applied in other brands. This role sits at the intersection of product, commercial strategy, and member experience. You will work closely with TEaL, XD, and Loyalty Tech teams and other product team to turn a complex programme into a simple, compelling story.

In This Role, You Will

  • Own the end-to-end loyalty messaging strategy across the member journey, defining a clear, value-led messaging hierarchy from pre-trip discovery through shopping, booking, and post-trip engagement.
  • Lead pre-booking and shopping messaging strategy so members see the most relevant earn, discount, or benefit message at the moment it most influences their decision to book.
  • Define and optimize post-booking and confirmation messaging to ensure members clearly understand what they earned, how loyalty benefits them, and why returning for their next trip is worth it.
  • Align loyalty messaging with BEX’s “win the whole trip” strategy by creating a coherent, multi-LOB story across hotels, flights, packages, cars, and activities, with consistent but context-aware rules for each line of business.
  • Partner closely with TEaL, XD, Loyalty Tech, and other product teams to translate a complex loyalty program into simple, compelling member-facing narratives and scalable frameworks that can be applied across Expedia Group brands.
  • Use research, analytics, and experimentation to measure messaging comprehension, member activation, and repeat booking impact, iterating on messaging strategies and safely integrating AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows that improve member and business outcomes.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of product management experience in consumer-facing products, including significant work on member, loyalty, or similar value-centric experiences.
  • Proven track record owning end-to-end messaging or member communication strategy (not only feature delivery), including defining hierarchies, frameworks, and cross-journey narratives.
  • Demonstrated experience collaborating across commercial, design, and engineering stakeholders to drive alignment on product narratives and implement messaging at scale across multiple touchpoints or lines of business.
  • Familiarity with experimentation and iterative testing as core tools for measuring messaging effectiveness, using data to refine what is shown, where, and when across the funnel.
  • Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products, including safely integrating and operating AI/ML‑enabled solutions that enhance personalization, targeting, or testing of loyalty messaging.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading loyalty or membership value communication across complex, multi-product or multi-brand ecosystems, with accountability for measurable improvements in engagement, activation, or repeat booking behavior.
  • Depth in designing and evolving cross-LOB messaging rules and frameworks that balance consistency with contextual accuracy for hotels, flights, packages, cars, and activities in a global, high-scale environment.
  • Strong background partnering with research and analytics to design robust measurement frameworks for comprehension, behavior change, and long-term value, and using those insights to inform product and messaging roadmaps.
  • Demonstrated experience taking products or member-facing communication strategies from concept through launch to scaled adoption, including structured A/B testing, iterative optimization, and ongoing lifecycle management.
  • Hands-on experience leveraging AI/ML-enabled solutions to improve how, when, and where loyalty value is communicated (for example, personalization, dynamic message selection, or automated experimentation), with a focus on safety, transparency, and member trust.

The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $173,000.00 to $242,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $277,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role. The total cash range for this position in San Jose is $187,000.00 to $261,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $299,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Benefits And Perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. The InterContinental Indianapolis brings urban luxury and timeless style to Monument Circle.  The landmarked Illinois Building has been restored to feature 170 Modern Guestrooms, 17 Luxurious Suites, Lobby Lounge and a stunning Rooftop Bar with iconic views of Monument Circle.

Explore our very own InterContinental® Hotels & Resorts – a truly international brand. Discover a modern, globally-focused culture where world travelers feel at home. Live the InterContinental life. You’ll find us in beautifully restored buildings and many exciting new developments. With 60 properties in the pipeline, our extraordinary world is set to expand.

At IHG we promise to give colleagues…

  • Room to Belong: Enable
  • Room to Grow: Enrich
  • Room to Make a Difference: Empower

The InterContinental creates exceptional experiences through our Brand Values by being:

  • Thoughtful
  • Cultured
  • Remarkable

We cultivate an engaging environment for our colleagues and guests by enlivening our IHG Core Values:

  • Do the right thing
  • Show we care
  • Aim higher
  • Celebrate difference
  • Work better together

A little taste of your day-to-day

Every day is different, but you’ll mostly be:

  • Recruitment and Onboarding:
    • Posting job openings and managing applications.
    • Scheduling interviews and coordinating with hiring managers.
    • Conducting background checks and pre-employment screenings.
    • Preparing new hire paperwork and conducting onboarding sessions.
  • Employee Records and Administration:
    • Maintaining accurate and up-to-date employee records (both physical and digital).
    • Managing employee data in HR information systems (HRIS).
    • Preparing HR reports and documentation.
  • Benefits Administration:
    • Assisting with employee benefits enrollment and changes.
    • Answering employee questions about benefits plans.
    • Liaising with benefits providers.
  • Payroll Support:

    • Maintaining time and attendance records.
  • Employee Relations:
    • Responding to employee inquiries and resolving basic HR issues.
    • Assisting with employee communication and engagement initiatives.
    • Supporting HR in handling employee relations matters.
  • HR Compliance:
    • Ensuring compliance with HR policies and procedures.
    • Staying up-to-date on employment laws and regulations.
  • Other Duties:
    • Coordinating HR events and activities.
    • Providing general administrative support to the HR department.
Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
  • Proven experience as an HR Coordinator or in a similar administrative role.
  • Knowledge of HR functions, principles, and best practices.
  • Familiarity with HRIS and other HR software.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

What You Can Expect From Us

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, 401k, and many other benefits to eligible employees.

We give our people everything they need to succeed. From a competitive salary that rewards all your hard work to a wide range of benefits designed to help you live your best work life – including a full uniform, impressive room discounts and some of the best training in the business.

We all take great pride in being genuine ambassadors of the InterContinental®️ brand and to be part of the brand you will have a thirst for travel, passion for culture and appreciation for diversity.
