Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Group, Conference and Events (GCE) Sales Manager, you’re not just driving revenue by leading strategic GCE sales efforts – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

 RESPONSIBILITIES

Here's What You'll Do During a Typical Day

  • Drive GCE revenue: Manage a portfolio of high-value Groups, Meetings and Events enquiries with a focus on achieving and exceeding conversion targets
  • Optimize business performance: Drive incremental revenue through strategic sales techniques, solution-based selling, and effective negotiation. Maximize profitability while maintaining strong client relationships and Hilton brand standards.
  • Lead sales strategy execution: Execute and adapt to evolving GME sales strategies, ensuring alignment with hotel and regional commercial priorities.
  • Stay ahead of the competition: Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and customer demand to identify opportunities for business growth. Partner closely with Revenue Management, Commercial, and Operations teams to develop winning sales strategies.
  • Ensure process accuracy: Conduct regular spot checks on bookings to support audit readiness and high-quality execution across systems and procedures
  • Promote the hotel: Organize and participate in promotional activities to increase visibility and drive GCE business
  • Client Relationship Management: Act as a trusted advisor throughout the sales process, providing expert guidance and recommendations, Build strong relationships with corporate clients, agencies, event organizers, and key decision-makers. Understand each client's unique objectives and deliver tailored solutions that exceed expectations.

Skills & Experience

  • Proven success in Groups, Meetings & Events sales or hotel sales within a large-scale hospitality environment or similar.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage and convert high-value enquiries.
  • Strong commercial awareness and strategic thinking capability.
  • Exceptional negotiation and influencing skills.
  • Experience creating bespoke client proposals and presentations.
  • Outstanding communication and relationship-building abilities.
  • Excellent presentation and site inspection skills.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing business priorities.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in sales systems, CRM platforms, and Microsoft Office applications.

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

About The Team

How We’ll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40 USD/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
  • Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
  • Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
  • Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
  • Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
  • Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Through our Care for All hub, we provide resources to help our Team Members to care for themselves, care for members of their team, and care for their loved ones. Eligible Team Members receive free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Senior Product Manager, EG Advertising Marketplace

Introduction To The Team

Expedia Group Advertising helps partners, including hotels, airlines, destination marketing organizations (DMOs) and more, deliver excellent traveler and B2B experiences. We drive growth for our partners and the Expedia Group marketplace through competitive supply, our leading advertising and travel media network and affiliate solutions.

Within EG Advertising, our team builds and optimizes the TravelAds auction platform that connects travelers with relevant lodging sponsored listings across the Expedia Group marketplace. We're dedicated to creating a world-class advertising experience that delivers value for our partners while enhancing the traveler experience through relevant, high-quality ad placements.

In This Role, You Will

  • Drive the strategic vision and roadmap for sponsored listings auction optimization, including auction mechanics, bidding strategies, and pricing models
  • Lead the development and evolution of auction functions to improve marketplace efficiency, partner ROI, and revenue growth
  • Own ad relevance initiatives that enhance the quality and personalization of sponsored listings for travelers
  • Partner with machine learning and engineering teams to design, implement and optimise auction algorithms that balance traveler experience, partner value, and business objectives
  • Define success metrics, analyze performance data, and identify opportunities to drive growth in sponsored listings through auction improvements
  • Leverage AI and GenAI tools to accelerate product development, enhance decision-making, and drive innovation in auction optimization
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product managers, engineering leaders, data scientists, and business stakeholders to deliver impactful features
  • Work closely with engineering teams to translate product requirements into technical solutions
  • Communicate product strategy, progress, and insights to senior leadership and stakeholders across the organization
  • Champion a data-driven approach to product development, leveraging experimentation and analytics to validate decisions
  • Stay informed about industry trends in auction technology, digital advertising, and marketplace dynamics

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Business, or related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience
  • 6+ years of product management experience, preferably in digital advertising, marketplace platforms, or auction-based systems
  • Proven track record of launching and scaling technical products that drive meaningful business outcomes
  • Experience with machine learning applications, preferably in advertising or marketplace optimization
  • Strong analytical skills with experience using data to inform product decisions and measure success
  • Proficient communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization
  • Experience working with engineering and data science teams to deliver complex, technical products
  • Demonstrated ability to work both collaboratively and autonomously in a fast-paced environment
  • Understanding of auction mechanics, pricing strategies, or related marketplace dynamics
  • Knowledge of digital advertising ecosystems, including programmatic advertising and sponsored search

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree (MBA, MS, or PhD) in a quantitative or technical field
  • Familiarity with AI tools, LLMs, or agent-based systems, including practical experience applying these technologies to product development
  • Previous experience at a technology company or marketplace business
  • Familiarity with agile development methodologies and product development lifecycles
  • Experience in two-sided marketplace products or platforms connecting supply and demand

The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $173,000.00 to $242,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $277,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Benefits And Perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life.

Accommodation requests

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.

About Expedia Group

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Important notice

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/.

Equal Opportunity

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. This employer participates in E-Verify. The employer will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from each new employee's I-9 to confirm work authorization.

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

This role is based at our corporate office in McLean, VA

This is your chance to be part of the Global Strategic Partnerships team that brings Hilton's most important partnerships to life through long-term relationship management, strategic growth planning, and integrated go-to-market execution. As Director, Partnership Strategy and Management, you will lead Hilton's enterprise partnership portfolio, ensuring current and prospective partners are aligned to Hilton's integrated marketing goals, business priorities, loyalty objectives, customer experience goals, and global customer growth strategy. This role blends strategic partner leadership, marketing acumen, commercial discipline, cross-functional influence, and portfolio management — making it both highly visible and deeply impactful.

What You'll Do During a Typical Day

  • Enterprise Partnership Strategy: Develop and own the strategic roadmap for Hilton's global enterprise partnership portfolio, ensuring partnerships are prioritized, structured, and activated in support of Hilton's commercial, marketing, brand, loyalty, and customer engagement objectives.
  • Portfolio Management: Lead ongoing management of current partners across sports, music, entertainment, lifestyle, travel, and other strategic categories, ensuring each relationship has clear objectives, operating rhythms, value drivers, and measurable outcomes.
  • Partnership Development: Identify, evaluate, negotiate, and onboard new partnership opportunities that advance Hilton's strategic marketing priorities, strengthen customer relevance, and create differentiated value for Hilton Honors members, guests, owners, and partners.
  • Commercial and Contract Leadership: Partner with Legal, Finance, Procurement, and business stakeholders to support negotiations, renewals, contracting, compliance, rights management, and risk mitigation across the partnership lifecycle.
  • Performance Governance: Establish measurement frameworks, scorecards, business reviews, and reporting processes to track partner performance, identify optimization opportunities, and communicate impact to senior leaders.

How You'll Collaborate With Others

  • Serve as a senior partnership lead across cross-functional go-to-market teams, partnering with integrated marketing, partnership activation, loyalty, brand, communications, sales, owner relations, finance, legal, and regional teams to integrate partnership priorities into business plans.
  • Build trusted relationships with external partners, agencies, vendors, and internal stakeholders, ensuring shared objectives, clear ways of working, and execution across global and regional initiatives.
  • Influence senior leaders and cross-functional teams by translating partner opportunities, market trends, and business requirements into clear recommendations, decision points, and action plans.
  • Lead, coach, and develop partnership management resources, setting priorities, building scalable processes, and fostering a culture across the Global Strategic Partnerships team.

Deliverables You'll Take Ownership Of

  • Global partnership strategy roadmap, including integrated marketing priorities, growth opportunities, partner segmentation, and annual planning recommendations.
  • Partner business plans, models, governance calendars, executive business reviews, and performance scorecards.
  • New partnership evaluation materials, business cases, negotiation inputs, onboarding plans, and launch readiness documents.
  • Cross-functional go-to-market plans that connect partner capabilities to global and regional integrated marketing priorities.
  • Budget plans, investment recommendations, ROI narratives, and executive reporting that demonstrate partnership value and inform future decision-making.

What It Takes to Make the Stay

You Have These Minimum Qualifications

  • Ten (10) years of professional experience
  • Five (5) years of experience in partnership strategy, strategic alliances, partner management, and/or sponsorships (preferably within a consumer brand, hospitality, travel, entertainment, sports, or agency environment)
  • Experience supporting negotiations, renewals, business cases, partner value propositions, contract deliverables, budget management, and/or financial reporting.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex, high-value partner relationships and translating strategic priorities into actionable plans, initiatives, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams, influence senior stakeholders, and build alignment across internal and external partner teams.
  • Experience developing performance frameworks, partner scorecards, executive reporting, and/or ROI narratives that connect partnership activity to business impact.
  • This is a McLean, VA based role (on average, in office 3 days per week)

It Would Be Useful If You Have

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Hospitality, or a related field; advanced degree or relevant certifications
  • Travel/Hospitality industry experience
  • Experience with managing celebrity partnerships for a major brand

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we're known for doesn't end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members' wellbeing, supporting you through all of life's moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
  • Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
  • Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
  • Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
  • Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
  • Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Generous paid time off (PTO) – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters most
  • Health & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family covered
  • Financial security for your future – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what's next
  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member's location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

Expedia Technology teams partner with our Product teams to create innovative products, services, and tools that deliver high-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction.

Within Traveler & Partner Service Platform, you will lead the Agent Tools organization. This team builds the systems customer service agents use to support travelers, partners, and B2B customers, including the agent desktop, case management, routing, and knowledge tools. You will help evolve the platform toward an AI-first, human-supported service model.

Key Responsibilities

In this role, you will:

  • Define and deliver the multi-year product and technology roadmap for Agent Tools across Retail, Vrbo, B2B, and financial-institution partner channels.
  • Lead the Salesforce Service Cloud agent desktop build-out and migration from legacy platforms, sequencing investment and managing delivery risk through cutover.
  • Advance AI-assisted resolution capabilities, including agent assist, smart routing, and knowledge surfacing, to improve service quality, first-contact resolution, and efficiency.
  • Partner with Service Platform, AI for Travelers, Operational Excellence, and Traveler, Partner, and B2B Operations leaders to translate frontline insights into product priorities.
  • Build clear business cases and prioritize tooling investments against measurable outcomes, including adoption, reliability, handle time, cases per agent, self-service rate, contact propensity, and cost per contact.
  • Build and lead a distributed product and engineering organization, developing leaders, strengthening team capability, and supporting succession planning.
  • Champion Expedia Group’s Leadership Agreements—Grow, Own, Include—through decisions, communication, and talent practices.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement, experimentation, measurement, and iteration.

Required

Experience and Qualifications

  • 10+ years of product and/or technology leadership experience, including at least 3 years leading product and engineering teams that build customer service, CRM, or platform capabilities at scale.
  • Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud or comparable agent desktop and CRM platforms, including modernization or migration from legacy technology.
  • Experience delivering service automation through product, technology, and AI, including large-scale agent tooling or self-service capabilities.
  • Experience leading in a medium-to-large, highly matrixed organization and aligning senior Product, Technology, and Operations stakeholders around shared outcomes.
  • Proficient communication, stakeholder engagement, operational measurement, and people leadership skills.

Preferred

  • Experience in travel, retail, technology, or another consumer-focused industry.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML applications in customer service and modern service-platform architectures.
  • Experience managing metrics such as CSAT/NPS, productivity, cost per contact, contact propensity, or self-service rate.
  • Experience building diverse, distributed teams across multiple locations

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

This role is based at our corporate office in McLean, VA

The Senior Director, Marketing Performance and Growth will lead a new team responsible for ensuring Hilton's marketing investments are driving optimal brand and commercial outcomes. This is a critical leadership role designed to move Hilton from insight-rich reporting to faster optimization across paid media, digital direct commerce, creative, and growth channels.

This role has accountability for optimization across multiple teams with the goal of reducing the time it takes to move from insight to action. This leader will establish a dedicated performance and optimization hub within Marketing, creating a new operating system with clear ownership, tighter decision-making, and measurable impact on ROI, brand health, channel growth, and digital direct commerce performance.

The Senior Director will be accountable for building the team, operating cadence, cross-functional model, and performance discipline needed to continuously improve how Hilton invests, learns, reallocates, and grows.

What You'll Do During a Typical Day

  • Lead the Marketing Performance & Optimization team, establishing the vision, operating model, governance, and day-to-day ways of working for a new embedded optimization capability.
  • Build a faster insight-to-action model that turns performance signals into concrete recommendations, budget shifts, channel adjustments, creative learnings, and measurable outcomes.
  • Optimize paid media investment and performance across major channels, partnering with media, regional marketing, finance, analytics, and agency teams to ensure spend is continuously evaluated and redeployed toward the highest-value opportunities.
  • Diagnose and improve digital direct commerce performance, identifying opportunities across web, mobile, CRM, media, and other growth channels to accelerate revenue and conversion outcomes.
  • Define, test, and scale growth channels by establishing a disciplined test-and-learn agenda, clear measurement frameworks, and repeatable playbooks for scaling what works.
  • Establish a clear operating cadence for the team, including daily performance signal reviews and anomaly detection, weekly optimization recommendations and budget-shift discussions, and monthly channel role and investment recalibration.
  • Build and maintain marketing tagging and tracking methodology in partnership with Marketing Technology team.
  • Create accountability against goal delivery, ensuring optimization work is tied directly to business outcomes rather than reporting activity alone.
  • Translate complex performance data into clear executive narratives and recommendations that help senior leaders make decisions about marketing investment, channel strategy, and growth opportunities.

How You'll Collaborate With Others

  • Partner closely with Strategy, Insights & Analytics, Finance, Media teams, Regional Marketing leaders, and Agencies to ensure measurement, investment decisions, and optimization actions are connected and aligned.
  • Build and develop a high-performing team with the specialized skills required to drive continuous optimization across analytics, media performance, creative insights, and growth strategy

Deliverables You'll Take Ownership Of

  • Own end-to-end accountability for improving the performance of Hilton's marketing investments, with a focus on paid media efficiency, digital direct commerce growth, channel performance, and commercial return.

What It Takes to Make the Stay

You Have These Minimum Qualifications

  • Twelve plus (12+) years of experience in marketing performance, media strategy, digital commerce, growth marketing, marketing analytics, or related commercial leadership roles.
  • Demonstrated experience managing or influencing large-scale marketing investment decisions across paid media, digital, CRM, mobile, web, or performance channels.
  • Strong understanding of marketing ROI, incrementality, attribution, media measurement, audience strategy, and performance optimization.
  • Experience turning data and insights into practical actions that improve business outcomes.
  • Experience building or leading cross-functional operating models across marketing, analytics, finance, agencies, and commercial teams.
  • Simplify complex performance topics and influence senior stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated leadership of teams, including building new capabilities, setting priorities, and creating accountability in matrixed organizations.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and standing up new ways of working where roles, processes, and decision rights need to be clarified.

It Would Be Useful If You Have

  • Experience in hospitality, travel, retail, loyalty, ecommerce, or another multi-channel consumer business.
  • Experience working in a global or regionally matrixed organization.
  • Familiarity with Marketing Mix Modeling, incrementality testing, media optimization tools, customer data platforms, and agency performance management.
  • Experience connecting creative testing and media optimization to commercial outcomes.

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we're known for doesn't end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members' wellbeing, supporting you through all of life's moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
  • Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
  • Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
  • Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
  • Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
  • Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Generous paid time off (PTO) – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters most
  • Health & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family covered
  • Financial security for your future – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what's next
  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member's location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

Hilton offers its eligible team members a comprehensive benefits package to support their mental and physical well-being, so they can Thrive personally and professionally. The pay range for this role is $175,000 – $230,000 and is determined based on applicable and specialized experience and location. Subject to plan terms and conditions, you will be eligible to participate in the Hilton Annual Incentive (Bonus) Plan, and the Company's long-term incentive plan, consistent with other team members at the same level and/or position within the Company.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

As Senior Product Manager in Loyalty, you will own how loyalty value is communicated to members across the full journey, from pre-trip through shopping, booking, and post-trip engagement. You will define the messaging hierarchy, simplify a fragmented experience into one that is clear and personally relevant, and ensure that every member touchpoint reflects what loyalty is worth to them, not just how it works. Your focus will be on BEX while designing scalable solutions that can be applied in other brands. This role sits at the intersection of product, commercial strategy, and member experience. You will work closely with TEaL, XD, and Loyalty Tech teams and other product team to turn a complex programme into a simple, compelling story.

In This Role, You Will

  • Own the end-to-end loyalty messaging strategy across the member journey, defining a clear, value-led messaging hierarchy from pre-trip discovery through shopping, booking, and post-trip engagement.
  • Lead pre-booking and shopping messaging strategy so members see the most relevant earn, discount, or benefit message at the moment it most influences their decision to book.
  • Define and optimize post-booking and confirmation messaging to ensure members clearly understand what they earned, how loyalty benefits them, and why returning for their next trip is worth it.
  • Align loyalty messaging with BEX’s “win the whole trip” strategy by creating a coherent, multi-LOB story across hotels, flights, packages, cars, and activities, with consistent but context-aware rules for each line of business.
  • Partner closely with TEaL, XD, Loyalty Tech, and other product teams to translate a complex loyalty program into simple, compelling member-facing narratives and scalable frameworks that can be applied across Expedia Group brands.
  • Use research, analytics, and experimentation to measure messaging comprehension, member activation, and repeat booking impact, iterating on messaging strategies and safely integrating AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows that improve member and business outcomes.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of product management experience in consumer-facing products, including significant work on member, loyalty, or similar value-centric experiences.
  • Proven track record owning end-to-end messaging or member communication strategy (not only feature delivery), including defining hierarchies, frameworks, and cross-journey narratives.
  • Demonstrated experience collaborating across commercial, design, and engineering stakeholders to drive alignment on product narratives and implement messaging at scale across multiple touchpoints or lines of business.
  • Familiarity with experimentation and iterative testing as core tools for measuring messaging effectiveness, using data to refine what is shown, where, and when across the funnel.
  • Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products, including safely integrating and operating AI/ML‑enabled solutions that enhance personalization, targeting, or testing of loyalty messaging.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading loyalty or membership value communication across complex, multi-product or multi-brand ecosystems, with accountability for measurable improvements in engagement, activation, or repeat booking behavior.
  • Depth in designing and evolving cross-LOB messaging rules and frameworks that balance consistency with contextual accuracy for hotels, flights, packages, cars, and activities in a global, high-scale environment.
  • Strong background partnering with research and analytics to design robust measurement frameworks for comprehension, behavior change, and long-term value, and using those insights to inform product and messaging roadmaps.
  • Demonstrated experience taking products or member-facing communication strategies from concept through launch to scaled adoption, including structured A/B testing, iterative optimization, and ongoing lifecycle management.
  • Hands-on experience leveraging AI/ML-enabled solutions to improve how, when, and where loyalty value is communicated (for example, personalization, dynamic message selection, or automated experimentation), with a focus on safety, transparency, and member trust.

The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $173,000.00 to $242,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $277,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role. The total cash range for this position in San Jose is $187,000.00 to $261,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $299,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

What you’ll do

ICM platform configuration and solution delivery

  • Translate incentive-plan requirements, terms and conditions, and business rules into effective ICM platform configurations.
  • Own or contribute to functional design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-release validation for new plans, plan changes, and enhancements.
  • Document calculation logic, data flows, configuration decisions, dependencies, and operational procedures.
  • Identify opportunities to use ICM platform capabilities, best practices, and approved AI tools to improve reliability, scalability, and user experience.
  • Use AI-assisted approaches to accelerate requirements analysis, configuration drafting, reuse of proven patterns, identification of edge cases, and preparation of configuration documentation; validate all AI-generated outputs against approved requirements and controls.

Data integrations and data quality

  • Own or support data integrations into the ICM platform from HR, attainment, and other operational data sources.
  • Monitor data loads and investigate failures, missing records, mapping issues, and data-quality exceptions.
  • Partner with Analytics, Data/Engineering, and HR Operations to validate source data and reconcile discrepancies.
  • Use SQL to inspect, validate, and troubleshoot data across multiple sources.

Testing, release management, and controls

  • Create and maintain test plans, test cases, test scripts, regression coverage, and release evidence.
  • Use AI-supported QA to compare requirements with configurations, expand test coverage, identify inconsistencies, summarize test results, and highlight likely regression risks, with human review before release decisions.
  • Validate plan calculations and downstream outputs when configurations change or defects are fixed.
  • Apply disciplined change-management practices, including documentation, approvals, testing, and traceability through the team’s ticketing and backlog processes.
  • Support SOX and audit requirements related to plan configuration, data connections, user access, and change management.

Operational support and troubleshooting

  • Support Incentive Operations during payout and accrual cycles, including investigation of calculation errors, data discrepancies, and system issues.
  • Triage production problems, assess impact, coordinate resolution, and communicate status clearly to stakeholders.
  • Work with the ICM platform vendor support team to diagnose critical errors, test fixes, and coordinate safe production rollouts.
  • Use AI-assisted triage and analysis to summarize errors, identify patterns across incidents, develop root-cause hypotheses, and accelerate runbook updates.
  • Help turn recurring incidents into permanent fixes, improved controls, or clearer operating procedures.

Access, backlog, and stakeholder management

  • Review and manage user access rights and support license provisioning in the ICM platform.
  • Maintain a prioritized backlog of features, configuration changes, defects, technical debt, and control improvements.
  • Estimate effort, identify dependencies, and communicate timelines and risks for delivery work.
  • Build trusted relationships with technical and non-technical partners, explaining system behavior and trade-offs in a clear, practical way.

What we’re looking for

Required Experience And Skills

  • Four or more years of hands-on programming, configuration, or technical administration in an Incentive Compensation Management (ICM) platform such as Captivate IQ, SAP Callidus Commissions, Varicent or comparable platforms.
  • Practical experience configuring calculation logic, testing plan changes, troubleshooting defects, and supporting production releases.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience integrating, validating, or reconciling data from multiple sources.
  • Demonstrated ability to create structured test plans, test cases, test scripts, and regression coverage.
  • Ability to translate business requirements and incentive-plan rules into robust technical solutions.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and investigative skills, with close attention to detail.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to work effectively across Operations, Analytics, HR, Finance, IT, and vendor teams.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities in a controlled, deadline-driven environment.

Helpful Additional Experience

  • Understanding of sales incentive plans, pay cycles, accruals, attainment data, and terms and conditions.
  • Experience with Workday or other HR-system data flows.
  • Experience with data tools such as Querybook, Tableau, or equivalent platforms.
  • Experience and ability to use AI in ICM plan configuration and rollout, including configuration support, test design, regression analysis, defect triage, maintenance, and technical documentation.
  • Experience using JIRA for ticketing, backlog, release, and change management.
  • Experience applying SOX, audit, access-control, or other governance requirements to a compensation or financial-technology system.
  • Curiosity, technical adaptability, and enthusiasm for learning new technologies.

What success looks like

During Your First 6–12 Months, You Will Be Making The Platform And The Operating Model More Dependable And Easier To Scale. Success Will Include

  • ICM platform configurations and plan changes are delivered with clear requirements, thorough testing, and reliable release evidence.
  • ICM platform data integrations and loads are monitored proactively, with issues diagnosed and resolved before they affect payout or accrual cycles.
  • Stakeholders have clear documentation of calculation logic, data flows, controls, and operational procedures.
  • Production issues are triaged quickly, communicated clearly, and converted into lasting fixes or process improvements.
  • Access, change-management, and audit controls are consistently applied.
  • Backlog reflects business priorities, realistic estimates, visible dependencies, and clear ownership.
  • AI is used thoughtfully to reduce repetitive work and improve speed and quality without weakening data privacy, access controls, auditability, or human accountability.

About The Role

It's a great time to join us at Airlines Reporting Corporation (ARC)! ARC accelerates the growth of global air travel by delivering forward-looking travel data, flexible distribution services and other innovative industry solutions. We are a leading travel intelligence company with the world’s largest, most comprehensive global airline ticket dataset, including more than 15 billion passenger flights. By working here, you can contribute to solutions and expertise that strengthen economies and enrich lives. We think big, embrace challenges and explore new ideas to lead the way for the travel industry.

ARC is looking for a talented Senior Director, Data Platform Engineering to d efine and execute the strategic vision and roadmap for the enterprise data platform. In this role, you will drive the development and operation of scalable, secure, and resilient data capabilities that enable analytics, AI, and business intelligence across the organization. You will provide technology leadership for data platform engineering, establish standards and best practices, and ensure delivery excellence through effective portfolio management, governance, and oversight. You will work closely with business and technology leaders to translate business priorities into platform capabilities, drive modernization and innovation initiatives, and ensure the successful execution, performance, and evolution of the organization's data platform ecosystem.

What You'll Get To Do

  • Enterprise Data Platform Ownership: Set the technology vision and lead execution of the enterprise data platform portfolio to ensure delivery excellence, platform resiliency, and operational efficiency. Own and advance ARC's enterprise data platform, to ensure it is architected, built, and scaled to meet the current and future data needs of ARC's data products, analytics, and business operations — not any single product or team. Champion modernization initiatives spanning data integration, ingestion, quality, observability, automation, and AI-ready architecture to support advanced analytics and digital objectives.
  • Strategic Technology Partnership: Serve as the front-end technology partner to ARC's data product organization and other business stakeholders to develop strategic roadmaps to meet commercial and enterprise objectives as well as advance core platform capabilities. Partner & collaborate across business divisions, data products, and technology to ensure the data platform enables current initiatives while proactively building toward future enterprise needs.
  • Data Engineering Capability & Workforce Strategy: Define and execute a multi-year data engineering capability and workforce strategy — including team structure, skills, and staffing — to ensure the function can meet growing enterprise demand.
  • Team Leadership: Lead and develop data engineering organization, building a high-performing team to foster a culture of excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.
  • Champion AI Enablement: Act as a critical partner to the AI engineering teams to ensure our data infrastructure and practices are optimized to support and accelerate AI.
  • Enhance Data Security and Governance: Partner with Corporate Security to define and implement policies and systems to safeguard data privacy, ensure compliance, and protect sensitive information. Ensure robust data access controls, audit trails, and data retention policies.

You'll Bring These Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field; equivalent experience considered.
  • 10+ years of experience in data engineering, data platform, or enterprise data architecture roles, including 5+ years in a leadership capacity.
  • Demonstrated experience building and scaling enterprise data platforms and leading data engineering teams.
  • Experience with modern data platform technologies (e.g., cloud data warehousing, ETL/ELT pipelines, data lake/lakehouse architectures).
  • Proven ability to partner with business and product stakeholders to translate needs into technical roadmaps.
  • Strong workforce planning and organizational development skills.
  • Excellent communication and executive presentation skills.

ARC123

What We Can Offer You

  • Joining ARC means joining a team that is motivated, diverse, creative, collaborative and solutions-oriented. We think big, embrace challenges, and explore new ideas to lead the way for the travel industry.
  • Our employees value the hands-on learning and professional development opportunities that allow them to expand their skills and grow their career in new, dynamic ways.
  • ARC offers WorkFlex. WorkFlex is ARC’s hybrid work program which offers eligible employees the flexibility to work from home while also requiring in office workdays throughout the year to foster collaboration and connection throughout the organization. We’ve designed WorkFlex to enable employees to succeed and thrive while maintaining strong connections to one another and ARC - both of which are critical to our shared success.
  • We offer a highly competitive, comprehensive benefits package so you can worry less and focus on what truly matters. Please click here to review our benefits on our company website.
  • By joining ARC, you will partner with top minds in the industry as we use data and technology to innovate how the world travels.

The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, allowing for meaningful future salary growth within the position.

EOE M/F/D/V Females and Minorities Encouraged to Apply

Job Title

Technical Business Analyst

External Job Title: Technical business analyst

Position type: Permanent

Location: Irving, Texas, Hybrid

About Your Business Area/Department

At Outpayce from Amadeus, our motto is Simply paid!

Outpayce delivers smooth travel payments at every step of the travel experience – from booking to airports, flights, hotels, and beyond – while simplifying and optimizing pay-ments for travel players. Serving every part of the global travel landscape, we’re build-ing a payments ecosystem that connects travel companies to the latest travel fintech inno-vations with an aim to improve the payment experience for travelers.

We have our unique position between merchants, payment partners, and travel, we have the experience and insight to help merchants to maximize sales, reduce costs, and im-prove efficiency. With our B2B payments, Merchants pay their global suppliers, simply. Our payment platform connects Merchants to card issuers in a range of markets to give them a choice, reach, and orchestration when paying for travel content.

To know more on Outpayce from Amadeus, visit https://www.outpayce.com/en

Summary Of The Role

You will join a globally distributed team across Dallas, Nice, and Bangalore that manages one of the most critical and complex products in the Payments domain. Your expertise will help shape and evolve the Amadeus Payment Platform, which processes millions of payments daily through credit card networks, acquiring banks, and alternative payment providers such as PayPal. You will combine product management and solutioning expertise, provide guidance and mentorship, drive innovation, translate strategy into actionable plans, influence departmental direction, and independently lead initiatives while promoting best practices and operational excellence.

In This Role You’ll

Technical & Functional Excellence

  • Establish standards for product definition activities, including specifications and solution design.
  • Analyze highly complex business problems and translate business needs into new product concepts, enhancements, and upgrades.
  • Design solutions to complex problems and support cross-area solution design, including architecture proposals for new products.
  • Support Pre-Sales activities and participate in Business Requirement Matrix (BRM) assessments.
  • Lead or review solution sizing, specifications, process engineering, and business flow assessments for complex and cross-functional initiatives.
  • Define recovery, action, and risk mitigation plans in case of system failures and ensure processes are followed from requirements through production.

Quality, Validation & Continuous Improvement

  • Create customer feedback mechanisms and solve business problems through a clear methodology and appropriate documentation.
  • Recommend improvements to specifications, documentation, solution design, and proactive maintenance practices.
  • Contribute to test strategy implementation, review test plans, ensure test traceability, and validate delivered functionality and system integrity.
  • Investigate, validate, and prioritize reported incidents to ensure production integrity.

Collaboration, Leadership & Knowledge Sharing

  • Coach, mentor, train, and provide guidance to Product Definition Analysts, QA Engineers, Software Development Engineers, and other less experienced professionals.
  • Serve as a key liaison between engineering, architecture, product, QA, customers, and other stakeholders through effective communication and collaboration.
  • Contribute to onboarding, communities of practice, organizational transformation initiatives, and knowledge sharing across teams.
  • Support Agile team and ART ceremonies, product feature definition, RFP/RFI responses, product promotion, customer presentations, demos, and product launches.
  • Contribute to delivery planning, customer relationship management, and the sharing of product, system flow, architecture, and engineering knowledge.

About The Ideal Candidate

  • 3+ years experience preferably in Payments or Airlines/travel domains – in capacity of a business ana-lyst is a plus.
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering / sciences or related fields.
  • Work experience in Agile / SaFe framework is preferred.

What We Can Offer You

  • Get rewarded with competitive remuneration, individual and company annual bonus, vacation and holiday paid time off, health insurances and other competitive benefits.
  • Professional development to broaden your knowledge and enhance your skills with on-line learning hubs packed with technical and soft skills training that allow you to de-velop and grow.
  • Enter a diverse and inclusive workplace, join one of the world’s top travel technology companies and take on a role that impacts millions of travelers around the globe

Application Process

The application process takes no longer than 10 minutes!

Create your candidate profile, upload your Resume/CV and apply today!

Working At Amadeus, You Will Find

🎯 A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you will be powering the future of travel and pursuing a critical mission and extraordinary purpose.

🌎 A truly global DNA - Everything at Amadeus is global, from our people to our business, which translates into our footprint, processes, and culture.

🎓 Great opportunities to learn - Learning happens all the time and in many ways at Amadeus, through on-the-job training, formal learning activities, and day-to-day interactions with colleagues.

🤗 A caring environment - Amadeus fosters a caring environment, nurturing both a fulfilling career and personal and family life. We care about our employees and strive to provide a supportive work environment.

💰 A complete rewards offer - Amadeus provides attractive remuneration packages, covering all essential components of a competitive reward offer, including salary, bonus, equity, and benefits.

🌟 A flexible working model - We want our employees to do their best work, wherever and however it works best for them.

🌈 A diverse and inclusive community - We are committed to leveraging our uniquely diverse population to drive innovation, creativity, and collaboration across our organization.

📈 A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental values that drive our actions and shape long-lasting relationships with our customers, partners, and employees.

Diversity & Inclusion

Amadeus is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or a related medical condition), ancestry, national origin, age, genetic information, military or veterans status, sexual orientation, gender expression, perception, or identity, marital status, mental or physical disability status, or any other protected federal, state, or local status unrelated to performance of work involved.

Amadeus endeavors to make https://jobs.amadeus.com/ accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us at accommodations@amadeus.com. About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

This role is based in Bangkok, Thailand, and is open to candidates worldwide. We offer a generous relocation package to ensure a smooth transition to living and working in Bangkok.

Get to Know Our Team:

The Performance Marketing Team of Agoda is a world leader in online marketing. We are highly data-driven and focused on developing at-scale marketing programs that improve the lifetime value of our customers.

Our team is a blend of the bright analysts, marketing strategists, and data scientists in the world. We foster a great learning environment where you will be able to learn and grow by working closely with experts from a variety of backgrounds from all over the world.

With Performance Marketing, MSE is a business development and marketing role within Agoda’s marketing department. It involves working with online vertical search advertisers (Meta Search Engines) to drive hotel booking sales.

In this role, you'll get to:

  • Own and manage marketing spend with large Meta Search Engine (MSE) partners
  • Independently manage your accounts
  • Manage the commercial relationship with MSE partners, including commercial terms, bidding and pricing strategies, and technical implementation
  • Decide in coordination with the Bidding and Pricing teams strategies that deliver expected ROIs and revenue growth
  • Track detailed performance/KPIs and deliver regular data-driven actionable insights to improve results
  • Succinctly communicate the results, ideas, and business statistics with different stakeholders
  • Ensure the advertiser implements the right Agoda APIs and related technological innovations
  • Be immersed and intimately familiar with the entire booking funnel including the user experience and conversion drivers between the advertiser and Agoda
  • Build long term relationships with advertisers that foster new opportunities and continuous growth in return from advertising dollars

What you’ll need to succeed:

  • Bachelor Degree in Computer Science/Statistics/Math or Engineering or Economics and Finance
  • Business development and/or account management track record with experience in online marketing
  • Fluent in English with strong communication skills (both written and verbal)
  • Self-motivated person with “Get it done!” attitude
  • Passionately analytical with strong ability to think logically and excellent problem-solving skills
  • Proficient in business intelligence tools and data warehouse i.e. SQL, Tableau and MS Excel
  • Ability to effectively communicate, influence and persuade with different levels of stakeholders (including Senior Management) with proven strong commercial acumen
  • Ability to represent Agoda with experience in interacting with external senior level executives
  • Strong analytical and statistical analysis skills to extract insights and recommendations

job.job_description:
Description de l'entreprise

Orfea, qui sommes-nous ?

Orfea est un acteur spécialisé dans l’hébergement hôtelier, dédié aux déplacements professionnels du personnel ferroviaire. Filiale des groupes SNCF et Accor, l’entreprise s’appuie sur une double expertise – connaissance des besoins opérationnels et savoir-faire hôtelier – pour proposer des solutions d’hébergement adaptées, fiables et de qualité aux personnels SNCF en déplacement professionnel.

Son activité repose sur l’exploitation de résidences hôtelières situées à proximité des gares, ainsi que sur un réseau élargi d’hôtels partenaires à l’échelle nationale.

L’objectif est de garantir aux collaborateurs SNCF en mobilité des conditions d’accueil et d’hébergement optimales, alliant confort, proximité et continuité de service, tout en proposant une offre flexible répondant aux contraintes opérationnelles des déplacements professionnels.

Orfea, quelles sont nos missions ?

Proposer un hébergement sur-mesure au sein du réseau des résidences Orfea et des prestataires hôteliers pour une activité d’1.5 millions de nuitées/an.

Offrir des solutions clef en main pour l’organisation de réunions et de séminaires.

Orfea, quelles sont nos valeurs ?

Engagement, coopération, satisfaction client, sens de l’hospitalité.

Au-delà de l’exigence sur les fondamentaux de la relation client en hôtellerie, Orfea s’assure du développement des compétences de ses collaborateurs, en proposant des parcours formation adaptés et sur-mesure aux besoins des équipes.

La Société fonde ses recrutements sur les seules compétences, expériences professionnelles, formations et qualifications des candidats.

Description du poste

Vous souhaitez mettre votre expertise hôtelière au service d’une activité à fort volume, où la qualité de chaque réservation contribue directement à la continuité des opérations de nos clients ?

Dans le cadre de la structuration de notre centrale de réservations, vous prenez la direction d’un dispositif organisé 24 h/24 et 7 j/7, traitant environ 360 000 nuitées par an pour la zone Île-de-France et pour un client majeur à dimension nationale. À la croisée des enjeux opérationnels, managériaux et économiques, vous donnez le cap, sécurisez la continuité de service et faites progresser la performance de l’activité.

À la tête d’une équipe d’une douzaine de collaborateurs, vous organisez les flux de réservations, coordonnez les relations avec les résidences Orfea et les partenaires hôteliers, et veillez à la meilleure utilisation des capacités d’hébergement disponibles. Votre feuille de route : conjuguer réactivité opérationnelle, satisfaction client, maîtrise des coûts et développement des équipes.

Quelles seront vos principales missions ?

PILOTER LA PERFORMANCE ET SÉCURISER L’ACTIVITÉ :

Vous garantissez la fluidité, la fiabilité et l’efficience du traitement des réservations, de l’anticipation des besoins jusqu’au suivi des résultats.

À Ce Titre, Vous :

  • Organisez, priorisez et supervisez les flux de réservations afin de garantir une réponse fiable et réactive, y compris lors des pics d’activité ou des tensions sur les capacités d’accueil ;
  • Coordonnez l’activité avec les Directeurs de résidence (H/F) d’Île-de-France et les fonctions internes concernées, dans une logique de continuité de service et de coopération ;
  • Optimisez l’utilisation des résidences Orfea et des allotements négociés auprès des hôtels partenaires, en conciliant disponibilité, qualité de service et maîtrise des coûts ;
  • Définissez et pilotez les indicateurs clés de l’activité : volumes, taux d’occupation, prix moyen, qualité de traitement, satisfaction client et prévisions d’activité ;
  • Analysez les écarts, arbitrez les priorités et déployez les plans d’action nécessaires à l’amélioration durable des résultats ;
  • Contribuez à l’élaboration budgétaire, au suivi économique de l’activité et à l’identification de nouveaux leviers de performance.

MANAGER, FÉDÉRER ET FAIRE GRANDIR L’ÉQUIPE :

Vous installez un cadre de fonctionnement clair et mobilisateur pour permettre à chacun de contribuer pleinement à la réussite collective.

  • Animez et accompagnez une équipe d’une douzaine de collaborateurs dans un environnement fonctionnant en continu ;
  • Adaptez l’organisation et le dimensionnement de l’équipe aux volumes, aux priorités et aux exigences de service ;
  • Fixez des objectifs lisibles, suivez la performance individuelle et collective et donnez des retours réguliers ;
  • Développez les compétences, favorisez l’autonomie et accompagnez les évolutions de pratiques et d’outils ;
  • Fédérez l’équipe autour d’une culture commune de l’engagement, de la coopération et du service client.

DÉVELOPPER LA QUALITÉ DE SERVICE ET LES PARTENARIATS :

Vous êtes l’interlocuteur de référence des parties prenantes et veillez à la qualité de l’expérience délivrée, de la demande de réservation jusqu’au suivi administratif et financier.

À Ce Titre, Vous :

  • Développez une relation de confiance avec les hôtels partenaires, les résidences Orfea, les clients donneurs d’ordre et les fonctions support ;
  • Animez le réseau de partenaires hôteliers et contribuez, avec le pôle hôtelier, à l’identification de nouvelles solutions d’hébergement ;
  • Garantissez l’application des engagements contractuels, des procédures et des standards de qualité, tout en faisant évoluer les pratiques lorsque cela est nécessaire ;
  • Analysez les retours et les indicateurs de satisfaction, traitez les irritants et pilotez les actions correctrices ;
  • Supervisez la qualité des flux administratifs et financiers, notamment le suivi de la facturation et de la balance âgée, dans le respect des échéances ;

Représentez la centrale lors des échanges avec les clients et contribuez, avec les équipes commerciales, marketing et communication, au développement et au rayonnement de l’offre Orfea.

Qualifications

Vous êtes un manager confirmé, issu de l’hôtellerie, d’un service de réservations ou d’un centre de contacts, et vous souhaitez franchir un cap ? Rejoignez un poste à fort enjeu où vous piloterez une activité de réservations à grande échelle, au cœur d’un environnement exigeant, orienté client et en transformation.

Vous justifiez d’une expérience significative dans le management d’une activité à forts volumes et à forte exigence de service, acquise dans l’hôtellerie, un service de réservations, la relation client à distance ou au sein d’un centre d’appels ou centre de contacts.

Vous Avez Notamment Occupé Des Fonctions Telles Que :

  • Directeur d’hébergement ou Directeur adjoint d’hôtel ;
  • Responsable des réservations ou d’une centrale de réservations ;
  • Superviseur ou responsable d’équipe en centre d’appels ou centre de contacts ;
  • Hyperviseur, responsable de plateau ou manager d’une activité de relation client à distance.

Vous maîtrisez le pilotage de flux, le suivi d’indicateurs de performance, l’organisation des ressources et l’animation d’équipes dans un environnement rythmé par des variations d’activité et des engagements de qualité de service. Une connaissance de l’hôtellerie, des réservations ou de la gestion de partenaires constitue un atout ; elle pourra également être acquise grâce à votre capacité à comprendre rapidement un nouvel environnement métier.

Votre culture du service client et de la performance opérationnelle est reconnue : vous savez conjuguer qualité de traitement, réactivité, respect des engagements de service et amélioration continue.

Compétences clés

  • Pilotage opérationnel : capacité à organiser et optimiser une activité complexe (volumes, flux, priorités)
  • Orientation client et qualité de service : sens du détail, exigence sur les standards et la satisfaction clients
  • Analyse et performance : maîtrise des indicateurs (TO, prix moyen, remplissage, etc.) et capacité à en tirer des leviers d’action
  • Gestion partenariale : aisance dans la relation avec des interlocuteurs variés (hôteliers, équipes terrain, fonctions support)
  • Maîtrise des outils de réservation et des environnements digitaux (idéalement PMS / CRS / outils de pilotage)

Posture et savoir-être

  • Leadership fédérateur : capacité à embarquer, expliquer, donner du sens et faire adhérer
  • Esprit structuré et pragmatique : capable de traiter à la fois les enjeux opérationnels quotidiens et les sujets d’amélioration continue
  • Exigence et sens des responsabilités : orientation résultats dans un contexte de service
  • Qualités de communication : clarté, pédagogie, capacité à travailler en transversal
  • Adaptabilité et réactivité, dans un environnement en évolution

Pourquoi ce poste va vous séduire ?

  • Un rôle clé et stratégique, au cœur du dispositif opérationnel
  • Un périmètre à la fois opérationnel et national, avec un impact direct sur la performance
  • Un environnement qui combine exigence hôtelière et enjeux business
  • L’opportunité de sortir du cadre classique d’un établissement pour piloter une activité transverse à forte visibilité

Informations supplémentaires

  • 13ème mois
  • Prime sur objectifs
  • Prime de participation
  • Tickets Restaurant
  • Mutuelle et prévoyance avantageuses
  • Carte All Heartist Accor

job.job_description:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Lifecycle Coordinator plays a critical role in ensuring Choice-branded hotels are accurately represented and fully bookable across all distribution channels throughout key lifecycle events, including openings, rebrands, suspensions, reinstatements, and terminations. This role is responsible for the integrity of hotel data, rate accuracy, and seamless distribution across OTA, GDS, and direct booking platforms—directly impacting hotel visibility, guest booking experience, and revenue performance. Serving as a key operational partner, the Coordinator collaborates cross-functionally with Property Support, Distribution, and IT teams to execute timely updates, resolve system discrepancies, and ensure hotels transition smoothly into market. This role also acts as a frontline resource for lifecycle-related system inquiries and issue resolution. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports, operating within a high-volume, fast-paced support environment.

Note: This role is 4 days onsite in Scottsdale, AZ not eligible for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Distribution & Data Integrity

  • Ensure hotel content (rates, descriptions, amenities, policies, and imagery) is accurate, complete, and consistently displayed across all booking channels.
  • Proactively identify and resolve discrepancies that could impact booking accuracy, guest experience, or revenue.

Hotel Onboarding & Lifecycle Execution

  • Coordinate end-to-end system setup and activation for new hotel openings, rebrands, and relaunches, including pre-sale readiness.
  • Execute lifecycle changes (suspensions, reinstatements, terminations) with precision to prevent booking disruption and guest confusion.
  • Perform system validation checks, including GDS initialization and test bookings, to confirm successful activation.

System & Distribution Coordination

  • Manage data integration from Propel into Choice systems, ensuring accurate property setup and connectivity.
  • Coordinate GDS switches and OTA distribution updates for onboarding and brand transitions.
  • Support secondary name updates and ensure changes are reflected across all platforms and stakeholders.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with internal teams (Property Support, Distribution, IT, and Operations) to ensure hotels are guest-ready and visible at the appropriate time.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for lifecycle-related system questions and issue resolution.

Issue Resolution & Continuous Improvement

  • Troubleshoot system or distribution issues, escalating as needed to drive timely resolution.
  • Identify recurring issues and provide input on process improvements to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Employment Experience

  • One to three years of experience in a customer service, hotel operations, hospitality support, or customer-facing role is strongly preferred.
  • Experience supporting hotel onboarding, distribution setup, rate loading, or connectivity across online travel agency and booking platforms is strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of hospitality reservation, central management, or distribution systems is preferred.
  • Experience with GDS, OTA connectivity, or hotel distribution operations is preferred.
  • Prior hotel industry experience, including exposure to openings, rebrands, or lifecycle support processes, is preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, and Word, with the ability to manage data and communicate clearly.
  • Proficiency with trouble ticket applications, such as ServiceNow, or similar customer support, reporting, and database tools.
  • Familiarity with hotel distribution systems, OTA platforms, GDS workflows, or related reservation technologies is preferred.

Additional Skills & Competencies

  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to identify issues and support timely resolution.
  • Strong verbal, written, and listening communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams and support partners.
  • Excellent interpersonal, organizational, and time-management skills, with strong attention to detail and follow-through.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining accuracy and service quality.

Education Requirements

  • High school diploma or GED required. Associates degree or higher education preferred.

Salary Range

The salary range for this position is $65,698 - $77,292.

Choice prioritizes our associate wellbeing by offering a comprehensive benefits program that is both competitive and flexible to help you achieve your wellbeing goals - here are just a few:

  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Leave and paid time-off for holidays, vacation, personal, family, volunteer, sick, jury duty, bereavement, military, and religious observance
  • Financial benefits for retirement and health savings
  • Employee recognition programs
  • Discounts at Choice hotels worldwide

About Choice

Choice Hotels International, Inc. (NYSE: CHH), is one of the largest lodging franchisors in the world. With 7,500 hotels in 45+ countries and territories, we offer a range of high-quality lodging options in the upper upscale, upper midscale, midscale, extended stay, and economy segments. We’re the hotel company for those who choose to bet on themselves — the striver, the dreamer, the entrepreneur — because that’s who we are, too.

At Choice, we are united by the simple belief that tomorrow will be even better than today — for associates, our company, and our franchisees. At our worldwide corporate headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, at our technology center in Scottsdale, Arizona, and through our associates around the globe, every voice is heard and every idea is listened to, no matter what area of the company they come from. We are united in supporting the entrepreneurial dreams of our thousands of franchise owners, which propels us forward — giving our work at Choice a purpose larger than our business.
