job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

The Continuous Improvement Coach serves as a dedicated Lean transformation practitioner within an assigned TechOps Value Stream and is responsible for leading Kaizen activities, coaching leaders and frontline employees, and supporting deployment of the TechOps Lean operating system ("Flight Path"). This role partners with operational leaders to improve safety, quality, delivery, and cost performance through Structured Problem Solving, Daily Management, standard work, and sustainable process improvements. The position plays a critical role in building organizational capability and accelerating adoption of Lean principles throughout the Value Stream.

The Continuous Improvement Coach works directly with operational teams at Gemba to facilitate transformational improvement activities, develop Lean capabilities, and ensure sustainment of improvement gains. This position serves as a key change agent within the Value Stream and helps leaders embed Flight Path principles into daily operations.

Roles And Responsibilities

  • Lead Kaizen preparation, execution, and sustainment activities to improve value stream performance and achieve safety, quality, delivery, and cost objectives.
  • Coach leaders and teams on Daily Management, Standard Work, and Structured Problem Solving methodologies to improve operational performance and develop organizational capability.
  • Facilitate Mission Control (i.e., weekly Value Stream leadership) reviews, operational improvement activities, and performance management discussions to identify issues, track progress, and drive accountability.
  • Partner with Continuous Improvement Specialists and operational teams to identify process abnormalities, eliminate waste, and implement sustainable countermeasures.
  • Support deployment and sustainment of the Flight Path operating system through coaching, training, facilitation, and change management activities.
  • Facilitate value stream assessments, Kaizen workshops, problem-solving sessions, and team-based improvement events to improve operational effectiveness.
  • Analyze operational performance data and observations from the Gemba to identify root causes, improvement opportunities, and performance trends.
  • Develop and monitor sustainment plans to ensure improvements are maintained and embedded into daily operations.
  • Conduct Gemba walks and coaching activities to reinforce Lean behaviors, identify barriers to performance, and support continuous improvement efforts.
  • Practice safety-conscious behaviors in all operational processes and procedures and promote a culture of safety throughout the organization.

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Operations Management, Aviation Management, or related field preferred; equivalent operational and continuous improvement experience considered.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in operations, maintenance, engineering, manufacturing, continuous improvement, or operational excellence.
  • Demonstrated experience facilitating Lean initiatives, Kaizen events, Structured Problem Solving, or process improvement activities and driving sustainable operational improvements.
  • Experience coaching leaders and employees through organizational change preferred.
  • Working knowledge of Lean, Daily Management, standard work, visual management, and problem-solving methodologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to coach leaders and frontline employees through behavioral, process, and cultural change.
  • Strong facilitation skills with experience leading Kaizen events, problem-solving workshops, operational reviews, and team-based improvement activities.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders and drive adoption of new operating methods without direct authority.
  • Strong communication, presentation, facilitation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to use operational performance data to identify opportunities and guide decision-making.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and other business productivity tools.
  • Ability to work effectively with all organizational levels, from frontline employees to senior leaders.
  • Some travel may be required.
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency.
  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Airline, aviation maintenance, MRO, manufacturing, or other highly regulated operational industry experience.
  • Formal Lean, Lean Six Sigma, Operational Excellence, Continuous Improvement, or Change Management certification.
  • Experience facilitating multiple Kaizen events and leading sustained operational improvement initiatives.
  • Experience implementing Daily Management systems, visual management, leader standard work, and performance management routines.
  • Experience coaching frontline leaders and operational teams in Lean leadership behaviors and structured problem solving.
  • Experience working at Gemba and driving improvements in complex operational environments.
  • Proven track record of improving safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and employee engagement through Lean principles and continuous improvement practices.
  • Experience influencing cultural change and sustaining improvements after implementation.
  • Experience supporting Mission Control reviews, operational performance reviews, and value stream transformation activities.

Benefits And Perks To Help You Keep Climbing

Our culture is rooted in a shared dedication to living our values – Honesty, Integrity, Respect, Perseverance, and Servant Leadership – every day, in everything we do. Exploring a career at Delta gives you a chance to see the world while providing great beneﬁts to help you keep climbing along the way:

  • Competitive salary, performance incentives, industry-leading proﬁt sharing, and 401(k) with generous direct contribution and company match.
  • Paid time off including vacation, holidays, and paid personal time.
  • Comprehensive health beneﬁts including medical, dental, vision, short/long term disability and life beneﬁts.
  • Wellbeing programs to support physical, emotional, social, and financial health, including access to an employee assistance program offering support for you and anyone in your household, free financial coaching, and extensive resources supporting mental health counseling.
  • Domestic and International (standby) Flight privileges for employees and eligible family members.
  • Career development programs to achieve your long-term career goals.
  • Access to over 500 discounts, specialty savings and voluntary benefits through Deltaperks such as car and hotel rentals and auto/homeowners/pet insurances.

Leadership/Team Quote:

Booking.com’s Fintech team is pivotal in developing scalable, compliant, and innovative solutions to support our partners and ensure adherence to global regulatory frameworks. Within this team, the RegTech function is responsible for creating and maintaining the technical architecture that underpins critical processes such as Know Your Customer (KYC), Proof of Address (POA), and Know Your Business (KYB). We are seeking a Senior Commercial Associate – RegTech with regulatory compliance experience, either within commercial operations in Financial Services or within Sales/Account/Project management. You will support the Senior Commercial Manager and work closely with Product and Tech teams to ensure seamless partner experiences and operational excellence.

Role Description:

As a Commercial Associate – RegTech, you will play a supporting role in managing key partner relationships, acting as advisor on compliance requirements, collaborating with cross-functional teams to enhance systems and processes that support partner verification and compliance. This role requires an understanding of KYC/KYB, Screening and other SAAS Compliance tools. Specific regulatory knowledge of PSD3, AMLR/AMLA and EIDAS 2.0 within the EEA context is highly desirable. The ability to support the management of numerous stakeholders (internal and external) with competing priorities; is key to success in this role.

Key Job Responsibilities and Duties:

  • Provide support to the Senior Commercial Manager liaising with (e.g., RegTech, Supplier Fraud Teams) and external vendors to optimize KYC, POA, and KYB solutions, and other Financial Crime solutions, ensuring regulatory compliance
  • Determine and support the input and outputs of a variety of POCs (Proof of Concepts) with prospective vendors - including detailed dat analysis
  • Support the execution and development of commercial strategies with vendors to achieve cost optimizations, expand services, and support Booking.com’s long-term objectives
  • Support the management of commercial contracts, vendor exploration, Proof-of-Concept documentation and Project Management
  • Understanding of compliance frameworks, particularly within the UK, EEA and the Americas, with a keen interest in regulatory compliance changes and divergence across markets
  • Analyze vendor performance against SLAs to drive improvements and decisioning
  • Identify and mitigate potential compliance risks to ensure robust and secure systems and processes


Qualifications & Skills:

  • Experience: 5+ years in compliance operations, Sales, account management, or technical Project Management, preferably in the Fintech, Banking and/or Regtech, Candidates must have experience working in a Regulated environment
  • Data Science and Data Analytics experience - specifically in the Financial Crime space related to evaluation of Proof-of Concept results, and setting parameters for these tests
  • Legal / commercial Contract skills ; experience with contract negotiations
  • Technical Acumen: Familiarity with the technical architecture and solutions involved in KYC, POA, KYB and other Regtech solutions
  • Compliance experience: Knowledge of regulatory requirements, particularly in sectors such as financial services, hospitality, or technology.
  • Account Management Skills: Demonstrated ability to support complex partner relationships, service reviews, and align with business goals
  • Data-Driven Approach: Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret performance metrics and drive data-informed decision-making


Benefits & Perks - Global Impact, Personal Relevance:

Booking.com’s Total Rewards Philosophy is not only about compensation but also about benefits. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, as well unique-to-Booking.com benefits which include:

  • Annual paid time off and generous paid leave scheme including: parent, grandparent, bereavement, and care leave

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion have been a core part of our company culture since day one. This ongoing journey starts with our very own employees, who represent over 140 nationalities and a wide range of ethnic and social backgrounds, genders and sexual orientations.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Senior Director, Talent Strategy Partner

Introduction To The Team

Our Corporate Functions are made up of teams that support Expedia Group, including our Global Finance Org., Traveler and Partner Service Platform, Legal Team, Strategy and Corporate Development Team, and People & Places Org.

As part of Expedia Group’s Talent team, the Senior Director, Talent Strategy Partner is a senior expert that shapes and delivers the talent and organization agenda for our divisions. You operate comfortably at both the strategic and tactical levels, pairing big-picture thinking about talent with a hands-on approach to analysis and execution. You put the traveler first by ensuring we have the leadership, capabilities, talent strategy, and organizational design to build world-class travel experiences at scale.

In This Role, You Will

Talent Strategy Delivery

  • Partner with HRBP Leaders to co‑create divisional talent agendas (e.g., capability building, leadership pipelines, mobility and development strategies) that drive near‑term priorities and longer‑term strategic plans.
  • Assess global talent and learning needs to define critical capability gaps; Translate these insights into an integrated talent strategy and roadmap that leverages data-driven health metrics to scale organizational performance.
  • Lead end‑to‑end succession planning and talent reviews for key leadership and critical roles, in partnership with HRBP Leaders and divisional leadership teams. Partnering with Talent Acquisition on VP+ executive pipelines.
  • Use talent and organizational health metrics to identify strengths, risks, and pipeline gaps, turning insights into concrete actions (development, moves, hiring, coaching).
  • Coach leaders and HRBPs on consistent talent identification and assessment practices, ensuring our processes are equitable and support diversity, equity, and inclusion.

Organization Design Consulting

  • Influence leaders to arrive at efficient, scalable, strategy-aligned org structures by leveraging org design expertise and best practices, including diagnostics, scenario design, options analysis.
  • Ensure org design aligns with enterprise frameworks and strategies, including headcount plans, financial guardrails, and enterprise org and talent standards (e.g., leveling guidelines).

Data Insights & Governance

  • Use talent and org health metrics (e.g., performance, succession, promotion, attrition, engagement) to generate insights and storylines that inform talent and org decisions at the divisional and enterprise level.
  • Track and communicate progress against talent and succession outcomes (bench strength, diversity outcomes, critical role coverage, internal mobility) and refine strategies based on these insights.
  • Role model an ownership mindset by treating divisional talent and org health as your business – focusing on long‑term value, not just the current cycle.

Enterprise Talent Champion

  • Lead readiness and change management to ensure talent products are flawlessly launched and deeply embedded for HRBPs, leaders, and employees.
  • Serve as the definitive subject matter expert (SME) for HRBPs and leaders on global talent products (e.g., EG Performance Management products), championing their implementation to drive the right results.
  • Influence enterprise talent strategies and product roadmaps by leveraging deep insight about HRBPs’, leaders’, and employees’ needs to ensure simple, scalable, and well understood products, processes, and playbooks.

Collaborate across the People Team and Expedia Group

  • Work closely with Talent Management, Organizational Effectiveness, Learning, Total Rewards, People Tech, People Analytics and HRBPs to bring an integrated People perspective to leaders.
  • Succeed together by sharing best practices, case studies and tools with HRBPs and Talent colleagues to raise the bar on talent, org design, and change capabilities across EG.

Experience And Qualifications

  • 14+ years' experience in the areas of Talent Management, Organizational Development/Effectiveness, and/or HR Business Partnering.
  • Proven experience partnering with C-suite and senior leaders in complex, global, matrixed organizations, operating as a high‑influence individual contributor who leads through expertise and relationships rather than direct authority.
  • Demonstrated impact shaping global talent and org strategies with significant scope and complexity (e.g., multiple regions, functions/divisions, or large-scale transformations).
  • Talent management expertise: deep understanding of performance, potential, readiness, and succession frameworks; able to coach leaders and HRBPs in using them effectively.
  • Org design & change management: able to diagnose organizational issues, design and evaluate alternative structures, and create pragmatic change and transition plans that leaders can execute.
  • Data fluency: able to interpret people and business data, identify patterns and risks, tell a clear story, and use insights to guide decisions and measure impact.
  • Relationship building & collaboration: trusted partner to HRBPs and leaders; actively connects across Talent, Org Effectiveness, Learning and other COEs to deliver integrated solutions.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Organizational Psychology, Business, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Advanced degree in Industrial/Organizational Psychology or related field, and/or professional certifications in Assessments (e.g., Prosci, Hogan, Insights), OD, Change Management, or Coaching (e.g., ICF ACC) are a plus.

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

job.job_description:
Senior UX Researcher - (Hybrid)

As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, " What's the next step?’’ Start your journey with us!

We're seeking an experienced Senior UX Researcher to join our UX Research team in Barcelona (hybrid). We are looking for a Senior User Researcher to become the dedicated research and intelligence partner for Prime, the heart of eDreams ODIGEO’s business. You will connect evidence from across flights, hotels, rail, ancillaries, payments, Customer Experience and international markets to create an integrated understanding of the Prime member journey. You will identify the strategic knowledge gaps that matter most, lead high-value mixed-methods research and advise Product Directors and executive leaders on opportunities to improve acquisition, engagement, cross-product adoption, retention, revenue and member experience.

If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.

Why eDreams ODIGEO

We’re the world's leading travel subscription platform.

  • We pioneered Prime, the first and world’s leading travel subscription programme since launching in 2017.
  • Millions of Prime members every year across multiple markets.
  • 5 brands: eDreams, GO Voyages, Opodo, Travellink, and the metasearch engine Liligo
  • This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalised service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members.
  • Diversity is our strength that’s why our eDOers are coming from different nationalities from all continents – 99% permanent contracts


Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges, and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a Senior UX Researcher in the UX Research team, you will be in charge of:

CORE: Prime Research and Intelligence

 Research and Intelligence

  • Manage the strategic research roadmap across the Prime lifecycle (acquisition, onboarding, engagement, adoption, retention).
  • Prioritize key research to guide Prime strategy, growth, revenue, and experience
  • Execute end-to-end generative, evaluative, and mixed-methods research.
  • Synthesize user feedback, behavioral data, and research into actionable insights.
  • Maintain an Evidence and Opportunity portfolio with source traceability and action items.
  • Link research-backed decisions to execution and measurable results.


Cross-Functional Program Management

  • Coordinate Prime research demand and cross-functional dependencies across teams.
  • Connect research across products to map the end-to-end Prime journey and remove silos.
  • Balance competing priorities for research resources, participants, and CRM capacity.
  • Establish delivery plans, key decisions, risks, and escalations for complex research initiatives.
  • Support cross-product research directly shaping Prime strategy and member experience.


Executive-Level Stakeholder Management

  • Advise Prime Product Directors and executives with actionable research insights.
  • Summarize evidence into clear recommendations, trade-offs, and risk assessments.
  • Regularly share insights, knowledge gaps, and research priorities with leaders.
  • Identify research gaps early to de-risk key product investments.
  • Transparently report research limitations and confidence levels.
  • Guide roadmaps using objective, evidence-based data.


Research Operations

  • Internal Member Participant Recruitment Management
  • Lead team-wide CRM participant recruitment as the primary owner.
  • Manage recruitment workflows, including prioritization, targeting, scheduling, incentives, and CRM QA.
  • Maintain a central roadmap, calendar, and contact records for cross-team outreach.
  • Enforce contact frequency, fatigue, privacy, consent, and sample quality controls.
  • Align cross-team recruitment to eliminate duplicate outreach and scheduling conflicts.
  • Monitor campaign metrics and member-contact risks to improve the CRM operating model.


Research Operations Infrastructure

  • Build scalable research infrastructure, including RACIs, SOPs, intake, and templates.
  • Set research planning, participant management, evidence traceability, and quality standards.
  • Track operations metrics to remove bottlenecks and increase speed, reliability, and output.
  • Partner with UR leadership and UXD Ops to define operational ownership.
  • Develop business cases for dedicated Research Operations capacity.


AI Transformation and Operations

  • Scale responsible AI workflows from planning to impact tracking.
  • Prioritize AI use cases that clear bottlenecks and improve accessibility.
  • Set validation, privacy, traceability, and quality controls.
  • Pilot and scale AI workflows based on quality and output impact.
  • Drive adoption with guidelines while keeping researchers accountable.


What you need to succeed:

Good to have

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:

Essential Experience

  • 5+ years of UX/behavioral research experience in digital products, e-commerce, SaaS, or subscriptions.
  • Proven leadership in strategic research influencing product roadmaps and business decisions.
  • Strong mixed-methods expertise across qualitative and quantitative research.
  • Skill in synthesizing multi-source evidence into actionable recommendations.
  • Ability to advise and influence Product Directors and executive stakeholders.
  • Experience with recruitment, customer panels, and scalable research operations.
  • Strong systems thinking to build governance, workflows, and measurable operational controls.
  • Cross-functional collaboration with Product, Design, Data, CRM, Legal, and Privacy teams.
  • Applied experience using AI in research workflows with strong evidence quality and privacy judgment.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.


Valuable Additional Experience

  • Advanced survey design, experimentation, or statistical analysis (R, Python, SPSS, SQL, Excel).
  • UX lab experience in experimental research, eye-tracking, or biometrics.
  • Membership, subscription, loyalty, retention, or LTV research.
  • Travel, international e-commerce, or multi-product user journey experience.
  • Familiarity with research repositories, taxonomies, or AI knowledge systems.
  • Coordinating recruitment via CRM or owned customer channels.
  • Setting participant-contact, fatigue, or sampling policies.
  • Cross-country, multi-language, or cross-cultural research experience.
  • Fluency in Spanish, German, French, or Italian (English is standard).


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Applied AI Tools: Demonstrated comfort using practical AI tools such as Gemini or other AI-powered assistants.
  • Experimentation Mindset: Curiosity and eagerness to explore, experiment with, and integrate emerging AI-driven solutions into workflows.
  • AI-Enhanced Problem Solving: Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to streamline processes and enhance productivity.
  • Adaptability and Learning Agility: Enthusiastic about continuously learning and quickly adapting to new AI features and capabilities.


What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

  • A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support, and premium equipment with role-based selection options and device ownership through our equipment lifecycle program when it reaches its refresh cycle.
  • Continuous learning to fuel your growth and explore new horizons! 📚 Learn and grow with free Coursera access, soft skills workshops, tech training, leadership development, and more. Plus, enjoy a great onboarding program.
  • Grow opportunities to empower your career and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.
  • Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcomes. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
  • Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padel tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
  • Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.


Wanna take a peek into what it's like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

Apply now!

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status. Our people are the key to our success. Each one of them is unique in their own way, and the respect for their uniqueness is and will always be a passion and motivation. Don’t meet every requirement? If you’re excited about this role but do not feel your experience aligns perfectly with all the requirements, we strongly encourage you to apply nevertheless.

job.job_description:
Organization- Hyatt Corporate Office

Summary

The Opportunity

Hyatt Hotels Corporation seeks an enthusiastic Director to join our Global Commercial Analytics team. In this role, you will be collaborating closely with the broader Commercial Services team, where you’ll be instrumental in continuing to make Hyatt a leading hospitality company. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list since 2013. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

  • Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on-site fitness center
  • A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption
  • Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

The Role

The Director of Marketing & Offer Analytics sets the strategy and operating model for integrated measurement across marketing, offers, and guest journeys. This leader establishes shared KPI hierarchies, measurement frameworks, taxonomies, and standards that connect campaign activation, conversion, offer production, incrementality, and guest engagement to broader Commercial outcomes. Leading a cross-functional insights track within Commercial Analytics, the Director aligns resources across analytics, marketing, loyalty, revenue management, brand, and technology partners, translating complex performance results into clear recommendations for senior leaders.

In this role, you will be accountable for:

  • Developing the enterprise strategy and governance model for marketing and offer measurement. Define the KPI hierarchy, taxonomy, measurement standards, decision rights, and roadmap used to evaluate campaign, offer, channel, and guest-journey performance.
  • Owning the integrated insights narrative for marketing and offer initiatives. Connect execution metrics and guest behavior to campaign and offer performance, then translate those findings into business outcomes such as bookings, revenue, penetration, enrollment, retention, and guest engagement.
  • Leading experimentation and causal measurement strategy by selecting the appropriate approach for each business question and overseeing test design, control methods, and attribution.
  • Guiding the measurement of offer economics, including forecasting, costing, production, and incremental impact. Partner with Finance, Loyalty, Revenue Management, and Marketing leaders to evaluate tradeoffs and recommend future offer design.
  • Leading cross-functional planning and resource alignment for the Marketing & Offers insights track. Set priorities, clarify ownership, manage dependencies and expectations, and coordinate project managers, measurement experts, technical resources, domain specialists, and analysts against the highest-value work.
  • Serving as a senior analytics thought partner in the Marketing and Commercial Analytics domains. Translate business questions into analytical priorities and performance insights into clear recommendations and actions.

Building organizational capability and executive confidence in marketing and offer analytics. Coach analysts and cross-functional partners on measurement practices, communicate implications to senior audiences, and promote responsible use of automation and AI to improve speed, consistency, and analytical quality.

Qualifications

Experience Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree with quantitative emphasis
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in marketing analytics, offer design and performance, loyalty, marketing operations or related areas in cross-functional, collaborative roles.

The Head of App and Web Technology will lead the vision, strategy, and execution for IHG’s most important direct digital channels, including the IHG One Rewards app and IHG’s global web ecosystem spanning brand websites and digital experiences for more than 7,000 hotels in over 20 languages. The role will set product and technology priorities, lead high-performing multidisciplinary teams, and partner across Product, Technology, Loyalty, Brand, Commercial, Hotel Operations, and regional stakeholders to turn business strategy and guest insight into a compelling roadmap, high-quality releases, and measurable commercial impact.

Your Day-to-Day

  • Set and activate a bold product and technology vision for IHG’s direct digital ecosystem, translating guest, owner, and commercial insight into 3–5 year strategic plans, annual investment priorities, and measurable value creation.
  • Assist the business in product management for the app, web to drive direct revenue contribution.
  • Partner with internal teams and external technology providers to deliver scalable, secure, and high-performing digital capabilities.
  • Champion enterprise-wide product and platform initiatives across functions, aligning stakeholders, shaping priorities, and driving delivery that advances IHG’s commercial, loyalty, brand, and hotel performance goals.
  • Assess emerging technology, user needs, customer touchpoints, and current-state capability gaps to identify the highest-impact product opportunities and guide future-state digital experiences across the guest journey.
  • Build compelling business cases for new initiatives, including cost-benefit analysis, return on investment, portfolio rationalization, product retirement opportunities, and profitability drivers.
  • Establish clear success metrics, performance standards, release schedules, annual targets, budgets, and delivery tracking to ensure product investments translate into reliable capabilities and measurable customer and commercial outcomes.

What We Need From You

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent work-related experience, with 12+ years of progressive experience across product marketing, product management, digital technology, and platform leadership.
  • Demonstrated experience leading the architecture, development, operation, and modernization of high-volume digital platforms across multi-cloud environments, including Amazon Web Services and Google Cloud Platform.
  • Strong command of cloud-native architecture, including microservices, APIs, event-driven integration, containers, serverless computing, data platforms, identity and access management, and resilient multi-region operations.

Application architecture and delivery for responsive and accessible user experiences, front-end frameworks, content management platforms, API-driven architecture, experimentation, performance optimization, and search-engine optimization.

job.job_description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

Care at GetYourGuide is in the middle of a fundamental transformation — and it's one of the most important bets we're making as a company. We're moving from traditional human-led support to an LLM-powered model, where AI handles the majority of interactions and our human teams focus on the cases that genuinely need them. That shift changes everything: how we staff, how we plan, how we measure, and what "great care" even looks like.

The Care Experience & Strategy team sits at the centre of this change. We're the function that turns operational complexity into clarity — owning the forecasting, analytics, and strategic planning that keep Care running as the model underneath it evolves. This isn't a team that maintains what exists. It's a team that's actively rebuilding how a world-class support organisation operates in an AI-first world. If you're energised by building something new rather than running something established, this is where you want to be.

Your mission

As Manager of Workforce Management, you'll own the forecasting and planning capability that Care's transformation depends on. Reporting to the Head of Care Experience & Strategy, you'll lead a team of three WFM specialists to replace our manual, Google Sheets-based forecasting models with an AI and automations driven approach — cutting forecast run time from ~23 hours to under 2 hours, while sharpening the accuracy our operations rely on. This is a build role, not a maintain role. You'll set the direction, make the calls on methodology and tooling, and take your team along with you.

  • Lead the end-to-end transformation of our forecasting capability, replacing manual Google Sheets-based models with an AI-driven solution that improves both speed and accuracy.
  • Build and mature forecasting models for emerging lines of business, ensuring our planning capability scales alongside GetYourGuide's growth
  • Develop a scenario modelling capability that enables Care leadership to stress-test assumptions, model trade-offs, and make faster, more confident operational decisions
  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of three WFM specialists — setting clear goals, giving regular feedback, and creating an environment where the team can do their best work
  • Drive AI adoption within your team — identifying new use cases, building workflows and automations, and helping your team develop their own AI capabilities
  • Partner closely with Care Operations, Finance, and Technology stakeholders to ensure forecasting outputs are understood, trusted, and acted upon
  • Define and own the metrics that measure forecast quality, model performance, and planning effectiveness — using data to continuously improve
  • Strengthen the continuous feedback loop between Realtime Management insights and future forecasts, driving continuous improvement of our forecasting accuracy

Your toolkit

  • 5+ years of professional experience, with at least 3 in workforce management, operations analytics, or a related planning function, ideally within a customer care, support, or contact centre environment
  • Proven track record of building or significantly improving forecasting models, with a strong grasp of forecasting methodologies and their practical trade-offs
  • Demonstrated experience applying automation and AI tools to improve the quality and efficiency of your work — you can share concrete examples of workflows or automations you've built and the impact they had
  • Strong analytical skills — comfortable working with large datasets, building models, and translating complex outputs into clear operational recommendations
  • Experience leading a small team of specialists, with the ability to set direction, develop people, and maintain high standards
  • Excellent stakeholder communication skills — you can translate technical forecasting concepts into language that resonates with operational and senior leadership audiences
  • A bias for action and continuous improvement — you don't wait to be told something is broken before fixing it

Extras that give you an edge

  • Experience with WFM platforms (e.g. Verint, NICE, Assembled, or similar)
  • Familiarity with Python, SQL, or other tools used for data modelling and automation
  • Experience building forecasting models in a multi-channel or multi-LOB care environment
  • Exposure to scenario planning or capacity modelling in an operational context

How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary

  • Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
  • Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
  • A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.
  • Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events
  • Monthly transportation and fitness budget
  • Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
  • Language reimbursement program
  • Health and wellness benefits

And more…

How To Apply

Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘how we hire’ and ‘life at GetYourGuide’. If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to get in touch at jobs@getyourguide.com.

We’re an equal opportunities employer

Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with your application.

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Director of Sales at Hilton Southampton Utilita Bowl, you’re not just driving revenue growth across all hotel segments – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

How We'll Help You Thrive

At Hilton, the hospitality we're known for doesn't end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members' wellbeing, supporting you through all of life's moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with a wide range of perks and benefits, including:

  • Competitive pay – with opportunities to grow your career with Hilton.
  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy discounted hotel stays through our Go Hilton travel programme, with room rates as low as $40 USD per night at participating hotels worldwide.
  • Food and beverage discounts – Receive 50% off food and beverage at participating outlets.
  • Free meals on duty – Helping you stay energised throughout your shift.
  • Generous holiday allowance – Enjoy 28 days' holiday including bank holidays, increasing with service.
  • Pension scheme – Supporting you as you plan for the future.
  • High street discounts – Access a range of exclusive savings through Perks at Work.
  • Mental health resources – Through our Care for All hub, Team Members have access to wellbeing resources, alongside free counselling and support through our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP).
  • Crisis Concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for practical support and emotional care.
  • Career development opportunities – Grow with Hilton through learning and development programmes designed to support your personal and professional growth.
  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member location and terms and conditions of employment.

Responsibilities

Hilton Southampton - Where world-class hospitality meets unforgettable events, Hilton Southampton - Utilita Bowl offers experiences few venues can match.

A 171-bedroom Hilton, the iconic Utilita Bowl cricket ground, extensive conference and event facilities, a spectacular 622m² ballroom accommodating up to 700 guests, Boundary Lakes Golf Course and an award-winning spa, we offer experiences and opportunities unlike any other venue on the South Coast.

As Director of Sales, you'll be the driving force behind the commercial success of one of the South Coast's most distinctive destinations. From landing high-profile conferences, groups and events to forging strategic partnerships, growing golf and leisure business, and unlocking new opportunities, you'll play a leading role in shaping the future of this exciting venue.

This is a role for a natural relationship-builder who loves being out in the market, spotting opportunities, winning new business and showcasing everything this unique destination has to offer.

Here's What You'll Do During a Typical Day

  • Drive sales strategy and revenue growth across key market segments, identifying opportunities to strengthen market share and deliver commercial success.
  • Generate and win new business by building a strong sales pipeline, securing new opportunities and converting prospects into long-term client relationships.
  • Champion the destination and brand through networking, industry events, client engagement, compelling presentations and exceptional site visits.
  • Build strategic partnerships with corporate clients, agencies and local stakeholders to maximise revenue and business opportunities.
  • Collaborate across teams, working closely with Revenue, Marketing and Operations to deliver integrated commercial solutions and outstanding client experiences.
  • Lead with energy and accountability, fostering a high-performance culture of collaboration, commercial excellence and continuous development.

Few sales roles offer this level of variety, visibility and opportunity to make a real impact.

One destination. Endless opportunities.

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

job.job_description:
Founded in the Queensland outback in 1920, Qantas has grown to be Australia’s largest regional, domestic, and international airline. Qantas has a range of subsidiary businesses that support the overall operations of the Group. The Qantas Group’s main business is the transportation of customers and freight using two complementary airline brands — Qantas and Jetstar — operating regional, domestic, and international services.

Job Description

  • Challenge yourself to an exciting career within the Qantas Group
  • Together we’ll achieve complete analysis of planning support
  • 18-month secondment role (Full Time Fixed Term) located at the Qantas Supply Chain

Our ability to stand the test of time has been no coincidence. We’ve come this far because we continue to evolve. It’s a challenge that never ends and drives every individual in our team to make tomorrow better than today for our customers.

Qantas Engineering keeps us at the forefront of aviation, caring and maintaining both the Qantas fleet, as well as aircraft for our customers across the Asia-Pacific region. Working with state-of-the-art equipment and resources, our shared commitment to professional excellence continues to keep our customers safe.

As a Principal Planning Analyst – Component Campaign, you will lead a team of Senior Analysts (Planning Support and Demand & Supply Planning) to support Qantas’ Component Campaigns, Charter Flights, Line Stations Planning & Logistics Management, Loans & Borrows, Fly-Away Kits, and Material Sales. The role ensures parts availability and effective supply chain coordination with internal and external stakeholders to prevent any impact on Operational On-Time Performance (OTP) due to insufficient spare parts.

This role is a mix of hands-on supply chain operations and internal/external stakeholder management, requiring strong communication skills, a solid understanding of operational processes to maintain accurate material visibility and support material availability, and sound technical and financial judgement to identify and recommend optimal solutions for the business.

You’ll have –

  • Minimum of 5 years of supply chain experience preferably in planning
  • Degree qualified, preferably in engineering, mathematics, science, supply chain or business
  • Extensive experience in supply chain, purchasing, repair management, and inventory optimisation
  • Strong leadership and team management skills
  • Solid understanding of planning, procurement, and inventory control principles
  • Proven stakeholder engagement and relationship-building ability with OEMs, repairer and airline partners
  • Strong analytical, financial and problem-solving capability
  • Proficient in SUPPLY, Mx and Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills
  • Flexible, self-motivated, and able to manage competing priorities
  • Continuous improvement mindset with sound compliance awareness.

Why Qantas?

You’ll join a team where creativity and passion are encouraged. Our people come together to allow us to dream big and deliver successfully.

There are many different opportunities across our team, which means you’ll be able to grow both personally and professionally at Qantas. Your development is a priority for us – so that you can maintain the high standards our customers have come to expect and can continue to develop over time. You’ll be supported from day 1 with on-the-job training and coaching as well as our formal training opportunities. While you may start in this role, we’ve got a great track record of supporting our people to take their career in so many different directions, the destinations are endless. 

The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.

  • We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave and the option to purchase additional paid leave for eligible employees.
  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.
  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.

Qantas are equal opportunity employers, so by coming to work for us, you’ll be part of an organisation that encourages diversity, supports charities and environmental initiatives. We encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, and people of all backgrounds to apply.

If you’re ready to step into a culture that will challenge and excite you, submit an application and let’s explore how we go places together.

Applications close: Friday 23rd of October 2026.

We’re a data-driven organization, which makes our Reporting & Analytics teams the backbone of our operation: constantly creating, testing, learning and iterating to better meet the needs of our customers. If you thrive in a fast-paced, ideas-led environment, you’re in the right place.

Why This Job’s a Big Deal

In your capacity as a Senior Analyst, you will act as a liaison between our team and Finance stakeholders across the organization - partnering with leadership across diverse Finance verticals, such as Accounting, Tax, AR, and AP, to streamline reporting requests, mitigate technical hurdles, and foster cross-departmental synergy.

In This Role, You Will

  • Serve as the main stakeholder liaison between our team and Finance stakeholders, building strong working relationships with leads across finance verticals, such as Accounting, Tax, AR, AP.
  • Act as the go-to point for incoming requests, issues & priorities from Finance stakeholders.
  • Configure & manage & continuously improve a ticketing/workflow tool (eg.: Jira Service Management or something similar) to track & prioritize incoming requests.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering, Finance, and cross-functional partners to provide regular reporting/visibility on request volumes, turnaround times, and open issues to both Finance leadership and internal stakeholders..
  • Leverage data analysis, data warehousing, and BI knowledge to understand, contextualize, and help scope Finance stakeholder requests.
  • Apply working knowledge of Tableau, data warehousing, and SQL to better understand business requirements and, where needed, assist with critical ad-hoc queries.

Who You Are

  • Working knowledge of core finance functions — Accounting, Tax, AR, AP — deep technical accounting expertise is not required.
  • Hands-on experience configuring and managing a ticketing/workflow tool (e.g., Jira Service Management or similar).
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and coordinate across departments without formal authority.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting issues and metrics to leadership.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity, particularly when resolution depends on teams outside of Finance.
  • Prior hands-on experience with data analysis, data warehousing, and BI tools/concepts — able to understand data-related requests and work effectively with technical teams.
  • Working knowledge of Tableau reports, data warehousing concepts, OBIEE/OAS reports and SQL (BigQuery)— while not a core responsibility, this helps the candidate better understand business requirements, collaborate effectively with the team, and independently handle critical ad-hoc queries when needed.
  • Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust.
  • The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics is essential.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have

  • Experience working with or alongside fintech platforms or payment systems.
  • Prior exposure to shared services, PMO, or service delivery models.
  • A process-improvement mindset — someone who looks to fix root causes, not just clear queues.

The salary range for this position is $110,000- $145,000K USD.

Who We Are

WE ARE PRICELINE.

Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.

Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.

We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.

Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.

If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!

Flexible work at Priceline

Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.

Perks & Benefits At Priceline

Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:

Health & wellness coverage including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources

Generous time off including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days

Work/life support including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)

Financial security programs such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts

Signature travel perks including employee-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits

Additional perks & discounts like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits

A people-first culture with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together

Specific benefits and programs vary by location.

Inclusion is a Big Deal!

To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.

Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.

job.job_description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY:

OAG is the essential intelligence partner transforming global travel. For nearly a century we've been the foundation the travel industry builds on: trusted, proven, essential. Today, we're going beyond.

We combine unmatched data quality, quantity and access with breakthrough technology and deep industry expertise to deliver what the industry truly needs: not just more data, but better answers. From real-time operational intelligence to strategic decision-making, we power the entire travel ecosystem, from airlines and airports to technology companies and financial institutions. And we're embedding AI throughout our intelligence layer, pairing decades of proprietary data with the latest technology to deliver answers that weren't possible before.

Travel moves the world, and we move travel. For more information visit www.oag.com

ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Senior Client Solutions Engineer leads OAG’s global developer relations capability and is the technical and solutions bridge between OAG and its most commercially significant accounts worldwide. Reporting to a Regional Sales Director, you will lead technical discovery, run proof-of-concept workstreams, own the technical path through complex integrations and build credibility with demanding technical buyers. You will also define and own the structured feedback loop from the field to the product organisation, shaping OAG’s API and data integration roadmap, and act as the primary technical authority across OAG for API architecture, data integration and the developer ecosystem. This is a technically demanding role that requires genuine depth across technical, commercial and product disciplines.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

  • Lead technical discovery and qualification on enterprise opportunities worldwide, matching OAG capability to the customer’s problem and handling technical objections when a buyer’s engineering or data team gets involved.
  • Design and lead proof-of-concept workstreams end to end, from scoping through to presenting results in commercial terms, and stay engaged through implementation on complex deals.
  • Own API and integration consultation, including architecture review, data pipeline scoping and technical risk identification.
  • Act as the primary technical authority across OAG for API architecture, data integration and the developer ecosystem, advising product and engineering on customer-driven technical direction.
  • Run OAG Intelligence Platform proofs of concept with early adopter customers, building the technical proof points the wider commercial team can use and feeding back on readiness ahead of broad commercial release.
  • Define and own the structured feedback loop from the field to the product organisation, working with the Head of Digital Product and the Head of Data Products to translate field intelligence into roadmap decisions.
  • Identify and facilitate customer developer partnerships, prototyping solutions to specific commercial problems and remaining the field-side point of accountability.
  • Support commercial teams at key moments in the deal cycle: briefing on technical market signals, creating replicable plays from every engagement, and coaching colleagues on technical topics where it materially improves customer conversations.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

  • Demonstrable track record of technical pre-sales or solutions work at enterprise level in a data, analytics, or SaaS business, with direct involvement in deals from first technical qualification through to contract.
  • Hands-on fluency with data APIs, integration architecture, and data pipeline design. Able to review an integration proposal, identify weaknesses, and redirect without needing to involve a delivery engineer.
  • Experience leading proof-of-concept workstreams independently: scoping, executing, and presenting results to both technical and commercial stakeholders.
  • Genuine credibility with senior technical buyers. Not experience presenting to senior buyers — the ability to hold a conversation at CTO or engineering lead level that the buyer finds substantive and specific to their context.
  • Some experience working alongside a product organisation: contributing to roadmap discussions, translating customer signals into structured input, or understanding how product decisions get made.
  • Strong commercial instinct. Understands the difference between a customer who is genuinely bought in and one who is managing you. Knows when a technical conversation is the deal and when it is a delay.



IF YOU HAVE THE FOLLOWING THAT WOULD BE GREAT:

  • Forward-deployed engineering or developer relations experience.
  • Experience with AI-enabled data products or intelligence platforms.

If you don’t meet every requirement but feel excited about this role, we’d still love to hear from you.

WE WILL OFFER YOU:

💡 You will proactively explore and adopt AI tools and automation in your day-to-day work, keeping the customer at the centre of everything you do. You will share learnings with your team and approach new technologies with curiosity and an open mind. At OAG, finding better ways to work and putting customers first is everyone's responsibility.

🚀 Real responsibility on hard problems, with the autonomy to own decisions and act on them, in an open culture built on trust.

🏡 Flexible working arrangements that allow remote work or office attendance

💰 401k administered by vitality. Medical, dental and vision insurance.

🏖️ 22 days holiday plus bank holidays, and a day off during your birthday month

🌍 Work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 1 month per year

👪 Inclusive family benefits designed to support you through parenthood and fertility journeys

The salary range for this role is $131,000 to $198,000 per annum plus bonus

OAG is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and able to perform at their best.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences. If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know — we’re happy to have an open conversation about how we can support you.

Salary Range: $131,000 USD - $197,000 USD

OPENING GENERAL MANAGER

Vagabond Inn Sacramento converting to City Express by Marriott Sacramento Old Town

Vista Investments is looking for a hands-on General Manager to run our Vagabond Inn in downtown Sacramento today and lead its conversion to a City Express by Marriott. The conversion is targeted for completion around March 2027.

This is two jobs at once. The hotel stays open throughout the renovation, so you keep it running well: guests served, revenue protected and the team steady while work goes on around them. At the same time, you prepare the hotel and its people for Marriott: brand standards, systems, training and certification. After the reflag, you own the City Express's results.

The hotel sits a few blocks from Old Sacramento's riverfront, near the Capitol, Golden 1 Center and the convention center, drawing government, business, event and leisure travelers.

About Vista Investments

Vista Investments develops, designs, owns, manages and franchises hotels, all under one roof. Our development, design and operations teams work together, so decisions move quickly. We're growing, and that means direct access to senior leadership and a real path to larger roles across our portfolio.

What You'll Do

Now through conversion: run the Vagabond Inn

  • Lead day-to-day operations and the team, keeping service, cleanliness and safety on standard during construction
  • Protect revenue as rooms and public areas come offline in phases: manage inventory, pricing and group commitments around the renovation schedule
  • Keep guests informed and comfortable through noise, closures and changes, and protect online ratings
  • Work closely with Vista's development team and contractors on phasing, room turnover, life safety and access
  • Keep the current team engaged through the change and identify who will grow into City Express roles

Prepare For Marriott (through About March 2027)

  • Lead the conversion plan with Marriott's City Express brand team and Vista's corporate team
  • Apply City Express brand standards and close gaps in operations, staffing and the physical product before inspection
  • Oversee FF&E installation and the cutover to Marriott's PMS, POS and revenue management systems
  • Recruit and onboard new department heads and staff as needed
  • Deliver brand training so the whole team is certified and ready on reflag day
  • Prepare for brand inspection and certification, and update all licenses and permits
  • Transition reservations, accounts and online listings from Vagabond Inn to Marriott with no gap in bookings

After conversion: run the City Express

  • Own the commercial strategy (pricing, distribution, positioning) and drive RevPAR and market share
  • Call on key accounts and build relationships with corporate, government, group and travel-agency clients
  • Build the annual budget, forecast monthly and act on P&L results with your managers
  • Keep labor, accounting, invoicing and audit procedures on standard, with reports to corporate on time
  • Lead a guest-first culture, stay visible on the floor at peak times, and turn guest scores into action plans
  • Coach, develop and hold your management team accountable, including performance reviews
  • Keep the hotel compliant with Marriott brand standards, OSHA, and local, state and federal requirements

Required

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 5+ years of progressive hotel management experience, including 2+ years as a General Manager or Assistant General Manager
  • Experience keeping a hotel operating and profitable through a renovation, brand conversion or opening
  • A track record of hitting budget, RevPAR and guest satisfaction targets
  • Strong command of P&Ls, budgeting, forecasting and revenue management
  • Experience hiring, training and leading a team
  • Comfort with hotel PMS, revenue management and reporting tools
  • Clear communication with guests, staff, owners, contractors and brand partners
  • Availability for a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends and holidays

Preferred

  • Experience working at a Marriott-branded hotel strongly preferred, including hands-on knowledge of Marriott systems and brand standards
  • Experience leading a conversion to a Marriott brand or another major brand's reflag
  • Bachelor's degree in hospitality, business or a related field (equivalent experience considered)
  • Select-service or extended-stay experience
  • Existing relationships in the Sacramento market

What We Offer

  • Base salary of $100,000 - $120,000, based on experience, plus a performance bonus tied to hotel KPIs
  • Medical, dental and vision insurance
  • 401(k) plan with a 2% company match
  • Paid time off and paid holidays
  • The chance to lead a hotel's transformation to a Marriott brand and shape its team and culture
  • Direct access to senior leadership and room to grow with a developing portfolio

This company is an equal opportunity employer.

About The Role

Reporting to the Global Digital Marketing Lead, the Digital Marketing Specialist will play a key role in making sure CTM’s digital experience delivers.

You’ll execute and optimise CTM’s global websites, build personalisation, conversational marketing and emerging AI capabilities, and own the tracking and reporting that demonstrates what is driving engagement and pipeline.

This is an opportunity to join a global marketing team with a clear focus on growing demand, building trust, strengthening customer advocacy and making CTM easier to discover, understand and choose.

You’ll have the opportunity to take real ownership of CTM’s digital experience while working across websites, marketing automation, analytics, personalisation and emerging AI technology. You’ll join a collaborative global team where you can experiment with new approaches, improve how our digital platforms operate and see the impact of your work across multiple markets.

This role suits a hands-on digital marketer who is curious, analytical and motivated to make things better. You’ll have the opportunity to own your area, work through problems and continually improve the platforms, workflows and digital experiences that support CTM’s global marketing strategy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute and optimise CTM’s global websites for user experience, accessibility, speed and conversion, including A/B testing, CRO, UX and SEO/AEO.

  • Support the development of emerging AI workflows across marketing and operations, testing new tools and approaches as capabilities evolve.
  • Build, maintain and improve workflows and integrations across Marketo, Microsoft Dynamics CRM and connected MarTech platforms.

  • Provide operational support across the wider MarTech stack, including platforms such as Oktopost and Wistia.
  • Lead Google Tag Manager implementation for website and campaign tracking, maintaining accurate and consistent attribution.

  • Monitor data quality and reporting standards, identifying trends, issues and opportunities for improvement.
  • Build, test and quality-check platform and campaign changes prior to release.
  • Maintain QA, integration health and process standards, ensuring activity aligns with relevant privacy and data regulations, including GDPR and CCPA.
  • Create and maintain process documentation and training materials to support knowledge sharing across the team.
  • Partner with marketing teams, partner brands and internal stakeholders to deliver consistent, well-tracked digital experiences.

About You

You’re a self-starter with a systems-thinking mindset who enjoys working through problems and turning ideas into practical solutions. You’re analytical by nature, comfortable digging into data to understand what’s happening and using those insights to improve what comes next.

You’ll Ideally Bring

  • 4+ years’ experience in digital marketing, marketing automation or website management, with strong hands-on delivery experience.

  • Strong organisation and self-motivation, with the ability to manage competing priorities and take ownership of your work.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to translate technical concepts into clear, practical information for different audiences.
  • A collaborative approach and confidence working with stakeholders across teams, regions and disciplines.

About CTM

Corporate Travel Management (CTM) is a global award-winning provider of innovative and cost-effective travel management solutions across the corporate, events, leisure and loyalty travel markets. We combine personalised service excellence with client-facing technology solutions, with offices across Australia, New Zealand, Asia, North America and Europe and more than 3,000 employees globally. At CTM, our people are our greatest asset. We are a team of collaborative, innovative and future-focused professionals who work with our company values in mind: Connect, Deliver and Evolve.

CTM offers a strong, established and sustainable work environment that supports your career development and wellbeing.

Come and work for a global award-winning company that values its people, community and technological innovation.
