At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction to Team

The Product Team creates high-quality end-to-end experiences for travelers, partners, and Expedia Group. Our focus on customer-centric innovation enables us to develop products that build loyalty and repeat business. We partner closely with teams across Expedia Group to drive growth and achieve results for our customers and the company.

This Principal Product Manager role is part of the Pricing & Inventory Team team which sits within our Product division. The team enables suppliers to sell and distribute their inventory by supporting pricing, availability, rate plans, promotions, fees, and related inventory capabilities across Expedia Group’s business formats. In this role, you will shape long-term product strategy across complex workstreams and drive products and solutions that positively impact business results across multiple teams.

In This Role, You Will

  • Define and evolve product strategy for pricing and inventory capabilities, translating complex business, marketplace, and customer needs into clear product direction and measurable outcomes.
  • Lead products end to end, from opportunity identification and problem framing through roadmap development, delivery, launch, adoption, and ongoing optimization.
  • Partner with engineering, data, economics, finance, operations, and other stakeholders to develop scalable solutions that improve pricing effectiveness, inventory availability, marketplace performance, and customer outcomes.
  • Establish priorities, clarify requirements, and guide cross-functional teams through complex product decisions, balancing customer value, business impact, operational considerations, and technical feasibility.
  • Use experimentation, analytics, forecasting, and other data-driven methods to evaluate product performance, test hypotheses, and refine pricing and inventory strategies.
  • Safely integrate and operate AI/ML-enabled solutions that improve outcomes, including familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field; or equivalent related professional experience.
  • Several years of relevant product management experience delivering complex products, platforms, or analytical solutions, with demonstrated ownership across the product lifecycle.
  • Experience leading products that require collaboration across multiple technical and business domains, including translating ambiguous problems into actionable product strategies, roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.
  • Strong ability to use customer insights, business context, quantitative analysis, experimentation, and market or operational data to make product decisions and communicate recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience taking products from concept to scaled adoption.
  • Experience leading pricing, inventory, marketplace, optimization, forecasting, or similarly complex data-driven products in high-volume or rapidly changing environments.
  • Track record of influencing product strategy and technical direction across multiple teams or domains, including making sound prioritization and tradeoff decisions.
  • Experience improving product and operational excellence through experimentation, instrumentation, automation, process improvement, and disciplined measurement of outcomes.
  • Hands-on experience using AI-driven tools, platforms, or workflows in product discovery, decision support, forecasting, experimentation, or optimization, and safely integrating AI/ML-enabled capabilities into production products.

The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $224,000.00 to $313,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $358,500.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Benefits And Perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

job.job_description:
Organization- Hyatt Corporate Office

Summary

The Opportunity

Hyatt seeks an enthusiastic Business Development Manager based in or around the SoCal area to join our Inclusive Collection Sales Team. In this role, you will be collaborating closely with the broader North America and Global Field Sales team, where you’ll be instrumental in continuing to make Hyatt a leading hospitality company. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for the last ten years. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

  • Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on-site fitness center
  • A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption
  • Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

The Role

In this role, you will be responsible for driving Inclusive Collection sales and business growth within your assigned territory covering 4 states. Key responsibilities include identifying, developing, and maintaining strong relationships with travel agencies and advisors; executing strategic and tactical sales plans; delivering product training; escorting travel advisor FAM trips; and representing the Inclusive Collection at industry conferences and events.

As a BDM, you’ll blend strategy with execution to grow market share and strengthen advisor engagement:

  • Drive Revenue Growth: Identify, develop, and expand relationships with travel agencies and advisors to increase Inclusive Collection sales.
  • Build Strong Partnerships: Cultivate high-value connections while increasing engagement with the Confidant Collective.
  • Expand Your Network: Prospect, onboard, and activate new agency accounts through sales calls, training, incentives, and FAM trips.
  • Be a Brand Ambassador: Represent Inclusive Collection at industry events, conferences, and trade shows—both domestically and internationally.
  • Educate & Inspire: Deliver impactful product trainings via in-person events, sales calls, webinars, blitzes, and social platforms.
  • Collaborate Strategically: Partner with tour operators and internal teams to maximize business opportunities.
  • Own Your Territory: Manage and optimize your regional budget to drive ROI through targeted sales activities.
  • Leverage Data & Tools: Utilize Salesforce to track performance, pipeline, competitive insights, and ROI.
  • Stay Connected: Maintain consistent communication with Regional Director, including weekly and bi-weekly meetings, for territory planning, strategy alignment, and performance reviews.
  • Live the Brand: Champion Hyatt’s core values in everything you do.

Qualifications

Experience Required:

You’re not just a salesperson—you’re a connector, storyteller, and strategist who thrives in a fast-paced, relationship-driven environment.

  • Bachelor’s degree or 5+ years equivalent experience in sales/marketing
  • 2–3+ years in field sales or business development within the travel industry
  • Proven ability to build trust, influence partners, and grow relationships
  • Strong presentation, communication, and organizational skills
  • Naturally curious, proactive, and results-oriented with the ability to multitask
  • A collaborative team player who works effectively across functions
  • Adaptable, flexible, and energized by travel and client engagement
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Valid driver’s license and passport required
  • Willingness to travel up to 75% (domestic & international)
  • Ability to work evenings and weekends as needed
  • Must be based in or willing to relocate to Southern California

Experience Preferred:

  • Background in luxury resort or hospitality sales
  • Established relationships with key West Coast Travel Agencies, Consortia and Tour Operators
  • Experience with Salesforce CRM
  • Spanish language skills a plus

The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all-encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary.

The salary range for this position is $80,000-$90,000. This position is also eligible to earn incentive awards, an annual bonus, monthly or quarterly incentives, etc.

The final pay rate/salary offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level, and other qualifications for the role, as well as the location of the performance of work. Pay for the successful candidate will meet local requirements, including the local minimum wage rate.

We welcome you:

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.

We value our relationships with recruitment partners and require that agencies contact us first before submitting any candidates. Hyatt will not be responsible for any fees and obligations associated with unsolicited submissions unless a formal agreement is in place.

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You will manage designated corporate accounts, develop and solicit new business, drive total hotel revenue from rooms, catering, and F&B outlets, address business needs, explore new opportunities, and expand existing business through promotional efforts and sales channels. As a C&E Manager, you’re not just generating and managing group sales – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Represent the hotel to prospective clients: Serve as the primary point of contact for customers seeking group rooms, meeting space, and food and beverage services
  • Drive new business opportunities: Respond to inquiries, initiate outreach, qualify leads, and solicit potential clients through proactive sales efforts
  • Manage the full sales cycle: Conduct site visits, entertain clients, prepare proposals, determine rates, negotiate contracts, and service accounts through fulfillment
  • Develop strategic sales plans: Create and execute strategies to achieve or exceed revenue and room night goals, adjusting based on performance and market conditions
  • Analyze sales performance: Evaluate lost business reports and identify opportunities to strengthen conversion and competitiveness
  • Support exceptional service delivery: Collaborate across departments to coordinate the fulfillment of contracted services and uphold the highest standards of client satisfaction
  • Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in hotel Corporate, MICE, or Group room sales
  • Fluent in both English & Japanese (speaking & writing)
  • Strong coordination, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills
  • Technical proficiency in hotel systems (e.g., Delphi, Salesforce, Market Planner Survey)
  • Ability to analyze sales data and market trends to inform strategy
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills with a collaborative mindset

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

job.job_description:
Founded in the Queensland outback in 1920, Qantas has grown to be Australia’s largest regional, domestic, and international airline. Qantas has a range of subsidiary businesses that support the overall operations of the Group. The Qantas Group’s main business is the transportation of customers and freight using two complementary airline brands — Qantas and Jetstar — operating regional, domestic, and international services.

Job Description

  • Lead one of the most critical operational sites in the network, with end-to-end accountability for safety, customer outcomes, operational performance, and commercial success.
  • Influence at the highest levels, building strategic partnerships with regulators, airport authorities, unions, and senior leaders while leading a large and diverse workforce.
  • Permanent role based in our Hobart Office

We’ve always been pioneers, and we’re proud to see that spirit in our people today. Our resilience has helped us through good and tough times, and it still drives us to keep pushing the challenging expectations today.

As the most senior leader at the Qantas Contact Centre located in Hobart, the Site Manager is responsible for the safe, compliant and sustainable operation of the site. You will lead high performing teams that provide best in class customer experience. You will be accountable for safe practices, workforce optimisation, financial outcomes and strategy.

Working closely with leaders across the group you will drive continuous improvement, support the delivery of strategic priorities that put our customer at the heart of what we do and our people first. You will foster an inclusive culture that embraces change.

You’ll have –

  • 10–15 years’ experience in senior operational leadership roles within complex, customer-focused environments.
  • Proven ability to lead large-scale operations and deliver strong performance across safety, service, and operational targets.
  • Demonstrated success leading diverse workforces, building capability, engagement, and high performance.
  • Strong industrial and employment relations experience, including collective bargaining, workforce consultation, union engagement, and conducting as well as overseeing disciplinary investigations, performance processes, and other complex employment relations matters.
  • Commercially astute, with experience managing P&L performance, budgets, forecasting, and cost outcomes.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence regulators, airport authorities, unions, and senior leaders.
  • Proven track record leading operational change, continuous improvement, and effective responses to disruptions and emergencies.

Why Qantas?

You’ll join a team where creativity and passion are encouraged. Our people come together to allow us to dream big and deliver successfully.

There are many different opportunities across our team, which means you’ll be able to grow both personally and professionally at Qantas. Your development is a priority for us – so that you can maintain the high standards our customers have come to expect and can continue to develop over time. You’ll be supported from day 1 with on the job training and coaching as well as our formal training opportunities. While you may start in this role, we’ve got a great track record of supporting our people to take their career in so many different directions, the destinations are endless.

The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.

  • We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave (plus superannuation payments on all paid and unpaid parental leave until your child turns 1) and additional purchased leave options for eligible employees.
  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.
  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.

Qantas is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity and inclusion.  We encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, and people of all backgrounds to apply.  If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at time of application.  Your personal information will be kept confidential in compliance with relevant privacy legislation.

Be a part of something special and play your part in the Qantas story – get in touch today.

Applications close Sunday 1st November

Please note: applications will only be considered for candidates who have the right to work in Australia / New Zealand without restriction or sponsorship.

job.job_description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY:

OAG is the essential intelligence partner transforming global travel. For nearly a century we've been the foundation the travel industry builds on: trusted, proven, essential. Today, we're going beyond.

We combine unmatched data quality, quantity and access with breakthrough technology and deep industry expertise to deliver what the industry truly needs: not just more data, but better answers. From real-time operational intelligence to strategic decision-making, we power the entire travel ecosystem, from airlines and airports to technology companies and financial institutions. And we're embedding AI throughout our intelligence layer, pairing decades of proprietary data with the latest technology to deliver answers that weren't possible before.

Travel moves the world, and we move travel. For more information visit www.oag.com

ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Senior Client Solutions Engineer leads OAG’s global developer relations capability and is the technical and solutions bridge between OAG and its most commercially significant accounts worldwide. Reporting to a Regional Sales Director, you will lead technical discovery, run proof-of-concept workstreams, own the technical path through complex integrations and build credibility with demanding technical buyers. You will also define and own the structured feedback loop from the field to the product organisation, shaping OAG’s API and data integration roadmap, and act as the primary technical authority across OAG for API architecture, data integration and the developer ecosystem. This is a technically demanding role that requires genuine depth across technical, commercial and product disciplines.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

  • Lead technical discovery and qualification on enterprise opportunities worldwide, matching OAG capability to the customer’s problem and handling technical objections when a buyer’s engineering or data team gets involved.
  • Design and lead proof-of-concept workstreams end to end, from scoping through to presenting results in commercial terms, and stay engaged through implementation on complex deals.
  • Own API and integration consultation, including architecture review, data pipeline scoping and technical risk identification.
  • Act as the primary technical authority across OAG for API architecture, data integration and the developer ecosystem, advising product and engineering on customer-driven technical direction.
  • Run OAG Intelligence Platform proofs of concept with early adopter customers, building the technical proof points the wider commercial team can use and feeding back on readiness ahead of broad commercial release.
  • Define and own the structured feedback loop from the field to the product organisation, working with the Head of Digital Product and the Head of Data Products to translate field intelligence into roadmap decisions.
  • Identify and facilitate customer developer partnerships, prototyping solutions to specific commercial problems and remaining the field-side point of accountability.
  • Support commercial teams at key moments in the deal cycle: briefing on technical market signals, creating replicable plays from every engagement, and coaching colleagues on technical topics where it materially improves customer conversations.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

  • Demonstrable track record of technical pre-sales or solutions work at enterprise level in a data, analytics, or SaaS business, with direct involvement in deals from first technical qualification through to contract.
  • Hands-on fluency with data APIs, integration architecture, and data pipeline design. Able to review an integration proposal, identify weaknesses, and redirect without needing to involve a delivery engineer.
  • Experience leading proof-of-concept workstreams independently: scoping, executing, and presenting results to both technical and commercial stakeholders.
  • Genuine credibility with senior technical buyers. Not experience presenting to senior buyers — the ability to hold a conversation at CTO or engineering lead level that the buyer finds substantive and specific to their context.
  • Some experience working alongside a product organisation: contributing to roadmap discussions, translating customer signals into structured input, or understanding how product decisions get made.
  • Strong commercial instinct. Understands the difference between a customer who is genuinely bought in and one who is managing you. Knows when a technical conversation is the deal and when it is a delay.



IF YOU HAVE THE FOLLOWING THAT WOULD BE GREAT:

  • Forward-deployed engineering or developer relations experience.
  • Experience with AI-enabled data products or intelligence platforms.

If you don’t meet every requirement but feel excited about this role, we’d still love to hear from you.

WE WILL OFFER YOU:

💡 You will proactively explore and adopt AI tools and automation in your day-to-day work, keeping the customer at the centre of everything you do. You will share learnings with your team and approach new technologies with curiosity and an open mind. At OAG, finding better ways to work and putting customers first is everyone's responsibility.

🚀 Real responsibility on hard problems, with the autonomy to own decisions and act on them, in an open culture built on trust.

🏡 Flexible working arrangements that allow remote work or office attendance

💰 401k administered by vitality. Medical, dental and vision insurance.

🏖️ 22 days holiday plus bank holidays, and a day off during your birthday month

🌍 Work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 1 month per year

👪 Inclusive family benefits designed to support you through parenthood and fertility journeys

The salary range for this role is $131,000 to $198,000 per annum plus bonus

OAG is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and able to perform at their best.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences. If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know — we’re happy to have an open conversation about how we can support you.

Salary Range: $131,000 USD - $197,000 USD

Summary of Position

Some Sales Directors’ simply sell the product. Our success in the market is the ability to tailor our offering to the client to match their existing strategic business direction when applied to travel. This is not a hard sell. Our service, product offering and competitive ability in the market, matched with an understanding of the clients’ own business travel requirements IS a win-win sell. We firmly believe (and our success proves) that we have a product and service offering that is a solid value proposition.

As highlighted above, `tailored travel solutions’ is what CTM is about, so you must have the ability to think creatively in your approach with clients. This will constantly be assessed in your ability to perform the role, aligned with your ability to understand the prospective client’s business direction, and resulting travel requirements. We believe in our product, and it is the responsibility of all our Business Development Managers to ensure that our product matches the sell and the market requirements. Your on-going input will be sought in this regard. Success in this role will come for those who are flexible, great with time management, enjoy the ‘give and take approach to their roles and job flexibility and are not afraid to ask for help proactively from the energetic team around them.

This is a hybrid role, based in the NYC metro area.

👉 Discover life at TheFork

What You Will Do

As a Chief of Staff you would be the right-hand person to our Chief Operating Officer (COO), and their direct management team. Your main mission would be to deeply understand what's happening across the company, assess the impact on our global Operations organization, and to help the COO make the most efficient decisions for Operations at a global level. job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

Delta Air Lines is seeking an experienced Product Manager to lead the Delta Flight Products (DFP) Onboard Digital Conversion (ODC) initiative, a strategic program focused on transforming DFP-equipped IFE aircraft to the Delta Sync Seatback experience.

This role will serve as the business product owner for the DFP ODC workstream and will be accountable for defining customer, operational, and business requirements that enable the deployment of the Delta Sync Seatback experience via third party hardware and software applications. The Product Manager will work at the intersection of Customer Experience, Design, IT, Program Management, Third Party Vendors, and aircraft operations to bring new next-gen IFE capabilities to market.

The successful candidate will own product strategy, requirements, prioritization, stakeholder alignment, testing oversight, and deployment readiness for a complex software development program spanning onboard systems, connectivity platforms, content ecosystems, and aircraft constraints.

This role requires strong product management expertise and the ability to influence cross-functional teams. The candidate should be comfortable navigating large-scale technology implementations with significant customer and operational impact.

The Product Manager, Delta Sync Seatback Transformation position is based in Atlanta, GA with weekly in-office presence required and ability to travel as needed.

Primary Functions

  • Serve as the Business Product Owner for the DFP ODC workstream
  • Define the product vision, roadmap, and priorities required to migrate DFP aircraft to the Delta Sync Seatback experience
  • Develop business cases and strategic recommendations that support roadmap prioritization and execution
  • Define detailed customer experience, operational, and business requirements for DFP ODC capabilities
  • Partner closely with the UI/UX Design Team to refine UX for system capabilities
  • Translate customer needs into epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and success metrics
  • Lead cross-functional alignment across Business, IT, Program Management, Design, and Suppliers
  • Communicate program status, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to leadership
  • Maintain and prioritize product backlog supporting DFP ODC development
  • Participate in roadmap planning, sprint reviews, and release readiness activities
  • Partner with Technical Product Owners, Engineers, Architects, QA teams, and Program Managers throughout the product lifecycle
  • Support development team through feature clarification, requirement refinement, and defect triage
  • Partner with IT and QA teams to establish test strategies that validate end-to-end customer experiences
  • Coordinate user acceptance testing activities and business validation
  • Support lab testing, aircraft validation, and test-fly activities as required
  • Ensure operational readiness and stakeholder alignment prior to deployment
  • Evaluate release performance and identify opportunities for continuous improvement following deployment

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • 7+ years of product management, product ownership, business analysis, or digital product delivery experience
  • Experience managing complex software development initiatives in Agile environments
  • Ability to define customer experience requirements and translate them into actionable technical deliverables
  • Strong project management and influencing skills across business and technical teams
  • Experience leading cross-functional efforts involving multiple teams, vendors, and dependencies
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
  • Ability to travel as needed, including support of aircraft testing activities
  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States.
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency.
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Product Management, or related field.
  • 7+ years in advertising product management or media product roles.
  • Experience working in technically complex environments and/or in experiential media preferred.
  • Airline or onboard systems experience preferred.

Benefits And Perks To Help You Keep Climbing

Our culture is rooted in a shared dedication to living our values – Care, Integrity, Resilience and Servant Leadership – every day, in everything we do. At Delta, our people are our success. At the heart of what we offer is our focus on Sharing Success with Delta employees. Exploring a career at Delta gives you a chance to see the world while earning great compensation and benefits to help you keep climbing along the way:

  • Competitive salary, industry-leading proﬁt sharing program, and performance incentives
  • 401(k) with generous company contributions up to 9%
  • New hires are eligible for up to 2-weeks of vacation. This is earned for use in the following vacation year (April 1 – March 31)
  • In addition to vacation, new hires are eligible for up to 56 hours of paid personal time within a 12-month period
  • 10 paid holidays per calendar year
  • Birthing parents are eligible for 12-weeks of paid maternity/parental leave
  • Non-birthing parents are eligible for 2-weeks of paid parental leave

Senior Manager, Business Performance Insights – Expedia Lodging & Portfolio

The Traveler Business Team has a mission to deliver the most convenient, rewarding, and memorable ways for people to travel and explore the world. This division has responsibility to build and drive the growth of our global consumer business across our Expedia, Hotels.com, Vrbo, and Portfolio brands, and across all our lines of businesses including Hotels, Vacation Rentals, Air, Car, Packages, and Insurtech.

We are looking for a Senior Manager of Business Performance Insights to join the Expedia & Portfolio team at Expedia Group. This role will be responsible for generating business performance insights for Expedia Lodging, which is the largest and fastest growing business in the Expedia portfolio

This is a fantastic opportunity to join the surging travel industry and help drive the business forward while working on impactful and complex problems. You will partner closely with Finance, Analytics, Marketing, Product & Tech and Supply teams to create compelling business performance insights to help Expedia & Portfolio brands win in the marketplace.

What You’ll Do

  • Own analysis of key site metrics (e.g., traffic, conversion, GBV, cancellations, take rate, GP) across multiple dimensions such as Brand, Geo, Experience (or platform), Channel, and Line of Business
  • Set annual performance targets, linked with strategic initiatives, and reforecast the targets regularly in close partnership with Finance and business leads
  • Monitor and drive performance towards those targets, including by optimizing spend allocation and by identifying short- and long-term underlying drivers of performance
  • Prepare and deliver communications via differing vehicles, ensuring various audiences (including ditrector+) have the right level of detail
  • Establish trusted working relationships with internal stakeholders (e.g. Finance, Marketing, Analytics) and build rapport to become a trusted advisor

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience; Master’s degree preferred
  • 6+ years of experience in business management, ecommerce, analytics or financial planning within the travel and/or tech industry
  • Understanding of financial metrics, forecasting, and budgeting
  • Very strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with ability to generate key insights and actions for the business
  • Ability to influence and collaborate with various levels of the organization
  • Strong Experience in SQL and Tableau/ Python preferred

The total cash range for this position in Austin is $155,000.00 to $217,000.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $248,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role. The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $155,000.00 to $217,000.00. What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a Area Market Manager in the Accommodation team you will be in charge of:

  • Be accountable for the KPIs of all the markets in your assigned area, monitoring each market and key accounts, and owning the recovery plan when a market or account is off track. At all times, ensure content, rates and availability across your area is competitive and attractive, and that additional inventory and promotional offers are secured for high-demand periods.
  • Translate the account management strategy into quarterly area plans, clarifying priorities, objectives and expectations, as well as reviewing and validating the plans built by your Market Managers and Market Specialists to ensure alignment with the overall area targets.
  • Lead, coach and develop a team of Market Managers and Market Specialists: Day-to-day coaching and support, regular 1:1s, performance reviews, development plans, hiring and onboarding
  • Build senior relationships with the most strategic accounts in your area, and act as an escalation point in complex negotiations. When relevant, attend industry fairs and events to meet strategic partners
  • Alongside the other Area Market Managers, support the Head of Account Management on wider business initiatives, leading assigned projects and representing Account Management in internal business reviews. In particular, ensure that market insights are fed back to the rest of the Inventory team.
  • Embed AI into your team's ways of working so it becomes a consistent way of working rather than isolated experimentation, sponsor the highest-value use cases, and coach your team on using AI effectively and responsibly.


What you need to succeed:

Good to have

  • Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:
  • Proven experience in account management or sales in the hotel industry (must) with at least 5 years in a commercial role, strong negotiation skills and a track record of developing trusted relationships with key hotel partners, chains or other relevant industry actors. Strong understanding of how hotel partners operate, leverage different distribution channels and make decisions.
  • At least one relevant experience managing a commercial team: setting clear and measurable objectives, giving ongoing actionable feedback, and building action plans for both top and low performers.
  • Full English proficiency (must), additional European language desired
  • Channel Managers knowledge and proficiency with CRM tools (Salesforce a plus).
  • Partner-facing focus: a genuine preference for time spent with hotel partners, personally building and owning senior relationships with chains and groups alongside managing your team.
  • Result oriented: proven ability to translate targets into clear, owned objectives for each team member, and to keep the team focused on delivery in a fast-moving, results-driven environment.
  • Adaptability and resilience : comfortable with change, shifting priorities and ambiguity, and able to reprioritize quickly when market conditions or business needs evolve.
  • Hands-on approach: ready to step directly into a market or an account when performance is at risk or an escalation requires it.
  • Collaboration: experience working closely with peers managing other areas, sharing best practices, and taking the lead on cross-area initiatives beyond your own scope.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Applied AI Tools: Demonstrated comfort using practical AI tools such as Gemini, or other AI-powered assistants.
  • Experimentation Mindset: Curiosity and eagerness to explore, experiment with, and integrate emerging AI-driven solutions into workflows.
  • AI-Enhanced Problem Solving: Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to streamline processes, and enhance productivity.
  • Adaptability and Learning Agility: Enthusiastic about continuously learning and quickly adapting to new AI features and capabilities.


What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture.

Here's what we offer:

  • Continuous learning to fuel your growth and explore new horizons! 📚 Learn and grow with free Coursera access, soft skills workshops, tech training, leadership development, and more. Plus, enjoy a great onboarding program.
  • Grow opportunities to empower your career and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.
  • Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcomes. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
  • Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padel tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
  • Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.


Wanna take a peek into what it's like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

Apply now!

job.job_description:
Lead finance for the global Six Senses portfolio as principal finance partner to Operations – driving hotel performance, owner value and governance through a period of significant growth. Based in London or Bangkok.

Whether you’re starting out or stepping up, you’ll find support, purpose and the chance to grow through every challenge at IHG Hotels & Resorts.

We’re seeking a Head of Finance – Six Senses to join our team in London, UK or Bangkok, Thailand. Reporting to the VP Finance, Six Senses, this is a global role with around 30% travel across the portfolio.

In this role, you’ll be the principal finance partner to the Six Senses Operations leadership team, connecting enterprise priorities with execution across 27 open hotels – a portfolio that could double in size over the next three years. Your time will be split broadly evenly between commercial business partnering and the analysis, performance and governance that keeps our hotels and IHG safe. As the face of Six Senses finance for owners and operational stakeholders, you’ll turn insight into clear actions that improve hotel performance and support growth that opens on brand and on target.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as a strategic business partner to the operations team and Six Senses Leadership Team.
  • Lead all aspects of financial planning, forecasting, budgeting and performance management across the Six Senses portfolio.
  • Drive hotel profitability, cash flow, fee generation and owner returns through effective financial analysis and decision support.
  • Provide oversight of financial governance, risk management, compliance and internal controls.
  • Partner with operations teams to improve hotel performance and support opening, conversion and growth initiatives.
  • Lead financial evaluation of development opportunities, management agreements and strategic investments.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with hotel owners, providing commercial insight and support on key business matters.
  • Support the continued integration and alignment of Six Senses within IHG while preserving the unique culture and positioning of the brand.
  • Lead, develop and inspire a high-performing finance team across multiple geographies.
  • Champion data-driven decision making and continuous improvement of finance processes, systems and reporting.

On a daily basis you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping the financial performance and growth of a globally recognised luxury wellness brand, helping owners, operators and leaders make confident, informed decisions.

Key Success Measures

  • Delivery of annual fee, GOP and cash flow targets.
  • Improvement in hotel profitability and owner returns.
  • Strong forecasting accuracy and financial discipline.
  • Successful support of openings, signings and portfolio growth.
  • Effective risk management and governance outcomes.
  • High engagement and development of the finance organization.
  • Positive owner and stakeholder feedback.

What We’re Looking For

  • Senior finance executive with multi-unit experience in hospitality, asset management or a consumer-facing industry; luxury experience is highly desirable.
  • Strong financial and commercial acumen with proven ability to influence executive decision-making.
  • Experience leading geographically dispersed teams and operating in a complex international environment.
  • Demonstrated capability managing owner relationships and supporting growth initiatives.
  • Strategic thinker with strong analytical, leadership and communication skills.
  • Ability to balance entrepreneurial growth ambitions with governance and financial discipline.
  • Qualified accountant preferred, though strong relevant experience will also be considered.
  • Existing right to work in the UK or Thailand, as we’re unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

What We Offer

We provide a wide range of benefits designed to help you live your best work life. Including:

  • Travel benefits that include discounted room rates and food & beverage
  • Recharge Days
  • Volunteering Days

At IHG Hotels & Resorts, we work together to deliver True Hospitality for Good on a global scale. With corporate offices and over 6,000 hotel destinations worldwide, a career at IHG is the perfect way to broaden your horizons. You’ll experience our unique culture and brilliant colleagues who will support and inspire you. With a host of corporate opportunities to choose from, wherever you are on your career journey, and whatever you want to achieve there’s Room for You at IHG.

Over recent years, we’ve transformed our company. We have bold ambitions to drive performance and maintain our relentless focus on growth in order to be the hotel company of choice that guests & owners love.

We are a hospitality business at our core and value connections and being together helps us foster a unique sense of belonging that also supports productivity. That’s why here at IHG, we give our colleagues flexibility and balance – working in a hybrid way, blending office and remote working collectively. We recognise that every role is different, that’s why leaders work with teams to determine how and when they collaborate.

We provide a wide range of benefits designed to help you live your best work life. Job Description

The beautiful Hilton Sedona Resort at Bell Rock is preparing to unveil its newly renovated hotel spa and fitness center this fall! This is an exciting time to join the team at Sedona’s only Hilton corporate-managed hotel.

We’re looking for a Spa Sales Manager to drive spa group bookings and membership sales while supporting the day-to-day operations of the spa. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a new and exciting chapter for the resort and help create memorable experiences for our guests.

Schedule: Flexible scheduling is required. Spa hours are from 6:00am-8:00pm

On Site Benefits: Complimentary Parking, Complimentary Lunch per shift. Complimentary Wellness Center Access.

Pay: Salaried Base + Opportunity for quarterly incentive

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Spa Manager, you’re not just overseeing daily spa operations – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:

  • Develop, prepare, negotiate, and manage proposals and agreements for group opportunities and other sales initiatives. Ensure all commitments are accurately communicated and executed in accordance with company policies, pricing strategies, and operational capabilities.
  • Lead the development and growth of the Spa Membership program, including membership acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, renewal, referral, and utilization strategies. Develop compelling membership value propositions, member benefits, incentives, communications, and experiences that encourage long-term loyalty and participation.
  • Develop and lead strategic sales and business development initiatives to drive spa revenue, membership growth, market penetration, and long-term retention. Cultivate high-value relationships and strategic partnerships across local, corporate, residential, wellness, hospitality, and community markets to expand the Spa’s reach, generate qualified business, and maximize revenue through partnerships, referrals, and corporate wellness opportunities.
  • Oversee the gym/fitness center, wellness class programming, and fitness and wellness providers to ensure a consistent, elevated guest and member experience. Manage class schedules, provider coordination, programming, utilization, service standards, and operational needs. Recruit, onboard, orient, support, and maintain relationships with fitness and wellness providers as applicable. Monitor provider performance and guest feedback and identify opportunities to improve programming, participation, and revenue.
  • Conduct external Sales activities including client appointments, networking events, community events, wellness activations, site inspections, property tours, and local outreach opportunities. Represent the Spa and property in a professional manner while actively promoting services, memberships, fitness facilities, wellness classes, and special events.
  • Plan and facilitate membership events, local activations, wellness experiences, open houses, pop-ups, partner events, fitness events, classes, and other initiatives designed to increase awareness, generate leads, strengthen relationships, drive membership conversion, and ongoing engagement with local community.
  • Oversee daily spa operations: Manage guest service, product quality, inventory, systems, and departmental budgets to ensure smooth and effective spa performance
  • Maximize revenue opportunities: Develop spa menus and implement marketing and merchandising strategies to support revenue growth and enhance the guest experience
  • Maintain spa facilities: Ensure spa areas and equipment are well-maintained, clean, and in excellent working order
  • Enhance guest satisfaction: Monitor service trends, respond to feedback, and implement improvements to elevate the overall spa experience
  • Inspire and develop the team: Supervise, coach, and mentor team members; conduct performance evaluations, provide professional development opportunities, and recognize achievements to build, engage, and retain a high-performing team
  • Uphold regulatory standards: Maintain compliance with health, safety, and sanitation, ensuring the highest standards of guest and team member wellbeing

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

About The Team

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
  • Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
  • Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
  • Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
  • Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
  • Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Generous paid time off (PTO) – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters most
  • Health & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family covered
  • Financial security for your future – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what’s next
  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

Founded in the Queensland outback in 1920, Qantas has grown to be Australia’s largest regional, domestic, and international airline. Qantas has a range of subsidiary businesses that support the overall operations of the Group. The Qantas Group’s main business is the transportation of customers and freight using two complementary airline brands — Qantas and Jetstar — operating regional, domestic, and international services.

Job Description

  • At Qantas, our teams come together to create new and unique experiences for our customers.
  • A fantastic opportunity to lead a team that focuses on cutting-edge technology and engineering principles.
  • Full-time and permanent position based at our new Product Innovation Centre in Adelaide.

Join Qantas in our brand-new Product Innovation Centre located in Adelaide by ensuring consumer needs are met, guiding the development of high-quality, scalable digital solutions that deliver real customer value, leveraging deep technical expertise and strategic alignment with user-centric goals.

The Software Technical Lead oversees a technical domain and manages the engineers within it, combining deep software development expertise with leadership responsibilities. They guide teams through the full development lifecycle, from problem discovery and system design to deployment and maintenance of live code. While involved in day-to-day delivery, they also focus on strategic planning and team leadership. Collaborating closely with Product Managers, they ensure software solutions deliver strong business and customer value aligned with strategic goals. Beyond their immediate teams, they contribute to the organisation’s broader technical vision and operational effectiveness as part of the Engineering and Delivery Leadership teams, helping shape the direction of digital products and services across the enterprise. .

You’ll Have

  • 10+ years’ experience in systems development and 3+ years in technology development leadership roles
  • Strong experience building and operating high‑traffic, customer‑facing web platforms
  • Expert in Java for backend services and APIs, with modern frameworks and patterns
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript / TypeScript with deep experience in React.js and modern frontend architectures
  • Experience designing scalable, resilient distributed systems, including API‑first and event‑driven approaches
  • Hands‑on experience with cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Azure or GCP), including containerisation and CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience using observability and monitoring tools (e.g. Splunk, Datadog, or similar) to support production systems
  • Passionate about clean code, quality, and continuous improvement with strong accountability
  • Ability to recommend frameworks, libraries, and tools that improve performance and scalability
  • Demonstrated ability to motivate and mentor developers, fostering team growth
  • Experienced in collaborating with technical and non-technical stakeholders, with strong influencing skills
  • Proven experience with delivering customer facing conversational AI or chatbots will be highly regarded

Why Qantas?

At Qantas, your career can take you further than you imagined. You’ll join a team where creativity and passion drives success. Together we dream big and deliver even bigger. 

You’ll find diverse opportunities to grow, personally and professionally. From day one, you’ll be supported with hands-on training, coaching, and formal learning programs designed to help you excel. Your development is our priority because we know that when you thrive, so do our customers.

And while this role is your starting point at Qantas, it’s just the beginning. We have a proud history of helping our people explore new paths and reach new heights - the destinations are endless.

The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel. 

  • We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave and the option to purchase additional paid leave for eligible employees.
  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.
  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan. 

Qantas is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity and inclusion. By coming to work for us, you’ll be part of an organisation that encourages diversity, supports charities and environmental initiatives. We encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, and people of all backgrounds to apply. If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at time of application. Your personal information will be kept confidential in compliance with relevant privacy legislation.

Apply at the earliest!

Get to Know Our Team:

The Performance Marketing Team of Agoda is a world leader in online marketing. We are highly data-driven and focused on developing at-scale marketing programs that improve the lifetime value of our customers.

  • Build long term relationships with advertisers that foster new opportunities and continuous growth in return from advertising dollars

  • Bachelor Degree in Computer Science/Statistics/Math or Engineering or Economics and Finance
  • Business development and/or account management track record with experience in online marketing
  • Fluent in English with strong communication skills (both written and verbal)

  • Ability to effectively communicate, influence and persuade with different levels of stakeholders (including Senior Management) with proven strong commercial acumen
  • Ability to represent Agoda with experience in interacting with external senior level executives
  • Strong analytical and statistical analysis skills to extract insights and recommendations

Company Description

HOTEL OVERVIEW

Strategically located in the heart of Singapore’s shopping, dining and entertainment districts and with the City Hall and Esplanade Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) train stations and other major transportation nodes at its doorstep, Fairmont Singapore and Swissôtel The Stamford are the gateway to explore Singapore’s landscapes at your convenience. With a total of 2,030 well-appointed guestrooms, both hotels also offer a distinct collection of 12 lifestyle and dining choices including Michelin-starred fine dining restaurant JAAN by Kirk Westaway, cutting-edge meeting space at Raffles City Convention Centre with 34 meeting rooms and one of Asia’s largest spas, Willow Stream Spa.

About Our Company

At Fairmont Singapore and Swissôtel The Stamford, we design career plans and unveil new professional perspectives through our various development programs. We shine when YOU shine. Come and be part of our dynamic team and experience immerse growth and career opportunities with us.

Job Description

The Assistant Marketing Communications Manager develops and leads communications strategies for assigned revenue streams and lifestyle-led portfolios across Fairmont Singapore and Swissôtel The Stamford. This role has a strong focus on campaign management, public relations, media relations, content development, influencer engagement, media planning, partnerships, F&B storytelling, spa and lifestyle campaigns, while supporting broader hotel, brand and corporate initiatives. The role supports the Director of Marketing Communications in managing campaign execution, agency coordination, media hosting and team workflow. This is a leadership position as second in-charge to lead and manage the team.

COMMUNICATIONS & MEDIA PLANNING

  • Formulate communications and media calendars for assigned portfolios, ensuring timely and accurate execution of initiatives with relevant business units and stakeholders.
  • Develop Public Relations angles, media materials, influencer briefs and content narratives that generate positive and relevant coverage across local, regional and international channels.
  • Develop media plan for campaigns and dedicated business units for brand positioning and/or to meet campaign objectives
  • Review communications materials including press releases, media pitches, social copy, sales decks, in-house collaterals, ad copy and campaign assets to ensure accuracy, tonality and brand alignment.
  • Lead assigned awards submissions, canvassing of votes or nominations, and post-award amplification with relevant stakeholders.
  • Identify partnership opportunities with lifestyle, luxury, F&B, wellness, cultural and corporate brands to create differentiated guest experiences.

LIFESTYLE, PUBLIC RELATIONS & PORTFOLIO MANAGEMENT

  • Lead or support lifestyle and Public Relations -driven portfolios such as selected F&B venues, spa, wellness, partnerships, IP-led collaborations, festive campaigns and hotel stories.
  • Manage media, blogger, content creator and influencer hosting to drive positive coverage and beneficial commercial outcomes.
  • Coordinate media familiarisation stays, F&B tastings, chef interviews, partner activations and hosted experiences in line with approved strategy and budgets.
  • Support restaurant and bar positioning by developing story angles around culinary concepts, chefs, menus, events, awards and collaborations.
  • Maintain active awareness of hospitality, lifestyle, dining, wellness and media trends to identify relevant opportunities.

CAMPAIGN & EVENT MANAGEMENT

  • Conceptualise, plan and execute integrated communications campaigns with the Director, internal team, Public relations agencies, digital partners and business unit stakeholders.
  • Support marketing and promotion of hotel-led events, ensuring strong attendance, media relevance, guest experience and post-event reporting.
  • Prepare campaign briefs, timelines, content requirements, photography or videography briefs, creative references and partner deliverables.
  • Coordinate cross-channel launches across website, social media, email, in-house displays, press outreach, partner platforms and advertising placements.
  • Monitor campaign performance and prepare updates with recommendations for optimisation.

MARKET RESEARCH & ANALYSIS

  • Conduct market research to identify consumer preferences, competitor activity, hospitality trends and relevant lifestyle or dining developments.
  • Analyse public relations , campaign, media monitoring, social and stakeholder feedback to develop informed recommendations that support business goals.
  • Review competitive communications to identify opportunities for differentiation and stronger positioning.

PARTNER, AGENCY & VENDOR ENGAGEMENT

  • Manage day-to-day agency, partner and vendor coordination for assigned projects, ensuring clear scopes, timelines, deliverables and approvals.
  • Host partners and industry contacts for ongoing engagement and potential collaborations.
  • Support negotiation of value-added partner arrangements that enhance brand relevance, reduce costs or improve guest experiences.

BUDGETING & ADMINISTRATION

  • Manage campaign and assigned business unit budgets and forecast.
  • Monitor campaign-level budgets, quotations and supplier costs for assigned projects, ensuring forecast accuracy and procurement compliance.
  • Support annual budget planning by gathering scopes, historical costs and proposed activity requirements.
  • Work with the Coordinator to ensure agreements, purchase requests, invoices and accruals are submitted accurately and on time.

Others

  • Comply with hotel and department policies and procedures at all times.
  • Assist with Sales & Marketing projects and carry out other duties as assigned by Management.

Qualifications

  • Degree or Diploma in Hospitality, Tourism, Marketing, Communications, Public Relations or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 3 to 6 years of marketing communications or public relations experience, preferably within hospitality, travel, lifestyle, luxury, F&B or agency environments.
  • Leadership – experience in leading and managing teams
  • Excellent spoken and written English. Fluency in a second language is preferred.
  • AI-enabled marketer, proficient in Claude, ChatGPT, relevant tools for content creation, presentations, project management
  • Strong knowledge of marketing communications (Branding, Public Relations , Events, Advertising), hospitality trends, media//KOL connections locally/regionally
  • Excellent writing, editing, media pitching and content planning skills.
  • Strong stakeholder management with the ability to work across multiple business units and senior stakeholders.
  • Ability to brief agencies, designers, photographers and vendors with clear objectives and timelines.
  • Strong analytical skills with comfort using media monitoring, influencer analysis and campaign performance data.
  • Creative, proactive and commercially minded, with a passion for hospitality and guest experiences.
  • Collaborative, adaptable and able to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

The Procurement Analytics, Data Infrastructure & Data Products Manager will design, build, and evolve analytics platforms, data products, and master data foundations that support the Procurement and Supply Chain organization. This role partners closely with Strategic Sourcing, Finance, Operations, and IT to enable fact-based decisions through scalable data models, spend cubes, dashboards, and curated analytics products across Direct and Indirect spend.

This role is designed for a hands-on builder with a strong product mindset, combining data architecture, BI engineering, and financial acumen to translate complex procurement data into actionable insights that drive sourcing strategies, supplier performance, and enterprise cost optimization.

Key Responsibilities

Procurement Data Infrastructure & Architecture

  • Design, build, and maintain end-to-end data infrastructure including ingestion, transformation, modeling, and semantic layers.
  • Develop analytical cubes covering supplier, category, contract, volume, rate, and spend hierarchies.
  • Integrate contracts, purchase orders, invoices, finance actuals, and operational data into a single source of truth.
  • Establish governance and quality standards for supplier master, category hierarchies, and contract/rate data.

Spend, Financial & Should-Cost Analytics

  • Partner with Finance to align analytics to budgets, forecasts, P&L impacts, and savings baselines.
  • Deliver volume, rate, mix, price variance, and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analytics.
  • Connect negotiated rates and should-cost assumptions to actual spend to identify leakage and compliance gaps.

Reporting, Dashboards & Self-Service Enablement

  • Build scalable dashboards and reporting solutions (Power BI / Tableau) delivering executive-ready insights.
  • Develop intuitive, self-service analytics products embedded into regular business rhythms.
  • Translate complex datasets into clear, decision-oriented narratives for leadership.

Offshore Analytics & Data Engineering Partnership (Dotted-Line)

  • Provide functional (dotted-line) leadership to offshore analytics and data engineering teams supporting Procurement analytics.
  • Translate business requirements into clear technical direction, reviewing deliverables to ensure quality, scalability, and alignment to standards.
  • Leverage offshore capacity to accelerate delivery while retaining hands-on ownership of solution design and analytics outcomes.
  • Define and govern the ETL / ELT architecture and data pipeline requirements, including source integration, transformations, orchestration, and data quality controls, while providing functional (dotted‑line) direction to offshore teams responsible for building and maintaining the pipelines.

Product Ownership & Enablement

  • Act as analytics product owner by defining use cases, maintaining delivery roadmaps, and prioritizing enhancements based on business value.
  • Enable adoption through structured trainings, equipping category teams to self‑serve analytics by delivering hands‑on training, practical playbooks, and by embedding data products into core operating rhythms.

Future-Ready Data Foundation

  • Design AI-ready data structures and semantic layers enabling future ML, AI, and LLM-based procurement use cases.
  • Partner with IT and engineering teams on scalable, enterprise-grade cloud data architecture.

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • 5+ years in analytics, BI, or data engineering roles supporting Procurement, Supply Chain, or Finance.
  • Advanced SQL and data modeling skills, including experience with cloud-based analytics data platforms (preferred: Microsoft Fabric or AWS).
  • Strong understanding of procurement financials including Direct and Indirect spend.
  • Experience building BI dashboards and semantic models (Power BI / Tableau).
  • Strong stakeholder communication skills and product mindset.
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency.
  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Finance, Engineering, MIS, Analytics, or related field.

Benefits And Perks To Help You Keep Climbing

Our culture is rooted in a shared dedication to living our values – Care, Integrity, Resilience and Servant Leadership – every day, in everything we do. At Delta, our people are our success. At the heart of what we offer is our focus on Sharing Success with Delta employees. Exploring a career at Delta gives you a chance to see the world while earning great compensation and benefits to help you keep climbing along the way:

  • Competitive salary, industry-leading proﬁt sharing program, and performance incentives
  • 401(k) with generous company contributions up to 9%
  • New hires are eligible for up to 2-weeks of vacation. This is earned for use in the following vacation year (April 1 – March 31)
  • In addition to vacation, new hires are eligible for up to 56 hours of paid personal time within a 12-month period
    • 10 paid holidays per calendar year
  • Birthing parents are eligible for 12-weeks of paid maternity/parental leave
  • Non-birthing parents are eligible for 2-weeks of paid parental leave
  • Comprehensive health beneﬁts including medical, dental, vision, short/long term disability and life insurance beneﬁts
  • Family care assistance through fertility support, surrogacy and adoption assistance, lactation support, subsidized back-up care, and programs that help with loved ones in all stages
  • Holistic Wellbeing programs to support physical, emotional, social, and financial health, including access to an employee assistance program offering support for you and anyone in your household, free financial coaching, and extensive resources supporting mental health
  • Domestic and International space-available flight privileges for employees and eligible family members
  • Career development programs to achieve your long-term career goals
  • World-wide partnerships to engage in community service and innovative goals created to focus on sustainability and reducing our carbon footprint
  • Business Resource Groups created to connect employees with common interests to promote inclusion, provide perspective and help implement strategies
  • Recognition rewards and awards through the platform Unstoppable Together
  • Access to over 500 discounts, specialty savings and voluntary benefits through Deltaperks such as car and hotel rentals and auto, home, and pet insurance, legal services, and childcare
