job.job_description:
Organization- Hyatt Corporate Office

Summary

The Opportunity

Hyatt Hotels Corporation is looking for an innovative Director of Social Media & Content to join our Global Marketing team to lead and transform social for one of hospitality’s most loved loyalty programs. This Director will lead Hyatt's global social media strategy, operations, and evolution for World of Hyatt. Social is one of the most important ways guests discover brands, share experiences, and decide where to travel. This role will define how World of Hyatt shows up in culture, earns attention, builds community, and turns social engagement into brand affinity, consideration, loyalty, and business results. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list since 2013. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

  • Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on-site fitness center
  • A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption
  • Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

The Role

This is a build-and-evolve leadership role for a social-native strategist with a strong point of view on what makes content worth watching, sharing, and remembering. The ideal candidate has demonstrated the ability to grow meaningful engagement, build audiences, and create a creator and influencer network from the ground up. They will bring a practical, forward-looking perspective on changing platforms, formats, technologies, and audience behaviors - and turn that perspective into action.

The Director will lead a team of social professionals and agency partners while working closely with brand and regional teams, media, communications, digital, customer care, marketing, hotel, product, and other partners globally. This role will set the quality bar for World of Hyatt's social presence and create the clarity, operating model, and momentum that allow teams to move quickly, test intelligently, learn across channels and build cultural relevance.

How you will make an impact:

  • Own and continually evolve Hyatt's global social media strategy for World of Hyatt, aligning business priorities, brand objectives, audience needs, and evolving technologies.
  • Set a clear point of view for how World of Hyatt can use social to strengthen brand relevance, deepen guest relationships, grow communities, and support commercial objectives.
  • Lead strategies that grow meaningful engagement, audience communities, content effectiveness, and loyalty across priority social platforms. Build on what is working, challenge what is not, and create a culture of testing, iteration and innovation.
  • Build and scale a creator and influencer network from the foundation up, including recruitment, relationship development, program mechanics, briefings, contracts, content frameworks, partner with media on affiliate or incentive structures where appropriate, measurement, and long-term program growth.
  • Own the social-native content strategy across formats including short-form video, creator-led storytelling, community content, live experiences, guest and user-generated content, and platform-native series. Understand what belongs in each format and share learnings across channels to maximize reach, efficiency, and impact.
  • Set the quality bar for World of Hyatt's social content and partner with brand, communications, and creative teams to ensure the work reflects Hyatt's purpose, brand identities, destinations, hotels, and guest experience while remaining distinctive and culturally relevant.
  • Create the operating model, processes, governance, tools, and standards required to activate social effectively across global, regional, and hotel teams. Establish a center of excellence that helps colleagues create better work and move with confidence.
  • Serve as Hyatt's primary social media subject matter expert, providing strategic guidance, education, playbooks, and best practices to colleagues and hotel teams. Help the organization stay current as platforms, creator norms, consumer behaviors, and disclosure expectations evolve.
  • Oversee real-time engagement, community management, social care, listening, and reputation management in partnership with customer care, communications, and regional teams. Understand how to turn people who already love Hyatt into active participants and advocates.
  • Establish and maintain a comprehensive social measurement framework, including benchmarks and KPIs for reach, audience growth, engagement quality, video performance, creator impact, sentiment, traffic, conversion, and business contribution. Make clear what is working, why it is working, and where to invest next.
  • Lead the evaluation and adoption of emerging platforms, technologies, formats, and tools - including AI-enabled capabilities where they can improve speed or quality - and make informed recommendations about where Hyatt should test, invest, or scale.
  • Partner with media, digital, brand, and agency teams on paid social activation and integrated campaigns. Know when to seed content organically, when to amplify it, and how to adapt it for audiences and channels further up the consideration funnel.
  • Manage the social media budget, agency relationships, technology partners, and other external vendors .

Qualifications

Experience Required:

  • 10+ years of experience in social media, digital marketing, content, communications, or a related field, with substantial experience leading social strategy and operations for a consumer-facing brand or business.
  • 5+ years of people leadership experience, including experience leading managers, hiring and developing talent and building high-performing teams.
  • A demonstrated record of growing meaningful social engagement and audience communities. You can show the work, explain the choices behind it, and connect performance to business or brand outcomes.
  • Proven experience building and scaling a creator, influencer, ambassador, affiliate, or user-generated-content program - ideally from close to zero - including recruitment, relationships, program structure, content frameworks, and measurement.
  • Deep knowledge of major global social platforms and the craft of social-native video. You understand why a short-form social series and a brand film require different creative disciplines, and you know how to lead both without flattening either.
  • A defensible point of view on what makes content good, culturally relevant, and worth sharing, along with the creative judgment to set a high quality bar across formats.
  • A point of view on content strategy leveraging existing assets, UGC, and creating new content to maximize budget and engagement
  • An outcome-driven approach to measurement. You have built KPI frameworks, dashboards, benchmarks, and testing plans where they did not yet exist, and you know how to distinguish attention from meaningful engagement and business impact.
  • A track record of turning audience insights, cultural trends, and platform changes into innovative, practical strategies. You move at the speed of culture and product, with the judgment to protect the brand while experimenting.

The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all-encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary.

We welcome you:

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.

The salary range for this position is $142,500 - $190,000

The final pay rate/salary offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level and other qualifications for the role, as well as the location of the performance of work. Pay for the successful candidate will meet local requirements, including the local minimum wage rate.

We value our relationships with recruitment partners and require that agencies contact us first before submitting any candidates. Hyatt will not be responsible for any fees and obligations associated with unsolicited submissions unless a formal agreement is in place.

About Us

Kimpton Aysla Mallorca is a sanctuary of calm and well-being, nestled among the lush foliage of sunny southern Mallorca. A progressive take on country-club life, where active leisure meets utter relaxation, and touches of tradition blend with modern values. This is modern lifestyle lux – Mallorca style.

Why We're Here

We believe heartfelt, human connections make people's lives better. Especially the people who work here.

Our founder, Bill Kimpton rebelled against impersonal, generic hospitality that makes people feel disconnected. He initiated a new boutique hotel standard and environment where people could connect, from the heart. That was the goal then, and it is still our purpose today.

Your work here has meaning. You're here to improve the lives of coworkers, guests, owners, communities, and together we make that happen. It's what drives all that we do. Every day you can improve lives in your own, unique way and you can expect the same in return. It all starts with you.

How We're Different

Our San Francisco-born entrepreneurial spirit and zest for life kick started this culture in 1981, and it shines through to this day.

It all flows from you. The lively, rebellious, genuine you - with your diverse background, talents, experiences, and plucky personality - is fully welcome, and celebrated here. Because we know that when people can be themselves at work, they shine.

That's what we seek out and celebrate. It's people of all kinds who share a knack for creativity and self-leadership. People who don't need to be told what to do to get things done. People who have an innate passion for making others' lives better.

It adds up to a work environment that's a bit quirky, irreverent, exciting, uncommon, empowering, and downright exceptional. Guests feel it; you'll feel it too.

Working at Kimpton is not just about working. And it’s certainly not like working at other places. We value personality, individuality, creativity, doing right, continually improving, focus and passion.

Differences make a difference. We are committed to creating a culture that reflects the diversity of our hotel and restaurant guests. With that goal in mind, we encourage each of our employees to understand, accept, and celebrate differences among people. That includes different personalities, lifestyles, work styles, education, and experience. We also welcome and embrace people of all races, ethnicities, ages, religions, physical abilities, sexual orientation, gender identities and genders.

Be Yourself – Lead Yourself – Make it Count

What’s the job?

As Sales Manager you will develop business through direct sales solicitation for different markets segments.

Reports to the Director of Sales & Marketing.

Your day-to-day

  • Establish client base from different markets businesses through direct outside and inside selling to secure business for the hotel to ensure that room night sales and revenue goals are met or exceeded.
  • Actively prospect and qualify new business.
  • Achieve personal and team goals as assigned.
  • Negotiate guest room rates, meeting room rental, function space, and/or hotel services within approved booking guidelines.
  • Accurately produce and/or review all sales contracts, rate agreements, and/or banquet/catering event orders.
  • May assist in developing and implementing sales plans. May also participate in the annual budgeting and planning process.
  • Work closely with other hotel departments to facilitate services agreed upon by the sales office and prospective clients.
  • Arrange and conduct special events, site inspections, and off-site presentations for potential clients.
  • Attend and represent hotel at trade shows and conventions and/or participate in sales trips to key feeder markets.
  • Follow up with clients regularly during and after departure to ensure satisfaction and secure future bookings.

What We Need From You

  • Bachelor’s degree in sales, marketing or related field.
  • 3+ years’ experience working in hotel sales department.
  • Must be fluent in local language, English and German. Any other language will be a plus.
  • Proactive, positive, energetic, dynamic, emphatic, team-worker and with passion for service.
  • Competitive and proactive seller willing to travel to find the right business.
  • Opera PMS and Delphi knowledge will be highly valuable.

What To Expect From Us

  • Discounted international room rates.
  • Employee recognition programmes.
  • Training programmes and access to IHG’s training tool.

Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

At Tripadvisor experiences, the only thing we love more than travel is data. We slice it, we dice it, and we use it to empower our decision making.

About The Role

As a Principal Product Data Scientist, you will operate as the most senior technical leader in the Product Data Science function. You will shape the vision, set the technical direction, and drive strategic impact through innovative analytical solutions. This role is both highly technical and deeply collaborative, requiring excellence in leadership, communication, and cross-functional influence.

What You Will Do

  • Lead and define the Data Science strategy for Product, ensuring that advanced analytics, data science, and AI methodologies are central to how we build great products and improve customer experiences.
  • Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to senior Product and Engineering leadership, ensuring that data-driven decision making is embedded at the highest levels of the organization.
  • Drive the development and adoption of next-generation data science tooling, platforms, and frameworks, with a focus on automation, scalability, and reproducibility.
  • Spearhead the exploration and integration of emerging AI technologies, such as Agentic AI and AI Agents, identifying and developing high-impact use cases from POC to production.
  • Champion best practices in experimentation, causal inference, and uplift modeling, ensuring statistical rigor in decision-making processes.
  • Take ownership of the most complex, high-profile analytical projects, translating ambiguous questions into clear, actionable recommendations that deliver commercial and customer value.
  • Mentor, coach, and develop other Data Scientists and Analysts, fostering a culture of critical thinking, continuous learning, and technical excellence.
  • Lead initiatives to scale impact through automation, self-service, and democratization of data science capabilities.
  • Develop sophisticated customer segmentation, and predictive models that directly inform and optimize the product roadmap.
  • Communicate complex analytical and technical concepts to diverse audiences, influencing stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, and Commercial teams.

Skills & Experience

  • Experience: Extensive experience in data science or a similar quantitative role, with a proven track record of supporting and influencing a product organization.
  • Technical & Modeling Expertise: Expert Level proficiency in Python and SQL. Deep, hands-on experience with statistical modeling, (quasi) experimentation, multi-arm bandit, and a wide range of machine learning techniques (e.g., Regression, Classification, Clustering).
  • Product Acumen: Demonstrated ability to define, implement, and operationalize crucial product and feature-level metrics from scratch.
  • Strategic Influence: A proven track record of driving strategic impact through proactive and collaborative approach with the proven ability to lead technical discussions, drive product strategy, and communicate complex insights effectively to cross-functional partners (e.g., Product, Engineering, Design).
  • Scaling Impact: Experience scaling analytics capabilities, driving impact through the creation of automated processes, self-service tools, or data products.
  • Critical Thinking: Leader in critical thinking, your previous experience will demonstrate the analysis of available facts, evidence, observations, and arguments in order to form a judgment by the application of rational, skeptical, and unbiased analyses and evaluation.
  • Leadership: Outstanding leadership skills, with experience in mentoring, coaching, and developing teams of analysts or data scientists.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Exceptional collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to engage, influence, and inspire cross-functional partners at all levels.
  • Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Engineering, Physics, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

You could be an especially great fit if you have:

  • Advanced programming background with the ability to build simulations and prototype data products.
  • Experience validating quantitative findings with qualitative methods (e.g., surveys, user research).
  • Demonstrated experience with applied AI, such as NLP, Large Language Models (LLMs), or Agentic AI for analytics.
  • Experience working within a two-sided marketplace, e-commerce, or the travel technology industry.
  • Masters degree or equivalent relevant programs

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!

No matter if you’re an accomplished tech whizz, an aspiring entertainer, or simply in love with flying.
There’s a place for you here.
job.job_description:
Bei der TUI Deutschland GmbH bieten wir ab August 2027 eine äußerst interessante und vielseitige Ausbildung Tourismuskaufleute (m/w/d) mit dem Schwerpunkt Reisevermittlung in Minden an.

Die TUI Deutschland GmbH ist der führende Reiseveranstalter auf dem deutschen Markt und eine Tochtergesellschaft der TUI Group. Sie steuert von Hannover aus nicht nur die Entwicklung, sondern auch den Vertrieb und die Vermarktung von TUI-Reisen in Deutschland. Neben der Kernmarke TUI gehören auch Spezialisten wie airtours, ltur und Gebeco zur Unternehmensgruppe. TUI Deutschland verantwortet außerdem die Geschäfte in Österreich und der Schweiz, um das zentraleuropäische Geschäft zu bündeln.

UNSER ANGEBOT

Deine Entwicklung

  • strukturiertes Onboarding
  • Schulungen, Seminare und Workshops
  • Seminarreise und ein mehrwöchiger Auslandseinsatz
  • umfangreiche Unterstützung bei deiner Prüfungsvorbereitung

Deine Vorteile

  • 30 Urlaubstage
  • Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld
  • attraktive Ausbildungsvergütung (1.082 € / 1.193 € / 1.337 € / Monat)
  • Reisevergünstigungen
  • Seminarreise und Auslandseinsatz
  • Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket/Jobticket
  • Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft

Deine Perspektiven

  • Netzwerkaufbau
  • internationale Zusammenarbeit
  • Übernahmemöglichkeiten in der gesamten TUI Welt, bei herausragenden Leistungen eine Übernahmegarantie

ZUR POSITION

Du liebst Reisen, bist kommunikativ und möchtest anderen zu unvergesslichen Urlaubserlebnissen verhelfen? Dann starte deine Ausbildung bei TUI! Im Reisebüro bist du die erste Anlaufstelle für unsere Kund:innen und unterstützt sie dabei, genau die Reise zu finden, die zu ihren Wünschen passt. Du berätst zu Reisezielen weltweit, vergleichst Angebote, organisierst individuelle Urlaubserlebnisse und stehst vor, während und nach der Reise als Ansprechpartner:in zur Seite. So wirst du Schritt für Schritt zum Reiseprofi und machst aus Reiseträumen echte Erlebnisse.

Freu Dich Auf

  • Einblicke in die Abläufe eines Reisebüros
  • Planung und Verkauf von Reiseerlebnissen
  • Kleine Teams und Zusammenarbeit mit tollen Kolleg*innen
  • Kennenlernen unserer unterschiedlichen Hotelkonzepte, Marken und Reiseprodukte
  • Übernahme eigener Verantwortung und aktive Mitgestaltung
  • Verständnis dafür, wie aus einer Idee ein unvergessliches Urlaubserlebnis entsteht

Bei uns bekommst du vielfältige Einblicke, übernimmst Verantwortung und entwickelst dich Schritt für Schritt zum Profi der Touristikbranche.

ZU DIR

Du passt zu uns, wenn...

  • du Reiseträume wahr werden lassen möchtest.
  • du gerne mit Menschen arbeitest und Kommunikation zu deinen Stärken zählt. 
  • du offen für Neues bist und Veränderungen eher spannend als anstrengend findest. 
  • du digital unterwegs bist und moderne Tools selbstverständlich nutzt. 
  • du im Team aufblühst und Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest. 
  • du (Fach)Abitur oder einen erweiterten Realschulabschluss mitbringst.

Noten sind wichtig. Noch wichtiger ist uns aber deine Persönlichkeit, deine Motivation und deine Begeisterung für die Touristik.

Lade deine Bewerbung einfach online hoch: 

  • Anschreiben (oder erzähl uns auf kreative Weise, warum du zu uns passt) 
  • Lebenslauf 
  • Deine letzten zwei Schulzeugnisse bzw. dein Abschlusszeugnis 
  • Optional: Praktikumsnachweise, Zertifikate oder weitere Unterlagen, die zeigen, wer du bist 

Bereit für deinen Start bei TUI? ️✈️

  • Bewirb dich online und sende uns deine Unterlagen. 
  • Zeig uns, wer du bist – im Auswahlprozess möchten wir dich und deine Stärken kennenlernen.
  • Lerne uns persönlich kennen – ab November laden wir dich zu unserem Bewerberauswahlverfahren ein.
  • Willkommen an Bord! Wenn alles passt, erhältst du dein Vertragsangebot und startest im August 2027 deine Reise bei TUI. 

Von einem Arbeitsplatz zu einem Ort, an dem man dazugehört. Bei TUI schätzen wir Vielfalt, Gleichberechtigung und Inklusion und ermutigen alle, so zu sein, wie sie sind. „Come as you are“ – das ist unsere Vision, denn nur durch Vielfalt ist unser Potenzial grenzenlos. Wir ermuntern Menschen mit Behinderung, sich zu bewerben.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Agoda is a leading global online travel platform connecting millions of travellers with accommodation, flights, and activities across 2 million+ properties in 200+ countries. As part of Booking Holdings, the world's largest online travel group, we combine the agility of a tech startup with global scale, investing heavily in data science, machine learning, and product innovation to make travel easier for everyone.

The Opportunity

Agoda's Customer Experience Group (CEG) is a large, globally distributed operation serving millions of customers through thousands of agents across owned sites and BPO partners. This role leads the Enablement Team Engine at the heart of CEG, the three interconnected functions that detect performance gaps, build capability, and drive adoption at scale. Talent Development, Quality Assurance and Change & Communications teams are all part of this function.

With generative AI reshaping how we learn and work, QA automation raising the bar on insight quality, and major platform migrations underway in 2026, this is a pivotal moment to shape how 3,000+ agents and leaders grow, perform, and change.

What You'll Do:

Strategic Leadership

  • Set the vision and multi-year roadmap for Talent Development, Quality Assurance, and Change & Communications, ensuring they operate as one integrated Enablement engine aligned to CEG business priorities and OKRs.
  • Champion the adoption of generative AI across learning, QA, and communications workflows, and lead the function through significant platform migrations and operational transformation.

Talent Development

  • Own the end-to-end learning architecture, onboarding, continuous learning, leadership development, and specialised upskilling, and drive measurable capability uplift using data from QA and operations to iterate fast.
  • Embed coaching frameworks that empower leaders to develop their teams day-to-day, and partner with HR, Operations, and Product to build capability ahead of demand.

Quality Assurance

  • Lead a QA function that goes beyond scoring, build frameworks that generate actionable behavioural and performance insights, drive automation at scale, and establish calibration processes that ensure consistency across owned sites and BPO partners.
  • Use root-cause analysis to influence process, product, and policy decisions upstream, not just to report scores.

Change & Communications

  • Lead CEG's change management capability for major transformations, build structured frameworks covering impact assessment, adoption tracking, and resistance management as standard practice across the organisation.
  • Own CEG's internal communications strategy: leadership messaging, channel management, engagement programmes, and knowledge architecture that keeps a distributed global workforce informed and aligned.

People Leadership

  • Lead, develop, and inspire a team of 140 across three sub-functions, coaching direct reports to operate with strategic independence and building a high-performance culture with clear accountability at every level.
  • Drive team engagement and retention; advocate actively for your people's growth and next career moves.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Act as a trusted partner to CEG Operations, HR, Product, and Technology leadership, translating Enablement outputs into business impact and representing the function at senior leadership level.
  • Manage BPO partner relationships to ensure Enablement standards are consistently embedded beyond Agoda's owned sites.

What We're Looking For:

Required Experience

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in Learning & Development, Quality, or Organisational Effectiveness, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role managing multi-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated track record leading at least two of the three disciplines (TD, QA, Change & Communications) in a large, complex, customer-facing environment.
  • Experience designing and scaling learning programmes, QA frameworks, or change initiatives in a contact centre, BPO-managed, or global operations context.
  • Strong data orientation, you use metrics to make decisions, evaluate impact, and challenge assumptions, not just to report activity.
  • Proven ability to lead through ambiguity and deliver in a high-velocity, iterative environment; comfortable with fast change and imperfect information.
  • Excellent communication and influencing skills, able to engage credibly at C-suite level and on the contact centre floor.
  • Experience managing or partnering with BPO / outsourced operations is strongly preferred.

Preferred / Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with generative AI tools applied to learning design, QA automation, or communications.
  • Background in travel tech, e-commerce, or other high-volume digital consumer businesses.
  • Familiarity with knowledge management systems and content governance in large-scale operations.

Why Agoda

  • Scale that matters, your work shapes the capability and performance of thousands of customer-facing professionals across a global operation.
  • A data-first, fast-iteration culture where ideas are tested, results are measured, and good work is recognized, no politics, no bureaucracy for its own sake.
  • Access to the resources, best practices, and talent networks of Booking Holdings, one of the world's leading technology companies.
  • A genuinely diverse, collaborative team spanning dozens of nationalities, with a Bangkok Operational HQ that is a hub of energy, innovation, and opportunity.
  • Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and real scope to grow into broader CEG, Agoda or Booking Holdings leadership.

Please review our Hiring Process Guidelines before your interview — click here to learn how interviewing at Agoda works.

Discover More About Working At Agoda

  • Agoda Careers https://careersatagoda.com
  • Facebook https://www.facebook.com/agodacareers/
  • LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/agoda
  • YouTube https://www.youtube.com/agodalife

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Agoda, we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds and orientations. We prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and innovation. Employment at Agoda is based solely on a person’s merit and qualifications. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity regardless of sex, age, race, color, national origin, religion, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, citizenship, veteran or military status, and other legally protected characteristics.

We will keep your application on file so that we can consider you for future vacancies and you can always ask to have your details removed from the file. For more details please read our privacy policy.

Disclaimer

We do not accept any terms or conditions, nor do we recognize any agency’s representation of a candidate, from unsolicited third-party or agency submissions. If we receive unsolicited or speculative CVs, we reserve the right to contact and hire the candidate directly without any obligation to pay a recruitment fee.

job.job_description:
Organization- Hyatt Corporate Office

Summary

This is a hybrid opportunity based in the Miami/Broward area of Florida.

The Opportunity

Hyatt Hotels Corporation seeks an enthusiastic Revenue Analyst to join our Revenue Management Team. In this role, you will be collaborating closely with the broader Revenue Management, Commercial and on Property teams, where you’ll be instrumental in continuing to make Hyatt a leading hospitality company. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list since 2013. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

  • Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on-site fitness center
  • A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption
  • Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

The Role

The Revenue Analyst is a strategic, data-driven professional responsible for supporting and optimizing hotel revenue performance across all market segments. This role oversees key revenue management functions, analyzes business trends, and develops actionable insights that drive revenue growth, market share, and profitability.

Working closely with the Regional Revenue Director or Cluster Director, the Revenue Analyst produces and interprets reports that evaluate business strategies, identify opportunities, and maximize total hotel revenue while improving RevPAR Index performance. The position leverages market intelligence, forecasting, pricing, and demand analysis to recommend optimal revenue strategies for both package and non-package business.

The successful candidate combines strong analytical capabilities with a collaborative leadership approach, partnering with hotel teams to educate, mentor, and support revenue-focused decision-making. Through effective communication and data-driven recommendations, the Revenue Analyst helps ensure alignment between revenue strategies and overall hotel business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

job.job_description:
About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

At Tripadvisor experiences, the only thing we love more than travel is data. We slice it, we dice it, and we use it to empower our decision making.

What You Will Do

As a Principal Data Scientist you will be a leading individual contributor responsible for how experimentation works across the organisation.

You will lead through technical depth, setting the standards others work to and raising the quality of measurement and decision-making across the function.

You will build the capability that lets teams experiment well without central support: the standards, tooling and protocols that make good practice the default, and a strategy for how it develops over time.

Both the speed and the reliability of decision-making should improve as a result. You will also take on the measurement questions we cannot currently answer well, where traffic is thin or the outcomes that matter take months to appear.

You Will

  • Set the technical standard for experimentation across Product Data Science, from conventional A/B testing to quasi-experimental and Bayesian methods, and make it practical through protocols, frameworks and tooling.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering and Data Platform teams to improve experimentation velocity without sacrificing rigour.
  • Critically assess how experimentation and the decisions that follow it affect platform health and growth, and make that relationship visible to leadership.
  • Own the measurement approach for Viator's most complex questions, where standard experimentation is insufficient and the method has to be designed rather than selected.
  • Develop and validate the statistical methods the organisation relies on, including simulation-based verification that they behave correctly before teams depend on them.
  • Act as the final technical authority on measurement validity, adjudicating disputed results and determining what the evidence does and does not support.
  • Standardise recurring analytical and experimentation processes across the function, using automation and AI capabilities where they materially improve consistency, throughput or quality.
  • Design and land methodological improvements with organisation-wide impact, such as variance reduction for difficult metrics, approaches for low-traffic surfaces, proxy and surrogate metrics for long-horizon outcomes, and designs that hold up where users compete for shared supply.
  • Grow the technical depth of the wider team by reviewing designs, mentoring senior data scientists, and improving how people reason about measurement.
  • Advise on where experimentation is the wrong tool and define what should be done instead.

Skills & Experience

  • Experience: Extensive experience in data science or a similar quantitative role, with a proven track record of supporting and influencing a product organisation.
  • Statistical & Experimentation Expertise: Authoritative command of experimentation in all its forms, from experimental design and variance reduction to causal inference, bandits and Bayesian methods. You should be able to develop and validate methodology, not only apply it.
  • Technical & Modelling Expertise: Expert level proficiency in Python and SQL. Deep, hands-on experience with statistical modelling, (quasi) experimentation, multi-arm bandits, and a wide range of machine learning techniques such as regression, classification and clustering.
  • Product Acumen: Demonstrated ability to define, implement and operationalise crucial product and feature-level metrics from scratch.
  • Partnership & Enablement: Demonstrated ability to improve how other teams work by providing guidance, tooling and protocols, increasing both the speed and the quality of their experimentation rather than absorbing the work yourself.
  • Decision Impact & Platform Health: Ability to critically assess how product decisions affect platform health and growth over time, and to bring that perspective into how experiments are designed and interpreted.
  • Standardising at Scale: Experience standardising processes, frameworks or methods across multiple teams, including the use of AI and automation to make good practice the default.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Proven ability to build strong relationships and drive outcomes across Product, Engineering, Data Platform and other central functions, often without direct authority.
  • Critical Thinking: Leader in critical thinking, with a demonstrated habit of establishing whether a result is trustworthy before establishing what it means.
  • Communication: Exceptional ability to explain measurement, method and uncertainty clearly to technical and non-technical audiences at every level.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Engineering, Physics, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

You could be an especially great fit if you have:

  • Experience with experimentation in a two-sided marketplace, where interference between users and finite shared supply complicate measurement.
  • Experience building and validating proxy or surrogate metrics for long-horizon outcomes, and a clear view of how far they can be trusted.
  • Experience with Bayesian and hierarchical approaches, particularly for low-traffic surfaces or pooling evidence across many small markets.
  • Experience building or materially improving experimentation platforms, measurement frameworks, self-service capabilities or data products.
  • Experience in a high-scale technology company, marketplace, e-commerce business or travel technology organisation, and familiarity with the seasonality and long purchase cycles that come with them.
  • Breadth in statistical modelling and machine learning, such as regression, classification, clustering and bandits, alongside your experimentation depth.
  • Experience applying AI, Large Language Models, agentic AI or automation to improve analytical productivity and decision-making effectiveness.
  • A reputation for raising the standard of thinking and decision-making in every team you join.
  • Experience with SaaS experimentation tools such as Statsig, Eppo or GrowthBook, or with an in-house platform.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Principal Product Manager, BEX AI Experiences

Introduction to the Team:

For 30 years, Expedia has helped people plan and book the trips that matter to them, and travelers count it among the most trusted brands in travel. AI is now changing how people search, decide, and plan, and that change is happening faster than anything our industry has seen since travel moved online. This role sits where those two things meet. You will have the trust and travel expertise of a brand millions of people already rely on, along with the freedom to reinvent how a trip gets planned. The job is to move fast with new technology while staying true to the travelers who depend on us to get their trip right. Few product roles anywhere offer that combination.

You will set the vision, strategy, and roadmap for AI across the Brand Expedia experience. That includes the AI tools travelers use today, the capabilities our platform teams are building, how Expedia shows up in other AI products, and new experiences we have not built yet. Your work will span contextual AI that understands where a traveler is in their trip, natural language search, agentic experiences that take work off the traveler's plate, multimodal inputs, and new apps. You will decide where AI should help, where it should stay out of the way, and how we know it is working for travelers and for the business.

Planning a trip is hard. People juggle dates, budgets, family preferences, and dozens of open tabs, often over several weeks. We want a product leader who is obsessed with that experience and believes AI can make trip planning feel easy, even fun. You will also have room to experiment. Alongside Brand Expedia, our portfolio includes Travelocity, Orbitz, and a long tail of brands such as Flights.com. That gives us places to test new ideas with different audiences and at different scales, then bring the winners to more travelers.

In This Role You Will

  • Write the product vision and multi-year strategy for AI on Brand Expedia, grounded in what travelers need and in where competitors and the technology are heading. Bring leaders across product, design, engineering, marketing, and brand along with you.
  • Own the roadmap for AI-powered experiences across inspiration, planning, booking, and the trip itself. Keep it current as the technology changes, and order it by what travelers need most.
  • Spend real time with travelers. Use research, behavioral data, and your own trip planning to find the moments where planning breaks down, and build from there.
  • Get hands-on with the technology. Prototype with large language models, shape prompts and agent behavior with engineers and designers, and track new model capabilities for ideas worth testing.
  • Set the standard for responsible AI on Brand Expedia. Work with engineering and science on how we evaluate, monitor, and tune models before and after launch, so every experience is accurate, helpful, and safe for travelers.
  • Partner with engineering leaders and the platform teams building agentic capabilities, skills, and travel expertise. Define what Brand Expedia needs, shape the architecture choices and tech debt priorities that decide how fast we can ship, and agree on dates.
  • Work with our partnership teams to shape how Expedia appears in third-party AI assistants and tools.
  • Make sure AI feels like one connected experience across Expedia's apps, site, and brands, rather than a set of separate features.
  • Own the business case. Make build, buy, or partner decisions, and take accountability for the financial results of what you launch.
  • Design and run experiments across Brand Expedia and our portfolio brands, including new apps and experiences outside today's site. Decide whether to scale, change, or stop each one.
  • Define how we measure success. Usage tells us whether travelers find the experience. Completed trips, multi-item bookings, and repeat travel tell us whether it matters.
  • Raise the bar for AI product craft across the organization. Coach product managers on customer journeys, traveler personas, and clear writing, and help build a team culture that is inclusive and keeps improving.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, business, or a related technical field with 12+ years of relevant experience, or a master’s degree in one of these fields with 10+ years of relevant experience; equivalent related professional experience may be considered.
  • Experience leading product strategy and delivering consumer experiences used at scale, with accountability for measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience shipping products built on large language models or machine learning, including conversational or natural language interfaces, agentic workflows, personalization, recommendations, or multimodal experiences.
  • Experience owning product vision, strategy, roadmaps, experimentation, and success metrics across a multi-experience or multi-domain product area.
  • Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products, including the ability to collaborate with engineering and science teams on model evaluation, monitoring, tuning, and responsible deployment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated ability to lead AI product strategy across a broad consumer ecosystem and connect experiences across applications, websites, brands, and third-party AI assistants.
  • Hands-on experience shaping agentic capabilities, skills, travel expertise, prompts, tool use, retrieval, memory, evaluation, latency, and cost tradeoffs with engineering and science partners.
  • Track record of building new products within a larger organization, using experimentation and data-driven decision-making to determine whether to scale, change, or stop an initiative.
  • Experience making architecture, technical debt, and build-versus-buy-or-partner decisions that improve the speed, quality, and economics of AI product delivery.
  • Advanced use of AI tools and workflows to improve product development, with experience translating emerging large language model and multimodal capabilities into safe, useful, and measurable consumer experiences.

The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $224,000.00 to $313,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $358,500.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Benefits And Perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. job.job_description:
Organization- Hyatt Corporate Office

Summary

The Opportunity

Hyatt Hotels Corporation seeks an enthusiastic Associate Field Marketing Manager for the Essentials portfolio to join a team that loves being the connection between corporate marketing strategy and hotel execution and is eager to develop their skill set through providing additional marketing support to members of the Field Marketing team, where you’ll be instrumental in continuing to make Hyatt a leading hospitality company. In this role, you will collaborate closely with multiple teams – such as Sales, Operations, Digital and Brand – on a shared goal: to drive hotel revenue. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list since 2013. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

  • Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on-site fitness center
  • A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption
  • Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

The Role

This position is responsible for supporting an effective digital marketing and media strategy for a designated portfolio of hotels for the Field Marketing Program hotels in the Latin America & Caribbean region. The Associate Field Marketing Manager helps develop and implement online marketing campaigns to acquire new customers, increase hotel revenues, market share and brand awareness while measuring and reporting on brand and property performance, and consulting with internal and external stakeholders. Digital encompasses organic and paid search, display/banner ads, mobile, paid social media, website, and email. In addition, they will also assist other Field Marketing Managers with tactical support and execution across digital content, website maintenance, regional offers and reporting for their hotels.

Additional responsibilities include:

  • Managing digital marketing programs for Field Marketing program hotels. Daily management of hotel websites, third party business and paid media listings (transient)
  • Plan and execute web content, SEO, SEM, Paid Social, Meta strategy for a portfolio of hotels. Support World of Hyatt, email marketing activation for the hotels
  • Assist hotels in the development of annual marketing plans and budgets to provide recommendations for spend based on market analysis, current performance metrics and best practices
  • Attend property/regional-level sales and revenue management calls as deemed necessary to inform digital plans and execution. Understand business needs and competition for properties and cluster regions, developing local marketing objectives, strategies, and tactics to meet owner objectives
  • Provide ongoing support to hotels to optimize online hotel presence, with a particular focus on growing book direct revenue and channel mix. Serve as a strategist and liaison for properties for digital agency programs and in other consultative matters
  • Coordinate with Field Marketing Managers to support tactical execution of marketing strategies for Field Marketing program hotels. Supporting website content management, third party listings, online optimizations, and reporting delivery
  • Deliver reporting to key stakeholders, including KPIs, comparative scorecards, summarization of performance and future recommendations and action items. Benchmark digital activities against comp set and peers in the industry, improving digital marketing strategy and tactics to be ahead of the curve
  • Provide ongoing training to property marketing teams. Develop how-to training manuals, guidance, and instruction on how to utilize our digital marketing platforms and tools to optimize digital activities and revenue performance to share with Field Marketing Managers and property marketing teams
  • Ensure property marketing programs and initiatives align closely with corporate and brand strategic priorities
  • Demonstrate a commitment to Hyatt core values

Ability to travel up to 10%

Qualifications

Experience Required:

  • 3+ years of experience in Digital Marketing, Media, or E-Commerce, with 6+ months of marketing and developing integrated plans for a global brand
  • Excellent interpersonal and written communications skills
  • Must be able to function at a fast pace in a service-oriented environment
  • Proven ability to impact and work with all levels of the organization
  • Build relationships and work effectively with numerous departments at the corporate office

Experience Preferred:

  • 2+ years hospitality marketing experience preferred
  • Initiative-taking, goal-oriented, creative, self-starter with exceptional prioritization, time management and organizational skills, including the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously effectively and competently and the flexibility and ability to quickly adapt to changes and new technologies
  • A passion for technology and digital media, including experience with communicating knowledge of evolving best practices and developing resources to action on web trends
  • Ability and willingness to operate in a fast-paced, complex corporate environment
  • Participant in DE&I activities and events
  • On property hotel experience
  • Bi-lingual (English and Spanish)

Skills Needed to Perform this Job:

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
  • Proficiency in online tools such as Adobe Analytics, Google My Business, TripAdvisor, Tableau, Google Applications, and various 3rd party listings
  • Knowledge of Koddi Private Markets platform
  • Ability to navigate through proprietary tools for Website Updates, Digital Asset Management, Custom ancillary promotional offers, and Vanity site platforms

The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all-encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary.

We welcome you:

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.

The salary range for this position is $80,000 - $85,000

The final pay rate/salary offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level and other qualifications for the role, as well as the location of the performance of work. Pay for the successful candidate will meet local requirements, including the local minimum wage rate.

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You’ll collaborate with key departments to streamline financial operations, manage cost control across storerooms and receiving, and help minimize food, beverage, and supply expenses. As a Cost Controller, you’re not just supporting the hotel’s financial operations – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Risk & Safety Management: Promote safe work practices to reduce accidents and workers' compensation costs; ensure hazard-free environments.
  • Credit & Financial Oversight: Conduct credit investigations, manage receivables, and ensure timely recovery or cancellation of non-performing accounts.
  • Team Collaboration: Build strong relationships with clients and partners—wholesalers, travel agents, airlines, and more—to support smooth operations.
  • Time & Document Management: Maintain accurate records, ensure timely credit application updates, and manage filing systems efficiently.
  • Operational Excellence: Process sundry payments, ensure accurate credit entries, and support any additional duties to keep hotel operations running smoothly.

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • Degree in Commerce, Accounting, Management, or related field; certified in Finance/Accounting
  • Professional accounting qualification preferred
  • Previous experience in a managerial operational accounting role.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.
  • Fluent in written and spoken English to meet business needs.
  • Good communication skills with clients.
  • Possess systems skills in OnQ, Check SCM, SUN, OPERA/ OnQ PMS, MICROS, HRLINK.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

This role is based in Bangkok, Thailand, and is open to candidates worldwide. We offer a generous relocation package to ensure a smooth transition to living and working in Bangkok.

Get to Know Our Team:

The Performance Marketing Team of Agoda is a world leader in online marketing. We are highly data-driven and focused on developing at-scale marketing programs that improve the lifetime value of our customers.

Our team is a blend of the bright analysts, marketing strategists, and data scientists in the world. We foster a great learning environment where you will be able to learn and grow by working closely with experts from a variety of backgrounds from all over the world.

With Performance Marketing, MSE is a business development and marketing role within Agoda’s marketing department. It involves working with online vertical search advertisers (Meta Search Engines) to drive hotel booking sales.

In this role, you'll get to:

  • Own and manage marketing spend with large Meta Search Engine (MSE) partners
  • Independently manage your accounts
  • Manage the commercial relationship with MSE partners, including commercial terms, bidding and pricing strategies, and technical implementation
  • Decide in coordination with the Bidding and Pricing teams strategies that deliver expected ROIs and revenue growth
  • Track detailed performance/KPIs and deliver regular data-driven actionable insights to improve results
  • Succinctly communicate the results, ideas, and business statistics with different stakeholders
  • Ensure the advertiser implements the right Agoda APIs and related technological innovations
  • Be immersed and intimately familiar with the entire booking funnel including the user experience and conversion drivers between the advertiser and Agoda
  • Build long term relationships with advertisers that foster new opportunities and continuous growth in return from advertising dollars

What you’ll need to succeed:

  • Bachelor Degree in Computer Science/Statistics/Math or Engineering or Economics and Finance
  • Business development and/or account management track record with experience in online marketing
  • Fluent in English with strong communication skills (both written and verbal)
  • Self-motivated person with “Get it done!” attitude
  • Passionately analytical with strong ability to think logically and excellent problem-solving skills
  • Proficient in business intelligence tools and data warehouse i.e. SQL, Tableau and MS Excel
  • Ability to effectively communicate, influence and persuade with different levels of stakeholders (including Senior Management) with proven strong commercial acumen
  • Ability to represent Agoda with experience in interacting with external senior level executives
  • Strong analytical and statistical analysis skills to extract insights and recommendations

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

What You'll Do

Own VIP (Variable Incentive Plan)Plan Design, Impact Modeling & Governance

  • Own end-to-end Variable Incentive Plans (VIP) & SPIFF program management, from recommendation through delivery, including new plans and exceptions.
  • Own Variable Incentive Plans (VIP) employee-level impact modeling — and the related financial impact estimates (annual cost), partnering with Finance to assess impact and secure funding approval.
  • Act as Sales Incentives subject matter expert building consensus with HR Compensation, HRBP and Finance ahead of Steering Committee review, and own preparation of Steering Committee approval materials (why, what, when, who, financial and employee impact).
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to Sales Leadership on incentive strategy, commercial structure, and execution rhythm.
  • Own submission of materials through the Geo Employee Representative Body (ERB) intake process, partnering with Geo on inform and consult requirements.
  • Own creation, maintenance, and issuance of VIP documentation (plan documents, T&Cs) and VIP setup in Workday (eligibility rules, employee VIP assignment).
  • Coordinate directly with Legal, Local Geo/Works Council teams, Finance, and Employee Communications as needed for VIP plan implementation.
  • Own the overall communication plan for VIP and commercial program changes. Communicate program vision and impact to senior leadership and wider organisation with clarity and confidence.

Own and Evolve the Sales Operating Model

  • Lead and partner with Sales Leaders and HR to define the evolution of the Sales Blueprint and Operating Framework, defining roles, competencies, KPIs, and actions that underpin sales excellence.
  • Lead the ongoing refinement, adoption, and execution of partner Tier Segmentation, ensuring clear differentiation of priorities, resourcing, and commercial approach, and driving consistent application across sales teams.
  • Drive adoption of the blueprint and sales frameworks across regions, embedding them into onboarding, coaching, and performance management.
  • Act as the connector between strategy and execution, ensuring sales excellence and VIP design are lived consistently across teams and regions.

Lead Strategic Sales Excellence Initiatives

  • Identify and lead complex, cross-functional programs that enhance sales performance and scalability, defining scope, governance, milestones, and success metrics.
  • Mobilize and influence senior stakeholders across Sales, Product, Legal, Finance, HR, and Commercial Operations.
  • Use data and AI to define KPIs, track sales excellence and VIP program effectiveness, and identify opportunities to simplify reporting and speed up decisions.

Who You Are

  • Strong program management and execution skills.
  • Experience on incentive plan design and employee impact modeling desired.
  • Experience navigating formal governance processes for any employee related changes.
  • Strong track record leading sales excellence, enablement, or commercial strategy programs at scale.
  • Comfortable operating at Senior Manager level: representing the function to senior stakeholders (VP+) with autonomy and minimal oversight.
  • AI-savvy and data-literate; confident using AI tools and data to shape design decisions, not just report on them.
  • Skilled at navigating cross-functional ambiguity across Sales, HR/Compensation, Legal, Finance, and Comms
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or related field; Travel or B2B SaaS experience preferred.

The total cash range for this position in Madrid is €70,000.00 to €98,000.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to €112,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership.
