job.job_description:
Job Description

Join us in creating a legacy where bespoke luxury meets sun-kissed adventures, Conrad Orlando at Evermore. As one of the most celebrated openings of 2024, be a part of the legacy as an Assistant Director of Sales!

Inspired by nature and fashioned for adventure, Conrad Orlando sits on the 1,100-acre Evermore Orlando Resort bordering Walt Disney World with a 20-acre tropical beach and 8-acre lagoon setting the stage for luxury which is as harmonious as it is captivating.

The stunning resort features 433 rooms (including 51 impeccably designed suites and 10 spacious family suites), 65,000 square feet of meeting space (40,000 indoor and 25,000 outdoor), a tranquil spa, two 18-hole golf courses, and 6 food and beverage outlets. This includes 3 restaurants (rooftop, southern Italian, and poolside), a cocktail bar, marketplace and in-room dining.

Why join the Conrad brand?

  • The modern luxury concept empowers you to deliver:
  • Personalized service with authenticity and passion
  • Impactful experiences
  • Creativity in our products and services

Want to learn more? Hotel Website , Facebook , Instagram

In this role, you will oversee a team of 2 Sales Managers and 1 team administrator while also managing a west coast sales region. This position will sit on-site at Conrad Orlando with overnight or weekend travel required 4-5 times a year. This role is approximately 60% sales and 40% team leadership.

The ideal candidate will have strong group sales experience with a solid understanding of luxury group dynamics. 5+ years' experience as a Senior Sales Manager or higher required within a full-service resort of 200 rooms or more.

Luxury resort experience and west coast region sales experience preferred.

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As an Assistant Director of Sales, you’re not just supporting the hotel’s sales strategy – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:

  • Drive sales within a key market segment: Manage a designated vertical market, applying expert sales skills to qualify leads, conduct outreach, deliver compelling proposals, and close business to meet revenue goals
  • Support strategic sales planning: Contribute to the hotel’s annual commercial strategy, aligning sales activities with business objectives, and collaborating with the broader commercial team to optimize performance
  • Execute targeted sales initiatives: Represent the hotel at tradeshows, client events, and sales calls; maintain a robust pipeline and develop plans to secure short- and long-term business
  • Foster stakeholder relationships: Engage with Hilton Worldwide Sales, Convention and Visitors Bureaus (CVBs), third-party travel partners, and key clients to drive demand, improve conversion, and support high-impact site visits and pre-convention meetings
  • Support sales performance and processes: Align day-to-day team activities with strategic goals by reinforcing business processes that drive revenue across Rooms, Catering, and Events
  • Track performance and market trends: Monitor business metrics, analyze the competitive landscape, and adjust tactics to meet evolving customer needs and market dynamics
  • Inspire and develop the team: Recruit, train, supervise, and mentor team members; conduct performance evaluations, provide professional development opportunities, and recognize achievements to build, engage and retain an engaged and high performing team

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

About The Team

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
  • Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
  • Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
  • Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
  • Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
  • Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Generous paid time off (PTO) – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters most
  • Health & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family covered
  • Financial security for your future – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what’s next
  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get To Know Our Team:

In the age of technology, things are constantly changing. The travel market is much the same, being more dynamic and complex than ever. Agoda’s Legal team is well suited to take on the challenges presented, adopting a proactive mindset to tackle challenges and solve problems. We are quick on our feet, decisive, and collaborate with multiple departments. We hire out-of-the-box thinkers that are well grounded with ethics and legal knowledge to ensure that Agoda achieves the right results, the right way.

The Opportunity:

We are looking for a highly autonomous, strategic, commercial and regulatory-focused sole legal counsel to lead our legal function in South Korea. As our only on-the-ground legal resource, you will act as the primary legal anchor for our local business. You will navigate a fast-moving and heavily regulated digital landscape, providing pragmatic advice to senior management while safeguarding our business interests.

The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in South Korean digital commerce regulations, privacy laws, and consumer protection. They will possess the confidence to handle complex issues with minimal supervision. The role requires sound legal judgment, strong analytical skills, the ability to manage complex multi-jurisdictional matters, and a practical, business-oriented approach to risk. The candidate should be comfortable working with cross-functional teams, coordinating external counsel, advising senior stakeholders, and helping the business move quickly while maintaining strong legal and compliance standards.

What You’ll Do:

Regulatory

  • Regulatory Navigation: Monitor, analyze, and ensure compliance with South Korean laws relevant to tech platforms and OTAs. This includes the Electronic Commerce Act, Act on Fair Labeling and Advertising, and Monopoly Regulation and Fair Trade Act. Act as the primary point of contact for local regulatory bodies, such as KFTC, KCC, PIPC, etc.
  • Data Privacy & Protection: Oversee absolute compliance with the Personal Information Protection Act (PIPA) regarding user data, cross-border data transfers, and cybersecurity protocols.
  • Licensing & Audits: Secure and maintain necessary local operating licenses and lead responses to regulatory audits or inquiries.

Commercial & Operations

  • Partner and Contract Management: Draft, review, and negotiate all local commercial agreements as well as managing stakeholders through negotiations from start to finish. These include partnerships with hotels, airlines, payment gateways, and marketing vendors, etc.
  • Localization Review: Review platform terms and conditions, user interfaces, promotional campaigns, and cancellation policies to ensure full alignment with strict Korean consumer protection mandates.
  • Turning legal advice into action: Work with stakeholders to move from legal analysis to implementation; helping teams understand their options, make informed decisions and execute the solutions.

Risk Management & Dispute Resolution

  • Litigation & Disputes: Manage customer disputes, claims filed with the Korea Consumer Agency (KCA), and coordinate external counsel for litigations.
  • Corporate Governance: Manage local corporate secretarial work and ensure corporate governance alignments with the global headquarters.
  • Risk Management: Identify legal risks early and develop proportionate, commercially workable mitigation strategies for the business.

Required Qualifications:

  • Education: LL.B., LL.M. or J.D. degree.
  • Experience: 5-10 years of post-qualification experience (PQE). A mix of law firm experience and in-house counsel experience at a multinational internet, e-commerce, or OTA company is highly preferred.
  • Regulatory Expertise: Proven track record dealing directly with the KFTC, KCC, or PIPC, with deep knowledge of consumer protection and data privacy law.
  • Language Proficiency: Native fluency in Korean and professional fluency in English is required for communicating with global teams.
  • Soft Skills: Possesses an exceptional commercial mindset, high resilience, and the capability to make firm, risk-based assessments independently in an ambiguous environment while effectively removing blockers and closing gaps between diverse stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with sound judgment and attention to detail.
  • Excellent academic credentials and experience working in a top-tier law firm and/or in-house legal team at a multinational company.
  • Experience with travel, technology, online platforms, fintech or another regulated digital business is preferred.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a large, diverse and collaborative team.
  • A demonstrated can-do, roll-up-your-sleeves approach, coupled with a strong work ethic and high integrity. You would rather get the right answer than the credit.
  • Ability to contribute at both the strategic and detailed levels, working collaboratively with colleagues and business teams to get things done.
  • Experience contributing to policies, procedures, training materials, playbooks or templates that improve legal efficiency and compliance.
  • Experience of using AI in an efficient and scalable manner.

Expedia Group Business to Business (EG B2B) partners with enterprises such as travel agencies, airlines, financial institutions, membership organizations and travel management companies to provide them with access to the leading Expedia Group travel inventory. We equip our partners with the right data, tools and technology that empowers them to build their business and maximize their potential.

You will shape the direction of EG B2B's rapidly growing business. In this role you will own strategic initiatives within the B2B Strategy & Transformation team, from framing the problem through to influencing the top leadership and driving cross-functional execution. You will lead the construction of the strategic plan, including market and competitor analysis and assessment of EG B2B performance, and you will represent Strategy & Transformation directly with senior leadership across Commercial, Product and Technology, and Finance. This position carries independent ownership of executive-facing workstreams and significant scope to shape how EG B2B competes.

Your role

  • Own the identification and prioritization of growth opportunities across B2B teams, and independently drive stakeholder alignment through to implementation
  • Lead the construction of strategic recommendations for the TLT and senior leadership, backed by rigorous analysis of pros, cons, cost, risk, resources, and timing
  • Act as a trusted advisor to VP and SVP-level stakeholders, shaping how they frame their biggest challenges and driving them toward decisions
  • Apply deep understanding of business processes to originate solutions against ambiguous, high-stakes objectives, not only respond to them
  • Direct the construction of advanced models and analyses across data sources, stress testing decisions and their impact across scenarios
  • Bring deep industry and market expertise to identify emerging trends ahead of the market and translate them into strategic bets
  • Serve as the senior go-to expert on how products and services should be applied within the industry to maximize enterprise value
  • Anticipate the financial and operational impact of key decisions across the B2B portfolio, and use that insight to steer multiple concurrent, complex initiatives
  • Assemble and mobilize the right mix of Commercial, Product and Technology, and Finance contributors for each initiative, adapting team composition as priorities shift
  • Lead virtual, cross-functional project teams assembled around specific initiatives, setting direction and holding contributors from other functions accountable to timelines and quality without formal reporting authority

Your experience

  • Bachelor's degree from top university required, MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred
  • 8+ years of experience within a management consulting firm, e-commerce and/or corporate strategy, including demonstrated progression into roles of increasing scope
  • Track record of leading cross-functional or matrixed teams and driving outcomes without formal management authority
  • Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with a track record of directing others' modeling, analysis, and presentation work
  • Comfortable operating with high ambiguity and imperfect information, with a demonstrated ability to originate structure where none exists
  • Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with experience navigating senior leadership teams and competing priorities across functions
  • Demonstrated ability to independently frame unstructured, ambiguous problems and set the agenda for how they get solved
  • Ability to distinguish key value drivers and high-impact actions from lower-value items, and to prioritize a portfolio of initiatives accordingly
  • A commercially astute self-starter with a track record of operating with minimal oversight

This role is based in Madrid, Spain. Candidates must have permission to work in Spain

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As an Assistant Financial Controller at Hampton by Hilton Bristol Airport, you’re not just assisting in the direction and administration of all hotel financial operations – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

How We'll Help You Thrive

At Hilton, the hospitality we're known for doesn't end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members'

  • Competitive pay – Earn up to £33,000 to £35,000 per annum
  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy discounted hotel stays through our Go Hilton travel programme, with room rates as low as $40 USD per night at participating hotels worldwide.
  • Food and beverage discounts – Receive 50% off food and beverage at participating outlets.
  • Free meals on duty – Helping you stay energised throughout your shift.
  • Generous holiday allowance – Enjoy 28 days' holiday including bank holidays, increasing with service.
  • Pension scheme – Supporting you as you plan for the future.
  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member location and terms and conditions of employment.

Responsibilities

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:

  • Support financial strategy execution: Assist in directing financial operations to ensure alignment with the hotel’s strategic goals, optimizing profitability and efficiency
  • Provide financial insights: Assist in reviewing financial performance, reconciling accounts, and preparing recommendations for hotel leadership and ownership
  • Manage financial operations: Oversee Accounts Receivable, Credit, and Night Audit functions, ensuring adherence to internal controls and financial policies
  • Oversee financial reporting: Lead the preparation and review of monthly financial statements, ensuring accuracy in cash receipt coding and supporting internal audits for transparency and compliance
  • Monitor and approve financial transactions: Review and authorize ledger reconciliations, tax filings, and payroll, ensuring financial accuracy and compliance

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team: 

The Corporate Strategy team works directly with Agoda's management team to provide business critical insights using analytics, ensure cross-functional alignment of goals and execution, and help teams drive strategic initiatives forward. We stay focused on aligning the highest-level company priorities with effective day-to-day operations and help evolve early-stage ideas into high-impact opportunities.

The Opportunity:

In this role you will be focusing on leading and contributing to a select number of projects, working with senior stakeholders across the organization. You will get to work closely with senior executives across functions - such as commercial/B2B, product, supply, marketing, and finance - to set our strategy and drive key business initiatives. You will develop outstanding insights on our markets, competitors, and business trends and disseminate this knowledge across Agoda to inform key decisions. You help our leaders run Agoda skillfully, which includes clarifying accountability and identifying and monitoring critical success metrics.

In this Role, you will get to: 

  • Lead your own team of analysts/managers on selected projects/requests from the top management
  • Help shape and drive internal performance analysis (trends, scenarios) relevant to corporate goal setting
  • Conduct industry, and competitor data analysis to support the definition of priorities and key issues
  • Develop draft business strategies and share with corporate strategy function
  • Support the creation of high-quality materials for senior stakeholders for both internal and external audiences
  • Help organize Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and other select team ceremonies (e.g., all hands, townhalls)
  • Track Objective and Key Results (OKRs) and conduct deep-dives on strategic topics as required
  • Coach analysts/manager to draft SQL queries to gather data from multiple databases within Agoda/ work with the analytics team to gather the required information for the analysis

What you will Need to Succeed:

  • Experience working in a similar role, ideally in a technology or travel focused company
  • Degree in BS or BA required
  • 6-8 years of Consulting experience is a strong plus
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Strong financial modeling skills
  • Ability to think strategically, learn fast and understand new business dynamics
  • Ability and willingness to drive projects independently, working efficiently to deliver results rapidly and engaging the relevant stakeholders throughout the process
  • Excellent ability to manage and influence senior stakeholders

It is great if you have:

  • Knowledge of SQL / Tableau or willingness to invest time to learn

This role will be based in Bangkok, Thailand. Relocation package will be provided.

  • Ably represent People Team in Agoda leadership forums, and represents Agoda in interactions with related brand companies in people-related topics aimed at sharing and learning best practices, harmonizing policies where appropriate such as inter-brand transfer

  • Translate people analytics into clear updates for stakeholders, shaping strategy and measuring program impact (e.g., exit drivers, retention, engagement, and performance-management trends)

  • Acute business acumen and understanding of how organizational structures and dynamics relate to execution
  • Deep experience implementing, operating, and improving performance management platforms and processes, preferably in fast moving Tech environments
  • Deep understanding of the systems and associated data across the employee lifecycle and attendant business processes across full employee lifecycle
  • Excellent executive presence and the ability to clearly articulate messages to a variety of audiences
  • Ability to bring business perspectives and facilitate outcomes is more important than experience in HR roles

  • Outstanding ability to lead a team with strong ability to prioritize and guide robust, detailed execution
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capability backed with excellent data sense
  • High level of discretion, confidentiality, and ethics
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to collaborate across a diverse, multicultural organization
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and change; brings structure and drive to deliver results
  • Humility, sense of humor, flexibility, good interpersonal skills and the ability to lead difficult conversations are a must
  • Undergraduate degree from a top university expected, advanced degrees welcome

As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Senior Manager, Business Performance Insights – Expedia Lodging & Portfolio

The Traveler Business Team has a mission to deliver the most convenient, rewarding, and memorable ways for people to travel and explore the world. This division has responsibility to build and drive the growth of our global consumer business across our Expedia, Hotels.com, Vrbo, and Portfolio brands, and across all our lines of businesses including Hotels, Vacation Rentals, Air, Car, Packages, and Insurtech.

We are looking for a Senior Manager of Business Performance Insights to join the Expedia & Portfolio team at Expedia Group. This role will be responsible for generating business performance insights for Expedia Lodging, which is the largest and fastest growing business in the Expedia portfolio

This is a fantastic opportunity to join the surging travel industry and help drive the business forward while working on impactful and complex problems. You will partner closely with Finance, Analytics, Marketing, Product & Tech and Supply teams to create compelling business performance insights to help Expedia & Portfolio brands win in the marketplace.

What You’ll Do

  • Own analysis of key site metrics (e.g., traffic, conversion, GBV, cancellations, take rate, GP) across multiple dimensions such as Brand, Geo, Experience (or platform), Channel, and Line of Business
  • Set annual performance targets, linked with strategic initiatives, and reforecast the targets regularly in close partnership with Finance and business leads
  • Monitor and drive performance towards those targets, including by optimizing spend allocation and by identifying short- and long-term underlying drivers of performance
  • Prepare and deliver communications via differing vehicles, ensuring various audiences (including ditrector+) have the right level of detail
  • Establish trusted working relationships with internal stakeholders (e.g. Finance, Marketing, Analytics) and build rapport to become a trusted advisor

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience; Master’s degree preferred
  • 6+ years of experience in business management, ecommerce, analytics or financial planning within the travel and/or tech industry
  • Understanding of financial metrics, forecasting, and budgeting
  • Very strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with ability to generate key insights and actions for the business
  • Ability to influence and collaborate with various levels of the organization
  • Strong Experience in SQL and Tableau/ Python preferred

The total cash range for this position in Austin is $155,000.00 to $217,000.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $248,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role. The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $155,000.00 to $217,000.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $248,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Senior Product Manager, EG Advertising Marketplace

Introduction To The Team

Expedia Group Advertising helps partners, including hotels, airlines, destination marketing organizations (DMOs) and more, deliver excellent traveler and B2B experiences. We drive growth for our partners and the Expedia Group marketplace through competitive supply, our leading advertising and travel media network and affiliate solutions.

Within EG Advertising, our team builds and optimizes the TravelAds auction platform that connects travelers with relevant lodging sponsored listings across the Expedia Group marketplace. We're dedicated to creating a world-class advertising experience that delivers value for our partners while enhancing the traveler experience through relevant, high-quality ad placements.

In This Role, You Will

  • Drive the strategic vision and roadmap for sponsored listings auction optimization, including auction mechanics, bidding strategies, and pricing models
  • Lead the development and evolution of auction functions to improve marketplace efficiency, partner ROI, and revenue growth
  • Own ad relevance initiatives that enhance the quality and personalization of sponsored listings for travelers
  • Partner with machine learning and engineering teams to design, implement and optimise auction algorithms that balance traveler experience, partner value, and business objectives
  • Define success metrics, analyze performance data, and identify opportunities to drive growth in sponsored listings through auction improvements
  • Leverage AI and GenAI tools to accelerate product development, enhance decision-making, and drive innovation in auction optimization
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product managers, engineering leaders, data scientists, and business stakeholders to deliver impactful features
  • Work closely with engineering teams to translate product requirements into technical solutions
  • Communicate product strategy, progress, and insights to senior leadership and stakeholders across the organization
  • Champion a data-driven approach to product development, leveraging experimentation and analytics to validate decisions
  • Stay informed about industry trends in auction technology, digital advertising, and marketplace dynamics

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Business, or related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience
  • 6+ years of product management experience, preferably in digital advertising, marketplace platforms, or auction-based systems
  • Proven track record of launching and scaling technical products that drive meaningful business outcomes
  • Experience with machine learning applications, preferably in advertising or marketplace optimization
  • Strong analytical skills with experience using data to inform product decisions and measure success
  • Proficient communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization
  • Experience working with engineering and data science teams to deliver complex, technical products
  • Demonstrated ability to work both collaboratively and autonomously in a fast-paced environment
  • Understanding of auction mechanics, pricing strategies, or related marketplace dynamics
  • Knowledge of digital advertising ecosystems, including programmatic advertising and sponsored search

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree (MBA, MS, or PhD) in a quantitative or technical field
  • Familiarity with AI tools, LLMs, or agent-based systems, including practical experience applying these technologies to product development
  • Previous experience at a technology company or marketplace business
  • Familiarity with agile development methodologies and product development lifecycles
  • Experience in two-sided marketplace products or platforms connecting supply and demand

Associate Account Manager

Introduction to the Team

The Account Management team drives growth and success for hotel and lodging partners by leveraging data, market insights, and consultative commercial conversations. Our team helps partners improve competitiveness, increase revenue, and maximize value from our platform while building long-term strategic relationships.

As an Associate Account Manager, you will develop foundational account management, sales, and negotiation skills while working closely with lodging partners to identify opportunities, solve business challenges, and drive mutual success.

In This Role, You Will

Partner Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain relationships with hotel and lodging partners and key decision-makers.
  • Conduct regular partner conversations to understand business objectives, challenges, and growth opportunities.
  • Support account planning activities designed to increase partner engagement and business performance.
  • Develop knowledge of partner business models, industry trends, and competitive landscapes.
  • Build credibility with partners through data-driven recommendations and consultative discussions.

Commercial Growth & Business Development

  • Identify revenue growth opportunities within assigned accounts through data analysis, market trends, and partner conversations.
  • Conduct commercial discussions focused on improving visibility, competitiveness, conversion, and overall partner performance.
  • Influence partner decisions through insights, recommendations, and value-based selling techniques.
  • Support the negotiation of commercial programs, promotions, and initiatives that drive mutual business growth.
  • Demonstrate curiosity and a proactive approach to uncovering new business opportunities and expanding partner engagement.
  • Use performance metrics and KPIs to identify risks and recommend actions that improve partner success.

Data, Insights & Problem Solving

  • Analyze account performance data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
  • Guide partners using market insights and performance recommendations that support business goals.
  • Gather and interpret information to develop practical solutions for partner business needs.
  • Contribute to business cases, recommendations, and commercial initiatives under the guidance of senior team members.
  • Learn how business decisions impact partner performance and company outcomes.

Commercial Acumen & Negotiation

  • Develop a working knowledge of commercial agreements, contract terms, and standard negotiation practices.
  • Learn when and how to partner with legal and internal stakeholders to support contract modifications.
  • Build confidence conducting commercial conversations and navigating partner objections.
  • Assist in evaluating the costs, benefits, and risks of potential business solutions.
  • Develop understanding of stakeholder decision-making processes and influence strategies.

Product & Market Knowledge

  • Build expertise in company products, tools, technologies, and partner solutions.
  • Understand how products and services create value for partners and customers.
  • Develop awareness of competitor offerings and market dynamics.
  • Learn how to position company solutions effectively in a competitive marketplace.

What To Expect

  • Engage with partners daily through a high volume of outbound phone calls, emails, and virtual meetings.
  • Manage a portfolio of accounts while balancing multiple priorities, deadlines, and partner needs.
  • Build relationships and influence business decisions through proactive outreach and consistent follow-up.
  • Work in a fast-paced environment where priorities, partner needs, and market conditions can change quickly.
  • Use data, insights, and performance metrics to prepare for partner conversations and identify growth opportunities.
  • Maintain accurate records of partner interactions, action plans, and account activities within internal systems.
  • Work across multiple digital tools and platforms, including CRM systems, reporting dashboards, productivity software, and AI-enabled solutions to manage workflows, analyze data, and support partner engagement.

Experience & Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • 0-2 years of professional experience.
  • Proficiency in English and the local language of the market served.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and translate insights into business recommendations.
  • Comfortable conducting business conversations in English.
  • Demonstrated interest in sales, business development, negotiation, hospitality, e-commerce, consulting, or customer-facing commercial roles.
  • Ability to build relationships and communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Self-motivated, curious, and eager to learn in a fast-paced environment.

Senior Director, Integrated Marketing – Hotels.com

Introduction to team

We create and deliver tailored marketing strategies for Expedia Group’s brands, focusing on establishing strong connections and cohesive experiences for travelers and partners. We leverage our functional expertise and creative excellence to build trust and loyalty for our brands through innovative marketing approaches and technology.

Make an impact!

In this role, you will develop the integrated marketing strategy for your assigned business area(s), informed by traveler insight, brand priorities, product roadmaps, marketable experiences and commercial goals. You will lead cross-functional execution of brand campaigns — from big moments like launches or Super Bowl to always-on programs or local activations — while bringing structure and momentum to complex workstreams.

In This Role, You Will

Strategy & Planning

  • Develop the integrated marketing strategy for your assigned business area(s), informed by traveler insight, brand priorities, product roadmaps, marketable experiences and commercial goals
  • Partner closely with the GM teams, product marketing, comms planning, media, our internal creative and design teams, or agencies to develop compelling campaign platforms and clear go-to-market plans
  • Translate brand strategy into actionable marketing plans with defined objectives, channel strategies, creative briefs, and performance KPIs

Campaign Development & Execution

  • Lead cross-functional execution of brand campaigns — from big moments like launches or Super Bowl to always-on programs or local activations
  • Oversee development of creative and media assets in partnership with internal teams and external agencies
  • Ensure all assets meet brand standards, reflect our tone of voice, and are adapted appropriately for channel and region

Collaboration & Influence

  • Build strong relationships with key partners across all key stakeholder groups: product, product marketing regional teams, comms, creative, growth marketing, media and sponsorships, PR, influencer marketing and social media
  • Bring structure and momentum to complex workstreams; influence senior stakeholders with clarity, data, and creative thinking
  • Guide junior team members and cross-functional contributors with clarity of purpose and a high bar for execution

Performance & Insights

  • Set campaign goals and work with analytics and media teams to track performance
  • Use insights to optimize in-flight campaigns and inform future initiatives
  • Share results and learnings across the organization to drive continuous improvement

Experience And Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field
  • Master’s degree, preferred
  • Proven experience (16+ years) with a track record of delivering results in marketing, creative leadership, and strategic planning
  • History of data driven brand strategies from vision to development
  • Highly skilled at managing competing priorities as well as bringing dispersed and highly matrixed teams along
  • Ability to interpret analytics and derive actionable insights
  • Experience establishing KPIs and using analytics to inform marketing strategies
  • Proven results in delivering business value through brand strategies
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal abilities
  • Passion for innovation, creativity, and staying ahead of industry trends

Director, Human Resources Business Partner

Our Corporate Functions are made up of teams that support Expedia Group, including Employee Communications, Finance, Legal, People Team, Inclusion and Diversity, and Global Social Impact and Sustainability.

Expedia Group is seeking a strategic Director, HR Business Partner to work with our Global Finance organization. This alignment is intentional because these teams work closely together to deliver business outcomes. In this role, you’ll work closely with executives to advance both business objectives and our people agenda, fostering a high-performance culture through innovative HR solutions. This is a great opportunity to partner with the direct reports (SVPs) of the CFO of Expedia Group and the members of the Global Finance Leadership team.

 

Please note this role is based in Seattle and follows our hybrid work model, requiring a minimum of three in-office days per week.  

What you'll do: 

  • Talent Strategy: Collaborate with global People team partners and business leaders to ensure the success of client groups through strategic talent initiatives. Key areas include identifying high-potential talent, driving succession planning, and building future-focused organizational capabilities. 
  • Organizational transformation and change management: Change is the only constant in a growing global tech company like EG. The Global Finance org is at the forefront of many such changes and going through constant transformation to build an effective and durable organizational strategy. Therefore, the HRBP will bring in structure in ambiguity, and demonstrate emotional maturity to guide the org through the transformation.
  • Organizational Effectiveness: Guide organizational design and change management strategies and implement processes, policies, and guidelines for conducting organizational reviews and improving alignment.
  • Strategic Business Partnership: Partner closely with the executive leaders to define the overall talent and business strategy, anticipating long-term people needs and translating business plans into HR program objectives.
  • Lead organizational structure analysis and design, identifying more effective structures and governance models to align with strategic goals. 
  • Define and implement organizational principles and health objectives, offering strategic insights to optimize performance. 
  • Design tools (e.g., surveys) to measure organizational effectiveness and assess issues related to structure, talent, and performance. 
  • Develop and implement programs to improve employee engagement, management capabilities, and leadership development. 
  • Leverage a deep understanding of business operations and challenges to propose tailored solutions that support organizational objectives. 
  • Facilitate collaboration among diverse stakeholders to co-create practical and impactful solutions. 
  • Apply systems thinking to enhance organizational efficiency, recommending improvements across policies, processes, and structures. 
  • Evaluate the long-term financial and operational impact of proposed solutions to support sustainable business outcomes. 
  • Partner with HR Centers of Excellence (COEs) and business leaders to design and implement HR programs, ensuring ongoing relevance and effectiveness. 
  • Apply strong data analysis skills and business acumen to inform decisions related to leadership, structure, and talent development. 
  • Works closely with business leaders to define the human resource structure, identifying workforce planning needs, leadership and management gaps, skillsets for the future and implement best-practice HR solutions to facilitate drive optimal performance.

 

Experience and Qualification:  

  • 10+ years’ relevant experience 
  • Strategic people business partner, experienced in designing end-to-end talent agenda, organizational development, delivery of global transformation programs 
  • Ability to deal with ambiguity and coach senior leaders through organizational transformations.
  • Analytical thinking and strategic problem-solving skills, with the drive to cut. through complexity and turn high-level business requirements and opportunities into specific initiatives 
  • Comfortable using advanced executive coaching techniques to make recommendations across opposing and equally critical business needs 
  • Natural bar-raiser: curious and passionate about the business context and leadership growth, builds strong relationships by being an inspiring and approachable leader 

The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $207,500.00 to $290,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $332,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Job Title

Service Design Principal Specialist

Summary Of The Role

Shape coherent end-to-end service experiences across Outpayce and Amadeus. Working across user needs, business strategy, technology and operations, this role combines strategic leadership with hands-on service and UX design to make complex solutions usable, scalable and commercially sound.

The role influences key stakeholders and cross-functional teams, connecting the overall service experience with the design and validation of digital products, interfaces and interactions.

In This Role You Will Be Responsible For

  • Service design strategy and vision
  • Define service design vision, principles and experience priorities for key Outpayce value streams.
  • Identify and prioritize improvements across customer, partner and operational journeys.
  • Establish service standards and success metrics, and support adoption across delivery teams.
  • End-to-end service and systems design
  • Design complex services using systems thinking, journey models, ecosystem maps and service blueprints.
  • Translate service concepts into user flows, wireframes, interaction designs and prototypes.
  • Balance user needs with compliance, risk, operational controls, feasibility and scalability.
  • Coordinate with Product, Engineering, Operations, Risk, Legal and Customer Support.
  • Evidence-based design and research
  • Partner with UX Research and Data to plan and synthesize research.
  • Turn evidence into prioritized opportunities, recommendations and validated concepts.
  • Make assumptions and evidence gaps explicit in decision-making.
  • Business acumen and value framing
  • Connect design outcomes to adoption, satisfaction, revenue enablement, efficiency and risk reduction.
  • Frame options, dependencies, trade-offs and expected value for roadmap decisions.
  • Recommend experience-led decision frameworks and KPIs.
  • Advocacy and influence
  • Act as a recognized service design and UX reference across relevant Amadeus and Outpayce initiatives.
  • Facilitate workshops, co-creation sessions and design reviews to build alignment.
  • Strengthen service design maturity through knowledge sharing and coaching.

About Candidate Profile

  • Significant service or experience design leadership in complex, multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Hands-on UX design and/or user research experience, from insight to validated digital experience.
  • Experience in fintech, payments, financial services or another regulated environment is highly desirable.
  • Proven influence across Product, Technology, Operations and Business teams.
  • Experience using AI to accelerate design and research while maintaining human judgment and traceability.

Skills and expertise

  • Service design: journey mapping, service blueprinting, ecosystem mapping and systems modelling.
  • UX design: information architecture, flows, interaction design, wireframing and prototyping.
  • Figma skills, including interactive prototypes, shared components and design systems.
  • Research literacy, evidence-based decision-making, facilitation, storytelling and communication.
  • Strategic thinking, pragmatic execution and strong business acumen.
  • AI-enabled workflows, including prompt and context design, workflow orchestration, evaluation and responsible experimentation.
  • Trusted advisor who challenges constructively.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and organizational complexity.
  • Strong advocate for service-led thinking beyond the design function.

Amadeus aspires to be a leader in Diversity and Inclusion in the tech industry, enabling every employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment, attracting the best talent from all backgrounds, and as a role model for an inclusive employee experience.

job.job_description:
Accor Tech & Digital est le moteur de la tech, des solutions digitales et de la transformation au sein du Groupe. Nos 5 000 talents s'engagent à offrir les meilleures expériences digitales et tech à nos clients, nos hôtels et nos équipes dans 110 pays, et à façonner l'avenir de l'hospitalité.

Accor Tech & Digital, des métiers où l’intelligence est d’abord humaine !



Description du poste

Accor Tech & Digital, c’est le laboratoire d’innovation et de transformation technologique du leader mondial de l’hôtellerie.

Nos équipes, appelées Heartist®, concentrent le meilleur de l'hospitalité et le meilleur de la tech & du digital.

Notre ambition : offrir à nos clients des expériences personnalisées, mémorables et durables.

Ici, nous faisons naître de nouvelles façons de voyager dans chacun de nos 5 500 hôtels, au plus proche de nos 100 millions de clients dans 110 pays.

Ici, nous sommes au cœur d’un formidable terrain de jeu de transition technologique et de conception de produits digitaux et de services, pour nos clients et nos équipes en hôtels.

Ici, votre champ d’application ne connaîtra aucune frontière.

Alors, avec nous, osez avoir un impact sur le monde !



C’est ici que votre plus grand défi vous attend :

Nous recherchons un(e) Senior Manager Études consommateurs, analyses de marché et business, doté(e) d’une forte vision stratégique, d’excellentes capacités d’analyse et d’un solide sens commercial, pour rejoindre notre équipe dynamique. Ce rôle clé contribuera à façonner l’avenir d’ALL Accor en transformant des comportements consommateurs complexes et les dynamiques de marché en stratégies opérationnelles, en contribuant au plan marketing stratégique annuel, en suivant l’évolution de la marque ALL Accor et en fédérant une communauté autour des insights et des données de marché. La personne retenue s’appuiera sur des analyses approfondies pour éclairer le positionnement de la marque, orienter les décisions d’investissement média et de développement des marchés, et aider les parties prenantes internes, à tous les niveaux de l’organisation, à comprendre l’évolution des secteurs du voyage et de l’hospitalité.



Vos missions :

1. Pilotage stratégique des insights et des études

  • Piloter de bout en bout la réalisation des principales études consommateurs et de marché, annuelles et trimestrielles. Cela comprend la conception des questionnaires, la gestion des prestataires, le suivi de la collecte des données, leur analyse rigoureuse ainsi que la présentation claire et convaincante des résultats à la direction et aux principales parties prenantes des différentes marques et régions d’Accor.
  • Identifier de manière proactive les nouvelles tendances de consommation, les évolutions du marché et le paysage concurrentiel dans l’hôtellerie mondiale et au-delà, afin d’anticiper leurs conséquences et leurs implications stratégiques pour ALL Accor (par exemple : impact des voyages de loisirs, exigences en matière de durabilité, nomadisme numérique…).
  • Développer et entretenir une connaissance approfondie des comportements et des préférences des membres ALL Accor, afin d’identifier des leviers pour renforcer la fidélité, l’engagement et la création de valeur. Promouvoir les meilleures méthodologies et les meilleurs outils d’étude, qualitatifs comme quantitatifs, en recherchant continuellement des approches innovantes pour recueillir des insights plus riches et directement exploitables.

2. Business intelligence et aide à la décision stratégique

  • Agir en tant que partenaire de confiance des parties prenantes internes, y compris de la direction, en fournissant des analyses fondées sur les données pour soutenir la planification stratégique, le développement des produits, le positionnement de la marque et l’amélioration des opérations.
  • Éclairer les décisions commerciales relatives aux investissements média et aux stratégies de développement des marchés. Cela implique d’analyser le potentiel des marchés, d’identifier les opportunités encore inexploitées, d’évaluer l’efficacité des campagnes et d’optimiser les dépenses sur les différents canaux et zones géographiques afin de maximiser le retour sur investissement d’Accor et de ses marques.
  • Réaliser régulièrement des analyses approfondies : benchmark concurrentiel, estimation de la taille des marchés, évaluation des opportunités et suivi des performances, afin d’identifier les leviers de croissance, d’efficacité et d’avantage concurrentiel.
  • Transformer des données complexes en analyses, récits et recommandations clairs, concis et convaincants, afin de faciliter la prise de décision à tous les niveaux, des ajustements tactiques aux évolutions stratégiques de long terme.



3. Collaboration transverse et influence

  • Développer des relations de collaboration solides avec les équipes globales et régionales, en veillant à ce que les insights soient largement partagés et efficacement intégrés aux processus métier.
  • Présenter de manière proactive les résultats et recommandations à des publics variés, et convaincre les parties prenantes grâce à des arguments étayés par les données et à une narration stratégique efficace.
  • Contribuer, avec les autres équipes transverses, au développement d’une culture fondée sur les insights et la donnée.

Qualifications

Et vous ?

Formation : diplôme en marketing, gestion, économie, statistiques ou dans un domaine quantitatif connexe. Un diplôme de niveau master (par exemple MBA ou MSc en marketing analytics) constitue un atout important.

Expérience :

  • Au moins 8 ans d’expérience dans les études consommateurs, les études de marché, l’analyse business ou le conseil en stratégie, idéalement dans l’hôtellerie, le voyage, le retail ou un autre secteur orienté consommateurs.
  • Expérience avérée dans le pilotage de projets d’études complexes, de leur conception à leur livraison, avec des résultats concrets pour l’activité, une excellente maîtrise des méthodologies, de la gestion de projet et de la relation avec les parties prenantes.
  • Expérience démontrée dans l’accompagnement de la stratégie de marque et des décisions d’investissement marketing grâce à des analyses fondées sur les données.
  • Une expérience au sein d’une organisation internationale ou multinationale est fortement souhaitée.

Compétences techniques :

  • Maîtrise experte des méthodologies d’études quantitatives et qualitatives (par exemple : segmentation, analyse conjointe, études de prix, suivi de la marque, groupes de discussion et entretiens approfondis).
  • Solides compétences analytiques et capacité à interpréter des jeux de données complexes pour en dégager les principales tendances et les insights clés.
  • Excellente maîtrise de la suite Microsoft Office, notamment d’Excel à un niveau avancé et de PowerPoint pour créer des présentations convaincantes.
  • La connaissance des plateformes d’analytics digital (par exemple Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics) et des outils de social listening constitue un plus.

Compétences comportementales :

  • Vision stratégique : capacité à relier les insights aux objectifs globaux de l’entreprise et à formuler des recommandations stratégiques à long terme.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication et en présentation : capacité à expliquer des idées complexes de manière claire, concise et persuasive à des publics variés, y compris à des dirigeants.
  • Solide sens des affaires : compréhension approfondie des leviers de performance, des implications financières et des dynamiques concurrentielles.
  • Proactivité et curiosité : autonomie et curiosité permanente pour comprendre les comportements des consommateurs et les tendances du marché.
  • Collaboration et influence : capacité à nouer des relations solides et à influencer les parties prenantes sans lien hiérarchique direct.
  • Résolution de problèmes : esprit de ressource et capacité à évoluer dans l’ambiguïté pour trouver des solutions efficaces.
  • Sens du détail : rigueur dans l’analyse des données et la production de rapports, avec une attention particulière portée à l’exactitude et à l’intégrité des résultats.
  • Intérêt pour l’hospitalité : intérêt sincère pour les secteurs du voyage et de l’hospitalité ainsi que pour la mission d’Accor.
  • Anglais écrit et oral : excellente maîtrise de l’anglais, notamment pour les présentations.

Informations supplémentaires

Et nous, quels sont nos engagements ?

- Sur le monde

  • Accor s’engage pour le monde qui nous entoure, avec une culture employeur forte centrée sur le développement de nos 300 000 talents.

  • Nous adoptons une approche d'amélioration continue pour réduire l'impact du digital sur l'environnement dans l’ensemble de nos projets.

- Sur votre carrière

  • Nous permettons à tous nos collaborateurs de maîtriser leur équilibre vie-perso / vie-pro et leur offrons les moyens de façonner leur environnement de travail à leur image.

  • Les parcours de formation et d’évolution sont définis à la fois individuellement et collectivement pour que nous grandissions ensemble, au quotidien.



- Concrètement, chez Accor Tech & Digital :

  • Télétravail possible plusieurs jours par semaine depuis la France et options de travail flexibles : travaillez depuis chez vous, nos bureaux, ou même nos hôtels et espaces de coworking grâce à Worklib.

  • Chaque mercredi après-midi, consacrez votre temps à du travail de fond et à votre développement personnel.

  • Travail dans un environnement multiculturel et anglophone.

  • Amélioration continue & formations : Hackathons, partenariats technologiques d’exception, talent management dédié, certifications et plateforme de formation spécifique.

et aussi,

  • Programme ALL - Heartist® : tarifs préférentiels et offres flash pour des séjours et expériences inoubliables dans toutes nos adresses Accor et chez nos partenaires, dans le monde entier.

  • Programme de volontariat Heartist® for good : 1 jour offert sur votre temps de travail pour vous engager en faveur d’une association.

  • Un CSE qui vous accompagne dans le financement de vos activités culturelles et sportives.

  • Forfait Mobilité durable pour l’utilisation d’un moyen de déplacement « vert » ou un dispositif « vélo de fonction » en partenariat avec Zenride

  • Prise en charge des abonnements de transports publics urbains entre le domicile et le lieu de travail, à hauteur de 75%.

  • Tickets restaurant de 11€ en valeur faciale.

  • Une mutuelle obligatoire financée à 50% par Accor sans frais supplémentaire en cas d'adhésion de vos ayants droits.

  • Sans oublier des conditions de travail attractives avec des espaces de travail collaboratifs, des restaurants, espaces de jeux ou encore des espaces de bien-être et de Sport sur site ou grâce à Gymlib.



Votre talent et votre motivation sont nos seuls critères de sélection.

Nous valorisons la richesse des diverses nationalités, personnalités et parcours professionnels.

Nous savons nous adapter aux besoins spécifiques de nos collaborateurs, notamment ceux en situation de handicap.

Nous encourageons toutes les candidatures, sans distinction de genre, alors osez postuler !



Pour nous, le recrutement est avant tout une histoire de rencontres.

Cette mission vous attire ? Postulez et nous vous proposerons :

  1. Un échange avec notre équipe recrutement pour vous présenter les lignes essentielles du poste ou vous orienter vers le rôle qui peut vous correspondre,

  1. Un ou des entretiens avec les managers et les membres de l’équipe,

  1. Pour certains postes, vous pourriez également être amené à effectuer un test ou une étude de cas, ainsi qu’un questionnaire sur votre personnalité et vos motivations.

  1. Un entretien final avec notre équipe des Ressources Humaines pour échanger sur la culture de notre Groupe, l’environnement de travail, notre programme de formation et les perspectives de carrière, ainsi que les différents avantages du Groupe.

  1. Un feedback personnalisé.

The Key Accounts team invests in long-term relationships that spans borders and cultures and results in incredible value for Agoda, our partners, and our customers.  

The Opportunity:

job.job_description:
Who are we looking for?

Choice Hotels has an exciting new opportunity as our Technical Services Specialist in the SkyTouch Technology division. SkyTouch Technology, is an independently operated division of Choice Hotels that provides the most widely used cloud-based (SaaS) hotel property management system. This role has the primary responsibility of creating a positive experience to all internal and external customers while delivering technical services, support and training. Our Technical Services Specialists are the face of SkyTouch and thereby will have a direct impact to the strategic direction where we create a distinct advantage through unparalleled customer engagement.

THIS IS A SHIFT POSITION IN A 24/7 SUPPORT CENTER. CANDIDATES SHOULD BE AVAILABLE FOR DAYS/NIGHTS/WEEKENDS AS NECESSARY.

Your Responsibilities

  • Use critical thinking skills to make the real time decisions required to keep internal and external customers operating at a profitable and efficient level.
  • Take ownership of, and respond to, all incoming requests for service through phone or incident tracking system within published team SLAs.
  • Provide knowledge and escalation point for all customers including, but not limited to, the Tier 1 Support team, System Implementers, System Trainers and Sales Executives.

job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

The Manager, TechOps Continuous Improvement - Strategic Value Stream leads deployment, adoption, governance, and sustainment of the TechOps Lean operating system ("Flight Path") within an assigned Strategic Value Stream (Engines, Airframes, or Line). This role serves as the primary Continuous Improvement business partner to the assigned Value Stream Owner and leadership team, driving improvements in safety, quality, delivery, and cost (in that order) through strategic deployment, operational excellence, leader coaching, and change leadership.

The Manager is responsible for aligning Flight Path activities to value stream priorities, building continuous improvement capabilities, coaching leaders and frontline teams, and leading a team of Continuous Improvement professionals. This position influences performance across multiple operational organizations within the value stream and plays a critical role in achieving sustainable operational and financial results.

Roles And Responsibilities

  • Lead deployment, governance, and sustainment of the Flight Path operating system within the assigned Value Stream, ensuring alignment to strategic priorities, operating plans, and performance objectives.
  • Partner with the Value Stream Owner and leadership team to identify, prioritize, and execute improvement opportunities that support safety, quality, delivery, and cost objectives.
  • Coach Value Stream leaders and frontline leadership teams in Lean leadership behaviors, structured problem solving, Daily Management, leader standard work, and continuous improvement methodologies to accelerate cultural transformation and performance improvement.
  • Lead and develop the assigned Value Stream Continuous Improvement team, including talent development, capability building, performance management, and deployment of continuous improvement resources.
  • Facilitate value stream assessments, Kaizen events, operational reviews, strategic planning workshops, and improvement activities to identify and eliminate operational waste and performance barriers.
  • Develop, monitor, and improve Daily Management systems, visual management processes, performance review cadences, and problem-solving routines across the Value Stream.
  • Analyze operational performance data, identify root causes of performance gaps, and develop sustainable countermeasures to improve business outcomes.
  • Lead change management efforts associated with Flight Path deployment and operational transformation initiatives while ensuring stakeholder engagement and adoption.
  • Conduct Gemba walks and other validation activities to assess implementation effectiveness and ensure compliance with Flight Path standards and expectations.
  • Practice safety-conscious behaviors in all operational processes and procedures and promote a culture of safety throughout the organization

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Operations Management, or related field required.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in operations, continuous improvement, operational excellence, engineering, maintenance, project management, or related business functions.
  • Minimum 3 years of leadership experience leading teams and/or significant cross-functional initiatives.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing Lean methodologies and driving measurable operational improvements.
  • Deep understanding of Lean principles, continuous improvement methodologies, Daily Management systems, and performance management processes.
  • Demonstrated experience facilitating value stream analysis, Kaizen events, operational reviews, and strategic planning workshops.
  • Experience coaching leaders and teams in structured problem solving, change management, and continuous improvement practices.
  • Strong facilitation, communication, presentation, and consensus-building skills.
  • Ability to translate strategic objectives into actionable improvement plans and measurable business results.
  • Experience managing and developing high-performing teams.
  • Strong analytical skills and proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and related business analysis tools.
  • Ability to work effectively with all organizational levels, from frontline employees to senior leaders.
  • Some travel may be required.
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency.
  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Master's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Operations Management, or related field.
  • Airline, aviation maintenance, MRO, manufacturing, or other highly regulated operational industry experience.
  • Formal Lean, Lean Six Sigma, Operational Excellence, or Continuous Improvement certification.
  • Experience deploying Lean operating systems across large operational organizations.
  • Experience implementing Daily Management, visual management, leader standard work, and performance management systems.
  • Proven track record of delivering measurable improvements in safety, quality, operational performance, employee engagement, and cost efficiency.
  • Experience leading organizational culture change initiatives and influencing leaders without direct authority.
  • Experience working across maintenance, engineering, planning, supply chain, or other complex operational environments.

Benefits And Perks To Help You Keep Climbing

Our culture is rooted in a shared dedication to living our values – Honesty, Integrity, Respect, Perseverance, and Servant Leadership – every day, in everything we do. Exploring a career at Delta gives you a chance to see the world while providing great beneﬁts to help you keep climbing along the way:

  • Competitive salary, performance incentives, industry-leading proﬁt sharing, and 401(k) with generous direct contribution and company match.
  • Paid time off including vacation, holidays, and paid personal time.
  • Comprehensive health beneﬁts including medical, dental, vision, short/long term disability and life beneﬁts.
  • Wellbeing programs to support physical, emotional, social, and financial health, including access to an employee assistance program offering support for you and anyone in your household, free financial coaching, and extensive resources supporting mental health counseling.
  • Domestic and International (standby) Flight privileges for employees and eligible family members.
  • Career development programs to achieve your long-term career goals.
  • Access to over 500 discounts, specialty savings and voluntary benefits through Deltaperks such as car and hotel rentals and auto/homeowners/pet insurances.
