We’re determined to make the world of travel more sustainable, more accessible, and more inclusive, to create a positive impact on a global scale. That’s why we’re always looking for people who search for better solutions, the ones eager to stray off the beaten path to find new ways of doing things. Because at Booking.com it’s more than a job, it’s a journey we’re on together.
job.job_description:
About Us: At Booking.com, data drives our decisions. Technology is at our core. And innovation is everywhere. But our company is more than datasets, lines of code or A/B tests. We're the thrill of the first night in a new place. The excitement of the next morning. The friends you encounter. The journeys you take. The sights you see. And the memories you make. Through our products, partners and people, we make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

Leadership/Team Quote:

The Agentic Modeling team enables Booking.com's mission teams to build production-grade AI agents.. We provide a modular, configuration-driven platform where teams compose reusable building blocks (tools, memory, context, strategies, prompts) into custom agents tailored to their domains, then own the full lifecycle of developing, testing, optimizing, and iterating on those agents in production.

Our platform powers agent-driven experiences across Connected Trip, Search, Trip Support, Content, and more — serving as the backbone for AI agent development at Booking.com.

Role Description:

In this role, you will lead a team of Machine Learning Scientists, ML and Data Engineers dedicated to building, evolving, and scaling Booking.com's agentic AI platform. This includes developing reusable agent types (classification, entity extraction, guardrails, summarization, general-purpose), agent strategies for planning and reasoning, memory capabilities, context management, and multi-agent patterns .

As a technical manager, you should be passionate about agentic AI systems, keep up to date with recent breakthroughs in LLM agents, tool use, and reasoning, define and shape the team's ML roadmap, and not be afraid to get your hands dirty with code when needed.

You are expected to be the focal point for all technical aspects, make sure your team members deliver on their tasks, and work together with product managers and mission stakeholders to define and shape the roadmap. You will work independently and be responsible for making technical decisions within your team.

When it comes to management, your expertise in handling people will motivate and inspire them to reach outstanding success! You should have experience in developing people. You will mentor and coach your team while working closely with Product Managers.

Key Job Responsibilities and Duties:

  • Leadership in Agentic AI Development — Build, guide, and mentor a team of ML scientists and engineers in developing agent types, strategies, SDK capabilities, and production tooling for AI agents at scale.
  • Platform & SDK Strategy — Define and communicate the technical vision for the agentic modeling platform, ensuring it scales across missions (Trip Planning, Search, AITP, Trip Support, Content) and enables teams to go from idea to production agent in days, not months.
  • Agent Strategy & Reasoning — Drive development of advanced agent planning capabilities: iterative reasoning, self-correction, multi-step logic with conditional paths, and multi-agent collaboration patterns.
  • Context & Memory Systems — Lead the design and implementation of smart context management and agent memory (short-term session state, long-term episodic and semantic memory) as configurable building blocks.
  • Evaluation & Optimization — Own the integration with evaluation frameworks and production data tooling to enable systematic agent improvement across accuracy, latency, cost, and reliability.
  • Developer Experience — Drive improvements to developer tooling (Claude Code integration, AI Studio), ensuring low barriers to entry and fast iteration cycles for mission teams.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, and excellence within the team.
  • Prioritize work in collaboration with Product Managers, depending on business needs and keeping stakeholders aligned at all times.
  • Translate machine learning vision and strategy into planning and execution, and ensure timely delivery.
  • Monitor product health, performance and business impact and act accordingly when requirements are not met.
  • Identify underlying issues and opportunities across domains and situations that are not obviously related through application of structured thinking and logic.
  • Drive, coach and mentor others through evidence and clear communication, explaining advanced technical concepts in simpler terms.
  • Continuously evolve your craft. Keep up to date with industry and academic standard methodologies in agentic AI, LLM tool use, and agent frameworks; introduce them to the ML community and promote their application where they can generate impact.
  • Actively contribute to Machine Learning at Booking.com through training, exploration of new technologies, interviewing, onboarding and mentoring colleagues.
  • Push for improvements, scaling and extending machine learning tooling and infrastructure, collaborating with central teams.


Qualifications & Skills:

  • Leadership Experience: At least 3 years of experience leading ML teams in NLP, Generative AI, or Agentic AI domains, with a proven ability to guide teams in achieving impactful results.
  • Agentic AI Expertise: Deep knowledge of LLM-based agent architectures — tool use, function calling, planning strategies (ReAct, chain-of-thought, iterative reasoning), memory systems, and multi-agent patterns. Experience building or leading teams that ship agent-based products at scale.
  • Platform & SDK Mindset: Experience building reusable ML platforms, SDKs, or frameworks consumed by multiple teams. Strong intuition for developer experience, API design, and configuration-driven architectures.
  • Academic and Applied Background:
    • MSc with 6+ years of professional experience, or PhD with 4+ years of experience, applying Machine Learning to solve business challenges.
    • Master's, PhD, or equivalent experience in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Artificial Intelligence, Physics, etc.).
    • Strong advantage for candidates with research or applied experience in NLP, dialogue systems, or agentic AI.
  • End-to-End R&D Proficiency: Demonstrated experience in designing and executing end-to-end research and development plans, from problem definition and prototyping to production deployment and monitoring.
  • Proven Impact: A track record of delivering measurable business value through the development and implementation of large-scale ML systems.
  • Experience on multiple machine learning facets: working with large data sets, model development, statistics, experimentation, data visualization, optimization, software development.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally in the development of machine learning products (e.g., Developers, UX specialists, Product Managers, etc.).
  • Strong working knowledge of Python, Java, Kafka, Hadoop, SQL, and Spark or similar technologies. Working experience with version control systems.
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Leading by example, gaining respect through actions, not your title. Developing your team and motivating them to achieve their goals. Providing feedback timely and managing key team performance indicators.

Benefits & Perks - Global Impact, Personal Relevance:

Booking.com's Total Rewards Philosophy is not only about compensation but also about benefits. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, as well unique-to-Booking.com benefits which include:

  • Annual paid time off and generous paid leave scheme including: parent, grandparent, bereavement, and care leave
  • Hybrid working including flexible working arrangements, and up to 20 days per year working from abroad (home country)
  • Industry leading product discounts - up to 1400 per year - for yourself, including automatic Genius Level 3 status and Booking.com wallet credit

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion have been a core part of our company culture since day one. This ongoing journey starts with our very own employees, who represent over 140 nationalities and a wide range of ethnic and social backgrounds, genders and sexual orientations.

Take it from our Chief People Officer, Paulo Pisano: "At Booking.com, the diversity of our people doesn't just build an outstanding workplace, it also creates a better and more inclusive travel experience for everyone. Inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. It's a place where you can make your mark and have a real impact in travel and tech."

job.job_description:
Agile Coach - (Hybrid)

As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, what's the next step? Start your journey with us!

  • We're seeking an experienced Agile Coach to join our Agile Team in Barcelona, Madrid, Alicante,Milan, Porto (hybrid) to collaborate with, and influence the leaders, stakeholders, and teams within the company. Together, we will drive increased agility, faster learning, more innovation, better products, and increased collaboration within the organisation. You will use your passion and expertise to help turn teams into high performing units, plus you will have a deep understanding of and experience in deploying new Agile methods, and an ability to learn and embrace new ways of helping drive increased team performance. Your success will come from your ability to help teams achieve their goals and deliver on commitments to their customers. If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.


Why eDreams ODIGEO

We’re the world's leading travel subscription platform.

  • We pioneered Prime, the first and largest travel subscription programme, which has topped over 7.8 million Prime members since launching in 2017.
  • Millions of customers every year across 44 markets – 5 brands: eDreams, GO Voyages, Opodo, Travellink, and the metasearch engine Liligo
  • More than 100 million searches per day on our websites - more than 6 billion AI daily predictions
  • Over 1,700 employees – More than 60 different nationalities from all continents – 99% permanent contracts


Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits. This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalised service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As an Agile Coach in the Agile Team you will be in charge of:

  • Collaborate with other Agile Coaches to develop a unified agile strategy, create cross-area collaboration frameworks, share best practices, and ensure consistent agile evolution and collaboration across the organization.
  • Guide executives, business units, and technology teams on change management and implementing Agile principles & values, helping them to build, grow, and continuously improve a thriving agile organization at scale;
  • Empower teams to make data-driven decisions, fostering cross-collaborations, reducing complexity, improving communication to ensure clear prioritisation of initiatives to maximise impact and reach eDOs strategic goals.
  • Design and support teams in the deployment of the eDOs development approach to optimise resource allocation, development of customer-centric products and services, and ultimately deliver value;
  • Provide Agile coaching and training to Product Owners, Dev Teams, and the wider business, coaching teams in all aspects of Kanban;
  • Expose our product and technology teams to the latest innovative thinking and ideas from the Lean and Agile community to increase agility, using Lean, Kanban, and other agile thinking to encourage a culture of experimentation, learning and continuous improvement;
  • Create, build, and facilitate or deliver customized workshops and training sessions.


What you need to succeed:

Good to have

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:

  • 3+ years’ experience in technology organizations with Agile/Kanban coaching experience;
  • Deep knowledge of Agile principles and practices and the ability to transfer that understanding at all levels of the organization;
  • Results driven ability to execute and embed
  • Consulting and facilitation skills in coaching technical and business teams in the adoption and improvement of Agile methodologies;
  • Conflict management skills
  • High degree of emotional intelligence and the ability to build strong relationships across various levels of the organisation
  • Excellent presentation and training skills;
  • Fluency in English is a requirement


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Applied AI Tools: Demonstrated comfort using practical AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or other AI-powered coding assistants.
  • Experimentation Mindset: Curiosity and eagerness to explore, experiment with, and integrate emerging AI-driven solutions into software development workflows.
  • AI-Enhanced Problem Solving: Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to debug code, streamline development processes, and enhance productivity.
  • Adaptability and Learning Agility: Enthusiastic about continuously learning and quickly adapting to new AI features and capabilities.
  • Collaboration with AI: Experience or interest in collaborating closely with AI tools as “pair programmers” to complement traditional software development practices.


What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture.

Here's what we offer:

  • A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and the possibility of choosing your equipment and, even better, keeping it for free after 3 years.
  • Continuous learning to fuel your growth and explore new horizons! 📚 Learn and grow with free Coursera access, soft skills workshops, tech training, leadership development, and more. Plus, enjoy a great onboarding program.
  • Grow opportunities to empower your career, and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.
  • Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcome, not time-in-seat. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
  • Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padel tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
  • Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.


Wanna take a peek into what it's like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

Apply now!

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Our people are the key to our success. Each one of them is unique in their own way and the respect for their uniqueness is and will always be a passion and motivation. Don’t meet every requirement? job.job_description:
Job Purpose

At the Emirates Group, we connect the world through our global hub in Dubai, ensuring our customers always Fly Better. As one of the most recognised and admired brands globally, we’re driven by innovation, ambition and excellence. Join a dynamic, fast-paced team where your ideas and relationship-building skills will directly shape employee experience across our global workforce.

Emirates, one of the world’s most awarded international airlines, operates across six continents and serves over 140 destinations through its hub in Dubai. The airline operates one of the most modern and efficient fleets, featuring spacious and comfortable Airbus A380, Airbus A350, and Boeing 777 aircraft.

Achieve the revenue sales targets and ensure productive trade engagement by maintaining and developing business relationships within the assigned account portfolio and territory.

  • To manage a defined mixed portfolio of corporate, leisure and special segment clients with accountability for Emirates overall sales performance for POS UK.
  • Build relationship, develop and implement effective sales and marketing initiatives/plans with assigned accounts to increase Emirates market share and revenue. To identify, evaluate and capitalise on new business opportunities within portfolio and market segment.
  • To negotiate, manage and follow up incentive agreements with corporate/leisure clients and review/assess performance on a minimum quarterly basis
  • To account manage all activity with assigned accounts, and ensure the effective dissemination and communication of Emirates developments to assigned clients.
  • To closely monitor portfolio sales performance and forward trend data and recommend action where necessary to protect and maximise revenue and ensure the Sales Managers are kept well informed of assigned portfolio performance, market feedback, conditions, trends and competitor activities and make recommendations as appropriate to protect the overall interest and the profitability of the airline.
  • To actively engage with clients within portfolio and maintain the required call frequency basis to build and maintain strong commercial relationships, and maintain necessary records in salesforce.com, including sales call visits, topics discussed, agreements achieved. To ensure virtual engagement with assigned accounts, by designing and delivering webinars to agency staff, lead road shows to actively engage and connect with the agents and to introduce EK product and services.
  • Promote & position Emirates corporate and leisure products including special segments (marine, humanitarian, cruise, student, MICE). .
  • To act as an ambassador for the company and attend industry functions, trade events, conferences and familiarisation trips to establish contacts, network and promote the interests of Emirates in and out of office hours as required.
  • To conduct Emirates product and fares training as required to ensure that assigned agents are kept up to date with all Emirates products/services.
  • Monitor and assess agent for any credit worthiness risks using available tools (RDOC, CRM AI app) and aim to mitigate risks as effectively as possible

Qualification

To Be Considered For This Role You Must Have

  • Educated to Graduate or ‘A’ Level standard or equivalent
  • Experience in field sales and all aspects of airline sales environment
  • Ability to source new business opportunities and manage high revenue potential accounts
  • Strong commercial acumen
  • Knowledge of digital workplace tools
  • Knowledge of reservations, fares and ticketing
  • Knowledge of Emirates’ products and services
  • Ability to maintain and interpret sales data/statistics
  • Experience in Microsoft Office applications including Word, Excel and PowerPoint
  • Excellent presentation and communications skills

You Will Stand Out If

  • Develop and implement the agreed marketing and sales plans with all Key Accounts within the segment
  • Closely monitor revenue results and account potential and recommend and implement actions as necessary to maximize revenue.
  • Negotiate and put forward incentive and discount agreements for selected accounts; implement the contract and assess effectiveness.
  • Generate sales leads by using the various business intelligence tools, qualify them and try to convert them into accounts.
  • Actively investigate and report competitor activity within the territory and consider Emirates response in coordination with local sales team.
  • Act as an Emirates ambassador within in the assigned sales territory and represent Emirates during functions.

Salary & benefits

Joining Emirates means becoming part of a global leader that truly invests in its people. Along with the opportunity to work on one of the world’s most advanced aircraft fleets, you’ll enjoy a market-leading reward package that recognises your contribution and supports your wellbeing.

Your Benefits Will Include In UK

  • Competitive salary, plus a guaranteed one-week salary bonus every November, increasing to two weeks after five years of service.
  • Comprehensive private healthcare covering you, your spouse, and up to two dependent children.
  • Annual health cash plan supporting your health and wellbeing expenses each year.
  • Generous pension scheme with employer contributions
  • Enhanced leave entitlement, rising to 26 days plus bank holidays annually.
  • Exclusive travel privileges, with access to our global network of flights and hotels from day one through staff travel benefits.
  • Emirates Platinum Card, offering exclusive discounts and lifestyle offers across the UAE and beyond.
  • Participation in our non-contractual profit share plan, rewarding your contribution to our collective success.

job.job_description:
【General Manager Message】

私たちは現在、ホテルの次の成長を見据え、各部門の専門性をさらに高めるとともに、部門の壁を越えて経営課題に取り組む運営体制の強化を進めています。

Financeは、その中心となる重要な部門の一つです。

私が求めているのは、過去の数字を正確にまとめるだけのFinance Managerではありません。

数字の背景にあるホテルの動きを理解し、「なぜこの数字になったのか」「次に何を変えるべきか」を考え、GMや各部門責任者に提案できるBisiness Partnerです。

新しいアイデアや改善提案を歓迎します。

GMとFinance Managerが率直に意見を交わしながら、より強いホテル運営の仕組みを一緒につくっていきたいと考えています。

また、スタッフの成長を支援し、チームとして高いパフォーマンスを発揮できる環境づくりにも期待しています。

Finance Manager経験者はもちろん、Assistant Finance Manager、Chief Accountant等として経験を積み、次のステップに挑戦したい方にもぜひお会いしたいと考えています。

【仕事内容】

・ホテルにおける経理・財務業務全般の管理

・月次・年次決算および財務諸表の作成・確認

・年間予算、Forecast、Rest of Year等の作成および管理

・P&L・BSの分析、予算・前年・Forecastとの差異分析

・売掛金（AR）、買掛金（AP）、General Ledger等の管理

・キャッシュフローおよび資金管理

・売上・経費・各種勘定の確認および内部統制

・GMへの財務分析・経営情報の提供、およびホテル運営戦略・事業計画策定への参画

・各部門責任者との連携による収益改善、コスト管理、生産性向上への提案

・オーナーおよびIHGへの各種Financial Report作成・対応

・内部監査・外部監査への対応

・Financeスタッフの指導・育成、業務分担およびチームマネジメント

・Finance業務プロセスの改善・標準化を通じた、安定した運営体制の構築

＊業務の変更範囲：会社の定める業務

【求める人材】

Financeを「経理部門」だけで完結させず、ホテル運営のビジネスパートナーとしてGMや各部門責任者と積極的にコミュニケーションを取り、数字からホテルの課題と可能性を捉え、改善策を提案・実行できる方を求めています。 チームメンバーを尊重し、育成・サポートしながら、周囲を巻き込んで成果につなげられる方を歓迎します。

【基本要件】 ・経理・財務業務の実務経験 ・月次決算、予算管理、財務分析等に関する知識・経験 ・Excelを含む基本的なPCスキル ・各部門と円滑に連携できるコミュニケーション能力 ・正確性、責任感、守秘義務への高い意識を持って業務を遂行できる方 【歓迎・優遇要件】 ・ホテルでの経理・財務実務経験者 優遇 ・外資系・インターナショナルホテルでの勤務経験者 優遇 ・Finance Manager、Assistant Finance Manager、Chief Accountant等の経験 ・Budget／Forecast作成およびP&L分析の経験 ・OPERA等のホテルシステム使用経験 ・外資系企業におけるFinancial Reportingの経験 ・英語によるメール・レポート等に対応できる方 ・簿記等の会計関連資格をお持ちの方 ・チームマネジメント・スタッフ育成経験

【待遇】

・給与月額 27～34万円（固定残業25～42時間分を含む）

・通勤手当 実費支給（上限月額2万円）

・昇給年1回（4月）、賞与年2回（7月、12月）

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

As a General Manager, you are not only responsible for providing strategic leadership and direction across all hotel operations – you’re also the driving force behind creating memorable guest experiences that reflect the true light and warmth of hospitality that is Hilton.

You will lead the hotel’s performance – from day-to-day operations to long-term strategy – while ensuring that every decision reflects Hilton’s commitment to exceptional service, team engagement, and business excellence.

Responsibilities

Your responsibilities will include::

  • Managing and optimizing hotel operations: You will lead the hotel with strategic oversight of all departments — ensuring alignment with Hilton brand standards. Through effective budgeting, forecasting, and service delivery, you’ll drive operational excellence and a seamless guest experience. By identifying inefficiencies and leveraging guest feedback, you’ll implement targeted improvements that enhance workflow, reduce waste, and elevate service. Your focus on continuous improvement, coaching, and innovation will strengthen team performance and consistently exceed guest expectations.
  • Managing commercial financial performance: You’ll take full ownership of the property’s financial performance, including sales, revenue and finance that will lead to growth, cost control, and profitability. This means setting and achieving targets for key performance indicators like GOP and RevPAR, while maintaining strong financial discipline. You'll also collaborate closely with the hotel’s commercial team and lead budgeting, forecasting, and strategic planning processes to ensure sustained financial health and business agility.
  • Communicating with key stakeholders: As the primary point of contact for hotel owners and Hilton’s corporate leadership, you will be responsible for maintaining alignment on business goals, operational strategies, and performance expectations. You will deliver regular updates, collaborate on long-term planning, and act as a trusted advisor, ensuring transparency and partnership at every level.
  • Leading and developing on-property teams: You will cultivate a high-performing, people-first culture by recruiting top talent, championing diversity and inclusion, and supporting the professional development of every team member. Through performance management, coaching, and recognition programs, you'll inspire engagement, accountability, and continuous growth. Your leadership will empower teams to deliver outstanding service while growing their own careers at Hilton.

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

job.job_description:
This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: 2 days in-office

Why This Job’s a Big Deal

Marketing and Advertising Technology is fast-paced and dynamic - so is this Company and this role. This position serves as an Analyst on the Privacy & AI Governance team at Priceline.com, which is part of the Legal department. The Analyst will play a critical role in maintaining responsible marketing governance processes that ensure user choices are honored and the Company maintains compliance with privacy and AI regulations such as CCPA (and other applicable U.S. laws) and GDPR. Reporting to the Chief Privacy Officer, this role will work cross-functionally, collaborating with other teams including marketing, security, enterprise data governance and other teams within Legal to ensure our marketing & advertising technology aligns with company policies and regulatory standards while supporting business objectives.

In This Role You Will Get To

  • Manage and continually develop policies and processes to ensure adtech and marketing tech compliance with applicable laws such as CCPA and GDPR.
  • Maintain and organize the marketing data inventory, collaborating with business partners to gather, document, and manage a real-time inventory of marketing activities with particular emphasis on tracking technologies.
  • Maintain data flow mapping across internal enterprise systems and between the Company and external partners, including social media
  • Conduct assurance checks on user-facing technologies, including tags and pixels, to verify accurate data collection and ensure compliance with the Company policies and applicable laws.
  • Audit and track privacy processes to ensure timely completion of user consent, preference management and opt out choices.
  • Manage and operate platforms and tooling supporting governance processes, e.g. OneTrust, to ensure accurate, efficient and auditable compliance; collaborate with technical owners of related platforms such as Tealium and Google analytics and they relate to governance.
  • Produce audit-ready reporting, dashboards and documentation.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Who You Are

  • 5-8 years experience in digital marketing operations or marketing analytics
  • data governance, compliance or risk management exposure

Education

Bachelor’s degree (BS) in Business Management, Information Technology, or other related fields.

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. In addition to a competitive base salary, certain roles may be eligible for an annual bonus and/or equity grant.

The salary range for this position is $100,000k to $115,000.

Who We Are

WE ARE PRICELINE.

Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.

Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.

We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.

Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.

If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!

Flexible work at Priceline

Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.

Perks & Benefits At Priceline

Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:

Health & wellness coverage including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources

Generous time off including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days

Work/life support including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)

Financial security programs such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts

Signature travel perks including employee-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits

Additional perks & discounts like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits

A people-first culture with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together

Specific benefits and programs vary by location.

Inclusion is a Big Deal!

To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.

Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.

Applying for this position

We're excited that you are interested in a career with us. For all current employees, please use the internal portal to find jobs and apply.

External candidates are required to have an account before applying. When you click Apply, returning candidates can log in, or new candidates can quickly create an account to save/view applications.

About Skyscanner

Everyone loves travelling, but planning is not without its challenges ✈️. That's why we've spent 20 years building tools that turn travel-planning chaos into a breeze. Today, around 160 million travellers count on us every month to skip the whole “47 browser tabs open” phase and find flights, cars, and hotels quickly and easily 💻.

Now, we’re on the lookout for a Global PR Lead to help us bring that vision to even more travellers.

About The Role

(Hybrid)

This is a role at the heart of our fast-paced, high-volume PR team, helping keep our communications flying in formation across 23 markets worldwide. You’ll be the central point connecting plans, people, budgets, agencies and operations — making sure our global PR machine runs smoothly, efficiently and at scale.

Working closely with our Senior Director of Communications, regional PR leads, internal teams and global agency partners, you’ll help turn our international PR strategy into coordinated action. From shaping global initiatives to sharpening the way we plan, measure and operate, you’ll bring the structure that helps brilliant PR ideas travel further.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Driving global PR planning: You’ll lead the planning process with our global PR agency hub, partnering with the Senior Director of Communications to keep forecasting, budgets, resources and priorities aligned.

  • Optimising our PR ecosystem: You’ll partner with Procurement and Finance to make sure we have the right suppliers, commercial setup and financial tracking in place to support growth — without the spreadsheet drama.
  • Keeping priorities moving: You’ll traffic-manage inbound requests, help the team navigate competing priorities and make sure resources are focused where they can have the greatest impact.
  • Leading global PR initiatives: You’ll spearhead strategic PR initiatives and special projects beyond our core campaigns, while supporting the delivery of our Awareness strategy and Big Bet activity through PR.
  • Making operations smarter: You’ll lead and collaborate on cross-functional improvements spanning tools and technology, including Tableau, ThoughtSpot, AI and our Product Ops model — finding smarter ways for a global team to work at scale.
  • Creating consistency across markets: You’ll partner with market leads, our global agency hub and Corporate and B2B PR teams to develop playbooks, strengthen processes and drive consistent adoption and delivery across 23 markets. You’ll also manage and develop our PR Coordinator, keeping calendars, finance trackers and reporting firmly on course.

About You

  • Global PR operator: You’ve worked in complex, international communications environments and know how to turn lots of moving parts into one joined-up plan.

  • Tech and data curious: You’re interested in how measurement, dashboards, AI and smarter tools can improve PR operations, reporting and decision-making at scale.
  • Calm in the whirlwind: You thrive in fast-paced environments, can prioritise when everything feels important, and enjoy helping teams work more effectively. You’re also comfortable managing and developing others along the way.

What It's Like Here

We are the real deal - no corporate gloss, no empty promises. Just a team of genuinely curious, caring humans ❤️, building things that help travellers explore the world a little easier 🧭.

Skyscanner is made up of brilliant humans from every corner of the world. We believe travel makes the world better - and that the same is true of our diverse teams. job.company_description:
OAG is the essential intelligence partner transforming global travel. For nearly 100 years, we've combined unmatched data quality, quantity and access with breakthrough technology and deep industry expertise. job.job_description:
OAG is the essential intelligence partner transforming global travel. For nearly a century, we've been the foundation the travel industry builds on, trusted, proven, essential. Today, we're going beyond.

We combine unmatched data quality, quantity and access with breakthrough technology and deep industry expertise to deliver what the industry truly needs: not just more data, but better answers. From real-time operational intelligence to strategic decision-making, we power the entire travel ecosystem, from airlines and airports to technology companies and financial institutions. We are actively embedding AI throughout our intelligence layer, combining nearly a century of proprietary data with the latest technology to deliver answers that were simply not possible before. We exist because travel moves the world, and we move travel. By transforming complexity into clarity and questions into answers, we give our partners the intelligence they need to thrive in an evolving world. For more information visit www.oag.com

ABOUT THE ROLE:

OAG Digital is the team turning our world-class data into a product-led growth engine: a unified experience where customers can discovery, try, pay and use on their own. We build the platform customers use to find, buy and use our data, and the intelligence products that turn that data into answers.

This is the most senior individual contributor role on the technical side of Digital. Its purpose is to turn the Digital strategy into a technical strategy that delivers it: deciding what gets built, in what order and to what standard, so the business can sell what it has committed to sell. A decision taken in one team should still work in another, our promises to customers on access, security, reliability and cost should hold on every channel, and the hardest problems should get solved once.

You’ll work across two areas. Core is the platform backbone: identity, auth, entitlements, billing, usage metering and the infrastructure everything else depends on. Intelligence is the layer above the data: AI-powered insights, predictive models built on Databricks and Snowflake, anomaly detection, and agentic features.

The role is hands-on. You’ll write production code on the hardest parts of the platform while setting direction, reviewing designs and helping other engineers do better work. We care about UX as much as throughput, and we’re AI-native: tooling is part of how we develop, not an afterthought.

This role can be worked remotely from anywhere in the UK only. Please note that we’re unable to offer visa sponsorship, so applicants will need the existing right to work in the UK.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

  • Design and build the hardest parts of the platform, hands on: how customers get to the right data and products, how that access is controlled, and what it costs us to serve. Stay close enough to the code that the design still holds once it’s built
  • Set the technical direction for problems that cross team boundaries: how customers are identified, what they’re allowed to use, how usage is measured and charged, and how existing customers and older systems move onto the new platform. Write the design down, get agreement, and stay with it through delivery so teams build to one approach rather than several
  • Set the standard for products built on AI and machine learning: define what a feature must do before it ships (show where its answer came from, be honest about how current the data is, fail predictably, be tested repeatably). Set the technical brief for data science teams, including how a model will be judged and the speed and cost it has to work within, and push back when a model isn’t the right tool
  • Work with the teams and partners outside Digital who build against your designs, including other parts of OAG and third parties. Share designs early, take feedback, change course where they’re right, and make the call when a cross-team decision has been open too long
  • Integrate AI models, data pipelines and event-driven systems on Databricks and Snowflake into the Intelligence layer
  • Improve how the whole of Digital builds software: review designs and code beyond your own team, mentor senior engineers, and make the good way to do something the easy way. This includes making AI-assisted development reliable, with the checks needed to keep quality high

We're looking for a Senior Marketing Manager, Loyalty to grow and strengthen our rewards programs across Tripadvisor and Viator — someone who can set strategic direction and execute against it. Location: East Coast- United States

What You’ll Do

  • Own the loyalty marketing strategy. Define and evolve the Tripadvisor Rewards value proposition and tiering strategy, and shape how the program shows up to members.

  • Measure what matters. Work with analytics to run and interpret holdout/control tests, and translate results into clear go/no-go calls and next steps.
  • Benchmark the competition. Track best-in-class loyalty programs (e.g., Starbucks, Nike, Sephora) to inform our approach to tiering, gamification, and member value.
  • Do the work at every level. Set strategy one day, brief creative or QA an offer the next.

Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of hands-on marketing experience working across the full spectrum from strategy to execution — in travel, e-commerce, subscription, or retail. You are equally able to build a program vision and ship a campaign.
  • A track record of product marketing work — translating product capabilities into clear member-facing value propositions and go-to-market plans.
  • Strong analytical skills — comfortable working with data - either in partnership with analytics and data science teams or working independently - to define metrics and interpret test results. You should be able to pull your own data using AI tools and dashboards.
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to improve efficiency, quality, and decision-making in day-to-day work.
  • Proven ability to operate effectively with a global-first mindset
  • A proven track record of cross-functional leadership — driving alignment and momentum across product, engineering, design, analytics, and CRM in a fast-paced, iterative environment; comfort operating with ambiguity and evolving scope.
  • A bias for action and comfort working with limited resources.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to flex between an executive-level strategy narrative and a detailed campaign brief.
  • Skilled at using AI tools to speed up research, analysis, and automate tasks in your day-to-day work.

Nice to have

  • Experience in loyalty or membership programs and an understanding of program economics and performance
  • Familiarity with marketplace/two-sided dynamics (e.g., supplier- or partner-funded offers).
  • Experience at a tech company.
  • Experience in travel, experiences, or marketplace businesses.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.

  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

We're looking for a strategic leader to shape the future of TUI Airline's network – someone who can balance commercial ambition with operational reality, and turn data into decisions that drive profitable growth across our global operations.

The role will be published until 28/10.

This role can be based in Luton (UK), Ostend (BE), or Hannover (DE).

About Our Offer

  • Personal benefits: Attractive remuneration, discretionary bonus schemes, generous travel benefits, extensive health & well-being support, and more.
  • Flexible working: Work is something you do, not somewhere you go. We encourage a healthy work-life balance with a dynamic working environment.
  • A career to shape: Access the TUI Learning Hub to level-up and reach your ambitions.
  • Broaden your network: We champion intercultural collaboration and provide opportunities to work on global projects and teams.
  • Community: Get involved with incredible local charity and sustainability initiatives like the TUI Care Foundation.

About The Job

  • You'll define and maintain our short and long-term network plan, ensuring it reflects seasonal demand patterns, customer requirements, and TUI Group priorities across all regions.
  • Leading the identification of new route opportunities and market entries is key – you'll prioritise where we fly next and how we deploy our aircraft to maximise both customer satisfaction and profitability.
  • As the commercial lead for fleet planning, you'll translate network ambitions into aircraft capacity requirements, working closely with Fleet, Finance, Operations and Strategy teams to ensure our fleet evolves to support growth.
  • Collaboration is at the heart of this role – you'll work hand-in-hand with B2B Sales, Regional Commercial teams, and Capacity Planning to ensure our network reflects real customer needs and market opportunities.
  • You'll develop structured, insight-driven route proposals including financial modelling, revenue forecasts, and ROI analysis, while maintaining the tools and methodologies that make our route evaluation best-in-class.
  • Building a high-performing team is essential – you'll lead, inspire and develop network analysts and planners, fostering a culture of excellence, curiosity and commercial rigour.

About You

  • You bring proven experience in leading airline network strategy, route profitability assessment, and capacity planning within a multi-market or multi-AOC airline environment.
  • Your strong understanding of airline economics, business case modelling, and strategic planning processes means you can navigate the complexity of a highly competitive and regulated industry.
  • Advanced skills in financial analysis are second nature to you – from business case development to scenario modelling, you know how to build compelling arguments for network decisions.
  • You're comfortable aligning network strategy with fleet planning, understanding how aircraft deployment and future capacity requirements connect to market development needs.
  • Demonstrated ability to incorporate customer needs and B2B feedback into network design shows you understand that great planning starts with listening to the people we serve.
  • You've got a track record of leading high-performing teams in fast-paced, cross-market environments, and you know how to build, coach and develop planning professionals who deliver results.

Accor Tech & Digital is the power engine of Accor technology, digital business and transformation. Our 5,000 talents are committed to deliver the best tech and digital experiences to our guests, hotels and staff across 110 countries and to shape the future of hospitality.

Accor Tech & Digital, jobs in the tech field where intelligence is above all human!



Job Description

Accor Tech & Digital is the innovation and technological transformation lab of the world leader in hospitality.

Our teams, known as Heartists®, bring together the best of hospitality with the best of tech and digital. Our ambition is to provide our customers with personalized, memorable, and sustainable experiences.

Here, we create new ways to travel within each of our 5,500 hotels, connecting closely with our 100 million clients in 110 countries.

Here, we are at the heart of an incredible playground for technological transition and the design of digital products and services for our customers and hotel teams.

Here, your scope will know no boundaries;

So join us and dare to make an impact on the world!



Here is where your greatest challenge awaits you:

We are seeking a highly strategic, analytical, and commercially-minded Senior Consumer, Market Insights & Business Analyst to join our dynamic team. This pivotal role will be instrumental in shaping ALL Accor's future by translating complex consumer behaviors and market dynamics into actionable business strategies, supporting the annual Strategic Marketing Plan, tracking the evolution of the ALL Accor brand and creating a community around insights and market data. The successful candidate will leverage deep insights to inform brand positioning, guide investment decisions in media and market development, and support our internal stakeholders across all levels of the organization in understanding the evolving landscape of travel and hospitality.





Your mission:

1. Strategic Insights & Research Leadership:

  • Lead and manage the end-to-end execution of key annual and quarterly consumer and market research initiatives. This includes survey design, vendor management, data collection oversight, rigorous analysis, and compelling presentation of findings to senior leadership and key stakeholders across various Accor brands and regions.
  • Proactively identify emerging consumer trends, market shifts, and competitive landscapes within the global hospitality industry and beyond, providing foresight and strategic implications for ALL Accor (e.g., impact of leisure travel, sustainability demands, digital nomadism...).
  • Develop and maintain a robust understanding of ALL Accor member behaviors and preferences, identifying opportunities for enhanced loyalty, engagement, and value creation. Champion best-in-class research methodologies (qualitative and quantitative) and tools, continuously seeking innovative approaches to gather richer, more actionable insights.



2. Business Intelligence & Strategic Decision Support:

  • Act as a trusted advisor to internal stakeholders (including senior management) by providing data-driven insights that support strategic planning, product development, brand positioning, and operational improvements.
  • Drive business decisions around media investment and market development strategies. This includes analyzing market potential, identifying white spaces, evaluating campaign effectiveness, and optimizing spend across various channels and geographies to maximize ROI for Accor and its brands.
  • Conduct in-depth regular business analysis, including competitive benchmarking, market sizing, opportunity assessments, and performance tracking, to identify areas for growth, efficiency, and competitive advantage.
  • Translate complex data into clear, concise, and compelling narratives and recommendations that enable effective decision-making at all levels, from tactical adjustments to long-term strategic shifts.



3. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence:

  • Foster strong collaborative relationships with global and regional teams, ensuring insights are widely disseminated and effectively integrated into business processes.
  • Proactively present findings and recommendations to diverse audiences, effectively influencing stakeholders through data-backed arguments and strategic storytelling
  • Create and contribute to a culture of insights and data with other cross-functional teams.

Qualifications

And you?

  • Education: Degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Economics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field. Master's degree (e.g., MBA, MSc in Marketing Analytics) is a significant plus.

  • Experience:
    • 8+ years of experience in consumer insights, market research, business analysis, or strategic consulting roles, preferably within the hospitality, travel, retail, or a related consumer-focused industry.
    • Proven track record of leading complex research projects from inception to delivery, driving actionable business outcomes with a mastery methodology, project management and stakeholder engagement.
    • Demonstrable experience in supporting brand strategy and marketing investment decisions through data-driven insights.
    • Experience working in a global or multi-national organization is highly desirable.

  • Technical Skills:
    • Expert proficiency in quantitative and qualitative research methodologies (e.g., segmentation, conjoint analysis, pricing studies, brand tracking, focus groups, in-depth interviews).
    • Advanced analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex datasets and identify key trends and insights.
    • Strong command of Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel (advanced) and PowerPoint (for compelling presentations).
    • Familiarity with digital analytics platforms (e.g., Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics) and social listening tools is a plus.

  • Soft Skills:
    • Strategic Thinker: Ability to connect insights to broader business objectives and develop long-term strategic recommendations.
    • Exceptional Communication & Presentation Skills: Ability to articulate complex ideas clearly, concisely, and persuasively to diverse audiences, including senior executives.
    • Strong Business Acumen: A deep understanding of business drivers, financial implications, and competitive dynamics.
    • Proactive & Curious: Self-starter with an insatiable curiosity for understanding consumer behavior and market trends.
    • Collaborative & Influential: Ability to build strong relationships and influence stakeholders without direct authority.
    • Problem-Solver: Resourceful and able to navigate ambiguity to find effective solutions.
    • Attention to Detail: Meticulous in data analysis and reporting, ensuring accuracy and integrity.
    • Passion for Hospitality: A genuine interest in the travel and hospitality industry and Accor's mission.
    • English written and presentation skills: the successful candidate will be highly proficient in English.

Additional Information

Accor dares to impact:

- the world

  • Accor is committed to the world around us, with a strong employer culture focused on the development of our 300,000 talents.
  • We adopt a continuous improvement approach to reduce the impact of digital on the environment across all our projects.

- your career:

  • We enable all our employees to manage their work-life balance and offer them the means to shape their work environment according to their preferences.
  • Training and career paths are defined both individually and collectively, allowing us to grow together on a daily basis.

- Specifically, at Accor Tech & Digital:

  • Remote work available several days per week from France, with flexible work options: work from home, from our offices, or even from our hotels and coworking spaces through Worklib.
  • Every Wednesday afternoon, dedicate your time to deep work and personal development.
  • Work in a multicultural and English-speaking environment.
  • Continuous improvement & training: hackathons, exceptional technology partnerships, dedicated talent management, certifications and a dedicated learning platform.

and also,

  • ALL - Heartist® Program: unforgettable stays and experiences at all Accor locations and partner venues worldwide.
  • Heartist® for Good Program: commit to supporting an association of your choice from those available on our volunteering platform (1 day offered per year by the Group during your working hours).
  • An Employee Social Committee (CSE) supporting the financing of your cultural and sports activities.
  • Sustainable Mobility Package for the use of eco-friendly transportation or access to a company bike program in partnership with Zenride.
  • Coverage of urban public transport subscriptions between home and workplace, in accordance with the rates set by French law “Loi Finance”.
  • €11 meal vouchers.
  • A mandatory health insurance plan funded at 50% by Accor without additional costs in case of enrollment of your dependents.
  • Attractive working conditions with collaborative workspaces, restaurants, and recreational areas as well as wellness and sports facilities, on-site or through Gymlib.

We value the richness of diverse nationalities, personalities, and professional backgrounds.

We know how to adapt to the specific needs of our employees, including those with disabilities.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

This role is open for Tokyo based or Bangkok based. For Bangkok based, Full visa and relocation support provided for you, family, etc.

Overview:

Based in Bangkok or Tokyo, Agoda’s Product Owners are responsible for defining the overall strategy and goals for Agoda’s various products, including the website, mobile applications and mobile website, email marketing, as well as advanced internal products and tools such as algorithmic PPC bidding systems and pricing software. POs drive the relentless innovation required to stay ahead in an extremely dynamic and competitive industry. Product Owners will create and maintain a product roadmap and will be responsible for communication with all stakeholders (business heads, marketing, developers, and senior management) to ensure that Agoda’s products continue to perform at the highest possible level and serve the needs of our many customer groups.

This role is based at Bangkok, Thailand or Tokyo Japan

A Product Owner will see the big picture and the small detail at the same time. He or she will understand the broad needs of the business, scan the competitive landscape in which their product operates, spot trends and technical developments and update the product roadmap as needed. At the same time, he or she will understand every detail of the product from design to functionality to usability. They will need to understand various ecommerce metrics and concepts very well – conversion, repeat rates, ROI, site performance metrics, bounce rates, return on investment, etc.

In summary, an Agoda Product Owner can expect to work on the cutting edge of technology, data, digital marketing, algorithmic decision-making and consumer psychology – all at a scale that very few ecommerce companies in the world today can offer.

Responsibilities:

job.job_description:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Internal Communications & Events Manager leads strategic employee communications and high-impact internal events that connect team members to company priorities, culture, and business goals. This role develops and executes communication strategies for enterprise initiatives, executive messaging, change management efforts, and employee engagement programs while producing engaging internal events and experiences. The ideal candidate is a strong communicator, storyteller, and project leader who can translate complex information into clear, compelling messages and deliver exceptional employee experiences that drive engagement and business results.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Communications Strategy & Planning

  • Develop and execute internal communication strategies that advance business priorities, organizational initiatives, and employee engagement goals.
  • Partner with leaders and key stakeholders to create communication plans aligned with company objectives and audience needs.
  • Craft clear, compelling messaging and communication materials for a variety of employee audiences.
  • Lead executive communications, organizational announcements, culture initiatives, and enterprise-wide messaging efforts.
  • Develop communication frameworks, toolkits, and resources that enable leaders to communicate effectively and consistently.
  • Evaluate communication effectiveness and recommend improvements based on business outcomes and employee feedback.

Campaign Development & Associate Engagement

  • Lead integrated communication campaigns that support key business initiatives, organizational change efforts, and employee experience programs.
  • Design multi-channel communication strategies that increase awareness, understanding, and engagement.
  • Partner with stakeholders to identify audience needs, objectives, and success measures.
  • Monitor campaign performance and leverage insights to continuously improve future communications.

Internal Events & Production

  • Lead the strategy, planning, and execution of internal events, including leadership meetings, town halls, recognition programs, and employee engagement experiences.
  • Collaborate with business leaders to define event objectives, key messages, and desired outcomes.
  • Manage event budgets, timelines, project plans, vendors, and production schedules.
  • Develop event content, executive presentations, speaker materials, communication plans, and run-of-show documentation.
  • Coordinate internal teams and external partners to deliver seamless, high-quality event experiences.
  • Ensure events reinforce company culture and support broader business and communication objectives.

Operational Communications & Incident Response

  • Serve as the lead communications partner during employee-impacting operational issues and business disruptions.
  • Assess communication needs, recommend response strategies, and deliver timely, accurate updates during rapidly evolving situations.
  • Manage communications related to office closures, severe weather, facilities issues, technology disruptions, safety matters, and other operational events.
  • Maintain communication tools, templates, and processes that support effective incident response and business continuity communications.
  • Demonstrate sound judgment, discretion, and composure under pressure.

Strategic Partnership & Communications Counsel

  • Advise leaders and stakeholders on communication strategy, change management, messaging, timing, audience engagement, and channel selection.
  • Lead communications planning for high-profile initiatives requiring coordinated, cross-functional support.
  • Partner closely with Human Resources and other business functions to align employee-facing communications and initiatives.
  • Build strong relationships across the organization to identify communication opportunities and improve overall communication effectiveness.
  • Champion strategic, enterprise-wide communication approaches that drive greater consistency and business impact.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Marketing, Event Management, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in internal communications, corporate communications, employee communications, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience leading communication strategy, planning, and execution for internal events, employee engagement programs, or organizational initiatives.
  • Demonstrated success managing communication campaigns and events from strategy through delivery.
  • Experience supporting executive communications, change communications, and time-sensitive operational communications.
  • Exceptional writing, editing, storytelling, and presentation development skills.
  • Strong project management, organizational, and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong visual and creative judgment with an understanding of brand standards and audience engagement best practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Communications, Public Relations, Organizational Communication, Marketing, or a related field.
  • Experience in hospitality, travel, entertainment, media, retail, or other customer-centric industries.
  • Experience managing large-scale employee events, leadership meetings, conferences, or recognition programs.
  • Experience working with external agencies, creative partners, production companies, or event vendors.
  • Experience with employee engagement platforms, collaboration tools, or internal communications technology.

COMPENSATION & SALARY RANGE:

Salary Range: $99,919 to $117,000 annually

This role is also eligible for an annual bonus under Choice’s Management Incentive Plan (MIP).

Pay ranges listed are what Choice Hotels reasonably expects to pay. Actual pay may be higher or lower and ranges may be adjusted in the future. Pay positioning within the range is influenced by factors including—but not limited to—education, experience, skills, certifications, performance, geographic location, business needs, seniority, and travel requirements.

WORK LOCATION & HYBRID SCHEDULE:

This position is based at Choice Hotels International’s corporate headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland. Regular onsite presence at this location is required. Associates are expected to follow the established hybrid work schedule, working onsite Monday through Thursday and remotely on Fridays.

RELOCATION & SPONSORSHIP:

Please note that relocation assistance is not available for this position. Additionally, Choice Hotels is not able to provide employment visa sponsorship now or in the future for this role.

Choice prioritizes our associate wellbeing by offering a comprehensive benefits program that is both competitive and flexible to help you achieve your wellbeing goals - here are just a few:

  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Leave and paid time-off for holidays, vacation, personal, family, volunteer, sick, jury duty, bereavement, military, and religious observance
  • Financial benefits for retirement and health savings
  • Employee recognition programs
  • Discounts at Choice hotels worldwide

About Choice

Choice Hotels International, Inc. (NYSE: CHH), is one of the largest lodging franchisors in the world. With 7,500 hotels in 45+ countries and territories, we offer a range of high-quality lodging options in the upper upscale, upper midscale, midscale, extended stay, and economy segments. We’re the hotel company for those who choose to bet on themselves — the striver, the dreamer, the entrepreneur — because that’s who we are, too.

At Choice, we are united by the simple belief that tomorrow will be even better than today — for associates, our company, and our franchisees. At our worldwide corporate headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, at our technology center in Scottsdale, Arizona, and through our associates around the globe, every voice is heard and every idea is listened to, no matter what area of the company they come from. We are united in supporting the entrepreneurial dreams of our thousands of franchise owners, which propels us forward — giving our work at Choice a purpose larger than our business.

Our corporate office locations:

North Bethesda, MD — Located at Pike & Rose, our worldwide headquarters is less than 15 miles from Washington, D.C., one block away from the North Bethesda Metro station, with easy access to I-495, complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.
