job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

Delta's operation generates a vast amount of information every day. Turning that information into better decisions and actions is critical to safety, reliability, customer experience, and financial performance. The General Manager, Ops Decisions & Insights leads the team responsible for understanding operational performance, emerging risks, customer impacts, and opportunities for improvement. This leader serves as a key partner to enterprise leaders, shaping how operational performance is measured, interpreted, and communicated to drive continuous improvement and a better customer experience.

There are two areas of the team this leader is responsible for: Enterprise Ops Insights and Decision Systems & Standards. These teams drive the operation by establishing operating cadences, elevating enterprise performance visibility, and synthesizing complex operational dynamics into clear narratives that lead to decisions and action. This role is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy, operations, customer experience, analytics, technology, and leadership. Success requires the ability to build high-performing teams, understand the breadth of the business, transform data into insights, and synthesize complex information in support of executive and Board-level discussions to drive decisions and action.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Enterprise Operational Insights and Storytelling  

  • Establish and maintain an integrated enterprise view of Delta’s operational performance and its connection to broader enterprise outcomes  
  • Develop and shape executive and Board-level presentations that synthesize complex data and diverse stakeholder inputs into clear storylines, compelling visuals, and actionable insights  
  • Provide thought leadership on the drivers of operational performance, helping leaders distinguish signal from noise and focus on the issues that matter most   
  • Set a high standard for executive communication across the team, including storyline development, presentation structure, visual storytelling, and synthesis

Advance Delta's Operational Decision System  

  • Establish operating cadences, decision frameworks, analytical standards, and performance management processes that improve the quality and consistency of operational decision-making
  • Create mechanisms that connect performance insights and decisions to clear ownership, follow-through, and measurable outcomes  
  • Advance the organization from reporting historical outcomes toward anticipating performance risks and identifying opportunities earlier  
  • Accelerate the use of advanced analytics, AI-augmented decision support, automation, and scenario-based planning to improve the speed and quality of decisions

Develop High-Performing Teams   

  • Lead a team of managers and analysts responsible for enterprise insights, analytical standards, and decision-support capabilities  
  • Develop leaders and individual contributors with strong critical thinking, analytical, executive presentation, storytelling, influencing, and problem-solving capabilities  
  • Build organizational capabilities that allow the team to anticipate evolving business needs and increase its impact on enterprise performance

What Success Looks Like: 

  • Enterprise leaders have a trusted, consistent view of operational performance and the issues that require attention  
  • Insights and operating cadences lead to faster alignment, clear accountability, and measurable action   
  • Executive and Board communications distill complexity into concise, visually compelling narratives that enable effective decisions   
  • Operations and Customer Experience have a more connected understanding of operational performance and customer impact, resulting in shared priorities
  • Advanced analytics, AI, and technology increase the speed, quality, and forward-looking nature of operational decision-making

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States.
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency.
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.
  • Must be a self-starter; ability to work independently with limited instruction or supervision.
  • Demonstrated experience leading, coaching, and developing teams, including direct leadership of managers or professional employees and accountability for organizational performance outcomes.
  • Minimum of 8+ years related experience.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to translate operational performance insights into action and build effective relationships at all levels.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal and relationship building skills - at all levels of the organization - with the ability to motivate and lead a team to achieve desired business results.
  • Ability to work effectively with senior leadership on C-Suite and Board topics to convey the enterprise ops narrative, drive change, and achieve strategic goals.
  • Develop and deliver executive-level presentations and communications that transform complex business insights, stakeholder perspectives, and organizational priorities into thoughtful narratives that drive influence, alignment, and support strategic decision-making.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Bachelor's degree in business management, finance, technical field (e.g., industrial engineering) or equivalent work experience.
  • Master's or other advanced degree
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across multiple functions and organizational levels.
  • Systems thinker with experience in process design, execution discipline, change management, and continuous improvement within a dynamic operating environment.

Benefits And Perks To Help You Keep Climbing

Our culture is rooted in a shared dedication to living our values – Care, Integrity, Resilience, Servant Leadership, and Teamwork – every day, in everything we do. At Delta, our people are our success. At the heart of what we offer is our focus on Sharing Success with Delta employees. Exploring a career at Delta gives you a chance to see the world while earning great compensation and benefits to help you keep climbing along the way:

  • Competitive salary, industry-leading proﬁt sharing program, and performance incentives
  • 401(k) with generous company contributions up to 9%
  • Paid time off including vacation, holidays, paid personal time, maternity and parental leave
  • Comprehensive health beneﬁts including medical, dental, vision, short/long term disability and life beneﬁts
  • Family care assistance through fertility support, surrogacy and adoption assistance, lactation support, subsidized back-up care, and programs that help with loved ones in all stages
  • Holistic Wellbeing programs to support physical, emotional, social, and financial health, including access to an employee assistance program offering support for you and anyone in your household, free financial coaching, and extensive resources supporting mental health
  • Domestic and International space-available flight privileges for employees and eligible family members
  • Career development programs to achieve your long-term career goals
  • World-wide partnerships to engage in community service and innovative goals created to focus on sustainability and reducing our carbon footprint
  • Business Resource Groups created to connect employees with common interests to promote inclusion, provide perspective and help implement strategies
  • Recognition rewards and awards through the platform Unstoppable Together
  • Access to over 500 discounts, specialty savings and voluntary benefits through Deltaperks such as car and hotel rentals and auto, home, and pet insurance, legal services, and childcare

Sales Operations Manager, Advertising

The Expedia Group Advertising (EGA) Field Operations team plays a critical role in enabling business growth through scalable processes, effective systems, and operational excellence. We partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Salesforce, Analytics, and Ad Operations teams to improve productivity, streamline workflows, and deliver data-driven solutions that help the organization operate more efficiently.

We are seeking a Sales Operations Manager, Advertising to lead complex operational initiatives that improve sales effectiveness and support business scale. In this role, you will evaluate current processes, identify opportunities for improvement, design and implement solutions, and measure success through data and performance analysis.

You will be responsible for initiatives that span lead and opportunity management, account planning, go-to-market processes, workflow automation, reporting, analytics, and business transformation efforts. Working cross-functionally, you will influence stakeholders across the organization and help shape the future of our advertising sales operations strategy.

In this role, you will

  • Design, implement, and optimize workflows and operational processes that improve sales productivity, efficiency, and effectiveness
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Salesforce, Analytics, and Ad Operations teams to gather requirements, identify business challenges, and develop scalable solutions
  • Lead initiatives related to lead management, opportunity workflows, account design, account planning, and go-to-market processes for new products and solutions
  • Evaluate and implement automation, reporting, and data-driven tools that improve operational performance and decision-making
  • Investigate business challenges, analyze data, and translate findings into actionable recommendations and business requirements
  • Measure the effectiveness of programs and process improvements through data analysis, stakeholder feedback, and performance metrics
  • Develop business cases and quantify opportunities to support investments in process improvements and operational enhancements
  • Lead complex cross-functional projects, establish project plans, define milestones, and drive execution against business objectives
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to stakeholders and senior leaders by providing operational expertise and strategic recommendations
  • Identify project risks, develop mitigation plans, manage budgets where applicable, and communicate progress to stakeholders
  • Create clear and effective communication materials, documentation, presentations, policies, and training resources
  • Support change management and adoption efforts by partnering with internal teams on training and enablement initiatives
  • Collaborate with Field Operations partners responsible for sales planning, territory design, compensation programs, incentives, and sales enablement to drive broader operational success

Experience And Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree, Master's degree, or equivalent professional experience
  • 5+ years of relevant experience with a Bachelor's degree or 3+ years of relevant experience with a Master's degree
  • Advanced Salesforce expertise, including experience as a Salesforce power user or administrator
  • Strong analytical skills with advanced Excel proficiency and working knowledge of SQL and AI-enabled data analysis tools
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and communicate effectively with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Experience managing multiple complex programs simultaneously while maintaining strong project documentation and organizational rigor
  • Strong program and project management skills, including planning, prioritization, execution, and change management
  • Experience analyzing business processes, identifying operational improvements, and implementing scalable solutions
  • Familiarity with technology, travel, advertising, media, or related industries
  • Strong business acumen with experience partnering closely with sales and marketing organizations
  • Ability to apply business strategy and customer needs to process, technology, and operational design decisions
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to tailor messaging for diverse audiences
  • Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, solve complex problems, and drive measurable business outcomes
  • Experience building stakeholder relationships and influencing decisions without direct authority
  • Strong attention to detail combined with the ability to balance strategic thinking and operational execution

Analysis and performance

  • Investigate questions and business challenges to establish facts, reach conclusions, and summarize findings into requirements while owning or helping design solutions
  • Identify methods for collecting data, perform analyses, and articulate findings to evaluate the impact of process changes
  • Use an understanding of current business processes, objectives, and challenges to recommend solutions and improvements
  • Measure stakeholder satisfaction and the efficiency and effectiveness of programs and processes using surveys, questionnaires, and other data collection methods
  • Identify and leverage existing data sources to evaluate business performance and operational effectiveness
  • Size opportunities and develop business cases to support change initiatives and associated investments

Project and stakeholder management

  • Lead increasingly complex non-technical projects and support adaptive programs operating in ambiguous environments
  • Act as a trusted advisor to team members, stakeholders, and leadership
  • Identify resource needs for projects and make recommendations regarding people, technology, partners, and other support requirements
  • Establish and maintain stakeholder trust by effectively addressing concerns and advocating for long-term business interests
  • Ensure business requirements are completed according to defined specifications and designs
  • Develop project schedules, define timelines, prioritize tasks, and drive achievement of key milestones
  • Keep stakeholders informed of progress, risks, and changes that may impact project delivery
  • Proactively manage project risks through anticipation, mitigation planning, and ongoing monitoring
  • Create, track, and report on project budgets when applicable
  • Tailor communication style, content, and format to effectively engage different audiences

Business, technology, and industry understanding

  • Develop awareness of industry trends, challenges, and emerging concepts relevant to advertising, technology, media, and travel
  • Build a broad understanding of industry products, services, and their applications while evaluating associated opportunities and tradeoffs
  • Help stakeholders explore and understand broader business challenges and opportunities
  • Demonstrate understanding of complex information, including legal, operational risk, and regulatory considerations, and clearly communicate key takeaways

job.job_description:
Start your journey with dnata catering & retail, where the sky is the limit!

About Us

Part of the Emirates Group, dnata catering & retail is Australia’s leading inflight catering and retail partner. We support many of the world’s most recognised airlines, delivering award‑winning meals and exceptional service that create memorable inflight dining experiences for thousands of travelers each day.

We're looking for an experienced and commercially driven Pricing Lead to join our Commercial team, based in either Sydney or Brisbane. This is an exciting opportunity to take ownership of a portfolio of airline and third-party customers, driving pricing strategy, profitability outcomes and commercial performance within a market-leading aviation business.

About The Role

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Pricing and Revenue Optimization, you will be responsible for delivering accurate, timely and commercially sound pricing outcomes across an assigned customer portfolio. You'll manage pricing activities from validated costing inputs through to pricing models, customer price lists, profitability analysis and approval-ready recommendations.

Working closely with Commercial, Sales, Finance, Operations, Procurement and Technology teams, you'll help identify revenue optimisation opportunities, support customer negotiations and contribute to continuous improvement across pricing processes and systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage end-to-end pricing activities across an assigned customer portfolio.
  • Develop and maintain pricing, costing and profitability models.
  • Support customer tenders, price reviews, contract changes and revenue recovery initiatives.
  • Analyse commercial performance and identify margin improvement opportunities.
  • Prepare pricing submissions, customer price lists and profitability reporting.
  • Apply contractual pricing mechanisms, indexation provisions and pricing controls.
  • Validate and reconcile pricing data across ERP, reporting and customer systems.
  • Support pricing requirements associated with system implementations and business initiatives.
  • Build strong relationships across Commercial, Finance, Operations, Procurement, Technology and customer-facing teams.
  • Contribute to process improvements, governance activities and pricing best practice.

About You

You'll be a commercially minded professional with strong analytical capability and the confidence to manage pricing activities across a diverse customer portfolio.

To Be Successful, You'll Bring

Summary

The Opportunity

Hyatt Hotels Corporation seeks an enthusiastic Director to join our Franchise & Owner Relations Group where you’ll join a team of field professionals who love what they do. In this role, you will be collaborating closely with the broader franchise community where you’ll be instrumental in continuing to make Hyatt a leading hospitality company. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list since 2013. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

  • Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on-site fitness center
  • A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption
  • Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

The Role

The Director of Franchise Performance is the liaison between Hyatt Hotels Corporation and our franchise owners & 3rd party management companies of our Essential Portfolio, and all performance needs related to these brands. Collaboration and coordination for internal colleagues (Development, Product & Brand Design, RAMP, Sales, Openings & Conversions, Marketing, Purchasing, IT, Finance, Legal, F & B, Brand Support, Facility Management, etc.) along with response and resolution to owner and management company needs so that they can efficiently and successfully operate their hotels. Job only encompasses single-unit owner/operators. Director is responsible for holding the owner / management companies accountable for both market share and brand health performance.

  • Hold performance reviews with owner/operators to ensure accountability & understanding of Hyatt’s Core Metric performance expectations.
  • Engage owner / operator to provide feedback on how to optimize their hotel’s performance.
  • Enforce Hyatt’s accountability programs with their portfolio of owners & operators; Focused Improvement Policy (FIP), Brand Protection Program (BPP), Quality Assurance Audits (QA), Brand Compliance Program (BCP) & Hyatt’s renovation policy.
  • Strategically Support the Delivery of Brand Initiatives. Build strong relationships with key business stakeholders, develops a deep understanding of business strategies as well as key business processes and systems.
  • Provide Commercial Services guidance (Sales, Revenue Management, Marketing) to grow the assets’ top line revenue and thus increase Hyatt’s fees.

Qualifications

Experience Required:

  • 5+ years of experience in same field, industry, or other equivalent business/ function role

Experience Preferred:

  • Bachelor’s degree in hospitality or a related field
  • Fluent in Microsoft Office suite of products
  • Proficient in ChatGPT or other LLMs

The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all-encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary.

We welcome you:

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.

The salary range for this position is $142,500 - $190,000. This position is also eligible to earn an annual bonus. The final pay rate/salary offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level and other qualifications for the role, as well as the location of the performance of work. Pay for the successful candidate will meet local requirements, including the local minimum wage rate.

We value our relationships with recruitment partners and require that agencies contact us first before submitting any candidates. Hyatt will not be responsible for any fees and obligations associated with unsolicited submissions unless a formal agreement is in place.

As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. job.job_description:
This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in-office.

From accounting and financial planning to risk/fraud analysis and payments, our Finance team ensures not only our company’s financial security, but also that our customers can buy from us with confidence.

Why This Job’s a Big Deal

Priceline – a part of Booking Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $90 billion – is looking for a Senior Analyst, FP&A to join its Finance team and support Technology Finance. Our FP&A team sits at the center of the organization and is actively involved with all major strategic decisions. In this role, you will serve as a key financial partner to our Technology organization, owning the planning, forecasting and reporting for technology spend – including software, cloud infrastructure, and IT consulting – and helping the business understand the return on our technology investments. The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. It’s therefore essential that this role meets our high standard of ethics, honesty, transparency and compliance.

In This Role You Will Get To

  • Act as an embedded financial partner to the CTO and Technology leadership team, serving as the connection between Finance rigor and Technology execution
  • Own the planning, budgeting and forecasting process for Technology spend – including software licensing/subscriptions, cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS, GCP), and IT consulting/professional services – in close partnership with the CTO and Technology leaders.
  • Partner day-to-day with engineering, product & technology enablement, accounting, and procurement teams to track spend against budget, identify variances, and surface areas for technology partners to find opportunities for cost optimization, such as cloud rightsizing, software rationalization, and vendor consolidation.
  • Support month-end close responsibilities for Technology accounts, including accrual support and variance analysis versus budget, forecast, and prior year, with clear narrative on key drivers.
  • Build and maintain reporting that gives Technology and Finance leadership visibility into performance, designing dashboards and conducting reviews across leadership and functional teams.
  • Support business cases and ROI analysis for major technology investments, and partner with legal and procurement on vendor contract renewals and negotiations.
  • Help evolve and automate Technology Finance’s reporting infrastructure, and contribute to broader FP&A process improvements.
  • Manage ad hoc requests and support special projects for Technology and Finance leadership.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting or other quantitative discipline
  • Minimum 7 years of related professional experience; FP&A experience required. Experience supporting a technology organization, or working with software and cloud cost data, is a plus
  • Proven track record of critical thinking, performing comprehensive analysis, synthesizing data and presenting insights in a clear and concise way
  • Computer proficiency with advanced knowledge of Excel, and ability and interest to learn and utilize tools such as OneStream, Fintastic, BigQuery, and cloud cost management platforms (e.g., AWS Cost Explorer, CloudZero)
  • Comfortable partnering with technical stakeholders and translating technology concepts – cloud consumption, software licensing models, capitalization rules – into financial terms, and vice versa
  • Demonstrated ability to multitask and meet deadlines within a fast-paced environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, coordinate the efforts of others, and work well with people at a wide range of levels
  • Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust
  • The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics is essential.

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. In addition to a competitive base salary, certain roles may be eligible for an annual bonus and/or equity grant.

The salary range for this position is $115,000 to $145,000

Who We Are

WE ARE PRICELINE.

Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.

Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.

We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.

Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.

If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!

Flexible work at Priceline

Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.

Perks & Benefits At Priceline

Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:

Health & wellness coverage including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources

Generous time off including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days

Work/life support including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)

Financial security programs such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts

Signature travel perks including employee-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits

Additional perks & discounts like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits

A people-first culture with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together

Specific benefits and programs vary by location.

Inclusion is a Big Deal!

To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.

Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.

Applying for this position

We're excited that you are interested in a career with us. For all current employees, please use the internal portal to find jobs and apply.

External candidates are required to have an account before applying. When you click Apply, returning candidates can log in, or new candidates can quickly create an account to save/view applications.

job.job_description:
About Skyscanner

Everyone loves travelling, but planning is not without its challenges ✈️. That's why we've spent 20 years building tools that turn travel-planning chaos into a breeze. Today, around 160 million travellers count on us every month to skip the whole “47 browser tabs open” phase and find flights, cars, and hotels quickly and easily 💻.

Joining Skyscanner means becoming part of a global brand that's striving to become the planet's go-to travel hack accessible for all 🌍.

Our vision? To be the world's number one travel ally. (Ambitious? 💪Yes, but, hey, that's what got us here).

Now, we’re on the lookout for a Global PR Lead to help us bring that vision to even more travellers.

About The Role

(Hybrid)

This is a role at the heart of our fast-paced, high-volume PR team, helping keep our communications flying in formation across 23 markets worldwide. You’ll be the central point connecting plans, people, budgets, agencies and operations — making sure our global PR machine runs smoothly, efficiently and at scale.

Working closely with our Senior Director of Communications, regional PR leads, internal teams and global agency partners, you’ll help turn our international PR strategy into coordinated action. From shaping global initiatives to sharpening the way we plan, measure and operate, you’ll bring the structure that helps brilliant PR ideas travel further.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Driving global PR planning: You’ll lead the planning process with our global PR agency hub, partnering with the Senior Director of Communications to keep forecasting, budgets, resources and priorities aligned.
  • Turning measurement into momentum: You’ll work closely with our measurement lead to make sure reporting is accurate, useful and connected to the strategies and decisions that matter.
  • Optimising our PR ecosystem: You’ll partner with Procurement and Finance to make sure we have the right suppliers, commercial setup and financial tracking in place to support growth — without the spreadsheet drama.
  • Keeping priorities moving: You’ll traffic-manage inbound requests, help the team navigate competing priorities and make sure resources are focused where they can have the greatest impact.
  • Leading global PR initiatives: You’ll spearhead strategic PR initiatives and special projects beyond our core campaigns, while supporting the delivery of our Awareness strategy and Big Bet activity through PR.
  • Making operations smarter: You’ll lead and collaborate on cross-functional improvements spanning tools and technology, including Tableau, ThoughtSpot, AI and our Product Ops model — finding smarter ways for a global team to work at scale.
  • Creating consistency across markets: You’ll partner with market leads, our global agency hub and Corporate and B2B PR teams to develop playbooks, strengthen processes and drive consistent adoption and delivery across 23 markets. You’ll also manage and develop our PR Coordinator, keeping calendars, finance trackers and reporting firmly on course.

About You

  • Global PR operator: You’ve worked in complex, international communications environments and know how to turn lots of moving parts into one joined-up plan.
  • Strategic and operational: You’re equally comfortable shaping a global PR initiative and getting into the detail needed to make it happen. Big picture, meet beautifully organised spreadsheet.
  • Stakeholder savvy: You build trusted relationships across senior leaders, market teams, agencies and cross-functional partners, bringing people together around shared priorities.
  • Agency confident: You know how to get the best from global agency relationships, balancing clear direction, strong partnership and accountability for delivery.
  • Commercially switched-on: You’re comfortable working with budgets, forecasting, suppliers, Procurement and Finance, and you understand how strong operational foundations help teams achieve more.
  • Tech and data curious: You’re interested in how measurement, dashboards, AI and smarter tools can improve PR operations, reporting and decision-making at scale.
  • Calm in the whirlwind: You thrive in fast-paced environments, can prioritise when everything feels important, and enjoy helping teams work more effectively. You’re also comfortable managing and developing others along the way.

What It's Like Here

We are the real deal - no corporate gloss, no empty promises. Just a team of genuinely curious, caring humans ❤️, building things that help travellers explore the world a little easier 🧭.

Skyscanner is made up of brilliant humans from every corner of the world. We believe travel makes the world better - and that the same is true of our diverse teams. We're proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and products that are accessible to all ✨.

Sound like your kind of adventure? 🚀 Apply now and help us shape the future of travel.

If you require any reasonable adjustments or accommodations for interviews, and/or wish to apply under the Disability Confident scheme, please let your recruiter know. job.job_description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Manager, Loyalty Marketing is a high-impact, commercially oriented role responsible for driving member growth, engagement and retention across Asia Pacific excluding China (APEC).

This is a new role sitting at the intersection of loyalty strategy, CRM, and experiential partnerships - built for a marketer who is equally comfortable designing a lifecycle journey and activating world-class partnerships. You will own the end-to-end member journeys for one of the world's largest hospitality loyalty programs, translating global strategy into locally relevant, measurable initiatives across a diverse and dynamic region. This role will report to the Director, Loyalty Marketing, APEC.


You will lead the evolution of CRM and lifecycle marketing for APEC — defining segmentation strategy, designing engagement programs, and driving measurable improvements in activation, retention and reactivation. You will work in close collaboration with global, continent and market teams, and play a central role in building the reach and scaling our loyalty program as a long-term growth driver for the business. Success in this role requires strong organizational skills, strategic thinking and a member-centric mindset.

This role is based in Singapore.


CORE COMPETENCIES

  • CRM & Lifecycle Marketing: Deep, hands-on experience designing and executing programs across the full customer journey. Builds segmentation logic, personalisation strategy and automated flows anchored in commercial outcomes, not just campaign execution.
  • Loyalty & Partnership Marketing: Solid understanding of loyalty program mechanics (earn/burn, tiering, member value proposition) and how to market them effectively across segments and channels. Proven ability to activate brand partnerships, event management and experiential moments from brief to delivery, with strong agency management.
  • Data Analysis & Fluency: Comfortable working with member behaviour data, campaign analytics and dashboards to surface insight and drive continuous improvement. Tracks activity to outcomes, not outputs.
  • Communication & Brand Stewardship: Executes customer-facing communications with a consistent, on-brand voice across owned and paid channels. Brings sharp copywriting instincts, strong creative review judgment, and the ability to influence and align across global, regional and local teams with different cultures and working styles.
  • Execution & Project Management: Highly organised with a strong bias for delivery. Manages multiple workstreams simultaneously, ensuring projects adhere to timelines.


CANDIDATE PROFILE

We are looking for a marketer with 4+ years of experience in loyalty, CRM or lifecycle marketing, ideally within hospitality, travel, or a consumer brand environment.

Requirement

  • 4-5 years of relevant professional experience in program management, marketing strategy, loyalty and lifecycle disciplines, digital or related function
  • Experience managing and directing strategic partners / agencies /vendors. Demonstrated relationship marketing skills a must.
  • Team player, proven ability to lead and work with cross-functional teams in support of specific business priorities
  • Languages: Proficiency in English required; proficiency in reading and writing in other Asian languages strongly preferred.


JOB SCOPE

Loyalty & Lifecycle Marketing

  • Drive member growth, engagement and advocacy across APEC through loyalty-led initiatives that build program awareness, deepen usage and deliver locally relevant member value
  • Develop and execute the continent's loyalty marketing plan - spanning promotions, lifecycle programs and CRM strategy - aligned with global strategy and optimised for local market nuance
  • Define and manage CRM strategy across the full customer lifecycle: acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention and reactivation
  • Plan and execute loyalty-led campaigns across owned channels (email, app, digital) and paid channels (social, digital) with audience analysis, targeting, segmentation and performance tracking
  • Identify opportunities for segmentation, personalisation to deliver on deeper customer value optimisation; drive continuous improvement in CRM effectiveness and automation capabilities
  • Leverage market research, member insights and data analytics to inform engagement strategies and personalised experiences
  • Design, implement and optimise loyalty programs that drive advocacy and revenue, delivering tangible value to target member segments
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including but not limited to MarTech, Enterprise Partnerships (Co-Brand, Airlines, Everyday Earn) and Loyalty Operations to integrate and orchestrate initiatives across key customer touchpoints
  • Serve as gatekeeper for all loyalty member communications, ensuring on-brand, accurate and effective execution


Performance Operations & Governance

  • Track and report program KPIs covering member acquisition, activation, retention, revenue contribution and repeat stay behaviour, with clear recommendations for improvement
  • Oversee CRM data accuracy, integrity and compliance across programs
  • Drive effective onboarding, training and adoption of loyalty programs and systems across property teams


Experiential Partnerships

  • Support the activation of global and regional marketing partnerships translating partnership rights into compelling, member-facing campaigns that drive high member engagement, leveraging on Marriott Bonvoy Moments
  • Ensure all partnership campaigns are executed in full alignment with partners, with rigorous agency management and end-to-end campaign planning
  • Support end-to-end event management and logistics planning for partnership activations, ensuring seamless on-ground execution and member experiences


Working Relations

Key interfaces:-

  • Area Directors of Marketing
  • Field Marketing team
  • Continent level agencies.

Integrated Marketing Planning

  • Supports development of continent destination marketing strategy and focused on key source markets and KPIs.
  • Monitor competitive activity in the category.

Promotions/ Partnerships

  • Partners with Revenue Strategy, develops and executes promotions/offers that drive KPIs for the continent or market (eg. Enrollment goals, direct channel goals, driving leisure revenue, etc.).
  • Partner with analytics team to ensure proper tracking and communication of all programs.

Integrated Marketing Execution

  • Develops marketing brief with clear KPIs and conducts kick off for all new programs.
  • Engages agencies in RFP process and project manages the creative design and execution process to bring a program to market. Ensures consumer messaging is clear.
  • Is responsible for ensuring all key stakeholders of the program are aligned.
  • Is responsible for communicating programs to the market and corporate teams and ensuring all channels are leveraged (social, digital, sales, etc).
  • Reviews program performance in real time and modifies program as needed.

Area/ Hotel Support

  • Partners with Directors of Field Marketing and other area marketing leaders.
  • Provides strong guidance on positioning and pull through of brands.
  • Advises field marketing on effective marketing communications planning, implementation and evaluation.
  • Conducts destination marketing training and develops resources and materials for Directors of Sales and Marketing with a focus on marketing planning, branding, positioning, messaging and storytelling.
  • Deal with own development of the process for new hotel ramp up and hotel positioning and messaging development. Partners with area marketing leaders to execute where needed.


MANAGEMENT COMPETENCIES

Leadership

  • Adaptability - Maintains performance level under pressure or when experiencing changes or challenges in the workplace.
  • Communication - Conveys information and ideas to others in a convincing and engaging manner through a variety of methods.
  • Problem Solving and Decision Making - Identifies and understands issues, problems, and opportunities; obtains and compares information from different sources to draw conclusions, develops and evaluates alternatives and solutions, solves problems, and chooses a course of action.
  • Professional Demeanor - Exhibits behavioral styles that convey confidence and command respect from others; makes a good first impression and represents the company in alignment with its values.

Managing Execution

  • Building and Contributing to Teams - Participates as a member of a team to move toward the completion of common goals while fostering cohesion and collaboration among team members.
  • Driving for Results - Sets high standards of performance for self and/or others; assumes responsibility for work objectives; initiates, focuses, and monitors the efforts of self and/or others toward the accomplishment goals; proactively takes action and goes beyond what is required.
  • Planning and Organizing - Gathers information and resources required to set a plan of action for self and/or others; prioritizes and arranges work requirements to accomplish goals and ensure work is completed.

Building Relationships

  • Coworker Relationships - Interacts with others in a way that builds openness, trust, and confidence in the pursuit of organizational goals and lasting relationships.
  • Customer Relationships - Develops and sustains relationships based on an understanding of customer/stakeholder needs and actions consistent with the company’s service standards.
  • Global Mindset - Supports employees and business partners with diverse styles, abilities, motivations, and/or cultural perspectives; utilizes differences to drive innovation, engagement and enhance business results; and ensures employees are given the opportunity to contribute to their full potential.

Generating Talent and Organizational Capability

  • Organizational Capability - Evaluates and adapts the structure of assignments and work processes to best fit the needs and/or support the goals of an organizational unit.
  • Talent Management - Provides guidance and feedback to help individuals develop and strengthen skills and abilities needed to accomplish work objectives.

Learning and Applying Professional Expertise

  • Applied Learning - Seeks and makes the most of learning opportunities to improve performance of self and/or others.
  • Business Acumen - Understands and utilizes business information to manage everyday operations and generate innovative solutions to approach business and administrative challenges.
  • Technical Acumen - Understands and utilizes professional skills and knowledge in a specific functional area to conduct and manage everyday business operations and generate innovative solutions to approach function-specific work challenges.
  • Basic Competencies - Fundamental competencies required for accomplishing basic work activities.
  • Basic Computer Skills - Uses basic computer hardware and software (e.g., personal computers, word processing software, Internet browsers, etc.).
  • Mathematical Reasoning - Adds, subtracts, multiplies, or divides quickly, correctly, and in a way that allows one to solve work-related issues.
  • Oral Comprehension - Listens to and understands information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences.
  • Reading Comprehension - Understands written sentences and paragraphs in work related documents.
  • Writing - Communicates effectively in writing as appropriate for the needs of the audience.

Join our Movement and Champion Restaurant Culture! 💚

At TheFork we believe that the best things in life happen around the table.

As the leading restaurant booking platform in Europe, we connect the broadest community of loyal diners with the world’s favorite restaurants. Powered by innovation and a deep passion for the restaurant industry, we create unique dining experiences across 11 countries.

We’re part of the Tripadvisor Group and proud to be building a diverse, people-first culture where “respect”, “ownership”, “growth” and “better together” values thrive.

If you’re passionate about food, technology, and making a real impact, your seat at the table is ready.

👉 Discover life at TheFork

What You Will Do

  • After selecting in-scope restaurants, you will proactively contact and schedule meetings with the owners or managers of the restaurants. Your daily activities will be composed of cold-calls, walk-in visits and pre organized meetings to present TheFork products and services.
  • You will be in charge of proposing and selling TheFork products and services, including: promotions, advanced software tool, booking widgets installed on the restaurant website, training & marketing solutions.
  • You will engage with the Restaurants managers to help them understand the opportunities, features and benefits of the TheFork Manager tool and TheFork network.
  • You will follow up with the prospects you engaged with until you close the deal and the restaurant is successfully published online on TheFork and affiliate websites.
  • Your coverage area will be North London and Essex. Having your own vehicle for mobility is preferred.

Who You Are

Job Title

Bid Manager

External Job Title: Bid Manager - Airports & Border Authorities

Position type: Full time

Location: Miami, Orlando, Dallas, or Remote (United States)

Job ID: R36072

Job family: Sales

About Your Business Area/Department

The Airports & Border Authorities Americas team drives growth by helping airports, governments, border agencies, cruise ports and other transportation stakeholders modernize passenger processing, airport operations, border control, biometrics, self-service and common-use infrastructure. We combine customer insight, solution expertise and disciplined bid execution to pursue strategic opportunities across the Americas.

Summary Of The Role

You will lead strategic and complex bids for Amadeus Airports & Border Authorities across the Americas, shaping winning strategies, coordinating cross-functional teams and partners, and managing customer engagement from early qualification through negotiation, contract award and a seamless transition to implementation.

In this role you’ll

  • Lead the end-to-end bid process for strategic and complex opportunities, from pre-bid engagement and qualification through submission, negotiation, contract award and handover to implementation.
  • Develop the bid strategy by understanding the customer’s business and commercial drivers, analyzing requirements, shaping a compelling value proposition and aligning the response with Amadeus strategy, financial objectives and approval processes.
  • Build and lead virtual bid teams across Sales, Solution Management, Product, Delivery, Finance, Legal and other support functions, establishing the project plan, governance, deliverables, responsibilities and decision points.
  • Act as a key customer contact during the bid, building credibility with senior stakeholders, preparing and leading formal and informal presentations, and coordinating the negotiation team during the pre-contract stage.
  • Own the quality and completeness of the customer response, including compliance matrices, solution and service descriptions, partner contributions, commercial inputs, risk assessment and the management of non-conformities.
  • Oversee multiple bids as required, communicate progress and risks clearly to senior management, escalate major issues, and ensure that decisions and approvals are obtained at the appropriate stages.
  • Identify, evaluate and coordinate external partners and solution providers, including content delivery, commercial alignment and contracting support where required.
  • Ensure a structured transition to the implementation team after award, with complete documentation and early-stage support to maintain continuity between the proposed solution and project execution.
  • Promote bid-management best practices, coach less-experienced colleagues and recommend improvements to tools, processes, governance and ways of working.

About The Ideal Candidate

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Information Technology, Aviation, Project Management or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  • At least 8 years of experience in bid management, proposal management, complex solution sales, pre-sales or a related commercial function, including leadership of large, multi-stakeholder responses.
  • Proven ability to manage strategic RFP/RFI processes, compliance matrices, executive reviews, commercial approvals, customer presentations and contract negotiations.
  • Strong project-management and stakeholder-leadership skills, with the ability to coordinate global and cross-functional teams without direct authority and to manage several priorities under firm deadlines.
  • Commercial and financial acumen, including confidence working with business cases, pricing inputs, risk assessments, contractual terms and P&L considerations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to translate complex solution content into clear, persuasive and customer-focused messaging. Spanish and/or Portuguese is an advantage.
  • Experience in airport technology, border management, aviation, transportation, government technology or other complex B2B/B2G environments is highly desirable.
  • APMP, PMP or an equivalent bid/project-management certification is desirable but not required.

What We Can Offer You

  • Get rewarded with competitive remuneration, individual and company annual bonus, vacation and holiday paid time off, health insurances and other competitive benefits.
  • Work from anywhere: onsite, hybrid or fully remote.
  • Professional development to broaden your knowledge and enhance your skills with on-line learning hubs packed with technical and soft skills training that allow you to develop and grow.
  • Enter a diverse and inclusive workplace, join one of the world’s top travel technology companies and take on a role that impacts millions of travelers around the globe.

Working at Amadeus, you will find

🎯 A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you will be powering the future of travel and pursuing a critical mission and extraordinary purpose.

🌎 A truly global DNA - Everything at Amadeus is global, from our people to our business, which translates into our footprint, processes, and culture.

🎓 Great opportunities to learn - Learning happens all the time and in many ways at Amadeus, through on-the-job training, formal learning activities, and day-to-day interactions with colleagues.

🤗 A caring environment - Amadeus fosters a caring environment, nurturing both a fulfilling career and personal and family life. We care about our employees and strive to provide a supportive work environment.

💰 A complete rewards offer - Amadeus provides attractive remuneration packages, covering all essential components of a competitive reward offer, including salary, bonus, equity, and benefits.

🌈 A diverse and inclusive community - We are committed to leveraging our uniquely diverse population to drive innovation, creativity, and collaboration across our organization.

📈 A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental values that drive our actions and shape long-lasting relationships with our customers, partners, and employees.

Application process

  • The application process takes no longer than 10 minutes!
  • Create your candidate profile, upload your Resume/CV and apply today!

Diversity & Inclusion

Amadeus is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or a related medical condition), ancestry, national origin, age, genetic information, military or veterans status, sexual orientation, gender expression, perception, or identity, marital status, mental or physical disability status, or any other protected federal, state, or local status unrelated to performance of work involved.

Amadeus endeavors to make https://jobs.amadeus.com/ accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us at accommodations@amadeus.com. This contact information is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

Be aware of recruitment scams

Amadeus Group never charges fees, requests payment, or asks for financial information during recruitment. All legitimate opportunities are communicated solely through official Amadeus channels, including our careers website. Any payment request or outreach via unofficial platforms (e.g., WhatsApp, Telegram) should be treated as fraudulent.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

This role is based in Bangkok, Thailand, and is open to candidates worldwide. We offer a generous relocation package to ensure a smooth transition to living and working in Bangkok.

Get to Know Our Team:

The Performance Marketing Team of Agoda is a world leader in online marketing. We are highly data-driven and focused on developing at-scale marketing programs that improve the lifetime value of our customers.

Our team is a blend of the bright analysts, marketing strategists, and data scientists in the world. We foster a great learning environment where you will be able to learn and grow by working closely with experts from a variety of backgrounds from all over the world.

With Performance Marketing, MSE is a business development and marketing role within Agoda’s marketing department. It involves working with online vertical search advertisers (Meta Search Engines) to drive hotel booking sales.

In this role, you'll get to:

  • Own and manage marketing spend with large Meta Search Engine (MSE) partners
  • Independently manage your accounts
  • Manage the commercial relationship with MSE partners, including commercial terms, bidding and pricing strategies, and technical implementation
  • Decide in coordination with the Bidding and Pricing teams strategies that deliver expected ROIs and revenue growth
  • Track detailed performance/KPIs and deliver regular data-driven actionable insights to improve results
  • Succinctly communicate the results, ideas, and business statistics with different stakeholders
  • Ensure the advertiser implements the right Agoda APIs and related technological innovations
  • Be immersed and intimately familiar with the entire booking funnel including the user experience and conversion drivers between the advertiser and Agoda
  • Build long term relationships with advertisers that foster new opportunities and continuous growth in return from advertising dollars

What you’ll need to succeed:

  • Bachelor Degree in Computer Science/Statistics/Math or Engineering or Economics and Finance
  • Business development and/or account management track record with experience in online marketing
  • Fluent in English with strong communication skills (both written and verbal)
  • Self-motivated person with “Get it done!” attitude
  • Passionately analytical with strong ability to think logically and excellent problem-solving skills
  • Proficient in business intelligence tools and data warehouse i.e. SQL, Tableau and MS Excel
  • Ability to effectively communicate, influence and persuade with different levels of stakeholders (including Senior Management) with proven strong commercial acumen
  • Ability to represent Agoda with experience in interacting with external senior level executives
  • Strong analytical and statistical analysis skills to extract insights and recommendations

job.job_description:
Job Summary

The Business Analyst, Strategic Sourcing provides analytical, reporting, and project coordination support that enables the Strategic Sourcing team to make informed purchasing decisions and conduct effective supplier negotiations. This individual contributor develops reporting and presentations for department and executive leadership, supports competitive sourcing processes through documentation and supplier evaluation tools, and applies artificial intelligence tools to improve sourcing workflows. The role supports contract documentation, vendor and market research, and negotiations while serving as the process owner for IT purchase orders. Reporting to the Director of Strategic Sourcing, this role works closely with sourcing category leads and cross-functional stakeholders to support efficient, accurate, and consistent sourcing processes.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare and maintain department reporting, dashboards, and scorecards to track sourcing activity, spend, savings, and other relevant business metrics.
  • Coordinate input from stakeholders and develop clear, polished presentations that communicate sourcing insights and recommendations to department and executive leadership.
  • Support requests for proposal, information, and quotation processes by preparing sourcing documentation, evaluation models, and supplier scorecards.
  • Identify and apply artificial intelligence and productivity tools, including Microsoft Copilot and Claude, to streamline sourcing workflows and improve team efficiency.
  • Gather and organize contract documentation, maintain negotiation workbooks, and conduct vendor and market research to support sourcing decisions.
  • Lead negotiations for smaller-dollar agreements and provide analytical and documentation support for larger supplier negotiations as directed by the Director of Strategic Sourcing.
  • Serve as the process owner for IT purchase orders, helping ensure requests are accurate, appropriately approved, and processed in a timely manner.
  • Maintain sourcing process documentation and identify opportunities to improve the consistency and efficiency of team workflows.

Qualifications

Employment Experience

  • 1 to 3 years of experience in business analysis, strategic sourcing, procurement, supply chain, finance, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting cross-functional teams; exposure to strategic sourcing, procurement, supplier management, or related purchasing processes is preferred.
  • This is an individual contributor position with no direct reports.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, including the ability to develop analytical reporting and business presentations.
  • Working knowledge of artificial intelligence tools such as Microsoft Copilot and Claude, with the ability to apply these tools to business processes and workflows.
  • Ability to organize and analyze sourcing, supplier, spend, and related business information.

Additional Skills & Competencies

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and reporting skills with attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate information into clear presentations and recommendations.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with sourcing partners, vendors, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Ability to prioritize work, adapt to changing business needs, and support process and organizational change.
  • Curiosity and willingness to learn and apply emerging AI and productivity tools.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and work experience.
  • No specific professional certification is required.

SALARY RANGE

The salary range for this position is $75,590 - $88,886.

Senior Operations Specialist, InsurTech

Introduction to the Team

If you seek a collaborative, exciting, and fast-paced environment and are passionate about the traveler journey, you will love Expedia Group’s Global InsurTech team! Expedia Group’s InsurTech team seeks to offer innovative products and solutions that drives our mission to provide: “Peace of Mind to Every Traveler, Everywhere.”

The Account Management team plays a key role in building and optimizing our partnerships with leading travel insurance supply partners. As a Senior Operations Specialist, you will take ownership of key operational workstreams that support these partnerships – driving execution, resolving complex issues, and ensuring our supply partners experience a seamless and high-performing relationship with Expedia Group. This is a cross-functional role that requires someone who thrives in ambiguous environments and brings structure, consistency, and proactive thinking to everything they do.

In This Role, You Will

  • Own and manage the day-to-day operational health of assigned insurance supply partner relationships, serving as a primary point of contact for operational matters and issue resolution.
  • Lead the preparation and facilitation of regular business reviews (weekly partner calls, MBRs, QBRs), synthesizing operational updates, performance insights, and action items for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Oversee financial reconciliation workstreams – including booking data, supplier payments, and invoice management – ensuring accuracy, identifying discrepancies, and driving resolution in collaboration with Accounting and Finance teams.
  • Take the lead on troubleshooting and resolving technical, connectivity, and compliance issues, coordinating across supply, product, tech, and customer service teams with minimal escalation.
  • Monitor and analyze key performance metrics (e.g. NPS, attach rates, claims, profitability) and translate findings into clear recommendations and action plans.
  • Drive process improvement initiatives, including the development and maintenance of SOPs, SLAs, and supplier performance dashboards, with a focus on automation and scalability.
  • Serve as a liaison between field operations and leadership, proactively flagging risks and summarizing cross-team updates.
  • Assist with licensing, reporting, and compliance requirements across global markets, staying current on regulatory developments that impact operations.
  • Analyze and interpret large datasets to surface actionable insights and support data-driven decision-making.

Experience And Qualifications

  • A structured and consistent operator who brings clarity and process discipline to complex, ambiguous situations – you don’t wait to be told what to do, you identify the problem and move toward a solution.
  • A proactive problem solver with strong analytical skills and a bias toward using data to drive recommendations and decisions.
  • An effective communicator and relationship builder who is comfortable engaging directly with external supply partners, translating operational complexity into clear, professional dialogue.
  • Highly organized with strong prioritization skills, able to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously without losing attention to detail.
  • Comfortable operating independently in high-pressure situations and navigating ambiguity with confidence and composure.
  • A collaborative team player who cultivates strong cross-functional relationships and knows how to get things done across a matrixed organization.
  • Have 3–5 years of relevant experience in an operations, account management, program management, or analyst role – ideally in a travel consumer, insurtech, fintech, consulting, or insurance environment.
  • Advanced user of Excel and PowerPoint; familiar with relational databases and data visualization/reporting tools (e.g. Tableau); experience with project management tools is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required; Master’s degree or equivalent a plus.
  • Proficiency in English required; additional language skills are a plus.

job.job_description:
Organization- Hyatt Corporate Office

Summary

The Opportunity

Hyatt Hotels Corporation seeks an enthusiastic Director to join our Data and Analytics department. In this role, you will be collaborating closely with the broader Machine Learning and AI team, where you’ll be instrumental in continuing to make Hyatt a leading hospitality company. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list since 2013. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

  • Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on-site fitness center
  • A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption
  • Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

The Role

The Director of AI Platforms and Shared Services leads the strategy, system architecture, and hands-on delivery of internal products that enable AI product engineering teams to build and operate AI applications and agents for business stakeholders. This leader treats internal engineering teams as customers, translating shared needs into reliable, reusable, self-service capabilities that simplify development and accelerate the path to production.

The role owns the technical vision and delivery roadmap for agent platforms, including agent runtimes and orchestration, tool and enterprise system integration, memory and context management, and agent evaluation and observability. Supporting shared services include inference, model deployment pipelines, feature stores, and enterprise embedding services backed by vector databases. Together, these capabilities support the lifecycle of agents and models, including versioning, validation, deployment, monitoring, and model registration and explainability. System design is central to the position: defining service boundaries, APIs, data flows, permissions, and deployment patterns while making practical tradeoffs across scalability, latency, reliability, security, and cost. The director brings experience owning and evolving end-to-end systems and uses that perspective to address product team needs while partnering closely with Platform and Infrastructure teams to meet enterprise requirements.

This is a player-coach role that combines team leadership with direct technical contribution. The director leads from the front, remaining actively involved in architecture, prototyping, Python development, design and code reviews, and solving difficult production problems across AWS and GCP. They build and develop a strong engineering team, establish sound engineering practices, and stay accountable for shared services from initial design through production operations and ongoing evolution. Success is measured by the usefulness and reliability of the internal products, reduced duplication across teams, and how easily engineers can move AI applications, agents, and models from experimentation into production.

Qualifications

Experience Required:

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience spanning AI engineering, machine learning engineering, or cloud platform engineering, including significant ownership of production systems.
  • 3+ years leading engineering teams, with continued hands-on involvement in architecture, development, and technical problem solving.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, delivering, operating, and evolving end-to-end platforms or shared services used by multiple engineering teams.
  • Experience building production agent or AI systems, including evaluation, deployment, observability, and integration with enterprise systems.
  • Experience partnering with Platform, Infrastructure, Security, and product engineering teams to balance product needs with enterprise requirements.
  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong system design skills, including distributed systems, service boundaries, application programming interfaces, design patterns, and tradeoffs across reliability, performance, security, and cost.
  • Strong Python development skills and experience building reusable libraries, services, and developer tools.
  • Experience with agent runtimes and orchestration, tool integration, memory and context management, retrieval, evaluation, and observability.
  • Experience with shared AI infrastructure, including inference services, embedding services, vector databases, and model deployment pipelines.
  • Understanding of AI and machine learning fundamentals and lifecycle capabilities, including registration, versioning, validation, deployment, monitoring, and explainability.
  • Experience with AWS and GCP, including deep production expertise in at least one.
  • Experience with Docker, container orchestration, infrastructure as code, automated testing, and continuous integration and continuous delivery.
  • Experience with agent interoperability protocols, feature stores, experimentation platforms, recommender systems, or forecasting systems preferred.

The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all-encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary.

We welcome you:

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.

The salary range for this position is $176,300 - $235,000

The final pay rate/salary offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level and other qualifications for the role, as well as the location of the performance of work. Pay for the successful candidate will meet local requirements, including the local minimum wage rate.
