job.job_description:
This role will execute franchise sales and business development strategies for assigned territory to achieve sales and development quotas. Expand and maintain the distribution of assigned brand portfolio. Lead key stakeholders in the deal process to prospect, qualify, structure, negotiate and close franchise deals. Demonstrate behavioral proficiencies as defined in the Developers Competency and Skill Matrix to include Business Development Expertise, Organizing, Market Knowledge, Technical Skills and Managing Relationships.

Your day to day

  • Effectively execute a regional development plan for assigned brands that promotes the maximization of each brand’s distribution within the territory, drives earnings and fee income, and promotes the growth of shareholder value. Attain annual territory growth quotas as developed by management. Utilize proven strategies to aggressively improve results that fall below plan.
  • Prospect, negotiate, and/or close specialized franchise sales deals in assigned geographical territories and target markets. Utilize knowledge of all major owners, developers and decision makers in assigned territory. Continuously research developments in related industries (e.g. office, retail, etc) to recognize emerging markets and opportunities.
  • Provide leads for potential joint ventures and management contracts. Use a wide variety of resources to research territory and identify qualified prospects.
  • Coordinate application/licensing process with Franchise Administration to ensure proper licensing agreements on franchised hotels. Monitor financial and administrative parameters surrounding franchise agreements as necessary.
  • Within assigned territory, assist in developing short and long-term franchise acquisition and disposition strategies/identifying targets that are consistent with brand growth, profitability and strategic objectives. Prepare and maintain annual business plans that align with development activities and timetables.
  • Call on investment groups, financial institutions, insurance companies, asset managers, individual investors, etc. to develop a network of contacts, build customer relationships that yield deal leads, and keep abreast of hotel development opportunities in the assigned marketplace.
  • Participate in the evaluation of financial opportunities of prospective applicants to determine viability of prospect. Use the P&Ls of hotels in the market, average costs of development, etc. to determine the strength of the market to support deals. Research and utilize interest rates, financing options, operating costs, and other data required to pencil out and drive deals.
  • Manage deals through closing to ensure coordination of all financial and legal documentation and the resolution of issues as they pertain to contractual agreements prior to hotel opening; and follow the completion and implementation of deal and hand-off to VP of Asset Management/Owner Relations and/or Operations as appropriate.

What We Need From You

  • Demonstrated project management experience in organizing, planning and executing large-scale financial and sales projects from conception through implementation.
  • Demonstrated effective verbal and written communication skills for the purpose of providing information to clients, vendors, senior management and staff. Gets clients involved and engaged by asking questions, consistently relating to client’s goals, and building the value of the opportunity.
  • Demonstrated business/financial negotiation and influencing/consensus building skills
  • Demonstrated ability to understand financial structures and deal valuation concepts
  • Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of effective sales and marketing strategies such as client prospecting and cultivation, new product evaluation, brand positioning and strategic fit
  • Demonstrated experience in franchise contract negotiation from prospecting investors to closing the deal.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of the hotel operations market, competitive market trends and factors, and financial feasibility analysis.

Travel - 40-60% required

Location - This role can be based in any major metropolitan city in Texas as a remote based role.

Development Incentive Plan

Commissions are paid monthly. This component of your plan is uncapped. You will be eligible for monthly payments under this component of the Development Incentive Plan after the management agreements or franchise agreements for the projects that have been executed.

job.job_description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team Mission

We're looking for a driven, resilient and results-oriented Account Executive to strengthen our expert Sales Team in San Francisco. This is a high-energy, sales role: you'll bring new tour, activity and attraction operators onto GetYourGuide's platform, and act as the local expert on how that market is responding to our growth initiatives. You will focus on building and managing a high-performing sales pipeline, negotiating optimal terms, and driving supplier acquisition across the US & Canada, directly impacting millions of travellers while advancing GetYourGuide's position in the experience industry.

Your Mission

  • Target, identify, and onboard new suppliers, primarily tour and experience providers as well as attractions
  • Present in-person and online demos of GetYourGuide's products
  • Educate operators on trends shaping the industry and give them insight on how to adapt, encouraging them to think differently about their business
  • Effectively manage the entire sales funnel, including outreach, negotiation, closing and onboarding, to consistently hit and exceed quota
  • Collaborate with internal teams to align supplier acquisition with broader business goals, ensuring sustainable growth
  • Represent GetYourGuide at relevant industry events to drive acquisition and build credibility
  • Listen closely to what operators want and feed that insight back to senior management
  • Regularly travel (up to 25%) to build strong relationships with suppliers in destination and create long-term partnerships

Your Toolkit

  • 2+ years of outbound B2B sales experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota, (technology or travel industry sales a plus)
  • Competitive, tenacious and results driven, with the resilience to thrive under pressure and against ambitious goals
  • You excel at handling objections, reframing conversations with insights, and creating constructive tension to close challenging deals.
  • You bring strong problem-solving skills, using data to prioritize actions and inform decisions.
  • Fluent level English, with strong communication, presentation & negotiation skills, able to articulate value clearly across diverse audiences
  • Knowledgeable about the travel industry, able to use that expertise to talk credibly with Tour operators & Attractions
  • Analytical and data-driven, with the ability to assess opportunities, read prospective buyers and use data to prioritise and persuade
  • Confident using CRM (Salesforce) and sales enablement tools, to Collaborative by nature, sharing best practices with peers and helping lift the wider team
  • Willing to work from the office on Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday

How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary

  • 10 Paid Sick Days Per Year
  • 20 Vacation Days Per Year
  • 40 Telecomuting Days
  • 16 weeks 100% paid parental leave for the birth of your child
  • Marriage Leave - 3 days
  • 401k Plan - a retirement plan (after 6 month employment), GYG offer company contribution match of up to 3.5%, 100% vested
  • Healthcare - medical, dental and vision options
    • Medical by Anthem: BlueCross BlueShield with 3 plans-Platinum PPO, Gold PPO, and Silver PPO + HSA.
    • Option for FSA (Flexible Spending Accounts), HSA (Health Savings Accounts)
    • Sunlife Dental & Vision
    • Others: Basic Life Insurance (no charge), Short Term Disability Insurance (no charge), Voluntary Life Insurance, Voluntary Long Term Disability Insurance, Voluntary Accident Insurance, Voluntary Specified Disease Insurance, TotalPet, InfoArmor

  • Family and Friends Discount
  • Learning Budget - 1,000 Euro per year
  • Maven Family Planning
  • Transportation reimbursement benefit: SF $104 per month
  • Lunch Provided in office twice a week
  • Snacks in office
And more…

Salary

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As an Assistant Director of Sales, you’re not just supporting the hotel’s sales strategy – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:

  • Drive sales within a key market segment: Manage a designated vertical market, applying expert sales skills to qualify leads, conduct outreach, deliver compelling proposals, and close business to meet revenue goals
  • Support strategic sales planning: Contribute to the hotel’s annual commercial strategy, aligning sales activities with business objectives, and collaborating with the broader commercial team to optimize performance
  • Execute targeted sales initiatives: Represent the hotel at tradeshows, client events, and sales calls; maintain a robust pipeline and develop plans to secure short- and long-term business
  • Enhance customer engagement: Build strong relationships with clients, Hilton Worldwide Sales, Convention and Visitors Bureaus, and intermediaries; lead site inspections and ensure personalized, value-driven client experiences
  • Support sales performance and processes: Align day-to-day team activities with strategic goals by reinforcing business processes that drive revenue across Rooms, Catering, and Events
  • Track performance and market trends: Monitor business metrics, analyze the competitive landscape, and adjust tactics to meet evolving customer needs and market dynamics
  • Inspire and develop the team: Recruit, train, supervise, and mentor team members; conduct performance evaluations, provide professional development opportunities, and recognize achievements to build, engage and retain an engaged and high performing team

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

Job Description

The successful candidate will join the Business Technology Department within the Finance Division. You will act as the Product Owner for Finance Systems, partnering closely with Finance business users, IT Division, and vendors to plan, design, and implement Finance digital initiatives. The role requires a strong understanding of finance processes and how these functions are performed in SAP Financial Accounting (FI) and Controlling (CO) modules.

Key Responsibilities

Own and drive the product roadmap for Finance systems, ensuring alignment between Finance process needs and system capabilities.

Collaborate with functional teams to identify, define, and document business needs, user requirements, and system enhancements.

Lead business process reviews and formulate use cases with business users.

Manage the end-to-end delivery for new projects and enhancements, including:

  • Requirements gathering, functional design, and solution validation.
  • Collaboration with internal/external stakeholders for smooth delivery and achievement of business KPIs.
  • Conducting User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and ensuring business requirements are met.
  • Driving change management, communications, and post-implementation reviews.

Provide Operational Support For Finance Systems

  • Guide users on system usage, authorisation, and administration.
  • Manage incident resolution and periodic system tasks.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and automation.
  • Support audits and compliance reviews of Finance IT applications.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Computer Science, Business IT, or a related discipline.
  • At least 3 years of experience in Finance, Business Technology, or ERP system implementation.
  • Prior hands-on experience with SAP S4 HANA FI & CO modules and strong understanding of core Finance processes (e.g. General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cost Center Accounting, Internal Orders).
  • Mid-career professionals with finance background transitioning into digital or product ownership roles are strongly preferred.
  • Experience in Agile delivery and stakeholder management is an advantage.
  • Exposure to tools such as SharePoint and Tableau will be beneficial.
  • Self-starter with strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Proven project management skills
  • Ability to work independently, prioritise effectively, and manage multiple initiatives concurrently.

The end date of this position is in December 2027.

We thank all candidates for your interest in Singapore Airlines, and regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

job.job_description:
Senior Manager, Incentives Strategy and Operations | Viator

About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

We are looking for an analytically rigorous, commercially minded, and execution-oriented leader to help shape and scale Tripadvisor’s incentives and loyalty portfolio.

This role will own the strategic and operational governance for how we evaluate, prioritize, and scale incentives across the business. The ideal candidate will be comfortable working across Finance, Product, Data, CRM, Regional, and Marketing teams to turn complex program economics into clear recommendations, scalable processes, and better business decisions.

You will play a critical role in helping the business answer some of its most important growth and profitability questions: Which incentives are truly incremental? Which audiences should we invest in? How do we balance conversion, customer value, margin, and cost discipline? And how do we build the operating model required to scale incentives responsibly across markets, channels, and customer segments?

This is a high-impact role for someone who can build structure from ambiguity, influence stakeholders without direct authority, and translate analysis into strategy, governance, and action. While execution teams will support campaign delivery, this role will be responsible for setting the strategic direction, operating cadence, measurement standards, and investment discipline that enable the incentives portfolio to scale effectively.

Job Location: Hybrid

This role is a hybrid position that requires 2-3 days per week in our London office.

What You’ll Do

Shape the strategy and governance model for incentives and loyalty:

  • Develop the strategic framework for how Tripadvisor evaluates, prioritizes, and scales incentive and loyalty initiatives across the business.
  • Define the principles and guardrails for when, where, and how incentives should be used, balancing growth, profitability, customer experience, and operational complexity.
  • Partner with CRM, Product, Regional, Marketing, Data, and Finance teams to ensure incentive initiatives are aligned to broader business priorities.
  • Help move the business from isolated campaigns and tests toward a more structured, scalable, and financially disciplined incentives portfolio.
  • Establish clear operating rhythms for reviewing performance, making investment decisions, and prioritizing future opportunities.

Build The Financial And Analytical Backbone For Incentives Performance

  • Own the framework for evaluating incentive and loyalty program performance, including redemption, incremental bookings, revenue impact, margin impact, customer lifetime value, cost-to-serve, and ROI.
  • Partner closely with Finance to build and maintain reliable P&L reporting infrastructure for incentives and loyalty, including spend tracking, forecasting, cost visibility, and program-level economics.
  • Support the department lead and Finance partners with the inputs needed for budget planning, investment trade-off discussions, and performance reviews.
  • Establish reporting cadences, approval processes, and investment guardrails so incentive spend remains transparent, disciplined, and aligned to business objectives.
  • Ensure leadership has a clear, trusted, and consistent view of incentive performance across programs, markets, channels, and customer segments.

Turn Insights Into Roadmap And Investment Decisions

  • Lead recurring and ad hoc deep dives into program performance, customer segments, test results, cost drivers, and behavioral trends to identify what is working, what is not, and where the business should invest next.
  • Translate complex analysis into clear strategic recommendations, business cases, and executive-ready narratives.
  • Partner with Product, Data, CRM, Regional, and Marketing teams to shape the incentives roadmap, ensuring initiatives are prioritized based on expected impact, cost, feasibility, and strategic fit.
  • Identify opportunities to improve incentive effectiveness through better targeting, program design, customer segmentation, channel coordination, and measurement.
  • Help leadership understand trade-offs across short-term conversion, long-term customer value, margin impact, operational complexity, and strategic growth.

Build Scalable Operating Processes For Cross-functional Execution

  • Design and improve the operating processes required to propose, approve, launch, measure, and review incentive initiatives.
  • Create clear standards for how incentive programs are evaluated before launch and assessed after execution.
  • Partner with execution teams to ensure campaign delivery is supported by strong strategic rationale, clear measurement plans, and appropriate financial guardrails.
  • Help build a scalable test-and-learn discipline for incentives, enabling the business to move quickly while maintaining measurement rigor and financial accountability.
  • Identify operational gaps, process inefficiencies, and areas of ambiguity that could limit the business’s ability to scale incentives effectively.

Champion Incentive Economics Across The Business

  • Serve as a key thought partner to Finance, Product, Data, CRM, Regional, and Marketing teams on how incentive investment translates into customer and business value.
  • Own the metrics, narrative, and recommendations that feed into recurring business reviews and leadership updates on incentives and loyalty.
  • Bring a structured, analytical perspective to strategic discussions, ensuring decisions are grounded in evidence rather than intuition or isolated campaign results.
  • Act as a connective tissue across teams, ensuring incentives are managed as a disciplined business portfolio rather than a set of disconnected campaigns.

What Success Looks Like

A successful candidate will help the business build a more structured, scalable, and financially disciplined approach to incentives and loyalty.

In This Role, Success Means

  • Leadership has a clear and trusted view of incentive performance, spend, ROI, and business impact.
  • Finance and business teams are aligned on how incentive economics are measured, reported, and forecasted.
  • Incentive investment decisions are grounded in clear evidence, consistent measurement, and well-defined business trade-offs.
  • Cross-functional teams have a repeatable operating model for proposing, launching, measuring, and scaling incentives.
  • The incentives roadmap reflects the highest-value opportunities across customer segments, channels, markets, and product surfaces.
  • Execution teams are supported by clear strategic direction, operating processes, and measurement standards.
  • The business can scale incentives with greater speed, confidence, and financial control.
  • Incentives become a more disciplined growth lever that supports both customer acquisition and long-term customer value.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to improve efficiency, quality, and decision-making in day-to-day work.
  • Proven ability to operate effectively with a global-first mindset
  • 7+ years of experience in growth strategy, business operations, commercial strategy, go-to-market strategy, incentives, loyalty, pricing, performance marketing, financial planning and analysis, or management consulting.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, with experience building or interpreting P&L models, ROI frameworks, forecasts, business cases, or investment recommendations.
  • Excellent analytical skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems, interpret complex data, and translate insights into clear business decisions.
  • Experience partnering with Finance, Data/Analytics, Product, Marketing, CRM, Regional, or Operations teams to build shared infrastructure and drive cross-functional alignment.
  • Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to build crisp strategy documents, business reviews, and decision-ready presentations.
  • Proven ability to influence without direct authority and drive progress across teams with different priorities, incentives, and levels of context.
  • Strong ownership mindset, attention to detail, and comfort operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.
  • A structured problem-solving approach, with a bias toward action and a high bar for analytical rigor.

Nice To Have Skills

  • Experience in management consulting, business operations, growth strategy, go-to-market strategy, or commercial strategy roles.
  • Experience working on loyalty, promotions, incentives, pricing, marketplace growth, customer lifecycle, or monetization programs.
  • Experience with experimentation, incrementality measurement, customer segmentation, or lifetime value analysis.
  • Familiarity with BI tools, SQL, dashboards, or analytics workflows.
  • Experience building operating rhythms, governance processes, or scalable cross-functional planning mechanisms.
  • Experience working in travel, marketplaces, e-commerce, consumer technology, or membership-based businesses.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

job.job_description:
We're looking for a strategic leader to shape the future of TUI Airline's network – someone who can balance commercial ambition with operational reality, and turn data into decisions that drive profitable growth across our global operations.

The role will be published until 28/10.

This role can be based in Luton (UK), Ostend (BE), or Hannover (DE).

About Our Offer

  • Personal benefits: Attractive remuneration, discretionary bonus schemes, generous travel benefits, extensive health & well-being support, and more.
  • Flexible working: Work is something you do, not somewhere you go. We encourage a healthy work-life balance with a dynamic working environment.
  • A career to shape: Access the TUI Learning Hub to level-up and reach your ambitions.
  • Broaden your network: We champion intercultural collaboration and provide opportunities to work on global projects and teams.
  • Community: Get involved with incredible local charity and sustainability initiatives like the TUI Care Foundation.

About The Job

  • You'll define and maintain our short and long-term network plan, ensuring it reflects seasonal demand patterns, customer requirements, and TUI Group priorities across all regions.
  • Leading the identification of new route opportunities and market entries is key – you'll prioritise where we fly next and how we deploy our aircraft to maximise both customer satisfaction and profitability.
  • As the commercial lead for fleet planning, you'll translate network ambitions into aircraft capacity requirements, working closely with Fleet, Finance, Operations and Strategy teams to ensure our fleet evolves to support growth.
  • Collaboration is at the heart of this role – you'll work hand-in-hand with B2B Sales, Regional Commercial teams, and Capacity Planning to ensure our network reflects real customer needs and market opportunities.
  • You'll develop structured, insight-driven route proposals including financial modelling, revenue forecasts, and ROI analysis, while maintaining the tools and methodologies that make our route evaluation best-in-class.
  • Building a high-performing team is essential – you'll lead, inspire and develop network analysts and planners, fostering a culture of excellence, curiosity and commercial rigour.

About You

  • You bring proven experience in leading airline network strategy, route profitability assessment, and capacity planning within a multi-market or multi-AOC airline environment.
  • Your strong understanding of airline economics, business case modelling, and strategic planning processes means you can navigate the complexity of a highly competitive and regulated industry.
  • Advanced skills in financial analysis are second nature to you – from business case development to scenario modelling, you know how to build compelling arguments for network decisions.
  • You're comfortable aligning network strategy with fleet planning, understanding how aircraft deployment and future capacity requirements connect to market development needs.
  • Demonstrated ability to incorporate customer needs and B2B feedback into network design shows you understand that great planning starts with listening to the people we serve.
  • You've got a track record of leading high-performing teams in fast-paced, cross-market environments, and you know how to build, coach and develop planning professionals who deliver results.

From a workplace to a place to belong. At TUI we embrace diversity, equity, and inclusion, encouraging everyone to come as you are, because together, our potential is limitless.

We are committed to supporting candidates with disabilities and impairments so if you require any support, please do let us know.

SECURITY STATEMENT

Safety and security are top priorities for us, so all job offers require successful completion of security checks before you can start. The specific requirements, timelines, and processes vary by country and may include professional references, criminal record checks for countries where you’ve recently lived, and any additional documentation required by local regulations, some of which may involve a cost depending on your location. We’ll guide you through every step of the process. Your official start date will only be confirmed once all required checks have been completed and cleared.

Job Title

AI Strategic Partnerships & Business Development Manager

About The AI Delivery Hub

The AI Delivery Hub supports Amadeus’ transformation into an AI-first organization. Its multidisciplinary teams design, build, and deliver AI solutions from concept through implementation. Working with product and platform teams across business lines, the Hub helps scale proven approaches into reusable capabilities and practical product outcomes.

About The AI Assistant Team

As part of the AI Assistant team, you will join a product incubation group that designs, validates, and scales AI-native solutions for how travelers plan, book, and manage trips through emerging AI interfaces.

About The Commercial & Strategy Team

The Commercial & Strategy team manages relationships with AI assistant partners. We identify opportunities, understand what creates value for customers and travelers, and develop commercial frameworks that support sustainable revenue. We connect Amadeus’ capabilities with market needs and share insights that help guide product priorities.

Summary Of The Role

In this role, you will serve as a strategic link between Amadeus and AI assistant partners, such as Gemini and ChatGPT.

You will combine relationship management with knowledge of Amadeus’ product portfolio, leading consultative discovery sessions that balance listening, problem-solving, and commercial awareness.

You will translate partner needs into relevant Amadeus solutions, shape opportunities collaboratively, and help move promising conversations toward clear commercial outcomes.

In This Role, You Will

  • Develop and maintain relationships with AI assistant partners, from initial engagement through ongoing collaboration.
  • Lead consultative discovery conversations to understand partner needs and identify suitable solutions.
  • Build knowledge of Amadeus’ portfolio across content, booking, orchestration, post-booking, payments, and infrastructure.
  • Identify and develop business opportunities in partnership with internal teams.
  • Create account development plans and commercial strategies.
  • Prepare commercial proposals and align them with relevant stakeholders.
  • Support the negotiation of complex agreements.
  • Share structured market insights, including partner priorities, decision-making criteria, and the role of travel in their strategy.
  • Map partner stakeholders and identify key decision-makers and advocates.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Product Marketing, and Engineering teams.
  • Contribute to learning sessions and share relevant insights across teams.
  • Explore effective ways of working in an AI-first environment and share learnings with the wider Amadeus community.

About The Ideal Candidate

  • Relevant experience in strategic partnerships, business development, consultative selling, solutions consulting, enterprise sales, account management, or a related area.
  • Experience in travel technology, SaaS, platform businesses, or another relevant technology environment is helpful; transferable experience from related sectors is also welcome.
  • Strong relationship-building, customer discovery, solution-framing, and stakeholder-mapping skills.
  • The ability to gather, organize, and clearly communicate market and customer insights.
  • Commercial judgment and the ability to learn Amadeus’ capabilities and connect them with customer needs.
  • Comfort working in an evolving, cross-functional environment.
  • Curiosity about AI technologies and the ability to understand core concepts related to AI assistants, large language models, agentic experiences, and AI-enabled travel use cases.
  • A university degree in business, technology, economics, engineering, or a related field is beneficial; equivalent professional experience is equally valued.

Working At Amadeus, You Will Find

🎯 A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you will be powering the future of travel and pursuing a critical mission and extraordinary purpose.

🌎 A truly global DNA - Everything at Amadeus is global, from our people to our business, which translates into our footprint, processes, and culture.

🎓 Great opportunities to learn - Learning happens all the time and in many ways at Amadeus, through on-the-job training, formal learning activities, and day-to-day interactions with colleagues.

🤗 A caring environment - Amadeus fosters a caring environment, nurturing both a fulfilling career and personal and family life. We care about our employees and strive to provide a supportive work environment.

💰 A complete rewards offer - Amadeus provides attractive remuneration packages, covering all essential components of a competitive reward offer, including salary, bonus, equity, and benefits.

🌟 A flexible working model - We want our employees to do their best work, wherever and however it works best for them.

🌈 A diverse and inclusive community - We are committed to leveraging our uniquely diverse population to drive innovation, creativity, and collaboration across our organization.

📈 A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental values that drive our actions and shape long-lasting relationships with our customers, partners, and employees.

What We Can Offer You

  • Get rewarded with competitive remuneration, individual and company annual bonus, vacation and holiday paid time off, health insurances and other competitive benefits.
  • Work a flexible hybrid schedule.
  • Professional development to broaden your knowledge and enhance your skills with on-line learning hubs packed with technical and soft skills training that allow you to develop and grow.
  • Enter a diverse and inclusive workplace, join one of the world’s top travel technology companies and take on a role that impacts millions of travelers around the globe

The application process takes no longer than 10 minutes!

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

This role is based in Bangkok, Thailand, and is open to candidates worldwide. We offer a generous relocation package to ensure a smooth transition to living and working in Bangkok.

Get to Know Our Team:

The Performance Marketing Team of Agoda is a world leader in online marketing. We are highly data-driven and focused on developing at-scale marketing programs that improve the lifetime value of our customers.

Our team is a blend of the bright analysts, marketing strategists, and data scientists in the world. We foster a great learning environment where you will be able to learn and grow by working closely with experts from a variety of backgrounds from all over the world.

With Performance Marketing, MSE is a business development and marketing role within Agoda’s marketing department. It involves working with online vertical search advertisers (Meta Search Engines) to drive hotel booking sales.

In this role, you'll get to:

  • Own and manage marketing spend with large Meta Search Engine (MSE) partners
  • Independently manage your accounts
  • Manage the commercial relationship with MSE partners, including commercial terms, bidding and pricing strategies, and technical implementation
  • Decide in coordination with the Bidding and Pricing teams strategies that deliver expected ROIs and revenue growth
  • Track detailed performance/KPIs and deliver regular data-driven actionable insights to improve results
  • Succinctly communicate the results, ideas, and business statistics with different stakeholders
  • Ensure the advertiser implements the right Agoda APIs and related technological innovations
  • Be immersed and intimately familiar with the entire booking funnel including the user experience and conversion drivers between the advertiser and Agoda
  • Build long term relationships with advertisers that foster new opportunities and continuous growth in return from advertising dollars

What you’ll need to succeed:

  • Bachelor Degree in Computer Science/Statistics/Math or Engineering or Economics and Finance
  • Business development and/or account management track record with experience in online marketing
  • Fluent in English with strong communication skills (both written and verbal)
  • Self-motivated person with “Get it done!” attitude
  • Passionately analytical with strong ability to think logically and excellent problem-solving skills
  • Proficient in business intelligence tools and data warehouse i.e. SQL, Tableau and MS Excel
  • Ability to effectively communicate, influence and persuade with different levels of stakeholders (including Senior Management) with proven strong commercial acumen
  • Ability to represent Agoda with experience in interacting with external senior level executives
  • Strong analytical and statistical analysis skills to extract insights and recommendations

job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

Leads museum functions and teams to deliver operational excellence, safety, and an exceptional experience for guests, partners, and internal stakeholders. Responsible for translating organizational strategy into actionable plans, overseeing staffing and budgets, ensuring regulatory and policy compliance, and driving continuous improvement aligned with Delta Professional Services standards and Delta brand values. Serves as a key leader in the day‑to‑day and strategic success of the Delta Flight Museum.

Key Responsibilities

Operational Leadership

  • Oversee daily operations for assigned museum functions, including staffing, schedules, work assignments, floor/event coverage, and service levels.
  • Manage operational readiness for museum facilities, exhibits, event spaces, surplus sales areas, and volunteer activities.
  • Ensure all museum environments and supporting activities meet safety, cleanliness, accessibility, and guest experience standards.

People Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop team members through regular feedback, performance management, recognition, and skills development.
  • Support hiring, onboarding, scheduling, and workforce planning for maintenance staff, event services teams, or volunteer groups.
  • Foster an inclusive, safety focused, service minded culture.

Compliance, Safety & Risk Management

  • Own SOPs, operational policies, and risk management protocols across assigned functional areas.
  • Conduct safety drills, inspections, incident reporting, and compliance audits.
  • Ensure regulatory adherence related to facilities, events, volunteer programs, and museum operations.

Financial & Resource Management

  • Manage labor, supplies, contracts, and project budgets; track and report variances.
  • Review expenditures and resource needs aligned with operational priorities and museum initiatives.

Event, Project & Program Execution

  • Oversee execution of museum events, rentals, surplus sales activities, maintenance programs, and volunteer engagements.
  • Direct project scope development, timelines, vendor coordination, and post project evaluations.

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Senior Product Manager, Air Shopping Platform

Introduction To The Team

Expedia Group’s Air Platform helps travelers find and book the right flights across our brands and shopping surfaces. We build the capabilities, metrics, and evaluation systems that help Search, Recommendations, ML, and Engineering teams understand whether flight ranking and recommendations are relevant and effective for travelers, suppliers, and the business—and where to focus the next improvement

Our work spans search quality, recommendation experiences, airline content, marketplace economics, and high-scale systems. We partner with Ranking and Personalization ML Science, ML Engineering, Search Engineering, Analytics, Marketing, Finance, and Airline Supply to improve how flight offers are retrieved, ranked, and presented. We also support Expedia’s presence across metasearch and demand-generation channels, including Google Flights, Skyscanner, Kayak, and other strategic traffic sources.

As Senior Product Manager, you will own product quality and relevance measurement across Air Search surfaces and recommendations. You will turn ambiguous questions about relevance, ranking, and engagement into clear metrics, credible evaluations, and roadmap decisions. Your work will shape how travelers experience search results and recommendations across Expedia Group brands—and how confidently teams can ship ranking and personalization changes.

In This Role, You Will

  • Own the product vision and roadmap for flight search and recommendation quality measurement, translating target outcomes and KPIs—such as relevance, ranking quality, recommendation engagement, and search-to-booking success—into measurable delivery milestones.
  • Define and own product metrics for search relevance and recommendation quality. Establish clear success measures, review them regularly, and hold the roadmap accountable to outcomes across both surfaces.
  • Partner with Ranking and Personalization ML Science, ML Engineering, and Search Engineering to define and evaluate ranking and recommendation model quality, and to make informed trade-offs on proposed model changes.
  • Set up and scale the search relevance evaluation system, including a curated query corpus, human relevance annotations, and LLM-as-judge scoring. Report results through the broader Search Health program and extend evaluation methods to recommendation surfaces such as destination recommendations, cross-sell, and rebooking.
  • Connect offline model-quality metrics with online indicators to assess changes and guide prioritization.
  • Lead competitive benchmarking of flight search relevance and recommendations. Translate findings into a prioritized set of product, ranking, and personalization investments.
  • Use customer insights, experimentation, and performance data to identify opportunities, validate hypotheses, and measure the traveler and business impact of changes.
  • Partner with Airline Supply, marketplace, and platform teams to improve offer visibility, content quality, pricing competitiveness, and shopping performance.
  • Shape how Expedia flight offers are surfaced across metasearch platforms, search engines, and other high-scale acquisition channels, balancing relevance and customer experience with traffic economics and business performance.
  • Work with Engineering on search architecture, content retrieval, caching, latency, content freshness, connectivity, and system scalability. Evaluate trade-offs among coverage, search costs, performance, and traveler experience.
  • Align cross-functional stakeholders on priorities, success metrics, and execution across complex dependencies; maintain delivery momentum as needs and evidence evolve.
  • Shape the long-term Air Search and Recommendations vision and contribute to an 18-month roadmap for Expedia Group’s air-commerce strategy.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of relevant professional experience in product management with a bachelor’s degree, 6+ years with a master’s degree, or equivalent related professional experience.
  • Strong technical aptitude and the ability to engage deeply on search and recommendation systems, platform architecture, APIs, scalability, and performance trade-offs.
  • Proven experience partnering closely with Engineering and technical teams to deliver complex products and measurable business outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability to define product metrics, use data and experimentation, and apply analytical thinking to inform strategy and prioritization.
  • Strong stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence and drive alignment without direct authority.
  • Exceptional ownership, bias for action, curiosity, and ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in search, recommendations, ranking, personalization, relevance measurement, or online experimentation for consumer products.
  • Familiarity with evaluating search or recommendation quality using offline metrics (for example, NDCG@10), online proxies, human relevance judgments, or LLM-assisted evaluation.
  • Experience with airline shopping, travel technology, flight distribution, metasearch, online travel marketplaces, or ecommerce.
  • Understanding of airline economics, supplier connectivity models, fare content, distribution costs, and marketplace dynamics.
  • Experience with large-scale consumer products, high-volume search systems, pricing platforms, or transactional marketplaces.
  • Understanding of traffic acquisition, performance marketing, and customer acquisition economics.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate complex business and technical trade-offs and influence technical strategy with senior Engineering and cross-functional leaders.

The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $173,000.00 to $242,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $277,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

job.job_description:
Change the way the world travels

GetYourGuide is the globally leading marketplace for unforgettable travel experiences. Travelers use GetYourGuide to discover the best things to do in a destination. Since its founding in 2009, people from all over the world have booked more than 150 million tours, activities, and attraction tickets through GetYourGuide. Powered by a global team of over 1000 travel experts and technologists, we are headquartered in Berlin and have 17 local offices around the world. Visit our careers website to learn more.

Team mission

GetYourGuide knows a great deal about every traveler, and almost none of it is usable today. Identity, booking history, browsing behavior, care conversations, preferences and predictions sit in separate systems, in different shapes, so every team that wants to act on what we know rebuilds its own partial version of it. The User Platform team is building the traveler context layer: resolving who someone is across devices and sessions, and turning scattered signals into a shared, interpretable and predictive understanding that every team can build on. We start with travelers, because that is where the leverage is, and the layer is designed to extend to our other users over time.

Your mission

As a Lead Product Manager, you will own the vision and strategy for a new platform at GetYourGuide, and you will be the first product manager on the team that builds it. Working with an Engineering Manager, engineers, an embedded data scientist and an analyst, you will define what the traveler context layer holds, how it is served, and which problems it solves first. This is a genuine zero to one: the identity model, the semantic memory that both humans and LLMs can read, the forward-looking predictions on top of it, and the self-serve interfaces that make it usable are all still to be designed.

The work is equal parts product craft and demand creation. Our consumers are other teams: search and ranking, lifecycle and paid channels, customer care, and the traveler experience itself. Their need is real and widely felt, but they struggle to define what would really solve their problems.

We are looking for a product leader who is fluent in data and machine learning without needing to be a data scientist, who is comfortable when the scope of a domain is still being drawn, and who wants to build the foundation that personalization at GetYourGuide will run on for years.

What You'll Do

  • Ownership: Develop and own a 12+ month vision and strategy for the traveler context domain, define how we win in it, and take full responsibility for the outcomes. Identify where the non-incremental impact sits and sequence the roadmap to reach it.
  • Ambiguity: Operate in a domain that is being defined as you build it. Break an open-ended platform problem into a phased, coherent plan, and make confident calls with incomplete information.
  • Prioritization: Choose the few use cases that prove the platform, and be explicit about what we will not build. Balance the depth a single consumer wants against the breadth the platform needs, and sequence to maximise learning.
  • Collaboration: Build trust with consuming teams across Growth, Retention, Search, Care and Supply, and negotiate the line between what we own and what they own. Proactively manage the dependencies and handoffs that keep the strategy executable.
  • Communication and adoption: Make the platform legible to the rest of the company, from engineers to executives. Create demand where none exists yet by showing teams what becomes possible, then convert that into committed adoption.
  • Technical fluency: Set the technical bar for the team and work credibly with data scientists and engineers on identity resolution, feature and embedding design, and serving architecture. Bring a clear point of view on when a heuristic beats a model, and on build versus buy versus partner.
  • Experimentation: Validate the layer with real consumers and real traffic. Design the tests that show a shared representation outperforms the local copies teams build today.
  • Leadership: Represent the interests of our users and our internal consumers at every level of the organization. Act with openness and transparency with your team, your peers and executive leadership, and coach others on the craft of building platform products

Your toolkit

  • 6+ years of professional experience in product management, including at least 2 years at Lead level or with equivalent scope, and meaningful time spent on data, machine learning or platform products
  • Demonstrated ownership of a product area whose users are other teams, such as an internal platform, an API or a data product, including strategy, KPI definition, goal setting and adoption, not only delivery
  • Strong data literacy: comfortable querying and interpreting large datasets, designing experiments, and working day to day with data scientists and analysts
  • A working understanding of the machine learning lifecycle and how it differs from software delivery, plus the judgment to know when analytics and good heuristics are the better answer
  • A track record of building alignment across a large and varied set of stakeholders, including senior leadership, in a way that is consistent with our Guiding Principles
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Bonus: experience with customer data platforms, identity resolution, segmentation or personalization systems
  • Bonus: experience putting LLMs into production
  • Bonus: experience in a marketplace or another two-sided platform
  • Bonus: an engineering or analytics background

How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary

  • Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
  • Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
  • A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.
  • Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events
  • Monthly transportation and fitness budget
  • Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
  • Language reimbursement program

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Sales Manager, you’re not just generating and managing group sales – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:

  • Generate and convert new business: Research, prospect, and qualify leads through proactive outreach and database mining to drive group sales and exceed lead generation goals
  • Build and maintain client relationships: Serve as the primary contact for assigned market segments, nurturing existing accounts and developing new ones to grow room revenue and overall profitability
  • Develop targeted sales strategies: Analyze hotel and market trends to create and execute business plans and marketing initiatives that capture demand and meet sales goals
  • Lead end-to-end sales process: Prepare proposals, conduct site visits, negotiate terms, and secure contracts tailored to client needs while maximizing revenue
  • Manage booking details: Coordinate customer requirements including room, food and beverage, and meeting space, and ensure accurate and timely entry of account and reservation information in the hotel’s sales management system

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

About The Team

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

Additional Information

Job Number26109762

Job CategoryProperty Leadership

Location19th Floor, Unit 1905-6, Bangkok Bangk 10500, Thailand VIEW ON MAP

ScheduleFull Time

Located Remotely?N

Position Type Management

Hotel Description

The proposed 22-story JW Marriott Hotel Bangkok Ratchadapisek will be part of a mixed-use complex that includes the 25-story Le Concorde office tower and retail spaces. Currently, Marriott International will take over the hotel’s operation under a white-label agreement in 2025, with the reflagging to JW Marriott Hotel Bangkok Ratchadapisek scheduled for Q1 2028. Renovation will take place during the white-label phase and remaining to be fully completed by 2030.

The property is situated in an area recognized for its residential and commercial character. It boasts good accessibility and visibility from Rachadapisek Road, with direct access to Huai Khwang Station along the MRT Blue Line. Conveniently located approximately less than 30 kilometers from Don Mueang Airport and Suvarnabhumi Airports.

Job Summary

Functions as the primary strategic business leader of the property with responsibility for all aspects of the operation, including guest and employee satisfaction, human resources, financial performance, sales and revenue generation and delivering a return on investment to both Marriott International and property ownership. Verifies implementation of service strategy and initiatives with the objective of meeting or exceeding guest expectations, increased profit and market share. Holds property leadership team accountable for strategy execution, and guides their individual professional development. The position verifies that sales engines are leveraged and initiates independent and proactive sales activities, when appropriate, to generate demand. Verifies that the objectives and goals of Marriott and property owners work together to achieve brand positioning and success. Builds owner loyalty through proactive communication, setting and managing expectations and delivering solid business results. The position is actively involved in the local community and builds strong relationships with local officials, businesses, and customers.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

The ideal candidate will have experience working in Thailand or Asia Pacific as a General Manager.

Education And Experience

  • 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 8 years’ experience in the management operations, sales and marketing, finance and accounting, or related professional area.

OR

  • 4-year bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 6 years’ experience in the management operations, sales and marketing, finance and accounting, or related professional area.

JOB SPECIFIC TASKS

Business Strategy Development

Stays current with industry trends and monitors strengths and weakness of competition; explores new business opportunities; develops business plans designed to maximize property customer satisfaction, profitability, and market share; ensures property business plans are aligned with the hotel’s business strategies; translates Marriott global strategic plan into one that can be executed on property.

Business Strategy Execution

Executes business plans designed to maximize property customer satisfaction, profitability, and market share; ensures that property business plans and employees are aligned with business strategies; holds property leadership team accountable for successful delivery of business plans; experiments with new ideas and takes calculated risks to improve guest satisfaction and profitability; evaluates the success of property business strategies to inform future business plan enhancements; continually ensures business plans and actions have a positive impact on property performance.

Sales and Marketing

Works closely with Sales and Marketing team to develop revenue generating strategies for property; identifies new business leads, develops tailored sales approach, and actively pursues leads with Sales and Marketing team; validates that sales and marketing strategy is aligned with brand strategy and is effectively executed against established goals; verifies that property leaders understand and leverage Marriott demand engines to full potential; augments guest preference for property through booking ease and quality interactions with sales force.

Talent Management and Organizational Capability

Creates a cohesive and high-performance Executive Committee that continuously strives for positive results and improvement; coaches Executive Committee by providing specific feedback and holds them accountable for performance; creates learning and development opportunities for employees; creates and effectively executes development plans for both direct reports based on their individual strengths, development needs, and career aspirations; ensures all managers are doing the same for their direct reports; identifies resource needs to strengthen property team; creates succession plans for future job openings; actively supports the staffing process; ensures effective work processes, systems and teamwork are in place to maximize individual and overall property performance.

Business Information Analysis

Reviews business related data such as market share, financial performance, inventory, employee engagement, and customer satisfaction; analyzes business information to proactively address changing market conditions, ensure property operates within budgetary guidelines, and achieves profit margin goals; uses business information to identify indicators of product and service successes and opportunities for improvement; integrates business information into business plans.

Employee and Labor Relations

Verifies that all employees are treated fairly, and with respect; builds rapport with employees by fostering an environment of open communication and spending time with employees on the frontlines; makes self-available to employees (“open door policy”); verifies that pay and benefits are appropriate for labor market; celebrates the success of employees in a public way; works with Human Resources to maximize employee engagement and monitor local labor environment to address issues as needed.

Revenue Management

Works with Revenue Management team to develop effective pricing strategies, balancing seasonality, economy, customer segments, property objectives and customer satisfaction; established revenue strategy that supports the hotel’s positioning in local market; ensures demand forecasting and sound revenue practices are in place to maximize yield; identifies ways to grow occupancy, RevPAR, and market share by researching and staying aware of competitor strategies; controls labor and capital expenses.

Owner Relations

Builds strong rapport with property owners through proactive and on-going communication; keeps owner informed of brand initiatives and guest experiences; provides owners with in-depth analysis of property performance, incorporating guest, financial and employee business data; manages an effective balance between owner interests and Marriott brand interests and develops solutions that create value for both; develops and effectively promotes ideas for improving property service and profitability to ownership.

Customer and Public Relations Management

Interacts with guests and other customers on a frequent basis to obtain feedback about their experiences on property; utilizes guest/customer feedback to recognize outstanding employee service performance and improve service delivery; emphasizes and holds leadership team accountable for addressing service failures or potential service failures, and for developing innovative ways to exceed guest expectations; establishes presence in the market by actively promoting an exemplary property/brand image, involving oneself in the local community, and by developing strategic alliances with local officials, businesses, and customers; anticipates needs of large groups or high profile guests in order to deliver flawless service; verifies that products, services, and events attain the appropriate publicity (“PR buzz”).

Company/Brand Policy, Procedures, And Standards Compliance

Verifies property compliance with legal, safety, operations, labor, and Marriott brand product and service standards; conducts both routine and short-notice quality assurance audits with specific departments; holds employees accountable for performing audits on a regular basis; conducts detailed walk-throughs to ensure building, public areas, kitchen, and grounds are well-maintained, safe, and meet or exceed guest expectations; validates that employees are appropriately trained and performing to standard.

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.  We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Marriott Hotels strive to elevate the art of hospitality, innovating at every opportunity while keeping the comfort of the oh-so-familiar all around the globe. As a host with Marriott Hotels, you will help keep the promise of "Wonderful Hospitality. Always." by delivering thoughtful, heartfelt, forward-thinking service that upholds and builds upon this living legacy. With the name that's synonymous with hospitality the world over, we are proud to welcome you to explore a career with Marriott Hotels. In joining Marriott Hotels, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.

JW Marriott is part of Marriott International's luxury portfolio and consists of more than 100 beautiful properties in gateway cities and distinctive resort locations around the world. JW believes our associates come first. Because if you're happy, our guests will be happy. JW Marriott associates are confident, innovative, genuine, intuitive, and carry on the legacy of the brand's namesake and company founder, J.Willard Marriott. Our hotels offer a work experience unlike any other, where you'll be part of a community and enjoy true camaraderie with a diverse group of co-workers. JW creates opportunities for training, development, recognition and most importantly, a place where you can pursue your passions in a luxury environment with a focus on holistic well-being. Treating guests exceptionally starts with the way we take care of our associates. That's The JW Treatment. In joining JW Marriott, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.

Project Operations Coordinator I Tripadvisor

About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

The CX & AI Operations Coordinator drives operational momentum within Tripadvisor’s Travel Experiences, leveraging AI tools and automation to elevate how we support global travelers. In this role, you will keep key experience initiatives strictly on track, monitor AI-driven support workflows, and deliver clear, actionable updates to leadership. Your core focus will be eliminating friction across the traveler journey—from booking tours and activities to on-the-ground support—ensuring our operations scale seamlessly to keep travelers moving.

Job Location: Hybrid

This role is a hybrid position that requires 2/3 days per week/month in our London office.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive Experience & AI Updates: Lead operational reporting for leadership, translating traveler sentiment, support analytics, and AI bot performance into concise, executive-ready updates.
  • Oversee AI Support Implementations: Track and manage AI-driven projects, including automated traveler triage, AI copilot tools for support agents, and self-service knowledge bases for tours, attractions, and activities.
  • Track Deliverables & Keep Teams on Schedule: Monitor project timelines across Support, Engineering, Product, and Supply teams to ensure traveler-facing initiatives launch on schedule.
  • Optimize the Traveler Journey: Continuously identify operational friction in support ticketing and leverage AI automation to decrease response times for urgent, in-destination traveler inquiries.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Ensure front-line traveler support teams are trained and aligned on new AI processes, maintaining clear standard operating procedures.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 2–4 years in customer operations, CX project management, or travel tech operations.
  • AI & Tech Literacy: Hands-on experience with modern AI-driven customer service platforms (e.g., Zendesk AI, Intercom, Salesforce) and workflow automations.
  • Execution & Accountability: Proven ability to drive cross-functional accountability, clear project bottlenecks, and keep high-stakes deliverables moving.
  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication, with a talent for converting complex operational data into digestible business updates.
  • Traveler Empathy: Passion for travel culture and a deep understanding of traveler pain points before, during, and after their booked experiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience in travel, hospitality, or marketplace platforms (tours, attractions, activities).
  • Experience deploying generative AI features or automated chat resolution systems in a fast-paced global consumer environment.
  • Project management certification (e.g., CAPM, Scrum Master, or PMP coursework).
  • Experience in a fast-paced tech, startup, or rapidly scaling corporate environment.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!
