job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Locations: Austin, Seattle, San Jose, San Francisco, Los Angeles, New York, Chicago

Why This Role Matters

Every traveler comes to Expedia Group with different needs, preferences, and intentions. The opportunity is to create experiences that understand those differences and become more useful with every interaction.

As part of our AI Platforms, Personalization, Memory, and Signal Capture team, you will help define how traveler signals, preferences, behaviors, memory, and feedback come together to power the next generation of personalized travel experiences.

One of our most interesting challenges is what happens when we know very little about a traveler. Many visitors arrive without prior booking history, while the signals we do have can be fragmented, missing, or difficult to translate into experiences travelers understand and trust.

This role sits at the intersection of product design, personalization, AI and machine learning, and systems thinking. You will help turn complex technology and data into intuitive experiences that progressively understand travelers better while giving them confidence in the experiences we create.

What You Will Do

As a Lead Product Designer, you will own meaningful parts of the personalization experience from exploration through product delivery. You will work across product surfaces and the underlying technology layer, connecting what Expedia Group learns about travelers with experiences that become increasingly relevant and useful over time.

You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, Analytics, Pricing, and Design to explore opportunities across memory, signal capture, personalization models, and cold-start experiences.

  • Shape the future of personalization. Define and design experiences that help Expedia Group better understand traveler intent, preferences, and behavior, and translate those signals into meaningful personalized experiences.
  • Solve the cold-start challenge. Explore ways to create value from a traveler’s first interactions, moving experiences from limited context toward increasingly relevant personalization.
  • Design better signal-capture experiences. Create thoughtful ways for travelers to express what matters to them, explicitly or implicitly, while considering how personalization can remain understandable and explainable.
  • Connect the experience and the system. Think across individual product surfaces and the broader personalization ecosystem, including how signals, memory, models, and traveler interactions influence one another.
  • Turn complex technology into intuitive experiences. Partner with technical teams to translate opportunities in AI, machine learning, data, and personalization into experiences travelers can understand and use.
  • Prototype to learn. Use high-fidelity prototyping and experimentation to make ideas tangible, evaluate possibilities, and accelerate learning. Coded prototyping can be one approach, but it is not a requirement.
  • Carry ideas toward real products. Help promising concepts mature into experiences that can inform and become part of Expedia Group products.
  • Set a high craft bar. Bring strong interaction and visual design judgment to complex problems, translating conceptual thinking into cohesive, polished experiences.
  • Influence through storytelling. Communicate the thinking, evidence, tradeoffs, and opportunities behind your work so partners and leaders can make informed decisions.
  • Raise the capability of the broader organization. Share patterns, learnings, and approaches that help other teams apply personalization thinking across the traveler journey.

What Success Looks Like

Traveler & Product Impact

  • Your work creates clearer, more relevant personalized experiences and helps ideas progress from exploration into product opportunities.

Design Excellence

  • You bring a strong product-design craft bar to an emerging technical space, creating experiences that feel thoughtful, intuitive, polished, and useful.

Systems Thinking

  • You connect individual interactions to the larger personalization ecosystem and understand how traveler signals, memory, models, and product experiences work together.

Strategic Influence

  • You make complex ideas understandable through strong storytelling, prototypes, and evidence, helping teams and leaders align around a direction.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of product design, UX design, interaction design, or equivalent experience creating digital products and experiences.
  • Bachelors or Masters degree in User Experience Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field; or equivalent professional experience.
  • A portfolio demonstrating strong product-design craft across complex digital experiences, including work that progressed toward or into market.
  • Ability to translate ambiguous or technically complex opportunities into clear, intuitive product experiences.
  • Strong systems thinking and the ability to connect individual interactions across broader journeys, platforms, or ecosystems.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional partners such as Product, Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, or Analytics.
  • Experience with, or demonstrated ability to quickly learn, AI, personalization, machine learning, or data-informed product experiences.
  • Strong prototyping skills and the ability to use prototypes to explore interactions, communicate ideas, and evaluate product directions.
  • Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to articulate design rationale and influence cross-functional partners and senior stakeholders.
  • Ability to work effectively in ambiguous, evolving product spaces while maintaining a high bar for craft and execution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing personalization, recommendations, identity, memory, preferences, or signal-capture experiences.
  • Experience designing products or experiences informed by AI or machine-learning systems.
  • Experience partnering closely with data scientists or working with model-driven product experiences.
  • Experience using AI-assisted design or prototyping tools.
  • Experience creating functional coded prototypes with tools such as React, Cursor, or similar technologies.
  • Front-end, full-stack, creative-technology, or design-technologist experience.

job.job_description:
If you’re an experienced Travel Consultant with a passion for the finer things in life while travelling, you’ll fit right into our Luxury Travel team. Our purpose is to open up the world for those who want to see. Every day, we give people all around the world the opportunity to do something really amazing – travel!

How you’ll be opening up the world for our customers…

As a Travel Consultant in our Luxury Travel team, you will help to plan, book and coordinate your customer’s next amazing luxury travel experience. You’ll be building unique itineraries for your customers with their every need front of mind to ensure they have a premium experience from “Bon Voyage” to “Welcome Home”. You will be booking everything from first class flights to five star hotels, premium tours, luxury cruising, travel insurance and more. You will be working towards KPI’s and incentive targets, therefore building your customer relationships will be critical to your success in this role.

What It Takes To Be a Luxury Travel Expert…

  • You’re the go-to person in your circle for travel recommendations, tips and tricks, with a minimum of 5 years experience as a Travel Consultant
  • You’re eager to provide exceptional service to welcome new customers to your existing database of loyal clientele
  • You have proven success in achieving your KPIs and sales targets
  • You seek out new ways to build on your success and think outside of the box for your customers to find the best travel solution for them
  • You understand the importance of organisation and managing your time effectively to achieve the best result and stay on top of your work
  • You’re not only good at the people stuff, but at the behind the scenes stuff too. Like building itineraries, doing up invoices, operating our complex booking systems and jumping between different programs with a customer in front of you
  • You know your way around GDS and you’re confident with complex computer systems
  • Extra points if you have personal experience with luxury travel!

Your First Class Employee Benefits:

  • At FCTG we understand the importance of flexibility while fostering a culture of collaboration through in person iterations – our Luxury Travel team offer hybrid working arrangements
  • Be rewarded with a base wage plus uncapped incentives payment structure - earn a percentage of every sale you make from day one, there’s no limit on what you can earn
  • Be gifted the time to provide the support your loyal clientele deserves, and to foster great relationships – you won’t be serving a constant queue, but the organic enquiry is there for you to be able to go above and beyond with your sales targets
  • You’ll be joining a highly experienced and skilled team
  • Unlock your wanderlust! Score incredible travel deals for you & your friends and family, and get ready to be invited to try premium air, cruise and land product for yourself through supplier famils
  • Brightness of Future: Career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses across the globe - we promote from within   
  • Embrace the famous Flight Centre culture at our Reward & Recognition with events throughout the year including, our most popular event on the calendar "Global Gathering"
  • Thrive in a workplace that values individualism – come as you are!

Don’t miss your flight! Apply now for one of the best adventures you’ll have.

*Flight Centre is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. *

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Director of Group Sales, you’re not just driving the hotel’s group revenue strategy – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:

  • Shape and execute group sales strategy: Oversee the hotel’s group sales efforts, aligning team priorities and initiatives with annual revenue goals for group rooms and banquets; contribute to the hotel’s annual commercial strategy in partnership with commercial and regional leadership teams
  • Drive commercial performance: Develop and implement business strategies that contribute to Rooms, Catering, and Event revenue streams, ensuring alignment with the hotel’s broader commercial objectives
  • Set and optimize pricing approach: Collaborate with commercial leadership to establish group pricing and rate strategies that maximize revenue and competitive market share
  • Develop data-driven sales strategies: Use performance metrics, demand forecasts, and competitive insights to shape sales plans, adjust deployment and mix strategies, and align activity with revenue goals and market conditions
  • Foster stakeholder relationships: Engage with Hilton Worldwide Sales, Convention and Visitors Bureaus (CVBs), third-party travel partners, and key clients to drive demand, improve conversion, and support high-impact site visits and pre-convention meetings
  • Lead business reviews and planning: Facilitate regular strategy and performance meetings while contributing to long-range commercial planning through analysis of performance trends, market shifts, and revenue opportunities
  • Cultivate a high-performing team: Recruit new talent while driving team growth and engagement through performance management, professional development, and recognition programs

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

Additional Information

Job Number26133807

Job CategorySales & Marketing

Location2 Harbourfront Place #06-08, Bank of America, Singapore 098499, Singapore VIEW ON MAP

ScheduleFull Time

Located Remotely?N

Position Type Management

Position Summary

Based in Singapore and reporting to the Director, Loyalty Operations & Program, APEC, the Senior Manager supports the successful deployment, implementation, adoption and ongoing sustenance of loyalty initiatives across the region. The role partners with APEC Hotels, Operations, IT, vendors, HQ teams and cross-functional stakeholders to drive rollout execution, hotel readiness and operational excellence for Marriott Bonvoy programs and capabilities.

This position combines project management, deployment planning, stakeholder engagement, change management, training facilitation and performance reporting. Working closely with the Assistant Manager, the Senior Manager oversees implementation activities, rollout governance, operational support and post-launch stabilization to ensure loyalty programs are effectively deployed, adopted and sustained across APEC.

Key Responsibilities

Project Delivery & Deployment

  • Lead the deployment, rollout and implementation of loyalty initiatives across APEC, ensuring projects are delivered effectively and aligned with business objectives.
  • Develop and manage implementation plans, project timelines, milestones, risks, dependencies and governance processes to support successful delivery.
  • Coordinate hotels, vendors, Operations, IT and cross-functional stakeholders to support implementation readiness, issue resolution and deployment execution.
  • Support pilot programs, testing activities, launch planning, go-live activities, post-launch stabilization efforts and broader Marriott Bonvoy loyalty initiatives as required.

Program Sustenance & Operational Support

  • Partner with the Off-Folio team to support the ongoing sustenance, adoption and operational success of deployed loyalty programs.
  • Monitor program adoption, identify operational challenges and coordinate remediation plans with relevant stakeholders.
  • Track implementation feedback, enhancement opportunities and operational issues, ensuring timely follow-up and resolution.
  • Support continuous improvement efforts that strengthen program performance, user experience and hotel adoption.

Change Management, Communications & Enablement

  • Develop and execute deployment communications, readiness activities and adoption plans to support successful program rollout.
  • Facilitate virtual and in-person training sessions, webinars, workshops, office hours and launch support activities.
  • Partner with Rooms and Off-Folio teams to support training delivery, hotel readiness and capability building across participating hotels.
  • Coordinate training logistics, communications, stakeholder participation and readiness tracking.

Governance & Reporting

  • Monitor project progress, deployment milestones, risks and dependencies, providing timely updates to leadership and project stakeholders.
  • Prepare project status reports, executive presentations, implementation updates and deployment communications.
  • Track deployment KPIs, implementation progress and adoption metrics to evaluate rollout effectiveness and identify improvement opportunities.
  • Maintain project documentation, governance records, implementation trackers and action logs.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Build and maintain effective working relationships with hotels, vendors, Operations, IT, HQ teams and regional stakeholders.
  • Facilitate project meetings, readiness reviews and deployment discussions to drive alignment, accountability and execution.
  • Act as a key point of coordination between business stakeholders and implementation teams throughout the deployment lifecycle.

People Leadership

  • Provide direction, coaching and oversight to the Assistant Manager, ensuring effective delivery of project coordination, reporting, deployment tracking and operational support activities.
  • Delegate responsibilities, monitor progress and support professional development to ensure successful execution of deployment and sustenance activities.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Experience and education

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Hotel & Restaurant Management, or a related discipline.
  • At least 6-8 years of relevant experience in project management, program deployment, operations, hospitality, implementation support or change management.
  • Experience leading large-scale deployments, hotel rollouts, systems implementations or cross-functional initiatives is highly valued.
  • Experience working in a regional and matrixed environment is preferred.
  • Hospitality, loyalty program, Food & Beverage or hotel operations experience is an advantage.

Skills and attributes

  • Strong project management, strategic planning and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to manage complex initiatives in a matrixed environment.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, influence stakeholders and drive alignment across diverse groups.
  • Strong analytical, structured thinking and business case development skills, with the ability to translate insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with confidence engaging senior leadership audiences.
  • Strong change management capability, including stakeholder engagement, organizational alignment and adoption planning.
  • Collaborative, adaptable and self-directed, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and drive results
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel and PowerPoint, with strong reporting and presentation skills.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

This role is based in Bangkok, Thailand, and is open to candidates worldwide. We offer a generous relocation package to ensure a smooth transition to living and working in Bangkok.

Get to Know Our Team:

The Performance Marketing Team of Agoda is a world leader in online marketing. We are highly data-driven and focused on developing at-scale marketing programs that improve the lifetime value of our customers.

Our team is a blend of the bright analysts, marketing strategists, and data scientists in the world. We foster a great learning environment where you will be able to learn and grow by working closely with experts from a variety of backgrounds from all over the world.

With Performance Marketing, MSE is a business development and marketing role within Agoda’s marketing department. It involves working with online vertical search advertisers (Meta Search Engines) to drive hotel booking sales.

In this role, you'll get to:

  • Own and manage marketing spend with large Meta Search Engine (MSE) partners
  • Independently manage your accounts
  • Manage the commercial relationship with MSE partners, including commercial terms, bidding and pricing strategies, and technical implementation
  • Decide in coordination with the Bidding and Pricing teams strategies that deliver expected ROIs and revenue growth
  • Track detailed performance/KPIs and deliver regular data-driven actionable insights to improve results
  • Succinctly communicate the results, ideas, and business statistics with different stakeholders
  • Ensure the advertiser implements the right Agoda APIs and related technological innovations
  • Be immersed and intimately familiar with the entire booking funnel including the user experience and conversion drivers between the advertiser and Agoda
  • Build long term relationships with advertisers that foster new opportunities and continuous growth in return from advertising dollars

What you’ll need to succeed:

  • Bachelor Degree in Computer Science/Statistics/Math or Engineering or Economics and Finance
  • Business development and/or account management track record with experience in online marketing
  • Fluent in English with strong communication skills (both written and verbal)
  • Self-motivated person with “Get it done!” attitude
  • Passionately analytical with strong ability to think logically and excellent problem-solving skills
  • Proficient in business intelligence tools and data warehouse i.e. SQL, Tableau and MS Excel
  • Ability to effectively communicate, influence and persuade with different levels of stakeholders (including Senior Management) with proven strong commercial acumen
  • Ability to represent Agoda with experience in interacting with external senior level executives
  • Strong analytical and statistical analysis skills to extract insights and recommendations

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Locations: Austin, Seattle, San Jose, San Francisco, Los Angeles, New York, Chicago

Why This Role Matters

Every traveler comes to Expedia Group with different needs, preferences, and intentions. The opportunity is to create experiences that understand those differences and become more useful with every interaction.

As part of our AI Platforms, Personalization, Memory, and Signal Capture team, you will help define how traveler signals, preferences, behaviors, memory, and feedback come together to power the next generation of personalized travel experiences.

One of our most interesting challenges is what happens when we know very little about a traveler. Many visitors arrive without prior booking history, while the signals we do have can be fragmented, missing, or difficult to translate into experiences travelers understand and trust.

This role sits at the intersection of product design, personalization, AI and machine learning, and systems thinking. You will help turn complex technology and data into intuitive experiences that progressively understand travelers better while giving them confidence in the experiences we create.

What You Will Do

As a Lead Product Designer, you will own meaningful parts of the personalization experience from exploration through product delivery. You will work across product surfaces and the underlying technology layer, connecting what Expedia Group learns about travelers with experiences that become increasingly relevant and useful over time.

You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, Analytics, Pricing, and Design to explore opportunities across memory, signal capture, personalization models, and cold-start experiences.

  • Shape the future of personalization. Define and design experiences that help Expedia Group better understand traveler intent, preferences, and behavior, and translate those signals into meaningful personalized experiences.
  • Solve the cold-start challenge. Explore ways to create value from a traveler’s first interactions, moving experiences from limited context toward increasingly relevant personalization.
  • Design better signal-capture experiences. Create thoughtful ways for travelers to express what matters to them, explicitly or implicitly, while considering how personalization can remain understandable and explainable.
  • Connect the experience and the system. Think across individual product surfaces and the broader personalization ecosystem, including how signals, memory, models, and traveler interactions influence one another.
  • Turn complex technology into intuitive experiences. Partner with technical teams to translate opportunities in AI, machine learning, data, and personalization into experiences travelers can understand and use.
  • Prototype to learn. Use high-fidelity prototyping and experimentation to make ideas tangible, evaluate possibilities, and accelerate learning. Coded prototyping can be one approach, but it is not a requirement.
  • Carry ideas toward real products. Help promising concepts mature into experiences that can inform and become part of Expedia Group products.
  • Set a high craft bar. Bring strong interaction and visual design judgment to complex problems, translating conceptual thinking into cohesive, polished experiences.
  • Influence through storytelling. Communicate the thinking, evidence, tradeoffs, and opportunities behind your work so partners and leaders can make informed decisions.
  • Raise the capability of the broader organization. Share patterns, learnings, and approaches that help other teams apply personalization thinking across the traveler journey.

What Success Looks Like

Traveler & Product Impact

  • Your work creates clearer, more relevant personalized experiences and helps ideas progress from exploration into product opportunities.

Design Excellence

  • You bring a strong product-design craft bar to an emerging technical space, creating experiences that feel thoughtful, intuitive, polished, and useful.

Systems Thinking

  • You connect individual interactions to the larger personalization ecosystem and understand how traveler signals, memory, models, and product experiences work together.

Strategic Influence

  • You make complex ideas understandable through strong storytelling, prototypes, and evidence, helping teams and leaders align around a direction.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of product design, UX design, interaction design, or equivalent experience creating digital products and experiences.
  • Bachelors or Masters degree in User Experience Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field; or equivalent professional experience.
  • A portfolio demonstrating strong product-design craft across complex digital experiences, including work that progressed toward or into market.
  • Ability to translate ambiguous or technically complex opportunities into clear, intuitive product experiences.
  • Strong systems thinking and the ability to connect individual interactions across broader journeys, platforms, or ecosystems.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional partners such as Product, Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, or Analytics.
  • Experience with, or demonstrated ability to quickly learn, AI, personalization, machine learning, or data-informed product experiences.
  • Strong prototyping skills and the ability to use prototypes to explore interactions, communicate ideas, and evaluate product directions.
  • Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to articulate design rationale and influence cross-functional partners and senior stakeholders.
  • Ability to work effectively in ambiguous, evolving product spaces while maintaining a high bar for craft and execution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing personalization, recommendations, identity, memory, preferences, or signal-capture experiences.
  • Experience designing products or experiences informed by AI or machine-learning systems.
  • Experience partnering closely with data scientists or working with model-driven product experiences.
  • Experience using AI-assisted design or prototyping tools.
  • Experience creating functional coded prototypes with tools such as React, Cursor, or similar technologies.
  • Front-end, full-stack, creative-technology, or design-technologist experience.

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! Responsibilities

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

How We'll Help You Thrive At Hilton

Hilton offers a lot of great benefits to full-time team members. We invest in our team members' wellbeing and provide support services through all of your life moments. There are many perks and benefits available to you including but not limited to the following:

  • Paid Time Off - generous program to help you relax, recharge and rejuvenate yourself

  • Free Meal & Free Parking - no hustle to pack your meal or to spend money on parking

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team:  

Agoda has taken many great strides in recent years, expanding our reach around the globe as well as our list of travel products. A critical driver to this success has been the team of Agoda Finance. We keep a steady hand on maintaining day-to-day financial operations while also keeping an eye out for future opportunities. Not only do we have the unique role of balancing risk management with continued innovation and growth, we also serve as a means of empowerment for both our team members and those within the company. Having experimentation and data analysis deeply ingrained in our culture, we provide the strategic insights Agoda’s business leaders need to push into new territories in sustainable and scalable ways. We also prioritize career development in Agoda Finance. Every function within the team has a well-defined career track with clear goals and development targets each step of the way.  

The Opportunity:

As a Vice President of Commercial Finance and FP&A, you'll lead the Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) and Commercial Finance teams for Agoda. The Strategic Finance team sits at the center of the organization, maintaining a steady pulse on the performance of the business and partnering with senior leaders across the company to provide analytical support for critical business decisions. As a direct report of the Agoda CFO, this individual will be an integral member of a team responsible for budgeting, forecasting and managing Agoda’s full P&L along with serving as a strategic financial business partner throughout the organization.

In this leadership role, you will:

  • Lead the development of financial strategies to enable growth, operational efficiency, and profitability;
  • Collaborate with teams across business verticals to understand their economics and partner to drive long-term profitable growth;
  • Serve as a key partner to the CFO, COO, and CEO across a wide range of finance responsibilities;
  • Lead annual budgeting, long-range planning, and quarterly forecasting activities across the division;
  • Lead the monthly financial review process and board content creation process, integrating financial results with business performance storytelling;
  • Partner with cross-functional leaders on business case development and scenario modeling;
  • Manage recurring and ad hoc requests from our leadership team and our corporate parent, Booking Holdings;
  • Develop KPIs and dashboards that monitor enterprise financial and operational performance;
  • Synthesize and communicate key financial and business insights at an executive level;
  • Manage internal and external stakeholders including auditors, regulators, and risk/compliance authorities to ensure financial and operational adherence as required;
  • Lead a high-performing and engaged team with the highest ethical standards.

What you’ll Need to Succeed: 

  • Minimum 12 years of related professional experience, FP&A experience required;
  • Corporate Finance experience within an e-commerce or tech sector is a plus;
  • Minimum 8 years in a management position;
  • Bachelor’s degree from a competitive program. MBA is a plus;
  • Exceptional analytical skills and natural curiosity regarding financial metrics and key business drivers;
  • Sharp communication skills and executive presence;
  • Strong financial modeling skills, and experience with Excel;
  • Experienced in creating 'C-level' presentations;
  • Excellent interpersonal, oral/written communication skills;
  • Experience with Fantastic or other planning tools is a plus;
  • Experience with tools such as OneStream, Hyperion/HFM, Essbase and Tableau are a plus;
  • Team player with a “no task is too small” attitude;
  • Demonstrated ability to multitask and meet deadlines within a fast-paced environment;
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, coordinate the efforts of others and work well with people at a wide range of levels;
  • The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Booking Holdings; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics is essential.

Do you enjoy solving complicated content problems? Do you want to use your Content Design skills to impact user experiences that help millions of people enjoy more of the world? At Expedia Group, our mission is to power global travel for everyone, everywhere.

As a Content Designer III in our Experience Design (XD) team, you'll work in a worldwide cross-disciplinary team that unites Product Design, Content Design, and Research to deliver innovative and cohesive end-to-end experiences that serve the needs of our travelers and partners. We're looking for a motivated and experienced Content Designer who is proficient in developing product content strategies, skilled at blending UX writing with storytelling, and confident in taking a content-first approach to end-to-end experience design.

Reporting to the Senior Content Design Manager, this Content Designer will help drive the content strategy and enhance the product experience for our Expedia and Insurance experiences.

You'll Be Ideal For This Role If You

  • Are passionate about finding the right content solutions to meet users' needs using research, data, and empathy
  • Have extensive experience in bringing clarity, consistency, and usability to the Loyalty product experiences
  • Are dedicated to designing product experiences that are helpful and human
  • Know that the same content strategy and design skills are that help you leverage AI to create better content faster

In This Role, You Will

Exemplify sound practices in human-centered content strategy and design. You'll be a confident content practitioner who can lead by example and is well-versed at taking a cross-organizational, holistic approach to the user experience. While no two days are the same, you'll specifically be expected to :

  • Design thoughtful, intuitive, and accessible content solutions for a range of product use cases and interactions – from onboarding and in-app education to transactional flows and push notifications.
  • Apply solid information architecture methods (such as content modeling and mapping) and UI frameworks to design scalable content solutions.
  • Audit, analyze, structure, create, and present compelling UX content throughout the product experience.
  • Partner across product and research teams using human-centered design methods to drive content tests that measurably improve the traveler experience, and identify, log, prioritize, and resolve content bugs across the portfolio.
  • Apply a holistic, customer-focused approach to creating a cohesive content strategy for our loyalty programme across all product areas.
  • Use both qualitative and quantitative insights, along with business analytics, to drive content insights and solutions.
  • Partner across teams to improve the accessibility, inclusion, readability, and translatability of product content
  • Have strong facilitation and presentation skills to clearly and confidently communicate the rationale for decision-making to team members and stakeholders.
  • Influence, persuade, and negotiate with stakeholders to design the best experiences that meet the needs of travelers and businesses.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience in core skills such as UX Writing, content audits and analysis, content mapping and modeling, information architecture, content planning and sourcing, conversational design, and storytelling (this is not a content marketing role)
  • 5+ years of experience as a Content Designer, UX writer, or Content Strategist
  • Ability to audit, analyze, structure, create, and design content independently in compelling user-focused product experiences using established frameworks
  • Strong skills in confidently presenting compelling rationale and narratives behind content strategies and decisions to peers, partners, and key stakeholders - such as Legal, Marketing, Security, Product, and top leadership
  • Expertise in persuasion and negotiation with stakeholders to create optimal experiences that balance both traveler satisfaction and business objectives
  • Experience applying human-centered design (HCD) practices to product experiences

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience taking a thoughtful, empathetic, and inclusive approach to design that meets every user where they are
  • Experience in solving complicated content problems for multiple user segments and can develop content solutions across brands.
  • Maintain a portfolio of work that showcases your skills as a design thinker and honed UX writer. We are particularly interested in examples of how your influence enhances cross-functional thinking to drive retention in Loyalty and Membership areas.
  • Demonstrate a curiosity to explore and apply emerging AI technologies, including prompt engineering, structured content to enhance strategy and operational efficiency.

Take the opportunity to gain insight into at least one other business area, paving the way for valuable future relationships.
  • Work on real-world projects: Apply your skills on the job through business-driven projects to reinforce your learning and gain hands-on experience.

Our Placement Opportunities

Revenue Analyst And Pricing Placement

This placement is ideal for a student interested in revenue management and pricing strategy, offering exposure to how commercial performance is driven across Hilton's EMEA portfolio. During the internship, you'll gain hands-on experience analysing business performance, supporting pricing decisions, and contributing to projects that directly impact hotel revenue.

You will be an integral part of the team and play an active role in our success, with responsibilities including:

  • Supporting analysis of hotel performance to identify opportunities and risks.
  • Assisting in the development and communication of pricing, inventory, and promotional strategies.

  • Perform tasks across Microsoft products such as Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, SharePoint, with the use of VBA, SQL, Python or similar coding languages.

RMCC Business Development Placement

This role is ideal for someone interested in business development, focused on identifying growth opportunities and driving commercial success across Hilton's EMEA portfolio. During the internship, you'll gain hands-on experience supporting RMCC expansion, including onboarding new hotels and contributing to large-scale change management initiatives within a structured framework.

You will play an active role in the team's success, with responsibilities including:

  • Assisting in testing and implementing pricing, inventory, and capability enhancements.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team:  

Agoda has taken many great strides in recent years, expanding our reach around the globe as well as our list of travel products. A critical driver to this success has been the team of Agoda Finance. We keep a steady hand on maintaining day-to-day financial operations while also keeping an eye out for future opportunities. Not only do we have the unique role of balancing risk management with continued innovation and growth, we also serve as a means of empowerment for both our team members and those within the company. Having experimentation and data analysis deeply ingrained in our culture, we provide the strategic insights Agoda’s business leaders need to push into new territories in sustainable and scalable ways. We also prioritize career development in Agoda Finance. Every function within the team has a well-defined career track with clear goals and development targets each step of the way.  

The Opportunity:

As a Vice President of Commercial Finance and FP&A, you'll lead the Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) and Commercial Finance teams for Agoda. The Strategic Finance team sits at the center of the organization, maintaining a steady pulse on the performance of the business and partnering with senior leaders across the company to provide analytical support for critical business decisions. As a direct report of the Agoda CFO, this individual will be an integral member of a team responsible for budgeting, forecasting and managing Agoda’s full P&L along with serving as a strategic financial business partner throughout the organization.

In this leadership role, you will:

  • Lead the development of financial strategies to enable growth, operational efficiency, and profitability;
  • Collaborate with teams across business verticals to understand their economics and partner to drive long-term profitable growth;
  • Serve as a key partner to the CFO, COO, and CEO across a wide range of finance responsibilities;
  • Lead annual budgeting, long-range planning, and quarterly forecasting activities across the division;
  • Lead the monthly financial review process and board content creation process, integrating financial results with business performance storytelling;
  • Partner with cross-functional leaders on business case development and scenario modeling;
  • Manage recurring and ad hoc requests from our leadership team and our corporate parent, Booking Holdings;
  • Develop KPIs and dashboards that monitor enterprise financial and operational performance;
  • Synthesize and communicate key financial and business insights at an executive level;
  • Manage internal and external stakeholders including auditors, regulators, and risk/compliance authorities to ensure financial and operational adherence as required;
  • Lead a high-performing and engaged team with the highest ethical standards.

What you’ll Need to Succeed: 

  • Minimum 12 years of related professional experience, FP&A experience required;
  • Corporate Finance experience within an e-commerce or tech sector is a plus;
  • Minimum 8 years in a management position;
  • Bachelor’s degree from a competitive program. MBA is a plus;
  • Exceptional analytical skills and natural curiosity regarding financial metrics and key business drivers;
  • Sharp communication skills and executive presence;
  • Strong financial modeling skills, and experience with Excel;
  • Experienced in creating 'C-level' presentations;
  • Excellent interpersonal, oral/written communication skills;
  • Experience with Fantastic or other planning tools is a plus;
  • Experience with tools such as OneStream, Hyperion/HFM, Essbase and Tableau are a plus;
  • Team player with a “no task is too small” attitude;
  • Demonstrated ability to multitask and meet deadlines within a fast-paced environment;
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, coordinate the efforts of others and work well with people at a wide range of levels;
  • The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Booking Holdings; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics is essential.

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Expedia Technology teams’ partner with our Product teams to create innovative products, services, and tools that deliver high-quality experiences for travellers, partners, and employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that build loyalty and traveller satisfaction.

The Content AI team develops content intelligence capabilities that can be leveraged across Expedia Group. The team works across textual, video, and image content. As Senior Manager, Machine Learning Science, you will lead work across the Content AI charter: content generation, content moderation and quality, and content relevance. You will help create a scalable capability that matches accurate, grounded content to travellers and enables partners to shape and improve their content.

In This Role, You Will

  • Manage, coach, and develop a high-performing, inclusive team of data scientists and machine learning engineers across locations.
  • Set team goals, OKRs, technical priorities, and operating rhythms aligned with organizational strategy.
  • Lead delivery across the Content AI charter, spanning content generation, content moderation and quality, and content relevance.
  • Guide development and adoption of end-to-end machine learning solutions across textual, video, and image content, with potential expansion into speech.
  • Develop accurate, relevant, grounded and non-hallucinating content AI capabilities that helps shape traveller and partner value across Expedia Group.
  • Apply effective stakeholder management across Product, Engineering, senior leadership, and cross-functional partners.
  • Optimize delivery through iterative execution, clear decision-making, effective processes, and a focus on measurable outcomes.
  • Bring an engineering mindset to machine learning work by promoting maintainable, modular, scalable, and production-aware solutions.
  • Communicate technical concepts, progress, insights, and recommendations clearly to varied audiences.
  • Build team practices that support feedback, knowledge sharing, professional development, recruiting, performance management, and career growth.

Required

Experience and Qualifications:

  • 4-5+ years of people leadership experience managing Machine Learning Scientists, Applied Scientists, Data Scientists, or multidisciplinary AI/ML teams.
  • Master’s degree in computer science, machine learning, statistics, mathematics, or a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience.
  • Significant experience in machine learning science, including supervised and unsupervised learning, model evaluation, generalization, robustness, and experimentation.
  • Experience delivering end-to-end machine learning solutions, from problem definition and data preparation through feature engineering, modelling, evaluation, and production integration.
  • Experience managing and developing data scientists or machine learning engineers, including recruiting, coaching, performance management, and career development.
  • Experience with Python, Scala, Java, or another major machine learning language, plus SQL.
  • Demonstrated stakeholder management, prioritization, delivery optimization, communication, influencing, and problem-solving skills.
  • An engineering mindset, including knowledge of software design principles, modular code, maintainability, and scalability.
  • Familiarity with large language models and willingness to learn across content areas and modalities.
  • Experience translating business objectives into practical, iterative, and cost-aware technical approaches.

Preferred

  • PhD in a relevant technical field.
  • Familiarity with LLMOps model inference, and machine learning platform capabilities.
  • Experience with GenAI, LLM fine-tuning, golden dataset construction, evaluation metric definition, multimodal retrieval, embeddings, quantization, or LLM decoder architecture optimization.
  • Experience with recommender systems or reinforcement learning.

Our Placement Opportunities

We have a range of placement opportunities within our highly talented Finance department:

Hilton Finance Centre Of Excellence

The Hilton Finance Centre of Excellence has two placement opportunities available, one in our Order-to-Cash (OTC) and another in our Record-To-Report (RTR) team. These placements provide exposure to a wide range of corporate finance activities, including journal postings, balance sheet reconciliations, VAT and revenue analysis, audit support, and financial reporting.

Interns will work closely with experienced professionals across various finance functions within the Centre of Excellence, contributing to the monthly close process, supporting compliance and control activities, and engaging in continuous improvement initiatives. You’ll gain insight into Hilton’s financial systems and processes, develop your analytical and organisational skills, and build a strong foundation for a career in finance. This is a unique opportunity to be part of a collaborative, fast-paced team within one of the world’s most recognised hospitality brands, where innovation and excellence are at the heart of everything we do.

Finance Global Brands & Commercial Services (GBCS) Placement

The GBCS Finance team supports Hilton’s Brand and Commercial engine - driving brand loyalty, top-line revenue and market share. This is a Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) arm of finance that is primarily responsible for the budgeting and forecasting of corporate expenditure across Brands, Sales, Marketing, Revenue Management and Technology functions.

The team works with a wide range of stakeholders across multiple regions with varying reporting needs, so there are excellent opportunities to develop both analytical and business partnering skills. As an intern, you will support all aspects of our monthly deliverables and will have a unique opportunity to learn about our commercial operations, whilst getting to know the teams driving these initiatives.

Statutory Reporting Placement

The UK Statutory Reporting and Accounting team is responsible for UK statutory reporting across Hilton’s international business, including preparation of all UK statutory accounts for audit, development of technical accounting judgments and estimates and compliance over other statutory requirements.

Hilton has over 50 companies registered in the UK that between them report the results of UK leased hotels and international managed and franchised hotels. The team are responsible for the accurate and timely preparation of UK statutory accounts and related regulatory filings, ensuring full compliance with FRS101 and Companies Act requirements and meeting the filing deadline at Companies House. The team is also a critical business partner throughout the Finance organization, partnering closely with Tax, Treasury and Financial Planning & Analysis teams.

As an intern, you will support the preparation and audit of statutory accounts under FRS 101. This includes preparing supporting workings, updating documents, and ensuring they agree to underlying records. This role provides the unusual opportunity to see the whole profit and loss account and balance sheet of a small group of hotels rather than one section of the balance sheet on a global basis. The role requires managing multiple tasks to help the team meet deadlines.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team:  

Agoda has taken many great strides in recent years, expanding our reach around the globe as well as our list of travel products. A critical driver to this success has been the team of Agoda Finance. We keep a steady hand on maintaining day-to-day financial operations while also keeping an eye out for future opportunities. Not only do we have the unique role of balancing risk management with continued innovation and growth, we also serve as a means of empowerment for both our team members and those within the company. Having experimentation and data analysis deeply ingrained in our culture, we provide the strategic insights Agoda’s business leaders need to push into new territories in sustainable and scalable ways. We also prioritize career development in Agoda Finance. Every function within the team has a well-defined career track with clear goals and development targets each step of the way.  

The Opportunity:

As a Vice President of Commercial Finance and FP&A, you'll lead the Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) and Commercial Finance teams for Agoda. The Strategic Finance team sits at the center of the organization, maintaining a steady pulse on the performance of the business and partnering with senior leaders across the company to provide analytical support for critical business decisions. As a direct report of the Agoda CFO, this individual will be an integral member of a team responsible for budgeting, forecasting and managing Agoda’s full P&L along with serving as a strategic financial business partner throughout the organization.

In this leadership role, you will:

  • Lead the development of financial strategies to enable growth, operational efficiency, and profitability;
  • Collaborate with teams across business verticals to understand their economics and partner to drive long-term profitable growth;
  • Serve as a key partner to the CFO, COO, and CEO across a wide range of finance responsibilities;
  • Lead annual budgeting, long-range planning, and quarterly forecasting activities across the division;
  • Lead the monthly financial review process and board content creation process, integrating financial results with business performance storytelling;
  • Partner with cross-functional leaders on business case development and scenario modeling;
  • Manage recurring and ad hoc requests from our leadership team and our corporate parent, Booking Holdings;
  • Develop KPIs and dashboards that monitor enterprise financial and operational performance;
  • Synthesize and communicate key financial and business insights at an executive level;
  • Manage internal and external stakeholders including auditors, regulators, and risk/compliance authorities to ensure financial and operational adherence as required;
  • Lead a high-performing and engaged team with the highest ethical standards.

What you’ll Need to Succeed: 

  • Minimum 12 years of related professional experience, FP&A experience required;
  • Corporate Finance experience within an e-commerce or tech sector is a plus;
  • Minimum 8 years in a management position;
  • Bachelor’s degree from a competitive program. MBA is a plus;
  • Exceptional analytical skills and natural curiosity regarding financial metrics and key business drivers;
  • Sharp communication skills and executive presence;
  • Strong financial modeling skills, and experience with Excel;
  • Experienced in creating 'C-level' presentations;
  • Excellent interpersonal, oral/written communication skills;
  • Experience with Fantastic or other planning tools is a plus;
  • Experience with tools such as OneStream, Hyperion/HFM, Essbase and Tableau are a plus;
  • Team player with a “no task is too small” attitude;
  • Demonstrated ability to multitask and meet deadlines within a fast-paced environment;
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, coordinate the efforts of others and work well with people at a wide range of levels;
  • The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Booking Holdings; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics is essential.

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

The location for this position is virtual/remote

The Revenue Management Consolidated Center (RMCC) offers owned, managed, and franchised hotels world-class revenue management and sales services. Responsible for helping hotels grow market share and outperform our competitors, the team of over 400 professionals supports over 2,400 hotels in the Americas. As a Director, RMCC Americas Managed, you will support the team that's helping a portfolio of Managed hotels consistently grow market share and outperform competitors. On the RMCC Americas Leadership team reporting to the Senior Director, RMCC Americas, you will work on projects including hotel performance deep dives, Managed budget achievement, and rolling out new initiatives.

What You'll Do During a Typical Day

  • Lead hotel facing revenue management strategy for a portfolio of Managed hotels in the Americas
  • Lead and develop team members deployed to support the portfolio
  • Drive market share through strategy collaboration

How You'll Collaborate With Others

  • Collaborate with RMCC Leadership and your team of direct reports
  • Partner with property level commercial teams to drive performance
  • Managed regional leadership on key owner deliverables and meetings

Deliverables You'll Take Ownership Of

  • Property and portfolio market share and budget achievement
  • Team member engagement and development

What It Takes to Make the Stay

You Have These Minimum Qualifications

  • Ten (10) years of professional experience
  • Five (5) years of work experience in revenue management representing a portfolio of hotels (high profile assets over 1,000 keys)
  • Four (4) years of collaborating with partners through data representation, interpretation and storytelling
  • Travel up to 40%

It Would Be Useful If You Have

  • BA/BS Bachelor's Degree
  • Three (3) years of Director level experience
  • Exposure to multiple commercial functions and/or a deep understanding of the commercial operating model
  • Experience in a leadership role within Sales, Marketing or Revenue Management within a global organization

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we're known for doesn't end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members' wellbeing, supporting you through all of life's moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
  • Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
  • Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
  • Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
  • Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
  • Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Generous paid time off (PTO) – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters most
  • Health & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family covered
  • Financial security for your future – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what's next
  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member's location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

Hilton offers its eligible team members a comprehensive benefits package to support their mental and physical well-being, so they can Thrive personally and professionally. The pay range for this role is $120,000 – $175,000 and is determined based on applicable and specialized experience and location. Subject to plan terms and conditions, you will be eligible to participate in the Hilton Annual Incentive (Bonus) Plan, consistent with other team members at the same level and/or position within the Company.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About Rocket Travel By Agoda

Rocket Travel by Agoda is a travel technology company founded in 2012 under our flagship consumer facing product, rocketmiles.com. Since then, we have evolved to partner with some of the largest consumer travel brands in the world creating white-label solutions that allow customers to earn and redeem miles and points for booking hotels, rental cars, flights and activities. Our global partnerships range from world-class airlines to international banks to large-scale shopping platforms. We help our partners develop successful go-to-market strategies through marketing expertise and data to support their overall growth.

We attract customers from every corner of the globe with a seamless user experience that's built in-house from ideation to finished product: our team includes front- and back-end developers, customer service, data analysts, designers, marketers, accountants, partnership sales, and managers.

Rocket Travel by Agoda is dedicated to creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to reach new heights in their career, and expand their knowledge working alongside talented, dedicated colleagues. We encourage all applicants with a touch of wanderlust to apply to our team, as we work toward helping our travelers reach the vacation of their dreams.

Get to know our team:

The Marketing team operates at the intersection of business strategy, data, and execution. We build and scale programs across growth, pricing, and commercial initiatives that drive customer value and sustainable business performance globally. We’re analytical, fast-moving, and deeply cross-functional — partnering closely with Product, Finance, and other teams to shape RTA's growth agenda.

The opportunity:

We are looking for a dynamic and versatile Marketing Manager who will focus on marketing guidance and support for our white label travel platform partners. This is a strategic role where you will work closely with our Partner Managers, Product Owners and the larger Marketing team to understand the partners’ needs, advise them on impactful marketing initiatives, and drive the growth of the platform.

What you'll do:

  • Marketing Strategy and Execution: Understand the partners’ business models and goals and provide expert advice on the best marketing strategies to achieve growth. Recommend initiatives to optimize campaigns and enhance platform performance for end-users.
  • Data-Driven Insights: Analyze large datasets to uncover trends and opportunities, delivering actionable insights that inform marketing strategies. Regularly monitor platform performance and recommend optimizations based on data findings.
  • Influencing Decision-Making: Guide and influence partners to adopt strategies and solutions that align with their goals as well as our business objectives. Serve as an advisor, simplifying complex marketing strategies for non-experts.
  • Revenue Growth: Strategically focus on maximizing contribution margin and ROI while ensuring partner satisfaction and long-term engagement.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams, including sales, product, analytics, and operations, to ensure smooth execution and alignment of initiatives.

What you'll need to succeed:

  • 5 years of relevant Marketing experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field; MBA preferred.
  • Proven marketing experience, ideally within e-commerce, travel, or SaaS environments.
  • Experience in a consultative or advisory role, preferably with a consulting background.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to dissect data and provide actionable recommendations. Basic knowledge of SQL (joins, filters, aggregates) is a must, advanced (window functions, CTEs) is a plus.
  • Exceptional communication, both written – clear, powerful slides – and spoken – ability to handle conversations with stakeholders and motivate them to adopt strategic decisions.
  • Exposure to sales with an understanding of how partnerships contribute to revenue growth.
  • Proven track record of leading multi-stakeholder initiatives successfully.

At this time, we’re unfortunately unable to provide support for OPT/CPT student visas or H-1B transfers for this role. As a result, preference will be given to candidates who are U.S. citizens, permanent residents, or Green Card holders.

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. In addition to a competitive base salary, roles are eligible to be considered for an annual bonus.

The annual salary range for the NYC-metro area is $110,000-$138,000.

E-Verify Program Participant

We are an E-Verify employer – meaning that your Form I-9 information will be provided to the federal government to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

For more information, please view: E-Verify Participation Poster (English/Spanish) and IER Right to Work Poster (English/Spanish)
