job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

As a participant in our 12-month Corporate Placements Programme in the Finance Department at our Glasgow Corporate Office – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by contributing to the memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Here’s what you can look forward to as a programme participant:

  • Prepare for a career in hospitality: Embark on a 12-month transformative journey, encompassing a structured framework of learning and development opportunities, business support activities, and ownership of your own project-based initiatives.
  • Gain hands-on operational experience: From day one, you’ll be fully integrated into Team Hilton. Connect with professionals across the business and gain insight into Finance. Take the opportunity to gain insight into at least one other business area, paving the way for valuable future relationships.
  • Work on real-world projects: Apply your skills on the job through business-driven projects to reinforce your learning and gain hands-on experience.
  • Develop your skills through world-class training and support: Access Hilton University’s e-learning modules and business library while building knowledge through business-driven projects.
  • Grow with personalised guidance: Benefit from regular feedback and coaching to ensure your progress is supported at every stage of the programme.
  • Hilton Perks: Including our Go Hilton Team Member Travel Program, which provides you with access to heavily reduced hotel room rates for you, your family & friends.
  • Salary & Benefits: £27,500 gross per annum & private healthcare.
  • Location: At our Glasgow Corporate Office, with some flexibility depending on team and business need. You will benefit from our social area, including a table tennis and pool table. We have good transport links, just a five-minute walk from Central & Queen Street Train Stations, and Buchanan Street Subway.

Our Placement Opportunities

We have a range of placement opportunities within our highly talented Finance department:

Hilton Glasgow Finance Centre of Excellence

Hilton’s Glasgow Finance Centre of Excellence is a great place for individuals looking to gain real-world experience in a global finance environment.

All placements will provide exposure to a wide range of corporate finance activities, including journal postings, balance sheet reconciliations, VAT and revenue analysis, audit support, and financial reporting. Placement students will work closely with experienced professionals across various finance functions, contributing to the monthly close process, supporting compliance and control activities, and engaging in continuous improvement initiatives.

You’ll gain insight into Hilton’s financial systems and processes, develop your analytical and organisational skills, and build a strong foundation for a career in finance. This is a unique opportunity to be part of a collaborative, fast-paced team within one of the world’s most recognised hospitality brands, where innovation and excellence are at the heart of everything we do.

We Have Opportunities Available In

  • Hotel Accounting.
  • Order-To-Cash (OTC).
  • Process-to-Pay (PTP).
  • Corporate Accounting.
  • Revenue Accounting.
  • US Banking.
  • Record to Report (RTR).

UK Payroll & Compliance Team

Hilton’s UK Payroll & Compliance Team is part of our wider HR function and is responsible for payroll activities for approximately 7,000 Team Members across 51 Hilton properties. This is a fantastic opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced, high-impact environment where accuracy, collaboration, and meeting deadlines are essential.

As an intern in the UK Payroll & Compliance Team, you will develop practical skills in payroll, finance, and compliance, while learning how we ensure our Team Members are paid accurately and on time.

What You’ll Gain

  • Practical experience in UK payroll legislation and processes.
  • Exposure to payroll accounting and financial controls.
  • The opportunity to work on meaningful projects and process improvements.
  • Collaboration with international teams and our Global Payroll Services network.
  • Insight into how a global organisation operates behind the scenes.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Supporting payroll processing and analysing payroll data.
  • Assisting with reconciliations, general ledger postings, and journal entries.
  • Contributing to balance sheet reconciliations and financial reporting.
  • Supporting HMRC compliance activities, including benefits-in-kind reporting.
  • Completing monthly SOX controls and audit checks.
  • Working closely with internal teams, including our Global Payroll team and Shared Service Centre in Hyderabad.

Financial Systems Team

Hilton's Financial Systems team is part of our global Finance function. This is a fantastic opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced, high-impact environment where accuracy, collaboration, and delivering against deadlines are key.

As a Financial Systems Intern, you'll develop an understanding of Hilton's financial systems and processes while working with teams across Finance, Technology, Global Support and external vendor partners. You’ll build analytical, technical, and problem-solving skills while contributing to system enhancements, process improvements, and global enhancement initiatives that support Hilton’s worldwide operations, creating a strong foundation for a future career in finance, systems, or technology.

You'll gain an appreciation of how a global organisation operates behind the scenes through collaboration with international teams and hands-on experience across a range of financial applications. In addition, you'll develop an understanding of financial controls and governance processes while gaining exposure to automation, digital transformation, and emerging AI-enabled finance technologies.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Supporting user administration activities and system administration tasks in BlackLine, including user access reviews, scheduling imports, organisational structure updates, and country rollouts.
  • Configuring expense types and maintaining override tables.
  • Troubleshooting end-user issues related to system access and functionality & supporting testing activities for system enhancements and new projects.
  • Maintaining training materials and application documentation to ensure they remain accurate and up to date.
  • Participating in project meetings and gaining exposure to system implementations, global rollouts, and enhancement initiatives.
  • Analysing system data and identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, user experience, and process effectiveness.

What We’re Looking For

We are seeking individuals who embody the Hilton Values in addition to the following criteria:

  • A current bachelor’s or master’s student completing a degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Economics, or other equivalent, that includes a required 12-month year in industry placement.
  • Availability to begin full-time employment on 5th July 2027, for a full-time 12-month placement.
  • You must have the independent right to work in the UK for the full duration of the 12-month placement. Please note that this role is not eligible for visa sponsorship under the Skilled Worker route, so we are unable to consider applications from candidates who would require sponsorship. If you hold a visa or status that allows you to work in the UK full-time without sponsorship (e.g. Settled Status, Pre-Settled Status, where a 12-month work placement is a permitted, required & assessed part of your UK University degree, or other independent work permissions), you are welcome to apply.
  • Fluency in English (spoken and written).
  • You should be able to demonstrate a genuine interest in Finance.
  • Able to demonstrate a high level of numerical and analytical capability.

Click here to learn more about Hilton's Corporate Placements

Selection Process

Applications are now open—don’t miss your chance to apply! Submissions close on Tuesday 20th October 2026

Our selection process is designed to bring out your best and help us get to know you. It includes:

  • Online assessments.
  • In-person Assessment Centre in our Glasgow Corporate Office (24th November 2026).

While the process is rigorous, it’s also the first step in your personal growth journey with Hilton. If selected, you’ll begin developing the skills, connections, and confidence to thrive in your career.

To ensure every application receives fair consideration, invitations to the final-stage assessment centre will be issued after applications have closed. Please complete each stage promptly and keep an eye on your inbox for updates.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing reasonable adjustments for applicants and employees with disabilities. If you require any support or adjustments during the recruitment process or to carry out the essential requirements of the role, please contact us.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About Rocket Travel By Agoda

Rocket Travel by Agoda is a travel technology company founded in 2012 under our flagship consumer facing product, rocketmiles.com. Since then, we have evolved to partner with some of the largest consumer travel brands in the world creating white-label solutions that allow customers to earn and redeem miles and points for booking hotels, rental cars, flights and activities. Our global partnerships range from world-class airlines to international banks to large-scale shopping platforms. We help our partners develop successful go-to-market strategies through marketing expertise and data to support their overall growth.

We attract customers from every corner of the globe with a seamless user experience that's built in-house from ideation to finished product: our team includes front- and back-end developers, customer service, data analysts, designers, marketers, accountants, partnership sales, and managers.

Rocket Travel by Agoda is dedicated to creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to reach new heights in their career, and expand their knowledge working alongside talented, dedicated colleagues. We encourage all applicants with a touch of wanderlust to apply to our team, as we work toward helping our travelers reach the vacation of their dreams.

As a Senior Partner Manager at Rocket Travel, you will:

  • Take the lead in growing Rocket Travel's largest partnerships in the Americas region with careful day-to-day management, goal and strategy setting, data analysis, and a keen focus on relationships.
  • Establish goals for partners and set the strategy to hit those goals. Influence internal and external partners to take on new initiatives to accomplish big milestones.
  • Prepare partner presentation materials, including account reviews for existing partners, and new product collateral.
  • Manage the partner marketing calendar so the entire team is aware of partner marketing activities, including briefing customer service and other stakeholders on promotion or campaign details.
  • Serve as the first point of escalation for partners to resolve issues with customers, partner platforms, etc.
  • Proactively benchmark competitive landscape on a regular basis to ensure that our products are well positioned and remain best-in-class; identify net new product features to evaluate/bring to the team for discussion.
  • Support finance with billing reconciliation to ensure correct billing from the partner.
  • Make recommendations for future campaigns and placements to optimize campaign performance, including promotional design and writing copy.
  • Collaborate with a team of marketers and designers to enhance the quality and performance of marketing and product efforts across Rocket Travel.
  • Participate in A/B testing using different approaches to driving conversion and repeat behavior that may differ from Rocket Travel core regions.
  • Manage your own deadlines across projects. There will be short turnarounds for some projects, and longer engagements for others. You know how to manage your time and balance both.
  • Be scrappy. We’re a small team and often wear many hats. Some projects may not be completely defined. This individual will take a resourceful approach to what’s needed and drive results.

About you:

  • You have a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing or related field.
  • You have 7+ years of relevant experience in partnership marketing & business development.
  • You are entrepreneurial and able to work independently/take ownership.
  • You understand how to summarize complex concepts and craft win-win strategies with partners.
  • You enjoy working with analytical people in data-driven businesses.
  • You have impeccable attention to detail, taking end to end ownership and quality control in all projects.
  • You have the ability to communicate with partners as needed with little to no oversight.
  • You put the customer front and center. Customers can be a traveler, a partner, or even a colleague. You ensure that work centers around solving their pain points.
  • You seek feedback. You have a growth mindset, are comfortable soliciting thoughts from others, and are curious to learn from a spectrum of perspectives.
  • You balance exploration with execution. Exploration and execution are both key to building innovative experiences. You understand when it’s time to explore and when it’s time to deliver.
  • You work well cross-functionally and are able to communicate effectively with others of varying backgrounds and areas of expertise.

About Rocket Travel By Agoda

Rocket Travel by Agoda is dedicated to creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to reach new heights in their career. We encourage all applicants looking to expand their knowledge working alongside talented, dedicated colleagues to apply to our team.

Candidates should be authorized to accept employment in the US from any employer, should be willing to start within three weeks of accepting an offer, and should be able to work the same daily working hours as our Chicago office.

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Senior Sales Manager, you’re not just generating and managing group sales – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

After 90 days of employment, 1 day work from home possibility based on performance.

After 6 months of employment, 2 day work from home possibility based on performance.

Hilton Santa Barbara Beachfront Resort is looking for their next Senior Sales Manager superstar to join the team. The property sits on 24-acres of beachfront, 360 guest rooms, 62,450 sf of event space and 17 meeting rooms. If you have a passion in providing safety and memorable experiences for guest, this is the position for you!

The ideal candidate will actively solicit new business, cultivate strong client relationships, and collaborate cross-functionally to ensure seamless and successful event execution. Join us and see why Hilton is ranked the best hospitality brand to work for! Our property offers free team member parking, meals with each shift and great career growth!

Key Qualifications

1-2 years senior hotel sales background.

Hotel size of 300+ guest room familiarity.

Large group selling background

Ability to take initiative and build new business and strengthen existing partnerships.

Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to interact effectively across all levels of the organization.

Ability to prioritize tasks, manage shifting deadlines.

Must be highly organized, team‑oriented, and able to work seamlessly with senior leadership.

Sales Incentive

Hilton offers the best in-market SIP (Short-Term Incentive Plan) to our Sales, Catering & Events teams to reward our employees for their contributions to our company’s financial success. The Plan includes a quarterly component worth 20% of bonus eligible earnings. The quarterly incentive may have multiple individually weighted objectives, meaning multiple opportunities to earn a payout.

Responsibilities

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:

  • Represent the hotel to prospective clients: Serve as the primary point of contact for customers seeking group rooms, meeting space, and food and beverage services
  • Drive new business opportunities: Respond to inquiries, initiate outreach, qualify leads, and solicit potential clients through proactive sales efforts
  • Manage the full sales cycle: Conduct site visits, entertain clients, prepare proposals, determine rates, negotiate contracts, and service accounts through fulfillment
  • Develop strategic sales plans: Create and execute strategies to achieve or exceed revenue and room night goals, adjusting based on performance and market conditions
  • Analyze sales performance: Evaluate lost business reports and identify opportunities to strengthen conversion and competitiveness
  • Support exceptional service delivery: Collaborate across departments to coordinate the fulfillment of contracted services and uphold the highest standards of client satisfaction
  • Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

:BV1

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

About The Team

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
  • Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
  • Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
  • Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
  • Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
  • Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Generous paid time off (PTO) – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters most
  • Health & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family covered
  • Financial security for your future – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what’s next
  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

Get to Know Our Team:

The Performance Marketing Team of Agoda is a world leader in online marketing. We are highly data-driven and focused on developing at-scale marketing programs that improve the lifetime value of our customers.

Our team is a blend of the bright analysts, marketing strategists, and data scientists in the world. We foster a great learning environment where you will be able to learn and grow by working closely with experts from a variety of backgrounds from all over the world.

With Performance Marketing, MSE is a business development and marketing role within Agoda’s marketing department. It involves working with online vertical search advertisers (Meta Search Engines) to drive hotel booking sales.

In this role, you'll get to:

  • Own and manage marketing spend with large Meta Search Engine (MSE) partners
  • Independently manage your accounts
  • Manage the commercial relationship with MSE partners, including commercial terms, bidding and pricing strategies, and technical implementation
  • Decide in coordination with the Bidding and Pricing teams strategies that deliver expected ROIs and revenue growth
  • Track detailed performance/KPIs and deliver regular data-driven actionable insights to improve results
  • Succinctly communicate the results, ideas, and business statistics with different stakeholders
  • Ensure the advertiser implements the right Agoda APIs and related technological innovations
  • Be immersed and intimately familiar with the entire booking funnel including the user experience and conversion drivers between the advertiser and Agoda
  • Build long term relationships with advertisers that foster new opportunities and continuous growth in return from advertising dollars

What you’ll need to succeed:

  • Bachelor Degree in Computer Science/Statistics/Math or Engineering or Economics and Finance
  • Business development and/or account management track record with experience in online marketing
  • Fluent in English with strong communication skills (both written and verbal)
  • Self-motivated person with “Get it done!” attitude
  • Passionately analytical with strong ability to think logically and excellent problem-solving skills
  • Proficient in business intelligence tools and data warehouse i.e. SQL, Tableau and MS Excel
  • Ability to effectively communicate, influence and persuade with different levels of stakeholders (including Senior Management) with proven strong commercial acumen
  • Ability to represent Agoda with experience in interacting with external senior level executives
  • Strong analytical and statistical analysis skills to extract insights and recommendations

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

As a participant in our 12-month Corporate Placements Programme in the Small Luxury Hotel's Department, you’re not just gaining hands-on experience at our Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA) Headquarters in Watford – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by contributing to the memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Here’s what you can look forward to as a programme participant:

  • Prepare for a career in hospitality: Embark on a 12-month transformative journey, encompassing a structured framework of learning and development opportunities, business support activities, and ownership of your own project-based initiatives.
  • Gain hands-on operational experience: From day one, you’ll be fully integrated into Team Hilton. Connect with professionals across the business and gain insight into Hilton's partnership with Small Luxury Hotel's. Take the opportunity to gain insight into at least one other business area, paving the way for valuable future relationships.
  • Work on real-world projects: Apply your skills on the job through business-driven projects to reinforce your learning and gain hands-on experience.
  • Develop your skills through world-class training and support: Access Hilton University’s e-learning modules and business library while building knowledge through business-driven projects.
  • Grow with personalised guidance: Benefit from regular feedback and coaching to ensure your progress is supported at every stage of the programme.
  • Hilton Perks: Including our Go Hilton Team Member Travel Program, which provides you with access to heavily reduced hotel room rates for you, your family & friends.
  • Salary & Benefits: £27,500 gross per annum & private healthcare.
  • Location: At our EMEA Headquarters in Watford, with some flexibility depending on team and business need. You will benefit from a subsidised restaurant, a games area and a free in-house gym.

Our Placement Opportunity

You will directly support the new development phase of properties to the partnership, as well as setting up new processes to enhance the support and capabilities for existing participating Hotels. This is an exciting opportunity to support a relatively new area for the business in Partnerships, growing both in number of properties as well as commercially. SLH & Hilton's partnership has grown exponentially since it's launch in 2024 and keeps Hilton at the forefront of the industry.

Here's a glimpse of some of the things you will be working on:

  • Build, review, and launch hotel's back end profiles, helping properties go live and start selling on Hilton channels.
  • Developing and managing communications for both internal and external partners, such as team announcements, newsletters and Property updates.
  • Reviewing and supporting enhancements to global partnership processes, within the team's jurisdiction as well as with other departments engaged in the partnership.
  • Coordinating key events and meeting series for the team.
  • Supporting the needs of hotels, through all key stages of participation life-cycle.
  • Undertaking and analysing regular reporting, to support Director and Brand leadership.
  • Supporting the SLH corporate partnership requests, as well as from global stakeholders and, as necessary, work across the business to develop the solutions needed.

What We’re Looking For

We are seeking individuals who embody the Hilton Values in addition to the following criteria:

  • A strong sense of alignment to our culture and values.
  • A current bachelor’s or master’s student completing a degree that includes a required 12-month year in industry placement.
  • Availability to begin full-time employment on 5th July 2027, for a full-time 12-month placement.
  • You must have the independent right to work in the UK for the full duration of the 12-month placement. Please note that this role is not eligible for visa sponsorship under the Skilled Worker route, so we are unable to consider applications from candidates who would require sponsorship. If you hold a visa or status that allows you to work in the UK full-time without sponsorship (e.g. Settled Status, Pre-Settled Status, where a 12-month work placement is a permitted, required & assessed part of your UK University degree, or other independent work permissions), you are welcome to apply.
  • Fluency in English (spoken and written).
  • You should be able to demonstrate a genuine interest in hospitality with a passion for customer service.
  • Strong communication, collaboration and team work.
  • Project management skills.
  • Attention to detail.
  • Digital literacy - strong Microsoft Office skills (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Word).

Click here to learn more about Hilton's Corporate Placements

Selection Process

Applications are now open—don’t miss your chance to apply! Submissions close on Sunday 1st November 2026.

Our selection process is designed to bring out your best and help us get to know you. It includes:

  • Online assessments.
  • In-person or virtual interview.

While the process is rigorous, it’s also the first step in your personal growth journey with Hilton. If selected, you’ll begin developing the skills, connections, and confidence to thrive in your career.

To ensure every application receives fair consideration, invitations to final-stage interviews will be issued after applications have closed. Please complete each stage promptly and keep an eye on your inbox for updates.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing reasonable adjustments for applicants and employees with disabilities. If you require any support or adjustments during the recruitment process or to carry out the essential requirements of the role, please contact us.

Leading ambitious changes and making a positive impact in the lives of our employees, the People Team is a crucial and rewarding part of the Agoda family.

The Opportunity:

This is a high-impact leadership role responsible for scaling one of Agoda's most critical engineering hiring functions — balancing speed, quality, and long-term talent strategy for the Tech organization. In this role, you will lead a team of TA Partners and Associate TA Partners while collaborating closely with key stakeholders, including Tech Department Leadership and Management, HR Business Partners, and Talent Analytics teams. You will focus on two core areas: driving your team to consistently achieve high-volume, high-quality hiring targets, and leading initiatives that continuously improve the recruitment function.

In this Role, you'll get to:

  • Lead the team to hire to target and remain fully staffed by optimizing sourcing strategy, recruitment funnel, and team structure
  • Own and manage a high-volume, evergreen hiring engine, delivering 100+ quality hires per year in a fast-paced environment
  • Drive improvements to hire quality (measured by objective metrics) through data-driven experimentation
  • Ensure operational excellence across every stage of the recruitment process (position intake, JDs, pre-screening, interview scorecards, offer communication, etc.)
  • Leverage recruitment data and reporting to partner effectively with your team and the broader business, including Tech Leadership
  • Reduce cost per hire while maintaining quality standards
  • Ensure Hiring Managers supported by your team develop strong interviewing skills
  • Develop strategies to build talent pipelines, adapting the bar appropriately to evolving hiring needs
  • Manage, coach, and grow a team of strong recruiters, enabling them to hire game-changers for Agoda
  • Act as a hands-on leader — comfortable diving into the details of sourcing, screening, or data when needed, not just managing from a distance
  • Explore and adopt AI-powered tools to improve recruiter productivity, candidate experience, and overall delivery
  • Lead projects that transform the recruitment function, such as:
  • Defining operational excellence standards for the recruitment process
  • Introducing new assessment tools
  • Building upskilling programs for recruiters
  • Experimenting with new recruitment models and approaches

What You'll Need to Succeed:

Must-Haves:

  • 8+ years of experience in recruitment, with a minimum of 2+ years in team management within a fast-paced, dynamic global environment
  • Proven experience managing high-volume, high-quality evergreen hiring programs (at least 100+ hires/year)
  • Strong ability to leverage data to drive decisions and optimize outcomes
  • Leadership skills to rally recruiters around ambitious targets
  • A strategic mindset with a strong focus on measurable impact, paired with a hands-on approach to execution
  • Continuous improvement mindset with high ownership — proactively identifying inefficiencies rather than reactively
  • Ability to work effectively across multiple senior stakeholders, including Tech Leadership

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Experience hiring for the Southeast Asia market
  • Experience managing relocation-based hiring across multiple international markets
  • Some exposure to leveraging AI tools to improve recruiting workflows or delivery
  • A track record of progression or promotion in previous roles, reflecting the ability to grow with scope and responsibility
  • Exposure to headcount models and resource planning

Additional Requirements:

  • Fluent in English
  • This role is based in Bangkok; relocation support will be provided.

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

As a participant in our 12-month Corporate Placements Programme in our Corporate Wellness Department, you’re not just gaining hands-on experience at our Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA) Headquarters in Watford – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by contributing to the memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Here’s what you can look forward to as a programme participant:

  • Prepare for a career in hospitality: Embark on a 12-month transformative journey, encompassing a structured framework of learning and development opportunities, business support activities, and ownership of your own project-based initiatives.
  • Gain hands-on operational experience: From day one, you’ll be fully integrated into Team Hilton. Connect with professionals across the business and gain insight into Wellness, Spa and Fitness. Take the opportunity to gain insight into at least one other business area, paving the way for valuable future relationships.
  • Work on real-world projects: Apply your skills on the job through business-driven projects to reinforce your learning and gain hands-on experience.
  • Develop your skills through world-class training and support: Access Hilton University’s e-learning modules and business library while building knowledge through business-driven projects.
  • Grow with personalised guidance: Benefit from regular feedback and coaching to ensure your progress is supported at every stage of the programme.
  • Hilton Perks: Including our Go Hilton Team Member Travel Program, which provides you with access to heavily reduced hotel room rates for you, your family & friends.
  • Salary & Benefits: £27,500 gross per annum & private healthcare.
  • Location: At our EMEA Headquarters in Watford, with some flexibility depending on team and business need. You will benefit from a subsidised restaurant, a games area and a free in-house gym.

Our Placement Opportunity

You will collaborate with a team of directors with extensive international experiences in spa, fitness, wellness, and hospitality. Together, you'll contribute to shaping and developing the EMEA wellness strategy across Hilton's multi-brand portfolio.

You will experience the dynamic world of wellness at a corporate level, with hotel visits, and exciting projects across the EMEA region. You'll gain hands-on experience in wellness development, operations, and strategy. You'll support impactful activities and deliverables that drive Hilton's wellness initiatives and enhance guest experiences.

Here's a glimpse of some of the things you will be working on:

  • Creative Contributions: Bring fresh ideas to Hilton's evolving wellness strategy.
  • Organisational Impact: Assist in coordinating wellness activities across EMEA.
  • Project Execution: Lead and monitor projects, presenting findings to the team.
  • Team Presentations: Share updates and insights during weekly meetings and monthly progress reflections.
  • Networking Opportunities: Attend events and connect with professionals across Hilton's EMEA network, from senior executives to hotel spa managers.
  • Social Media Campaigns: Design and run initiatives that promote Hilton's wellness programmes.
  • Collaborative Projects: Partner with other departments to bring wellness concepts into life across Hilton.
  • Hotel Visits: Explore spa and fitness facilities at various hotels to understand operations and guest experiences firsthand.
  • Data and Analysis: Gather and analyse information to evaluate wellness performance, using tools like Excel and PowerPoint.

What is it like being the Wellness Intern at Hilton?

Hear from a Wellness Intern about their time on placement:

"I study Business Management at university, and this placement has been a great opportunity to use skills from a range of my university modules and develop my confidence in a corporate environment. During this role, you will be working with a small team which I find allows you to work on a wide range of tasks which is an excellent opportunity to find out which aspects you enjoy the most which will be beneficial to gaining a job post-graduation. Whilst your team is small, there will be opportunity to work with other departments, giving you the chance to get further insight into what happens across the company. Hilton is a super supportive work environment, and you will have regular opportunities to gain feedback from your managers which will be great for your development".

What We Are Looking For

We are seeking individuals who embody the Hilton Values in addition to the following criteria:

  • A current bachelor’s or master’s student completing a degree that includes a required 12-month year in industry placement.
  • A Hospitality or Business Management degree is preferred.
  • Availability to begin full-time employment on 5th July 2027, for a full-time 12-month placement.
  • You must have the independent right to work in the UK for the full duration of the 12-month placement. Please note that this role is not eligible for visa sponsorship under the Skilled Worker route, so we are unable to consider applications from candidates who would require sponsorship. If you hold a visa or status that allows you to work in the UK full-time without sponsorship (e.g. Settled Status, Pre-Settled Status, where a 12-month work placement is a permitted, required & assessed part of your UK University degree, or other independent work permissions), you are welcome to apply.
  • Fluency in English (spoken and written).
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Exceptionally organised and comfortable prioritising tasks and working to deadlines.
  • Additional European, Middle Eastern or African language skills would be advantageous, although not essential.

Click here to learn more about Hilton's Corporate Placements

Selection Process

Applications are now open—don’t miss your chance to apply! Submissions close on Sunday 1st November 2026.

Our selection process is designed to bring out your best and help us get to know you. It includes:

  • Online assessments.
  • In-person or virtual interview.

While the process is rigorous, it’s also the first step in your personal growth journey with Hilton. If selected, you’ll begin developing the skills, connections, and confidence to thrive in your career.

To ensure every application receives fair consideration, invitations to final-stage interviews will be issued after applications have closed. Please complete each stage promptly and keep an eye on your inbox for updates.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing reasonable adjustments for applicants and employees with disabilities. If you require any support or adjustments during the recruitment process or to carry out the essential requirements of the role, please contact us.

job.job_description:
Job Title

Customer Success Management Principal (Travel Sellers)

Purpose of the Role

Amadeus Customer Success Management Principal (CSMs) empower Travel Sellers to maximize the value of Amadeus solutions, ensuring a higher return on investment and significant business impact. CSMs bring expertise to support customer business expansion, understanding their needs and constraints to promote early adoption and optimal usage of Amadeus products. This enables Amadeus to respond swiftly and accurately to customer needs.

CSMs partner with customers to maximize adoption and ensure they achieve desired business outcomes post-implementation. Key performance indicators (KPIs) for CSMs include customer satisfaction, solution adoption, value delivered to customers, low churn, and growth through upsells. While Account Managers remain the primary point of contact, CSMs guide the post-sales cycle, playing a crucial role in successful sales, renewals, and account expansion.

Depending on the size, complexity, and strategic value of the customer, a CSM may be assigned to one or multiple accounts. CSMs work closely with Account Managers and are integral members of the Extended Account Team.

Roles And Responsibilities

  • Common Accountabilities
  • Technical Proficiency: Ensure the team performs at a high level, recognized for their expertise in their area, and may formally train Specialists/Senior Specialists.
  • Business Insight: Understand how main business drivers impact their area, assess complex problems with broad impact, improve processes, recommend solutions, and develop risk mitigation plans. Communicate complex information effectively.
  • Autonomy: Work with a significant level of independence and collaboration based on management directions, guide projects or contribute to cross-functional projects, and may contribute to resource and budget planning.
  • Facilitate Up-Front Customer Alignment and Goal-Setting
  • Based in Australia to support strategic Travel Agency customers.
  • Participate in internal handover meetings organized by Account Managers to understand the Account Plan and customer context.
  • Coordinate Amadeus roles in engaging customers in goal-setting and design, including meetings with key decision-makers to agree on program KPIs, tracking methods, and program design elements.
  • Co-create success plans with buyers/decision-makers, codifying program value-driving outcomes.
  • Set clear expectations on the engagement model with stakeholders, building a stakeholder map, communicating the role of CSM, and discussing resource requirements and risks based on customer deployment readiness.
  • Ensure Early Adoption and Usage
  • Share progress updates with key buyers/decision-makers on the implementation journey, working with the implementation team.
  • Lead final “go-live” meetings with key administrators and decision-makers post-implementation to align on deployment.
  • Regularly check-in during the first 90 days post-launch, discussing key data points (user/admin login rate, number of active users) and tactically finding ways to boost adoption.
  • Share helpful resources and collateral content with administrators in the early stages to support deployment.
  • Manage Ongoing Customer Health
  • Proactively review key metrics, reach out when they drop below target, and find ways to drive adoption.
  • Conduct monthly, mid-year, and annual business reviews to discuss Amadeus's progress towards value and opportunities for improvement based on the success charter and KPI tracking (via automated dashboards).
  • Play a coordinating support role when customers face technical challenges by activating individuals with relevant expertise and providing progress updates.
  • Support Account Managers in Renewals and Expansion (Upsell)
  • Identify growth or expansion opportunities and engage with relevant teams (Pre-Sales and Account Management).
  • Regularly check in with Account Managers to discuss opportunities for account growth (in line with the Account Plan) and ways to address growth bottlenecks.
  • Support Account Managers in renewals preparation, sharing customer progress towards value (Customer Success Plan) to drive renewals treatment.

Relevant Work Experience

  • Experience in the Travel Industry, with experience in air travel/flights and API/Web Services (desirable).
  • Experience in roles involving significant customer interaction at all levels, with a strong understanding of customer needs and business drivers.
  • Demonstrated ability to advocate for customers internally, with curiosity and knowledge about Amadeus solutions.
  • Ability to develop networks internally and with customers.
  • Bachelor's degree in business or related fields.
  • Previous hands-on experience as Account Manager, Delivery Manager, Customer Care, Product Management, IT Account Management or other similar roles.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Salesforce.com, Qlik, Tableau.

Note: As part of our recruitment process, successful candidates will be required to complete pre-employment screening, which includes a National Coordinated Criminal History Check. Employment offers and ongoing engagement will be subject to the satisfactory completion of this screening.

Diversity & Inclusion

Amadeus aspires to be a leader in Diversity and Inclusion in the tech industry, enabling every employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment, attracting the best talent from all backgrounds, and as a role model for an inclusive employee experience. 

Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer and committed to an accessible recruitment process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law.

Be aware of recruitment scams

Amadeus Group never charges fees, requests payment, or asks for financial information during recruitment. All legitimate opportunities are communicated solely through official Amadeus channels, including our careers website. Any payment request or outreach via unofficial platforms (e.g., WhatsApp, Telegram) should be treated as fraudulent.

job.job_description:
Accor Tech & Digital est le moteur de la tech, des solutions digitales et de la transformation au sein du Groupe. Nos 5 000 talents s'engagent à offrir les meilleures expériences digitales et tech à nos clients, nos hôtels et nos équipes dans 110 pays, et à façonner l'avenir de l'hospitalité.

Accor Tech & Digital, des métiers où l’intelligence est d’abord humaine !



Description du poste

Accor Tech & Digital, c’est le laboratoire d’innovation et de transformation technologique du leader mondial de l’hôtellerie.

Nos équipes, appelées Heartist®, concentrent le meilleur de l'hospitalité et le meilleur de la tech & du digital.

Notre ambition : offrir à nos clients des expériences personnalisées, mémorables et durables.

Ici, nous faisons naître de nouvelles façons de voyager dans chacun de nos 5 500 hôtels, au plus proche de nos 100 millions de clients dans 110 pays.

Ici, nous sommes au cœur d’un formidable terrain de jeu de transition technologique et de conception de produits digitaux et de services, pour nos clients et nos équipes en hôtels.

Ici, votre champ d’application ne connaîtra aucune frontière.

Alors, avec nous, osez avoir un impact sur le monde !

C’est ici que vous attend votre plus grand défi :

Rôle & Enjeux

Sous la responsabilité du VP Product Distribution API, AI Connectivity & Content Platform, le Product Director Content Platform est responsable du pilotage stratégique et opérationnel d'un périmètre produit centré sur la donnée de contenu hôtelier, levier clé de la performance des canaux de distribution directs d'Accor.

Au terme de plusieurs années de refonte du socle technique, la tribe entre dans une nouvelle phase : passer d'une logique projet/delivery à un Product Operating Model centré sur la valeur mesurable, la proximité business et l'exploitation de l'IA pour élever la qualité et la personnalisation du contenu.

Ce rôle est déterminant pour :

  • Ancrer la culture produit au sein d'équipes qui ont majoritairement opéré en mode projet
  • Mesurer l'incrément de valeur apporté par chaque évolution du périmètre content
  • Embarquer les équipes business et les hôteliers dans une vision produit long terme
  • Accélérer l'exploitation de l'IA sur un périmètre à fort potentiel : traduction, enrichissement, personnalisation, aide à la saisie

Périmètre Produit

Le Product Director Content Platform couvre trois produits interdépendants :

  • HCM (Hotel Content Manager) : solution permettant aux hôteliers de saisir et gérer le contenu descriptif et photos exposés sur les canaux de distribution directs. Utilisateurs principaux : équipes hôtelières, responsables contenu propriétés.
  • Content API : API fournissant les informations descriptives des hôtels (contenu, search par destination ou critères) aux canaux de distribution. Utilisateurs principaux : équipes Distribution, partenaires, canaux directs.
  • PIM (Product Information Manager) : solution marché (InRiver) de gestion centralisée de la donnée produit hôtelière, socle de référence du contenu. Utilisateurs principaux : équipes data, content ops, exploitation hôtelière.

Votre mission :

1. Product Strategy & Vision

  • Construire et porter la vision produit long terme du périmètre Content Platform, alignée avec la stratégie Distribution du groupe
  • Définir et faire évoluer le positionnement produit de chacune des trois solutions (HCM, Content API, PIM) en lien avec les objectifs business
  • Traduire la stratégie en roadmap priorisée, arbitrée et lisible pour toutes les parties prenantes
  • Être l'ambassadeur du périmètre auprès du leadership Accor et des partenaires externes

2. Product Operating Model

  • Piloter la transition vers un modèle produit orienté valeur : définir les métriques de succès (qualité du contenu, taux de complétude, impact sur la conversion, satisfaction hôteliers)
  • Mettre en place les rituels et outils permettant une visibilité continue sur le delivery et l'impact business
  • Développer la proximité avec les équipes business (Distribution, E-commerce, Revenue Management) et avec les hôteliers pour ancrer les décisions produit dans des problèmes réels mesurés
  • Standardiser les pratiques produit au sein de l'équipe (user stories, critères d'acceptation, release notes, métriques)

3. Management & Accompagnement des Équipes

  • Manager et faire monter en compétences les Product Owners du périmètre
  • Définir clairement les rôles, les zones de responsabilité et les modes de collaboration avec les architectes fonctionnels, les équipes business et les équipes tech
  • Favoriser une culture d'ownership, de rigueur et de curiosité produit au sein de l'équipe
  • Identifier les besoins en ressources et en compétences pour accompagner la croissance du périmètre

4. IA & Innovation Contenu

  • Porter l'ambition IA du périmètre : traduction automatique des contenus hôteliers, enrichissement IA, aide à la saisie intelligente pour les hôteliers, détection des lacunes de contenu
  • Initier et piloter des POC et phases de discovery pour explorer la personnalisation du contenu selon les segments clients
  • Collaborer avec les équipes data et les équipes Connectivity for AI Channels pour maximiser l'exploitation des contenus hôteliers dans les canaux émergents (agents IA, moteurs de recommandation, etc.)
  • Exploiter les avis clients comme signal de qualité et source d'amélioration continue du contenu

5. Product Marketing & Valeur Perçue

  • Développer le volet Product Marketing du périmètre : formaliser la proposition de valeur de chaque produit, documenter les features exposées, outiller les équipes commerciales et les hôteliers
  • Rendre visible l'impact des évolutions produit auprès des parties prenantes internes et externes
  • Concevoir et animer un processus de collecte et de priorisation des demandes d'évolution fonctionnelle (hôteliers, équipes Distribution, partenaires)

Contexte & environnement

  • Groupe hôtelier international, périmètre stratégique au cœur de la distribution directe
  • Environnement en transformation : passage d'une culture projet à une culture produit
  • Collaboration étroite avec les tribus Distribution API, E-commerce, NGA/NGD et les équipes tech
  • Rattachement direct au VP Product Distribution API, AI Connectivity & Content Platform

Qualifications

Et vous ?

Compétences techniques & produit

  • Solide expérience en gestion de produit digital B2B ou B2B2C (5 ans minimum)
  • Maîtrise du cycle de vie produit : discovery, delivery, mesure d'impact
  • Expérience avec des périmètres data, contenu ou PIM appréciée
  • Bonne compréhension des APIs et des enjeux d'intégration dans un écosystème distribué
  • Familiarité avec les outils et approches IA appliquées au contenu (génération, traduction, enrichissement)

Compétences comportementales

  • Orientation valeur et impact : capacité à définir des métriques, à mesurer l'incrément et à prendre des décisions basées sur la donnée
  • Proximité business : aisance à naviguer entre équipes produit/tech et interlocuteurs business ou hôteliers
  • Leadership : capacité à embarquer, fédérer et faire grandir une équipe
  • Rigueur et structure : capacité à rendre lisible un périmètre complexe et à produire des livrables clairs et actionnables
  • Curiosité et ouverture à l'IA : envie de construire dans un environnement où l'IA devient un levier central

Informations supplémentaires

Et nous, quels sont nos engagements ?

- Sur le monde

  • Accor s’engage pour le monde qui nous entoure, avec une culture employeur forte centrée sur le développement de nos 300 000 talents.
  • Nous adoptons une approche d'amélioration continue pour réduire l'impact du digital sur l'environnement dans l’ensemble de nos projets.

- Sur votre carrière

  • Nous permettons à tous nos collaborateurs de maîtriser leur équilibre vie-perso / vie-pro et leur offrons les moyens de façonner leur environnement de travail à leur image.
  • Les parcours de formation et d’évolution sont définis à la fois individuellement et collectivement pour que nous grandissions ensemble, au quotidien.

- Concrètement, chez Accor Tech & Digital :

  • Télétravail possible plusieurs jours par semaine depuis la France et options de travail flexibles : travaillez depuis chez vous, nos bureaux, ou même nos hôtels et espaces de coworking grâce à Worklib.
  • Chaque mercredi après-midi, consacrez votre temps à du travail de fond et à votre développement personnel.
  • Travail dans un environnement multiculturel et anglophone.
  • Amélioration continue & formations : Hackathons, partenariats technologiques d’exception, talent management dédié, certifications et plateforme de formation dédiée.

et aussi,

  • Programme ALL - Heartist® : tarifs préférentiels et offres flash pour des séjours et expériences inoubliables dans toutes nos adresses Accor et chez nos partenaires, dans le monde entier.
  • Programme de volontariat Heartist® for good : 1 jour offert sur votre temps de travail pour vous engager en faveur d’une association.
  • Un CSE qui vous accompagne dans le financement de vos activités culturelles et sportives.
  • Forfait Mobilité durable pour l’utilisation d’un moyen de déplacement « vert » ou un dispositif « vélo de fonction » en partenariat avec Zenride
  • Prise en charge des abonnements de transports publics urbains entre le domicile et le lieu de travail, au barème de la Loi Finance.
  • Tickets restaurant de 11€ en valeur faciale.
  • Une mutuelle obligatoire financée à 50% par Accor sans frais supplémentaire en cas d'adhésion de vos ayants droits.
  • Sans oublier des conditions de travail attractives avec des espaces de travail collaboratifs, des restaurants, espaces de jeux ou encore des espaces de bien-être et de Sport sur site ou grâce à Gymlib.

Votre talent et votre motivation sont nos seuls critères de sélection.

Nous valorisons la richesse des diverses nationalités, personnalités et parcours professionnels.

Nous savons nous adapter aux besoins spécifiques de nos collaborateurs, notamment ceux en situation de handicap.

Nous encourageons toutes les candidatures, sans distinction de genre, alors osez postuler !

Pour nous, le recrutement est avant tout une histoire de rencontres.



Cette mission vous attire ? Postulez et nous vous proposerons :

  1. Un échange avec notre équipe recrutement pour vous présenter les lignes essentielles du poste ou vous orienter vers le rôle qui peut vous correspondre,
  2. Un ou des entretiens avec les managers et les membres de l’équipe,
  3. Pour certains postes, vous pourriez également être amené à effectuer un test ou une étude de cas, ainsi qu’un questionnaire sur votre personnalité et vos motivations.
  4. Un entretien final avec notre équipe des Ressources Humaines pour échanger sur la culture de notre Groupe, l’environnement de travail, notre programme de formation et les perspectives de carrière, ainsi que les différents avantages du Groupe.
  5. Un feedback personnalisé.

Job Description:


The Product Manager (PM) defines the strategic vision and roadmap for products, creating new features from concept to completion. The PM leads cross-functional teams, ensuring alignment with strategy, commercial, and support teams throughout the product development lifecycle. By selecting key features, optimizing the roadmap, and leveraging market research, the PM drives product direction while utilizing agile, customer-centric approaches to maximize business value and deliver an exceptional user experience.


Duties & Responsibilities


  • Define product features and align them with the overall product strategy. Establish and evolve the product roadmap, prioritizing features that deliver business value.
  • Oversee the creation of new features, balancing customer needs with budget and technical constraints. Work closely with engineering to ensure technical specifications meet the desired user experience.
  • Use in-depth industry knowledge, customer relationships, and market research to inform product decisions and enhancements.
  • Lead collaboration across teams (Product, Commercial, Marketing, and Strategy) throughout the product lifecycle, driving continuous improvement and ensuring alignment with business goals.
  • Plan and execute product releases, ensuring timely delivery while managing cross-product dependencies.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to drive product adoption, meet key performance indicators (KPIs), and deliver customer value.
  • Foster an agile, customer-centric team culture focused on problem-solving and fast delivery. Inspire continuous learning and development within the team.


Required qualifications:

  • Experience as a Product Manager or in a similar role, bringing roadmap features from concept to completion while following a product management process.
  • Proven ability to prioritize features by business value while balancing customer needs, budget, and technical constraints.
  • Experience working with engineering to translate requirements into technical specifications.
  • Experience collaborating across Engineering, Commercial, Marketing, and Strategy teams.
  • Experience with agile, customer-centric development, product releases, and cross-product dependencies.
  • Experience with product management tools like Aha!, Jira, or similar.
  • Ability to use market research and customer feedback to inform decisions and to track KPIs and adoption.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.


Preferred qualifications:

  • Familiarity with LLMs and AI-assisted tools to support product management and prototyping (coding skills not required).
  • Knowledge of the airline, travel, or fare distribution industry.
  • Experience with data or B2B technology products.


Compensation:

Salary Range: $104,000 - $125,000


The disclosed salary range applies uniformly across all U.S. locations and is not modified based on geographic differentials.

job.job_description:
Job Summary

The Strategic Sourcing Manager leads complex sourcing initiatives, commercial negotiations, supplier selection, and vendor management across multiple categories. This individual contributor manages the end-to-end sourcing process, from defining business requirements and identifying suppliers through competitive sourcing, evaluation, negotiation, contracting, and ongoing supplier performance management. The role partners with stakeholders across the organization to develop sourcing strategies and recommendations that support cost optimization, risk mitigation, service improvement, and revenue-generating opportunities. The Strategic Sourcing Manager applies market intelligence, financial and commercial analysis, and sound judgment to solve complex sourcing challenges and influence business decisions. The role also identifies opportunities to improve procurement processes, analytics, systems, and AI-enabled workflows.

Responsibilities

  • Lead complex, end-to-end sourcing initiatives across multiple vendor categories, including supplier discovery, business-requirement development, competitive sourcing, proposal evaluation, stakeholder alignment, negotiation, and contract execution.
  • Develop and execute requests for information, requests for proposal, and requests for quotation that clearly communicate business requirements and enable objective supplier-selection decisions.
  • Lead commercial negotiations and administer supplier agreements to achieve favorable terms, mitigate risk, and support the operational and financial priorities of Choice Hotels, its franchisees, and internal stakeholders.
  • Build and manage supplier relationships that create measurable value through cost optimization, service improvement, innovation, risk mitigation, and revenue-generating partnership opportunities.
  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to define requirements, develop sourcing strategies, evaluate supplier performance, resolve complex issues, and ensure suppliers meet contractual and operational expectations.
  • Analyze supplier proposals, market intelligence, spending patterns, financial information, and business cases to develop well-supported procurement recommendations and inform leadership decisions.
  • Monitor supplier performance and identify opportunities to strengthen service, commercial outcomes, governance, and long-term vendor value.
  • Exercise independent judgment in developing sourcing approaches and solutions to complex procurement and supplier challenges.
  • Identify and implement improvements to procurement processes, contracting workflows, analytics, systems, and AI-enabled tools that increase efficiency, consistency, and decision quality.
  • Lead or contribute to strategic initiatives and special assignments supporting Procurement Services priorities.

Qualifications

Employment Experience

  • Minimum of seven years of experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, contract negotiation, supplier management, category management, or a related business discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex requests for information, requests for proposal, and requests for quotation from requirements development through supplier evaluation and selection.
  • Demonstrated experience leading commercial negotiations and administering supplier agreements.
  • Experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to define complex business requirements and develop sourcing strategies.
  • Experience performing financial, commercial, spend, market, supplier, or business-case analysis to develop recommendations and support decision-making.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple sourcing initiatives or complex negotiations with competing priorities.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Proficiency in developing proposal analyses, supplier evaluations, negotiation materials, business cases, and executive-ready recommendations.
  • Ability to apply AI-enabled and other productivity tools to improve research, analysis, planning, workflow efficiency, and execution.
  • Working knowledge of procurement, contract-management, strategic-sourcing, or supplier-performance tools.

Additional Skills & Competencies

  • Strong commercial negotiation and stakeholder-influence skills.
  • Strong analytical judgment and structured problem-solving capability.
  • Clear written, verbal, interpersonal, and presentation communication skills.
  • Strong project management, prioritization, organization, and follow-through.
  • Ability to operate independently while building effective cross-functional and supplier relationships.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, supply chain management, finance, procurement, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.

SALARY RANGE

The salary range for this position is $99,919 - $117,000. In addition to the annual salary, this role is eligible for an annual bonus based on the terms of Choice's Management Incentive Plan (MIP).

Choice prioritizes our associate wellbeing by offering a comprehensive benefits program that is both competitive and flexible to help you achieve your wellbeing goals - here are just a few:

  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Leave and paid time-off for holidays, vacation, personal, family, volunteer, sick, jury duty, bereavement, military, and religious observance
  • Financial benefits for retirement and health savings
  • Employee recognition programs
  • Discounts at Choice hotels worldwide

About Choice

Choice Hotels International, Inc. (NYSE: CHH), is one of the largest lodging franchisors in the world. With 7,500 hotels in 45+ countries and territories, we offer a range of high-quality lodging options in the upper upscale, upper midscale, midscale, extended stay, and economy segments. We’re the hotel company for those who choose to bet on themselves — the striver, the dreamer, the entrepreneur — because that’s who we are, too.

At Choice, we are united by the simple belief that tomorrow will be even better than today — for associates, our company, and our franchisees. At our worldwide corporate headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, at our technology center in Scottsdale, Arizona, and through our associates around the globe, every voice is heard and every idea is listened to, no matter what area of the company they come from. We are united in supporting the entrepreneurial dreams of our thousands of franchise owners, which propels us forward — giving our work at Choice a purpose larger than our business.

Our corporate office locations:

North Bethesda, MD — Located at Pike & Rose, our worldwide headquarters is less than 15 miles from Washington, D.C., one block away from the North Bethesda Metro station, with easy access to I-495, complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Scottsdale, AZ — Located at the northwest corner of Loop 101, the Scottsdale office is home to our technology, eCommerce and customer service organizations, with easy access to complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Minneapolis, MN — Select roles are based in our Minneapolis office on Highway 394, near the intersection with Highway 100, only five minutes from downtown.

Field/Remote — Select roles designated as field/remote will require associates to work from a home office, connecting virtually with Choice team members and leadership on Zoom, with possible required travel depending on the role.

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Senior Analytics Partner, People Analytics

Introduction to Team

Our Corporate Functions are made up of teams that support Expedia Group, including Employee Communications, Finance, Legal, People Team, Inclusion and Diversity, and Global Social Impact and Sustainability.

As part of Expedia Group’s People Analytics team and sitting within our Analytics Partnership function, the Senior Analytics Partner is a senior expert and consultant who shapes and delivers the analytics agenda for our divisions and COEs. You operate comfortably at both the strategic and tactical levels, pairing big-picture thinking with a hands-on approach to analysis and execution. You put the traveler first by ensuring we leverage analytics to enable data-driven strategies and decision making that realize business impact.

In This Role, You Will

Analytics Delivery

  • Translate business and people priorities into analytics opportunities and strategies that drive measurable business impact.
  • Independently lead end-to-end analytics projects: clarify the business question, scope work into a clear SOW, translate complex business problems into the right analytical approach, iterate with stakeholders, and deliver executive-ready narratives and recommendations.
  • Turn complex data and analyses into simple, compelling visualizations and stories that inform decisions for both technical and non‑technical audience
  • Develop measurement strategies and define, build, and test new metrics that inform org health assessment, talent reviews, QBR/MBRS, and program/product impact.
  • Document and automate recurring analytics tasks and deliverables to improve efficiency, quality, and speed.
  • Serve as the bridge between customers (HR, business) and product team to help productize analytics into AI-native, simplified product experiences that are tied to real business decisions.

Partnerships and Consulting

  • Partner closely with HR Business Partners, Talent Partners, COEs, and senior business leaders see around corners and influence strategies and decisions through data.
  • Partner on identifying and delivering strategic analytics, metric development, and org health and talent insights to drive org effectiveness and business impact.
  • Empower partners to self‑serve using our people insights products, while personally taking on the more complex and ambiguous analytics needs.
  • Design and deliver engaging, consumable learning labs, office hours, and coaching to upskill partners on data literacy, product fluency, and AI-assisted analytics.
  • Support engagement surveys with division- or COE-level survey insights interpretation, delivery, and recommendations for actioning.
  • Manage intake and prioritization of analytics requests, using clear principles and deep business/org knowledge to ensure on-time delivery of high-impact work.
  • Coordinate feedback sessions for product design, UAT, pilots, and GTM strategy.

People Analytics Collaboration

  • Raise the bar with your Analytics Partners through peer feedback, reusable code and templates, thought leadership on new analytical methods, and business context to achieve a holistic view in driving business impact.
  • Partner with Machine Learning Science to validate and scale models for optimal business value.
  • Monitor data quality and needs, partnering with Data Engineering on new data sources, issue resolution, and table optimization.
  • Surface user needs and feedback to Product team to shape the roadmap, influence feature prioritization, and continuously improve the UX of our products; define business requirements for product development and enhancements.
  • Deliver knowledge exchange sessions for the entire People Analytics team to share best practices, project outcomes, and advance team awareness and capabilities.

Mindset & EG Behaviors

Role

You role model Expedia Group’s Behaviors, which define how we make decisions, collaborate, and deliver value for travelers and partners:

  • We Put the Traveler First – you anchor analytics priorities and contextualize insights in the impact they have on the teams who serve travelers and partners.
  • We Think Big – you see around corners, identifying opportunities others don’t, bring innovative approaches and ideas, and approach work through a systems lens
  • We Operate with Excellence – you raise the bar on execution through strong planning, documentation, analytics automation, and continuous improvement
  • We have an Ownership Mindset – you look at the business as if it’s your own, thinking beyond your role to build organizational data-driven decision making.
  • We Succeed Together – you foster collaboration and candor—giving feedback directly, challenging and debating respectfully, disagreeing when necessary and committing fully to deliver as one team.

Experience And Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in People Analytics and consulting/stakeholder-facing roles
  • Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in Analytics/Data Science, Industrial/Organizational Psychology, or related quantitative/behavioral field.

Technical Skills

  • Fluent in R or Python, SQL, Tableau; experience with Qualtrics, DataBricks preferred.
  • Proven ability working with large, unstructured data, extracting from multiple data sources (e.g., Workday, engineering productivity, sales), and combining into the required datasets for analytics and modeling.
  • Advanced understanding of common data models, their assumptions, the business questions they can best answer, and data to best support the model.
  • Demonstrated experience in using advanced statistical methods (e.g., predictive modeling; ONA a plus) to solve a variety of business challenges, selecting statistical techniques without using unnecessarily complex methods.
  • Experience in designing and executing employee listening programs and results.
  • Proficiency in using AI to accelerate analytics (e.g., framing problems, prompt engineering, assessing quality of AI-generated code).
  • Proven capability to produce a high volume of analytics work at pace, with strong attention to detail.

Consulting/Partnering Skills

  • Demonstrated business acumen, problem-framing, and critical thinking; ability to align people analytics with business strategy and guide decision making.
  • Exceptional storytelling and communication skills, producing clear, simple, and executive‑ready narratives independently and presenting to senior leadership.
  • Experience operating in complex, global, matrixed organizations as a high‑influence individual contributor who leads through expertise, influence, and relationships rather than direct authority.
  • Success in building trusted relationships with HR partners and business leaders at all levels.
  • Resilience, agility, and comfort with ambiguity in a fast-changing environment.

The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $173,000.00 to $242,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $277,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Benefits And Perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.
