Overview

Gain real-world business, accounting, and financial training that will teach you all aspects of financial management pertaining to running a successful business. Our program fully prepares you to become a Controller/VP of Finance of your own financial operation. A key partner in our organization, the Controller/VP of Finance oversees all aspects of financial management and provides balance to the partnership formed with the marketing and operational pieces of our business. As an Accountant, you can count on a career path with a clear beginning and an open end that’s full of opportunities. With training, development, mentoring, and a culture of promotion from within, you’ll always be progressing in your career.

This position is located at 320 Pronghorn Trail, Bozeman, MT 59718

We Offer

  • Competitive Compensation - This position offers targeted 1st year annual compensation of $60,000 with an average 40 hour work week.
  • Paid Time Off, starting with 20 days off per year
  • Health, Dental, Vision insurance; Life Insurance; Prescription coverage
  • Employee discounts on car rentals, car purchases and much more!
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match and profit sharing

Enterprise Mobility is a leading provider of mobility solutions, owning and operating the Enterprise Rent-A-Car, National Car Rental and Alamo Rent A Car brands through its integrated global network of independent regional subsidiaries. Enterprise Mobility and its affiliates offer extensive car rental, carsharing, truck rental, fleet management, retail car sales, as well as travel management and other transportation services, to make travel easier and more convenient for customers.

Privately held by the Taylor family of St. Louis, Enterprise Mobility together with its affiliate Enterprise Fleet Management manages a diverse fleet of 2.4 million vehicles and accounted for nearly $39 billion in revenue through a network of more than 9,500 fully-staffed neighborhood and airport rental locations in more than 90 countries and territories.

At Enterprise Mobility, you will have the chance to run your own financial operation and provide balance to the marketing and operational pieces of our business. We offer a comprehensive development program where you will work closely with sales and marketing, human resources, risk management, real estate strategy, and more to produce excellence in customer service, growth strategies, operating efficiencies, and profitability.

As your understanding of our business grows and your ability to make solid business decisions develops, you will soon take on a supervisory role within a business management team. With our entrepreneurial philosophy, there is truly nothing holding you back.

Responsibilities

Starting as an Accountant, you are executing accounting procedures and principles that will lead to financial statement, preparation, and financial analysis.

  • Prepare financial statements
  • Perform branch audit evaluations
  • Assemble bank reconciliation and account schedule
  • Prepare journal entries, expense accruals and allocations
  • Participate in a timely and accurate month-end closing process
  • Assist personnel with questions regarding accounting policies and procedures
  • Analyze income statements fluctuations
  • Provide process improvement and cost saving ideas
  • Managing financial records, assist in financial reporting
  • Support budgeting and forecasting
  • Conduct audits and ensure compliance
  • Collaborate with other departments
  • May be responsible for T& E reports, coding, account classification and reimbursement amounts
  • May be responsible for preparation and sales and other tax returns

Equal Opportunity Employer/Disability/Veterans

Qualifications

  • Must have a Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance.
  • Will consider college students within 1 semesters of graduation with a degree in Accounting or Finance.
  • Must have basic proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Word.
  • Flexibility for career advancement could include relocation outside local area/state.
  • Must have a valid driver's license with no more than 2 moving violations and/or at-fault accidents on driving record in the past 3 years.
    • No drug or alcohol related convictions on driving record (DUI/DWI) within the past 5 years.
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States and not require work authorization sponsorship by our company for this position now or in the future.

job.job_description:
Organization- Hyatt Corporate Office

Summary

The Opportunity

Hyatt Hotels Corporation is seeking a strategic Regional Manager of Hotel Finance to support financial operations and performance across a select group of managed hotels within a designated region. Reporting to the Director of Performance Optimization, this role combines operational finance oversight with analytical support, serving as a key business partner to hotel leadership and regional operations. In collaboration with the Regional Director of Finance, this role is assists in the accountable for driving profitability, operational performance, and compliance, while serving as a key business partner to RDOF, Field Operations leadership, and property-level Directors of Finance. The Regional Manager of Hotel Finance ensures financial integrity, supports hotel operations, and leads initiatives that enhance both performance and long-term value creation.

This position is ideal for a finance professional with strong hotel experience who is ready to expand their impact across multiple properties, contribute to regional strategy, and support data-driven decision-making. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list since 2013. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

  • Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on-site fitness center
  • A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption
  • Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

The Role

The Regional Manager of Hotel Analytics plays a key supporting role in driving financial performance and operational alignment across a defined group of managed hotels. With a strong foundation in hotel finance and a sharp analytical mindset, this leader provides actionable insights, ensures financial discipline, and supports compliance across the region.

Reporting to the Director of Performance Optimization, the Regional Manger of Hotel Analytics acts as a connector between property-level finance teams and above-property leadership. Through a hands-on, service-oriented approach, they help translate strategy into execution, support hotel openings and transitions, and contribute to regional initiatives that enhance profitability and efficiency.

This role requires a collaborative mindset, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous improvement. While not the primary strategic lead, the Regional Manager of Analytics is a trusted partner who brings financial clarity and operational support to help hotels achieve their goals and uphold Hyatt’s values.

Financial Oversight & Operational Support

  • Partner with hotel Directors of Finance and General Managers to support financial operations, budgeting, forecasting, and capital planning.
  • Assist in resolving property-level control issues and ensuring compliance with internal policies and management agreements.

Regional Analytics & Performance Insights

  • Conduct monthly financial reviews and trend analysis across assigned hotels.
  • Support the Regional Director of Finance and Operations leadership with data-driven recommendations to improve profitability and efficiency.
  • Assist in setting performance targets and evaluating progress against goals.

Compliance & Technical Guidance

  • Ensure adherence to Hyatt’s accounting principles, internal controls, and financial reporting standards.
  • Provide guidance on cash management, capital expenditures, and audit readiness.
  • Support hotels in understanding and complying with balance sheet reviews, AR compliance and World of Hyatt.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with regional and corporate teams in finance, tax, legal, HR, and operations to address hotel-specific needs.
  • Participate in regional meetings, training sessions, and site visits to support hotel teams and foster alignment.
  • Contribute to talent development efforts by mentoring finance leaders and supporting succession planning initiatives.

Additional Responsibilities Include

  • Support Regional DOF with oversight of assigned portfolio to ensure accounting principles are followed in all hotels, as well as compliance with management agreement terms, such as Management Fee calculation, Performance tests, F&E provisions, contracting authority and audit requirements
  • Opportunities to participate in Hyatt’s Diversity & Inclusion activities

Qualifications

Experience Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or non-related field with appropriate experience
  • Minimum 5-7 years of progressive hotel finance experience, including property-level leadership roles.
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational abilities.
  • Ability to travel regionally as required (40%-50%).

Experience Preferred:

  • Experience with Oracle and Hyperion

The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all-encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary.

We welcome you:

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.

The salary range for this position is $98,000 - $125,000. This position is also eligible to earn incentive awards, an annual bonus, monthly or quarterly incentives, etc.

The final pay rate/salary offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level, and other qualifications for the role, as well as the location of the performance of work. Pay for the successful candidate will meet local requirements, including the local minimum wage rate.

We value our relationships with recruitment partners and require that agencies contact us first before submitting any candidates. Hyatt will not be responsible for any fees and obligations associated with unsolicited submissions unless a formal agreement is in place.

job.job_description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Team mission

As a Senior Account Executive Lead you will report to our Head of Sales EMEA and lead a team of 10 Account Executives spread across Paris, Amsterdam, and Dubai offices. Together, they're on the front line of supply growth: prospecting, acquiring, and signing the region's best attractions and activity partners, building relationships that last, and turning every deal into a strategic supply advantage for GetYourGuide.


Your mission

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of 10 Account Executives to consistently hit and exceed new supplier acquisition and revenue targets.
  • Build a disciplined operating rhythm: weekly pipeline reviews, forecast accuracy checks, activity and conversion dashboards, call coaching, and deal strategy sessions.
  • Drive sales process excellence: identify and scale opportunities across the funnel ( outreach tactics, pitch quality, objection handling, pricing/terms negotiations, pitch, deal cycle management)
  • Ensure high-quality CRM hygiene and data integrity; leverage sales tools and software (including CRM like Salesforce and sales enablement tools) for forecasting, capacity planning, and performance insights.
  • Partner cross-functionally with BizOps, Supply Marketing, Legal, and Finance to remove roadblocks, accelerate onboarding, and scale repeatable playbooks.
  • Lead hiring, onboarding, and continuous development of Bar raiser; foster an inclusive, high-trust, high-ownership team culture grounded in ethics and customer impact.


Your toolkit

  • 5+ years in B2B sales including 2+ years leading high-velocity new business teams (e.g., SDR/AE or field acquisition) with a strong record of exceeding targets.
  • Strong operational leader: builds repeatable systems, improves KPIs across the funnel (activity, conversion, cycle time, forecast accuracy), and scales best practices.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English; native-level fluency in French
  • Exceptional coach and communicator: uplevels objection handling, negotiation, and executive storytelling; runs effective deal reviews and call coaching.
  • Data-driven and process-oriented: comfortable with sales tools and software—including CRM (e.g., Salesforce) and sales enablement tools—for forecasting and performance management.
  • Skilled negotiator with a win-win mentality; comfortable creating constructive tension and closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals.
  • Deep curiosity and business acumen: ties proposals to ROI, efficiency, and risk; adapts messaging to supplier leadership.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, international and entrepreneurial environment; models high ethics, resilience, and accountability.
  • Travel industry, marketplace, or travel tech experience is a plus; a relevant network in tourism is an advantage.


Extras that give you an edge

  • You’re energized by AI: You make time to work with AI, and you bring your team along. You build intuition through hands-on trials, help your team do the same, and turn what you all learn into real improvements to how the team works.


How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary

We are seeking a Lead Delivery Specialist - Offer Optimization & Revenue Management to join our global Delivery team, where innovation knows no borders. This team delivers high-impact dynamic pricing and revenue optimization solutions that empower airlines to modernize commercial strategy and drive profitable growth. It connects advanced data science, operations research models and complex systems to turn airline data into scalable, real-world business outcomes. With an inclusive culture and flexible work environment, we work together with boldness, curiosity and commitment so we can all win together.

As a Lead Delivery Specialist, you will act as a subject matter expert across the end-to-end implementation lifecycle for Dynamic Pricing and Revenue Management applications. You will partner closely with airline analysts, Operations Research teams, developers and project leads to deploy, fine-tune and optimize specialized analytical models. This role requires deep airline domain expertise, strong analytical leadership and the confidence to guide customers through complex business process transformations.

What You'll Do

  • Lead solution delivery across the full implementation lifecycle, from Project Kick-Off and Business Process Assessment through customer care transition.
  • Partner with Operations Research teams to deploy, validate and fine-tune Dynamic Pricing and Revenue Management models for optimal airline customer performance.
  • Guide data gathering and perform end-to-end data validation checks across all implementation stages to ensure high solution quality and model integrity.
  • Train customer analysts on software interfaces, business processes and model outputs while leading project teams and mentoring junior business analysts.
  • Support RFP responses, define Work Orders, contribute to sales operations estimation and communicate customer best practices back to Solution Management.

What You'll Bring

Required qualifications

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in airline Revenue Management and Pricing, including hands-on experience with Origin & Destination (O&D) RM applications and associated machine learning or operations research models.
  • Deep functional expertise in Dynamic Pricing, Offer Optimization, Competitive Benchmarking and dynamic forecasting/optimization techniques.
  • Solid technical proficiency in database concepts, SQL and NoSQL environments (such as Google BigQuery or MongoDB).
  • Experience with major travel distribution or reservation systems (Sabre, Amadeus or Galileo).
  • Willingness to travel 30–40% of the time for customer meetings and implementation milestones.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Technical experience with analytical tools such as Python, R, VBA, SQL Developer, Studio 3T or Compass.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce CRM tools.

Benefits That Support You

Our benefits reflect how we value you – with competitive compensation, generous time off, health and well-being support, and opportunities to grow.

For Employees Based In The US, Benefits Include

  • Five weeks of paid time off (PTO), 12 paid holidays, paid volunteer time off each quarter and an

Additional Company-wide Year-end Break.

  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision insurance coverage, with Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options.
  • Paid parental leave and family-building support, including adoption reimbursement.
  • A 401(k) retirement savings plan with an immediate 6% company match.
  • Access to Emotional Wellbeing Solutions, the Calm app, virtual medical care and wellness programs.
  • A hybrid work arrangement with three days in the office and two days working remotely to support work-life balance.
  • Global diversity and inclusion programs.

Eligibility and coverage are subject to applicable benefit plans and company policies.

job.job_description:
Founded in the Queensland outback in 1920, Qantas has grown to be Australia’s largest regional, domestic, and international airline. Qantas has a range of subsidiary businesses that support the overall operations of the Group. The Qantas Group’s main business is the transportation of customers and freight using two complementary airline brands — Qantas and Jetstar — operating regional, domestic, and international services.

Job Description

  • Coordinate end-to-end finance support for Charters across commercial, operational and finance teams for Qantas Airlines.
  • Lead network and portfolio insight that strengthens commercial decisions and performance.
  • 24-month fixed term, full-time role based at Mascot HQ.

Reporting to the Head of Finance – Planning and Performance, you’ll provide dedicated finance business partnering across Charters, network analysis and portfolio performance. As Charters operates across multiple business areas, you’ll bring together financial inputs and perspectives from commercial, operational and finance stakeholders, providing an integrated view across the charter lifecycle—from initial opportunity and aircraft allocation through delivery and financial close.

This highly visible, hands-on role combines commercial insight, performance analysis and practical process ownership. You’ll bring structure and accountability to complex decisions, identify emerging issues early and help stakeholders turn insight into action.

What You'll Deliver

  • Coordinate the end-to-end financial view of Charters across commercial, operational and finance teams, creating clear ownership of decisions, hand-offs and actions.
  • Own and improve charter pricing and costing models, supporting customer enquiries, commercial proposals and contracting with clear assumptions, risks, approvals and finance sign-offs.
  • Deliver network and portfolio analysis, and improve performance reporting and planning processes, to support commercial decisions, prioritisation and broader strategic initiatives.
  • Own budgeting and forecasting for charter revenue, maintaining a credible outlook based on volume, pricing, timing and operational assumptions.
  • Partner with finance systems and profitability stakeholders to strengthen data, inputs, allocations and route and charter profitability reporting.

What You'll Bring

  • 6+ years in FP&A, commercial finance or finance business partnering, with a track record of converting complex financial and operational information into insights that influence senior decisions and improve business outcomes.
  • Strong driver-based forecasting and modelling capability including experience with pricing, costing and scenario analysis.
  • A track record of influencing senior leaders, constructively challenging assumptions and moving discussions from analysis to action
  • Experience partnering with operational business units in a large, complex organisation, navigating multiple stakeholders, interdependencies and competing priorities.
  • Clear communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to present analysis and recommendations in a practical, accessible way.
  • CA or CPA qualified or equivalent, with tertiary qualifications in finance, commerce or a related discipline.

Why Qantas?

You’ll join a team where creativity and passion are encouraged. Our people come together to allow us to dream big and deliver successfully.

There are many different opportunities across our team, which means you’ll be able to grow both personally and professionally at Qantas. Your development is a priority for us – so that you can maintain the high standards our customers have come to expect and can continue to develop over time. You’ll be supported from day 1 with on the job training and coaching as well as our formal training opportunities. While you may start in this role, we’ve got a great track record of supporting our people to take their career in so many different directions, the destinations are endless.

The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel. 

  • We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave and the option to purchase additional paid leave for eligible employees.
  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.
  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan. 

Qantas is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity and inclusion. By coming to work for us, you'll be part of an organisation that encourages diversity, supports charities and environmental initiatives and ensures equal opportunities for all. If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at the time of application. Your personal information will be kept confidential in compliance with relevant privacy legislation.

If you're ready for a culture that will challenge and excite you, submit an application today.

Priceline, part of Booking Holdings Inc., has been a leader in online travel for over 25 years. Through our innovative technology, we make travel affordable and accessible for all, helping millions of travelers each year experience the moments that matter most. Whether it’s a much-needed getaway, wedding, reunion, graduation, or rooting on a favorite team—those are the moments that nobody should miss out on.
We welcome people who are at the top of their game, who want to learn and grow with others and who take their work seriously – but not themselves. We’re building an inclusive and uniquely talented team to make sure our customers can be there for all of life’s important moments. Come join us!
job.job_description:
This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in-office.

Whether it’s hotels, rental cars, flights, cruises or packages, our Lines of Business develop the relationships we need to generate great deals and then get them to Priceline customers - so they can experience all the moments that matter to them.

Why This Job’s a Big Deal

As a Strategic Partnerships Manager, you’re at the heart of driving the company’s future growth in the ultra-competitive B2B travel sector. This role is a unique opportunity to make a direct, visible impact on revenue by acquiring high-value partnerships and expanding the company’s footprint among key industry players.

You’ll serve as a trusted representative of the brand, shaping how it’s perceived among partners, customers, and competitors alike. This position puts you at the crossroads of strategy and execution, giving you a stake in shaping product direction, customer experience, and go-to-market plans—while also delivering real, measurable results.

What makes the role truly compelling is the level of responsibility and cross-functional influence: you’ll manage the full business development cycle, from first contact through onboarding, integration, and long-term partnership growth. You’ll collaborate cross-functionally with diverse teams and lead major commercial deals. Leveraging your industry insights, analytical skills, and creativity, you’ll solve complex challenges, capture new opportunities, and ensure ongoing value for both new and existing partners in a fast-moving environment.

In This Role You Will Get To

  • Work alongside Senior Management on a portfolio of high-value partnerships, developing and maintaining key partnership relationships, identifying growth opportunities, and managing legal contractual and renewal requirements.
  • Build, nurture, and expand relationships with both existing and new high-value partners in the travel sector to strengthen the company’s market position and grow your professional network.
  • Drive regional sales growth by managing the entire business development lifecycle—prospecting new accounts, onboarding partners, and continually developing established accounts for long-term success.
  • Stay at the forefront of industry trends and the competitive landscape.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams spanning product, customer service, finance, and marketing, giving you broad exposure and influence within the organization.
  • Ensure all partners (new and existing) experience ongoing support, addressing their evolving needs and driving exceptional Partner satisfaction which directly influences KPI’s.
  • Use your analytical and negotiation skills to solve commercial challenges and craft tailored solutions in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Maintain responsibility over your portfolio and activities, planning and prioritizing sales efforts to meet deadlines, deliver results and exceed growth targets.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent, in any relevant field preferably in Business, Marketing, or Technology.
  • A minimum of 5 years work experience in business, marketing, technology or project management.
  • You have a deep understanding of the travel, hospitality, or bed bank landscape, leveraging a strong professional network. Your strategic mindset helps you spot commercial opportunities ahead of the curve.
  • Bonus: Experience in the corporate travel sector is a plus.
  • You enjoy championing your organization’s brand and can connect with stakeholders at all levels, both internally and externally. You’re equally comfortable leading complex deal negotiations, problem-solving in real time, or collaborating cross-functionally with product, customer service, finance, and marketing teams to develop solutions that deliver real value.
  • Analytically minded and highly organized, you expertly prioritize and juggle multiple projects within fast-paced environments, always meeting deadlines and delivering results. Above all, you’re a proactive team player recognized for your integrity, professionalism, and unwavering commitment to customer satisfaction.
  • Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust.
  • The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics is essential.

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. In addition to a competitive base salary, certain roles may be eligible for an annual bonus and/or equity grant.

The salary range for this position is $100,000-$120,000.

Who We Are

WE ARE PRICELINE.

Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.

Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.

We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.

Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.

If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!

Flexible work at Priceline

Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.

Perks & Benefits At Priceline

Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:

Health & wellness coverage including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources

Generous time off including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days

Work/life support including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)

Financial security programs such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts

Signature travel perks including employee-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits

Additional perks & discounts like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits

A people-first culture with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together

Specific benefits and programs vary by location.

Inclusion is a Big Deal!

To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.

Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.

Applying for this position

We're excited that you are interested in a career with us. For all current employees, please use the internal portal to find jobs and apply.

External candidates are required to have an account before applying. When you click Apply, returning candidates can log in, or new candidates can quickly create an account to save/view applications.

職務概要（Job Summary）

Manager, Digital Consulting, MDS Japan & Guamは、アジア太平洋地域（中国を除くAPEC地域）において、Marriott Digital Services（MDS）プログラムに参加するホテルのデジタル施策運営を日常的に管理・推進する責任を担います。

対象となるサービスには以下が含まれます。

  • SEO（検索エンジン最適化）
  • GEO（生成AI向け検索最適化）
  • HWSコンテンツ管理
  • 有料広告（Paid Media）運用
  • パフォーマンス分析およびレポーティング

本ポジションはホテル側の主要窓口として機能し、社内チームとの連携を図りながら、すべての成果物が期限通りに提供されることを確実にします。

また、プログラム戦略の策定、期待値の設定、パフォーマンスレポートの提供、高品質なサービス提供の責任を負います。

本ポジションは Director, Digital Consulting, MDS Japan & Guam にレポートします。

MDSチームは、世界中のマリオットブランドホテルに対しデジタルソリューションを提供しています。MDSプログラムに加盟しているホテル向けに、グローバルデジタル組織内のインハウスエージェンシーとして幅広いデジタルサービスを提供しています。

応募資格（Candidate Profile）

学歴・経験

  • 経営学、マーケティング、ホスピタリティ、または関連分野の大学卒業者が望ましい
  • デジタルマーケティング分野で4年以上の経験必須
  • ホテル業界またはオンライン旅行代理店（OTA）での経験があれば尚可
  • 広告代理店等でのアカウントサービス／クライアントサポート経験が望ましい
  • ネイティブレベルの日本語およびビジネスレベルの英語力必須（社内外コミュニケーションで使用）

主な業務内容（Core Work Activities）

  • 業務・プロジェクト・方針の管理
  • SEO、有料広告、レポーティングを活用し、一貫性のあるデジタル戦略を提供する
  • プログラム施策を管理・進捗追跡し、成果物を期限内に納品する
  • 請求対象業務・非請求業務の工数管理を行い、収益性を確保する
  • ホテルとの長期的な関係を構築・維持する
  • プログラム期間中のキックオフミーティングや定期レポート会議を主導する
  • オンサイト・オフサイト施策を活用し、戦略的キーワード最適化を推進する
  • ホテルからの問い合わせや課題に迅速に対応し、必要に応じてDirectorへエスカレーションする
  • データ分析結果を解釈し、プレゼンテーション形式でホテルへ報告する
  • プログラムの成果をモニタリングし、必要に応じて戦略変更を提案する
  • 契約更新時期を把握し、継続契約を積極的に提案する
  • ホテル目標達成に向けて追加サービスや施策を提案する
  • 顧客満足度調査および契約更新目標を達成する
  • 日本・グアム地域向けのデジタルサポート（マーケティングキャンペーン、OTAマーチャンダイジング、各種プラットフォーム更新等）を実施する
  • グローバルデジタル施策導入に伴うホテル向けトレーニングを提供する
  • Marriott.comのパフォーマンス向上に関する地域横断プロジェクトを支援する
  • オペレーション支援
  • MDSオペレーションチームと連携し、高品質かつ期限内の施策実行を確保する
  • 業務プロセス改善のためフィードバックを提供する
  • ホテルからの意見収集を行い、サービス品質向上に活かす
  • 新入社員のオンボーディングおよび教育支援
  • 社内外の特別プロジェクトへ積極的に参加する
  • MDSサポートチームとの継続的なコミュニケーションを行う
  • ホテルの状況や実績情報を最新状態で管理する
  • MDSの組織文化や職場環境改善活動を支援する
  • 研修やカンファレンスへ参加し専門知識を向上させる
  • デジタル業界に関する学習機会を積極的に追求する
  • その他
  • 関連する社内外会議へ参加する
  • マネージャーや同僚へ適時情報共有を行う
  • アイデアや方針を分かりやすく整理して説明する
  • 問題解決手法を活用し意思決定を行う
  • 社内顧客や各部門責任者との良好な関係を維持する
  • 効率的な時間管理を行う
  • ホテルやオーナーからの問い合わせ対応を行う
  • 上司から指示されたその他合理的な業務を遂行する

求められるコンピテンシー（Management Competencies)

リーダーシップ

  • 適応力（Adaptability）
  • コミュニケーション能力（Communication）
  • 問題解決・意思決定能力（Problem Solving & Decision Making）

実行力

  • チームワークの構築と貢献
  • 結果志向
  • 計画立案・組織化能力

関係構築

  • 同僚との関係構築
  • 顧客との関係構築
  • グローバルマインドセット

人材育成

  • 人材育成支援（Talent Management）

専門性・基礎能力

  • 継続的学習
  • ビジネス感覚（Business Acumen）
  • テクニカルスキル
  • 基本的なPCスキル
  • 数理的思考力
  • 傾聴力
  • 読解力（日本語、英語）
  • 文書作成能力 （日本語、英語）

job.company_description:
Travelport is the intelligent infrastructure powering modern travel retail. Operating in more than 160 countries, we connect airlines, hotels, and travel sellers through a global platform that simplifies travel retail and improves the traveler experience from search to servicing.
Under CEO John Mangelaars, Travelport is evolving beyond its GDS roots into an AI-enabled travel platform designed to close the gap between inspiration, and real-world booking and servicing. At the heart of this evolution is Travelport TripServices, our cloud-native API suite, enabling customers to search, sell, book and service travel through rich global content, intelligent automation and modern retailing capabilities.
job.job_description:
SENIOR PRODUCT MANAGER, SEARCH & PRICE | PRODUCT | LONDON - UK


Travel obsessed? Big tech fan? Hey, you’re in good company. If you want to be part of the industry that makes the world go round, then look no further.

Travelport is the brains behind lots of your travel bookings- plane, car or hotel. Our technology is used to book that magical holiday, infamous bachelorette party or long overdue school reunion. While we can’t solve mosquito bites or lost luggage, we can simplify a lot of the technical parts of travel, and we’re looking for the best thinkers to help us do it.

We’re hiring right now for a Senior Product Manager, Trip Services Search & Price! Search for #Travelport on LinkedIn and hear from our amazing team.


How you’ll make an impact:

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to play a pivotal role in the evolution of Travelport Trip Services, the complex, high-volume APIs which power how agencies, partners, and developers search, price, book and service Travelport’s multi-source content. Reporting to the Director of Product, Trip Services, you will help shape the future of this part of Travelport’s Product Portfolio.

In this role, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for Search and Price within Trip Services, ensuring customers can quickly find, compare and accurately price the right offers across NDC, ATPCO/EDIFACT and low-cost carrier content. You will combine deep product management craft, commercial acumen, and technical understanding (APIs, data, and AI principles) to drive adoption and deliver measurable value for our customers and for Travelport.

This is a senior, hands-on role for a strategic builder: someone who thrives in ambiguity, leads through influence, and loves solving complex customer problems, delivering value and measuring the outcome. You will translate vision into actionable outcomes across engineering, architecture, design, data, support and commercial teams, turning complex platform capabilities into simple, high-performing API experiences.


Your role in action:

  • Own the end-to-end lifecycle for search and price capabilities in Trip Services, from discovery through release to customers, building out significant new capabilities over time.
  • Define the strategy and roadmap for Search and Price, balancing content breadth, relevance, response time, price accuracy and cost to serve.
  • Through a deep understanding of agency, OTA and TMC workflows and the airline distribution ecosystem, identify problems and opportunities for smarter shopping and offer presentation.
  • Drive the evolution of multi-source offer aggregation across NDC, ATPCO/EDIFACT and LCC content, including branded fares, fare families and ancillaries, so customers can compare like for like.
  • Work collaboratively with product and technology teams to develop an optimised and aligned set of epics across the Trip Services customer journey.
  • Define, track, and analyse key metrics such as look to book, price to book accuracy, response times, shopping cost and API adoption, and feed learnings back into the product development process.
  • Partner with engineering and architecture on performance, scalability and shopping efficiency, including caching, filtering and intelligent request optimisation.
  • Explore and apply AI and machine learning to improve relevance, ranking and personalisation of search results.
  • Work with airline and content partners to understand new capabilities and translate them into clear Trip Services product priorities.
  • Ship software successfully, managing influence across product, engineering, commercial, and support teams through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus building.
  • Clearly communicate product strategy, benefits and results to a wide range of audiences, from immediate stakeholders to customers and the wider business.
  • Act as a senior voice for Search and Price with key customers and partners, and mentor and support other product managers in the team.


Could this be you?

  • Significant product management experience, developing complex products in travel technology, marketplace, or platform environments and delivering large-scale products.
  • A track record of setting product strategy and crafting compelling narratives that connect product vision to business outcomes, influencing senior stakeholders and aligning cross-functional teams.
  • Strong knowledge of air shopping and pricing, including fares, fare rules, taxes, branded fares and NDC offer and order concepts. GDS or airline distribution experience is a strong advantage.
  • Strong understanding of API ecosystems, automation and data analytics, with experience owning API or developer-facing products and the technical fluency to engage confidently with engineers on performance, latency and scalability trade-offs.
  • Strong understanding of using data and metrics to understand customers and make data driven decisions on strategy and planning.
  • Demonstrated ability to improve customer experience, through understanding customer needs and requirements and driving successful adoption of highly used technology solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience of using AI to shape customer value, with familiarity with AI-native product design, intelligent automation and emerging LLM-based capabilities.
  • Helps build a strong product culture, raising the bar on product craft across the team.
  • Professionally represents the product through compelling product demos internally and externally.
  • Ability to convincingly connect larger business goals to feature backlog items, keeping delivery aligned with Product strategy.


Discover why our teams love working here:


Where do we start! Our benefits package includes:


We offer a package that includes 25 days annual leave per annum, hybrid working model, pension contribution, private medical, life assurance and personal travel insurance. We believe all employees contribute to the success of the company and should be able to share in that success, which is why all jobs are eligible to participate in our bonus program with any payouts being subject to individual and company performance.


Search for #lifeattravelport & #travelportGDL for our employee stories on LinkedIn!


Your journey at Travelport starts here.


Our application process is quick, easy, and hassle-free. Apply in just a few minutes!


We are an equal opportunities employer and will consider all qualified applicants purely on their skills and abilities. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation, if needed.

job.job_description:
Job description:

Why Wyndham?

By joining Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, you will play an integral role in our mission to make hotel travel possible for all. You’ll be part of the largest hotel franchise company in the world, where we strive to deliver the best value to our owners and guests. Most importantly, you’ll be entrusted to live our unique Count on Me culture, set by our core values of integrity, accountability, inclusive, caring and fun. At Wyndham, we provide all team members the opportunity to grow through best-in-class training and career development, leadership training, mentorship opportunities and educational support.  Supporting our team members is a top priority, which is why we offer competitive compensation and benefits, vacation, team member appreciation days, workplace flexibility and much more.  At Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, we value and embrace a culture of diversity, equity and inclusion that supports team members of all backgrounds and experiences. We can’t wait to welcome you!

The Role

Manager of Franchise Operations supports the overall mission of the Franchise Operations team by nurturing relationships with owners by understanding their individual goals and needs while recognizing every hotels in unique. The MFO optimizes owners’ performance by delivering innovative solutions and relevant resources using our experience and network across the organization. 

What you'll do
  • Compel owner involvement to achieve performance goals and drive franchisee satisfaction by embracing an Owner First mindset that directly aligns with our Count on Me service culture values: Being Responsive, Being Respectful and Delivering a Great Experience.
  • Develop trusted relationships with external customers in order to educate, motivate and influence adoption of tools and resources to elevate performance.
  • Execute Wyndham Hotels and Resorts initiatives, projects and related tasks. 
  • Execute a Portfolio Management strategy that improves overall performance through consistent communication, contact and touchpoints with hotels and owners.
  • Analyze data to develop and execute strategies to expand revenue generation opportunities, drive growth and performance while improving quality performance and increasing customer satisfaction with each hotel. 
  • Drive NRG through retention and development opportunities.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders. 
  • Provide accountability to the organization through documentation, follow up and system reporting. 
  • Achieve annual service, performance and KPI goals in order to impact WHR profitability.
  • Take ownership of personal and professional development.
  • Project a positive image and promote the value of Wyndham Hotels & Resorts.
  • Respond to one off requests from the business that are property specific within in indicated SLA. 
You'll be successful if you have
  • Position entails exposure to interior and exterior hotel property environments inclusive of the multilevel properties, inclement weather (i.e. stairs, onsite restaurants, pool and exercise facilities, etc.) 
  • Seamless continuation of work while traveling on company business (i.e. conduct work using mobile devices, from hotels, while at trade shows, and/or across varying time zones when necessary). 
  • 90% travel with flexible work schedule. 
  • Work under pressure with extended hours/days when required, in order to meet deadlines.
  • This position requires the ability to stand and be on your feet for approximately 50% of the day. 
  • This position requires the ability to sit and drive long distances for approximately 75% of the week. 
  • Qualified candidates must be able to lift a minimum of 10 lbs. 
  • This position requires the ability to bend, twist, squat, push/pull while inspecting properties. 
Required Qualifications/Experience
  • 2 to 4 years of progressive experience in a hotel or a related field required, preferably, property and corporate management experience. 
  • 4 year college degree (Preferred). 
  • Multi-property experience.
  •  Industry certifications (Preferred).
  • Proficient in Microsoft Suite (i.e. Office, Word, PowerPoint, Excel etc.)

Company Overview

Wyndham Hotels & Resorts is one of the largest hotel franchise companies in the world by number of properties with approximately 8,400 hotels across over 95 countries on six continents. Through our network of approximately 869,000 rooms appealing to the everyday traveler, Wyndham commands a leading presence in the hospitality industry. Headquartered in Parsippany, N.J. with offices around the world in London, Shanghai, Buenos Aires, Dubai and more, Wyndham employs more than 2,000 corporate team members worldwide who are dedicated to the Company’s mission of making hotel travel possible for all. Supporting thousands of franchisees and a growing global portfolio of 25 hotel brands—think household names like Wyndham, La Quinta, Ramada, Days Inn and Super 8—Wyndham team members are a widespread group of individuals with diverse interests and backgrounds. Our unique Count on Me culture, commitment to flexibility and core values of Integrity, Accountability, Inclusivity, Caring and Fun are just part of what continues to make Wyndham an award-winning best place to work.

Wyndham Hotels & Resorts is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

 

Job Location: Remote in the United States, Remote, Remote, Remote  00000
Employment Status: Full-time

 

Compensation & Benefits

For U.S. based positions only, the expected pay range for this position is $80,000 - $105,000 annually.

 

Wyndham Hotels & Resorts carefully considers a wide range of factors when determining compensation such as work location, background, experience, and performance. Compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case.

 

In addition to the base pay, this role is eligible to receive an incentive payment pursuant to the Franchised Development US Incentive Plan with a 15% annual target, subject to the terms of the Plan.

 

Wyndham Hotels & Resorts is committed to attracting, motivating, and retaining talented team members who align with our company’s core values. We are proud to reward our full-time team members with comprehensive benefit programs and resources which include:

  • Health insurance with HSA and FSA options
  • Dental insurance
  • Vision insurance
  • Life/AD&D insurance
  • Short- and Long-Term Disability coverage
  • 401(k) with generous company match
  • Vacation time- Accrue 2.019 hours of paid vacation per week
  • Paid holidays- 11 Core Scheduled Paid Holidays with potential additional paid days off as business operations and the calendar permit (e.g. in 2026, there is an additional 7 days of paid company closure).
  • Paid sick leave accrued as state and local laws require
  • Additional paid time off in the form of one volunteer day, bereavement time, as well as jury duty time.  

 

Participation in any of the benefit plans and programs made available to team members is subject to satisfaction of eligibility requirements. More information can be found on Our Benefits Page.  Wyndham Hotels & Resorts reserves the right to amend or terminate any benefit plan or program at any time in accordance with applicable law.

 

We are accepting applications for this position through 08/01/2026.

job.job_description:
Achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. Grow your career, access top-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network.

Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.

Description

The Senior Strategic Sourcing Manager plays a key role in developing and executing sourcing strategies that create long-term value for the business. This position leads supplier strategy development within their assigned portfolio, drives cost optimization opportunities, and supports operational excellence through data-driven decision making. The role partners closely with internal stakeholders and suppliers to improve performance, mitigate risk, and strengthen the end-to-end supply chain. Success in this role requires strong business acumen, analytical thinking, supplier relationship management expertise, and an innovative mindset.

Core Accountabilities/Key Responsibilities

  • Define and execute supplier-specific sourcing strategies that drive competitive advantage, improve supplier performance, and deliver sustainable cost savings.
  • Lead contract negotiations, internal stakeholder and supplier relationship management activities to secure reliable, cost-effective goods and services.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, including union leadership, and supplier partners to resolve complex sourcing challenges and support business objectives.
  • Utilize scenario planning and supply chain analysis to identify opportunities that improve efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance service levels.
  • Prepare bid comparisons, financial summaries, recommendation materials, supplier scorecards and stakeholder presentations.
  • Proactively identify and respond to issues that may create contractual exposure, operational risk, or union grievances.
  • Maintain dashboards, reports, and key performance indicators that provide visibility into industry and market trends, and supply risks.

Please note: This is a hybrid role based in Chicago, requiring 3 days in office.

Qualifications

What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):

  • 2+ years of experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, supply chain, or a related business function.
  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • Experience with contract and supplier management initiatives.
  • Experience supporting travel, hospitality, hotels, or related procurement categories.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and drive cost optimization across sourcing activities.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without sponsorship
  • Successful completion of interview required to meet job qualification
  • Reliable, punctual attendance is an essential function of the position

What will help you propel from the pack (Preferred Qualifications):

  • Experience in scenario planning and sourcing analytics.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience in demand forecasting, supply chain analytics, and requirements management.
  • Demonstrates an understanding of the capabilities and limitations of generative AI tools and effectively leverages them for research, analysis, content creation, and problem-solving.
  • Applies critical thinking to validate AI-generated outputs while adhering to company policies related to responsible AI use, data privacy, and security

The base pay range for this role is $81,795.00 to $106,602.00.

The base salary range/hourly rate listed is dependent on job-related, factors such as experience, education, and skills. This position is also eligible for bonus and/or long-term incentive compensation awards.

You may be eligible for the following competitive benefits: medical, dental, vision, life, accident & disability, parental leave, employee assistance program, commuter, paid holidays, paid time off, 401(k) and flight privileges.

job.job_description:
AI & Business Intelligence Program Manager I Tripadvisor

About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

The AI & Business Intelligence Program Manager leads the end-to-end execution of data strategy and AI initiatives across Tripadvisor’s Travel Experiences. Positioning yourself at the intersection of business intelligence, product, and customer operations, you will translate complex machine learning models, predictive traveler trends, and generative AI features into tangible operational strategy. You will maintain program momentum, unblock technical and cross-functional teams, and regularly deliver high-level BI and performance updates to executive leadership.

Job Location: Hybrid

This role is a hybrid position that requires 2/3 days per week in our London Office.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive Executive & Business Updates: Establish clear reporting cadences for leadership, translating AI model performance, traveler engagement trends, and BI dashboard metrics into executive-ready status updates.
  • Orchestrate AI & BI Roadmaps: Direct complex, cross-functional programs spanning Data Engineering, AI/ML, Product, and Traveler CX teams to ensure business intelligence initiatives land on time.
  • Deliver Operational Momentum: Maintain project management rigor across data pipelines, predictive search features, dynamic pricing models, and AI support systems—tracking milestones and holding dependencies accountable.
  • Translate Data into Strategy: Partner with CX and Product leadership to convert traveler behavior data and BI reporting into actionable operational changes that reduce friction across the booking and trip lifecycle.

  • Develop a strong understanding of Japan’s travel market and competitive landscape.

Partner & Ecosystem Development

Preferred

You know how to create opportunities rather than wait for an RFP. You can win new clients, grow strategic accounts and build multi-stakeholder account plans. You also understand that success in Japan requires local relationships, cultural awareness, persistence and trust.

Financially astute, you manage budgets with precision and adapt to evolving conditions with agility. You ensure compliance with quality and brand standards, while proactively implementing initiatives that enhance guest satisfaction and protect our reputation.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Role Summary

Agoda is looking for a strategic, data-driven leader to steer our global marketing investments. In this role, you aren’t just spending a budget; you are managing a global P&L. You will bridge the gap between high-level financial targets and granular marketing execution, ensuring every dollar spent maximizes long-term profitability. You will define our global market strategy, own our Lifetime Value (LTV) frameworks, and lead a high-performing team to outpace the competition in a high-velocity travel market.

This position grants you a "seat at the table" for Agoda’s most critical commercial decisions. You will use machine learning and predictive analytics to solve the "game theory" of the online travel industry, where pricing and loyalty change by the hour.

What You Will Do

  • P&L Stewardship: Drive marketing investment strategies to meet Finance P&L targets, balancing short-term volume with long-term margin optimization.
  • Strategic Growth Strategy: Define and execute Agoda’s global growth roadmap, identifying market opportunities and responding to competitor moves in real-time.
  • Investment Orchestration: Coordinate marketing spend across all digital channels (Performance, Brand, Meta) to ensure a cohesive and efficient global footprint.
  • LTV & Unit Economics: Together with the data science team, own and refine our definition of Lifetime Value (LTV); use these insights to shift the business toward high-value customer acquisition.
  • Forecasting & Modeling: Lead business forecasting efforts to predict market shifts and proactively adjust investment levels.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as the primary liaison between Marketing, Corporate Strategy, Product, Finance and Supply to align and execute cross-functional initiatives.
  • Team Development: Lead and mentor a team of analysts, fostering a culture of rigorous experimentation and "get-things-done" ownership.

Experience & Skills

  • Analytical Rigor: Exceptional ability to translate complex data sets into actionable business strategies. Expertise in SQL, Excel, or data visualization tools is expected.
  • Commercial Acumen: Strong background in Revenue Management, Forecasting, Pricing, or Growth Equity. You understand how marketing levers impact the bottom line.
  • Strategic Mindset: Experience defining 1–3 year growth strategies in a global, fast-paced e-commerce or OTA environment.

How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

The Specialist, Treasury will have responsibility for managing all debt and lease activities in Delta's Treasury Management System. Additional responsibilities to include ownership of Delta's banking counterparty risk model and analysis of bank fees. This position requires finance and technical acumen along with the ability to partner with multiple internal and external stakeholders.

  • Input new debt and lease transactions into Delta's Treasury Management System, FIS Quantum. This involves partnership with the Capital Markets and Financial Reporting teams to understand the contractual terms of the transaction and translate those into Quantum to ensure that deals are tracked and accounted for properly.
  • Ongoing management of debt and lease deals in Quantum including debt service payments, interest rate resets and oversight of monthly accruals
  • Support the Treasury Services team by posting accounting entries to SAP
  • Utilize Bloomberg to manage Delta's banking counterparty risk model to monitor the financial health of the institutions where Delta holds cash deposits
  • Review and process trustee fee invoices
  • Utilize Redbridge Hawkeye to analyze and identify any discrepancies related bank fees
  • Prepare Delta's debt maturity ladder on a quarterly basis
  • Maintain amortization schedules for debt issuance costs in Delta’s Treasury management system
  • Prepare and distribute debt compliance certificates in accordance with lending agreements on a quarterly basis
  • Deliver ad hoc reporting and analysis for Financial Reporting and Capital Markets
  • Respond to external audit requests including EY audit deliverables, SOX compliance activities, debt and lease payment support, and process walk throughs

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States.
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency.
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.
  • High level of attention to detail
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment partnering with individuals outside both the department and company.
  • A minimum of 3 years of relevant experience
  • Strong project management, organizational, and prioritization skills
  • Candidate must be a self-learner with the ability to pick up new technologies and provide tangible results.
  • Understanding of Finance and Accounting fundamentals
  • Must be proficient in the use of Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Outlook

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting or Business is preferred
  • Experience with a Treasury Management System, Bloomberg knowledge is a plus
  • Proficiency with SAP
  • Experience with corporate debt and lease instruments

Benefits And Perks To Help You Keep Climbing

Our culture is rooted in a shared dedication to living our values – Care, Integrity, Resilience, Servant Leadership, and Teamwork – every day, in everything we do. At Delta, our people are our success. At the heart of what we offer is our focus on Sharing Success with Delta employees. Exploring a career at Delta gives you a chance to see the world while earning great compensation and benefits to help you keep climbing along the way:

  • Competitive salary, industry-leading proﬁt sharing program, and performance incentives
  • 401(k) with generous company contributions up to 9%
  • Paid time off including vacation, holidays, paid personal time, maternity and parental leave
  • Comprehensive health beneﬁts including medical, dental, vision, short/long term disability and life beneﬁts

  • Holistic Wellbeing programs to support physical, emotional, social, and financial health, including access to an employee assistance program offering support for you and anyone in your household, free financial coaching, and extensive resources supporting mental health
  • Domestic and International space-available flight privileges for employees and eligible family members

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Principal Product Manager, Communications & Intelligence

Introduction To The Team

Expedia Group is seeking a Principal Product Manager, Comms & Intelligence to lead strategy and execution for the capabilities that make our customer communications smarter, more personalized, and more measurable. This role sits at the intersection of CRM, marketing technology, and applied AI owning how we turn customer data into better-targeted, better-timed, and better-performing communications across email, push, SMS, in-product, transactional, and emerging channels.

As an individual contributor at the Principal level, you will act as the senior technical and strategic voice for data- and AI-driven communications, partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Marketing, Analytics, Legal, and Privacy teams to shape outcomes across the broader CRM and Communications portfolio.

In This Role You Will

  • Define the product vision and roadmap for communications intelligence — audience insights, personalization models, channel/send-time optimization, and performance measurement.
  • Drive the evolution of customer data signals (behavioral, transactional, engagement) into actionable inputs for journey orchestration and targeting.
  • Partner with Data Science and Engineering to build and scale models for personalization, propensity, and next-best-message/channel decisioning.
  • Own the measurement and experimentation framework that quantifies communication effectiveness and informs prioritization.
  • Drive responsible use of AI/ML in communications, balancing automation, personalization, and customer trust and compliance.
  • Act as a technical and strategic escalation point for cross-team tradeoffs involving data quality, identity, consent, and model performance.
  • Align senior stakeholders around priorities, risks, and measurable engagement and business outcomes.
  • Mentor other Product Managers on data-informed product craft and analytical rigor, without formal management authority.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree with 12+ years of industry product management experience, or a master’s degree with 10+ years of experience, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Significant product management experience, including senior or lead individual-contributor work spanning data, analytics, or AI-driven products.
  • Experience in CRM, customer engagement, marketing technology, or communications/messaging products.
  • Strong understanding of customer data, personalization, experimentation, attribution, and privacy/consent frameworks.
  • Technical fluency across APIs, data models, ML/AI concepts, and platform architecture.
  • Strong executive communication and stakeholder-influence skills — able to lead through data-backed persuasion rather than formal authority.
  • Track record of using data and experimentation to drive measurable improvements in customer engagement outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience defining and scaling communications intelligence capabilities across multiple channels, including audience insights, journey orchestration, personalization, send-time optimization, and next-best-message or channel decisioning.
  • Depth in experimentation design, attribution, measurement strategy, and data-driven prioritization for customer engagement products.
  • Experience partnering with Data Science and Engineering to apply AI/ML models to real-world personalization, propensity, targeting, or communication optimization products.
  • Demonstrated leadership in responsible AI/ML adoption, including operationalizing model performance, data quality, identity, privacy, consent, and customer trust considerations.
  • Track record of aligning Product, Engineering, Data Science, Marketing, Analytics, Legal, and Privacy stakeholders around complex tradeoffs and measurable business outcomes.

The total cash range for this position in San Jose is $242,000.00 to $338,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $387,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role. Organization- Hyatt Corporate Office

Summary

The Opportunity

Hyatt Hotels Corporation seeks an enthusiastic Director, Strategic Initiatives to join our Growth Strategy & Analytics department. In this role, you will collaborate closely with Growth leadership and cross-functional partners across Development, Brand, Finance, Operations, Commercial, and other teams to translate Hyatt’s growth strategy into tangible initiatives and measurable outcomes. You will be instrumental in helping bring Hyatt’s strategy to life across the organization by driving alignment, monitoring progress, strengthening execution discipline, and advancing practical AI-enabled capabilities that improve decision-making and operational efficiency. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list since 2013. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

  • Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally

KAYAK is looking for a NetSuite / Salesforce / FloQast Administrator to join our Enterprise Applications team within Finance. You'll be the day-to-day owner of configuration, user administration, and integration health across our core finance and revenue systems — the person who actually knows why a saved search broke, why a workflow stalled, or why a sync between NetSuite and Salesforce didn't fire. This role rewards curiosity and precision: you don't need to arrive as a NetSuite expert, but you do need to want to become one, and you need to be the kind of person who double-checks a config change before it touches production. You'll work closely with Finance, Accounting, Sales Ops, and Engineering, and partner with senior systems analysts and architects on the bigger roadmap items — but the daily craft of keeping these systems accurate, well-documented, and running smoothly is yours.

This role will be required to work from our Concord, MA or Cambridge, MA office at least 3 days per week.

In This Role, You Will

  • Administer day-to-day configuration of NetSuite, Salesforce, FloQast and Blackline: user setup/deactivation, roles and permissions, saved searches, SuiteAnalytics workbooks/dashboards, Salesforce flows and validation rules, troubleshooting issues within Salesforce.
  • Serve as backup administrator for Expensify, supporting user provisioning, system configuration, synchronization issues, and end-user troubleshooting
  • Build and maintain NetSuite SuiteFlow workflows and troubleshoot existing SuiteScript customizations — you don't need to write scripts from scratch on day one, but you should be comfortable reading one, tracing what it does, and knowing when to escalate to a developer.
  • Triage and resolve support tickets from Finance and general employees related to expense reports, financial records, and account access, digging into root cause rather than just closing the ticket.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot integrations between NetSuite and Salesforce — including iPaaS/middleware tools and direct API/SFTP data feeds — escalating to engineering when needed.
  • Support month-end and quarter-end close by ensuring system data accuracy, running reports, and resolving reconciliation discrepancies.
  • Support the month-end close by managing file-based data transfers to the external reporting platform, validating successful loads, and troubleshooting exceptions with the Reporting team
  • Perform sandbox testing and validate NetSuite's release upgrades against existing customizations and integrations before anything touches production.
  • Maintain user access lists and perform basic access reviews to support audit, SOX, and compliance needs.
  • Create and maintain clear documentation, quick-reference guides, and training materials — you take pride in writing something a new teammate could actually follow without asking you a follow-up question.
  • Partner with senior systems analysts/architects to implement approved process changes and provide hands-on support during testing and hypercare for larger rollouts, without owning roadmap prioritization.

Please Apply If You Have

  • 2-4 years of hands-on administration experience with NetSuite, Salesforce, and/or Expensify (or similar ERP/CRM/expense platforms) — OR strong ERP/CRM administration fundamentals elsewhere plus genuine enthusiasm for going deep on NetSuite specifically. We'd rather hire for curiosity and a learning mindset than a perfect checklist of prior tools.
  • Familiarity with (or eagerness to quickly learn) NetSuite's configuration layer: saved searches, SuiteFlow, roles/permissions, custom fields and records, and at least reading-level comfort with SuiteScript.
  • Working knowledge of basic system integrations (API/SFTP, or iPaaS tools like Celigo/Workato/Boomi) and comfort troubleshooting data sync issues.
  • Real attention to detail — the kind that notices a saved search is returning one extra row before it becomes a finance reporting problem.
  • Solid Excel/Google Sheets skills; comfort building reports and saved searches.
  • Clear communicator who can support non-technical end users and explain system issues in plain language.
  • Familiarity with basic finance/accounting workflows (AP, expense management, order-to-cash) is a plus but not required.
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience; NetSuite/Salesforce admin certifications (e.g. NetSuite SuiteFoundation, Salesforce Administrator) are a plus and a good signal of the self-directed learning this role rewards.

Benefits And Perks

  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year.
  • Company-wide week off a year – the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)
  • No meeting Fridays
  • Paid parental leave
  • Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday
  • Paid volunteer time
  • Focus on your career growth:
  • Development Dollars
  • Leadership development
  • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings
  • Travel Discounts
  • Employee Resource Groups
  • Competitive retirement and health plans
  • Free lunch 2 days per week
  • Focus on mental health and well-being:
  • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
  • Company-paid subscription to HeadSpace

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. The range for this Massachusetts-based role is $85,000-$100,000.

We offer a competitive base salary and benefits including: health benefits; flexible spending account; retirement benefits; life insurance; paid time off (including PTO, paid sick leave, medical leave, bereavement leave, floating holidays and paid holidays); and parental leave benefits. This role is eligible to be considered for an annual bonus.

Inclusion

At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That's why we're focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here.
