This role requires deep airline revenue management expertise, strong data analytical skills and the ability to partner effectively with customer executives and internal sales teams.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the end-to-end implementation lifecycle for Dynamic Pricing and Revenue Management solutions, from project kickoff and business process assessment through transition to customer care.

  • Demonstrated expertise in Dynamic Pricing, Competitive Benchmarking, Offer Optimization, Forecasting, Optimization techniques and experimentation framework design.
  • Strong data analytical skills with working knowledge of SQL, NoSQL databases (such as Google BigQuery or MongoDB) and database concepts.

Benefits That Support You

job.job_description:
SUMMARY

The General Manager (GM) is responsible for the overall leadership, performance, and successful operation of the hotel. As the most senior property leader, the GM provides strategic direction across all functional areas, ensuring the delivery of exceptional guest experiences, strong financial performance, operational excellence, brand compliance, and team member engagement.


The General Manager serves as the primary ambassador of the hotel brand at property level, ensuring the consistent delivery of financial results, including Revenue and GOP targets, adherence to brand standards and Quality Assurance requirements, achievement of guest satisfaction objectives such as OSAT, NPS and online reputation score, loyalty programme growth (Wyndham Rewards), commercial performance targets including RGI, ADR, RevPar, and occupancy, and the successful execution of strategic initiatives.


Working collaboratively with hotel ownership and Wyndham franchise representatives, the General Manager drives sustainable business performance, enhances the hotel's market position, and maximizes long-term asset value.


The General Manager is expected to maintain regular engagement with the Wyndham Franchise Operations team, actively participating in Business Review Meetings, operational reviews, and performance discussions, while ensuring timely follow-through on agreed actions and development plans.


The role plays a critical part in balancing owner expectations with brand standards and long-term business success, ensuring decisions support both immediate commercial objectives and the sustained growth, reputation, and profitability of the hotel.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic Leadership

  • Lead the hotel's overall business strategy and operations to achieve financial, commercial, guest satisfaction, and people objectives.

  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and service excellence across the hotel.

Financial & Business Performance

  • Monitor business performance through financial and operational reporting, implementing corrective action where required.
  • Ensure effective cost control and resource management while maintaining guest satisfaction and service standards.
  • Identify opportunities for business growth, profitability enhancement, and operational efficiencies.
  • Establish strategies to optimize RevPAR, ADR, occupancy, market penetration, and Revenue Generation Index (RGI).

Commercial & Revenue Leadership

  • Ensure Revenue Management, Sales, Marketing, and Operations teams maximize revenue opportunities.

  • Support public relations initiatives, social media engagement, strategic partnerships, and community involvement activities.
  • Build relationships with key corporate clients, travel partners, tourism organizations, and local stakeholders.
  • Chair or actively participate in Revenue Strategy Meetings and Commercial Reviews.

  • Champion Wyndham Rewards enrolment, engagement, and contribution to hotel revenue growth.

Guest Experience & Quality

  • Champion a guest-centric culture focused on delivering exceptional experiences and service excellence.
  • Ensure achievement of guest satisfaction targets, including NPS and OSAT Score, online reputation scores, and other guest experience metrics.
  • Maintain compliance with all brand standards, operating procedures, and quality assurance programs.
  • Continuously evaluate guest feedback and operational performance to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Ensure service standards are consistently communicated, trained, implemented, and measured throughout the hotel.
  • Conduct regular property inspections to ensure exceptional presentation, cleanliness, maintenance standards, and guest experience delivery.
  • Ensure all departments operate efficiently and consistently in accordance with brand standards and local regulatory requirements.
  • Champion a culture of continuous improvement through process optimisation, innovation, and best-practice sharing.

Leadership & Talent Management

  • Recruit, develop, engage, and retain a high-performing leadership team and hotel workforce.
  • Inspire, coach, mentor, and support department leaders to achieve individual and business objectives.
  • Promote a culture of diversity, inclusion, engagement, recognition, and continuous learning.
  • Promote the Count On Me Service culture, by acting as a role model and ensuring appropriate training compliance across the hotel teams.
  • Ensure workforce plans align with business needs and operational requirements.
  • Drive employee engagement initiatives and support achievement of key people metrics, including:
  • Employee engagement
  • Retention and turnover
  • Productivity
  • Internal promotions
  • Recruitment effectiveness
  • Talent development
  • Ensure compliance with Wyndham People Compliance Standards and all applicable employment requirements.

Brand, Compliance & Risk Management

  • Serve as the guardian of brand standards and ensure full compliance with all brand requirements.
  • Ensure compliance with legal, regulatory, health and safety, employment, financial, and operational obligations.

· Monitor updates in statutory regulations and implement proactive measures to ensure strict compliance, safeguarding the enterprise against legal penalties or sanctions.

  • Ensure all departmental Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) remain current, effective, and consistently followed.
  • Lead crisis management, risk assessment, and business continuity planning activities.

· Participate in brand conferences, leadership meetings, training programs, and franchise engagement activities.

Job Overview And Responsibilities

The Manager of Automation & AI is responsible for leading the strategy, governance, development, and adoption of industry leading automation and Artificial Intelligence capabilities across the Engineering and Operations, and Digital Technology services. This role focuses on identifying, prioritizing, designing, implementing and measuring success of solutions that improve service reliability, operational efficiency, employee productivity, and customer outcomes.

The position serves as a key transformation leader, partnering with engineering, AI COE, operations, platform, service management, and business teams to create and execute an enterprise automation and AI roadmap. The role drives the adoption of modern technologies including workflow automation, orchestration, agentic AI, generative AI, self-healing operations, and intelligent service delivery capabilities.

This leader is accountable for building scalable delivery models, establishing governance standards, developing workforce capabilities, and ensuring that automation and AI investments generate measurable business value with the appropriate metrics. The role balances strategic planning with hands-on execution leadership to accelerate technology modernization and operational transformation initiatives

  • Define and execute the Engineering and Operations Automation & AI implementation plan and strategy
  • Develop and maintain a prioritized automation and AI roadmap aligned to organizational goals
  • Establish governance processes, intake models, prioritization frameworks, and value realization methodologies
  • Lead identification and evaluation of automation and AI opportunities across infrastructure, operations, engineering, service management, and platform teams
  • Create executive-level metrics and reporting that demonstrate business value, efficiency gains, and operational improvements
  • Partner with senior technology leaders to align investments and priorities
  • Define standards, methodologies, reusable patterns, development practices, and guardrails
  • Drive consistency across automation, workflow orchestration, agentic AI, generative AI, and intelligent operations initiatives across Engineering and Operations
  • Create governance structures for use case intake, backlog management, delivery execution, and operational support
  • Promote enterprise adoption through community engagement, communications, coaching, and best practice sharing
  • Manage staffing models and capability development plans
  • Lead matrixed teams responsible for development and deployment of automation and AI solutions
  • Manage end-to-end lifecycle activities including ideation, design, development, testing, deployment, adoption, measurement, and continuous improvement
  • Facilitate sprint planning, backlog prioritization, release management, and delivery reviews as appropriate
  • Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, measurable, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards
  • Partner with service owners and operational teams to identify manual, repetitive, and high-volume activities suitable for automation
  • Drive implementation of self-service capabilities, workflow automation, intelligent ticket routing, predictive operations, and self-healing solutions
  • Reduce operational toil and increase efficiency through automation-first practices
  • Build Engineering and Operations organizational Automation & AI capabilities through training, coaching, and workforce enablement programs
  • Partner with service owners, AI COE, and engineering teams to identify, prioritize, and implement high-value AI and automation opportunities
  • Lead adoption of automation-first and AI-enabled ways of working across technology teams
  • Develop talent pipelines, career paths, and skill development plans supporting future-state technology capabilities
  • Foster a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, collaboration, and accountability
  • Develop business cases, funding strategies, and investment plans for Automation & AI initiatives for Engineering and Operations
  • Manage budgets, resource allocations, vendor engagements, and financial forecasts supporting the Automation & AI portfolio
  • Measure and communicate realized value through productivity gains, cost avoidance, capacity creation, and operational efficiency improvements
  • Provide executive reporting and performance metrics to ensure investments align with strategic business outcomes

Qualifications

What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business Administration, Data Analytics, or related field
  • 5+ years progressive technology leadership experience
  • 3+ years leading automation, AI, platform engineering, operational excellence, or transformation initiatives

  • Leadership experience and the ability to guide and inspire a team
  • A mindset for continuous learning and staying updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices
  • Experience in common architecture frameworks such as Microservices, API management
  • Experience in Robotic Process automation
  • Experience in designing and building applications using AWS (or other hyperscalers) cloud architecture & services and support of highly available and resilient multi-region platforms
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without sponsorship

job.job_description:
About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

At Tripadvisor experiences, the only thing we love more than travel is data. We slice it, we dice it, and we use it to empower our decision making.

About The Role

As a Principal Product Data Scientist, you will operate as the most senior technical leader in the Product Data Science function. You will shape the vision, set the technical direction, and drive strategic impact through innovative analytical solutions. This role is both highly technical and deeply collaborative, requiring excellence in leadership, communication, and cross-functional influence.

What You Will Do

  • Lead and define the Data Science strategy for Product, ensuring that advanced analytics, data science, and AI methodologies are central to how we build great products and improve customer experiences.
  • Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to senior Product and Engineering leadership, ensuring that data-driven decision making is embedded at the highest levels of the organization.
  • Drive the development and adoption of next-generation data science tooling, platforms, and frameworks, with a focus on automation, scalability, and reproducibility.
  • Spearhead the exploration and integration of emerging AI technologies, such as Agentic AI and AI Agents, identifying and developing high-impact use cases from POC to production.
  • Champion best practices in experimentation, causal inference, and uplift modeling, ensuring statistical rigor in decision-making processes.
  • Take ownership of the most complex, high-profile analytical projects, translating ambiguous questions into clear, actionable recommendations that deliver commercial and customer value.
  • Mentor, coach, and develop other Data Scientists and Analysts, fostering a culture of critical thinking, continuous learning, and technical excellence.
  • Lead initiatives to scale impact through automation, self-service, and democratization of data science capabilities.
  • Develop sophisticated customer segmentation, and predictive models that directly inform and optimize the product roadmap.
  • Communicate complex analytical and technical concepts to diverse audiences, influencing stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, and Commercial teams.

Skills & Experience

  • Experience: Extensive experience in data science or a similar quantitative role, with a proven track record of supporting and influencing a product organization.
  • Technical & Modeling Expertise: Expert Level proficiency in Python and SQL. Deep, hands-on experience with statistical modeling, (quasi) experimentation, multi-arm bandit, and a wide range of machine learning techniques (e.g., Regression, Classification, Clustering).
  • Product Acumen: Demonstrated ability to define, implement, and operationalize crucial product and feature-level metrics from scratch.
  • Strategic Influence: A proven track record of driving strategic impact through proactive and collaborative approach with the proven ability to lead technical discussions, drive product strategy, and communicate complex insights effectively to cross-functional partners (e.g., Product, Engineering, Design).
  • Scaling Impact: Experience scaling analytics capabilities, driving impact through the creation of automated processes, self-service tools, or data products.
  • Critical Thinking: Leader in critical thinking, your previous experience will demonstrate the analysis of available facts, evidence, observations, and arguments in order to form a judgment by the application of rational, skeptical, and unbiased analyses and evaluation.
  • Leadership: Outstanding leadership skills, with experience in mentoring, coaching, and developing teams of analysts or data scientists.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Exceptional collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to engage, influence, and inspire cross-functional partners at all levels.
  • Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Engineering, Physics, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

You could be an especially great fit if you have:

  • Advanced programming background with the ability to build simulations and prototype data products.
  • Experience validating quantitative findings with qualitative methods (e.g., surveys, user research).
  • Demonstrated experience with applied AI, such as NLP, Large Language Models (LLMs), or Agentic AI for analytics.
  • Experience working within a two-sided marketplace, e-commerce, or the travel technology industry.
  • Masters degree or equivalent relevant programs

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!

job.job_description:
Travelzoo is seeking a Marketing Manager [Member Acquisition] to join our team in Berlin. In this position, you will drive performance-focused digital marketing initiatives to acquire and retain Travelzoo Members in Germany. The position focuses on hands-on campaign management across acquisition channels, data-driven optimisation, and measurable subscriber growth. The ideal candidate brings strong analytical skills, experience managing performance marketing campaigns, and a passion for scaling membership growth in a subscription-based environment.


Do you feel…


  • Enthusiastic to understand target groups, acquisition funnels, and all touchpoints along the customer journey
  • Motivated to take ownership of performance marketing activities across Paid Social, Affiliate, Programmatic, Display, Email, and additional digital acquisition channels
  • Keen to plan, implement, and optimise digital marketing campaigns across platforms such as Meta, Reddit, affiliate networks, and programmatic channels
  • Capable of conducting audience and creative testing, including A/B testing and creative optimisation, to identify scalable and cost-efficient acquisition strategies
  • Driven to analyse channel effectiveness and campaign performance based on KPIs including ROAS, conversion rates, and member sign ups
  • Confident working with analytics and attribution tools (Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Tableau, tracking solutions, internal reporting tools, etc.) to evaluate website traffic, conversion performance, and customer behaviour
  • Curious to identify emerging marketing trends, new acquisition opportunities, and innovative platforms to diversify growth efforts
  • Empowered to collaborate closely with creative, analytics, product, and international marketing teams to align campaigns with wider business and brand objectives
  • Comfortable managing external partners, publishers, affiliate relationships, agencies, and in house campaigns
  • Motivated to share insights and best practices across teams to improve overall marketing effectiveness


You are ideally…


  • Degree educated (or equivalent experience), ideally in Marketing, Business, Data Science, or a related field
  • A professional with 5-10 years of experience in digital performance marketing, ideally focused on member acquisition, subscriptions, or lead generation
  • Experienced working with subscription-based products and consumer-facing brands. Experience within the travel or lifestyle industry is highly desirable
  • A high performer with strong knowledge of attribution models, conversion tracking, analytics tools, and campaign optimisation methodologies
  • Analytical, commercially-minded, and highly data-driven
  • Experienced across Paid Social, Affiliate Marketing, Programmatic Advertising, and digital acquisition strategy
  • An individual with strong attention to detail who enjoys developing creative concepts and high-performing digital ad copy. Photoshop skills are a plus
  • An excellent communicator with strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills
  • Empathetic with a hands-on, innovative working style and a can-do attitude
  • Passionate about travel and digital consumer experiences
  • Fluent in German and English


What’s in it for you…


  • Broaden your horizon by working with a global team and potentially in a different country
  • Experience one of our travel deals first-hand each year, with additional vacation days and a travel budget – we call it the Travelzoo Experience
  • We recognize your achievements with our employee awards
  • Enjoy working like an entrepreneur? Our flat hierarchies will provide you with this opportunity
  • We offer competitive compensation and benefit packages


If you are excited about this opportunity and feel intrigued by our values of “leading by example”, “warm heart”, “cool head” and “working hands”, then we would like to get to know you!

job.job_description:
Bei der TUI AG in Hannover bieten wir ab August 2027 ein sehr interessantes und vielseitiges duales Studium zum Bachelor of Arts Business Administration (m/w/d) bzw. Bachelor of Science Business Economics (m/w/d) mit der Vertiefung Tourismus- und Eventmanagement an.

Die TUI AG, mit Sitz in Deutschland, ist als Mutterkonzern der weltweit führende Touristikanbieter und das Herzstück der TUI-Unternehmensgruppe. Sie bündelt unter ihrem Dach sämtliche touristischen Aktivitäten der Gruppe und steuert die strategische Ausrichtung ihrer Tochtergesellschaften.

UNSER ANGEBOT

Deine Entwicklung

  • strukturiertes Onboarding
  • Schulungen, Seminare und Workshops
  • Seminarreise und ein mehrwöchiger Auslandseinsatz
  • umfangreiche Unterstützung bei deiner Prüfungsvorbereitung

Deine Vorteile

  • 30 Urlaubstage
  • Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld
  • attraktive Ausbildungsvergütung (895€ / 1.031€ / 1.234€ / Monat)
  • Reisevergünstigungen
  • mit TUI WORKWIDE bis zu 30 Tage im Ausland arbeiten
  • Deutschlandticket als Jobticket
  • Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft

Deine Perspektiven

  • Netzwerkaufbau
  • internationale Zusammenarbeit
  • Übernahmemöglichkeiten in der gesamten TUI Welt, bei herausragenden Leistungen eine Übernahmegarantie

ZUR POSITION

Du interessierst dich für wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge und möchtest dein Studium mit wertvoller Praxiserfahrung verbinden? Dann starte dein duales Studium bei der TUI AG in Hannover und erlebe, wie Theorie und Praxis in einem internationalen Unternehmen zusammenkommen.

Freu Dich Auf

  • Ein dreijähriges duales Studium der Betriebswirtschaftslehre mit international anerkanntem Abschluss (B. A. oder B. Sc.)
  • Wechsel zwischen Theoriephasen an der Leibniz Fachhochschule Hannover (http://www.leibniz-fh.de) und Praxisphasen bei TUI
  • Vielfältige Einblicke in international ausgerichtete Fachbereiche der TUI Group und ihrer Konzerngesellschaften
  • Kennenlernen eines der weltweit führenden Touristikkonzerne aus unterschiedlichen Perspektiven
  • Mitarbeit in verschiedenen Unternehmensbereichen und aktive Unterstützung im Tagesgeschäft
  • Betriebsinterne Trainings und Workshops zu Themen wie Gesundheit, Projektmanagement oder Microsoft 365
  • Übernahme eigener Aufgaben und schrittweise Verantwortung während des Studiums

ZU DIR

Du passt zu uns, wenn...

  • du eine allgemeine Hochschulreife mit gutem oder sehr gutem Abschluss mitbringst.
  • du ein ausgeprägtes Zahlenverständnis besitzt und analytisch denkst.
  • du Interesse an wirtschaftlichen Zusammenhängen hast und idealerweise bereits erste praktische Erfahrungen im kaufmännischen Bereich sammeln konntest.
  • du Spaß am Umgang mit digitalen Systemen und modernen Tools wie Microsoft 365 hast.
  • du sehr gute Englischkenntnisse mitbringst.
  • du selbstständig arbeitest, gerne im Team zusammenarbeitest und offen für neue Perspektiven bist.
  • soziales oder ehrenamtliches Engagement für dich selbstverständlich ist.
  • du idealerweise erste internationale Erfahrungen gesammelt hast.

Noten sind wichtig. Noch wichtiger sind uns deine Persönlichkeit, deine Motivation und deine Begeisterung dafür, Neues zu lernen und Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

Lade Deine Bewerbung Einfach Online Hoch

  • Anschreiben (oder erzähl uns auf kreative Weise, warum du zu uns passt)
  • Lebenslauf
  • Deine letzten zwei Schulzeugnisse bzw. dein Abschlusszeugnus
  • Optional: Praktikumsnachweise, Zertifikate oder weitere Unterlagen, die zeigen, wer du bist

Bereit für deinen Start bei TUI? ️✈️

  • Bewirb dich online und schicke uns deine Unterlagen.
  • Zeig uns, was in dir steckt - mit einem kurzen Online-Test.
  • Lerne uns persönlich kennen und entdecke beim Assessment Center die Welt von TUI.
  • Willkommen an Bord! Wenn alles passt, erhältst du dein Vertragsangebot für den Start im August 2027 und deine Reise bei TUI kann beginnen.

Von einem Arbeitsplatz zu einem Ort, an dem man dazugehört. Bei TUI schätzen wir Vielfalt, Gleichberechtigung und Inklusion und ermutigen alle, so zu sein, wie sie sind. „Come as you are“ – das ist unsere Vision, denn nur durch Vielfalt ist unser Potenzial grenzenlos. Wir ermuntern Menschen mit Behinderung, sich zu bewerben.

job.job_description:
About Sojern & RateGain:

RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global leader in AI-powered SaaS solutions for the travel and hospitality industry, serving over 16,000 customers and 700+ partners across 100+ countries. Since its founding in 2004, RateGain has been at the forefront of helping travel brands accelerate revenue through smarter acquisition, stronger retention, and deeper customer engagement.

Today, RateGain stands among the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data. Its platforms empower revenue management, distribution, and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, online travel agencies, car rentals, cruises, and more—enabling them to make faster, data-driven decisions that drive measurable business outcomes.

With deep industry trust, RateGain works with 26 of the top 33 hotel chains, 25 of the top 30 OTAs, 4 of the top 5 airlines, and numerous Fortune 500 companies globally—unlocking new revenue opportunities every day.

Following the integration of Sojern and the addition of Adara, RateGain has evolved into one of the most advanced AI-powered growth ecosystems in travel. Positioned at the intersection of demand generation, revenue optimisation, and AI-driven traveler intelligence, the company brings together:


  • Demand Generation: Programmatic and multi-channel media to drive high-intent audiences
  • Revenue Optimisation: Pricing, distribution, and conversion intelligence to maximise performance
  • Traveler Data Intelligence: Billions of real-time signals powering predictive insights


Together, these capabilities enable the world’s leading travel brands—hotels, airlines, destinations, and OTAs—to unify marketing, distribution, and revenue strategy into a single, intelligent growth engine.


This is not just SaaS; it’s a transformative platform redefining how the travel industry grows.


About the Role:

We are seeking a Senior Sales Director – Corporate APAC to lead growth across a few of our most strategic Asia Pacific markets (Singapore, Hong Kong, and Australia / New-Zealand). With SG and HK as the primary focus, this role offers significant headroom to scale enterprise travel accounts across our Corporate Vertical (Airlines, Hotels, Car Rentals, OTAs, Finance, Telcos and Luxury brands) while also driving expansion across the AU / NZ countries.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Define and execute the SG, HK, AU and NZ go-to-market strategy for enterprise accounts.
  • Drive new business acquisition across Airlines, Hotels, Car Rentals, OTAs, Finance, Telcos, and Luxury brand organizations
  • Own, maintain, and close large, complex enterprise deals involving multiple stakeholders across C-suite, marketing, revenue, and technology teams
  • Build and expand strategic relationships across the RateGain Travel Technologies Limited, Sojern, and Adara ecosystem
  • Identify and unlock cross-sell and upsell opportunities across the full platform suite
  • Develop strong executive-level relationships to drive long-term partnerships through Enterprise initiatives that go beyond classic media channel activations (Loyalty, Planning Solutions, Enrichment, etc.).


Additional Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, and Customer Success to align on market needs and drive revenue outcomes
  • Build and manage a robust pipeline, ensuring consistent forecasting and deal velocity
  • Represent the organization at industry events, conferences, and client engagements across APAC
  • Continuously track market trends, competitive landscape, and customer needs to refine strategy.


Qualifications & Required Competencies:

  • 12+ years of experience in enterprise sales within AdTech, MarTech, Travel Tech, or SaaS
  • Demonstrated success in closing high-value, multi-threaded enterprise deals
  • Strong understanding of digital advertising, data platforms, or the travel ecosystem
  • Proven ability to engage and influence C-level stakeholders
  • Experience in managing long sales cycles and complex deal structures
  • Strong hunter mindset with a track record of new logo acquisition and account expansion
  • Experience working across APAC markets
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment


Work Environment Details:

Based in Singapore, with a hybrid role that includes time in the office and/or from home.


Specific requirements

Travel: Need to be flexible to travel across SG, HK and AU/NZ as and when the day-day business requires it.


Why Join Us

This is an opportunity to play a critical role in shaping the infrastructure of a growing, global organization. You’ll work alongside a collaborative, high-performing team, gain exposure to international operations, and have the opportunity to grow your career as the company expands.


Equal Opportunity Employer

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Senior Sales Manager, you’re not just generating and managing group sales – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:

  • Represent the hotel to prospective clients: Serve as the primary point of contact for customers seeking group rooms, meeting space, and food and beverage services
  • Drive new business opportunities: Respond to inquiries, initiate outreach, qualify leads, and solicit potential clients through proactive sales efforts
  • Manage the full sales cycle: Conduct site visits, entertain clients, prepare proposals, determine rates, negotiate contracts, and service accounts through fulfillment
  • Develop strategic sales plans: Create and execute strategies to achieve or exceed revenue and room night goals, adjusting based on performance and market conditions
  • Analyze sales performance: Evaluate lost business reports and identify opportunities to strengthen conversion and competitiveness
  • Support exceptional service delivery: Collaborate across departments to coordinate the fulfillment of contracted services and uphold the highest standards of client satisfaction
  • Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

About The Team

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
  • Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
  • Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
  • Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
  • Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
  • Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Generous paid time off (PTO) – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters most
  • Health & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family covered
  • Financial security for your future – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what’s next
  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

This role is based in Bangkok, Thailand, and is open to candidates worldwide. We offer a generous relocation package to ensure a smooth transition to living and working in Bangkok.

Get to Know our Team:

The Marketing Team of Agoda is a world leader in online marketing. This department is highly data-driven and focused on developing at-scale marketing programs that improve the lifetime value of Agoda customers through measurable marketing programs and channels. The team is a blend of the best analysts, marketing strategists, and data scientists in the world. The marketing leadership at Agoda have deep experience in data science, product, strategy, and other marketing fields and have built an organization that thrives on data, creative ideas, and technology.

The Opportunity:

We are launching a new B2C Product designed to make travel spending seamless and transparent for all travelers.

As Senior Growth Marketing Manager – New verticals, you will play a key role in taking this product from early stage to scale. You’ll own growth strategy and execution across acquisition and retention, working closely with product, fintech, and cross-functional marketing teams. This is a unique opportunity to build a new vertical within Agoda from the ground up.

In this Role, You'll Get to:

  • Co-own with product the go-to market strategy: targeted segments, USP, and positioning for product
  • Design the marketing strategy for the new B2C product across the full funnel – from user acquisition and activation to engagement and retention
  • Execute the marketing strategy: e.g., 
    • Launch the different marketing channels (e.g., paid search, app campaigns, affiliates) 
    • Optimize performance campaigns across channels such as; App campaigns, Paid search
    • Work closely with Product and Design to Shape onboarding, in-app messaging, and key user journeys
  • Collaborate with Fintech, Legal, and Compliance to ensure campaigns, claims, and messaging are accurate, compliant, and easy for customers to understand and Translate regulatory constraints into clear, user-friendly communications
  • Build and continuously improve dashboards, reporting, and processes to scale growth operations over time.
  • Over time, manage and mentor a team (e.g., :2 analysts/marketers) as the vertical grows.

What You'll Need to Succeed:

Must Have Qualifications

  • Marketing expertise: At least 8 years of experience with 3+ years of hands-on growth/ direct marketing in app-based or digital products, focusing on user acquisition and retention
  • Strong analytical skills.
    • Comfortable working with data and performance metrics (CAC, LTV, activation, retention, payback, cohorts).
    • Ability to pull and analyze data using SQL and/or self serve BI tools.
  • Demonstrated entrepreneurial / builder mentality.
    • Able to operate in ambiguity, set up new processes, and “figure things out” without a playbook.
    • Bias for action and experimentation.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience collaborating with multi team in multiple department 

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Direct marketing, Performance marketing and Affiliate marketing for financial products
  • Experience in fintech or financial services, such as Travel cards, multicurrency wallets
  • Experience launching or scaling a new product or major feature

Company Description

Why work for Accor?

We are far more than a worldwide leader. We welcome you as you are and you can find a job and brand that matches your personality. We support you to grow and learn every day, making sure that work brings purpose to your life, so that during your journey with us, you can continue to explore Accor’s limitless possibilities.

Discover the life that awaits you at Accor, visit https://careers.accor.com/ Do what you love, care for the world, dare to challenge the status quo! #BELIMITLESS

Our Commitment To Diversity & Inclusion

We are an inclusive company and our ambition is to attract, recruit and promote diverse talent. Any opportunity within our community to adapt and develop our processes to embrace others is encouraged

Job Description

About you:

You're a commercially sharp, results-driven leader who sees opportunities where others see obstacles — and you have the track record to prove it. Armed with deep market expertise and an instinct for securing business, you drive revenue with energy, precision and a genuine thrill for the chase. You're a natural motivator: your team hits targets because you make excellence feel achievable, and you lead by example rather than directive.

Strategically, you're always a step ahead — you read market conditions like a seasoned local, embrace the digital trends reshaping our industry, and turn insight into action before the competition has finished their morning coffee. You're a creative problem-solver, a polished relationship-builder beloved by clients and colleagues alike, and you carry a genuine passion for hospitality. Simply put: you're ready to take our hotel to the next level, and you'll have a ball doing it.

What You Will Be Doing

As Director of Sales & Marketing for Novotel & ibis Styles Melbourne Airport, you'll lead the commercial engine of a dual-brand, high-volume airport property and no two days will look the same.

  • Drive revenue across all segments — secure Corporate, Domestic, Leisure, Conferencing (internal and external) and Incentive business, then sustain, maximise, yield and grow each segment to hit and exceed budgeted revenue.
  • Own the strategy — read market conditions with a commercial eye, develop sharp strategies for the business unit, and implement them with the pace and precision our high-performance environment demands.
  • Lead the Business, Events and Groups Department — coach, motivate and grow the team to unlock every opportunity in this thriving sector, from intimate boardroom sessions to large-scale conferences and events.
  • Steer the Digital, Marketing and PR function — oversee all activity across digital channels, marketing campaigns and public relations, ensuring every touchpoint reflects Accor's brand guidelines and standards, while championing our venues, precinct partnerships and the unique personality of both brands.

Additional Information

Our Hotel

The Novotel & ibis styles Melbourne Airport is a dual-branded property with a total of 464 rooms - 248 in Novotel Melbourne Airport and 216 in ibis Styles Melbourne Airport, this dynamic new development is just steps from Terminal 4, Melbourne Airport, offering convenience and comfort for travellers and professionals alike.

Our guests can enjoy a selection of food & beverage venues: Boccata, meaning “mouthful” in Italian, celebrates the city’s migrant heritage and marries Italian favourites with local, contemporary touch. Amber State Taphouse & Kitchen is the ideal gathering place that celebrates the joy of getting together through the Aussie tradition of barbecue and beer – with craft beers on tap, wines, and cocktails. Small holdings featuring the classic Melbourne cafe culture with a range of delightful baked pastry treats, gourmet breakfast dishes, superb sandwiches and specialty coffee.

In addition to our exceptional food and beverage venues, the Novotel & ibis styles Melbourne Airport features premier event spaces designed to accommodate everything from intimate meetings to grand receptions. Our elegant ballroom can host up to 480 guests for a cocktail-style event or 240 for a seated banquet and can be effortlessly divided into Ballroom 1, 2, and 3, providing flexible configurations to suit any occasion, whether it’s a conference, workshop, product launch, or celebration. For guests seeking a productive environment, Aerofoil, our premium co-working space, offers a stylish and comfortable setting ideal for catching up on work between flights, hosting important meetings, or staying connected on the go.

This is a village centre supporting the airport community as a place to gather and socialise for everyone who travels and works from the airport precinct.

What is in it for you?

  • Learning programs through our “Learn your Way” Academy platforms, ongoing training and development opportunities (self-pace, virtual webinars, face to face)
  • ALL Heartist, Employee benefit card, offering discounted accommodation, food and beverage at Accor properties worldwide.
  • Complimentary car parking.
  • Mental health and well-being support initiatives.
  • Access to our Employee Assistance Program.

job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

The Manager, Technical Operations Inventory Accounting is responsible for the overall accounting, reporting, and control environment for Technical Operations spare parts inventory and MRO inventory assets. This role owns inventory accounting processes, including the capitalization, transfer, and retirement of assets within the Fixed Asset System, while ensuring compliance with accounting standards, internal controls, and audit requirements.

The position serves as a trusted advisor to Operations Finance and Technical Operations leadership, providing guidance on complex inventory and asset accounting matters, supporting strategic financial initiatives, and driving process improvements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Technical Operations inventory accounting, reporting, and control activities
  • Oversee accounting for spare parts inventory, including capitalization, transfers, and retirements within the Fixed Asset System
  • Review and approve journal entries, significant asset transactions, account reconciliations, and financial reporting schedules
  • Prepare and review inventory reporting, asset roll forwards, cash flow analyses, and ad hoc financial reporting
  • Oversee asset audits and support SOX compliance and internal control requirements
  • Leverage technology, including AI (and data strategy), to design effective, modern, and streamlined processes, policies and controls
  • Mentor and develop a team of accounting and finance professionals and cultivate an engaged and highly motivated team
  • Develop and implement accounting processes and controls to support evolving business needs and organizational growth
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to Finance and Technical Operations leadership on inventory and asset accounting matters
  • Support strategic financial initiatives and business transformation efforts

This role combines technical accounting expertise, large data and analytics, people leadership, financial controllership, and business partnership to ensure the integrity of inventory and asset accounting while supporting the strategic objectives of Technical Operations and Finance.

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Undergraduate degree in accounting or related field required
  • Five years related work experience using Microsoft Excel, MS Power Bi, SharePoint, PowerPoint and Word required
  • Solid understanding of financial statements (income statement, balance sheet, cash flow and SEC reports)
  • Knowledge of accounting principles, terms and processes
  • Excellent planning and organizational skills, strong business acumen and robust analytical skills
  • The ability to work independently to analyze complex accounting issues
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills and leadership required to promote cross-divisional coordination
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency.
  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in finance, accounting or other related field.
  • Certified Public Accountant (CPA)
  • Experience in overseeing monthly close processes in a large public company
  • Understanding of Delta’s financial systems and operations
  • SAP/FCCS experience a plus
  • Proven track record of successfully navigating a cross-functional, matrixed organization

Benefits And Perks To Help You Keep Climbing

Our culture is rooted in a shared dedication to living our values – Care, Integrity, Resilience, Servant Leadership, and Teamwork – every day, in everything we do. At Delta, our people are our success. At the heart of what we offer is our focus on Sharing Success with Delta employees.

Benefits

Exploring a career at Delta gives you a chance to see the world while earning great compensation and benefits to help you keep climbing along the way:

  • Competitive salary, industry-leading proﬁt sharing program, and performance incentives
  • 401(k) with generous company contributions up to 9%
  • Paid time off including vacation, holidays, paid personal time, maternity and parental leave
  • Comprehensive health beneﬁts including medical, dental, vision, short/long term disability and life beneﬁts
  • Family care assistance through fertility support, surrogacy and adoption assistance, lactation support, subsidized back-up care, and programs that help with loved ones in all stages
  • Holistic Wellbeing programs to support physical, emotional, social, and financial health, including access to an employee assistance program offering support for you and anyone in your household, free financial coaching, and extensive resources supporting mental health
  • Domestic and International space-available flight privileges for employees and eligible family members
  • Career development programs to achieve your long-term career goals
  • World-wide partnerships to engage in community service and innovative goals created to focus on sustainability and reducing our carbon footprint
  • Business Resource Groups created to connect employees with common interests to promote inclusion, provide perspective and help implement strategies
  • Recognition rewards and awards through the platform Unstoppable Together
  • Access to over 500 discounts, specialty savings and voluntary benefits through Deltaperks such as car and hotel rentals and auto, home, and pet insurance, legal services, and childcare

As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Principal Product Manager, Communications & Intelligence

Introduction To The Team

Expedia Group is seeking a Principal Product Manager, Comms & Intelligence to lead strategy and execution for the capabilities that make our customer communications smarter, more personalized, and more measurable. This role sits at the intersection of CRM, marketing technology, and applied AI owning how we turn customer data into better-targeted, better-timed, and better-performing communications across email, push, SMS, in-product, transactional, and emerging channels.

As an individual contributor at the Principal level, you will act as the senior technical and strategic voice for data- and AI-driven communications, partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Marketing, Analytics, Legal, and Privacy teams to shape outcomes across the broader CRM and Communications portfolio.

In This Role You Will

  • Define the product vision and roadmap for communications intelligence — audience insights, personalization models, channel/send-time optimization, and performance measurement.
  • Drive the evolution of customer data signals (behavioral, transactional, engagement) into actionable inputs for journey orchestration and targeting.
  • Partner with Data Science and Engineering to build and scale models for personalization, propensity, and next-best-message/channel decisioning.
  • Own the measurement and experimentation framework that quantifies communication effectiveness and informs prioritization.
  • Drive responsible use of AI/ML in communications, balancing automation, personalization, and customer trust and compliance.
  • Act as a technical and strategic escalation point for cross-team tradeoffs involving data quality, identity, consent, and model performance.
  • Align senior stakeholders around priorities, risks, and measurable engagement and business outcomes.
  • Mentor other Product Managers on data-informed product craft and analytical rigor, without formal management authority.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree with 12+ years of industry product management experience, or a master’s degree with 10+ years of experience, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Significant product management experience, including senior or lead individual-contributor work spanning data, analytics, or AI-driven products.
  • Experience in CRM, customer engagement, marketing technology, or communications/messaging products.
  • Strong understanding of customer data, personalization, experimentation, attribution, and privacy/consent frameworks.
  • Technical fluency across APIs, data models, ML/AI concepts, and platform architecture.
  • Strong executive communication and stakeholder-influence skills — able to lead through data-backed persuasion rather than formal authority.
  • Track record of using data and experimentation to drive measurable improvements in customer engagement outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience defining and scaling communications intelligence capabilities across multiple channels, including audience insights, journey orchestration, personalization, send-time optimization, and next-best-message or channel decisioning.
  • Depth in experimentation design, attribution, measurement strategy, and data-driven prioritization for customer engagement products.
  • Experience partnering with Data Science and Engineering to apply AI/ML models to real-world personalization, propensity, targeting, or communication optimization products.
  • Demonstrated leadership in responsible AI/ML adoption, including operationalizing model performance, data quality, identity, privacy, consent, and customer trust considerations.
  • Track record of aligning Product, Engineering, Data Science, Marketing, Analytics, Legal, and Privacy stakeholders around complex tradeoffs and measurable business outcomes.

The total cash range for this position in San Jose is $242,000.00 to $338,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $387,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role. Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

job.job_description:
¡Crece con nosotros en Hyatt!


En Hyatt seguimos creciendo y escribiendo un nuevo capítulo de transformación y expansión.

Como parte del crecimiento de nuestro Centro de Servicios Compartidos (Shared Service Center) y del proceso de centralización de las operaciones contables de nuestros hoteles, estamos fortaleciendo continuamente nuestro equipo de Finanzas y Contabilidad.


¡Estamos en búsqueda constante de talento! Nuestro plan de expansión contempla la incorporación de nuevos hoteles a la operación centralizada aproximadamente cada dos meses, generando alrededor de 5 oportunidades de contratación mensuales para nuestro equipo.


Buscamos profesionales apasionados, comprometidos y con ganas de desarrollarse, que deseen formar parte de este proyecto y sumarse a nuestras próximas etapas de crecimiento.


Analista de Ingresos | Corporativo Hyatt


Tu próximo reto

Serás responsable de gestionar, registrar y validar las transacciones de ingresos de nuestros hoteles, garantizando su correcta contabilización, conciliación y reconocimiento conforme a las políticas y normas contables aplicables.


Formarás parte de un equipo enfocado en la precisión de la información financiera, la eficiencia operativa y la mejora continua, brindando soporte a las operaciones hoteleras a través de nuestro

Centro de Servicios Compartidos.


¿Cuáles serán tus principales responsabilidades?

  • Registro de ingresos: Validar, clasificar y contabilizar las transacciones diarias de ingresos de nuestros hoteles, asegurando su precisión e integridad en los sistemas financieros.
  • Gestión contable: Preparar y registrar asientos contables relacionados con ingresos, garantizando su correcto reconocimiento y cumplimiento de las políticas contables.
  • Conciliaciones contables: Realizar conciliaciones periódicas de cuentas de ingresos, identificar discrepancias y gestionar los ajustes necesarios.
  • Cierres y reportes financieros: Participar en los procesos de cierre mensual y anual, así como en la elaboración de reportes de ingresos, análisis de variaciones e información financiera para la toma de decisiones.
  • Cumplimiento y control: Mantener registros y documentación de soporte actualizados, asegurando el cumplimiento de controles internos, normas contables y requerimientos de auditoría.
  • Mejora continua y colaboración: Identificar oportunidades de optimización y estandarización de procesos, trabajando en coordinación con los equipos de Contabilidad General, Cuentas por Cobrar y otras áreas financieras.


¿Qué buscamos en ti?

  • Licenciatura en Contabilidad, Finanzas o carreras afines.
  • Experiencia previa en Contabilidad de Ingresos (Revenue Accounting), Contabilidad General o áreas contables y financieras.
  • Conocimiento de reconocimiento de ingresos, registros contables, conciliaciones y procesos de cierre mensual y anual.
  • Conocimiento de controles internos, políticas contables y elaboración de reportes financieros.
  • Manejo de Microsoft Office, especialmente Excel.
  • Experiencia con sistemas contables o ERP; Oracle será considerado un plus.
  • Deseable experiencia en Centros de Servicios Compartidos y/o industria hotelera.
  • Habilidades de organización, atención al detalle, capacidad analítica, trabajo en equipo y orientación a resultados.


¡Queremos conocerte!


Si buscas nuevos retos y quieres formar parte de un equipo que impulsa la transformación de la industria hotelera, esta oportunidad es para ti.


Las contrataciones e incorporaciones se realizarán de manera escalonada, conforme al calendario de expansión y centralización de nuevos hoteles.


¡Postúlate hoy con tu CV actualizado y sé parte del crecimiento de Hyatt!

With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

KAYAK for Business (K4B) is KAYAK's corporate travel platform — built to help companies manage business travel through a modern online booking experience, AI-powered features, and a connected network of travel management partners.

KAYAK is seeking a highly motivated Senior Manager to lead Supplier Relations for KAYAK for Business. This person will report to the Senior Director KAYAK for Business and oversee the portfolio of all global preferred supplier partners (TMC, airline, rail, lodging, car rental, ground, expense, payment, etc).

This position is based in our Miami, FL office at least 3 times per week.

In This Role, You Will

  • Drive global growth, engaging new partnerships as well as optimizing and retaining our existing partnerships, while expanding the value proposition and aligning the K4B strategy for suppliers and other partnerships
  • Design and lead travel partner evaluations, communications, and contracting for the organization
  • Collaborate with partners & internal teams on commercial opportunities, developing and strengthening strategic and mutually beneficial relationships for K4B and its partners
  • Working closely with customers and internal collaborators to ensure current and future content & functionality needs are exceeded
  • Collaborate with key internal teams like Business Development, Account Management, Product & Marketing to achieve target goals
  • Contribute to determining and prioritizing new technology improvements to help drive additional sales to key partners
  • Work closely with the Finance department for budgeting and forecasting and revenue reconciliation from suppliers

Please Apply If You Have

  • 7+ years in travel agency, distribution, payment, air/lodging/car/rail supplier or related fields
  • Proven history of building and maintaining strong relationships both internally and externally
  • Savvy and clear communicator, story teller and presenter to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Outstanding analytic skills to drive positive partnership results based on analysis
  • Expert negotiator, developing creative solutions to problems or barriers
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced tech environment
  • Recognized as a thought leader within the Travel Industry
  • Experience in tech a major plus
  • Strong business development and problem-solving skills coupled with a willingness to “roll up your sleeves”
  • Experience working with global teams in multiple locations

Benefits And Perks

  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year
  • Focus on mental health and well-being:
    • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
    • Company-paid subscription to HeadSpace
    • Company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)
  • No meeting Fridays

The Enterprise PMO serves teams across United Airlines. We're looking for a Senior Marketing Manager, Loyalty to grow and strengthen our rewards programs across Tripadvisor and Viator — someone who can set strategic direction and execute against it. This role is 100% dedicated to Loyalty and works closely with product, engineering, analytics, and CRM. You'll move between strategy, campaign execution, and analysis depending on what the work needs day to day.

Location: East Coast- United States

What You’ll Do

  • Own the loyalty marketing strategy. Define and evolve the Tripadvisor Rewards value proposition and tiering strategy, and shape how the program shows up to members.
  • Run the campaign engine. Plan and execute always-on and calendared campaigns — Welcome Offer optimization, sales events (e.g., Travel Deal Tuesday), sweepstakes, challenges, and partner-funded promotions — across paid and owned channels.
  • Lead cross-functionally. Drive alignment with product, engineering, design, and analytics to test and launch new program mechanics, from offer targeting to member perks.
  • Build the business case with data. Use booking and program data — member behavior, redemption, tier progression, holdout/incrementality results — to prioritize what to build next and prove out ROI to leadership.
  • Measure what matters. Work with analytics to run and interpret holdout/control tests, and translate results into clear go/no-go calls and next steps.
  • Benchmark the competition. Track best-in-class loyalty programs (e.g., Starbucks, Nike, Sephora) to inform our approach to tiering, gamification, and member value.
  • Do the work at every level. Set strategy one day, brief creative or QA an offer the next.

Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of hands-on marketing experience working across the full spectrum from strategy to execution — in travel, e-commerce, subscription, or retail. You are equally able to build a program vision and ship a campaign.
  • A track record of product marketing work — translating product capabilities into clear member-facing value propositions and go-to-market plans.
  • Strong analytical skills — comfortable working with data - either in partnership with analytics and data science teams or working independently - to define metrics and interpret test results. You should be able to pull your own data using AI tools and dashboards.
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to improve efficiency, quality, and decision-making in day-to-day work.
  • Proven ability to operate effectively with a global-first mindset
  • A proven track record of cross-functional leadership — driving alignment and momentum across product, engineering, design, analytics, and CRM in a fast-paced, iterative environment; comfort operating with ambiguity and evolving scope.
  • A bias for action and comfort working with limited resources.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to flex between an executive-level strategy narrative and a detailed campaign brief.
  • Skilled at using AI tools to speed up research, analysis, and automate tasks in your day-to-day work.

Nice to have

  • Experience in loyalty or membership programs and an understanding of program economics and performance
  • Familiarity with marketplace/two-sided dynamics (e.g., supplier- or partner-funded offers).
  • Experience at a tech company.
  • Experience in travel, experiences, or marketplace businesses.

  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

The salary range for this role is $160,000-$175,000. This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. An employee’s pay position within the wage range will be based on several factors including, but limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs. This compensation range may also be modified in the future.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

job.job_description:
Here at TUI, you’ll find we’re an inclusive company with a culture of care and by joining the Retail Team as an Apprentice Travel Advisor in our Pontyclun store we’ll provide a valuable insight into the world of travel and fully support you in working towards the Level 3 Travel Consultant Apprenticeship. You’ll put all customers at the heart of our business by creating unforgettable holiday experiences that make us the best-loved holiday company.

As part of our commitment to provide exceptional customer service and flexibility for our customers, you’ll enjoy a varied shift pattern each week including, weekends, bank holidays and evenings at some of our busier stores.

About Our Offer

  • TUI offers much more than just a starting salary starting of £8.50 per hour which increases after the first year
  • Be rewarded for exceeding your targets with our commission scheme
  • Enjoy fantastic holiday benefits, discounts, special offers and the ability to purchase additional TUI time off
  • Benefit from our Health and Wellbeing across key areas – Financial, Health, Social, Community and Career
  • Investment in your development and career progression
  • Pension scheme and life assurance

About The Job

  • Use your passion to inspire our customers and colleagues whilst enjoying a great amount of fun
  • Your drive to achieve will lead you to exceed your sales and objectives, in Retail we call it ‘Smashing your Targets’

  • If things don’t go to plan, your colleague network will actively help you investigate and resolve any question or complaint
  • As technology advances so does TUI, you’ll receive support and training on a variety of systems empowering you to enhance your knowledge, skills and behaviours to confidently adapt your style to help answer questions whilst bringing memorable holidays to life for our customers
  • You’ll be given time within your working week to complete practical and written assignments via your online learning platform and with the support of your manager and a dedicated learning coach you'll be guided through your apprenticeship with the aim to achieve a Level 3 Travel Consultant qualification.

About You

  • Good knowledge of excellent customer service and a genuine passion to work within tourism
  • Dedicated to achieve, goals, targets and a Level 3 Travel Consultant qualification
  • Self-motivated and willing to act on feedback, remaining positive when faced with challenges
  • Willing to embrace change and adapt to new ways of working
  • A team player who engages and collaborates with our customers and colleagues
  • An organised individual who takes pride in their work and able to communicate effectively

From a workplace to a place to belong. At TUI we embrace diversity, equity and inclusion, encouraging everyone to come as you are, because together, our potential is limitless.

job.job_description:
About Us

Founded in 1999 and listed on NASDAQ in 2003 and HKEX in 2021, Trip.com Group is a leading global travel service provider comprising of Trip.com, Ctrip, Skyscanner, and Qunar.


Across its platforms, Trip.com Group integrates travel resources from industry partners and helps travellers worldwide pursue the perfect trip with exceptional travel products and services.


We have four Customer Service Centres for Trip.com established in Japan, Korea, the UK, and the Philippines, providing 24/7 customer service in 19 different languages.


We have more than 30,000 employees scattered across 30 countries in Asia, Europe, the Americas, and Oceania, striving to expand our global markets and aiming to be the world’s leading and most trusted family of online travel brands that aspire to deliver the perfect trip at the best price for every traveller.


The Business Development Manager, Distribution will be responsible for expanding and optimising the distribution network for Trip.com’s Attractions, Tours & Activities business. This role focuses on acquiring, managing, and growing partnerships with distribution partners (OTAs, affiliates, resellers, travel agencies, and platform partners) to drive supply visibility, transaction growth, and revenue performance across global markets. Open to location in Paris, London, Frankfurt and Berlin.


In this Role, you will do the following:

Distribution Partnership Development:

  • Identify, onboard, and manage strategic distribution partners, including OTAs, affiliates, travel agencies, Meta, and other B2B channels.
  • Develop scalable distribution strategies to increase exposure and sales of Attractions, Tours & Activities products across multiple markets.
  • Negotiate commercial terms, commission structures, and partnership agreements to ensure mutual growth and profitability.

Account Management & Growth:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned distribution partners, ensuring strong relationships and long-term collaboration.
  • Drive partner performance through joint business planning, promotions, and product optimisation initiatives.
  • Monitor partner KPIs, analyse performance data, and implement action plans to improve conversion, booking volume, and revenue.

Market & Product Strategy:

  • Collaborate with internal teams (Supply, Operations team) to align distribution strategies with overall business objectives.
  • Provide market insights on competitive landscape, pricing trends, and customer behavior to inform product and distribution decisions.
  • Support the localisation and market expansion of A&T, products across key source (Global) and destination markets (Europe).

Operational Excellence

  • Ensure smooth onboarding, API or system integration, and operational readiness of distribution partners.
  • Resolve partner-related issues efficiently, including content accuracy, inventory availability, pricing discrepancies, and operational escalations.


What you'll Need to Succeed

  • 3–7 years of experience in Business Development, Partnerships, or Distribution, preferably within OTA, travel tech, tourism, or e-commerce industries.
  • Solid understanding of Attractions, Tours & Activities, distribution models, or B2B/B2B2C partnerships is highly preferred.
  • Experience working with channel managers or travel technology platforms is a strong advantage.
  • Strong commercial acumen with proven negotiation and deal-closing capabilities.
  • Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and drive business decisions.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, both internally and externally.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, cross-cultural, and matrixed organisation.
  • Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus, depending on market coverage.
  • Results-driven, proactive, and highly motivated with an entrepreneurial mindset.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Adaptable in multicultural and fast-paced environments
  • Passion for travel, experiences, and building scalable global partnerships.


Why Trip.com Group

We offer a stage to unleash your full potential and drive global impact. As an international team, we embrace an open and inclusive culture that supports and respect team members in and out of the workplace. Everyone is on a trip, whether it's a career trip or a life trip. At Trip.com Group, you can define your own trip by setting a goal and celebrate your success by recognizing the progress you have made.

What’s more?

  • Our rapid business growth in global offers abundant career opportunities at various levels and in multiple functions
  • Internal transfer is encouraged, and global job rotation program enable you to pursue a global career path and make global impact
  • We provide learning opportunities to further your career in areas of leadership capability, soft skill and professional expertise.
  • We encourage flexible work arrangement
  • Have fun with company-sponsored greetings and activities at holidays, birthdays, and colorful team events.

Click the link to learn more about This is a Trip Where Both Your Career and Life Can Flourish!

Sojern is a Travel Marketing Platform that helps you find, attract, convert, and engage your customers throughout the travel buying journey.
