We deliver unrivaled traveler insight, intelligent audiences, multichannel activation and optimization, and a connected guest experience for hotels – all in one place.
job.job_description:
About Sojern & RateGain:

RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global leader in AI-powered SaaS solutions for the travel and hospitality industry, serving over 16,000 customers and 700+ partners across 100+ countries. Since its founding in 2004, RateGain has been at the forefront of helping travel brands accelerate revenue through smarter acquisition, stronger retention, and deeper customer engagement.

Today, RateGain stands among the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data. Its platforms empower revenue management, distribution, and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, online travel agencies, car rentals, cruises, and more—enabling them to make faster, data-driven decisions that drive measurable business outcomes.

With deep industry trust, RateGain works with 26 of the top 33 hotel chains, 25 of the top 30 OTAs, 4 of the top 5 airlines, and numerous Fortune 500 companies globally—unlocking new revenue opportunities every day.

Following the integration of Sojern and the addition of Adara, RateGain has evolved into one of the most advanced AI-powered growth ecosystems in travel. Positioned at the intersection of demand generation, revenue optimisation, and AI-driven traveler intelligence, the company brings together:


  • Demand Generation: Programmatic and multi-channel media to drive high-intent audiences
  • Revenue Optimisation: Pricing, distribution, and conversion intelligence to maximise performance
  • Traveler Data Intelligence: Billions of real-time signals powering predictive insights


Together, these capabilities enable the world’s leading travel brands—hotels, airlines, destinations, and OTAs—to unify marketing, distribution, and revenue strategy into a single, intelligent growth engine. This is not just SaaS—it’s a transformative platform redefining how the travel industry grows.


About the Role:

We are seeking Director Sales - Corporate (Australia / NZ) to lead growth across two of our most strategic Asia Pacific markets (Singapore, Hong-Kong and Australia / New-Zealand). This role offers significant headroom to scale enterprise travel accounts across our Corporate Vertical (Airlines, Hotels, Car Rentals, OTAs, Finances, Telcos and Luxury brands).

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Define and execute the AU and NZ go-to-market strategy for enterprise accounts.
  • Drive new business acquisition across Airlines, Hotels, Car Rentals, OTAs, Finances, Telcos and Luxury brands organizations
  • Own, Maintain and close large, complex enterprise deals involving multiple stakeholders across C-suite, marketing, revenue, and technology teams
  • Build and expand strategic relationships across the RateGain Travel Technologies Limited, Sojern, and Adara ecosystem
  • Identify and unlock cross-sell and upsell opportunities across the full platform suite
  • Develop strong executive-level relationships to drive long-term partnerships through Enterprise initiative that are going beyond classic media channel activations (Loyalty, Planning Solutions, Enrichment etc).


Additional Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, and Customer Success to align on market needs and drive revenue outcomes
  • Build and manage a robust pipeline, ensuring consistent forecasting and deal velocity
  • Represent the organization at industry events, conferences, and client engagements across Australia & New Zealand.
  • Continuously track market trends, competitive landscape, and customer needs to refine strategy.


Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience in enterprise sales within AdTech, MarTech, Travel Tech, or SaaS
  • Demonstrated success in closing high-value, multi-threaded enterprise deals
  • Strong understanding of digital advertising, data platforms, or the travel ecosystem
  • Proven ability to engage and influence C-level stakeholders
  • Experience in managing long sales cycles and complex deal structures
  • Strong hunter mindset with a track record of new logo acquisition and account expansion
  • Experience working across Australia & New-Zealand markets
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment


Work Environment Details:

Based in Australia, with a hybrid role working from the office and / or from home.


Specific requirements

Travel: Need to be flexible to travel across AU/NZ as off when the day-day business requires it.


Why Join Us

This is an opportunity to play a critical role in shaping the infrastructure of a growing, global organization. You’ll work alongside a collaborative, high-performing team, gain exposure to international operations, and have the opportunity to grow your career as the company expands.


Equal Opportunity Employer

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Do you want to Be A Part of something unique?

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Gathering, Experience and Commercial Curator at Hart Shoreditch Hotel, Curio Collection, you’re not just identifying, developing, and securing new business opportunities to drive revenue – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

How We'll Help You Thrive

At Hilton, the hospitality we're known for doesn't end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members' wellbeing, supporting you through all of life's moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with a wide range of perks and benefits, including:

  • Competitive pay – £28,683.20 per annum plus incentives if targets are reached and opportunities to grow your career with Hilton.
  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy discounted hotel stays through our Go Hilton travel programme, with room rates as low as $40 USD per night at participating hotels worldwide.
  • Food and beverage discounts – Receive 50% off food and beverage at participating outlets.
  • Free meals on duty – Helping you stay energised throughout your shift.
  • Generous holiday allowance – Enjoy 28 days' holiday including bank holidays, increasing with service.
  • Pension scheme – Supporting you as you plan for the future.
  • High street discounts – Access a range of exclusive savings through Perks at Work.
  • Mental health resources – Through our Care for All hub, Team Members have access to wellbeing resources, alongside free counselling and support through our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP).
  • Crisis Concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for practical support and emotional care.
  • Career development opportunities – Grow with Hilton through learning and development programmes designed to support your personal and professional growth.
  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member location and terms and conditions of employment.

Hart Shoreditch Hotel London, Curio Collection by Hilton is a boutique lifestyle hotel based in the cultural, creative and trendy scene of Shoreditch.

Our team strives to be friendly, supportive and inclusive and we are always looking for people who live and breathe these values.

About Curio Collection By Hilton Hotels

Hilton’s Curio Collection brand appeals to travelers seeking one-of-a-kind discoveries and authentic experiences. Each Curio Collection by Hilton hotel is part of the destination it calls home — authentically embodying the distinct culture and spirit of the community in which they reside.

Responsibilities

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:

The Gathering, Experience & Commercial Curator is the creative and commercial heart of the hotel’s event sales and experience offering.

Responsible for conceptualizing, curating, and producing gatherings that embody the brand’s spirit and local culture, the Curator ensures every event — from intimate dinners to immersive brand collaborations — delivers meaningful impact, exceptional service, and strong commercial results.

  • Generate new business leads: Analyze local market trends and competitor activity to uncover opportunities across revenue streams
  • Grow customer accounts: Build relationships with existing customers and travel locally to expand market share and drive business to the hotel/cluster
  • Negotiate and contract effectively: Secure group and corporate bookings by negotiating rates and preparing contracts in line with pricing strategies
  • Develop local marketing: Support business growth by leveraging creative marketing channels tailored to the local market
  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with other hotel departments to develop exceptional guest experiences and build comprehensive sales programs
  • Provide visibility into sales efforts: Maintain detailed records of sales activity and deliver timely updates to Sales leadership
  • Respond to client enquiries: Handle customer questions and requests promptly and professionally to support conversion and satisfaction

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

This role is based in Bangkok, Thailand, and is open to candidates worldwide. We offer a generous relocation package to ensure a smooth transition to living and working in Bangkok.

Get to Know our Team:

The Marketing Team of Agoda is a world leader in online marketing. This department is highly data-driven and focused on developing at-scale marketing programs that improve the lifetime value of Agoda customers through measurable marketing programs and channels. The team is a blend of the best analysts, marketing strategists, and data scientists in the world. The marketing leadership at Agoda have deep experience in data science, product, strategy, and other marketing fields and have built an organization that thrives on data, creative ideas, and technology.

The Opportunity:

We are launching a new B2C Product designed to make travel spending seamless and transparent for all travelers.

As Senior Growth Marketing Manager – New verticals, you will play a key role in taking this product from early stage to scale. You’ll own growth strategy and execution across acquisition and retention, working closely with product, fintech, and cross-functional marketing teams. This is a unique opportunity to build a new vertical within Agoda from the ground up.

In this Role, You'll Get to:

  • Co-own with product the go-to market strategy: targeted segments, USP, and positioning for product
  • Design the marketing strategy for the new B2C product across the full funnel – from user acquisition and activation to engagement and retention
  • Execute the marketing strategy: e.g., 
    • Launch the different marketing channels (e.g., paid search, app campaigns, affiliates) 
    • Optimize performance campaigns across channels such as; App campaigns, Paid search
    • Work closely with Product and Design to Shape onboarding, in-app messaging, and key user journeys
  • Collaborate with Fintech, Legal, and Compliance to ensure campaigns, claims, and messaging are accurate, compliant, and easy for customers to understand and Translate regulatory constraints into clear, user-friendly communications
  • Build and continuously improve dashboards, reporting, and processes to scale growth operations over time.
  • Over time, manage and mentor a team (e.g., :2 analysts/marketers) as the vertical grows.

What You'll Need to Succeed:

Must Have Qualifications

  • Marketing expertise: At least 8 years of experience with 3+ years of hands-on growth/ direct marketing in app-based or digital products, focusing on user acquisition and retention
  • Strong analytical skills.
    • Comfortable working with data and performance metrics (CAC, LTV, activation, retention, payback, cohorts).
    • Ability to pull and analyze data using SQL and/or self serve BI tools.
  • Demonstrated entrepreneurial / builder mentality.
    • Able to operate in ambiguity, set up new processes, and “figure things out” without a playbook.
    • Bias for action and experimentation.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience collaborating with multi team in multiple department 

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Direct marketing, Performance marketing and Affiliate marketing for financial products
  • Experience in fintech or financial services, such as Travel cards, multicurrency wallets
  • Experience launching or scaling a new product or major feature

We are more than 290,000 hospitality experts placing people at the heart of what we do, creating emotion for our guests, and nurturing passion for service and achievement beyond limits. What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

Exploring a career at Delta gives you a chance to see the world while earning great compensation and benefits to help you keep climbing along the way:

The Senior Commercial Administrator provides high-level commercial and administrative support to the Commercial team, ensuring the effective management of customer contracts, pricing, commercial reporting, tender submissions and customer governance processes.

The role is responsible for maintaining commercial documentation, coordinating contract administration, supporting new business opportunities, monitoring commercial performance, and ensuring accurate and timely delivery of key commercial activities. The position plays a critical role in supporting revenue growth, customer retention and compliance across all dnata Airport Services business units.

Key Responsibilities:

Commercial Administration

Manage the administration of all customer contracts, ensuring documentation is current, accurate and securely maintained.

Maintain the commercial contract register, including contract terms, pricing schedules, renewal dates and key obligations.

Track contract milestones, expiry dates, CPI adjustments and review periods.

Coordinate execution and filing of agreements, amendments and variations.

Support contract governance processes across the business.

Pricing & Financial Support

Assist in preparing pricing models and commercial proposals.

Coordinate annual CPI reviews and customer pricing adjustments.

Prepare customer quotations and pricing schedules.

Maintain commercial pricing databases.

Support revenue analysis and commercial reporting.

Assist Finance with customer invoicing queries relating to contractual pricing.

Tender & Proposal Management

Coordinate end-to-end tender administration.

Prepare submission documents and ensure compliance with tender requirements.

Maintain a library of company capability statements, templates and supporting documentation.

Coordinate internal stakeholder inputs for proposals.

Track tender opportunities and submission deadlines.

Customer & Commercial Reporting

Prepare monthly customer performance reports.

Produce commercial dashboards and KPI reporting.

Support customer business reviews and governance meetings.

Prepare presentation material for executive and customer meetings.

Monitor contract performance against agreed commercial commitments.

Stakeholder Coordination

Liaise with operational teams to gather information supporting commercial activities.

Work closely with Finance, Legal, Procurement and Operations.

Coordinate customer requests relating to commercial matters.

Support implementation of new customer contracts and service variations.

Business Improvement

Identify opportunities to improve commercial processes and systems.

Develop standard operating procedures for commercial administration.

Improve document control and contract management practices.

Support implementation of new commercial systems and reporting tools.

Skills & Experience

Essential:

Minimum 3 years’ experience in a commercial administration, contracts or business support role.

Strong contract administration experience.

Excellent organisational and project coordination skills.

Advanced Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint skills.

Strong analytical and financial literacy.

Exceptional written and verbal communication.

Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

High attention to detail and accuracy.

Desirable:

Experience within aviation, airport services or logistics.

Experience preparing tender submissions.

Knowledge of commercial contracts and pricing methodologies.

Experience with ERP or contract management systems.

Understanding of financial reporting and budgeting.

Working Relationships

If you are looking for a dynamic role with great exposure to the business and customers then apply today!

The Director, Leadership Development will shape and scale how leaders grow at Expedia Group. This role will create practical, connected leadership solutions that help people leaders perform at their best, build strong teams, navigate change, and deliver better business outcomes.

You will lead an integrated leadership development agenda across the People function, partnering closely with Talent Management, Capability Building, Employee Experience, People Analytics, Organisational Development, Organizational Effectiveness, and HR Business Partners. You will turn business and workforce needs into simple, measurable experiences that can reach leaders across the organization.

This role is for a strategic builder who can move comfortably between enterprise thinking and hands-on execution. You will bring an AI mindset to the work: exploring how AI can improve leader effectiveness, personalize development, scale access to support, and help the Learning team make better decisions.

In This Role, You Will

Set the strategy and roadmap:

  • Define and evolve the leadership development strategy, principles, priorities, and roadmap in partnership with Learning leadership and key People stakeholders.
  • Translate enterprise strategy, workforce insights, and evolving leadership expectations into focused development priorities.
  • Establish a coherent leadership development architecture, including experiences for new, experienced, senior, and enterprise leaders.
  • Build a clear point of view on the leadership capabilities needed for the future of work, including responsible and effective use of AI.

Build Scalable Solutions

  • Design and oversee practical, inclusive leadership experiences that can scale across functions, geographies, levels, and business contexts.
  • Create a balanced portfolio of programs, journeys, tools, manager resources, digital learning, peer experiences, coaching, and on-the-job application.
  • Use a learner-centered approach to make development easy to understand, relevant to the work, and accessible at the moment of need.
  • Design for the full leadership journey, with simple interventions embedded in the flow of work and tailored to moments that matter.

Integrate Across The People Ecosystem

  • Connect leadership development with talent reviews, succession planning, career growth, performance, and internal mobility.
  • Align leadership experiences with broader enterprise and functional capability priorities.
  • Support transformation, team effectiveness, operating model changes, and enterprise ways of working.
  • Partner with Employee Experience to strengthen the connection between leader behavior, culture, engagement, inclusion, and the employee journey.
  • Partner with People Analytics to use data and insights to identify needs, target interventions, measure outcomes, and improve decisions.
  • Work with HRBPs to understand business needs, prioritize opportunities, activate solutions, and reinforce application in the flow of work.

Lead With An AI Mindset

  • Identify high-value opportunities to use AI in leadership development, including personalization, practice, coaching support, content discovery, insights, and measurement.
  • Experiment with emerging tools and approaches while maintaining appropriate standards for privacy, inclusion, quality, transparency, and responsible use.
  • Help leaders build the judgment and confidence to lead effectively in an AI-enabled workplace.
  • Share practical guidance and examples that help the Learning team and People partners use AI thoughtfully and productively.

Experience And Qualifications

  • 10+ years experience leading enterprise leadership development, organizational development, talent, learning, or a closely related discipline.
  • A track record of creating and scaling leadership programs, academies, journeys, or capability solutions across a complex organization.
  • Strong understanding of how leadership development connects to talent management, employee experience, organizational effectiveness, culture, and business performance.
  • Experience partnering with senior leaders and HRBPs to diagnose needs, shape priorities, and deliver outcomes.
  • A practical understanding of AI and a curiosity to apply it to learning, leadership, and the employee experience.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, storytelling, and stakeholder-management skills.

The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $207,500.00 to $290,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $332,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

job.job_description:
Organization- Hyatt Corporate Office

Summary

The Opportunity

Hyatt Hotels Corporation seeks an enthusiastic Regional Vice President, Strategic Performance, to support Hyatt Luxury Brands within America’s Performance Hub. In this role, the Regional Vice President, Strategic Performance, will collaborate closely with Portfolio Health, Operational Performance, Field Operations and cross-functional partners to strengthen hotel performance, develop General Managers, deepen owner relationships, advance guest experience and support the continued refinement and evolution of the Luxury Brands. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list since 2013. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

  • Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on-site fitness center
  • A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption
  • Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

The Role

  • Lead, support and develop a portfolio of approximately 10–15 Hotel General Managers and their leadership teams, providing coaching, performance guidance, succession support and capability building resources that strengthen leadership effectiveness.
  • Drive hotel performance across financial results and guest satisfaction measures by diagnosing performance gaps, establishing clear action plans and ensuring timely follow-through against core metrics, with particular attention to luxury service delivery and guest expectations.
  • Build and sustain trusted owner relationships by providing proactive support, communicating hotel performance and strategic priorities, addressing concerns and driving positive owner sentiment, with an understanding of the expectations and investment priorities associated with luxury assets.
  • Exercise independent judgment on General Manager hiring, leadership accountability and performance actions, partnering with appropriate Human Resources and business leaders as needed.
  • Strengthen commercial behaviors and results across the portfolio by applying strong commercial acumen and partnering with hotel and enterprise Commercial teams on revenue, sales, marketing and demand-generation opportunities.
  • Evaluate hotel operating effectiveness and guide actions that improve execution, efficiency, leadership alignment, and overall business performance through accountability of use of available tools and resources while maintaining Hyatt standards.
  • Review and approve hotel-level financial recommendations within established authority, and prepare and present items requiring further approval to owners and Corporate leaders.
  • Apply an asset-management perspective to hotel strategy, financial decisions, capital priorities and operating plans to support sustainable performance and long-term asset value, including the unique positioning and investment considerations of luxury hotels.
  • Partner closely with Brand teams to drive alignment with Luxury Brand standards and priorities, while contributing field insights that support brand refinement, differentiation and evolution across the luxury portfolio.
  • Provide enterprise leadership across America’s Managed Performance Hub and partner functions, using data, hotel operations and commercial tools, and AI-enabled capabilities to identify issues, generate insights and accelerate effective action plans.
  • Demonstrate a commitment to Hyatt core values.

Qualifications

Experience Required:

  • 10+ years of hotel operations and/or commercial or finance experience with a proven track record of success.
  • Prior Hotel General Manager or above-property/regional experience required; luxury hotel or luxury brand experience strongly preferred.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen with demonstrated ability to translate performance data into operating actions.
  • Experience leading hotel performance, leadership accountability and owner relationships across complex operating environments, with demonstrated understanding of luxury service standards and guest expectations preferred.
  • Knowledge of asset management principles preferred.
  • Strong enterprise leadership skills with the ability to influence across hotels, functions, owners and Corporate leadership.
  • Ability to diagnose complex performance problems quickly and develop clear, practical action plans that drive measurable turnaround.
  • Strong relationship-management and communication skills, particularly with Hotel General Managers, hotel leadership teams and owners.
  • Ability to travel up to 50% to support assigned hotels, owners and business priorities.

Experience Preferred:

  • Bachelors degree preferred
  • Proficiency with hotel operations and commercial performance tools.
  • Strong AI acumen and demonstrated ability to use AI-enabled tools to analyze performance, generate insights and improve productivity.

The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all-encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary.

We welcome you:

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.

The salary range for this position is $161,300-$250,000. This role is also eligible for an Annual Incentive Plan, LTIP and DCP plan.

The final pay rate/salary offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level and other qualifications for the role, as well as the location of the performance of work. Pay for the successful candidate will meet local requirements, including the local minimum wage rate.

Introduction

Play a key role in keeping hotel technology secure, reliable and performing at its best, directly supporting hotel operations, guest experience and colleague productivity. You’ll combine hands-on technical expertise with proactive infrastructure management, cybersecurity and technology improvement, working across participating hotels in the JAPAC region. This is an exciting opportunity for a technology professional who enjoys solving problems, taking ownership and using technology to make a tangible difference to hotel operations.

Your day to day

  • Provide high-quality onsite and remote technology support across participating hotels, taking ownership of technical incidents and escalations from initial investigation through to resolution.
  • Manage and maintain hotel technology infrastructure, including networks, devices, cloud-connected services and critical hotel systems, ensuring technology remains reliable and supports day-to-day operations.
  • Strengthen cybersecurity and operational resilience through security updates, vulnerability remediation, system protection, backup and recovery activities, addressing identified risks through to closure.
  • Use monitoring, analytics and automation to identify potential issues, improve service delivery and reduce avoidable disruption, while maintaining accurate technology documentation and asset information.
  • Support technology projects, system upgrades, equipment lifecycle planning and new hotel openings, working closely with hotel teams, regional technology colleagues, vendors and service partners to deliver successful outcomes.

What We Need From You

  • A minimum of 3 years' experience in technical support or infrastructure operations, ideally gained within hospitality or another round-the-clock operational environment.
  • Hands-on experience supporting Windows, Microsoft 365, identity and endpoint management, together with strong knowledge of networks, Wi-Fi, firewalls, secure remote connectivity and internet infrastructure.
  • Experience supporting hotel technology such as property management, point-of-sale, payments, revenue management, back-office and guest-facing systems.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity, including security updates, vulnerability management, endpoint protection, incident response and secure system configuration.
  • Relevant technology certifications across Microsoft, Cisco, cloud or cybersecurity, together with ITIL 4 Foundation, plus strong communication and stakeholder-management skills when working with hotel teams, technology partners and vendors.

Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

Job Summary

Functions as the Operational Business leader of the property. Areas of responsibility may include Front Office, Housekeeping, Food and Beverage/Culinary and Engineering/Maintenance and Recreation. Works with direct reports (e.g., department heads) to develop and implement departmental strategies and manage the implementation of the brand service strategy and brand initiatives. Verifies that Villas Operations meet the brand’s standards, targets customer/owner needs, monitors employee satisfaction, focuses on growing revenues and maximizes the financial performance of the department and develops positive owner relations. Develops and implements property-wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand’s target customer and employees and provides a return on investment.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education And Experience

  • 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 4 years experience in the guest services, front desk, housekeeping, sales and marketing, management operations, or related professional area.

OR

  • 4-year bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, housekeeping, sales and marketing, management operations, or related professional area.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Managing Profitability and Owner Relations

  • Demonstrates and communicates key drivers of guest satisfaction for the brand’s target customer.
  • Analyzes service issues and identifies trends.
  • Makes and executes the necessary decisions to keep property moving forward toward achievement of goals.
  • Works with hotel management team to develop an operational strategy that is aligned with the brand’s business strategy and leads its execution.
  • Maintains a strong, positive relationship with the Board of Directors of the property HOA’s.
  • Attends quarterly Board of Director meeting for HOA.
  • Develops yearly HOA Budget in tandem with Vistana Finance and present year to the Board of directors for approval.
  • Provides leadership at Annual Homeowners Association Meeting including support for report out on the years activities and results, as well provides open Q&A for those attending the meetings.
  • Conducts monthly P&L with Property team and Vistana Finance.
  • Attends Quarterly Business Review meetings with Vistana Corporate team reviewing the quarter’s results to budget/forecast and overall financial health of the HOA.
  • Attends Monthly Account Receivables calls with VSE Finance reviewing outstanding receivables.
  • Establishes Vistana approved contracts with all vendors, verifying that appropriate records maintained for all vendors.
  • Reviews reports and financial statements to determine hotel operations performance against budget.
  • Coaches and supports operations team to effectively manage occupancy and rate, wages and controllable expenses.
  • Compares budgeted wages to actual wages, coaching direct reports to address problem areas and holding team accountable for results. Reviews the Wage Progress Report.

Managing Revenue Goals

  • Monitors hotel operations sales performance against budget.
  • Focuses on growing revenues and maximizes the financial performance of the department
  • Collaborates with Revenue Management to monetize Developer Owned units, HOA owned Units, SPG Conversion Units from Owners, and unused Owner inventory through daily rental of units through traditional means of booking rooms.
  • Participates in weekly revenue forecast meetings to review current rate strategies and revenue generation.
  • Participates in monthly revenue forecast reviews with Revenue Management and Owner Inventory team.

Leading Operations and Department Teams

  • Functions as the strategic business leader of the property's Hotel Operations; areas of responsibility may include Recreation, Front Office, Housekeeping, Food and Beverage/Culinary and Engineering/Maintenance.
  • Works with direct reports (e.g., department heads) to develop and implement departmental strategies and manage the implementation of the brand service strategy and brand initiatives.
  • Develops and implements property-wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand’s target customer and employees and provides a return on investment.
  • Champions the brand’s service vision for product and service delivery and ensures alignment amongst the hotel leadership teams.
  • Develops systems to enable employees to understand guest satisfaction results.
  • Communicates a clear and consistent message regarding departmental goals to produce desired results.
  • Performs other duties, as assigned, to meet business needs.
  • Verifies that the Engineering and Housekeeping Departments successfully conduct Maintenance Weeks Program for the resort.

Managing The Guest Experience

  • Reviews guest feedback with leadership team and verifies that appropriate corrective action is taken.
  • Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
  • Stays visible and interfaces with customers on a regular basis to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
  • Creates an atmosphere in all Rooms and Food and Beverage areas that meets or exceeds guest expectations.
  • Oversees and manage Social Media and Reputation Management. Responds to on-line reviews within set guidelines for responding.
  • Participate in monthly Social Media call with Vistana Team.
  • Collaborates with Vistana Marketing to ensure the Concierge team is performing to brand and guest expectations.
  • Provides leadership to drive the success of Vistana Owner-centric promotions or activities that are rolled-out to enhance the owner experience.

Managing and Conducting Human Resources Activities

  • Facilitates the development of creative solutions to overcome obstacles and manages the implementation to continually improve guest satisfaction results.
  • Verifies that employees are treated fairly and equitably.
  • Verifies that regular, ongoing communication is happening in Operations (e.g., pre-shift briefings, staff meetings).
  • Fosters employee commitment to providing excellent service, participates in daily stand-up meetings and models desired service behaviors in all interactions with guests and employees.
  • Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of staff/operations meetings with an emphasis on generating innovative ways to continually improve results.
  • Sets goals and expectations for direct reports using the performance review process and holds staff accountable for successful performance.
  • Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an “open door policy” and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
  • Verifies that property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and supports the Peer Review Process.
  • Conducts annual performance appraisal with direct reports according to Standard Operating Procedures.
  • Champions change, manages the implementation of brand and regional business initiatives and communicates follow-up actions to team as necessary.

Description

About the Job

The Sales Manager, Agency is responsible for managing and supporting some of United’s most strategic agency partnerships, including emerging and growing sectors such as loyalty travel, representing approximately $700 million to more than $1 billion in annual United revenue. The role provides dedicated ownership of one or more strategically important agency partnerships while supporting broader partnership strategies across corporate, leisure, and loyalty travel channels. Serving as a primary commercial point of contact, the Sales Manager develops data-driven growth strategies, negotiates commercial agreements, evaluates investment performance, and strengthens partner engagement to drive sustainable revenue growth and customer value.

The Sales Manager advances United’s commercial objectives by developing mutually beneficial agency partnerships that drive sustainable revenue growth, customer engagement, and long-term business value. Success in this role requires strategic thinking, analytical rigor, strong commercial acumen, and effective relationship management to deliver measurable results for both United and its partners.

The role also advances United’s commercial and distribution priorities by applying a digital-first mindset and facilitating adoption of modern retailing capabilities, including NDC and direct-connect opportunities through preferred distribution channels. Through strategic account ownership, customer engagement, rigorous financial analysis, persuasive brand and value proposition selling, and effective use of sales tools and incentives, the Sales Manager improves account performance and delivers sustainable commercial results.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships, serving as a primary commercial point of contact for assigned accounts.
  • Develop and execute commercial growth strategies that drive revenue, share gains, customer retention, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Develop and execute business plans for strategic agency partnerships, including emerging growth channels such as loyalty travel.
  • Analyze customer performance, market trends, and investment effectiveness to identify growth opportunities, forecast results, benchmark performance, and inform commercial decision-making.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to design, negotiate, launch, and optimize commercial programs and customer investments.
  • Lead contract negotiations, renewals, and commercial recommendations that maximize business performance.
  • Monitor account health, identify risks and opportunities, and implement corrective actions as needed.
  • Build credibility across customer organizations and influence decision-makers at multiple levels.
  • Create and deliver compelling executive-level presentations, proposals, and business reviews.
  • Collaborate across Revenue Management, Distribution, Digital, Finance, Legal, and Sales teams to align strategies and maximize growth opportunities.
  • Champion innovation across digital and advisor-led channels, including modern retailing, direct-connect, and merchandising opportunities.
  • Leverage executive engagement, joint customer initiatives, industry events, and advisory forums to strengthen strategic relationships.
  • Provide end-to-end ownership of assigned strategic partnerships, including strategy development, investment governance, execution, and performance management.

Note: This position provides a remote work arrangement, with preference towards candidates living within 50 miles of a United Airlines hub location (Chicago, Houston, Dulles, Newark, Denver, Los Angeles, or San Francisco). Travel required up to 50% of the time (both domestic and international).

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in sales, account management, customer relationship management, or a related commercial role
  • Experience in B2B2C marketing and selling
  • Strong foundational understanding of airline sales, travel agency sales, loyalty travel programs, and corporate travel management practices
  • Demonstrated skills in customer relationship management, account management, sales management, and commercial negotiation
  • Experience analyzing customer data, booking trends, financial performance, and market opportunities to support revenue growth and investment decisions
  • Strong communication, partnership-building, and contract management capabilities
  • Exceptional analytical, financial, sales, and negotiating skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear commercial recommendations
  • Ability to create and deliver exceptional client- or executive-facing presentations
  • Working knowledge of new distribution capabilities (NDC), content aggregators, direct-connect models, and digitally-enabled travel retailing
  • Reliable, punctual attendance is an essential function of the position
  • Successful completion of interview required to meet job qualification
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in sales, account management, customer relationship management, or a related commercial role
  • Experience with competitive intelligence and business intelligence reporting
  • Demonstrated digital mindset and curiosity, with experience identifying and advancing technology-enabled commercial opportunities
  • Proficiency in data visualization and presentation storytelling
  • Experience supporting customer experience management initiatives
  • Background owning large, complex strategic partnerships or agency sales relationships with accountability for growth, investment, and measurable business outcomes
  • Demonstrates an understanding of the capabilities and limitations of generative AI tools and effectively leverages them to support research, analysis, content creation, and problem-solving. Applies critical thinking to validate AI-generated outputs while adhering to organizational policies for responsible AI use, data privacy, and security.

The base pay range for this role is $78,755.00 to $102,598.00.

The base salary range/hourly rate listed is dependent on job-related, factors such as experience, education, and skills. This position is also eligible for bonus and/or long-term incentive compensation awards.

Dedicated to fulfilling its founding vision to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality, Hilton has welcomed over 4 billion guests in its more than 100-year history. Named as the No. 1 World’s Best Workplace by Great Place to Work and Fortune, Hilton aims to create the best culture for its 500,000 team members around the world. Hilton has introduced industry-leading technology enhancements to improve the guest experience, including Digital Key Share, automated complimentary room upgrades and the ability to book confirmed connecting rooms. Through the award-winning guest loyalty program Hilton Honors, the nearly 250 million Hilton Honors members who book directly with Hilton can earn Points for hotel stays and experiences money can't buy. With the free Hilton Honors app, guests can book their stay, select their room, check in, unlock their door with a Digital Key and check out, all from their smartphone. Visit stories.hilton.com for more information, and connect with Hilton on Facebook, X, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube.
job.job_description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

As a participant in our 12-month Corporate Placements Programme in the Global Distribution Department, you’re not just gaining hands-on experience at our Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA) Headquarters in Watford – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by contributing to the memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Here’s what you can look forward to as a programme participant:

  • Prepare for a career in hospitality: Embark on a 12-month transformative journey, encompassing a structured framework of learning and development opportunities, business support activities, and ownership of your own project-based initiatives.
  • Gain hands-on operational experience: From day one, you’ll be fully integrated into Team Hilton. Connect with professionals across the business and gain insight into Global Distribution. Take the opportunity to gain insight into at least one other business area, paving the way for valuable future relationships.
  • Work on real-world projects: Apply your skills on the job through business-driven projects to reinforce your learning and gain hands-on experience.
  • Develop your skills through world-class training and support: Access Hilton University’s e-learning modules and business library while building knowledge through business-driven projects.
  • Grow with personalised guidance: Benefit from regular feedback and coaching to ensure your progress is supported at every stage of the programme.
  • Hilton Perks: Including our Go Hilton Team Member Travel Program, which provides you with access to heavily reduced hotel room rates for you, your family & friends.
  • Salary & Benefits: £27,500 gross per annum & private healthcare.
  • Location: At our EMEA Headquarters in Watford, with some flexibility depending on team and business need. You will benefit from a subsidised restaurant, a games area and a free in-house gym.

Our Placement Opportunities

We have a range of placement opportunities within our highly talented Global Distribution department:

Distribution Strategy Placement

In this role, you will support the Strategy & Planning team managing relationships with our connected third-party channels. This is a unique opportunity for an intern to gain valuable experience in a global environment and gain a depth of knowledge of the complex distribution landscape in hospitality. You will be involved in the execution of marketing activities, development of internal training material, hosting workshops, account managing channels, the development of new channels and a variety of related projects to optimise distribution.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Developing business cases for newly identified channels for connectivity and identifying demand opportunities.
  • Collaborate with other internal Global Distribution functions as well as other departments within Hilton, including; Revenue Management, Pricing, Sales, Rate Loading, Marketing & eCommerce and IT.
  • Work alongside the Global Distribution Implementation Team on new channel activations to meet the demand identified from the original business case.
  • Conduct business reviews with channels and identify areas of opportunity to optimise performance and support commercial teams in driving demand for any need markets.
  • Lead projects on a regional or global level to optimise and enhance property performance on connected channels.
  • Work with various internal and external stakeholders to develop and implement marketing plans to support any promotional activity.
  • Supporting the development of presentations, messaging documents, and other communication materials for internal and external audiences.

Distribution Services International Placement

Distribution Services centrally manages the automated process that calculates and disburses travel agent, meeting planner, and third-party online compensation globally. Our team is committed to supporting Hilton’s Global Sales Organization in maintaining relationships and agreements with travel planners across the globe and reducing the administrative burden on hotel teams, speed payment and grow preference with third party intermediaries.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct reconciliation reviews, data analysis, reporting, and inquiry resolution activities, communicating findings with stakeholders to ensure accurate results and timely completion of key deliverables.
  • Identify data discrepancies and operational issues, partnering with internal teams, hotels, and travel agencies to investigate root causes and implement corrective actions.
  • Support new business partner onboarding through historical analysis, trend identification, and data validation to provide insights and establish operational benchmarks.
  • Prepare recurring and ad-hoc reports, presentations, and business reviews to support operational decision-making and stakeholder communications.
  • Support departmental objectives by managing inquiries and TopDesk tickets, conducting research and analysis to resolve complex cases and improve operational efficiency.
  • Create and maintain process documentation, quality control procedures, and other resources that support knowledge sharing and operational consistency.
  • Participate in team meetings, cross-functional initiatives, and special projects to support business objectives and professional development.

Global Distribution Implementation & Operations Placement

In this role, you will support the Director of Channel & Product Activations, as well as the Global Distribution Implementations and Operations teams. The successful candidate will contribute to the management and optimisation of over 300 online third-party distribution channels, alongside Hilton’s 9,000+ properties, ensuring seamless distribution of real-time rates and inventory to end consumers.

This is a unique opportunity for an intern to gain valuable hands-on experience within a global, cross-functional environment, develop an understanding of the complex hospitality distribution landscape, and contribute to initiatives that generate significant annual revenue.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support the implementation of new third-party channel connections, as well as the launch of new distribution products and promotional initiatives across connected third party channels.
  • Monitor, review and respond to support tickets from properties and distribution partners, escalating issues where necessary to ensure timely resolution.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with teams including Hilton IT, Revenue Management, and Sales to support project delivery and resolve operational challenges efficiently.
  • Proactively audit and analyse Special Rate Plans (SRPs) and channel accounts to identify and address potential discrepancies or risks.
  • Develop, maintain, and regularly review operational guides, training materials, and internal documentation to ensure accuracy and relevance.
  • Support the creation of presentations, communication materials, and stakeholder messaging for both internal and external audiences.
  • Assist with ad-hoc projects aimed at improving processes, driving efficiency, and supporting continuous improvement across Implementations and Operations, including documenting and rolling out new workflows and training.

What We’re Looking For

We are seeking individuals who embody the Hilton Values in addition to the following criteria:

  • A current bachelor’s or master’s student completing a degree that includes a required 12-month year in industry placement.
  • Preferably studying towards a degree in Business Administration, Hospitality Management, or similar.
  • Availability to begin full-time employment on 5th July 2027, for a full-time 12-month placement.
  • You must have the independent right to work in the UK for the full duration of the 12-month placement. Please note that this role is not eligible for visa sponsorship under the Skilled Worker route, so we are unable to consider applications from candidates who would require sponsorship. If you hold a visa or status that allows you to work in the UK full-time without sponsorship (e.g. Settled Status, Pre-Settled Status, where a 12-month work placement is a permitted, required & assessed part of your UK University degree, or other independent work permissions), you are welcome to apply.
  • Fluency in English (spoken and written).
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office - particularly, MS Word, MS PowerPoint, and MS Excel.
  • Ability to adapt to change and work in a fast-paced environment.
  • A positive attitude and willingness to learn.

Click here to learn more about Hilton's Corporate Placements

Selection Process

Applications are now open—don’t miss your chance to apply! Submissions close on Sunday 1st November 2026

Our selection process is designed to bring out your best and help us get to know you. It includes:

  • Online assessments.
  • In-person or virtual interview.

While the process is rigorous, it’s also the first step in your personal growth journey with Hilton. If selected, you’ll begin developing the skills, connections, and confidence to thrive in your career.

To ensure every application receives fair consideration, invitations to final-stage interviews will be issued after applications have closed. Please complete each stage promptly and keep an eye on your inbox for updates.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing reasonable adjustments for applicants and employees with disabilities. If you require any support or adjustments during the recruitment process or to carry out the essential requirements of the role, please contact us.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team: 

The Customer Experience Group (CEG) of Agoda serves our customers and partners to deliver satisfying results. This is accomplished with the support of our Global Service Verticals (GSV) team — the backbone of CEG’s global operations. Our team includes project managers, process owners, analysts, and talent management. Together we improve the quality and efficiency of our customer and partner support processes.

We are a data-driven environment, eager to move fast and learn through experimentation. A clear focus on supporting our customers and partners is bolstered by a strong, entrepreneurial culture that enriches us and Agoda’s business performance.

This role sits in the B2B Partnerships and Automation team, part of CEG’s Global Service Verticals. The team drives end-to-end customer experience and process improvements, and scales impact through automation, AI, and tooling across customer-facing and agent-facing journeys.

The Opportunity:

Joining the team, you will be focusing on leading and contributing to a select number of projects, working with senior stakeholders across the organization.

You will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and driving the execution of key initiatives, including setting clear project objectives, managing timelines, mitigating risks, and ensuring deliverables are met on time and within scope.

You will get to work closely with senior executives to manage Company and Group wide projects and drive key business initiatives within the Customer Experience Group. You will develop outstanding insights on our markets, competitors, and business trends and disseminate this knowledge across Agoda to inform key decisions. You help our leaders run Agoda skillfully, which includes clarifying accountability and identifying and monitoring critical success metrics.

In this Role, you will get to: 

Project Management and Execution: 

  • Manage and oversee strategic projects, ensuring initiatives move the dial, are executed on time and exceed expectations. 
  • Develop and maintain project roadmaps, timelines, and deliverables, coordinating across multiple teams in various departments to ensure successful implementation. 
  • Create business cases for initiatives to be pursued across Agoda
  • Monitor project progress and proactively address risks and challenges to maintain alignment with business objectives. 
  • Support the development and deployment of tools and processes to improve team efficiency and productivity. 

Stakeholder Management and Collaboration: 

  • Act as a central point of contact between different departments and commercial functions, including those of other brands of Booking Holdings. 
  • Facilitate communication and alignment across teams, ensuring all stakeholders are informed and engaged throughout project lifecycles. 
  • Support Directors/ Associate Directors in the creation of material for the Board / Management team
  • Support in the articulation of department strategy

Strategy, Performance Steering and Reporting: 

  • Track, analyze and guide team performance against key metrics, providing regular updates and actionable insights to collaborators and leadership alike. 
  • Compile reports and updates for senior leadership to showcase progress, challenges, and outcomes of key initiatives. 

What you will Need to Succeed:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field; advanced degree preferred. 
  • 4-6 years of relevant experience in a strategy consulting firm or in a tech company (project / program manager role) - chief of staff experience is a plus.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex ideas clearly and concisely. 
  • Proven track record of successful cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management. 
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate strategic initiatives and drive business growth. 
  • Ability to influence stakeholders 
  • Ability to learn fast and understand new business dynamics. 
  • Excitement to join a dynamic and innovative team within Agoda, with excellent growth prospects. 
  • It is great if you have:
  • Knowledge of SQL / Tableau or willingness to invest time in learning

Please review our Hiring Process Guidelines before your interview — click here to learn how interviewing at Agoda works.

Discover More About Working At Agoda

  • Agoda Careers https://careersatagoda.com
  • Facebook https://www.facebook.com/agodacareers/
  • LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/agoda
  • YouTube https://www.youtube.com/agodalife

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Agoda, we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds and orientations. We prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and innovation. Employment at Agoda is based solely on a person’s merit and qualifications. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity regardless of sex, age, race, color, national origin, religion, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, citizenship, veteran or military status, and other legally protected characteristics.

We will keep your application on file so that we can consider you for future vacancies and you can always ask to have your details removed from the file. For more details please read our privacy policy.

Disclaimer

We do not accept any terms or conditions, nor do we recognize any agency’s representation of a candidate, from unsolicited third-party or agency submissions. If we receive unsolicited or speculative CVs, we reserve the right to contact and hire the candidate directly without any obligation to pay a recruitment fee.

job.job_description:
Description de l'entreprise

Situé à proximité des Champs-Elysées, des haut-lieux de la culture et de la Mode, l’hôtel Sofitel Paris Arc de Triomphe, au design élégant et intemporel, accueille une clientèle française et internationale dans ses 124 chambres et Suites, son restaurant Envies, le Bar Sorsi ou ses 5 salons privés.

Depuis plusieurs années, l’hôtel est engagé dans une démarche responsable, récompensée par les labels Clef Verte, Tourisme & Handicap et Ecotable, démarche que l’hôtel Sofitel Paris Arc de Triomphe conduit également auprès de ses collaborateurs Heartists pour le bien-être et l’épanouissement de tous.

Le Sofitel Paris Arc de Triomphe recherche un(e) Responsable communication & marketing.

Description du poste

Rattaché(e) à la Direction générale, le/la Responsable Marketing & Communication définit, coordonne et déploie le plan marketing et communication de l’hôtel, dans le respect de la stratégie Sofitel et de la feuille de route validée avec la Direction générale et les équipes Marketing / Brand régionales.

Véritable chef d’orchestre de l’image et de la désirabilité de l’établissement, il/elle garantit la cohérence des messages et des contenus, pilote les agences et prestataires, orchestre les activations de marque et les événements associés, et veille à la bonne exécution des actions dans le respect des délais, des budgets et des standards de la marque.

Le poste conjugue vision stratégique et forte capacité opérationnelle : transformer les orientations en actions concrètes, valoriser les différentes expériences de l’hôtel et mesurer la contribution des initiatives à la notoriété, à l’engagement des publics et à la performance de l’établissement.

  • Stratégie marketing et pilotage du plan d’action
  • Construire le plan marketing et communication annuel à partir de la stratégie de l’hôtel, des priorités commerciales, des temps forts business et de la feuille de route de la marque.
  • Décliner les objectifs en plan d’actions opérationnel : calendrier, marchés et publics prioritaires, canaux, livrables, responsables, budgets et indicateurs de performance.
  • Assurer la bonne exécution du plan marketing selon la feuille de route validée par la Direction générale et les équipes Regional Marketing / Brand ; anticiper les risques, arbitrer les priorités et proposer des actions correctives.
  • Intégrer les Brand Momentums et activations proposés par la marque, en assurer l’adaptation pertinente à l’hôtel et coordonner l’organisation des événements et dispositifs associés.
  • Veiller à la cohérence des prises de parole entre les différents points de contact : hôtel, offres, expériences, supports commerciaux, site internet, réseaux sociaux, relations presse et communications partenaires.
  • Communication, image et contenus
  • Définir et déployer une stratégie de communication qui renforce la notoriété, l’attractivité et la préférence de l’hôtel auprès de ses clientèles cibles.
  • Construire un storytelling distinctif, fidèle à l’identité Sofitel et ancré dans la destination parisienne, en valorisant les expériences, les équipes, les savoir-faire et les temps forts de l’établissement.
  • Superviser la production des contenus éditoriaux et visuels : briefs, shootings photo et vidéo, banque d’images, textes, supports print et digitaux, dossiers de présentation et outils de communication.
  • Garantir le respect de la plateforme de marque, des chartes graphiques et éditoriales, des guidelines social media et des circuits de validation.
  • Coordonner la mise à jour des contenus sur les canaux pertinents avec les équipes internes et les interlocuteurs digitaux concernés, en veillant à l’exactitude des informations diffusées.
  • Relations presse, influence et réseaux sociaux
  • Définir les priorités de relations presse et d’influence en cohérence avec le positionnement de l’hôtel, ses actualités et ses marchés prioritaires.
  • Piloter les agences RP et influence : briefs, recommandations, plans d’action, invitations, accueils presse et créateurs de contenu, suivi des livrables et bilan des retombées.
  • Développer des relations suivies avec les médias, journalistes, prescripteurs et partenaires pertinents, en France et à l’international, en coordination avec la marque et les équipes régionales.
  • Construire et suivre le calendrier éditorial social media ; coordonner la création, la validation et la publication des contenus, ainsi que la modération et la gestion des interactions selon les responsabilités définies.
  • Suivre les résultats par canal : portée, engagement, qualité des audiences, trafic généré, retombées éditoriales et contribution aux objectifs de communication.

Le ou la responsable communication&marketing sera également en charge de :

  • Assurer l’intégration des campagnes, plateformes créatives, Brand Momentums et temps forts Sofitel dans le calendrier de l’hôtel, en adaptant leur exécution aux enjeux locaux.
  • Piloter les agences et partenaires externes prestataires marketing, créatifs, RP, influence, social media, photo / vidéo et événementiel selon le périmètre confié.
  • Construire et suivre le budget marketing et communication, engager les dépenses conformément aux procédures en vigueur et assurer le suivi des devis, commandes et factures.
  • Gérer la communication interne et collaborer de façon transverse et constante avec la Direction générale, les équipes commerciales, revenue management, e-commerce, hébergement, restauration et les autres services de l’hôtel.

Qualifications

  • Formation supérieure (Bac+4/5) en marketing, communication, relations publiques ou équivalent.
  • Expérience confirmée en marketing et communication, idéalement dans l’hôtellerie, les marques de luxe, le lifestyle ou les environnements exigeants.
  • Bonne compréhension des codes de la marque
  • Excellentes qualités rédactionnelles et relationnelle
  • Langues : Anglais bilingue impératif. La maîtrise d'une troisième langue est un atout.
  • Maîtrise des outils bureautiques et aisance avec les plateformes de gestion de contenus, de réseaux sociaux et de reporting.

Informations supplémentaires

  • Statut Cadre au forfait 214 jours travaillés
  • 13ème mois sans condition d’ancienneté
  • Indemnité nourriture mensuelle en fonction de la législation en vigueur
  • Intéressement collectif
  • Remboursement du titre de transport à hauteur de 100%
  • Mutuelle et prévoyance en vigueur dans l’établissement
  • Carte Heartist Bienvenue ACCOR (nombreux avantages : hôtels, restaurants, location de voitures, voyages, équipements, loisirs...)
  • Pressing
