job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

The ACS Tools and Technology team provides Delta's 30,000+ Airport Customer Service frontline team with the necessary technology and tools to offer customers a warm, caring, and elevated travel experience. We are looking for a highly motivated and self-driven Product Owner to join our team to support the technology conceptualization and product delivery of best-in-class tools to serve our frontline teams effectively. As part of the Tools and Technology team, you will play a critical role in redefining customer and employee experiences by setting new technology standards for thousands of ACS employees. We are seeking a Product Owner to support product development and improvements from ideation, roadmapping to execution and adoption. Specifically, this PO role is located in the Tower and Turn vertical, with exciting opportunities to work on optimizations, and AI-adjacent products, partnering with internal and third-party development while delivering solutions to Tower Agents and other user groups.

  • Provide leadership and direction to Analysts in reviewing, communicating, and translating business needs for both technical and non-technical audiences and stakeholders
  • Define and drive the work of squad/pods within Information Technology to prioritize the sprint backlog, balancing requirements of business stakeholders
  • Work directly with internal and external design resources to create UX/UI experiences that support new product functionality for both informational and transactional customer needs
  • Leverage and data and analytics to drive product roadmap, product development, prioritization of features and performance and adoption
  • Collaborate with other Product Owners, Product Managers, and stakeholders to refine features and stories and accept completed stories, ensuring they meet all predefined criteria
  • Coordinate with other Product Owners across the organization to align cross-squad efforts and maintain coherence in product development
  • Translate product development goals into requirements including features, user stories, and acceptance test criteria
  • Attend regular ceremonies with the Information Technology team including backlog grooming, sprint planning, daily standups, sprint review/demos, and retrospectives
  • Identify and communicate opportunities to increase revenue, customer satisfaction, employee satisfaction, and operational efficiency
  • Provide regular status reports to key stakeholders, sponsors, project managers, and others involved in the project
  • Play an integral role in engagement, communication, change management, feedback loops, and overall leadership visibility across the system
  • Develop both strategic and tactical plans that create a safety-conscious environment resulting in employee safety and wellbeing
  • Additional Responsibilities:
  • Take ownership of writing user stories and ensure they clearly convey the required functionality to the IT development teams
  • Actively participate in all squad ceremonies, including sprint demos, planning, and retrospectives
  • Provide continuous feedback during sprint demos and lead discussions to ensure effective iterations of product features
  • Maintain open lines of communication with stakeholders to review product progress and outcomes
  • Work closely with stakeholders and Product Managers to contribute to the overarching product vision and strategy with data-backed ideation and iterative solutioning
  • Champion agile methodologies within the squad, promoting best practices and continuous improvement
  • Utilize tools like Agility and Aha! for effective project management and ensure data hygiene to track progress accurately

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States.
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency.
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.
  • Agile Product Management training and experience
  • Proven experience as a Product Owner (or similar role), in a dynamic agile environment
  • Demonstrated initiative and ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Proficiency in written and oral communications and ability to produce concise, relevant documents and presentations
  • Curious mindset, willing to ask " how might we" or "why" to drive innovation and high performance
  • Must be performing satisfactorily in present position
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency
  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Strong understanding of agile practices and principles, with a certification in Agile methodology preferred
  • Human Centered Design experience or practice
  • Experience with internal and external facing channels
  • Experience with digital.ai (Agility/VersionOne) or Jira
  • Experience with optimization, simulation, and/or augmented intelligence

Benefits And Perks To Help You Keep Climbing

Our culture is rooted in a shared dedication to living our values – Care, Integrity, Resilience and Servant Leadership – every day, in everything we do. At Delta, our people are our success. At the heart of what we offer is our focus on Sharing Success with Delta employees. Exploring a career at Delta gives you a chance to see the world while earning great compensation and benefits to help you keep climbing along the way:

  • Competitive salary, industry-leading proﬁt sharing program, and performance incentives
  • 401(k) with generous company contributions up to 9%
  • New hires are eligible for up to 2-weeks of vacation. This is earned for use in the following vacation year (April 1 – March 31)
  • In addition to vacation, new hires are eligible for up to 56 hours of paid personal time within a 12-month period
  • 10 paid holidays per calendar year
  • Birthing parents are eligible for 12-weeks of paid maternity/parental leave
  • Non-birthing parents are eligible for 2-weeks of paid parental leave
  • Comprehensive health beneﬁts including medical, dental, vision, short/long term disability and life insurance beneﬁts
  • Family care assistance through fertility support, surrogacy and adoption assistance, lactation support, subsidized back-up care, and programs that help with loved ones in all stages
  • Holistic Wellbeing programs to support physical, emotional, social, and financial health, including access to an employee assistance program offering support for you and anyone in your household, free financial coaching, and extensive resources supporting mental health
  • Domestic and International space-available flight privileges for employees and eligible family members
  • Career development programs to achieve your long-term career goals
  • World-wide partnerships to engage in community service and innovative goals created to focus on sustainability and reducing our carbon footprint
  • Business Resource Groups created to connect employees with common interests to promote inclusion, provide perspective and help implement strategies
  • Recognition rewards and awards through the platform Unstoppable Together
  • Access to over 500 discounts, specialty savings and voluntary benefits through Deltaperks such as car and hotel rentals and auto, home, and pet insurance, legal services, and childcare

job.company_description:
Expedia Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: EXPE) is the global travel marketplace with one purpose: to help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. Expedia Group™ connects travelers, partners, and advertisers through its trusted brands, leading technology, and rich first-party data, delivering predictive, personalized experiences that shape the future of travel.

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction to the Team

Our Corporate Functions are made up of teams that support Expedia Group, including our Global Finance Org., Traveler and Partner Service Platform, Legal Team, Strategy and Corporate Development Team, and People & Places Org.

The Senior Manager, Traveler Compensation Strategy role sits within the Traveler and Partner Service Platform and partners across Operations, brands, analytics, finance, legal, product, and technology to improve traveler outcomes and business performance.

Make an impact!

As an individual contributor, you will define and drive traveler compensation strategy across refunds, goodwill offers, credits, points, and related treatments. You will turn policy and data into scalable self-service and agent-facing solutions, strengthen recovery outcomes, improve operational efficiency, and deliver measurable financial impact.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead traveler compensation strategy and initiatives in close partnership with Operations and brands, creating clarity on priorities, outcomes, and execution.
  • Own traveler compensation policies and strategy across refunds, goodwill offers, credits, points, and related treatments, balancing traveler outcomes with business value.
  • Serve as the primary strategic partner for compensation strategy, aligning recommendations, governance, and execution with Operations, brands, analytics, finance, legal, product, and technology partners.
  • Own return-on-investment analysis and ongoing monitoring for major compensation spend and loss management initiatives, translating data into recommendations for senior leaders.
  • Partner with Product and Technology to integrate compensation treatments into self-service and agent tools, translating policy and strategy into scalable experiences and clear requirements.
  • Maintain and publish a compensation and loss management scorecard covering loss, recovery, customer experience, agent performance, spend, and return on investment; and provide program management for key initiatives through roadmaps, dependencies, milestones, and risk management.

Experience And Qualifications

  • You have 8+ years of experience in strategy, customer operations, finance, consulting, loss management, or a related field.
  • You have experience leading complex, cross-functional work and influencing partners across Operations, brands, finance, legal, product, and technology.
  • You have led complex, cross-functional programs from strategy through implementation, including planning, governance, risk management, and measurable outcomes.
  • You are comfortable analyzing financial, operational, customer experience, and workforce metrics, including spend and return on investment.
  • You build trust with senior stakeholders and communicate complex ideas clearly in writing and presentations, using sound judgment and thoughtful influence.
  • Preferred: You have experience in contact center operations, e-commerce, travel, or a comparable customer-facing environment, along with experience applying data and artificial intelligence to improve decisions, workflows, or customer experiences.

The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $146,000.00 to $204,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $233,500.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Benefits And Perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life.

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

job.job_description:
Are you ready to turn your love of travel into a career that takes you further than you ever imagined personally and professionally? Your Flight Centre journey is uniquely yours - and we’re here to champion it, celebrate it, and help it take flight. As a Flightie you’re not just building a career - you’re shaping a life filled with purpose, connection, and discovery. If you’re looking for the next stamp in careers passport - we’re looking for Sales Travel Consultants across Australia who are keen to dazzle, discover and delight our customers! Navigate your career. Explore the world.

What you’ll be doing - where your passion will meet purpose!

  • Work full-time, on-site in one of our retail stores on a rotating roster across a 7-day trade
  • Plan itineraries, book travel and convert enquiries into bookings in person, over the phone and via email for our customers
  • Work towards individual KPIs and sales targets where you’ll sell the whole holiday including flights, accommodation, car hire, tours, travel insurance, cruises, transfers and more
  • Build a customer base of new and returning customers from regular domestic bookings to lavish international holidays and everything in between
  • Be the expert! Assist our customers with their travel related questions including visas, best time of year to travel, what to pack, where to eat, what to avoid, you name it!
  • Enjoy a base wage plus an uncapped incentive payment structure where you earn a percentage of every sale, your pay is completely uncapped!

What we’re looking for - do you have the travel bug?

  • You’re a seasoned traveller with a history of international destinations (and even more on your bucket list!) and you’re the go-to person in your circle for travel recommendations, tips and tricks
  • Great organisational skills - you’re the type to take notes, manage your calendar well and are quick to respond to your customer’s phone calls and emails
  • Determination to meet your sales targets and KPIs while balancing your workload in a high-pressure environment (think customers lining up, phones ringing, email inbox filling!)
  • Enthusiasm, passion and a warmth that makes our customers want to book with you every time!
  • A savviness with computers, ready to toggle between various complex systems when finding the right flight and package options for your customer

What you will gain from a career with Flight Centre - let’s unpack the benefits!

💲 We'll boost your wage to $65K equivalent for your first 90 days while you learn the ropes! Average earnings for a Travel Consultant in their first year are $70K, while Senior Consultants average $100K and Team Leaders average $138K annually - including superannuation and penalty rates.

🌏 Become a true expert – access industry travel discounts and qualify for sponsored ‘Familiarisation Trips’ to explore new destinations and products around the world 

💎 Brightness of Future: Career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses across the globe - we promote from within   

🎉 Social: Embrace the famous Flight Centre culture at our Reward & Recognition events throughout the year including our most popular events on the calendar Global Gathering and EOFY Celebration

🎓 Get qualified for free with a Certificate 3 & 4 in Travel & Tourism (worth 20k!) through Australian Apprentice Training - you may also be eligible to receive direct financial support while you study 

🌈 Thrive in a workplace that embraces individualism – come as you are!  

💛 Be part of a workplace committed to reconciliation through our Reconciliation Action Plan - we proudly support Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander inclusion, cultural safety, and dedicated cultural leave

Okay, I’m in!

Are you keen to join our team of Flighties? Hit apply now for your application to be read by a real human, no AI here! If your application is successful, you’ll be invited to have a 15-minute phone interview with one of our dedicated team of recruiters. Get ready to work, travel and grow.

Why is Flight Centre such a great place to work?

We are devoted to being a global employer of choice by nurturing our legendary culture - focused on our people and infused with adventure and accountability. We uplift and support our team through a compelling Employee Value Proposition that offers exciting career and travel opportunities, fantastic benefits, a meaningful sense of purpose and well-deserved recognition. Explore us on LinkedIn or check out our careers page at www.fctgcareers.com

job.company_description: This is the story of airline that leads the industry from ground to clouds. Our global cast of over 100,000+ hero characters are each on a journey to be a force for good for our customers, the planet and each other. Come be part of this story.
job.job_description:
Achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. Grow your career, access top-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network.

Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.

Description

About the Job

The Multi-Channel Agencies Sales Manager is responsible for managing and growing a portfolio of strategic travel management company relationships across multiple channels, representing $10M to $100M+ in annual GDS or non-GDS revenue. Serving as the primary commercial point of contact, the role builds strong relationships with headquarters, regional, and senior-level stakeholders to drive revenue, increase share, strengthen customer satisfaction, and maximize return on investment. Focus is on developing and executing data-driven account strategies, identifying new sales opportunities, negotiating incentive and contractual agreements, and managing customer programs and investments, including co-op and travel funds. The role also advances United’s commercial and distribution priorities by facilitating adoption of modern retailing capabilities, including NDC through preferred distribution channels, while driving compliance with United’s Book & Ticketing policy. Through strategic account management, customer engagement, analytics, and effective use of sales tools and incentives, the Sales Manager improves account performance and delivers sustainable commercial results.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain strong, long-term customer relationships, serving as the primary commercial point of contact for assigned accounts.
  • Identify, develop, and close sales opportunities that drive revenue growth, increase share, strengthen customer retention, and expand product adoption.
  • Analyze customer travel behavior, booking patterns, and account performance to identify growth, upsell, cross-sell, and optimization opportunities.
  • Develop tailored sales strategies, proposals, and business solutions leveraging historical performance, customer insights, market dynamics, and promotional opportunities.
  • Lead contract negotiations and renewals, develop pricing and commercial recommendations, and deliver account performance reviews that strengthen customer partnerships and maximize business results.
  • Conduct in-depth analysis and high-quality account reviews, establish challenging yet achievable performance goals, and consistently monitor progress against key objectives.
  • Proactively monitor account health, identify performance gaps and retention risks, and implement corrective strategies to improve results.
  • Forecast revenue and performance trends, evaluate profitability drivers, and translate insights into actionable strategies that support account planning and commercial decision-making.
  • Benchmark customer performance against relevant industry and peer metrics to identify opportunities and strengthen overall account performance.
  • Navigate complex customer organizations to build relationships, influence decision makers, and establish credibility across senior leadership and key functional areas.
  • Create and deliver compelling, executive-level presentations and business reviews, positioning United as a trusted advisor and strategic business partner.
  • Collaborate across internal stakeholder groups, including Corporate, Military/Government, Digital Sales, and other teams, to align strategies and maximize commercial opportunities.
  • Leverage executive engagement, joint customer calls, advisory boards, industry forums, and company-sponsored events to deepen strategic relationships and advance business objectives.
  • Provide day-to-day leadership and oversight of the assigned portfolio, while providing functional direction to support teams to ensure alignment, execution, and achievement of commercial goals.

Note: This position provides a remote work arrangement, with preference towards candidates living within 50 miles of a United Airlines hub location (Chicago, Houston, Dulles, Newark, Denver, Los Angeles, or San Francisco). Travel required up to 50% of the time (both domestic and international).

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in sales, account management, customer relationship management, or a related commercial role
  • Experience in B2B2C marketing and selling
  • Strong foundational understanding of airline sales, travel agency sales and corporate travel management practices
  • Demonstrated skills in customer relationship management, account management, sales management, and commercial negotiation
  • Experience analyzing customer data, booking trends, and market opportunities to support revenue growth
  • Strong communication, partnership-building, and contract management capabilities
  • Strong analytical and negotiating skills
  • Ability to create and deliver exceptional client or executive-facing presentations
  • Working knowledge of new distribution capabilities (NDC) and content aggregators
  • Reliable, punctual attendance is an essential function of the position
  • Successful completion of interview required to meet job qualification
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in sales, account management, customer relationship management, or a related commercial role
  • Experience with competitive intelligence and business intelligence reporting
  • Proficiency in data visualization and presentation storytelling
  • Experience supporting customer experience management initiatives
  • Background managing strategic partnerships or agency sales relationships
  • Demonstrates an understanding of the capabilities and limitations of generative AI tools and effectively leverages them to support research, analysis, content creation, and problem-solving. job.job_description:
Customer Experience Improvement Lead | Tripadvisor

About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

Job Location: This role requires 1 day per week in our London Office

Who are we looking for?

As the Lead, Customer Experience Improvement Lead, you will sit at the intersection of AI analytics, traveler psychology, and revenue optimization. Cancellations are one of the most critical churn metrics in Experience driven disruptions, changing plans, price volatility, or booking friction, how we handle a cancellation defines our relationship with our travelers.

You will sit at the intersection of empathetic service, AI analytics, and business strategy. You will design and own an enterprise-grade Closed-Loop Root Cause Intelligence Engine. Your mission is twofold: decode why travelers cancel in real time to ensure Service Operations provide effortless support and translate real-time cancellation reasons into high-impact business insights that drive executive decision-making, revenue protection, policy adjustments, and product innovation. At Tripadvisor Group we are Traveler first in all our decision making.

Key Responsibilities

  • Business Insights & Strategic Commercial Value
  • Executive Decision Intelligence: Translate conversational data and cancellation reasons into actionable business insights and financial impact models for executive leadership
  • Cancellation Reason Economics: Quantify the true business cost of each cancellation driver (e.g., policy friction vs. price matching vs. competitor gains vs. service failures) to guide capital allocation and resource prioritization.
  • Market & Competitor Signal Analysis: Identify macro-trends and market shifts in cancellation drivers (e.g., travelers canceling due to lower pricing found on competitor platforms, macro-economic shifts, or changing travel sentiment) to inform dynamic pricing and policy strategies.
  • Closed-Loop Root Cause Analysis & Operational Fixes
  • Establish a robust Closed-Loop Root Cause Analysis (CLRCA) framework to continuously map, track, and categorize customer friction into Product, Policy, Process, Partner or People leveraging existing Voice of Business automated mechanisms
  • Provide feedback to Service Operations for Process optimisation and People Coaching opportunities
  • Maintain a dynamic Friction-to-Fix Tracker that quantifies the financial and sentiment impact of unresolved root causes and holds cross-functional owners accountable for operational resolutions.
  • Real-Time AI & Traveler-Centric Signal Infrastructure
  • Design and deploy AI-driven conversational intelligence models (LLM/NLP) that prioritize identifying traveler distress, confusion, and intent across voice, chat, messaging, and email.
  • Build real-time alert systems to catch emerging traveler friction points (e.g., policy ambiguity, system outages, sudden flight disruptions) before they turn into mass cancellation waves.
  • Integrate generative AI speech-to-text, sentiment scoring, and intent recognition tools directly into front-line agent platforms to support teams in delivering empathetic care.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Business & Financial Acumen: Exceptional ability to translate unstructured customer text/audio into quantifiable business metrics, ROI calculations, and strategic recommendations for senior executives.
  • Traveler-First Mindset: Unwavering commitment to designing solutions that solve customer pain points first, knowing sustainable revenue growth naturally follows.
  • Closed-Loop & Root Cause Expertise: Demonstrated track record of implementing Closed-Loop Feedback systems and Root Cause Analysis methodologies (5 Whys, Fishbone, Failure Mode Analysis) in customer-facing environments.
  • Domain Experience: 5+ years in Customer Insights, Voice of Customer (VoC), CX Analytics, or Behavioral Data Science within the Travel, Airline, Hospitality, or OTA sectors.
  • AI & NLP Expertise: Hands-on experience with AI tools, NLP, speech analytics (e.g., CallMiner, Gong, Medallia, Retell AI, Qualtrics AI, or proprietary LLM pipelines).
  • Data Literacy: Proficiency in visualization tools (Tableau, PowerBI) and SQL/Python to query conversational and operational databases.

Skills You Should Bring To The Role

  • Strategic Storytelling: Ability to synthesize complex, multi-channel conversational data into clear executive summaries and business cases.
  • Cross-Functional Influence: Proven track record of convincing Product, Commercial, and Finance leaders to prioritize systemic fixes based on traveler feedback.
  • Agility: Capability to react swiftly during high-stress operational events to protect both the traveler experience and company performance.

Why Join Service Operations?

  • Drive Core Business Strategy: Move beyond simple survey reporting to directly influence revenue protection, commercial strategy, and product roadmap decisions.
  • Traveler-Centric Impact: Help fundamentally reshape how travel disruptions are handled by fixing the root causes of friction and putting human care at the heart of our technology.
  • Next-Gen AI Tech Stack: Work with cutting-edge real-time speech analytics, LLM reasoning, and agentic workflows to solve high-stakes challenges

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!

job.job_description:
Job Description


We're looking for a Manager, Customer Engagement (EMEA) to join our Loyalty EMEA team at Hilton.


This is an exciting opportunity to work in a friendly, ambitious, and fast-paced environment where creativity, customer focus, and commercial impact go hand in hand.


The role would suit a CRM & Loyalty Marketing Manager or a Client Account Manager with agency background who thrives on delivering impactful marketing campaigns and building strong relationships with stakeholders across the business and agency partners.


If you're passionate about creating engaging and relevant customer communications, using storytelling to inspire action, leveraging customer insights to drive relevance and engagement, and applying commercial thinking to support business priorities, we'd love to hear from you.


Core initiatives in scope


  • You'll be responsible for developing and delivering member engagement strategies that strengthen relationships with Hilton Honors members across the EMEA region.
  • You'll act as a key connector between our agency partners and multiple teams across the Marketing & Loyalty organisation, including Brand & Enterprise, Destination Marketing, Co-brand, New Hotel Openings, CRM, MarTech, Analytics, and Customer Marketing Operations.
  • Working closely with these teams and our agency partners, you'll design and execute CRM journeys, regional offers, and marketing activations across email and mobile channels that drive member activation, repeat stays, retention, engagement, and overall satisfaction.
  • The role also plays an important part in launching new partnerships from a member experience perspective, including designing onboarding journeys for partner members and ensuring a seamless, engaging, and rewarding end-to-end Hilton Honors experience.


What areas will you be supporting?


  • Lead flagship member engagement programmes across EMEA, including Monthly Unlocked and StayInspired, ensuring strong regional execution, creative excellence, stakeholder alignment, and clear performance reporting.
  • Support the activation of new partnerships from a member engagement perspective, coordinating onboarding journeys for partner members, including welcome communications, programme education, and first-stay activation, while ensuring a clear and compelling value proposition across all channels.
  • Partner closely with teams across the Marketing & Loyalty organisation, including Brand & Enterprise, Destination Marketing, Co-brand, New Hotel Openings, and Partnerships, to align CRM activity with broader campaigns, product and proposition launches, partnership commitments, and regional commercial priorities.


Responsibilities


What will your day to day look like?


  • Own the CRM campaign calendar and delivery plan, ensuring activity is aligned to Hilton’s commercial priorities, tentpole moments, customer needs and partner commitments.
  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of CRM journeys and regional offers across email, mobile app, and other relevant channels, from planning and briefing through to launch and optimisation. While Customer Marketing Operations and agency partners support the technical build and deployment, you will oversee the process, coordinating stakeholders and managing timelines to ensure campaigns are delivered successfully and on schedule.
  • Develop clear audience and campaign briefs that leverage customer insights and segmentation to deliver highly targeted and personalised communications that increase relevance, deepen engagement, and drive repeat stays.
  • Champion a test-and-learn culture, using A/B testing, pilots, and other experimentation methods to continuously improve performance and scale successful approaches across markets and audience segments.
  • Act as the guardian of CRM quality, ensuring copy, creative, design, targeting, and proposition work together to deliver an elevated customer experience while supporting commercial objectives.
  • Establish clear success metrics, monitor campaign performance, capture learnings, and translate insights into actionable recommendations, providing regular updates and performance reporting to senior stakeholders.
  • Translate insights and member feedback into action: identify friction points across the member journey (understanding benefits, enrollment quality, recognition), recommend fixes, and drive stakeholder follow-through.
  • Stay ahead of emerging trends, identifying new channels, technologies, and AI-enabled ways of working that can enhance CRM effectiveness, unlock creativity, and improve team productivity.


Qualifications


What are we looking for?


Required Qualifications, Experience & Skills


  • Experience in customer engagement, CRM / lifecycle / loyalty marketing within a multi-market or international environment.
  • A strong understanding of customer segmentation, audience targeting, and personalisation, with the ability to translate insights into relevant and engaging customer experiences and content.
  • Highly organised with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent stakeholder and agency management skills, with a collaborative approach and a track record of building strong cross-functional relationships. Strong team player.
  • Self-starter, able to work independently.
  • Ability to deliver through influence in a matrixed organization and manage multiple workstreams end-to-end.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with confidence presenting recommendations to senior audiences.
  • Exceptional planning, prioritisation, and organisational skills, combined with a keen eye for detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality work at pace.
  • Analytical mindset, with the ability to use data and insights to identify opportunities, diagnose challenges, develop hypotheses, and measure success.


Preferred Qualifications, Experience & Skills


  • Loyalty program or hospitality experience.
  • Experience working with destination marketing or travel demand-generation initiatives.
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms and experimentation approaches (working knowledge).
  • Experience supporting partnership launches / activations from a customer journey perspective.


About Us


Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture


At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible.


As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.


Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.


Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.


Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.


About The Team


How We’ll Help You Thrive


Benefits


At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:


  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40 USD/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
  • Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
  • Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
  • Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
  • Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
  • Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Through our Care for All hub, we provide resources to help our Team Members to care for themselves, care for members of their team, and care for their loved ones. Eligible Team Members receive free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)


*Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

Now is an exciting time to be part of Delta's Crew Resources Technology team as we enhance the frontline employee experience through new decision making and execution applications. This is an opportunity to bring new strategies and initiatives to life while retiring legacy technology. We are seeking a Product Owner to help define the strategy and provide technical expertise for all current and future Crew Resources technology. The Product Owner will work across Crew Resources, Flight Ops, In-Flight Service, and IT to ensure development requests are well understood across the enterprise, gain cross-divisional consensus on priorities, and ensure deliverables meet business needs. To do so, this individual will need to manage multiple projects at once, communicate effectively, build strong cross-divisional partnerships, understand how to write project requirements, and understand the crew member experience.

  • Work with the business and IT on the replacement of the legacy Crew Scheduling systems (DBMS and OSS)
  • Manage the delivery of multiple development teams
  • End-to-end product ownership duties including understanding the business problem, identifying stakeholder needs, and developing optimal solutions so that the business derives value from the new applications
  • Understand the business and technology vision and translate it into strategy and requirements so that products meet the business's needs
  • Work across multiple user groups and technologies that interact with Scheduling, including Pay, Reroute, Training, Bid and Award, FCL, and Communications
  • Coach and mentor junior members of the team
  • Work with end users to understand their needs and develop product enhancements that provide value
  • Identify opportunities to make improvements to departmental processes, systems, or products to enhance the performance of the team, and deliver solutions
  • Prepare internal communications that include ad hoc reports, executive summaries, and formal presentations to senior leaders
  • Develop subject matter expertise for crew related data and systems that can be translated into optimal design and development
  • Build and maintain an executable product roadmap that balances business value, funding, cross-initiative dependencies, and development complexity that guides current and future development
  • Lead phases of project management, including requirements gathering, development prioritization, and implementation of strategies
  • Prioritize product backlog, projects, and initiatives across multiple stakeholder groups so that IT is working on the right things
  • Write functional user stories and acceptance criteria that enable a smooth handoff to development
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies with development teams to provide direction and drive progress
  • Model Delta's Rules of the Road and core values
  • Practice safety-conscious behaviors in all operational processes and procedures.

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States.
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency.
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.
  • Minimum 4 years of experience with Crew and/or IT Project/Product Ownership
  • Verbally present ideas succinctly and persuasively; demonstrate logical thinking when responding to questions or providing alternative solutions
  • Ability to develop presentations that include visuals that advance the story, speak to an executive audience, and influence outcomes
  • Experience translating a business vision into written requirements
  • Track record of managing products or complex projects successfully
  • Ability to lead and influence others responsible for deliverables, including stakeholders from other departments
  • Exhibit curiosity and think creatively to help identify solutions
  • Proven success in understanding and managing complex processes
  • Willingness to gain a deep understanding of the product and become the subject matter expert and take ownership for its development and performance
  • Self-starter with the ability to work well with diverse groups in a time sensitive and team environment with minimal oversight
  • Results oriented and capable of meeting or exceeding deadlines with attention to detail and follow through
  • Currency in user experience best practices and new technology trends
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking and styles

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Prior experience as an agile product manager/owner preferred
  • Broad knowledge of Crew Resources, Flight Ops, or Inflight Service preferred, but not required

Benefits And Perks To Help You Keep Climbing

Our culture is rooted in a shared dedication to living our values – Care, Integrity, Resilience and Servant Leadership – every day, in everything we do. At Delta, our people are our success. At the heart of what we offer is our focus on Sharing Success with Delta employees. Exploring a career at Delta gives you a chance to see the world while earning great compensation and benefits to help you keep climbing along the way:

  • Competitive salary, industry-leading proﬁt sharing program, and performance incentives
  • 401(k) with generous company contributions up to 9%
  • New hires are eligible for up to 2-weeks of vacation. This is earned for use in the following vacation year (April 1 – March 31)
  • In addition to vacation, new hires are eligible for up to 56 hours of paid personal time within a 12-month period
  • 10 paid holidays per calendar year
  • Birthing parents are eligible for 12-weeks of paid maternity/parental leave
  • Non-birthing parents are eligible for 2-weeks of paid parental leave
  • Comprehensive health beneﬁts including medical, dental, vision, short/long term disability and life insurance beneﬁts
  • Family care assistance through fertility support, surrogacy and adoption assistance, lactation support, subsidized back-up care, and programs that help with loved ones in all stages
  • Holistic Wellbeing programs to support physical, emotional, social, and financial health, including access to an employee assistance program offering support for you and anyone in your household, free financial coaching, and extensive resources supporting mental health
  • Domestic and International space-available flight privileges for employees and eligible family members
  • Career development programs to achieve your long-term career goals

Introduction To Team

The Product Team creates high-quality end-to-end experiences for travelers, partners, and Expedia Group. Our focus on customer-centric innovation enables us to develop products that build loyalty and repeat business. We partner closely with teams across Expedia Group to drive growth and achieve results for our customers and the company.

We connect Travelers to new experiences, through trusted relationships. We use the power of Expedia Group brands to empower strategic partners to nurture and grow the existing relationship with their audience. The Comms team builds the foundational capabilities that help Expedia Group engage travelers and partners with the right message, at the right time, through the right channel.

In this role, you’ll design frameworks and tools to enable consistent, personalized communications across EG’s brands and make it easier for teams to create, manage, and understand customer communications. Our Comms Hub is at the center of this strategy and you’ll work to create prototypes and AI-powered experiences to support all our communication channels across in-app messages, push notifications and emails.

Ultimately, you’ll own the designs that help the Comms team to deliver more proactive, relevant experiences while improving communication quality, scalability, and trust.

In This Role, You Will

  • Design simple, elegant, trustworthy experiences that optimize user engagement, product performance, and business impact—while holding a high design quality bar.
  • Incorporate research and test findings to identify insights, considering multiple sources of information to make informed design decisions and determine the right solution.
  • Communicate crisp traveler-centric product narratives to a range of internal and external stakeholders, through effective visual storytelling.
  • Thoughtfully leverage emergent agentic design and prototyping tools to streamline design processes without compromising quality.
  • Partner effectively with Product and Engineering stakeholders, collaborating on requirements, concepts and deliverables where appropriate.
  • Collaborate with developers to ensure seamless implementation and understand the nuance between hard tech-constraints and opportunities to challenge conventions.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelors or equivalent in Product Design, User Experience Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of professional experience working in Product Design, User Experience Design or a related professional field.
  • Experience translating product requirements into design strategy and then acting on that strategy to deliver proposed design solutions which meet those requirements.
  • Experience mapping customer journeys and leveraging user stories and personas to inform design strategy.
  • Experience crafting design deliverables at various fidelities, including wireframes, mockups, and prototypes.
  • Experience leveraging design systems and shared component libraries to ensure consistency and velocity.
  • Experience thoughtfully leveraging emergent AI tools to streamline design processes without compromising quality.
  • Experience collaborating with a range of diverse stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Content and Research.
  • Strong attention to design and visual detail.
  • Knowledge of current design tools and software.
  • A portfolio showcasing design skills representative of your work at each stage of a product life cycle, from conception to release, that details the team, thought processes, successes, and pivots along the way.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working across multiple devices, webviews and browsers.
  • Experience in designing for human diversity (internationalization, localization, accessibility, etc.)
  • Experience designing for agentic platforms and tools.
  • Experience working on strategic partnerships.
  • Experience presenting to executive audiences.

Organization- ALGV/HIC/AMS/UVC Corporate Office

Summary

The Opportunity

The Regional Director of Revenue Management (RDRM) will serve as the strategic business partner and leader for revenue optimization across a defined geographic region within the Hyatt Inclusive Collection. This role is responsible for driving topline revenue performance through effective pricing, inventory management, and distribution strategies. The RDRM will collaborate closely with the RVP of Sales, providing strategic guidance and leadership to on-property revenue teams, ensuring alignment with Hyatt’s commercial strategy and organizational goals. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best, and fastest growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities to our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list since 2013. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

  • Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Work-life benefits

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results driven and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

________________________________________

The Role

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

  • Partner with the RVP of Sales and other commercial leaders to create cohesive sales, marketing, and revenue strategies.
  • Lead regional revenue management practices, including pricing strategy, distribution channel optimization, inventory controls, and demand forecasting.
  • Analyze market trends, competitor performance, and demand patterns to identify opportunities and risks.
  • Drive adoption of revenue management systems, tools, and best practices across all properties in the region.
  • Provide leadership, mentorship, and coaching to on-property Directors of Revenue Management and revenue teams.
  • Monitor property and regional revenue performance against established KPIs, including RevPAR, GOPPAR, ADR, and occupancy.
  • Prepare and present regular performance reports, forecasts, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Lead revenue-focused meetings and regional business reviews.
  • Collaborate with property General Managers, Sales & Marketing leaders, and Finance partners to align on revenue goals and initiatives.
  • Work cross-functionally with Hyatt’s corporate revenue and commercial strategy teams to ensure consistency and best practice adoption.
  • Special initiatives and cross-functional projects.

Qualifications

Experience Required:

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in hotel revenue management, with at least 3 years in a multi-property or regional leadership role.

Experience Preferred:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration
  • Certified Revenue Management Executive (CRME) through Hospitality Sales and Marketing Association (HSMAI)
  • Excel, Revenue Management System (RMS) Experience, general Distribution systems knowledge

The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary.

________________________________________

We welcome you:

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs, only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.

We value our relationships with recruitment partners and require that agencies contact us first before submitting any candidates. Hyatt will not be responsible for any fees and obligations associated with unsolicited submissions unless a formal agreement is in place.

job.job_description:
About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

What You’ll Do

  • Position Summary

Our experience operators and suppliers are the product. Every traveler experience on Viator starts with an operator who is seamlessly onboarded, verified, and supported; every Bókun customer decides whether to stay in their first weeks on the platform, and requires ongoing technical support for success and retention.

As Director, Service Delivery & Excellence, B2B, you will lead the end-to-end B2B support organization across Viator Supply and Bókun. Combining Front-Line Service Delivery and Service Excellence into a single mandate, you will modernize support operations—leveraging AI and automation to reduce cost-to-serve while elevating quality, first-contact resolution, and supplier satisfaction across the complete partner lifecycle.

Location: UK (Hybrid - Commutable to Oxford 2-3 days per week)

  • Key Responsibilities
  • Strategy and Planning: Responsible for the development and execution of the B2B support organization in line with Company strategy and OKRs.
  • End-to-End B2B Support Operations: Own front-line operational delivery across Viator Supply (onboarding, product creation/setup, compliance, verification, ongoing support) and Bókun (sign-up support, early customer success, SaaS technical support).
  • BPO Strategy & Vendor Governance: Lead end-to-end BPO commercial relationships across partner sites in North Africa and Asia—managing RFPs, contract negotiations, SOWs, workforce capacity planning, and vendor performance management.
  • AI & Operational Transformation: Identify, design, and ship AI-driven tooling, self-serve capabilities, and workflow automation across in-house and outsourced operations to scale support efficiently.
  • Compliance, Verification & Quality Control: Enforce strict onboarding workflows (business verification, liability insurance, legal compliance) and audit supplier quality metrics to protect platform integrity and traveler experience.
  • Process Excellence & Systems Ownership: Apply continuous improvement frameworks (Lean Six Sigma) to eliminate friction; own the support technology stack with Salesforce at the core.
  • Commercial Contribution & Budgeting: Manage operational headcount, vendor spend, and tooling budgets. Expand proactive quality initiatives and revenue-generating support activities (supplier upsells and SaaS tier upgrades).
  • Collaborate effectively with Key Stakeholders: within the Supply/Bokun organizations and across the organization
  • Requirements & Minimum Qualifications
  • 8+ years in B2B support, partner operations, or service delivery, including proven leadership experience managing managers.
  • Scale & BPO Management: Proven success leading multi-site operations (100+ FTE) with hands-on BPO vendor management (RFPs, contract negotiations, QA, and governance).
  • AI & Automation Track Record: Demonstrated experience deploying AI or automation tools across support, vetting, or operational workflows with measurable impact.
  • Salesforce & Technology Systems: Strong working knowledge of Salesforce as a support platform (Salesforce Administrator training preferred) alongside contact-center telephony and knowledge systems.
  • Compliance & Workforce Planning: Experience operating in regulated environments with compliance/vetting frameworks; expertise in workforce forecasting and capacity planning across hybrid teams.
  • Budget Stewardship & Travel: Full operational budget ownership (staffing, vendor spend, tooling); willing to travel internationally c. 30% of the time (site visits to North Africa and Asia).
  • Preferred: Travel, hospitality, or SaaS/marketplace industry experience; COPC certification; Lean Six Sigma Green/Black Belt.
  • Leadership Values & Attributes
  • Traveler First: Recognize that supplier operational health directly shapes traveler experience. Practice Behavioral Truth Seeking (prioritizing customer action over anecdotes) and Scientific Validation (utilizing A/B testing over expert opinion).
  • Execution is Our Edge: Drive High-Velocity Execution using the 80/20 rule. Champion AI-First Adoption to automate manual tasks and maintain a fail-fast learning mindset.
  • We Succeed Together: Practice Radical Accountability (no problem is someone else's problem) and Empowered Ownership by pushing decisions to the lowest level. Lead with high EQ, low ego, and empathetic change leadership.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveler first

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Director of Finance, you’re not just overseeing all hotel financial operations – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:

  • Drive financial strategy: Oversee all financial operations, ensuring alignment with the hotel’s strategic goals to optimize profitability and efficiency
  • Oversee financial planning and analysis: Direct the preparation of annual plans, projections, and budgets, providing financial insights to support business decisions
  • Advise hotel leadership: Serve as the primary financial advisor to hotel management, ownership, and department heads, offering data-driven recommendations to enhance financial performance
  • Ensure financial compliance: Uphold adherence to Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and safeguard hotel assets through strong financial controls
  • Optimize financial reporting: Oversee systems and processes to drive accuracy, efficiency, and transparency in financial reporting.
  • Monitor and approve financial transactions: Oversee and authorize hotel sales, purchases, salaries, and expenses to maintain fiscal responsibility and operational efficiency
  • Cultivate a high-performing team: Drive engagement and retention through performance management, professional development, and recognition programs

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

About The Team

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
  • Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
  • Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
  • Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
  • Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
  • Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Generous paid time off (PTO) – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters most
  • Health & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family covered
  • Financial security for your future – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what’s next
  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

The DMS Sales Acount Representative will be responsible for achieving annual financial targets for key accounts by responding to general aircraft parts inquiries received via phone, email, and listing agencies. This position will play key role in executing sales strategies, monitoring and reporting results and implementing corrective actions, as well as key account development and objectives. The Sales Account Representative will develop and pursue sales opportunities as well as other sales responsibilities for organization as needed.

This position is based in Atlanta and will report to the DMS Regional Sales Director.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Collaborating with DMS Sales Directors and Account Managers to produce and maintain a strategic account plan for key accounts.
  • Building relationships with buyers within key accounts for sustained and repeatable transactional execution.
  • Monitoring and responding to incoming requests from key customers via phone, email, and listing agencies, such as ILS and Aeroxchange
  • Maintaining knowledge of key customer requirements and plans as well as competitor actions and market trends.
  • Closing new sales opportunities, processing orders and communicating with internal departments to assure orders are processed and shipped in a timely manner.
  • Providing excellent customer service to include communicating expected delivery date and providing status updates to the customer until order is delivered.
  • Collecting and entering key customer requirements, competitor actions and market intel needed to help the organization make commercial decisions.
  • Participating in projects to improve the sales process and customer experience.
  • Using Salesforce.com extensively as the primary sales tool to manage quote and order pipeline, record contact information and communications, and to report progress versus goals.
  • Monitoring DMS performance in the eyes of customer and acting on issues to improve accuracy, consistency and professionalism of every customer interaction.
  • Supporting tactical part sales activity and other service sales efforts by providing access to key focal points, facilitating account communications and providing insight regarding customer.
  • Performing other duties as assigned by the Regional Sales Director, including providing back-up to other DMS sales team members during their absences.

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency.
  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required.
  • 18-24 months Inside Sales experience required.
  • Must excel in transactional account management and relationship management.
  • Aviation product knowledge and a general knowledge of repair economics is a plus.
  • Strong business acumen including problem solving, data analysis and supply chain management.
  • Excellent presentation skills and proficient in the use of MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
  • Must demonstrate organization values of integrity, respect, innovation, teamwork, professionalism and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to research and resolve technical questions relative to aircraft components.
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to provide excellent customer service.
  • Doer with the ability and desire to implement effective sales tactics.
  • Driven to achieve financial results.
  • Demonstrates DMS Core Values of Integrity, Respect, and Perseverance

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction to the Team

Our Corporate Functions are made up of teams that support Expedia Group, including our Global Finance Org., Traveler and Partner Service Platform, Legal Team, Strategy and Corporate Development Team, and People & Places Org.

The Senior Manager, Traveler Compensation Strategy role sits within the Traveler and Partner Service Platform and partners across Operations, brands, analytics, finance, legal, product, and technology to improve traveler outcomes and business performance.

Make an impact!

As an individual contributor, you will define and drive traveler compensation strategy across refunds, goodwill offers, credits, points, and related treatments. You will turn policy and data into scalable self-service and agent-facing solutions, strengthen recovery outcomes, improve operational efficiency, and deliver measurable financial impact.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead traveler compensation strategy and initiatives in close partnership with Operations and brands, creating clarity on priorities, outcomes, and execution.
  • Own traveler compensation policies and strategy across refunds, goodwill offers, credits, points, and related treatments, balancing traveler outcomes with business value.
  • Serve as the primary strategic partner for compensation strategy, aligning recommendations, governance, and execution with Operations, brands, analytics, finance, legal, product, and technology partners.
  • Own return-on-investment analysis and ongoing monitoring for major compensation spend and loss management initiatives, translating data into recommendations for senior leaders.
  • Partner with Product and Technology to integrate compensation treatments into self-service and agent tools, translating policy and strategy into scalable experiences and clear requirements.
  • Maintain and publish a compensation and loss management scorecard covering loss, recovery, customer experience, agent performance, spend, and return on investment; and provide program management for key initiatives through roadmaps, dependencies, milestones, and risk management.

Experience And Qualifications

  • You have 8+ years of experience in strategy, customer operations, finance, consulting, loss management, or a related field.
  • You have experience leading complex, cross-functional work and influencing partners across Operations, brands, finance, legal, product, and technology.
  • You have led complex, cross-functional programs from strategy through implementation, including planning, governance, risk management, and measurable outcomes.
  • You are comfortable analyzing financial, operational, customer experience, and workforce metrics, including spend and return on investment.
  • You build trust with senior stakeholders and communicate complex ideas clearly in writing and presentations, using sound judgment and thoughtful influence.
  • Preferred: You have experience in contact center operations, e-commerce, travel, or a comparable customer-facing environment, along with experience applying data and artificial intelligence to improve decisions, workflows, or customer experiences.

The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $146,000.00 to $204,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $233,500.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Benefits And Perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life.

Accommodation requests

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
