What unites us is creating moments that enrich the lives of our 21 million customers.
Beside the unforgettable experience we provide our customers, we also believe in the good that tourism can bring and we care deeply about our environmental impact. The TUI Care foundation has projects in over 30 countries worldwide, building on the potential of tourism as a global force for development. The Foundation opens up new perspectives through education and training, empowers local communities to benefit from the success of tourism and engages in the protection of nature and the environment.
At TUI we simply say “Let’s TUI it”. For us, that means creating happiness. Tackling challenges every day together, with a positive, can-do attitude, and finding solutions even for the most unexpected situations. Our teams across TUI are just as diverse as our destinations. So whether you have lots of experience or none at all. If you want to work in an office or feel best in the field. There’s a place for you here.
job.job_description:
Here at TUI, you’ll find we’re an inclusive company with a culture of care and by joining the Retail Team as a Store Manager at our Leigh store, you’ll lead a team to become destination experts to recommend and sell holidays, Cruise, UK Breaks and additional products whilst delivering exceptional sales and service results. You’ll put all customers at the heart of our business by creating unforgettable holiday experiences that make us the best-loved holiday company.

As part of our dedication to delivering exceptional customer service and flexibility for our customers, you’ll enjoy a varied shift pattern each week including weekends and bank holidays, and evenings at some of our busier stores.

About Our Offer

  • TUI offers much more than just a starting salary of £15.34 per hour
  • Be rewarded for exceeding your targets with our commission and discretionary bonus schemes
  • Enjoy fantastic holiday benefits, discounts, special offers and the ability to purchase additional TUI time off
  • Benefit from our Health and Wellbeing across key areas – Financial, Health, Social, Community and Career
  • Investment in your development and career progression
  • Pension scheme and life assurance.

About The Job

  • Lead by example and role model our company values to inspire and coach your team whilst embracing change and rising to the demands that this role brings
  • Develop your team to be proactive and investigate and resolve every question or complaint. If things don’t go quite right, you’ll be confident to step in and take ownership
  • You’ll use customer feedback and insights to spot trends and find new ways to improve customer satisfaction and loyalty to grow our business
  • As technology advances so does TUI, you’ll work with a variety of systems empowering you to enhance your knowledge to improve our customer digital journey
  • Drive your team to exceed company sales and service goals, in Retail we call it ‘Smashing your Targets’
  • Recruit and retain talent, maintaining high levels of engagement and low levels of attrition.

About You

  • Proven passion for leading by example and delivering excellent customer service
  • Confident and fun motivator with a strong drive to achieve goals and sales targets
  • Comfortable to handle and prioritise multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment and bounce back from challenges

Named as the No. 1 World’s Best Workplace by Great Place to Work and Fortune, Hilton aims to create the best culture for its 500,000 team members around the world. Hilton has introduced industry-leading technology enhancements to improve the guest experience, including Digital Key Share, automated complimentary room upgrades and the ability to book confirmed connecting rooms. Through the award-winning guest loyalty program Hilton Honors, the nearly 250 million Hilton Honors members who book directly with Hilton can earn Points for hotel stays and experiences money can't buy. With the free Hilton Honors app, guests can book their stay, select their room, check in, unlock their door with a Digital Key and check out, all from their smartphone. job.job_description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

As a participant in our 12-month Corporate Placements Programme in the Marketing Department, you’re not just gaining hands-on experience at our Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA) Headquarters in Watford – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by contributing to the memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Here’s what you can look forward to as a programme participant:

  • Prepare for a career in hospitality: Embark on a 12-month transformative journey, encompassing a structured framework of learning and development opportunities, business support activities, and ownership of your own project-based initiatives.
  • Gain hands-on operational experience: From day one, you’ll be fully integrated into Team Hilton. Connect with professionals across the business and gain insight into Marketing. Take the opportunity to gain insight into at least one other business area, paving the way for valuable future relationships.
  • Work on real-world projects: Apply your skills on the job through business-driven projects to reinforce your learning and gain hands-on experience.
  • Develop your skills through world-class training and support: Access Hilton University’s e-learning modules and business library while building knowledge through business-driven projects.
  • Grow with personalised guidance: Benefit from regular feedback and coaching to ensure your progress is supported at every stage of the programme.
  • Hilton Perks: Including our Go Hilton Team Member Travel Program, which provides you with access to heavily reduced hotel room rates for you, your family & friends.
  • Salary & Benefits: £27,500 gross per annum & private healthcare.
  • Location: At our EMEA Headquarters in Watford, with some flexibility depending on team and business need. You will benefit from a subsidised restaurant, a games area and a free in-house gym.

Our Placement Opportunities

We have a range of placement opportunities within our highly talented Marketing department:

Brand Marketing

As the EMEA Brand Marketing intern, you will play an active role in developing marketing campaigns and activating partnerships. You will carry out a range of administrative/support activities, as well as having ownership of your own project-based initiatives. The EMEA Brand Marketing team develop marketing and partnership strategies and tactics to drive brand consideration with key consumer target segments across key focus markets: UK, UAE, Saudi Arabia and Germany.

As the brand marketing intern, you will also support the team in terms of developing internal communications to share learnings and impact of campaigns and initiatives.

Destination Marketing

As a Destination Marketing Intern, you will support the UK and Ireland team in delivering regional marketing and eCommerce strategies that drive direct revenue and commercial performance. Working across loyalty, partnerships, campaigns, content, SEO, performance advertising, web retailing and social media, you will help key destinations and ownership groups maximise Hilton’s corporate Marketing and Loyalty services.

You Will:

  • Support the team in cultivating and leveraging high-impact in-market relationships with Destination Marketing Organisations (DMOs) and travel authorities to increase the effectiveness of all marketing activities.
  • Perform campaign execution for assigned destinations and ensure each has a tailored annual marketing plan that adapts to emerging business needs.
  • Support with the storytelling of digital performance and co-operative initiatives.
  • Present regular business reviews and strategic insights to hotels and leadership.

Loyalty

As the EMEA Loyalty intern, you will oversee initiatives to drive the growth and engagement of the Hilton Honors membership base across the EMEA region.

You Will:

Oversee and continually evolve our hotel-level Hilton Honors Champion programme (who are our on-property team members responsible for driving the success of Hilton Honors) supporting our 700 Hilton Honors Champions in EMEA. 

Support the execution of Honors member email communications, to elevate the member experience and build brand affinity within the EMEA region. This includes overseeing the end-to-end process of launching and analyzing performance of Hilton Honors member email communications, including content planning and managing the design process.

 Support team with initiatives aimed at driving Hilton Honors performance on-property (including enrolling new members, engaging with members, and ensuring they have a best-in-class stay). This includes developing hotel-facing training, communications, and targeted initiatives to support Hilton Honors goals/objectives.

Digital Content, AI Discovery & Social

How travelers discover their next destination is changing fast, with AI reshaping the journey from inspiration to booking. This internship offers a front-row view of how Hilton is responding to this shift and shaping the future of digital discovery.

The Hilton EMEA Content Marketing team is shaping how millions of travelers discover our brands, destinations and hotels across Search, AI, Social and Hilton.com.

We're looking for a curious, analytical, and digitally minded placement student who is excited by the future of digital marketing. As part of our team, you'll gain hands-on experience across content marketing, SEO, AI discovery, social media and digital analytics while working alongside industry-leading marketers on campaigns and initiatives spanning across Europe, the Middle East and Africa.

This is a unique opportunity to learn how content is created, optimised and measured across multiple digital channels, while helping Hilton improve how travelers discover and engage with our brands.

Some Of The Projects You May Support Include:

  • Creating and optimising digital content across Hilton.com, including destination guides, campaign landing pages and hotel experiences.
  • Supporting SEO and AI discovery initiatives to improve Hilton's visibility across search engines and AI platforms.
  • Assisting with social media planning, trend analysis and content coordination across EMEA markets.
  • Researching emerging AI and search trends to help shape the future of digital discovery at Hilton.

What We’re Looking For

We are seeking individuals who embody the Hilton Values in addition to the following criteria:

  • A current bachelor’s or master’s student completing a degree that includes a required 12-month year in industry placement.
  • For Destination Marketing, Loyalty and Brand specifically: a Marketing, Advertising, Communications, Media Studies, Business or related degree is preferred.
  • Availability to begin full-time employment on 5th July 2027, for a full-time 12-month placement.
  • You must have the independent right to work in the UK for the full duration of the 12-month placement. Please note that this role is not eligible for visa sponsorship under the Skilled Worker route, so we are unable to consider applications from candidates who would require sponsorship. If you hold a visa or status that allows you to work in the UK full-time without sponsorship (e.g. Settled Status, Pre-Settled Status, where a 12-month work placement is a permitted, required & assessed part of your UK University degree, or other independent work permissions), you are welcome to apply.
  • Fluency in English (spoken and written).
  • Excellent attention to detail, organisational skills, and the ability to communicate clearly and confidently.
  • A collaborative, proactive approach, with strong interpersonal skills and a willingness to take ownership of tasks.
  • For Destination Marketing, Loyalty, and Brand specifically: knowledge of Microsoft suite of products (Excel, Word, PowerPoints) and numerical understanding.
  • For Digital Content, AI Discovery & Social specifically: strong interest in digital marketing, content, SEO, AI, social media, and emerging technologies, an analytical mindset with curiosity and a willingness to learn.
  • You should be able to demonstrate a genuine interest in Marketing.

Click here to learn more about Hilton's Corporate Placements

Selection Process

Applications are now open—don’t miss your chance to apply! Submissions close on Sunday 1st November 2026

Our selection process is designed to bring out your best and help us get to know you. It includes:

  • Online assessments.
  • In-person or virtual interview.

While the process is rigorous, it’s also the first step in your personal growth journey with Hilton. If selected, you’ll begin developing the skills, connections, and confidence to thrive in your career.

To ensure every application receives fair consideration, invitations to final-stage interviews will be issued after applications have closed. Please complete each stage promptly and keep an eye on your inbox for updates.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing reasonable adjustments for applicants and employees with disabilities. If you require any support or adjustments during the recruitment process or to carry out the essential requirements of the role, please contact us.

job.job_description:
¡Crece con nosotros en Hyatt!


En Hyatt seguimos creciendo y escribiendo un nuevo capítulo de transformación y expansión.

Como parte del crecimiento de nuestro Centro de Servicios Compartidos (Shared Service Center) y del proceso de centralización de las operaciones contables de nuestros hoteles, estamos fortaleciendo continuamente nuestro equipo de Finanzas y Contabilidad.


¡Estamos en búsqueda constante de talento! Nuestro plan de expansión contempla la incorporación de nuevos hoteles a la operación centralizada aproximadamente cada dos meses, generando alrededor de 5 oportunidades de contratación mensuales para nuestro equipo.


Buscamos profesionales apasionados, comprometidos y con ganas de desarrollarse, que deseen formar parte de este proyecto y sumarse a nuestras próximas etapas de crecimiento.


Analista de Cuentas por Pagar | Corporativo Hyatt


Tu próximo reto


Serás responsable de gestionar y procesar las cuentas por pagar de nuestros hoteles, garantizando la precisión de las transacciones, el cumplimiento de los plazos de pago y la correcta aplicación de nuestras políticas y controles financieros.


Formarás parte de un equipo enfocado en la eficiencia operativa, la mejora continua y la excelencia en el servicio a nuestros clientes internos.


¿Cuáles serán tus principales responsabilidades?

  • Gestión de facturas: Recibir, validar y procesar facturas de proveedores, asegurando su correcta contabilización y cumplimiento de políticas internas.
  • Administración de pagos: Preparar y dar seguimiento a pagos, garantizando su precisión y ejecución oportuna.
  • Relación con proveedores: Atender consultas, resolver discrepancias y mantener una comunicación efectiva con proveedores y equipos internos.
  • Conciliaciones contables: Revisar y conciliar cuentas y transacciones para asegurar la integridad de los registros financieros.
  • Cumplimiento y control: Mantener documentación y registros actualizados, asegurando el cumplimiento de controles internos y requerimientos de auditoría.
  • Mejora continua: Identificar oportunidades de optimización, automatización y estandarización de procesos dentro del Centro de Servicios Compartidos.


¿Qué buscamos en ti?

  • Licenciatura en Contabilidad, Finanzas o carreras afines.
  • Experiencia previa en Cuentas por Pagar o áreas contables y financieras.
  • Conocimiento de procesos contables, conciliaciones y gestión de pagos.
  • Manejo de Microsoft Office, especialmente Excel.
  • Experiencia con sistemas contables o ERP; Oracle será considerado un plus.
  • Deseable experiencia en Centros de Servicios Compartidos y/o industria hotelera.
  • Habilidades de organización, atención al detalle, análisis y orientación al servicio.


¡Queremos conocerte!

Si buscas nuevos retos y quieres formar parte de un equipo que impulsa la transformación de la industria hotelera, esta oportunidad es para ti.


Las contrataciones e incorporaciones se realizarán de manera escalonada, conforme al calendario de expansión y centralización de nuevos hoteles.


¡Postúlate hoy y sé parte del crecimiento de Hyatt!


Care Connects Us.


¡Postúlate hoy y sé parte de las próximas etapas de crecimiento de Hyatt!

job.job_description:
If you’re looking for the next stamp in your career passport, we’re looking for Sales Travel Consultants across Inner City Brisbane who are keen to dazzle, discover, and delight our customers at the following Flight Centre stores:

  • South Bank

Are you ready to turn your love of travel into a career that takes you further than you ever imagined, both personally and professionally? Your Flight Centre journey is uniquely yours - and we’re here to champion it, celebrate it, and help it take flight. As a Flightie you’re not just building a career - you’re shaping a life filled with purpose, connection, and discovery. Navigate your career. Explore the world.

What you’ll be doing - where your passion will meet purpose!

  • Work full-time, on-site in one of our retail stores on a rotating roster across a 7-day trade
  • Plan itineraries, book travel and convert enquiries into bookings in person, over the phone and via email for our customers
  • Work towards individual KPIs and sales targets where you’ll sell the whole holiday including flights, accommodation, car hire, tours, travel insurance, cruises, transfers and more
  • Build a customer base of new and returning customers from regular domestic bookings to lavish international holidays and everything in between
  • Be the expert! Assist our customers with their travel related questions including visas, best time of year to travel, what to pack, where to eat, what to avoid, you name it!
  • Enjoy a base wage plus an uncapped incentive payment structure where you earn a percentage of every sale, your pay is completely uncapped!

What we’re looking for - do you have the travel bug?

  • Great organisational skills - you’re the type to take notes, manage your calendar well and are quick to respond to your customer’s phone calls and emails
  • A genuine passion for travel and desire to help open up the world to our customers!
  • Determination to meet your sales targets and KPIs while balancing your workload in a high-pressure environment (think customers lining up, phones ringing, email inbox filling!)
  • Enthusiasm, passion and a warmth that makes our customers want to book with you every time!
  • A savviness with computers, ready to toggle between various complex systems when finding the right flight and package options for your customer

What you will gain from a career with Flight Centre - let’s unpack the benefits!

💲 We'll boost your wage to $65K equivalent for your first 90 days while you learn the ropes! Average earnings for a Travel Consultant in their first year are $70K, while Senior Consultants average $100K and Team Leaders average $138K annually - including superannuation and penalty rates.

🌏 Become a true expert – access industry travel discounts and qualify for sponsored ‘Familiarisation Trips’ to explore new destinations and products around the world 

💎 Brightness of Future: Career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses across the globe - we promote from within   

🎉 Social: Embrace the famous Flight Centre culture at our Reward & Recognition events throughout the year including our most popular events on the calendar Global Gathering and EOFY Celebration

Additional Information

LocationTokyu Land Corporation Ebisu Bldg 2F, 1-18-18 Ebisu Shibuya-ku, Tokyo Tokyo 150-0013, Japan VIEW ON MAP

募集概要

Voyage グローバル・リーダーシップ・ディベロップメント・プログラム

Voyage: 今日の学びが、明日のリーダーを育てる

マリオット・インターナショナルでは、大学を卒業したばかりの皆さまを対象に、生涯にわたるキャリア形成とリーダーシップへの道を切り開く特別な機会をご提供しています。

グローバル・リーダーシップ・ディベロップメント・プログラム「Voyage」は、メンターによるサポートと実践的な学習体験を通じて、将来の成功に向けたキャリア形成を支援します。

Voyageは有給のフルタイム開発プログラムです。参加者は学生時代に培った知識やスキルを活かしながら、実際の業務経験を通じてさらなる成長を遂げることができます。

  • 応募する国・地域において就労資格を有していることが必須です（当該国・地域の市民または永住権保持者）。ビザスポンサーシップ、就労許可証のスポンサーシップ、および転居支援（リロケーションサポート）は提供しておりません。

プログラムについて

Voyageは、実践的で専門性の高いトレーニングとリーダーシップ開発カリキュラムを組み合わせた、受賞歴のあるエリート育成プログラムです。

本プログラムは教室ではなく、マリオット・インターナショナルが運営するホテルを舞台に実施され、世界50か国以上で展開されています。

Voyageは以下の分野で募集を行っています。

  • 経理・財務（Accounting & Finance）
  • 調理（Culinary）
  • エンジニアリング（Engineering）
  • イベント運営（Event Operations）
  • イベント企画（Event Planning）
  • 料飲運営（Food & Beverage Operations）
  • 人事（Human Resources）
  • レベニューマネジメント（Revenue Management）
  • 宿泊部門運営（Rooms Operations）
  • セールス＆マーケティング（Sales & Marketing）
  • 情報技術（Information Technology）
  • レジデンス（Residences）

Voyageに参加すると、マリオットのシニアリーダーやコーチとの交流機会を得られるだけでなく、自身の能力を発揮する多くのチャンスに恵まれます。

また、各部門でのミニローテーションを通じてホテル運営を総合的に学び、現役および卒業生のVoyage参加者とのネットワークを築くことができます。

プログラム期間は18か月です。

参加者はマリオットの豊かな企業文化とグローバルブランドポートフォリオに触れながら、業界をリードするホスピタリティの基準を学びます。

Voyageで得られる経験

Voyage参加者は、実際の業務を通じて学びます。

プログラムに選抜された方は、以下のような経験を積むことができます。

  • お客様との信頼関係を構築する
  • 組織内でイノベーションを推進する
  • プロジェクトおよび人材マネジメントの経験を積む
  • Voyageプロジェクトを通じて業務改善や新しい取り組みを提案する
  • これまでの学びを活かした特別プロジェクトに携わる

Marriott Leadershipへの道

参加者はマネジメントミーティングに参加し、世界中のVoyage参加者と協働する機会を得られます。

課題解決に取り組むだけでなく、新しいアイデアや革新的な提案を行うことも期待されます。

また、カリキュラムへのフィードバックを通じて、将来のVoyage参加者の体験向上にも貢献できます。

プログラム修了後は、さらなる挑戦に向けた十分な知識と経験を身につけることができ、多くの卒業生がスーパーバイザー職や初級管理職としてキャリアをスタートしています。

応募資格

Voyageに応募するには、応募時点で大学またはホテルスクールを卒業後1年以内であることが必要です。

その他の応募資格：

  • 学士号または同等以上の学歴を有すること（調理部門については短期大学卒業資格も可）
  • 優れた論理的思考力およびコミュニケーション能力
  • 良好な人間関係を構築し、協働できる能力
  • 自律的に業務を遂行できること
  • 自己成長・キャリア成長への強い意欲
  • 日本語での業務遂行に十分な語学力（会話・読み書き）が必須です。英語力を有する方は歓迎いたします。
  • 応募先の国における就労資格を有していること（当該国の国籍保有者または永住権保有者）。本ポジションでは、ビザスポンサーシップ、就労許可取得支援、および転居支援は提供しておりません。

※応募日時点から12か月以内に卒業予定の大学生・専門学校生も選考対象となる場合があります。

※入社時期は2027年4月を予定しております。

4月入社が難しい場合は、履歴書に卒業予定日および就業可能開始日をご記載ください。選考時の参考とさせていただきます。

オンライン応募完了後、ビデオインタビューを実施してください。書類選考を通過された方にのみ採用担当者よりご連絡いたします。

今後の採用情報、企業ニュース、キャリアアドバイスを受け取るために、ぜひTalent Community (careers.marriott.com/talent-community)へのご登録をご検討ください。

詳しくはこちら

Marriott.com/EarlyCareers 。

マリオットインターナショナルでは、機会均等の雇用主として、すべての人を歓迎し、機会を提供するよう努めています。アソシエイトひとり一人のバックグラウンドが評価され、尊重される環境を積極的に育んでいます。私たちの最大の強みは、アソシエイトの様々な文化、才能、経験が豊かに融合している点にあります。当社は、身体障害者、退役軍人、あるいは準拠法によって保護されるその他の根拠を含め、あらゆる根拠に基づく差別の撤廃に取り組んでいます。

Job Summary

The Voyage Global Leadership Development Program

Voyage: Training tomorrow’s leaders today

Marriott International welcomes recent university graduates to experience the career development adventure of a lifetime and a world of leadership opportunities. Our global leadership development program, Voyage, propels participants on a mentored, learning-inspired journey to prepare you for a successful career. Voyage is a full-time, paid development program. As an associate and trainee, you’ll build upon the skills you developed in school by participating in real world assignments.

  • Work authorization in the country you apply is required (local citizen or permanent resident). Visa sponsorship, work permit sponsorship, and relocation support are not available.

About The Journey

Voyage is an elite, award-winning program that provides a combination of hands-on, discipline-specific training and a leadership-focused curriculum. The program takes place at a Marriott International managed hotel, not a classroom, and is offered in 50+ countries. Voyage is available in the following disciplines:

  • Accounting & Finance
  • Culinary
  • Engineering
  • Event Operations
  • Event Planning
  • Food & Beverage Operations
  • Human Resources
  • Revenue Management
  • Rooms Operations
  • Sales & Marketing
  • Information Technology
  • Residences

When you join Voyage, you gain access to Marriott’s senior leaders and coaches and have many opportunities to stand out. You’ll participate in mini-rotations across the disciplines to learn firsthand how to manage various hotel functions and to connect with current and former Voyage participants through our social collaboration tools. Voyage is a 18 months full-time program. You’ll immediately be immersed in our rich culture and portfolio of global brands to learn how Marriott sets the standard of industry excellence.

The Experience You’ll Gain

Voyage participants learn by doing! You’ll be fully immersed in the day-to-day operations of a hotel. If accepted into this elite program, you will:

  • Cultivate customer relationships
  • Be a champion for innovation within the organization
  • Get exposure to managing projects & people
  • Improve processes & pitch new initiatives through your Voyage project
  • Take on special projects that will draw upon all your training

Destination: Marriott leadership

You’ll participate in management meetings and collaborate with Voyage participants worldwide. You’ll be expected to solve challenges, as well as offer ideas and innovative solutions. You will also have an opportunity to provide feedback on your curriculum and have an impact on future Voyage hires’ experiences. After graduation, you’ll be well-prepared to pursue your passion and take on new challenges. Many program graduates are ready to step into a Marriott supervisory or entry-level management role right away, because the program has provided a foundation for future leadership.

Ready to embark?

To become a Voyage participant, you must have graduated from a university or hotel school within the past year. Other qualifications include:

  • Bachelors degree or equivalent higher level education required (Associates degree acceptable for Culinary)
  • Superior critical thinking & interpersonal communication skills
  • Ability to foster relationships & work collaboratively
  • Self-manage & be a self-starter
  • Real desire for personal & professional growth
  • Fluency in Japanese, with excellent verbal and written communication skills, is required. Proficiency in English will be an advantage.
  • Work authorization in the country you apply (local citizen or permanent resident). Visa sponsorship, work permit sponsorship, and relocation support are not available.
  • Those currently enrolled in a college/university with an expected graduation date within 12 months of the date of application may also be considered.
  • Please note that the onboarding period is in April 2027. If you are unable to join the April intake, please indicate your expected graduation date and earliest availability on your CV for our consideration.

Kindly complete the video interview upon successful submission of your application online, and the hiring team will contact you if shortlisted.

To stay connected and receive updates on future opportunities, company news, and career tips, we invite you to join our Talent Community (careers.marriott.com/talent-community).

Want to learn more?

Visit Marriott.com/EarlyCareers

job.job_description:
Job Description

The Director, Sustainability & Responsible Business - Asia Pacific (APAC) will play a key role in advancing Travel with Purpose initiatives across the region by driving sustainability performance among APAC hotels, partnering with business partners to advance our 2030 goals, engaging and activating the Travel with Purpose Champion Network, showcasing Travel with Purpose at major leadership events and in strategic communications, and supporting responsible sourcing and animal welfare priorities. Working closely with regional and global stakeholders, the role will help strengthen program adoption, elevate engagement, and enhance Hilton’s sustainability impact across APAC and globally.

The position reports to the Senior Director, Global Sustainability & Responsible Business.

Responsibilities

HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT

Your role is important, and below are some of the fundamental job duties that make your work unique.

  • Lead efforts in APAC to meet Hilton’s Travel with Purpose 2030 Goals, including energy, carbon, water, and waste reduction, as well as volunteerism and creating career growth opportunities for all.
  • Drive, implement, and track programs to make meaningful progress on Hilton’s TWP 2030 Goals.
  • Work closely with other corporate functions, including Communications, Operations, Engineering, Brands, F&B, Openings, Architecture Design & Construction (AD&C), Development, Sales, Procurement, HR, Owner Relations, and others, to incorporate sustainability into corporate strategy, policies and programs.
  • Act as an advisor and subject matter expert on sustainability matters to our hotels, particularly to guide them on achieving their energy, carbon, water, and waste reduction targets.
  • Conduct data analysis to understand hotels’ sustainability performance and prepare reporting for senior leadership and external communications.
  • Maintain support for the APAC Travel with Purpose Champions, a cross-functional group of corporate and hotel leaders that support the advancement of the Travel with Purpose strategy, and activate a broader group of hotel-level champions.
  • Present frequently on Travel with Purpose to internal and external audiences.
  • Analyze the needs of the region and contribute to and lead the development of global Travel with Purpose programs and resources. Regionalize content for APAC, working alongside other regional leads in the Americas and EMEA and other subject matter experts.
  • Contribute to Hilton communications and annual reporting efforts, including capturing APAC success stories for the annual Travel with Purpose Report, website, social media, and external communications.
  • Oversee delivery of annual Travel with Purpose Awards.
  • Lead and organize volunteerism and engagement efforts during Earth Day and Travel with Purpose Week.
  • Create and manage Travel with Purpose presence at Hilton conferences.
  • Represent Hilton on industry groups and in external speaking engagements.
  • Maintain continual awareness of sustainability trends and best practices in the hospitality industry.

Qualifications

WHY YOU’LL BE A GREAT FIT

You Have These Minimum Qualifications

  • Subject matter expertise in sustainability and understanding of broader trends and best practices, particularly in the hospitality industry.
  • Motivated and collaborative self-starter to represent global team independently in APAC.
  • Outstanding project management, organizational, and collaboration skills that ensure teamwork across all levels.
  • Outstanding written, analytical, and verbal communication skills.
  • Confidence engaging senior leaders, including SVPs and VPs.
  • Demonstrated relationship-building skills and ability to build trust, advise, and support others.
  • Willingness to work across time zones, including taking meetings in the early mornings or late evenings for the US time zone.
  • 8+ years of professional experience with a minimum of 3 years of experience in a relevant role, such as sustainability, hospitality, or business strategy consulting.
  • Strong problem-solving skills to resolve issues effectively and creatively while maintaining a high level of flexibility, partnership, and integrity.
  • Ability to travel as the need arises (10%).

It Would Be Useful If You Have

  • Proficiency in Mandarin Chinese to engage hotels in China (e.g., deliver training)
  • Knowledge of data management associated with carbon reporting standards, internal/external ESG reporting, and third-party frameworks and certifications (e.g., ISO standards, GreenKey, GSTC).

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests - we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career — and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay - we’re a great place to work.

job.job_description:
Organization- Regional Office - EAME

Summary

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best, and fastest growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities to our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences and jobs into careers.

Your Role

As Digital Marketing Associate Manager for Europe and North Africa (ENA) you will play an important role in developing and delivering innovative digital marketing strategies that strengthen Hyatt’s brand presence, deepen guest engagement, and drive acquisition, loyalty, and measurable business growth across the region.

Combining strategic thinking with hands-on digital expertise, you will translate insights into impactful campaigns, optimize performance across multiple channels, and identify new opportunities to connect with our audiences.

You will manage the relationship with our ENA Digital Media Agency, collaborate closely with our regional EAME agency, and partner with hotel teams and key stakeholders to ensure a consistent, effective, and forward-thinking approach to digital marketing. Through your creativity, analytical mindset, and collaborative spirit, you will help our hotels make the most of digital opportunities and deliver meaningful results.

Contract Type: Fixed-term maternity leave cover

Location: Palma, Spain (Hybrid working arrangement)

Start Date: November 1, 2026

Contract Duration: Minimum 6 months

Your Responsibilities

Digital Strategy & Campaign Performance

  • Support the development and execution of comprehensive digital marketing strategies that align with Hyatt’s business objectives, strengthen brand visibility, and drive guest engagement, acquisition, and loyalty across ENA
  • Plan, execute, and optimize digital advertising campaigns across channels including Google, Meta, LinkedIn, search engine marketing (SEM), metasearch, programmatic, display, and social media, with a focus on maximizing return on investment.
  • Monitor and analyze campaign performance, develop insightful dashboards and reports, and translate data into actionable recommendations that continuously improve marketing effectiveness.
  • Manage digital marketing budgets, ensuring thoughtful allocation of resources, efficient media investment, and strong campaign performance.

Agency Management & Regional Collaboration

  • Manage the day-to-day relationship with Hyatt’s ENA Digital Media Agency, ensuring high-quality execution, alignment with brand and commercial objectives, and effective budget management.
  • Collaborate closely with the EAME regional Digital Media Agency to promote consistency in strategy, campaign execution, reporting, and the adoption of best practices across markets.

Stakeholder Partnerships

  • Partner with Marketing, Brand, Loyalty, Franchise, Revenue, and CRM teams to align campaign objectives, messaging, and digital content with Hyatt’s broader commercial priorities and brand standards.

Qualifications

Your Qualifications & Experience

We are looking for a digitally savvy, collaborative, and results-oriented marketing professional who brings together strategic thinking, analytical expertise, and a genuine passion for driving business performance.

Experience & Expertise

  • A minimum of 4 years of professional experience in digital marketing, with demonstrated expertise in digital media strategy, campaign management, and performance optimization.
  • Strong knowledge of paid digital advertising, including SEM, metasearch, paid social, display, programmatic advertising, and affiliate marketing.
  • Advanced proficiency in digital analytics and advertising platforms, including Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, Google Ads, Meta advertising platforms, and relevant media technologies.
  • Experience working with or managing external agencies and coordinating marketing initiatives across multiple markets or regions.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based marketing technologies, including personalization, content management, data analytics, e-commerce, CRM, mobile, and collaboration platforms.
  • Experience with marketing automation and CRM campaigns would be an advantage.
  • A bachelor's degree is preferred.

Skills & Capabilities

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insights, compelling stories, and practical business recommendations.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to engage and collaborate effectively across departments, markets, and levels of leadership.
  • A creative and curious mindset, combined with commercial awareness and a passion for exploring new digital opportunities.
  • Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality, brand-aligned work.
  • High proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and digital marketing reporting tools.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build productive relationships and collaborate across diverse teams.

How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for the last ten years. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer the following benefits:

  • Health insurance , fully covered by the company.
  • Flexible compensation  for meals and childcare.
  • The option to request salary advances .
  • Up to 12 complimentary hotel nights per year , prorated according to the length of your contract.
  • Two remote-working days per week.
  • Special discounts  at Hyatt hotels worldwide, as well as on a range of services and products.

You’ll be part of our exclusive world of care,  #WorldofCare , where your well-being and development are our priority .

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs, only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.

job.job_description:
If you’re looking for the next stamp in your career passport, we’re looking for Sales Travel Consultants across South Brisbane who are keen to dazzle, discover, and delight our customers at the following Flight Centre stores:

  • Garden City

Are you ready to turn your love of travel into a career that takes you further than you ever imagined, both personally and professionally? Your Flight Centre journey is uniquely yours - and we’re here to champion it, celebrate it, and help it take flight. As a Flightie you’re not just building a career - you’re shaping a life filled with purpose, connection, and discovery. Navigate your career. Explore the world.

What you’ll be doing - where your passion will meet purpose!

  • Work full-time, on-site in one of our retail stores on a rotating roster across a 7-day trade
  • Plan itineraries, book travel and convert enquiries into bookings in person, over the phone and via email for our customers
  • Work towards individual KPIs and sales targets where you’ll sell the whole holiday including flights, accommodation, car hire, tours, travel insurance, cruises, transfers and more
  • Build a customer base of new and returning customers from regular domestic bookings to lavish international holidays and everything in between
  • Be the expert! Assist our customers with their travel related questions including visas, best time of year to travel, what to pack, where to eat, what to avoid, you name it!
  • Enjoy a base wage plus an uncapped incentive payment structure where you earn a percentage of every sale, your pay is completely uncapped!

What we’re looking for - do you have the travel bug?

  • Great organisational skills - you’re the type to take notes, manage your calendar well and are quick to respond to your customer’s phone calls and emails
  • A genuine passion for travel and desire to help open up the world to our customers!
  • Determination to meet your sales targets and KPIs while balancing your workload in a high-pressure environment (think customers lining up, phones ringing, email inbox filling!)
  • Enthusiasm, passion and a warmth that makes our customers want to book with you every time!
  • A savviness with computers, ready to toggle between various complex systems when finding the right flight and package options for your customer

What you will gain from a career with Flight Centre - let’s unpack the benefits!

💲 We'll boost your wage to $65K equivalent for your first 90 days while you learn the ropes! Average earnings for a Travel Consultant in their first year are $70K, while Senior Consultants average $100K and Team Leaders average $138K annually - including superannuation and penalty rates.

🌏 Become a true expert – access industry travel discounts and qualify for sponsored ‘Familiarisation Trips’ to explore new destinations and products around the world 

💎 Brightness of Future: Career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses across the globe - we promote from within   

🎉 Social: Embrace the famous Flight Centre culture at our Reward & Recognition events throughout the year including our most popular events on the calendar Global Gathering and Flichella    

🎓 Get qualified for free with a Certificate 3 & 4 in Travel & Tourism (worth 20k!) through Australian Apprentice Training - you may also be eligible to receive direct financial support while you study 

🌈 Thrive in a workplace that embraces individualism – come as you are!  

Okay, I’m in!

Are you keen to join our team of Flighties? Hit apply now for your application to be read by a real human, no AI here! If your application is successful, you’ll be invited to have a 15-minute phone interview with one of our dedicated team of recruiters. Get ready to work, travel and grow.

Why is Flight Centre such a great place to work?

We are devoted to being a global employer of choice by nurturing our legendary culture - focused on our people and infused with adventure and accountability. We uplift and support our team through a compelling Employee Value Proposition that offers exciting career and travel opportunities, fantastic benefits, a meaningful sense of purpose and well-deserved recognition. Explore us on LinkedIn or check out our careers page at www.fctgcareers.com

*Flight Centre is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.*

#FCB

Additional Information

Job Number 26118853

Job Category Sales & Marketing

Location Barnard's Inn 86 Fetter Lane, London Londo EC4A 1EN, United KingdomVIEW ON MAP

Schedule Full Time

Located Remotely? N

Position Type Management

As a member of the Distribution Strategy team, the Senior Manager, Distribution- Connectivity serves as a Connectivity subject matter expert; working in partnership with the Senior Director, Global Connectivity and other Connectivity and key stakeholders across the organization. This role will provide guidance for strategic needs on how to grow partnerships through new and enhanced capabilities via Marriott’s transformation and technology architecture. They will execute evolving distribution strategies in the complex B2B and B2C intermediary segments while transitioning Marriott’s legacy platforms into new technological capabilities. This role will focus on enhancing 3rd party partnerships globally to support new strategies and best in class distribution for Marriott franchisees.

The responsibilities of this role include supporting implementation and execution of partner interfaces, enhancements, distribution initiatives, as well as escalation/resolution processes to ensure business objectives and operational service levels are met. This role will also work very closely with the commercial account teams within the Global Sales and Distribution organizations to ensure Marriott’s distribution partners are connected and achieving business continuity. This role is responsible for representing Distribution requirements for our technology transformation on behalf of 3rd party partners within the Americas region while also keeping in mind a frictionless customer experience, providing intuitive technology for associates, and positioning Marriott to pursue new emerging businesses.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

Required

  • 4-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, or related major and 4+ years of relevant professional experience, demonstrating progressive career growth and a pattern of exceptional performance;

OR

  • 6+ years of relevant professional experience in marketing or related function, demonstrating progressive career growth and pattern of exceptional performance.

Preferred

  • At least four years of relevant work experience managing complex projects and efforts to successful execution
  • Possess a strong understanding of third party distribution channels and core Marriott systems
  • Previous experience working with CRS systems, Global Distribution Systems (GDS), Online Travel Agencies (OTAs), and/or technology intermediaries
  • Ability to identify and understand issues, problems and opportunities, and obtain and compare information from different sources to draw conclusions and chooses a course of action
  • Previous exposure working within all levels of the organization
  • Background in 3rd party account management, managing partner expectations/needs/requirements
  • Strong understanding and capabilities utilizing Microsoft office suite, including excel and PowerPoint applications
  • Experience presenting and explaining new requirements/needs to leadership with comfort
  • Familiarity working with cross-functional stakeholders including sales, revenue management, and technology organizations

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

  • Serves as Connectivity Subject Matter Expert (SME) for 3rd party distribution systems
  • Provides insights into distribution environment and make recommendations how to support strategic distribution initiatives
  • Acts as a consultant for key distribution partners to educate on best practices for implementing Marriott Distribution Programs
  • Works with key distribution partners to optimize and grow Marriotts presence and revenue
  • Manage expectations for the IT roadmap to implement new partner interfaces supporting Global and Continent Distribution Strategy
  • Manage pulling through core capabilities and enhancements to existing partner interfaces
  • Works with commercial teams to activate new partners while maintaining high standards of operational service levels
  • Work with Director Channel Operations & Support to monitor property and partner feedback, and manage escalation resolution process
  • Identify knowledge gaps and create a plan to educate key stake holders to better understand how distribution strategies are managed and executed in the region
  • Develops and sustains relationships based on an understanding of stakeholder needs working within a complex and ambiguous environment, ability to navigate decisions logically and maintain the best interest of the company
  • Uses an effective interpersonal style to build a cohesive team, inspires and sustains team cohesion and engagement by focusing the team on its mission and importance to the organization.
  • Sets high standards of performance for self and others.
  • Assumes responsibility and accountability for goals.

Delivering on the Needs of Key Stakeholders

  • Understands and meets the needs of key stakeholders.
  • Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish work.
  • Determines priorities, schedules, plans and necessary resources to ensure completion of any projects on schedule.
  • Collaborates with internal partners and stakeholders to support business/initiative strategies
  • Communicates concepts in a clear and persuasive manner that is easy to understand.
  • Generates and provides accurate and timely results in the form of reports, presentations, etc.
  • Demonstrates an understanding of business priorities.
  • Sets clear goals and expectations for direct reports using the performance review process and holds direct report(s) accountable for performance.
  • Leads specific team while assisting with meeting or exceeding department goals.
  • Translates broader organizational initiatives into relevant goals for direct report(s).
  • Creates and nurtures an environment that emphasizes motivation, empowerment, teamwork, and continuous improvement.

United Kingdom

At the time of application, applicants must have the legal right to work in the United Kingdom. Unfortunately, this role is not eligible for visa sponsorship or relocation assistance.

WHY JOIN MARRIOTT INTERNATIONAL?

Marriott International has been recognized as one of Fortune’s 100 Best Companies to Work For™ in 2026 by Great Place to Work®. This is a reflection of our people-first culture, commitment to wellbeing, and collaborative workplace. This accolade joins a growing list of regional honors, reinforcing our dedication to creating an exceptional environment where associates thrive.

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.  We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Marriott International is the world’s largest hotel company, with more brands, more hotels and more opportunities for associates to grow and succeed. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.

job.company_description:
We’re adventure seekers. Smile givers. Impact makers.
We believe in the power of travel. It broadens horizons for our customers, and for our people too. New places to live, new roles to explore, new communities to join. It’s yours for the taking.
We’re TUI, a leading global travel and leisure experience company that makes holiday dreams come true for people around the world.
We are one of the world’s leading tourism groups counting 1200 travel agencies and online portals, five airlines with around 130 aircraft, over 400 hotels, 16 cruise liners, digital platforms for tours and activities and most importantly over 60 000 colleagues around the world. What unites us is creating moments that enrich the lives of our 21 million customers.
Beside the unforgettable experience we provide our customers, we also believe in the good that tourism can bring and we care deeply about our environmental impact. The TUI Care foundation has projects in over 30 countries worldwide, building on the potential of tourism as a global force for development. The Foundation opens up new perspectives through education and training, empowers local communities to benefit from the success of tourism and engages in the protection of nature and the environment.
At TUI we simply say “Let’s TUI it”. For us, that means creating happiness. Tackling challenges every day together, with a positive, can-do attitude, and finding solutions even for the most unexpected situations. Our teams across TUI are just as diverse as our destinations. So whether you have lots of experience or none at all. If you want to work in an office or feel best in the field. No matter if you’re an accomplished tech whizz, an aspiring entertainer, or simply in love with flying.
There’s a place for you here.
job.job_description:
Join TUI Musement as a Supply Management Executive in France where you will own assigned operators and/or destinations within a specific country area in order to support commercial relation with suppliers and contract all needed components across different segments (excursions, tickets, multi-day tours, shorex, transfers) and areas. In this perspective, your main objective will be to build up local offer based on different requirements and driving higher margins to support TUI Musement bottom line results. Besides margins growth, key performance metrics include the achievement of product targets at destination level including quality of the same. You will be working in a dedicate and autonomous team of experts managing end-to-end objectives as set up by TUI Musement strategy from a sourcing standpoint. Key for this role will be your capability of creating and supporting commercial relationships with local operators and venues, including attractions museums public venues.

The role can be fully remote in France.

Closing Date 27.10.2026

About Our Offer

  • Personal benefits: Attractive remuneration, extensive health & well-being support, and more.
  • Flexible working: Work is something you do, not somewhere you go. We encourage a healthy work-life balance with a dynamic working environment.
  • A career to shape: Access the TUI Learning Hub to level-up and reach your ambitions.
  • Broaden your network: We champion intercultural collaboration and provide opportunities to work on global projects and teams
  • Community: Get involved with incredible local charity and sustainability initiatives like the TUI Care Foundation.

About The Job

  • Support commercial growth by building strong relationships with tour, activity and ticketing suppliers in the top destinations and venues in the region
  • Support the suppliers’ enrolment and onboarding process
  • Build and optimise the supply of pre-existing cities and venues as well as launch new destinations within the region
  • Be an expert in your destination – generating new leads and strategic acquisition of new and unique products
  • Liaise with different stakeholders to implement best practices
  • Have a comprehensive understanding of the competitive landscape and tourism trends in the region

About You

  • Experience in sales or account management, preferably in the tourism and/or e-commerce industry
  • Fluency in French and English is essential
  • Commercial mindset with proven negotiation skills and a successful record of closing deals and building strategic partnerships
  • Willingness to work under pressure in a dynamic environment and to quickly address issues
  • Strong analytical and numerical skills
  • Full understanding of digital components and new industry standards, with particular regard to API-based connectivity, channel managers, reservation technologies)
  • Comfortable with targets and working in a key results-driven environment with different priorities
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Solid knowledge of digital tools (e.g. tasks managements, CRM, contracting platforms)

From a workplace to a place to belong. At TUI we embrace diversity, equity, and inclusion, encouraging everyone to come as you are, because together, our potential is limitless.

We are committed to supporting candidates with disabilities and impairments so if you require any support, please do let us know.

job.job_description:
Organization- Hyatt Corporate Office

Summary

The Opportunity

Hyatt Hotels Corporation Corporation seeks an enthusiastic Senior Copywriter, Global Content to join our Global Creative and Content Team. In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional partners to develop emotionally compelling, brand-driven copy that supports integrated marketing campaigns, promotional initiatives and guest engagement across Hyatt’s global portfolio.

As a key contributor within a pooled team model, this role develops high-impact copy that supports brand growth, promotional initiatives and omnichannel marketing campaigns. This role focuses on campaign-level storytelling and integrated marketing execution across Hyatt’s global brand portfolio, loyalty initiatives and commercial partnerships. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list since 2013. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

  • Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on-site fitness center
  • A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption
  • Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

The Role

The Senior Copywriter is responsible for developing compelling campaign copy and brand storytelling across multiple marketing channels, including web, email, social, paid media, CRM, and sales materials.

This role translates creative briefs into cohesive, audience-focused messaging and supports the integrated execution of global initiatives. Working within defined campaign guidelines, the Senior Copywriter works closely with creative leaders and brand stakeholders to deliver impactful content that drives engagement and elevates Hyatt’s brand portfolio.

  • Develop copy for integrated marketing campaigns, including seasonal promotions, loyalty initiatives, partnerships and B2B communications.
  • Translate creative briefs into clear, compelling and brand-aligned messaging frameworks.
  • Write across channels including web, email, social, display, app and sales enablement materials while maintaining a consistent brand voice and storytelling approach.
  • Collaborate with campaign leads to ensure alignment with approved strategic direction.
  • Ensure tone, voice and structural consistency.
  • Support localization readiness by delivering high-quality source copy.
  • Balance creativity with precision, ensuring messaging accurately reflects promotional details, offer terms and legal requirements.
  • Craft emotionally compelling, insight-driven messaging that strengthens brand affinity and inspires guest engagement.
  • Adapt messaging for various audience segments while maintaining brand guardrails.
  • Manage multiple concurrent projects within a fast-paced, high-variability environment.
  • Incorporate personalization and AI-enabled content tools where appropriate to enhance efficiency.

Qualifications

Experience Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in English, Communications, Journalism, Marketing or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in copywriting, campaign development or brand storytelling.
  • Demonstrated experience writing for integrated, omnichannel marketing campaigns.
  • Strong understanding of brand voice and audience segmentation.
  • Exceptional writing, editing and storytelling skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.

Experience Preferred:

  • Experience in hospitality, travel, lifestyle or loyalty marketing.
  • Familiarity with SEO principles and digital best practices.
  • Experience working within content management systems and project management tools.
  • Exposure to AI-powered content creation tools.

The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all-encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary.

We welcome you:

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.

The salary range for this position is $78,500 - $100,000. This position is also eligible to earn an annual bonus. The final pay rate/salary offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level and other qualifications for the role, as well as the location of the performance of work. Pay for the successful candidate will meet local requirements, including the local minimum wage rate.

 We value our relationships with recruitment partners and require that agencies contact us first before submitting any candidates. Hyatt will not be responsible for any fees and obligations associated with unsolicited submissions unless a formal agreement is in place.

job.job_description:
If you’re an experienced Travel Consultant with a knack for making the complex seem simple, you'll fit right in with our Round the World team. Our purpose is to open up the world for those who want to see. Every day, we give people all around the world the opportunity to do something really amazing – travel!

How you’ll be opening up the world for our customers…

As a Travel Consultant in our Round the World team, you will help to plan, book and coordinate your customer’s next amazing travel experience, all built around multi-stop, complex travel itineraries. You'll be curating bespoke airfares and land itineraries that customers cannot find online, with a dedicated complex, multi-stop and round the world enquiry stream - no domestic bookings! But it’s not just airfares – you’ll be the expert for your customer’s every need, including flights, accommodation, cruises, tours, insurance and more! You will be working towards KPI’s and incentive targets, therefore building your customer relationships will be critical to your success in this role.

What it takes to be a Round the World expert…

  • You’re the go-to person in your circle for travel recommendations, tips and tricks, with prior experience as a Travel Consultant
  • You seek out new ways to build on your success and think outside of the box for your customers to find the best travel solution for them
  • You have proven success in achieving your KPIs and sales targets
  • You understand the importance of organisation and managing your time effectively to achieve the best result and stay on top of your work
  • You’re not only good at the people stuff, but at the behind the scenes stuff too. Like building itineraries, doing up invoices, operating our complex booking systems and jumping between different programs with a customer in front of you
  • You’re comfortable with complexity
  • You know your way around GDS and you’re confident to learn complex computer systems

Your First Class Employee Benefits:

  • At FCTG we understand the importance of flexibility while fostering a culture of collaboration through in person iterations – our Round the World team offer hybrid working arrangements
  • Be rewarded with a base wage plus uncapped commission structure - earn a percentage of every sale you make from day one, there’s no limit on what you can earn
  • You'll be working in a high performing team of experts
  • Be gifted the time to provide the support your loyal clientele deserves, and to foster great relationships – you won’t be serving a constant queue, but the organic enquiry is there for you to be able to go above and beyond with your sales targets
  • Unlock your wanderlust! Score incredible travel deals for you & your friends and family, plus the opportunity to qualify for famils!
  • Brightness of Future: Career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses across the globe - we promote from within   
  • Embrace the famous Flight Centre culture at our Reward & Recognition events throughout the year, including our most popular event on the calendar "Global Gathering"
  • Thrive in a workplace that values individualism – come as you are!

Don’t miss your flight! Apply now for one of the best adventures you’ll have.

job.job_description:
Bei der TUI Deutschland GmbH in Hannover bieten wir ab August 2027 ein interessantes und vielseitiges duales Studium zum Bachelor of Science Business Economics mit der Fachrichtung Tourismus- und Eventmanagement (m/w/d) an.

Die TUI Deutschland GmbH ist der führende Reiseveranstalter auf dem deutschen Markt und eine Tochtergesellschaft der TUI Group. Sie steuert von Hannover aus nicht nur die Entwicklung, sondern auch den Vertrieb und die Vermarktung von TUI-Reisen in Deutschland. Neben der Kernmarke TUI gehören auch Spezialisten wie airtours, ltur und Gebeco zur Unternehmensgruppe. TUI Deutschland verantwortet außerdem die Geschäfte in Österreich und der Schweiz, um das zentraleuropäische Geschäft zu bündeln.

UNSER ANGEBOT

Deine Entwicklung

  • strukturiertes Onboarding
  • Schulungen, Seminare und Workshops
  • Seminarreise und ein mehrwöchiger Auslandseinsatz
  • umfangreiche Unterstützung bei deiner Prüfungsvorbereitung

Deine Vorteile

  • 30 Urlaubstage
  • Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld
  • attraktive Ausbildungsvergütung (1.082 € / 1.193 € / 1.337 € / Monat)
  • Reisevergünstigungen
  • mit TUI WORKWIDE bis zu 30 Tage im Ausland arbeiten
  • Deutschlandticket als Jobticket
  • Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft

Deine Perspektiven

  • Netzwerkaufbau
  • internationale Zusammenarbeit
  • Übernahmemöglichkeiten in der gesamten TUI Welt, bei herausragenden Leistungen eine Übernahmegarantie

ZUR POSITION

Du möchtest verstehen, wie wirtschaftliche Entscheidungen entstehen, analysierst gerne Zusammenhänge und hast Spaß daran, mit Zahlen und Daten echte Mehrwerte zu schaffen? Dann starte dein duales Studium bei TUI!

Während deines Studiums wechselst du regelmäßig zwischen Theorie und Praxis. An der Leibniz Fachhochschule in Hannover erwirbst du fundiertes betriebswirtschaftliches Wissen, das du in den Praxisphasen direkt bei TUI anwenden kannst. Dabei lernst du verschiedene Fachbereiche kennen, arbeitest an spannenden Projekten mit und gewinnst Einblicke in die wirtschaftlichen Zusammenhänge eines internationalen Touristikunternehmens.

Ob...

  • Controlling,
  • Finance
  • Commercial Analytics oder
  • weitere betriebswirtschaftliche Fachbereiche:

Bei uns arbeitest du mit modernen Daten- und Analysetools, unterstützt wichtige Entscheidungsprozesse und entwickelst dich Schritt für Schritt zur gefragten Nachwuchskraft. Dabei übernehmen wir nicht nur deine Studiengebühren, sondern bieten dir auch zahlreiche Trainings, E-Learnings und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

ZU DIR

Du passt zu uns, wenn...

  • du wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge spannend findest und gerne den Dingen auf den Grund gehst.
  • du Spaß an Zahlen, Daten und analytischem Denken hast.
  • du neugierig bist und neue Themen mit Offenheit und Eigeninitiative angehst.
  • du digital unterwegs bist und moderne Tools selbstverständlich nutzt.
  • du sowohl selbstständig arbeiten als auch gemeinsam im Team Lösungen entwickeln möchtest.
  • du Lust hast, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dich persönlich weiterzuentwickeln.
  • du sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse mitbringst.
  • du dein Abitur erfolgreich abgeschlossen hast oder bald abschließen wirst.

Deine Noten sind für uns ein wichtiger Anhaltspunkt. Noch wichtiger ist uns aber deine Persönlichkeit, deine Motivation und deine Bereitschaft, Neues zu lernen und mitzugestalten.

Lade Deine Bewerbung Einfach Online Hoch

  • Anschreiben (oder erzähl uns auf kreative Weise, warum du zu uns passt)
  • Lebenslauf
  • Deine letzten zwei Schulzeugnisse bzw. dein Abschlusszeugnus
  • Optional: Praktikumsnachweise, Zertifikate oder weitere Unterlagen, die zeigen, wer du bist

Bereit für deinen Start bei TUI? ️✈️

  • Bewirb dich online und schicke uns deine Unterlagen.
  • Zeig uns, was in dir steckt - mit einem kurzen Online-Test.
  • Lerne uns persönlich kennen und entdecke beim Assessment Center die Welt von TUI.
  • Willkommen an Bord! Wenn alles passt, erhältst du dein Vertragsangebot für den Start im August 2027 und deine Reise bei TUI kann beginnen.

Von einem Arbeitsplatz zu einem Ort, an dem man dazugehört. Bei TUI schätzen wir Vielfalt, Gleichberechtigung und Inklusion und ermutigen alle, so zu sein, wie sie sind. „Come as you are“ – das ist unsere Vision, denn nur durch Vielfalt ist unser Potenzial grenzenlos. Wir ermuntern Menschen mit Behinderung, sich zu bewerben.

job.job_description:
If you’re an experienced Travel Consultant with a passion for the finer things in life while travelling, you’ll fit right into our Luxury Travel team. Our purpose is to open up the world for those who want to see. Every day, we give people all around the world the opportunity to do something really amazing – travel!

How you’ll be opening up the world for our customers…

As a Travel Consultant in our Luxury Travel team, you will help to plan, book and coordinate your customer’s next amazing luxury travel experience. You’ll be building unique itineraries for your customers with their every need front of mind to ensure they have a premium experience from “Bon Voyage” to “Welcome Home”. You will be booking everything from first class flights to five star hotels, premium tours, luxury cruising, travel insurance and more. You will be working towards KPI’s and incentive targets, therefore building your customer relationships will be critical to your success in this role.

What It Takes To Be a Luxury Travel Expert…

  • You’re the go-to person in your circle for travel recommendations, tips and tricks, with a minimum of 5 years experience as a Travel Consultant
  • You’re eager to provide exceptional service to welcome new customers to your existing database of loyal clientele
  • You have proven success in achieving your KPIs and sales targets
  • You seek out new ways to build on your success and think outside of the box for your customers to find the best travel solution for them
  • You understand the importance of organisation and managing your time effectively to achieve the best result and stay on top of your work
  • You’re not only good at the people stuff, but at the behind the scenes stuff too. Like building itineraries, doing up invoices, operating our complex booking systems and jumping between different programs with a customer in front of you
  • You know your way around GDS and you’re confident with complex computer systems
  • Extra points if you have personal experience with luxury travel!

Your First Class Employee Benefits:

  • At FCTG we understand the importance of flexibility while fostering a culture of collaboration through in person iterations – our Luxury Travel team offer hybrid working arrangements
  • Be rewarded with a base wage plus uncapped incentives payment structure - earn a percentage of every sale you make from day one, there’s no limit on what you can earn
  • Be gifted the time to provide the support your loyal clientele deserves, and to foster great relationships – you won’t be serving a constant queue, but the organic enquiry is there for you to be able to go above and beyond with your sales targets
  • You’ll be joining a highly experienced and skilled team
  • Unlock your wanderlust! Score incredible travel deals for you & your friends and family, and get ready to be invited to try premium air, cruise and land product for yourself through supplier famils
  • Brightness of Future: Career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses across the globe - we promote from within   
  • Embrace the famous Flight Centre culture at our Reward & Recognition with events throughout the year including, our most popular event on the calendar "Global Gathering"
  • Thrive in a workplace that values individualism – come as you are!

Don’t miss your flight! Apply now for one of the best adventures you’ll have.

*Flight Centre is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. *

There’s a place for you here.
job.job_description:
Here at TUI, you’ll find we’re an inclusive company with a culture of care and by joining the Retail Team as a Travel Advisor in our Heswall store, we’ll support you to become a destination expert so that you can recommend and sell holidays, Cruise, UK Breaks and additional products. You’ll put all customers at the heart of our business by creating unforgettable holiday experiences that make us the best-loved holiday company.

As part of our dedication to delivering exceptional customer service and flexibility for our customers, you’ll enjoy a varied shift pattern each week including weekends and bank holidays, and evenings at some of our busier stores.

About Our Offer

  • TUI offers much more than just starting salary of £13.09 per hour
  • Be rewarded for exceeding your targets with our commission scheme
  • Enjoy fantastic holiday benefits, discounts, special offers and the ability to purchase additional TUI time off
  • Benefit from our Health and Wellbeing across key areas – Financial, Health, Social, Community and Career
  • Investment in your development and career progression
  • Pension scheme and life assurance

About The Job

  • Use your passion to inspire our customers and colleagues whilst enjoying a great amount of fun
  • Your drive to achieve will lead you to exceed your sales objectives, in Retail we call it ‘Smashing your Targets’
  • You’ll embrace change and rise to the challenges of a customer engaged role both face to face and virtually
  • If things don’t go to plan, you’ll need to be confident to actively investigate and resolve any question or complaint
  • As technology advances so does TUI, you’ll receive training on a variety of systems empowering you to enhance your knowledge whilst bringing memorable holidays to life for our customers.

About You

  • Excellent customer service skills with a genuine passion to go above and beyond
  • A strong dedication to achieve goals and sales targets
  • Able to prioritise multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment and bounce back from challenges
  • Ability to embrace change and adapt to new ways of working
  • A team player who engages and collaborates with our customers and colleagues
  • An organised individual who takes pride in their work and communicates effectively
  • Able to work a varied shift pattern each week in-line with shop opening and closing times.

From a workplace to a place to belong. At TUI we embrace diversity, equity and inclusion, encouraging everyone to come as you are, because together, our potential is limitless.

We're committed to supporting candidates with disabilities and impairments so if you require any support, please let us know.

For the Hiring Manger to have sight of your application, you'll also need complete our online assessment - you'll be prompted to do this once you've submitted your application.

Please note, if you've been interviewed for this role within the last 6 months, we're unable to consider a further application at this time
