job.job_description:
Organization- Hyatt Corporate Office

Summary

The Opportunity

Hyatt Hotels Corporation seeks an enthusiastic SEO and GEO Manager to join our Digital Marketing team. closely with the broader Content, Engineering, Product, and Field Marketing teams, where you’ll be instrumental in continuing to make Hyatt a leading hospitality company. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list since 2013. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

  • Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on-site fitness center
  • A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption
  • Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

The Role

Hyatt seeks an enthusiastic, curious, and results-oriented SEO and GEO Manager to join the Global Media Team. This Manager will drive high-quality organic traffic, maximize visibility across traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms, and grow revenue through strategic affiliate partnerships. The role combines technical SEO expertise, AI search strategy, content optimization, and affiliate program management to increase qualified traffic, direct bookings, and revenue. Working across Digital Product, Engineering, Content, Brand, Media, and Field Marketing, the Manager will help build a cohesive, data-driven discovery strategy that keeps Hyatt at the forefront of the evolving search landscape.

  • Develop and execute enterprise SEO and GEO strategies that improve organic visibility, qualified traffic, conversions, and direct bookings in alignment with key business goals.
  • Develop strategies to improve Hyatt’s visibility, accuracy, authority, and citation presence across AI-powered search experiences, including ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, and emerging generative platforms.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Brand, Content, Digital Product, Engineering, Media, and regional and property-level teams to integrate SEO and GEO best practices into campaigns, hotel launches, seasonal travel moments, destination content, product experiences, and technical roadmaps. Translate search insights into actionable briefs, standards, and training that support evergreen growth.
  • Conduct technical audits covering site architecture, crawlability, indexation, crawl budget, page rendering, site speed, and structured data. Partner with Product and Engineering to resolve issues and provide SEO quality assurance for site releases, template changes, redesigns, and migrations.
  • Identify visibility gaps, citation opportunities, competitive trends, and content priorities across AI-powered discovery platforms.
  • Develop and execute search- and GEO-informed content strategies grounded in keyword research, prompt and topic analysis, traveler intent, competitive insights, and performance data.
  • Guide optimization across metadata, headings, copy structure, internal linking, taxonomy, and content formats.
  • Assist in the management of the affiliate marketing program including partner strategy, performance optimization, and measurement, to drive incremental revenue and customer acquisition.
  • Leverage analytics, search intelligence, and affiliate platforms—including Adobe Analytics, Google Search Console, Botify, Semrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, Profound, and Partnerize—to measure performance, identify opportunities, and communicate business impact to key stakeholders.
  • Manage agency and vendor relationships, including project scope, deliverables, performance, and accountability.
  • Stay at the forefront of developments in SEO, GEO, AEO, AI-powered discovery, and consumer search behavior, translating emerging trends into actionable business recommendations.

Qualifications

Experience Required:

  • 5+ years of relevant professional experience in SEO, digital marketing, organic growth or related function
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex search concepts for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated experience with SEO strategy and execution, with a proven track record of success in driving growth
  • Exceptional technical, local, and content focused SEO knowledge
  • Possess an innovative, problem-solving, and solutions-oriented mindset
  • Exceptional organizational, presentation, and communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Strong analytical and excel skills, experience with Adobe Analytics a plus
  • Proficiency with enterprise SEO software such as Screaming Frog, Botify, SEMRush, or Ahrefs.
  • Understanding of front-end web technology including HTML, CSS, JavaScript.

Experience Preferred:

  • Bachelor’s degree from accredited 4-year institution
  • Knowledge of AI search platforms and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) strategies
  • Experience managing Affiliate programs and working with Affiliate platforms
  • Experience in hospitality a plus

The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all-encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary.

We welcome you:

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.

The salary range for this position is $117,000 - $135,000

The final pay rate/salary offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level and other qualifications for the role, as well as the location of the performance of work. Pay for the successful candidate will meet local requirements, including the local minimum wage rate.

We value our relationships with recruitment partners and require that agencies contact us first before submitting any candidates. Hyatt will not be responsible for any fees and obligations associated with unsolicited submissions unless a formal agreement is in place.

job.job_description:
Bei der TUI Deutschland GmbH bieten wir ab August 2027 eine sehr interessante und vielseitige Ausbildung im E-Commerce (m/w/d) in Hannover an.

Die TUI Deutschland GmbH ist der führende Reiseveranstalter auf dem deutschen Markt und eine Tochtergesellschaft der TUI Group. Sie steuert von Hannover aus nicht nur die Entwicklung, sondern auch den Vertrieb und die Vermarktung von TUI-Reisen in Deutschland. Neben der Kernmarke TUI gehören auch Spezialisten wie airtours, ltur und Gebeco zur Unternehmensgruppe. TUI Deutschland verantwortet außerdem die Geschäfte in Österreich und der Schweiz, um das zentraleuropäische Geschäft zu bündeln.

UNSER ANGEBOT

Deine Entwicklung

  • strukturiertes Onboarding
  • Schulungen, Seminare und Workshops
  • Seminarreise und ein mehrwöchiger Auslandseinsatz
  • umfangreiche Unterstützung bei deiner Prüfungsvorbereitung

Deine Vorteile

  • 30 Urlaubstage
  • Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld
  • attraktive Ausbildungsvergütung (1.082 € / 1.193 € / 1.337 € / Monat)
  • Reisevergünstigungen
  • mit TUI WORKWIDE bis zu 30 Tage im Ausland arbeiten
  • Deutschlandticket als Jobticket
  • Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft

Deine Perspektiven

  • Netzwerkaufbau
  • internationale Zusammenarbeit
  • Übernahmemöglichkeiten in der gesamten TUI Welt, bei herausragenden Leistungen eine Übernahmegarantie

ZUR POSITION

Du interessierst dich für Online-Shops, Social Media, digitale Trends und möchtest wissen, wie Reisen online erfolgreich verkauft werden? Dann komm zu TUI! Während deiner Ausbildung lernst du die vielfältige Welt des E-Commerce kennen, arbeitest an spannenden Online-Projekten mit und gestaltest das digitale Urlaubserlebnis unserer Kund*innen aktiv mit.

Ob...

  • Online-Marketing,
  • Webshops & Buchungsstrecken,
  • digitale Kundenkommunikation oder
  • Datenanalyse & Vertriebssteuerung:

Bei uns bekommst du abwechslungsreiche Einblicke, bringst deine Ideen ein und entwickelst dich Schritt für Schritt zum E-Commerce-Profi.

ZUR DIR

Du passt zu uns, wenn...

  • du Lust hast, die Welt des Reisens hinter den Kulissen kennenzulernen.
  • du gerne mit Menschen arbeitest und Kommunikation zu deinen Stärken zählt.
  • du offen für Neues bist und Veränderungen eher spannend als anstrengend findest.
  • du digital unterwegs bist und moderne Tools selbstverständlich nutzt.
  • du im Team aufblühst und Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest.
  • du (Fach-)Abitur oder einen erweiterten Realschulabschuss mitbringst.

Noten sind wichtig. Noch wichtiger ist uns aber deine Persönlichkeit, deine Motivation und deine Begeisterung für die Touristik.

Lade Deine Bewerbung Einfach Online Hoch

  • Anschreiben (oder erzähl uns auf kreative Weise, warum du zu uns passt)
  • Lebenslauf
  • Deine letzten zwei Schulzeugnisse bzw. dein Abschlusszeugnus
  • Optional: Praktikumsnachweise, Zertifikate oder weitere Unterlagen, die zeigen, wer du bist

Bereit für deinen Start bei TUI? ️✈️

  • Bewirb dich online und schicke uns deine Unterlagen.
  • Zeig uns, was in dir steckt - mit einem kurzen Online-Test.
  • Lerne uns persönlich kennen und entdecke beim Assessment Center die Welt von TUI.
  • Willkommen an Bord! Wenn alles passt, erhältst du dein Vertragsangebot für den Start im August 2027 und deine Reise bei TUI kann beginnen.

Von einem Arbeitsplatz zu einem Ort, an dem man dazugehört. Bei TUI schätzen wir Vielfalt, Gleichberechtigung und Inklusion und ermutigen alle, so zu sein, wie sie sind. „Come as you are“ – das ist unsere Vision, denn nur durch Vielfalt ist unser Potenzial grenzenlos. Wir ermuntern Menschen mit Behinderung, sich zu bewerben.

job.job_description:
Job Title

Project Manager (Go-To-Market)

Purpose of the Role

Within Travel Distribution (TRD), the Product Marketing Management (PMM) unit brings together Market Intelligence, Portfolio Market Management, Go-To-Market (GTM), and Communications teams. PMM transforms market, industry, and customer insights into product strategy and lifecycle decisions, while driving successful product adoption through effective positioning, packaging, and promotion.

As part of the GTM Project Management team, you will support the execution of the GTM Projects Plan across global markets, managing product launches, enhancements, updates, and decommissioning initiatives for the Travel Sellers portfolio. You will ensure end-to-end market readiness by coordinating GTM activities across Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Legal, Delivery, Revenue Management, Customer Learning, and Customer Care teams. Working closely with regional and global stakeholders, you will contribute to project planning, foster cross-functional collaboration, and ensure effective communication between PMM and the APAC region.

Key Responsibilities

  • Project Management
  • Review and validate project requests, ensuring business inputs are complete and ready for initiation.
  • Assess and recommend whether to proceed with GTM project launches.
  • Lead project planning and execution following Amadeus’s methodologies and governance practices.
  • Manage key timelines, risks, deliverables, and interdependencies.
  • Coordinate execution across stakeholders and business functions.
  • Take actions to keep projects on track and ensure successful outcomes.
  • Provide regular updates on project progress, risks, and dependencies.
  • Proactively identify, assess, and communicate risks and issues.
  • Market Management & Communication
  • Develop a deep understanding of market-specific requirements, processes, and tools.
  • Keep up to date with business priorities, portfolio strategies, opportunities, and challenges.
  • Act as the main liaison for regional teams on GTM project activities and guidance.
  • Ensure timely and effective communication of project updates and decisions.
  • Promote understanding of the GTM Project Management team’s role, responsibilities, and services.
  • Develop effective working relationships with regional and global stakeholders.
  • Support clear and collaborative communication between PMM and APAC teams.
  • Continuous Improvement
  • Contribute to enhancing GTM processes, frameworks, and delivery methodologies.
  • Support initiatives that improve efficiency, effectiveness, and scalability.
  • Encourage collaboration and knowledge sharing across regional teams.
  • Promote shared practices, governance, and global collaboration.
  • Support actions that strengthen cross-regional engagement and operational excellence

Required Experience & Qualifications

  • Experience in Product Management, Product Deployment, Project Management, or related fields.
  • Experience delivering or contributing to complex cross-functional projects in regional or global contexts.
  • Understanding of business needs, market opportunities, and the impact of project decisions on outcomes.
  • Experience managing product lifecycle activities, including go-to-market planning, product launches, enhancements, and updates.
  • Excellent project management skills, including planning, coordination, risk management, and continuous improvement.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities, with capacity to manage various priorities in a dynamic environment.
  • Effective communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, with ability to work across diverse, global teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Product Management, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • This role requires valid and unrestricted work rights in Thailand.

Note: whilst this position is advertised with a Manager title for market alignment purposes, it is an Individual Contributor role and does not include direct people management responsibilities. The successful candidate's employment contract and internal designation will reflect the appropriate Individual Contributor title in accordance with the company's internal job architecture.

What we can offer you ?

🎯 A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you will be powering the future of travel and pursuing a critical mission and extraordinary purpose.

🌎 A truly global DNA - Everything at Amadeus is global, from our people to our business, which translates into our footprint, processes, and culture.

🎓 Great opportunities to learn - Learning happens all the time and in many ways at Amadeus, through on-the-job training, formal learning activities, and day-to-day interactions with colleagues.

job.job_description:
Company Description

Welcome to  Elysium Noosa Resort  an elegant retreat set in the heart of one of Australia’s most iconic coastal destinations.

Elysium Noosa has been thoughtfully reimagined across every guest touchpoint - from Cibaria Noosa and Bar Capri on Hastings Street to our rooms and suites. This transformation establishes a new benchmark for luxury hospitality on the Sunshine Coast.

Our team is dedicated to creating guest experiences that feel both effortless and deeply personal. Every interaction is guided by care, intuition, and attention to detail, delivering moments of delight that elevate each stay.

Job Description

We’re looking for an experienced, detail-driven finance professional to join our team as Assistant Director of Finance. Working closely with our Director of Finance, you’ll keep the Accounts Department running smoothly and make sure the financial and operational reports our leaders rely on are accurate, relevant and on time.

Key Responsibilities

Department leadership

  • Lead the Accounts Department day to day, managing the Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Payroll and Stores teams
  • Run bi-weekly Finance Office briefings and monthly Finance Department meetings
  • Build strong cross-training and succession planning, with enough knowledge of every finance role to train new team members

General ledger and month end

  • Prepare daily interface journals from the Property Management System, keeping the guest, deposit and accounts receivable ledgers in balance with the General Ledger
  • Approve accounts payable journals and creditor payment runs, and oversee the inventory-to-payables interface
  • Issue and manage the month-end timetable, preparing journals for wages, accruals, prepayments, stock movements and allocations
  • Complete monthly reconciliations for all balance sheet accounts and produce accounts to trial balance for the Director of Finance
  • Oversee debt collection and bad debt provisioning in line with Sovereign Operations guidelines
  • Manage travel agent and frequent flyer commission accruals and payments

Reporting, budgets and forecasts

  • Deliver accurate, timely reporting, including monthly operating statements, F&B outlet statements, capital expenditure reports, daily revenue reports and weekly wage analysis
  • Help prepare the annual budget and monthly departmental forecasts, and manage budget uploads into Sun and TM1
  • Assist with the owner’s half-yearly and year-end financial schedules
  • Help department heads understand hotel systems, financial results, budgets and forecasts

Payroll and payments

  • Oversee the timely payment of creditors, wages, commissions and tax, including foreign payments and internet banking
  • Audit weekly payroll and sign off master file changes, pay rate changes and new hires
  • Act as a Class “B” bank account signatory, signing together with a Class “A” signatory

Compliance and controls

  • Lodge statutory reports and returns accurately and on time, including BAS (GST), payroll tax, PAYG withholding, PPCA, workers’ compensation and ABS reporting
  • Make sure Elysium, Accor and Sovereign Operations policies are implemented and internal controls are working effectively
  • Maintain compliance with the Accor Internal Audit program and ensure all internal and external audit recommendations are actioned
  • Oversee compliance with GST, privacy, AML/CTF, superannuation, immigration, Queensland WorkCover and gaming regulatory requirements, including daily and monthly gaming cash reconciliations

Qualifications

  • A degree in Accounting, Finance or Commerce; CA or CPA qualified (or working towards it)
  • Experience in hotel or hospitality finance, ideally in a supervisory or assistant controller role
  • Strong knowledge of hotel accounting systems, reconciliations, month-end processes and internal controls
  • Experience with budgeting, forecasting and management reporting
  • The ability to explain financial information clearly to non-finance managers
  • A sharp eye for detail and the confidence to question numbers that don’t look right
  • Experience with Accor policies or audit programs is highly regarded

Additional Information

  • Hands-on experience across the full hotel finance function, from payroll and compliance to budgets and owner reporting
  • Accor ALL Heartist benefits, including discounted room rates at Accor hotels worldwide
  • Discounts on food and beverage at participating Accor hotels and restaurants
  • Discounted rates for family and friends at Accor hotels

job.job_description:
About The Role

It's a great time to join us at Airlines Reporting Corporation (ARC)! ARC accelerates the growth of global air travel by delivering forward-looking travel data, flexible distribution services and other innovative industry solutions. We are a leading travel intelligence company with the world’s largest, most comprehensive global airline ticket dataset, including more than 15 billion passenger flights. By working here, you can contribute to solutions and expertise that strengthen economies and enrich lives. We think big, embrace challenges and explore new ideas to lead the way for the travel industry.

ARC is looking for a talented Data & Insights Analyst IIto join our team! In this role, you will independently own standard analysis, dashboards, recurring reporting, and sales operations support. You will support variety of teams including ARC Pay, Revenue Integrity, Customer Engagement (CE), People & Culture, and the Executive Team. The Data & Insights Analyst II will translate business questions into analytical approaches, synthesize findings, and improve recurring metrics and reporting processes. You'll be expected to provide dependable analysis and interpretation to business partners, expand functional and domain knowledge across ARC’s products and teams. You will maintain integrity of customer relationship management tool (CRM) and sales opportunity data; coordinate with business technology departments to enhance CRM.

What You'll Get To Do

  • Own standard analysis end to end, including requirements gathering, data extraction, validation, dashboard/report development, synthesis of findings, and stakeholder follow-up.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to implement CRM solutions to meet the needs of the CE Team and enterprise.
  • Build and improve recurring dashboards, key performance indicator reporting, and standardized analyses that help stakeholders monitor performance and identify trends or issues. Routinely present results.
  • Coordinate with Marketing and Product teams on CRM contact information, sales tracking, order processing, contracting and customer support. Resolve customer billing issues with Financial Services.

You'll Bring These Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in business, analytics, economics, statistics, information systems, data science, finance, or related field
  • 2-4 years’ experience
  • Working to strong proficiency in SQL, Snowflake, Tableau, and Excel
  • Ability to own routine analysis, dashboarding, and reporting end to end
  • Strong quality assurance mindset and comfort improving metric logic and reporting processes
  • CRM admin skills required; Salesforce Certified Administrator preferred
  • Knowledge of airline or travel agency industries preferred

What We Can Offer You

  • Joining ARC means joining a team that is motivated, diverse, creative, collaborative and solutions-oriented. We think big, embrace challenges, and explore new ideas to lead the way for the travel industry.
  • Our employees value the hands-on learning and professional development opportunities that allow them to expand their skills and grow their career in new, dynamic ways.
  • ARC offers WorkFlex. WorkFlex is ARC’s hybrid work program which offers eligible employees the flexibility to work from home while also requiring in office workdays throughout the year to foster collaboration and connection throughout the organization. We’ve designed WorkFlex to enable employees to succeed and thrive while maintaining strong connections to one another and ARC - both of which are critical to our shared success.
  • We offer a highly competitive, comprehensive benefits package so you can worry less and focus on what truly matters. Please click here to review our benefits on our company website.
  • By joining ARC, you will partner with top minds in the industry as we use data and technology to innovate how the world travels.

The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, allowing for meaningful future salary growth within the position.

EOE M/F/D/V Females and Minorities Encouraged to Apply

job.job_description:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Commercial Activation & Performance Manager is responsible for identifying revenue performance opportunities, driving commercial activation strategies, and supporting hotels in improving market share, demand generation, and overall revenue performance. This role partners closely with Senior Regional Directors (SRDs), Area Directors, hotel teams, and Commercial Centers of Excellence to develop and execute initiatives that enhance commercial effectiveness across the portfolio.

The Commercial Activation & Performance Manager serves as a strategic advisor to hotels by leveraging performance analytics, commercial planning, revenue optimization strategies, enterprise programs, and cross-functional resources to deliver sustainable business growth. The role is responsible for translating performance insights into actionable plans, coordinating commercial support across the organization, and ensuring initiatives are effectively activated, measured, and sustained.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Revenue Performance Opportunity Identification

  • Identify hotels with the greatest opportunities to improve revenue performance, market share, and demand generation.
  • Analyze hotel-level performance trends, risks, and performance gaps to uncover growth opportunities and potential concerns.
  • Develop actionable insights and recommendations for Senior Regional Directors (SRDs) to support portfolio prioritization, resource deployment, and strategic decision-making.
  • Communicate emerging commercial trends, risks, and opportunity areas to Segment Commercial Leadership to support broader business initiatives.
  • Monitor portfolio performance and provide recommendations to improve overall commercial effectiveness.
  • Synthesize performance data into clear opportunity assessments, business cases, and recommendations for field leaders, hotel teams, and senior leadership.

Property-Level Commercial Planning

Non-ROCS Hotels

  • Partner directly with hotel ownership and management teams to develop practical commercial plans focused on:
    • Pricing strategy
    • Demand generation
    • Business mix optimization
    • Revenue growth opportunities
  • Provide guidance on promotional strategies, pricing decisions, and revenue recovery opportunities during periods of need.
  • Own, maintain, and continuously improve the commercial planning framework used across the portfolio.
  • Evaluate channel performance and recommend actions to improve revenue production and profitability.
  • Support hotels in strengthening direct booking performance and optimizing distribution strategies.
  • Identify market events, local demand drivers, and other opportunities to increase demand and market share.

Portfolio Prioritization & Action Planning

  • Collaborate with Area Directors and Senior Regional Directors to identify and implement hotel-specific commercial growth strategies.
  • Develop action plans and recommendations for underperforming hotels to improve commercial performance.
  • Assist hotels in evaluating negotiated account production and identifying opportunities to grow profitable business.
  • Connect hotels with enterprise programs, tools, resources, and subject matter experts that support commercial success.
  • Measure the effectiveness of implemented recommendations and ensure actions result in sustainable performance improvements.
  • Develop and manage commercial activation plans, tracking implementation progress, key milestones, and business outcomes.

Commercial Activation, Cross-Functional Alignment & Enablement

  • Partner with Revenue Management, Global Sales, Marketing, Loyalty, Distribution, Digital Commerce, Reservation Services, and other Commercial Centers of Excellence to align resources, strategies, and support needed to improve hotel performance.
  • Ensure hotels are aware of and effectively utilizing available enterprise programs, tools, and commercial resources.
  • Drive awareness, adoption, and utilization of enterprise revenue-generating programs and initiatives, including:
    • Easy Bid
    • DirectPay
    • Choice Business Direct
    • Future commercial activation programs
  • Develop and maintain scalable playbooks, best practices, tools, and resources that hotels can independently implement to improve commercial performance.
  • Serve as a liaison between hotels and corporate commercial teams to ensure opportunities, barriers, and support needs are clearly communicated and addressed.
  • Partner with commercial and operational stakeholders to improve execution of strategic revenue initiatives.
  • Drive engagement and accountability around commercial performance initiatives that improve hotel competitiveness and revenue growth.
  • Support ROCS Program Revenue Managers by providing supplemental coverage, transition support, and project assistance as business needs require.

Project Management, Performance Measurement & Strategic Initiatives

  • Lead the development, execution, and monitoring of commercial activation projects and strategic performance initiatives.
  • Maintain project plans, action trackers, and stakeholder communications to ensure timely execution and accountability.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness and return on investment of commercial initiatives using performance metrics, adoption rates, and revenue outcomes.
  • Identify and present critical areas of commercial opportunity, performance risk, and growth potential to field leadership and key stakeholders.
  • Support the deployment of new commercial strategies, tools, programs, and enterprise initiatives as business needs evolve.
  • Recommend process improvements that strengthen the connection between operational execution and commercial performance outcomes.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Hospitality, Business, Marketing, Revenue Management, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in hotel revenue management, commercial strategy, sales, marketing, operations, franchise support, or related disciplines.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable recommendations.
  • Working knowledge of hotel revenue management principles, distribution channels, demand generation strategies, and commercial performance drivers.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence outcomes and drive action without direct authority.
  • Excellent project management, organizational, and prioritization skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across multiple stakeholder groups, including owners, operators, field teams, and corporate partners.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, manage competing priorities, and maintain a strategic mindset.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and consultative skills.
  • Ability to travel as business needs require.

COMPENSATION & SALARY RANGE:

Salary Range: $114,907-$135,184 annually

This role is also eligible for an annual bonus under Choice’s Management Incentive Plan (MIP).

Pay ranges listed are what Choice Hotels reasonably expects to pay. Actual pay may be higher or lower and ranges may be adjusted in the future. Pay positioning within the range is influenced by factors including—but not limited to—education, experience, skills, certifications, performance, geographic location, business needs, seniority, and travel requirements.

Choice prioritizes our associate wellbeing by offering a comprehensive benefits program that is both competitive and flexible to help you achieve your wellbeing goals - here are just a few:

  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Leave and paid time-off for holidays, vacation, personal, family, volunteer, sick, jury duty, bereavement, military, and religious observance
  • Financial benefits for retirement and health savings
  • Employee recognition programs
  • Discounts at Choice hotels worldwide

About Choice

Choice Hotels International, Inc. (NYSE: CHH), is one of the largest lodging franchisors in the world. With 7,500 hotels in 45+ countries and territories, we offer a range of high-quality lodging options in the upper upscale, upper midscale, midscale, extended stay, and economy segments. We’re the hotel company for those who choose to bet on themselves — the striver, the dreamer, the entrepreneur — because that’s who we are, too.

At Choice, we are united by the simple belief that tomorrow will be even better than today — for associates, our company, and our franchisees. At our worldwide corporate headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, at our technology center in Scottsdale, Arizona, and through our associates around the globe, every voice is heard and every idea is listened to, no matter what area of the company they come from. We are united in supporting the entrepreneurial dreams of our thousands of franchise owners, which propels us forward — giving our work at Choice a purpose larger than our business.

Our corporate office locations:

North Bethesda, MD — Located at Pike & Rose, our worldwide headquarters is less than 15 miles from Washington, D.C., one block away from the North Bethesda Metro station, with easy access to I-495, complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Scottsdale, AZ — Located at the northwest corner of Loop 101, the Scottsdale office is home to our technology, eCommerce and customer service organizations, with easy access to complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Minneapolis, MN — Select roles are based in our Minneapolis office on Highway 394, near the intersection with Highway 100, only five minutes from downtown.

Field/Remote — Select roles designated as field/remote will require associates to work from a home office, connecting virtually with Choice team members and leadership on Zoom, with possible required travel depending on the role.

Choice’s Cultural Values

Welcome and Respect Everyone | Be Bold | Be Quick | Listen | Be Curious | Show Integrity

Choice’s Leadership Principles

Act with Intention | Lead with Authenticity | Grow & Deliver

Key Job Responsibilities and Duties:

  • Build and execute a market intelligence- and data-driven commercial strategy to deliver results for strategic accounts and new partner acquisition.
  • Lead, coach, and inspire a high-performing team, overseeing talent development and driving stretching account strategies.
  • Ensure proper internal and external operating models are in place to meet compliance, ethics, and performance standards.
  • Oversee commercial trading reporting to Senior Management and drive high-impact actions to improve overall portfolio performance.

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Product Manager III, Intent Understanding & Refinement

Introduction to the Team

The Product Team creates high-quality end-to-end experiences for travelers, partners, and Expedia Group. Our focus on customer-centric innovation enables us to develop products that build loyalty and repeat business. We partner closely with teams across Expedia Group to drive growth and achieve results for our customers and the company.

Make an impact!

We are looking for a Product Manager III to lead intent understanding and refinement across Expedia Group’s Search and Recommendations experiences.

Travelers often express their needs indirectly: a destination may imply a trip purpose, a collection of words may signal a preference, and an evolving session may reveal intent that was not present in the initial query. This role will help our products understand those signals, refine them into useful traveler context, and translate that understanding into better search and recommendation experiences.

You will define the product strategy, operating model, and roadmap for capabilities that connect traveler intent to relevant results, recommendations, and next-best experiences. You will work across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Design, Research, and business stakeholders to make intent understanding a consistent, measurable capability across the shopping journey.

In This Role, You Will

  • Establish a clear framework for representing traveler intent, including explicit queries, inferred preferences, trip context, constraints, and changes in intent throughout a session.
  • Identify opportunities to improve how intent is captured, interpreted, disambiguated, refined, and passed to downstream experiences.
  • Translate ambiguous traveler problems into crisp product requirements, measurable outcomes, and sequenced roadmaps.
  • Partner with Data Science and Machine Learning teams on model objectives, feature priorities, evaluation frameworks, feedback loops, and responsible use of personalization signals.
  • Work with Engineering and platform teams to define scalable interfaces, data contracts, instrumentation, and self-service capabilities that can support multiple brands, markets, and traveler journeys.
  • Own and identify opportunities to improve filters categories/labels/models.
  • Balance traveler value, business impact, technical feasibility, operational complexity, and trust when making prioritization decisions.
  • Develop a shared taxonomy and language for intent signals and filters so that teams can align on definitions, ownership, quality, and measurement.
  • Establish success metrics and guardrails, such as relevance, engagement, progression, conversion, satisfaction, latency, coverage, and fairness.
  • Use qualitative and quantitative research, experimentation, behavioral data, and operational feedback to identify gaps and validate solutions.
  • Create alignment across a complex stakeholder environment and communicate product direction clearly to senior leaders and delivery teams.
  • Help shape the longer-term evolution of Search and Recommendations into more adaptive, context-aware, and traveler-centered experiences.

Experience And Qualifications

Minimum qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field; or equivalent related professional experience
  • 5 or more years of product management experience, including ownership of a platform or capability that other teams built on top of
  • Demonstrated experience taking products from concept to scaled adoption
  • Data fluency, including proficiency with experimentation tooling and the data analysis used to design and evaluate tests
  • Experience with machine learning backed products such as ranking or recommendation systems

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools or workflows, and with applying machine learning concepts to real world products
  • Experience with configurable or low-code platforms where internal teams are your customer alongside the traveler
  • Experience trading organic relevance against paid or promoted placement, or a comparable commercial tension

Location expectations

This role is based in Seattle, Washington only.

The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $137,500.00 to $192,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $220,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Benefits And Perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life.

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

job.job_description:
Overview

Du hast Lust während deines Studiums viele praktische Erfahrung zu sammeln, wichtige Kompetenzen zu erlernen und nützliche Kontakte zu knüpfen, die deiner Karriere weiterhelfen? Dann bist du bei Enterprise genau richtig!

Als weltgrößter Mobilitätsdienstleister triffst du bei Enterprise auf ein wachsendes internationales Unternehmen mit spannenden Herausforderungen und ungeahnten Aufstiegschancen. Stell dir über 1,7 Millionen Fahrzeuge an 9.500 globalen Standorten mit 80.000 Mitarbeitenden vor, die einen Jahresumsatz von 22,5 Milliarden US-Dollar einfahren. Dann hast du einen ersten Eindruck von uns!

Responsibilities

Dein Praktikum wirst du in einer unserer 200 deutschlandweit Teams absolvieren und so unser Unternehmen von der Pike auf kennenlernen. Kaffeekochen und Kopieren steht für unsere Praktikanten nicht auf dem Programm: Vom ersten Arbeitstag an wirst du ins Tagesgeschäft mit einbezogen und erlernst so neue Kenntnisse wie Führungsqualitäten, Flexibilität und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten "on the job". Dabei erwarten dich abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben und spannende Herausforderungen im Kundenservice, im Vertrieb, im Marketing oder im Business-Management. So zum Beispiel:

  • Verkaufsgespräche zu führen
  • Geschäftspartnerschaften aufzubauen und zu pflegen
  • Effektiv mit Kunden, Lieferanten und Kollegen zu kommunizieren und zu interagieren
  • Kostenkontrolle
  • Strategien zur Konfliktlösung
  • Flottenplanung

Bei Enterprise ist kein Tag wie der andere!

Und das Beste: Wenn du dich nach deinem Hochschulabschluss entscheidest, an unserem Management Trainee Programm teilzunehmen, dann werden dir die bereits im Praktikum erworbenen Kenntnisse angerechnet. Das verkürzt deine Zeit als Trainee und einer steilen Karriere bei Enterprise steht nichts mehr im Wege. Selbst wenn du dich nach dem Studium entscheidest, woanders zu arbeiten, so hast du doch durch dein Praktikum bei uns eine erstklassige Berufserfahrung vorzuweisen, die nicht nur auf deinem Lebenslauf gut aussieht, sondern dir in Jobinterviews und in deiner weiteren Karriere helfen wird. Ein Praktikum im Management bei Enterprise lohnt sich also wirklich! Und das auch im wörtlichen Sinne, denn alle unsere Praktika werden vergütet.

Qualifications

Unsere Praktika sind um dich herum konzipiert. Es spielt für uns keine Rolle, in welchem Semester du bist, welchen Studiengang du studierst oder wann du bei uns anfangen willst. Wie lange willst du dein Praktikum bei uns absolvieren? Das hängt ganz von dir ab. Du hast die Wahl zwischen mehrmonatigen Sommerpraktika bis hin zu ganzjährigen Praktika, die du jederzeit beginnen kannst. Und bei der großen Auswahl an unseren Filialen in Deutschland haben wir mit Sicherheit auch einen freien Praktikumsplatz an deinem Wunschort.

Wir freuen uns, wenn du motiviert bist, Eigeninitiative zeigst und Verantwortung übernehmen willst. Alles andere bringen wir dir während deines Praktikums bei. Und es werden sich für dich viele interessante Möglichkeiten und Situationen ergeben, in denen du richtig loslegen und uns zeigen kannst, was in dir steckt – egal wie lange du bei uns bleibst.

Auch Solltest Du In Deinem Gepäck Haben

  • Eine unbegrenzte Arbeitserlaubnis in Deutschland.
  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
  • Einen gültigen deutschen Führerschein und 1 Jahr lang Fahrpraxis.
  • Höchstens 3 Punkt im Fahreignungsregister (FAER) in Flensburg und keine Vermerke in deiner Fahrerakte aus den letzten 5 Jahren aufgrund von Alkohol- oder Drogendelikten.
  • Solltest du aufgrund einer körperlichen Einschränkung nicht Auto fahren können, bewirb dich bitte trotzdem. Gemeinsam werden wir eine Lösung finden.

Bitte bewirb dich nur einmal, und zwar direkt auf die Stelle in der Region, in der du arbeiten möchtest. Bei deinem ersten Gespräch mit unserem Recruiter kannst du aber gerne die möglichen Einsatzgebiete noch im Detail besprechen.

As Purchasing Manager, I will fully comprehend the vision of Six Senses to help people reconnect with themselves, others and the world around them and our values of local sensitivity and global sensibility, crafted experiences, emotional hospitality, responsible and caring, fun and quirky and pioneering wellness.

Sustainability, Wellness and Out of the Ordinary experiences are at the core of everything we do at Six Senses. I will safeguard these pillars and their strategic planning and development, ensuring all activities, initiatives and practices are activated and embraced within the hotel.

Duties And Responsibilities

As Purchasing Manager, I will assume full responsibility for the efficient operation of the Purchasing function to provide exceptional product within brand operating standards across the preparation and processing of requisitions and purchase orders for supplies and equipment, storage and stock takes.

The duties and responsibilities will include:

  • Source and purchase the most suitable products for the operation that are relevant and in line with Six Senses policies plus wellness and sustainability practices
  • Regularly review suppliers and contracts to ensure conformity with Six Senses requirements.
  • Vendor and market assessment, ordering, stocktakes and storage will be undertaken at the required times to ensure all stock is on hand, is of the right quality and properly stored in line with Six Senses standards.
  • Instill a fair and transparent Vendor/Supplier Vetting process and hold vendors/suppliers to Six Senses Sustainability and Eat With Six Senses guidelines.

Qualifications

To execute the position of Purchasing Manager, I must have the required qualifications, technical skills and experience in a similar role in luxury hotels with proven results and includes the following:

  • Possess a minimum of a Bachelor’s degree in Materials or Purchasing Management, or a relevant field of work and three years purchasing experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. More than three years’ experience in a similar role, preferred.

The above is intended to provide an overview of the role and responsibilities for a Purchasing Manager at Six Senses Tel Aviv. It is not and does not infer that the above is an inclusive and/or exhaustive list of the duties and responsibilities inherent in the position.

job.job_description:

KAYAK is looking for a NetSuite / Salesforce / FloQast Administrator to join our Enterprise Applications team within Finance. You'll be the day-to-day owner of configuration, user administration, and integration health across our core finance and revenue systems — the person who actually knows why a saved search broke, why a workflow stalled, or why a sync between NetSuite and Salesforce didn't fire. This role rewards curiosity and precision: you don't need to arrive as a NetSuite expert, but you do need to want to become one, and you need to be the kind of person who double-checks a config change before it touches production. You'll work closely with Finance, Accounting, Sales Ops, and Engineering, and partner with senior systems analysts and architects on the bigger roadmap items — but the daily craft of keeping these systems accurate, well-documented, and running smoothly is yours.

This role will be required to work from our Concord, MA or Cambridge, MA office at least 3 days per week.

In This Role, You Will

  • Administer day-to-day configuration of NetSuite, Salesforce, FloQast and Blackline: user setup/deactivation, roles and permissions, saved searches, SuiteAnalytics workbooks/dashboards, Salesforce flows and validation rules, troubleshooting issues within Salesforce.
  • Serve as backup administrator for Expensify, supporting user provisioning, system configuration, synchronization issues, and end-user troubleshooting
  • Build and maintain NetSuite SuiteFlow workflows and troubleshoot existing SuiteScript customizations — you don't need to write scripts from scratch on day one, but you should be comfortable reading one, tracing what it does, and knowing when to escalate to a developer.
  • Triage and resolve support tickets from Finance and general employees related to expense reports, financial records, and account access, digging into root cause rather than just closing the ticket.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot integrations between NetSuite and Salesforce — including iPaaS/middleware tools and direct API/SFTP data feeds — escalating to engineering when needed.
  • Support month-end and quarter-end close by ensuring system data accuracy, running reports, and resolving reconciliation discrepancies.
  • Support the month-end close by managing file-based data transfers to the external reporting platform, validating successful loads, and troubleshooting exceptions with the Reporting team
  • Perform sandbox testing and validate NetSuite's release upgrades against existing customizations and integrations before anything touches production.
  • Maintain user access lists and perform basic access reviews to support audit, SOX, and compliance needs.
  • Create and maintain clear documentation, quick-reference guides, and training materials — you take pride in writing something a new teammate could actually follow without asking you a follow-up question.
  • Partner with senior systems analysts/architects to implement approved process changes and provide hands-on support during testing and hypercare for larger rollouts, without owning roadmap prioritization.

Please Apply If You Have

  • 2-4 years of hands-on administration experience with NetSuite, Salesforce, and/or Expensify (or similar ERP/CRM/expense platforms) — OR strong ERP/CRM administration fundamentals elsewhere plus genuine enthusiasm for going deep on NetSuite specifically. We'd rather hire for curiosity and a learning mindset than a perfect checklist of prior tools.
  • Familiarity with (or eagerness to quickly learn) NetSuite's configuration layer: saved searches, SuiteFlow, roles/permissions, custom fields and records, and at least reading-level comfort with SuiteScript.
  • Working knowledge of basic system integrations (API/SFTP, or iPaaS tools like Celigo/Workato/Boomi) and comfort troubleshooting data sync issues.
  • Real attention to detail — the kind that notices a saved search is returning one extra row before it becomes a finance reporting problem.
  • Solid Excel/Google Sheets skills; comfort building reports and saved searches.
  • Clear communicator who can support non-technical end users and explain system issues in plain language.
  • Familiarity with basic finance/accounting workflows (AP, expense management, order-to-cash) is a plus but not required.
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience; NetSuite/Salesforce admin certifications (e.g. NetSuite SuiteFoundation, Salesforce Administrator) are a plus and a good signal of the self-directed learning this role rewards.

Benefits And Perks

  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year.
  • Company-wide week off a year – the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)
  • No meeting Fridays
  • Paid parental leave
  • Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday
  • Paid volunteer time
  • Focus on your career growth:
  • Development Dollars
  • Leadership development
  • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings
  • Travel Discounts
  • Employee Resource Groups
  • Competitive retirement and health plans
  • Free lunch 2 days per week
  • Focus on mental health and well-being:
  • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
  • Company-paid subscription to HeadSpace

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. The range for this Massachusetts-based role is $85,000-$100,000.

We offer a competitive base salary and benefits including: health benefits; flexible spending account; retirement benefits; life insurance; paid time off (including PTO, paid sick leave, medical leave, bereavement leave, floating holidays and paid holidays); and parental leave benefits. This role is eligible to be considered for an annual bonus.

Inclusion

At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That's why we're focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here.

Need any adjustments for the interview, application or on the job? No problem – just give us a heads-up. We've got you.

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Team mission

By combining data fluency with storytelling and emotion, we partner closely with Marketing, Brand, Data, and Product to ensure every post-click touchpoint delivers early signals of value, matches customer intent, and earns lasting trust.

Leading user experience for the Channel Landing Pages group, this role shapes the strategic direction for how travelers explore, decide, and book. Partnering with Product and Engineering, you will drive systemic UX innovation that turns high-intent traffic into repeat customers and long-term business growth.

Your mission

  • Lead and grow a team of three product designers along with a dotted line content designer and UX researcher delivering the Landing Pages across a portfolio of page types and intents
  • Co-lead the Channel Landing Pages group alongside Product and Engineering counterparts, driving its operating rhythm, shared roadmap, and cross-functional alignment
  • Partner with brand and channel marketing leads to translate campaign intent into coherent, high-converting post-click journeys across web and app
  • Set and uphold a high bar for UI/visual design craft across the portfolio, through design reviews and hands-on guidance

Your toolkit

  • Strong personal craft in UI/visual design and ability to teach and raise the bar across the team in this area

What It Takes to Make the Stay

The Voyage Global Leadership Development Program

Voyage: Training tomorrow’s leaders today

Marriott International welcomes recent university graduates to experience the career development adventure of a lifetime and a world of leadership opportunities. About The Journey

Voyage is an elite, award-winning program that provides a combination of hands-on, discipline-specific training and a leadership-focused curriculum. The program takes place at a Marriott International managed hotel, not a classroom, and is offered in 50+ countries. Voyage is available in the following disciplines:

  • Event Planning

When you join Voyage, you gain access to Marriott’s senior leaders and coaches and have many opportunities to stand out. You’ll participate in mini-rotations across the disciplines to learn firsthand how to manage various hotel functions and to connect with current and former Voyage participants through our social collaboration tools. Voyage is a 18 months full-time program. You’ll immediately be immersed in our rich culture and portfolio of global brands to learn how Marriott sets the standard of industry excellence.

The Experience You’ll Gain

Voyage participants learn by doing! You’ll be fully immersed in the day-to-day operations of a hotel. If accepted into this elite program, you will:

You will also have an opportunity to provide feedback on your curriculum and have an impact on future Voyage hires’ experiences. After graduation, you’ll be well-prepared to pursue your passion and take on new challenges. Many program graduates are ready to step into a Marriott supervisory or entry-level management role right away, because the program has provided a foundation for future leadership.

Ready to embark?

Development Manager (Full-stack)

This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in-office.

Our Technology team is the backbone of our company: constantly creating, testing, learning and iterating to better meet the needs of our customers. If you thrive in a fast-paced, ideas-led environment, you’re in the right place.

Why This Job’s a Big Deal

As one of the leaders, you’ll have a big impact on our products, their technical direction as well as influence the company's technical strategy. We value ownership and accountability while building our products to be the best travel deal makers in the world for millions of our customers. We need an innovator that will solve complex technical problems, drive new product initiatives and changes in a highly engaged collaborative environment.

In This Role You Will Get To

  • Provide constructive feedback and influence the performance and career development of high performing engineers.
  • Full ownership of the Full Stack of our products, contribute and collaborate with peers on cross team initiatives.
  • Continuous collaboration with stakeholders across multiple departments and teams to understand their business and product strategies and translate those into strategic technical plans.
  • Decide with senior management in developing long-term technology road maps and execution of existing initiatives.
  • Lead multiple projects - including planning, prioritization, and task delegation.
  • Enforce accountability for the quality of software that is created.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or a related field or equivalent practical experience.
  • Proven leader in hiring, mentoring, coaching and developing engineering talent, including performance management.
  • Expert knowledge of Java, Springboot, Python, JavaScript, API, Webservices, GKE, developing ML models and its best practices. Knowledge with React.js, TypeScript, Node.js, GraphQL.
  • A crafty problem solver to knock in a fast paced environment who works to find win-win solutions. You knock down barriers.
  • Ability to drive the development of high scale systems and system integrations.
  • Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust.
  • The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics is essential.

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. In addition to a competitive base salary, certain roles may be eligible for an annual bonus and/or equity grant.

The salary range for this position is $160,000-$200,000 USD.

Who We Are

WE ARE PRICELINE.

Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.

Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.

We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.

Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.

If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!

Flexible work at Priceline

Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.

Perks & Benefits At Priceline

Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:

Health & wellness coverage including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources

Generous time off including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days

Work/life support including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)

Financial security programs such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts

Signature travel perks including employee-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits

Additional perks & discounts like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits

A people-first culture with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together

Specific benefits and programs vary by location.

Inclusion is a Big Deal!

To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.

Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.

job.job_description:
• Join our Group Technology team and transform how Qantas Engineering works through technology and data
  • Lead emerging products from discovery and proof of value through to secure, scalable production services
  • Permanent opportunity based at our Head Office in Mascot


At Qantas, we represent Australia to the world. Our strength comes from our people, their different experiences and perspectives, and a shared commitment to safety, performance and delivering for our customers.


Technology plays a critical role in helping us operate safely, efficiently and reliably. As the Technical Product Owner, Engineering Digital and Data Products, you will lead a portfolio of existing, emerging and data-driven products supporting Qantas Engineering. This includes workforce mobility, maintenance optimisation, the Engineering data platform and related digital solutions.

Working closely with Engineering leaders, frontline teams, technology specialists and external partners, you will identify where technology can improve aircraft availability, maintenance productivity, safety and cost. You will help take opportunities from discovery and proof of value through to scaled, supportable production services.


This is an opportunity to deliver practical innovation with measurable operational impact. You will build the trusted data foundations needed for analytics, optimisation and future AI and machine-learning use cases, while ensuring products are secure, resilient and integrated effectively with the wider maintenance technology landscape.


What You’ll Bring To The Role

You are an experienced technology product leader who can turn emerging ideas into secure, scalable products that deliver measurable operational value. You will bring:

  • Extensive experience in technology product ownership or product management including manufacturer supplied and in house developed products
  • Demonstrated success taking products from discovery and proof of concept through to supported production services, with evidence of measurable business or operational outcomes.
  • Proven vendor-management experience across specialist partners, aircraft manufacturers or enterprise vendors.
  • Experience developing data platforms or data products that support reporting, analytics, optimisation and future AI or machine-learning use cases.
  • Exposure to operational technologies such as mobile devices, IoT, RFID, predictive maintenance or optimisation, ideally within aviation, rail, defence, manufacturing or utilities.
  • Strong capability in business-case development, benefits realisation, budget management and total-cost-of-ownership governance.
  • The ability to embed safety, cyber security, privacy, regulatory compliance, data governance and operational resilience throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Strong stakeholder, change and people leadership skills, with the ability to influence multidisciplinary teams and drive frontline adoption.
  • A degree in information technology, engineering, data or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience in aviation maintenance or maintenance, repair and overhaul environments will be highly regarded. Familiarity with aircraft health-monitoring data, maintenance and engineering systems and optimisation would also be advantageous.


Why Qantas?

If you’re successful in your application, you’ll join a team where creativity and passion are encouraged. Our people come together to allow us to dream big and deliver successfully.

There are many different opportunities across our team, which means you’ll be able to grow both personally and professionally at Qantas. Your development is a priority for us – so that you can maintain the high standards our customers have come to expect and can continue to develop over time. You’ll be supported from day 1 with on the job training and coaching as well as our formal training opportunities. While you may start in this role, we’ve got a great track record of supporting our people to take their career in so many different directions, the destinations are endless.


The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.

  • We love to travel: Enjoy discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave and additional purchased leave options.
  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging for everything from motor vehicles to electronic devices.
  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether its learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.


Qantas is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity and inclusion. By coming to work for us, you’ll be part of an organisation that encourages diversity, supports charities and environmental initiatives. We encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, and people of all backgrounds to apply. If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at time of application. Your personal information will be kept confidential in compliance with relevant privacy legislation.

job.job_description:
MANAGER .

REPORTS TO

Social Content Director

LOCATION

Remote

CLASSIFICATION

Exempt, full-time

EMPLOYER

Odyssey Studios Group LLC

THE ROLE

The Social Content Manager owns the day-to-day social programs for assigned client accounts — and shoots them. This is a hands-on role that runs strategy through execution: building the calendar, traveling to destinations to capture original photo and vertical video, editing and publishing, managing the community, and reporting on what worked. It suits someone who can hold a client conversation in the morning and be shooting on location that afternoon, and who knows the difference between content that should ship quickly while a moment is live and content that deserves to be finished properly. The role reports to the Social Content Director and works closely with Creative, Production, Paid Media, and Account teams.

Who We’re Looking For

  • Social practitioner who is equally comfortable building a strategy and operating a camera
  • Confident solo operator in the field, able to work quickly and unobtrusively in public places
  • Editor with range — fast mobile cuts when speed matters, finished work in Premiere when craft matters
  • Strong editorial instincts about what is worth capturing and what is worth publishing
  • Organized enough to run several accounts, calendars, and shoot schedules without dropping threads
  • Clear communicator who can present work and results to clients and take feedback well

What You’ll Own

  • Own day-to-day social strategy and execution for assigned client accounts
  • Build and maintain content calendars tied to client goals, campaigns, and destination seasonality
  • Capture original photo and vertical video on location, traveling to client destinations
  • Edit and finish content across the full range of speeds — from quick mobile cuts published while still on location, to finished pieces cut in Premiere
  • Publish and schedule across platforms using Odyssey’s publishing stack
  • Manage community engagement day to day — responding, moderating, and escalating per practice standards
  • Monitor performance and deliver recurring reporting with insight and clear recommendations
  • Flag high-performing organic content to the Director and Paid Media for amplification
  • Brief and coordinate creators on assigned accounts, collect deliverables, and track usage rights and disclosure compliance
  • Collect talent releases and location permissions in the field, and keep assets organized and correctly tagged
  • Use AI-assisted tools within the standards and disclosure practices set by the Director
  • Partner with Creative, Production, Paid Media, and Account teams on integrated campaigns
  • Present work, results, and recommendations directly to clients
  • Track platform changes, formats, and trends, and recommend tests worth running
  • Support new business with account audits, content samples, and proposal input

What You Bring

  • 4+ years in social media, content production, or a combination of the two
  • A portfolio of vertical video and social content you personally shot and cut
  • Working camera skills — phone-first capture, framing, natural light, and usable audio in the field
  • Editing fluency in both mobile tools and Adobe Premiere Pro; Photoshop, Lightroom, or After Effects a plus
  • Judgment about when speed serves the work and when it does not
  • Ability to read platform analytics and turn them into recommendations, not just recaps
  • Working knowledge of content usage rights, talent releases, FTC disclosure, and music licensing on brand accounts
  • Deep familiarity with Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, Pinterest, and LinkedIn
  • Experience with publishing, listening, and analytics tools — Publer, Brand24 or Mention, Meta Business Suite, TikTok Analytics, YouTube Studio, or similar — and comfort learning proprietary internal tooling
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to travel, including occasional weekends and irregular hours around shoots and events
  • Experience in tourism, hospitality, destination marketing, media, or content preferred
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, Media, or a related field preferred

How We Work

This is a remote position with significant field work. Travel to client destinations for production is estimated at 20%+ annually and includes occasional weekends, early mornings, and evenings around shoots and events. On-location work involves carrying camera and audio equipment of approximately 25–30 pounds, extended periods standing and walking, and working outdoors in heat, sun, rain, and marine environments. Remaining work is performed at a computer.

Our Commitment To Culture

At Odyssey Studios Group and Miles Partnership , we are driven by our commitment to actively evolve inclusive marketing industry practices, drive innovation within the company and empower our team, our clients and the communities we serve. We will make intentional actions to build a work culture where our team members are always heard, empowered and valued. We will provide a culture of service where we enable our teams and clients to meaningfully engage with their communities, share and tell their stories through travel, and lead a movement across the broader tourism industry to influence social change and ensure open access to travel for all.

Odyssey Studios Group and Miles Partnership, LLLP are equal employment opportunity employers.

As a publicly listed company on the Australian Securities Exchanges (ASX: CTD), CTM conducts its business in accordance with stringent corporate governance requirements and with complete transparency of financial performance and viability which, in turn, provides our customers, employees, partners and shareholders with maximum confidence in their partnership with CTM. More information on CTM’s Corporate Governance and financial performance can be found at https://investor.travelctm.com.au/
