If you’re looking for the next stamp in your career passport, we’re looking for Sales Travel Consultants across the Moreton Bay Region who are keen to dazzle, discover, and delight our customers at the following Flight Centre stores:

  • Samford

Are you ready to turn your love of travel into a career that takes you further than you ever imagined, both personally and professionally? Your Flight Centre journey is uniquely yours - and we’re here to champion it, celebrate it, and help it take flight. As a Flightie you’re not just building a career - you’re shaping a life filled with purpose, connection, and discovery. Navigate your career. Explore the world.

What you’ll be doing - where your passion will meet purpose!

  • Work full-time, on-site in one of our retail stores on a rotating roster across a 7-day trade
  • Plan itineraries, book travel and convert enquiries into bookings in person, over the phone and via email for our customers
  • Work towards individual KPIs and sales targets where you’ll sell the whole holiday including flights, accommodation, car hire, tours, travel insurance, cruises, transfers and more
  • Build a customer base of new and returning customers from regular domestic bookings to lavish international holidays and everything in between
  • Be the expert! Assist our customers with their travel related questions including visas, best time of year to travel, what to pack, where to eat, what to avoid, you name it!
  • Enjoy a base wage plus an uncapped incentive payment structure where you earn a percentage of every sale, your pay is completely uncapped!

What we’re looking for - do you have the travel bug?

  • Great organisational skills - you’re the type to take notes, manage your calendar well and are quick to respond to your customer’s phone calls and emails
  • A genuine passion for travel and desire to help open up the world to our customers!
  • Determination to meet your sales targets and KPIs while balancing your workload in a high-pressure environment (think customers lining up, phones ringing, email inbox filling!)
  • Enthusiasm, passion and a warmth that makes our customers want to book with you every time!
  • A savviness with computers, ready to toggle between various complex systems when finding the right flight and package options for your customer

What you will gain from a career with Flight Centre - let’s unpack the benefits!

💲 Average earnings for a Travel Consultant in their first year are $70K, while Senior Consultants average $100K and Team Leaders average $138K annually - including superannuation and penalty rates.

🌏 Become a true expert – access industry travel discounts and qualify for sponsored ‘Familiarisation Trips’ to explore new destinations and products around the world 

💎 Brightness of Future: Career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses across the globe - we promote from within   

🎉 Social: Embrace the famous Flight Centre culture at our Reward & Recognition events throughout the year including our most popular events on the calendar Global Gathering and Flichella    

🎓 Get qualified for free with a Certificate 3 & 4 in Travel & Tourism (worth 20k!) through Australian Apprentice Training - you may also be eligible to receive direct financial support while you study 

🌈 Thrive in a workplace that embraces individualism – come as you are!  

💛 Be part of a workplace committed to reconciliation through our Reconciliation Action Plan - we proudly support Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander inclusion, cultural safety, and dedicated cultural leave

Okay, I’m in!

Are you keen to join our team of Flighties? Hit apply now for your application to be read by a real human, no AI here! If your application is successful, you’ll be invited to have a 15-minute phone interview with one of our dedicated team of recruiters. Get ready to work, travel and grow.

Why is Flight Centre such a great place to work?

We are devoted to being a global employer of choice by nurturing our legendary culture - focused on our people and infused with adventure and accountability. We uplift and support our team through a compelling Employee Value Proposition that offers exciting career and travel opportunities, fantastic benefits, a meaningful sense of purpose and well-deserved recognition. Explore us on LinkedIn or check out our careers page at www.fctgcareers.com

job.job_description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

Travelers come to GetYourGuide with options in front of them, and they book when they’re confident they’ve found the right one. As a member of the Traveler Analytics leadership team, you’ll lead Comparison Analytics. You’ll define how we measure and improve the moment travelers choose between experiences: the activity page, the content and reviews behind it, how options and prices are presented, and what makes one experience stand out from another.

This means answering hard product questions. What makes a traveler confident enough to book? Which content changes decisions, and how do we measure that when conversion alone misses part of the value? How do price and value presentation shape choice? You’ll partner with Product, Design, Engineering, and Content leaders to shape these decisions, while building the analytics foundation and the team that delivers the answers. We need someone who has built and led high-performing analytics teams, built the measurement a product area runs its decisions on, and shaped company strategy with data.

Your toolkit

  • Proven leadership: You’ve hired, developed, and grown teams of analysts in fast-growth environments. You’ve coached analysts into senior ICs and leads, and you’re great at it.
  • Strategic partnership: You’ve shaped company strategy and roadmaps, influenced resource allocation, and built measurement frameworks that change how businesses make decisions instead of only reporting on them.
  • Hands-on technical fluency: You’re a hands-on leader who is proficient with SQL, experimentation design, causal inference, and metric definition. You can review a complex analysis, spot the flaw, and get into the data when needed. You don’t need to write every query, but you can, and you’ll use those skills to level up the team.
  • Influence executives: You turn complex analyses into crisp recommendations. You know when to push back on ideas and when to say “we don’t know yet, but here’s how we’ll find out.

Extras that give you an edge

  • Two-sided marketplace or e-commerce experience (preferred but not required)

How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary

  • Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
  • Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
  • A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.
  • Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with a quarterly team event budget
  • Access to leading AI tools plus the resources and budget to get the most out of them
  • Monthly transportation and fitness budget
  • Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
  • Language reimbursement program
  • Health and wellness benefits

And more…

How To Apply

Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘how we hire’ and ‘life at GetYourGuide’. If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to get in touch at jobs@getyourguide.com.

We’re an equal opportunities employer

Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with your application.

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Director of Operations at Hilton London Paddington, you’re not just directing daily hotel operations – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:

  • Provide strategic leadership across hotel operations by directing all day-to-day operational functions, ensuring exceptional commercial performance, guest satisfaction, operational excellence, and full compliance with Hilton and brand standards.
  • Drive the hotel's operational and financial strategy, taking ownership of operational budgets, forecasting, business planning, resource allocation, and performance delivery to achieve ambitious revenue and profit targets.
  • Champion a culture of service excellence, analysing guest insights, market trends, and operational performance to shape and execute strategies that continually elevate the guest experience and strengthen the hotel's competitive position.
  • Lead performance and productivity initiatives across the operation, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, optimise resources, enhance profitability, and deliver sustainable business results.
  • Oversee quality, risk and compliance programmes, ensuring rigorous operational standards, effective service recovery processes, and consistent achievement of guest satisfaction, quality assurance and brand metrics.
  • Act as a key member of the Executive Committee, partnering with the General Manager to influence strategic direction, drive change initiatives, and deliver the hotel's long-term business objectives.
  • Develop and inspire a high-performing leadership team, creating a culture of accountability, engagement and continuous development while building succession pipelines for future talent.
  • Lead strategic stakeholder and commercial partnerships, managing relationships with owners, corporate partners, local businesses and third-parties, to drive operational excellence, brand alignment and commercial performance while representing the hotel and Hilton brand.

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

About The Team

How We’ll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40 USD/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
  • Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
  • Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
  • Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
  • Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
  • Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Through our Care for All hub, we provide resources to help our Team Members to care for themselves, care for members of their team, and care for their loved ones. Eligible Team Members receive free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

job.job_description:
• Great opportunity within our Identity & Access Management Technology Team
  • Opportunity to drive enterprise-wide adoption of identity and security capabilities
  • Permanent, full-time role with a hybrid model of working from home and at our Mascot Campus


At Qantas, we represent Australia to the world. Our diverse country is known for its unique spirit, mateship, and a can-do attitude. Together we're strong and resilient, and we work hard to make sure we're always at our best.


Technology is a big part of how we continue to pioneer our way forward. With eyes on the future, our IT team harness technology on a global scale and tailor local solutions for each of our ports. Together we'll show you it's possible to make an impact and to never underestimate what you're capable of achieving.


As the Service Delivery Lead – Identity, you’ll make sure the identity capabilities we build are delivered, adopted, and used well across the Group. You’ll work alongside the Product Owner - Identity, Cyber, Architecture, our operations partner, and business teams.

You’ll help teams onboard applications, adopt access models, and complete User Access Reviews in a compliant way. That strengthens our security posture. It also takes the technology burden off business teams so they can focus on their core work.


You’ll be the voice of our customers to the Product Owner, using adoption data and service insight to shape the identity roadmap. You’ll also partner with operations and service partners so new and changed capabilities land smoothly in business-as-usual.


This isn’t a hands-on engineering role. You will need genuine identity depth, though, to be credible with Cyber and Architecture and to translate platform capability into terms stakeholders can act on.


What You’ll Do

  • Build and run adoption plans for Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) and Privileged Access Management (PAM) capabilities, covering application onboarding, roles, entitlements, approval workflows, and privileged access.
  • Engage business stakeholders to understand their requirements and help them plan for new and changing capabilities.
  • Lead change, training, communications, and engagement forums, including communities of practice.
  • Support User Access Reviews by giving business owners the tools, guidance, and support to complete them well and on time.
  • Measure adoption, utilisation, compliance uplift, and benefits realisation, and turn the results into clear reporting and executive dashboards.
  • Coordinate feature launches, gather business feedback, and feed improvement opportunities into the roadmap.
  • Provide input on service performance and operational readiness so capabilities are properly supported before go-live.
  • Contribute to risk, issue, and dependency management, escalations, and delivery governance across BAU and project work.
  • Work with service partners to make sure adoption outcomes meet commitments, business requirements, and service levels.


What You’ll Bring

  • 8+ years’ experience in service delivery, adoption, change management, enablement, business analysis, project management, or related disciplines, including 3+ years in IAM, PAM, or cyber security.
  • A track record of driving structured, compliant adoption of technology capabilities across a large enterprise.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, plus IGA and PAM concepts and tools such as SailPoint, Saviynt, Idira (CyberArk).
  • Experience taking capabilities from concept through to BAU, including operational readiness and handover to support teams.
  • An understanding of service management practices such as ITIL, and how service performance and adoption connect.
  • Strong analytical skills, with experience using adoption metrics to drive decisions and support business cases.
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement across business, security, and technology teams, with experience using Jira and Confluence.


Why Qantas?

If you’re successful in your application, you’ll join a team where creativity and passion are encouraged. Our people come together to allow us to dream big and deliver successfully.


There are many different opportunities across our team, which means you’ll be able to grow both personally and professionally at Qantas. Your development is a priority for us – so that you can maintain the high standards our customers have come to expect and can continue to develop over time. You’ll be supported from day 1 with on the job training and coaching as well as our formal training opportunities. While you may start in this role, we’ve got a great track record of supporting our people to take their career in so many different directions, the destinations are endless.


The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.

  • We love to travel: Enjoy discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave and additional purchased leave options.
  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging for everything from motor vehicles to electronic devices.

About The Role

Reporting to the CEO, Australia & New Zealand, with a dotted line to the Group Chief People Officer, the Head of People is the senior people adviser to the regional CEO and leadership team. As a member of both the Australia & New Zealand Executive Team and CTM’s People Leadership Team, you’ll shape and deliver the people agenda that supports business strategy and performance across the region.

CTM operates within a global matrix, bringing together regional business priorities and global Centres of Excellence (CoEs) that develop and deliver common people programs. In this role, you’ll connect these priorities by representing regional needs in global decision-making, ensuring global programs are implemented effectively across Australia and New Zealand, and applying sound local judgement to employment legislation, culture and business practices.

This is an opportunity for an experienced HR leader to influence at executive level, lead a broad people agenda and drive meaningful outcomes across a complex, multi-region business.

What You’ll Do

  • Executive partnership: Advise the CEO and leadership team on people priorities that deliver the business plan and CTM’s global People Strategy.
  • Global and regional alignment: Work with the Group Chief People Officer, Centres of Excellence and fellow Region Heads of HR to deliver consistent global programs while addressing local requirements.
  • Organisation and talent: Lead organisational design, workforce planning, talent reviews and succession planning, and coach leaders on leadership, team effectiveness and performance.
  • Employee relations and compliance: Lead complex employee and industrial relations matters, ensuring compliance with Australian and New Zealand employment law and CTM’s risk and governance frameworks, including WHS, psychosocial safety and return to work.
  • People programs and insights: Partner with Centres of Excellence across reward, talent acquisition, learning, HR operations and payroll, using engagement and workforce data to identify risks and opportunities.
  • Change and communications: Lead the people aspects of restructures, acquisitions and transformation programs, alongside internal communications aligned with Group messaging.

About You

You’re a commercially minded and influential HR leader who combines strategic thinking with strong technical expertise and the confidence to navigate complex business and people challenges. You build trusted executive relationships, challenge constructively and know how to balance global consistency with local business needs.

You’ll Bring

  • At least 10 years of HR experience, including senior leadership roles partnering with a CEO and executive team.
  • Expert knowledge of Australian and New Zealand employment law, industrial relations and workplace health and safety, including psychosocial safety and return-to-work requirements.
  • A sound understanding of payroll compliance, with the ability to oversee service delivery and hold HR Operations accountable for accuracy.
  • Experience working in a global or multi-region, matrixed organisation.
  • Strong strategic and commercial acumen, with the ability to turn people data and insights into practical recommendations that influence business decisions.
  • Demonstrated expertise in organisation design, workforce planning, talent management and leading organisational change.
  • The ability to influence without authority, navigate competing priorities and constructively challenge senior executives.
  • Proven experience leading, developing and engaging a team of HR professionals.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, coupled with sound judgement and absolute discretion.
  • A tertiary qualification in Human Resources, Business, Organisational Psychology, Industrial Relations or a related discipline.

Postgraduate qualifications or professional HR accreditation will be highly regarded. Experience in travel, services or multi-site businesses will also be advantageous.

Corporate Travel Management (CTM) is a global award-winning provider of innovative and cost-effective travel management solutions across the corporate, events, leisure and loyalty travel markets. We combine personalised service excellence with client-facing technology solutions, with offices across Australia, New Zealand, Asia, North America and Europe and more than 3,000 employees globally.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team:   

The Fintech Commercial team is the glue between external Fintech partners (schemes, PSPs, issuers) and Agoda’s Finance department. We represent the business side of Agoda’s “Pay-in” (Consumer Payments) and “Pay-out” (Business payments) pillars within the Agoda Fintech ecosystem. Together with our Fintech partners and cross-functional stakeholders, we identify and implement payments optimization initiatives, launch new payment methods and drive Fintech innovation across Agoda. 

 

The Opportunity:  

We are looking for a talented, results-oriented Payments Operations Analyst to join the Agoda finance team. You will: 

  • Analyze payment partner commercials   
  • Validate strategic deals and own invoice reconciliation   
  • Run financial analysis and data-driven insights 
  • Drive business case development for new fintech initiatives  

This is an ideal role for someone with 2–4 years’ experience in Finance, Fintech/Tech, or Consulting industries, who wants exposure to payments partner management at scale.  

Successful candidates tend to have strong analytical and data skills and are self-starters who are comfortable working in environments defined by volatility, uncertainty, complexity and ambiguity. In addition, good performers in this role are organized, possess effective interpersonal skills and can successfully partner with cross functional teams in a result-oriented manner. 

 

In this Role, you’ll get to own:  

Commercial Operations & Controls  

  • Perform monthly reconciliation of fintech partner commercials (PSPs, Payment schemes, etc.) on a timely basis  
  • Validate partner invoices against contractual terms and transaction-level data   
  • Ensure reconciliation data pipelines remain accurate and complete by coordinating with BI and external partners  
  • Be the trusted owner of reconciliation controls, maintaining clear documentation and partnering with stakeholders to ensure smooth audit walkthroughs each cycle  
  • Maintain documentation trails and process controls in accordance with Finance governance  

What You’ll Need to Succeed: 

Required  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or related field   
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in: Consulting (Big4 preferred), Corporate Finance, Fintech / Payments, Commercial Finance or Deal Analytics  
  • Advanced Excel skills: financial modeling proficiency required 
  • Analytical mindset with strong quantitative skills   
  • Detail-oriented with strong internal control awareness   
  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English  

Preferred  

  • Experience in payment ecosystem (PSPs, Payment schemes, etc.)   
  • Exposure to SQL or data querying tools   
  • Experience building structured business cases for senior stakeholders   
  • Experience working cross-functionally in fast-paced environment   
  • Knowledge of OTA business models (Merchant, Agency, Commission-based etc.)

Job Description

About you

You're a creative powerhouse who lives and breathes all things digital — the kind of person who spots the next big social trend before breakfast and already has three campaign ideas by lunch. You thrive on variety, juggle deadlines with a smile, and know that in a high-paced airport hotel, "busy" is the baseline and "brilliant" is the standard. With a knack for words, an eye for a great image, and you're just as comfortable crafting a press release as you are briefing an agency or building a 12-month marketing calendar. You're a natural connector and you bring energy, ideas and a sense of humour to everything you do.

What You Will Be Doing

As our Digital Marketing gun at Novotel & ibis Styles Melbourne Airport, you'll own the online presence of not one but two brands — from microsites and Accor channels to third-party platforms, keeping imagery, content, special offers and e-newsletters fresh, sharp and impossible to scroll past. You'll run our social media channels (with agency support and plenty of room to make your mark), drive website traffic through SEO and SEM.

You will build a rolling 12-month marketing calendar that keeps our Food & Beverage venues, leisure offerings and Meetings & Events front of mind. That means cracking promos for Boccata, Small Holdings and Amber State, event activations, collateral design, eDMs and paid campaigns, all while managing supplier and media agency relationships, growing our guest database and keeping our image and video library picture-perfect. You'll report monthly on campaign ROI, work closely with the Director of Sales & Marketing, champion PR and communications across the hotel, hunt down new initiatives before anyone else spots them, and bring bold, creative ideas to fill the quiet periods and smash the peaks. Fast-paced, dual-brand, full of personality — this is marketing with the volume turned all the way up.

Additional Information

Our Hotel

The Novotel & ibis styles Melbourne Airport is a dual-branded property with a total of 464 rooms - 248 in Novotel Melbourne Airport and 216 in ibis Styles Melbourne Airport, this dynamic new development is just steps from Terminal 4, Melbourne Airport, offering convenience and comfort for travellers and professionals alike.

Our guests can enjoy a selection of food & beverage venues: Boccata, meaning “mouthful” in Italian, celebrates the city’s migrant heritage and marries Italian favourites with local, contemporary touch. Amber State Taphouse & Kitchen is the ideal gathering place that celebrates the joy of getting together through the Aussie tradition of barbecue and beer – with craft beers on tap, wines, and cocktails. Small holdings featuring the classic Melbourne cafe culture with a range of delightful baked pastry treats, gourmet breakfast dishes, superb sandwiches and specialty coffee.

In addition to our exceptional food and beverage venues, the Novotel & ibis styles Melbourne Airport features premier event spaces designed to accommodate everything from intimate meetings to grand receptions. Our elegant ballroom can host up to 480 guests for a cocktail-style event or 240 for a seated banquet and can be effortlessly divided into Ballroom 1, 2, and 3, providing flexible configurations to suit any occasion, whether it’s a conference, workshop, product launch, or celebration. For guests seeking a productive environment, Aerofoil, our premium co-working space, offers a stylish and comfortable setting ideal for catching up on work between flights, hosting important meetings, or staying connected on the go.

This is a village centre supporting the airport community as a place to gather and socialise for everyone who travels and works from the airport precinct.

What is in it for you?

  • Learning programs through our “Learn your Way” Academy platforms, ongoing training and development opportunities (self-pace, virtual webinars, face to face)
  • ALL Heartist, Employee benefit card, offering discounted accommodation, food and beverage at Accor properties worldwide.
  • Complimentary car parking.
  • Mental health and well-being support initiatives.
  • Access to our Employee Assistance Program.

job.job_description:
About The Role

It's a great time to join us at Airlines Reporting Corporation (ARC)! ARC accelerates the growth of global air travel by delivering forward-looking travel data, flexible distribution services and other innovative industry solutions. We are a leading travel intelligence company with the world’s largest, most comprehensive global airline ticket dataset, including more than 15 billion passenger flights. By working here, you can contribute to solutions and expertise that strengthen economies and enrich lives. We think big, embrace challenges and explore new ideas to lead the way for the travel industry.

We are looking for a talented Customer Marketing Lead to apply broad and deep knowledge of ARC, its solutions, customers, and the global air travel industry to develop and manage product positioning, value propositions, target-market definitions, differentiated messaging, and customer marketing plans aligned with ARC’s broader marketing and communications strategy. You will conduct market research and collaborate across functions to define market segments. You will partner closely with Marketing and Communications, Product Management, and Sales to create product messaging, marketing plans, and sales and buyer enablement assets. You will lead initiatives and support peer-led efforts as needed, with teamwork essential to success. You will lead key customer engagement programs, including customer advocacy and win-loss research, requiring frequent customer interaction and strong communication and interpersonal skills. You will present findings and recommendations to leadership.

What You'll Get To Do

  • Conduct internal and external research to define customer needs and ensure they’re met with appropriate marketing content. Provide informational insights regarding customers, markets, and competitors to measure performance and support product development.
  • Build and maintain relationships with internal stakeholders and ARC partners to align customer marketing initiatives with business objectives.
  • Communicate regularly with customers to complete research and gain insight, including working group participation, webinar support and win/loss.
  • Own development of product positioning documents, value propositions, marketing materials for sales, and more. Coordinate with the broader marketing and communications team, product management and sales to develop marketing programs that drive adoption, engagement, retention and expansion.
  • Lead customer engagement efforts with the goal of capturing customer interest and needs, product attractiveness/feasibility and testimonials across solutions. This will entail meeting or interviewing key executives at ARC’s travel agency, airline, and other partners.

You'll Bring These Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in customer marketing, product marketing or a related field.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent experience considered
  • Airline, travel agency or corporate travel experience strongly preferred, including knowledge of airline distribution and financial settlement.
  • Understanding of customer needs, travel data and industry trends and the ability to use these insights to guide marketing strategy.
  • Ability to develop clear positioning, value propositions and messaging that connect ARC’s products and solutions to customer needs.
  • Experience developing marketing strategies that support product launches, customer engagement, adoption and retention.
  • Strong research skills, including the ability to identify customer segments, develop personas and assess market opportunities.
  • Ability to collaborate across teams and translate product capabilities into meaningful customer benefits.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex workflows, integrations and application programming interfaces in language customers can understand.
  • Ability to summarize findings, present recommendations and communicate results to senior leaders and executives.

What We Can Offer You

  • Joining ARC means joining a team that is motivated, diverse, creative, collaborative and solutions-oriented. We think big, embrace challenges, and explore new ideas to lead the way for the travel industry.
  • Our employees value the hands-on learning and professional development opportunities that allow them to expand their skills and grow their career in new, dynamic ways.
  • ARC offers WorkFlex. WorkFlex is ARC’s hybrid work program which offers eligible employees the flexibility to work from home while also requiring in office workdays throughout the year to foster collaboration and connection throughout the organization. We’ve designed WorkFlex to enable employees to succeed and thrive while maintaining strong connections to one another and ARC - both of which are critical to our shared success.
  • We offer a highly competitive, comprehensive benefits package so you can worry less and focus on what truly matters. Please click here to review our benefits on our company website.
  • By joining ARC, you will partner with top minds in the industry as we use data and technology to innovate how the world travels.

The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, allowing for meaningful future salary growth within the position.

job.job_description:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Development Deal Manager supports franchise growth by managing the negotiation, preparation, approval, and execution of franchise agreements and related legal documents. This individual-contributor role serves as a primary point of contact for assigned Franchise Development leaders, regions, and brands, coordinating with prospective franchisees and internal stakeholders to resolve deal issues and move agreements toward execution. The role conducts financial, market, and franchisee research, secures required approvals, and maintains accurate agreement and property information. The Development Deal Manager balances changing priorities and high-volume peak periods while producing accurate, timely, and legally compliant work. This role helps ensure new franchise agreements support corporate growth objectives, provide value to the company, and comply with internal policies and applicable laws.

Note: This role is a remote position and is not eligible for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Franchise Development Deal Management

  • Negotiate franchise agreement terms with prospective franchisees in partnership with Development leaders and internal stakeholders, ensuring proposed terms are fully reviewed, appropriately approved, and aligned with company objectives.
  • Manage assigned franchise deals from application through contract execution, proactively identifying potential obstacles and coordinating solutions that support timely completion.
  • Obtain and document required internal approvals before agreements and related documents are issued or executed.
  • Create financial performance reports for Development Regional Vice Presidents and other leaders for distribution to prospective franchisees, following applicable requirements governing supplemental earnings claims.
  • Conduct geospatial market analysis using ChoiceMap to support administration of the company’s Impact Policy for new franchise applications.
  • Research applicants’ existing business portfolios and operating histories, evaluate proposed areas of protection, and prepare committee materials and business cases for deal sponsorship.
  • Partner with Development Regional Vice Presidents, Vice Presidents, and Senior Vice Presidents, as well as Retention, Credit, Owner Portfolio Strategy Operations, Fair Franchising, Franchise Services, Openings, Billing, and Legal Compliance, to resolve issues affecting franchise agreement negotiations.
  • Maintain accurate franchise agreement, franchisee, and property information in company systems and provide timely, accurate reporting to business partners.
  • Coordinate across the organization to overcome obstacles, meet contractual and regulatory deadlines, improve processes, and support the timely execution of development contracts.

Drafting, Revising, and Executing Franchise Agreements

  • Prepare franchise agreements, promissory notes, guarantees, addenda, affidavits, and other documents required to complete franchise transactions.

Additional Skills And Competencies

Expedia Group's Treasury team takes full ownership of global cash management, investments, capital markets, foreign exchange, and risk/insurance programs across the globe supporting multiple corporate entities. The team works closely with tax, accounting, investor relations, payments, product and legal to ensure liquidity and funding for the business across the globe.

If you're a highly motivated, results-driven finance professional with great communication and project management skills, this is the job for you. This position offers the opportunity to stretch your skills and see your ideas have an impact on Expedia’s overall business. In this position on our Global Banking Team, you will play an integral role in managing the banking infrastructure and drive technology solutions across Treasury.

Key Responsibilities

In This Role, You Will

  • Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of global bank accounts, including openings, closures, signer updates, and documentation coordination.
  • Administer the issuance, amendment, renewal, and cancellation of letters of credit and bank guarantees globally.
  • Partner with Treasury and Data Engineering teams to develop Treasury data infrastructure using data visualization, machine learning, and artificial intelligence.
  • Lead automation of management reporting through advanced analytics platforms, improving accuracy, efficiency, and real-time decision-making.
  • Administer Treasury Management System and online banking platforms while maintaining internal access controls and segregation of duties.
  • Partner with Legal and global banking providers to support Know Your Customer and Anti-Money Laundering compliance.
  • Perform periodic Sarbanes-Oxley user access and segregation of duties reviews.
  • Identify opportunities to apply artificial intelligence to anomaly detection, process automation, predictive analytics, and liquidity optimization.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on global banking products and services.
  • Maintain timely communication with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Lead or support additional Treasury projects and initiatives.

Required

Experience and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Accounting, Data Science, or a related technical field; or Equivalent related professional experience.
  • Three or more years of experience in banking, corporate treasury, corporate accounting, or a comparable field.
  • Knowledge of banking regulations, cash management, foreign exchange, and banking practices.
  • Proficient written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organization, documentation, project management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and Power BI.

Preferred

  • Experience with SQL, Python, R, or similar programming languages.
  • Experience administering Treasury Management Systems or online banking platforms.
  • Experience with bank account management, letters of credit, bank guarantees, KYC, AML, or SOX controls.
  • Experience applying analytics, automation, machine learning, or artificial intelligence to finance or Treasury operations.

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! Responsibilities

As a Cluster International Sales, this position plays the responsibility of international sales for 2 properties, Hilton Osaka and Double Tree by Hilton Osaka Castle.

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Represent the hotel to prospective clients: Serve as the primary point of contact for customers seeking group rooms, meeting space, and food and beverage services
  • Drive new business opportunities: Respond to inquiries, initiate outreach, qualify leads, and solicit potential clients through proactive sales efforts
  • Manage the full sales cycle: Conduct site visits, entertain clients, prepare proposals, determine rates, negotiate contracts, and service accounts through fulfillment
  • Develop strategic sales plans: Create and execute strategies to achieve or exceed revenue and room night goals, adjusting based on performance and market conditions
  • Analyze sales performance: Evaluate lost business reports and identify opportunities to strengthen conversion and competitiveness
  • Support exceptional service delivery: Collaborate across departments to coordinate the fulfillment of contracted services and uphold the highest standards of client satisfaction
  • Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

Working Shift

This position is primarily office-based and typically operates Monday through Friday during standard business hours.

Flexibility is required to accommodate business demands, key operational priorities, and occasional after-hours support when necessary.

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

This Role Requires The Following Language Skill

  • English (business level)

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience of corporate, MICE, or group room sales, or operation department in hotel industry
  • Proven track record in driving revenue and managing key accounts
  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills

  • Excellent communication and leadership skills with a collaborative mindset

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

About The Role

Reporting to the Group Chief People Officer, the Group HR Business Partner is a trusted adviser to CTM Group's Executives, translating business strategy into people priorities that support organisational effectiveness and business performance.

Operating across CTM’s global matrix, you’ll work closely with Group Executives, regional HR leaders and Centres of Excellence (CoEs) to align global people initiatives with regional priorities. From organisation design and talent strategy to employee relations, performance and transformation, you’ll bring sound judgement, commercial insight and the ability to influence across a complex, multi-region business.

What You'll Do

  • Executive partnership: Advise Group Executives on people priorities, aligning business objectives with CTM’s global People Strategy.
  • Organisation and talent: Lead organisation design, workforce planning, talent reviews and succession planning, while coaching executives on leadership, team effectiveness and performance.
  • Global and regional alignment: Partner with regional HR leaders, HR Business Partners and CoEs to coordinate people initiatives, maintain consistency and minimise duplication.
  • Employee relations and governance: Manage complex and sensitive people matters, ensuring practices align with employment legislation, company policy and CTM’s risk and governance frameworks.
  • Change and people insights: Lead the people aspects of restructures, acquisitions and transformation, using workforce and engagement data to identify risks and inform executive decisions.
  • Reward, operations and communications: Advise on remuneration and incentives, provide responsive HR support to Group functions, and lead Group internal communications in partnership with regional teams.

About You

You’re an experienced HR leader with strong commercial acumen, sound judgement and the confidence to influence senior stakeholders across a global organisation.

You’ll Bring

  • 8+ years of HR experience, including significant experience as a strategic HR Business Partner to C-suite or Group Executives.
  • Experience in a global or multi-region, matrixed organisation.
  • Strong knowledge of employment law and employee relations across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Expertise in organisation design, workforce planning, talent management and succession planning.
  • A track record of leading organisational change, restructures or transformation initiatives.
  • The ability to translate people data into practical recommendations and constructively challenge senior leaders.
  • Experience in internal or change communications and leading and developing a team.
  • Excellent communication skills across cultures and time zones, with a high level of discretion when handling confidential information.

A tertiary qualification in Human Resources, Business, Organisational Psychology, Industrial Relations or a related discipline is required. Postgraduate qualifications or professional HR accreditation will be highly regarded.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team

The Customer Experience Group (CEG) of Agoda serves our customers and partners to deliver satisfying results. This is accomplished with the support of our Global Service Verticals (GSV) team — the backbone of CEG’s global operations. Our team includes project managers, process owners, analysts, and talent management. Together we improve the quality and efficiency of our customer and partner support processes.

We are a data-driven environment, eager to move fast and learn through experimentation. A clear focus on supporting our customers and partners is bolstered by a strong, entrepreneurial culture that enriches us and Agoda’s business performance.

This role sits in the B2B Partnerships and Automation team, part of CEG’s Global Service Verticals. The team drives end-to-end customer experience and process improvements, and scales impact through automation, AI, and tooling across customer-facing and agent-facing journeys.

The Opportunity

This Associate Director role owns and leads the project management team for this area: setting direction, raising the delivery bar, and being accountable for the outcomes of the team’s portfolio.

The portfolio typically covers:

  • (i) automation, AI, and tooling that improve customer and agent experience, and
  • (ii) process optimization and CX improvements across the post-booking journey, including operational (CS) support and optimization.

You will combine strategic problem solving, hands-on data-driven execution, strong project management, and senior stakeholder and partner management. Commercial acumen is a real advantage: you will often be the CEG project counterpart to commercial and partner stakeholders, translating business needs into deliverable work without owning the commercial P&L.

In this Role, you’ll get to:

Lead the Project Management Team and its Portfolio

  • Own the PM team end-to-end: vision, structure, ways of working, hiring, coaching, performance, and succession of project managers (and people managers on the team, where applicable).
  • Set long-term direction and annual/quarterly OKRs for the team, aligned with CEG and Agoda-wide priorities.
  • Own the outcomes of the team’s portfolio of global initiatives — prioritization, quality, impact, risk, and delivery.
  • Prioritize and drive work that moves mission-critical metrics: customer satisfaction (e.g. CSAT), service levels, automation quality, productivity, cost efficiency, and employee/agent engagement.
  • Ensure CEG project readiness to support Agoda’s new business and product initiatives by working closely with Product, Data, Strategic Partnerships, Finance, Legal, Operations/Support, and other teams.

Drive Automation, AI, and Continuous Innovation

  • Identify opportunities to leverage automation, AI, and tooling across customer and agent journeys (e.g. self-service, workflow automation, AI quality testing, agent guidance).
  • Partner with Product, Technology, Data, and CEG teams to design, prioritize, and implement solutions — from experimentation through global rollout and impact measurement.
  • Oversee configuration and governance of operational flows and low-code/automation tools so solutions are robust, scalable, and aligned with CX standards.
  • Act as a natural innovator: reframe problems, pitch new approaches (tech/AI and non-tech process), and systematically improve how the team and CEG work — not only execute a pre-agreed roadmap.

Shape Process, CX, and Operational Support Improvements

  • Lead project work that improves CEG end-to-end processes across the post-booking journey, removing pain points and improving operational performance through targeted initiatives and data-driven insight.
  • Own and evolve frameworks and roadmaps for how we continuously improve internal SOPs and related processes, balancing CX/PX outcomes vs efficiency/cost.
  • Drive strategic project initiatives such as localization support in key growth markets, regulatory work, and operational (CS) support and optimization — in close partnership with ops and commercial teams, without taking line ownership of those functions.
  • Define clear problem statements and business cases; prioritize customer and partner pain points against success metrics.

Partner, Stakeholder, and Commercial Interface

  • Build trusted relationships with senior leaders across CEG, Agoda, Booking Holdings, and other functions; influence priorities and decisions as the owner of this PM team’s agenda.
  • Be a primary project counterpart for core partners and commercial stakeholders: understand commercial context, surface operable trade-offs, and land cross-functional alignment.
  • Present to CEG senior leadership with confidence and minimal supervision; act as the go-to person for this team’s domain.
  • Monitor milestones, risks, and dependencies; troubleshoot issues; implement mitigation — remaining the ultimate owner of the portfolio’s outcomes.

What You’ll Need To Succeed

Experience & Background

  • At least 8–10+ years in project/program management, operations, customer experience, process improvement, strategy, management consulting, or similar — with a strong project management core (this is non-negotiable).
  • Significant people leadership: building and leading a high-performing team of project managers (including people managers and individual contributors).
  • Proven track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives from idea to implementation, with clear, measurable business impact.
  • Experience working across operational CS / customer support environments (optimization, process, tooling, quality, or service delivery projects) is strongly preferred.

job.company_description: Airlines Reporting Corporation (ARC) accelerates growth for the travel industry by delivering forward-looking travel data, flexible distribution services and innovative financial solutions. job.job_description:
About The Role

It's a great time to join us at Airlines Reporting Corporation (ARC)! ARC accelerates the growth of global air travel by delivering forward-looking travel data, flexible distribution services and other innovative industry solutions. We are a leading travel intelligence company with the world’s largest, most comprehensive global airline ticket dataset, including more than 15 billion passenger flights. By working here, you can contribute to solutions and expertise that strengthen economies and enrich lives. We think big, embrace challenges and explore new ideas to lead the way for the travel industry.

We are looking for a talented Customer Marketing Lead to apply broad and deep knowledge of ARC, its solutions, customers, and the global air travel industry to develop and manage product positioning, value propositions, target-market definitions, differentiated messaging, and customer marketing plans aligned with ARC’s broader marketing and communications strategy. You will conduct market research and collaborate across functions to define market segments. You will partner closely with Marketing and Communications, Product Management, and Sales to create product messaging, marketing plans, and sales and buyer enablement assets. You will lead initiatives and support peer-led efforts as needed, with teamwork essential to success. You will lead key customer engagement programs, including customer advocacy and win-loss research, requiring frequent customer interaction and strong communication and interpersonal skills. You will present findings and recommendations to leadership.

What You'll Get To Do

  • Conduct internal and external research to define customer needs and ensure they’re met with appropriate marketing content. Provide informational insights regarding customers, markets, and competitors to measure performance and support product development.
  • Build and maintain relationships with internal stakeholders and ARC partners to align customer marketing initiatives with business objectives.
  • Communicate regularly with customers to complete research and gain insight, including working group participation, webinar support and win/loss.
  • Own development of product positioning documents, value propositions, marketing materials for sales, and more. Coordinate with the broader marketing and communications team, product management and sales to develop marketing programs that drive adoption, engagement, retention and expansion.
  • Lead customer engagement efforts with the goal of capturing customer interest and needs, product attractiveness/feasibility and testimonials across solutions. This will entail meeting or interviewing key executives at ARC’s travel agency, airline, and other partners.

You'll Bring These Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in customer marketing, product marketing or a related field.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent experience considered
  • Airline, travel agency or corporate travel experience strongly preferred, including knowledge of airline distribution and financial settlement.
  • Understanding of customer needs, travel data and industry trends and the ability to use these insights to guide marketing strategy.
  • Ability to develop clear positioning, value propositions and messaging that connect ARC’s products and solutions to customer needs.
  • Experience developing marketing strategies that support product launches, customer engagement, adoption and retention.
  • Strong research skills, including the ability to identify customer segments, develop personas and assess market opportunities.
  • Ability to collaborate across teams and translate product capabilities into meaningful customer benefits.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex workflows, integrations and application programming interfaces in language customers can understand.
  • Ability to summarize findings, present recommendations and communicate results to senior leaders and executives.

What We Can Offer You

  • Joining ARC means joining a team that is motivated, diverse, creative, collaborative and solutions-oriented. We think big, embrace challenges, and explore new ideas to lead the way for the travel industry.
  • Our employees value the hands-on learning and professional development opportunities that allow them to expand their skills and grow their career in new, dynamic ways.
  • ARC offers WorkFlex. WorkFlex is ARC’s hybrid work program which offers eligible employees the flexibility to work from home while also requiring in office workdays throughout the year to foster collaboration and connection throughout the organization. We’ve designed WorkFlex to enable employees to succeed and thrive while maintaining strong connections to one another and ARC - both of which are critical to our shared success.
  • We offer a highly competitive, comprehensive benefits package so you can worry less and focus on what truly matters. Please click here to review our benefits on our company website.
  • By joining ARC, you will partner with top minds in the industry as we use data and technology to innovate how the world travels.

The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, allowing for meaningful future salary growth within the position.

EOE M/F/D/V Females and Minorities Encouraged to Apply

job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

At Delta Air Lines, connection is at the heart of everything we do and guides our every action. We strive to welcome and care for all our customers during their travels with us and aim to deliver an elevated experience.

The Acquisitions Strategy team sits inside the larger Delta Sync and Partnerships team and is responsible for driving performance of our top-tier in-flight partners. We drive growth, retention, and operational excellence across the portfolio. This highly strategic and visible team has created a one-of-a-kind onboard travel journey by providing highly engaging products and experiences for our passengers. We are a highly collaborative team that values curiosity, accountability, and continued improvement. To be successful, this role will require a multi-functional utility player who does not hesitate to own an ambiguous workstream and has never said, “that’s not my job.”

The Project Leader, Acquisition Strategy, is responsible for driving business performance, including forecasting and strategic insights across the Delta Sync portfolio. This role sits within our Marketing + Product org but will partner closely with cross-functional teams including Loyalty, Finance, and Digital teams to ensure performance transparency and scalable business processes that support customer growth and retention. The ideal candidate is comfortable translating data into actionable insights and influencing decision-making at multiple levels of the organization.

The Team Has Some Primary Responsibilities

  • Drive full funnel awareness down to conversion metrics for our Delta Sync partners
  • Drive engagement across customer-facing channels that support customer, brand, and partner needs

Job Responsibilities

  • Ownership. Quickly build knowledge of business, processes, and performance drivers and independently manage workstreams.
  • Business + Performance Insights. Maintain business forecasting and planning, while also being able to navigate marketing campaign level performance reporting, insights, and optimizations. Synthesize data from multiple sources to tell the story of campaign effectiveness.
  • Stakeholder Management. Drive alignment across teams with competing priorities and build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders
  • Marketing Strategy and Execution. Support go-to-market initiatives, managing timelines, with ability to track program milestones and identify risks. Manage cross-collaboration execution to help execute campaigns.
  • Project Management. Ability to manage projects, timelines, and deliverables autonomously. Ensure prioritization and focusing on delivering what will make an impact.

This Person Can Be Described As

  • Someone who is energized by solving business problems, while being comfortable building processes and solutions
  • Naturally curious, proactive, and eager to learn
  • Thriving in ambiguity, with the ability to balance big picture visions with tactical execution
  • Having the ability to blend business operations and marketing expertise to influence stakeholders
  • Not afraid to seek out information, ask questions and accelerate their knowledge

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • 5+ years of relevant business experience
  • Must be comfortable operating in ambiguous environments with limited direction
  • Strong understanding of marketing performance metrics and campaign measurement
  • Strong written communication skills with ability to quickly produce executive-level content (e.g., deck building, email)
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication and relationship-building skills required, with an emphasis on seeking input and understanding concerns of other stakeholders
  • Proven ability to organize, prioritize, handle time constraints, and manage shifting priorities, with an eye and attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple projects at once, including ability to develop workback plans and maintain timelines
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, statistical, and conceptual thinking skills
  • Assertive and confident thinker with ability to push the envelope; action oriented and capable of helping to define strategic options, scenarios, and consequences
  • Positively resolves conflict and removes obstacles to change; creates an environment where established ways of thinking can be provocatively challenged and evolved
  • Must have strong performance record & exemplary performance in current position
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency.
  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Marketing experience
  • Analytics, Measurement, Reporting experience
  • Airline experience
  • Experience with subscription-based business, lifecycle programs, or recurring revenue models

Benefits And Perks To Help You Keep Climbing

Our culture is rooted in a shared dedication to living our values – Care, Integrity, Resilience, Servant Leadership, and Teamwork – every day, in everything we do. At Delta, our people are our success. At the heart of what we offer is our focus on Sharing Success with Delta employees. Exploring a career at Delta gives you a chance to see the world while earning great compensation and benefits to help you keep climbing along the way.

Why You'll Love Delta

  • Competitive salary, industry-leading proﬁt sharing program, and performance incentives
  • 401(k) with generous company contributions up to 9%
  • Paid time off including vacation, holidays, paid personal time, maternity and parental leave
  • Comprehensive health beneﬁts including medical, dental, vision, short/long term disability and life beneﬁts
  • Family care assistance through fertility support, surrogacy and adoption assistance, lactation support, subsidized back-up care, and programs that help with loved ones in all stages
  • Holistic Wellbeing programs to support physical, emotional, social, and financial health, including access to an employee assistance program offering support for you and anyone in your household, free financial coaching, and extensive resources supporting mental health
  • Domestic and International space-available flight privileges for employees and eligible family members
  • World-wide partnerships to engage in community service and innovative goals created to focus on sustainability and reducing our carbon footprint
  • Recognition rewards and awards through the platform Unstoppable Together
  • Business Resource Groups created to connect employees with common interests to promote inclusion, provide perspective and help implement strategies
  • Access to over 500 discounts, specialty savings and voluntary benefits through Deltaperks such as car and hotel rentals and auto, home, and pet insurance, legal services, and childcare

We're looking for a senior, hands-on Principal Designer to set the standard for design across three of the world’s biggest travel brands: Expedia, Hotels.com and Vrbo. In this position, you will own the depth and quality of our craft and help shape the studio's creative direction. You will push our brands to be bolder and more distinctive, balancing precision with speed across a fast-moving, high-volume studio. You will also be at the forefront of what’s next, exploring how generative AI and emerging tools can unlock new creative possibilities for our brands.

Reporting to the Creative Director, you will bring strong taste and systems thinking to the frameworks that keep the studio ahead of a fast-changing creative landscape. Above all, you will help build a culture where craft and great ideas come first, and creative innovation thrives.

  • Partner with senior stakeholders. Present and champion creative work with senior leaders, and collaborate closely with integrated marketing, product and teams across the business.
  • Push the craft forward. Test and pilot new tools, formats and creative technologies, and bring the best of them into the studio’s roadmap.

Experience And Qualifications

  • A portfolio that shows exceptional craft and range across brand identity, campaign and digital work
  • Strong motion design skills, and an understanding of how motion shapes an identity
  • Hands-on experience with generative and AI creative tools such as Comfy, Weave, Midjourney, Flora, Adobe Firefly or Runway
  • A strong understanding of brand systems and how to keep work consistent at scale
  • Experience presenting creative to senior stakeholders
  • The ability to balance creative ambition with deadlines, budget and business priorities

Nice To Have Experience

  • Comfort with code to build or customise generative tools and pipelines
  • Experience fine-tuning or training generative AI models for design
  • Experience working with product and UX design teams on design systems
  • Experience in a large, multi-brand or global organisation

job.job_description:
The Opportunity

At InterContinental Hayman Great Barrier Reef, every day begins with ocean views and the spirit of true hospitality. Live, work, and thrive on one of the iconic 74 Whitsunday Islands, where a rewarding career meets an extraordinary island lifestyle—delivering and inspiring incredible experiences for our guests and colleagues alike.

Don’t just count the numbers. Be the force that drives success.

Behind every great hotel is a leader who knows how to turn financial insight into meaningful impact. As our Director of Finance & Business Support, you’ll take your place at the leadership table, influence key decisions and shape the financial direction of the hotel. Partnering with owners and senior leaders, you’ll challenge conventional thinking, identify opportunities for greater profitability and lead not only the Finance function, but also the hotel’s Information technology and Procurement teams. In return, you’ll have the scope to make your mark across the entire operation, strengthen your executive leadership experience and see the tangible results of your work.

Ready to take the lead, influence the bigger picture and leave your mark? We want to hear from you. Bring your commercial vision, your leadership ambition and your drive for excellence — and join us in shaping what comes next.

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

  • Lead and develop the Finance, Procurement and IT teams: Set clear priorities, coach and develop team members, build capability across functions, and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Own the hotel's financial performance: Lead annual budgeting, forecasting and financial reporting, providing insights into revenue, departmental expenses, labour costs and operating margins to drive profitability.
  • Drive procurement strategy and governance: Oversee purchasing and barge operations, supplier relationships, contract negotiations, inventory controls and sourcing practices to maximise value, ensure compliance and support operational requirements.
  • Provide strategic oversight of hotel technology systems: Partner with operational leaders and IHG technology teams to ensure reliable, secure and efficient technology infrastructure, supporting both guest-facing and back-of-house systems.
  • Maximise hotel profitability and cash flow: Monitor financial performance against budget, analyse variances, manage working capital and implement strategies to optimise costs, control expenditure and improve operating efficiency.
  • Drive commercial decision-making: Partner with the General Manager, department heads and owners to evaluate business performance, benchmark results, assess capital investment opportunities and deliver strong returns.
  • Oversee financial controls and compliance: Ensure the integrity of hotel accounting, financial statements, payroll, purchasing, inventory controls, credit and collections, while maintaining audit readiness and compliance with company policies and statutory requirements.
  • Champion governance, risk management and stakeholder relationships: Safeguard hotel assets, oversee contracts, owner reporting, technology governance and internal controls, ensuring business processes support operational excellence and an exceptional guest experience.

See Yourself in Our Team

To be successful in this role, you’ll have:

  • Bachelor’s degree / higher education qualification in Accounting, Finance or Commerce.
  • 4-8 years’ experience in hotel accounting or audit.
  • Strong leadership skills
  • Excellent communication and strong analytical skills as well as the ability to work collaboratively and champion change
  • Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional business support teams, ideally including Finance, Procurement and/or Information Technology.
  • Commercially astute with strong contract negotiation, vendor management and business partnering capabilities.
  • Experience within hospitality, tourism, large-scale resort operations or complex multi-department environments will be highly regarded.

Live the Island Life

  • Join a vibrant and diverse team, making lifelong friendships, and become part of an unforgettable island community.
  • We make island living convenient and affordable with subsidised staff accommodation and meals. We also offer dedicated staff facilities - pool, beach, gym, bar, diner, laundry, and more.
  • Enjoy swimming, snorkeling, hiking, kayaking, and exploring the Whitsundays after your shift or on your days off.
  • Your commute ends in paradise, with beautiful beaches and breathtaking ocean views just moments away.
  • Grow your career with opportunities for career growth, training, and professional development.
  • Enjoy exclusive employee, friends, and family discount rates across our InterContinental Hotels & Resorts properties worldwide.

At IHG Hotels & Resorts, we believe great hospitality starts with great people. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome, respected and valued. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, religions, genders, gender identities and sexual orientations. We pride ourselves on a diverse and family friendly environment, and welcome applicants with primary school aged children as our island offers a State Primary School.

If you require any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know, we're here to support you.

Ready to Work in Paradise

  • Please visit our Careers Page for all details regarding living and working on Hayman Island at: https://haymanisland.intercontinental.com/careers/ or click the ‘Apply Now’ button.
  • We also invite you to learn more by following our social channels:
    • Facebook via @ICHIRcareers and Instagram via @ihg_australia_careers
Applications close 8 November 2026. We will be reviewing and contacting candidates throughout the advertising period. The application may close earlier if the position is filled.

Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.
