job.job_description:
Are you ready to turn your love of travel into a career that takes you further than you ever imagined personally and professionally? Your Flight Centre journey is uniquely yours - and we’re here to champion it, celebrate it, and help it take flight. As a Flightie you’re not just building a career - you’re shaping a life filled with purpose, connection, and discovery. If you’re looking for the next stamp in careers passport - we’re looking for Sales Travel Consultants across Australia who are keen to dazzle, discover and delight our customers! Navigate your career. Explore the world.

What you’ll be doing - where your passion will meet purpose!

  • Work full-time, on-site in one of our retail stores on a rotating roster across a 7-day trade
  • Plan itineraries, book travel and convert enquiries into bookings in person, over the phone and via email for our customers
  • Work towards individual KPIs and sales targets where you’ll sell the whole holiday including flights, accommodation, car hire, tours, travel insurance, cruises, transfers and more
  • Build a customer base of new and returning customers from regular domestic bookings to lavish international holidays and everything in between
  • Be the expert! Assist our customers with their travel related questions including visas, best time of year to travel, what to pack, where to eat, what to avoid, you name it!
  • Enjoy a base wage plus an uncapped incentive payment structure where you earn a percentage of every sale, your pay is completely uncapped!

What we’re looking for - do you have the travel bug?

  • You’re a seasoned traveller with a history of international destinations (and even more on your bucket list!) and you’re the go-to person in your circle for travel recommendations, tips and tricks
  • Great organisational skills - you’re the type to take notes, manage your calendar well and are quick to respond to your customer’s phone calls and emails
  • Determination to meet your sales targets and KPIs while balancing your workload in a high-pressure environment (think customers lining up, phones ringing, email inbox filling!)
  • Enthusiasm, passion and a warmth that makes our customers want to book with you every time!
  • A savviness with computers, ready to toggle between various complex systems when finding the right flight and package options for your customer

What you will gain from a career with Flight Centre - let’s unpack the benefits!

💲 We'll boost your wage to $65K equivalent for your first 90 days while you learn the ropes! Average earnings for a Travel Consultant in their first year are $70K, while Senior Consultants average $100K and Team Leaders average $138K annually - including superannuation and penalty rates.

🌏 Become a true expert – access industry travel discounts and qualify for sponsored ‘Familiarisation Trips’ to explore new destinations and products around the world 

💎 Brightness of Future: Career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses across the globe - we promote from within   

🎉 Social: Embrace the famous Flight Centre culture at our Reward & Recognition events throughout the year including our most popular events on the calendar Global Gathering and EOFY Celebration

🎓 Get qualified for free with a Certificate 3 & 4 in Travel & Tourism (worth 20k!) through Australian Apprentice Training - you may also be eligible to receive direct financial support while you study 

🌈 Thrive in a workplace that embraces individualism – come as you are!  

💛 Be part of a workplace committed to reconciliation through our Reconciliation Action Plan - we proudly support Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander inclusion, cultural safety, and dedicated cultural leave

Okay, I’m in!

Are you keen to join our team of Flighties? Hit apply now for your application to be read by a real human, no AI here! If your application is successful, you’ll be invited to have a 15-minute phone interview with one of our dedicated team of recruiters. Get ready to work, travel and grow.

Why is Flight Centre such a great place to work?

We are devoted to being a global employer of choice by nurturing our legendary culture - focused on our people and infused with adventure and accountability. We uplift and support our team through a compelling Employee Value Proposition that offers exciting career and travel opportunities, fantastic benefits, a meaningful sense of purpose and well-deserved recognition. Explore us on LinkedIn or check out our careers page at www.fctgcareers.com

job.job_description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

We're looking for an outstanding Lead Product Manager to join GetYourGuide's Paid Search team. In this role, you'll drive the vision, strategy, and growth of the products that power one of our largest customer acquisition channels.

Paid Search at GetYourGuide sits at the intersection of back-end automation and data products. The tech powering the channel is no longer just a set of back-end systems — it's increasingly a portfolio of data products (signals, feeds, bidding inputs, attribution) consumed by our Marketing team and by adjacent Growth surfaces. Your job is to shape that portfolio: set the strategy, define the roadmap, and partner with engineering to ship it.

You'll work closely with the Paid Search Tech engineering team, the Growth Data Product team, and the Paid Search Marketing team, who are both your closest partners and your primary internal customers. If you want to shape the future of paid customer acquisition with us, read on.

Your mission

  • Ownership: You are skilled at laying out your team's strategy, setting goals, and following through — owning the outcomes of your team's work end to end.
  • Ambiguity: You can create meaning and value from ambiguity, and you're comfortable operating in a space where the "product" is often a system, a signal, or a model rather than a UI.
  • Data product thinking: You treat internal capabilities — bidding inputs, feeds, signals, attribution — as products with consumers, contracts, and a roadmap, not as back-end plumbing. You define what "good" looks like for the teams that depend on them.
  • Communication: You demonstrate a clear and structured approach to communicating; able to connect your team's strategy to the company's mission and break it down into clear next steps for engineers, marketers, and leadership alike.
  • Prioritisation: You use your data skills and customer empathy to weigh competing initiatives, make clear decisions on priorities, and continually re-evaluate your roadmap based on what you learn.
  • Collaboration: You build trust across a demanding set of stakeholders — the Paid Search Tech engineering team, the Growth Data Product team, and the Paid Search Marketing team — keeping them aligned on a shared roadmap and clear expectations.
  • Experimentation: You use experimentation to evaluate your team's investments, leveraging your data skills to interpret results and decide what to do next.

Your toolkit

  • 7+ years of professional experience in product management.
  • Demonstrated experience building data products or ML-adjacent products — for example, feature stores, signal pipelines, ML platforms, bidding, pricing, ranking, or attribution systems. You can reason about model-driven products, feedback loops, and guardrails.
  • Demonstrated ownership over a product in a previous role, including responsibilities for strategy, KPI setup, goal-setting, and roadmap.
  • Strong data analytics skills, with the ability to derive insights from large datasets.
  • Experience with experimentation as a core decision-making tool.
  • Experience working with large Paid Search setups is a strong plus.
  • Experience with Search Engine Optimization is a plus.
  • Experience working on a SaaS product, a marketplace, or in the travel industry is a plus.

How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary

  • Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
  • Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
  • A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.
  • Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events
  • Monthly transportation and fitness budget
  • Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
  • Language reimbursement program
  • Health and wellness benefits

And more…

How To Apply

Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘how we hire’ and ‘life at GetYourGuide’. If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to get in touch at jobs@getyourguide.com.

We’re an equal opportunities employer

Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with your application.

job.job_description:
Job Description

Putting the customer at the heart of what we do and making their lives easier is key to this role. The Account Executive, ASO UK&I will support the management and growth of a defined portfolio of Corporate, MICE and business development accounts, with a clear focus on driving demand into UK&I hotels and increasing Hilton’s share. The Account Executive will build strong account management capability, develop customer relationships, support account strategies and identify new opportunities, while working closely with Account Managers, Directors, hotels and support teams to deliver agreed targets.

Responsibilities

The Account Executive will work within the ASO UK&I team to support transient and group business across Hilton’s portfolio of hotels. The role will manage a defined account base, contribute to account plans, support transient RFP activity, help convert group opportunities and present relevant Hilton updates to customers. The role will also include business development activity, including identifying prospective customers, supporting negotiations for transient and group opportunities and representing Hilton at selected customer meetings, trade shows and industry events.

Planning Activities

  • Supports transient and group strategy for the assigned account base in line with Hilton revenue priorities.
  • Uses a total account management approach to understand where the strongest opportunities exist across transient, group, meetings and business development activity.
  • Identifies and evaluates new business opportunities within the current account base and agreed prospect accounts.
  • Contributes to account development plans and supports communication of key actions, opportunities and updates internally and externally.
  • Supports customer RFP activity, increasing the number of relevant solicited and accepted hotels to help drive market share.
  • Follows agreed processes for managing the account portfolio, ensuring activity is accurate, timely and aligned to team priorities.
  • Takes ownership for agreed actions and activities within the assigned account base, escalating risks or opportunities where appropriate.
  • Develops strong working relationships with key hotels receiving business from the account portfolio, building understanding of hotel needs and commercial priorities.

Organizing Activities

  • Implements agreed activity plans to support the strategic direction of the account base and Hilton’s revenue strategies.
  • Manages the RFP process with guidance from the manager and support from RFP Support and Sales Support teams, ensuring procedures support the customer and drive business into Hilton.
  • Coordinates tasks with Hilton Direct, Project Desk and Sales Support to ensure customer requirements are progressed efficiently.
  • Provides clear and timely updates to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Tracks the impact of customer activity and marketing initiatives on account performance.
  • Builds effective working relationships with customers to understand needs, influence decisions and secure repeat business.
  • Networks with sub-account handlers, global leads and internal stakeholders where relevant.
  • Strengthens relationships with key hotels and aligns activity where it can support conversion and market share growth.
  • Maximises opportunities by developing relationships with relevant third parties, including MICE agents and TMCs.
  • Supports the creation, implementation and communication of account strategies, delivering agreed targets and activity goals.
  • Develops practical Account Plans with clear objectives, timelines and sales activities to support account penetration.
  • Identifies key customer contacts, influencers and decision makers, using this understanding to support conversion and relationship growth.
  • Communicates account activity, opportunities, risks and successes on a regular basis, including quarterly account updates where required.

Directing Activities

  • Coordinates agreed actions with Sales Support, Hilton Direct and Project Desk, encouraging timely follow-up through clear communication.
  • Reviews Account Plans regularly with their manager, updating Salesforce records accordingly.
  • Supports account-specific marketing and customer engagement initiatives to help drive business.
  • Contributes to marketing activity that underpins account strategies and supports increased market share.

Controlling Activities

  • Tracks actual performance versus agreed targets, highlights gaps and takes appropriate corrective action with manager guidance.
  • Follows Account Development Plans and provides updates on progress, risks and opportunities.
  • Ensures RFP processes are followed in line with Hilton best practice and Salesforce guidelines.
  • Maintains Salesforce to ensure accurate and up-to-date customer and account information.
  • Keeps customer requirements, interests, activities and opportunities up to date in Salesforce.
  • Works with support teams, including RFP Support, Sales Support, Hilton Direct and Project Desk, to ensure agreed tasks are completed for the customer.
  • Provides accurate updates and reports to support account performance reviews and future planning.
  • Reviews the customer base to identify opportunities for further account penetration and new business development.

Supportive Functions

In addition to performance of the essential functions, this position may be required to perform a combination of the following supportive functions, with the percentage of time performing each function to be solely determined by the supervisor based upon the particular requirements of the company.

  • Attendance at sales workshops.
  • Involvement in various projects to support the wider HWS team’s strategies.
  • Additional supportive functions as appropriate.
  • Supports colleagues with customer appointments, presentations and follow-up activity where required.
  • Supports the planning and attendance of familiarisation trips detailed in account development plans to help drive market share.

Qualifications

The individual must possess the following knowledge, skills and abilities and be able to perform the essential functions of the job, with or without reasonable accommodation.

  • Strong communication skills, including written communication, customer presentations and confident verbal updates.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and external contacts.
  • Demonstrates high standards of ethical behaviour and discretion with sensitive information.
  • Ability to take initiative, prioritise tasks and follow through on actions required to achieve agreed goals.
  • Good problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify issues, work with others and recommend practical solutions.
  • Ability to work independently while seeking guidance appropriately and keeping stakeholders informed.
  • Ability to adjust plans and priorities as situations change.
  • Prioritises, organises and uses a systematic approach to get things done.
  • Commercial curiosity and the ability to translate customer needs and account insight into practical sales actions.
  • Contributes positively when working with peers and wider team members.
  • Builds strong relationships and presents a professional image to customers and external contacts.
  • Able to manage more than one task or customer situation at a time.
  • Adapts quickly and positively to new situations.
  • Positive attitude and willingness to learn.
  • Commitment to delivering a high level of customer service.
  • Proactive sales approach with a focus on activity, conversion and results.
  • Ability to work well under pressure and manage competing deadlines.
  • Passion for sales and target-based performance.
  • Flexibility to travel as required.
  • Ideally has on-property hotel, reservations, sales support or corporate customer-facing experience.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience in a customer-facing, sales support, hotel, revenue-generating or account coordination role.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications and comfortable using CRM or sales systems.
  • Fluency in spoken and written English.
  • Commitment to delivering a high level of customer service.
  • Strong organisational and planning skills.
  • Proactive sales approach and appetite to develop account management capability.
  • Ability to work well under pressure and manage multiple priorities.
  • Interest in sales, commercial performance and target-based working.
  • Flexibility to travel
  • Can demonstrate good problem-solving skills and a desire to achieve practical solutions.

Education And Experience

When you travel with CTM or any of our travel brands, you can rest assured you’re supported by a team of passionate and accomplished travel professionals, leveraging extensive global buying power for the best deals in travel, and backed by award-winning tools that deliver exceptional travel experiences and outcomes.

About The Role

The role of Senior Financial Accountant will report directly to the Financial Controller - ANZ. This role will work with the Finance leadership team to prepare monthly financial reports, end of month financial accounting and to improve overall Finance processes involving the Financial Accounting team.

The role is a central member of the corporate accounting team assisting the business in delivering excellence in customer service, innovation and return on investment whilst contributing to achieving our business strategies. The role will be responsible for the compliance of statutory requirements, preparation of monthly and annual financial reports, accounting records and other information, allowing senior management to make informed business decisions and thereby improve our profitability.

The role is also responsible for the continuous review and improvement of accounting processes, including interactions with other areas of the business and offshore outsourced team, to complete required workflows, to determine process improvements to increase efficiency and effectiveness of team processes and automate and integrate wherever possible. The role will involve some management accounting tasks such as participation in budgeting and reporting activities when requested.

This role will also include engagement and working alongside offshore resources and assisting with exception resolution.

About You

To be successful in this role, you will bring:

  • Minimum 5+ year’s experience
  • Formal qualifications in accounting essential (e.g. Tertiary degree or equivalent completed)
  • Completion of CA/CPA or equivalent
  • Experience in taxation related areas, such as FBT, Income Tax, GST and Payroll Tax
  • Minimum intermediate level experience in the Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel
  • Experience with SAP Business One or similar accounting / package is desirable, but not essential
  • Strong organisational and time management skills with the ability to prioritise and manage multiple concurrent tasks.
  • Effective written and interpersonal communication skills

CTM is a global award-winning provider of innovative and cost-effective travel management solutions to the corporate, events, leisure and loyalty travel markets. CTM offer a strong, established and sustainable work environment which will support your career development and wellbeing.

Come work for a global award winning company that values its people, community, and technological innovation.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to know our team:

The B2B Pricing team sits within B2B Marketing and partners with Product, Commercial, Finance, and Data Science to define, test, and scale strategies that drive sustainable growth and profitability for Agoda and our partners. We combine deep analytical rigor with an experimentation mindset to optimize across marketing levers (primarily pricing) and advise on growth across B2B2C channels.

The Opportunity:

As Associate Manager/Manager, B2B Pricing & Growth Strategy, you will own pricing strategy and execution while acting as a consultative, data‑driven advisor to B2B2C growth initiatives. You’ll translate commercial goals into testable pricing and marketing levers, design measurement, and lead cross‑functional rollouts that improve business outcomes. You will work closely with the commercial organization and cross‑functional stakeholders, serving as a go‑to partner for pricing and growth decisions for key partners (e.g., large loyalty programs, marketplaces, and digital wallets such as Rakuten or Paytm).

In this role, you’ll get to:

  • Define and evolve pricing strategies, segmentation, and marketing action for partners.
  • Lead the experimentation roadmap (A/B and multivariate tests), including hypotheses, success metrics, and decision frameworks.
  • Build marketing roadmaps and analyses (elasticity, cannibalization, incrementality) to advise relevant marketing actions.
  • Act as a consultative growth advisor to partner teams: co‑create joint plans, model impact/P&L, align OKRs, and operationalize execution across channels.
  • Build playbooks to scale winning strategies across markets and partners; document learnings and institutionalize best practices.
  • Create Tableau dashboards and crisp executive narratives that synthesize performance, insights, and recommendations; drive action in weekly/monthly reviews.
  • Vendor/Partner Management: Manage relationships with external partners including strategic presentations.

What you’ll need to succeed:

  • 5+ years in data-driven role, revenue/growth, marketing, strategy, or analytics roles in e‑commerce, travel, tech;
  • Consulting experience is a strong plus
  • Strong business acumen and structured problem‑solving; ability to frame trade‑offs, model scenarios, and influence decisions with clear “so‑what.”
  • Fluency with data: advanced Excel, SQL, and Tableau; comfort with large datasets and experiment readouts.
  • Practical experience with controlled experiments.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and communication; able to simplify complex analyses for senior and partner audiences and drive alignment.
  • High ownership and bias for action; thrive in an ambiguous, fast‑paced, test‑and‑learn environment.
  • BA/BS in a quantitative field (e.g., Economics, Statistics, Engineering) or equivalent experience.

It’s great if you have:

  • Building decision frameworks in production.
  • Background in management consulting or internal strategy (e.g., growth, pricing, or partnerships).
  • MBA or advanced degree is a plus; we value equivalent operating experience and measurable outcomes.
  • Familiarity with Python/R for modeling and scaling analysis.
  • Domain exposure to B2B channels, partner/affiliate programs, or wholesale/whitelabel constructs.

The Night Manager provides overall management coverage during overnight operations, ensuring guest satisfaction, service excellence, safety, and smooth hotel operations — with a strong focus on Front Office and Night Audit activities.   • Ensure the accuracy and completion of Night Audit procedures, daily reports, and system rollovers

Delta’s Pilot Learning team is seeking an individual who is passionate about project management and process improvement, particularly as it relates to the infrastructure and documentation that supports pilot training and development. This person will be involved in supporting a variety of project management and operational initiatives across the Flight Operations (Flight Ops) Learning ecosystem.

This role will support the coordination and documentation of projects that enable the Flight Ops Learning team and infrastructure. An understanding of project management methodologies, process improvement practices, stakeholder communication, and departmental documentation would be beneficial. Working across multiple concurrent initiatives, this position will assist in ensuring that project activities are tracked, communicated, and executed in alignment with the team strategy and project management ecosystem.

Role

The successful candidate will coordinate and direct numerous project activities as defined by the Manager, Flight Ops Learning. Key focus areas of the role include:

  • Project Management ecosystem enhancement.
  • Department process documentation and continuous improvement.

The successful candidate will possess the ability to work in a team environment and:

  • Work directly with the Manager, Pilot Learning to coordinate and direct numerous project activities.
  • Take a hands-on approach to preparing and communicating project performance, cost updates, and status reports.
  • Manage and drive strategic and process-focused initiatives that support the Flight Operations Learning infrastructure.
  • Prepare and assist with project documentation and team documentation.
  • Identify action items, capture existing processes, and identify future process improvements.
  • Update and leverage project management tools to provide visibility of strategy, timelines, communication, and success metrics.
  • Support the creation of operational dashboards and roadmaps relevant to various levels of leadership and key stakeholders.
  • Gather feedback and propose process improvement recommendations for optimal project outcomes.
  • Attend project planning meetings and provide meeting notes when applicable.

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalent.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Excellent communication skills (verbal and written), liaising with both technical and non-technical professionals.

We are looking to identify and develop future business leaders through our 2027 Expedia - Finance Leadership Program (FLP). You’ll complete three 12-month rotations on different teams to give you exposure to the many facets of our travel ecosystem. Throughout the program, you’ll benefit from dedicated professional and personal development opportunities during your rotations to help you identify what excites you the most about your career future.  

 

Program Overview:

  • Team Rotations: three 12-month rotations (within Finance) to build knowledge of our business, across various Expedia Group divisions.
  • Finance Leadership Program: accelerated career development to build you into the next generation of Finance leaders through multi-disciplinary finance experience, differentiated learning opportunities focused on a combination of technical, interpersonal, and leadership skills, in-program leadership opportunities, and increased exposure to senior leaders throughout Finance.
  • Industry Recognized Qualification: we will sponsor your studies towards your chosen qualification of either CIMA or ACCA

In This Role You Will:

Our Finance Leadership Program Graduates work on impactful projects which support the overall Expedia Group (EG) Finance vision. Each member of the program will rotate through assignments across diverse functional areas within Finance, including Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Commercial Finance, Marketing Finance, Controllership, Audit, Treasury, Tax, and more.

The work will cover core elements of reporting, analysis and forecasting, as well as compliance and commercial business modelling, across EG divisions. You will have the opportunity to learn from peers across all levels and to collaborate with senior stakeholders to help drive the business forward as well as: 

  • Analyse data for trends and insights, to inform better decision-making  
  • Partner with our Finance & Analytics teams to develop and share business understanding and build future forecasts and outlooks   
  • Build business cases or investment proposals to help support growth  
  • Engage with Commercial, Strategic and Finance leaders across EG 
  • Lead core workstreams for the Finance Leadership Program with and on behalf of your fellow FLP peers 
  • Work on exciting value-adding tasks and opportunities that help drive our Global Finance vision and priorities 

Minimum Requirements:

We know that many potential candidates can be hesitant to apply for a job if they aren't sure that they meet all the criteria shared. If you meet all the criteria labelled ‘Must’ and are interested in this role, we encourage you to apply! 

  • Must be available to start on August 16, 2027
  • Must be graduating with an undergraduate degree between March 2027 and July 2027 which is focused on quantitative or analytical competencies (e.g., Economics, Finance, Accounting, Business, Statistics, Maths, etc.) 
  • Must have no more than 2 years' professional experience 
  • Must be willing to relocate to city of job location if outside commuting distance 
  • Must have a willingness to learn across a range of financial disciplines and a curiosity when working through tasks during each rotation 
  • Must be an ambitious, aspiring future leader who isn’t afraid to “Go Get What’s Next” 

Preferred Experience:

  • Helpful to have effective communication skills and the ability to engage with a variety of stakeholders (e.g., internal, external, technical, non-technical people)   
  • Helpful that you are comfortable unpacking complex data to identify core performance drivers and pay great attention to detail  
  • Helpful to have a data-driven mindset when problem solving and finding resolutions to benefit our teams and customers   
  • Helpful to have a positive attitude towards change and is at ease if needed to adapt

job.job_description:
Manage and perform strategic analysis of complex markets to assess the desirability of specific locations in the U.S., Canada, the Caribbean, and Mexico to determine the value of a new or converted franchise hotel on the existing franchise system. Provide strategic analysis and support regarding complex strategic and operational questions across multiple functions (including development, brand strategy and franchise operations). Provide support for key decision making processes, including the Franchise Approval Committee. Maintain and track regional view on system size and pipeline highlighting actions required to meet IHG system size growth ambition. Provide financial, analytical and business planning support and advice to assigned business unit to ensure their success in implementing the Company’s strategic priorities.

Your day to day

  • Conduct strategic analyses which include the development, data mining, and interpretation of quantitative analytical support for Franchise Sales and Development and Americas Finance.
  • Provide in-depth analytical support and insight, including a deep understanding of complex market performance drivers, to identify target locations for the Company’s mainstream, upscale or new brand hotels. Develop reports and processes to maintain and track performance against targets over time. Communicate frequently with the field sales team to translate complex analysis into easy to understand market insights. Support the development and ongoing evolution of the COMPASS model build outs and improvements to the tool.
  • Support and manage the development of key strategic reports utilized regularly for decision making by senior management, including reports specifically for the CEO and regional operating committee members (reports include confidential data and information with which major decisions are made).
  • Perform market analyses for the US, Canada, Caribbean, and Mexico territories to include studies of current and future trends of consumer economic, demographic and competitive data.
  • Independently conduct market field work to establish viability and/or feasibility of proposed IHG branded hotels.
  • Build and maintain data and systems underpinning Market Strategy approach e.g., Compass, Tableau, Business Objects, Access database(s).
  • Maintain and track Americas region view on system size, pipeline, all development revenue streams, and royalty projections to ensure alignment with IHG system growth ambition.
  • Review proposed hotel projects for location attributes, notification to existing owners, and recommendations as part of IHG’s internal review process.

What We Need From You

  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Business, Strategy, Finance, Statistics or a relevant field of work, or an equivalent combination of education and work related experience
  • 3 plus years’ progressive work experience in strategy, consultancy or finance with demonstrated mastery of technical and business knowledge, understanding multiple disciplines/processes and tackling complex strategic issues related to the position. Previous work experience in the Hotel Industry, market planning or real estate development areas are highly desirable
  • Demonstrated project management experience in planning and executing complex analytical projects and processes from conception through implementation.
  • Demonstrated strategic thinking through an ability to analyze markets, performance data, and complex business issues in order to draw insight/conclusions.
  • Demonstrated financial modeling/analysis (DCF, NPV, accounting, statistics) and basic financial principals.
  • Demonstrated ability to assess and understand a variety of internal and external economic and financial issues and to analyze data and forecast future business trends in order to support the strategic market/business planning function.
  • Demonstrated effective verbal and written communication skills for the purpose of providing information to clients, vendors, senior management and staff. Demonstrated ability to communicate and present data and analysis using a persuasive argument or to effectively negotiate a position.
  • Demonstrated advanced-level knowledge and understanding of economic conditions, industry trends, financial statements, and other issues affecting potential franchise transactions. Demonstrated ability to analyze these factors and draw logical conclusions.
  • Demonstrated strong interpersonal skills and relationship-building skills, in order to effectively act as a liaison to explain analysis, recommendations and decisions to the Director, Market Strategy & Development Analytics, the development/ franchise sales organization and senior management
  • Demonstrated financial and business analysis skills, and demonstrated ability to analyze operating, forecast, and budget information. Demonstrated ability to use the results of analysis to make effective strategic decisions

Travel – 15-25%

Location – Atlanta, GA: Our hybrid work structure is an expectation of three (3) days a week in office. This expectation may be adjusted to evolve with the changing needs of the business.

The salary range for this role is $84,000.00 to $97,000.00. This role is also eligible for bonus pay (as applicable). We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, 401K, and other benefits to employees.

Are you ready to turn your love of travel into a career that takes you further than you ever imagined personally and professionally? As a Flightie you’re not just building a career - you’re shaping a life filled with purpose, connection, and discovery. job.job_description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

As Director of Product, Growth, you will be the most senior product leader for our Growth organization, joining the Chief Product Officer's staff. Your mandate is to build each product in our growth and marketing portfolio in the right direction, in close alignment with our business goals — while always delivering real value back to our users, not just building to what marketing needs.

Marketing channels that have historically been siloed are converging, and you will drive the scale, leverage, and consistently excellent user experience that convergence makes possible. This is one of the largest and most consequential product scopes at GetYourGuide: it sits atop the single largest line item on our P&L outside of revenue itself, spanning Landing Pages, Paid Search Technology, Strategic Partnerships, Lifecycle Marketing, and our Creative Platform (which includes our Marketing Technology Platform and Creator tooling). You will likely own or co-own strategy for a broader cluster as well.

Equally important, you will build a great product management organization — hiring, developing, and growing PMs across the growth, data, UX, and platform archetypes that a world-class marketing product org needs. You will lead a team of several direct reports (a mix of product leads and managers) across a wider organization, partnering closely with senior stakeholders on the business side.

This is a role with clear, measurable success criteria and a genuine path toward broader scope and impact as our growth investment continues to compound.

What You'll Do

  • Own a cohesive product strategy across Growth that ties investment to business impact in both absolute and relative terms — raising the bar on how opportunities are assessed and influencing prioritization across product and marketing.
  • Champion user experience as a first-class lever in every product you and your team build, even highly technical ones — using "why is this good for our users" to guide decisions alongside business goals.
  • Drive convergence across historically siloed marketing channels, building scale and leverage while maintaining a consistently excellent, trustworthy user experience across all of them.
  • Build, grow, and uplevel a high-performing PM organization spanning growth, data, UX, and platform archetypes — hiring well, developing talent, and partnering closely with senior individual contributors.
  • Operate effectively in a functional matrix, partnering with senior business leaders (including on paid search) where priorities are at times business-driven, while representing user and product interests at every level.
  • Translate company-level strategy into a compelling long-term vision for Growth product, build alignment across cross-functional and executive stakeholders, and create excitement for that vision.
  • Bring a clear point of view on how AI is changing product management and the growth/martech space, and help your organization put that into practice.

What You Should Bring

  • A proven track record leading marketing/growth product organizations at scale in consumer technology, as the senior product leader across a broad, multi-team scope.
  • Deep experience in paid search product, plus meaningful experience in at least one other channel — lifecycle, affiliates/partnerships, or creative — rather than being a single-channel specialist.
  • Comfort operating against large marketing budgets ($100M+), with the commercial and analytical judgment that scale requires.
  • A track record of building and upskilling a product organization — hiring, developing, and growing PMs and PM leaders across different archetypes.
  • Experience navigating genuine trade-offs between user experience and business/marketing goals, with a clear point of view on how to make that call.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience operating in a functional matrix alongside senior business partners.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Bonus: experience working on a marketplace (consumer marketplaces ideal; B2B marketplaces with an SMB focus are also valuable) — supply-and-demand dynamics shouldn't need explaining.
  • Bonus: additional breadth across partnerships/affiliate marketing, creator products, or marketing technology platforms.
  • Bonus: experience with in-house advertising or monetization products is a plus, though not the immediate focus of this role.

How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary

  • Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
  • Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
  • A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.
  • Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events
  • Monthly transportation and fitness budget
  • Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
  • Language reimbursement program
  • Health and wellness benefits

And more…

How To Apply

Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘how we hire’ and ‘life at GetYourGuide’. If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to get in touch at jobs@getyourguide.com.

We’re an equal opportunities employer

Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with your application.

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! Your core responsibilities include auditing, processing, and timely payment of all hotel payments, as well as keeping a proper record of all amounts due to the hotel from guests, concessionaires, tenants, credit card companies, and employees. As an Account Executive, you’re not just supporting the hotel’s financial operations – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Perform essential accounting functions: Execute tasks across Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Payroll, and General Accounting to support financial operations
  • Address questions and disputes: Research and respond to inquiries and partner with internal and external parties to resolve disputes promptly
  • Participate in financial reporting: Assist with the production of monthly accounts, month-end responsibilities, and internal controls over financial data
  • Assist with financial communication: Report financial results and aid in understanding financial matters for both internal and external stakeholders
  • Collaborate for success: Build and maintain cooperative relationships with other finance and corporate departments

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • University degree with 1-2 years of relevant experience.
  • Attention to detail, good communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office with system skills in Check SCM, SUN.
  • A professional accounting qualification would be advantageous.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

You’ll participate in mini-rotations across the disciplines to learn firsthand how to manage various hotel functions and to connect with current and former Voyage participants through our social collaboration tools. The Experience You’ll Gain

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to know our team:

The B2B Pricing team sits within B2B Marketing and partners with Product, Commercial, Finance, and Data Science to define, test, and scale strategies that drive sustainable growth and profitability for Agoda and our partners. We combine deep analytical rigor with an experimentation mindset to optimize across marketing levers (primarily pricing) and advise on growth across B2B2C channels.

The Opportunity:

As Associate Manager/Manager, B2B Pricing & Commercial Strategy, you will own pricing strategy and execution while acting as a consultative, data‑driven advisor to B2B2C growth initiatives. You’ll translate commercial goals into testable pricing and marketing levers, design measurement, and lead cross‑functional rollouts that improve business outcomes. You will work closely with the commercial organization and cross‑functional stakeholders, serving as a go‑to partner for pricing and growth decisions for key partners (e.g., large loyalty programs, marketplaces, and digital wallets such as Rakuten or Paytm).

In this role, you’ll get to:

  • Define and evolve pricing strategies, segmentation, and marketing action for partners.
  • Lead the experimentation roadmap (A/B and multivariate tests), including hypotheses, success metrics, and decision frameworks.
  • Build marketing roadmaps and analyses (elasticity, cannibalization, incrementality) to advise relevant marketing actions.
  • Act as a consultative growth advisor to partner teams: co‑create joint plans, model impact/P&L, align OKRs, and operationalize execution across channels.
  • Build playbooks to scale winning strategies across markets and partners; document learnings and institutionalize best practices.
  • Create Tableau dashboards and crisp executive narratives that synthesize performance, insights, and recommendations; drive action in weekly/monthly reviews.
  • Vendor/Partner Management: Manage relationships with external partners including strategic presentations.

What you’ll need to succeed:

  • 5+ years in data-driven role, revenue/growth, marketing, strategy, or analytics roles in e‑commerce, travel, tech;
  • Strong business acumen and structured problem‑solving; ability to frame trade‑offs, model scenarios, and influence decisions with clear “so‑what.”
  • Fluency with data: advanced Excel, SQL, and Tableau; comfort with large datasets and experiment readouts.
  • Practical experience with controlled experiments.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and communication; able to simplify complex analyses for senior and partner audiences and drive alignment.
  • High ownership and bias for action; thrive in an ambiguous, fast‑paced, test‑and‑learn environment.
  • BA/BS in a quantitative field (e.g., Economics, Statistics, Engineering) or equivalent experience.

It’s great if you have:

  • Building decision frameworks in production.
  • Background in management consulting or internal strategy (e.g., growth, pricing, or partnerships).
  • MBA or advanced degree is a plus; we value equivalent operating experience and measurable outcomes.
  • Familiarity with Python/R for modeling and scaling analysis.
  • Domain exposure to B2B channels, partner/affiliate programs, or wholesale/whitelabel constructs.

Change Management & Adoption

Machine Learning Scientist II – VRBO Pricing
Introduction To The Team
Travel platform pricing and monetization has critical impacts on business health. The Machine Learning Science team is building a scalable and robust system to enable pricing as a lever to optimize business performance. The system should be steered based on desired outputs, such as a given tradeoff between volume and profit. Our work directly decides prices across different lines of business, influencing multi-billion dollar revenue.   
As a Machine Learning Scientist II, you will help to research and build this pricing system. You will work on end-to-end pricing problems. You will collaborate with a strong team of machine learning scientists, data scientists, engineers, product managers, and operation analytics. You will contribute to an area of active scientific research: causal inference using machine learning methods, mixed integer programming, ML-based demand estimation, experiment design with spillovers. 
In This Role, You Will
  • Help to research and implement scalable machine learning and data science solutions end to end with engineering rigor. 
  • Articulate technical solutions and plans to stakeholders.  
  • Follow the latest technology and research and be able to customize them to our problem space. 
  • Guide to solutions using data insights. 
  • Collaborate with other machine learning and data science teams to build a great data science culture in Expedia Group
Minimum Qualifications
  • Advanced degree in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Statistics, Operations Research, Economics) or equivalent professional experience.
  • Hands-on experience in machine learning, operations research, or causal inference.
  • Strong analytical skills for working with complex datasets and generating actionable insights.
  • Proficiency in Python or Scala.
  • Familiarity with big data ecosystems such as Hadoop or Spark.
  • Solid understanding of modern ML and data science techniques and their mathematical foundations.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and effectively.
  • Pragmatic approach to problem-solving.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience in pricing strategies or revenue optimization.
  • Background in large-scale marketplace experiment design and analysis.
  • Exposure to mixed-integer programming and ML-based demand estimation.
  • Knowledge of causal inference methods applied to real-world business problems.
  • Experience collaborating in cross-functional teams with engineers, product managers, and analytics professionals.
The total cash range for this position in Austin is $112,000.00 to $156,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $179,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

This highly visible role requires an effective relationship builder who can influence across functions, confidently engage senior stakeholders, and balance the unique needs of luxury and lifestyle hotels.

Your day-to-day

Hotel Hospitality And Luxury Experience Required

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You will manage designated corporate accounts, develop and solicit new business, drive total hotel revenue from rooms, catering, and F&B outlets, address business needs, explore new opportunities, and expand existing business through promotional efforts and sales channels. As a Senior Sales Manager, you’re not just generating and managing group sales – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

As a Senior Sales Manager (MICE), you will work to maximize revenue opportunities through the sale of conference facility space and guest rooms. A Senior Sales Manager (MICE) will be directly responsible for performing the following task to the highest standards:

  • Review sales and other revenue generating business plans, identify gaps, ensure proactive measures to fill hotel rooms, F&B venues and conference space capacity and meet set targets
  • Contribute to the selling strategy of the hotel and manage the departments so that Team Members adhere to the strategy
  • Support Team with building business pipeline from past clients and generate demand in tangible target (BBOB, Opening Date, and Closing Date).
  • Understand the competitive marketplace and implement approaches to ensure the hotel stays competitive in the local market
  • Ensure the Sales Team is developed effectively and embraces a culture of high-quality standards and proactive selling
  • Receive and convert incoming enquiries to achieve targets and maximize revenue
  • Responds to group RFPs through making proposals and sales presentation to prospective clients as well as explain, negotiate and close hotel sales
  • Accurate data entry of group and meeting enquiries using Delphi FDC
  • Build strong relationships with customers to fully understand their needs
  • Conduct briefings and other meetings as needed to obtain optimal results
  • Sales and telemarketing calls to customers and prospective customers to solicit business, engage sales activities.
  • Conduct property tours, site inspections and host as entertainment for potential clients where relevant and appropriate.
  • Work effectively to build relationships with colleagues in the hotel operations department
  • Drawing up Sales Activity Plan and business leads, submit weekly sales call reports and future week activity plan as per the defined reporting standards as determined by Director of Sales
  • Participate in industry events and represent the hotel at national and international specialist trade fairs and workshops, agreed by the Director of Sales and in co-ordination with the whole Business Development Department.
  • Support Director of Sales in supervising and coaching team members
  • Support Director of Sales in tasks such as team member training and performance related assessments.
  • Perform other duties delegated by Director of Sales and Commercial Director

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • Demonstrates a positive and professional approach to work, with strong communication skills.
  • Demonstrated sales experience in MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences and Exhibitions), with the ability to identify opportunities and achieve business objectives.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret business performance indicators and market or competitive trends.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain client relationships and achieve sales targets.
  • Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
  • Demonstrates accountability, adaptability, and resilience in a fast-paced business environment.
  • Able to work effectively under pressure and manage competing priorities.
  • At least 2 years of relevant experience in a similar sales capacity is preferred.
  • Tertiary qualification or equivalent relevant qualification is preferred.

How We’ll Help You Thrive

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40 USD/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program

Health & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you covered

  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know the Team

Agoda is a digital travel platform headquartered in Asia and part of Booking Holdings. Our technology teams build and operate the products, platforms, and infrastructure that power millions of travel experiences globally.

The Tech Talent Acquisition team plays a critical role in supporting Agoda’s continued growth and innovation. We partner closely with leaders across Engineering, Product, Data, Infrastructure, Security, and other technology functions to attract and hire exceptional talent from across the region and around the world.

We are a high-performing, collaborative, and globally minded team that values speed, quality, data-driven decision-making, and an outstanding candidate experience. Our work goes beyond filling roles—we help shape Agoda’s talent strategy, strengthen our employer brand, and build the capabilities needed for long-term business success.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Talent Acquisition Partner – Tech, you will play a strategic and hands-on role in building Agoda’s technology organization.

You will partner with senior technology leaders and hiring managers to understand business priorities, translate them into effective hiring strategies, and deliver high-quality talent across a range of technical roles. You will manage the full recruitment lifecycle, from workforce planning and talent mapping through to offer negotiation and onboarding partnership.

This role is ideal for an experienced recruiter who is comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment; understands the technical talent market; and can balance strategic stakeholder partnership with strong execution.

You will also contribute to improving how Agoda hires by using market intelligence, recruitment data, experimentation, and process improvement to raise the standard of talent acquisition across the organization.

In This Role, You’ll Get to

  • Partner with senior technology leaders and hiring managers to understand business objectives, workforce plans, team structures, and hiring priorities.
  • Translate business needs into clear recruitment strategies, target candidate profiles, sourcing plans, and hiring timelines.
  • Own the full-cycle recruitment process for technical and technology leadership roles, ensuring a consistent, efficient, and positive candidate experience.
  • Recruit across areas such as Software Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, Product, Infrastructure, Cloud, Cybersecurity, DevOps, Architecture, and other technology disciplines.
  • Build strong relationships with candidates and develop long-term talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.
  • Conduct proactive sourcing, market mapping, talent identification, and competitor research to strengthen Agoda’s access to high-quality talent.
  • Provide hiring managers with market intelligence on talent availability, compensation expectations, role requirements, skills trends, and competitor activity.
  • Advise stakeholders on role scope, job requirements, seniority, interview processes, assessment approaches, and candidate calibration.
  • Manage complex recruitment processes across multiple locations and jurisdictions, including international hiring and relocation where relevant.
  • Assess candidates against both technical requirements and Agoda’s leadership principles, team fit, and long-term potential.
  • Lead candidate engagement, closing, offer negotiation, and pre-joining management for senior and hard-to-hire talent.
  • Use recruitment data and insights to monitor hiring performance, identify risks, and recommend improvements.
  • Contribute to recruitment projects, employer branding initiatives, talent events, sourcing campaigns, interview training, and process improvement programs.
  • Collaborate with other Talent Acquisition Partners and cross-functional teams to share market knowledge, improve hiring practices, and deliver a consistent experience across Agoda.
  • Represent Agoda externally and help position the company as an employer of choice for technology professionals.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • 8–10+ years of experience in end-to-end talent acquisition, preferably within an in-house environment.
  • Demonstrated experience recruiting for technology roles across multiple disciplines and seniority levels.
  • Experience partnering with senior leaders and hiring managers in technology, digital, platform, or similarly complex businesses.
  • Strong understanding of technical talent markets, particularly within software engineering, data, product, infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, or related areas.
  • Proven ability to develop and execute talent acquisition strategies in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Experience recruiting senior-level or leadership talent and managing complex candidate engagement and offer processes.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to challenge, advise, and build trust with senior leaders.
  • Ability to use data, market insights, and structured problem-solving to guide recruitment decisions.
  • Strong sourcing and talent-mapping capability, including the use of LinkedIn and other recruitment channels.
  • Excellent candidate management and closing skills, including the ability to communicate Agoda’s value proposition and secure in-demand talent.
  • Experience supporting international recruitment, relocation, or cross-border hiring would be an advantage.
  • A proactive, adaptable, and solutions-oriented approach, with a strong bias for action.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
  • Experience using recruitment and productivity tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter, applicant tracking systems, job boards, Microsoft Office, PowerPoint, and Excel.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to shape the technology organization of one of Asia’s leading digital travel companies.
  • A highly collaborative, international, and technology-driven working environment.
  • The opportunity to work directly with senior leaders and influence hiring strategy at scale.
  • Exposure to a broad range of technical roles, talent markets, and recruitment challenges.
  • A culture that values ownership, experimentation, continuous improvement, and data-driven decision-making.
  • The chance to make a meaningful impact on both business performance and candidate experience.

Please review our Hiring Process Guidelines before your interview — click here to learn how interviewing at Agoda works.

  • Facebook https://www.facebook.com/agodacareers/

Senior Integrated Marketing Manager (6-month Contract or Gig, start mid-Oct 2026)


At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.


Here, you’ll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors - Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together - help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.


At Expedia Group, our Marketing team connects travelers to our brands through data-driven campaigns, content, and performance strategies. We partner across the whole of marketing, analytics, product, commercial and merchandising teams to drive awareness, engagement, and loyalty.


We are looking for a commercially minded marketing strategist to lead Brand Expedia’s integrated marketing approach for global sales and regional limited-time offers. This role sits at the intersection of brand, business, and traveler needs, leading retail campaigns from early planning through execution and optimization.


In this role, you will


Own the strategy and execution of retail campaigns, including global sales and regional limited-time offers.

Proactively build and manage complex project timelines across creative, production, and channel teams, maintaining clear status updates and ensuring deadlines are met.

Partner across product, merchandising, legal, regional markets, creative, media, analytics, and channel teams to align scope, messaging, timelines, dependencies and execution plans.

Lead channel teams through briefing, asset development, delivery, and execution to ensure campaigns launch smoothly and consistently across touchpoints.

Translate stakeholder input into clear, actionable feedback for creative teams while navigating conflicting viewpoints, reducing ambiguity, and moving work forward.

Use performance data, testing, and global insights to optimize campaigns and improve repeatable ways of working across commercial and lifecycle marketing programs.

Who you are


A strategic and commercially savvy marketer with deep experience in integrated marketing, brand strategy, campaign development, and commercial strategy.

Highly self-directed and comfortable independently driving campaigns from early planning through launch in a complex, cross-functional environment.

Exceptionally detail-oriented, with strong judgment and a bias to drive action.

Experienced in leading cross-functional initiatives across creative, production, product, analytics, merchandising, legal, regional markets, and channel teams.

Comfortable balancing long-term brand building with near-term commercial delivery, while maintaining consistency across global and regional markets.

Highly organized and effective at managing multiple priorities, influencing senior stakeholders, and staying close to execution details.

Preferred experience


9+ years of experience delivering results in global integrated marketing.

Experience leading global or multi-market integrated marketing programs across promotional campaigns and retail moments.

Strong command of messaging development, creative briefing, cross-channel planning, and campaign performance analysis.

Familiarity with travel, e-commerce, marketplace, or consumer technology businesses.

Locations can be Austin, LA or Seattle.


Benefits and perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life


Accommodation requests

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands — Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo — along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group’s Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Title Reservations Manager

Scope of Work As Reservations Manager, I will fully comprehend the vision of Six Senses to help people reconnect with themselves, others and the world around them and our values of local sensitivity and global sensibility, crafted experiences, emotional hospitality, responsible and caring, fun and quirky and pioneering wellness.

Sustainability, Wellness and Out of the Ordinary experiences are at the core of everything we do at Six Senses. I will safeguard these pillars and support their strategic development and implementation and ensure all directives, practices and initiatives are implemented, embraced, adopted within the hotel.

Duties And Responsibilities

As Reservations Manager, I will assume full responsibility for the efficient operation of the Reservations Department, ensuring exceptional service delivery, revenue optimization, and adherence to brand standards and operational procedures.

The duties and responsibilities include:

  • Continually focus on revenue generation and business growth opportunities for the hotel, spa, and Six Senses Tel Aviv.
  • Manage inventory availability, pricing, and daily rate fluctuations in coordination with the Director of Revenue and communicate selling guidelines to the Reservations team.
  • Collaborate with the Director of Revenue and Director of Sales & Marketing to develop and implement pricing strategies that maximize revenue and support the long-term growth of all market segments.
  • Ensure the accurate processing of reservations, amendments, cancellations, and advance deposits.
  • Monitor future room availability and occupancy patterns to maximize inventory utilization and revenue opportunities.
  • Review all reservations daily to ensure complete and accurate guest profiles, reservation details, and rate, market, and source code allocations.
  • Monitor cancellations, no-shows, room blocks, group reservations, and allotments, ensuring appropriate follow-up actions are taken.
  • Ensure compliance with all legal, financial, operational, security, safety, and brand requirements relating to the reservations function.
  • Prepare and analyze reservations and revenue-related reports, identifying trends and recommending actions to improve business performance.
  • Maintain effective collaboration with Revenue Management, Sales & Marketing, Front Office, Guest Experience Maker (GEM), and other operational departments to ensure seamless guest journeys and commercial success.
  • Lead, motivate, train, and develop the Reservations team, ensuring high levels of performance, engagement, and service excellence.
  • Work closely with the GEM team to establish and support shared guest experience objectives, ensuring guest preferences and expectations are accurately captured and communicated.
  • Manage and optimize online distribution channels and booking platforms to ensure rate integrity, availability accuracy, and maximum revenue capture.

Qualifications

To execute the position of Reservations Manager, I must possess the required qualifications, technical skills, and experience to perform the role successfully, including:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum of one year of experience as a Reservations Manager in a luxury hotel environment, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. Three or more years of experience in a similar role preferred.
  • Proven ability to manage reservations operations, optimize revenue opportunities, and lead a high-performing team.
  • Strong knowledge of hotel reservation systems, distribution channels, revenue management principles, and forecasting practices.
  • Exceptional communication, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Fluent in both Hebrew and English, spoken and written; additional language proficiency is an advantage.
  • Demonstrated commitment to delivering exceptional guest service and upholding luxury hospitality standards.

The above is intended to provide an overview of the role and responsibilities for Reservations Manager at Six Senses Tel Aviv. It is not and does not infer that the above is an inclusive and/or exhaustive list of the duties and responsibilities inherent in the position.

Six Senses Tel Aviv is an equal opportunity employer. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment.

Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

🎓 Get qualified for free with a Certificate 3 & 4 in Travel & Tourism (worth 20k!) through Australian Apprentice Training - you may also be eligible to receive direct financial support while you study

🌈 Thrive in a workplace that embraces individualism – come as you are! 

Okay, I’m in!

Are you keen to join our team of Flighties? Hit apply now for your application to be read by a real human, no AI here! If your application is successful, you’ll be invited to have a 15-minute phone interview with one of our dedicated team of recruiters. Get ready to work, travel and grow.

Why is Flight Centre such a great place to work?

We are devoted to being a global employer of choice by nurturing our legendary culture - focused on our people and infused with adventure and accountability. We uplift and support our team through a compelling Employee Value Proposition that offers exciting career and travel opportunities, fantastic benefits, a meaningful sense of purpose and well-deserved recognition.
