Job Title

Manager User Experience (UX) Research & Design

Business Environment

The Manager, UX Research & Design guides and develops a multi-disciplinary team delivering high-quality user experiences across Amadeus Hospitality products. This role shapes UX strategy, aligns research and design practices, supports the growth of UX maturity, and fosters effective collaboration with Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders. You will be responsible for supporting team performance, professional growth, and long-term capability development in alignment with user and business needs.

Main Responsibilities

UX Design & Strategy

  • Provide strategic direction, constructive critique, and quality oversight to support high-quality design outcomes.
  • Ensure alignment with user experience (UX) principles, accessibility standards, and the design system.
  • Influence product scope and prioritization using research insights, data, and design frameworks.

Project & Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Promote early UX involvement across the full product lifecycle.
  • Identify and plan for resource needs in alignment with product roadmaps and domain priorities.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, leadership, and customers to contribute to product direction and experience outcomes.

UX Research

  • Define and align on research strategy, guide methodologies, and ensure insights are actionable and credible.
  • Increase visibility and understanding of UX research across product teams and leadership.

Team Development & Coaching

  • Encourage continuous learning, adaptability, and development within the team.
  • Establish shared expectations, role clarity, and career paths for team members.
  • Provide ongoing coaching, mentoring, and constructive feedback through regular one-to-one discussions.
  • Support the development of competencies in research, design, communication, strategy, and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Delegate thoughtfully and create opportunities for designers and researchers to take ownership of initiatives.

The Ideal Candidate

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human–Computer Interaction (HCI), User Experience, Interaction Design, Psychology, Cognitive Science, Human Factors, Information Design, Computer Science, Business or Management, or a related field.
  • Experience in User Experience, combining design, research, and cross-functional delivery.
  • Experience guiding UX teams, including designers, researchers, writers, or design operations.
  • Demonstrated experience contributing UX leadership in complex software-as-a-service (SaaS) environments, including business-to-business (B2B), business-to-consumer (B2C), or enterprise workflows.
  • Experience designing for multi-platform ecosystems such as web, mobile, customer relationship management (CRM) platforms (e.g., Salesforce), or operational tools.
  • Experience collaborating with product, engineering, and business partners to influence strategy and roadmaps.

Skills & Competencies

  • Advanced interaction and systems design skills, with experience using Figma or equivalent design tools.
  • Solid understanding of information architecture, prototyping, usability testing, and accessibility best practices.
  • Clear and effective communication, facilitation, and storytelling skills.
  • Ability to work through ambiguity and engage senior stakeholders constructively.
  • Understanding of design systems and how to scale user experiences across products.
  • Collaborative approach and ability to work across geographies and disciplines.
  • Clear ownership and accountability.

Diversity & Inclusion

Amadeus aspires to be a leader in Diversity and Inclusion in the tech industry, enabling every employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment, attracting the best talent from all backgrounds, and as a role model for an inclusive employee experience. 

Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer and committed to an accessible recruitment process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law.

Be aware of recruitment scams

Amadeus Group never charges fees, requests payment, or asks for financial information during recruitment. All legitimate opportunities are communicated solely through official Amadeus channels, including our careers website. Any payment request or outreach via unofficial platforms (e.g., WhatsApp, Telegram) should be treated as fraudulent.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know Our Team

Agoda Homes—a core business line within Agoda—supports a wide range of non-hotel accommodation types including serviced apartments, homes, private villas, farm stays, chalets, boats, and more. While these accommodations have always been available on Agoda.com, today’s evolving landscape demands a sharpened focus on expanding supply and elevating quality. Our team builds long-term, cross-cultural partnerships that create exceptional value for Agoda, our partners, and our customers.

The Opportunity

This role is responsible for expanding the supply of non-hotel accommodations in Thailand and Vietnam, strengthening partner relationships, and improving the quality of Homes supply. The ideal Area Manager, Homes Supply has experience in the homes, hotel, or travel industry—especially online travel —and will manage accommodation partners to unlock opportunities for mutual business growth.

The role includes sourcing and acquiring new supply, maintaining and optimizing existing relationships, and combining on-the-ground insights with data analysis to uncover strategic opportunities. You will communicate key findings to internal and external stakeholders and contribute to projects such as developing a host community network to accelerate supply growth. Key responsibilities of the role include managing relationships with our key supply partners in the Thai and Vietnam markets, including ensuring we obtain the best prices and availability for our customers.

This position is based in our Bangkok office. You will work closely with colleagues across regional and central teams, including counterparts within your respecting countries.

In this role, you will be responsible for:

  • Lead the implementation of Homes market strategy in Thailand and Vietnam.
  • Lead, inspire, coach and develop teams to grow our local business.
  • Implement strategies with Homes partners to enhance productivity and opportunities to maintain a competitive advantage.
  • Deliver on country commercial and profitability targets.
  • Work with market leadership on strategic planning and establishing objectives. Develop KPIs to drive strategic priorities.
  • Develop and own relationships with key decision makers at hotels, technology partners and other local or regional partners.
  • Be a champion for the team. Pitch new ideas backed by business case, recommend changes and/or request additional support for commercial improvements.

Please note that responsibilities may evolve based on business needs.

What You’ll Need to Succeed:

  • More than 7 years of professional experience
  • Fluency in English & Thai is required
  • Proven strong leadership skills, team leader and team player is a must
  • Past success in mentoring and building results-oriented and solutions-focused teams that cater to strong team dynamics and collaboration as well as long-term partner relationships
  • Relevant commercial, business development or general management experience
  • Deep numerical and analytical skills and attention to details
  • Strong communications skills to articulate direction, value proposition and recommended solutions to both external partners and internal stakeholders
  • A curious mindset, energized by and adapt well to changes
  • Be creative and innovative
  • Professional “get it done” attitude and work ethic
  • Experience in e-commerce, online businesses, or technology is preferred; a consulting background is a plus.

Please review our Hiring Process Guidelines before your interview — click here to learn how interviewing at Agoda works.

Discover More About Working At Agoda

  • Agoda Careers https://careersatagoda.com
  • Facebook https://www.facebook.com/agodacareers/
  • LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/agoda
  • YouTube https://www.youtube.com/agodalife

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Agoda, we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds and orientations. We prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and innovation. Employment at Agoda is based solely on a person’s merit and qualifications. job.job_description:
Description de l'entreprise

La Maison Sofitel, Sofitel Legend, MGallery & Emblems est la direction générale monde en charge de la performance et du développement des 4 marques d’hôtels de luxe MGallery, Sofitel, Sofitel Legend and Emblems, présentes dans plus de 60 pays, et célébrant des expériences de voyage uniques ancrées dans leurs destinations.

Notre signature : nous encourageons la diversité, l’intelligence collective et émotionnelle. Chaque Talent de «La Maison » s’exprime avec authenticité, joie de vivre dans des environnements inclusifs et a l’opportunité de surprendre nos clients en réalisant des expériences sur-mesure, avec la possibilité d’aller toujours plus loin chaque jour, tout en célébrant la culture locale.

Rejoignez La Maison pour viser l’excellence et vivre pleinement ce qui vous anime !

Description du poste

Notre offre

La Maison Sofitel, Sofitel Legend, MGallery & Emblems repose sur un socle de valeurs définissant notre culture d’entreprise. Ces valeurs fédèrent l’ensemble des collaborateurs autour de la réalisation d'objectifs et de principes communs. Elles définissent la manière dont nous interagissons avec nos clients, collègues et communautés et guident nos comportements.

Nos Valeurs Sont Les Suivantes

  • Passion et fierté : montrer un engagement sans pareil à nos marques, notre clientèle et toutes les personnes avec qui nous travaillons, en faisant preuve d’une certaine intelligence émotionnelle
  • Excellence : un sens des affaires transparent, grâce auquel nous activons tous les bons leviers pour que nos hôtels soient les meilleurs du marché
  • Responsabilité : nous sommes toutes et tous des entrepreneurs responsables et libres
  • Proximité : un esprit familial, qui se traduit par une grande solidarité et réactivité, notamment grâce au dialogue sur le terrain
  • Confiance et transparence : tout partager, sans retenue. Les retours ? Un cadeau dont il ne faut pas se priver
  • Une relation durable : aussi bien avec les propriétaires d’hôtels qu’avec nos talents. Pour créer un sentiment d’appartenance
  • Libre et sur mesure : un service personnalisé, encouragé par les expériences. De quoi dévoiler une nouvelle créativité

Si vous partagez ces valeurs, rejoignez-nous et vous pourrez ainsi vous épanouir en tant que collaborateur d’une équipe solidaire et inclusive.

Une carrière dans laquelle vous pouvez exprimer votre passion

Au sein du département marketing de la Maison MGallery, Sofitel, Sofitel Legend & Emblems, nous recherchons un Senior brand manager Emblems rattaché au VP Marketing MGallery & Emblems Collection.

Vos missions en quelques mots ?

Contribuer au déploiement de la stratégie de marque et du plan marketing associé sur l’ensemble des canaux de communication et de distribution, avec pour objectif de maximiser le capital de marque et d’assurer le succès du lancement.

Enjeu du département Marketing

Créer et promouvoir une image claire et différenciante des marques de la Maison Sofitel, Sofitel Legend, MGallery Collection & Emblems Collection afin de renforcer leur notoriété et leur attractivité.

Que font les Senior brand manager Marketing ?

Ils/elles assistent le VP Marketing à la mise en œuvre de la stratégie et des actions nécessaires à la croissance durable de la marque. Ils/elles s’assurent de sa parfaite expression en interne comme en externe, afin d’en assurer une communication homogène et impactante.

De la stratégie à l’expérience client, en passant par la promotion et les partenariats : ils participent à la définition et exécution de chaque pilier de la marque. La marque ayant été lancé en Novembre 2025, une grande proximité et connaissance des propriétés est attendue pour pouvoir les accompagner et amplifier leur plan marketing et de communication.

Description Du Poste

  • Participer à la mise en œuvre de la stratégie de la marque à travers des plans marketings différenciants, forts et cohérents sur l’ensemble des marchés et cibles clés identifiées
  • Assurer le suivi des campagnes marketing globales à 360° (media, RP, social media, influence, partenariats, CRM) afin d'accroître la notoriété de la marque, dont le pilotage marketing (avec l'aide des Regionals) des ouvertures d'hôtels (France, Italie…) et des temps forts de la marque (salons professionnels type ILTM, événements d'ouverture etc).
  • Etablir une relation saine en transversal avec les agences créatives et media internes comme externes, les équipes réseaux sociaux, influence, RP, media afin d’orchestrer une stratégie de contenu cohérente et forte
  • Accompagner la montée en puissance et modernisation de nos sites internet afin d’accroître leur performance
  • Rédiger et suivre l’implémentation des guidelines ‘expérience client’ propres à la marque
  • Rédiger les standards et guidelines opérationnels de la marque et monitorer leur implémentation au sein des hôtels.
  • Analyser l’évolution des KPIs de la marque afin de mesurer l’impact des actions menées (satisfaction clients, ROI, notoriété, part de marché,…)
  • Soutenir les équipes Développement en valorisant la marque auprès des propriétaires et investisseurs, et contribuer ainsi à la croissance de la collection
  • Soutenir activement les autres équipes transversales (D&TS, Wellbeing, F&B, Commercial, T&C, CSR, Opérations, Achats, Legal, CMI etc.) dans leurs différentes missions afférant à la marque
  • Pratiquer une veille concurrentielle constante
  • Gérer l’aspect administratif de la marque (suivi budgétaire, organisation meetings, etc.)

Qualifications

Votre contribution

  • Vous avez un minimum de 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle acquise dans le domaine du marketing ou de la communication (chez l’annonceur, en agence de publicité ou en cabinet de conseil)
  • Vous connaissez le secteur du luxe et avez une forte appétence pour le monde de l’hôtellerie
  • Vous avez déjà travaillé sur une marque ou un portefeuille de marque avec succès
  • Vous avez l’habitude et aimez travailler avec des agences media, de publicité et communication
  • Vous êtes un bon communicant et êtes à l’aise en prise de parole orale en public, en anglais comme en français. Vous faites preuve de réelles qualités rédactionnelles et d’une sensibilité éditoriale marquée.
  • Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour vos excellentes compétences organisationnelles pour initier, organiser et diriger vos priorités et les projets sur lesquels vous travaillez ou contribuez
  • Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre relationnel et votre capacité à travailler efficacement en équipe
  • Vous avez une capacité à structurer des sujets complexes et de manière synthétique
  • Vous avez une forte capacité de travail sur de multiples projets
  • Vous avez un sens aigu du détail et le goût de l'excellence
  • Vous êtes autonome, créatif et avez l’habitude de conduire des projets 360.

Informations supplémentaires

Postulez maintenant

Laissez votre passion s’exprimer. Rendez-vous sur careers.accor.com

job.job_description:
Job Summary

The Paid Social Manager defines and evolves how paid social media is leveraged across Choice Hotels. This is an individual contributor role within Paid Media Labs, serving as the organization’s hub for channel expertise, innovation, and thought leadership in paid social. This role is responsible for helping evolve how Choice approaches platforms/partners such as Meta, TikTok, Reddit, Snapchat and other social media partners, developing best practices, identifying partner innovation opportunities, and enabling teams to execute at a high level.

This position focuses on defining the “how” and “why” of paid social, ensuring teams are equipped with the right frameworks, partner strategies, and forward-looking POVs to drive both immediate performance and long-term capability building.

  • Note: This role is 4 days onsite in North Bethesda, MD and is not eligible for visa sponsorship now or in the future**

Key Responsibilities

Channel Expertise & Thought Leadership

  • Serve as the in-house SME for Paid Social across platforms (Meta, TikTok, Reddit, Pinterest, and emerging social channels).
  • Recommend and help evolve how Choice Hotels leverages Paid Social across brands, segments, and media programs to drive business outcomes.
  • Develop and maintain forward-looking and backward-looking POVs on:
    • Audience targeting, segmentation, and prospecting vs. retargeting approaches
    • Platform capabilities, automation, privacy changes, and emerging industry trends
  • Collaborate with Creative team on Creative best practices for Paid Social (e.g., video, short-form, and AI-enabled creative)
  • Translate competitive intelligence, platform developments, and industry trends into actionable recommendations that inform channel strategy, planning, and investment decisions.
  • Build strong partnerships with social platforms and agency partners to identify innovation opportunities, benchmark performance, and stay ahead of emerging trends.
  • Serve as a key liaison with the agency Social Media COE to ensure alignment on best practices, testing priorities, and innovation opportunities.

Influence on Strategy & Execution

  • Partner with Paid Media Planning & Activation teams to guide and influence paid social strategies; provide input into annual channel strategy and quarterly media plans
  • Provide frameworks, best practices, and recommendations that support campaign approach and investment decisions.
  • Ensure campaigns reflect best-in-class paid social practices without direct ownership of execution
  • Identify gaps, inconsistencies, or missed opportunities and recommend improvements

Strategic Partnerships & Ecosystem Development

  • Build and maintain relationships with key social platforms (Meta, TikTok, Reddit, Pinterest, and others).
  • Parter with key social platform partners on JPBs focused on:
    • Innovation roadmaps
    • Beta and early access opportunities
    • Partner accountability and value creation
    • Best-in-class capability adoption
  • Ensure platform partners contribute to long-term capability building and not just campaign delivery

Operational Excellence & Capability Building

  • Build repeatable playbooks, templates, and frameworks that improve the consistency, quality, and scalability of the team’s work over time
  • Share what’s working across platforms, bring fresh insights to the table, and collaborate to keep social strategy and content ahead of the curve
  • Contribute to scalable systems and operating improvements that allow the team to focus more energy on higher-impact work
  • Drive adoption of best practices and elevate overall team capability through enablement and knowledge sharing

Testing, Innovation & Insights

  • Lead paid social testing and learning initiatives (e.g. creative testing, incrementality testing, audience frameworks, platform capabilities).
  • Partner with AAT to ensure paid social is accurately represented in measurement approaches
  • Translate platform trends and performance signals into actionable insights and strategic recommendations
  • Surface new opportunities for growth across formats, audiences, and partners

Qualifications

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, or equivalent related experience.
  • 3-5 years of experience in paid social or social media (with emphasis on performance)
  • Deep expertise in social media platforms
  • Experience operating in a strategy, innovation, COE, or SME-type role
  • Proven ability to:
    • Develop channel-level POVs and frameworks
    • Influence cross-functional teams through expertise and recommendations
    • Partner effectively with platforms and agencies to support business objectives

    Technical Skills
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Platform algorithms and automation (e.g. Advantage+, signal-based optimization)
    • Creative strategy and testing methodologies
    • Measurement frameworks (e.g. incrementality, CMM)
  • Familiarity with structured test-and-learn frameworks and experimentation methodologies within performance media.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, for analysis, forecasting, and executive-ready communication.

Additional Skills & Competencies

  • Analytical problem‑solving: Ability to synthesize complex data into clear insights, implications, and recommended actions.
  • Executive communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to deliver clear, executive‑ready narratives.
  • Autonomy & ownership: Comfortable operating with limited day‑to‑day direction while maintaining high accountability for outcomes.
  • Strategic judgment: Ability to balance efficiency and growth objectives and make informed trade‑off recommendations.
  • Cross‑functional influence: Effective collaborator who raises execution standards through POVs, best practices, and shared playbooks.

Salary Range

The salary range for this position is $99,919 - $117,552. In addition to the annual salary, this role is eligible for an annual bonus based on the terms of Choice's Management Incentive Plan (MIP).

Choice prioritizes our associate wellbeing by offering a comprehensive benefits program that is both competitive and flexible to help you achieve your wellbeing goals - here are just a few:

  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Leave and paid time-off for holidays, vacation, personal, family, volunteer, sick, jury duty, bereavement, military, and religious observance
  • Financial benefits for retirement and health savings
  • Employee recognition programs

job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

The Director, Materials Strategy, is a critical leader within Technical Operations responsible for defining and executing the long-term vision for the Materials organization. This leader oversees inventory management, materials planning, material availability, and supply chain performance while driving innovation through advanced analytics, process optimization, automation, and emerging technologies that enhance reliability, efficiency and working capital performance.

Reporting to the Managing Director, Component Operations, the Director serves as a senior functional expert and transformational leader responsible for advancing the Materials organization’s strategy, performance, and long-term capabilities. The role leads a complex, multi-layered organization through general managers and managers, building a high-performing leadership team, strengthening succession readiness, and developing the next generation of Materials and Supply Chain talent.

Success in this role requires deep aviation materials and supply chain expertise, coupled with a forward-looking mindset that leverages data, advanced analytics, AI, automation, and digital technologies to enhance material availability, optimize inventory investment, improve operational reliability, and drive sustained business performance.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and execute the long-term Materials strategy aligned with Technical Operations’ operational, financial, customer, and growth objectives.
  • Serve as the enterprise subject matter expert for aviation materials, inventory optimization, demand planning, and material availability.
  • Build a multi-year roadmap that supports future fleet, maintenance, and MRO growth.
  • Identify emerging industry trends, technologies, and best practices to drive innovation, strengthen supply chain resilience, and sustain competitive advantage.

Operational Excellence

  • Lead enterprise inventory strategy, demand planning, material readiness, supplier performance, and strategic supplier partnerships to ensure operational reliability and supply chain effectiveness.
  • Ensure the right material is available at the right time, in the right location, balancing service, reliability and working capital objectives.
  • Drive Lean, Six Sigma and champion continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Establish and govern performance metrics that drive accountability and continuous improvement across service, reliability, inventory productivity, quality, cost efficiency, and operational effectiveness.

Data Analytics & Technology Leadership

  • Champion advanced analytics, AI, machine learning, and digital technologies to improve decisions and outcomes.
  • Partner with Technology, Engineering, Maintenance, Commercial, Logistics, and Finance to enable predictive decision making.
  • Develop dashboards, KPIs, and tools that provide actionable insights.
  • Lead modernization that simplifies processes, increases automation, and improves user experience.

Talent & Organizational Leadership

  • Lead a large, multi-layered organization through direct reports and second-level leaders, creating alignment, accountability, and focus on strategic and operational priorities.
  • Build a robust leadership pipeline and succession bench to ensure organizational readiness, leadership continuity, and long-term business success.
  • Develop high-performing leaders who effectively balance operational execution, strategic thinking, innovation, and people leadership
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Partner across Engineering, Maintenance, Supply Chain, Logistics, Finance, Technology, Operations Planning, and Commercial.
  • Influence decisions across organizational boundaries and create alignment around enterprise priorities.
  • Communicate effectively with frontline employees, senior leaders, and executive stakeholders.

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Operations, or related field.
  • 10+ years of progressive leadership in aviation materials, supply chain, inventory planning, or related operational functions.
  • Significant experience leading large teams through multiple layers of leadership.
  • Deep understanding of aviation materials, inventory optimization, forecasting, operational planning, and maintenance-driven supply chains.
  • Demonstrated leadership of large-scale operational and organizational transformation.
  • Strong analytical capability and experience using data to drive decisions.
  • Proven delivery of measurable operational, cost, reliability, and customer outcomes.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • This position requires 5 days in office and 25% global travel.
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency.
  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Advanced degree in Business, Supply Chain, Analytics, or related field.
  • Experience implementing AI, machine learning, automation, or advanced analytics.
  • Lean, Six Sigma, APICS, CSCP, or equivalent certification.
  • Experience in airline, aerospace, MRO, manufacturing, or another highly complex operational environment.

Benefits And Perks To Help You Keep Climbing

Our culture is rooted in a shared dedication to living our values – Care, Integrity, Resilience and Servant Leadership – every day, in everything we do. At Delta, our people are our success. At the heart of what we offer is our focus on Sharing Success with Delta employees. Exploring a career at Delta gives you a chance to see the world while earning great compensation and benefits to help you keep climbing along the way:

  • Competitive salary, industry-leading proﬁt sharing program, and performance incentives.

  • Family care assistance through fertility support, surrogacy and adoption assistance, lactation support, subsidized back-up care, and programs that help with loved ones in all stages.
  • Holistic Wellbeing programs to support physical, emotional, social, and financial health, including access to an employee assistance program offering support for you and anyone in your household, free financial coaching, and extensive resources supporting mental health.
  • Domestic and International space-available flight privileges for employees and eligible family members.

job.job_description:
Starte bei uns, um deine großartigen Ideen einzubringen. Und bleibe, weil sie gehört werden.

Wer wir sind

Wir sind Enterprise Mobility, ein familiengeführter, weltweit tätiger Mobilitätsdienstleister mit einem Umsatz von 38 Milliarden US-Dollar, fast 90.000 Mitarbeitenden und Engagement in 95 Ländern. Unter der Leitung von CEO Chrissy Taylor bauen wir das Unternehmen auf eine starke Tradition, die uns die Stabilität gibt, den langfristigen Erfolg unserer Mitarbeitenden, unserer Kund:innen sowie unseres Geschäfts in den Fokus zu stellen. Bei uns erwarten dich Teams, die Vielfalt leben, gemeinsam anpacken und sich gegenseitig unterstützen.

Dein Einstieg bei uns

Als Management Trainee (m_w_d) hast du die Freiheit und Unterstützung, deine Kompetenzen weiterzuentwickeln und deinen Weg in die Filialverantwortung aktiv zu gestalten. Die meisten unserer heutigen Führungskräfte bis hin zu unserer CEO haben ihre Karriere als Management Trainee (m_w_d) begonnen, du lernst bei uns nicht theoretisch, sondern „on the job“, übernimmst Verantwortung vom ersten Tag an und baust so deine Karriere Schritt für Schritt auf.

Aufgaben

Was dich erwartet

Bei uns bist du richtig, wenn du etwas bewegen willst und bereit bist, über dich hinauszuwachsen. Mit einem betriebswirtschaftlichen Studium kannst du dein Wissen direkt in die Praxis umsetzen und auf das nächste Level bringen. Kommst du aus einem anderen Bereich, holen wir dich dort ab, wo du stehst, und bringen dir alles bei, was du brauchst. Du arbeitest in Teams, in denen unterschiedliche Perspektiven geschätzt werden und jede Person die Unterstützung und Wertschätzung erfährt, um ihr volles Potenzial zu entfalten.

  • Du übernimmst früh Verantwortung für das operative Daily Business
  • Du sammelst Erfahrung in Kundenservice, Vertrieb, Business Management und Finance
  • Du baust dein Sales- und Verhandlungsgeschick aus
  • Du baust echte Kundenbeziehungen auf und entwickelst neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten
  • Du entwickelst dein unternehmerisches Denken, von Umsatz bis Kostenkontrolle
  • Du wächst Schritt für Schritt in eine Führungsrolle hinein

Deine Entwicklung

Bei uns zählt Leistung – und die wird gesehen:

  • Abschluss des Trainee-Programms nach durchschnittlich 10 Monaten
  • Im Anschluss erste Beförderung zum Management Assistant
  • Schneller Aufstieg möglich zur Filialleitung in unter 2 Jahren
  • Vielfältige Karrierewege, z. B. in unser Sales Team, HR oder Risikomanagement
Profil

Was du mitbringst

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium
  • Motivation, Dinge anzupacken und Verantwortung zu übernehmen
  • Erfahrung im und Spaß am Kundenkontakt, Vertrieb und Teamarbeit

  • Eine unbefristete Arbeits- und Aufenthaltserlaubnis für Deutschland

  • Fließende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse
  • Deutscher oder EU-Führerschein und 1 Jahr Fahrpraxis,
  • Maximal 3 Punkte im Verkehrszentralregister in Flensburg (Nachweis erforderlich)
  • Kein Verstoß gegen die Straßenverkehrsordnung in Zusammenhang mit Alkohol oder Drogen

Auch spannend: Bewerbungen aus Tourismus, Hospitality oder Sales sind willkommen, egal ob mit Studium oder abgeschlossener Ausbildung mit einschlägiger Berufserfahrung.

Gehe den nächsten Schritt - Klick auf „Jetzt bewerben“, beantworte ein paar Fragen und fertig.
Wir melden uns bei dir und schauen gemeinsam, ob wir zueinander passen.

Noch unsicher? Du musst nicht alle Punkte perfekt erfüllen. Wenn du motiviert bist, und Lust hast dich weiterzuentwickeln, passt du wahrscheinlich sehr gut zu uns. Enterprise ist ein inklusiver Arbeitgeber. Es ist uns wichtig, eine Vielfalt an Mitarbeitenden mit den unterschiedlichsten Hintergründen zu beschäftigen. Auch wenn du aus gesundheitlichen Gründen nicht Auto fahren kannst, suchen wir gemeinsam eine Lösung.

Neugierig auf unsere Benefits? Einen Überblick über unsere Leistungen und Prämien findest du auf unserer Karriereseite: Leistungen und Prämien bei Enterprise Mobility

Senior Growth Marketing Manager, Connectivity

Are you ready to make an impact at the world’s largest online travel platform? Expedia Group’s Supply Marketing Team is responsible for building and developing relationships with lodging, connectivity and transport partners throughout the world, to constantly connect our product offering to our traveller demand. Our marketing team is forward-thinking and high-energy, so we look for people who flourish in a dynamic environment and who are not afraid to roll up their sleeves. Our team is based worldwide, and we thrive on the impact we deliver to Expedia Group’s business.

As the Senior Growth Marketing Manager, Connectivity, you will lead our two-sided go-to-market model, driving Connectivity Provider API adoption on one side and Supply Partner (hotel and vacation rental) usage on the other. You will own growth marketing for Connectivity across the provider and property audiences, from awareness through GA adoption and opportunity capture, and deliver against a quarterly planning and release cadence run in partnership with Product Marketing. This role provides an excellent career growth opportunity, deepening your marketing, account-based marketing (ABM) and people leadership skills with the industry’s largest connectivity providers.

This position collaborates with many internal departments, including Product Marketing (PMM), Field Enablement, Hotel Partner Marketing, VR Partner Marketing, Business Programs, Analytics and Digital Operations, to gather intelligence, define plans, and implement programs that increase provider adoption, partner usage and business growth.

What You'll Do

  • Own and evolve Connectivity Marketing’s two-sided GTM model, balancing Provider Adoption and Supply Partner Use across the Awareness, Pilot and GA phases
  • Lead API adoption, usage and opportunity-capture initiatives, translating provider readiness, ADP revenue signal and partner cohort mapping into scaled marketing programs
  • Determine marketing strategy to accomplish Connectivity’s commercial objectives, flexing as required
  • Build and run the new 1:1 ABM approach for top strategic connectivity providers, and oversee differentiated marketing solutions across CPP Elite/Preferred and long-tail cohorts
  • Partner with Hotel Marketing and VR Marketing to plan and execute cross-LOB Shared Bets, moving oppy capture from ad hoc requests to structured, plan-led campaigns direct to supply partners
  • Lead Connectivity’s quarterly GTM planning and release cadence in partnership with Product Marketing (PMM) and Business Programs, translating Connectivity XLT priorities into a predictable delivery rhythm partners can plan against
  • Establish dependable working relationships with stakeholders, including executive (VP+) level, and build rapport to become a trusted business partner
  • Influence senior leaders, stakeholders and peers to manage initiatives end-to-end successfully, moving others to a preferred alternative where required
  • Partner with Analytics to define and report on account-tiered success metrics (engagement, product/API adoption, commercial impact) and present clear, actionable recommendations

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s in Marketing, Communications, Advertising or a related field; or equivalent related professional experience
  • 8+ years marketing experience
  • Experience developing and implementing successful B2B partner marketing campaigns and programs at scale, ideally across a multi-audience or two-sided GTM model
  • Experience building or running account-based marketing (ABM) programs for strategic, high-value accounts
  • Strong written communication and visual storytelling, with the ability to translate complex product or API concepts into partner-facing narratives
  • Solid understanding of marketing channel mix (email, webinar, Seismic/self-serve, partner-internal comms) and how to sequence channels across a partner lifecycle
  • Comfortable operating in a quarterly planning cadence, balancing committed delivery with a rolling look-ahead signal
  • Ability to work effectively cross-functionally across Product Marketing, Field Enablement, Hotel/VR Marketing, Commercial and Analytics
  • Strong data analysis and insight development skills; able to define and defend success metrics (adoption, usage, commercial impact) to executive stakeholders
  • Message Gears or Salesforce Marketing Cloud email system experience is a plus
  • Preference for previous experience working in a role with a global remit

Driven by creativity, innovation and a passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences, Imagine Cruising continues to evolve its offering and expand its international presence.


In 2026, Imagine Cruising welcomed Travelbag into the business. Bringing together Travelbag’s expertise in tailor-made land holidays with Imagine Cruising’s cruise experiences broadens choice for customers. It also gives Imagine Cruising its first high street presence through Travelbag’s seven UK stores. Driven by creativity, innovation and a passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences, the business continues to evolve its offering and expand its international presence.

We are looking for a commercially minded Finance Director to join our UK leadership team, playing a pivotal role in shaping financial strategy, driving profitable growth and supporting the next chapter of the business's success.


As a Finance Director, Imagine Cruising, your role will be to lead the end-to-end Finance function for Imagine Cruising, acting as the most senior Finance leader in the business. The role is accountable for financial strategy, performance management, governance, control, and cash stewardship, supporting the CEO and leadership team in driving profitable growth and operational efficiency. You will also have to ensure robust financial management across the business, while embedding a high-performance culture and aligning with Group governance and reporting requirements. Based at our Royal Wooton Bassett head office, near to Swindon. This is an office-based role, with business travel required. We are looking for a leader who brings the same energy, ambition and drive that define Imagine Cruising, thriving in a dynamic, and entrepreneurial environment.


In This Role, You Will:

  • Act as a strategic and commercial partner to the Managing Director and leadership team, influencing investment decisions, growth strategy, and business priorities.
  • Lead the end‑to‑end financial planning cycle, including budgets, forecasts, and long‑range plans, aligned to business objectives.
  • Own delivery of EBITDA, PAT, and cash flow targets, providing insightful analysis of performance drivers, risks, and opportunities.
  • Oversee accurate, timely, and insightful management reporting, including monthly management accounts, forecasts, variance analysis, KPIs, cash flow reporting, and quarterly balance sheet reporting.
  • Ensure a strong financial control environment in line with Group Policy, supporting clean internal and external audits and timely statutory reporting.
  • Act as the primary interface with Group Finance, internal and external auditors, and regulatory bodies, including ownership of the CAA relationship and ATOL licence requirements.
  • Maintain balance sheet integrity, regulatory, legal, tax, and HMRC compliance, including Senior Accounting Officer (SAO) sign‑off responsibilities.
  • Lead treasury, cash flow forecasting, liquidity management, working capital optimisation, and banking relationships.
  • Identify and mitigate financial risks, including liquidity, credit, and foreign exchange exposure.
  • Lead delivery of an efficient Finance function, overseeing end‑to‑end Order‑to‑Cash (O2C) and Procure‑to‑Pay (P2P) processes.
  • Drive standardisation, automation, and continuous improvement across finance operations and systems.
  • Own the Finance systems strategy, ensuring effective use, development, and governance of ERP and reporting tools.
  • Lead Finance input into wider business transformation initiatives.
  • Set clear objectives, develop talent, and build a high‑performance, accountable, and collaborative finance culture.


To be considered for the role, you must meet the below requirements:

  • Professional accounting qualification is essential (ACA, ACCA, CIMA, or equivalent).
  • Significant post‑qualified experience, including proven success in a senior Finance leadership role.
  • Demonstrated experience leading multi‑functional Finance teams.
  • Strong background in financial control, reporting, FP&A, and cash management.
  • Experience operating at senior leadership level, with exposure to board‑level engagement.
  • Experience working within a large, complex, global matrix organisation and shared services environment.
  • Experience operating in a multi-country or multi-site environment, with a proven ability to lead, collaborate with and influence geographically dispersed Finance teams.
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to translate financial data into clear business insight.
  • Proven stakeholder management and influencing capability across senior leaders and corporate teams.


You’ll Have An Edge If You Have

  • Prior responsibility for regulatory engagement and statutory licensing environments.
  • Experience leading finance transformation, automation, or ERP enhancement programmes.
  • A track record of improving profit‑to‑cash conversion and capital efficiency.


Salary & benefits

Join our growing team and enjoy a competitive remuneration package, including a contributory pension scheme, flexible salary sacrifice options, private medical cover, life assurance, employee wellbeing support, discounted dental and critical illness cover, preferential travel rates and retail discounts.

🌈 Thrive in a workplace that embraces individualism – come as you are!

job.job_description:
KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is the world’s leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We’re also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

At KAYAK, data is how we make better decisions for travelers and partners alike — and the Commercial Analytics team is at the center of that work. As an Analyst on this globally distributed team, you'll help turn commercial data into clear, actionable insights that directly support revenue decisions across flights, hotels, cars, and advertising, working closely with colleagues across North America, Europe, Latin America, and Asia-Pacific.

This role will be required to work from our Cambridge, MA office at least 3 days per week.

In This Role, You Will

  • Analyze commercial datasets to identify trends, opportunities, and performance drivers across travel verticals including flights, hotels, cars, and advertising
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports using data visualization and reporting tools to give commercial teams timely visibility into business performance
  • Respond to ad-hoc data and analysis requests from commercial teams
  • Monitor data accuracy, troubleshoot discrepancies, and maintain reporting reliability across existing data sources
  • Define and document key performance indicators (KPIs) in collaboration with commercial teams, and build models to support forecasting and goal-setting
  • Collaborate with data engineering and business intelligence colleagues to ensure data quality and translate commercial reporting needs into technical requirements
  • Contribute to global analytics projects such as inventory forecasting, partner-facing reporting tools, and the development of AI-assisted analytics solutions
  • Present findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior commercial leaders.

Please Apply If You Have

  • At least 2 years of experience working with data in an analytical, business intelligence, operations, or similar role — we value demonstrated ability and transferable skills; equivalent experience, training, or self-directed learning is considered
  • At least 2 years of hands-on SQL experience, writing queries to explore and manipulate large datasets
  • Hands-on experience with at least one data visualization or reporting tool (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Superset, Power BI, or a comparable platform)
  • The ability to communicate data findings clearly to people with varying levels of technical background, including in written summaries and presentations
  • Curiosity, attention to detail, and an enjoyment of working through ambiguous problems using data
  • Comfort working in a global, cross-functional environment with colleagues across multiple time zones

To Stand Out, You Also Have

  • Experience with Python or R for data manipulation, automation, or modeling
  • Familiarity with the travel, e-commerce, or digital advertising industry
  • Experience working with AI or agentic analytics tools
  • Exposure to large-scale data warehouse environments (e.g., Trino, Vertica, or similar).

Benefits And Perks

  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year
  • Focus on mental health and well-being:
    • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
    • Company-paid subscription to HeadSpace
    • Company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)
    • No meeting Fridays
  • Paid parental leave
  • Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday
  • Paid volunteer time
  • Focus on your career growth:
    • Development Dollars
    • Leadership development
    • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings
  • Travel Discounts
  • Employee Resource Groups
  • Competitive retirement and health plans
  • Free lunch 2 days per week
  • Fun quarterly events such as boat trips, arcades, ski trips, Thursday socials, and more
There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. The range for this Massachusetts-based role is $90,000-$105,000.

We offer a competitive base salary and benefits including: health benefits; flexible spending account; retirement benefits; life insurance; paid time off (including PTO, paid sick leave, medical leave, bereavement leave, floating holidays and paid holidays); and parental leave benefits. This role is eligible to be considered for an annual bonus.

Inclusion

At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That’s why we’re focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here.

Need an accommodation for the interview, application or on the job? No problem - just give us a heads-up. We’ve got you.

job.job_description:
Hyatt Inclusive Collection se encuentra en búsqueda de tu talento como Supervisor(a) de Contabilidad General | Shared Service Center


Objetivo del puesto

Supervisar y asegurar la correcta ejecución de los procesos de contabilidad general, garantizando el cumplimiento de las políticas contables, fiscales y de control interno, así como la entrega oportuna, precisa y confiable de la información financiera. La posición será responsable de coordinar actividades contables para las propiedades y unidades de negocio asignadas, promoviendo la estandarización de procesos, la eficiencia operativa y el cumplimiento de los niveles de servicio establecidos dentro del Shared Service Center.


Principales funciones:

  • Supervisar las operaciones de contabilidad general y asegurar el registro correcto, completo y oportuno de las transacciones financieras.
  • Coordinar y revisar cierres contables mensuales y anuales, garantizando el cumplimiento del calendario corporativo y de los entregables establecidos.
  • Revisar pólizas contables, provisiones, reclasificaciones, amortizaciones, depreciaciones y demás asientos de cierre.
  • Realizar y validar conciliaciones bancarias, intercompañías y de cuentas de balance, asegurando el seguimiento y resolución de partidas pendientes.
  • Supervisar la integración y depuración de cuentas contables, identificando diferencias, riesgos y desviaciones relevantes.
  • Elaborar, revisar y analizar estados financieros, reportes de resultados, variaciones presupuestales e informes gerenciales.
  • Analizar fluctuaciones mensuales y explicar variaciones significativas contra presupuesto, forecast y periodos anteriores.
  • Asegurar el cumplimiento de las normas contables, fiscales, corporativas y de auditoría aplicables.
  • Coordinar la atención de auditorías internas y externas, preparando información, soportes y conciliaciones requeridas.
  • Dar seguimiento a controles internos e identificar oportunidades de mejora, automatización y estandarización en los procesos contables.
  • Asegurar el cumplimiento de políticas, procedimientos, matrices de autorización y lineamientos de segregación de funciones.
  • Monitorear indicadores de desempeño, tiempos de respuesta, calidad de la información y cumplimiento de acuerdos de nivel de servicio del Shared Service Center.
  • Dar seguimiento a incidencias contables y coordinar su resolución con hoteles, áreas corporativas y equipos de soporte.
  • Liderar, desarrollar y dar retroalimentación al equipo de contabilidad, asignando cargas de trabajo y asegurando el cumplimiento de objetivos.
  • Capacitar al equipo en políticas contables, procedimientos, herramientas y mejores prácticas del área.
  • Participar en procesos de transición, migración e integración de nuevas propiedades o unidades de negocio al Shared Service Center.
  • Colaborar con las áreas de Finanzas, Cuentas por Pagar, Cuentas por Cobrar, Tesorería, Impuestos, Nómina, Compras y Operaciones para asegurar la integridad de la información financiera.
  • Mantener una comunicación efectiva con los equipos financieros de los hoteles y brindar soporte en consultas relacionadas con registros, cierres y conciliaciones.
  • Preparar información financiera y análisis especiales solicitados por la gerencia, contraloría o dirección corporativa.
  • Promover una cultura de servicio, precisión, cumplimiento y mejora continua dentro del equipo.


Requisitos

  • Licenciatura en Contaduría Pública, Finanzas o carrera afín.
  • Mínimo 5 años de experiencia en contabilidad general.
  • Experiencia indispensable en la industria hotelera.
  • Experiencia en Shared Services altamente deseable.
  • Experiencia previa supervisando equipos de trabajo y distribuyendo cargas operativas.
  • Conocimiento sólido de cierres contables, conciliaciones, integración de cuentas, estados financieros y controles internos.
  • Experiencia en análisis de variaciones, provisiones, depreciaciones, amortizaciones y operaciones intercompañías.
  • Conocimiento de normas contables, obligaciones fiscales y procesos de auditoría.
  • Capacidad para trabajar con calendarios de cierre exigentes y múltiples unidades de negocio.
  • Habilidad para analizar información financiera, identificar riesgos y proponer soluciones.
  • Orientación al detalle, organización, sentido de urgencia y enfoque en resultados.
  • Excel intermedio-avanzado, incluyendo tablas dinámicas, fórmulas, cruces de información y manejo de bases de datos.
  • Buen manejo de sistemas ERP como SAP, Oracle, PeopleSoft o similar.
  • Deseable experiencia con herramientas de conciliación, reportería financiera y automatización de procesos.
  • Inglés intermedio-avanzado, deseable para comunicación con equipos regionales y corporativos.

Take ownership of some of the region’s most important local messaging platforms, creating relevant digital experiences that strengthen engagement and commercial performance.   • Create and manage a strong always-on content approach, balancing brand storytelling, loyalty communications and tactical offers while using performance insights to continually improve engagement.
  • Partner closely with technology teams to translate marketing needs into practical solutions and support the evolution of automation, personalisation, customer lifecycle messaging and artificial intelligence use cases.

What We Need From You

We provide a wide range of benefits designed to help you live your best work life. Team mission

We have a seat at the table and are able to navigate between big picture views and an analytical mindset to enable our Management team to make optimal decisions to achieve our company's mission.

But it does not end here - you will also be involved in the quarterly OKR process and Quarterly Business Reviews to turn strategy into execution and see the results come to live.

  • A proactive, detail-oriented approach with strong organizational and time management skills.

Job Description

海外レジャー、法人、団体など複数のセグメントを対象に、各市場特性を踏まえた最適な営業戦略を立案・実行し、ニセコビレッジ全体のビジネスチャンスを最大化することが本ポジションのミッションです。国内外の旅行会社、法人顧客、パートナーとの長期的な関係構築に加え、新規市場の開拓にも積極的に取り組んでいただきます。また、3ホテルそれぞれのブランド力や特色を最大限に活かした提案型営業を通じて、持続的な成長をリードしていただきます。

世界的に評価され、数々の受賞歴を誇る極上のパウダースノーが魅力のスキーリゾート、そして夏には雄大な自然に囲まれた一流ゴルフコースが広がる特別な環境で、国際的な営業キャリアを大きく飛躍させる絶好の機会です。

Responsibilities

【具体的な業務内容】

  • 複数ホテルの商品（宿泊・宴会・レストラン等）の販売・プロモーション
  • 世界中から注目を集めるインバウンド市場（レジャーFITと団体・MICE）の開拓
  • クラスター全体の売上を最大化する営業戦略の企画・実行
  • 成長著しいニセコ市場・競合の分析
  • 既存顧客との信頼関係構築と、新規パートナー開拓
  • サイトインスペクションや現地同行でホテルの魅力を直接紹介
  • Delphi (を活用したアカウント管理
  • 国内外への出張（年数回）

Qualifications

【応募資格】

  • MICE営業経験3年以上
  • 日本語・英語でのビジネスコミュニケーション力（中国語・韓国語ができれば尚可）
  • 高いコミュニケーション力・プレゼンテーション力・交渉力

【求める人物像】

  • 常に先を見据え、自らチャンスを見つけて行動できる前向きな姿勢
  • 課題に直面した際にも解決策を考え、主体的に取り組む問題解決力
  • チームワークを重視し、営業推進部内だけでなく、ホテル内の他部署や、ヒルトン・ワールドワイド・セールスなどの外部チームとも円滑に連携できる方
  • 変化や成長のスピードが早いリゾート市場でキャリアを伸ばしたい方
  • ホスピタリティ業界・旅行業界への興味をお持ちの方

job.job_description:
Job Description

The successful candidate will join the Corporate Learning Centre Department in SIA Human Resources Division. He/she will be responsible for developing and executing holistic and targeted programmes/initiatives to strengthen leadership competencies, and reinforcing pipeline of leaders at the enterprise and business levels.

Key Responsibilities

  • Responsible for the design of an integrated leadership and people development (LPD) curriculum and ensure it is relevant and aligned with organizational leadership strategy and developments. The curriculum also serves as a learning roadmap to inform staff of suitable training through career passages and milestones; and provide relevant training for step-up competencies to equip staff for current and next level of roles and responsibilities.
  • Manage external training consultants to deliver LPD programs, to ensure best-in-class training experience and maximise knowledge application and retention through effective pre and post course reinforcement support.
  • Source and execute leadership and behavioural assessments independently, or together with Talent Management; and curate relevant individualized leadership interventions for senior leaders to close identified competency gaps and equip them for current and future roles. This includes curating suitable leadership and executive programmes, conferences, roundtables, among others, from Centres of Excellence/ Institutes of Higher Learning relevant to individual’s training needs and/or portfolio responsibilities.
  • Co-develop leadership content for senior leader Management Trainers as part of ‘leader-as-coach’ culture, to impart leadership and business knowledge as well as experience back to the Organization and increase engagement across different leader levels.
  • Periodic review of in-house continuing education schemes to ensure relevance and alignment with the organisation’s and national workforce initiatives
  • Ensure continued relevance and best-in-class orientation programme as part of onboarding of new joiners.
  • Increase focus on leadership and people development concerns and competencies across the organisation.
  • Manage all logistics and administration matters, with support from the Learning Shared Services Team, pertaining to leadership training

Requirements

  • Possess a University Bachelor's Degree
  • Minimum 5 years of working experience in a Learning & Development role, preferably in Leadership and People Development and/or Talent Management domains
  • WSA Advanced Certificate in Training & Performance (ACLP) or WSQ Advanced Certificate in Training & Assessment (ACTA)
  • WSQ Diploma in Design and Development of Learning for Performance (DDDLP) or WSQ Diploma in Adult and Continuing Education (DACE), will be an advantage
  • Ability to present well with strong interpersonal and communication skills, with good stakeholder management skills
  • Resourceful, Analytical and good conceptual skills
  • Data Analytical skills

We thank all candidates for your interest in Singapore Airlines, and regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

We welcome people who are at the top of their game, who want to learn and grow with others and who take their work seriously – but not themselves. We’re building an inclusive and uniquely talented team to make sure our customers can be there for all of life’s important moments. Come join us!
job.job_description:
This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in-office.

Whether it’s hotels, rental cars, flights, cruises or packages, our Lines of Business develop the relationships we need to generate great deals and then get them to Priceline and Agoda customers so they can experience all the moments that matter to them.

Why This Job’s a Big Deal

As a Market Manager, your key objective is to maintain and grow Priceline’s network of hotel partnerships and accommodation supply inventory through building, establishing and strengthening account relationships. The Market Manager uses their knowledge of the travel industry, and their experience in sales negotiation, revenue management and data analysis, to increase revenue by optimizing Priceline’s hotel partnerships. Additionally, as a Market Manager you will identify trends, optimize pricing, ensure content competitiveness, and use data to secure business wins that satisfy consumer demand and improve hotel bookings on Priceline.com and Agoda.com websites.

In This Role You Will Get To

  • Build strong hotel supplier relationships and effectively communicate Priceline and Agoda’s value proposition to grow bookings, room nights and revenue in assigned portfolio
  • Evaluate market trends, partner performance, and competitor landscape to ensure the competitiveness of Priceline and Agoda’s products
  • Analyze data to identify business growth opportunities across assigned portfolio
  • Conduct ongoing reviews of production with hotel accounts and present strategic recommendations to optimize Priceline and Agoda accommodation availability, content competitiveness and hotel performance, using a consultative approach
  • Prioritize, plan and implement effectively to meet/exceed defined targets and goals
  • Identify, prioritize, negotiate, contract and onboard non-participating hotels, ensuring favorable terms and conditions
  • Research and troubleshoot pricing and availability competitiveness issues preventing hotels from optimizing booking performance
  • Educate and train hotel partners on Priceline and Agoda systems, tools, programs and reporting
  • Collaborate with internal partners to execute business initiatives and drive market strategy
  • Prepare presentations and materials to present at both external and internal meetings
  • Represent Priceline and Agoda in assigned market(s), participate in industry organizations and events, and establish relationships with key local influencers

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent, in any relevant field
  • 4+ years professional experience in sales; travel industry experience preferred
  • Demonstrated success acquiring & building long term customer relationships
  • Strong sales negotiation skills and ability to creatively “think on the fly” when negotiating with hotel partners
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to influence external and internal stakeholders
  • Hungry, determined, motivated, solution-oriented, and results-focused
  • A great teammate with demonstrated leadership skills, a professional “get it done” attitude, and strong work ethic
  • Ability to multitask effectively, change gears quickly, and thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
  • Strong critical thinking, data analysis and data visualization skills
  • Possesses self-awareness, a sense of curiosity and a growth mindset
  • Comfortable in two-way feedback culture and challenging the status quo
  • Flexibility to travel up to 30% for partner/market visits and team meetings
  • Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust.
  • The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics is essential.

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. In addition to a competitive base salary, certain roles may be eligible for an annual bonus and/or equity grant.

The salary range for this position is $70,000-$90,000.

Who We Are

WE ARE PRICELINE.

Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.

Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.

We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.

Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.

If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!

Flexible work at Priceline

Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.

Inclusion is a Big Deal !

To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.

Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.

Applying for this position

We're excited that you are interested in a career with us. For all current employees, please use the internal portal to find jobs and apply.

External candidates are required to have an account before applying. When you click Apply, returning candidates can log in, or new candidates can quickly create an account to save/view applications.

job.job_description:
Founded in the Queensland outback in 1920, Qantas has grown to be Australia’s largest regional, domestic, and international airline. Qantas has a range of subsidiary businesses that support the overall operations of the Group. The Qantas Group’s main business is the transportation of customers and freight using two complementary airline brands — Qantas and Jetstar — operating regional, domestic, and international services.

Job Description

  • Challenge yourself to an exciting career within the Qantas Group
  • Together we’ll achieve complete analysis of planning support
  • A 18-month secondment role located at the Qantas Supply Chain

Our ability to stand the test of time has been no coincidence. We’ve come this far because we continue to evolve. It’s a challenge that never ends and drives every individual in our team to make tomorrow better than today for our customers.

Qantas Engineering keeps us at the forefront of aviation, caring and maintaining both the Qantas fleet, as well as aircraft for our customers across the Asia-Pacific region. Working with state-of-the-art equipment and resources, our shared commitment to professional excellence continues to keep our customers safe.

As a Principal Planning Analyst - Components, you will lead a small team in the management of parts under contract that support the Qantas mainline fleet, ensuring contracted part availability targets are met to support On-Time Performance (OTP). This involves managing parts that are contract and modification. You will also monitor supplier performance by working with stakeholders to resolve shortages and improve reliability, as well as contribute to improvement initiatives such as system upgrades and fleet modification programs.

This role is a mix of hands-on supply chain operations and contracted supplier engagement, requiring strong analytical skills, process discipline, and the ability to collaborate across Qantas Engineering and with external suppliers.

You’ll have –

  • Degree qualified, with experience in supply chain planning, purchasing or inventory management
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience in demand planning and inventory optimisation
  • Strong understanding of planning, purchasing, and inventory control principles
  • Confident using a variety of computer systems, particularly inventory planning tools, Microsoft Excel, and Access
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Proven ability to build and maintain relationships at senior levels, with a strong stakeholder management approach
  • Demonstrated leadership capabilities, including experience managing and leading teams
  • Strong analytical and financial acumen, with effective problem-solving skills
  • A proactive mindset with a focus on continuous improvement

Why Qantas?

You’ll join a team where creativity and passion are encouraged. Our people come together to allow us to dream big and deliver successfully. There are many different opportunities across our team, which means you’ll be able to grow both personally and professionally at Qantas. Your development is a priority for us – so that you can maintain the high standards our customers have come to expect and can continue to develop over time. You’ll be supported from day 1 with on the job training and coaching as well as our formal training opportunities. While you may start in this role, we’ve got a great track record of supporting our people to take their career in so many different directions, the destinations are endless.

The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.

  • We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 14 weeks paid parental leave and the option to purchase additional paid leave for eligible employees.
  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.
  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.
  • We’re constantly evolving, and this means the opportunities for our people are endless. In every role there’s the opportunity to embrace personal development and career growth, ownership of projects, and the ability to make an impact.

Qantas is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity and inclusion. If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at time of application.

If you’re ready to step into a culture that will challenge and excite you, submit an application and let’s explore how we go places together.

To apply please upload your resume only, no cover letter required

Applications close: Sunday 25th October 2026

Summary of Position

This position is responsible for all aspects of full-service and a la carte meeting and incentive programs of various size and scope. The primary responsibility is to manage all facets of the planning process and be the primary point of contact for Events customers. This individual must be able to travel on-site and to client meetings as requested by the account.

Schedule / Shift

Standard

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Program management from concept to completion; to include meeting and striving to exceed program goals, and objectives, contracting with suppliers, creating cost estimates for budget purposes, program execution and reconciliation.
  • Lead discovery calls to engage customer and learn about the meeting needs focusing on the goals and objectives of the program. Include all internal stakeholders.
  • Make destination recommendations; submit RFP’s through Cvent for a diverse group of customers with consideration of the program goals, objectives, budget and space requirements.
  • Produce accurate documents/reports for clients and vendors in conjunction with account needs.
  • Conduct effective vendor negotiations and contract execution to include terms, due dates, cost savings and concessions for hotel/venue, ground transportation, DMC, audio-visual production, food & beverage, optional activities and other suppliers contributing to the success of the program. Facilitate contract execution between the parties in a timely manner.
  • Provide meeting owner/requester a summary of all terms, due dates, total costs and deposits to meet and exceed program timelines and deadlines.
  • Record accurate budget, cost, savings and contract execution in Cvent or applicable technology.
  • Ability to travel on-site with programs as needed. While on-site, employee should maintain a professional demeanor and project a positive reflection of Event Travel Management.
  • Manage program reconciliation, invoicing, accounts payable, and accounts receivables for each program; when applicable. Follow-up to ensure timely payment processing and revenue reconciliation.
  • Provide exceptional service and manage the relationship with the meeting owner. Proactively offer professional recommendations to the client based on industry knowledge and expertise. Secure repeat business.
  • Utilize time tracking for accurate billing by project.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Leadership Responsibilities

  • This position does not have supervisory responsibilities.

Required of all CTM Positions

  • Embrace CTM’s core values of Connect, Evolve and Deliver.
  • Professional, collaborative and supportive interaction with employees, clients, suppliers and vendors.
  • Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
  • Appropriate and professional written and verbal communication.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines, handle and prioritize simultaneous requests.
  • Creative and analytical thinking with strong problem-solving and consultative skills.
  • Demonstrates calm under pressure – is a proactive contributor and eager to learn.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Ability to do basic math.
  • Ability to read and interpret information.
  • Attention to detail.
  • Regular and reliable attendance.

Education and Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent is required.
  • Minimum of five (5) year's event/meeting planning experience required.
  • A CMP and/or CMM designation is preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Demonstrate a collaborative work style by using a consultative approach with clients, and peers, to quickly assess information, anticipate issues and outcomes, and make effective recommendations including ability to draw clear conclusions. Escalate to leadership for guidance when necessary.
  • Strong knowledge of domestic and international destinations, hotel brands and venues.
  • General working knowledge of RFP, registration technology and on-line booking tools utilized in Events.
  • Identify process efficiency opportunities and challenge the status quo. Work with leadership team on efficiency opportunities, account specific best practices and continual enhancements.
  • Ability to work evening hours, weekends and longer hours during high volume periods.
