job.job_description:
About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

The Tripadvisor Experiences Engineering team is distributed across Europe and is responsible for the platform, mobile apps and all their supporting infrastructure. We run the systems that help operators build their businesses and those which enable third parties to utilise our inventory. We provide the tools which help our customer services team provide world class service to travellers and operators internationally.

About The Role

We're looking for a Principal Product Engineer who pairs deep engineering craft with strong product instincts. You'll work across the stack - mobile, web, backend - wherever the highest-leverage problem happens to live that quarter. You don't wait for a perfectly scoped ticket; you partner with product, design, and data to figure out what's worth building, then ship it end-to-end.

We expect breadth. We also expect real depth in the mobile app ecosystem - our customer-facing experiences live there. But we're not hiring a mobile only specialist. We're hiring a generalist with mobile chops who can lead an iOS architecture review on Tuesday and untangle a backend latency regression on Wednesday.

What You'll Do

  • Identify, scope, and ship the changes that move business metrics - across mobile, web, services, and data layers
  • Architect long-lasting systems that hold up under real production conditions: performance, reliability, scalability, offline behavior, consistency
  • Lead technical design reviews across teams, weighing trade-offs not just in code but in product impact, time-to-ship, and operational cost
  • Drive operational maturity wherever it's weakest - release management, observability, incident response, performance monitoring - including in the mobile apps
  • Partner with PMs, designers, and engineering leaders to shape what we build, why, and in what order; you're a peer in those conversations, not a downstream implementer
  • Set the technical bar for the org by example: write the prototype, prove the pattern, then teach it
  • Communicate trade-offs clearly to engineers, product partners, and senior stakeholders

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years of software experience, with significant time still spent hands-on in code - track record of shipping product-impacting work end-to-end, not just owning a layer
  • Real depth in the mobile app ecosystem (iOS and/or Android, with strong fluency in Swift and/or Kotlin and the surrounding ecosystem - offline sync, push, auth, persistence, networking, REST/GraphQL) - and credible breadth beyond it
  • Demonstrated breadth: you've worked seriously in at least one of {web frontend, backend services, data/infra, platform tooling} alongside mobile, and can hold your own in code review there
  • Strong product judgment: you've made calls about what not to build, and can defend them with evidence
  • Comfort troubleshooting in production across stacks - crash analysis, latency tracing, release-health debugging
  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration; you make the people around you better

Nice to have

  • Background in marketplaces, bookings, or other transactional consumer products
  • Time spent close to data - experimentation, analytics instrumentation, or ML-adjacent work

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. The Voyage Global Leadership Development Program

Voyage: Training tomorrow’s leaders today

Marriott International welcomes recent university graduates to experience the career development adventure of a lifetime and a world of leadership opportunities. Our global leadership development program, Voyage, propels participants on a mentored, learning-inspired journey to prepare you for a successful career. Voyage is a full-time, paid development program. As an associate and trainee, you’ll build upon the skills you developed in school by participating in real world assignments.

Ready to embark?

To become a Voyage participant, you must have graduated with a degree from a university or hotel school within the last 2 years ie. on or after March 2025. If you are currently enrolled in a college/university with an expected graduation date within 12 months of the date of application may also be considered.

Other qualifications/requirements include:

  • Bachelors or Masters degree required (Associates degree acceptable for Culinary). Your application confirms you meet the above degree requirement.
  • Superior critical-thinking & interpersonal communication skills
  • The ability to foster relationships & work collaboratively
  • The ability to self-manage & be a self-starter
  • A real desire for personal & professional growth
  • Fluency in local language may be required
  • All candidates need to have the right to work in the country to which they are applying for with the exception of the United Arab Emirates (work visa provided)

About The Journey

Voyage is an elite, award-winning program that provides a combination of hands-on, discipline-specific training and a leadership-focused curriculum. The program takes place at a Marriott International managed hotel, not a classroom, and is offered in 50+ countries.

Voyage is a leadership development programme, but we do expect you to show you are ready to take on those added responsibilities. Proactivity, open communication and teamwork are all crucial in performing and showcasing you are ready for your next step.

When you join Voyage, you gain access to Marriott’s senior leaders and coaches and have many opportunities to stand out. You’ll participate in mini-rotations across the disciplines to learn firsthand how to manage various hotel functions and to connect with current and former Voyage participants through our social collaboration tools. Each individual’s Voyage journey is unique, spanning 12-18 months dependent upon your career interests, passions, goals, and location. You’ll immediately be immersed in our rich culture and portfolio of global brands to learn how Marriott sets the standard of industry excellence.

The Experience You’ll Gain

Voyage participants learn by doing! You’ll be fully immersed in the day-to-day operations of a hotel. If accepted into this elite program, you will:

  • Cultivate customer relationships
  • Be a champion for innovation within the organization
  • Get exposure to managing projects & people
  • Improve processes & pitch new initiatives through your Voyage project
  • Take on special projects that will draw upon all your training

Destination: Marriott leadership

You’ll participate in management meetings and collaborate with Voyage participants worldwide. You’ll be expected to solve challenges, as well as offer ideas and innovative solutions. You will also have an opportunity to provide feedback on your curriculum and have an impact on future Voyage hires’ experiences. After graduation, you’ll be well-prepared to pursue your passion and take on new challenges. Many program graduates are ready to step into a Marriott supervisory or entry-level management role right away, because the program has provided a foundation for future leadership.

Application Process

  • Online Application (closes 1st December)
  • Paradox Video Interview
  • Management Assessment
  • Recruiter Screen
  • Final Interview with hotel

Purpose of the Role

Associate Manager - Training Consultancy & Delivery is responsible for leading a team of Training Consultants who design, deliver, and optimize customer learning solutions that drive product adoption, operational excellence, and measurable business outcomes.

This role combines people leadership, customer consultancy, learning strategy, and service delivery management to ensure customers receive high-quality, value-driven training services. The successful candidate will develop a motivated and collaborative team, build trusted relationships with customers and stakeholders, and continuously evolve training services to meet changing business and customer needs.

As a trusted partner to customers and internal stakeholders, the Manager plays a key role in capability development, customer success, service excellence, and the ongoing growth of the Training Services portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Training Consultants to deliver effective learning solutions and meaningful customer outcomes.
  • Cultivate a culture of teamwork, ownership, customer focus, and ongoing learning.
  • Manage team priorities, capacity, and resources to ensure efficient and high-quality service delivery.
  • Partner with customers to understand business goals, identify capability gaps, and recommend practical learning and adoption strategies.
  • Oversee the successful full lifecycle delivery of training programs across assigned customers, projects, and regions.
  • Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders and provide consultative guidance on learning and capability development.
  • Track training effectiveness, adoption, and impact using relevant measures and ongoing feedback.
  • Identify opportunities to expand and improve training services, contributing to customer growth and value realization.
  • Collaborate with Customer Success, Consulting, Product, Sales, and Support teams to align learning initiatives with business priorities.
  • Drive ongoing enhancement of training services, methodologies, tools, and delivery practices.
  • Lead and contribute to improvement and innovation initiatives supporting the Training Services portfolio.
  • Promote knowledge sharing, best practices, and cross-functional collaboration throughout the organization.

Relevant Experience

  • Strong leadership, coaching, and team development skills with the ability to support and motivate engaged teams.
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, and collaboration skills, including interactions with senior customers and business leaders.
  • Solid understanding of customer objectives and ability to translate them into effective learning and capability development solutions.
  • Experience in learning strategy, training needs analysis, program design, and delivery of instructor-led, virtual, blended, and digital learning.
  • Experience managing complex programs, projects, and service delivery while balancing expectations, quality, and business needs.
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess learning effectiveness and impact using data-driven insights and feedback.
  • Effective planning and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in an evolving environment.
  • Excellent communication, change leadership, and continuous learning mindset, with the ability to work effectively across global and multicultural teams.

job.job_description:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Area Director, Franchise Performance, Core Brands is responsible for driving the commercial performance of a portfolio of midscale and upper midscale franchised hotels. Acting as a trusted advisor to hotel owners, operators, and management companies, this role leverages revenue, market, and operational performance data to identify opportunities for growth and profitability.

The Area Director develops and influences execution of strategic commercial action plans that improve RevPAR, market share, ADR, occupancy, revenue growth, and owner profitability. Through a combination of on-site consultations, virtual engagements, business reviews, and cross-functional collaboration, the role aligns hotel performance strategies with company initiatives and available resources.

This position partners closely with Revenue Management, Sales, Marketing, Loyalty, Distribution, Brand, and Operations teams to support commercial excellence and sustained portfolio growth while fostering strong franchisee relationships and driving program adoption.

NOTE: To be considered for this position, candidates must currently reside in the Northeast/New England region. Relocation assistance is not available for this role. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates who meet the position requirements and location criteria.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Commercial Performance Management & Strategic Advisory

  • Serve as a strategic commercial advisor to hotel owners and operators, using hotel, portfolio, and market data to identify revenue opportunities and performance improvement initiatives.
  • Conduct property visits, performance reviews, and business consultations that connect revenue strategy, sales activation, marketing, distribution, loyalty participation, guest experience, and operational execution to profitable growth.
  • Influence stakeholder adoption of agreed-upon commercial priorities through clear accountability, performance goals, and follow-through.
  • Evaluate market demand, competitive positioning, business mix, pricing strategy, distribution effectiveness, and sales performance to prioritize the highest-value opportunities.
  • Develop action-oriented recommendations that improve revenue generation, profitability, market share, and long-term owner value.

Revenue & Market Performance Accountability

  • Drive improvement in portfolio and hotel-level commercial metrics, including RevPAR, RevPAR Index, ADR, occupancy, revenue growth, and profitability.
  • Analyze performance trends, pace reports, demand drivers, channel contribution, competitive intelligence, and market dynamics to guide performance strategies.
  • Partner with Revenue Management resources and hotel leadership to align pricing, inventory, forecasting, and segment strategies with evolving market conditions.
  • Monitor commercial dashboards and performance indicators, proactively identifying risks and adjusting strategies to improve outcomes.
  • Escalate performance concerns and recommend corrective actions when business objectives are not being achieved.

Commercial Resource Activation

  • Coordinate targeted support from Revenue Management, Sales, Marketing, Loyalty, Distribution, Brand, and Operations partners based on individual hotel opportunities and needs.
  • Increase engagement and participation in proprietary revenue-generating programs and initiatives.
  • Measure and assess the effectiveness of resource activation by evaluating business impact, program participation, and performance improvements.
  • Ensure hotel teams understand and leverage available corporate resources to maximize commercial results.

Data-Driven Consultation & Business Influence

  • Translate complex operational and financial data into actionable recommendations for owners and hotel leadership teams.
  • Utilize internal and external performance tools, dashboards, benchmarking resources, and business intelligence platforms to quantify opportunities and inform decision-making.
  • Apply trusted-advisor consultation practices to align stakeholders around commercial priorities, investments, and execution commitments.
  • Measure effectiveness through performance improvement, owner engagement, action-plan completion, and program adoption.
  • Maintain expertise in industry trends, market conditions, competitive activity, and company commercial initiatives.

Owner & Stakeholder Relationship Management

  • Lead recurring performance discussions with hotel owners, management companies, and property leadership teams.
  • Build credibility and trust through commercial expertise, responsiveness, and sound business judgment.
  • Document commitments, action items, and strategic decisions while ensuring accountability and follow-through.
  • Provide leadership with insights regarding revenue performance, ownership engagement, competitive threats, and emerging business risks.
  • Serve as a primary relationship holder within the assigned portfolio and territory.

Administration & Organizational Support

  • Maintain accurate documentation of consultations, performance plans, ownership interactions, and commercial initiatives within company systems.
  • Submit timely and accurate expense reporting.
  • Support franchise growth, retention initiatives, and participation in relevant franchise associations and industry activities.
  • Share market intelligence, best practices, and emerging opportunities with franchisees, peers, and corporate stakeholders.
  • Participate in special projects and other organizational initiatives as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Employment Experience

  • Minimum fifteen (15) years of progressive hotel industry experience with significant responsibility for commercial strategy, revenue performance, sales, marketing, revenue management, or multi-property performance improvement.
  • Minimum ten (10) years of hotel leadership experience, preferably including franchise performance, revenue management, commercial leadership, or multi-unit operational responsibility.
  • Demonstrated success improving hotel commercial performance, including revenue growth, RevPAR, market share, and owner profitability.
  • Proven ability to influence business decisions through analytical insights and strategic consultation.
  • Experience working effectively within a matrixed organization and influencing outcomes without direct authority.

Technical Skills

  • Strong analytical, forecasting, and financial acumen.
  • Experience utilizing hotel performance and business intelligence tools, including revenue, financial, market share, and benchmarking platforms.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to analyze and interpret large datasets and translate findings into practical business recommendations.
  • Knowledge of hotel revenue management principles, sales activation strategies, distribution channels, marketing performance, loyalty programs, and profitability metrics.

Additional Skills & Competencies

  • Exceptional consulting, communication, negotiation, and influencing skills.
  • Strong executive presence and ability to communicate effectively with hotel owners and senior leaders.
  • Ability to balance multiple priorities while managing a geographically dispersed portfolio.
  • Strong relationship-building and stakeholder-management capabilities.
  • Demonstrated commercial acumen and strategic thinking.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and adapt priorities within a changing business environment.
  • Commitment to organizational values, integrity, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree in Hotel Management, Business Management, Marketing, Finance, or a related field or equivalent combination of education and work experience.
  • MBA preferred.

OTHER REQUIREMENTS:

  • Regular travel of approximately 70% is required.
  • Participation in conferences, owner meetings, special projects, and organizational initiatives as needed.
  • Ability to travel independently throughout the assigned territory

COMPENSATION & SALARY RANGE:

Salary Range: $99,919 to $117,000 annually

This role is also eligible for an annual bonus under Choice’s Management Incentive Plan (MIP).

Pay ranges listed are what Choice Hotels reasonably expects to pay. Actual pay may be higher or lower and ranges may be adjusted in the future. Pay positioning within the range is influenced by factors including—but not limited to—education, experience, skills, certifications, performance, geographic location, business needs, seniority, and travel requirements.

Choice prioritizes our associate wellbeing by offering a comprehensive benefits program that is both competitive and flexible to help you achieve your wellbeing goals - here are just a few:

  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Leave and paid time-off for holidays, vacation, personal, family, volunteer, sick, jury duty, bereavement, military, and religious observance
  • Financial benefits for retirement and health savings
  • Employee recognition programs
  • Discounts at Choice hotels worldwide

About Choice

Choice Hotels International, Inc. (NYSE: CHH), is one of the largest lodging franchisors in the world. With 7,500 hotels in 45+ countries and territories, we offer a range of high-quality lodging options in the upper upscale, upper midscale, midscale, extended stay, and economy segments. We’re the hotel company for those who choose to bet on themselves — the striver, the dreamer, the entrepreneur — because that’s who we are, too.

At Choice, we are united by the simple belief that tomorrow will be even better than today — for associates, our company, and our franchisees. At our worldwide corporate headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, at our technology center in Scottsdale, Arizona, and through our associates around the globe, every voice is heard and every idea is listened to, no matter what area of the company they come from. We are united in supporting the entrepreneurial dreams of our thousands of franchise owners, which propels us forward — giving our work at Choice a purpose larger than our business.

Our corporate office locations:

North Bethesda, MD — Located at Pike & Rose, our worldwide headquarters is less than 15 miles from Washington, D.C., one block away from the North Bethesda Metro station, with easy access to I-495, complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Scottsdale, AZ — Located at the northwest corner of Loop 101, the Scottsdale office is home to our technology, eCommerce and customer service organizations, with easy access to complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Minneapolis, MN — Select roles are based in our Minneapolis office on Highway 394, near the intersection with Highway 100, only five minutes from downtown.

Field/Remote — Select roles designated as field/remote will require associates to work from a home office, connecting virtually with Choice team members and leadership on Zoom, with possible required travel depending on the role.

Choice’s Cultural Values

Welcome and Respect Everyone | Be Bold | Be Quick | Listen | Be Curious | Show Integrity

Choice’s Leadership Principles

Act with Intention | Lead with Authenticity | Grow & Deliver

job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

The Product Owner for Crew360 will play a key role within the Crew Technology organization, helping shape the strategy, prioritization, and continuous improvement of the Crew360 platform. This role builds on strong digital analytics and user experience insight capabilities, using Quantum Metric and other tools to understand user behavior, identify friction points, and translate data into product decisions and enhancements across crew-facing web and mobile experiences. In addition to leading insight generation, this role will work closely with cross-functional partners to define priorities, support delivery decisions, and help ensure Crew360 evolves in ways that improve usability, reliability, and business value for Delta’s crew members.

  • Help define, prioritize, and refine product needs for the Crew360 platform in partnership with Product Management, Engineering, UX, and business stakeholders.
  • Translate user behavior data, business needs, and operational priorities into clear recommendations that inform the product roadmap and backlog.
  • Support decision-making on enhancements, tradeoffs, and feature priorities to improve the digital crew experience.
  • Serve as a key connector between analytics insight and product action, helping ensure identified issues and opportunities are translated into meaningful improvements.
  • Use Quantum Metric and other analytics tools to monitor, diagnose, and optimize user journeys across Crew360 web and mobile applications.
  • Translate complex behavioral and performance data into actionable insights that improve user experience, reliability, and effectiveness.
  • Identify key trends, pain points, and opportunities through quantitative analysis and user behavior mapping.
  • Develop a strong understanding of crew workflows and user needs to inform both analysis and product recommendations.
  • Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, UX, and business stakeholders to align on needs, priorities, and solution direction.
  • Present data stories, product insights, and recommendations in clear, concise formats tailored to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Build trusted relationships across teams to support informed, insight-driven product decisions.
  • Serve as a subject-matter resource for Crew360 digital experience insights and product improvement opportunities.
  • Partner with the Digital Analytics team to support tagging strategies, dashboard creation, data exploration, and KPI monitoring.
  • Ensure accuracy, consistency, and completeness of analytics instrumentation across Crew360 experiences.
  • Validate analytics implementations and collaborate with engineering teams to enhance tracking and measurement capabilities.
  • Help identify and close gaps between measurement, product priorities, and execution.
  • Identify measurement gaps and recommend enhancements to instrumentation, tagging, and data quality processes.
  • Develop and refine frameworks for measuring digital experience success across Crew360.
  • Proactively explore new analytics features, product practices, and best practices to advance Crew Technology’s digital and product maturity.
  • Recommend and help shape improvements that support a more effective, intuitive, and reliable Crew360 experience over time.

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States.
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency.
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.
  • 3–5+ years of experience in digital analytics, product analytics, product ownership, or related roles.
  • Hands-on experience with Quantum Metric or comparable experience analytics platforms.
  • Strong ability to analyze quantitative data, identify patterns, and develop clear insights and recommendations.
  • Experience collaborating in cross-functional product or technology environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to work through ambiguity, balance competing priorities, and independently identify next steps.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decisions across technical and business teams.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience supporting both mobile and web applications.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Computer Science, Business, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Familiarity with agile product development processes and backlog refinement.
  • Experience writing or shaping product requirements, user stories, or enhancement priorities.
  • Experience with SQL, Python, or visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI).
  • Prior exposure to airline operations or crew-focused technology environments.

Benefits And Perks To Help You Keep Climbing

Our culture is rooted in a shared dedication to living our values – Care, Integrity, Resilience and Servant Leadership – every day, in everything we do. At Delta, our people are our success. At the heart of what we offer is our focus on Sharing Success with Delta employees. Starte bei uns, um deine großartigen Ideen einzubringen. Und bleibe, weil sie gehört werden.

Wer wir sind

Wir sind Enterprise Mobility, ein familiengeführter, weltweit tätiger Mobilitätsdienstleister mit einem Umsatz von 38 Milliarden US-Dollar, fast 90.000 Mitarbeitenden und Engagement in 95 Ländern. Bei uns erwarten dich Teams, die Vielfalt leben, gemeinsam anpacken und sich gegenseitig unterstützen.

Dein Einstieg bei uns

Als Management Trainee (m_w_d) hast du die Freiheit und Unterstützung, deine Kompetenzen weiterzuentwickeln und deinen Weg in die Filialverantwortung aktiv zu gestalten. Die meisten unserer heutigen Führungskräfte bis hin zu unserer CEO haben ihre Karriere als Management Trainee (m_w_d) begonnen, du lernst bei uns nicht theoretisch, sondern „on the job“, übernimmst Verantwortung vom ersten Tag an und baust so deine Karriere Schritt für Schritt auf.

Aufgaben

Was dich erwartet

Bei uns bist du richtig, wenn du etwas bewegen willst und bereit bist, über dich hinauszuwachsen. Mit einem betriebswirtschaftlichen Studium kannst du dein Wissen direkt in die Praxis umsetzen und auf das nächste Level bringen. Kommst du aus einem anderen Bereich, holen wir dich dort ab, wo du stehst, und bringen dir alles bei, was du brauchst. Du arbeitest in Teams, in denen unterschiedliche Perspektiven geschätzt werden und jede Person die Unterstützung und Wertschätzung erfährt, um ihr volles Potenzial zu entfalten.

  • Du übernimmst früh Verantwortung für das operative Daily Business
  • Du sammelst Erfahrung in Kundenservice, Vertrieb, Business Management und Finance
  • Du baust dein Sales- und Verhandlungsgeschick aus
  • Du baust echte Kundenbeziehungen auf und entwickelst neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten
  • Du entwickelst dein unternehmerisches Denken, von Umsatz bis Kostenkontrolle
  • Du wächst Schritt für Schritt in eine Führungsrolle hinein

Deine Entwicklung

Bei uns zählt Leistung – und die wird gesehen:

  • Abschluss des Trainee-Programms nach durchschnittlich 10 Monaten
  • Im Anschluss erste Beförderung zum Management Assistant
  • Schneller Aufstieg möglich zur Filialleitung in unter 2 Jahren
  • Vielfältige Karrierewege, z. B. in unser Sales Team, HR oder Risikomanagement
Profil

Was du mitbringst

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium

  • Eine unbefristete Arbeits- und Aufenthaltserlaubnis für Deutschland

  • Fließende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse
  • Deutscher oder EU-Führerschein und 1 Jahr Fahrpraxis,
  • Maximal 3 Punkte im Verkehrszentralregister in Flensburg (Nachweis erforderlich)
  • Kein Verstoß gegen die Straßenverkehrsordnung in Zusammenhang mit Alkohol oder Drogen

Auch spannend: Bewerbungen aus Tourismus, Hospitality oder Sales sind willkommen, egal ob mit Studium oder abgeschlossener Ausbildung mit einschlägiger Berufserfahrung.

Gehe den nächsten Schritt - Klick auf „Jetzt bewerben“, beantworte ein paar Fragen und fertig.
Wir melden uns bei dir und schauen gemeinsam, ob wir zueinander passen.

Noch unsicher? Du musst nicht alle Punkte perfekt erfüllen. Wenn du motiviert bist, und Lust hast dich weiterzuentwickeln, passt du wahrscheinlich sehr gut zu uns. Enterprise ist ein inklusiver Arbeitgeber. Es ist uns wichtig, eine Vielfalt an Mitarbeitenden mit den unterschiedlichsten Hintergründen zu beschäftigen. Auch wenn du aus gesundheitlichen Gründen nicht Auto fahren kannst, suchen wir gemeinsam eine Lösung.

職務内容および責任

ビジョンと価値観

クオリティ・マネージャーとして、Six Sensesのビジョンである「人々が自分自身、他者、そして周囲の世界とのつながりを取り戻せるよう支援すること」を深く理解し、以下の価値観を体現します。

  • 地域への感性とグローバルな視点（Local Sensitivity and Global Sensibility）
  • 心に残る体験の創造（Crafted Experiences）
  • 感動を生むおもてなし（Emotional Hospitality）
  • 責任感と思いやり（Responsible and Caring）
  • 楽しさと個性（Fun and Quirky）
  • ウェルネスにおける先駆性（Pioneering Wellness）

また、Six Sensesにおいて「サステナビリティ（持続可能性）」「ウェルネス」「唯一無二の体験（Out of the Ordinary Experiences）」は、すべての活動の中核を成しています。私はこれらの重要な柱を守り、その戦略的計画および発展を推進し、ホテル内のあらゆる活動・取り組み・運営において実践・浸透されるよう努めます。

運営上の責任

クオリティーマネージャーは以下の業務を遂行します。

  • ホテルにおける品質基準およびブランド基準の策定、導入、維持
  • 品質保証プログラムを統括し、一貫性のある卓越した運営品質を確保
  • 各種品質監査（LQA、衛生監査、OPS監査など）の実施および管理を行い、測定可能な改善を推進
  • ゲストフィードバックやレビュー分析を通じて傾向や改善機会を特定し、GM向けのアクションプランを作成
    • 現地で収集したフィードバック
    • HeartBeat／Medallia
    • ソーシャルメディア
    • Eメール など
  • グローバル、リージョナル、およびホテルのリーダーと連携し、必要に応じて是正措置および予防措置を実施
  • ブランド基準、サステナビリティ、ウェルネス、衛生基準および法令要件への準拠を確保
  • 品質体制の構築、オープン準備、ブランド導入に関して主要関係者へ助言・支援
  • 全部門において継続的改善と学習の文化を推進
  • サービス品質をゲストエクスペリエンスおよびブランドプロミスと整合させる
  • データやKPIを活用し、パフォーマンス管理およびベストプラクティスの比較分析を実施
  • サステナビリティ、ウェルネス、オペレーション、トレーニング部門と連携し、包括的な品質向上を推進
  • 品質関連研修プログラムおよび監査ツールの開発を支援
    • 人事トレーナーとの連携
    • Train the Trainerの実施
    • HOT（Heads of Teams）の支援
  • 成功事例、革新的な取り組み、教訓などを他施設と共有する仕組みを推進（ニュースレター等）
  • 品質に関するホテル内ミーティング、監査、パートナー評価においてホテルを代表
  • GMの戦略的な意思決定を支援するため、定期的な品質レポートおよび分析結果を提供
  • 品質に関連する全事項について、GM、EC（Executive Committee）、HOTsとの連絡窓口として機能
  • ホテル全体および賃貸プログラム対象のブランドレジデンスを含む、すべての運営エリアに重点を置く

必要なスキル・経験

私は以下の資格・経験を有します。

  • ホテルマネジメントの学位、または同等の学歴・職務経験
  • オペレーショナル・リーダーシップ職での勤務経験
  • IHGシステムに関する高度な理解と運用責任経験（理想として5年以上）
  • Six Sensesの理念およびブランド価値への深い共感
  • あらゆるレベルの従業員を指導し、影響を与えた実績
  • 英語力（必須）
  • その他の外国語能力があれば尚可

備考

  • 勤務日や勤務時間は、事業運営上の必要性、繁忙期・閑散期、および現地の労働法令に基づいて決定されます。
  • 本ポジションでは、長時間の立ち仕事や歩行を伴う場合があります。
  • 業務内容は運営上の要件に応じて変更される可能性があります。
  • 業績評価は、本職務記述書に定められた責任および業務内容に基づいて行われます。
  • 業務関連の会議やイベントへの出張が求められる場合があります。Duties and Responsibilities
  • Vision and Values

As a Quality Manager, you will fully comprehend the vision of Six Senses to help people reconnect with themselves, others, and the world around them, and embody the following values:

  • Crafted Experiences

  • Sustainability, Wellness, and Out of the Ordinary Experiences are at the core of everything we do at Six Senses. you will safeguard these pillars and support their strategic planning and development, ensuring that all activities, initiatives, and operational practices are implemented and embraced throughout the property.
  • Operational Responsibilities
  • The Quality Manager will be responsible for the following:

  • Represent the property in quality-related meetings, audits, and partner evaluations.
  • Provide regular quality reports and insights to the General Manager to support strategic decision-making.
  • Act as the primary liaison to the General Manager, Executive Committee (EC), and Heads of Teams (HOTs) on all quality-related matters.

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Hotel Manager, you’re not just overseeing day-to-day hotel operations – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:

  • Manage hotel operations: Oversee the overall functioning of the property, with direct oversight of operational performance.
  • Act as the General Manager delegate: Assume full operational leadership responsibilities in the absence of the General Manager
  • Maximize performance and satisfaction: Drive operational efficiency, profitability, and service excellence to ensure a high level of guest and team member satisfaction. Partner with commercial and finance leadership to maximize sales opportunities and financial control
  • Oversee quality and service initiatives: Implement and manage daily quality assurance processes to enhance the guest experience and ensure alignment with brand standards
  • Communicate with key stakeholders: Partner with hotel owners and corporate leadership to align business goals and operational strategy
  • Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

About The Team

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
  • Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
  • Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
  • Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
  • Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
  • Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Generous paid time off (PTO) – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters most
  • Health & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family covered
  • Financial security for your future – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what’s next
  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

Through our innovative technology, we make travel affordable and accessible for all, helping millions of travelers each year experience the moments that matter most. job.job_description:
This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in-office.

Associate Market Manager

Whether it’s hotels, rental cars, flights, cruises or packages, our Lines of Business develop the relationships we need to generate great deals and then get them to Priceline customers – so they can experience all the moments that matter to them.

Why This Job’s a Big Deal

As an Associate Market Manager, your key objective is to develop and maintain Priceline’s network of hotel partnerships and accommodation supply inventory through building, establishing and strengthening account relationships. The Associate Market Manager demonstrates their knowledge of the travel industry, and their experience in sales negotiation, revenue management and data analysis, to increase revenue by optimizing Priceline’s hotel partnerships. Additionally, this role is expected to identify trends, optimize pricing, ensure content competitiveness, and use data to secure business wins that ensure consumer demand on both Priceline.com and Agoda.com storefronts.

In This Role You Will Get To

  • Build strong hotel supplier relationships and effectively communicate Priceline and Agoda’s value proposition to grow bookings, room nights and revenue in assigned portfolio
  • Prioritize, plan and implement effectively to meet/exceed defined targets and goals
  • Analyze data to identify business growth opportunities and ensure the competitiveness of Priceline and Agoda’s products by evaluating market trends, partner performance, and competitor landscape
  • Conduct ongoing reviews of production with hotel accounts and present strategic recommendations to optimize hotel performance, using a consultative approach
  • Identify, prioritize, negotiate, contract and onboard non-participating hotels, ensuring favorable terms and conditions
  • Research and troubleshoot rate and availability issues preventing hotels from improving booking performance
  • Educate and train hotel partners on Priceline and Agoda systems, tools, programs and reporting
  • Collaborate with internal partners to complete business initiatives and drive market strategy
  • Prepare presentations and materials to present at both external and internal meetings
  • Represent Priceline and Agoda in assigned market(s), participate in industry organizations and events, and establish relationships with key local influencers

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent, in any relevant field
  • One to three years’ experience in sales; travel industry experience preferred
  • Demonstrated success acquiring & building long term customer relationships
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to influence external and internal collaborators
  • Strong sales negotiation skills and ability to creatively “think on the fly” when negotiating with hotel partners
  • A great teammate with a professional “get it done” attitude and work ethic
  • Adapts well to change and thrives in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong critical thinking and data analysis skills
  • Possesses self-awareness, a sense of curiosity and a growth mindset
  • Comfortable in two-way feedback culture
  • Flexible to travel for partner visits and meetings
  • Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust.
  • The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics is essential.

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. In addition to a competitive base salary, certain roles may be eligible for an annual bonus and/or equity grant.

The salary range for this position is $55,000-$70,000K USD.

Who We Are

WE ARE PRICELINE.

Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.

Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.

We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.

Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.

If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!

Flexible work at Priceline

Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.

Perks & Benefits At Priceline

Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:

Health & wellness coverage including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources

Generous time off including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days

Work/life support including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)

Financial security programs such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts

Signature travel perks including employee-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits

Additional perks & discounts like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits

A people-first culture with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together

Specific benefits and programs vary by location.

Inclusion is a Big Deal!

To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.

Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.

Applying for this position

We're excited that you are interested in a career with us. For all current employees, please use the internal portal to find jobs and apply.

External candidates are required to have an account before applying. When you click Apply, returning candidates can log in, or new candidates can quickly create an account to save/view applications.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team:

Agoda is a travel booking platform and accommodation is at our core. As our accommodation partners are a key to our success, we work hard to ensure their success. That is why the Strategic Accounts Management (SAM) team in Agoda specializes in account management. We serve as consultants, offering strategic advice on how best to excel on Agoda’s commercial platform. We are direct contributors to what makes Agoda one of the market leaders because we understand accommodation needs and offer innovative solutions. From Bangkok to London and beyond, our team has footprints in over 50 locations around the world. With the help of industry-leading technology, we work and collaborate globally to bring together the best ideas from diverse perspectives. The SAM team invests in long-term relationships that spans borders and cultures and results in incredible value for Agoda, our partners, and our customers.

 

The Opportunity:

As a Strategic Account Manager, you will be the main contact between our accommodation partners and Agoda, with the responsibility of nurturing the relationship with our key supply partners and driving mutual growth. A key responsibility in developing our business is the ability to identify and acquire new sources of supply and product offerings within an assigned territory while maintaining existing relationships.

 

In this Role, you’ll get to:

  • Develop long lasting relationships with key supply partners to enable Agoda’s growth in the region
  • Maintain regular and meaningful engagement with Agoda’s key supply partners
  • Analyze large datasets to propose tailor-made solutions to Agoda’s supply partners
  • Leverage analytical and problem-solving skills to identify new opportunities to grow Agoda’s business
  • Train and inform clients of both new and existing technologies, tools, and models
  • Prepare materials to aid in growing our business during partner meetings
  • Respond to partners requests in a timely and effective manner
  • Gain buy-in from relevant stakeholders to execute strategies and help launch promotional campaigns to enhance productivity and maintain Agoda’s competitiveness
  • Leverage product offerings to match market demands to maximize our ability to convert passive customers into active ones
  • Deliver on country KPIs, growth targets and country strategic initiatives
  • Support the Area Manager in preparing country reporting for senior stakeholders

 

What you’ll Need to Succeed:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Minimum 3 – 5 years of experience in business development and/or account management
  • Strong interpersonal skills & ability to influence both external / internal stakeholders
  • Experience in internet/e-commerce preferred
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Team player with a professional “get it done” attitude and work ethic
  • Proven success in acquiring, building & maintaining long term customer relationships
  • Adapts well to change and able to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to create new, innovative ideas
  • Strong Proficiency in English

 

It’s Great if you have:

  • MBA or Master’s degree
  • Experience in Travel industry

The Facilities Manager is responsible for leading the operational performance, maintenance, compliance, and long-term asset strategy of a portfolio of purpose-built student accommodation communities. Reporting to the Portfolio Manager, this role provides leadership across building operations, contractor management, capital works, sustainability initiatives, and regulatory compliance, ensuring safe, efficient, and customer-focused environments from pre-opening through ongoing operations while supporting exceptional resident experiences.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead building operations, essential services, and maintenance strategies across a multi-property accommodation portfolio.

  • Drive WHS, risk management, emergency preparedness, and building regulatory compliance initiatives.
  • Oversee maintenance budgets, capital works projects, and long-term asset lifecycle planning.
  • Foster strong stakeholder relationships while delivering exceptional resident and customer experiences.

Skills And Experience

  • Strong technical expertise across HVAC, fire safety, electrical, security, plumbing, and building systems.
  • Demonstrated success managing contractors, maintenance programmes, compliance obligations, and service delivery standards.
  • Sound knowledge of WHS legislation, risk management frameworks, and statutory building requirements.

At Accor, we welcome you as you are. We help you grow and learn, so that work brings purpose to your life. By joining Accor, every chapter of your story is yours to write, and together we can imagine tomorrow's hospitality. Accor is an inclusive company, building diverse teams across the globe.

job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

Delta Air Lines leads the global travel industry with its SkyMiles loyalty program, delivering a rich suite of benefits and experiences for millions of SkyMiles Members worldwide. The SkyMiles program is central to Delta’s welcoming, elevated and caring brand promise, helping deepen customer engagement and reward high-value Members throughout the travel journey. SkyMiles is seeking an individual who will be responsible for redemption strategy and analysis through analyzing retail and award booking data, booking trends and customer behavior. Additionally, this individual will project manage the implementation of new award initiatives that seek to both optimize award revenue for Delta and improve SkyMiles Member satisfaction (NSAT) with award value. This position will interact regularly with CE&L leadership and work collaboratively with Delta's commercial teams such as Revenue Management. This position will be based in Atlanta, GA.

  • Lead development and execution of our Award redemption strategy and merchandising, in partnership with Revenue Management, Finance, Digital and other Commercial teams
  • Project manage new award initiatives, working with Product, Digital and IT teams to improve award utility for SkyMiles Members
  • Strategically evaluate and propose changes to redemption policy and products
  • Demonstrate strong technical skills including quantitative and qualitative analysis, financial insight, data analysis, model building and scenario planning for the purpose of building business cases for new redemption initiatives
  • Optimize the value and experience we deliver to SkyMiles Members, driving increased satisfaction (NSAT) while balancing the business implications of redemption and financial impact to Delta
  • Monitor and analyze award customer value (CV) trends and changes in the competitive landscape by producing regular reporting on award CV for both Delta and other airlines (OA)
  • Evaluate and analyze new redemption capabilities for SkyMiles Members, including both air and non-air products
  • Identify and analyze award redemption trends, such as changes in customer behavior, key revenue drivers, top destinations, etc. to optimize award revenue and customer value

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States.
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency.
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.
  • Must be performing satisfactorily in current position
  • 3+ years of relevant work experience in Revenue Management, Loyalty or another Commercial function required
  • Must have superior analytical skills and be fluent in Microsoft Office software (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
  • Must have working experience with SQL, SAS, Hyperion/Brio and Tableau
  • Must be comfortable regularly communicating results and analysis to leadership through decks/presentations, as well as through e-mail and in-person meetings
  • Must possess strong financial, economic, analytical, oral, and written communication skills
  • Ability to apply a customer-focused mindset when evaluating business impact
  • A self-starter that is intellectually curious and demonstrates a strong passion for Loyalty
  • Creative, innovative, and flexible in responding to constantly evolving needs and priorities
  • Ability to work in an autonomous, fast-paced environment with continual change and manage several responsibilities that demand a high degree of initiative, drive, and time management

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience with, and/or an understanding of, loyalty programs and Delta’s Revenue Management systems and processes
  • Prior experience working in Digital or Product teams and/or a strong understanding of Delta’s product and technology prioritization processes

Benefits And Perks To Help You Keep Climbing

Our culture is rooted in a shared dedication to living our values – Care, Integrity, Resilience, Servant Leadership, and Teamwork – every day, in everything we do. At Delta, our people are our success. At the heart of what we offer is our focus on Sharing Success with Delta employees.

Benefits

Exploring a career at Delta gives you a chance to see the world while earning great compensation and benefits to help you keep climbing along the way:

  • Competitive salary, industry-leading proﬁt sharing program, and performance incentives
  • 401(k) with generous company contributions up to 9%
  • Paid time off including vacation, holidays, paid personal time, maternity and parental leave
  • Comprehensive health beneﬁts including medical, dental, vision, short/long term disability and life beneﬁts
  • Family care assistance through fertility support, surrogacy and adoption assistance, lactation support, subsidized back-up care, and programs that help with loved ones in all stages
  • Holistic Wellbeing programs to support physical, emotional, social, and financial health, including access to an employee assistance program offering support for you and anyone in your household, free financial coaching, and extensive resources supporting mental health
  • Domestic and International space-available flight privileges for employees and eligible family members
  • Career development programs to achieve your long-term career goals
  • World-wide partnerships to engage in community service and innovative goals created to focus on sustainability and reducing our carbon footprint
  • Business Resource Groups created to connect employees with common interests to promote inclusion, provide perspective and help implement strategies
  • Recognition rewards and awards through the platform Unstoppable Together
  • Access to over 500 discounts, specialty savings and voluntary benefits through Deltaperks such as car and hotel rentals and auto, home, and pet insurance, legal services, and childcare

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Sales Manager, you’re not just generating and managing group sales – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:

  • Generate and convert new business: Research, prospect, and qualify leads through proactive outreach and database mining to drive group sales and exceed lead generation goals
  • Build and maintain client relationships: Serve as the primary contact for assigned market segments, nurturing existing accounts and developing new ones to grow room revenue and overall profitability
  • Develop targeted sales strategies: Analyze hotel and market trends to create and execute business plans and marketing initiatives that capture demand and meet sales goals
  • Lead end-to-end sales process: Prepare proposals, conduct site visits, negotiate terms, and secure contracts tailored to client needs while maximizing revenue
  • Manage booking details: Coordinate customer requirements including room, food and beverage, and meeting space, and ensure accurate and timely entry of account and reservation information in the hotel’s sales management system
  • Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

About The Team

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
  • Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
  • Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
  • Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
  • Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
  • Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to know our team

The B2B Digital Marketing team sits within Agoda’s B2B Marketing organization and is responsible for delivering high‑quality, scalable marketing campaigns for our partners across B2B2C channels. We work closely with Commercial, Product, Data, and regional Marketing teams to ensure campaigns are efficiently executed, performance is clearly measured, and partners receive actionable, data‑driven recommendations that drive value for both Agoda and our partners.

Our mission is to balance operational excellence with growth impact — building repeatable, scalable frameworks that allow us to support dozens of partners at once, while still delivering insights tailored to each partner’s performance and business context.

The role

As Manager, B2B Digital Marketing, you will own the end‑to‑end marketing delivery for partner campaigns, manage a small team, and play a critical role in shaping how we operate and scale partner marketing. This role sits at the intersection of people management, analytics, process optimization, and value creation. You’ll ensure campaigns run smoothly and efficiently, while also continuously improving performance through insight‑driven recommendations, standardized frameworks, and better tools.

What you will be doing

Campaign Delivery & Partner Marketing

  • Own the delivery of B2B partner marketing campaigns across channels, ensuring timely execution, high quality, and consistent standards.
  • Oversee campaign planning, setup, monitoring, and post‑campaign analysis.
  • Ensure partners receive clear insights on performance and actionable recommendations to improve outcomes.

Process Management & Optimization

  • Design, improve, and document end‑to‑end marketing delivery processes to increase efficiency, reliability, and output quality.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks and drive continuous improvement through tooling, automation, and clearer workflows.
  • Establish SLAs, quality checks, and governance to ensure campaigns run smoothly at scale.

Analytics, Insights & Value Creation

  • Analyze campaign performance to understand what works, what doesn’t, and why.
  • Identify drivers of success across partners and campaign types (e.g., formats, targeting, budget allocation, creatives).
  • Translate insights into practical recommendations that increase campaign effectiveness and average value per partner.
  • Use data to prioritize efforts and guide partners toward higher‑impact marketing actions.

Scalable Frameworks & Tooling

  • Build standardized frameworks, playbooks, and tools that allow the team to manage and improve tens of partners simultaneously.
  • Balance standardization with flexibility by enabling customizable recommendations based on partner performance data and business context.
  • Partner with Data, Product, and Marketing Ops to scale solutions through dashboards, templates, and self‑serve tools where possible.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Manage, coach, and develop 2 direct reports; set clear goals, structures, and feedback loops.
  • Communicate confidently with internal stakeholders and external partners, simplifying complex data into clear narratives and next steps.
  • Act as a trusted point of contact for B2B marketing delivery and performance discussions.

What you’ll need to succeed

  • 5+ years of experience in data‑driven marketing, operations, analytics, consulting, or growth roles, ideally in tech, e‑commerce, travel, or B2B environments.
  • Consulting experience is a strong plus
  • Strong SQL skills (must‑have) with the ability to independently analyze large datasets and draw clear conclusions.
  • Proven experience improving processes, frameworks, or operating models in a complex or scaling environment.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to connect data to business impact and practical recommendations.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills — able to influence, educate, and align both internal teams and partners.
  • People management experience or clear readiness to manage and develop others.
  • Bachelor’s degree

It’s great if you have

  • Background in management consulting, internal strategy, or operations excellence roles.
  • Experience building standardized playbooks or scalable partner programs.
  • Familiarity with marketing performance metrics and experimentation concepts.
  • Experience working with dashboards (e.g., Tableau or similar BI tools).
  • Exposure to B2B, affiliate, partner marketing, or marketplace models.

How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

The Software Technical Program Manager, Inflight Entertainment & Connectivity Platform is responsible for leading complex software development, systems integration, and platform delivery programs supporting Delta's Inflight Entertainment & Connectivity (IFEC) ecosystem, including Next Generation Inflight Entertainment initiatives. The role serves as the primary program leader coordinating technology, business, operational, and vendor stakeholders to successfully deliver strategic software products and platform capabilities while ensuring alignment with business objectives, project governance standards, quality requirements, schedules, and budgets.

  • Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of complex software development, platform modernization, and systems integration programs supporting Delta's IFEC ecosystem and customer-facing technology initiatives.
  • Manage program scope, schedules, budgets, resources, risks, dependencies, governance processes, and change control activities to ensure successful program execution and delivery outcomes.
  • Coordinate and influence cross-functional teams including Technology, Product, Business Operations, Engineering, Development, Quality Assurance, Scrum teams, vendors, and executive stakeholders to drive alignment and accountability.
  • Develop and maintain integrated program plans, roadmaps, milestones, release schedules, resource plans, risk registers, and executive communications to support strategic decision making and project success.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives for software delivery, Agile practices, project governance, operational effectiveness, and stakeholder communication while ensuring compliance with Delta project management methodologies and standards.

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States.
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency.
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.
  • Advanced technical program and project management expertise.
  • Strong knowledge of software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies and Agile delivery frameworks.
  • Experience leading enterprise software and systems integration initiatives.
  • Program governance, risk management, and issue resolution expertise.
  • Roadmap planning, release management, and resource planning capabilities.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Executive-level communication and presentation skills.
  • Stakeholder management and influencing skills within matrix organizations.
  • Experience working with cloud technologies, web services, integrated software platforms, and embedded systems.
  • Strong ability to manage competing priorities and drive accountability across teams.
  • Vendor and partner management capabilities.
  • Ability to lead cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience delivering IFEC, platform, product development, or regulated industry technology programs.
  • Quality assurance and technology operations experience.

Benefits And Perks To Help You Keep Climbing

Our culture is rooted in a shared dedication to living our values – Care, Integrity, Resilience, Servant Leadership, and Teamwork – every day, in everything we do. At Delta, our people are our success. At the heart of what we offer is our focus on Sharing Success with Delta employees.   • 401(k) with generous company contributions up to 9%
  • Paid time off including vacation, holidays, paid personal time, maternity and parental leave

  • Domestic and International space-available flight privileges for employees and eligible family members

  • Business Resource Groups created to connect employees with common interests to promote inclusion, provide perspective and help implement strategies

Overview

The Accounts Receivable (AR) Coordinator for business to business accounts is responsible for prioritizing assigned accounts and making daily calls to accounts with balances past thirty (30) days to collect and/or address disputed items.

This position will be in person in Tulsa, OK with the option to work a hybrid schedule. Working hours will be Monday through Friday with an 8 hour set schedule work day between the hours of 7:00am-6:00pm.

We offer a robust Benefits Package including, but not limited to:

  • Competitive Compensation - This position offers targeted 1st year annual compensation of $37,500 with an average 40 hour work week.
  • Paid Time Off, starting with 12 days off per year
  • Health, Dental, Vision insurance; Life Insurance; Prescription coverage
  • Employee discounts on car rentals, car purchases and much more!
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match and profit sharing

Privately held by the Taylor family of St. Louis, Enterprise Mobility together with its affiliate Enterprise Fleet Management manages a diverse fleet of 2.4 million vehicles and accounted for nearly $38 billion in revenue through a network of more than 9,500 fully-staffed neighborhood and airport rental locations in more than 90 countries and territories.

We are committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. Candidates should expect identity verification, video interviews, technical validation of skills, and verification of employment, education, and work authorization. Falsification of information, proxy interviewing, or misrepresentation of experience or location will result in disqualification.

Responsibilities

  • Contact accounts as needed to collect and follow up on past due balances.
  • Maintain clear and concise notes accurately reflecting information provided in applicable systems
  • Contact management and sales prior to notifying accounts of credit suspension

  • Report issues concerning payment of accounts to management
  • Request and send reprints (paper or electronic) of invoices, statements and vouchers to accounts as needed
  • Maintain all aging balances within percentage requirements determined by management

  • Perform additional analysis and reporting as requested by management
  • Seek to improve job performance through self assessment, skill development, training and goal setting
  • Maintain a regular and reliable level of attendance and punctuality
  • Perform miscellaneous job-related duties as assigned

Equal Opportunity Employer/Disability/Veterans

Qualifications

  • 1 year Account Receivable, Business to Business collections and /or customer service experience using a computer on a daily basis required
  • Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills required
  • Apart from religious observations, must be able to work Monday-Friday 40 hours/ work week
  • Must be willing to accept starting pay of $18.03/hour.
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States and not require work authorization sponsorship by our company for this position now or in the future.
  • Current resident in the Tulsa area

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Director of Sales and Marketing, you’re not just overseeing commercial strategies for the hotel – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:

  • Drive total revenue performance: Lead sales and marketing efforts across all segments, including group, catering, business transient, and leisure, to achieve revenue goals and profitability targets
  • Develop commercial strategy: Set and execute the hotel’s multi-year commercial plan in partnership with on-property and regional leaders, aligning enterprise solutions with local market needs
  • Optimize pricing and business mix: Collaborate with Commercial Leadership to implement pricing strategies, forecast demand, and define the optimal mix of business for each period
  • Analyze performance and convert insights to action: Lead the Sales & Marketing Optimization Process, using data to identify opportunities, adjust tactics, and communicate performance drivers through regular commercial reviews
  • Lead marketing and digital strategy: Oversee B2B marketing, digital campaigns, social media, PR, and online content to strengthen brand presence and demand generation
  • Ensure brand alignment and operational excellence: Oversee sales and marketing activities to ensure consistency with brand standards, corporate identity, and enterprise communication tools
  • Cultivate a high-performing team: Recruit new talent while driving team growth and engagement through performance management, professional development, and recognition programs

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune.
