Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

About The Team

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

  • Innovative Problem-Solving Skills: The ability to tackle complex challenges in a non-linear fashion is essential. We seek a resourceful candidate who can effectively navigate the organization to gather necessary information and implement innovative solutions while adapting to evolving scenarios and leveraging valuable resources creatively.
  • Strong Communication Skills: Exceptional writing and verbal communication abilities, with proficiency in creating impactful and visually appealing presentations.
  • Stakeholder management: Ability to effectively communicate, influence and persuade with different levels of stakeholders (including Senior Management) with proven strong commercial acumen

It’s great if you have: 

  • Experience in digital or social media marketing
  • Experience in hypothesis testing frameworks, statistical analysis, and using Python/R for data manipulation and analysis.

job.job_description:
Overview

Kundenservice liegt dir im Blut? Du bist ein echtes Verkaufstalent und liebst es, Herausforderungen im Sinne deiner Kunden zu lösen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

Über Uns

Als weltgrößter Mobilitätsdienstleister triffst du bei Enterprise auf ein in Deutschland wachsendes internationales Unternehmen mit spannenden Herausforderungen und großartigen Aufstiegschancen. Der Hauptsitz unseres 1957 gegründeten Unternehmens ist in St. Louis (USA), aber unser globales Netzwerk erstreckt sich auf mehr als 90 Länder. Stell dir 2,3 Millionen Fahrzeuge an 9.500 globalen Standorten mit über 90.000 Mitarbeitenden vor, die einen Jahresumsatz von 39 Milliarden US-Dollar einfahren. Dann hast du einen ersten Eindruck von uns und was wir bewegen!

Du bist stolz darauf, auch bei mehreren Aufgaben gleichzeitig den Überblick zu behalten? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

Für unsere Filiale am Flughafen Stuttgart suchen wir engagierte und motivierte Kundenberater in Vollzeit (m_w_d) zur Unterstützung unseres dynamischen Teams! Direkt vor Ort berätst du unsere Kunden, vermietest Fahrzeuge, übergibst diese an unsere Kunden und kümmerst dich um alle dazugehörigen administrativen Tätigkeiten.

Responsibilities

Kein Tag ist wie der andere:

  • Vermiete das passende Auto für den individuellen Bedarf deiner Kunden
  • Dein Kunde vertraut dir als kompetenter Ansprechpartner
  • Jeder Kunde ist anders, aber dein Kundenservice ist immer gleich erstklassig
  • Administrative Tätigkeiten erledigst du schnell und professionell

Qualifications

Deine individuellen Stärken:

Kommunikative Fähigkeiten sind uns wichtig, Unternehmergeist und Teamfähigkeit wissen wir sehr zu schätzen. Erste Erfahrungen im Verkauf und Kundendienst sind garantiert von Vorteil. Aber vor allem solltest du motiviert sein und Lust dazu haben, deinen Kunden einen exzellenten Service zu bieten.

Diese Kriterien Erfüllst Du

  • Mindestalter von 18 Jahren.
  • Eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder Berufserfahrung wünschenswert
  • Führerschein der Klasse B
  • Eine uneingeschränkte Arbeitserlaubnis in Deutschland
  • Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Diese Benefits Warten Auf Dich

  • Eine umfangreiche Einarbeitung in einem großartigen Filialteam
  • Eine Bandbreite an Entwicklungs- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
  • Diverse Boni und Provisionen zusätzlich zu deinem Gehalt
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge sowie weitere Versicherungen
  • Regelmäßige Events bzw. Firmenfeiern
  • Fahrzeuganmietung zu vergünstigten Mitarbeiterkonditionen (für dich, deine Familie und Freunde)

Deine Bewerbung

Um dich auf diese Stelle zu bewerben, klicke einfach auf „Jetzt Bewerben”. Du erstellst kurz dein Profil in unserem System und beantwortest einige stellenbezogene Fragen – fertig! Ein Recruiter wird sich mit dir in Verbindung setzten, um alles Weitere zu besprechen.

WICHTIG: Enterprise ist ein inklusiver Arbeitgeber. Es ist uns wichtig, eine Vielfalt an Mitarbeitenden mit den unterschiedlichsten Hintergründen zu beschäftigen. Daher richtet sich diese Stellenanzeige an alle Bewerber (m_w_d). Solltest du aufgrund einer körperlichen Einschränkung nicht Auto fahren können, bewirb dich bitte trotzdem. Gemeinsam werden wir eine Lösung finden.

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You will provide support, from administrative, customer service, and sales lead development perspectives, for the Sales & Marketing team to develop future and repeat business. As GC&E Assistant Manager Events / Conference / Sales, you’re not just supporting event delivery/sales lead development perspectives – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Communication & Client Engagement: Communicate effectively with clients, vendors, and internal teams to ensure smooth project execution.
  • Customer Service: Deliver exceptional service to guests and clients, ensuring satisfaction throughout the event or campaign lifecycle.
  • Project Coordination: Assist in planning and executing events and marketing projects, managing timelines and logistics.
  • Market Research: Conduct research to identify customer preferences, market trends, and competitive insights.
  • Budget Support: Help manage budgets, track expenses, and ensure cost-effective execution.
  • Sales Support: Assist the sales team with proposals, client negotiations, and promotional activities.
  • Vendor & Stakeholder Relations: Maintain strong relationships with external partners to ensure quality and reliability.
  • Problem-Solving: Address issues promptly during planning and execution phases.
  • Performance Analysis: Evaluate the success of campaigns and events using data and KPIs.
  • Team Collaboration: Work cross-functionally with departments to align efforts and achieve goals.
  • Innovation & Adaptability: Stay current with industry trends and apply innovative approaches.
  • Technical Tools: Use hotel systems such as Delphi, Salesforce, OnQ, and Market Planner Survey tools effectively.

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • At least 2 year of experience in a hotel sales admin/coordinator role preferred.
  • Diploma or degree in Marketing, Hospitality, Communications, or related field.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Experience in customer service, event coordination, or marketing preferred.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and hotel/event management software.
  • Creative mindset with attention to detail.
  • Ability to multitask and manage time effectively.
  • Analytical thinking and data-driven decision-making.
  • Team player with a proactive attitude and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with digital marketing tools and CRM platforms is a plus.
  • Language Skills: Japanese and English language skills sufficient for day-to-day business communication, email correspondence and client interaction Experience: Experience in hotel operations, reception and reservations is desirable but not mandatory (around 2 years is acceptable)

Personal Qualities

  • Strong communication, coordination, and customer service skills
  • Strong interest in hotel sales, meetings and events, MICE, or group business
  • Ability to manage multiple inquiries and projects simultaneously
  • Strong attention to detail, particularly when handling quotations, contracts, reservations, and numerical information
  • A proactive approach to client follow-up and business development
  • Strong teamwork skills and the ability to coordinate effectively with both sales and operational departments
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team:

Agoda’s Customer Support Team understands that travel can be an everchanging environment. That is why we provide in-person, real-time help around the clock and in 38 languages. No matter the issue, we present the best of Agoda’s values to each customer with multiple support channels and a strong desire to serve. Certainly, doing more than answering phone calls or replying to emails, our specialists actively look for ways to improve our customer experience.

We quickly adapt to challenges by collaborating with other teams and experimenting on everything we can. This has allowed us to develop new and effective products that produce meaningful results and continue to drive Agoda’s business performance. Our Customer Support Team serves a daily role in contributing to the core strength and service of Agoda with a clear vision and a focus on efficient and satisfying customer support.

This role is responsible for leading the customer service teams supporting Japanese Language as they provide support to customers across voice, email, chat, and back-office activities.

The Manager of Customer Experience Group provides vision, leadership, and guidance to each team leader and associates in the key operating areas through performance and goal setting. Effectively communicates with the team, developing a climate in which information is shared openly. Clearly defines team goals and expectations. Develops tactical plans to reach these goals.

This role requires a high level of personal and professional skills associated with running global operations teams. First and foremost, this is a people leader role and enabling local teams to be successful is core to the role.

In addition to being a brilliant people leader and communicator, the ideal candidate will bring a vision, a sense of curiosity, a passion for travel, keen analytical skills, a tech-centric mindset, and a willingness to lead by example. This position will report to the Head of Customer Service Delivery.

What You'll Do:

  • Lead diverse teams across markets with unique requirements, regulations, and practices.
  • Continually strive to exceed partners' expectations.
  • Guide your team through frequent changes in technology, processes, and business priorities.
  • Connect with your team through regular check-ins to understand successes and pain points, and translate those insights into actionable solutions.
  • Identify and drive solutions for your regions using an agile, data-driven approach, including designing, and running experiments.
  • Collaborate with a variety of functions such as WFM, Content, Finance, Operational Excellence, Customer experience, L&D, Analytics, and Talent Management.
  • Present results and propose solutions to Senior Leaders and stakeholders.
  • Understands the key drivers of customer satisfaction & dissatisfaction and works with customer service leaders to address customer dissatisfaction and implement self-healing processes where possible.
  • Regularly review customer feedback and QA insights to help educate teams about Agoda products and services as well as identify customer handling improvement opportunities.

What You'll Bring:

  • Must be excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and Japanese
  • A minimum of 10 years of work experience, with at least 3 years in a senior role managing operational responsibilities (contact center, vendor management at scale, etc.).
  • Excellent problem-solving capabilities, with a knack for identifying improvement opportunities on customer experience and efficiency using a data-driven approach.
  • The ability to successfully lead or support multiple initiatives concurrently.
  • A proven track record of leading change.
  • Persuasive skills to convince senior leaders.
  • A fast-paced approach to problem-solving and decision-making.
  • The ability to foster a culture of personal development through coaching and partnership with L&D, engagement, and continuous improvement.
  • Excellent personal and interpersonal skills to lead and engage with the team and partner effectively with other departments.
  • E-commerce or travel industry experience is a plus.

Good to Have:

  • Project management certifications (PMP, Six Sigma, COPC or equivalent), travel industry experience and Online Travel knowledge
  • Are you ready to take your career to new heights with Agoda?
  • Apply today and let's revolutionize the travel industry together.

Starte bei uns, um deine großartigen Ideen einzubringen. Und bleibe, weil sie gehört werden.

Wer wir sind

Wir sind Enterprise Mobility, ein familiengeführter, weltweit tätiger Mobilitätsdienstleister mit einem Umsatz von 38 Milliarden US-Dollar, fast 90.000 Mitarbeitenden und Engagement in 95 Ländern. Unter der Leitung von CEO Chrissy Taylor bauen wir das Unternehmen auf eine starke Tradition, die uns die Stabilität gibt, den langfristigen Erfolg unserer Mitarbeitenden, unserer Kund:innen sowie unseres Geschäfts in den Fokus zu stellen. Bei uns erwarten dich Teams, die Vielfalt leben, gemeinsam anpacken und sich gegenseitig unterstützen.

Dein Einstieg bei uns

Als Management Trainee (m_w_d) hast du die Freiheit und Unterstützung, deine Kompetenzen weiterzuentwickeln und deinen Weg in die Filialverantwortung aktiv zu gestalten. Die meisten unserer heutigen Führungskräfte bis hin zu unserer CEO haben ihre Karriere als Management Trainee (m_w_d) begonnen, du lernst bei uns nicht theoretisch, sondern „on the job“, übernimmst Verantwortung vom ersten Tag an und baust so deine Karriere Schritt für Schritt auf.

Aufgaben

Was dich erwartet

Bei uns bist du richtig, wenn du etwas bewegen willst und bereit bist, über dich hinauszuwachsen. Mit einem betriebswirtschaftlichen Studium kannst du dein Wissen direkt in die Praxis umsetzen und auf das nächste Level bringen. Kommst du aus einem anderen Bereich, holen wir dich dort ab, wo du stehst, und bringen dir alles bei, was du brauchst. Du arbeitest in Teams, in denen unterschiedliche Perspektiven geschätzt werden und jede Person die Unterstützung und Wertschätzung erfährt, um ihr volles Potenzial zu entfalten.

  • Du übernimmst früh Verantwortung für das operative Daily Business
  • Du sammelst Erfahrung in Kundenservice, Vertrieb, Business Management und Finance
  • Du baust dein Sales- und Verhandlungsgeschick aus
  • Du baust echte Kundenbeziehungen auf und entwickelst neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten
  • Du entwickelst dein unternehmerisches Denken, von Umsatz bis Kostenkontrolle
  • Du wächst Schritt für Schritt in eine Führungsrolle hinein

Deine Entwicklung

Bei uns zählt Leistung – und die wird gesehen:

  • Abschluss des Trainee-Programms nach durchschnittlich 10 Monaten
  • Im Anschluss erste Beförderung zum Management Assistant
  • Schneller Aufstieg möglich zur Filialleitung in unter 2 Jahren
  • Vielfältige Karrierewege, z. B. in unser Sales Team, HR oder Risikomanagement
Profil

Was du mitbringst

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium

  • Eine unbefristete Arbeits- und Aufenthaltserlaubnis für Deutschland

  • Fließende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse
  • Deutscher oder EU-Führerschein und 1 Jahr Fahrpraxis,
  • Maximal 3 Punkte im Verkehrszentralregister in Flensburg (Nachweis erforderlich)
  • Kein Verstoß gegen die Straßenverkehrsordnung in Zusammenhang mit Alkohol oder Drogen

Auch spannend: Bewerbungen aus Tourismus, Hospitality oder Sales sind willkommen, egal ob mit Studium oder abgeschlossener Ausbildung mit einschlägiger Berufserfahrung.

Gehe den nächsten Schritt - Klick auf „Jetzt bewerben“, beantworte ein paar Fragen und fertig.
Wir melden uns bei dir und schauen gemeinsam, ob wir zueinander passen.

Noch unsicher? Du musst nicht alle Punkte perfekt erfüllen. Wenn du motiviert bist, und Lust hast dich weiterzuentwickeln, passt du wahrscheinlich sehr gut zu uns. Enterprise ist ein inklusiver Arbeitgeber. Es ist uns wichtig, eine Vielfalt an Mitarbeitenden mit den unterschiedlichsten Hintergründen zu beschäftigen. Auch wenn du aus gesundheitlichen Gründen nicht Auto fahren kannst, suchen wir gemeinsam eine Lösung.

Responsibilities

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:

  • Oversee general ledger and financial reporting: Reconcile General Ledger accounts, review discrepancies, and guide team members in resolving issues to ensure accuracy and compliance

  • Control budgets and inventory: Track and manage inventories and operational expenses to maintain cost control
  • Supervise payroll processing: Oversee timekeeping systems, weekly payroll submissions, gratuity calculations, and monthly payroll audits
  • Handle financial transactions: Ensure proper processing of received checks, calculate daily deposit transmittals, and maintain financial records
  • Inspire and develop the team: Supervise, coach, and mentor team members; conduct performance evaluations, provide professional development opportunities, and recognize achievements to build, retain, and engage a high-performing team

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

About The Team

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
  • Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future

At Enterprise Mobility™ we are paving a new way forward by creating better experiences for how we move. We give people around the world the ability to connect in ways that suit their unique needs. It’s a bold idea that has defined our purpose-led, people-first organization for over 65 years, and it’s one that we continue to strive toward with every journey.
Through our trusted brands and our portfolio of offerings, we aim to reach the highest levels of customer service with each interaction. And we invest in — and care about — each other, our communities and every journey. It’s a point of pride and distinction, rooted in our origins. And it’s what will continue to drive the future of the organization and mobility itself.
Over the years, we’ve learned moving forward isn’t a simple matter of going from point A to B. Today, mobility is the movement of people and goods. It goes beyond the vehicles we drive to encompass an integrated way of travel that meets every individual’s unique needs and preferences.
That is why it’s our vision to be the world’s best and most trusted mobility company. As mobility continues to evolve, we'll continue to innovate to work toward a reimagined mobility future that is more accessible, efficient and sustainable for all.
job.job_description:
Starte bei uns, um deine großartigen Ideen einzubringen. Und bleibe, weil sie gehört werden.

Wer wir sind

Wir sind Enterprise Mobility, ein familiengeführter, weltweit tätiger Mobilitätsdienstleister mit einem Umsatz von 38 Milliarden US-Dollar, fast 90.000 Mitarbeitenden und Engagement in 95 Ländern. Unter der Leitung von CEO Chrissy Taylor bauen wir das Unternehmen auf eine starke Tradition, die uns die Stabilität gibt, den langfristigen Erfolg unserer Mitarbeitenden, unserer Kund:innen sowie unseres Geschäfts in den Fokus zu stellen. Bei uns erwarten dich Teams, die Vielfalt leben, gemeinsam anpacken und sich gegenseitig unterstützen.

Dein Einstieg bei uns

Als Management Trainee (m_w_d) hast du die Freiheit und Unterstützung, deine Kompetenzen weiterzuentwickeln und deinen Weg in die Filialverantwortung aktiv zu gestalten. Die meisten unserer heutigen Führungskräfte bis hin zu unserer CEO haben ihre Karriere als Management Trainee (m_w_d) begonnen, du lernst bei uns nicht theoretisch, sondern „on the job“, übernimmst Verantwortung vom ersten Tag an und baust so deine Karriere Schritt für Schritt auf.

Aufgaben

Was dich erwartet

Bei uns bist du richtig, wenn du etwas bewegen willst und bereit bist, über dich hinauszuwachsen. Mit einem betriebswirtschaftlichen Studium kannst du dein Wissen direkt in die Praxis umsetzen und auf das nächste Level bringen. Kommst du aus einem anderen Bereich, holen wir dich dort ab, wo du stehst, und bringen dir alles bei, was du brauchst. Du arbeitest in Teams, in denen unterschiedliche Perspektiven geschätzt werden und jede Person die Unterstützung und Wertschätzung erfährt, um ihr volles Potenzial zu entfalten.

  • Du übernimmst früh Verantwortung für das operative Daily Business
  • Du sammelst Erfahrung in Kundenservice, Vertrieb, Business Management und Finance
  • Du baust dein Sales- und Verhandlungsgeschick aus
  • Du baust echte Kundenbeziehungen auf und entwickelst neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten
  • Du entwickelst dein unternehmerisches Denken, von Umsatz bis Kostenkontrolle
  • Du wächst Schritt für Schritt in eine Führungsrolle hinein

Deine Entwicklung

Bei uns zählt Leistung – und die wird gesehen:

  • Abschluss des Trainee-Programms nach durchschnittlich 10 Monaten
  • Im Anschluss erste Beförderung zum Management Assistant
  • Schneller Aufstieg möglich zur Filialleitung in unter 2 Jahren
  • Vielfältige Karrierewege, z. B. in unser Sales Team, HR oder Risikomanagement


Profil

Was du mitbringst

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium
  • Motivation, Dinge anzupacken und Verantwortung zu übernehmen
  • Erfahrung im und Spaß am Kundenkontakt, Vertrieb und Teamarbeit

  • Eine unbefristete Arbeits- und Aufenthaltserlaubnis für Deutschland

  • Fließende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse
  • Deutscher oder EU-Führerschein und 1 Jahr Fahrpraxis,
  • Maximal 3 Punkte im Verkehrszentralregister in Flensburg (Nachweis erforderlich)
  • Kein Verstoß gegen die Straßenverkehrsordnung in Zusammenhang mit Alkohol oder Drogen

Auch spannend: Bewerbungen aus Tourismus, Hospitality oder Sales sind willkommen, egal ob mit Studium oder abgeschlossener Ausbildung mit einschlägiger Berufserfahrung.

Gehe den nächsten Schritt - Klick auf „Jetzt bewerben“, beantworte ein paar Fragen und fertig.
Wir melden uns bei dir und schauen gemeinsam, ob wir zueinander passen.

Noch unsicher? Du musst nicht alle Punkte perfekt erfüllen. Wenn du motiviert bist, und Lust hast dich weiterzuentwickeln, passt du wahrscheinlich sehr gut zu uns. Enterprise ist ein inklusiver Arbeitgeber. Es ist uns wichtig, eine Vielfalt an Mitarbeitenden mit den unterschiedlichsten Hintergründen zu beschäftigen. Auch wenn du aus gesundheitlichen Gründen nicht Auto fahren kannst, suchen wir gemeinsam eine Lösung.

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You will lead and manage the day-to-day operations of the accounting department and play a vital role in maintaining the company's financial stability and health. As a Cluster Hotel Accountant, you’re not just ensuring accurate and timely recording of financial data – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest across two hotels. You will be part of two teams, DoubleTree by Hilton Perth Waterfront and DoubleTree by Hilton Perth Northbridge.

Discover Your Next Destination

Be part of two exceptional DoubleTree by Hilton hotels in Perth. Located in the heart of Perth's vibrant entertainment and cultural precinct, DoubleTree by Hilton Perth Northbridge offers modern accommodation, dynamic dining experiences, and easy access to the city's best attractions and nightlife. Just moments away on the banks of the Swan River, DoubleTree by Hilton Perth Waterfront provides stunning waterfront views, contemporary hospitality, and a unique guest experience in the heart of Elizabeth Quay.

A World of Rewards

  • Complimentary laundering of your work attire
  • Complimentary fresh and healthy meals while on duty
  • Personalised development with support from our on-site Learning & Development Manager, plus global career opportunities across Hilton.
  • Make a meaningful impact through our award-winning Corporate Responsibility programmes – learn more ( Responsible Business | Travel with Purpose | Hilton TWP )
  • Go Hilton Team Member Travel Program – enjoy heavily discounted hotel stays from as little as $70 per night across the globe
  • Fitness Passport - access a wide network of gyms and fitness centres
  • Up to 25% off Food & Beverage across participating outlets
  • Year-round recognition programmes celebrating your contributions and achievements
  • Wellbeing initiatives to support your mental and physical health

Responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Ledger Management: Adjust general ledger accounts and maintain supporting documentation.
  • Compliance Review: Investigate cashier discrepancies and verify travel agent commissions for compliance.
  • Budget Support: Assist the Finance Managers in budget and forecast preparation.
  • F&B Control Oversight: Review food and beverage control adjustments and certifications.
  • Interdepartmental Coordination: Collaborate with other departments and government agencies on accounting matters.
  • Policy Compliance: Ensure adherence to accounting policies, SOPs, and internal controls.

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • Valid Australian working rights with a minimum of 12 months remaining
  • University degree in Accounting or Finance; professional accounting qualification preferred
  • Minimum 2 years’ experience in an accounting role, preferably within the hospitality industry.
  • Strong knowledge of financial reporting, general ledger, and internal controls
  • Familiarity with local tax laws and government liaison experience
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and hotel financial systems; Hilton standards knowledge is a plus
  • Fluent in written and spoken English
  • Detail-oriented, reliable, and able to manage multiple tasks efficiently
  • Flexible with working hours, especially during month-end closing

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

Overview

As we continue to build a team that drives us forward, the Marketing team is excited to announce the opening for an EU Marketing Strategy Manager – Replacement & Leisure Division, based at our European Headquarters in Egham, Surrey.

The Marketing Manager is responsible for marketing strategies and go-to marketing plans for the Replacement & Leisure Division across the European Corporate Countries to drive sustained growth by driving engagement with our brands and delivering on established business KPIs The Marketing Manager leverages insights and historical performance to inform marketing strategies and optimizations to drive marketing impact and investments. The Marketing Manager regularly interacts with Sales and Operations teams to ensure marketing strategy alignment with business/sales strategies. The Marketing Strategy Manager balances the needs of established business, while proactively evaluating new opportunities to drive key marketing objectives – including brand awareness and consideration, lead generation, product positioning, client onboarding and retention, and sales eablement. This position collaborates regularly with Brand and Digital Strategy, as well as internal and external marketing and Communications teams/agencies, to define, grow and connect with target audiences through compelling messaging across marketing funnel positions –ensuring our brands and messaging reach the right audiences at the right time. Based on business objectives, this position is responsible for creating, managing the implementation, and optimizing marketing strategies and budgets.

Organization Overview

We’re Enterprise Mobility. A family-owned, global mobility leader with a $39 billion turnover, nearly 90,000 team members, and operations in 95 countries. Led by CEO Chrissy Taylor, the third generation of the Taylor family, we’re built on a legacy that gives us the stability to focus on the long-term success of our people, our customers and our business.

From a fleet of seven cars, more than six decades ago, to a global network serving consumers, businesses and governments, Enterprise Mobility is a leading provider of mobility solutions including car rental, fleet management, flexible vehicle-hire, carsharing, vanpooling, car sales, truck rental, vehicle subscription, luxury rental, technology solutions and more, to help make travel easier and more convenient.

Additional Information

Location: Egham, Surrey, TW20 9FB (Plenty of free on site parking and approx. 15 minutes walk from Egham station) Hybrid, 3 days in the office, 2 days working from home.

Salary: Competitive

Hours: 45 per week

Please let us know about any accommodations you may need to participate in the recruitment process.

Please note that all applicants must have the ability to pass a security check involving financial probity and basic criminality.

Responsibilities

  • Manage, develop, and implement marketing plans, campaign strategies, programs, and materials, to deliver against objectives (e.g. days earned growth, new account growth, referral growth. ancillary product sales, and other quantifiable business outcomes)
  • Leverage market, B2B and/or B2C customer performance, and brand health insights to inform and tailor marketing strategies, plans, campaigns, and optimization opportunities for RLD across the customer journey lifecycle
  • Develop comprehensive and strategically aligned business briefs that clearly articulate marketing objectives, target audience insights, key messaging points, as well as creative inspiration and guidelines
  • Manage and develop strong relationships with internal Marketing teams, business partners, and external agencies (when applicable) to align campaign planning, creative development, execution needs, and performance follow-up
  • Monitor all business, industry, market, competitor, technology, and consumer trends to identify opportunities for innovation and competitive advantage
  • Align marketing plans and campaign priorities with business objectives, stakeholder needs, customer priorities, and available performance insights, ensuring broader objective clarity across Marketing teams
  • Manage assigned marketing budgets through disciplined campaign performance measurement and return on investment, recommending adjustments that improve marketing effectiveness and support business priorities
  • Manage monthly reporting on key initiatives, performance measures, campaign results, and progress towards business objectives
  • Seek to improve job performance through self-assessment, skill development, training and goal setting
  • Maintain a regular and reliable level of attendance and punctuality
  • Perform miscellaneous job-related duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • Successful track record with marketing brands and channels
  • Comprehensive (end to end) marketing experience
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills across all levels of employees and management
  • Ability to juggle multiple responsibilities, meet deadlines and prioritise to complete work on a timely basis
  • Excellent organisation and time-management skills

job.job_description:
Starte bei uns, um deine großartigen Ideen einzubringen. Und bleibe, weil sie gehört werden.

Wer wir sind

Wir sind Enterprise Mobility, ein familiengeführter, weltweit tätiger Mobilitätsdienstleister mit einem Umsatz von 38 Milliarden US-Dollar, fast 90.000 Mitarbeitenden und Engagement in 95 Ländern. Unter der Leitung von CEO Chrissy Taylor bauen wir das Unternehmen auf eine starke Tradition, die uns die Stabilität gibt, den langfristigen Erfolg unserer Mitarbeitenden, unserer Kund:innen sowie unseres Geschäfts in den Fokus zu stellen. Bei uns erwarten dich Teams, die Vielfalt leben, gemeinsam anpacken und sich gegenseitig unterstützen.

Dein Einstieg bei uns

Als Management Trainee (m_w_d) hast du die Freiheit und Unterstützung, deine Kompetenzen weiterzuentwickeln und deinen Weg in die Filialverantwortung aktiv zu gestalten. Die meisten unserer heutigen Führungskräfte bis hin zu unserer CEO haben ihre Karriere als Management Trainee (m_w_d) begonnen, du lernst bei uns nicht theoretisch, sondern „on the job“, übernimmst Verantwortung vom ersten Tag an und baust so deine Karriere Schritt für Schritt auf.

Aufgaben

Was dich erwartet

Bei uns bist du richtig, wenn du etwas bewegen willst und bereit bist, über dich hinauszuwachsen. Mit einem betriebswirtschaftlichen Studium kannst du dein Wissen direkt in die Praxis umsetzen und auf das nächste Level bringen. Kommst du aus einem anderen Bereich, holen wir dich dort ab, wo du stehst, und bringen dir alles bei, was du brauchst. Du arbeitest in Teams, in denen unterschiedliche Perspektiven geschätzt werden und jede Person die Unterstützung und Wertschätzung erfährt, um ihr volles Potenzial zu entfalten.

  • Du übernimmst früh Verantwortung für das operative Daily Business
  • Du sammelst Erfahrung in Kundenservice, Vertrieb, Business Management und Finance
  • Du baust dein Sales- und Verhandlungsgeschick aus
  • Du baust echte Kundenbeziehungen auf und entwickelst neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten
  • Du entwickelst dein unternehmerisches Denken, von Umsatz bis Kostenkontrolle
  • Du wächst Schritt für Schritt in eine Führungsrolle hinein

Deine Entwicklung

Bei uns zählt Leistung – und die wird gesehen:

  • Abschluss des Trainee-Programms nach durchschnittlich 10 Monaten
  • Im Anschluss erste Beförderung zum Management Assistant
  • Schneller Aufstieg möglich zur Filialleitung in unter 2 Jahren
  • Vielfältige Karrierewege, z. B. in unser Sales Team, HR oder Risikomanagement
Profil

Was du mitbringst

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium
  • Motivation, Dinge anzupacken und Verantwortung zu übernehmen
  • Erfahrung im und Spaß am Kundenkontakt, Vertrieb und Teamarbeit

  • Eine unbefristete Arbeits- und Aufenthaltserlaubnis für Deutschland

  • Fließende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse
  • Deutscher oder EU-Führerschein und 1 Jahr Fahrpraxis,
  • Maximal 3 Punkte im Verkehrszentralregister in Flensburg (Nachweis erforderlich)
  • Kein Verstoß gegen die Straßenverkehrsordnung in Zusammenhang mit Alkohol oder Drogen

Auch spannend: Bewerbungen aus Tourismus, Hospitality oder Sales sind willkommen, egal ob mit Studium oder abgeschlossener Ausbildung mit einschlägiger Berufserfahrung.

Gehe den nächsten Schritt - Klick auf „Jetzt bewerben“, beantworte ein paar Fragen und fertig.
Wir melden uns bei dir und schauen gemeinsam, ob wir zueinander passen.

Noch unsicher? Du musst nicht alle Punkte perfekt erfüllen. Wenn du motiviert bist, und Lust hast dich weiterzuentwickeln, passt du wahrscheinlich sehr gut zu uns. Enterprise ist ein inklusiver Arbeitgeber. Es ist uns wichtig, eine Vielfalt an Mitarbeitenden mit den unterschiedlichsten Hintergründen zu beschäftigen. Auch wenn du aus gesundheitlichen Gründen nicht Auto fahren kannst, suchen wir gemeinsam eine Lösung.

 Please be advised that a valid work permit for Germany is required for non-EU citizens. Unfortunately, applications without a valid work permit and sufficient German language skills may not be considered.

It’s a bold idea that has defined our purpose-led, people-first organization for over 65 years, and it’s one that we continue to strive toward with every journey.
Through our trusted brands and our portfolio of offerings, we aim to reach the highest levels of customer service with each interaction. And we invest in — and care about — each other, our communities and every journey. It’s a point of pride and distinction, rooted in our origins. It’s how we grew from a pioneer with a fleet of seven cars to a global mobility leader with more than 90,000 team members around the world. And it’s what will continue to drive the future of the organization and mobility itself.
Over the years, we’ve learned moving forward isn’t a simple matter of going from point A to B. Today, mobility is the movement of people and goods. It goes beyond the vehicles we drive to encompass an integrated way of travel that meets every individual’s unique needs and preferences.
That is why it’s our vision to be the world’s best and most trusted mobility company. As mobility continues to evolve, we'll continue to innovate to work toward a reimagined mobility future that is more accessible, efficient and sustainable for all.
job.job_description:
Starte bei uns, um deine großartigen Ideen einzubringen. Und bleibe, weil sie gehört werden.

Wer wir sind

Wir sind Enterprise Mobility, ein familiengeführter, weltweit tätiger Mobilitätsdienstleister mit einem Umsatz von 38 Milliarden US-Dollar, fast 90.000 Mitarbeitenden und Engagement in 95 Ländern. Unter der Leitung von CEO Chrissy Taylor bauen wir das Unternehmen auf eine starke Tradition, die uns die Stabilität gibt, den langfristigen Erfolg unserer Mitarbeitenden, unserer Kund:innen sowie unseres Geschäfts in den Fokus zu stellen. Bei uns erwarten dich Teams, die Vielfalt leben, gemeinsam anpacken und sich gegenseitig unterstützen.

Dein Einstieg bei uns

Als Management Trainee (m_w_d) hast du die Freiheit und Unterstützung, deine Kompetenzen weiterzuentwickeln und deinen Weg in die Filialverantwortung aktiv zu gestalten. Die meisten unserer heutigen Führungskräfte bis hin zu unserer CEO haben ihre Karriere als Management Trainee (m_w_d) begonnen, du lernst bei uns nicht theoretisch, sondern „on the job“, übernimmst Verantwortung vom ersten Tag an und baust so deine Karriere Schritt für Schritt auf.

Aufgaben

Was dich erwartet

Bei uns bist du richtig, wenn du etwas bewegen willst und bereit bist, über dich hinauszuwachsen. Mit einem betriebswirtschaftlichen Studium kannst du dein Wissen direkt in die Praxis umsetzen und auf das nächste Level bringen. Kommst du aus einem anderen Bereich, holen wir dich dort ab, wo du stehst, und bringen dir alles bei, was du brauchst. Du arbeitest in Teams, in denen unterschiedliche Perspektiven geschätzt werden und jede Person die Unterstützung und Wertschätzung erfährt, um ihr volles Potenzial zu entfalten.

  • Du übernimmst früh Verantwortung für das operative Daily Business
  • Du sammelst Erfahrung in Kundenservice, Vertrieb, Business Management und Finance
  • Du baust dein Sales- und Verhandlungsgeschick aus
  • Du baust echte Kundenbeziehungen auf und entwickelst neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten
  • Du entwickelst dein unternehmerisches Denken, von Umsatz bis Kostenkontrolle
  • Du wächst Schritt für Schritt in eine Führungsrolle hinein

Deine Entwicklung

Bei uns zählt Leistung – und die wird gesehen:

  • Abschluss des Trainee-Programms nach durchschnittlich 10 Monaten
  • Im Anschluss erste Beförderung zum Management Assistant
  • Schneller Aufstieg möglich zur Filialleitung in unter 2 Jahren
  • Vielfältige Karrierewege, z. B. in unser Sales Team, HR oder Risikomanagement


Profil

Was du mitbringst

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium
  • Motivation, Dinge anzupacken und Verantwortung zu übernehmen
  • Erfahrung im und Spaß am Kundenkontakt, Vertrieb und Teamarbeit

  • Eine unbefristete Arbeits- und Aufenthaltserlaubnis für Deutschland

  • Fließende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse
  • Deutscher oder EU-Führerschein und 1 Jahr Fahrpraxis,
  • Maximal 3 Punkte im Verkehrszentralregister in Flensburg (Nachweis erforderlich)
  • Kein Verstoß gegen die Straßenverkehrsordnung in Zusammenhang mit Alkohol oder Drogen

Auch spannend: Bewerbungen aus Tourismus, Hospitality oder Sales sind willkommen, egal ob mit Studium oder abgeschlossener Ausbildung mit einschlägiger Berufserfahrung.

Gehe den nächsten Schritt - Klick auf „Jetzt bewerben“, beantworte ein paar Fragen und fertig.
Wir melden uns bei dir und schauen gemeinsam, ob wir zueinander passen.

Noch unsicher? Du musst nicht alle Punkte perfekt erfüllen. Wenn du motiviert bist, und Lust hast dich weiterzuentwickeln, passt du wahrscheinlich sehr gut zu uns. Enterprise ist ein inklusiver Arbeitgeber. Es ist uns wichtig, eine Vielfalt an Mitarbeitenden mit den unterschiedlichsten Hintergründen zu beschäftigen. Auch wenn du aus gesundheitlichen Gründen nicht Auto fahren kannst, suchen wir gemeinsam eine Lösung.

Neugierig auf unsere Benefits? Einen Überblick über unsere Leistungen und Prämien findest du auf unserer Karriereseite: Leistungen und Prämien bei Enterprise Mobility


Wir bieten

 Please be advised that a valid work permit for Germany is required for non-EU citizens. Unfortunately, applications without a valid work permit and sufficient German language skills may not be considered.

job.job_description:
• This role is not eligible for sponsorship AND is four days onsite hybrid at our N. Scottsdale office **

Who are we looking for?

Choice Hotels, one of the world’s largest lodging franchisors, has an exciting opportunity for a Software Engineer 2 within our Guest and Loyalty Domain. This team drives the systems powering our loyalty program and guest engagement data. As a key contributor, you’ll participate in the full development lifecycle—analyzing complex problems, crafting thoughtful solutions, and helping build the future of our platform.

We’re looking for an ambitious and inquisitive engineer, someone who thrives on learning, embraces new technology, and is excited by the opportunity to build impactful systems in a collaborative environment.

If you’re a self-starter who enjoys technology and solving meaningful problems, we invite you to apply today and #MakeItYourChoice.

Your Responsibilities

  • Analyze user stories and develop secure, maintainable Java code with Spring frameworks.
  • Use agentic AI tools (e.g., Copilot, Claude) to improve productivity and code quality.
  • Contribute to design discussions, peer code reviews, and integration testing efforts.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies including standups, sprint planning, and retrospectives.
  • Support CI/CD pipelines and cloud-based deployments (AWS).
  • Assist with monitoring and debugging production systems using tools like Prometheus and OpenSearch.
  • Partner closely with QA for validation and test planning.
  • Participate in a rotating on-call schedule to support production systems.
  • Stay current on new technologies, frameworks, and software development best practices.

Your Experience, Skills & Competencies

  • Bachelor’s in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 2–4 years of Java (v1.8+) development experience with Spring (REST, MVC, Security).
  • Hands-on experience with AWS or other cloud environments.
  • Experience with collaboration tools such as Jira and Confluence.
  • Familiarity with REST API design and consumption patterns
  • Source control proficiency – Bitbucket / Git workflows, branching strategies, and merge conflict resolution
  • Comfort using modern Java IDEs such as IntelliJ IDEA or Visual Studio Code, and build tools such as Maven or Gradle
  • Understanding of secure coding practices and fundamentals of application security
  • Strong debugging habits and experience working with logs and monitoring tools
  • SQL/relational database fundamentals
  • Good verbal, written, and listening communication skills
  • Good interpersonal skills and demeanor
  • A curious, growth-oriented mindset and an eagerness to explore tools like Copilot, Claude, or other AI-powered developer assistants

Your Team

This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Manager of Software Engineering in the Guest & Loyalty Domain. You’ll be part of a tight-knit, collaborative team of 5–7 engineers, working alongside cross-functional partners in product, QA, and architecture.

  • PLEASE NOTE: This role is not eligible for sponsorship ***

Choice prioritizes our associate wellbeing by offering a comprehensive benefits program that is both competitive and flexible to help you achieve your wellbeing goals - here are just a few:

  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Leave and paid time-off for holidays, vacation, personal, family, volunteer, sick, jury duty, bereavement, military, and religious observance
  • Financial benefits for retirement and health savings
  • Employee recognition programs
  • Discounts at Choice hotels worldwide

About Choice

Choice Hotels International, Inc. (NYSE: CHH), is one of the largest lodging franchisors in the world. With 7,500 hotels in 45+ countries and territories, we offer a range of high-quality lodging options in the upper upscale, upper midscale, midscale, extended stay, and economy segments. We’re the hotel company for those who choose to bet on themselves — the striver, the dreamer, the entrepreneur — because that’s who we are, too.

At Choice, we are united by the simple belief that tomorrow will be even better than today — for associates, our company, and our franchisees. At our worldwide corporate headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, at our technology center in Scottsdale, Arizona, and through our associates around the globe, every voice is heard and every idea is listened to, no matter what area of the company they come from. We are united in supporting the entrepreneurial dreams of our thousands of franchise owners, which propels us forward — giving our work at Choice a purpose larger than our business.

Our corporate office locations:

North Bethesda, MD — Located at Pike & Rose, our worldwide headquarters is less than 15 miles from Washington, D.C., one block away from the North Bethesda Metro station, with easy access to I-495, complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Scottsdale, AZ — Located at the northwest corner of Loop 101, the Scottsdale office is home to our technology, eCommerce and customer service organizations, with easy access to complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Minneapolis, MN — Select roles are based in our Minneapolis office on Highway 394, near the intersection with Highway 100, only five minutes from downtown.

Field/Remote — Select roles designated as field/remote will require associates to work from a home office, connecting virtually with Choice team members and leadership on Zoom, with possible required travel depending on the role.

Choice’s Cultural Values

Welcome and Respect Everyone | Be Bold | Be Quick | Listen | Be Curious | Show Integrity

Choice’s Leadership Principles

Act with Intention | Lead with Authenticity | Grow & Deliver

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Role Summary

Grows a segment of the portfolio of accounts by managing them directly or contributing to deepening those partnerships.

Analyzes business and operational performance to find opportunities for optimization.

Handles service delivery for active accounts, communicating technical and operational impacts as needed.

Ensures execution of account strategies and shares best practices across teams and regions.

Experience

3+ years for Bachelor's

2+ years for Master's

Education

Bachelor's or Master's or equivalent experience

Functional/ Technical Skills

Proficiency in English + German language

Effective communicator

Proficient in sales techniques

Portfolio management, relationship account management, upselling, and cross-selling

Role Expectations

  • Builds relationships with customer account team, including key buyers/decision makers.
  • Assists in creating opportunities (e.g., progress meetings, fact-finding/exploratory meetings) to build customer account.
  • Understands and reports a customer’s business issues through appropriate organization channels.
  • Recommends products, services, and insights that meet customer needs.
  • Acquires a good understanding of how the department operates and fits into the larger organization.
  • Demonstrates awareness of the policies, practices, trends, and information (including competitor) that impact the organization and its customers.
  • Demonstrates good understanding of the financial impact of decisions/solutions on the organization and its customers.
  • Documents components of a business case for change at the direction of more senior colleagues as needed.
  • Acquires and maintains a working knowledge of financial data and the company’s standard contract terms and conditions by reading product literature, contracts, and asking questions of peers.
  • Learns when to partner with legal resources to modify or adjust standard contract terms.
  • Learns the contract negotiation process and how to complete contractual arrangements.
  • Exchanges nuanced information to build consensus.
  • Able to handle key objections with ease and proactively seeks help from a manager when needed to address areas of difference and ensure agreements among all parties.
  • Conducts straightforward cost, benefit, and risk analyses of possible solutions and the implications not reaching an agreement.
  • Identifies and actively engages stakeholders in decision making and strategies to benefit account and organization. Closes deals effectively.
  • Understands standard offerings and major areas of expertise.
  • Builds a working knowledge of products, technologies, offerings, etc., within scope of responsibility.
  • Develops an understanding of competitors’ standard products and services.
  • Demonstrates insightful application of products, technologies, and offerings to account.
  • Demonstrates the importance of maintaining ongoing business relationships with colleagues and external customers.
  • Strategically builds relationships to support total portfolio and organization needs.
  • Develops understanding of customer's industry and competitive market.
  • Attends meetings with customers to understand needs and expectations.
  • Learns the metrics to assess the performance of products, services, and solutions against customer needs/expectations.
  • Develops key value proposition statements, case studies, etc., to demonstrate the value of the company’s products, services, and solutions.

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

job.job_description:
As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, what's the next step? Start your journey with us!

We are building a world-class Search Engine Marketing organization and are seeking a highly motivated and strategically-minded Senior SEM Specialist to join one of the most efficient SEM teams in Europe. Composed of SEM Account Managers, Analysts, Data Scientists, and Data Engineers, we are among the top Google and Microsoft Bing customers by spend in Europe.

This is a key strategic role within eDreams Odigeo that will help shape the future of the business. You will work alongside Country Managers, Product Managers, Pricing Analysts, Marketing Analysts, and many more, acting as a strategic PPC expert.

The SEM team members are passionate about data, automation, and innovation, thriving in a collaborative and agile environment. They are eager to learn, deep dive into complex challenges, share constructive feedback, and constantly challenge the status quo.

We are looking for a leader in execution who can take things to the next level. As part of an agile team, you will have the opportunity to drive forward long-term strategic initiatives autonomously, design and implement best-in-class campaigns, and contribute to our high level of automation and strategic direction.

Join us and help us reach our ambitious goal of becoming the global leader in online travel!

Why eDreams ODIGEO

Join the world's leading travel subscription platform...

  • We pioneered Prime, the first and world’s leading travel subscription programme since launching in 2017.
  • Millions of Prime members every year across multiple markets.
  • 5 brands: eDreams, GO Voyages, Opodo, Travellink, and the metasearch engine Liligo
  • This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalised service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members.
  • Diversity is our strength that’s why our eDOers are coming from different nationalities from all continents – 99% permanent contracts


Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a Senior SEM Specialist, your role extends beyond execution to include strategic leadership, mentorship, and significant business impact:

  • Strategic Leadership & Planning: Build and drive long-term PPC strategies that contribute to sustained business growth, aligning PPC efforts with overarching business objectives and the broader marketing mix.
  • Performance Optimization & Risk Mitigation: Conduct complex data analysis to uncover strategic patterns, translate these findings into actionable strategies, and proactively identify potential risks within PPC initiatives, developing robust mitigation and contingency plans.
  • Cutting-Edge Execution & Standards: Plan, design, implement, and optimize highly effective SEM campaigns across all our brands & products, ensuring execution adheres to best-in-class industry standards and sets a high performance benchmark. Provide operational guidance and coordination within assigned scopes.
  • Business Acumen & Strategic Optimization: Steer spend and revenue of the SEM campaigns towards given targets by deciding on the right bid strategies, strategically optimizing PPC spend across diverse program scopes to maximize performance, volume, and ROI, considering company-wide KPIs.
  • Forecasting & Innovation: Contribute to forecasting and scenario planning, providing valuable insights to the leadership team. Champion a culture of experimentation and innovation, proactively exploring new platforms and methodologies to maintain our technical edge.
  • Stakeholder Management & Communication: Serve as the primary contact for key high-level stakeholders. Influence strategic decisions by effectively presenting complex, data-driven insights in high-level executive summaries to peers, managers, and external partners (e.g., Google, Microsoft).
  • Team Guidance & Expert Mentorship: Act as a recognized subject matter expert who elevates the team's capabilities by providing in-depth technical guidance, disseminating best practices, and fostering a culture of continuous learning and development.
  • Agile & Collaborative Work: Take full ownership of chosen quarterly strategic initiatives, coordinating the working team to achieve the objective, and closely collaborating with other departments to align actions towards common company targets.


What can you expect:

  • Strategic Impact: Make a direct, high-level impact on Odigeo's success by steering and strategically shaping one of its biggest acquisition channels.
  • Scale and Autonomy: Work at scale across all Brands, Products & Markets with large, open budgets and a high level of autonomy as part of an agile, self-organizing team.

About GetYourGuide

GetYourGuide is the globally leading marketplace for unforgettable travel experiences. Travelers use GetYourGuide to discover the best things to do in a destination. The Mission

Technology has been and continues to be the catalyst for GetYourGuide’s growth. Our work in Marketplace is shaping global travel experiences, and you can help.

The features we build enable our customers to seamlessly book unforgettable experiences and empower our partners to expand their businesses. This is a complex task that presents an extraordinary opportunity. From creating the Supplier infrastructure that improves our supplier's businesses to developing innovative marketplace features that drive the next phase of our growth, you can build incredible solutions at GetYourGuide on a global scale.

Whether you are working on crafting dynamic search and recommendation algorithms or designing new features to accelerate the company's growth, you will have the chance to make a real impact. At GetYourGuide, our Teams are constantly pushing the boundaries, finding new ways to bring the magic of travel to people all over the world.

We’re organized in cross-functional mission teams composed of backend and full-stack engineers, mobile engineers, data engineers, product managers, and designers.

You Will

  • Work with engineers, designers, and analysts
  • Help to enable your mission team to iterate fast and learn about our customers by designing, launching, and iterating on A/B experiments
  • Maintain high-quality standards and continuously improve our code base, system, and processes
  • Design and develop efficient solutions that can continue to scale
  • Mentor other team members and be involved with hiring
  • Contribute to the team’s roadmap and long-term strategy
  • Work with Java, Spring Boot, Vue.js, SASS, Node.js, PHP, MySQL, PostgreSQL, GraphQL, Kafka, Kubernetes

Who You Are

  • 6+ years of software development experience
  • Expertise in web application development using component-based frameworks
  • High proficiency in Java
  • Experience designing architecture and deployment of web applications & services
  • Experience with writing tests
  • Ability to turn ideas into fast, reliable, and maintainable code
  • Positive, proactive team player who is passionate about their craft
  • Customer-centric prioritization and data-driven decision-making
  • Mature judgment in choosing when and how to use AI tools, proactively lead the team in adopting and evaluating new AI technologies, and support others in applying AI effectively while maintaining strong standards for quality, security, and governance.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to clearly explain technical concepts to others

Bonus Points For

  • Knowledge of frameworks and toolchains such as Node.js, Vue.js, or similar component-based Frontend frameworks and libraries
  • Experience with A/B testing, hypothesis building, and event-based analytics
  • Prior experience working in the e-commerce space
  • Prior experience in start-up environments

How We Set You Up For Success

  • Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

About The Opportunity

The General Manager will provide strategic and operational leadership for the resort, driving financial performance, operational excellence, and exceptional guest experience. This leader will oversee all aspects of the property while developing a high-performing team and fostering strong relationships with ownership, Hilton, and the local community.

The ideal candidate will be a proven hospitality executive with experience leading a large-scale luxury or upper-upscale resort. The successful GM will bring strong commercial acumen, operational discipline, and a passion for service, while positioning the resort for continued growth and success in the Santa Barbara market.

About The Property

Hilton Santa Barbara Beachfront Resort is a premier oceanfront destination set across 24 acres along Santa Barbara’s iconic East Beach. Offering the perfect blend of coastal beauty, elevated amenities, and classic California hospitality, the resort features 360 guest rooms and suites, multiple dining outlets, a full-service spa, swimming pool, tennis and pickleball courts, and direct access to the beach.

With approximately 60,000 square feet of indoor and outdoor event space, the resort is a sought-after destination for leisure travelers, meetings, weddings, and special events. Its stunning oceanfront setting, expansive resort amenities, and proximity to all that Santa Barbara has to offer make Hilton Santa Barbara Beachfront Resort a standout hospitality destination and one of the market’s most distinctive properties.

What are we looking for?

Basic Qualifications

  • Minimum of 2 years’ General Manager experience managing a property with minimum $30 million revenue.
  • Strong financial and commercial acumen, with expertise in budget management, financial oversight, revenue optimization, and driving profitability.
  • Demonstrated eye for detail and a commitment to delivering elevated, luxury-level hospitality and guest experiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive high team member engagement and build a strong culture, with a proven track record of developing talent, improving retention, and leading high-performing teams.
  • Strong community leadership and relationship-building skills, with the ability to establish a trusted presence within Santa Barbara, while building meaningful local partnerships, and leveraging community connections to drive business and long-term success.
  • Adept at identifying opportunities for business expansion and driving long-term profitability in the hospitality industry.
  • Experience managing owner relations and fostering positive partnerships.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Resort experience.
  • Local market experience.
  • Hilton brand experience.

Responsibilities

As General Manager, your responsibilities will also include:

  • Managing and optimizing hotel operations: You will lead the hotel with strategic oversight of all departments — ensuring alignment with Hilton brand standards. Through effective budgeting, forecasting, and service delivery, you’ll drive operational excellence and a seamless guest experience. By identifying inefficiencies and leveraging guest feedback, you’ll implement targeted improvements that enhance workflow, reduce waste, and elevate service. Your focus on continuous improvement, coaching, and innovation will strengthen team performance and consistently exceed guest expectations.
  • Managing commercial financial performance: You’ll take full ownership of the property’s financial performance, including sales, revenue and finance that will lead to growth, cost control, and profitability. This means setting and achieving targets for key performance indicators like GOP and RevPAR, while maintaining strong financial discipline. You'll also collaborate closely with the hotel’s commercial team and lead budgeting, forecasting, and strategic planning processes to ensure sustained financial health and business agility.
  • Communicating with key stakeholders: As the primary point of contact for hotel owners and Hilton’s corporate leadership, you will be responsible for maintaining alignment on business goals, operational strategies, and performance expectations. You will deliver regular updates, collaborate on long-term planning, and act as a trusted advisor, ensuring transparency and partnership at every level.
  • Leading and developing on-property teams: You will cultivate a high-performing, people-first culture by recruiting top talent, championing diversity and inclusion, and supporting the professional development of every team member. Through performance management, coaching, and recognition programs, you'll inspire engagement, accountability, and continuous growth. Your leadership will empower teams to deliver outstanding service while growing their own careers at Hilton.

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

About The Team

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
  • Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
  • Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
  • Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
  • Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
  • Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Generous paid time off (PTO) – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters most
  • Health & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family covered
  • Financial security for your future – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what’s next
  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.
