job.job_description:
Job Summary

The Senior Paid Media Manager is a senior individual contributor responsible for leading full-funnel paid media strategies that drive measurable business results across the enterprise. This role serves as a trusted advisor to stakeholders, oversees agency partnerships, and provides expertise across paid search, social, display, video, metasearch, audio, and digital out-of-home channels. The position partners closely with Brand, Analytics, Creative, Finance, and external partners to optimize media investments and improve business performance. Operating with a high degree of autonomy, the Senior Paid Media Manager influences strategic decisions through deep subject matter expertise, data-driven insights, and cross-functional collaboration.

Note: This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a strategic business partner to key stakeholders by providing recommendations on media investment strategy, channel mix, optimization approaches, and performance opportunities.
  • Lead the development and execution of full-funnel paid media strategies across Search, Metasearch, Social, Display, Video, Connected TV (CTV), Online Video (OLV), Programmatic, Audio, and Digital Out-of-Home (DOOH) channels.
  • Develop integrated media plans and investment recommendations based on business objectives, market opportunities, and performance insights.
  • Partner with internal teams and external agencies to ensure media strategies align with business goals, audience targets, and creative execution.
  • Monitor campaign performance, analyze results, and translate findings into actionable recommendations that improve return on investment and business outcomes.
  • Drive continuous improvement through structured testing, experimentation, measurement frameworks, attribution strategies, and optimization initiatives.
  • Provide thought leadership on media trends, emerging technologies, and innovative opportunities that enhance enterprise marketing effectiveness.
  • Lead relationships with media agencies, publishers, and technology partners to ensure execution quality, accountability, and performance excellence.
  • Manage media budgets, forecasts, spend pacing, and allocation strategies to ensure financial accuracy and efficient use of resources.

Qualifications

Employment Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in paid media, performance marketing, or related digital marketing disciplines.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience across Paid Search, Paid Social, Programmatic Display & Video, Metasearch, Audio, and DOOH media channels.
  • Experience working in agency and/or in-house marketing environments preferred.
  • Proven experience leading complex programs, influencing stakeholders, and driving business outcomes without direct authority.
  • Experience operating as a senior individual contributor with accountability for strategic initiatives and measurable business results.

Technical Skills

  • Hands-on experience with major digital media platforms, including Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, DV360, and The Trade Desk.
  • Working knowledge of ad technology platforms, analytics tools, and media measurement solutions, including Google Marketing Platform and Adobe Analytics.
  • Experience with attribution modeling, media measurement frameworks, and incrementality testing methodologies.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and presentation software for campaign analysis, forecasting, reporting, and executive communications.

Additional Skills & Competencies

  • Strategic thinking and business partnership skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to convert insights into action.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders and build strong cross-functional relationships.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ownership mindset, intellectual curiosity, and commitment to continuous improvement.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.
  • Advanced degree preferred.
  • Relevant digital marketing certifications are a plus.(Not required)

Travel Requirements

  • Occasional travel to Choice Hotels headquarters, approximately 4-6 times per year.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience marketing within a franchise business model, including knowledge of franchise marketing funds and budget allocation structures.
  • Proven success managing marketing strategies across a portfolio of brands ("house of brands"), balancing brand positioning, audience targeting, and messaging for multiple audiences simultaneously.
  • Strong background in consumer-led marketing, with a focus on driving customer acquisition, retention, and customer lifetime value (CLTV).
  • Experience developing and executing marketing strategies that support measurable business growth and guest acquisition objectives.
  • Hospitality industry experience strongly preferred, ideally with franchised hotel brands or multi-brand hospitality organizations.
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote environment and collaborate across cross-functional teams operating in Eastern Time Zone (EST).

Salary Range

The salary range for this position is $99,919 - $135,000. In addition to the annual salary, this role is eligible for an annual bonus based on the terms of Choice's Management Incentive Plan (MIP).

Choice prioritizes our associate wellbeing by offering a comprehensive benefits program that is both competitive and flexible to help you achieve your wellbeing goals - here are just a few:

  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Leave and paid time-off for holidays, vacation, personal, family, volunteer, sick, jury duty, bereavement, military, and religious observance
  • Financial benefits for retirement and health savings
  • Employee recognition programs
  • Discounts at Choice hotels worldwide

About Choice

Choice Hotels International, Inc. (NYSE: CHH), is one of the largest lodging franchisors in the world. With 7,500 hotels in 45+ countries and territories, we offer a range of high-quality lodging options in the upper upscale, upper midscale, midscale, extended stay, and economy segments. We’re the hotel company for those who choose to bet on themselves — the striver, the dreamer, the entrepreneur — because that’s who we are, too.

At Choice, we are united by the simple belief that tomorrow will be even better than today — for associates, our company, and our franchisees. At our worldwide corporate headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, at our technology center in Scottsdale, Arizona, and through our associates around the globe, every voice is heard and every idea is listened to, no matter what area of the company they come from. We are united in supporting the entrepreneurial dreams of our thousands of franchise owners, which propels us forward — giving our work at Choice a purpose larger than our business.

Our corporate office locations:

North Bethesda, MD — Located at Pike & Rose, our worldwide headquarters is less than 15 miles from Washington, D.C., one block away from the North Bethesda Metro station, with easy access to I-495, complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Scottsdale, AZ — Located at the northwest corner of Loop 101, the Scottsdale office is home to our technology, eCommerce and customer service organizations, with easy access to complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Minneapolis, MN — Select roles are based in our Minneapolis office on Highway 394, near the intersection with Highway 100, only five minutes from downtown.

Field/Remote — Select roles designated as field/remote will require associates to work from a home office, connecting virtually with Choice team members and leadership on Zoom, with possible required travel depending on the role.

Choice’s Cultural Values

Welcome and Respect Everyone | Be Bold | Be Quick | Listen | Be Curious | Show Integrity

Choice’s Leadership Principles

Act with Intention | Lead with Authenticity | Grow & Deliver

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Media & Sponsorships Business Director

Introduction to the team

We create and deliver tailored marketing strategies for Expedia Group’s brands, focusing on establishing strong connections and cohesive experiences for travelers and partners. We leverage our functional expertise and creative excellence to build trust and loyalty for our brands through innovative marketing approaches and technology.

Our team delivers travel inspiration through boundary-pushing media solutions and purposeful sponsorships. By blending strategic innovation with advanced technology, we create seamless, high-impact journeys that captivate travelers and elevate our brands. We measure success through the sustained growth we deliver for Expedia Group via our trusted worldwide collaborators.

Make an impact

We are seeking a dynamic Brand Media and Sponsorship Business Director to serve as the Dedicated Global Brand Media Lead for our organization. In this high-impact individual contributor role, you will act as the strategic bridge and trusted advisor between the Integrated Marketing and Creative team and the Global Media and Sponsorship team. You will be responsible for orchestrating the end-to-end brand media and sponsorship narrative, ensuring that global strategies are not only fiscally responsible but also deliver against core business objectives, across all markets.

The Media and Sponsorship Business Director, reports directly to the VP, Global Media and Sponsorship, and is accountable for setting the strategic media and sponsorship approach for one of our leading consumer brands (Expedia, Hotels.com or Vrbo), leading the distribution and communication of briefs (both internal and external), and ensuring all outputs deliver against the agreed integrated marketing plan, business and financial objectives. As the core brand champion, the Director builds alignment with interdependent stakeholders, governs process, and provides direction to empower the Media and Sponsorships Strategy and Planning Teams to design holistic strategies and plans that deliver agreed business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Governance

  • Global Stakeholder Leadership: Act as the primary strategic interface for the Integrated Marketing & Creative organization (and Brand General Manager’s, where required), serving as the dedicated global lead for all brand media and sponsorship initiatives.
  • Process Governance: Collaborate cross-functionally to design, implement, and govern the interaction process between Integrated Marketing, Brands and execution teams, ensuring consistency, compliance, and agility.
  • Project Leadership: Lead high-visibility brand and partner projects, driving alignment across internal stakeholders and external agencies to ensure effective delivery.
  • Innovation: Champion innovative ideas and approaches to evolve internal communication frameworks, guiding hybrid in-house digital teams and external agencies towards optimal media strategy, integrated media plans, data-driven learning agendas and mobilizing insights & optimization outputs to drive efficiency and pre agreed brand measurement framework KPIs.

Planning, Briefing & Deliverables

  • Brief Ownership: Own the distribution and communication of all brand media and sponsorship briefs (internal and external), ensuring clarity of vision and objectives.
  • Core Deliverable Management: Manage the development and delivery of key outputs, including strategic approaches, rationale documentation, holistic media plans, and post-campaign reports.
  • Objective Planning: Apply analytical rigor and a scientific mindset to produce evidence-based proposals, rationale, and learning agendas to drive impact.
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Work with Planning, Agency, and Execution Leads to coordinate responses to briefs, ensuring all outputs align with the agreed strategic business goals and integrated marketing team deliverables.
  • Creative Integration: Collaborate with Integrated Marketing & Creative teams to ensure media, sponsorship, and creative strategies are aligned, defining asset requirements and delivery timelines.

Financial Accountability & Performance

  • P&L Ownership: Be accountable for brand-specific media and sponsorship finance decisions and P&L management. This includes ensuring financial rigor, transparency, and managing the allocation of capital across markets, channels, and geographies based on measurement outputs, corporate guidance and Brand GM requests.
  • Business Reporting: Drive brand business targets and lead comprehensive reporting activities, including Monthly and Quarterly Business Reviews (MBRs/QBRs) and other key performance forums.
  • Global Synthesis: Synthesize market-specific schematics and reports into global views, analyzing learnings to provide actionable insights that inform future planning and capital allocation.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field; or equivalent related professional experience
  • 12+ years experience in client management and strategic media and sponsorship planning, gained in‑house at a global brand and/or in a senior leadership role at a media/creative agency or relevant technology platform
  • Brings a forward-looking perspective on AI, from setting foundations to employing technology to enhance integrated marketing, media, and sponsorship workflows
  • Proven experience leading complex, multi‑market brand media strategies across channels (digital, offline, and sponsorships) and translating them into integrated, executable plans
  • Strong financial acumen, with a track record of managing large, complex media budgets and P&Ls, ensuring financial rigor, transparency, and compliance
  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex data and plans into clear, concise narratives and executive‑ready insights

Preferred Qualifications

  • A highly consultative approach with a strong track record of influencing and aligning senior stakeholders in matrixed, global organizations
  • Demonstrated operational excellence, with the ability to prioritize multiple complex projects, govern process, and drive work to high‑quality completion at pace
  • Analytical mindset with comfort applying data, measurement frameworks, and learning agendas to inform strategy, optimization, and investment decisions
  • Proactive problem‑solver who identifies issues and opportunities, takes ownership, and drives toward solutions while escalating appropriately when needed

The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $207,500.00 to $290,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $332,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Benefits And Perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Du liebst es, in einem dynamischen Umfeld strategische und nachhaltige Themen zu entwickeln und bei deren Umsetzung maßgeblich zu unterstützen? Dann bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil unseres Strategie- und Sustainability-Teams der Lufthansa Airlines. Gemeinsam mit Dir gestalten wir die Zukunft der LH Airlines.

Aufgaben

Das Strategie- und Sustainability-Team der LHA verantwortet die Entwicklung und Umsetzung der Strategie und die Erreichung der Nachhaltigkeitsziele, u.a. durch Beratung und Unterstützung des LHA Management Boards.

Zu deinen Hauptaufgaben gehören:

  • Teilnahme an Aufgaben mit hoher wirtschaftlicher und strategischer Relevanz durch die Unterstützung bei der Planung, Durchführung und Steuerung zentraler Initiativen
  • Das Erlernen praktischer Fertigkeiten mit Fokus auf die Strukturierung und Analyse komplexer, mehrdimensionaler und bereichsübergreifender Fragestellungen
  • Mitwirkung bei der Entwicklung von Zielsystemen, Kennzahlen und Maßnahmen zur Steuerung sowie Überwachung der Strategieumsetzung
  • Unterstützung bei der Kommunikation von Strategie- und Nachhaltigkeitsinitiativen an Fachbereiche und bereichsübergreifende Stakeholder
  • Mitarbeit bei der Entwicklung von Konzepten, Business Cases und Geschäftsplänen zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung strategischer Projekte

Benefits

  • Discounts bei ausgewählten Partnern
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Kostenloses Parken
  • Events für Mitarbeiter:innen
  • Kantine

Voraussetzungen

Um ein Praktikum in unserem Unternehmen zu absolvieren, musst du dich zum Zeitpunkt des Praktikums mindestens im 3. Studiensemester befinden.

  • Immatrikulation über den gesamten Zeitraum des Praktikums (aktuelle Immatrikulationsbescheinigung und ein schriftlicher Pflichtpraktikumsnachweis müssen der Bewerbung beigefügt werden) oder das Praktikum zwischen dem Bachelor- und Masterstudium (Gap Year)
  • Studium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, des Wirtschaftsingenieurwesens, einer naturwissenschaftlichen Fachrichtung oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs mit wirtschaftlichem Bezu
  • Fähigkeiten in der professionellen Kommunikation in deutscher und englischer Sprache auf verhandlungssicherem Niveau
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in den MS-Office-Anwendungen, insbesondere PowerPoint und Excel
  • Ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit sowie ein hohes Maß an Kreativität, Flexibilität und Einsatzbereitschaft

Weitere Informationen auch in unseren FAQs.

Über uns

Die Lufthansa Group ist ein weltweit operierender Luftverkehrskonzern. In ihrem Heimatmarkt Europa nimmt sie als umsatzstärkste Airline Group die führende Rolle ein. Mit ca. 100.000 Mitarbeiter:innen erzielte die Lufthansa Group im Geschäftsjahr 2025 einen Umsatz von 39.597 Mio. EUR. Die Lufthansa Group setzt sich aus den Geschäftsfeldern Passagier-Airlines, Logistik, Technik sowie den Weiteren Gesellschaften und Konzernfunktionen zusammen.

job.job_description:
Senior Paid Social Specialist - (Hybrid)

As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, " What's the next step?’’ Start your journey with us!

We're seeking an experienced Senior Paid Social Specialist to join our Online Display & Video Marketing team. This position, reporting into the Display & Video Advertising Manager, will contribute with the rest of the team to deliver on our ambitious growth expectations. In this role you will work with the rest of the team in designing the strategy and executing, measuring and optimising both acquisition and re-engagement campaigns across several media providers, including, but not limited to, Meta, TikTok, Youtube, Pinterest, Spotify, Snapchat.

If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.

Why eDreams ODIGEO

We’re the world's leading travel subscription platform.

  • We pioneered Prime, the first and world’s leading travel subscription programme since launching in 2017.
  • Millions of Prime members every year across multiple markets.
  • 5 brands: eDreams, GO Voyages, Opodo, Travellink, and the metasearch engine Liligo
  • This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalised service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members.
  • Diversity is our strength that’s why our eDOers are coming from different nationalities from all continents – 99% permanent contracts


Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a Senior Paid Social Specialist in the Online Display & Video Marketing team you will be in charge of:

  • Design and execute full funnel marketing campaigns – from awareness/branding to performance-based acquisition, retargeting and re-engagement – across different paid social providers and geographies for both Web and App platforms;
  • Own the campaign performance to ensure campaign targets are met (sales, cost per sale, ROAS, brand awareness, reach, etc) through continuous analysis and optimization;
  • Design the agenda for the assigned media and campaigns, across all the key enablers including campaign setup, measurement, creative, tracking;
  • Preparation of regular reports with clear, actionable insights;
  • Design and execute A/B testing for media buying, audiences, content/promotions and creatives;
  • Collaborate with providers (Meta, TikTok, etc.) in order to maximise the full potential of each platform/media (testing new features, digesting new data, etc);
  • Create new/improve current best practices and document processes for campaign launch and ongoing optimization;
  • Collaborate with the internal creative team as well as external creative agencies to ensure creatives do align to the requirements from publishers;
  • Help defining the budget and generate investment scenarios for the launch of new campaigns;


What you need to succeed:

Good to have

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:

  • At least 4 years of experience in online marketing related roles focusing on Paid Social with proven hands-on track record of managing high-budget performance campaigns;
  • Deep understanding and hands-on experience in managing one or more media buying platforms among Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Snapchat, Pinterest, etc
  • Exceptional analytical skills and the ability to analyze data following new approaches to make optimization decisions;
  • Truly curious and passionate about online marketing. Willing to help create and nurture a best-in-class marketing organization. We are looking for people that really want to be the best at digital advertising and know each media inside out;
  • Strong understanding of display and video performance metrics, industry best practices, audience segmentation, cross and upselling strategies, creative performance insights;
  • Strong organizational skills, comfortable working in demanding environments. You will be surrounded by top industry talents.
  • Any prior experience in mobile app performance marketing (like AppsFlyer, Google App Campaigns, or Meta and TikTok App) is valued and considered a plus, but is not mandatory;
  • Self driven to achieve results;
  • Any level in English as long as you are able to tell a story from the data, communicate information around campaigns and have relevant conversation with the team and the stakeholders.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Applied AI Tools: Demonstrated comfort using practical AI tools such as Gemini, or other AI-powered assistants.
  • Experimentation Mindset: Curiosity and eagerness to explore, experiment with, and integrate emerging AI-driven solutions into workflows.
  • AI-Enhanced Problem Solving: Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to streamline processes, and enhance productivity.
  • Adaptability and Learning Agility: Enthusiastic about continuously learning and quickly adapting to new AI features and capabilities.


What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture.

Here's what we offer:

  • A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and premium equipment with role-based selection options and device ownership through our equipment lifecycle program when it reaches its refresh cycle.
  • Continuous learning to fuel your growth and explore new horizons! 📚 Learn and grow with free Coursera access, soft skills workshops, tech training, leadership development, and more. Plus, enjoy a great onboarding program. Grow opportunities to empower your career and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.
  • Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcomes. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
  • Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padeltournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
  • Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.


Wanna take a peek into what it's like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

Apply now!

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Our people are the key to our success. Each one of them is unique in their own way and the respect for their uniqueness is and will always be a passion and motivation. Don’t meet every requirement? If you’re excited about this role but do not feel your experience aligns perfectly with all the requirements we strongly encourage you to apply nevertheless.

job.job_description:
Organization- The Standard, Mexico City

Summary

The Standard, Mexico City arrives in the historic Tabacalera neighborhood with character, color, and a signature wink. With 206 guestrooms, 27 branded residences, vibrant dining destinations, and a rooftop overlooking the Monumento a la Revolución, we're bringing our unmistakable energy to Latin America.

We're looking for a Night Manager to take charge after dark and ensure the hotel runs smoothly, safely, and with the unmistakable spirit of The Standard. We’re searching for someone calm under pressure, naturally resourceful, and able to turn unexpected moments into seamless guest experiences.

The Opportunity

At The Standard, the night has its own rhythm.

As our Night Manager, you’ll be the face of the hotel after hours—leading the overnight operation, supporting our guests and colleagues, and making sure every detail is handled with confidence, discretion, and a little personality. From late-night arrivals to early-morning departures, you’ll help create a stay that feels effortless around the clock.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the hotel’s overnight operation, ensuring a smooth and memorable guest experience.
  • Act as the senior point of contact for guests, colleagues, and overnight partners.
  • Handle guest requests, concerns, and unexpected situations with professionalism and good judgment.
  • Coordinate with Front Office, Housekeeping, Security, Engineering, and Food & Beverage teams.
  • Oversee late arrivals, VIP guests, room moves, wake-up calls, and early departures.
  • Ensure all overnight procedures, safety protocols, and security standards are followed.
  • Review daily reports, operational logs, and financial information with accuracy.
  • Support the Night Audit process and ensure all transactions are properly recorded.
  • Complete thorough handovers to the morning team, ensuring continuity across shifts.
  • Lead, support, and motivate overnight colleagues, creating a calm and confident working environment.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the guest experience and the way the hotel operates after dark.

Qualifications

What You'll Bring

  • Previous experience in a Night Manager, Duty Manager, Front Office Manager, or similar hotel leadership role.
  • Experience in a luxury lifestyle hotel or high-energy hospitality environment.
  • Strong knowledge of Front Office and overnight hotel operations.
  • Calm decision-making skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving abilities.
  • A natural instinct for hospitality and a genuine interest in people.
  • Strong attention to detail, without losing sight of the bigger picture.
  • Fluency in English and Spanish, with the ability to confidently engage with an international clientele.
  • Flexibility to work overnight shifts, weekends, and holidays.
  • A confident, curious, and personable approach that feels right at home at The Standard.

If you know how to keep the energy going after dark, stay cool when the unexpected happens, and make every guest feel looked after at any hour, we’d love to hear from you.

Nice To Have

Benefits And Perks

  • Company-wide week off each year
  • No-meeting Fridays

  • Focus on your career growth:

job.job_description:
The Global Luxury & Lifestyle Sales Account Director is primarily responsible for an account portfolio luxury agencies to maximize and drive revenues and market share to IHG brands. Knowledge of luxury consortia networks and agency partners across Midwestern USA. Manage and coordinate transient and group luxury travel requests for hotel partners, ensuring a high level of service and client engagement.

Key to this role is creating, evolving and driving strategic global account plans while developing relationships and networks within the accounts to increase opportunities, conversion and revenue for our hotels. The role is responsible for interacting with all Associates from their respective accounts as well as IHG Hotel sales teams to deliver bookings from our mutual end user customers.

Location – Remote: **Candidate must reside in Midwestern U.S.: Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Minnesota, Michigan, Missouri, Nebraska, Ohio or Wisconsin; and must reside within 1 hour proximity to a major US airport**

Your day to day

  • Manage and develop portfolio of accounts to maximize market share and revenues;
    • Assess accounts and their opportunities, as a result create account plans as per the IHG template and execute strategies and tactics to drive revenue and market share.
    • Network within the accounts to find key decision makers, their support staff and other relationship opportunities.
    • Collaborate with IHG hotels to design and deliver on in person events that allow travel agents to experience IHG brands.
    • Conduct or participate in client meetings as well as plan and coordinate familiarization tours and site inspections.
    • Handle and manage clients’ queries or issues.
    • Gather information on current and prospective clients/contacts to generate incremental business.
    • Collaborate with IHG hotel facing sales teams to deliver for NHOPs and key portfolios of hotels.
    • Keep an accurate record of all sales calls made for future reference and control purposes in the sales system.
  • Ensure accurate Account Profiles and Account planning are undertaken at least annually with such templates completed and posted to appropriate communication channels and sales systems, i.e. complete annual SSRP’s as set out by InterContinental Hotels & Resorts regional sales policy.
  • Work with the appropriate Hotels to ensure clear communication of expectations and goals. For each account as appropriate develop a network of support at key hotels ensuring close working relationships with hotel management and sales staff.
  • Update Account and Contact profiles, attach Account plans, ensure ‘live’ information for action.
  • Use both account interaction and publicly available tools to monitor competitors' activities as it relates to both IHG and the portfolio of accounts and share relevant information with key stakeholders in line with the IHG counsel.
  • Other duties & responsibilities:
    • Maintain effective control of sales expenses.
    • Assist with familiarizations and entertaining as required.
    • Act as a resource for all on property hotel staff.
    • Include hotel General Managers and sales staff where appropriate on sales call.
    • Report to the Director of Global Luxury & Lifestyle for The Americas on market trends.
What We Need From You:

  • Bachelor's or Master’s Degree in Marketing, Management, Business, or a relevant field of work, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience preferred.

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotel team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You are responsible for the overall management of the hotel's accounting records and financial reports, ensuring compliance with company, owner, statutory, and fiscal requirements and timetables. As a Director of Finance, you’re not just overseeing all hotel financial operations – you’re a strategic business partner who works alongside the business, supporting and advising on strategic and operational decision-making through insights that drive better business performance.

Responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Drive financial strategy: Oversee all financial operations, ensuring alignment with the hotel’s strategic goals to optimize profitability and efficiency
  • Oversee financial planning and analysis: Direct the preparation of annual plans, projections, and budgets, providing financial insights to support business decisions
  • Advise hotel leadership: Serve as the primary financial advisor to hotel management, ownership, and department heads, offering data-driven recommendations to enhance financial performance
  • Ensure financial compliance: Uphold adherence to Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and safeguard hotel assets through strong financial controls
  • Optimize financial reporting: Oversee systems and processes to drive accuracy, efficiency, and transparency in financial reporting.
  • Monitor and approve financial transactions: Oversee and authorize hotel sales, purchases, salaries, and expenses to maintain fiscal responsibility and operational efficiency
  • Cultivate a high-performing team: Drive engagement and retention through performance management, professional development, and recognition programs

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • University degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field
  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in hotel finance, including 3+ years in a leadership role
  • Professional accounting qualification preferred
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken)
  • Proficient in hotel systems such as PEP, Birch St, Navision, Agilysys, etc.
  • Strong skills in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
  • Deep understanding of financial controls, compliance, and reporting standards
  • Proven ability to lead teams and collaborate across departments

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

Job Description

The successful candidate will play a key role within the Properties Department, overseeing the facilities management of assigned SIA owned and leased premises in Singapore. The role encompasses a wide range of responsibilities, from managing preventive and corrective maintenance to coordinating soft services, project management, internal works requisitions, facility bookings, and more. The candidate will work closely with internal stakeholders, service providers, and regulatory authorities to ensure the smooth, safe, and efficient operation of all facilities under their care.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage a team to deliver systematic, cost-effective, and responsive maintenance of building equipment, systems, and common services.
  • Oversee the operations of the Building Operations Centre (BOC), ensuring timely and professional handling of service requests, feedback, and complaints from occupants, with issues tracked to closure.
  • Manage and monitor Integrated Facilities Management (IFM) and other FM related service contracts, ensuring performance in line with specifications, SLAs/KPIs, and statutory compliance.
  • Strategically plan and manage energy and utility consumption to support sustainability targets, including achieving Green Mark and energy management goals.
  • Prepare, manage, and control operating and capital expenditure budgets, including forecasting, cost estimation, and tracking of project and maintenance expenditure.
  • Plan and manage improvement and retrofitting projects, overseeing the full project lifecycle from feasibility and design through procurement, implementation, commissioning, and handover.
  • Liaise with authorities, regulatory agencies, and internal stakeholders to ensure compliance with statutory requirements, licences, inspections, and permits related to property and facilities.
  • Assist the Manager in conducting feasibility studies, site assessments, technical evaluations, and lifecycle costing to support FM strategies and initiatives.
  • Manage administrative functions related to building and facilities operations, including procurement, requisition processing, documentation, asset tracking, and service level monitoring.
  • Drive continuous improvement in FM service delivery, maintenance regimes, digitalisation efforts, and customer experience through proactive reviews, root cause analysis, and system enhancements.
  • Conduct regular inspections and audits of service providers to ensure adherence to safety, regulatory, environmental, and quality standards, and close out findings promptly.
  • Collaborate closely with building occupants and business units to meet operational needs, project schedules, and space requirements, including facility bookings.
  • Stay abreast of the latest technologies and best practices, and drive Smart FM, energy optimisation, and digital building initiatives.
  • Lead the IFM team during emergencies such as system failures, fire alarms, or business continuity events, and maintain and test emergency response plans.
  • Promote a strong workplace culture of safety, service excellence, environmental stewardship, and stakeholder engagement within the FM team.
  • Perform any other duties as assigned to support facility management related operations.

Requirements

  • Degree in Engineering, Building, Facilities Management, or a related discipline.
  • Fresh graduates are welcome to apply. Candidates with relevant internship or work experience in facilities management, engineering, or building maintenance will have an added advantage.
  • Basic understanding of FM operations, building services, and systems, including MEP, ACMV, P&S, and fire protection.
  • Certifications such as BCA GMAP (FM), SCEM, WEMP, or FSM are advantageous but not mandatory.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving abilities, with good communication and interpersonal skills.
  • A team player with a proactive mindset and a willingness to learn in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Able to respond to urgent operational matters when required (including after office hours).
  • Strong interest in building operations, facilities management, and sustainability practices.
  • Knowledge of relevant Singapore codes and regulations (e.g., Fire Safety Act, WSH, BCA requirements).
  • Ability to read technical drawings and familiarity with CMMS/Smart FM platforms and basic data analysis (e.g., Excel/Power BI) will have an added advantage.

We thank all candidates for your interest in Singapore Airlines, and regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

Senior Director, Flights Engineering

Our Technology team is the backbone of our company: constantly creating, testing, learning and iterating to better meet the needs of our customers. If you thrive in a fast-paced, ideas-led environment, you’re in the right place.

Why This Job’s a Big Deal

As one of our leaders, you’ll have a big impact on our products and their technical direction, as well as influence the company's technical strategy. You will also have a big impact on your team members, their day-to-day experience on our team and their growth over time. To continuously deliver on our goal to be the best travel deal makers in the world for millions of our customers, we need to have well designed technology that is reliable, performs well, and allows for the continuous improvements we make to our products, and we also need to have teams that feel engaged, productive, empowered, and sustainable. All of this requires talented leaders with the right mix of technical, collaborative, management, and leadership skills and values.

In This Role You Will Get To

  • Lead and be responsible for a software development teams that owns the services that power Priceline’s Flight Shopping Platform
  • Serve as a leader of leaders, scaling delivery and cross-functional execution through your teams
  • Drive technology strategy, operational backbone, and system architecture decisions across the flights domain
  • Lead adoption of AI/agentic engineering practices to accelerate shopping-experience innovation
  • Own the multi-team roadmap and partner with Product Group Engineering leads, flight commercial stakeholders, and cross-functional peers to set priorities and long-term technical direction
  • Manage and coach talented managers and engineers of all levels of experience.
  • Have influence on what we build, how we build, and how we work.
  • Participate in various formal and/or grass-roots technical and non-technical communities at Priceline.
  • Become part of a team and organization that is passionate about our work, but values a healthy work/life balance.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science or related field.
  • 15+ years of experience in software engineering and development.
  • 5+ years experience in leading software development teams.
  • Proven track record managing a mix of people-managers and senior ICs, overseeing an org of 20+ across multiple teams
  • B2C, e-commerce, or OTA experience, ideally with a strong experimentation culture; travel industry experience a plus
  • Skilled at hiring, coaching, and developing engineering leaders, including performance management of managers
  • Experience operating across global, cross-functional teams and managing competing priorities through organizational change
  • Proven collaboration skills with both technical and less-technical colleagues.
  • Experience with developing on Cloud, especially GCP and AWS.
  • Strong system-architecture fluency, with comfort partnering deeply on technical decisions
  • Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust.
  • The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics is essential.

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. In addition to a competitive base salary, certain roles may be eligible for an annual bonus and/or equity grant.

The salary range for this position is $210,000- $265,000K USD.

Who We Are

WE ARE PRICELINE.

Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.

Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.

We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.

Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.

If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!

Flexible work at Priceline

Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.

Perks & Benefits At Priceline

Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:

Health & wellness coverage including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources

Generous time off including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days

Work/life support including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)

Financial security programs such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts

Signature travel perks including employee-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits

Additional perks & discounts like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits

A people-first culture with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together

Specific benefits and programs vary by location.

Inclusion is a Big Deal!

To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.

Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.

job.job_description:
About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

Tripadvisor Experiences Engineering is the team that builds and supports the world's leading marketplace for travel experiences. We believe that making memories is what travel is all about. And with 400,000+ travel experiences to explore—everything from simple tours to extreme adventures (and everything in between) —making memories that will last a lifetime has never been easier.

About The Role

We are looking for a product-focused Senior Software Engineer to join our Experiences Engineering team. This is a full-stack role, leveraging Java, SQL, React, AWS and AI tools. It suits T-shaped engineers who thrive on autonomy and technical leadership. You’ll build and maintain highly scalable distributed systems that power travel experiences for millions of users globally.

We embrace flexibility in where and how work gets done and also value meaningful in-person moments to connect and collaborate. You can expect a remote-first working model with periodic in-person gatherings at your closest office for team connection, planning, or other key moments. This position is open to candidates based within a commutable distance (generally up to 1.5 hours) of one of our office hubs in London, Oxford, Krakow or Lisbon.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead Technical Design: Own features end-to-end, leading the design and implementation of highly visible features while balancing security, privacy, and performance.
  • Translate Strategy to Action: Work with Product and Data partners to turn high-level business goals into clear technical specifications, often serving as the technical lead for multi-quarter initiatives.
  • Elevate the Team: Set the bar for code quality, lead the adoption of review standards, and mentor junior and mid-level engineers.
  • Master Agentic AI: Use AI tools as a strategic partner to plan approaches, decompose ambiguous work, and establish new standards for monitoring and reliability.
  • Architect for Resilience: Define the operational strategy and design highly fault-tolerant architectures, proactively identifying structural risks and setting the team-wide standards for automation, monitoring, and long-term stability.
  • Optimize Systems: Actively look for opportunities to simplify, consolidate, or retire legacy code to reduce complexity and increase team velocity.

Skills & Experience

We typically look for 5+ years’ experience, following a Bachelor’s degree or above in Comp Science or a related field.

  • Distributed Systems Expertise: Deep understanding of concurrent programming and experience building high-performance, scalable backend systems in cloud environments.
  • Analytical Mindset: A habit of asking how will we know this worked? and using operational data or experiment results to validate every significant technical decision.
  • Full-Stack Proficiency: Strong experience in at least one modern backend language (e.g., Java, C#, Go, Python) and familiarity with modern front-end frameworks.
  • AI Coding: you are fluent coding with either Cursor or Codex/Claude/Open Code.
  • Navigating Ambiguity: Comfortable making rational tradeoffs between non-functional requirements and delivery speed in an evolving environment.
  • Collaborative Leadership: Proven ability to build relationships across disciplines and communicate technical trade-offs to non-technical partners.

We’d love to see experience with NoSQL databases, GraphQL, Kafka, or containerization (Docker/Kubernetes). Experience building tools or abstractions that provide leverage to an entire engineering team is also a significant plus. We don’t expect you to know everything on day one. More than any specific tool, we value curiosity and the ability to solve problems creatively.

We value engineers from different technical backgrounds. You can complete our coding interview exercises in any language of your choice, but need to be open to working within the Java ecosystem when you join!

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation packages, including base salary, annual bonus, and more.
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. We take a remote-friendly approach to collaboration, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like in select locations.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

  • Traveller first: We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.
  • Execution is our edge: We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.
  • We succeed together: The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

Discover more in our Tech Blog, for an inside look into some of our exciting and ground-breaking technical projects here at Tripadvisor Group.

Tripadvisor Group champions the unique identities, abilities, and experiences of all our people – employees, customers, and partners. This stems from our belief in the transformative power of travel, dining, and experiences to connect us and open doors to worlds very different from our own. Our ED&I strategy shapes how we approach our people, culture, business, and reputation. Tripadvisor Group strives to embed inclusion and belonging across all our brands.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!

How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

Join Delta Air Lines As a Reservations Co-Op And Help Shape The Future Of Customer Care. You’ll Work On High-impact Projects That Improve The Servicing Experiences For Millions Of Customers While Gaining Hands-on Experience In Data Analytics, Process Improvement, Product Management, Or Statistical Modeling. While Co-oping In Reservations You’ll Gain

  • Real-world experience in a Fortune 100 company
  • Experience presenting to an executive audience
  • Mentorship and networking opportunities

What is Reservations?

The Reservations department serves as a key point of contact for customers before, during, and after their travel experience. This co-op opportunity is based at our General Offices (GO) and functions as a back-office support role. In this position, you will support the department by partnering closely with our Customer Engagement Centers and providing essential behind-the-scenes assistance that enhances both the customer experience and the effectiveness of our frontline agents.

Job Summary

As a Reservations Co-Op, you will act as an internal consultant within the department, leading semester-long projects that support divisional strategies and business objectives. These initiatives often involve cross-functional collaboration to identify opportunities, improve processes, and deliver solutions that benefit both customers and employees. Co-ops apply strong critical thinking and interpersonal skills to perform tasks such as:

  • Resolve product, process, and project-related issues and risks
  • Perform data analysis and collection
  • Identify and recommend process improvements and operational efficiencies

These projects are often complex and may involve exposure to sensitive or confidential information and present moderate financial risk. The final project deliverable is a capstone presentation given to division leaders highlighting project lessons learned, impacts made, and recommendations going forward.

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Must be currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree
  • Must not be enrolled in any classes, either remote or on-campus, during the duration of the program
  • Must be able to work 16 consecutive weeks
  • Must be able to come into Corporate Headquarters in Atlanta 4 times per week
  • Must be able to commit to three rotations prior to finishing undergraduate degree (any combination of spring, summer, and fall)
  • A strong team player, detail oriented, and perform well under pressure
  • Conveys professional image to all levels of associates
  • Proficient in MS Office applications, including Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint
  • Must be willing to travel as required
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency.
  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills highly preferred
  • Possess technical skills, with an emphasis on SQL and any programming language
  • Possess business skills such as business modeling, project management, or competitive analysis

Senior Commercial Credit Risk Analyst

This role sits within the B2B Finance Credit team, acting as a key interface between Sales, Commercial Finance, Partner Finance, Accounting and Group Treasury. You will support some of our largest global travel partners and play a central role in strengthening the financial governance of our growing credit programme.

This position will suit a candidate with strong analytical capability, excellent communication and negotiation skills, and proven experience managing large and complex partner portfolios (50M+ credit exposure) as long as small travel businesses. You will be a trusted business partner who can influence senior stakeholders internally and externally, while confidently assessing financial risk and resolving complex issues.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead and manage a portfolio of high-value partners, including complex credit arrangements, significant credit limits and large multi-currency exposures.
  • Assess and recommend credit limits through detailed financial analysis, including interpretation of balance sheets, cash flow statements and group structures.
  • Build strong, trust-based relationships with major travel partners—acting as their core finance point of contact for risk, payment performance, and commercial discussions.
  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Product & Tech and Commercial Finance to support strategic growth while ensuring governance and risk mitigation.
  • Resolve complex finance issues involving unallocated cash, disputes, reconciliation gaps, or operational blockers impacting receivables.
  • Drive negotiations on collateral, payment terms, and risk-based decisions with large partners, balancing commercial opportunity with financial protection.
  • Support our credit insurance programme, with an effective management of coverage gaps.
  • Strengthen collections processes and identify opportunities to reduce ageing, improve forecasting accuracy, and optimise partner payment behaviour.
  • Evaluate and store partner financial information, ensuring completeness, accuracy and compliance with internal controls.
  • Support the Credit Risk Director in developing and updating Credit Management Policies, ensuring they reflect evolving business strategy and risk appetite.

Experience And Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in credit control, credit risk or corporate finance, with a focus on large B2B portfolios or high-risk accounts.
  • Proven ability to interpret financial statements, assess business models and form clear risk opinions.
  • Experience setting or reviewing credit limits of high amounts is highly desirable.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence senior internal stakeholders and external partners.
  • Demonstrated ability to resolve complex issues, and dispute, think critically, and manage escalations with a calm, solutions-driven approach.
  • Strong relationship-building skills across functions and cultures.
  • High attention to detail and ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.
  • Advanced Excel skills and strong system adaptability (experience with AI, Power BI Power Query is a plus).
  • Experience in business partnering roles or environments where finance must collaborate closely with commercial teams.
  • Knowledge of B2B business models, credit insurance, securitisation or collateral management is advantageous.
  • English speaker
  • Travel experience desirable

Please note that this role is only available in the following locations: Madrid, in alignment with our flexible work model which requires employees to be in-office at least three days a week. We are unable to offer relocation assistance for this role.

The total cash range for this position in Madrid is €43,000.00 to €60,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to €69,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Organization- Hyatt Corporate Office

Summary

Please note that we are only considering candidates located on the west coast for this role, preferably Los Angeles.

The Opportunity

Hyatt Hotels Corporation seeks a Global Sales Director to join our Hyatt Sales Force – Luxury, Lifestyle and Leisure team to lead account management and strategic growth within the Entertainment market. The Global Sales Director will manage third party entertainment accounts and develop new business opportunities to drive market share growth and premium business to Hyatt’s portfolio of hotels. This Director will work in tandem with the LLL and Sports & Entertainment HSF teams, internal and external stakeholders to create and implement strategic account plans that deliver on the organization’s sales strategy, short term and long-term strategic objectives as well as tactics/initiatives for our HSF Accounts.

In this role, you will be collaborating closely with the broader Hyatt Sales Force and individual hotel teams where you’ll be instrumental in continuing to make Hyatt a leading hospitality company. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list since 2013. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

  • Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on-site fitness center
  • A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption
  • Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

The Role

The primary responsibility of the Global Sales Director includes developing strategic account plans to drive new revenue opportunities and market share growth across a portfolio of qualified Entertainment Accounts. Primarily these accounts will be with travel agencies and niche third party organizations. The Director position includes total account management, handling both group and transient travel, with a focus on the West Coast US Market. This position will be responsible for developing and nurturing long term strategic global accounts/relationships with a focus on shifting market share as well as driving premium business and new customers to our portfolio of brands. Brand and program awareness globally is also key to supporting our hotels through proactive sales missions, tradeshows/events and hotel familiarization trips. This is a remote position and the individual reports directly to the Sr Director of Global Sales - Lifestyle.

  • Create and maintain strategic account/action plans for each account that will include: quota targets, customer engagement, key tactics to grow account revenue globally, annual & quarterly account reviews, promotions and B2B marketing opportunities.
  • Support worldwide hotel sales needs based on agreed priorities and anticipated business levels.
  • Work closely with Hyatt Sales Force (HSF) colleagues to retain and expand the HSF’s Key accounts.
  • Act as subject matter expert in the Entertainment segment, accountable for sharing market insights, trends, and opportunities to HSF leadership.
  • Be the “one-stop shop” problem solver for all assigned HSF accounts.
  • Manage and attend Entertainment industry events and Hyatt customer events annually, with a test and learn mentality to ensure that we are
  • Collaboration and accountability for all internal resources around Entertainment segment on HyattConnect and other internal comms, engaging with the field to create ROI on their activities.
  • Entertain customers based on business priorities, including the ability to travel and work off peak hours.
  • Ensure a high level of exposure through direct sales solicitation, telephone contact and written communications.
  • Ensure that Sales Contracts follow established Policies and Procedures and are based on sound commercial judgment.
  • Maintain an awareness of market developments / customer trends.
  • Assist hotel representatives with customer engagement including and not limited to scheduling appointments, targeted customer events, Sales Calls and webinars.
  • Ability to manage an event budget, communication and curate branded experiences for small groups and large events that are customer facing.
  • Ability to fiscally maintain an annual T&E, Seminar and Tradeshow budget.
  • Attend industry events representing Hyatt through the organization’s principles and purpose, and acting as a brand ambassador for our portfolio.
  • Assist new Hotels to identify and acquire potential Accounts.
  • Help to organize and coordinate familiarization trips.
  • Conduct Product Presentations to increase awareness with Key Accounts.
  • Prepare Monthly Activities Report and Production Reports when needed.
  • Very strong follow up, organizational skills and leadership skills.
  • Must be a self-starter and capable of working independently in a fast paced and relatively autonomous environment.
  • Must have good communication and interpersonal skills, particularly with presenting both virtually and in person to every level within the organization, and externally to clients.
  • Takes initiative, is a team player, personable, discreet, and reliable.

Qualifications

Experience Required:

  • At least 8 years related industry experience in global or regional sales, or hotel leadership role.
  • Has worked within hotel sales operations on property.
  • Strong understanding of entertainment travel and a network of contacts
  • Excellent Presentation and networking skills

Experience Preferred:

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • Comprehensive knowledge of Hotels and Sales Practices
  • MS Office, Lanyon, Reserve, Opera, Oracle and Envision preferred
  • Sales and/or operations roles in All inclusive, Luxury, full service and select service properties

The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all-encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary.

The salary range for this position is $115,000 - $130,000. This position is also eligible to participate in a sales incentive plan.

The final pay rate/salary offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level and other qualifications for the role, as well as the location of the performance of work. Pay for the successful candidate will meet local requirements, including the local minimum wage rate.

We welcome you:

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.

We value our relationships with recruitment partners and require that agencies contact us first before submitting any candidates. Hyatt will not be responsible for any fees and obligations associated with unsolicited submissions unless a formal agreement is in place.

job.job_description:
We are seeking a Head of Airline Payments EMEA-APAC to join our global Airline and Hospitality Payments team, where innovation knows no borders.

Payments are no longer just the final step in travel. They shape conversion, trust, operational efficiency and the customer experience. This role will help airlines across EMEA and APAC move faster, simplify payment complexity and get more value from Sabre Travel Payments.

As Head of Airline Payments EMEA-APAC, you will lead regional commercial growth for airline payments. You will build new customer relationships, grow existing accounts and guide airlines through payment modernization with clear, practical advice. You will also connect regional customer needs with Sabre’s global product, marketing and operations teams so we can keep solving the right problems, together.

This is a senior commercial leadership role for someone who can challenge old ways of working, build trust with customers and turn opportunity into measurable growth. Let’s get going.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the EMEA-APAC airline payments sales strategy across new business, renewals, expansion and share-shift opportunities.
  • Build and grow trusted relationships with airline payment, distribution, finance and commercial leaders.
  • Guide customers through payment modernization, including acceptance, virtual cards, account-to-account payments, supplier enablement, fraud, chargebacks and reconciliation.
  • Shape compelling value propositions, negotiate enterprise agreements and move opportunities from early engagement to commercial close.
  • Partner with product, marketing, operations and regional commercial teams to connect customer needs with roadmap priorities and go-to-market plans.

What You’ll Bring

  • Solid experience in strategic sales, commercial partnerships or business development, ideally in airline payments, fintech, travel technology or enterprise SaaS.
  • Proven success selling payment or financial technology solutions to airlines, travel sellers or other travel ecosystem partners.
  • Strong understanding of merchant services, payment acceptance, fraud management, chargebacks, reconciliation, virtual cards and account-to-account payments.
  • Experience leading complex, long-cycle enterprise sales and negotiating with senior customer stakeholders across EMEA, APAC or global markets.
  • Strong commercial judgment, a collaborative leadership style and the confidence to challenge legacy processes when there is a better way forward.

Benefits That Support You

  • Competitive pay and performance-based bonuses
  • Flexible work options
  • Comprehensive healthcare coverage
  • Generous paid time off and holidays
  • Professional development opportunities

Location: we are open to hire this position in different countries across Europe.

We will review your application carefully against the role requirements and keep you informed as the process moves forward. Candidates who meet the minimum criteria will be contacted for next steps.

At Sabre, you’ll work with people who are ambitious for our customers and each other. You’ll collaborate with airlines, fintechs, banks, card networks and travel leaders to help solve real payment challenges across the travel ecosystem.

You’ll also play a role in helping travel payments move toward more open, order-based and customer-centered ways of working. The status quo has had its turn. Now we build what comes next.
