job.job_description:
Organization- Hyatt Corporate Office

Summary

The Opportunity

Join a dynamic team where no two days are the same, providing practical legal guidance that supports Hyatt's hotel operations and business objectives across the Americas. Working closely with Operations, Risk Management, Commercial Services, and hotel leadership, you will advise on a wide range of operational, compliance, and business matters while helping protect Hyatt's brand and manage legal risk.

You will partner with business teams to address complex operational issues, assess and resolve legal risks, and develop practical solutions that support hotels and enhance the guest experience. This role also provides opportunities to contribute to policy development, training, and enterprise initiatives that promote consistency, operational excellence, and proactive risk management.

This is an excellent opportunity to work at the intersection of law and hotel operations, collaborating with leaders across the organization and helping shape legal strategies, business processes, and operational practices that have a meaningful impact across Hyatt's portfolio. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list since 2013. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

  • Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on-site fitness center
  • A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption
  • Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

The Role

Responsibilities include providing legal support for hotel operations, commercial initiatives, and enterprise projects across the Americas. This includes:

  • Advising on operational, sales, distribution, and commercial matters affecting managed hotels
  • Supporting hotel safety, security, risk management, and other operational initiatives
  • Negotiating and advising on vendor, commercial, and other operational agreements while supporting the development of contracting standards
  • Partnering with transactional legal teams and business stakeholders to support hotel ownership changes, management transitions, and other strategic business transactions
  • Developing and implementing operational policies, guidance, and best practices
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams—including Development, Finance, Tax, Risk Management, and Commercial Services—on strategic initiatives and enterprise projects

Qualifications

Experience Required:

  • 4 - 6 years of legal experience in either private law firm or in-house counsel position
  • Degree from a four-year college with a strong academic performance and an interest in learning more about the practice of law.
  • Juris Doctorate (J.D.)
  • Experience in one or more of the following: commercial transactions, real estate, litigation, or commercial contracting.

Experience Preferred:

  • Prior experience working in a service industry or providing legal services in the hospitality or commercial real estate industry is extremely helpful, not required

The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all-encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary.

We welcome you:

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.

The salary range for this position is $160,000 to $180,000. This position is also eligible to earn incentive awards, an annual bonus, monthly or quarterly incentives, etc.

The final pay rate/salary offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level, and other qualifications for the role, as well as the location of the performance of work. Pay for the successful candidate will meet local requirements, including the local minimum wage rate.

We value our relationships with recruitment partners and require that agencies contact us first before submitting any candidates. Hyatt will not be responsible for any fees and obligations associated with unsolicited submissions unless a formal agreement is in place.

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As the Director of Operations, you work closely with the General Manager to oversee all operational departments, including front office, housekeeping, food and beverage, and other key departments, ensuring the hotel operates efficiently while maintaining the highest guest service standards. As a Guest Operations Manager, you don’t just oversee all aspects of hotel operations – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Leadership & Strategic Direction: Lead operational departments to ensure alignment with hotel goals. Partner with the General Manager to develop and execute performance-driven strategies.
  • Operational Oversight: Manage daily hotel operations for seamless guest experiences. Drive process improvements to enhance efficiency and reduce costs.
  • Guest Experience: Ensure service excellence across all guest interactions. Monitor feedback and implement initiatives to elevate satisfaction.
  • Financial Management: Oversee departmental budgets and cost control. Analyze financial reports to improve profitability without compromising quality.
  • Team Development: Motivate and develop department heads and teams. Promote continuous learning and a high-performance culture.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate with all departments for smooth operations. Align with sales, marketing, and revenue teams to support business goals.
  • Compliance & Risk: Ensure adherence to health, safety, and regulatory standards. Manage risk through policy enforcement and emergency protocols.
  • Reporting & Analytics: Deliver regular performance reports and leadership insights. Track KPIs to guide data-driven decisions.

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • A degree in hospitality management, business administration, or a related field is preferred.
  • Proven leadership in senior hotel operations, preferably within luxury hospitality.
  • Deep knowledge of hotel functions—front office, housekeeping, F&B, and engineering.
  • Strong ability to lead, engage, and develop high-performing teams.
  • Skilled in budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and financial analysis.
  • Familiar with hotel PMS and operational software.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with a cross-functional, guest-centric approach.
  • Understanding of safety, regulatory standards, and risk management protocols.
  • Willingness to work varied hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays.
  • Fluent in English; additional languages are an asset.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Locations: San Francisco, Seattle, New York, Los Angeles, or Austin

About The Role

Motion is how our products feel and how our stories land. As Director / Principal Motion Designer, you'll define Expedia Design's motion language and raise the bar for both product and brand.

You are equally at home refining a micro-interaction in the app and directing a sizzle reel for a major campaign.

You'll partner closely with product designers, engineers, brand, and marketing. You'll also act as the connective tissue between design intent and what actually ships.

What You'll Do

Define and evolve our motion language

  • Establish motion principles, patterns, and guidelines that make our products feel delightful, clear, and unmistakably Expedia
  • Build motion into our design system so teams can use it consistently and at scale

Design UI motion for product

  • Craft the details that make an app feel polished: transitions, micro-interactions, state changes, loading and success moments, and moments of delight
  • Prototype to explore and validate ideas, and advocate for motion that serves usability, not just decoration

Bridge design and engineering

  • Write clear, implementable motion specs for engineers (timing, easing, springs, choreography, triggers) across iOS, Android, and web
  • Partner with engineering on implementation and review builds to make sure the shipped experience matches the intent
  • Stay current on motion implementation approaches across tech stacks (e.g., native animation frameworks, Lottie, Rive, CSS/JS animation) and advise teams on the right approach for each use case

Create editorial and promotional motion

  • Design, build, or direct sizzle reels, product launch videos, and promotional and storytelling pieces
  • Develop concepts, storyboards, and narratives, and guide them through production, whether you execute them yourself or direct internal teams and external partners

Lead and elevate

  • Be the go-to expert and voice for motion across Expedia Design, setting the quality bar and giving thoughtful, constructive critique
  • Mentor designers and partners on motion craft, and build motion capability across the organization
  • Influence stakeholders, from product leadership to brand and marketing, on why and how motion matters

What You Bring

Must have:

  • Deep expertise in UI motion design, with a portfolio that shows polished, purposeful product animation
  • Proven ability to create engineering-ready motion specs and hand off across iOS, Android, and web
  • Strong working knowledge of how motion is implemented in code across different tech stacks, and the practical constraints of each
  • Mastery of industry-standard motion and prototyping tools (e.g., After Effects, Figma, Principle, Rive, Lottie workflows, or equivalent)
  • Demonstrated ability to design, build, or direct editorial motion work such as brand films, sizzle videos, and promotional content
  • Strong storytelling, art direction, and sense of timing, rhythm, and craft
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience influencing cross-functional partners at a senior level
  • Experience raising the craft bar for a team or organization, through mentorship, standards, or leadership

Nice To Have

  • 3D design skills (e.g., Cinema 4D, Blender) and experience integrating 3D into product or brand storytelling
  • Experience building or contributing to a motion system within a design system
  • Experience in travel, consumer marketplaces, or other high-volume consumer products
  • Hands-on familiarity with front-end or native animation code, enough to prototype or contribute directly

What Success Looks Like

  • Our products have a recognizable, cohesive, and delightful motion identity
  • Engineers have clear specs and ship motion that matches design intent
  • Brand and campaign storytelling is elevated through compelling motion work
  • Motion craft and capability grow across the design organization

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Design, Motion, HCI, User Experience, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 5–10+ years of experience in product design or related disciplines, including leadership of large-scale teams.
  • Proven ability to define and drive organization-level customer experience strategy.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate as a player-coach, balancing leadership with direct engagement in design work.
  • Strong communication skills across design, research, and content strategy practices.
  • Experience integrating customer insights, data, and AI-driven systems into design solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Track record of executing a large-scale customer experience vision.
  • Experience building and scaling design systems.
  • Success coaching senior creatives while maintaining craft quality.
  • Expertise in storytelling and stakeholder influence.
  • Experience leading AI/ML-enabled product design efforts.
  • Passion for craft, with a history of personally influencing design outcomes through hands-on involvement, not just direction-setting.

Summary

The Standard, Mexico City arrives in the historic Tabacalera neighborhood with character, color, and a signature wink. With 206 guestrooms, 27 branded residences, vibrant dining destinations, and a rooftop overlooking the Monumento a la Revolución, we're bringing our unmistakable energy to Latin America.

We're looking for a Rooms Controller to help keep the hotel’s rooms operation moving with precision, pace, and personality. We’re searching for someone highly organized, naturally collaborative, and able to see the bigger picture while keeping track of every moving part.

The Opportunity

At The Standard, a smooth stay starts long before a guest opens their door.

As our Rooms Controller, you’ll connect the dots between Front Office, Housekeeping, Engineering, and hotel leadership to ensure our rooms are ready, accurately reported, and perfectly aligned with the needs of the operation. You’ll be at the center of the action, turning information into momentum and helping create a seamless experience for both guests and colleagues.

What You'll Do

  • Monitor and coordinate the daily status of all guestrooms and residences.
  • Maintain accurate room status information in the property management system.
  • Coordinate closely with Front Office and Housekeeping on room readiness, priorities, out-of-order rooms, and room moves.
  • Track discrepancies between system status and physical room status, following up until resolved.
  • Help prioritize rooms based on arrivals, VIPs, special occasions, early check-ins, and operational needs.
  • Communicate updates clearly and efficiently across departments.
  • Monitor room inspections, maintenance requests, deep-cleaning schedules, and pending follow-up.
  • Support the timely release of clean and inspected rooms.
  • Keep accurate records, logs, reports, and shift handovers.
  • Help identify patterns or recurring issues that may affect room availability or the guest experience.
  • Respond quickly and calmly to last-minute changes and unexpected situations.
  • Support a smooth flow of information across the Rooms Division throughout the day.
  • Follow all hotel standards related to privacy, safety, security, and guest confidentiality.
  • Contribute to a working environment that is organized, communicative, and distinctly The Standard.

Qualifications

What You'll Bring

  • Previous experience in Rooms Control, Housekeeping Coordination, Front Office, Rooms Division, or a similar hotel operations role.
  • Experience in a luxury lifestyle hotel, boutique hotel, or high-energy hospitality environment.
  • Strong knowledge of room status, housekeeping operations, and hotel coordination.
  • Excellent organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
  • Confidence working with property management systems and operational reports.
  • The ability to manage multiple priorities while staying calm and focused.
  • Strong communication skills and a natural ability to connect with different departments.
  • A proactive, solution-oriented approach to problem-solving.
  • Fluency in English and Spanish, with the ability to confidently communicate with an international team and clientele.
  • Flexibility to work varied shifts, weekends, and holidays.
  • A curious, reliable, and personable approach that feels right at home at The Standard.

If you’re the person who knows what needs to happen next—and how to keep everyone moving in the same direction—we’d love to meet you.

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Sales Manager, you’re not just generating and managing group sales – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Turn relationships into unforgettable experiences in one of Hawai‘i’s most distinctive destinations. We’re seeking a dynamic Sales Manager to join Hale Hokuala and help grow business within the Hawai‘i market. The ideal candidate brings 3–5 years of hospitality sales experience, ideally within group sales, along with strong knowledge of the local market and culture. Experience with Delphi and/or Salesforce is a plus. If you’re humble, hungry, relationship-driven, and energized by creating new business opportunities, this is an exciting opportunity to make an impact while representing an exceptional island destination.

Sales Incentive

Hilton offers a best-in-market SIP (Short-Term Incentive Plan) to our Sales, Catering & Events teams to reward our employees for their contributions to our company’s financial success. The Plan includes a quarterly component worth 20% of bonus eligible earnings. The quarterly incentive may have multiple individually weighted objectives, meaning multiple opportunities to earn a payout.

Responsibilities

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:

  • Generate and convert new business: Research, prospect, and qualify leads through proactive outreach and database mining to drive group sales and exceed lead generation goals
  • Build and maintain client relationships: Serve as the primary contact for assigned market segments, nurturing existing accounts and developing new ones to grow room revenue and overall profitability
  • Develop targeted sales strategies: Analyze hotel and market trends to create and execute business plans and marketing initiatives that capture demand and meet sales goals
  • Lead end-to-end sales process: Prepare proposals, conduct site visits, negotiate terms, and secure contracts tailored to client needs while maximizing revenue
  • Manage booking details: Coordinate customer requirements including room, food and beverage, and meeting space, and ensure accurate and timely entry of account and reservation information in the hotel’s sales management system
  • Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

About The Team

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
  • Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
  • Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
  • Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
  • Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
  • Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Generous paid time off (PTO) – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters most
  • Health & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family covered
  • Financial security for your future – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what’s next
  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Locations: San Francisco, Seattle, New York, Los Angeles, or Austin

About The Role

Motion is how our products feel and how our stories land. As Director / Principal Motion Designer, you'll define Expedia Design's motion language and raise the bar for both product and brand.

You are equally at home refining a micro-interaction in the app and directing a sizzle reel for a major campaign.

You'll partner closely with product designers, engineers, brand, and marketing. You'll also act as the connective tissue between design intent and what actually ships.

What You'll Do

Define and evolve our motion language

  • Establish motion principles, patterns, and guidelines that make our products feel delightful, clear, and unmistakably Expedia
  • Build motion into our design system so teams can use it consistently and at scale

Design UI motion for product

  • Craft the details that make an app feel polished: transitions, micro-interactions, state changes, loading and success moments, and moments of delight
  • Prototype to explore and validate ideas, and advocate for motion that serves usability, not just decoration

Bridge design and engineering

  • Write clear, implementable motion specs for engineers (timing, easing, springs, choreography, triggers) across iOS, Android, and web
  • Partner with engineering on implementation and review builds to make sure the shipped experience matches the intent
  • Stay current on motion implementation approaches across tech stacks (e.g., native animation frameworks, Lottie, Rive, CSS/JS animation) and advise teams on the right approach for each use case

Create editorial and promotional motion

  • Design, build, or direct sizzle reels, product launch videos, and promotional and storytelling pieces
  • Develop concepts, storyboards, and narratives, and guide them through production, whether you execute them yourself or direct internal teams and external partners

Lead and elevate

  • Be the go-to expert and voice for motion across Expedia Design, setting the quality bar and giving thoughtful, constructive critique
  • Mentor designers and partners on motion craft, and build motion capability across the organization
  • Influence stakeholders, from product leadership to brand and marketing, on why and how motion matters

What You Bring

Must have:

  • Deep expertise in UI motion design, with a portfolio that shows polished, purposeful product animation
  • Proven ability to create engineering-ready motion specs and hand off across iOS, Android, and web
  • Strong working knowledge of how motion is implemented in code across different tech stacks, and the practical constraints of each
  • Mastery of industry-standard motion and prototyping tools (e.g., After Effects, Figma, Principle, Rive, Lottie workflows, or equivalent)
  • Demonstrated ability to design, build, or direct editorial motion work such as brand films, sizzle videos, and promotional content
  • Strong storytelling, art direction, and sense of timing, rhythm, and craft
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience influencing cross-functional partners at a senior level
  • Experience raising the craft bar for a team or organization, through mentorship, standards, or leadership

Nice To Have

  • 3D design skills (e.g., Cinema 4D, Blender) and experience integrating 3D into product or brand storytelling
  • Experience building or contributing to a motion system within a design system
  • Experience in travel, consumer marketplaces, or other high-volume consumer products
  • Hands-on familiarity with front-end or native animation code, enough to prototype or contribute directly

What Success Looks Like

  • Our products have a recognizable, cohesive, and delightful motion identity
  • Engineers have clear specs and ship motion that matches design intent
  • Brand and campaign storytelling is elevated through compelling motion work
  • Motion craft and capability grow across the design organization

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Design, Motion, HCI, User Experience, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 5–10+ years of experience in product design or related disciplines, including leadership of large-scale teams.
  • Proven ability to define and drive organization-level customer experience strategy.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate as a player-coach, balancing leadership with direct engagement in design work.
  • Strong communication skills across design, research, and content strategy practices.
  • Experience integrating customer insights, data, and AI-driven systems into design solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Track record of executing a large-scale customer experience vision.
  • Experience building and scaling design systems.
  • Success coaching senior creatives while maintaining craft quality.
  • Expertise in storytelling and stakeholder influence.
  • Experience leading AI/ML-enabled product design efforts.
  • Passion for craft, with a history of personally influencing design outcomes through hands-on involvement, not just direction-setting.

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Locations: San Francisco, Seattle, New York, Los Angeles, or Austin

About The Role

Motion is how our products feel and how our stories land. As Director / Principal Motion Designer, you'll define Expedia Design's motion language and raise the bar for both product and brand.

You are equally at home refining a micro-interaction in the app and directing a sizzle reel for a major campaign.

You'll partner closely with product designers, engineers, brand, and marketing. You'll also act as the connective tissue between design intent and what actually ships.

What You'll Do

Define and evolve our motion language

  • Establish motion principles, patterns, and guidelines that make our products feel delightful, clear, and unmistakably Expedia
  • Build motion into our design system so teams can use it consistently and at scale

Design UI motion for product

  • Craft the details that make an app feel polished: transitions, micro-interactions, state changes, loading and success moments, and moments of delight
  • Prototype to explore and validate ideas, and advocate for motion that serves usability, not just decoration

Bridge design and engineering

  • Write clear, implementable motion specs for engineers (timing, easing, springs, choreography, triggers) across iOS, Android, and web
  • Partner with engineering on implementation and review builds to make sure the shipped experience matches the intent
  • Stay current on motion implementation approaches across tech stacks (e.g., native animation frameworks, Lottie, Rive, CSS/JS animation) and advise teams on the right approach for each use case

Create editorial and promotional motion

  • Design, build, or direct sizzle reels, product launch videos, and promotional and storytelling pieces
  • Develop concepts, storyboards, and narratives, and guide them through production, whether you execute them yourself or direct internal teams and external partners

Lead and elevate

  • Be the go-to expert and voice for motion across Expedia Design, setting the quality bar and giving thoughtful, constructive critique
  • Mentor designers and partners on motion craft, and build motion capability across the organization
  • Influence stakeholders, from product leadership to brand and marketing, on why and how motion matters

What You Bring

Must have:

  • Deep expertise in UI motion design, with a portfolio that shows polished, purposeful product animation
  • Proven ability to create engineering-ready motion specs and hand off across iOS, Android, and web
  • Strong working knowledge of how motion is implemented in code across different tech stacks, and the practical constraints of each
  • Mastery of industry-standard motion and prototyping tools (e.g., After Effects, Figma, Principle, Rive, Lottie workflows, or equivalent)
  • Demonstrated ability to design, build, or direct editorial motion work such as brand films, sizzle videos, and promotional content
  • Strong storytelling, art direction, and sense of timing, rhythm, and craft
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience influencing cross-functional partners at a senior level
  • Experience raising the craft bar for a team or organization, through mentorship, standards, or leadership

Nice To Have

  • 3D design skills (e.g., Cinema 4D, Blender) and experience integrating 3D into product or brand storytelling
  • Experience building or contributing to a motion system within a design system
  • Experience in travel, consumer marketplaces, or other high-volume consumer products
  • Hands-on familiarity with front-end or native animation code, enough to prototype or contribute directly

What Success Looks Like

  • Our products have a recognizable, cohesive, and delightful motion identity
  • Engineers have clear specs and ship motion that matches design intent
  • Brand and campaign storytelling is elevated through compelling motion work
  • Motion craft and capability grow across the design organization

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Design, Motion, HCI, User Experience, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 5–10+ years of experience in product design or related disciplines, including leadership of large-scale teams.
  • Proven ability to define and drive organization-level customer experience strategy.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate as a player-coach, balancing leadership with direct engagement in design work.
  • Strong communication skills across design, research, and content strategy practices.
  • Experience integrating customer insights, data, and AI-driven systems into design solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Track record of executing a large-scale customer experience vision.
  • Experience building and scaling design systems.
  • Success coaching senior creatives while maintaining craft quality.
  • Expertise in storytelling and stakeholder influence.
  • Experience leading AI/ML-enabled product design efforts.
  • Passion for craft, with a history of personally influencing design outcomes through hands-on involvement, not just direction-setting.

Responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Shape and execute sales strategy: Develop and implement revenue-driving sales strategies across group, business transient, leisure transient, and catering segments, aligned with the hotel’s commercial goals and strategic plan
  • Drive revenue performance and profitability: Contribute to achieving revenue targets and profitability goals by optimizing pricing, improving business mix, and guiding forecasting accuracy
  • Lead business reviews and planning: Facilitate regular strategy and performance meetings while contributing to long-range commercial planning through analysis of performance trends, market shifts, and revenue opportunities
  • Ensure commercial alignment: Collaborate with revenue and marketing leaders to align sales tactics with pricing, distribution, and promotional strategies, and to support forecasting and rate strategies
  • Foster stakeholder relationships: Engage with Hilton Worldwide Sales, Convention and Visitors Bureaus (CVBs), third-party travel partners, and key clients to drive demand, improve conversion, and support high-impact site visits and pre-convention meetings
  • Develop data-informed strategies: Track market and competitor activity to inform strategy and help maintain competitive positioning in group and transient segments
  • Cultivate a high-performing team: Recruit new talent while driving team growth and engagement through performance management, professional development, and recognition programs

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • Degree qualifications in Business Management or equivalent.
  • At least 5 years of experience in managing a hospitality proactive sales role preferred.
  • Minimum 5+ years in a revenue-generating or commercial role within hospitality or travel.
  • Proven experience managing and developing high-performing sales or commercial teams.
  • Skilled in creating and presenting sales strategies to senior executives and stakeholder groups.
  • Proficient in analyzing departmental financial data to inform strategic decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify and capitalize on new business opportunities.
  • Experience working in matrixed environments across departments.
  • Experience in multi-complex hotel or travel operations.
  • Technical Proficiency in hotel management software (e.g., Delphi, Salesforce, OnQ, Market Planner Survey systems) is a plus.

We believe in the power of travel. It broadens horizons for our customers, and for our people too. New places to live, new roles to explore, new communities to join. It’s yours for the taking.
We’re TUI, a leading global travel and leisure experience company that makes holiday dreams come true for people around the world.
We are one of the world’s leading tourism groups counting 1200 travel agencies and online portals, five airlines with around 130 aircraft, over 400 hotels, 16 cruise liners, digital platforms for tours and activities and most importantly over 60 000 colleagues around the world. What unites us is creating moments that enrich the lives of our 21 million customers.
Beside the unforgettable experience we provide our customers, we also believe in the good that tourism can bring and we care deeply about our environmental impact. The TUI Care foundation has projects in over 30 countries worldwide, building on the potential of tourism as a global force for development. The Foundation opens up new perspectives through education and training, empowers local communities to benefit from the success of tourism and engages in the protection of nature and the environment.
At TUI we simply say “Let’s TUI it”. For us, that means creating happiness. Tackling challenges every day together, with a positive, can-do attitude, and finding solutions even for the most unexpected situations. Our teams across TUI are just as diverse as our destinations. So whether you have lots of experience or none at all. If you want to work in an office or feel best in the field. No matter if you’re an accomplished tech whizz, an aspiring entertainer, or simply in love with flying.
There’s a place for you here.
job.job_description:
Here at TUI, you’ll find we’re an inclusive company with a culture of care and by joining the Retail Team as a Travel Advisor in our Blackpool store, we’ll support you to become a destination expert so that you can recommend and sell holidays, Cruise, UK Breaks and additional products. You’ll put all customers at the heart of our business by creating unforgettable holiday experiences that make us the best-loved holiday company.

As part of our dedication to delivering exceptional customer service and flexibility for our customers, you’ll enjoy a varied shift pattern each week including weekends and bank holidays, and evenings at some of our busier stores.

About Our Offer

  • TUI offers much more than just starting salary of £13.09 per hour
  • Be rewarded for exceeding your targets with our commission scheme
  • Enjoy fantastic holiday benefits, discounts, special offers and the ability to purchase additional TUI time off
  • Benefit from our Health and Wellbeing across key areas – Financial, Health, Social, Community and Career
  • Investment in your development and career progression
  • Pension scheme and life assurance

About The Job

  • Use your passion to inspire our customers and colleagues whilst enjoying a great amount of fun
  • Your drive to achieve will lead you to exceed your sales objectives, in Retail we call it ‘Smashing your Targets’
  • You’ll embrace change and rise to the challenges of a customer engaged role both face to face and virtually
  • If things don’t go to plan, you’ll need to be confident to actively investigate and resolve any question or complaint
  • As technology advances so does TUI, you’ll receive training on a variety of systems empowering you to enhance your knowledge whilst bringing memorable holidays to life for our customers.

About You

  • Excellent customer service skills with a genuine passion to go above and beyond
  • A strong dedication to achieve goals and sales targets
  • Able to prioritise multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment and bounce back from challenges
  • Ability to embrace change and adapt to new ways of working
  • A team player who engages and collaborates with our customers and colleagues
  • An organised individual who takes pride in their work and communicates effectively
  • Able to work a varied shift pattern each week in-line with shop opening and closing times.

From a workplace to a place to belong. At TUI we embrace diversity, equity and inclusion, encouraging everyone to come as you are, because together, our potential is limitless.

We're committed to supporting candidates with disabilities and impairments so if you require any support, please let us know.

For the Hiring Manger to have sight of your application, you'll also need complete our online assessment - you'll be prompted to do this once you've submitted your application.

Please note, if you've been interviewed for this role within the last 6 months, we're unable to consider a further application at this time

job.company_description:
We are Accor
We are more than 290,000 hospitality experts placing people at the heart of what we do, creating emotion for our guests, and nurturing passion for service and achievement beyond limits. Building on the strength of our teams and of our fully integrated ecosystem of leading brands, personalized services & expert solutions, we break new ground to reimagine hospitality and inspire new ways to experience the world.
We are dedicated to suit all desires and needs, and reinvent the guest experience every day with our 45 hotel brands across all segments- 5,600 properties around the world from luxury five-star palaces to smart economy hotels, exquisite residences to full-service resorts.
Because we take care of millions of guests and each of our hotels is a world in itself, where every action counts. We strive to make positive impact both locally and globally, to ensure hospitality benefits not only the few, but all.
job.job_description:
Accor is a world leader in the hotel industry, present in 110 countries, with more than 5,500 hotels and 10,000 restaurants and bars. The group deploys an integrated hotel ecosystem that is among the most diversified in the sector, notably associating luxury and high-end brands, mid-range and economic offers, exclusive lifestyle concepts, venues for shows and entertainment, clubs, restaurants and bars, private residences, shared accommodation, Qantas Lounges, concierge services and co-working spaces. Accor has a portfolio of incomparable brands, led by more than 300,000 employees around the world.



Job Description

We are seeking an experienced and commercially driven Senior Portfolio Manager to lead a high performing team within the Centre of Revenue Intelligence, driving revenue performance across a portfolio of hotels throughout the MEA APAC region.

Reporting to the Vice President of Revenue Management, you will lead a team of Portfolio Managers and a Portfolio Specialist, while maintaining responsibility for an assigned portfolio of hotels. You will oversee the implementation of revenue management strategies, processes and best practices, ensuring commercial performance is aligned with regional priorities and business objectives.

As the senior commercial leader for your portfolio, you will partner closely with General Managers, Regional Directors of Revenue Management and Executive Leadership to deliver sustainable revenue growth, optimise distribution strategies and build a high performing revenue management culture across the team.

Getting to know the role and your responsibilities

  • Develop and execute portfolio-wide revenue management strategies in collaboration with Commercial departments.
  • Lead, coach and mentor Portfolio Managers and the Portfolio Specialist, fostering capability development, accountability and a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Provide strategic revenue management leadership while directly managing a small portfolio of hotels.
  • Drive the consistent adoption of revenue management best practices, tools and processes across the portfolio.
  • Act as the senior escalation point for complex commercial matters, including hotel performance challenges, stakeholder issues and strategic decision making.
  • Oversee distribution-related activities, including troubleshooting, technology escalations and collaboration with OTA partners and revenue technology providers.
  • Analyse commercial performance, identify risks and opportunities, and provide strategic recommendations to regional leadership.
  • Prepare and present executive level reporting, including portfolio performance, commercial insights and key business initiatives.
  • Build trusted relationships with General Managers, Regional Directors of Revenue Management, hotel leadership teams, owners and key commercial stakeholders to influence business outcomes.
  • Champion a high performance culture that delivers measurable improvements in RevPAR, market share and overall commercial performance.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Hospitality, Business, Commerce or a related discipline.
  • 5+ years' experience in Revenue Management, including demonstrated experience leading and developing high-performing teams.
  • Extensive expertise in revenue management, pricing, forecasting, distribution and commercial strategy within the hospitality industry.
  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and operate as a trusted commercial advisor beyond traditional revenue management responsibilities.
  • Exceptional leadership, coaching and communication skills, with experience engaging General Managers, Executive Leadership, Owners and Asset Managers.
  • Strong strategic thinking, commercial acumen and analytical capability, with the ability to translate data into business outcomes.
  • Highly organised, proactive and resilient, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while leading a geographically dispersed portfolio.
  • Fluency in English and at least one additional language, written and spoken, is required. Two additional languages are preferred.

Additional Information

  • Enjoy discounted Heartist® rates across Accor's global network of hotels, food and beverage venues, and wellness centres.
  • Explore international career opportunities across Accor's hotel portfolio.
  • Benefit from continuous learning and professional development, including Accor's Revenue Management Academy certification.

This role is based in Bangkok, Thailand. Only applicants who currently hold full working rights in Bangkok, Thailand will be considered.

Candidate screening and interviews may be conducted prior to the closing date of the advertisement. Accor reserves the right to close applications for the position prior to the advertised date. We encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

  • Native/Fluent Japanese Language Level Required for this Position*

Strategic Accounts Management Team

Agoda is a travel booking platform and accommodation is at our core. As our accommodation partners are a key to our success, we work hard to ensure their success. That is why the Strategic Accounts Management (SAM) team in Agoda specializes in account management. We serve as consultants, offering strategic advice on how best to excel on Agoda’s commercial platform. We are direct contributors to what makes Agoda one of the market leaders because we understand accommodation needs and offer innovative solutions. From Bangkok to London and beyond, our team has footprints in over 50 locations around the world. With the help of industry-leading technology, we work and collaborate globally to bring together the best ideas from diverse perspectives. The SAM team invests in long-term relationships that spans borders and cultures and results in incredible value for Agoda, our partners, and our customers.

The Opportunity:

As a Strategic Account Manager, you will be the main contact between our accommodation partners and Agoda, with the responsibility of nurturing the relationship with our key supply partners and driving mutual growth. A key responsibility in developing our business is the ability to identify and acquire new sources of supply and product offerings within an assigned territory while maintaining existing relationships.

In this Role, you’ll get to:

  • Develop long lasting relationships with key supply partners to enable Agoda’s growth in the region
  • Maintain regular and meaningful engagement with Agoda’s key supply partners
  • Analyze large datasets to propose tailor-made solutions to Agoda’s supply partners
  • Leverage analytical and problem-solving skills to identify new opportunities to grow Agoda’s business
  • Train and inform clients of both new and existing technologies, tools, and models
  • Prepare materials to aid in growing our business during partner meetings
  • Respond to partners requests in a timely and effective manner
  • Gain buy-in from relevant stakeholders to execute strategies and help launch promotional campaigns to enhance productivity and maintain Agoda’s competitiveness
  • Leverage product offerings to match market demands to maximize our ability to convert passive customers into active ones
  • Deliver on country KPIs, growth targets and country strategic initiatives
  • Support the Area Manager in preparing country reporting for senior stakeholders

What you’ll Need to Succeed:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Minimum 3 – 5 years of experience in business development and/or account management
  • Strong interpersonal skills & ability to influence both external / internal stakeholders
  • Experience in internet/e-commerce preferred
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Team player with a professional “get it done” attitude and work ethic
  • Proven success in acquiring, building & maintaining long term customer relationships
  • Adapts well to change and able to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to create new, innovative ideas
  • Native level Japanese to communicate with clients speaking Japanese and intermediate English to communicate internally.

It’s Great if you have:

  • MBA or Master’s degree
  • Experience in Travel industry

job.company_description: Airlines Reporting Corporation (ARC) accelerates growth for the travel industry by delivering forward-looking travel data, flexible distribution services and innovative financial solutions. We use our knowledge to connect stakeholders across the travel ecosystem. ARC is headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, with offices in Louisville, Kentucky, and Tampa, Florida.
job.job_description:
About The Role

It's a great time to join us at Airlines Reporting Corporation (ARC)! ARC accelerates the growth of global air travel by delivering forward-looking travel data, flexible distribution services and other innovative industry solutions. We are a leading travel intelligence company with the world’s largest, most comprehensive global airline ticket dataset, including more than 15 billion passenger flights. By working here, you can contribute to solutions and expertise that strengthen economies and enrich lives. We think big, embrace challenges and explore new ideas to lead the way for the travel industry.

ARC is looking for a talented Manager, External Communications to join our team! In this role, you will develop, coordinate and execute overarching content and media strategies to strengthen the ARC brand. You will create awareness and demand for ARC’s solutions among target audiences. These strategies must align with ARC’s corporate strategy and create a lasting positive impression among customers, partners and media. The Manager, External Communications will develop and deliver social media, media and marketing plans for both new and established solutions to achieve brand and revenue objectives. You'll lead the development and execution of ARC’s content strategy, telling ARC’s story through marketing and communications channels. You will also lead a team of skilled communications experts and ensure alignment of activities. You'll establish goals and expectations and evaluate performance using data, qualitative assessments, and feedback. And, you will work collaboratively with internal business leaders and cross-functional groups, make decisions, maintain confidentiality, multitask, and prioritize in a high-volume environment.

What You'll Get To Do

  • Develop strategic marketing plans and KPIs for the ARC brand and solutions portfolios. Lead the execution of these plans through content and promotional opportunities in partnership with the broader brand and marketing team, business stakeholders, customer engagement, and other leaders.
  • Plan, develop and deliver content across a range of brand and marketing channels using a shared calendar. Communications include web-based communications, social media, email, paid and/or earned media, and conference topics.
  • Monitor, track and analyze the cost, quality and effectiveness of marketing activities. Present status updates on strategic marketing campaigns and programs to key stakeholders throughout the company. Lead efforts to track brand health and marketing positioning of competitors.
  • Create and/or edit content with an eye for detail and make recommendations for strategic accuracy. Craft executive talking points, communications and other content as needed. Support review of content that includes emails, social media, presentations, webpages and video scripts. Support ARC customer engagement.
  • Build and maintain close relationships with internal stakeholders, members of the media and ARC partners to further business goals.
  • Supervise, mentor and develop direct reports and extended team members; provide direction, leadership and coaching to project teams to execute brand and product marketing plans.

You'll Bring These Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in communications, English, journalism, marketing, business or related field required; equivalent experience considered
  • 6+ years of experience in strategic marketing; ideally some experience in the airline industry
  • Knowledge of branding and marketing principles
  • Experience directly leading individuals and teams
  • Customer-focused with commitment to quality
  • Outstanding communication, leadership and conflict-resolution skills
  • A strategic, analytical and creative thinker and nuanced communicator with excellent organizational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks in a high-volume environment.

What We Can Offer You

  • Joining ARC means joining a team that is motivated, diverse, creative, collaborative and solutions-oriented. We think big, embrace challenges, and explore new ideas to lead the way for the travel industry.
  • Our employees value the hands-on learning and professional development opportunities that allow them to expand their skills and grow their career in new, dynamic ways.
  • ARC offers WorkFlex. WorkFlex is ARC’s hybrid work program which offers eligible employees the flexibility to work from home while also requiring in office workdays throughout the year to foster collaboration and connection throughout the organization. We’ve designed WorkFlex to enable employees to succeed and thrive while maintaining strong connections to one another and ARC - both of which are critical to our shared success.
  • We offer a highly competitive, comprehensive benefits package so you can worry less and focus on what truly matters. Please click here to review our benefits on our company website.
  • By joining ARC, you will partner with top minds in the industry as we use data and technology to innovate how the world travels.

The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, allowing for meaningful future salary growth within the position.

EOE M/F/D/V Females and Minorities Encouraged to Apply

job.company_description:
A career at Booking.com is all about the journey, helping you explore new challenges in a place where you can be your best self. With plenty of exciting twists, turns and opportunities along the way.
We’ve always been pioneers, on a mission to shape the future of travel through cutting edge technology, to make it easier for everyone to enjoy amazing experiences wherever they go. Under a desert sky, or in the heart of a bustling city. Discovering the perfect hideaway, or the perfect paella.
When you join us, you’ll be part of a community where taking a different path and trying something new is celebrated and supported. And where making a difference counts.
We’re determined to make the world of travel more sustainable, more accessible, and more inclusive, to create a positive impact on a global scale. That’s why we’re always looking for people who search for better solutions, the ones eager to stray off the beaten path to find new ways of doing things. Because at Booking.com it’s more than a job, it’s a journey we’re on together.
job.job_description:
About Us: At Booking.com, data drives our decisions. Technology is at our core. And innovation is everywhere. But our company is more than datasets, lines of code or A/B tests. We’re the thrill of the first night in a new place. The excitement of the next morning. The friends you encounter. The journeys you take. The sights you see. And the memories you make. Through our products, partners and people, we make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

The Role: As Junior Legal Counsel - Product, you will provide practical, timely and commercially focused legal support to Booking.com’s Trips Product teams (Cars, Rides, and Attractions). The Trips verticals are a significant part of Booking.com's strategy to further build the “Connected Trip” and to grow and scale Booking.com’s multi-product offerings to travelers.

You will work closely with Product, Engineering and Data, Commercial, Privacy, Competition and Consumer Law, Compliance and other LPA colleagues to help the business develop and scale products responsibly. You will be embedded in initiatives from early ideation through implementation, helping teams identify legal risks, develop proportionate mitigations and make well-informed decisions.

The role combines day-to-day product legal advice with ownership of defined legal workstreams, scalable guidance and process improvements.

Key responsibilities:

  • Advise Product teams on product concepts, customer journeys, product requirements, UX designs, copy, pricing, promotions, rankings, personalisation, terms and disclosures.
  • Identify and assess legal and regulatory risks, including consumer protection, privacy and data use, platform and intermediary regulation, competition, artificial intelligence, safety and relevant local requirements.
  • Provide clear, concise and options-led advice that balances customer experience, commercial objectives and legal risk.
  • Independently manage routine and lower-complexity legal matters, with guidance from senior counsel on higher-risk or more complex issues.
  • Review, draft and update customer-facing terms, disclosures, partner communications, internal guidance and other legal materials.
  • Support the Initiative Review Process and RAPID decision-making model by gathering information, conducting initial legal triage and risk assessment, coordinating input from relevant LPA specialists, documenting decisions and tracking mitigations.
  • Act as the legal point of contact for defined product initiatives, attending relevant business meetings, maintaining action trackers and coordinating dependencies through to implementation.
  • Support the implementation of new legislation, regulatory guidance, enforcement outcomes and agreed legal advice into product processes, controls, customer communications and training.
  • Develop scalable legal resources, including FAQs, playbooks, decision trees, checklists and training materials, so that teams can self-serve on recurring lower-risk questions.
  • Help improve ways of working between Product and Legal, including legal intake, workflow tracking, prioritisation, knowledge management and the effective use of tools and AI technology.
  • Support the management of regulatory enquiries, disputes and consumer litigation matters where required. This may include helping to assess the legal and commercial context, coordinating internal stakeholders, establishing and maintaining information and evidence-gathering processes, preparing chronologies and factual summaries, supporting instructions to and communications with external counsel, tracking actions and deadlines, and helping to implement remediation or settlement-related steps under the guidance of senior lawyers.
  • From time to time, you may be required to support from a commercial legal perspective; for example, supporting senior legal stakeholders in helping draft and negotiate simple commercial agreements, maintaining the Trips contract template library and modernising our contracting processes in collaboration with the wider LPA department.
  • Build trusted relationships with business stakeholders and encourage early engagement with Legal.


Skills and experience required:

  • Law degree and qualification to practise, or equivalent relevant legal experience depending on the hiring market.
  • Indicative experience level: 1–3 years post-qualification experience, gained in a reputable law firm or in-house.
  • Experience in an in-house, technology, platform, marketplace, travel or commercial legal environment is desirable.
  • Exposure to product, consumer protection, commercial, privacy, competition, regulatory or technology law.
  • Strong legal research, drafting, analytical and organisational skills.
  • Ability to explain complex legal issues clearly to non-legal stakeholders.
  • Ability to provide practical advice while recognising when to seek input or escalate.
  • Comfortable managing multiple priorities, deadlines and changing requirements.
  • Proactive ownership of matters, with strong attention to detail and follow-through.
  • Collaborative approach and confidence working with international, multidisciplinary and multicultural teams.
  • Curiosity about products, technology, artificial intelligence and emerging regulation and keenness to learn about new areas of law.
  • Willingness to improve processes and develop more efficient, scalable ways of working.
  • Advising on customer-facing digital products, online marketplaces or platform businesses.
  • Working with product managers, engineers, designers, data specialists or UX writers.
  • Experience with consumer-facing pricing, promotions, ranking, personalisation or choice architecture.
  • Experience supporting regulatory implementation, incident response, disputes or external counsel.
  • Experience creating legal guidance, training, FAQs or playbooks.
  • Familiarity with Jira, legal intake processes, workflow tools or AI-enabled legal tools.


Further traits look for:

  • Alignment with Booking.com’s values (Customer First, Succeed Together, Own It, Learn Forever, Do the Right Thing).
  • Curiosity, flexibility, and a creative, pragmatic approach to problem-solving.
  • Confidence with collaboration.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Proactivity, resilience, and a drive to deliver results.
  • Strong judgment with attention to both the big picture and key details.
  • Courage to take a stance and make tough decisions.
  • Team-oriented, self-aware, and a good listener.
  • Agility in prioritizing and meeting deadlines.
  • Forward-thinking, with a focus on emerging legal and policy issues.


Please note we are prioritising local candidates for this role. Relocations and sponsorship will not be provided.

Why join the Legal & Public Affairs Team now?

This is a pivotal moment in e-commerce and travel, and joining Booking.com’s Legal & Public Affairs (LPA) team provides you with opportunities to shape the future. The LPA team plays a key role in enabling Booking.com to become a one-stop solution for all travel-related needs, from accommodation to rental cars, flights and attractions, and beyond.
