job.job_description:
About The Role

It's a great time to join us at Airlines Reporting Corporation (ARC)! ARC accelerates the growth of global air travel by delivering forward-looking travel data, flexible distribution services and other innovative industry solutions. We are a leading travel intelligence company with the world’s largest, most comprehensive global airline ticket dataset, including more than 15 billion passenger flights. By working here, you can contribute to solutions and expertise that strengthen economies and enrich lives. We think big, embrace challenges and explore new ideas to lead the way for the travel industry.

ARC is looking for a talented Data & Insights Analyst IIto join our team! In this role, you will independently own standard analysis, dashboards, recurring reporting, and sales operations support. You will support variety of teams including ARC Pay, Revenue Integrity, Customer Engagement (CE), People & Culture, and the Executive Team. The Data & Insights Analyst II will translate business questions into analytical approaches, synthesize findings, and improve recurring metrics and reporting processes. You'll be expected to provide dependable analysis and interpretation to business partners, expand functional and domain knowledge across ARC’s products and teams. You will maintain integrity of customer relationship management tool (CRM) and sales opportunity data; coordinate with business technology departments to enhance CRM.

What You'll Get To Do

  • Own standard analysis end to end, including requirements gathering, data extraction, validation, dashboard/report development, synthesis of findings, and stakeholder follow-up.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to implement CRM solutions to meet the needs of the CE Team and enterprise.
  • Build and improve recurring dashboards, key performance indicator reporting, and standardized analyses that help stakeholders monitor performance and identify trends or issues. Routinely present results.
  • Coordinate with Marketing and Product teams on CRM contact information, sales tracking, order processing, contracting and customer support. Resolve customer billing issues with Financial Services.

You'll Bring These Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in business, analytics, economics, statistics, information systems, data science, finance, or related field
  • 2-4 years’ experience
  • Working to strong proficiency in SQL, Snowflake, Tableau, and Excel
  • Ability to own routine analysis, dashboarding, and reporting end to end
  • Strong quality assurance mindset and comfort improving metric logic and reporting processes
  • CRM admin skills required; Salesforce Certified Administrator preferred
  • Knowledge of airline or travel agency industries preferred

What We Can Offer You

  • Joining ARC means joining a team that is motivated, diverse, creative, collaborative and solutions-oriented. We think big, embrace challenges, and explore new ideas to lead the way for the travel industry.
  • Our employees value the hands-on learning and professional development opportunities that allow them to expand their skills and grow their career in new, dynamic ways.
  • ARC offers WorkFlex. WorkFlex is ARC’s hybrid work program which offers eligible employees the flexibility to work from home while also requiring in office workdays throughout the year to foster collaboration and connection throughout the organization. We’ve designed WorkFlex to enable employees to succeed and thrive while maintaining strong connections to one another and ARC - both of which are critical to our shared success.
  • We offer a highly competitive, comprehensive benefits package so you can worry less and focus on what truly matters. Please click here to review our benefits on our company website.
  • By joining ARC, you will partner with top minds in the industry as we use data and technology to innovate how the world travels.

The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, allowing for meaningful future salary growth within the position.

EOE M/F/D/V Females and Minorities Encouraged to Apply

job.job_description:
JOB SUMMARY:

Choice Hotels, one of the world’s largest lodging franchisors, has an opportunity for a Data Scientist 3, Applied AI, on the Data Science team. You will play an integral role in developing predictive analytics and applied AI capabilities in support of key corporate initiatives. Our cross-functional team of data scientists and engineers develops and deploys statistical models, machine learning algorithms, and AI solutions that drive business decisions and interactions with our customers.

The team partners with leaders across the enterprise to deliver end-to-end data science solutions for Marketing, Loyalty, Global Sales, Finance, Franchise Development, eCommerce, and Brands. Examples include customer lifetime value, hotel performance forecasting, site selection, and generative AI applications. In addition to building models, the Data Scientist will contribute to upskilling the team, provide guidance on data sources for ingestion to improve modeling effectiveness, and collaborate with the Data Delivery and IT teams to ensure Choice’s AWS analytics platform can meet future state needs for machine learning, generative AI, and predictive analytics.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead modeling initiatives that drive enterprise decisions, working with stakeholders to solve strategic and operational needs with statistical models and AI.
  • Deliver timely ad hoc analyses and product presentations, including geospatial analyses, that communicate insights to stakeholders.
  • Work with IT and the Data Delivery teams to enhance infrastructure needed to support real-time, machine learning, and generative AI modeling capabilities
  • Deploy solutions using AWS services such as Redshift, Athena, S3, SageMaker AI, Bedrock, and AgentCore.
  • Research cutting-edge methodologies and contribute to upskilling the overall team’s capabilities, including the use of AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, which are core to how the team prototypes, codes, and performs analysis day to day.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Employment Experience

  • 5+ years of analytical experience, with a background in predictive modeling and statistical techniques such as regression, segmentation and clustering, and time series analysis
  • Hands-on experience building with large language models (LLMs)

Technical Skills

  • Experience with Machine Learning approaches and techniques such as decision trees, gradient boosted models, and neural networks, including standard data preparation and model evaluation practices
  • Familiarity with LLMs, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic workflows
  • Comfort with (or strong enthusiasm to adopt) AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code; agentic coding workflows are a major part of our day-to-day work
  • Working knowledge of Python/R and SQL, along with Git version control and code review practices
  • Familiarity with the ML and AI model development lifecycle from prototyping through deployment and monitoring in production
  • Comfortable with lightweight data engineering, data quality monitoring, data profiling, and preparing datasets
  • Knowledge of AWS services such as Redshift, Athena, S3, Lambda, SageMaker AI, Bedrock, and AgentCore; AWS certification is a plus
  • Experience with geospatial analytics and tools (e.g., ArcGIS, GeoPandas, PostGIS) is a plus
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint and Word

Additional Skills & Competencies

  • Must be an energized self-starter who can work independently and who drives for results
  • Ability to evaluate business trends and develop successful solutions that enhance business performance
  • Effectively partner with business stakeholders to ensure integrated and timely insights to the enterprise
  • Has strong intellectual curiosity and is an active learner, able to enhance personal, professional, and business growth through new knowledge and experiences.
  • Results oriented; delivers results under difficult conditions and demonstrates balanced judgment under pressure
  • Writes clean, clear, and well-documented code that others can read, maintain, and build on
  • Good communication skills, including oral (one on one and presentations to large audiences) and written

Education Requirements

  • Master’s Degree in Data Science, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research or other quantitative field

COMPENSATION & SALARY RANGE:

The salary range for this position is $114,907-135,000. Pay ranges listed are what Choice Hotels reasonably expects to pay. Actual pay may be higher or lower and ranges may be adjusted in the future. Pay positioning within the range is influenced by factors including—but not limited to—education, experience, skills, certifications, performance, geographic location, business needs, seniority, and travel requirements.

LOCATION & WORK SCHEDULE:

This role is based at our corporate headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, and follows a hybrid work schedule, requiring regular in-office collaboration alongside remote work flexibility.

Choice prioritizes our associate wellbeing by offering a comprehensive benefits program that is both competitive and flexible to help you achieve your wellbeing goals - here are just a few:

  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Leave and paid time-off for holidays, vacation, personal, family, volunteer, sick, jury duty, bereavement, military, and religious observance
  • Financial benefits for retirement and health savings
  • Employee recognition programs
  • Discounts at Choice hotels worldwide

About Choice

Choice Hotels International, Inc. (NYSE: CHH), is one of the largest lodging franchisors in the world. With 7,500 hotels in 45+ countries and territories, we offer a range of high-quality lodging options in the upper upscale, upper midscale, midscale, extended stay, and economy segments. We’re the hotel company for those who choose to bet on themselves — the striver, the dreamer, the entrepreneur — because that’s who we are, too.

At Choice, we are united by the simple belief that tomorrow will be even better than today — for associates, our company, and our franchisees. At our worldwide corporate headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, at our technology center in Scottsdale, Arizona, and through our associates around the globe, every voice is heard and every idea is listened to, no matter what area of the company they come from. We are united in supporting the entrepreneurial dreams of our thousands of franchise owners, which propels us forward — giving our work at Choice a purpose larger than our business.

Our corporate office locations:

North Bethesda, MD — Located at Pike & Rose, our worldwide headquarters is less than 15 miles from Washington, D.C., one block away from the North Bethesda Metro station, with easy access to I-495, complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Scottsdale, AZ — Located at the northwest corner of Loop 101, the Scottsdale office is home to our technology, eCommerce and customer service organizations, with easy access to complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Minneapolis, MN — Select roles are based in our Minneapolis office on Highway 394, near the intersection with Highway 100, only five minutes from downtown.

Field/Remote — Select roles designated as field/remote will require associates to work from a home office, connecting virtually with Choice team members and leadership on Zoom, with possible required travel depending on the role.

Choice’s Cultural Values

Welcome and Respect Everyone | Be Bold | Be Quick | Listen | Be Curious | Show Integrity

Choice’s Leadership Principles

Act with Intention | Lead with Authenticity | Grow & Deliver

Senior Manager, Merchandising and Customer Growth

Introduction to the Team

Expedia Group’s Consumer Business Has Three Flagship Brands

  • Expedia® is the one-stop shop for travel, with a mission of helping travelers get the most out of every trip they take by providing everything they need all in one place, and feel supported every step of the way.
  • Hotels.com® is the hotels expert that is all about giving travelers more of what they want — whether that’s instant savings, flexible options, or rewards they can actually use.
  • Vrbo® is the trusted vacation rental brand perfecting stays before they happen by helping travelers find their perfect fit, ensuring quality homes and hosts, and providing trusted support.

These teams set the strategic vision, operating plans, and investment priorities to create compelling and distinct traveler value and drive business growth.

The team is responsible for effectively partnering with cross-functional teams in Marketing, Product, Technology, Supply, Advertising, Servicing, and Corporate Functions to deliver the best traveler and business outcomes.

Make an impact!

Are you passionate about bringing brand strategies to life and creating seamless, relevant experiences for travelers? Are you energized by using merchandising, experimentation, and cross-functional partnership to drive customer growth? We are looking for a Senior Manager, Merchandising and Customer Growth to lead North America merchandising strategy across Brand Expedia and our Portfolio brands, with a focus on merchandising attach opportunities and app strategy and testing. This role reports to the Director, Merchandising and Operations, Brand Expedia and Portfolio.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead North America merchandising strategy: Own the North America merchandising roadmap and calendar across Brand Expedia and our Portfolio brands, aligning priorities across customer touch points.
  • Drive merchandising attach strategy: Define and execute strategies that increase relevant cross-sell and upsell opportunities across the traveler journey, partnering with Product, Marketing, Analytics, and Supply, to improve customer value and business growth.
  • Shape app merchandising strategy: Establish the merchandising strategy for app experiences, including surface prioritization, placement strategy, personalization opportunities, and coordination with Marketing, Product, Design, and Engineering.
  • Build a test-and-learn engine: Partner with Product and Analytics to develop a consistent experimentation cadence across web and app merchandising touchpoints; formulate hypotheses, prioritize tests, evaluate results, and translate learnings into scalable improvements.
  • Lead merchandising execution: Coordinate the timely delivery of merchandising initiatives and promotions across Marketing, Product, Supply, Legal, and Finance, ensuring clear ownership, dependencies, and escalation paths.
  • Measure performance and optimize: Analyze performance, incrementality, customer engagement, conversion, and attach results; lead campaign and merchandising retrospectives and recommend optimization actions to improve future delivery.
  • Create cross-functional alignment: Bring structure and clarity to complex initiatives, communicate decisions and tradeoffs, and maintain a shared view of priorities, risks, and progress for senior stakeholders.
  • Stay close to the market: Monitor travel category trends, competitive experiences, and best-in-class ecommerce merchandising to identify opportunities for Brand Expedia and our Portfolio brands.

Experience And Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Management, or a related field; MBA preferred.
  • 8+ years of experience in B2C ecommerce, digital merchandising, loyalty or brand marketing, retail management, or a related field.
  • Experience leading merchandising across North America, multiple brands, lines of business, or customer segments.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and optimizing attach, cross-sell, upsell, or other customer growth strategies.
  • Experience building app merchandising strategies and partnering with Product, Design, Engineering, and Analytics teams to deliver customer-facing experiences.
  • Experience with A/B testing frameworks, experimentation design, traffic data sources, and performance measurement.
  • Strong project or program management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver through ambiguity in a fast-paced B2C environment.
  • Proven ability to influence and align stakeholders across multiple subject areas, prioritize opportunities, and mitigate risks.
  • Strong analytical and business acumen, with the ability to turn customer and performance data into clear recommendations and action.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively, concisely, and in a way that is tailored to the audience, including senior leaders.
  • Resilient and constructive when faced with change; able to shift approaches in response to unexpected events and circumstances.

As you think about your next bold career move, are you ready to shape the future of digital marketing with data and AI? Start your journey with us!

We are seeking an ambitious, experienced Online Marketing Analytics Manager to join our Marketing Performance organization in Barcelona. In this role, you will lead and continue building a talented team of analysts, drive our advanced analytics and AI agenda, and turn complex data into strategic growth for our global business.

Why eDreams ODIGEO

Join the world's leading travel subscription platform...

  • We pioneered Prime, the first and world’s leading travel subscription programme since launching in 2017.
  • Millions of Prime members every year across multiple markets.
  • 5 brands: eDreams, GO Voyages, Opodo, Travellink, and the metasearch engine Liligo
  • This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalised service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members.
  • Diversity is our strength that’s why our eDOers are coming from different nationalities from all continents – 99% permanent contracts


Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, exciting challenges, and a transparent view of how your work directly contributes to our global company goals and our customers. As our Online Marketing Analytics Manager, you will be in charge of:

  • Shaping the Strategy: Define and execute the analytics and reporting strategy for our online marketing campaigns, ensuring long-term value generation through deep, actionable insights and data-driven decision-making.
  • Pioneering AI & Automation: Champion the strategic adoption and implementation of AI within our marketing analytics ecosystem. You will leverage predictive modeling and intelligent automation to transform raw data into forward-looking insights, keeping us at the absolute cutting edge of marketing innovation.
  • Driving Innovation: Design, track, and analyze experiments while helping build a continuous "test and learn" agenda across marketing channels.
  • Leading & Mentoring: Manage a team of analysts—leading, supporting, coaching, and guiding them. You will set clear expectations and ensure they are fully equipped to succeed by providing them with the necessary business context, tools, and hands-on guidance to deliver robust, high-impact insights.
  • Solving Complex Business Problems: Translate complex business questions into functional analyses. Extract, manipulate, and model data from diverse sources using Python, R, or SQL, and collaborate with stakeholders to bring your insights to life.
  • Performance Reporting: Report on overall campaign performance to senior management, evaluating success and delivering clear insights from multiple analytical angles.


How You Will Do It

Our Ways of Working and Core Mindset

  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Deeply understand business requirements by working closely with key stakeholders, combining their needs with your deep knowledge of digital marketing analytics and statistics to build best-in-class practices.
  • Impact-Driven Prioritization: Effectively prioritize projects and requests to drive consistent progress against our Objectives and Key Results (OKRs).
  • Agile Execution: Work and adapt in a fast-paced, agile, and lean environment focused on delivering continuous value to our customers.
  • Strategic Focus: Manage multiple selected projects simultaneously without losing sight of the "big picture."
  • Culture of Growth: Empower and develop junior team members, fostering a supportive environment and contributing positively to our shared growth mindset.


What you need to succeed:

Your Profile, Skills, And Experience

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions! You will have the opportunity to learn, grow, and make a real impact on our business. Here is what we are looking for:

Core Requirements:

  • Education: Degree in a quantitative or technical field (such as Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline).
  • Analytical Mindset: Excellent analytical thinking, with fluency in data analysis and a proven ability to translate complex data into compelling stories (data storytelling).
  • Curiosity & Proactive Ownership: Naturally curious and highly proactive, with a relentless drive to dig beneath the surface, solve complex business challenges, and take full ownership of end-to-end outcomes.
  • Business Acumen: Exceptional business intuition and context-awareness. Proven track record of grounding analysis in core business metrics and translating goals into actionable strategies that prioritize real trading impact over technical complexity.
  • Proven Track Record: Solid professional experience in digital marketing analytics roles, with prior experience mentoring or managing other analysts.


Technical Toolkit:

  • Strong proficiency in writing SQL queries to extract and manipulate data.
  • Experience or knowledge working with Python, R, or similar programming languages for data manipulation and statistical analysis.
  • Experience building dashboards using data visualization tools (e.g., Looker Studio/DataStudio, Tableau, PowerBI).
  • Statistical Foundation: A solid understanding of statistical techniques for interpreting summary metrics, assessing confidence intervals, and conducting hypothesis testing (A/B testing).
  • Soft Skills: Exceptional communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail. You are highly collaborative and thrive on giving and receiving feedback.
  • Language: Fluency in English (both written and verbal).


Good to have

  • Domain Expertise: A strong understanding of digital marketing and marketing/ad-tech ecosystems (including tracking, conversion funnels, and core marketing KPIs).
  • Agile Frameworks: Familiarity working within agile or lean frameworks.
  • Advanced Marketing Methodologies: Exposure to Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), Causal Inference, or multi-touch attribution frameworks.
  • AI & ML Applications: Practical experience applying machine learning algorithms or AI tools to marketing problems (e.g., customer lifetime value modeling, predictive churn, automated insights).


What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

  • A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and premium equipment with role-based selection options and device ownership through our equipment lifecycle program when it reaches its refresh cycle.
  • Continuous learning to fuel your growth and explore new horizons! 📚 Learn and grow with free Coursera access, soft skills workshops, tech training, leadership development, and more. Plus, enjoy a great onboarding program.
  • Grow opportunities to empower your career and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.
  • Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcomes. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
  • Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padel tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
  • Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.


Wanna take a peek into what it's like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

Apply now!

Desde hace 26 años revoluciona la industria del turismo a través de la tecnología, y, con su continua apuesta al desarrollo del sector, hoy forma una empresa consolidada que integra a Best Day, HotelDO, Viajes Falabella, Koin, ViajaNet y Stays.net, convirtiéndose en una de las Compañías más relevantes de la región y capaz de ofrecer una experiencia personalizada a más de 30 millones de clientes. Desde 2025, integra el Grupo Prosus, junto a iFood, Sympla y OLX Brasil.
Despegar opera en 19 países, acompañando a los latinoamericanos desde el momento en que sueñan con viajar hasta cuando están compartiendo recuerdos. Con el propósito de conectar todos los viajes de manera impecable, ha desarrollado métodos de pago alternativos y financiamiento, democratizando el acceso al consumo y acercando a los latinoamericanos a su próxima experiencia de viaje. Fue la primera empresa del sector en la región en crear una asistente de viaje con IA generativa, SOFIA.
Descubre las búsquedas activas: https://jobs.lever.co/despegar
job.job_description:
Somos Despegar, parte del ecosistema de Prosus, y hace más de 25 años revolucionamos la forma de viajar en América Latina ✈️. Construimos tecnología que transforma experiencias y conecta a millones de personas con sus sueños de viaje.


Buscamos talento que piense en 10x, actúe con autonomía y genere impacto real. Si te apasiona innovar, aprender rápido y construir en equipo, este lugar es para ti



Buscamos una persona analítica, resolutiva y orientada al servicio para asumir las demandas operativas de hoteles y socios de hospedaje, acompañando cada caso hasta su resolución.

Como Partner Operations Analyst trabajarás en conjunto con Market Management para asegurar una operación confiable y una experiencia consistente para nuestros partners. Serás responsable del diagnóstico inicial y seguimiento de temas relacionados con extranet, contenido, tarifas y promociones, disponibilidad, reservas, cancelaciones, cobros y pagos.

Tu trabajo debe asegurar que los acuerdos comerciales se ejecuten correctamente y que los problemas avancen con la prioridad adecuada, liberando tiempo de los equipos comerciales para enfocarse en relación, negociación y crecimiento.


 


 


¿Cómo generas impacto?

  • Primer contacto y diagnóstico. Recibir demandas de partners y Market Managers, reunir evidencia e identificar causa, urgencia e impacto comercial

  • Priorización y resolución. Resolver los casos dentro de tu alcance y escalar los demás con diagnóstico completo, evidencia y seguimiento hasta cierre

  • Configuración de cuenta. Apoyar altas y mantenimiento de contenido, habitaciones, políticas, accesos y configuraciones en extranet

  • Ejecución de acuerdos comerciales. Cargar y validar tarifas, disponibilidad y promociones conforme a las condiciones acordadas

  • Reservas y pagos. Investigar incidencias de reservas, cancelaciones, cargos, facturación y pagos, articulando a las áreas responsables

  • Comunicación proactiva. Mantener al partner informado sobre estatus, siguientes pasos y tiempos de resolución, traduciendo temas técnicos o financieros de forma clara

  • Disciplina de seguimiento. Documentar y mantener actualizados casos, responsables, compromisos y evidencias en CRM y herramientas de tickets

  • Colaboración transversal. Trabajar con Finanzas, Reservas, Atención, Conectividad, Producto y Tecnología para resolver casos complejos

  • Mejora continua. Detectar causas recurrentes y proponer mejoras, automatización y autoservicio que reduzcan retrabajo



Lo que te diferencia:

  • 2 a 4 años de experiencia en Customer Operations, Customer Success, soporte B2B, hotelería u operaciones de partners

  • Capacidad analítica para reunir evidencia, identificar causa raíz y priorizar por impacto

  • Experiencia con CRM y herramientas de gestión de tickets; HubSpot, ServiceNow, Jira o equivalentes son deseables

  • Organización para gestionar múltiples demandas y compromisos simultáneos

  • Comunicación clara, escucha activa, empatía y orientación a solución

  • Mentalidad de ownership: mantener el seguimiento aun cuando la resolución dependa de otra área

  • Conocimiento de hotelería, OTAs, extranets, tarifas, promociones, reservas y pagos es un diferenciador





¿Qué ofrecemos?



  • Autonomía real para tomar decisiones e impactar desde el día 1

  • Cultura de aprendizaje continuo: fallamos rápido, aprendemos y escalamos

  • Equipo diverso, colaborativo y sin silos

  • Oportunidades de crecimiento en un ecosistema global (Prosus)



Valoramos el ownership, la innovación y poner a las personas en el centro.


Viajar te transforma, trabajar en Despegar también ✈️

job.job_description:
If you’re looking for the next stamp in your career passport, we’re looking for Sales Travel Consultants across Rockhampton who are keen to dazzle, discover, and delight our customers!

Are you ready to turn your love of travel into a career that takes you further than you ever imagined, both personally and professionally? Your Flight Centre journey is uniquely yours - and we’re here to champion it, celebrate it, and help it take flight. As a Flightie you’re not just building a career - you’re shaping a life filled with purpose, connection, and discovery. Navigate your career. Explore the world.

What you’ll be doing - where your passion will meet purpose!

  • Work full-time, on-site in one of our retail stores on a rotating roster across a 7-day trade
  • Plan itineraries, book travel and convert enquiries into bookings in person, over the phone and via email for our customers
  • Work towards individual KPIs and sales targets where you’ll sell the whole holiday including flights, accommodation, car hire, tours, travel insurance, cruises, transfers and more
  • Build a customer base of new and returning customers from regular domestic bookings to lavish international holidays and everything in between
  • Be the expert! Assist our customers with their travel related questions including visas, best time of year to travel, what to pack, where to eat, what to avoid, you name it!
  • Enjoy a base wage plus an uncapped incentive payment structure where you earn a percentage of every sale, your pay is completely uncapped!

What we’re looking for - do you have the travel bug?

  • Great organisational skills - you’re the type to take notes, manage your calendar well and are quick to respond to your customer’s phone calls and emails
  • A genuine passion for travel and desire to help open up the world to our customers!
  • Determination to meet your sales targets and KPIs while balancing your workload in a high-pressure environment (think customers lining up, phones ringing, email inbox filling!)
  • Enthusiasm, passion and a warmth that makes our customers want to book with you every time!
  • A savviness with computers, ready to toggle between various complex systems when finding the right flight and package options for your customer

What you will gain from a career with Flight Centre - let’s unpack the benefits!

💲 Average earnings for a Travel Consultant in their first year are $70K, while Senior Consultants average $100K and Team Leaders average $138K annually - including superannuation and penalty rates.

🌏 Become a true expert – access industry travel discounts and qualify for sponsored ‘Familiarisation Trips’ to explore new destinations and products around the world 

💎 Brightness of Future: Career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses across the globe - we promote from within   

🎉 Social: Embrace the famous Flight Centre culture at our Reward & Recognition events throughout the year including our most popular events on the calendar Global Gathering and Flichella    

🎓 Get qualified for free with a Certificate 3 & 4 in Travel & Tourism (worth 20k!) through Australian Apprentice Training - you may also be eligible to receive direct financial support while you study 

🌈 Thrive in a workplace that embraces individualism – come as you are!  

Okay, I’m in!

Are you keen to join our team of Flighties? Hit apply now for your application to be read by a real human, no AI here! If your application is successful, you’ll be invited to have a 15-minute phone interview with one of our dedicated team of recruiters. Get ready to work, travel and grow.

Why is Flight Centre such a great place to work?

We are devoted to being a global employer of choice by nurturing our legendary culture - focused on our people and infused with adventure and accountability. We uplift and support our team through a compelling Employee Value Proposition that offers exciting career and travel opportunities, fantastic benefits, a meaningful sense of purpose and well-deserved recognition. Explore us on LinkedIn or check out our careers page at www.fctgcareers.com

*Flight Centre is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.*

KAYAK is part of a global network that includes our sister brand OpenTable, as well as a portfolio of travel metasearch brands including Swoodoo, checkfelix, momondo, Cheapflights, Mundi and HotelsCombined. Collectively, we’re uniquely equipped to help people experience the world through travel and dining.
KAYAK is part of Booking Holdings Inc. and operates sites in more than 70 countries and territories.

job.job_description:
KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is a leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

KAYAK for Business (K4B) is KAYAK's corporate travel platform — built to help companies manage business travel through a modern online booking experience, AI-powered features, and a connected network of travel management partners.

KAYAK is seeking a highly motivated Senior Manager to lead Supplier Relations for KAYAK for Business. This person will report to the Senior Director KAYAK for Business and oversee the portfolio of all global preferred supplier partners (TMC, airline, rail, lodging, car rental, ground, expense, payment, etc).

This position is based in our Cambridge, MA office at least 3 times per week.

In This Role, You Will

  • Drive global growth, engaging new partnerships as well as optimizing and retaining our existing partnerships, while expanding the value proposition and aligning the K4B strategy for suppliers and other partnerships
  • Design and lead travel partner evaluations, communications, and contracting for the organization
  • Collaborate with partners & internal teams on commercial opportunities, developing and strengthening strategic and mutually beneficial relationships for K4B and its partners
  • Working closely with customers and internal collaborators to ensure current and future content & functionality needs are exceeded
  • Collaborate with key internal teams like Business Development, Account Management, Product & Marketing to achieve target goals
  • Contribute to determining and prioritizing new technology improvements to help drive additional sales to key partners
  • Work closely with the Finance department for budgeting and forecasting and revenue reconciliation from suppliers

Please Apply If You Have

  • 7+ years in travel agency, distribution, payment, air/lodging/car/rail supplier or related fields
  • Proven history of building and maintaining strong relationships both internally and externally
  • Savvy and clear communicator, story teller and presenter to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Outstanding analytic skills to drive positive partnership results based on analysis
  • Expert negotiator, developing creative solutions to problems or barriers
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced tech environment
  • Recognized as a thought leader within the Travel Industry
  • Experience in tech a major plus
  • Strong business development and problem-solving skills coupled with a willingness to “roll up your sleeves”
  • Experience working with global teams in multiple locations

Benefits And Perks

  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year
  • Focus on mental health and well-being:
    • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
    • Company-paid subscription to HeadSpace
    • Company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)
  • No meeting Fridays
  • Paid parental leave
  • Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday
  • Paid volunteer time
  • Focus on your career growth:
    • Development Dollars
    • Leadership development
    • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings
  • Travel Discounts
  • Employee Resource Groups
  • Competitive retirement and health plans
  • Free lunch 2 days per week
  • Fun quarterly events such as boat trips, arcades, ski trips, Thursday happy hours, and more
There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. The range for this Massachusetts-based role is $135,000-$155,000.

We offer a competitive base salary and benefits including: health benefits; flexible spending account; retirement benefits; life insurance; paid time off (including PTO, paid sick leave, medical leave, bereavement leave, floating holidays and paid holidays); and parental leave benefits. This role is eligible to be considered for an annual bonus.

Inclusion

At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That's why we're focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here.

Need any adjustments for the interview, application or on the job? No problem - just give us a heads-up. We've got you.

job.job_description:
Your day to day:

As Complex Director of Sales & Marketing covering the Six Senses Grenada and InterContinental Grenada(Opening Q4 of 2026, you will develop and implement strategies to ensure revenue and room night sales goals are achieved, sales and marketing strategies are set, tactical plans are created and implemented, and results are monitored and achieved.

Leadership

  • Deploy sales and marketing colleagues for comprehensive coverage of key markets, segments, and customers
  • Develop your team and improve their performance through training, coaching and feedback
  • Assign performance and development goals for colleagues; monitor achievement of revenue targets and course correct when needed
  • Drive a great working environment for your teams to thrive, creating synergy between the two resorts and a sense of one team
  • Develop and maintain great working relationships with key clients, guests, vendors and communities in local markets

Strategic Planning & Execution

  • Lead the strategic commercial plan for both resorts, working with Revenue Management and Marketing Communications
  • Implement strategies and programming that are tailored to the market segments of both resorts
  • With RM and GMs, analyze growth opportunities across key segments
  • Develop a strong sales strategic plan that maximizes high season revenue and creates shoulder season opportunities
  • Working with digital marketing and PR partners, develop and execute strategy to maximize awareness, interest, and realized revenues for the resorts

Cluster Sales Management

  • Develop a comprehensive travel and trade show plan to maximize coverage and impact
  • Work closely with Luxury Lifestyle Global Sales to coordinate sales plans
  • Monitor sales deployment and performance of the sales team
  • Nurture a proactive sales culture and an effective prospecting program

Financial Management and Reporting

  • Prepare departmental budgets and financial plans including both resorts' commercial plan  
  • Create and implement commercial plans that drive measurable incremental occupancy, achieve RevPAR goals, food and beverage, and catering revenues
  • Produce monthly reports and sales forecasts to analyze current/potential market and sales trends, coordinate activities to increase revenue and market share,e and monitor performance to ensure actual sales meet or exceed established revenue plan 
  • Review monthly reports and sales forecasts to analyze current/potential market and sales trends
  • Coordinate activities to increase revenue and market share and monitor performance to meet or exceed established revenue plans

Guest Experience

  • Create programming at both resorts to drive incremental revenues
  • Communicate special needs for arriving VIPs, large groups, and other key guests
  • Lead marketing efforts to upsell guests on hotel services, offerings, and amenities

Responsible Business

  • Work closely with key business leaders, officials, and representatives of local community groups within the city to ensure constant high-profile exposure for the hotel
  • Effectively communicate and market aspects of the hotel that are sustainable or “green” and use information to gain new business opportunities
  • Work with advertising agencies, consulting firms, and vendors to maximize advertising investments and ensure ads represent brand identity
  • Raise the awareness and reputation of your hotel and the brand locally – occasionally acting as hotel representative for media-related inquiry
  • Identify improvements to marketing activities and overall hotel sales performance and work with other departments 
  • Ad-hoc duties – unexpected moments when we must pull together to get a task done

Accountability

This is the top commercial role overseeing two resorts. Resorts may have multiple sites and facilities, high-volume catering and/or convention facilities, and a large number of VIP and special service guests. May manage a large number of professional-level and administrative sales, catering, and/or convention employee

Skills And Experience

  • To execute the position of Area Director of Sales & Marketing, I must have the required qualifications, technical skills, and experience in a similar role in luxury hotels with proven results and includes the following:
  • Five or more years of experience in a senior sales and marketing role
  • Experience in managing a remote team(s); dual property experience is ideal
  • Strong knowledge of the Caribbean market and business trends preferred
  • Technical skills include Advanced MS Office and familiarity with various property systems

The above is intended to provide an overview of the role and responsibilities for an Area Director of Sales & Marketing at Intercontinental Dominica, Six Senses Grenada & InterContinental Grenada. It is not and does not infer that the above is an inclusive and/or exhaustive list of the duties and responsibilities inherent in the position.

Location – Remote: **Candidate must reside within the US East Coast near a major airport

About Six Senses La Sagesse Grenada

Surrounded by nature, there are 56 pool suites. Combining eco-credentials and comfort, the design uses natural, renewable, and repurposed materials. The organic and contemporary interiors feature an open-plan bedroom, while the outdoor terrace leads to a private plunge pool for a cooling dip. In addition, there are 15 villas enjoying a prime hillside or oceanfront setting, ranging between one, two, and four bedrooms. The five four-bedroom villas located on the Bluff offer a 270-degree view of one of the most coveted locations in the Caribbean. It has never been more important to be mentally, physically, and spiritually happy. This has been considered in every aspect of the design, with ample light, fresh air, and space.

About InterContinental Grenada - La Sagesse

Opening November 2026, this stunning resort will offer 120 thoughtfully designed guest rooms and suites, complemented by a collection of exceptional restaurants and bars, a world-class spa, state-of-the-art fitness center, and a striking pool and Beach Club. With panoramic views overlooking La Sagesse Bay, this resort will offer expansive indoor and outdoor meeting and event space, seamlessly combining sophisticated luxury with the island’s stunning natural beauty.

About Us

IHG Hotels & Resorts is one of the largest hotel companies in the world and one of the world’s leading hotel and resort companies with a family of 19 brands. Our purpose – True Hospitality for Good – comes to life in every one of our collections. With luxury and lifestyle, we are taking it to new heights.

Five visionary brands - InterContinental, Regent Hotels, Six Senses, Vignette Collection and Kimpton Hotels - make up our luxury collection. Individually, they are icons. Together, they bring unforgettable and unparalleled experiences to travelers in over 430 hotels and resorts in 100 countries around the world.

Having recently added a host of incredible properties to our portfolio, we now stand as one of the world’s leading luxury operators. Each of our hotels cultivates a distinctive style and ambience where we embrace every opportunity to give our guests unforgettable and unparalleled experiences.

The salary range for this position is $180,000.00 - 200,000.00 This role is also eligible for bonus pay (as applicable). We offer a comprehensive package of benefits, including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, 401K, and other benefits to employees.

At IHG Hotels & Resorts, we work together to deliver True Hospitality for Good on a global scale. With corporate offices and over 6,000 hotel destinations worldwide, a career at IHG is the perfect way to broaden your horizons. You’ll experience our unique culture and brilliant colleagues who will support and inspire you. With a host of corporate opportunities to choose from, wherever you are on your career journey, and whatever you want to achieve there’s Room for You at IHG.

Over recent years, we’ve transformed our company. We have bold ambitions to drive performance and maintain our relentless focus on growth in order to be the hotel company of choice that guests & owners love.

We are a hospitality business at our core and value connections and being together helps us foster a unique sense of belonging that also supports productivity. That’s why here at IHG, we give our colleagues flexibility and balance – working in a hybrid way, blending office and remote working collectively. We recognise that every role is different, that’s why leaders work with teams to determine how and when they collaborate.

We provide a wide range of benefits designed to help you live your best work life. These include impressive room discounts across our many properties, recharge days and volunteering days throughout the year. Through our myWellbeing framework, we are committed to supporting wellbeing in your health, lifestyle, and workplace. We offer a unique and inclusive culture, where there is always Room for You to belong, grow and make a difference.

Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams where we celebrate difference and encourage colleagues to bring their whole selves to work. job.job_description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

GetYourGuide knows a lot about travelers, and we want to make better use of that data. Identity, booking history, browsing behavior, care conversations, preferences and predictions all sit in separate systems, in different shapes. The User Platform team is a brand new function with truly outsized opportunity for impact. They are building the traveler context layer: resolving who someone is across devices and sessions, and turning scattered signals into a shared, interpretable, and predictive understanding that every team can build on. As this function matures, the scope will extend to our other users over time.

Role Overview

As an Engineering Manager, you will own the vision and set up for a new platform at GetYourGuide. You will be working with a Product Manager, engineers, an embedded data scientist, and an analyst. You will define what the traveler context layer holds, how it is served, and which problems it solves first. This is a genuine zero-to-one opportunity. Your team will design the identity model, the semantic memory that both humans and LLMs can read, the forward-looking predictions on top of it, and the self-serve interfaces that make it usable.

The work is equal parts craft and demand creation. Our consumers are other teams: search and ranking, lifecycle and paid channels, customer care, and the traveler experience itself. Their need is real and widely felt.

We are looking for an Engineering leader who is fluent in setting up new teams, data, a new platform, Backend systems, and who is comfortable when the scope of a domain is still being drawn, and who wants to build the foundation that personalization at GetYourGuide will run on for years.

Your mission

  • Lead hiring and performance management for a team of engineers, setting a high bar for talent and enabling engineers to grow and perform at their best
  • Work closely with the Product Manager in a highly collaborative setup to shape and deliver the roadmap and strategy, driving business results across a large, complex domain end-to-end, setting the tech direction for your team
  • Drive technical excellence and own and raise the system health of the team
  • Foster a supportive culture that continuously evolves based on learnings
  • Champion an experimentation mindset, leveraging data and insights to validate ideas and iterate quickly
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with stakeholders across the business to drive impactful initiatives

Your toolkit

  • A seasoned engineering leader with strong ownership, aligning technical direction with team and stakeholder needs
  • Comfortable navigating complex problem spaces and empowering your team to do the same
  • Passionate about experimentation as a core tool for discovery and decision-making
  • Bring a full-stack mindset and can engage meaningfully across backend and frontend systems
  • Experienced in applying AI technologies within product development
  • A people-first leader who coaches and supports engineers at all levels without micromanaging
  • Deeply customer-focused, using product judgment to guide roadmap and priorities
  • Thrive in an international, cross-functional environment with strong collaboration skills

How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary

  • Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
  • Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
  • A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.
  • Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events
  • Monthly transportation and fitness budget

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You will manage designated corporate accounts, develop and solicit new business, drive total hotel revenue from rooms, catering, and F&B outlets, address business needs, explore new opportunities, and expand existing business through promotional efforts and sales channels. As a Sales Manager, you’re not just generating and managing group sales – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Represent the hotel to prospective clients: Serve as the primary point of contact for customers seeking group rooms, meeting space, and food and beverage services
  • Drive new business opportunities: Respond to inquiries, initiate outreach, qualify leads, and solicit potential clients through proactive sales efforts
  • Manage the full sales cycle: Conduct site visits, entertain clients, prepare proposals, determine rates, negotiate contracts, and service accounts through fulfillment
  • Develop strategic sales plans: Create and execute strategies to achieve or exceed revenue and room night goals, adjusting based on performance and market conditions
  • Analyze sales performance: Evaluate lost business reports and identify opportunities to strengthen conversion and competitiveness
  • Support exceptional service delivery: Collaborate across departments to coordinate the fulfillment of contracted services and uphold the highest standards of client satisfaction
  • Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • Diploma or degree in Hospitality, Business, or related field
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in hotel Corporate, MICE, or Group room sales
  • Proven track record in driving revenue and managing key accounts
  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills
  • Technical proficiency in hotel systems (e.g., Delphi, Salesforce, OnQ, Market Planner Survey)
  • Ability to analyze sales data and market trends to inform strategy
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills with a collaborative mindset

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

• An exciting opportunity to get involved in partnership transformation initiatives, strategy design, development, management and growth of a core portfolio of external commercial partnerships
  • Challenge yourself to manage a portfolio of commercial partners and introduce new revenue and product diversification opportunities in the Hotels & Holidays space
  • Permanent Full time role based at our Corporate Campus in Mascot


Qantas has always been dedicated to going above and beyond for their customers – both in the air, and on the ground and at Qantas Loyalty; we’re a huge part of that commitment. By taking the time to recognise and reward our members, we build stronger relationships with the people who matter most.


As the Senior Commercial Manager, Partnerships, you will operate within The Hotels and Holidays Partnerships stream, responsible for the supply stream of the business, overseeing margin optimisation, procurement strategy and end to end partnerships for Qantas Group Accommodation. You will be accountable for strategic oversight of the focus areas and leading the larger components of strategy build and stakeholder management. You will develop, build and guide on the implementation of strategies across all cross functional Hotels and Holidays streams that enable delivery of revenue growth, margin optimisation, operational and process efficiencies, in addition to the development of new initiatives that drive incremental revenue growth.


This role is an important leadership position, setting the direction, driving outcomes, and cascading core partnership strategies across the Hotels and Holidays business. You will be accountable for understanding the broader business across end-to-end product squads to enable prioritisation and partner with cross-functional stakeholders. Overseeing a portfolio of core Hotels and Holidays partnerships, you will lead the end-to-end execution of partnerships—from strategy and negotiation through to contracting, management, and final implementation.


The Senior Commercial Manager, Partnerships plays a key stakeholder management role, organising and facilitating outcomes that enable delivery of revenue/margin optimisation and opening new revenue streams and opportunities, across the business.


You’ll have –

  • 15 years+ experience in the management of large scale and complex Partnerships in Aviation, Travel, Retail or other significant household spend categories
  • Tertiary qualifications in Business, Commerce, Finance or Economics or equivalent experience. Post graduate qualifications eg MBA in related disciplines well regarded
  • Exceptionally strong external stakeholder management skills, including C-suite executives, with passion for sales, business development and partnerships management
  • Exceptional commercial acumen with well-developed strategic, financial, customer, commercial modelling and relationship management skills
  • Strong analytical and data-analysis capability with a focus on identifying opportunities, applying critical thinking, problem solving and overall better decision making
  • Thorough understanding of customer loyalty fundamentals, core drivers of loyalty value creation and partnership execution within a loyalty programme context
  • Thorough understand of partner and customer/member perspectives and ability to leverage data and insight as part of partnership strategy development and performance appraisal
  • Ability to strategically design and develop partnership frameworks including industry/sector appraisals, competitor benchmarking, pipeline development, opportunity sizing, deal structures, commercial constructs and success KPIs and measures
  • Revenue and gross margin management experience in a partnership context and ability to manage financial targets, budgets and forecasting
  • Significant business development, negotiation and contracting experience with in-depth knowledge of all components of deal making, partnership development and onboarding
  • Significant experience in developing key internal and external materials including pitching and proposals, business casing and strategic plan development
  • Exceptional experience in value creation through partnership marketing with sound knowledge of ‘go to market’ strategies and core drivers of value creation for the customer and partner
  • Partnership product development experience and ability to liaise with SME stakeholders on key inputs including technology, data, legal, product and ux to develop best in class customer products and experiences
  • Ability to appraise partnership performance, understand key partnership value drivers and define success KPIs
  • Exceptional people management experience with ability to lead, motivate, coach and develop high performing teams
  • High level of motivation and ability to work independently with a proactive and can-do attitude
  • Results oriented with demonstrated ability to deliver results under pressure in a complex business environment across a variety of industries
  • Thorough understanding of Agile ways of working and methodologies and/or experience of working in an Agile organisation


Why Qantas?

If you’re successful in your application, you’ll join a team where creativity and passion are encouraged. Our people come together to allow us to dream big and deliver successfully.

There are many different opportunities across our team, which means you’ll be able to grow both personally and professionally at Qantas. Your development is a priority for us – so that you can maintain the high standards our customers have come to expect and can continue to develop over time. You’ll be supported from day 1 with on the job training and coaching as well as our formal training opportunities. While you may start in this role, we’ve got a great track record of supporting our people to take their career in so many different directions, the destinations are endless.


The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.

  • We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave and the option to purchase additional paid leave for eligible employees.
  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.

job.job_description:
Job Description

PRODUCT MANAGER – MULTI-SOURCE AIR CONTENT

Travel obsessed? Big tech fan? Hey, you’re in good company. If you want to be part of the industry that makes the world go round, then look no further.

Travelport is the brains behind lots of your travel bookings—plane, car or hotel. Our technology is used to book that magical holiday, infamous bachelorette party or long overdue school reunion. While we can’t solve mosquito bites or lost luggage, we can simplify a lot of the technical parts of travel, and we’re looking for the best thinkers to help us do it.

We’re hiring right now for a Product Manager – Multi Source Air Content! Search for #Travelport on LinkedIn and hear from our amazing team.

How you’ll make an impact:

What does a great Product Manager do?

The Product Manager is responsible for identifying our customer needs in the travel industry market, understanding those needs by creating clear and defined features and lean business cases. Supporting an Agile Product Delivery Customer Centric approach in defining, building, and releasing a continuous flow of value and services to the customer.

Guiding the work through Lean product management and developing and executing on the product vision and product roadmap, the Product Manager identifies customer needs to articulate value propositions that will drive the optimum return on investment for their product.

The Product Manager will be versed in multi-source technology, specifically content that enables end-to-end capabilities through API and agency point of sale. The Product Manager influences the vision and direction to the delivery teams around value pursuit, feature prioritisation and feature-level acceptance criteria. The Product Manager will apply analytics and quantitative, data-driven decision-making models to inform business decisions coupled with the ability to think creatively about constraints. Responsible for entire product lifecycle including sunsetting of products.

This role requires extensive collaboration with other product managers to ensure integration of content and prioritisation across many initiatives.

Your role in action:

  • Developing deep functional product knowledge and understanding the technical composition of systems that support it.
  • Developing and communicating the product vision and roadmap for internal and external consumption.
  • Researching and collaborating to understand and document customer needs and validate solutions.
  • Translating high-level market requirements into epic level features, authoring acceptance criteria, and providing product acceptance to ensure market needs are met, using tools such as JIRA.
  • Collaborating to understand, document, and support portfolio work.
  • Serving as a subject matter expert to Travelport technical teams ensuring a complete functional definition of the desired features.


Could this be you?

  • Knowledge and implementation of product management and product owner techniques, tools & principles.
  • Ability to clearly express the connections between larger business goals and small backlog items for alignment with Product strategy.
  • Communicate effectively on the purpose and vision of the product roadmap to the wider delivery team and their role in delivering or contributing to the business outcomes.
  • Effective management, prioritisation and ownership & accountability for the product backlog; stakeholder management of the backlog and ability to say "no" where items don't make sense for the bigger picture.


Discover why our teams love working here

Where do we start! Our benefits package includes:

We offer a package that includes 25 days annual leave per annum, plus Christmas working days (office shutdown), hybrid working model, pension contribution, private medical, life assurance and personal travel insurance. We believe all employees contribute to the success of the company and should be able to share in that success, which is why all jobs are eligible to participate in our bonus programme with any payouts being subject to individual and company performance.

Search for & #travelportGDL for our employee stories on LinkedIn!

Your journey at Travelport starts here.

Our application process is quick, easy, and hassle-free — apply in just a few minutes!

We are an equal opportunities employer and will consider all qualified applicants purely on their skills and abilities. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation, if needed.

About Us

Travelport is a worldwide travel retail platform. Our next-generation virtual marketplace connects travel buyers and travel sellers, that share our passion for delivering exceptional travel experiences.

Unconflicted and independent, we are re-inventing a simpler future for travel’s complex ecosystem.

Our platform gives the industry the power to help people see the world. We make it simple for businesses like airlines, hotels, and car rental companies to connect to agencies and travelers, through personalized and engaging content.

We are a diverse and inclusive workforce, representative of the communities and customers we serve. We are socially responsible, and we give back to our communities.

We encourage our people to think differently and have the courage, confidence, and ambition to challenge what has been done before.

Travelport is on a mission to make Travel easier and more rewarding for everyone.

Founded in Australia in 2015, the company provides support and resources to independent contractors (ICs), enabling them to thrive in their businesses.   • Experience coordinating digital marketing content across social media, websites/content management systems (CMS) and email marketing.
  • Experience managing content approvals, updates and publishing processes to keep marketing activity on track.

Experience in travel, tourism, hospitality or supplier/partner marketing would be highly advantageous.

Why CTM & 1000MTG?

job.job_description:
Product Marketing Manager I Viator

About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

This role owns key aspects of commercial strategy, go-to-market, and narrative for how Viator grows value across its supply organisation — shaping strategy alongside Commercial and Product teams, not just executing it, and turning that strategy into positioning and enablement that suppliers understand, trust, and act on. It sits at the intersection of commercial strategy, product, and supplier-facing marketing, and is accountable for making sure Viator's most important supply-side initiatives are right, and that they land with operators, not just internally.

The strength of any supply-side initiative starts with whether the strategy behind it is right — and that requires someone close enough to the evidence to shape it, not just market it after the fact. This role brings senior commercial marketing capability that can build strategy, ground it in original research, and carry it through to execution that lands with operators.

Job Location: Hybrid

This role is a hybrid position in London, UK. Travel to company offices is expected 1-2 days per week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategy Development: Build strategy and identify key initiatives to enable us to meet our company goals - bringing a point of view on what Viator should do next and why, backed by evidence rather than assumption.
  • Independent Research & Insight: Run research into supplier behaviour, needs, and market dynamics - designing and conducting the work directly rather than relying solely on other teams' output and use it to shape strategy before it's built.
  • Product Roadmap Influence: Work as a key partner with product, using supplier insight and data to actively guide what gets built and prioritised.
  • Commercial GTM Ownership: Take supply-side commercial strategy such as pricing, promotions, incentive structures, new programs and turn it into positioning and launch plans that suppliers act on, from first announcement through adoption.
  • Supplier Growth Strategy: Partner with Commercial teams to translate operator insight into marketing and product initiatives that measurably grow supplier earnings and engagement.
  • Lifecycle & CRM Strategy: Shape supplier lifecycle CRM programs so that engagement, retention, and reactivation efforts stay aligned to what's commercially important right now.
  • Initiative Launch & Rollout: Lead the end-to-end rollout of major supply-side initiatives - sequencing, localisation where relevant, and adapting positioning and enablement to what actually works for the operators it's aimed at, rather than exporting a single playbook.
  • Competitive & Market Intelligence: Track how competitors win and retain supply, and turn that into a sharper Viator offering.

Skills And Experience

  • 8+ years in product marketing, with experience owning commercial or GTM strategy
  • Experience influencing product roadmap as a peer to product teams, backed by evidence.
  • Strong grasp of two-sided marketplace dynamics.
  • Comfortable working directly with data science/analytics and core metrics.
  • Sharp GTM and positioning craft — turns ambiguous strategy into messaging people act on.
  • Experience across more than one stage of a supplier/partner lifecycle.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!
