Description

Job overview and responsibilities

The Senior Manager of IT Applications Development will be pivotal in building a team dedicated to developing innovative solutions for our Travel Systems supporting our Human Resources Business Partners. This position will drive technological advancements and shape our company's future amid ongoing transformations related to Employee Travel Modernization and innovative Learning development tools. As a leader, you will have exceptional leadership and communication skills and a deep understanding of driving organizational change, Agile development, and solutions architecture.

  • Leadership and Team Management
    • Build and lead a high-performing agile team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning with both on and offshore resources
    • Provide strategic direction and oversight to ensure the successful execution of product goals, resource management, and day-to-day operations
    • Establish goals for the team and individuals, including performance reviews and career and performance plans
    • Enable the DT transformation of building agile based pods aligned to our common metrics and measure
  • Communication and Stakeholder Management
    • Collaborate with United's business and IT leadership teams and product subject matter experts to establish the product's long-term vision, goals, and strategy
    • Develop multi-year product road map beginning with migrating the legacy system off the mainframe to cloud based application
    • Share knowledge and work together to generate innovative solutions to problems
    • Align with business partners on delivery success criteria and ensure technology solutions follow architectural standards
  • Budgeting and Resource Management
    • Provide delivery estimates and business case updates to support overall DT performance metrics and product status reporting
    • Develop and manage the program budget, ensuring efficient resource allocation to support strategic initiatives and operational need
    • Track and report on key performance metrics, making data-driving decisions to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the team
  • Strategic IT Planning and Execution
    • Evaluate, implement, and manage SaaS-based solutions and develop in-house cloud-based solutions
    • Develop plans for migration from legacy systems to modern technologies
    • Identify technical obstacles early and collaborate closely with the team to find innovative solutions
    • Responsible for escalating, assisting, and following up on resolving issues related to the delivery of technology solutions
    • Ensure that Agile methodologies are implemented following best practices and that continuous improvements are made as needed
    • Ensure compliance with code scanning and other security protocols during development and release
Qualifications

What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or related field preferred
  • 7+ years of relevant experience
  • Proven experience leading and developing IT teams both on and offshore, with a strong focus on leadership, mentorship, and team development
  • Experience implementing SaaS solutions
  • Successful track record of building applications using AWS cloud
  • Leadership experience managing multiple cross-functional teams or projects and influencing senior-level management and key stakeholders
  • Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization
  • A mindset for continuous learning and staying updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices (eg, AI and Agentic design)
  • Advanced technical and business knowledge in software development life cycle, quality assurance, project management, and other related disciplines/processes
  • Well-versed in Agile development and product management/pod support
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without sponsorship
  • Successful completion of interview required to meet job qualification
  • Reliable, punctual attendance is an essential function of the position

What will help you propel from the pack (Preferred Qualifications):

  • Master's degree
  • Understanding of system architecture principles, including the ability to design scalable and reliable solutions
  • 3+ years of Application development (.Net, Java, or other modern language)
  • Experience with modernizing mainframe systems to AWS Cloud
  • Experience with SAAS Learning tools including VR & AI technology
  • Experience with utilizing AI solutions for developing code and increasing efficiency

The base pay range for this role is $140,600.00 to $183,108.00.

The base salary range/hourly rate listed is dependent on job-related, factors such as experience, education, and skills. This position is also eligible for bonus and/or long-term incentive compensation awards.

You may be eligible for the following competitive benefits: medical, dental, vision, life, accident & disability, parental leave, employee assistance program, commuter, paid holidays, paid time off, 401(k) and flight privileges.

job.job_description:
About Us

Founded in 1999 and listed on NASDAQ in 2003 and HKEX in 2021, Trip.com Group is a leading global travel service provider comprising of Trip.com, Ctrip, Skyscanner, and Qunar.


Across its platforms, Trip.com Group integrates travel resources from industry partners and helps travellers worldwide pursue the perfect trip with exceptional travel products and services.


We have four Customer Service Centres for Trip.com established in Japan, Korea, the UK, and the Philippines, providing 24/7 customer service in 19 different languages.


We have more than 30,000 employees scattered across 30 countries in Asia, Europe, the Americas, and Oceania, striving to expand our global markets and aiming to be the world’s leading and most trusted family of online travel brands that aspire to deliver the perfect trip at the best price for every traveller.


About Trip.Biz

Trip.Biz is part of Trip.com Group and provides business travel management solutions for corporate

clients. Headquartered in Singapore, Trip.Biz is a leading digital TMC, elevating business travel

management through human-centric technology, rich inventory and sustainable solutions—all on one

platform. With roots dating back to 2006, Trip.Biz has earned the trust of over 15,000 large-scale

corporations and more than 980,000 small and medium-sized enterprises globally. Our global customer

service points of sale support clients across different time zones.


In this Role, you’ll get to

  • Develop and manage strategic partnerships with global and regional airlines to strengthen Trip.Biz’s

content competitiveness, commercial positioning and corporate travel value proposition.

Lead commercial negotiations with airline partners, including incentive agreements, private fares,

corporate programs, NDC partnerships, marketing collaborations and other strategic initiatives that

drive revenue growth and customer value.

Identify and execute growth opportunities across key markets by expanding airline content, improving

customer coverage and enhancing product competitiveness for corporate travel clients.

Partner closely with internal teams to drive the implementation and optimization of airline connectivity

solutions, including NDC, API, direct connects and other distribution initiatives.

Monitor airline performance, booking trends, market developments and commercial effectiveness,

providing data-driven insights and recommendations to maximize growth, profitability and partner

engagement.

Act as the primary business owner for airline-related initiatives, ensuring successful execution of

commercial agreements, product launches, content enhancements and operational improvements.

Build and maintain senior stakeholder relationships across airline commercial, distribution, sales,

account management and partnership teams to drive long-term strategic collaboration.

Support enterprise sales, client implementations and RFP processes by developing airline-related

solutions that address corporate customer requirements and strengthen Trip.Biz’s value proposition.

Lead cross-functional initiatives to resolve airline operational, servicing and distribution challenges,

ensuring alignment between commercial objectives, customer needs and operational feasibility.

Develop market-specific airline strategies to support regional expansion, increase customer adoption

and drive incremental GMV, revenue and market share.

Collaborate with internal stakeholders to define airline partnership priorities, commercial frameworks

and go-to-market strategies that support Trip.Biz’s global transportation objectives.


What you’ll Need to Succeed

  • Bachelor’s degree or above.
  • At least 5 years of relevant experience in the airline, Online Travel Agency (OTA) or Travel

Management Company (TMC) industry.

Solid knowledge of the airline industry; corporate travel experience is preferred.

Strong negotiation skills, an entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to work independently.

Willingness to travel when required.


﻿Why Trip.com Group

We offer a stage to unleash your full potential and drive global impact. As an international team, we embrace an open and inclusive culture that supports and respect team members in and out of the workplace. Everyone is on a trip, whether it's a career trip or a life trip. At Trip.com Group, you can define your own trip by setting a goal and celebrate your success by recognizing the progress you have made.


What’s more?

  • Our rapid business growth in global offers abundant career opportunities at various levels and in multiple functions
  • Internal transfer is encouraged, and global job rotation program enable you to pursue a global career path and make global impact
  • We provide learning opportunities to further your career in areas of leadership capability, soft skill and professional expertise.
  • Have fun with company-sponsored greetings and activities at holidays, birthdays, and colorful team events.


Click the link to learn more about What makes Trip.com Group a leading global travel service provider?


Click the link to learn more about This is a Trip Where Both Your Career and Life Can Flourish!


Find out more job opportunities at https://careers.trip.com


Have a good trip, and see you soon!

We believe in the power of travel. It broadens horizons for our customers, and for our people too. New places to live, new roles to explore, new communities to join. It’s yours for the taking.

At TUI we simply say “Let’s TUI it”. For us, that means creating happiness. Tackling challenges every day together, with a positive, can-do attitude, and finding solutions even for the most unexpected situations. Our teams across TUI are just as diverse as our destinations. No matter if you’re an accomplished tech whizz, an aspiring entertainer, or simply in love with flying.
There’s a place for you here.

job.job_description:
Accor Tech & Digital est le moteur de la tech, des solutions digitales et de la transformation au sein du Groupe. Nos 5 000 talents s'engagent à offrir les meilleures expériences digitales et tech à nos clients, nos hôtels et nos équipes dans 110 pays, et à façonner l'avenir de l'hospitalité.

Accor Tech & Digital, des métiers où l’intelligence est d’abord humaine !



Description du poste

Accor Tech & Digital, c’est le laboratoire d’innovation et de transformation technologique du leader mondial de l’hôtellerie.

Nos équipes, appelées Heartist®, concentrent le meilleur de l'hospitalité et le meilleur de la tech & du digital.

Notre ambition : offrir à nos clients des expériences personnalisées, mémorables et durables.



Ici, nous faisons naître de nouvelles façons de voyager dans chacun de nos 5 500 hôtels, au plus proche de nos 100 millions de clients dans 110 pays.

Ici, nous sommes au cœur d’un formidable terrain de jeu de transition technologique et de conception de produits digitaux et de services, pour nos clients et nos équipes en hôtels.

Ici, votre champ d’application ne connaîtra aucune frontière.

Alors, avec nous, osez avoir un impact sur le monde !

C’est ici que vous attend votre plus grand défi :

Le Product Owner Digital Workplace est responsable de définir, livrer et améliorer continuellement l’experience utilisateurs autour des appareils utilisateur, des outils de productivité et des outils de ‘Self-Service’ notamment autour des Identités et des Accès avec une forte mentalité centrée sur l'utilisateur final.

Il/Elle mène la transition vers la gestion moderne des terminaux (Modern Device Management) tout en développant les capacités de collaboration à travers la pile Microsoft365 et collaborant étroitement avec les équipes maintenant les plateformes Digital Workplace ainsi qu'avec toutes les parties prenantes métier, hôtelières, cybersécurité et infrastructures.​

Votre mission :

Le département Digital Workplace vise à offrir un environnement numérique fluide, sécurisé et centré sur l'utilisateur, qui permet aux employés d'Accor de collaborer efficacement, d'accéder facilement aux ressources et applications, et de travailler de manière productive depuis n'importe où. Sa mission est de fournir des outils, des appareils et des solutions d'identité modernes tout en garantissant l'adoption et l'amélioration continue des services afin de maximiser la productivité des collaborateurs.​

Stratégie produit & Vision​

  • Définir la vision produit et les feuilles de route (backlog) en accord avec la direction produit et la stratégie de plateforme Digital Workplace.​
  • Promouvoir une approche centrée sur l'utilisateur final, en veillant à ce que les solutions répondent aux besoins des employés et des équipes hôtelières.​
  • Surveiller l'adoption, la performance, la qualité du service et la satisfaction des utilisateurs afin de guider l'amélioration continue.​

Familles de produits du Digital Workplace​

Le département produit est structuré autour de 3 familles de produits, alignés avec nos plateformes. :

  • Employee Self-Service: produits permettant le gestion du cycle de vie des identités et des accès
  • Employee Digital Experience: produits garantissant la diminution des irritants dans l’utilisation des outils et matériels utilisés par les collaborateurs.​
  • Employee Productivity: produits permettant l’amélioration de la productivité des employées du groupe (tel que les outils collaboratifs et GenIA).​

Rôle du Product Owner​

  • Mener la transformation produit au sein du département Digital Workplace.​
  • Favoriser la définition, l'évolution et le déploiement des produits.​
  • Traduire & Vulgariser les besoins / irritants exprimés par les utilisateurs.​
  • Mesurer la valeur des solutions apportées / proposées / demandées pour prioriser les feuilles de route​
  • Créer et Gérer les élements du backlog produit (User Story, Issue/bug, Effort, …) ​
  • Coordonner la livraison avec les ingénieurs, la cybersécurité et les autres départements impliqués.​
  • Superviser les plans de déploiement, la communication et la gestion du changement afin de soutenir l'adoption à grande échelle.​
  • Garantir la gouvernance, la conformité, l'optimisation des couts (ex: licences) et les pratiques de sécurité dès la conception des produits.​
  • Collaborer & Participer à l’animation des communautés notamment avec les équipes RH, CyberSecurité, IT régionales, les opérations hôtelières.​
  • Servir de point de contact central pour les décisions produit, les mises à jour de la feuille de route et l'évolution du service.​

Qualifications

Et vous ?

  • 4 à 7+ ans d'expérience en tant que Product Owner lié au Digital Workplace (Identité, Endpoint et outils collaboratifs & productivités) ​
  • Expérience de la mise en œuvre de solutions de travail à grande échelle dans des environnements internationaux.​
  • Capacité avérée à coordonner avec la cybersécurité, l'ingénierie de plateforme et les parties prenantes du secteur.​
  • Mentalité analytique pour le suivi et la gouvernance des KPI.​
  • Anglais courant.
  • Expérience en Product Owner ou gestion de produit pour des solutions Digital Workplace.​
  • Une solide compréhension des cycles de vie des appareils, des identités et des accès et de la conception de l'expérience utilisateur final.​
  • Capacité à définir des feuilles de route produit, gérer les arriérés et fournir des résultats commerciaux mesurables.​
  • Bonne compréhension des services de collaboration Microsoft (M365, EntraID) et de la gestion des appareils utilisateurs (SCCM, Intune).​
  • Mentalité orientée utilisateur final/centrée sur le client​
  • Solides capacités de collaboration, de communication et de gestion des parties prenantes.​
  • Adaptabilité et résolution de problèmes ​
  • Solides compétences interpersonnelles et en leadership​
  • À l'aise dans un environnement global, distribué et matriciel.​

Informations supplémentaires

Et nous, quels sont nos engagements ?

- Sur le monde

  • Accor s’engage pour le monde qui nous entoure, avec une culture employeur forte centrée sur le développement de nos 300 000 talents.
  • Nous adoptons une approche d'amélioration continue pour réduire l'impact du digital sur l'environnement dans l’ensemble de nos projets.

- Sur votre carrière

  • Nous permettons à tous nos collaborateurs de maîtriser leur équilibre vie-perso / vie-pro et leur offrons les moyens de façonner leur environnement de travail à leur image.
  • Les parcours de formation et d’évolution sont définis à la fois individuellement et collectivement pour que nous grandissions ensemble, au quotidien.

- Concrètement, chez Accor Tech & Digital :

  • Télétravail possible plusieurs jours par semaine depuis la France et options de travail flexibles : travaillez depuis chez vous, nos bureaux, ou même nos hôtels et espaces de coworking grâce à Worklib.
  • Chaque mercredi après-midi, consacrez votre temps à du travail de fond et à votre développement personnel.
  • Travail dans un environnement multiculturel et anglophone.
  • Amélioration continue & formations : Hackathons, partenariats technologiques d’exception, talent management dédié, certifications et plateforme de formation dédiée.

et aussi,

  • Programme ALL - Heartist® : tarifs préférentiels et offres flash pour des séjours et expériences inoubliables dans toutes nos adresses Accor et chez nos partenaires, dans le monde entier.
  • Programme de volontariat Heartist® for good : 1 jour offert sur votre temps de travail pour vous engager en faveur d’une association.
  • Un CSE qui vous accompagne dans le financement de vos activités culturelles et sportives.
  • Forfait Mobilité durable pour l’utilisation d’un moyen de déplacement « vert » ou un dispositif « vélo de fonction » en partenariat avec Zenride
  • Prise en charge des abonnements de transports publics urbains entre le domicile et le lieu de travail, au barème de la Loi Finance.
  • Tickets restaurant de 11€ en valeur faciale.
  • Une mutuelle obligatoire financée à 50% par Accor sans frais supplémentaire en cas d'adhésion de vos ayants droits.
  • Sans oublier des conditions de travail attractives avec des espaces de travail collaboratifs, des restaurants, espaces de jeux ou encore des espaces de bien-être et de Sport sur site ou grâce à Gymlib.

Votre talent et votre motivation sont nos seuls critères de sélection.

Nous valorisons la richesse des diverses nationalités, personnalités et parcours professionnels.

Nous savons nous adapter aux besoins spécifiques de nos collaborateurs, notamment ceux en situation de handicap.

Nous encourageons toutes les candidatures, sans distinction de genre, alors osez postuler !

Pour nous, le recrutement est avant tout une histoire de rencontres.



Cette mission vous attire ? Postulez et nous vous proposerons :

  1. Un échange avec notre équipe recrutement pour vous présenter les lignes essentielles du poste ou vous orienter vers le rôle qui peut vous correspondre,

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to know our team:

In Product, ideas come alive. The world is moving fast so our culture empowers ownership and minimal bureaucracy. That’s the environment that enables you to do what you think is right – and quickly. Our Product Managers move fast, fail, learn, and pivot.

Being a product-centric organization, our team works cross-functionally to build products from conception to launch by bringing together engineering and business worlds. Agoda Product Managers work closely with executive leadership and have high visibility among the C-suite; they have direct impact on Agoda’s growth and strategy. Product puts our travelers first and delivers that special travel experience in the most creative expression.

The opportunity:

This role is Bangkok-based, Relocation Provided. Principal Product Managers are analytical and data-driven individuals, who’re responsible for building products end-to-end focusing on analyzing and experimenting until our solutions are perfectly tailored to our travelers. As our next Principal Product Manager, you will drive product strategy and partner closely with senior leadership cross-functionally to define, build, and deliver the best travel solutions.

You will get dedicated engineering resources that you, and only you define and allocate. We expect you to have a hands-on mentality and spend considerable time with your SCRUM teams, have enthusiasm to develop engineered processes and technologies and apply innovative solutions to make organizational improvements. You can modify *every* system we have in our company to suit their needs.

By applying to this role, you'll be considered for a role either in User Experience, Marketing, Finance or Supply product vertical. The goal is to match you with the team that best aligns with your interests, competencies, and where you will have the most impact. We’re looking for Product Leaders for every part of our business. Our entire Product team sits in Bangkok.

In this role, you'll get to:

  • Analyze the online travel ecosystem, markets, competitive landscape and user requirements.
  • Conceptualize, launch and optimize products and features, experiment, test their performance and iterate quickly.
  • Work collaboratively with Engineering, Marketing, Legal and UX teams on cutting-edge technologies.
  • Develop innovative solutions to some of the world’s difficult problems by collaborating as needed across regions, product areas, and functions.

What you'll need to succeed:

  • 8+ years of Product Management experience
  • Proven ability to leverage analytics and quantitative methods to inform and influence decision-making
  • Strong data skills
  • Excellent communication skills (both verbal and written in English) with proven ability to convey complex messages clearly and with conviction to different stakeholders
  • Experience developing and launching products
  • Experience leading global product vision, go-to-market strategy and design discussions.
  • Entrepreneurial and analytical skills; effective at breaking down complex problems and driving and managing change
  • Hands-on mentality

It's great if you have:

  • MBA or Master’s degree in Math, Economics, Computer Science or Statistics
  • Data tools - SQL, Python, R, or equivalent

job.job_description:
About The Role

It's a great time to join us at Airlines Reporting Corporation (ARC)! ARC accelerates the growth of global air travel by delivering forward-looking travel data, flexible distribution services and other innovative industry solutions. We are a leading travel intelligence company with the world’s largest, most comprehensive global airline ticket dataset, including more than 15 billion passenger flights. By working here, you can contribute to solutions and expertise that strengthen economies and enrich lives. We think big, embrace challenges and explore new ideas to lead the way for the travel industry.

ARC is looking for a talented Manager, External Communications to join our team! In this role, you will develop, coordinate and execute overarching content and media strategies to strengthen the ARC brand. You will create awareness and demand for ARC’s solutions among target audiences. These strategies must align with ARC’s corporate strategy and create a lasting positive impression among customers, partners and media. The Manager, External Communications will develop and deliver social media, media and marketing plans for both new and established solutions to achieve brand and revenue objectives. You'll lead the development and execution of ARC’s content strategy, telling ARC’s story through marketing and communications channels. You will also lead a team of skilled communications experts and ensure alignment of activities. You'll establish goals and expectations and evaluate performance using data, qualitative assessments, and feedback. And, you will work collaboratively with internal business leaders and cross-functional groups, make decisions, maintain confidentiality, multitask, and prioritize in a high-volume environment.

What You'll Get To Do

  • Develop strategic marketing plans and KPIs for the ARC brand and solutions portfolios. Lead the execution of these plans through content and promotional opportunities in partnership with the broader brand and marketing team, business stakeholders, customer engagement, and other leaders.
  • Plan, develop and deliver content across a range of brand and marketing channels using a shared calendar. Communications include web-based communications, social media, email, paid and/or earned media, and conference topics.
  • Monitor, track and analyze the cost, quality and effectiveness of marketing activities. Present status updates on strategic marketing campaigns and programs to key stakeholders throughout the company. Lead efforts to track brand health and marketing positioning of competitors.
  • Create and/or edit content with an eye for detail and make recommendations for strategic accuracy. Craft executive talking points, communications and other content as needed. Support review of content that includes emails, social media, presentations, webpages and video scripts. Support ARC customer engagement.
  • Build and maintain close relationships with internal stakeholders, members of the media and ARC partners to further business goals.
  • Supervise, mentor and develop direct reports and extended team members; provide direction, leadership and coaching to project teams to execute brand and product marketing plans.

You'll Bring These Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in communications, English, journalism, marketing, business or related field required; equivalent experience considered
  • 6+ years of experience in strategic marketing; ideally some experience in the airline industry
  • Knowledge of branding and marketing principles
  • Experience directly leading individuals and teams
  • Customer-focused with commitment to quality
  • Outstanding communication, leadership and conflict-resolution skills
  • A strategic, analytical and creative thinker and nuanced communicator with excellent organizational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks in a high-volume environment.

What We Can Offer You

  • Joining ARC means joining a team that is motivated, diverse, creative, collaborative and solutions-oriented. We think big, embrace challenges, and explore new ideas to lead the way for the travel industry.
  • Our employees value the hands-on learning and professional development opportunities that allow them to expand their skills and grow their career in new, dynamic ways.
  • ARC offers WorkFlex. WorkFlex is ARC’s hybrid work program which offers eligible employees the flexibility to work from home while also requiring in office workdays throughout the year to foster collaboration and connection throughout the organization. We’ve designed WorkFlex to enable employees to succeed and thrive while maintaining strong connections to one another and ARC - both of which are critical to our shared success.
  • We offer a highly competitive, comprehensive benefits package so you can worry less and focus on what truly matters. Please click here to review our benefits on our company website.
  • By joining ARC, you will partner with top minds in the industry as we use data and technology to innovate how the world travels.

The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, allowing for meaningful future salary growth within the position.

Senior Manager, Merchandising and Customer Growth

Introduction to the Team

Expedia Group’s Consumer Business Has Three Flagship Brands

  • Expedia® is the one-stop shop for travel, with a mission of helping travelers get the most out of every trip they take by providing everything they need all in one place, and feel supported every step of the way.

  • Vrbo® is the trusted vacation rental brand perfecting stays before they happen by helping travelers find their perfect fit, ensuring quality homes and hosts, and providing trusted support.

These teams set the strategic vision, operating plans, and investment priorities to create compelling and distinct traveler value and drive business growth.

The team is responsible for effectively partnering with cross-functional teams in Marketing, Product, Technology, Supply, Advertising, Servicing, and Corporate Functions to deliver the best traveler and business outcomes.

Make an impact!

Are you passionate about bringing brand strategies to life and creating seamless, relevant experiences for travelers? Are you energized by using merchandising, experimentation, and cross-functional partnership to drive customer growth? We are looking for a Senior Manager, Merchandising and Customer Growth to lead North America merchandising strategy across Brand Expedia and our Portfolio brands, with a focus on merchandising attach opportunities and app strategy and testing. This role reports to the Director, Merchandising and Operations, Brand Expedia and Portfolio.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead North America merchandising strategy: Own the North America merchandising roadmap and calendar across Brand Expedia and our Portfolio brands, aligning priorities across customer touch points.
  • Drive merchandising attach strategy: Define and execute strategies that increase relevant cross-sell and upsell opportunities across the traveler journey, partnering with Product, Marketing, Analytics, and Supply, to improve customer value and business growth.
  • Shape app merchandising strategy: Establish the merchandising strategy for app experiences, including surface prioritization, placement strategy, personalization opportunities, and coordination with Marketing, Product, Design, and Engineering.
  • Build a test-and-learn engine: Partner with Product and Analytics to develop a consistent experimentation cadence across web and app merchandising touchpoints; formulate hypotheses, prioritize tests, evaluate results, and translate learnings into scalable improvements.
  • Lead merchandising execution: Coordinate the timely delivery of merchandising initiatives and promotions across Marketing, Product, Supply, Legal, and Finance, ensuring clear ownership, dependencies, and escalation paths.
  • Measure performance and optimize: Analyze performance, incrementality, customer engagement, conversion, and attach results; lead campaign and merchandising retrospectives and recommend optimization actions to improve future delivery.
  • Create cross-functional alignment: Bring structure and clarity to complex initiatives, communicate decisions and tradeoffs, and maintain a shared view of priorities, risks, and progress for senior stakeholders.
  • Stay close to the market: Monitor travel category trends, competitive experiences, and best-in-class ecommerce merchandising to identify opportunities for Brand Expedia and our Portfolio brands.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Management, or a related field; MBA preferred.
  • 8+ years of experience in B2C ecommerce, digital merchandising, loyalty or brand marketing, retail management, or a related field.
  • Experience leading merchandising across North America, multiple brands, lines of business, or customer segments.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and optimizing attach, cross-sell, upsell, or other customer growth strategies.
  • Experience building app merchandising strategies and partnering with Product, Design, Engineering, and Analytics teams to deliver customer-facing experiences.
  • Experience with A/B testing frameworks, experimentation design, traffic data sources, and performance measurement.
  • Strong project or program management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver through ambiguity in a fast-paced B2C environment.
  • Proven ability to influence and align stakeholders across multiple subject areas, prioritize opportunities, and mitigate risks.
  • Strong analytical and business acumen, with the ability to turn customer and performance data into clear recommendations and action.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively, concisely, and in a way that is tailored to the audience, including senior leaders.
  • Resilient and constructive when faced with change; able to shift approaches in response to unexpected events and circumstances.

It’s how we grew from a pioneer with a fleet of seven cars to a global mobility leader with more than 90,000 team members around the world. And it’s what will continue to drive the future of the organization and mobility itself.
Over the years, we’ve learned moving forward isn’t a simple matter of going from point A to B. Today, mobility is the movement of people and goods. It goes beyond the vehicles we drive to encompass an integrated way of travel that meets every individual’s unique needs and preferences.
That is why it’s our vision to be the world’s best and most trusted mobility company. As mobility continues to evolve, we'll continue to innovate to work toward a reimagined mobility future that is more accessible, efficient and sustainable for all.
job.job_description:
Overview

Gain real-world business, accounting, and financial training that will teach you all aspects of financial management pertaining to running a successful business. Our program fully prepares you to become a Controller/VP of Finance with Enterprise. A key partner in our organization, the Controller/VP of Finance oversees all aspects of financial management and provides balance to the partnership formed with the marketing and operational pieces of our business. As an Accountant, you can count on a career path with a clear beginning and an open end that’s full of opportunities. With training, development, mentoring, and a culture of promotion from within, you’ll always be progressing in your career.

We Offer

  • Competitive Compensation - This position offers targeted 1st year annual compensation of $58,000 with an average 40 hour work week.
  • Additional Pay: $4,000 for a master’s degree and CPA/CMA
  • Company laptop provided
  • Opportunity for additional $1,500 in team performance-based bonuses
  • Paid Time Off
  • Health, Dental, Vision insurance; Life Insurance; Prescription coverage
  • Employee discounts on car rentals, car purchases and much more!
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match and profit sharing

We’re a family-owned, world-class portfolio of brands and leading provider of mobility solutions worldwide. Founded more than 65 years ago with a commitment to the communities that we serve, we operate a global network with 90,000 dedicated team members across nearly 100 countries, and more than 2.1 million vehicles taking our customers where they want to go. We owe our success to each and every one of our people. That's why we empower everyone on our team with opportunities for growth.

At Enterprise Mobility, you will have the chance to run your own financial operation and provide balance to the marketing and operational pieces of our business. We offer a comprehensive development program where you will work closely with sales and marketing, human resources, risk management, real estate strategy, and more to produce excellence in customer service, growth strategies, operating efficiencies, and profitability.

As your understanding of our business grows and your ability to make solid business decisions develops, you will soon take on a supervisory role within a business management team. With our entrepreneurial philosophy, there is truly nothing holding you back.

Responsibilities

Starting as an Accountant, you are executing accounting procedures and principles that will lead to financial statement, preparation, and financial analysis.

  • Prepare financial statements
  • Perform branch audit evaluations
  • Assemble bank reconciliation and account schedule
  • Prepare journal entries, expense accruals and allocations
  • Participate in a timely and accurate month-end closing process
  • Assist personnel with questions regarding accounting policies and procedures
  • Analyze income statements fluctuations
  • Provide process improvement and cost saving ideas
  • Managing financial records, assist in financial reporting
  • Support budgeting and forecasting
  • Conduct audits and ensure compliance
  • Collaborate with other departments
  • May be responsible for T& E reports, coding, account classification and reimbursement amounts
  • May be responsible for preparation and sales and other tax returns

Qualified Candidates Must Also Possess The Following Skills/competencies

  • Solid organizational skills while paying close attention to detail
  • Strong analytical and communication skills with the ability to multi-task

Equal Opportunity Employer/Disability/Veterans

Qualifications

  • Must have a Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance.
  • CPA, CMA, MBA or commitment to obtain a plus.
  • Must have basic proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Word.
  • Flexibility for career advancement could include relocation outside local area/state within 2-5 year period for potential promotion opportunities.
  • Must have a valid driver's license with no more than 2 moving violations and/or at-fault accidents on driving record in the past 3 years.
  • No drug or alcohol related convictions on driving record (DUI/DWI) within the past 5 years.
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States and not require work authorization sponsorship by our company for this position now or in the future.
  • Must be at least 18 years old.

job.job_description:
If you’re looking for the next stamp in your career passport, we’re looking for Sales Travel Consultants at Flight Centre Robina who are keen to dazzle, discover, and delight our customers!

Are you ready to turn your love of travel into a career that takes you further than you ever imagined personally and professionally? Your Flight Centre journey is uniquely yours - and we’re here to champion it, celebrate it, and help it take flight. As a Flightie you’re not just building a career - you’re shaping a life filled with purpose, connection, and discovery. If you’re looking for the next stamp in careers passport - we’re looking for Sales Travel Consultants across Australia who are keen to dazzle, discover and delight our customers! Navigate your career. Explore the world.

What you’ll be doing - where your passion will meet purpose!

  • Work full-time, on-site in one of our retail stores on a rotating roster across a 7-day trade
  • Plan itineraries, book travel and convert enquiries into bookings in person, over the phone and via email for our customers
  • Work towards individual KPIs and sales targets where you’ll sell the whole holiday including flights, accommodation, car hire, tours, travel insurance, cruises, transfers and more
  • Build a customer base of new and returning customers from regular domestic bookings to lavish international holidays and everything in between
  • Be the expert! Assist our customers with their travel related questions including visas, best time of year to travel, what to pack, where to eat, what to avoid, you name it!
  • Enjoy a base wage plus an uncapped incentive payment structure where you earn a percentage of every sale, your pay is completely uncapped!

What we’re looking for - do you have the travel bug?

  • You’re a seasoned traveller with a history of international destinations (and even more on your bucket list!) and you’re the go-to person in your circle for travel recommendations, tips and tricks
  • Great organisational skills - you’re the type to take notes, manage your calendar well and are quick to respond to your customer’s phone calls and emails
  • Determination to meet your sales targets and KPIs while balancing your workload in a high-pressure environment (think customers lining up, phones ringing, email inbox filling!)
  • Enthusiasm, passion and a warmth that makes our customers want to book with you every time!
  • A savviness with computers, ready to toggle between various complex systems when finding the right flight and package options for your customer

What you will gain from a career with Flight Centre - let’s unpack the benefits!

💲 We'll boost your wage to $65K equivalent for your first 90 days while you learn the ropes! Average earnings for a Travel Consultant in their first year are $70K, while Senior Consultants average $100K and Team Leaders average $138K annually - including superannuation and penalty rates.

🌏 Become a true expert – access industry travel discounts and qualify for sponsored ‘Familiarisation Trips’ to explore new destinations and products around the world 

💎 Brightness of Future: Career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses across the globe - we promote from within   

🎉 Social: Embrace the famous Flight Centre culture at our Reward & Recognition events throughout the year including our most popular events on the calendar Global Gathering and EOFY Celebration

🎓 Get qualified for free with a Certificate 3 & 4 in Travel & Tourism (worth 20k!) through Australian Apprentice Training - you may also be eligible to receive direct financial support while you study 

🌈 Thrive in a workplace that embraces individualism – come as you are!  

💛 Be part of a workplace committed to reconciliation through our Reconciliation Action Plan - we proudly support Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander inclusion, cultural safety, and dedicated cultural leave

Okay, I’m in!

Are you keen to join our team of Flighties? Hit apply now for your application to be read by a real human, no AI here! If your application is successful, you’ll be invited to have a 15-minute phone interview with one of our dedicated team of recruiters. Get ready to work, travel and grow.

Why is Flight Centre such a great place to work?

We are devoted to being a global employer of choice by nurturing our legendary culture - focused on our people and infused with adventure and accountability. We uplift and support our team through a compelling Employee Value Proposition that offers exciting career and travel opportunities, fantastic benefits, a meaningful sense of purpose and well-deserved recognition. Explore us on LinkedIn or check out our careers page at www.fctgcareers.com

This role will execute franchise sales and business development strategies for assigned territory to achieve sales and development quotas. Expand and maintain the distribution of assigned brand portfolio. Lead key stakeholders in the deal process to prospect, qualify, structure, negotiate and close franchise deals. Demonstrate behavioral proficiencies as defined in the Developers Competency and Skill Matrix to include Business Development Expertise, Organizing, Market Knowledge, Technical Skills and Managing Relationships.

Your day to day

  • Effectively execute a regional development plan for assigned brands that promotes the maximization of each brand’s distribution within the territory, drives earnings and fee income, and promotes the growth of shareholder value. Attain annual territory growth quotas as developed by management. Utilize proven strategies to aggressively improve results that fall below plan.
  • Prospect, negotiate, and/or close specialized franchise sales deals in assigned geographical territories and target markets. Utilize knowledge of all major owners, developers and decision makers in assigned territory. Continuously research developments in related industries (e.g. office, retail, etc) to recognize emerging markets and opportunities.
  • Provide leads for potential joint ventures and management contracts. Use a wide variety of resources to research territory and identify qualified prospects.
  • Coordinate application/licensing process with Franchise Administration to ensure proper licensing agreements on franchised hotels. Monitor financial and administrative parameters surrounding franchise agreements as necessary.
  • Within assigned territory, assist in developing short and long-term franchise acquisition and disposition strategies/identifying targets that are consistent with brand growth, profitability and strategic objectives. Prepare and maintain annual business plans that align with development activities and timetables.
  • Call on investment groups, financial institutions, insurance companies, asset managers, individual investors, etc. to develop a network of contacts, build customer relationships that yield deal leads, and keep abreast of hotel development opportunities in the assigned marketplace.
  • Participate in the evaluation of financial opportunities of prospective applicants to determine viability of prospect. Use the P&Ls of hotels in the market, average costs of development, etc. to determine the strength of the market to support deals. Research and utilize interest rates, financing options, operating costs, and other data required to pencil out and drive deals.
  • Manage deals through closing to ensure coordination of all financial and legal documentation and the resolution of issues as they pertain to contractual agreements prior to hotel opening; and follow the completion and implementation of deal and hand-off to VP of Asset Management/Owner Relations and/or Operations as appropriate.

What We Need From You

  • Demonstrated project management experience in organizing, planning and executing large-scale financial and sales projects from conception through implementation.
  • Demonstrated effective verbal and written communication skills for the purpose of providing information to clients, vendors, senior management and staff. Gets clients involved and engaged by asking questions, consistently relating to client’s goals, and building the value of the opportunity.
  • Demonstrated business/financial negotiation and influencing/consensus building skills
  • Demonstrated ability to understand financial structures and deal valuation concepts
  • Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of effective sales and marketing strategies such as client prospecting and cultivation, new product evaluation, brand positioning and strategic fit
  • Demonstrated experience in franchise contract negotiation from prospecting investors to closing the deal.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of the hotel operations market, competitive market trends and factors, and financial feasibility analysis.

Travel - 40% - 60% required

Location - this role can be based in any metropolitan city in New York (not Manhattan), Maine, Vermont, Rhode Island, New Jersey, Massachusetts, New Hampshire

Development Incentive Plan

Commissions are paid monthly. This component of your plan is uncapped. You will be eligible for monthly payments under this component of the Development Incentive Plan after the management agreements or franchise agreements for the projects that have been executed.

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As the Director of Operations, you work closely with the General Manager to oversee all operational departments, including front office, housekeeping, food and beverage, and other key departments, ensuring the hotel operates efficiently while maintaining the highest guest service standards. As a Guest Operations Manager, you don’t just oversee all aspects of hotel operations – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

As Guest Operations Manager, you will be responsible for the effective operational management of the hotel so Heads of Department achieve and exceed their revenue and Guest satisfaction targets. Specifically, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Work in conjunction with the General Manager / Area General Manager to actively manage key property issues (including capital projects; customer service; refurbishment)
  • Assist the development of meaningful, achievable hotel budgets and other short and long term hotel strategic goals
  • Provide effective leadership to the hotel management team and team members to ensure targets are met and exceeded
  • Respond to audits that are completed by the company to ensure continual improvement is achieved
  • Plan, direct and coordinate the service delivery of all operational departments in order to meet and exceed guest expectations
  • Comply and exceed hotel and company Service Standards
  • Ensure that costs are controlled throughout the operational departments and results are analysed regularly to highlight problem areas and take appropriate action
  • Manage and develop the Heads of Department to ensure career progression and effective succession planning within the hotel and company
  • Seek and respond to Guest feedback in order to achieve positive outcomes and high levels of customer satisfaction
  • Hold regular briefings and communication meetings with the HOD team

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

Qualifications

A Guest Operations Manager serving Hilton brands is always working on behalf of our Guests and working with other Team Members. To successfully fill this role, you must possess the following qualifications, attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:

  • A degree or diploma in Hotel Management or equivalent
  • Strong commercial acumen, preferably with experience in Food and Beverage or Rooms Management
  • Experience in managing budgets, revenue proposals and forecasting results
  • In-depth knowledge of the hotel / leisure / service sector
  • Strong leadership skills to effectively manage and motivate the team to achieve high level of perform and exceed targets
  • Accountable and resilient
  • Ability to work under pressure

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

job.job_description:
About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator.

Who are we looking for?

As a CX Advisor, you will ensure our tour operators strictly adhere to established procedures—specifically regarding the traveler experience and platform content guidelines. Operating with a dedicated, traveler-first mindset, you will help resolve daily operational challenges and maintain service standards to safeguard the operator ecosystem. Beyond driving operational efficiency, you will provide hands-on support to tour operators worldwide, guiding them via email, chat, and phone to maintain accurate and high-performing product listings on Viator and Tripadvisor.

Operating in our fast-paced, evolving environment, you will bring Tripadvisor's Traveler First philosophy to life by advocating for both our travelers and operators in every decision. If you have a genuine love for travel, exceptional B2B customer service skills, and a proactive can-do attitude, you will thrive here. In this role, you will not only support and scale our growing online business but also play a vital role in the development, training, and collective success of your colleagues.

Role Scope & Focus

  • Execution to Escalations: Maintains primary oversight of high-volume onshore and Tier-2 queue management while utilizing content management systems to review, refine, and optimize tour and activity listings across Viator.
  • Technical & Strategic Scope: Focus on executing standard workflows and applying established best practices.

Key Responsibilities

Operator Support & Issue Resolution

  • Support: Provide high-quality, real-time assistance to tour operators via email, live chat, and phone.
  • Support & Resolution: Assist with resolving operational questions and identifying issues, escalating complex concerns to senior team members when needed.
  • Account & Booking Care: Assist operators with account management, product inquiries, and booking resolutions.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with internal support teams to swiftly resolve overlapping traveler and operator issues.

Product Optimization & Connectivity

  • Listing Enhancement: Utilize content management systems to review, refine, and optimize tour and activity listings on Viator.
  • Accurate Distribution: Ensure precise categorization of products across all sales channels, including Viator, Tripadvisor, and distribution partners.
  • Technical Connectivity: Facilitate and troubleshoot seamless integration between operator booking systems and Viator/Tripadvisor platforms.
  • Product Guidance: Share established best practices with operators to help improve their product listings and visibility.

Team Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Self-Service Advocacy: Train operators to effectively utilize self-service tools for managing bookings, updating account details, and maintaining accurate profiles.
  • Team Support: Participate in team discussions, contribute to group goals, and support new departmental initiatives.
  • Relationship Building: Establish and maintain trusted relationships with internal business units, external vendors, and global partners.
  • Agility: Handle other duties and projects as assigned to support business growth.

Qualifications & Experience

Professional Experience & Skills

  • Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. Prior customer support or partner-facing experience is a plus, but not required.
  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English (bilingual proficiency is a plus).
  • Technical Savvy: Proficient with Google Workspace, online platforms, and CRM systems (experience with Salesforce is highly preferred).
  • Problem-Solving: Ability to learn quickly, follow established processes, and work effectively as part of a team to solve routine challenges.
  • Work Ethic: A self-motivated professional with meticulous attention to detail and a commitment to thorough follow-through.

Home Office & Technical Requirements

  • Internet Connectivity: Reliable high-speed broadband connection with minimum speeds of 25 Mbps download and 10 Mbps upload.
  • Work Environment: A quiet, dedicated home office setup with a direct Ethernet connection to the router or modem.
  • Flexibility: Ability to work a flexible schedule to accommodate evolving operational needs and customer demands.

Skills You Should Bring To The Role

  • Traveler-First Mindset (Essential): A passion for driving exceptional partner value and delivering effortless, high-quality support resolutions.
  • Communication (Required): Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to clearly articulate operational issues to colleagues and partners.
  • Analytical Skills: Ability to review basic data and identify trends to help solve operational issues.
  • Industry Expertise (Preferred): Prior experience in a similar partner support or operations role within the travel and hospitality sector.

Description

The Senior Manager of Quality Engineering within Information Technology will provide strategic leadership for the quality engineering organization, driving the vision, execution, and continuous evolution of enterprise quality practices across a portfolio of products, platforms, and technology initiatives. The position will lead multiple Quality Engineering teams and managers, ensuring the successful delivery of high-quality, reliable, and scalable technology solutions that support business objectives and customer experience goals.

This role is accountable for defining and governing enterprise quality engineering strategies, standards, frameworks, and operating models that enable modern software delivery. The position will partner closely with senior technology and business leaders to integrate quality throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), leveraging automation, AI-enabled quality engineering, observability, and data-driven insights to improve software reliability, accelerate delivery, and reduce operational risk.

As a senior leader, this role will drive organizational quality transformation by advancing intelligent automation, continuous testing, predictive quality analytics, and engineering excellence practices across the enterprise. The position will oversee quality execution across large-scale programs and product portfolios while ensuring alignment with architectural standards, security requirements, regulatory obligations, and enterprise governance policies.

The role will continuously evaluate emerging technologies, AI capabilities, and industry best practices, establishing a culture of innovation and continuous improvement. This position is responsible for developing organizational capabilities, optimizing engineering productivity, and championing quality as a strategic business enabler across the enterprise.

  • Organizational Effectiveness / People:
  • Lead multiple Quality Engineering teams and managers, providing strategic direction, talent development, workforce planning, and organizational leadership across a portfolio of products and platforms.
  • Assess and align QA resource capacity, skillsets, and organizational structure to meet evolving testing demands, delivery priorities, and competency requirements.
  • Application Delivery/Support:
  • Define and execute enterprise quality engineering strategies, aligning quality objectives with business goals, product roadmaps, customer experience, and engineering transformation initiatives, ensuring a delightful experience for our customers.
  • Oversee end-to-end quality assurance lifecycle execution, including test planning, execution, validation, and user acceptance support across multiple teams.
  • Guide estimation, planning, and prioritization of testing efforts for new features, products, and platform capabilities.
  • Oversee execution of test plans across teams, ensuring timely delivery, adequate test coverage, and proactive mitigation of risks to project timelines and deliverables.
  • AI-Driven Innovation:
  • Drive AI-powered quality transformation, implementing Generative AI, Agentic AI, predictive analytics, and intelligent automation to improve software quality, delivery speed, and engineering productivity at scale.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:
  • Establish and govern enterprise-wide quality practices, standards, frameworks, and metrics that ensure consistent quality outcomes across Agile, DevOps, in on-premises and cloud-native environments.
  • Collaborate with development, product, and business stakeholders to support user acceptance testing, align validation criteria, and ensure business readiness for releases.
  • Technical Execution and Guidance:
  • Lead large-scale automation, continuous testing, and quality observability initiatives, integrating quality intelligence into CI/CD pipelines and software delivery processes, driving high standards for engineering excellence.
  • Establish and govern defect management practices, including defect tracking, prioritization, and resolution processes, ensuring timely remediation and high-quality outcomes.
  • High-Performance and Data-Driven:
  • Monitor and optimize organizational performance through data-driven insights, leveraging quality metrics, AI effectiveness measures, operational KPIs, and customer outcomes to continuously improve software reliability and engineering efficiency.
  • Identify and address systemic quality risks through proactive monitoring of testing progress, defect trends, and quality indicators, ensuring minimal impact to delivery timelines and product quality.
  • Strategic Leadership and Guidance:
  • Partner with senior technology and business leaders to influence investment decisions, manage quality risks, prioritize transformation initiatives, and drive measurable business outcomes.

Qualifications

Minimum Experience:

  • 5+ years of management experience in Quality Engineering or IT leadership related role
  • 3+ years of experience implementing Test Automation framework
  • 3+ years of experience in supporting release automation (CICD) and application performance testing

5 Key Skills

  • Software Testing Strategy
  • Test Automation
  • Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment
  • DevOps
  • Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) Management

Prevalent Skills: 

  • Test Case Design 
  • Software Test Case Management 
  • Test Environment Management 
  • Software Testing Strategy 
  • Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment 
  • Test Automation 
  • Regulatory Compliance 
  • Agile Testing 
  • Programming/Scripting 
  • DevOps 
  • Continuous Improvement 
  • Project/Program Management 
  • Technical Reporting 
  • Test Auditing 
  • Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) Management 

Emerging Skills

  • Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning 
  • Policy Design & Development 
  • Security Testing Strategy 
  • Cyber Risk Management 
  • Cloud Testing Strategy

Step into a pivotal role where you'll shape the future of industrial relations within TUI Airline. As our Senior HR Business Partner for Industrial Relations, you'll be the strategic lead for managing union relationships, collective bargaining and employee relations within your AOC, while actively driving cross-border HR initiatives. This is your chance to build trust with unions and management alike, lead meaningful negotiations, and support transformational change in one of the world's leading aviation businesses.

The role will be published until 23/10.

About Our Offer

  • Personal benefits: Attractive remuneration, discretionary bonus schemes, generous travel benefits, extensive health & well-being support, and more.
  • Flexible working: Work is something you do, not somewhere you go. We encourage a healthy work-life balance with a dynamic working environment.
  • A career to shape: Access the TUI Learning Hub to level-up and reach your ambitions.
  • Broaden your network: We champion intercultural collaboration and provide opportunities to work on global projects and teams.
  • Community: Get involved with incredible local charity and sustainability initiatives like the TUI Care Foundation.

About The Job

  • Building effective union and works council relationships, you'll manage day-to-day industrial and employee relations topics within TUI Airways, ensuring legally compliant handling of matters so business operations run smoothly.
  • You'll lead collective bargaining processes under guidance of the Head of HR, preparing negotiations that align with business objectives and implementing outcomes locally.
  • As a trusted partner for local management on strategic IR and HR topics, you'll advise on people matters and organizational implications to support informed decision-making.
  • Leading the negotiation, implementation and monitoring of collective agreements, works council agreements and policies ensures agreed frameworks are effectively applied across the organization.
  • From an employee relations perspective, you'll proactively lead change initiatives including cross-border projects, ensuring proper consultation with employee representative bodies so change is implemented effectively and sustainably.
  • Collaborating with the wider HR and IR community across TUI Airline, you'll share local insights and best practices while supporting initiatives across our global airline.

About You

  • A degree in HR, Law, Business Administration or comparable qualification, or relevant HR qualifications provide your educational foundation.
  • Several years of experience in an Industrial Relations role demonstrates your capability in this specialized field.
  • Your strong experience in industrial relations and close working with employee representative bodies is essential for success.
  • Proven experience in collective bargaining and negotiations shows you can lead complex discussions effectively.
  • Significant experience of operating in unionized environments means you understand the nuances of this landscape.
  • Previous experience in aviation or a comparable industry is essential for this role.
  • Solid knowledge of local labour law, collective bargaining processes and HR best practice underpins your work.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills enable you to navigate complex relationships.
  • The ability to build credibility and trust with unions and management comes naturally to you.
  • Exceptional negotiating and influencing skills allow you to achieve outcomes that work for all parties.
  • Your structured, pragmatic and solution-oriented approach helps you tackle challenges effectively.
  • Strong analytical skills support your decision-making and strategic thinking.
  • Taking initiative and working independently with minimal supervision is something you're comfortable with.
  • Assertiveness and the ability to effectively challenge when needed are part of your skillset.
  • Flexibility and adaptability allow you to thrive in a constantly changing environment.
  • Operating in a complex, regulated and fast-paced environment energizes rather than overwhelms you.
  • A proactive approach to learning and self-development keeps you at the top of your game.
  • Sound judgement and the ability to maintain confidentiality are non-negotiable in this role.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to know our team:

In Product, ideas come alive. The world is moving fast so our culture empowers ownership and minimal bureaucracy. That’s the environment that enables you to do what you think is right – and quickly. Our Product Managers move fast, fail, learn, and pivot.

Being a product-centric organization, our team works cross-functionally to build products from conception to launch by bringing together engineering and business worlds. Agoda Product Managers work closely with executive leadership and have high visibility among the C-suite; they have direct impact on Agoda’s growth and strategy. Product puts our travelers first and delivers that special travel experience in the most creative expression.

The opportunity:

This role is Bangkok-based, Relocation Provided. Principal Product Managers are analytical and data-driven individuals, who’re responsible for building products end-to-end focusing on analyzing and experimenting until our solutions are perfectly tailored to our travelers. As our next Principal Product Manager, you will drive product strategy and partner closely with senior leadership cross-functionally to define, build, and deliver the best travel solutions.

You will get dedicated engineering resources that you, and only you define and allocate. We expect you to have a hands-on mentality and spend considerable time with your SCRUM teams, have enthusiasm to develop engineered processes and technologies and apply innovative solutions to make organizational improvements. You can modify *every* system we have in our company to suit their needs.

By applying to this role, you'll be considered for a role either in User Experience, Marketing, Finance or Supply product vertical. The goal is to match you with the team that best aligns with your interests, competencies, and where you will have the most impact. We’re looking for Product Leaders for every part of our business. Our entire Product team sits in Bangkok.

In this role, you'll get to:

  • Analyze the online travel ecosystem, markets, competitive landscape and user requirements.
  • Conceptualize, launch and optimize products and features, experiment, test their performance and iterate quickly.
  • Work collaboratively with Engineering, Marketing, Legal and UX teams on cutting-edge technologies.
  • Develop innovative solutions to some of the world’s difficult problems by collaborating as needed across regions, product areas, and functions.

What you'll need to succeed:

  • 8+ years of Product Management experience
  • Proven ability to leverage analytics and quantitative methods to inform and influence decision-making
  • Strong data skills
  • Excellent communication skills (both verbal and written in English) with proven ability to convey complex messages clearly and with conviction to different stakeholders
  • Experience developing and launching products
  • Experience leading global product vision, go-to-market strategy and design discussions.
  • Entrepreneurial and analytical skills; effective at breaking down complex problems and driving and managing change
  • Hands-on mentality

It's great if you have:

  • MBA or Master’s degree in Math, Economics, Computer Science or Statistics
  • Data tools - SQL, Python, R, or equivalent

The TechOps Finance team is seeking an innovative and results-driven individual for the Project Manager – TechOps Finance role. The successful candidate will have a continuous improvement mindset and thrives in a dynamic, team-oriented environment.

Key Responsibilities For This Position Include

  • Ownership of Engine Product Line P&Ls, creating insightful reporting, owning weekly forecast process, developing long-range financial outlook, and supporting the annual operating plan process
  • Streamline and automate financial processes and improving business partner visibility to financial performance
  • Perform ad-hoc analysis and identify business challenges and opportunities
  • Support the monthly financial close and ensure proper internal controls
  • Drive engagement through spending significant time on the shop floor to observe processes, understand value streams, and learn the actual flow of parts
  • Collaboration with cross-functional teams to align financial goals with operational strategies
  • Partner with Product Line owners to gain an in-depth understanding of supplier contracts

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • At least 5 years of experience in finance, operations or analytics-based role
  • Strong project management, financial analysis, and decision-making skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and workflows in a structured manner
  • Excellent presentation, written and oral communication skills. Demonstrated ability to distill complex business topics into a cohesive story using metrics and data
  • Forward thinking, self-starter that has a proven ability to work independently
  • Exceptional interpersonal communication and relationship-building skills. Fosters an inclusive environment that values diverse people, thinking and styles
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.

  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency.
  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Prior experience with financial / accounting processes
  • Knowledge of Delta financial systems or TechOps data and systems
  • Experience with data querying and analysis highly valued
  • Past experience with optimizing financial or operational processes
  • Undergraduate / graduate degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or quantitative major strongly preferred
  • Ability to influence without direct authority and drive change in a cross-functional environment.
  • Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail and a proactive approach.

Benefits And Perks To Help You Keep Climbing

Our culture is rooted in a shared dedication to living our values – Care, Integrity, Resilience, Servant Leadership, and Teamwork – every day, in everything we do. At Delta, our people are our success. At the heart of what we offer is our focus on Sharing Success with Delta employees.

Benefits

Exploring a career at Delta gives you a chance to see the world while earning great compensation and benefits to help you keep climbing along the way:

  • Competitive salary, industry-leading proﬁt sharing program, and performance incentives
  • 401(k) with generous company contributions up to 9%
  • Paid time off including vacation, holidays, paid personal time, maternity and parental leave
