Organization- Hyatt Corporate Office

Summary

The Opportunity

Hyatt Hotels Corporation seeks an enthusiastic VP Global Distribution to join our Global Revenue Management & Distribution Organization. In this role, you will collaborate closely with the broader Commercial team to shape how guests and customers discover, compare, and book Hyatt across a rapidly evolving distribution ecosystem, from direct digital and loyalty-enabled channels to global partners, metasearch, and AI-assisted travel planning. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list since 2013. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

  • Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on-site fitness center
  • A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption
  • Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

The Role

The Vice President, Global Distribution leads Hyatt’s global distribution strategy and provides enterprise oversight across owned, third-party, B2B, loyalty-enabled, and emerging digital distribution channels. This leader is accountable for profitable demand capture, optimal channel mix, rate integrity, partner governance, distribution technology enablement, and Hyatt’s visibility across the evolving travel discovery and booking ecosystem.

  • Develop and execute Hyatt's long-term global distribution strategy to achieve optimal, profitable channel mix across all booking channels, with specific focus on increasing penetration through Hyatt.com, the World of Hyatt app, mobile, direct digital, metasearch, and other owned or loyalty-enabled booking paths.
  • Lead Hyatt's strategy for visibility and conversion across the modern hotel-shopping journey, including search, metasearch, maps, OTA storefronts, social discovery, AI-assisted travel planning, conversational search, and emerging AI-enabled booking interfaces.
  • Partner closely with Loyalty, Digital Product, Marketing, Revenue Management, Brand, and Technology teams to ensure World of Hyatt member value, exclusive rates, benefits, content, and direct-booking advantages are clearly surfaced and accurately represented across owned and third-party distribution environments.
  • Develop and manage the B2B and B2C distribution account portfolio across all segments, including OTAs, GDSs, wholesalers, travel management companies, consortia, metasearch partners, affiliate partners, API-based distributors, and emerging AI-enabled travel platforms; lead new partner development through the lens of incremental demand, total contribution, direct guest relationship, loyalty enrollment, data access, operational complexity, and long-term strategic value.
  • Provide oversight and final decision-making for third-party distribution relationships, both retail and wholesale, from contract development through implementation, connectivity, content quality, performance monitoring, compliance, and renewal strategy.
  • Maintain enterprise focus on net revenue, total contribution, and customer acquisition cost by increasing transparency into distribution costs, commissions, media spend, loyalty economics, wholesale leakage, payment costs, cancellation behavior, and partner-funded discounts.
  • Strengthen Hyatt's global approach to rate integrity, parity, member-rate visibility, wholesale controls, and unauthorized redistribution, while adapting to changing regulatory environments and evolving platform rules across regions.
  • Develop, communicate, and operationalize distribution reporting, analytics, automation, and KPIs, including net rate, cost of sale, channel contribution, source-market mix, booking attribution, direct-booking penetration, loyalty contribution, content accuracy, rate integrity, and partner-level performance, so hotels and regional teams can take faster action.
  • Act as primary business sponsor for distribution-related technology initiatives, including CRS/connectivity enhancements, third-party intermediary integrations, API strategy, metasearch connectivity, content syndication, machine-readable hotel content, AI/search visibility, rate and inventory controls, and system operationalization of net rates.
  • Assist with new openings, conversions, and brand integrations to ensure sound distribution principles are implemented from the start, including channel setup, content readiness, rate integrity, loyalty visibility, wholesale controls, and direct-booking optimization.
  • Represent Hyatt externally and monitor the evolving distribution landscape, including industry events, standards bodies, OTA strategy, metasearch economics, AI/search evolution, regulatory changes, data-access rights, privacy expectations, and emerging commercial models that may affect Hyatt's ability to own the guest relationship.

Lead and set direction for global distribution personnel, including recruiting, coaching, developing, and motivating team members with the capabilities required for a more technical, data-driven, cross-functional, and partner-oriented distribution environment.

Qualifications

Experience Required

  • 15+ years of experience in hospitality, travel distribution, revenue management, commercial strategy, digital commerce, or other equivalent business function.
  • Extensive knowledge of the hotel distribution landscape and how it relates to the hospitality industry, including direct digital, mobile app, OTAs, GDS, wholesale, metasearch, B2B, B2C, API-based connectivity, and emerging AI-assisted discovery and booking channels.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and execute global distribution strategy across third-party, B2B, B2C, web, mobile, app, loyalty-enabled, and partner distribution channels.
  • Experience managing complex third-party distribution partner relationships, including contract development, implementation, connectivity, performance monitoring, commercial governance, and renewal strategy.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, including understanding of channel mix, net revenue, cost of sale, customer acquisition cost, rate integrity, loyalty economics, and hotel profitability.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate distribution data, partner performance, and market dynamics into actionable commercial strategies.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Revenue Management, Loyalty, Digital, Marketing, Technology, Legal, Operations, regional teams, and hotel leaders to drive enterprise-wide priorities.
  • Excellent communication, influence, project management, and stakeholder alignment skills in a complex global environment.
  • Effective people manager and coach with experience leading, recruiting, developing, and motivating high-performing global or cross-functional teams.

Experience Preferred:

  • Bachelor's degree in hospitality, business, marketing, technology, analytics, finance, or a related field.
  • Advanced degree or professional certifications in hospitality, revenue management, digital commerce, distribution, analytics, or related disciplines.
  • Experience supporting new hotel openings, conversions, or brand integrations with distribution planning, channel setup, content readiness, loyalty visibility, and implementation.
  • Experience serving as business sponsor for distribution-related technology initiatives, including intermediary connectivity, CRS/channel integrations, API strategy, metasearch, content syndication, rate and inventory controls, and system operationalization of net rates.
  • Experience developing or improving reporting, dashboards, and KPIs related to channel contribution, net rate, cost of sale, direct-booking penetration, loyalty contribution, rate integrity, and partner-level performance.
  • Experience with loyalty-enabled distribution strategies, including member-rate visibility, direct-booking value proposition, app/web conversion, and guest relationship ownership.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted search, conversational travel planning, metasearch evolution, structured content, and the implications of machine-readable hotel information for distribution visibility.
  • Experience managing rate integrity, parity, wholesale controls, unauthorized redistribution, and regional regulatory considerations impacting hotel distribution.
  • Experience representing a hospitality or travel company at industry events, panels, trade associations, standards bodies, or partner forums related to distribution, connectivity, commercial technology, or digital travel.

The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all-encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary.

We welcome you:

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.

job.job_description:
We are actively recruiting a Director, Global Tax Accounting, to join our team. This role will have oversight and responsibility over the global tax accounting function and report directly to the Vice President of Tax.

The ideal candidate is a highly technical ASC 740 expert with 15+ years of progressive experience who possesses a strong change mindset. As a US-based multinational corporation, we need a leader with the ability to own and stay lock step with tax technical and regulatory changes in the jurisdictions in which we operate, as well as incorporate business changes unique to a quarter, while actively championing change.

In this role, you will own our global tax accounting strategy, moving beyond historical reporting to modernize our tax technology, streamline workflows, and act as a strategic advisor to leadership.

You will lead an outsourced tax provision function leveraging the broader global tax organization during interim and year-end close cycles to modernize our processes, mitigate risk, and navigate a rapidly evolving regulatory environment, with the ultimate goal of migrating to an insourced tax provision process.

Key Responsibilities

  • Global Tax Accounting & Financial Reporting (ASC 740)
  • Manage all tax accounting and financial reporting of taxes, including interim and annual calculations of the global tax provision, effective tax rate (ETR), tax reserves (ASC 740-10/FIN 48), and external tax disclosures (Forms 10-K, 10-Q, etc.).
  • Oversee the accurate and timely preparation, review, and disclosure of the global consolidated income tax provision (quarterly and annually) in accordance with ASC 740.
  • Responsible for update of the quarterly worldwide legal entity rolling forecast based on the WW forecast provided by FP&A, ensure proper inputs and review of the GAAP to statutory differences, update of permanent and material temporary differences for Tier 1 entities, and timely identification of discrete items for a given quarter for calculation of the EAETR and resulting journal entry.
  • Manage current and deferred tax reporting for all domestic and foreign legal entities pursuant to ASC 740. This includes valuation allowances, indefinite reinvestment assertions on outside basis differences, and foreign currency translation adjustments.
  • Lead the tax component of SEC filings (Form 10-K, 10-Q), ensuring impeccable footnotes, MD&A disclosures, and compliance with Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX 404) internal controls.
  • Manage complex multinational tax accounting issues, including valuation allowances, uncertain tax positions (ASC 740-10/FIN 48), and business combinations.
  • Regulatory Modernization: Monitor, evaluate, and implement accounting workflows for recent and evolving tax laws, specifically OECD Pillar Two Global Minimum Tax, Corporate Alternative Minimum Tax (CAMT), changing international provisions (GILTI/NCTI, Subpart F, Foreign Tax Credits) and local country tax laws to assess their financial statement impacts.
  • Explain and discuss technical tax accounting items clearly with senior management, the CFO, and independent auditors.
  • Coordinate with Corporate Accounting on internal accounting method changes and new Accounting Standards (US GAAP/SEC) along with their related tax accounting implications.
  • Forecasting & Process Transformation (Change Mindset)
  • Dynamic Forecasting: Manage the forecast of interim and annual effective tax rates and cash taxes. Partner closely with FP&A to establish dynamic forecasting models broken down by legal entity.
  • Process & Technology Innovation: Actively drive tax accounting process improvements and technology transformation. Identify, champion, and implement advanced tax technology, automation tools, and data/analytics solutions to streamline the close engine and reduce manual risk, leveraging AI for effective data analytics.
  • SOX Excellence: Develop, maintain, and enhance a best-in-class SOX infrastructure, ensuring effective and practical internal controls and related SOX 404 documentation across all provision and compliance systems.
  • Leadership & Team Development
  • Manage the day-to-day activities of the tax accounting function, providing high-impact leadership, development, and technical consultation.
  • Act as a visible, transformative senior leader responsible for developing forward-looking objectives, motivating team members across the tax function and fostering an agile team culture capable of navigating regulatory changes.

Job Requirements & Qualifications

  • Experience: Minimum of 15 years of progressive experience in corporate taxation, with a heavy emphasis on ASC 740. A combination of large public accounting (Big 4) and multinational public company industry experience is preferred.
  • Education & Credentials: Bachelor’s degree in accounting is required (Master's in Tax or Accounting preferred). CPA certification is required.
  • Technical Excellence: Master-level technical expertise in all aspects of tax accounting (ASC 740) and US GAAP within large, consolidated corporations and complex multinationals.
  • Systems & Data Literacy: Proven track record in process improvement and the implementation of tax technology, data, and analytics tools. Hands-on experience maintaining and enhancing provision systems (e.g., ONESOURCE Tax Provision), ERP systems (e.g., SAP), and consolidation tools (e.g., HFM) is highly desired.
  • Leadership & Courage: Proven track record in leadership, team building, and change management. Ability to clearly explain financial risks, challenge the status quo, and make strategic recommendations to executive leadership.
  • Communication: Well-developed written and oral communication skills, with a specific ability to translate complex international tax legislation into clear business impacts.

Desired Soft Skills

The ideal candidate will be self-motivated, a champion for continuous improvement, and an expert in critical thinking, analysis, and collaborative problem-solving.

  • Proactive, highly responsive, and resourceful when facing complex data challenges.
  • Highly flexible, motivated, and comfortable driving initiatives independently or within cross-functional teams.
  • Able to multi-task, prioritize effectively, and maintain composure under tight quarter-end deadlines.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to interact effectively and build trust across all levels of the organization.

Benefits/Perks

  • Competitive compensation
  • Generous Paid Time Off (5 weeks PTO your first year!)
  • 4 days (one per quarter) of Volunteer Time Off (VTO)
  • Year-End break from Dec 26th – Dec 31st
  • We offer comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and Wellness Programs
  • Paid parental leave
  • An infrastructure that allows flexible working arrangements
  • Formal and informal reward, recognition, and acknowledgment programs

job.job_description:
This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in-office.

We pride ourselves on Customer Care at Priceline; our team delivers the best. Through our partner contact centers and online support services, we ensure customers are supported before, during, and after booking a deal with Priceline.

Why This Job Is a Big Deal

The Manager, Support Services Implementation & Readiness leads the training implementation and organizational-readiness activities required to launch new products, technologies, processes, lines of business, and contact center partner programs successfully.

This role owns train-the-trainer strategy and execution, trainer certification, implementation-specific readiness standards, partner-site preparation, training deployment, nesting support, launch coordination, stabilization, and transition to ongoing Training Operations.

Flight is the role’s dominant area of expertise because of the complexity and operational risk associated with airline servicing and training. The Manager must also possess strong travel-agent knowledge across Hotel and Rental Car operations to support integrated Customer Care initiatives and identify cross-product dependencies.

The role applies to the portfolio, Jira, communications, and change-enablement standards established by the Senior Program Manager, Learning Operations & Change Enablement. It partners with Quality and Training Operations to establish proficiency measures, assess implementation outcomes, and transition stabilized programs into ongoing ownership.

In This Role, You Will Get To

  • Put the customer at the center of everything you do.
  • Demonstrate the Priceline values of Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability, and Trust.
  • Model “Get the Right Results, the Right Way” through sound judgment, transparency, integrity, and ethical decision-making.

Implementation Planning and Organizational Readiness

  • Lead assigned Customer Care implementations from planning through readiness, launch, stabilization, transition, and closure.
  • Translate approved business, product, operational, and technology requirements into integrated implementation and training plans.
  • Define scope, milestones, deliverables, functional owners, dependencies, risks, decisions, and success measures.
  • Own implementation-specific organizational-readiness criteria and assessments.
  • Evaluate readiness across people, processes, training, knowledge, Quality, technology, communications, staffing, leadership support, and partner-site capability.
  • Ensure readiness gaps have clear owners, actions, target dates, mitigation plans, and escalation paths.
  • Prepare readiness summaries and go-live recommendations for Support Services and operational leadership.
  • Develop launch, support, escalation, contingency, and stabilization plans.
  • Maintain implementation records and reporting in accordance with established portfolio and Jira-governance standards.

Train-the-Trainer and Trainer Certification

  • Own the train-the-trainer strategy and execution for implementations across Flight, Hotel, and Rental Car.
  • Determine trainer prerequisites, preparation requirements, certification standards, and implementation-specific expectations.
  • Facilitate or oversee train-the-trainer sessions for internal and external contact center trainers.
  • Validate trainer subject-matter knowledge, system proficiency, facilitation capability, scenario application, and operational readiness.
  • Develop and maintain trainer assessments, observation practices, certification criteria, and supporting documentation.
  • Establish remediation and recertification requirements when trainers do not meet readiness standards.
  • Monitor trainer performance during initial delivery and provide targeted coaching, feedback, and reinforcement.
  • Document trainer-readiness results, certification decisions, identified risks, and required actions.
  • Ensure train-the-trainer practices support consistent delivery across sites, regions, and contact center partners.

Flight and Travel Expertise

  • Apply deep Flight knowledge to planning, curriculum validation, train-the-trainer, readiness assessment, and launch support.
  • Ensure Flight training addresses airline policies, fare rules, ticketing, exchanges, refunds, cancellations, schedule changes, irregular operations, and escalation procedures.
  • Evaluate whether trainers and learners can accurately apply complex Flight requirements to realistic customer scenarios.
  • Identify customer, financial, compliance, and operational risks associated with Flight knowledge, system, workflow, or readiness gaps.
  • Apply strong travel-agent knowledge across Hotel and Rental Car products, policies, workflows, servicing models, and customer scenarios.
  • Identify differences and dependencies among Flight, Hotel, and Rental Car that may affect curriculum, delivery, technology, Quality, or partner readiness.
  • Maintain current knowledge of travel operations, systems, product changes, and emerging capability requirements.

Training and Functional Readiness

  • Partner with Instructional Design to ensure curricula, facilitator guides, learner materials, assessments, simulations, and job aids are ready for implementation.
  • Provide Flight, Hotel, Rental Car, and operational feedback regarding curriculum accuracy, usability, sequencing, and implementation risk.
  • Partner with Knowledge Management to ensure required procedures, policies, knowledge articles, and performance-support materials are approved and accessible.
  • Partner with Training Operations on trainer assignments, delivery capacity, learner schedules, classroom execution, nesting, and long-term ownership.
  • Partner with Quality on scorecard readiness, calibration, proficiency measures, early-tenure monitoring, and post-launch performance.
  • Partner with Product and Technology on requirements, system access, training environments, testing, defects, deployment timing, and operational support.
  • Partner with Learning Operations and Change Enablement on system assignments, Jira requirements, communications, stakeholder impacts, and adoption support.
  • Coordinate site-specific implementation plans while maintaining alignment with Priceline standards.

Partner-Site Readiness

  • Serve as a primary implementation and training contact for external contact center partners.
  • Assess site readiness across trainer capability, learner prerequisites, classroom infrastructure, technology access, staffing, leadership support, and nesting.
  • Communicate requirements, milestones, risks, decisions, and readiness expectations clearly and consistently.
  • Facilitate partner feedback and ensure relevant operational considerations are incorporated into implementation plans.
  • Escalate readiness concerns that could affect training effectiveness, customer experience, compliance, or launch success.
  • Promote consistent training and certification practices while accounting for legitimate market, language, and operational differences.

Launch, Stabilization, and Transition

  • Coordinate training-related launch, command-center, and hypercare activities when required.
  • Monitor trainer, learner, operational, Quality, technology, and customer indicators during launch and stabilization.
  • Track training completion, knowledge attainment, certification, graduation, proficiency, early-tenure Quality, productivity, and speed to competency.
  • Identify whether implementation gaps result from curriculum, trainer capability, facilitation, systems, knowledge, operational support, or learner proficiency.
  • Coordinate issue resolution and maintain visibility into severity, ownership, timing, and customer or business impact.
  • Determine when implementation and training stabilization criteria have been achieved.
  • Formally transition ongoing training ownership to the Senior Manager, Quality & Capability Development and Training Operations.
  • Ensure the receiving teams have the curriculum, documentation, trainer records, performance findings, outstanding actions, reporting, and support processes needed for ongoing execution.

Implementation Measurement and Improvement

  • Define implementation success measures with Quality, Training Operations, Operations, and other functional leaders.
  • Evaluate readiness, launch execution, trainer certification, learner proficiency, and stabilization outcomes.
  • Develop implementation dashboards, readiness summaries, risk reports, and leadership recommendations.
  • Conduct post-implementation reviews and document results, lessons learned, unresolved actions, and improvement opportunities.
  • Provide sustained performance findings to Quality and Training Operations for continued analysis and intervention.
  • Provide governance and process lessons to Learning Operations and Change Enablement for incorporation into future standards, workflows, and communications.
  • Improve train-the-trainer, certification, readiness, launch, and transition practices based on implementation outcomes.

People and Stakeholder Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop assigned team members, trainers, implementation resources, and workstream leads.
  • Establish clear expectations and accountability for readiness and implementation deliverables.
  • Build productive relationships with internal leaders, external partners, trainers, subject-matter experts, and operational stakeholders.
  • Influence decisions across functional and organizational boundaries.
  • Communicate complex travel and implementation information clearly to operational, technical, partner, and executive audiences.
  • Create an environment of transparency, shared accountability, constructive challenge, and disciplined execution.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, learning and development, organizational development, operations management, project management, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience will be considered in lue of education.
  • Seven or more years of progressively responsible experience in travel contact center operations, training, learning implementation, operational readiness, or a related discipline.
  • Five or more years of experience leading training implementations, train-the-trainer programs, trainer certification, or large-scale learning deployments.
  • Three or more years of leadership experience, including direct people leadership or formal responsibility for trainers, implementation teams, or complex workstreams.
  • Deep demonstrated knowledge of Flight servicing and training, including airline policies, fare rules, ticketing, exchanges, refunds, cancellations, schedule changes, irregular operations, and escalation practices.
  • Demonstrated travel-agent knowledge across Hotel and Rental Car products, servicing models, policies, workflows, and customer scenarios.
  • Demonstrated experience evaluating trainer readiness and establishing certification, remediation, and recertification requirements.
  • Experience translating complex business requirements into training, knowledge, Quality, technology, operational, and readiness plans.
  • Experience supporting multi-site, outsourced, BPO, or global contact center operations.
  • Experience managing implementations through planning, curriculum readiness, train-the-trainer, delivery, nesting, launch, stabilization, and transition.
  • Experience using learning and operational data to evaluate readiness, proficiency, and implementation performance.
  • Experience with airline reservation systems, Global Distribution Systems, Flight servicing platforms, or comparable travel technology is strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, Google Workspace, learning-management systems, and virtual-training platforms.

The salary range for this position is CAD $100k to $120k

Who We Are

WE ARE PRICELINE.

Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.

Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.

We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.

Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.

If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!

Flexible work at Priceline

Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.

Perks & Benefits At Priceline

Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:

Health & wellness coverage including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources

Generous time off including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days

Work/life support including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)

Financial security programs such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts

Signature travel perks including employee-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits

Additional perks & discounts like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits

A people-first culture with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together

Specific benefits and programs vary by location.

Inclusion is a Big Deal!

To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.

Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.

Applying for this position

We're excited that you are interested in a career with us. For all current employees, please use the internal portal to find jobs and apply.

External candidates are required to have an account before applying. When you click Apply, returning candidates can log in, or new candidates can quickly create an account to save/view applications.

Job Summary

As a key member of the Global Growth Delivery leadership team, the Vice President, Growth Delivery, is responsible for accelerating Marriott's ability to convert partnerships, acquisitions, brand expansions, and other strategic growth opportunities into operating results. This role aligns disciplines and delivers the internal capabilities required to move opportunities from deal approval through integration and launch with greater speed, predictability, and scale. By accelerating the activation of new brands, partnerships, acquisitions, and other strategic initiatives, this role contributes to Marriott's broader growth strategy and objectives.

Role

Success in this role requires strong critical thinking, enterprise leadership, commercial judgment, and the ability to manage complex stakeholder interactions. Specifically, the Vice President will:

  • Serve as the enterprise leader for growth integration strategy and execution, including the process design, governance, decision rights, and operating protocols followed by participants and executives.
  • Partner with Technology, Digital, Finance, Development, Operations, and other key stakeholders to shorten the time from deal to delivery through streamlined processes, automation, and business-focused use of AI-enabled capabilities.
  • Accelerate growth initiatives by giving stakeholders the right information at the right time, establishing accountability for decisions and deadlines, and removing barriers that delay launch or value realization.
  • Architect success by maintaining focus on enterprise outcomes, applying repeatable best practices, and surfacing disconnects that could erode value, increase cost, slow delivery, or create risk.

The Vice President, Growth Delivery, functions as a strategic business leader and enterprise orchestrator for growth execution. The role creates frameworks to identify priorities, simplifies complex information, anticipates challenges, and partners with senior executives to deliver Marriott's shared strategic objectives. This role reports to the Managing Vice President, Portfolio Planning & Product Delivery.

SUCCESS MEASURES

  • Reduced cycle time from deal approval to integration, launch, and business activation.
  • Successful activation of growth opportunities that support Marriott's broader growth strategy and objectives.
  • Improved predictability, scalability, and stakeholder confidence across the Growth portfolio.
  • Greater effectiveness of annual Growth initiative funding through disciplined prioritization, resource allocation, automation, and continuous process improvement.
  • Measurable improvements in delivery cost, capacity, decision velocity, and realization of intended business outcomes.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education And Experience

  • Four-year undergraduate degree from an accredited university and 12+ years of experience in strategy development, consulting, and/or development roles, with direct hands-on experience in M&A integration planning, execution, and risk management; or
  • 15+ years of relevant professional experience in a related function, demonstrating progressive career growth and a pattern of exceptional performance.

Required Experience And Capabilities

Join Qantas in our brand-new Product and Innovation Centre located in Adelaide to help meet evolving consumer needs by enabling agile teams to deliver faster, more adaptive solutions that prioritise customer value, continuous feedback, and innovation at every stage of the product lifecycle.


As the Delivery Lead, you will lead the design, planning and delivery of the digital roadmap for the Qantas Business Rewards online booking tool and Business Account. job.job_description:
About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

About The Role

The Tripadvisor Group Machine Learning Team is looking for an experienced individual to join a dynamic and fast-paced team to help support our Marketing efforts. As an ML II Scientist, you will apply your modeling skills to a wide variety of problem spaces including, but not limited to bidding for online advertising, customer modeling, experimental design, revenue optimization, attribution, recommendations, life time value. You will have access to the newest development tools and huge data sets. You will deploy your solutions online and be able to observe the impact of your work in real time as you help the company grow.

Tripadvisor Group comprises Tripadvisor, the world's leading travel information site, and Viator, the leading marketplace for travel experiences.. The ML Team creates systems that influence the travel decisions of millions of people per day. We apply cutting edge machine learning techniques to a wide variety of areas. To ensure continued success, Tripadvisor promotes a culture of personal development, including social activities, journal clubs, memberships in online learning resources, and participation in industry conferences. Have a great time while shaping the future of travel!

What You'll Do

We are looking for someone who is independent, curious, and motivated, who likes discussing ideas and will bring something new to the table. You will be working in a diverse environment where you’ll collaborate with a broad multidisciplinary team of data scientists, analysts, software engineers, and product managers. You’ll be encouraged to take ownership of your projects and to find new opportunities and problems where machine learning could be applied to improve the business.

  • Use machine learning models to solve a variety of core business problems across marketing.
  • Seek out new opportunities to apply data science and machine learning in the marketing space across all channels (e.g.,paid, organic, search, demand creation, affiliates, CRM…)
  • Automate ETL pipelines
  • Prototype, evaluate, deploy and maintain new ML models in production
  • Design AB tests and analyze their results
  • Discover new ways to analyze and interpret the data
  • Communicate progress and interpretation of experimental results to technical and business stakeholders

Skills & Experience

  • Team player
  • Loves to learn
  • Great communication skills with both technical and non-technical partners
  • Gets things done on time and on specification
  • Genuinely interested in AI — you've played with AI tools yourself, and you're excited to grow your skills in that space rather than waiting for it to be handed to you

Qualifications

  • PhD or Masters in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or related field preferred (or masters with 2+ years of practical experience)
  • Knowledge of AB test design and analysis
  • Strong background in machine learning and statistics
  • Solid foundation on data structures and algorithms
  • Proficiency in Python for numerical/statistical programming (our group relies heavily on Numpy/Pandas/Scikit-learn)
  • Ability to interpret and write complex SQL queries
  • Experience with big data technologies, such as Hive and Spark
  • Track record of leading the deployment and maintenance of models
  • Hands-on experience with AI-powered tools

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!

Working closely with Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, and regional stakeholders, the Director drives consistency, knowledge sharing, platform readiness, and adoption across the organization. Success in this role is measured by the effectiveness, usability, and adoption of the enablement tools and standards that support regional teams worldwide.

job.job_description:
Job Description

SENIOR PRODUCT MANAGER, SEARCH & PRICE | PRODUCT

Travel obsessed? Big tech fan? Hey, you’re in good company. If you want to be part of the industry that makes the world go round, then look no further.

Travelport is the brains behind lots of your travel bookings- plane, car or hotel. Our technology is used to book that magical holiday, infamous bachelorette party or long overdue school reunion. While we can’t solve mosquito bites or lost luggage, we can simplify a lot of the technical parts of travel, and we’re looking for the best thinkers to help us do it.

We’re hiring right now for a Senior Product Manager, Trip Services Search & Price! Search for #Travelport on LinkedIn and hear from our amazing team.

How you’ll make an impact:

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to play a pivotal role in the evolution of Travelport Trip Services, the complex, high-volume APIs which power how agencies, partners, and developers search, price, book and service Travelport’s multi-source content. Reporting to the Director of Product, Trip Services, you will help shape the future of this part of Travelport’s Product Portfolio.

In this role, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for Search and Price within Trip Services, ensuring customers can quickly find, compare and accurately price the right offers across NDC, ATPCO/EDIFACT and low-cost carrier content. You will combine deep product management craft, commercial acumen, and technical understanding (APIs, data, and AI principles) to drive adoption and deliver measurable value for our customers and for Travelport.

This is a senior, hands-on role for a strategic builder: someone who thrives in ambiguity, leads through influence, and loves solving complex customer problems, delivering value and measuring the outcome. You will translate vision into actionable outcomes across engineering, architecture, design, data, support and commercial teams, turning complex platform capabilities into simple, high-performing API experiences.

Your role in action:

  • Own the end-to-end lifecycle for search and price capabilities in Trip Services, from discovery through release to customers, building out significant new capabilities over time.
  • Define the strategy and roadmap for Search and Price, balancing content breadth, relevance, response time, price accuracy and cost to serve.
  • Through a deep understanding of agency, OTA and TMC workflows and the airline distribution ecosystem, identify problems and opportunities for smarter shopping and offer presentation.
  • Drive the evolution of multi-source offer aggregation across NDC, ATPCO/EDIFACT and LCC content, including branded fares, fare families and ancillaries, so customers can compare like for like.
  • Work collaboratively with product and technology teams to develop an optimised and aligned set of epics across the Trip Services customer journey.
  • Define, track, and analyse key metrics such as look to book, price to book accuracy, response times, shopping cost and API adoption, and feed learnings back into the product development process.
  • Partner with engineering and architecture on performance, scalability and shopping efficiency, including caching, filtering and intelligent request optimisation.
  • Explore and apply AI and machine learning to improve relevance, ranking and personalisation of search results.
  • Work with airline and content partners to understand new capabilities and translate them into clear Trip Services product priorities.
  • Ship software successfully, managing influence across product, engineering, commercial, and support teams through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus building.
  • Clearly communicate product strategy, benefits and results to a wide range of audiences, from immediate stakeholders to customers and the wider business.
  • Act as a senior voice for Search and Price with key customers and partners, and mentor and support other product managers in the team.


Could this be you?

  • Significant product management experience, developing complex products in travel technology, marketplace, or platform environments and delivering large-scale products.
  • A track record of setting product strategy and crafting compelling narratives that connect product vision to business outcomes, influencing senior stakeholders and aligning cross-functional teams.
  • Strong knowledge of air shopping and pricing, including fares, fare rules, taxes, branded fares and NDC offer and order concepts. GDS or airline distribution experience is a strong advantage.
  • Strong understanding of API ecosystems, automation and data analytics, with experience owning API or developer-facing products and the technical fluency to engage confidently with engineers on performance, latency and scalability trade-offs.
  • Strong understanding of using data and metrics to understand customers and make data driven decisions on strategy and planning.
  • Demonstrated ability to improve customer experience, through understanding customer needs and requirements and driving successful adoption of highly used technology solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience of using AI to shape customer value, with familiarity with AI-native product design, intelligent automation and emerging LLM-based capabilities.
  • Helps build a strong product culture, raising the bar on product craft across the team.
  • Professionally represents the product through compelling product demos internally and externally.
  • Ability to convincingly connect larger business goals to feature backlog items, keeping delivery aligned with Product strategy.


Discover why our teams love working here:

We offer a package that includes 25 days annual leave per annum, hybrid working model, pension contribution, private medical, life assurance and personal travel insurance. We believe all employees contribute to the success of the company and should be able to share in that success, which is why all jobs are eligible to participate in our bonus program with any payouts being subject to individual and company performance.

Marketing Manager, Japan


Job Summary:


We are looking for a Marketing Manager to drive sustainable growth for Trip.com Japan, a leading online travel agency, by solving critical business and organizational problems. This role goes beyond managing individual projects. You will operate at the intersection of strategy and execution, owning product growth initiatives that connect global product capabilities with localized user experiences and on-the-ground delivery. You will play a critical role in contributing to business growth through marketing activities with strategic action planning for customers' engagement.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Execute and manage marketing activities, including campaign operations and CRM, to optimize customer touchpoints — bringing fresh ideas and local insights to enhance relevance and engagement.
  • Support the development and execution of Japan’s engagement programs, working closely with global and local cross-functional teams.
  • Monitor and analyze performance across campaigns and channels, identify improvement opportunities, and take initiative to implement actionable optimizations.
  • Collaborate with global stakeholders (campaign, CRM, and operations teams) to ensure smooth execution while adapting global frameworks to local needs.
  • Build strong working relationships with internal teams and partners, proactively identifying ways to maximize business impact through collaboration.
  • Take ownership of assigned projects, manage day-to-day challenges, and drive timely delivery with a strong sense of responsibility.
  • Communicate clearly with stakeholders, sharing insights, progress, and improvement ideas to support better decision-making.
  • Manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment, demonstrating strong organization, prioritization, and problem-solving skills.


業務内容

  • 顧客接点の最適化に向けて、キャンペーンオペレーションや CRM を含むマーケティング活動を実行・管理する。新しいアイデアや現地ならではの知見を取り入れ、関連性とエンゲージメントを高める。
  • グローバル・ローカルのクロスファンクショナルチームと密接に連携しながら、日本におけるエンゲージメントプログラムの企画・実行をサポートする。
  • キャンペーンおよびチャネル全体のパフォーマンスをモニタリング・分析し、改善機会を特定して、実効性のある最適化施策を主体的に実行する。
  • グローバルのステークホルダー(キャンペーン、CRM、オペレーションチーム)と協働し、グローバルの枠組みを現地のニーズに適応させながら、円滑な実行を確保する。
  • 社内チームやパートナーと強固な協力関係を構築し、協働を通じて事業インパクトを最大化する方法を主体的に見出す。
  • 担当プロジェクトのオーナーシップを持ち、日々の課題に対応しながら、強い責任感を持って納期通りのデリバリーを推進する。
  • ステークホルダーと明確なコミュニケーションを図り、インサイトや進捗、改善アイデアを共有して、より良い意思決定を支援する。
  • 優れた組織力・優先順位付け・問題解決能力を発揮しながら、スピード感のある環境で複数のタスクを管理する。


Basic Qualifications:


  • Business-level proficiency in English (spoken, written, and reading).
  • Hands-on experience in digital marketing, including areas such as customer acquisition, promotions, CRM, product marketing, or channel marketing.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data, generate insights, and apply them to improve performance.
  • Understanding of B2C marketing fundamentals, including conversion optimization and customer journey management.
  • User-focused mindset, with the ability to identify customer needs and pain points through data and/or research, and translate them into actionable improvements.
  • Clear and effective communication skills, with the ability to present ideas and insights in a structured and persuasive way.
  • Proactive learning attitude, with a willingness to continuously improve and share learnings to elevate team performance.
  • Strong sense of ownership and attention to detail, with a commitment to delivering quality outcomes.


応募資格

  • ビジネスレベルの英語力(会話・読み書き)。
  • 顧客獲得、プロモーション、CRM、プロダクトマーケティング、チャネルマーケティングなど、デジタルマーケティングにおける実務経験。
  • データを解釈し、インサイトを導き出し、パフォーマンス改善に活かすことができる高い分析力。
  • コンバージョン最適化やカスタマージャーニー管理を含む、BtoC マーケティングの基礎的な理解。
  • データやリサーチを通じて顧客ニーズや課題を特定し、実行可能な改善策に落とし込むことができる、ユーザー志向のマインドセット。
  • アイデアやインサイトを構造的かつ説得力のある形で提示できる、明確で効果的なコミュニケーション能力。
  • 継続的な学習意欲を持ち、学びをチームに共有してチームパフォーマンス向上に貢献する姿勢。
  • 高い当事者意識と細部への注意力を持ち、質の高い成果を届けることへのコミットメント。


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with BtoC business, consumer products, media and/or e-commerce, app service experience or knowledge is plus.
  • Passion for travel and technology and the confluence of the two
  • Experiences working with global teams and overseas offices


  • BtoC 事業、消費財、メディア、e コマース分野での経験、またはアプリサービスに関する経験・知見があれば尚可。
  • 旅行とテクノロジー、そしてその融合領域への情熱。
  • グローバルチームや海外オフィスとの協働経験。

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

The Opportunity:

As the Associate Director for Japan, your main objectives will be to develop and deploy Agoda’s Japan strategy, provide guidance and leadership to ensure the successful account management of Agoda’s major partners, and deliver on targets and growth expectations that are key to Agoda’s business goals. To succeed in this role, you will bring excellent analytical skills, strong account and client management experience, a proven record of sustainable performance, and the capacity to lead, motivate, coach, and mentor teams. In addition, the ability to establish and develop valued long-term partnerships will be essential.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement strategies to accelerate Agoda’s business in Japan.
  • Demonstrate outstanding team leadership to grow the local business and consistently deliver on plans.
  • Implement strategies with top partners to enhance productivity and maintain a competitive advantage.
  • Establish and maintain robust relationships at senior levels, including C-level with key partners—driving partnership expansions and identifying significant opportunities.
  • Has the ability to lead a company-wide project with a few multidisciplinary teams.
  • Coordinate with top management on strategic planning and objectives.
  • Lead, coach, develop, and manage multiple teams through upskilling and coaching.
  • Modify the organizational structure by bringing in top talent, supporting recruitment, or assisting in restructuring key organizational components.
  • Conduct market research on industry and Japanese market trends to ensure Agoda’s competitiveness.
  • Attend and participate in relevant industry events.

What You’ll Need to Succeed:

  • More than 8 years of professional experience at multi-national companies.
  • 3–5+ years’ experience in leading, coaching, and developing teams, with a proven track record in rapidly changing environments.
  • Relevant experience in account management, business development, or general management. Travel industry experience is not required.
  • Strong numerical and analytical skills with keen attention to detail.
  • Ability to effectively communicate proposals to potential partners and internal stakeholders.
  • Strategic thinker; management consulting experience highly valued.
  • Professional “get it done” attitude and strong work ethic.
  • Resourceful, energetic, and self-driven personality.
  • Ability to move quickly, adapt well to change, and thrive in dynamic environments.
  • Experience in online or e-commerce business preferred.
  • Fluency in English and Japanese is required.

Situé au cœur du quartier historique de Paris 11ème, l’hôtel Ibis Paris Bastille Opéra vous accueille dans un cadre branché et authentique.

Description du poste

En CDI, à temps plein (39h/semaine), tu pilotes l'ensemble de notre activité restauration. Du petit déjeuner, en passant par le restaurant et le bar, tu es garant(e) de la qualité de service, de la satisfaction client et des performances économiques.

  • Tu pourras contribuer à valoriser l’image du restaurant sur les réseaux sociaux, en mettant en avant les équipes.

Qualifications

Ce que nous recherchons :

  • Tu as au moins 2 ans d’expérience en gestion d'activité restauration (chef de rang, responsable salle, maître d’hôtel)

  • Tu sais former, responsabiliser et faire grandir les talents autour de toi.

Informations supplémentaires

job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

Provide data analytics, reporting, and business intelligence support for the Customer Engagement Center and related business functions by developing and maintaining dashboards, reports, and operational data solutions. Work with data from multiple systems and sources, including SQL-based environments, Power BI connections and other approved business and cloud-based data platforms. Deliver actionable insights, support performance measurement and decision-making, collaborate with stakeholders to define reporting requirements, and leverage advanced analytics, automation, and AI-driven capabilities to improve business visibility, efficiency, and outcomes.

Essential Functions

  • Develop, implement, maintain and continuously improve dashboards, reports, visualizations, analytics workflows, and business insight solutions using Power BI, Power Automate, and other approved technologies to support operational decision-making and business performance.
  • Design, optimize and support SQL queries, data models, reporting infrastructure, and dashboard connections while ensuring data integrity, report accuracy, and reliable performance of analytics solutions.
  • Partner with stakeholders to gather requirements, define reporting needs, and translate business and operational priorities into practical analytics and reporting solutions aligned with established project objectives.
  • Analyze data from multiple business systems and data sources, including cloud-based platforms such as AWS, to identify trends, generate insights, and support process improvement initiatives.
  • Prepare and support OPSCenter payroll processing; including, but not limited to, corrective adjustments, incentive payouts, and employee wage rate updates.
  • Provide user support, troubleshooting, testing, implementation, enhancement, and continuous improvement for reporting, analytics, and business intelligence tools.
  • Participate in multi-functional efforts to improve reporting quality, data visibility, process efficiency, and operational decision support.
  • Support the evaluation, implementation, adoption, validation, and monitoring of AI-enabled analytics solutions, including predictive analytics, anomaly detection, natural language querying, and generative AI capabilities, ensuring outputs are accurate, reliable and aligned with business objectives.

High Accountability Functions

  • Lead the development, enhancement, and long-term strategy for reporting, visualization, and analytics solutions that support CEC performance, operational effectiveness and business decision-making.
  • Partner with senior leaders and business stakeholders to define reporting priorities, evaluate business challenges, and provide data-driven recommendations that influence operational and strategic decisions.
  • Serve as the SME for reporting governance, data integrity, metric standardization, and analytics best practices, ensuring accurate, reliable and actional business intelligence.
  • Drive complex cross-functional initiatives that leverage analytics, automation, and business intelligence capabilities to improve operational efficiency, user experience, employee productivity and overall business performance.
  • Own the evaluation, implementation, and optimization of AI-enabled analytics, automation, forecasting and predictive insights capabilities to enhance business performance and decision support.

Other Duties

  • Regularly evaluate processes, data workflows, and reporting outputs and recommend opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, and user experience.
  • Attend and participate in meetings related to assigned responsibilities, projects, and operational support activities.
  • Generate, analyze, and distribute reports related to assigned responsibilities.
  • Comply with all corporate and departmental policies, procedures, and applicable governmental regulations.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned, including cross-utilization within the department or in support of other departments, as business needs require.
  • Stay informed on emerging analytics, business intelligence, automation, and artificial intelligence technologies and recommend practical applications to support business objectives and operational efficiency.

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

DLV Customer Engagement Center Minot, North Dakota

POSITION TYPE/STANDARD SCHEDULE

Full-Time Monday through Friday; 8:30 a.m. to 5 p.m. Occasional evening and weekend may be required as job duties demand.

TRAVEL

N/A

SALARY RANGE

$50,638 - $81,712

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university; or equivalent work experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience required.
  • 1-2 years of experience in business intelligence, reporting, analytics, data visualization or related disciplines required.
  • Proficiency with SQL, relational databases, Power BI, and dashboard/report development required.
  • 1-2 years of experience working with multiple data sources, including SQL-based environments, cloud-based platforms (AWS, Azure, Microsoft Fabric, or similar) and related data connection methods preferred.
  • Working knowledge of AI-enabled analytics, predictive analytics, generative AI, and automation technologies, including the ability to evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, reliability, and business value.
  • Experience gathering business requirements, validating stakeholder needs, analyzing operational data, identifying trends, and delivering data-driven insights to support business decision-making required.
  • Knowledge of data validation, reporting accuracy, and dashboard outputs preferred.
  • Experience with workflow or automation tools such as Power Automate preferred.
  • Knowledge of DLV programs, policies, procedures, and reservations systems preferred.
  • Prior experience writing technical or business documentation preferred.
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled analytics, generative AI tools, Microsoft Copilot, predictive analytics, machine learning concepts, or natural language query technologies preferred.
  • Experience with programming or data analysis tools such as Python or R preferred; knowledge of ASP.Net, C#, JAVA, HTML, CSS or JavaScript is a plus.
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency.
  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

Benefits and Perks to Help You Keep Climbing

Benefits

Here, you’ll have the opportunity to see the world, while building a rewarding career supported by competitive compensation and benefits. In addition to the ongoing career and compensation advancement opportunities, we are proud to offer a competitive benefits package which includes:

  • Competitive salary, profit-sharing program, recognition and performance incentives.
  • 401(k) with generous company contributions up to 5%.
  • Paid time off including vacation, holidays, paid personal time, birthing parent, and parental leave.
  • Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental, vision, short/long term disability, and life benefits.
  • Family care assistance through fertility support, surrogacy and adoption assistance, lactation support, subsidized back-up care, and programs that help with loved ones in all stages.
  • We offer comprehensive wellbeing programs to support your overall health, including an employee assistance program, free financial mentoring, and abundant mental health resources.
  • Domestic and International space-available flight privileges for employees and eligible family members.
  • Career development programs to achieve your long-term career goals.
  • Access to more than 500 discounts, specialty savings, and voluntary benefits through Delta Perks such as auto, home and pet insurance, legal services, childcare and more.

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

We create and deliver tailored marketing strategies for Expedia Group’s brands, focusing on establishing strong connections and cohesive experiences for travelers and partners. We leverage our functional expertise and creative excellence to build trust and loyalty for our brands through innovative marketing approaches and technology.

Senior Partner Marketing Manager

A high performing and influential individual contributor who consistently applies (and regularly enhances) the partner marketing capabilities and playbooks to tackle the most complex business challenges and opportunities. Provides support and deep expertise to GTM marketing initiatives and interfaces regularly with executive (VP+) leadership.

In This Role, You Will

  • Gathers information about partner business challenges and creates data-driven marketing initiatives to drive adoption of Expedia Group Advertising solutions
  • Supports event-based marketing initiatives with demonstrated ROI
  • Translates product marketing narratives and campaign insights into field-ready assets that sellers can activate in partner conversations and events
  • Owns tracking and reporting of marketing performance for Destination Marketing Organization programs, measuring against KPIs including marketing-influenced revenue (MIR), lead volume, and pipeline conversion
  • Segments and prioritizes audiences/ messaging to ladder up to commercial goals
  • Coordinates project plan across functions and competing timelines from other projects; leads development of strategies to get assigned project done amidst opposing needs for resources
  • Measure, track, and adjust initiatives based on performance insights and partner feedback
  • Serves as a connector across teams, ensuring that Destination Marketing Organization marketing efforts are integrated into broader Expedia Group Advertising GTM motions and not operating in isolation

Experience And Qualifications

  • 8+ years of B2B marketing experience for Bachelor's / 6+ years for Master's
  • Experience managing large partner marketing budgets across multiple channels
  • Strong decision-making and prioritization skills, guided by data and business impact
  • Analytical and data-driven, comfortable using performance data and market trends
  • Solid understanding of marketing channel mix and relationship between channels
  • Experienced in managing complex, cross-functional projects with tight timelines and multiple stakeholders
  • Skilled at building trusted relationships with internal stakeholders and influencing cross-functional teams
  • Strong communication, with the ability to present ideas clearly to senior audiences
  • Self-motivated and able to drive success with limited guidance, while also acting as part of one team
  • Organized and proactive, with strong project management skills

The total cash range for this position in Chicago is $146,000.00 to $204,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $233,500.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Benefits And Perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

job.job_description:
As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, what's the next step? Start your journey with us!

We’re looking for a Performance Marketing Product Owner (MarTech) to join our Marketing Measurement & Data Activation area in Barcelona at eDreams ODIGEO. This role sits at the intersection of Data, Engineering, Analytics, and Media platforms, ensuring that all customer interactions and marketing activities are accurately captured, measured, and compliant with evolving regulations. If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.

Why eDreams ODIGEO

J oin the world's leading travel subscription platform.

Millions of customers every year across 44 markets – 5 brands – over 7.7 million Prime members since launching in 2017.

More than 100 million searches per day on our websites - more than 6 billion AI daily predictions

Over 1,700 employees – More than 60 different nationalities from all continents – 99% permanent contracts

We're the world’s leading travel subscription platform. We pioneered Prime, the first and largest travel subscription programme, which has topped over 7.7 million members since launching in 2017. Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits. This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalised service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members.

What You Will Do

The Role’s Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a Performance Marketing Product Owner in the Marketing Measurement & Data Activation Team you will be in charge of:

  • Reporting to the Head of Marketing Measurement & Data Activation, you will define the data-enablement roadmap for each media platform (e.g., Facebook, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube) and measurement partner (e.g., Appsflyer, Google Analytics).
  • You will orchestrate, together with a dedicated engineering team, the implementation of web and app tracking, audience creation, and data feeds for marketing campaigns. You will also collaborate closely with Legal and Compliance teams to ensure our tracking framework remains fully aligned with GDPR and privacy requirements.
  • Define and lead the media tracking and data activation agenda — setting priorities, identifying opportunities, and ensuring robust, timely, and future-proof implementations across all channels and platforms.
  • Advise marketing teams on technical feasibility and guide them on how new marketing strategies can be operationalized and measured.
  • Define specifications for event tracking across web and mobile (Google Analytics, Appsflyer, GTM, SDKs, Data Layers) and coordinate implementation with the dedicated engineering team.
  • Build and manage audience segments across platforms such as Meta, TikTok, Criteo, Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Apple Ads, and additional DSPs.
  • Audit existing tracking implementations for accuracy, completeness, and compliance, and establish processes for ongoing monitoring and validation.
  • Troubleshoot tracking and tagging issues, working closely with development teams to identify root causes and implement fixes.
  • Conduct ad-hoc analyses to detect tracking gaps, quantify business impact, and evaluate the value of new or improved tracking implementations.
  • Document tracking setups, audience definitions, and compliance decisions to ensure transparency, scalability, and smooth handover.
  • Stay current on new products, features, and best practices across media and measurement platforms.


What you need to succeed:

Good to have

  • 3+ years of experience in analytics implementation, MarTech, AdTech, or closely related fields.
  • Master’s degree in a technical or scientific discipline (e.g., Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Data Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Chemistry, etc.).
  • Expertise with implementing conversion tracking across marketing platforms (pixel, CAPI, API/Events, Enhanced Conversions or equivalent), as well as audience setup, product/data feed catalogues, conversion windows, and attribution configurations.
  • Strong understanding of web and app analytics fundamentals, including event structures, conversion tracking, and data layer design.
  • Experience with the tracking and measurement ecosystems of major media platforms, such as Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Apple Ads, Criteo, and others.
  • Exceptional attention to detail with a rigorous approach to accuracy and quality. Problem-solving mindset, with strong troubleshooting and QA capabilities. Proactive, fast learner, and naturally curious about data privacy, tracking technologies, and the evolving marketing tech landscape.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Applied AI Tools: Demonstrated comfort using practical AI tools such as Gemini, or other AI-powered assistants.
  • Experimentation Mindset: Curiosity and eagerness to explore, experiment with, and integrate emerging AI-driven solutions into workflows.
  • AI-Enhanced Problem Solving: Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to streamline processes, and enhance productivity.
  • Adaptability and Learning Agility: Enthusiastic about continuously learning and quickly adapting to new AI features and capabilities.


What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture. Here's what we offer:

  • A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and premium equipment with role-based selection options and device ownership through our equipment lifecycle program when it reaches its refresh cycle.
  • Continuous learning to fuel your growth and explore new horizons! 📚 Learn and grow with free Coursera access, soft skills workshops, tech training, leadership development, and more. Plus, enjoy a great onboarding program.
  • Grow opportunities to empower your career and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.
  • Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcomes. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
  • Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padel tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
  • Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.


Wanna take a peek into what it's like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

Apply now!

  • A strong understanding of high-end luxury service, and the confidence to drive it consistently through your team.

What We Offer

Vignette Collection is a diverse group of luxury hotels with a fresh focus, offering guests a more authentic and thoughtful way to travel.
