Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You will lead the sales team and ensure that the hotel’s revenue targets are met. This role involves developing and implementing sales strategies, building relationships with key clients, and overseeing the daily operations of the sales department. As a Director of Sales , you’re not just driving revenue growth across all hotel segments – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Shape and execute sales strategy: Develop and implement revenue-driving sales strategies across group, business transient, leisure transient, and catering segments, aligned with the hotel’s commercial goals and strategic plan
  • Drive revenue performance and profitability: Contribute to achieving revenue targets and profitability goals by optimizing pricing, improving business mix, and guiding forecasting accuracy
  • Lead business reviews and planning: Facilitate regular strategy and performance meetings while contributing to long-range commercial planning through analysis of performance trends, market shifts, and revenue opportunities
  • Ensure commercial alignment: Collaborate with revenue and marketing leaders to align sales tactics with pricing, distribution, and promotional strategies, and to support forecasting and rate strategies
  • Foster stakeholder relationships: Engage with Hilton Worldwide Sales, Convention and Visitors Bureaus (CVBs), third-party travel partners, and key clients to drive demand, improve conversion, and support high-impact site visits and pre-convention meetings
  • Develop data-informed strategies: Track market and competitor activity to inform strategy and help maintain competitive positioning in group and transient segments
  • Cultivate a high-performing team: Recruit new talent while driving team growth and engagement through performance management, professional development, and recognition programs

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • Degree qualifications in Business Management or equivalent.
  • At least 5 years of experience in managing a hospitality proactive sales role preferred.
  • Minimum 5+ years in a revenue-generating or commercial role within hospitality or travel.
  • Proven experience managing and developing high-performing sales or commercial teams.
  • Skilled in creating and presenting sales strategies to senior executives and stakeholder groups.
  • Proficient in analyzing departmental financial data to inform strategic decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify and capitalize on new business opportunities.
  • Experience working in matrixed environments across departments.
  • Experience in multi-complex hotel or travel operations.
  • Technical Proficiency in hotel management software (e.g., Delphi, Salesforce, OnQ, Market Planner Survey systems) is a plus.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

Job Summary

The Area Director of Sales & Marketing provides strategic leadership and support to sales teams across all brands within the Hawaii and French Polynesia market. The position is responsible for achieving property revenue goals, team booking pace goals, guest and associate satisfaction, and the financial performance of the sales function at each participating property. In partnership with property teams and centralized marketing resources, the Area Director develops and activates demand-generation initiatives tailored to the needs of the Hawaii market. The role oversees both the group and leisure segment teams to drive revenue and achieve the individual goals of all participating properties. Serving as the in-market representative for participating managed and franchised hotels, the role collaborates with the Vice President of Luxury Sales on market-wide initiatives and helps ensure alignment across the portfolio. In partnership with Sales and Marketing leadership, the Area Director shares accountability for hotel performance and supports each property in achieving its total sales and revenue objectives, improving market share, and advancing major change efforts across the region.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Required

Education and Experience

Preferred

job.job_description:
About Tripadvisor

We believe that we are better together, and at Tripadvisor we welcome you for who you are. Our workplace is for everyone, as is our people powered platform. At Tripadvisor, we want you to bring your unique perspective and experiences, so we can collectively revolutionize travel and together find the good out there.

Tripadvisor is the world's leading travel platform. Viator, a Tripadvisor company, is the leading marketplace for travel experiences, connecting travellers with 300,000+ things to do around the world. Our Marketing Analytics team owns the analytics stack for marketing — covering Search, CRM, Display, and Affiliate — in a high-velocity ecommerce environment where booking dynamics, intent signals, and seasonality make every data problem genuinely interesting. Search Marketing sits at the center of our growth strategy, and we're investing seriously in both the analytics craft and the AI tools that make that craft faster and sharper.

About The Role

The Marketing Analytics team is looking for a Sr Data Analyst, Search Marketing who is, at their core, a strong analyst — sharp with data, comfortable in SQL, and genuinely fluent in the search landscape: how paid and organic search interact, how the SERP evolves, and how that translates into traffic and revenue. Alongside that analytical core, we're looking for someone with a real appetite for AI — someone who is curious about how AI tools can speed up analysis, sharpen insight, and change the way analysts work, and who wants to keep growing in that direction.

You'll be expected to arrive with a solid command of search marketing analytics and be able to work with a good degree of independence from day one. You'll partner closely with channel owners and stakeholders across the business, and help shape how less experienced analysts on the team approach search data.

What You'll Do

  • Analyze search performance. Dig into SEM and SEO data to understand what's driving traffic and revenue, and translate that into clear, actionable insight for the marketing team.
  • Ensure performance is properly measured. Make sure search channel performance is tracked accurately and reliably, and surface insights that help the team increase both performance and efficiency.
  • Support experimentation. Help design and analyze incrementality tests and experiments across search channels, ensuring results are measured rigorously and communicated clearly.
  • Track the SERP. Build a working understanding of how paid and organic search features interact, and help monitor the impact of Google algorithm updates on our performance.
  • Analyze the competitive and demand landscape. Track impression/click share, competitor positioning and search demand trends to uncover opportunities across the business — informing our bidding strategy and influencing supply acquisition.
  • Stay ahead on AI search. Build an understanding of the evolving AI search landscape, track our presence in LLM and AI-generated responses, and turn those findings into concrete recommendations for our AI search strategy.
  • Monitor daily trading. Keep a close eye on day-to-day search performance against targets, flagging trends and anomalies early.
  • Collaborate across channels and teams. Work with analysts on CRM, Display, and Affiliate Marketing, as well as ML colleagues, to spot opportunities where search insights connect to the bigger marketing picture.
  • Bring an AI-curious mindset to the work. Look for opportunities to use AI tools — for querying data faster, summarizing findings, or automating recurring reporting — and bring ideas back to the team on what's actually useful versus hype.
  • Build toward bigger business cases. Support the development of analyses and recommendations that improve search traffic and commercial outcomes over time.

Skills & Experience

  • A solid analyst first — SQL and structured thinking come naturally to you, and you enjoy getting into the details of the data
  • Data driven — you let the numbers guide the conversation, and you're comfortable challenging assumptions with evidence
  • Curious about search: you want to understand why something ranks, why traffic moved, and what it means for the business
  • A true team player — you work well with analysts from other channels, ML colleagues, and stakeholders across the business, and you're generous with your time and ideas
  • Genuinely interested in AI — you've played with AI tools yourself, and you're excited to grow your skills in that space rather than waiting for it to be handed to you
  • Comfortable asking questions and learning fast, without needing every answer to already be known
  • A clear communicator who can turn a messy dataset into a simple, useful takeaway
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently in a fast-moving environment, while still being a strong team collaborator

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in an analytical field (Math, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, or related) required.
  • 3-5 years in an analytical role, ideally at a fast-paced ecommerce company, with experience in Search Marketing Analytics a plus
  • Strong SQL skills and comfort working with large, complex datasets
  • Basic proficiency in Python
  • Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker)
  • Solid understanding of statistical testing and experimentation
  • Genuine personal interest in AI, with curiosity about applying AI tools to analytics work
  • Strong communication skills, able to present findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with SEM, SEO, PPC, or content marketing concepts
  • More advanced programming experience in Python or R
  • Hands-on experience with AI-powered analytics or querying tools
  • Experience working in a matrixed, cross-functional marketing team

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!

We’re adventure seekers. Smile givers. Impact makers.
We believe in the power of travel. It broadens horizons for our customers, and for our people too. New places to live, new roles to explore, new communities to join. It’s yours for the taking.
We’re TUI, a leading global travel and leisure experience company that makes holiday dreams come true for people around the world.
We are one of the world’s leading tourism groups counting 1200 travel agencies and online portals, five airlines with around 130 aircraft, over 400 hotels, 16 cruise liners, digital platforms for tours and activities and most importantly over 60 000 colleagues around the world. What unites us is creating moments that enrich the lives of our 21 million customers.
Beside the unforgettable experience we provide our customers, we also believe in the good that tourism can bring and we care deeply about our environmental impact. The TUI Care foundation has projects in over 30 countries worldwide, building on the potential of tourism as a global force for development. The Foundation opens up new perspectives through education and training, empowers local communities to benefit from the success of tourism and engages in the protection of nature and the environment.
At TUI we simply say “Let’s TUI it”. For us, that means creating happiness. Tackling challenges every day together, with a positive, can-do attitude, and finding solutions even for the most unexpected situations. Our teams across TUI are just as diverse as our destinations. So whether you have lots of experience or none at all. If you want to work in an office or feel best in the field. No matter if you’re an accomplished tech whizz, an aspiring entertainer, or simply in love with flying.
There’s a place for you here.
job.job_description:
Here at TUI, you’ll find we’re an inclusive company with a culture of care and by joining the Retail Team as an Apprentice Travel Advisor in our Leeds Lands Lane store we’ll provide a valuable insight into the world of travel and fully support you in working towards the Level 3 Travel Consultant Apprenticeship. Our two-year Apprenticeship Scheme is structured to develop you in becoming a destination expert so that you can recommend and sell holidays, Cruise, UK Breaks and additional products. You’ll put all customers at the heart of our business by creating unforgettable holiday experiences that make us the best-loved holiday company.

As part of our commitment to provide exceptional customer service and flexibility for our customers, you’ll enjoy a varied shift pattern each week including, weekends, bank holidays and evenings at some of our busier stores.

About Our Offer

  • TUI offers much more than just a starting salary starting of £8.50 per hour which increases after the first year
  • Be rewarded for exceeding your targets with our commission scheme
  • Enjoy fantastic holiday benefits, discounts, special offers and the ability to purchase additional TUI time off
  • Benefit from our Health and Wellbeing across key areas – Financial, Health, Social, Community and Career
  • Investment in your development and career progression
  • Pension scheme and life assurance

About The Job

  • Use your passion to inspire our customers and colleagues whilst enjoying a great amount of fun
  • Your drive to achieve will lead you to exceed your sales and objectives, in Retail we call it ‘Smashing your Targets’
  • You’ll embrace change and rise to the challenges of a customer engaged role face to face and virtually
  • If things don’t go to plan, your colleague network will actively help you investigate and resolve any question or complaint
  • As technology advances so does TUI, you’ll receive support and training on a variety of systems empowering you to enhance your knowledge, skills and behaviours to confidently adapt your style to help answer questions whilst bringing memorable holidays to life for our customers
  • You’ll be given time within your working week to complete practical and written assignments via your online learning platform and with the support of your manager and a dedicated learning coach you'll be guided through your apprenticeship with the aim to achieve a Level 3 Travel Consultant qualification.

About You

  • Good knowledge of excellent customer service and a genuine passion to work within tourism
  • Dedicated to achieve, goals, targets and a Level 3 Travel Consultant qualification
  • Self-motivated and willing to act on feedback, remaining positive when faced with challenges
  • Willing to embrace change and adapt to new ways of working
  • A team player who engages and collaborates with our customers and colleagues
  • An organised individual who takes pride in their work and able to communicate effectively
  • Grade 9 – 4 GCSE or equivalent in both English and Maths
  • Able to work a varied shift pattern each week in-line with shop opening and closing times.

From a workplace to a place to belong. At TUI we embrace diversity, equity and inclusion, encouraging everyone to come as you are, because together, our potential is limitless.

We're committed to supporting candidates with disabilities and impairments so if you require any support, please let us know.

For the Hiring Manger to have sight of your application, you'll also need complete our online assessment - you'll be prompted to do this once you've submitted your application.

Please note, if you've been interviewed for this role within the last 6 months, we're unable to consider a further application at this time.

job.job_description:
Product Growth Manager


Job Summary:


We are looking for a Product Growth Manager to drive sustainable growth for Trip.com Japan, a leading online travel agency, by solving critical business and organizational problems. This role goes beyond managing individual projects. You will operate at the intersection of strategy and execution, owning product growth initiatives that connect global product capabilities with localized user experiences and on-the-ground delivery. You will play a critical role in contributing to business growth through product performance and market adaptation.


Key Responsibilities:


As a product growth manager, you will exercise your skills to:

  • Enhance User Experience: Build and optimize the JP user experience for one of the largest online travel platforms by identifying pain points and implementing innovative solutions.
  • Understand Customers: Regularly interact with users to gather insights and translate them into actionable product improvements that anticipate customer needs.
  • Leverage Data & Insights: Use advanced analytics, user research, and market trends to guide product decision-making and foster a data-driven culture.
  • Champion Localization: Ensure products resonate with regional markets by integrating local user preferences and behaviors into the design process. Lead product localization with an analytical and observant perspective and tackle issues with a creative approach.
  • Stakeholder Influence: Drive and influence multiple stakeholders on project improvement opportunities and be able to present to leadership team to drive critical business initiatives.
  • Multitask: Manage multiple projects requiring frequent communication, organization/time management, and problem-solving skills.


Basic Qualifications:


  • Proven Expertise: A proven track record of building high-quality products at scale. With 3+ years in product management or product operations, collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver exceptional results.
  • B2C Focus: Expertise in optimizing conversion flows and customer journeys for consumer-facing products
  • User-Centric Mindset: Proficiency in user research methods, discovery processes and data analysis with a commitment to addressing customer pain points effectively
  • Passion for UX: A strong advocate for intuitive and delightful user experiences that exceed customer expectations.
  • Project Management: Adept at managing complex product launches and aligning cross-functional teams to achieve goals.
  • Communication: Exceptional skills in presenting ideas and findings clearly and persuasively to diverse audiences.
  • Bar-raising Mindset: A dedication to excellence in all aspects of product design, strategy, and execution.


Preferred Qualifications:


  • Business level of English proficiency
  • Experiences working with global teams and oversea offices
  • Enthusiasm for travel experiences is a plus

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world. Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide. No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team

The Customer Experience Group (CEG) of Agoda effectively serves our customers and partners to ensure satisfying results. This great task is accomplished with the support of our Global Service Verticals (GSV) team. We serve as the backbone for CEG’s global operations. Our team is comprised of project managers, process owners, analysts, and talent management. Together we work nonstop to improve the quality and efficiency of our customer and partner support processes. We are a very data-driven environment, eager to move fast and learn through experimentation. A clear focus on supporting our customers and partners is bolstered by a strong, entrepreneurial culture that enriches us and Agoda’s business performance.

This role is within the Partner Excellence team, which is a part of CEG’s Global Service Verticals. The team focuses on driving end‑to‑end partner experience and process improvements, and scaling impact through automation, AI, and tooling across both partner-facing and agent-facing journeys.

The Opportunity:

This role is responsible for leading a portfolio of global partner excellence programmes with a focus on complex system support in the Customer Experience Group (CEG), with a focus on: (i) process optimization and PX improvements across the post‑booking partner journey, (ii) automation, AI, and tooling to enhance customer and agent experience, (iii) collaboration with product and commercial teams to drive structural changes and (iv) reduce partner effort and CEG cost‑to‑serve, unlock commercial value from partner support insights

You will lead a high‑performing team of project managers/experts to drive measurable impact on customer satisfaction, efficiency, quality, and cost. The role combines strategic problem solving, hands‑on data-driven execution, and strong stakeholder management with both technical (Product/Tech/Data) and non‑technical (Operations/Support/Commercial) teams.

In this Role, you’ll get to:

Lead and Own a Portfolio of Transformational Initiatives

  • Own from end‑to‑end a collection of projects and/or areas of business in CEG (global coverage), spanning commercial enablement and process excellence initiatives.
  • Prioritize, plan, and drive initiatives that improve mission‑critical metrics: partner satisfaction (e.g., PSAT), service levels, automation quality, productivity, cost efficiency, and employee/agent engagement.
  • Ensure CEG readiness to support Agoda’s new business and product initiatives by working closely with Product, Engineering, Data, Marketing, Strategic Partnerships, Partner Services, Finance, Legal, and other CEG teams.

Shape End‑to‑End Customer & Process Improvements

  • Continuously improve CEG end‑to‑end processes across the post‑booking journey to remove pain points, and improve operational performance through targeted initiatives and data driven insights.
  • Own and evolve frameworks and roadmaps for how we continuously improve our internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and related processes; balancing CX/PX outcomes vs. efficiency/cost.
  • Define clear problem statements and build business cases to define and prioritize customer/partner pain points and success metrics.

Drive Commercial driven Solutions & Insights in Operations

  • Partner with Product Management / Technology /CEG teams to design, prioritize, and implement solutions, from experimentation and configuration through to global rollout and impact measurement.
  • Drive strategic initiatives across CEG such as improving complex systems support in key growth markets, regulatory initiatives and partner closely with our commercial teams in order to improve partner/supplier pain points.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage automation, AI, and tooling across customer, partner and agent journeys (e.g., self‑service, post-booking APIs).

Lead and Develop a High‑Performing Team

  • Set long‑term vision, strategy, and annual/quarterly OKRs for your team, aligning with CEG and Agoda-wide priorities.
  • Manage and coach a team of project managers (and potentially people managers), building talent, capability, and succession within the Partner Excellence team.
  • Provide structured feedback, mentoring, and support to enable your team’s growth and to consistently raise the bar for quality and impact.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior leaders and stakeholders across CEG and other functions, effectively influencing priorities and decisions.
  • Monitor project milestones, identify risks and dependencies, troubleshoot issues, and implement mitigation plans—acting at all times as the ultimate owner of the portfolio’s outcomes.

What you’ll Need to Succeed:

Experience & Background

  • At least 8–10+ years of experience in project/program management, strategy & operations, commercial excellence, process improvement, management consulting, or similar fields.
  • Significant people leadership experience, including building and managing high‑performing teams (ideally including people managers and individual contributors).
  • Proven track record of leading and influencing complex, cross‑functional initiatives from idea to implementation, with clear, measurable business impact.
  • Experience working closely with Product/Technology/Data teams on technical or automation/AI-focused projects is highly advantageous.

Technical & Analytical Skills

  • Strong analytical mindset; comfortable with numbers and quantitative problem solving. Able to define analysis structures, interpret data, challenge existing metrics, and make recommendations.
  • Familiarity with data and analytics tools (e.g., SQL, Tableau, Metabase, VBA, or similar) and experience leveraging them to drive decisions.
  • Comfort working with or overseeing workflow / automation / agent guidance tools, and the ability to engage in technical discussions with Product/Engineering/Data teams. Coding ability is a plus(you have to be willing to learn)
  • Exposure to AI/ML‑driven solutions in an operational or PX context (e.g., chatbots, recommendation engines, routing, classification, or decision support tools) is a strong plus.

Commercial Excellence, Process, And Delivery Skills

  • Demonstrated experience in process improvement and transformation, ideally in commercial, operations or customer support environments.
  • Strong project and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives in parallel, structure complex problems, and orchestrate cross‑functional teams.
  • Experience defining and driving improvements in KPIs such as CSAT, NPS, SLAs, handle time, productivity, or cost‑to‑serve.

Leadership, Communication & Ways of Working

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in English, with the ability to influence and align stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced, dynamic, multicultural environment, comfortable with ambiguity and experimentation in a high‑velocity setting.
  • A growth mindset and positive attitude: proactive, hands‑on, detail‑oriented, and with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Eagerness to pitch new ideas, take initiative, and seek out opportunities for improvement; comfortable giving and receiving feedback.
  • Professional experience with Microsoft Office tools (e.g., Excel, Word, PowerPoint). Experience with collaboration and project tracking tools is a plus.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package (relocation support and visa support provided for successful overseas candidates)
  • Exciting, high‑impact career opportunity with a major global OTA, including potential moves between teams and global locations. You will interact with departmental senior leadership regularly.
  • Dynamic, multinational tech environment with colleagues from diverse educational and professional backgrounds.
  • Continuous learning and development opportunities through corporate learning programs.
  • Modern office space and convenient location at the heart of Bangkok Metropolitan, Hub of Asia.

Please review our Hiring Process Guidelines before your interview — click here to learn how interviewing at Agoda works.

job.job_description:
Company Description

Join us at Accor, where life pulses with passion!

As a pioneer in the art of responsible hospitality, the Accor Group gathers more than 45 brands, 5,600 hotels, 10,000 restaurants, and lifestyle destinations, in 110 countries. While each brand has its own personality, where you will be able to truly find yourself, they all share a common ambition: to keep innovating and challenging the status-quo.

You will be part of the Accor Global Procurement Team within the Digital Factory, a great team of dynamic, passionate, and enthusiastic individuals that work together and with the Accor’s hubs in the deployment of strategic projects, to ensure the growth and the strengthening of the group’s value proposition to customers and owners.

About Astore, Our Global Procurement Organization

Astore is our Global Procurement Organization which covers all products & services needed by our clients to address their daily operational needs or one-shot construction or renovation projects. Its international organization and digital roadmap aim to ease the procurement operations of our Accor hotels and non-Accor partners.

With more than 7500 clients worldwide and about 2000 external partners, our ambition is to become the first choice for procurement solution for the hospitality sector.

The Procurement organization gathers approximately 200 FTE in 20+ procurement offices including the Global Procurement office.

Job Description

As Digital Business Manager, you will act as the business ambassador of Accor's digital procurement solutions for UK and Benelux.

Your mission will be to increase adoption, engagement, and business value generated through our digital ecosystem by working closely with Sales teams, Category Managers, Procurement stakeholders, suppliers, and hotel customers.

You will be responsible for demonstrating how our digital solutions support commercial objectives, improve operational efficiency, and create value for both hotels and suppliers.

Based in London, you will play a key role in accelerating digital transformation across your region while acting as the voice of customers towards product and digital teams.

What You Will Be Doing

Drive adoption and business growth

  • Develop and execute adoption plans for Accor's digital procurement tools.
  • Support customers in maximizing the value generated through digital platforms.
  • Identify opportunities to increase platform usage, transaction volumes and customer engagement.
  • Promote digital solutions as business enablers rather than operational tools.

Partner with Sales teams

  • Work closely with Sales teams to integrate digital solutions into customer discussions and value propositions.
  • Support business development activities by demonstrating how digital procurement solutions contribute to revenue growth, efficiency, compliance and customer satisfaction.
  • Participate in customer meetings, workshops, roadshows and events.
  • Build compelling business cases and success stories showcasing platform value.

Act as the voice of the market

  • Gather customer feedback, market insights and business requirements.
  • Collaborate with Product teams to ensure regional needs are reflected in solution roadmaps.
  • Contribute to prioritization discussions and product improvement initiatives.

Training, communication and change management

  • Deliver presentations, webinars and workshops to customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders.
  • Promote best practices and drive awareness of new functionalities and services.

Performance monitoring and reporting

  • Track adoption, engagement and commercial KPIs.
  • Analyse business performance and identify growth opportunities.
  • Provide recommendations and action plans based on data-driven insights.

Qualifications

Your experience and skills include:

  • Education level: Master / MBA / Bac + 4/5
  • Field of study: Digital communication / Digital project management
  • Language: Fluent in English, All deliverables will be in English.
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Enthusiasm for learning and a proactive approach to tackling challenges.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and Canva
  • Technology savvy with a willingness and the curiosity to understand BI tools/processes
  • A keen interest in teamwork
  • Ability to work on several projects in parallel and prioritise tasks
  • Strict adherence to schedules and quality of deliverables

Additional Information

What’s in there for you?

  • Unique opportunity to take your first steps and develop your career with worldwide Augmented Hospitality leaders
  • Package of benefits and perks of working for Accor
  • Work in a multi-national team
  • Hybrid way of working
  • Talent development opportunities
  • Access to a comprehensive training catalogue within our Accor Academy
  • Option to further develop and grow in- and outside of the region or globally
  • Various ESG activities & initiatives

job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

Delta’s Integrated Operations Planning team aligns strategic plans across operations, develops key operational inputs to the airline schedule, and designs cross-divisional solutions to achieve operational goals. The Analytics Specialist, Airport Planning Integration, supports this work by organizing and analyzing planning data to enable rapid decision-making. This role partners closely with leaders and business partners to understand operational processes, address emerging challenges, and develop data-driven solutions that improve operational performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop new schedule KPIs and create automated reporting in support of executive-level future planning reviews
  • Produce robust documentation and training materials to assist other teams in interpreting and analyzing future schedules
  • Be the central owner of schedule data for operations teams, partnering with Network Planning to maintain consistent and accurate data flows, as well as developing new data sources and structures
  • Develop a thorough understanding of the schedule development process, including timelines and various schedule constraints
  • Partner with Network planning teams to create schedule feedback loops that resolve conflicts and provide feasible solutions in future schedules
  • Directly create and work with team members on written materials that distill findings and insights for a variety of audiences
  • Sustain a culture of independence and curiosity, driving cross-divisional decision making with little direction and supporting team members to look for problems to solve and then come up with innovative ideas
  • Identify and resolve or escalate, as appropriate, potential roadblocks within projects
  • Enjoy working in a high-profile environment with fluid priorities, ambiguity and extremely aggressive timelines
  • Be intellectually curious, ask questions, and speak up when they have an idea
  • Have a team first attitude, with the success of our team and business partners as their top priority
  • Distill information and synthesize complex problems and processes to form a cohesive story for leaders across the organization
  • Present findings to Operations Analytics leaders

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Strong business acumen, statistical, analytical, and problem-solving skills, and able to manage complex processes with cross-functional teams
  • Excellent written, presentation, and verbal skills, with the ability to produce concise, relevant, strategically driven documents and presentations for senior leaders
  • Be a strong team player, detail oriented, and perform well under pressure
  • 3+ years of experience in analysis, information science, data visualization, or other relevant quantitative field
  • Direct experience communicating with stakeholders, delivering projects end-to-end, and working collaboratively to drive improvement in the overall analytical support of Delta operations worldwide
  • Must be comfortable working in group and individual settings.
  • Experience with analytical tools, such as SQL, Python, and Tableau or Power BI required
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency.
  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Bachelor's degree and 3 years work experience in Data Analytics, Decision Science, Engineering, Business, Finance or related analytical field OR Masters level degree OR equivalent experience AND/OR a combination of both
  • Previous experience in operational roles

Benefits And Perks To Help You Keep Climbing

Our culture is rooted in a shared dedication to living our values – Care, Integrity, Resilience, Servant Leadership, and Teamwork – every day, in everything we do. At Delta, our people are our success. At the heart of what we offer is our focus on Sharing Success with Delta employees. Exploring a career at Delta gives you a chance to see the world while earning great compensation and benefits to help you keep climbing along the way:

  • Competitive salary, industry-leading proﬁt sharing program, and performance incentives
  • 401(k) with generous company contributions up to 9%
  • Paid time off including vacation, holidays, paid personal time, maternity and parental leave
  • Comprehensive health beneﬁts including medical, dental, vision, short/long term disability and life beneﬁts
  • Family care assistance through fertility support, surrogacy and adoption assistance, lactation support, subsidized back-up care, and programs that help with loved ones in all stages
  • Holistic Wellbeing programs to support physical, emotional, social, and financial health, including access to an employee assistance program offering support for you and anyone in your household, free financial coaching, and extensive resources supporting mental health
  • Domestic and International space-available flight privileges for employees and eligible family members
  • Career development programs to achieve your long-term career goals
  • World-wide partnerships to engage in community service and innovative goals created to focus on sustainability and reducing our carbon footprint
  • Business Resource Groups created to connect employees with common interests to promote inclusion, provide perspective and help implement strategies
  • Recognition rewards and awards through the platform Unstoppable Together
  • Access to over 500 discounts, specialty savings and voluntary benefits through Deltaperks such as car and hotel rentals and auto, home, and pet insurance, legal services, and childcare

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Director of Product Management, Communications and CRM

Introduction To The Team

Expedia Group is seeking a Director of Product Management to lead the strategy, roadmap, execution, and people development for customer relationship management (CRM) and communications products.

This leader will shape how Expedia Group delivers personalized, timely, measurable, and compliant customer communications across email, push, SMS, in-product, transactional, and emerging channels. The role will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data, Marketing, Analytics, Legal, Privacy, and Operations teams.

In This Role, You Will

  • Define and execute the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities for CRM and customer communications products across email, push, SMS, in-product, transactional, and emerging channels.
  • Lead the evolution of customer data, marketing automation, messaging, personalization, journey orchestration, experimentation, and analytics capabilities to deliver measurable customer and business outcomes.
  • Partner with Engineering and Data teams to improve audience activation, identity, consent, preferences, suppression, data quality, measurement, APIs, integrations, data models, and platform architecture.
  • Establish scalable product discovery, intake, prioritization, requirements, delivery, adoption, and operating practices that improve speed, quality, reliability, compliance, and customer experience.
  • Evaluate build, buy, and configure decisions across Salesforce and comparable enterprise platforms while aligning stakeholders on priorities, tradeoffs, risks, and outcomes.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing product team while safely integrating and operating AI/ML-enabled solutions that improve customer engagement and product-team effectiveness.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of product management experience with a Masters, 12+ with a Bachelors, or equivalent related professional experience
  • Significant product management experience leading multiple products, platforms, or interconnected capabilities within CRM, customer engagement, marketing technology, communications, data, or a related technical domain.
  • Demonstrated experience managing, developing, and scaling product teams, including setting goals, decision rights, operating rhythms, and career-development plans.
  • Experience owning product strategy and execution across a multi-product or platform scope, with accountability for prioritization, delivery, adoption, and measurable customer and business outcomes.
  • Strong technical fluency across APIs, data models, integrations, identity, platform architecture, customer data, personalization, journey orchestration, experimentation, analytics, and privacy.
  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Salesforce Data Cloud, or comparable enterprise platforms, along with familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real-world products.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience applying AI/ML-enabled automation and responsible AI practices to personalization, customer communications, engagement optimization, or product-team workflows.
  • Experience leading CRM and communications product portfolios at scale across multiple channels, customer journeys, enterprise platforms, and stakeholder groups.
  • Proven ability to establish architecture-informed product direction and make effective build, buy, and configure decisions across complex integrations, data ecosystems, identity, consent, and measurement capabilities.
  • Track record of using experimentation, analytics, and operational metrics to improve customer engagement, product adoption, reliability, compliance, and business performance.
  • Experience creating scalable product operating models, developing diverse product talent, and influencing executive stakeholders through clear tradeoff, risk, prioritization, and investment recommendations.

The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $224,000.00 to $313,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $358,500.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role. Organization- Hotel Martinez

Summary

Inauguré en 1929, l’Hôtel Martinez, qui fait partie de The Unbound Collection by Hyatt, incarne la Riviera des Années Folles. Le style Art Déco caractérise ce lieu iconique de La Côte d’Azur à travers ses différents espaces de vie, recréant l’harmonie parfaite entre une nature généreuse et un art de vivre méditerranéen. Ses 410 chambres et suites sont un clin d’œil à l’univers du Yachting et ses Appartements Penthouse rendent hommage au 7ème Art. L’atmosphère conviviale, d’insouciance et de joie de vivre fait de l’Hôtel Martinez le rendez-vous incontournable de La Croisette et l’adresse des personnalités de tous horizons.

En symbiose avec les origines de l’Hôtel Martinez, « La Plage du Martinez » se réinvente avec une nouvelle carte et un nouveau décor face à la mer et à l’iconique ponton de l’hôtel. La cuisine met à l’honneur des références fortes à la Méditerranée et à la French Riviera, en s’appuyant sur une collaboration étroite avec des producteurs locaux et des produits de saison. La décoration, signée Rémi Tessier, s’inspire de l’esprit yachting en plongeant les convives dans l’ambiance du pont d’un bateau. En exclusivité, 150 « Director Chairs » ont été créées, chacune ornée d’une sélection de 150 réalisateurs et acteurs emblématiques, offrant un véritable clin d’œil au monde du cinéma et du yachting.

 Le restaurant « La Palme d’Or » accueille les convives autour d’une expérience gastronomique unique, sublimant les saveurs de la Méditerranée. En complément, le restaurant « Le Sud » célèbre l’hédonisme méditerranéen avec une cuisine ouverte cultivant l’esprit yachting.

Ainsi, l’Hôtel Martinez continue de briller par son élégance et son héritage, combinant histoire, gastronomie et design, pour offrir à ses invités une expérience inoubliable au cœur de La Côte d’Azur.

« We care for people so they can be their best »

Notre raison d’être nous inspire à faire preuve de care, jour après jour, envers toutes les personnes avec qui nous sommes en contact. Alors que nous continuons à nous développer à travers le monde, nous ne perdons pas de vue ce qui est le plus important à nos yeux : le bien-être et l’épanouissement de tous, clients, partenaires, collègues, fournisseurs et membres de la communauté locale. 

Les hôtels Hyatt en France sont fiers d’avoir obtenu la certification Great Place To Work™ 2026-2027, une reconnaissance fondée sur les témoignages et l’expérience vécue par nos collaborateurs. Venez découvrir un environnement où chacun peut grandir, s’épanouir et développer sa carrière au sein de Hyatt.

job.job_description:
About Tripadvisor

We believe that we are better together, and at Tripadvisor we welcome you for who you are. Our workplace is for everyone, as is our people powered platform. At Tripadvisor, we want you to bring your unique perspective and experiences, so we can collectively revolutionize travel and together find the good out there.

Tripadvisor is the world’s largest online travel site, visited by 390 million travellers each month, and our Experiences business, Viator, is a fast-evolving and highly data-driven part of the organisation.

At Viator, data is at the heart of how we build great products. We use it to understand our customers, improve decision-making, and drive measurable business impact.

About The Role

As a Senior Manager of Product Data Science, you will be a key leadership figure within the Product Data Science organisation, responsible for building and scaling a high-performing team of Analysts and Data Scientists embedded within Product domains.

You will not only deliver impact through your team, but also raise the overall analytical and technical bar of the organisation, ensuring data science, experimentation, and product analytics are consistently applied at a high standard across multiple product areas.

You will act as a force multiplier for decision-making quality, improving how Product, Engineering, Design, and Commercial teams use data to shape strategy, prioritise work, and evaluate impact.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead, develop, and grow a team of Product Analysts and/or Data Scientists, ensuring consistently high performance, strong technical standards, and clear ownership of impact.
  • Drive effective goal-setting, planning and execution processes across Product Data Science, bringing leadership and discipline to OKRs, prioritisation and delivery against strategic objectives.
  • Set and continuously raise the bar for analytical quality, experimentation rigour, and data science application across your teams, ensuring outputs are robust, actionable, and decision-oriented.
  • Act as a senior technical and strategic leader, reviewing and shaping high-impact analytical work, experimentation design, and advanced modelling approaches where required.
  • Partner closely with senior Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Commercial leaders to define priorities, shape roadmaps, and ensure data science is embedded in strategic decision-making.
  • Translate ambiguous business problems into structured analytical and data science problems, ensuring your team delivers clear, commercially meaningful recommendations.
  • Drive adoption of scalable analytical frameworks, experimentation standards, and AI-enabled tooling to improve efficiency, consistency, and speed of decision-making across teams.
  • Champion best practices in experimentation, causal inference, segmentation, and customer understanding, ensuring statistical and analytical rigor across the organisation.
  • Build and maintain strong partnerships with Data Platform, Data Engineering and other central data functions, ensuring the team can effectively leverage shared capabilities while influencing the long-term data ecosystem.
  • Build and evolve the team’s capability through hiring, coaching, and performance management, ensuring strong technical depth and leadership within the function.
  • Identify and remove systemic blockers to high-quality analytics delivery, improving tooling, processes, ways of working and organisational effectiveness across Product Data Science while leading change that enables the team to scale.
  • Influence and align cross-functional stakeholders across multiple product domains, ensuring clarity, prioritisation, and strong decision-making discipline.

Skills & Experience

  • Experience: Extensive experience in data science or a similar quantitative role, with a proven track record of supporting and influencing a product organization.
  • Technical & Modeling Expertise: Expert Level proficiency in Python and SQL. Deep, hands-on experience with statistical modeling, (quasi) experimentation, multi-arm bandit, and a wide range of machine learning techniques (e.g., Regression, Classification, Clustering).
  • Product Acumen: Demonstrated ability to define, implement, and operationalise crucial product and feature-level metrics from scratch.
  • Strategic Influence: A proven track record of driving strategic impact through proactive and collaborative approach with the proven ability to lead technical discussions, drive product strategy, and communicate complex insights effectively to cross-functional partners (e.g., Product, Engineering, Design).
  • Scaling Impact: Experience scaling analytics or data science capabilities, driving impact through the creation of automated processes, self-service tools, or data products.
  • Critical Thinking: Leader in critical thinking, your previous experience will demonstrate the analysis of available facts, evidence, observations, and arguments in order to form a judgment by the application of rational, skeptical, and unbiased analyses and evaluation.
  • Leadership: Outstanding leadership skills, with experience in mentoring, coaching, and developing teams of analysts or data scientists.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Exceptional collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to engage, influence, and inspire cross-functional partners at all levels.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Proven ability to build strong relationships and drive outcomes across Product, Engineering, Data Platform and other central functions, often without direct authority.
  • Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Engineering, Physics, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

You could be an especially great fit if you have:

  • Experience working within a high-scale technology company, marketplace, e-commerce business, or travel technology organisation.
  • A strong technical background in Product Data Science, Data Science, Experimentation, or Machine Learning before moving into leadership roles.
  • Experience building and scaling experimentation platforms, measurement frameworks, self-service capabilities, or data products.
  • Experience applying AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, or automation technologies to improve analytics productivity and decision-making effectiveness.
  • Experience leading organisational change, improving analytical maturity, and raising standards across multiple teams or functions.
  • A reputation for raising the standard of thinking, execution, and decision-making in every team and organisation you join.

job.job_description:
Description de l'entreprise

Description De L’entreprise

Accor est un leader mondial de l’hospitalité augmentée, qui propose des expériences uniques dans 5800 hôtels et résidences implantés dans 110 destinations. Depuis plus de 50 ans, tout le savoir-faire hôtelier de Accor s’illustre à travers une collection incomparable de marques, du luxe à l’économique, adossées à l’un des programmes de fidélité les plus attractifs au monde.

ALL Accor est à la fois la plateforme de réservation et le programme de fidélité du groupe. ALL Accor propose à ses membres un vaste choix de marques hôtelières au meilleur prix, de nombreuses récompenses, des privilèges uniques par statut, un accès privilégié à des expériences inoubliables.

Description du poste

En tant qu’Assistant(e) Chef(fe) de Projet B2B Loyalty, vous rejoindrez le département Loyalty qui a pour mission de développer et gérer le programme de fidélité ALL Accor du Groupe Accor, à destination des entreprises. Vous intégrerez l’équipe en charge de la stratégie B2B du programme de fidélité, composée de 4 personnes, et votre rôle sera d’identifier des opportunités et proposer des recommandations visant à accélérer la pénétration et la performance marketing des offres du programme auprès des voyageurs professionnels et organisateurs d’évènements. A la frontière entre les Sales et le Marketing, vous évoluerez dans un environnement aux équipes transverses Sales, Produit, Distribution, Communication, Partnerships, …

Au cœur des projets stratégiques de la transformation du groupe, vous bénéficierez d’un impact direct sur la croissance de l’activité via le passage à l’échelle de nouvelles offres.

Voici les missions sur lesquelles vous serez amené à travailler en tant que stagiaire conventionné(e) :

  • Business Development & Strategy:
  • Contribuer activement au déploiement et au lancement opérationnel de notre nouvelle offre business ;
  • Identifier et cibler de nouvelles opportunités de comptes B2B (PME, ETI, … ) & partenaires potentiels susceptibles d'adhérer au programme et aux offres B2B ;
  • Concevoir et mettre à jour les pitch decks & présentations commerciales sur les offres B2B Loyalty à destination des équipes Sales et des hôtels ;
  • Participer à la création de nouvelles offres de partenariats B2B, du cadrage initial jusqu'à la phase de contractualisation ;
  • Soutenir l'organisation d'événements Sales (webinaires, évènements clients, …) pour promouvoir les offres B2B Loyalty ;
  • Réaliser une veille concurrentielle et sectorielle sur les tendances des programmes de fidélité B2B dans le secteur de l'hôtellerie et du voyage d'affaires.
  • Performance Marketing & Optimisation des offres B2B Loyalty :
  • Assurer la mise en place technique des offres B2B Loyalty et suivre leur performance ;
  • Formaliser et tester de nouvelles mécaniques d’incentive pour booster le recrutement sur le nouveau programme business ;
  • Analyser la performance des campagnes marketing B2B mises en place en central et formuler des recommandations d’optimisation ;
  • Structurer et animer un catalogue d’offres B2B2C à destination des Sales & Régions ;
  • Accompagner les équipes marketing régionales & centrales dans la création et l’optimisation de campagnes B2B marketing ;
  • Aider à la préparation des revues de performance avec les clients et partenaires externes ;
  • Améliorer la visibilité des offres Loyalty sur l’ensemble de nos canaux digitaux pour maximiser le taux de conversion ;

Autres Missions, Non Exhaustives

  • Concevoir des supports d’aide à la décision impactants pour valoriser l’apport business du programme de fidélité auprès de diverses équipes ;
  • Soutenir quotidiennement l’équipe dans le suivi, la gestion et la mise en œuvre de projets.

Ces missions pourraient évoluer en fonction des priorités stratégiques du Groupe sur lesquelles l’équipe pourrait intervenir.

Qualifications

Profil recherché

  • Vous suivez une formation Master / MBA - Bac + 4/5 de type école de commerce, école d’ingénieurs, formation universitaire en marketing, …

job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

At Delta, we connect people and cultures, power extraordinary experiences, and shape the future of travel. Here, you'll work on complex challenges on a global scale, using augmented intelligence to build emerging technologies, amplify human potential and continuously grow the skills that keep you at the forefront of what's next.

Our Digital Site domain is seeking a Senior Technical Product Engineer who combines the technical depth of an engineer, the customer obsession of a product manager, and the analytical mindset of a growth leader. This role is responsible for driving digital customer experience improvements, product innovation, experimentation, platform modernization, and measurable business outcomes across web, mobile, APIs, and enterprise platforms. The ideal candidate is highly technical, deeply data-driven, and passionate about solving customer problems at scale. They can translate business strategy into product requirements, partner with engineering teams to deliver solutions, and use analytics to continuously improve customer outcomes and business performance. This role is inspired by modern product leadership principles emphasizing growth, customer-centricity, AI-powered product development, experimentation, and cross-functional collaboration.

Key Responsibilities

  • Product Strategy & Execution
    • Own end-to-end delivery of digital product capabilities from ideation through production release.
    • Define product vision, roadmaps, business cases, success metrics, and prioritization frameworks.
    • Translate customer needs, business objectives, and technical constraints into actionable product requirements.
    • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on conversion, engagement, task accomplishment, reliability, and customer satisfaction.
  • Technical Product Leadership
    • Partner with engineering, architecture, UX, analytics, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable solutions.
    • Lead requirements definition for APIs, microservices, system integrations, cloud-native platforms, and enterprise applications.
    • Evaluate technical trade-offs and guide solution design decisions with engineering teams.
    • Support modernization initiatives involving cloud platforms, AI/ML capabilities, customer data platforms, personalization engines, and digital experience platforms.
  • Data, Analytics & Experimentation
    • Define KPIs, success metrics, instrumentation requirements, and experimentation plans.
    • Use customer behavior analytics, A/B testing, funnel analysis, and operational metrics to drive decision-making.
    • Identify growth opportunities through customer journey analysis and experimentation.
    • Build executive-level insights and recommendations backed by quantitative and qualitative data.
  • Customer Experience & Growth
    • Champion customer-centric product design and usability improvements.
    • Drive initiatives that improve conversion, retention, self-service adoption, and digital engagement.
    • Partner with UX teams to identify and eliminate customer friction points.
    • Leverage customer feedback, analytics, and market research to prioritize high-impact opportunities.
  • AI & Emerging Technology Adoption
    • Evaluate and implement AI-driven product opportunities.
    • Partner with engineering teams to identify automation and operational efficiency improvements.
    • Apply modern product development practices using AI-assisted tools, rapid prototyping, and experimentation techniques.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership
    • Influence stakeholders across business, technology, operations, and executive leadership.
    • Facilitate roadmap discussions, backlog prioritization, sprint planning, and release readiness.
    • Communicate product strategy, progress, risks, and outcomes to senior leadership.
    • Mentor junior product and engineering team members.
What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related experience.
  • Experience working with APIs, cloud technologies, distributed systems, and enterprise-scale digital platforms.
  • Demonstrated success improving measurable customer and business outcomes through data-driven product decisions.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience using tools such as Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, Amplitude, Mixpanel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.
  • Excellent verbal, written, and executive communication skills.
  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile, Scrum, and modern engineering practices.
  • 8+ years of experience in Product Management, Technical Product Management, Software Engineering, Product Engineering, or related disciplines.
  • Growth mindset and experimentation-first approach.
  • Passion for AI, modern product management, and continuous learning.
  • Ability to connect strategy, technology, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Exceptional product thinking and customer empathy.
  • Experienced in iterative and incremental product delivery
  • Experience with agile processes including scrum and comfortable running scrum ceremonies
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency.
  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience in eCommerce, travel, fintech, marketplace, loyalty, digital commerce, or consumer-facing digital products.
  • Experience with AI-enabled products, personalization platforms, experimentation frameworks, or customer data platforms.
  • Familiarity with cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Experience with customer journey mapping, product growth frameworks, and conversion optimization.
  • MBA or advanced degree preferred.

Benefits And Perks To Help You Keep Climbing

Our culture is rooted in a shared dedication to living our values – Care, Integrity, Resilience and Servant Leadership – every day, in everything we do. At Delta, our people are our success. At the heart of what we offer is our focus on Sharing Success with Delta employees. Exploring a career at Delta gives you a chance to see the world while earning great compensation and benefits to help you keep climbing along the way:

  • Competitive salary, industry-leading proﬁt sharing program, and performance incentives
  • 401(k) with generous company contributions up to 9%
  • New hires are eligible for up to 2-weeks of vacation. This is earned for use in the following vacation year (April 1 – March 31)
  • In addition to vacation, new hires are eligible for up to 56 hours of paid personal time within a 12-month period
  • 10 paid holidays per calendar year
  • Birthing parents are eligible for 12-weeks of paid maternity/parental leave
  • Non-birthing parents are eligible for 2-weeks of paid parental leave
  • Comprehensive health beneﬁts including medical, dental, vision, short/long term disability and life insurance beneﬁts
  • Family care assistance through fertility support, surrogacy and adoption assistance, lactation support, subsidized back-up care, and programs that help with loved ones in all stages
  • Holistic Wellbeing programs to support physical, emotional, social, and financial health, including access to an employee assistance program offering support for you and anyone in your household, free financial coaching, and extensive resources supporting mental health
  • Domestic and International space-available flight privileges for employees and eligible family members
  • Career development programs to achieve your long-term career goals
  • World-wide partnerships to engage in community service and innovative goals created to focus on sustainability and reducing our carbon footprint
  • Business Resource Groups created to connect employees with common interests to promote inclusion, provide perspective and help implement strategies
  • Recognition rewards and awards through the platform Unstoppable Together

Introduction To The Team

Expedia Group is seeking a Director of Product Management to lead the strategy, roadmap, execution, and people development for customer relationship management (CRM) and communications products.

This leader will shape how Expedia Group delivers personalized, timely, measurable, and compliant customer communications across email, push, SMS, in-product, transactional, and emerging channels. The role will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data, Marketing, Analytics, Legal, Privacy, and Operations teams.

In This Role, You Will

  • Define and execute the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities for CRM and customer communications products across email, push, SMS, in-product, transactional, and emerging channels.
  • Lead the evolution of customer data, marketing automation, messaging, personalization, journey orchestration, experimentation, and analytics capabilities to deliver measurable customer and business outcomes.
  • Partner with Engineering and Data teams to improve audience activation, identity, consent, preferences, suppression, data quality, measurement, APIs, integrations, data models, and platform architecture.
  • Establish scalable product discovery, intake, prioritization, requirements, delivery, adoption, and operating practices that improve speed, quality, reliability, compliance, and customer experience.
  • Evaluate build, buy, and configure decisions across Salesforce and comparable enterprise platforms while aligning stakeholders on priorities, tradeoffs, risks, and outcomes.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing product team while safely integrating and operating AI/ML-enabled solutions that improve customer engagement and product-team effectiveness.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of product management experience with a Masters, 12+ with a Bachelors, or equivalent related professional experience
  • Significant product management experience leading multiple products, platforms, or interconnected capabilities within CRM, customer engagement, marketing technology, communications, data, or a related technical domain.
  • Demonstrated experience managing, developing, and scaling product teams, including setting goals, decision rights, operating rhythms, and career-development plans.
  • Experience owning product strategy and execution across a multi-product or platform scope, with accountability for prioritization, delivery, adoption, and measurable customer and business outcomes.
  • Strong technical fluency across APIs, data models, integrations, identity, platform architecture, customer data, personalization, journey orchestration, experimentation, analytics, and privacy.
  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Salesforce Data Cloud, or comparable enterprise platforms, along with familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real-world products.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience applying AI/ML-enabled automation and responsible AI practices to personalization, customer communications, engagement optimization, or product-team workflows.
  • Experience leading CRM and communications product portfolios at scale across multiple channels, customer journeys, enterprise platforms, and stakeholder groups.
  • Proven ability to establish architecture-informed product direction and make effective build, buy, and configure decisions across complex integrations, data ecosystems, identity, consent, and measurement capabilities.
  • Track record of using experimentation, analytics, and operational metrics to improve customer engagement, product adoption, reliability, compliance, and business performance.
  • Experience creating scalable product operating models, developing diverse product talent, and influencing executive stakeholders through clear tradeoff, risk, prioritization, and investment recommendations.

Are you ready to turn your love of travel into a career that takes you further than you ever imagined personally and professionally? Navigate your career. Explore the world.

What you’ll be doing - where your passion will meet purpose!

What we’re looking for - do you have the travel bug?

  • You’re a seasoned traveller with a history of international destinations (and even more on your bucket list!) and you’re the go-to person in your circle for travel recommendations, tips and tricks
  • Great organisational skills - you’re the type to take notes, manage your calendar well and are quick to respond to your customer’s phone calls and emails
  • Determination to meet your sales targets and KPIs while balancing your workload in a high-pressure environment (think customers lining up, phones ringing, email inbox filling!)
  • Enthusiasm, passion and a warmth that makes our customers want to book with you every time!
  • A savviness with computers, ready to toggle between various complex systems when finding the right flight and package options for your customer

What you will gain from a career with Flight Centre - let’s unpack the benefits!

💲 We'll boost your wage to $65K equivalent for your first 90 days while you learn the ropes! Average earnings for a Travel Consultant in their first year are $70K, while Senior Consultants average $100K and Team Leaders average $138K annually - including superannuation and penalty rates.

💎 Brightness of Future: Career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses across the globe - we promote from within   

🎉 Social: Embrace the famous Flight Centre culture at our Reward & Recognition events throughout the year including our most popular events on the calendar Global Gathering and EOFY Celebration

🎓 Get qualified for free with a Certificate 3 & 4 in Travel & Tourism (worth 20k!) through Australian Apprentice Training - you may also be eligible to receive direct financial support while you study 

🌈 Thrive in a workplace that embraces individualism – come as you are!  

💛 Be part of a workplace committed to reconciliation through our Reconciliation Action Plan - we proudly support Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander inclusion, cultural safety, and dedicated cultural leave

Okay, I’m in!

Are you keen to join our team of Flighties? Hit apply now for your application to be read by a real human, no AI here! If your application is successful, you’ll be invited to have a 15-minute phone interview with one of our dedicated team of recruiters. Get ready to work, travel and grow.

Why is Flight Centre such a great place to work?

We are devoted to being a global employer of choice by nurturing our legendary culture - focused on our people and infused with adventure and accountability. About the Job:

As Crowne Plaza Melbourne Carlton continues its exciting inaugural year, you will play a key role in building market presence, securing new business opportunities, and establishing the hotel as a sought-after destination for conferences, events, and group accommodation. Working closely with clients and hotel teams, you will drive sales, develop lasting relationships, and deliver exceptional experiences that contribute to the hotel's ongoing success.

What we are looking for:

Commencing in December 2026, the ideal candidate will possess exceptional organisational and communication skills, strong attention to detail, and a proven track record in securing business and delivering successful conferences, events, and group accommodation. You will manage the full event lifecycle, from initial enquiry and contracting through to execution and post-event follow-up. Working closely with clients and hotel teams, you will maximise revenue opportunities while delivering exceptional service and memorable experiences.

Responsibilities:

Business

  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities, including corporate clients, associations, event planners, and React to all new sales leads to ensure business growth and conversion. At all times understanding the clients needs while optimising hotel revenue.
  • Build long-term relationships with clients to generate repeat business, referrals, and ongoing loyalty to both the hotel and IHG brands.
  • Monitor business performance, competitor activity and local market demand generators to identify opportunities, develop compelling promotions and enhance the overall guest and client experience.
  • Ensure correct and accurate billing and post stay communication with clients
  • Collaborate as part of the hotel commercial team to promote and market the hotel's conferencing and event facilities, driving revenue and maximizing occupancy.
  • Negotiate contracts and pricing with vendors, such as audio-visual suppliers, decorators, entertainers, and transportation providers, to secure the best value for the hotel and clients.

job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

At Delta Air Lines, connection is at the heart of everything we do and guides our every action. We strive to welcome and care for all our customers during their travels with us and aim to deliver an elevated experience.

Delta is on a journey to become a world‑class retailer—consistently offering, selling, and servicing high‑quality, personalized products in customers’ channels of choice.
