job.job_description:
About Marketplace

Booking.com's Marketplace unit turns travel goals into travel realities. Our purpose? To create frictionless experiences at each and every stage of the trip. From browsing to booking and beyond, our focus is on building the connected experiences which make journeys smoother, faster and more enjoyable. Think of us as travel matchmakers, ensuring seamless integration across our product verticals to effortlessly and intuitively connect traveler preferences and actions.

The Marketplace mission is to truly understand traveller needs and behaviour across multiple verticals, design and implement common traveller-facing product experiences, steward travellers to the right vertical offering, and grow Connected Trips, where travellers not only book hotels or homes, but also flights, car rentals, rides, and local attractions with us. The long-term mission of Marketplace is to grow traveller loyalty through delivering phenomenal product experience, by evolving our customer loyalty program, and by ensuring Booking.com supports our travellers in the right way throughout their trip. Marketplace Business Unit runs the common parts of our website and app, as well as is responsible for key Booking.com-wide capabilities, such as the User Experience, Experimentation Platform, Measurement, and operational Predictive ML models.

Senior Director Engineering - Connected Trip Experience & Data

As Senior Director Engineering, you will lead the engineering organisation behind the Connected Trip: the experiences travelers use to plan, search, book and manage a whole trip, the shared foundations those experiences are built on, and the data and AI spine that makes them intelligent. Marketplace runs the common parts of Booking.com's website and app, plus company-wide capabilities including user experience, the experimentation platform, measurement and operational ML models. That means the systems your teams build reach travelers across 28M+ listings, 174,000 destinations and 44 languages, and are depended on by every business unit in the company.

We hire the best and the brightest professionals, and we empower them to innovate, you need to have:

  • First hand experience of building customer centric experiences at scale on AI, Mobile, and web platforms in partnership with Product
  • Experience of leading technology organisations at scale
  • Demonstrable experience of partnership with senior stakeholders in and out of technology across matrix organisations
  • Deep engineering and technology leadership background who can influence and shape our technology narrative including engineering best practice, AI adoption and modernisation
  • Demonstrable experience at building and growing a collaborative, high trust and focused organisation
  • Demonstrable experience of leading organisations involved in data & AI products & services


Role can be based in Amsterdam or Manchester.

Your focus will be:

  • Leading the Technology organisations for Connected Trip Product Experience, Foundations and Data.
  • Deeply partnering with Product & Data, planning and delivering to meet our objectives
  • Embedding Gen AI into our Customer Experience, Ways of Working and Data platforms
  • Continually raising the maturity and capability of the organisation so that we are fast, sharp and focused
  • Ensuring your organisation is engaged, focused and resilient.


Desired Outcomes:

  • Deliver on Connected Trip product and Data & AI ambition
  • Evolve and execute our technology strategy improving tech maturity, scalability, agility, and efficiency, and ensuring future-proofing
  • Embed Data & AI deeply into the organisation from a Customer, Builder and Platform perspective
  • Deeply embed customer centricity into the habits of your organisation
  • Highly engaged, motivated and focused organisation empowered to deliver at speed.
  • Technology thought leadership and partnership in and out of Marketplace to drive our strategy forward.
  • Ensure the technology strategy is clearly communicated and understood across the organization, and drive adoption and execution.
  • Drive alignment and buy-in from both tech and non-tech stakeholders by effectively influencing and collaborating at all levels.


B. Responsible

People & Function Leadership

  • Lead, inspire and motivate your Engineering function through leading by example and setting expectations around what success looks like, giving ownership and providing clarity when necessary
  • Line manage Directors and Senior Managers as well as top technical talent, such as Principals.
  • Communicate strategy in a compelling manner to multiple teams and relevant stakeholders
  • Foster inclusion by holding self and others accountable
  • Drive people centric initiatives that enable workforce diversity
  • Organisational design, strategy and budget to ensure we are set up to deliver on our strategic agenda
  • Partner in and outside of our Business unit to lead and shape the people agenda across Booking.com
  • Create a learning environment by coaching, two-way feedback, helping people extract and share personal learnings, and support teams to constantly adapt
  • Foster a positive engineering culture who innovate, work as a team and celebrate success
  • Build a world class team through nurturing, attracting, and retaining tech talent from around the world
  • Empower your teams to do their best work at Booking.com
  • Be curious, learn, iterate and shape our culture
  • Deputise for the VP


Technology, Craft & Delivery Leadership

  • Create long-term plans that align with the overall focus of the business
  • Lead, influence and own delivery within your function including department goals
  • Partner with other functions and business units to deliver on our strategic agenda
  • Maintain focus on the end goal, minimise risk and remove roadblocks for our strategic agenda
  • Ensure clear and effective communication at all levels: proactively keep all stakeholders informed of what’s happening, upcoming changes, projects, issues and risks
  • Foster mastery in engineering craftsmanship across Booking.com including shaping ways of working
  • Own Technology-wide topics and help lead and grow the department
  • Embed Agile ways of working and values within the organisation
  • Identify problems and significantly improve, change or adapt existing methods and techniques drawing from personal experiences and feedback
  • Drive a DevOps culture


Technology, Architecture & Product Strategy

  • Shape, define and build new products, processes and operational plans in alignment with the commercial and financial needs of the business
  • Lead, take ownership and shape the technology strategic objectives and roadmaps
  • Be a strategic thought partner and influence senior stakeholders across the Accommodations and the broader business to set and align the strategic direction of your function
  • Make decisions in complex and ambiguous situations, and guide others in their decision making by recognizing and challenging assumptions, introducing relevant data and multiple perspectives
  • Ensure that the Booking architecture principles and engineering practices are adhered to, and that there is direction and alignment for each product.
  • Anticipate the need for changes based on context, and set renewed courses of action to engage teams and achieve goals, while striving to make the impact clear and understandable
  • Drive innovation in your function
  • Own the architecture across your function


B.Skilled

  • Extensive years of Tech Leadership experience
  • Experience with large scale platforms and high traffic (100,000+ visitors per day), preferably E-commerce sites or marketplace companies
  • Demonstrable experience of building, shaping and leading a cross functional Engineering function or business unit at scale (150/200+ people)
  • Must understand technology and have a proven track record of designing and building high quality web and mobile applications especially high volume consumer facing applications
  • Demonstrable experience of working in Agile environments and more importantly an Agile culture and ethos
  • Demonstrable experience of setting, leading and influencing both the Engineering and Business strategy to the medium and long-term
  • Experience with managing and coaching teams of senior tech leaders including building and growing teams
  • Independent, pragmatic and proactive work attitude
  • Well versed in Engineering Craftsmanship
  • Cloud based technologies
  • Building a DevOps culture
  • Be humble and human
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Strong commercial acumen
  • Be able to deputise for the VP of Engineering

As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Finance Manager

Growth Marketing Finance is looking for a Finance Manager to join its Financial Planning & Analysis team, serving as the finance business partner for Expedia Group's Brand Awareness portfolio. This role is the financial connective tissue across some of EG's most visible and complex marketing investment — spanning upper-funnel Brand Media, Sponsorships, Demand Generation, Global Communications, PR, Influencer/Creator, Creative production, and media agency economics.

Do you have a passion for brand and upper-funnel marketing economics and the ability to translate complex, multi-channel spend into clear commercial insight? Are you energized by working across creative, comms, and sponsorship teams who think differently than traditional performance marketers? Do you know how to build trust with senior stakeholders while holding firm on financial governance? Then this role is for you.

What You Will Do

Financial Planning, Forecasting & Close

  • Own annual planning, quarterly outlooks, and monthly close across all Brand Awareness channels — Brand Media, DG, Sponsorships, Global Communications, PR, Influencer/Creator, and Creative production
  • Maintain brand-, market-, and channel-level spend views by working and non-working category, ensuring accurate load and reconciliation to central finance targets
  • Perform variance analysis on actuals versus plan and forecast, translating drivers into clear narratives for channel leaders and senior finance stakeholders
  • Manage close and accrual processes, including Brand Media reclasses, accrual submissions, PO versus AP cutoff alignment, and invoice timing across agencies and vendors
  • Partner with Accounting, Procurement, and AP teams to ensure financial controls are applied consistently across all spend categories

Brand Media & Sponsorships

  • Serve as the finance business partner for Brand Media and Sponsorships, supporting investment cases, deal structures, rights fee evaluation, payment scheduling, and forecast pacing for major partnerships (e.g. sports, entertainment, licensing)
  • Govern working versus non-working classification for sponsorship elements — including media components, activation, IP/rights, and production — and resolve classification ambiguities across brands and markets
  • Partner with the OMD media agency team on SOW governance, agency fee reconciliation, committed spend tracking, procurement alignment, and scope change evaluation
  • Support contract, CARF, PO, and invoice approvals for media and sponsorship commitments, confirming budget availability and ensuring compliance with finance governance standards

DG, Global Communications & Influencer/Creator

  • Support Demand Generation budget ownership, including working media forecasts, transfers, incremental approvals, and unallocated budget management across brands
  • Own the non-working budget view across Global Communications, PR, Creative, Research, Sponsorships, and influencer/creator support costs — and maintain baseline, reduction, and uncommitted-initiative scenarios for leadership
  • Govern influencer and creator finance, including working spend (paid amplification, whitelisting, dark posts, creator content distribution) and non-working costs (talent management, retainers, licensing, travel, legal, and operations), ensuring clear classification and accurate forecasting
  • Partner with Global Comms, PR, and organic social teams on budget governance, accruals, and spend pacing across communications activations, media relations, and PR-adjacent campaigns
  • Manage Creative production finance, including agency fees, OOH production, and campaign development costs, and support purchase approvals and requisitions across creative vendor and agency spend

Reporting, Governance & Executive Support

  • Build and maintain executive-ready reporting on Brand Awareness budget, forecast, commitments, risks, and trade-offs — across brands (BEX, HCOM, Vrbo) and by channel and cost type
  • Develop integrated campaign financial support, from investment case through post-campaign readout, covering media, sponsorships, PR, organic, influencer, and creative components
  • Provide finance guidance on non-working versus working spend framework evolution, particularly as influencer, creator, and Global Comms classifications continue to develop
  • Challenge investment choices using brand measurement frameworks, reach and awareness metrics, campaign effectiveness data, and brand-health indicators — not only short-term ROAS
  • Support senior leadership decisions on sponsorship investments, reallocations, budget trade-offs, and scenario planning, providing clear and timely financial context

Who You Are

  • Advanced analytical, modeling, and forecasting skills; Advanced Excel required, SQL experience preferred
  • Experience in brand, media, or marketing finance; familiarity with working versus non-working budget frameworks strongly preferred
  • Ability to manage complexity across multiple channels, stakeholders, and cost categories simultaneously — without losing accuracy or commercial perspective
  • Strong communication skills; able to translate financial complexity into clear, confident recommendations for creative, comms, and brand audiences who are not finance-native
  • High intellectual curiosity and ownership mindset; you build and improve processes, not just report against them
  • Comfortable working with ambiguity, including evolving budget definitions and classification frameworks in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
  • BA required; MBA preferred
  • 5+ years of relevant finance experience with increasing levels of responsibility, including at least 2 years in a marketing or media finance role

Expedia Group recognizes our success is dependent on the success of our people. We are a global travel platform, made up of the most knowledgeable, passionate, and creative people in our business. Our brands recognize the power of travel to break down barriers and bring the world within reach — that responsibility inspires us to be the place where exceptional people want to do their best work, and to provide them the tools to do so.

Whether you're applying to work in engineering or customer support, marketing or lodging supply, at Expedia Group we act as one team, working towards a common goal; to bring the world within reach. What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a People Support Specialist in the People Team you will be in charge of:

  • Next-Gen Payroll & Compliance Support
  • Collaborate with local teams and external payroll providers to coordinate payroll and employee relations across assigned European locations.
  • Provide monthly operational support and backup coverage for the Spanish payroll cycle (including Social Security, tax alignment, and resolving employee inquiries).
  • Ensure compliance with local labor laws, collective bargaining agreements, and regulations across assigned international sites.
  • AI Initiative: Work as a team to identify opportunities to implement automated workflows and AI-driven auditing tools that eliminate manual errors in payroll and tax processing.
  • Managing the Employee Lifecycle & Experience
  • Drive and manage the full employee cycle, from seamless onboarding and welcoming new starters to supportive offboarding processes.
  • Manage employee documentation, benefits, and leave administration (sick leave, maternity/paternity, IT/leaves of absence) with precision.
  • Act as a friendly and reliable point of contact for employee queries across international sites and Spain, working closely with HR colleagues to provide timely resolution.
  • AI Initiative: Leverage AI tools and automated ticketing systems to streamline response times and deliver an efficient, high-quality experience for all team members during working hours.
  • Data Intelligence & Strategy
  • Maintain "Data Excellence" within our HRIS through close teamwork, ensuring all employee records are accurate, up-to-date, and compliant with privacy standards.
  • Generate insightful operational reports to support data-driven decision-making across the People Support Team.
  • AI Initiative: Utilize predictive analytics and AI tools to track key operational metrics, such as employee turnover trends, request volumes, and process bottlenecks.


What you need to succeed:

Good to have

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:

  • Team Player: Strong collaborative spirit and interpersonal skills, with a proven track record of working effectively in international and multi-location teams.
  • Languages: Full professional proficiency in English and Spanish is required. Mid-to-high proficiency in French or German is highly valued to support our international sites.
  • Tech Stack: Advanced Excel skills. Experience working with HRIS platforms and strong AI literacy (familiarity with LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI-integrated HR tools).
  • The AI Mindset: A genuine interest in how Artificial Intelligence and automation can optimize HR workflows and eliminate repetitive administrative tasks.
  • Compliance & Ethics: Strong awareness of GDPR and a "security-first" mindset when handling sensitive employee data.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Applied AI Tools: Demonstrated comfort using practical AI tools such as Gemini, or other AI-powered assistants.

Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
  • Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.

job.job_description:
Introduction

Drive revenue performance across a diverso portfolio of hotels while working at the heart of data-driven commercial strategy. This role offers the opportunity to partner closely with hotel and commercial teams to optimise pricing, demand, and distribution performance across multiple markets. If you’re passionate about revenue strategy, analytics, and influencing business outcomes, this is a role where you can make a measurable impact.

Your day to day

  • Act as the revenue lead for a portfolio of hotels, driving pricing, demand, and distribution strategies through regular performance reviews and ongoing engagement with hotel teams
  • Use data, insights, and market intelligence to identify performance opportunities and implement strategies to maximise revenue and profitability across the portfolio
  • Partner with commercial, sales, and marketing teams to align strategies, improve channel performance, and optimise overall revenue delivery
  • Support the rollout of new systems, tools, and revenue initiatives, ensuring strong adoption and capability across teams
  • Contribute to and lead key projects that enhance revenue management practices, processes, and overall performance outcomes
  • Coach and support team members, building capability and strengthening the overall revenue management talent pipeline

What We Need From You

  • Proven experience (6+ years) in revenue management, pricing, or commercial strategy, ideally within hospitality or a similar industry
  • Strong understanding of revenue management principles, pricing strategies, and demand optimisation techniques
  • Highly analytical with the ability to translate data, market insights, and trends into clear, actionable strategies
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and align cross-functional teams
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment
  • Leadership mindset with the ability to coach, develop, and inspire others while driving performance outcome

At IHG Hotels & Resorts, we work together to deliver True Hospitality for Good on a global scale. With corporate offices and over 6,000 hotel destinations worldwide, a career at IHG is the perfect way to broaden your horizons. You’ll experience our unique culture and brilliant colleagues who will support and inspire you. With a host of corporate opportunities to choose from, wherever you are on your career journey, and whatever you want to achieve there’s Room for You at IHG.

Over recent years, we’ve transformed our company. We have bold ambitions to drive performance and maintain our relentless focus on growth in order to be the hotel company of choice that guests & owners love.

We are a hospitality business at our core and value connections and being together helps us foster a unique sense of belonging that also supports productivity. That’s why here at IHG, we give our colleagues flexibility and balance – working in a hybrid way, blending office and remote working collectively. We recognise that every role is different, that’s why leaders work with teams to determine how and when they collaborate.

We provide a wide range of benefits designed to help you live your best work life. These include impressive room discounts across our many properties, recharge days and volunteering days throughout the year. Through our myWellbeing framework, we are committed to supporting wellbeing in your health, lifestyle, and workplace. We offer a unique and inclusive culture, where there is always Room for You to belong, grow and make a difference.

Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams where we celebrate difference and encourage colleagues to bring their whole selves to work. IHG Hotels & Resorts provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other category protected by applicable laws. We promote a culture of trust, support, and acceptance. Always welcoming different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

job.job_description:
Organization- Hyatt Corporate Office

Summary

The Opportunity

Hyatt Hotels Corporation seeks an enthusiastic Sales Specialist to join our growing Central Sales Management department, where you’ll focus on group lead response for a portfolio of Full-Service hotels. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list since 2013. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

  • Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on-site fitness center
  • A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption
  • Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

The Role

The Central Services – Sales Specialist is someone who has demonstrated through performance a thorough understanding and competence in Group Sales, Hyatt systems and the hotel/business travel industry. The Central Sales –Sales Specialist will be responsible for supporting a sales funnel at Full-Service properties. They will receive leads from many different sources, interact with clients, create proposals, and respond in a way that is beneficial for each hotel and their individual goals. This person may also be responsible managing a sales funnel and contracting business. This person will utilize Envision and other sales tools to promptly respond to leads to increase conversion and revenue.

They will have thorough experience with professional selling skills: opening, probing, supporting, closing. Must possess exceptional negotiating skills. Must be proficient in general computer knowledge and able to train and monitor the process of sending referrals, setting traces and profiling accounts. Communication and organizational skills are of utmost importance for this position.

Qualifications

Experience Required

  • Previous Hyatt Group Sales Experience

Experience Preferred:

  • A true desire to satisfy the needs of other in a fast-paced environment
  • Refined verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong organization and presentation skills
  • Must be able to work independently and simultaneously manage multiple tasks
  • Must be outgoing and a proven self-starter
  • A minimum of 3-5 years of hotel sales or comparable experience preferred
  • Must be proficient in general computer knowledge, Envision, Opera and CVENT

The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all-encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary.

The salary range for this position is $75,000-$80,000. This position is also eligible to earn incentive awards, an annual bonus, monthly or quarterly incentives, etc.

The final pay rate/salary offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level, and other qualifications for the role, as well as the location of the performance of work.Pay for the successful candidate will meet local requirements, including the local minimum wage rate.

We welcome you:

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.

We value our relationships with recruitment partners and require that agencies contact us first before submitting any candidates. Hyatt will not be responsible for any fees and obligations associated with unsolicited submissions unless a formal agreement is in place.

KAYAK is seeking a Manager, Kubernetes Operations to lead the team responsible for the reliability, scalability, and security of our container orchestration platform. In this role, you will combine deep technical expertise with a genuine passion for people leadership — guiding a team of platform engineers while shaping the strategy that keeps our containerized production environment running at global scale. You will be a key partner to engineering, security, and infrastructure teams, helping KAYAK move faster and more safely by building a platform your colleagues can depend on.

In This Role You Will

  • Own the technical roadmap and operational strategy for the Kubernetes platform, ensuring cluster reliability, scalability, and security across production and non-production environments.
  • Lead a team of container platform engineers, taking full responsibility for hiring, performance management, and career development to build a high-performing, inclusive team.
  • Deliver a continuously improving container platform by driving cluster lifecycle management — including version upgrades, node provisioning, capacity planning, and workload migration from legacy orchestration platforms.
  • Coach engineers on Kubernetes best practices, container security, RBAC design, and operational excellence, fostering a culture of ownership and continuous learning.
  • Collaborate closely with software engineering, security, and infrastructure teams to ensure containerized workloads are reliable, observable, and deployable with confidence.
  • Drive the adoption of infrastructure-as-code and GitOps practices for cluster configuration and application deployment, reducing manual toil and improving consistency across environments.
  • Design and enforce standards for Kubernetes observability — including metrics collection, alerting, and dashboarding — so the team can detect and resolve incidents quickly and conduct effective post-incident reviews.
  • Hold the team to a high standard of operational excellence, including on-call practices, incident response, and blameless post-mortems.
  • Collaborate with adjacent operations and engineering leaders to align the Kubernetes platform roadmap with broader infrastructure and product engineering goals.
  • Advance the team's security posture by partnering with security teams on cluster hardening, network policy enforcement, and compliance requirements.

Please Apply If You Have

  • 8+ years of experience in SRE, DevOps, or platform/infrastructure engineering, with at least 3 years in an engineering leadership or management role.
  • A proven track record of operating large-scale, 24/7 production Kubernetes environments, including cluster lifecycle management (upgrades, node provisioning, capacity planning) and workload migration from legacy container orchestration platforms.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise with Kubernetes — including RBAC design, network policy, cluster hardening, and multi-environment operations spanning on-premises and cloud infrastructure.
  • A strong technical foundation in both on premise and cloud infrastructure (GCP and/or AWS) and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform and Ansible.
  • Experience as a people manager with a demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and retain engineering talent, and a commitment to building inclusive, high-performing teams.
  • Solid experience with modern observability tooling — such as Prometheus, Grafana, or equivalent — including alerting, dashboarding, and incident-driven tuning.
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting or automation language (Python, Go, or Bash) to support infrastructure-as-code workflows and reduce operational toil.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate a clear technical vision and work effectively with cross-functional engineering, security, and product teams.
  • A degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Benefits and Perks

  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year
  • Focus on mental health and well-being:
    • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
    • Company-paid subscription to HeadSpace
    • Company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)
    • No meeting Fridays
  • Paid parental leave
  • Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday
  • Paid volunteer time
  • Focus on your career growth:
    • Development Dollars
    • Leadership development
    • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings
    • Travel Discounts
    • Employee Resource Groups
  • Competitive retirement and health plans
  • Free lunch 2 days per week
  • Fun quarterly events such as boat trips, arcades, ski trips, Thursday happy hours, and more
EQUITY ELIGIBLE

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. The range for this Massachusetts based role is $175,000-$200,000, not inclusive of annual bonus and recurring RSU grants.

We offer a competitive base salary and benefits including: health benefits; flexible spending account; retirement benefits; life insurance; paid time off (including PTO, paid sick leave, medical leave, bereavement leave, floating holidays and paid holidays); and parental leave benefits.

INCLUSION

At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That's why we're focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here.

Need any adjustments for the interview, application or on the job? No problem - just give us a heads-up. We've got you.

job.job_description:
Title: Associate Director - Marketing

Location: Gurgaon


Job Description



Who We Are:

Fareportal is a travel technology company powering a next-generation travel concierge service. Utilizing its innovative technology and company owned and operated global contact centres, Fareportal has built strong industry partnerships providing customers access to over 500 airlines, a million lodgings, and hundreds of car rental companies around the globe. With a portfolio of consumer travel brands including CheapOair and OneTravel, Fareportal enables consumers to book-online, on mobile apps for iOS and Android, by phone, or live chat. Fareportal provides its airline partners with access to a broad customer base that books high-yielding international travel and add-on ancillaries.


FAREPORTAL HIGHLIGHTS:


  • Fareportal is the number 1 privately held online travel company in flight volume.
  • Fareportal partners with over 600 airlines, 1 million lodgings, and hundreds of car rental companies worldwide.
  • 2019 annual sales exceeded $5 billion.
  • Fareportal sees over 150 million unique visitors annually to our desktop and mobile sites.


Fareportal, with its global workforce of over 2,600 employees, is strategically positioned with 9 offices in 6 countries and headquartered in New York City.


Role Overview


We are looking for a data-driven Associate Director - Marketing to help scale and optimize marketing performance for our e-commerce business. The role focuses on analyzing marketing channels, customer behavior, and campaign performance to drive profitable growth.

You will play a key role in customer lifetime value (LTV) analysis, customer segmentation, and experimentation, helping the marketing and product teams make data-backed decisions to improve acquisition efficiency, retention, and overall marketing ROI.


Key Responsibilities


Marketing Performance Analysis:

  • Analyze performance across marketing channels including Paid Search, Paid Social, Display, Affiliates, SEO, Email, and App campaigns o Track and monitor key metrics such as CAC, ROAS, LTV, conversion rate, CTR, and AOV o Build dashboards and reports to track daily, weekly, and monthly marketing performance.
  • Identify trends and insights to improve campaign efficiency and marketing ROI.


Customer Lifetime Value (LTV) Analysis:

  • Develop and maintain LTV models to understand the long-term value of customers acquired through different channels.
  • Analyze LTV vs CAC across channels, campaigns, and customer cohorts o Support marketing budget allocation based on profitability and payback periods.
  • Monitor cohort performance and repeat purchase behavior.


Customer Segmentation & Behavioral Analysis :

  • Create and maintain customer segmentation frameworks based on acquisition channel, behavior, demographics, and purchase patterns.
  • Analyze high-value customer segments and identify opportunities for targeted acquisition.
  • Support marketing and CRM teams with segmentation insights for retention and lifecycle campaigns.
  • Conduct deep-dive analysis into new vs returning customers, high-value cohorts, and churn patterns.


Experimentation & A/B Testing :

  • Design, run, and analyze A/B tests and marketing experiments across campaigns, creatives, landing pages, and targeting strategies.
  • Measure experiment results and provide statistically sound insights and recommendations.
  • Work with marketing and product teams to build a structured experimentation roadmap.
  • Track and document learnings from experiments to improve future campaigns.


Attribution & Measurement:

  • Support development and analysis of multi-touch attribution models.
  • Analyze the contribution of brand vs non-brand marketing channels.
  • Ensure accurate tracking across analytics platforms (e.g., GA4, AppsFlyer, Amplitude, Mixpanel).


Reporting & Business Insights :

  • Build dashboards and automated reports using SQL, Excel, and BI tools.
  • Present actionable insights to marketing, product, and leadership teams.
  • Translate complex data into clear business recommendations.


Required Skills & Qualifications


Experience:

8-12 years of experience in marketing analytics, growth analytics, or digital analytics. Experience working with e-commerce, marketplaces, or consumer tech companies

Technical Skills:

Strong SQL and Python skills for data extraction and analysis, Advanced

Excel / Google Sheets skills, Experience with BI tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or Data

Studio), Familiarity with Google Analytics (GA4) or similar analytics platforms.

Analytical Skills:

Experience building LTV and cohort analysis models, Strong

understanding of customer segmentation techniques, Experience designing and analyzing A/B tests and marketing experiments.


Disclaimer

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Fareportal reserves the right to change the job duties, responsibilities, expectations or requirements posted here at any time at the Company’s sole discretion, with or without notice.

  • Innovation and Optimization: Continuously refine and enhance our inventory growth tactics and playbooks, driving innovation.
  • Entrepreneurial Impact: Leverage your entrepreneurial spirit to think about scaled implementation and optimization of initiatives within a dynamic startup environment.

Your toolkit

  • Skilled at data-driven discovery: you ask the right questions, know where to look for data, spot the root cause behind a symptom, and document clearly.

• At Qantas, our teams come together to create new and unique experiences for our customers
  • A fantastic opportunity to lead and coach squads to deliver world class products
  • Full-time permanent position based at our new Product and Innovation Centre in Adelaide


Join Qantas in our brand-new Product and Innovation Centre located in Adelaide to help meet evolving consumer needs by enabling agile teams to deliver faster, more adaptive solutions that prioritise customer value, continuous feedback, and innovation at every stage of the product lifecycle.


As the Agile Delivery Lead, you will sit across digital product streams including mobile applications, conversational AI and customer servicing. You will lead agile squads to deliver features aligned with strategic goals, while mentoring teams to improve delivery practices and agile maturity. You’ll foster a culture of autonomy, collaboration, and transparency.


Your primary responsibility is to plan and coordinate product delivery, ensuring alignment to agreed agile practices and frameworks. You’ll coach teams to improve agile maturity, foster collaboration, and remove impediments to maintain delivery flow. By driving continuous improvement, reducing waste, and optimising resource utilisation, you’ll help teams deliver value early and consistently.


This is a unique opportunity to play an instrumental role in shaping culture, ways of working and support squad ramp-up at the new Qantas Product Innovation Centre based in Adelaide.


You’ll have:

  • 3+ years as an Agile Delivery Lead or Agile Iteration Manager in a digital environment
  • Proven ability to plan and coordinate delivery from discovery through to release, optimising time to value
  • Demonstrated ability to coach individuals and squads in adopting Agile mindsets and practices, enabling high-performing teams
  • Proficient in multiple agile frameworks such as Scrum, Kanban, Design Thinking, and other frameworks
  • Strong capability in risk and issue identification and management
  • Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Proficient in Jira, Confluence and Miro


Why Qantas?

At Qantas, your career can take you further than you imagined. You’ll join a team where creativity and passion drive success. Together we dream big and deliver even bigger.

You’ll find diverse opportunities to grow, personally and professionally. From day one, you’ll be supported with hands-on training, coaching, and formal learning programs designed to help you excel. Your development is our priority because we know that when you thrive, so do our customers.

And while this role is your starting point at Qantas, it’s just the beginning. We have a proud history of helping our people explore new paths and reach new heights - the destinations are endless.


The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.

  • We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave and the option to purchase additional paid leave for eligible employees.
  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.
  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.


Qantas is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity and inclusion. We encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, and people of all backgrounds to apply. If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at time of application. Your personal information will be kept confidential in compliance with relevant privacy legislation.


Be a part of something special and play your part in the Qantas story – get in touch today.

You Can Impress With The Following

What We Offer You

Overview

Travel Leaders Network (www.TravelLeaders.com) , as one of the largest sellers of luxury travel, cruises and tours in the industry, is a passionate community of travel professionals focused on mutual success. Representing approximately 5,700 travel agency locations across the United States and Canada, this Network uses the power of its parent company, Internova Travel Group, to assist millions of leisure and business travelers annually.

Travel agent members who belong to Travel Leaders Network have access to meaningful supplier partnerships, innovative technology that integrates with industry-leading marketing, exclusive value-added programs and member support and training that only a company with their size and strength can offer. Travel Leaders Network gives their members everything they need to grow as a Leader and inspire more people to travel better.

Responsibilities

Serve as a key liaison between Internova and its preferred Destination and Global Tourism Board Partners, managing a diverse portfolio of mid-tier through top-tier, complex accounts. The Account Manager is responsible for end-to-end partner management, campaign execution, relationship development, and coordination across Internova business units to ensure successful delivery of partner commitments and long-term partnership value. In addition to assigned accounts, the Account Manager will support designated team-wide functions and cross-functional areas, helping facilitate communication, maintain processes and resources, and promote consistency and collaboration across the Destinations team and Internova business units.

Account & Partner Management

  • Manage a portfolio of mid-tier through top-tier destination partners, including complex, multi-faceted partnerships spanning multiple Internova business units.
  • Serve as the primary day-to-day partner contact, building strong relationships and maintaining a high level of partner service and engagement.
  • Manage the full lifecycle of assigned partner agreements, from annual planning and activation through execution, reporting, renewal, and ongoing account development.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of partner objectives, contracted commitments, budgets, timelines, and performance expectations.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen existing partnerships and support account retention, renewals, and appropriate growth in collaboration with Destination team leadership.

Campaign Management & Execution

  • Translate contracted partner plans into clear, actionable campaign timelines and oversee successful execution across B2B, B2C, events, publications, education, and other applicable channels.
  • Coordinate multiple partner campaigns and deliverables simultaneously, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and alignment with contracted commitments.
  • Partner with Creative, Marketing, Events, Analytics, and other internal teams to move campaigns from planning through execution.
  • Review campaign assets and deliverables for accuracy, partner alignment, brand standards, and contractual requirements.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Team Support

  • Collaborate across Internova business units and functional teams to support the successful execution of Destination Partner programs and initiatives.
  • Support assigned cross-functional or team-wide areas of responsibility, helping facilitate communication, coordination, and consistent processes across the Destinations team.
  • Maintain and share relevant updates, resources, tools, and process information related to assigned functional areas.
  • Partner with fellow Account Managers to ensure information and best practices are communicated consistently across the team.
  • Contribute to team-wide initiatives, events, process improvements, and special projects as assigned.

Partner Reporting, Budget & Performance Management

  • Manage assigned partner budgets and ensure activities remain within contracted revenue and expense parameters.
  • Maintain accurate account records, campaign documentation, timelines, and partner activity.
  • Coordinate collection and analysis of campaign performance data, KPIs, and proof of performance.
  • Develop comprehensive partner recaps that demonstrate campaign delivery, results, and overall partnership value.
  • Use performance insights to inform partner conversations, renewals, and future account recommendations.
  • Proactively identify execution risks, resolve issues, and communicate changes or recommendations to partners and internal stakeholders.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, advertising, tourism, business administration, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • 5+ years of account management, partnership marketing, or related experience; travel, tourism, hospitality, tourism board, tour operator, consortia, or destination experience strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex client or partner relationships, multiple concurrent campaigns, and significant program budgets.
  • Strong relationship-management skills with the ability to communicate effectively and professionally with both external partners and internal stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to coordinate complex projects across multiple teams, manage competing priorities, and deliver against deadlines with strong attention to detail.
  • Strong written, verbal, presentation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Highly organized, proactive, collaborative, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office and related business tools, including document preparation, presentations, data analysis, spreadsheet management, and project-management platforms such as Smartsheet and other required technology tools
  • Ability to travel for partner meetings, industry events, and Internova programs as required.

Job Description:


Are you a detail-oriented individual with a passion for numbers? We are seeking a talented Accountant to join our vibrant team. In this role, you'll play a vital part in ensuring that cost and expense documents are accurately recorded. Your meticulous attention to detail will be essential in reflecting revenue and expenses in our accounting records, adhering to applicable legislation, company regulations, circular letters, approvals, and generally accepted accounting principles. You'll also be responsible for communicating activities required by local laws to our certified public accountant and diligently monitoring compliance.


Responsibilities:


  • Timely monitor and verify revenues from our sales management, ensuring compliance with relevant laws, legislation, and regulations. Your expertise in recording these revenues accurately in our accounting records will be invaluable.
  • Respond to requests by providing comprehensive office income, cost, financing, and financial statistical information to the Sales Manager or your immediate superior.
  • Take charge of timely bank deposits for sales proceeds (Office+BSP+Cargo+CASS+GSA) and diligently record them.
  • Efficiently process payments for approved expenditures, strictly following written approvals. Your keen eye for detail will ensure proper accounting records and the best interests of the company. Additionally, handle disbursements of allowances as necessary.
  • Maintain the annual cost budget sheet and keep a close watch on costs, making sure they align with the budget limits. Take proactive steps to prevent exceeding budget portions and promptly inform your superior.
  • Skillfully manage administrative affairs and diligently follow up on related issues.


Desired Skills & Experience:


  • Bachelor's degree or at least high school graduation.
  • Preferably, at least one year of experience in finance, accounting, monthly close, and financial reporting.
  • Proficient knowledge of generally accepted accounting principles, procedures, and their practical application.
  • Familiarity and competency with MS Office products.
  • Excellent command of English and local language(s).
  • Valid work permit or citizenship (the company does not provide or assist with work permits).
  • Demonstrated sense of responsibility and the ability to make accurate and effective decisions. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and skilled in analyzing various data.
  • Experience with SAP system preferred.
  • A collaborative team player who can also work independently when required, thriving in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proactive problem-solving skills.


Benefits:


  • Commuting Allowance
  • Private Health Insurance
  • Pass / Ced Ticket Benefits

Job Title

Hospitality Onboarding & Implementation Analyst

External Job Title: Hospitality Onboarding & Implementation Analyst

Location: Atlanta, Georgia (Hybrid)

Position: Permanent

About Our Business Area/department

At Amadeus Travel Intelligence, we help the global travel industry make smarter, data-driven decisions through one of the world's most comprehensive hospitality data ecosystems. Our Data Acquisition, Onboarding & Data Quality team is responsible for acquiring, onboarding, validating, and maintaining the high-quality data that powers our industry-leading intelligence solutions. We work closely with hotel companies, technology partners, and cross-functional teams to ensure data accuracy, drive operational excellence, and deliver trusted insights that help customers make better business decisions.

Summary

Hospitality Onboarding & Implementation Analyst plays a critical role in onboarding and maintaining global hospitality industry data that powers our Business Intelligence solutions. This position is responsible for ensuring the acquisition, quality, governance, and ongoing integrity of data assets by working closely with leading hospitality organizations, technology providers, and independent hotels worldwide. The analyst will partner with both business and technical teams to deliver high-quality data that meets extract specifications, validation standards, and business requirements.

  • Lead end to end onboarding, re-onboarding and go live activities for hotel properties participating in Demand 360
  • Coordinate integrations with PMS providers, channel managers, and hospitality technology partners, including OPERA Cloud, StayNTouch, Infor HMS, Cloudbeds, Duetto, Otelier, and similar platforms.
  • Serve as the primary liaison between customers, partners, and internal teams throughout onboarding, validation, and production support activities.
  • Analyze, validate, and troubleshoot reservation, group, occupancy, and related hospitality data to ensure data quality, completeness, and compliance with Demand360 standards.
  • Review and maintain booking source, market segment, rate plan, and other data mappings, while performing audits and root cause analysis to identify and resolve data issues.
  • Manage historical data loads, data migrations, baseline creation, resynchronizations, and onboarding remediation efforts.
  • Utilize SQL, data analysis techniques, and Unix/Linux tools to investigate data discrepancies and support operational issue resolution.
  • Recommend and implement improvements to onboarding processes, data governance, quality controls, and operational workflows.
  • Communicate onboarding status, validation results, technical requirements, and go-live readiness to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Drive projects from initial onboarding through validation, approval, and production activation while ensuring a positive customer experience.

Ideal Candidate

  • Hospitality industry experience with a strong understanding of hospitality terminology, standards, business processes, and hotel operations.
  • Familiarity with Property Management Systems (PMS), reservations data, central reservation systems, or other hospitality technology platforms.
  • Strong SQL skills for data analysis, validation, troubleshooting, and root cause investigation.
  • Understanding of Business Intelligence, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes, and data integration concepts.
  • Knowledge of database, data warehouse, or data architecture principles.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills.
  • Proven ability to effectively manage projects and collaborate across business and technical teams.
  • Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • Experience in hospitality, data management, business intelligence, analytics, or a related discipline preferred.
  • Experience working with hospitality data sources, PMS platforms, reservations data, or hotel technology systems is highly desirable

What We Can Offer You

  • Get rewarded with competitive remuneration, individual and company annual bonus, vacation and holiday paid time off, health insurances and other competitive benefits.
  • Hybrid working model.
  • Professional development to broaden your knowledge and enhance your skills with on-line learning hubs packed with technical and soft skills training that allow you to develop and grow.
  • Enter a diverse and inclusive workplace, join one of the world’s top travel technology companies and take on a role that impacts millions of travelers around the globe.

Working at Amadeus, you will find

  • 🎯 A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you will be powering the future of travel and pursuing a critical mission and extraordinary purpose.
  • 🌎 A truly global DNA - Everything at Amadeus is global, from our people to our business, which translates into our footprint, processes, and culture.
  • 🎓 Great opportunities to learn - Learning happens all the time and in many ways at Amadeus, through on-the-job training, formal learning activities, and day-to-day interactions with colleagues.
  • 🤗 A caring environment - Amadeus fosters a caring environment, nurturing both a fulfilling career and personal and family life. We care about our employees and strive to provide a supportive work environment.
  • 💰 A complete rewards offer - Amadeus provides attractive remuneration packages, covering all essential components of a competitive reward offer, including salary, bonus, equity, and benefits.
  • 🌈 A diverse and inclusive community - We are committed to leveraging our uniquely diverse population to drive innovation, creativity, and collaboration across our organization.
  • 📈 A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental values that drive our actions and shape long-lasting relationships with our customers, partners, and employees.

Diversity & Inclusion

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get To Know Our Team:

Travel Distribution is a team of creative entrepreneurs that develop and scale travel API solutions for Agoda’s and other Booking Holdings strategic partners.

Our teams are structured to acquire, manage relationships and optimize the performance of accommodation API partners, both on buying and selling sides. We develop win-win relationships and leverage Agoda’s and Booking Holdings’ unique travel product portfolio and tech solutions to bring our partners the advantages they seek.  Utilizing our strong brand and resources, we gain access to most competitive accommodation inventories worldwide as well as build new channels to increase the visibility of Agoda and the other group companies, introduce more travelers to our great products and services and deliver significant profits to the overall business.  

The Opportunity:

The role offers an opportunity to lead strategic projects end-to-end, from ideation, obtaining senior stakeholders' buy-in, implementation, and measuring impact. The successful candidate will work with stakeholders across departments (Tech, Marketing, Supply, Legal, Finance, etc.), including presenting to senior stakeholders, in order to solve and drive complex projects that will provide step changes to our third-party accommodation supply business.

The core functions of the team include:

  • Ideating new initiatives and drive the implementation end-to-end to grow the Travel Distribution business
  • Building business cases to evaluate new commercial initiatives or new product features requests through collecting requirements from account management teams and partners
  • Revenue optimization initiatives through distribution and pricing experiments content improvements
  • Enabling and supporting account management teams with tools, documentation and efficient processes
  • Partaking in commercial terms and incentives optimization, including rolling out new commercial and API connectivity features to partners
  • Credit risk management
  • Maintaining and setup control frameworks and SLAs agreed with major stakeholders,
  • Managing stakeholders across departments such as Product, Tech, Finance, Legal, etc.

What You’ll Do:

A Senior Manager will bring a strong business strategy and analytical acumen coupled with operations and project management knowledge, attention to details and strive for efficiency, coupled with the ability to make things happen hands-on.

This position is based in Bangkok. 

What You’ll Need to Succeed:  

  • 7+ years of experience demonstrated ability to lead cross‑functional strategy or program initiatives end‑to‑end and deliver measurable outcomes; backgrounds may include consulting, corporate strategy, business operations, business analytics, product/program management, or equivalent experience
  • Strong numerical and analytical skills, with hands-on knowledge of data pulling and processing tools
  • Strong critical thinking, strategic thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Fluent in English with strong stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to own the initiative end-to-end from idea creation, to testing and execution, including managing various stakeholders to get buy-ins
  • Independent and self-driven
  • Able to move fast and adapt well with changes

Good to have:

  • Experience with SQL and Tableau
  • Experience and understanding of online travel industry, B2B travel APIs experience and/or connectivity skills
  • Experience in go-to-market initiatives implementation

Skills & Experience

  • Proficient in negotiating with suppliers, vendors, and clients to establish favourable terms that benefit all parties involved

Accor Benefits

At Accor, we welcome you as you are. We help you grow and learn, so that work brings purpose to your life. By joining Accor, every chapter of your story is yours to write, and together we can imagine tomorrow's hospitality. Accor is an inclusive company, building diverse teams across the globe.

job.job_description:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Senior Analyst, Financial Account Management is responsible for managing a designated portfolio of franchisee accounts and driving the timely collection of outstanding receivables while supporting the long-term health of franchise relationships. This role owns the collections strategy for assigned accounts, identifies and manages financial risk, and recommends appropriate escalation actions, including payment arrangements, defaults, reservation suspensions, settlements, and franchise termination.

The Senior Analyst serves as a key point of contact between Finance and internal business partners, including Franchise Sales, Operations, and Legal. Success in this role requires strong financial and analytical skills, sound business judgment, effective negotiation capabilities, and the ability to influence both franchisees and internal stakeholders. The Senior Analyst must balance the company’s financial interests with broader business considerations and franchise relationships.

Note: This role is onsite 4 days a week in North Bethesda, MD and is not eligible for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Franchise Portfolio Management

  • Manage an assigned territory and portfolio of franchisee accounts, with end-to-end accountability for collection activity and portfolio performance.
  • Monitor accounts receivable balances, aging, payment trends, and other indicators to proactively identify delinquency and financial risk.
  • Develop and execute account-specific collection strategies based on the franchisee’s financial position, payment history, operational circumstances, and overall relationship with the company.
  • Establish appropriate contact strategies and maintain consistent communication with franchisees regarding outstanding balances and payment obligations.
  • Negotiate payment arrangements and other solutions within established policies and authority levels.
  • Maintain accurate and timely documentation of collection activities, commitments, disputes, and account status.

Risk Management & Escalation

  • Evaluate delinquent and high-risk franchisee accounts and determine appropriate next steps within established policies and delegated authority.
  • Prepare recommendations for payment settlements, defaults, reservation suspensions, and other collection or enforcement actions.
  • Develop well-supported recommendations for franchise termination when collection efforts and other remedies have been exhausted.
  • Escalate complex or high-risk situations to Financial Account Management leadership and other appropriate stakeholders.
  • Ensure recommendations consider outstanding receivables, contractual obligations, franchisee circumstances, operational impact, and the broader business relationship.
  • Partner with Legal to support default, enforcement, and termination processes and ensure required documentation is complete and accurate.
  • Identify emerging portfolio risks and escalate significant trends or exposures to leadership.

Franchisee Relationship Management

  • Build productive relationships with franchise owners and operators while maintaining appropriate financial accountability.
  • Navigate difficult financial conversations professionally and effectively, including disputes, payment negotiations, defaults, and potential suspensions.
  • Seek solutions that maximize recovery while appropriately considering the long-term value and viability of the franchise relationship.
  • Serve as a knowledgeable resource to franchisees regarding account balances, payment obligations, and collection processes.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Develop strong working relationships with Franchise Sales, Franchise Operations, Legal, Finance, and other internal stakeholders.
  • Proactively communicate with business partners regarding significant delinquency, financial risk, and proposed collection actions within the assigned territory.
  • Incorporate relevant operational and relationship considerations into account strategies while maintaining appropriate financial controls and collection discipline.
  • Build stakeholder alignment and obtain cross-functional support for collection actions, particularly defaults, reservation suspensions, settlements, and termination recommendations.
  • Partner with Franchise Sales and Operations to understand the broader franchisee relationship and identify solutions that protect both company financial interests and strategically important franchise relationships.
  • Serve as a subject matter resource on collection matters for internal business partners.

Analysis & Continuous Improvement

  • Analyze portfolio performance, aging, delinquency trends, and collection results to identify risks and opportunities.
  • Provide management with clear reporting and insights regarding significant accounts, emerging risks, and anticipated collection outcomes.
  • Identify recurring issues contributing to franchisee delinquency and partner with stakeholders to address root causes.
  • Recommend improvements to collection processes, policies, reporting, and systems.
  • Share best practices and provide guidance to less experienced team members as appropriate.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Employment Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
  • 4+ years of experience in commercial collections, accounts receivable, credit, financial operations, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience independently managing a portfolio of complex customer or business accounts.
  • Experience negotiating payment arrangements and resolving complex financial disputes.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess financial risk and develop appropriate recommendations.
  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-management skills, including the ability to navigate difficult conversations and competing stakeholder priorities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to independently manage a high-volume portfolio and competing priorities.
  • Proficiency with office software; intermediate+ Excel skills required.
  • Experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud or similar ERP systems and/or Salesforce
  • Knowledge of franchise agreements and franchise financial operations.

Salary Range

The salary range for this role is $65,698 - $85,000.

Choice prioritizes our associate wellbeing by offering a comprehensive benefits program that is both competitive and flexible to help you achieve your wellbeing goals - here are just a few:

  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Leave and paid time-off for holidays, vacation, personal, family, volunteer, sick, jury duty, bereavement, military, and religious observance
  • Financial benefits for retirement and health savings
  • Employee recognition programs
  • Discounts at Choice hotels worldwide

About Choice

Choice Hotels International, Inc. (NYSE: CHH), is one of the largest lodging franchisors in the world. With 7,500 hotels in 45+ countries and territories, we offer a range of high-quality lodging options in the upper upscale, upper midscale, midscale, extended stay, and economy segments. We’re the hotel company for those who choose to bet on themselves — the striver, the dreamer, the entrepreneur — because that’s who we are, too.

At Choice, we are united by the simple belief that tomorrow will be even better than today — for associates, our company, and our franchisees. At our worldwide corporate headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, at our technology center in Scottsdale, Arizona, and through our associates around the globe, every voice is heard and every idea is listened to, no matter what area of the company they come from. We are united in supporting the entrepreneurial dreams of our thousands of franchise owners, which propels us forward — giving our work at Choice a purpose larger than our business.

Our corporate office locations:

North Bethesda, MD — Located at Pike & Rose, our worldwide headquarters is less than 15 miles from Washington, D.C., one block away from the North Bethesda Metro station, with easy access to I-495, complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Scottsdale, AZ — Located at the northwest corner of Loop 101, the Scottsdale office is home to our technology, eCommerce and customer service organizations, with easy access to complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Minneapolis, MN — Select roles are based in our Minneapolis office on Highway 394, near the intersection with Highway 100, only five minutes from downtown.

Field/Remote — Select roles designated as field/remote will require associates to work from a home office, connecting virtually with Choice team members and leadership on Zoom, with possible required travel depending on the role.

Choice’s Cultural Values

Welcome and Respect Everyone | Be Bold | Be Quick | Listen | Be Curious | Show Integrity

Choice’s Leadership Principles

Act with Intention | Lead with Authenticity | Grow & Deliver

Leadership/Team Quote: "The Cars commercial Supply Management team is at the forefront of shaping how our customers experience car rentals worldwide. Role Description: Join our Cars commercial Supply Management team and play a pivotal role in ensuring we have the strongest contracts and commercials within the car rental market.
