At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

At Expedia Group, performance is product quality. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager, Performance to define and lead the strategy for improving user-perceived performance across our traveler facing experiences, while building the systems, operating model, and guardrails needed to prevent regressions before they reach travelers.

In this role, you will partner across engineering, architecture, product, UX, analytics, experimentation, and platform teams to make performance measurable, actionable, and durable. You will own the product vision and roadmap for performance across web and app, balancing near-term experience improvements with longer-term investments in instrumentation, diagnostics, release protections, and performance-by-default product development practices.

You will help Expedia Group deliver faster, more stable, and more resilient experiences for travelers by ensuring teams can understand performance, prioritize the right improvements, and prevent degradation at scale.

What You Will Do

  • Define and drive the product strategy, roadmap, and success metrics for performance across web and native app experiences.
  • Establish a clear performance product vision spanning page and screen load speed, interaction responsiveness, visual stability, reliability of measurement, and degradation prevention.
  • Partner with engineering and architecture leaders to identify and prioritize platform and product investments that improve performance at scale.
  • Own the performance measurement framework across web and app, including headline metrics, driver metrics, and guardrail metrics that help teams make better prioritization decisions.
  • Lead discovery across stakeholder groups to identify root causes of poor user experience, quantify business impact, and translate findings into roadmap priorities.
  • Drive adoption of performance standards, budgets, and release guardrails that reduce regressions and improve consistency across teams.
  • Shape the operating model for performance reviews, regression triage, escalation paths, and accountability for remediation.
  • Partner with experimentation and analytics teams to evaluate how product, content, and feature changes affect performance and traveler outcomes.
  • Collaborate with teams responsible for observability, monitoring, and developer tooling to improve visibility into performance bottlenecks and degradations.
  • Influence roadmaps across multiple product and platform teams without direct authority, aligning leaders on shared goals, sequencing, and trade-offs.
  • Serve as a key point of contact for performance strategy, progress, and outcomes with senior stakeholders across Product and Technology.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of product management experience with a Bachelor's degree, or 6+ years with a Master's degree.
  • Experience defining product strategy, roadmaps, success metrics, and measurable outcomes for platform products or highly technical product domains.
  • Experience owning products through discovery, prioritization, delivery, adoption, and ongoing optimization.
  • Experience leading large-scale, cross-functional initiatives across multiple product, engineering, and platform teams, influencing roadmaps and driving alignment without direct authority.
  • Strong technical product management experience, with the ability to partner closely with engineering teams on complex technical challenges.
  • Deep understanding of web and/or mobile application performance, including performance measurement, observability, monitoring, diagnostics, release protections, and performance regression prevention.
  • Experience using data, analytics, experimentation, and customer insights to evaluate impact and make informed product decisions and trade-offs.
  • Proven ability to communicate effectively and build alignment across diverse stakeholder groups in a global organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in application performance, developer productivity, platform products, infrastructure, developer tools, or similarly technical domains.
  • Experience establishing performance standards, budgets, guardrails, governance models, escalation processes, and accountability mechanisms across multiple teams.
  • Experience building frameworks, playbooks, or operating models that drive quality, reliability, and performance improvements at scale.
  • Experience working on data-intensive products and translating complex technical metrics into actionable product insights.
  • Background in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or prior hands-on software development experience.
  • Proven track record of taking products from concept through scaled adoption and measurable business impact.
  • Experience using experimentation and analytics to understand how product and feature changes affect customer experience and business outcomes.
  • Familiarity with AI-driven products, tools, or workflows, including experience identifying opportunities to apply AI/ML capabilities to solve customer or business problems.

Accommodation requests

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.

About Expedia Group

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Important notice

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/.

Equal Opportunity

Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a Online Marketing Analytics Manager in the Online Marketing Data Analyst team you will be in charge of:

  • Partner with media stakeholders to understand business objectives and identify where measurement or deeper analysis can improve decision-making.
  • Independently lead end-to-end analytical projects, from translating business problems into structured analytical approaches through analysis execution, insight generation and stakeholder communication.
  • Present evidence-based recommendations, clearly articulating expected business benefits, trade-offs, risks and limitations, and drive their adoption across the business.
  • Proactively identify and propose new analytical projects, experiments and optimisation initiatives that improve business performance.
  • Overseeing the design of a cross-platform test-and-learn agenda and supporting its implementation.
  • Develop measurement plans and analytical frameworks to evaluate the effectiveness of marketing investments.
  • Work closely with Data Engineering to continuously improve the marketing data landscape by identifying opportunities to enhance data quality, reliability and completeness, and enable new reporting views, datasets and data sources.
  • Collaborate with the Tracking and Data Activation teams to strengthen the quality, availability and usability of marketing data across platforms.


What you need to succeed:

Good to have

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:

  • At least 8 years of experience in Marketing Analytics, ideally within a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Strong SQL skills, including writing efficient, complex queries across large datasets.
  • Strong Python skills for data processing, analysis, automation and data visualisation.
  • Experience designing and conducting complex analytical projects from problem definition through to business recommendation.
  • Strong analytics knowledge, with the ability to select and apply appropriate analytical methodologies to different business questions.
  • Experience with experimentation and causal measurement techniques such as A/B testing, incrementality measurement, causal inference or quasi-experimental methods.
  • Ability to identify patterns, opportunities and optimisation levers through proactive exploration of large and complex datasets.
  • Ability to balance measurement rigor with pragmatic business constraints.
  • Experience communicating analytical findings to senior stakeholders and influencing strategic business decisions, by helping them navigate how to use the derived insights into the marketing strategy.
  • Ability to independently own complex analytical initiatives involving multiple stakeholders. Experience with marketing platforms (e.g. Google Ads, Apple Search ads, Youtube, Meta, TikTok, etc.) and tools like GA4, Appsflyer, AppTweak or similar are beneficial but not essential.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Applied AI Tools: Demonstrated comfort using practical AI tools such as Gemini, or other AI-powered assistants.
  • Experimentation Mindset: Curiosity and eagerness to explore, experiment with, and integrate emerging AI-driven solutions into workflows.
  • AI-Enhanced Problem Solving: Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to streamline processes, and enhance productivity.
  • Adaptability and Learning Agility: Enthusiastic about continuously learning and quickly adapting to new AI features and capabilities.


What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture.

Here's what we offer:

  • A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and premium equipment with role-based selection options and device ownership through our equipment lifecycle program when it reaches its refresh cycle.

  • Grow opportunities to empower your career and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.
  • Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcomes. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
  • Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padel tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
  • Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.


Wanna take a peek into what it's like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

Apply now!

job.job_description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Your mission

The Brand Strategy Lead owns the quality, consistency and distinctiveness of GetYourGuide's brand, partnering closely with Analytics, Customer Insights, Product, and Supply to keep the brand coherent globally and relevant locally.

Please note this role is a individual contributor and will not be leading a team but leading and owning the brand frameworks and positioning.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the brand framework - narrative, positioning and USPs. Define what GetYourGuide stands for, what associations it is and is not building, and how the organisation reads progress against them.
  • Know the market and the customer, globally and locally. Track competitive dynamics, category shifts, and how the Modern Explorer is changing, and turn genuine local differences into shared knowledge instead of market-specific narratives.
  • Turn strategy into something the org can act on. Build the chain from barrier → narrative angle → proof points → recommended levers, and keep the messaging hierarchy and narrative repository current as the source of truth for what's in, out, and true.
  • Make the brand a resource, not a gatekeeper. Package strategy so Product, Supply, Analytics, Customer Insights, and other teams can act on it directly, and bring narrative and CVP input into their roadmaps early enough to shape decisions.
  • Contribute to, and where relevant own, brand programs that build proof points. Identify and help shape the research, partnerships, or flagship initiatives that generate real evidence for the narrative, working with Activation and other teams to bring them to life.
  • Define how the org knows the brand is working. Own the brand health and equity measurement framework — the scorecard that shows whether the narrative is landing, not just whether it shipped.

You’ll be successful if you have

  • Judgment and taste, the confidence to make narrative calls without a rulebook, and the discipline not to over-document strategy instead of deciding.
  • Sharp analytical instincts, comfortable working with data and research directly, and skilled at turning market and customer understanding into strategic implications.
  • Creativity and cultural fluency, a feel for what's shifting in culture and category, and the instinct to find a fresh, distinctive angle on the CVP instead of defaulting to convention.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder skills, the emotional intelligence to build trust across Product, Supply, Analytics, and Creative, and get them to act on a shared narrative.
  • Great communication skills, able to turn ambiguous strategic input into a clear, actionable plan that people outside the strategy team can build against.
  • Program management experience across various functional teams
  • Excellent written and spoken communication in English; additional languages are a plus.

Experience Preferred

  • 8 years+ Brand strategy experience: meaningful experience in brand strategy, positioning, or narrative development, ideally across multiple brands and markets.
  • Agency experience is a plus.
  • Experience working with data analytics and insight to direct research and translate insights into brand decisions.
  • Senior IC track record, comfort operating as a senior individual contributor with no direct reports — influence here comes from the quality of the thinking, not from headcount.

How We’ll Measure Impact

  • Quality and consistency of our Brand Narrative across the organisation
  • Brand health targets defined with leadership and tracked transparently.
  • Successful collaboration & influence of internal teams (creative, supply, product, care).

How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary

  • Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
  • Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
  • A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.
  • Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events

  • Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
  • Language reimbursement program
  • Health and wellness benefits

And more…

How To Apply

Job Description

Hilton is seeking a strategic and influential leader to join our Regional Operations team as Director, Operations Support – Japan, Korea & Micronesia (JKM).

This role serves as a key member of the JKM Operations leadership team, partnering closely with the Area Vice President, General Managers, hotel owners, and regional functional leaders to drive operational excellence, business performance, strategic initiatives, and organizational capability across the portfolio.

The Director will lead and oversee priority operational projects, support the execution of regional growth and transformation strategies, and ensure alignment with Hilton's commercial objectives, brand standards, and guest experience expectations. Through effective stakeholder engagement and cross-functional collaboration, the role will help accelerate performance, strengthen operational capabilities, and drive sustainable business results across the JKM region.

Responsibilities

HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT

Your role is important, and below are some of the fundamental job duties that make your work unique.

Strategic Operations Leadership

  • Act as a trusted advisor to the Area Vice President (AVP) on operational priorities, business performance, and strategic initiatives across Japan, Korea, & Micronesia.
  • Support the development and execution of regional operational strategies that drive revenue growth, profitability, guest satisfaction, and team member engagement.

  • You have experience in the restaurant or hospitality industry, or with reservation or POS software.

  • You have created training content such as guides, videos or webinars.
  • You have a commercial eye and enjoy spotting upsell opportunities.

What We Offer You

  • ⚖️ Flexible working environment (2 days home office per week + up to 4 total weeks additional flexibility during the summer period and in December to work fully remotely)

  • 🤝 Highly inclusive working environment

  • 🎓 Continuous learning and development programs
  • 😌 Free access to the Calm app to help you build resilience wherever you are in your mental health journey

  • 🏥 Health insurance
  • 👩‍🦽 Life & Disability Insurance at no cost to the employee
  • 👴 Attractive pension plans
  • 🍴 Amazing offices with dining, a coffee point on each floor, and leisure area
  • 🎤 Team building events

All hiring happens through our careers site and official email. We do not text or ask for payment during the hiring process. Please report any suspicious messages immediately.

We believe that we are better together, and we welcome you for who you are. We endeavor to ensure that everyone - regardless of ability, age, socio-economic & cultural background, ethnicity, faith, gender, gender expression, gender identity, ideology, national origin, race, sexual orientation, marital status, or any characteristic protected under applicable law - has the opportunity to reach their full potential. Drive digital success for global hospitality brands through your analytical mindset, creativity, and client partnership.

In this role, you'll

  • Analytical thinker with the ability to interpret campaign data, identify optimization opportunities, and draw meaningful business insights.

  • Fluent in English and at least one additional European language (Italian, French, or German); Spanish or another language is a plus.

  • Curious about digital innovation and comfortable using AI productivity tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, or ChatGPT to enhance efficiency.
  • Collaborative, client-oriented, and adaptable — able to thrive in a dynamic, international environment.

What We Can Offer You

🌎 A truly global DNA - Everything at Amadeus is global, from our people to our business, which translates into our footprint, processes, and culture.

🌟 A hybrid working model - We want our employees to do their best work, however the hybrid model works best for them.

🌈 A diverse and inclusive community - We are committed to leveraging our uniquely diverse population to drive innovation, creativity, and collaboration across our organization.

📈 A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental values that drive our actions and shape long-lasting relationships with our customers, partners, and employees.

🎯 A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you will be powering the future of travel and pursuing a critical mission and extraordinary purpose.

Diversity & Inclusion

Amadeus aspires to be a leader in Diversity and Inclusion in the tech industry, enabling every employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment, attracting the best talent from all backgrounds, and as a role model for an inclusive employee experience. 

Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer and committed to an accessible recruitment process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know Our Team

The Strategic Partnerships team is responsible for identifying, building, and scaling high-impact partnerships that expand Agoda’s reach, improve customer acquisition, and create long-term business value.

For Japan, Financial Institution (FI) partnerships represent a strategic growth channel. This role will focus on developing and managing relationships with banks, card issuers, digital wallets, and other financial ecosystem partners to drive customer engagement, commercial growth, and win-win partnership outcomes.

You will work cross-functionally with teams across Commercial, Marketing, Product, Finance, Legal, Analytics, and Operations to bring partnership opportunities from idea to execution and optimization.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships to lead Agoda’s Japan FI partnership strategy and execution.

In this role, you will be responsible for identifying new partnership opportunities, managing key strategic accounts, negotiating commercial agreements, and driving performance across Agoda’s financial institution partnerships in Japan. You will help shape Agoda’s local partnership roadmap, unlock joint business opportunities, and ensure excellent execution of campaigns and initiatives with partners.

The ideal candidate brings strong business development and partnership experience, sharp commercial judgment, analytical rigor, and the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders. This role requires someone who is highly strategic but also willing to work hands-on to deliver measurable outcomes.

Why This Role Matters

This role is critical to Agoda’s growth in Japan. Financial institution partnerships are a highly strategic channel that can unlock scalable customer demand, deepen brand presence, and create differentiated value for travelers and partners alike.

As Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships, you will play a central role in shaping Agoda’s FI ecosystem in Japan and delivering high-impact partnerships that drive sustainable business growth.

What You’ll Do

Partnership Strategy & Business Development

  • Define and drive Agoda’s FI partnership strategy for Japan, aligned with market priorities and business growth objectives
  • Identify, evaluate, and prioritize new partnership opportunities with banks, credit card issuers, payment platforms, loyalty programs, and other financial ecosystem players
  • Build compelling partnership value propositions and business cases to secure internal alignment and partner buy-in
  • Lead commercial discussions, negotiations, and contract execution with prospective and existing FI partners

Account Management & Growth

  • Own and grow a portfolio of key FI partners in Japan, ensuring strong relationship management and long-term strategic alignment
  • Develop joint business plans with partners to drive customer acquisition, transaction growth, brand visibility, and partnership profitability
  • Monitor partner performance and proactively identify growth levers, optimization opportunities, and operational improvements
  • Ensure timely execution of campaigns, product integrations, and partner initiatives

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Analytics, Finance, Legal, and Operations to launch and scale partnership initiatives
  • Translate partner needs into clear internal requirements and drive execution across multiple teams
  • Influence decision-making through strong communication, stakeholder management, and data-backed recommendations
  • Support process improvements, reporting frameworks, and operating models to improve scalability and partner experience

Analytics & Optimization

  • Analyze partnership performance, customer behavior, campaign effectiveness, and commercial outcomes to generate actionable insights
  • Use data to identify trends, optimize investment decisions, and improve partnership ROI
  • Build business cases for new initiatives and present recommendations to senior stakeholders
  • Track key success metrics and maintain clear visibility on pipeline, performance, and impact

Experience

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • 7+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, account management, consulting, or a related commercial role
  • Strong experience managing external partners and driving commercial outcomes in a fast-paced, data-driven environment
  • Experience working with or within financial institutions, payment companies, loyalty ecosystems, or digital consumer platforms is highly preferred
  • Experience in e-commerce, travel, fintech, payments, or internet platforms is a strong plus
  • Proven track record of leading cross-functional initiatives from concept through execution

job.job_description:
Description de l'entreprise

Rejoignez Accor – une aventure professionnelle au cœur d'un groupe engagé, international et en transformation

Accor, leader mondial de l'hospitalité, présent dans plus de 110 pays avec 5 500 hôtels, vous ouvre ses portes.

C'est ici que convergent les expertises globales du Groupe : stratégie, finance, ressources humaines, juridique, technologies, marketing, développement durable, communication, audit, achats, etc.

Rejoindre Accor, c'est participer activement à la définition, à la structuration et à l'accompagnement de la transformation d'un groupe international, en lien direct avec les équipes opérationnelles dans le monde entier.

Description du poste

C’est ici que vous attend votre plus grand défi :

Au sein de la division Premium Brands, vous accompagnerez le President, membre de l’Executive Committee d’Accor, dans la coordination et l’animation d’un portefeuille international de marques, d’hôtels et d’équipes à travers le monde. Ce rôle stratégique vous place au cœur des interactions entre les équipes dirigeantes, les régions et les partenaires clés de la division.

Vous contribuerez à optimiser l’efficacité du President en assurant une gestion proactive des priorités, des parties prenantes et des sujets stratégiques, tout en garantissant un haut niveau de qualité d’exécution.

Votre Mission

  • Piloter un agenda international complexe et en constante évolution en cohérence avec les priorités business.
  • Organiser et coordonner les réunions de leadership, business reviews, comités et événements stratégiques.
  • Préparer les dossiers, notes de synthèse, briefings et documents nécessaires à la prise de décision.
  • Assurer le suivi des décisions, plans d’actions et engagements pris auprès des parties prenantes internes et externes.
  • Coordonner les interactions entre le President, son équipe de direction, les régions et les fonctions corporate.
  • Favoriser la circulation de l’information et l’alignement au sein de l’équipe de leadership Premium Brands.
  • Organiser les déplacements internationaux et garantir leur parfaite exécution.
  • Participer à l’amélioration continue du fonctionnement du bureau du President grâce à des méthodes de travail efficaces et à l’utilisation d’outils digitaux.
  • Assurer un traitement rigoureux des informations sensibles et confidentielles.

Qualifications

Et vous ?

Profil recherché

  • Expérience significative dans l’assistanat de direction auprès d’un membre de comité exécutif, d’un dirigeant international ou d’un environnement équivalent.
  • Expérience confirmée de gestion d’agendas complexes et de déplacements internationaux.
  • Expérience au sein d’un groupe international, matriciel et multiculturel.
  • Excellentes capacités d’organisation, d’anticipation et de priorisation.
  • Excellente communication écrite et orale.
  • Forte capacité à interagir avec des interlocuteurs de haut niveau.
  • Expérience de coordination de sujets transverses et de multiples parties prenantes.

Soft Skills Clés

  • Sens du discernement et de la confidentialité.
  • Esprit d’initiative et autonomie.
  • Intelligence relationnelle et diplomatie.
  • Fiabilité et sens du service.
  • Agilité dans un environnement international exigeant.
  • Capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités simultanément tout en maintenant un haut niveau de qualité.

Compétences techniques

  • Maîtrise des outils Microsoft 365.
  • Aisance avec les outils collaboratifs et digitaux.
  • Capacité à concevoir des supports de préparation et de communication exécutive.
  • Maîtrise des outils d’organisation et de planification.

Langues

  • Français et anglais courant indispensables.

Informations supplémentaires

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Et nous, quels sont nos engagements ?

  • Sur le monde
  • Accor s'engage pour le monde qui nous entoure, avec une culture employeur forte centrée sur le développement de nos 300 000 talents.
  • Nous adoptons une approche d'amélioration continue pour réduire l'impact du digital sur l'environnement dans l'ensemble de nos projets.
  • Sur votre carrière
  • Nous permettons à tous nos collaborateurs de maîtriser leur équilibre vie-perso / pro et leur offrons les moyens de façonner leur environnement de travail à leur image.
  • Un Talent Management dédié, une amélioration continue et des parcours de formation et d'évolution sont définis à la fois individuellement et collectivement pour que nous grandissions ensemble, au quotidien.
  • Concrètement, chez Accor :
  • Télétravail possible plusieurs jours par semaine depuis la France et options de travail flexibles : travaillez depuis chez vous, nos bureaux, ou même nos hôtels et espaces de coworking grâce à Worklib.

et aussi,

  • Programme ALL - Heartist® : tarifs préférentiels et offres flash pour des séjours et expériences inoubliables dans toutes nos adresses Accor et chez nos partenaires, dans le monde entier.
  • Programme de volontariat Heartist® for good : 1 jour offert sur votre temps de travail pour vous engager en faveur d'une association.
  • Un CSE qui vous accompagne dans le financement de vos activités culturelles et sportives.
  • Forfait Mobilité durable pour l'utilisation d'un moyen de déplacement « vert » ou un dispositif « vélo de fonction » en partenariat avec Zenride
  • Prise en charge des abonnements de transports publics urbains entre le domicile et le lieu de travail, à hauteur de 75%.
  • Tickets restaurant de 11€ en valeur faciale.

  • Sans oublier des conditions de travail attractives avec des espaces de travail collaboratifs, des restaurants, espaces de jeux ou encore des espaces de bien-être et de Sport sur site ou grâce à Gymlib.

Votre talent et votre motivation sont nos seuls critères de sélection.

Nous valorisons la richesse des diverses nationalités, personnalités et parcours professionnels.

Nous savons nous adapter aux besoins spécifiques de nos collaborateurs, notamment ceux en situation de handicap.

Nous encourageons toutes les candidatures, sans distinction de genre, alors osez postuler !

Pour nous, le recrutement est avant tout une histoire de rencontres.

Cette mission vous attire ? Postulez et nous vous proposerons :

  • Un entretien final avec notre équipe des Ressources Humaines pour échanger sur la culture de notre Groupe, l'environnement de travail, notre programme de formation et les perspectives de carrière, ainsi que les différents avantages du Groupe.

job.job_description:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Area Director, Franchise Performance, Core Brands is responsible for driving the commercial performance of a portfolio of midscale and upper midscale franchised hotels. Acting as a trusted advisor to hotel owners, operators, and management companies, this role leverages revenue, market, and operational performance data to identify opportunities for growth and profitability.

The Area Director develops and influences execution of strategic commercial action plans that improve RevPAR, market share, ADR, occupancy, revenue growth, and owner profitability. Through a combination of on-site consultations, virtual engagements, business reviews, and cross-functional collaboration, the role aligns hotel performance strategies with company initiatives and available resources.

This position partners closely with Revenue Management, Sales, Marketing, Loyalty, Distribution, Brand, and Operations teams to support commercial excellence and sustained portfolio growth while fostering strong franchisee relationships and driving program adoption.

NOTE: To be considered for this position, candidates must currently reside in Virginia or North Carolina. Relocation assistance is not available for this role. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates who meet the position requirements and location criteria.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Commercial Performance Management & Strategic Advisory

  • Serve as a strategic commercial advisor to hotel owners and operators, using hotel, portfolio, and market data to identify revenue opportunities and performance improvement initiatives.
  • Conduct property visits, performance reviews, and business consultations that connect revenue strategy, sales activation, marketing, distribution, loyalty participation, guest experience, and operational execution to profitable growth.
  • Influence stakeholder adoption of agreed-upon commercial priorities through clear accountability, performance goals, and follow-through.
  • Evaluate market demand, competitive positioning, business mix, pricing strategy, distribution effectiveness, and sales performance to prioritize the highest-value opportunities.
  • Develop action-oriented recommendations that improve revenue generation, profitability, market share, and long-term owner value.\

Revenue & Market Performance Accountability

  • Drive improvement in portfolio and hotel-level commercial metrics, including RevPAR, RevPAR Index, ADR, occupancy, revenue growth, and profitability.
  • Analyze performance trends, pace reports, demand drivers, channel contribution, competitive intelligence, and market dynamics to guide performance strategies.
  • Partner with Revenue Management resources and hotel leadership to align pricing, inventory, forecasting, and segment strategies with evolving market conditions.
  • Monitor commercial dashboards and performance indicators, proactively identifying risks and adjusting strategies to improve outcomes.
  • Escalate performance concerns and recommend corrective actions when business objectives are not being achieved.

Commercial Resource Activation

  • Coordinate targeted support from Revenue Management, Sales, Marketing, Loyalty, Distribution, Brand, and Operations partners based on individual hotel opportunities and needs.
  • Increase engagement and participation in proprietary revenue-generating programs and initiatives.
  • Measure and assess the effectiveness of resource activation by evaluating business impact, program participation, and performance improvements.
  • Ensure hotel teams understand and leverage available corporate resources to maximize commercial results.

Data-Driven Consultation & Business Influence

  • Translate complex operational and financial data into actionable recommendations for owners and hotel leadership teams.
  • Utilize internal and external performance tools, dashboards, benchmarking resources, and business intelligence platforms to quantify opportunities and inform decision-making.
  • Apply trusted-advisor consultation practices to align stakeholders around commercial priorities, investments, and execution commitments.
  • Measure effectiveness through performance improvement, owner engagement, action-plan completion, and program adoption.
  • Maintain expertise in industry trends, market conditions, competitive activity, and company commercial initiatives.

Owner & Stakeholder Relationship Management

  • Lead recurring performance discussions with hotel owners, management companies, and property leadership teams.
  • Build credibility and trust through commercial expertise, responsiveness, and sound business judgment.
  • Document commitments, action items, and strategic decisions while ensuring accountability and follow-through.
  • Provide leadership with insights regarding revenue performance, ownership engagement, competitive threats, and emerging business risks.
  • Serve as a primary relationship holder within the assigned portfolio and territory.

Administration & Organizational Support

  • Maintain accurate documentation of consultations, performance plans, ownership interactions, and commercial initiatives within company systems.
  • Submit timely and accurate expense reporting.
  • Support franchise growth, retention initiatives, and participation in relevant franchise associations and industry activities.
  • Share market intelligence, best practices, and emerging opportunities with franchisees, peers, and corporate stakeholders.
  • Participate in special projects and other organizational initiatives as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Employment Experience

  • Minimum fifteen (15) years of progressive hotel industry experience with significant responsibility for commercial strategy, revenue performance, sales, marketing, revenue management, or multi-property performance improvement.
  • Minimum ten (10) years of hotel leadership experience, preferably including franchise performance, revenue management, commercial leadership, or multi-unit operational responsibility.
  • Demonstrated success improving hotel commercial performance, including revenue growth, RevPAR, market share, and owner profitability.
  • Proven ability to influence business decisions through analytical insights and strategic consultation.
  • Experience working effectively within a matrixed organization and influencing outcomes without direct authority.

Technical Skills

  • Strong analytical, forecasting, and financial acumen.
  • Experience utilizing hotel performance and business intelligence tools, including revenue, financial, market share, and benchmarking platforms.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to analyze and interpret large datasets and translate findings into practical business recommendations.
  • Knowledge of hotel revenue management principles, sales activation strategies, distribution channels, marketing performance, loyalty programs, and profitability metrics.

Additional Skills & Competencies

  • Exceptional consulting, communication, negotiation, and influencing skills.
  • Strong executive presence and ability to communicate effectively with hotel owners and senior leaders.
  • Ability to balance multiple priorities while managing a geographically dispersed portfolio.
  • Strong relationship-building and stakeholder-management capabilities.
  • Demonstrated commercial acumen and strategic thinking.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and adapt priorities within a changing business environment.
  • Commitment to organizational values, integrity, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree in Hotel Management, Business Management, Marketing, Finance, or a related field or equivalent combination of education and work experience.
  • MBA preferred.

OTHER REQUIREMENTS:

  • Regular travel of approximately 70% is required.
  • Participation in conferences, owner meetings, special projects, and organizational initiatives as needed.
  • Ability to travel independently throughout the assigned territory

COMPENSATION & SALARY RANGE:

Salary Range: $99,919 to $117,000 annually

This role is also eligible for an annual bonus under Choice’s Management Incentive Plan (MIP).

Pay ranges listed are what Choice Hotels reasonably expects to pay. Actual pay may be higher or lower and ranges may be adjusted in the future. Pay positioning within the range is influenced by factors including—but not limited to—education, experience, skills, certifications, performance, geographic location, business needs, seniority, and travel requirements.

Choice prioritizes our associate wellbeing by offering a comprehensive benefits program that is both competitive and flexible to help you achieve your wellbeing goals - here are just a few:

  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Leave and paid time-off for holidays, vacation, personal, family, volunteer, sick, jury duty, bereavement, military, and religious observance
  • Financial benefits for retirement and health savings
  • Employee recognition programs
  • Discounts at Choice hotels worldwide

About Choice

Choice Hotels International, Inc. (NYSE: CHH), is one of the largest lodging franchisors in the world. With 7,500 hotels in 45+ countries and territories, we offer a range of high-quality lodging options in the upper upscale, upper midscale, midscale, extended stay, and economy segments. We’re the hotel company for those who choose to bet on themselves — the striver, the dreamer, the entrepreneur — because that’s who we are, too.

At Choice, we are united by the simple belief that tomorrow will be even better than today — for associates, our company, and our franchisees. At our worldwide corporate headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, at our technology center in Scottsdale, Arizona, and through our associates around the globe, every voice is heard and every idea is listened to, no matter what area of the company they come from. We are united in supporting the entrepreneurial dreams of our thousands of franchise owners, which propels us forward — giving our work at Choice a purpose larger than our business.

Our corporate office locations:

North Bethesda, MD — Located at Pike & Rose, our worldwide headquarters is less than 15 miles from Washington, D.C., one block away from the North Bethesda Metro station, with easy access to I-495, complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Scottsdale, AZ — Located at the northwest corner of Loop 101, the Scottsdale office is home to our technology, eCommerce and customer service organizations, with easy access to complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Minneapolis, MN — Select roles are based in our Minneapolis office on Highway 394, near the intersection with Highway 100, only five minutes from downtown.

Field/Remote — Select roles designated as field/remote will require associates to work from a home office, connecting virtually with Choice team members and leadership on Zoom, with possible required travel depending on the role.

Choice’s Cultural Values

Welcome and Respect Everyone | Be Bold | Be Quick | Listen | Be Curious | Show Integrity

Choice’s Leadership Principles

Act with Intention | Lead with Authenticity | Grow & Deliver

job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

The Project Manager, TechOps FP&A directs division financial planning, forecasting, analytics, and process-improvement initiatives that strengthen the predictability, transparency, and efficiency of TechOps financial performance. The role connects financial acumen, project execution, and data capability by developing scalable planning tools, querying and integrating large datasets, and translating operational and financial information into decision-ready insights for leaders. The Project Manager also governs recurring FP&A deliverables, timelines, documentation, and cross-functional coordination to ensure accurate and timely outputs.

  • Govern capital and investment analysis: Support capital prioritization, business cases, CAR submissions, project cash-flow forecasts, ROI/payback analysis, funding visibility, and post-approval tracking. Ensure financial assumptions, approvals, and supporting documentation are complete and traceable.
  • Deliver decision support and executive communication: Perform ad hoc analysis, develop presentations, and communicate complex findings in a concise manner. Frame tradeoffs, implications, and recommended actions for finance and business leaders.
  • Financial planning, forecasting, and performance analysis: Own and coordinate TechOps outlook, planning, variance analysis, risk and opportunity assessment, scenario modeling, and consolidated submissions. Translate financial and operational drivers into clear recommendations and leadership-ready narratives.
  • Own FP&A process governance and calendar: Maintain key calendars, stage gates, submission requirements, templates, controls, and documentation for forecast, plan, close, capital, and leadership deliverables. Proactively identify gaps and drive timely resolution.
  • Build data-enabled FP&A solutions: Query, combine, validate, and analyze large financial and operational datasets using SQL and available enterprise data platforms. Develop repeatable models, reporting tools, and automated workflows that reduce manual effort, improve accuracy, and create an auditable source of truth.

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States.
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency.
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.
  • At least three years of progressive experience in FP&A, corporate or business-unit finance, financial analysis, data analytics, project management, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of financial planning, forecasting, variance analysis, scenario modeling, cost drivers, capital analysis, cash flow, ROI, and management reporting.
  • Hands-on experience using SQL or another comparable query language or data platform to retrieve, join, filter, aggregate, reconcile, and analyze large datasets.
  • Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills, including complex financial modeling and executive-level presentations.
  • Ability to influence without direct authority, build alignment across diverse stakeholder groups, and constructively challenge assumptions.
  • Ability to communicate complex financial and technical information in a concise, comprehensive, and decision-oriented manner to all levels of management.
  • Demonstrated curiosity, sound judgement, and a continuous improvement mindset in an ambiguous, deadline-driven environment.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • A bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or other business-related field is preferred.
  • MBA or CPA highly preferred.
  • Experience in a complex operational environment, including capital planning, labor or productivity analytics, cash or working-capital analysis, or maintenance-related financial analysis.
  • Working knowledge of Power Query, Power BI, Smart View, SAP, SAP HANA, or comparable enterprise analytics and planning platforms.

Benefits And Perks To Help You Keep Climbing

Our culture is rooted in a shared dedication to living our values – Care, Integrity, Resilience, Servant Leadership, and Teamwork – every day, in everything we do. At Delta, our people are our success. At the heart of what we offer is our focus on Sharing Success with Delta employees. Exploring a career at Delta gives you a chance to see the world while earning great compensation and benefits to help you keep climbing along the way:

  • Competitive salary, industry-leading proﬁt sharing program, and performance incentives
  • 401(k) with generous company contributions up to 9%
  • Paid time off including vacation, holidays, paid personal time, maternity and parental leave
  • Comprehensive health beneﬁts including medical, dental, vision, short/long term disability and life beneﬁts
  • Family care assistance through fertility support, surrogacy and adoption assistance, lactation support, subsidized back-up care, and programs that help with loved ones in all stages
  • Holistic Wellbeing programs to support physical, emotional, social, and financial health, including access to an employee assistance program offering support for you and anyone in your household, free financial coaching, and extensive resources supporting mental health
  • Domestic and International space-available flight privileges for employees and eligible family members
  • Career development programs to achieve your long-term career goals
  • World-wide partnerships to engage in community service and innovative goals created to focus on sustainability and reducing our carbon footprint
  • Business Resource Groups created to connect employees with common interests to promote inclusion, provide perspective and help implement strategies
  • Recognition rewards and awards through the platform Unstoppable Together
  • Access to over 500 discounts, specialty savings and voluntary benefits through Deltaperks such as car and hotel rentals and auto, home, and pet insurance, legal services, and childcare

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Senior Financial Analyst, Growth Marketing Finance – Affiliates & Enterprise Commercial

Growth Marketing Finance is looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to join its Financial Planning & Analysis team, supporting the Strategic Partnerships & Affiliates (SPA) channel and enterprise commercial initiatives spanning Expedia Group's consumer brands.

Do you have excellent financial analysis skills and a passion for channel economics and partner-driven growth? Do you know how to translate complex financial data into clear, actionable commercial insight for both financial and non-financial partners? Are you excited to help shape how EG grows its affiliate and branded partnership channels into the future? Then this role is for you!

What You Will Do

SPA Affiliate Channel Finance

  • Partner with the SPA Affiliates channel team to develop financial insights that drive profitability and growth across EG's affiliate partner portfolio
  • Own weekly, monthly, and quarterly affiliate channel financial reporting & Close process — including spend, commission, bookings/NBV, and gross profit performance versus plan and prior periods
  • Perform variance analysis and outlook forecasting for affiliate channel costs and revenue, communicating key drivers clearly to channel leaders and senior finance stakeholders
  • Translate affiliate channel economics (commissions, attribution, coupon costs, ROAS) into commercial insights that directly inform marketing investment decisions
  • Evaluate commercial viability of new affiliate partner deals and launches, including partner-level profitability, commission structures, and incremental value contribution
  • Partner with SPA data, analytics, and engineering teams to improve forecast accuracy, reporting quality, and spend visibility across the affiliate partner base
  • Support affiliate channel-level business cases for product and capability investments

Enterprise Commercial & Cross-Brand Support

  • Provide financial planning and analytical support for enterprise commercial initiatives spanning EG's consumer brands — including card-linked offers, co-branded landing experiences, affiliate-aware search, and app-routed affiliate traffic programs
  • Partner with cross-functional teams across Brand Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo to evaluate the financial impact of new branded partnership and loyalty-linked products (e.g. OneKey, points exchange, loyalty-connected co-branded experiences)
  • Build and maintain financial models that quantify cross-channel and cross-brand implications of SPA investment decisions, including capital allocation tradeoffs versus other demand channels

job.job_description:
Organization- Hyatt Corporate Office

Summary

The Opportunity

Hyatt seeks an enthusiastic Central Sales Specialist to join our Central Sales Management team. In this role, you will be collaborating closely with the broader Central Sales Management team, where you’ll be instrumental in continuing to make Hyatt a leading hospitality company. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list since 2013. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

  • Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on-site fitness center
  • A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption
  • Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

The Role

The Central Services – Sales Specialist is responsible for driving incremental revenue across Essentials hotels by strategically managing Group and Transient sales opportunities throughout the entire sales lifecycle. Serving as an extension of each hotel's sales team, this role requires a strong understanding of the mid-scale segment, including its customer base, market trends, and revenue opportunities.

As a trusted sales partner, the Sales Specialist manages a dynamic pipeline of opportunities by qualifying leads, building client relationships, preparing compelling proposals, negotiating and contracting business, and guiding opportunities from inquiry through conversion. Leveraging Hyatt sales platforms—including Envision, Lanyon, and other sales technologies—the Sales Specialist ensures timely, strategic follow-up that maximizes conversion, supports hotel-specific sales goals, and delivers measurable revenue results.

The ideal candidate demonstrates expertise in Group and Transient sales funnel management, excels in managing a high-volume pipeline, and consistently delivers an exceptional customer experience. Success in this role requires strong business acumen, effective prioritization, and a proven ability to support mid-scale hotels while applying Hyatt systems and sales strategies to grow market share and top-line revenue.

Qualifications

Experience Required

  • Previous Hyatt Select Service and/or upper-midscale experience required
  • A true desire to satisfy the needs of others in a fast-paced environment
  • Refined verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong organization and presentation skills
  • Must be able to work independently and simultaneously manage multiple tasks
  • Must be outgoing and a proven self-starter
  • A minimum of 3-5 years of hotel sales or comparable experience preferred
  • Must be proficient in general computer knowledge, Envision, Lanyon Opera, and Cvent

Experience Preferred:

  • Bachelor’s degree in hospitalilty or a related field

The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all-encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary.

The salary range for this position is $75,000-$80,000. This position is also eligible to earn incentive awards, an annual bonus, monthly or quarterly incentives, etc.

The final pay rate/salary offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level, and other qualifications for the role, as well as the location of the performance of work. Pay for the successful candidate will meet local requirements, including the local minimum wage rate.

We welcome you:

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.

We value our relationships with recruitment partners and require that agencies contact us first before submitting any candidates. Hyatt will not be responsible for any fees and obligations associated with unsolicited submissions unless a formal agreement is in place.

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You will lead the sales team and ensure that the hotel’s revenue targets are met. This role involves developing and implementing sales strategies, building relationships with key clients, and overseeing the daily operations of the sales department. As a Commercial Manager - HGI Rayong and Cluster Director of Sales - Hilton Pattaya and HGI Rayong, you’re not just driving revenue growth across all hotel segments – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Shape and execute sales strategy: Develop and implement revenue-driving sales strategies across group, business transient, leisure transient, and catering segments, aligned with the hotel’s commercial goals and strategic plan
  • Drive revenue performance and profitability: Contribute to achieving revenue targets and profitability goals by optimizing pricing, improving business mix, and guiding forecasting accuracy
  • Lead business reviews and planning: Facilitate regular strategy and performance meetings while contributing to long-range commercial planning through analysis of performance trends, market shifts, and revenue opportunities
  • Ensure commercial alignment: Collaborate with revenue and marketing leaders to align sales tactics with pricing, distribution, and promotional strategies, and to support forecasting and rate strategies
  • Foster stakeholder relationships: Engage with Hilton Worldwide Sales, Convention and Visitors Bureaus (CVBs), third-party travel partners, and key clients to drive demand, improve conversion, and support high-impact site visits and pre-convention meetings
  • Develop data-informed strategies: Track market and competitor activity to inform strategy and help maintain competitive positioning in group and transient segments
  • Cultivate a high-performing team: Recruit new talent while driving team growth and engagement through performance management, professional development, and recognition programs

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • Degree qualifications in Business Management or equivalent.
  • At least 5 years of experience in managing a hospitality proactive sales role preferred.
  • Minimum 5+ years in a revenue-generating or commercial role within hospitality or travel.
  • Proven experience managing and developing high-performing sales or commercial teams.
  • Skilled in creating and presenting sales strategies to senior executives and stakeholder groups.
  • Proficient in analyzing departmental financial data to inform strategic decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify and capitalize on new business opportunities.
  • Experience working in matrixed environments across departments.
  • Experience in multi-complex hotel or travel operations.
  • Technical Proficiency in hotel management software (e.g., Delphi, Salesforce, OnQ, Market Planner Survey systems) is a plus.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

We believe in the power of travel. It broadens horizons for our customers, and for our people too. New places to live, new roles to explore, new communities to join. It’s yours for the taking.
We’re TUI, a leading global travel and leisure experience company that makes holiday dreams come true for people around the world.
We are one of the world’s leading tourism groups counting 1200 travel agencies and online portals, five airlines with around 130 aircraft, over 400 hotels, 16 cruise liners, digital platforms for tours and activities and most importantly over 60 000 colleagues around the world. What unites us is creating moments that enrich the lives of our 21 million customers.
Beside the unforgettable experience we provide our customers, we also believe in the good that tourism can bring and we care deeply about our environmental impact. The TUI Care foundation has projects in over 30 countries worldwide, building on the potential of tourism as a global force for development. The Foundation opens up new perspectives through education and training, empowers local communities to benefit from the success of tourism and engages in the protection of nature and the environment.
At TUI we simply say “Let’s TUI it”. For us, that means creating happiness. Tackling challenges every day together, with a positive, can-do attitude, and finding solutions even for the most unexpected situations. Our teams across TUI are just as diverse as our destinations. So whether you have lots of experience or none at all. If you want to work in an office or feel best in the field. No matter if you’re an accomplished tech whizz, an aspiring entertainer, or simply in love with flying.
There’s a place for you here.
job.job_description:
Here at TUI, you’ll find we’re an inclusive company with a culture of care and by joining the Retail Team as a Travel Advisor in our Oxford store, we’ll support you to become a destination expert so that you can recommend and sell holidays, Cruise, UK Breaks and additional products. You’ll put all customers at the heart of our business by creating unforgettable holiday experiences that make us the best-loved holiday company.

As part of our dedication to delivering exceptional customer service and flexibility for our customers, you’ll enjoy a varied shift pattern each week including weekends and bank holidays, and evenings at some of our busier stores.

About Our Offer

  • TUI offers much more than just starting salary of £13.09 per hour
  • Be rewarded for exceeding your targets with our commission scheme
  • Enjoy fantastic holiday benefits, discounts, special offers and the ability to purchase additional TUI time off
  • Benefit from our Health and Wellbeing across key areas – Financial, Health, Social, Community and Career
  • Investment in your development and career progression
  • Pension scheme and life assurance

About The Job

  • Use your passion to inspire our customers and colleagues whilst enjoying a great amount of fun
  • Your drive to achieve will lead you to exceed your sales objectives, in Retail we call it ‘Smashing your Targets’
  • You’ll embrace change and rise to the challenges of a customer engaged role both face to face and virtually
  • If things don’t go to plan, you’ll need to be confident to actively investigate and resolve any question or complaint
  • As technology advances so does TUI, you’ll receive training on a variety of systems empowering you to enhance your knowledge whilst bringing memorable holidays to life for our customers.

About You

  • Excellent customer service skills with a genuine passion to go above and beyond
  • A strong dedication to achieve goals and sales targets
  • Able to prioritise multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment and bounce back from challenges
  • Ability to embrace change and adapt to new ways of working
  • A team player who engages and collaborates with our customers and colleagues
  • An organised individual who takes pride in their work and communicates effectively
  • Able to work a varied shift pattern each week in-line with shop opening and closing times.

From a workplace to a place to belong. At TUI we embrace diversity, equity and inclusion, encouraging everyone to come as you are, because together, our potential is limitless.

We're committed to supporting candidates with disabilities and impairments so if you require any support, please let us know.

For the Hiring Manger to have sight of your application, you'll also need complete our online assessment - you'll be prompted to do this once you've submitted your application.

Please note, if you've been interviewed for this role within the last 6 months, we're unable to consider a further application at this time

job.job_description:
Job Title

Customer Success Management Specialist (Hospitality)

Purpose Of The Role

The Customer Success Management (CSM) Specialist is the main contact for customers at Amadeus Hospitality. They understand the company's products and the hospitality industry well. The CSM helps customers and the company increase their revenues. They handle new and renewal sales for their accounts and support other account owners when needed.

The CSM ensures customers are onboarded successfully and manage their accounts. They help customers get the most out of Amadeus products and find opportunities for other products. The CSM provides regular updates to improve product use and serves as a point of contact for any issues.

Main Responsibilities

  • Manage new and renewal sales for accounts and support other account owners.
  • Act as the main contact for assigned accounts, handle customer communications, resolve conflicts, and ensure contract compliance.
  • Conduct regular business reviews with customers to meet their goals and assist with revenue strategies. Ensure optimal product use and share system updates.
  • Resolve customer issues quickly and handle escalated matters. Inform team leads and the Director of Operations about any problems and track risks in the CRM.
  • Understand each product and service to make informed recommendations to clients.
  • Meet regional consortia goals for renewal and new sales during the consortia season and throughout the year.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and assess their impact on clients.
  • Support the onboarding and ongoing service delivery for customers. Review major deliverables to ensure quality and work closely with project teams to identify issues and opportunities.
  • Work with the collections department to ensure timely payment of orders and address any outstanding bills over 90 days.

About The Ideal Candidate

  • Proven experience in a Sales or Revenue Management role within the hospitality industry, with a proven ability to persuade, influence, and negotiate effectively.
  • In-depth understanding of customer relationship management, coupled with excellent communication and conflict resolution skills, and the capability to manage multiple accounts and projects simultaneously.
  • Extensive background in the hospitality industry or a comprehensive understanding of hotel operations, particularly in the context of revenue management.
  • Relevant degree or Diploma in Hospitality, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Note: As part of our recruitment process, successful candidates will be required to complete pre-employment screening, which includes a National Coordinated Criminal History Check. Employment offers and ongoing engagement will be subject to the satisfactory completion of this screening.

What we can offer you ?

🎯 A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you will be powering the future of travel and pursuing a critical mission and extraordinary purpose.

🌎 A truly global DNA - Everything at Amadeus is global, from our people to our business, which translates into our footprint, processes, and culture.

🎓 Great opportunities to learn - Learning happens all the time and in many ways at Amadeus, through on-the-job training, formal learning activities, and day-to-day interactions with colleagues.

🤗 A caring environment - Amadeus fosters a caring environment, nurturing both a fulfilling career and personal and family life. We care about our employees and strive to provide a supportive work environment.

💰 A complete rewards offer - Amadeus provides attractive remuneration packages, covering all essential components of a competitive reward offer, including salary, bonus, equity, and benefits.

🌟 A flexible working model - We want our employees to do their best work, wherever and however it works best for them.

🌈 A diverse and inclusive community - We are committed to leveraging our uniquely diverse population to drive innovation, creativity, and collaboration across our organization.

📈 A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental values that drive our actions and shape long-lasting relationships with our customers, partners, and employees.

Diversity & Inclusion

Amadeus aspires to be a leader in Diversity and Inclusion in the tech industry, enabling every employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment, attracting the best talent from all backgrounds, and as a role model for an inclusive employee experience. 

Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer and committed to an accessible recruitment process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law.

Be aware of recruitment scams

Amadeus Group never charges fees, requests payment, or asks for financial information during recruitment. All legitimate opportunities are communicated solely through official Amadeus channels, including our careers website. Any payment request or outreach via unofficial platforms (e.g., WhatsApp, Telegram) should be treated as fraudulent.
