job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know Our Team

The Strategic Partnerships team is responsible for identifying, building, and scaling high-impact partnerships that expand Agoda’s reach, improve customer acquisition, and create long-term business value.

For Japan, Financial Institution (FI) partnerships represent a strategic growth channel. This role will focus on developing and managing relationships with banks, card issuers, digital wallets, and other financial ecosystem partners to drive customer engagement, commercial growth, and win-win partnership outcomes.

You will work cross-functionally with teams across Commercial, Marketing, Product, Finance, Legal, Analytics, and Operations to bring partnership opportunities from idea to execution and optimization.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships to lead Agoda’s Japan FI partnership strategy and execution.

In this role, you will be responsible for identifying new partnership opportunities, managing key strategic accounts, negotiating commercial agreements, and driving performance across Agoda’s financial institution partnerships in Japan. You will help shape Agoda’s local partnership roadmap, unlock joint business opportunities, and ensure excellent execution of campaigns and initiatives with partners.

The ideal candidate brings strong business development and partnership experience, sharp commercial judgment, analytical rigor, and the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders. This role requires someone who is highly strategic but also willing to work hands-on to deliver measurable outcomes.

Why This Role Matters

This role is critical to Agoda’s growth in Japan. Financial institution partnerships are a highly strategic channel that can unlock scalable customer demand, deepen brand presence, and create differentiated value for travelers and partners alike.

As Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships, you will play a central role in shaping Agoda’s FI ecosystem in Japan and delivering high-impact partnerships that drive sustainable business growth.

What You’ll Do

Partnership Strategy & Business Development

  • Define and drive Agoda’s FI partnership strategy for Japan, aligned with market priorities and business growth objectives
  • Identify, evaluate, and prioritize new partnership opportunities with banks, credit card issuers, payment platforms, loyalty programs, and other financial ecosystem players
  • Build compelling partnership value propositions and business cases to secure internal alignment and partner buy-in
  • Lead commercial discussions, negotiations, and contract execution with prospective and existing FI partners

Account Management & Growth

  • Own and grow a portfolio of key FI partners in Japan, ensuring strong relationship management and long-term strategic alignment
  • Develop joint business plans with partners to drive customer acquisition, transaction growth, brand visibility, and partnership profitability
  • Monitor partner performance and proactively identify growth levers, optimization opportunities, and operational improvements
  • Ensure timely execution of campaigns, product integrations, and partner initiatives

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Analytics, Finance, Legal, and Operations to launch and scale partnership initiatives
  • Translate partner needs into clear internal requirements and drive execution across multiple teams
  • Influence decision-making through strong communication, stakeholder management, and data-backed recommendations
  • Support process improvements, reporting frameworks, and operating models to improve scalability and partner experience

Analytics & Optimization

  • Analyze partnership performance, customer behavior, campaign effectiveness, and commercial outcomes to generate actionable insights
  • Use data to identify trends, optimize investment decisions, and improve partnership ROI
  • Build business cases for new initiatives and present recommendations to senior stakeholders
  • Track key success metrics and maintain clear visibility on pipeline, performance, and impact

Experience

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • 7+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, account management, consulting, or a related commercial role
  • Strong experience managing external partners and driving commercial outcomes in a fast-paced, data-driven environment
  • Experience working with or within financial institutions, payment companies, loyalty ecosystems, or digital consumer platforms is highly preferred
  • Experience in e-commerce, travel, fintech, payments, or internet platforms is a strong plus
  • Proven track record of leading cross-functional initiatives from concept through execution

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to structure win-win partnerships and negotiate effectively
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to convert data into clear business insights and actions
  • Strong project management capabilities with high attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience influencing senior internal and external stakeholders
  • Self-starter with a bias for action and ability to operate independently in an ambiguous environment
  • Comfortable working hands-on while also thinking strategically

Technical / Functional

  • Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience with SQL, Tableau, or data visualization tools is a plus
  • Ability to develop business cases, commercial models, and performance reporting frameworks
  • Familiarity with campaign execution, co-marketing partnerships, loyalty mechanics, or payment-related partnership models is beneficial

Language

  • Fluency in English and Japanese is required

job.job_description:
Company Description

 Join Accor – a professional journey at the heart of a committed, international and transforming group

Accor, a global leader in hospitality, present in more than 110 countries with 5,500 hotels, welcomes you to its offices located in Issy-les-Moulineaux.

This is where the Group’s global expertise comes together: strategy, finance, human resources, legal, technology, marketing, sustainability, communication, audit, procurement, etc.

Joining Accor means actively contributing to defining, structuring, and supporting the transformation of an international group, in direct connection with operational teams around the world.

Job Description

Accor Tech & Digital is the innovation and technological transformation lab of the world leader in hospitality.

Our teams, known as Heartists®, bring together the best of hospitality with the best of tech and digital. Our ambition is to provide our customers with personalized, memorable, and sustainable experiences.

Here, we create new ways to travel within each of our 5,500 hotels, connecting closely with our 100 million clients in 110 countries.

Here, we are at the heart of an incredible playground for technological transition and the design of digital products and services for our customers and hotel teams.

Here, your scope will know no boundaries;

So join us and dare to make an impact on the world!

This Is Where Your Greatest Challenge Awaits

Reporting to the SVP of Data Science & AI, you will join a team at the heart of the Accor Group’s transformation through data and artificial intelligence.

Within the Data department, the Data Science & AI vertical aims to define and implement the Group’s AI vision, to scale up the use of ML, GenAI and Agentic AI, and to maximise the business impact of these technologies on the customer experience, hotel operations and internal teams.

You will act as the bridge between business sponsors and the AI / Data Engineering teams, ensuring the right product is built, shipped, adopted and continuously improved.

Your Mission

  • Business Partnership: capture business needs, frame AI use cases, align on KPIs and expected value with stakeholders (Commercial, Marketing, Distribution, Operations, Brand).
  • Product Ownership:
    • Own product vision, roadmap and backlog;
    • Prioritise features balancing business value, technical feasibility and risk.
  • Delivery Leadership:
    • Lead an internal/external squad composed of Data Scientists, AI / GenAI Engineers & ML Ops Engineers;
    • Drive sprints, quality, time-to-market and production readiness.
  • Adoption & Value Tracking:
    • Drive change management and end-user adoption;
    • Measure usage, ROI and business impact;
    • Report to sponsors and leadership.
  • Vendor & Budget Management: steer external partners (OpenAI, Giskard, Converteo, Artefact, etc.), manage budget, contracts and SLAs
  • Risk, Ethics & Compliance: ensure GDPR, Responsible AI and security guardrails are embedded by design, in close partnership with DPO, Legal and Compliance teams.
Qualifications

And you?

  • Master's Degree in Engineering, Data Science, Computer Science or Business School with a strong Tech/Data grounding
  • Strong experience (7+ years) in Product Management, Consulting or applied AI delivery, with at least one major AI / Data Product shipped end-to-end in production
  • Experience in hospitality, travel or retail is a plus

Technical Skills

  • Hands-on literacy in GenAI and ML Ops making you able to challenge technical choices with Data Scientists and AI Engineers
  • Fluency with OpenAI, AWS AgentCore, Anthropic and Microsoft Foundry

Soft Skills & Mindset

  • Strong business acumen and ability to translate priorities into AI products in a complex organisation
  • Ability to manage senior stakeholders up to C-Level
  • You identify with these three key values shared by your team members: Learn & Be Curious ; Take Ownership ; Build Trust with Stakeholders

Additional Information

Accor Dares To Impact

  • the world
  • Accor is committed to the world around us, with a strong employer culture focused on the development of our 300,000 talents.
  • We adopt a continuous improvement approach to reduce the impact of digital on the environment across all our projects.
  • your career:
  • We enable all our employees to manage their work-life balance and offer them the means to shape their work environment according to their preferences.
  • Training and career paths are defined both individually and collectively, allowing us to grow together on a daily basis.
  • Specifically, at Accor Tech & Digital:
  • Remote work available several days per week from France, with flexible work options: work from home, from our offices, or even from our hotels and coworking spaces through Worklib.
  • Every Wednesday afternoon, dedicate your time to deep work and personal development.
  • Work in a multicultural and English-speaking environment.
  • Continuous improvement & training: hackathons, exceptional technology partnerships, dedicated talent management, certifications and a dedicated learning platform.

and also,

  • ALL - Heartist® Program: unforgettable stays and experiences at all Accor locations and partner venues worldwide.
  • Heartist® for Good Program: commit to supporting an association of your choice from those available on our volunteering platform (1 day offered per year by the Group during your working hours).
  • An Employee Social Committee (CSE) supporting the financing of your cultural and sports activities.
  • Sustainable Mobility Package for the use of eco-friendly transportation or access to a company bike program in partnership with Zenride.
  • Coverage of urban public transport subscriptions between home and workplace, in accordance with the rates set by French law “Loi Finance”.
  • €11 meal vouchers.
  • A mandatory health insurance plan funded at 50% by Accor without additional costs in case of enrollment of your dependents.
  • Attractive working conditions with collaborative workspaces, restaurants, and recreational areas as well as wellness and sports facilities, on-site or through Gymlib.

Your talent and motivation are our only selection criteria.

We value the richness of diverse nationalities, personalities, and professional backgrounds.

We know how to adapt to the specific needs of our employees, including those with disabilities.

We encourage all applications, regardless of gender, so go ahead and apply!

Recruitment is all about people!

Is this mission appealing to you? Apply, and we will offer you:

  • A meeting with our recruitment team to present the essential aspects of the position to you or guide you towards the role that may suit you.
  • An interview with the team manager responsible for the role you are interested in.
  • For some roles, you might also be required to complete an assessment (use case and motivation questionnaire.
  • A final interview with our Human Resources team to discuss our Group's culture, work environment, training program, career prospects, as well as various benefits offered by the Group.
  • A personalized feedback.

job.job_description:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Analyst, Financial Account Management is responsible for managing a designated portfolio of franchisee accounts and supporting the timely collection of outstanding receivables. This role works directly with franchisees to resolve past-due balances, monitor account activity, and execute collection strategies in accordance with established policies and procedures.

The Analyst partners with Financial Account Management leadership and internal stakeholders, including Franchise Sales, Operations, Legal, and Finance, to address delinquent accounts while considering the broader franchise relationship. The role will identify accounts requiring additional action and support recommendations related to payment arrangements, defaults, reservation suspensions, settlements, and franchise termination. Success in this role requires strong communication and organizational skills, attention to detail, developing financial and business judgment, and the ability to build productive relationships with franchisees and internal partners.

Note: This role is onsite 4 days a week in North Bethesda, MD and is not eligible for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Franchise Portfolio Management

  • Manage an assigned territory and portfolio of franchisee accounts, with responsibility for day-to-day collection activities and follow-up.
  • Monitor accounts receivable balances, aging, payment activity, and delinquency to identify accounts requiring collection action.
  • Contact franchisees regarding past-due balances and establish clear expectations for payment
  • Work with franchisees to understand circumstances contributing to delinquency and identify appropriate paths toward resolution.
  • Execute collection strategies in accordance with established policies, procedures, and direction from Financial Account Management leadership.
  • Facilitate payment arrangements within established guidelines and escalate requests requiring additional approval.
  • Research and help resolve billing questions, disputes, and account discrepancies in partnership with appropriate internal teams.
  • Maintain accurate and timely documentation of collection activities, franchisee commitments, disputes, and account status.
  • Prioritize collection activities based on account aging, balances, risk, and established business priorities.

Risk Management & Escalation

  • Identify franchisee accounts requiring escalation based on delinquency, broken payment commitments, financial risk, or other established criteria.
  • Gather relevant account information and prepare recommendations for next steps, including payment arrangements, defaults, reservation suspensions, settlements, or other collection actions.
  • Support the development of termination recommendations when collection efforts and other remedies have been unsuccessful.
  • Escalate complex, high-risk, or sensitive franchisee situations to Senior Analysts or Financial Account Management leadership for guidance and decision-making.
  • Execute approved collection and enforcement actions and ensure appropriate follow-up is completed.
  • Partner with Legal and Financial Account Management leadership to provide documentation and account information needed to support default, suspension, or termination processes.
  • Develop an understanding of franchise agreements, company policies, and contractual remedies applicable to delinquent accounts.

Franchisee Relationship Management

  • Build professional and productive relationships with franchise owners and operators while maintaining appropriate financial accountability.
  • Communicate clearly and professionally with franchisees regarding outstanding balances, payment commitments, and collection requirements.
  • Navigate difficult financial conversations with professionalism and seek guidance on particularly complex or sensitive situations.
  • Balance effective collections practices with appropriate consideration for the broader franchise relationship.
  • Provide franchisees with accurate information regarding account balances, payment obligations, and collection processes.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Develop effective working relationships with Franchise Sales, Franchise Operations, Legal, Finance, and other internal stakeholders.
  • Communicate account status, collection activity, and significant franchisee issues to appropriate business partners.
  • Seek input from internal stakeholders when operational, contractual, or relationship considerations may affect the collection strategy.
  • Coordinate with business partners to support agreed-upon collection actions and account resolutions.
  • Develop an understanding of how collection decisions may affect broader franchise relationships and company objectives.
  • Escalate situations involving competing business priorities to Senior Analysts or Financial Account Management leadership as appropriate.

Analysis & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor assigned portfolio performance and identify changes in aging, delinquency, and payment behavior.
  • Prepare regular account updates and provide accurate information for portfolio reporting and forecasting.
  • Identify recurring account issues and communicate potential trends to Financial Account Management leadership.
  • Participate in process improvement initiatives and contribute ideas for improving collection effectiveness and the franchisee experience.
  • Develop knowledge of collections best practices, company policies, franchise agreements, and the broader franchise business model.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Employment Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
  • 2-3+ years of experience in collections, accounts receivable, credit, customer financial services, finance, or a related field.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to conduct professional and sometimes difficult conversations regarding financial obligations.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts, deadlines, and priorities.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining accurate account documentation.
  • Solid analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently within established guidelines while recognizing when escalation or additional guidance is appropriate.
  • Ability to develop productive working relationships with both external customers and internal business partners.
  • Experience working across Sales, Operations, Legal, Finance, or similar business functions.

Salary Range

The salary range for this role is $57,129 - $75,000.

Choice prioritizes our associate wellbeing by offering a comprehensive benefits program that is both competitive and flexible to help you achieve your wellbeing goals - here are just a few:

  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Leave and paid time-off for holidays, vacation, personal, family, volunteer, sick, jury duty, bereavement, military, and religious observance
  • Financial benefits for retirement and health savings
  • Employee recognition programs
  • Discounts at Choice hotels worldwide

About Choice

Choice Hotels International, Inc. (NYSE: CHH), is one of the largest lodging franchisors in the world. With 7,500 hotels in 45+ countries and territories, we offer a range of high-quality lodging options in the upper upscale, upper midscale, midscale, extended stay, and economy segments. At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Manager, Performance Marketing

Introduction to the Team

We create and deliver tailored marketing strategies for Expedia Group’s brands, focusing on establishing strong connections and cohesive experiences for travelers and partners. We leverage our functional expertise and creative excellence to build trust and loyalty for our brands through innovative marketing approaches and technology.

Make an impact

The Performance Marketing team helps Expedia Group connect travelers with the right travel experiences through data-led, technology-enabled marketing. This role sits at the intersection of search marketing, product strategy, data science, and automation. You will shape the strategy and operating model for Expedia Group’s non-Google search portfolio, combining search expertise, experimentation, automation, and artificial intelligence (AI) to improve efficiency and accelerate growth across global markets.

In this role, you will

  • Own the strategic vision and performance of the non-Google Search Engine Marketing (SEM) portfolio, including Bing, Yahoo Japan, and Naver
  • Develop scalable account-structure standards, testing frameworks, and decision-making playbooks for campaign management and optimization
  • Lead AI, automation, and marketing technology initiatives, including dashboards, monitoring systems, and AI-powered workflows
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Operations teams to define roadmaps and build solutions that connect business objectives with technical implementation
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for non-Google search engines and emerging search technologies, while influencing partner roadmaps through strategic engagement with Microsoft, Yahoo Japan, and Naver
  • Present strategic recommendations and business performance updates to senior leadership, mentor colleagues, and build organizational capability in SEM, analytics, automation, and AI adoption

Experience And Qualifications

  • You have a bachelor’s degree in a quantitative, technical, or business discipline; or equivalent related professional experience
  • You have advanced SQL and Microsoft Excel skills, with experience analyzing large datasets
  • You have experience with Python, automation technologies, AI tools, marketing technology platforms, or APIs
  • You have a strong understanding of SEM strategy, experimentation, bidding systems, and performance optimization
  • You can translate business objectives into practical technical solutions and work effectively across multidisciplinary teams
  • You have proficient communication, stakeholder management, project leadership, and mentoring skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • You have experience building AI-enabled marketing solutions or internal automation tools
  • You have experience operating within complex, global performance marketing organizations
  • You have demonstrated the ability to shape product roadmaps and develop long-term strategic plans

Accommodation requests

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.

About Expedia Group

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Equal Opportunity

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

job.job_description:
【ポジション概要】

日本&ミクロネシア担当デジタル（オムニチャネル）マーケティング・アソシエイト・マネージャーは、LINEエコシステム、IHGジャパンが運営するソーシャルチャネル、IHGジャパンのウェブサイトを中心に、日本市場向け自社デジタルチャネルおよびカスタマージャーニーの実行・運用から継続的な最適化までを一貫して担います。あわせて、グローバルおよびEAPACキャンペーンの日本・ミクロネシアにおけるローカライズと実行を支援し、承認済みのキャンペーン方針を、IHG.com、ウェブ／アプリのマーチャンダイジング、メール、モバイルプッシュ通知、LINE、Instagramの各チャネルにおいて、現地市場に即した実行可能な施策計画へと落とし込みます。

業務は、オムニチャネル全体の企画・統合管理と実務の遂行の両面にわたります。具体的には、コンテンツ・素材の取りまとめ、プラットフォームおよびコンテンツの設定、ローカライズ、関係者との合意形成、代理店・テクノロジーパートナーの管理、テスト、品質チェック（QA）、ローンチ準備、パフォーマンスレポーティング、ローンチ後の最適化を担当します。

マーケティング、ロイヤリティ、ブランド、テクノロジー、アナリティクス、リージョナル／グローバルチーム、代理店、ホテルの関係者と連携して一貫性のある質の高い顧客体験を提供し、効果的なオムニチャネル施策と継続的な最適化を通じて、ダイレクトチャネルの成果、顧客エンゲージメント、収益の拡大に貢献します。

【主な業務内容】

オムニチャネルの企画・統合管理

  • 承認済みの市場戦略、キャンペーン、ロイヤリティプログラムの優先事項を、LINE、Instagram、IHG.com、メール、モバイルプッシュ通知、ウェブ／アプリ上のコミュニケーションおよびマーチャンダイジングにわたる、実行可能なオムニチャネル施策計画に落とし込む。
  • カスタマージャーニーにおける担当各チャネルの役割を、ターゲット、メッセージ、タイミング、コンテンツ形式、遷移先、CTAを含めて定義する。
  • 統合チャネルカレンダー、実行計画、逆算スケジュール、進捗管理表、ローンチ準備資料を作成・更新する。
  • 調整や進捗確認にとどまらず、担当範囲内のコンテンツ・プラットフォーム設定を自ら管理・実施する。
  • 関連するステークホルダー、リスク、責任の所在が曖昧な領域を早期に洗い出し、主体的に解決へ導く。
  • パフォーマンス結果を集約し、得られた示唆を明確かつ実行可能な改善策につなげる。
  • LINEエコシステムの運用・活性化
  • LINE公式アカウントおよびLINEミニアプリの日々の運用・施策実行を管理する。
  • ランディングページ、バナー、リッチメニュー、メッセージ配信、キャンペーン、ゲーミフィケーション施策を企画・実行する。
  • コンテンツ、クリエイティブ素材、ホテル・特典情報、利用規約、リンク、計測要件など、実行に必要な情報・素材を取りまとめる。
  • コンテンツ・プラットフォームの設定、テスト環境での確認、ジャーニーテスト、QA、本番リリースに向けた準備を担う。
  • 代理店、技術チーム、社内関係者、ホテルチームを主体的に動かし、品質とスケジュールを担保する。
  • パフォーマンスデータや顧客行動データを活用し、コンテンツ、ターゲティング、ジャーニー、施策の仕組みを改善する。
  • IHGジャパン運営ソーシャルチャネルの管理
  • Instagramを中心に、IHGジャパンが運営するソーシャルチャネルのコンテンツおよび施策カレンダーを管理する。
  • フィード投稿、リール、その他担当フォーマットについて、ブリーフ作成、素材制作、キャプション、承認、投稿スケジュールを管理・調整する。
  • ペイドメディア、ブランド、キャンペーン、ホテルの各担当者と連携し、送客およびキャンペーン全体の目標達成を支援する。
  • ソーシャルチャネルからLINE、IHG.com、関連するキャンペーン体験へ顧客を誘導する導線を設計する。
  • 代理店の成果物を管理し、レポートや知見をもとにコンテンツ、フォーマット、カスタマージャーニーを改善する。
  • IHGジャパン ウェブサイトの最適化
  • IHG.com上の日本市場向けコンテンツおよびカスタマージャーニー（日本市場向けページ、デスティネーション・ブランド紹介コンテンツ、キャンペーンページなど）を管理し、継続的に改善する。
  • アクセス解析データ、検索パフォーマンスデータ、ユーザーの検索意図をもとに、コンテンツの不足、ジャーニー上の離脱要因、改善余地を特定する。
  • コンテンツ構成、タイトル、ディスクリプション、内部リンク、回答型コンテンツに、SEOおよびAI検索（AIO）の最新の考え方を適用する。
  • ローカライズ、代理店による制作、関係者レビュー、コンテンツ設定、QA、公開までを取りまとめる。
  • 必要に応じて、ウェブサイトのコンテンツをLINE、Instagram、メール、モバイルプッシュ通知、アプリ上のジャーニーと連動させる。
  • グローバルおよびEAPACチームと連携し、グローバル共通のプラットフォーム基準と、日本特有の顧客・ビジネスニーズとの両立を図る。
  • グローバル・EAPACキャンペーンの実行支援
  • パートナーシップキャンペーンを含む、グローバルおよびEAPACキャンペーンの日本・ミクロネシアにおけるローカライズと実行を支援する。
  • 承認済みのリージョナルキャンペーン方針を、担当するオムニチャネルの各タッチポイントにおいて、現地市場に即した成果物に落とし込む。
  • IHG.com、ウェブ／アプリのマーチャンダイジング、メール、モバイルプッシュ通知、LINE、Instagramにおける担当成果物について、設定、ローカライズ、入稿、テスト、QA、ローンチ準備までを管理する。
  • グローバル、EAPAC、日本・ミクロネシアの関係者から、必要な情報や意思決定を主体的に取り付ける。
  • リージョナル施策のうち現地対応が必要な点を見極め、根拠に基づく提言を行う。
  • 市場別の実績、実行上の学び、今後のキャンペーンに向けた提言を取りまとめる。

【応募要件】

学歴

  • ビジネス、マーケティング、デジタル、コミュニケーション、または関連分野の学士号もしくは修士号、またはこれと同等の学歴と実務経験

経験

  • デジタルマーケティング、CRM、自社チャネルマーケティング、ソーシャルメディア、Eコマース、デジタルコンテンツ、または関連分野における5〜8年程度の実務経験
  • 企画、ブリーフィング、コンテンツ制作、プラットフォーム／コンテンツ設定、テスト、QA、ローンチ、効果検証まで、プロジェクトを一貫して遂行した実績
  • 日常的な指示が限られる環境で、複数の案件、関係者、相互依存関係を並行して管理できる能力
  • 社内外の関係者を主体的に巻き込み、情報収集、意思決定、成果物の納品を推進した実績
  • 代理店、テクノロジーパートナー、サプライヤーなど、外部の実行パートナーを管理した経験
  • グローバルまたはリージョナルのマトリクス組織において、ローカル施策とグローバル／リージョナル施策の双方を支援した経験
  • ホスピタリティ、旅行、ロイヤリティプログラム、小売、Eコマース、または消費者向けプラットフォーム事業での経験（歓迎）

技術・チャネルに関する知識

  • ウェブサイト、メール、モバイルプッシュ通知、アプリ、ソーシャルプラットフォームなど、自社デジタルチャネルに関する確かな実務知識
  • LINE公式アカウント、LINEミニアプリ、または同等のメッセージング／ミニアプリ・エコシステムの実務経験（強く歓迎）
  • CMSおよびウェブサイト運用プロセス、ランディングページ制作、デジタルコンテンツ設定、配信対象（オーディエンス）要件、キャンペーン計測、QAに関する実務知識
  • アクセス解析および検索パフォーマンス分析ツールの実務知識（Adobe Analytics、Google Search Consoleの経験があれば尚可）
  • SEOおよびAI検索（AIO）の最新動向に関する実務知識。コンテンツの構造、権威性、関連性、回答型の情報設計が、従来の検索およびAIを活用した検索体験における露出向上にどう寄与するかを理解していること
  • パフォーマンスデータを読み解き、得られた示唆をチャネル・コンテンツの具体的な改善策に落とし込める能力
  • ネイティブレベルの日本語力と高いビジネス英語力を持ち、両言語で、そのまま公開できる水準のコンテンツを自ら作成・校閲し、プレゼンテーションができること

ステークホルダーマネジメント・リーダーシップ

  • 施策の遂行に必要な社内外の関係者を自ら特定し、巻き込む。
  • 部門横断チームにおいて、役割、責任範囲、意思決定ポイント、期限を明確にする。
  • 正式な権限やシニアマネージャーからの継続的な指示に頼らず、周囲への働きかけ、論理的なコミュニケーション、能動的なフォローアップによって物事を前に進める。
  • 上位の関係者、専門部署、代理店、テクノロジーパートナー、ホテルチームと臆せず向き合い、適切に調整・リードする。
  • ビジネス、マーケティング、クリエイティブ、アナリティクス、テクノロジーの各関係者の視点や言葉の違いを理解し、橋渡し役を担う。
  • 優先順位の対立や責任の所在の曖昧さを見極め、現実的な解決に向けて調整する。
  • 自ら判断・解決できる事項と、エスカレーションが必要な事項を適切に見極める。
  • エスカレーションの際は、背景、ビジネスへの影響、選択肢、明確な推奨案をあわせて提示する。
  • 分かりやすいブリーフ、意思決定記録、会議の結論、ネクストアクションを文書化する。

デリバリー管理・ガバナンス・品質管理

  • 担当施策を、ブリーフィングから実行、ローンチ、レポーティング、最適化まで自律的に推進する。
  • シニアマネージャーの継続的な指示に頼らず、必要な情報を主体的に収集し、意思決定を促す。
  • リスク、遅延、品質上の懸念、責任の所在の曖昧さを早期に把握し、解決に向けて手を打つ。
  • 日本語・英語双方のコピーおよびコンテンツ品質に責任を持ち、シニアマネージャーの確認を前提とせず、自らの判断でそのまま公開できる水準まで仕上げる。
  • コピー、クリエイティブ、ローカライズ、リンク、ランディングページ、設定、計測、配信対象要件、プラットフォーム上の表示、カスタマージャーニーまで、エンドツーエンドのQAを自ら完結させる。
  • 不十分なブリーフ、責任の所在が不明確な状態、根拠に乏しい提案、求められる水準に満たない成果物に対しては、臆せず問題提起する。
  • プロセス、意思決定、得られた知見を文書化し、特定の個人に依存しない業務体制をつくる。

[Purpose of the Role]

The Associate Manager, Digital （Omni-Channel） Marketing, Japan & Micronesia is responsible for the end-to-end execution, operation and continuous optimization of Japan-specific owned digital channels and customer journeys, with a primary focus on the LINE ecosystem, IHG Japan-owned social channels and the IHG Japan website. The role also supports the localization and execution of Global and EAPAC campaigns in Japan & Micronesia, translating approved campaign direction into locally relevant and executable channel plans across IHG.com, web and app merchandising, email, mobile push, LINE and Instagram.

The role combines omni-channel planning and orchestration with hands-on execution, including content and asset coordination, platform and content setup, localization, stakeholder alignment, agency and technology-partner management, testing, quality assurance, launch readiness, performance reporting and post-launch optimization.

The role works across marketing, loyalty, brand, technology, analytics, regional and global teams, agencies and hotel stakeholders to deliver consistent, high-quality customer experiences, and contributes to direct-channel performance, customer engagement and revenue growth through effective omni-channel execution and continuous optimization.

[Your Day to Day]

Omni-Channel Planning and Orchestration

  • Translate approved market, campaign and loyalty program priorities into actionable omni-channel plans across LINE, Instagram, IHG.com, email, mobile push and web/app communication and merchandising.
  • Define the role of each assigned channel within the customer journey, including audience, message, timing, content format, landing destination and call to action.
  • Develop and maintain integrated channel calendars, execution plans, work-back schedules, delivery trackers and launch-readiness documentation.
  • Personally manage or complete required content and platform setup within the assigned scope, rather than limiting involvement to coordination and status tracking.
  • Identify dependencies, required stakeholders, risks and ownership gaps early, and independently drive timely resolution.
  • Consolidate performance results and convert findings into clear, executable improvements.
  • LINE Ecosystem Operation and Activation
  • Manage day-to-day operation and execution of LINE Official Account and LINE MiniApp.
  • Plan and execute landing pages, banners, rich menus, messages, campaigns and gamified experiences.
  • Coordinate content, creative assets, hotel and offer information, terms and conditions, links, tracking requirements and other inputs required for execution.
  • Manage content and platform setup, test-environment review, journey testing, QA and production-release readiness.
  • Independently drive agencies, technology teams, internal stakeholders and hotel teams to maintain quality and timelines.
  • Use performance and customer-behaviour data to improve content, targeting, journeys and activation mechanics.
  • IHG Japan-Owned Social Channel Management
  • Manage the content and activation calendar for IHG Japan-owned social channels, with a primary focus on Instagram.
  • Coordinate Feed, Reels and other assigned formats, including briefs, asset development, captions, approvals and publishing schedules.
  • Collaborate with Paid Media, Brand, Campaign and hotel stakeholders to support traffic-driving and broader campaign objectives.
  • Define how social channels connect customers to LINE, IHG.com and relevant campaign experiences.
  • Manage agency deliverables and use reporting and learnings to improve content, formats and customer journeys.
  • IHG Japan Website Optimization
  • Manage and continuously enhance Japan-specific content and customer journeys on IHG.com, including local market pages, destination and brand content, and campaign pages.
  • Use analytics, search-performance data and customer-search intent to identify content gaps, journey friction and optimization opportunities.
  • Apply SEO and emerging AI-search/AIO principles to content structure, titles, descriptions, internal links and answer-oriented content.

[What We Need From You]

Education

Experience

Delivery Management, Governance and Quality Assurance

Organization- Hyatt Corporate Office

Summary

The Opportunity

Hyatt Hotels Corporation seeks an enthusiastic Revenue Analyst to join our Revenue Management Team. In this role, you will be collaborating closely with the broader Revenue Management, Commercial and on Property teams, where you’ll be instrumental in continuing to make Hyatt a leading hospitality company. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list since 2013. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

  • Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on-site fitness center
  • A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption
  • Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

The Role

The Revenue Analyst is a strategic, data-driven professional responsible for supporting and optimizing hotel revenue performance across all market segments. This role oversees key revenue management functions, analyzes business trends, and develops actionable insights that drive revenue growth, market share, and profitability.

Working closely with the Regional Revenue Director or Cluster Director, the Revenue Analyst produces and interprets reports that evaluate business strategies, identify opportunities, and maximize total hotel revenue while improving RevPAR Index performance. The position leverages market intelligence, forecasting, pricing, and demand analysis to recommend optimal revenue strategies for both package and non-package business.

The successful candidate combines strong analytical capabilities with a collaborative leadership approach, partnering with hotel teams to educate, mentor, and support revenue-focused decision-making. Through effective communication and data-driven recommendations, the Revenue Analyst helps ensure alignment between revenue strategies and overall hotel business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze market trends, demand patterns, and competitive performance to identify revenue opportunities.
  • Develop and maintain accurate forecasts, pricing strategies, and revenue optimization plans.
  • Produce and interpret reports that evaluate business performance and support strategic decision-making.
  • Monitor and drive RevPAR Index, market share, and total revenue performance.
  • Collaborate with hotel operations, sales, and leadership teams to execute revenue strategies.
  • Support package and non-package pricing initiatives to maximize profitability.
  • Provide guidance, training, and mentorship to hotel team members on revenue management best practices.

Recommend strategic actions based on performance analysis, industry trends, and market conditions.

Qualifications

Experience Required

  • Minimumof2yearsofexperiencepreferred inReservations,Operationsor Finance.
  • Minimumof2yearsofexperiencepreferredwithExcelandrelateddatamanagement systems .

Experience Preferred:

  • Bachelor’sDegree required.
  • HighSchoolDiplomaorequivalent required.

The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all-encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary.

The hourly rate range for this position is $35/hour-$37/hour.

The final pay rate/salary offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level, and other qualifications for the role, as well as the location of the performance of work.Pay for the successful candidate will meet local requirements, including the local minimum wage rate.

We welcome you:

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.

We value our relationships with recruitment partners and require that agencies contact us first before submitting any candidates. Hyatt will not be responsible for any fees and obligations associated with unsolicited submissions unless a formal agreement is in place.

Key Account Manager I Viator

About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

Viator, a Tripadvisor company, is the leading marketplace for travel experiences. We believe that making memories is what travel is all about. And with 300,000+ travel experiences to explore—everything from simple tours to extreme adventures (and all the niche, interesting stuff in between)—memories that will last a lifetime has never been easier. With industry-leading flexibility and last-minute availability, it's never too late to make any day extraordinary. Viator. One app, 300,000+ travel experiences you’ll remember.

We are seeking a driven and high-performing Key Account Manager who will be responsible for the health and quality of the Viator product offering within their designated portfolio of high value accounts across various destinations. The Key Account Manager will have a deep understanding of trends, opportunities, and challenges within their accounts and work to optimize Viator’s product offering to best match the consumer demand in terms of product variety, pricing, and availability.

You are a brand ambassador that will focus on a select number of high valued accounts to ensure continued optimization and growth. You will be responsible for meeting/exceeding key performance indicators and maintaining/improving the overall commercial health of your accounts. In this role you will be working with both internal and external stakeholders to align on necessary product offerings in your set of accounts, carrying out critically important tasks to maintain and grow our competitive advantage and continually improve Viator’s catalogue of experiences.

Job Location: Hybrid

This role is a hybrid position that requires 2/3 days per week in our London Office.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Partnership & Account Growth

  • Lead as the primary point of contact for high-value global accounts, forging and maintaining deep, strategic relationships.
  • Diagnose and proactively address unique business opportunities, identifying scalable solutions to deliver results.
  • Develop and execute account strategies that are directly tied to business objectives and measurable growth.

Product Excellence & Optimization

  • Elevate and maintain a best-in-class product portfolio for the assigned accounts to maximize traveller appeal.
  • Ensure product quality, availability, and optimal pricing, directly aligning the offering with evolving traveller and market demand.
  • Leverage knowledge of the online travel industry to serve as a trusted expert and deliver actionable insights to partners.

Commercial Leadership & Performance

  • Negotiate favorable commercial terms that protect and maximise Viator's profitability.
  • Proactively monitor and analyse key performance metrics, taking swift corrective actions to maintain and improve the overall commercial health of accounts.
  • Provide regular, concise performance reports and strategic updates to senior management on account status, growth forecasts, and potential business risks.

Partner Success & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Champion rapid issue resolution by collaborating seamlessly with the internal team of Destination Specialists and Support Teams to ensure an exceptional level of partner satisfaction.
  • Maintain a competitive edge by continuously monitoring industry trends, competitor strategies, and shifts in customer preferences to inform partner guidance.

Key Skills And Experience

Commercial & Results Focus

  • Entrepreneurial & Commercially Driven: Growth focused, never settle.
  • Execution & Urgency: Demonstrated ability to grow accounts with a focus on delivering results and swift execution, paired with a strong sense of urgency in a dynamic environment.
  • Negotiation: Highly skilled in securing favorable terms and maintaining relationships.
  • Account Growth: Passionate about achieving success and excellence.

Analytical & Technical Acumen

  • Analytical Mindset: Possesses a strong analytical mindset and advanced data analysis abilities.
  • Technical Background: Strong technical background to support data-driven decisions.
  • Industry Knowledge: Good understanding of the online travel landscape.

Relationship & Collaboration

  • Internal Networking: Highly skilled in leveraging professional connections, demonstrating resourcefulness and the ability to effectively use internal networks and available tools.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to build rapport with both clients and internal teams.
  • Teamwork & Independence: Embraces new ideas and works well in teams while also having the ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively.

Foundational Experience

  • Required Years: 5+ years in B2B Account Management or Sales.
  • Industry Experience (Plus): Online Travel Agency, operator, or travel experience is a significant plus.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know Our Team

The Strategic Partnerships team is responsible for identifying, building, and scaling high-impact partnerships that expand Agoda’s reach, improve customer acquisition, and create long-term business value.

For Japan, Financial Institution (FI) partnerships represent a strategic growth channel. This role will focus on developing and managing relationships with banks, card issuers, digital wallets, and other financial ecosystem partners to drive customer engagement, commercial growth, and win-win partnership outcomes.

You will work cross-functionally with teams across Commercial, Marketing, Product, Finance, Legal, Analytics, and Operations to bring partnership opportunities from idea to execution and optimization.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships to lead Agoda’s Japan FI partnership strategy and execution.

In this role, you will be responsible for identifying new partnership opportunities, managing key strategic accounts, negotiating commercial agreements, and driving performance across Agoda’s financial institution partnerships in Japan. You will help shape Agoda’s local partnership roadmap, unlock joint business opportunities, and ensure excellent execution of campaigns and initiatives with partners.

The ideal candidate brings strong business development and partnership experience, sharp commercial judgment, analytical rigor, and the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders. This role requires someone who is highly strategic but also willing to work hands-on to deliver measurable outcomes.

Why This Role Matters

This role is critical to Agoda’s growth in Japan. Financial institution partnerships are a highly strategic channel that can unlock scalable customer demand, deepen brand presence, and create differentiated value for travelers and partners alike.

As Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships, you will play a central role in shaping Agoda’s FI ecosystem in Japan and delivering high-impact partnerships that drive sustainable business growth.

What You’ll Do

Partnership Strategy & Business Development

  • Define and drive Agoda’s FI partnership strategy for Japan, aligned with market priorities and business growth objectives
  • Identify, evaluate, and prioritize new partnership opportunities with banks, credit card issuers, payment platforms, loyalty programs, and other financial ecosystem players
  • Build compelling partnership value propositions and business cases to secure internal alignment and partner buy-in
  • Lead commercial discussions, negotiations, and contract execution with prospective and existing FI partners

Account Management & Growth

  • Own and grow a portfolio of key FI partners in Japan, ensuring strong relationship management and long-term strategic alignment
  • Develop joint business plans with partners to drive customer acquisition, transaction growth, brand visibility, and partnership profitability
  • Monitor partner performance and proactively identify growth levers, optimization opportunities, and operational improvements
  • Ensure timely execution of campaigns, product integrations, and partner initiatives

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Analytics, Finance, Legal, and Operations to launch and scale partnership initiatives
  • Translate partner needs into clear internal requirements and drive execution across multiple teams
  • Influence decision-making through strong communication, stakeholder management, and data-backed recommendations
  • Support process improvements, reporting frameworks, and operating models to improve scalability and partner experience

Analytics & Optimization

  • Analyze partnership performance, customer behavior, campaign effectiveness, and commercial outcomes to generate actionable insights
  • Use data to identify trends, optimize investment decisions, and improve partnership ROI
  • Build business cases for new initiatives and present recommendations to senior stakeholders
  • Track key success metrics and maintain clear visibility on pipeline, performance, and impact

Experience

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • 7+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, account management, consulting, or a related commercial role
  • Strong experience managing external partners and driving commercial outcomes in a fast-paced, data-driven environment
  • Experience working with or within financial institutions, payment companies, loyalty ecosystems, or digital consumer platforms is highly preferred
  • Experience in e-commerce, travel, fintech, payments, or internet platforms is a strong plus
  • Proven track record of leading cross-functional initiatives from concept through execution

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to structure win-win partnerships and negotiate effectively

job.job_description:
Description de l'entreprise

Accor Tech & Digital est le moteur de la tech, des solutions digitales et de la transformation au sein du Groupe. Nos 5 000 talents s'engagent à offrir les meilleures expériences digitales et tech à nos clients, nos hôtels et nos équipes dans 110 pays, et à façonner l'avenir de l'hospitalité.

Accor Tech & Digital, des métiers où l’intelligence est d’abord humaine !

Description du poste

Accor Tech & Digital, c’est le laboratoire d’innovation et de transformation technologique du leader mondial de l’hôtellerie.

Nos équipes, appelées Heartist®, concentrent le meilleur de l'hospitalité et le meilleur de la tech & du digital.

Notre ambition : offrir à nos clients des expériences personnalisées, mémorables et durables.

Ici, nous faisons naître de nouvelles façons de voyager dans chacun de nos 5 500 hôtels, au plus proche de nos 100 millions de clients dans 110 pays.

Ici, nous sommes au cœur d’un formidable terrain de jeu de transition technologique et de conception de produits digitaux et de services, pour nos clients et nos équipes en hôtels.

Ici, votre champ d’application ne connaîtra aucune frontière.

Alors, avec nous, osez avoir un impact sur le monde !

C’est ici que vous attend votre plus grand défi :

Sous la responsabilité du SVP of Data Science & AI, vous rejoindrez une équipe au cœur de la transformation du groupe Accor grâce aux données et à l’intelligence artificielle.

Au sein du département Data, le pôle Data Science & IA a pour objectif de définir et de mettre en œuvre la vision du groupe en matière d’IA, de développer l’utilisation du machine learning, de l’IA générative et de l’IA agentique, et d’optimiser l’impact commercial de ces technologies sur l’expérience client, l’exploitation hôtelière et les équipes internes.

Vous ferez le lien entre les responsables métier et les équipes d’IA et d’ingénierie des données, en veillant à ce que le bon produit soit développé, déployé, adopté et amélioré en continu.

Votre Mission

  • Business Partnership : cerner les besoins métier, définir les cas d’utilisation de l’IA, s’aligner sur les indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) et la valeur attendue avec les parties prenantes (Commercial, Marketing, Distribution, Opérations, Marque).
  • Product Ownership :
    • Gérer la vision du produit, la feuille de route et le backlog ;
    • Hiérarchiser les fonctionnalités en trouvant le juste équilibre entre valeur métier, faisabilité technique et risques.
  • Delivery Leadership :
    • Diriger une équipe interne/externe composée de data scientists, d’ingénieurs IA / GenAI et d’ingénieurs ML Ops ;
    • Piloter les sprints, la qualité, les délais de mise sur le marché et la préparation à la production.
  • Adoption & Value Tracking :
    • Piloter la gestion du changement et l'adoption par les utilisateurs finaux ;
    • Mesurer l'utilisation, le retour sur investissement et l'impact métier ;
    • Rendre compte aux parties prenantes et à la direction.
  • Gestion des fournisseurs et du budget : piloter les partenaires externes (OpenAI, Giskard, Converteo, Artefact, etc.), gérer le budget, les contrats et les SLA
  • Risques, éthique et conformité : veiller à ce que le RGPD, les principes d'IA responsable et les mesures de sécurité soient intégrés dès la conception, en étroite collaboration avec le délégué à la protection des données (DPO), les équipes juridiques et de conformité.
Qualifications

Et vous ?

  • Master en ingénierie ou en science des données, informatique ou en école de commerce
  • Solide expérience (7 ans ou plus) dans la gestion de produits, le conseil ou la mise en œuvre concrète de solutions IA, avec au moins un produit majeur lié à l'IA ayant été déployé de bout en bout en production
  • Une expérience dans le secteur de l'hôtellerie / voyage / distribution est un atout

Compétences Techniques

  • Solide socle de compétences pratiques en matière de GenAI et de ML Ops, vous permettant de remettre en question les choix techniques aux côtés des data scientists et des ingénieurs en IA
  • Maîtrise d'OpenAI, d'AWS AgentCore, d'Anthropic et de Microsoft Foundry

Attitudes & Comportements

  • Capacité à saisir des opportunités business, ainsi que qu'à traduire les priorités en produits d'IA au sein d'une organisation complexe
  • Capacité à gérer des parties prenantes de haut niveau, jusqu'à C-Level
  • Vous adhérez à ces trois valeurs clés partagées par les membres de l'équipe : Lear & Be Curious ; Take Ownership ; Build Trust with Stakeholders

Informations supplémentaires

Et nous, quels sont nos engagements ?

  • Sur le monde
  • Accor s’engage pour le monde qui nous entoure, avec une culture employeur forte centrée sur le développement de nos 300 000 talents.
  • Nous adoptons une approche d'amélioration continue pour réduire l'impact du digital sur l'environnement dans l’ensemble de nos projets.
  • Sur votre carrière
  • Nous permettons à tous nos collaborateurs de maîtriser leur équilibre vie-perso / vie-pro et leur offrons les moyens de façonner leur environnement de travail à leur image.
  • Les parcours de formation et d’évolution sont définis à la fois individuellement et collectivement pour que nous grandissions ensemble, au quotidien.
  • Concrètement, chez Accor Tech & Digital :
  • Télétravail possible plusieurs jours par semaine depuis la France et options de travail flexibles : travaillez depuis chez vous, nos bureaux, ou même nos hôtels et espaces de coworking grâce à Worklib.
  • Chaque mercredi après-midi, consacrez votre temps à du travail de fond et à votre développement personnel.
  • Travail dans un environnement multiculturel et anglophone.
  • Amélioration continue & formations : Hackathons, partenariats technologiques d’exception, talent management dédié, certifications et plateforme de formation dédiée.

et aussi,

  • Programme ALL - Heartist® : tarifs préférentiels et offres flash pour des séjours et expériences inoubliables dans toutes nos adresses Accor et chez nos partenaires, dans le monde entier.
  • Programme de volontariat Heartist® for good : 1 jour offert sur votre temps de travail pour vous engager en faveur d’une association.
  • Un CSE qui vous accompagne dans le financement de vos activités culturelles et sportives.
  • Forfait Mobilité durable pour l’utilisation d’un moyen de déplacement « vert » ou un dispositif « vélo de fonction » en partenariat avec Zenride
  • Prise en charge des abonnements de transports publics urbains entre le domicile et le lieu de travail, au barème de la Loi Finance.
  • Tickets restaurant de 11€ en valeur faciale.
  • Une mutuelle obligatoire financée à 50% par Accor sans frais supplémentaire en cas d'adhésion de vos ayants droits.
  • Sans oublier des conditions de travail attractives avec des espaces de travail collaboratifs, des restaurants, espaces de jeux ou encore des espaces de bien-être et de Sport sur site ou grâce à Gymlib.

Votre talent et votre motivation sont nos seuls critères de sélection.

Nous valorisons la richesse des diverses nationalités, personnalités et parcours professionnels.

Nous savons nous adapter aux besoins spécifiques de nos collaborateurs, notamment ceux en situation de handicap.

Nous encourageons toutes les candidatures, sans distinction de genre, alors osez postuler !

Pour nous, le recrutement est avant tout une histoire de rencontres.

Cette mission vous attire ? Postulez et nous vous proposerons :

  • Un échange avec notre équipe recrutement pour vous présenter les lignes essentielles du poste ou vous orienter vers le rôle qui peut vous correspondre,
  • Un ou des entretiens avec les managers et les membres de l’équipe,
  • Pour certains postes, vous pourriez également être amené à effectuer un test ou une étude de cas, ainsi qu’un questionnaire sur votre personnalité et vos motivations.
  • Un entretien final avec notre équipe des Ressources Humaines pour échanger sur la culture de notre Groupe, l’environnement de travail, notre programme de formation et les perspectives de carrière, ainsi que les différents avantages du Groupe.
  • Un feedback personnalisé.

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction to Team

Our Technology Team partners with teams across Expedia Group to create innovative products, services, and tools to deliver high-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction.

This Senior Software Developer role is part of the AI Foundations team which builds and scales reusable AI agents and an underlying agentic platform that automate high-volume engineering workflows, reduce “keep the lights on” effort, and unlock meaningful productivity gains for product and platform teams across Expedia Group. As a Senior Software Development Engineer at Expedia Group, you design, develop, and operate high-quality software solutions that deliver traveler, partner, and business value across multiple services, raising the bar on architecture, reliability, and data-driven outcomes.

In This Role, You Will

  • Design, build, and evolve scalable, resilient services and systems that power agentic AI capabilities across our platform.
  • Lead system design (including low-level design), API design, and data modeling for complex, distributed services that integrate traditional software components with AI-driven workflows.
  • Safely integrate and operate AI/ML‑enabled solutions that improve outcomes, ensuring quality, robustness, observability, and compliance across experimentation, training, and production environments.
  • Partner with product, applied science, data, and platform teams to define technical direction, break down ambiguous problems, and deliver high-impact features that are reusable across multiple product domains.
  • Drive engineering excellence by setting standards for code quality, testing, performance, security, and reliability, and by mentoring other engineers in modern software and AI development practices.
  • Leverage familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products to design agentic orchestration, tool interfaces, and safeguards that improve developer and traveler experiences.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or Equivalent related professional experience.
  • 6+ years of professional software development experience with a Master's degree, or 8+ years with a Bachelor's degree.
  • Proven ownership of the end-to-end lifecycle of one or more services or components, including design, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and incident response.
  • Strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g. Java, Kotlin, Python) and system design (LLD), API design, and data modeling for scalable, reliable services.
  • Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products, including integrating AI/ML capabilities into user-facing or platform services.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing and evolving multi-service or domain-level architectures that combine deterministic services with AI/ML or agentic components, optimizing for scalability, reliability, and cost.
  • Demonstrated track record of improving operational excellence at scale, including observability, SLOs, capacity planning, incident management, and continuous improvement of services that incorporate AI/ML behavior.
  • Hands-on experience with safely integrating and operating AI/ML‑enabled solutions that improve outcomes, such as model-backed APIs, retrieval-augmented systems, or workflow/agent orchestration frameworks.
  • Ability to use data and experimentation to drive technical and product decisions, including evaluating AI system performance, guardrails, and user impact across multiple product areas.
  • Deep experience with AI-driven or agentic architectures at the platform or domain level, such as building tools, connectors, or orchestration layers that allow AI agents to reliably act on complex travel or commerce systems.

The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $184,500.00 to $258,000.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $295,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Benefits And Perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life.

Accommodation requests

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.

About Expedia Group

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Important notice

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/.

Equal Opportunity

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. This employer participates in E-Verify. The employer will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from each new employee's I-9 to confirm work authorization.

job.job_description:
About Us

IHG Hotels & Resorts is one of the largest hotel companies in the world and one of the world’s leading hotel and resort companies with a family of 19 brands. Our purpose – True Hospitality for Good – comes to life in every one of our collections. With luxury and lifestyle, we are taking it to new heights.

Five visionary brands - InterContinental, Regent Hotels, Six Senses, Vignette Collection and Kimpton Hotels - make up our luxury collection. Individually, they are icons. Together, they bring unforgettable and unparalleled experiences to travelers in over 430 hotels and resorts in 100 countries around the world.

Having recently added a host of incredible properties to our portfolio, we now stand as one of the world’s leading luxury operators. Each of our hotels cultivates a distinctive style and ambience where we embrace every opportunity to give our guests unforgettable and unparalleled experiences.

About The Hotel

A luxurious hotel destination at The Wharf on D.C.’s Waterfront, the InterContinental Washington D.C. – The Wharf in the reimagined Wharf neighborhood brings sophistication to its contemporary style. Perfectly placed on the beautiful Potomac River, InterContinental Washington D.C. – The Wharf enjoys the most incredible waterfront views of D.C. Steps away from America’s political epicenter, the hotel embraces guests with an exquisitely curated resort destination that reignites the river’s edge and a captivating sanctuary in the center of The Wharf neighborhood, paying homage to the maritime and industrial-working heritage of its setting. Featuring a relaxing seasonal rooftop pool with striking Potomac River views and the indulging full-service spa, The Spa at The Wharf, modern luxury, culture, and a rich history combine in the Wharf neighborhood to create a perfect atmosphere for guests and locals alike.

At InterContinental Hotels & Resorts® we want our guests to feel special, cosmopolitan and In the Know which means we need you to:

  • Be charming by being approachable, having confidence and showing respect.
  • Stay in the moment by understanding and anticipating guests’ needs, being attentive and taking ownership of getting things done.
  • Make it memorable by being knowledgeable, sharing stories and showing your style to create moments that make people feel special.

About The Senior Conference Services Manager Position

As a Senior Conference Services Manager, you will build strong client relationships and drive group and event business by delivering exceptional service from the planning phase through the post-event follow-up. You will coordinate event details, maximize revenue opportunities through upselling, and ensure seamless communication between clients and hotel departments.

A little taste of your day-to-day

Key Responsibilities

  • Reports Directly to the Director of Catering (DOC).
  • Manage client details, develop Banquet Event Orders (BEOs) and coordinate with hotel departments to ensure flawless execution during the clients event phase on property.
  • Identify client needs, provide personalized solutions, and maximize upselling opportunities.
  • Coordinate menus, food and beverage, room setups, group room blocks, VIP services, and other event details.
  • Conduct hotel and event space tours for contracted events, tastings, and client entertainment as appropriate.
  • Maintain accurate client records, event details, reports, billing, and post-conference documentation.
  • Partner with Operations and other hotel departments to ensure successful event execution and exceptional guest satisfaction.
  • Monitor event setups and service delivery to ensure compliance with client requirements and hotel standards.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with meeting planners and other business partners to generate referrals for repeat and new business.
  • Welcome and support group contacts during events and follow up after departure to secure future business.
  • Leader of the Event Planning/Conference Service team.
  • Will complete Convention Planning teams actions plans.
  • First point of contact for Planning Questions, Training and Support.
  • Will track the Likelihood to recommend service scores.
  • Lead the preparation of the departmental banquet budget/forecasting and implementation of the hotel’s conference services strategy.
  • Will participate in the annual budgeting and planning process for Banquet revenue.
  • Support departmental sales strategies, ensure team forecast accuracy.
  • Will track the performance vs the banquet budget and report financial updates to the team weekly.
  • Will assign Sales/Events bookings to the planning team.
  • Will oversee the Resume and BEO meeting
  • Will work on the seasonal menu pricing and item selection process, with the final approval of the DOSM and DOC.
  • Other team leadership responsibilities as assigned by the DOC
  • Promote teamwork, effective communication, and quality service throughout the hotel.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Some college and 3-5 years of sales, marketing, hotel, or catering experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Hotel sales and/or catering experience preferred.
  • Fluent in English with strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong organizational, problem-solving, mathematical, and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively with guests, colleagues, and external partners.
  • Ability to lift/carry up to 50 pounds and frequently stand, walk, bend, stoop, and kneel.
  • Ability to travel for workshops, tradeshows, conventions, and other business events.
  • Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays as business needs require.
  • Alcohol awareness certification and/or applicable food handler or health certification as required by local regulations.

What You Can Expect From Us

We give our people everything they need to succeed. From a competitive salary that rewards all your hard work to a wide range of benefits designed to help you live your best work life – including a full uniform, impressive room discounts and some of the best training in the business.

The hourly pay rate for this role is $38.00 to $40.00. This rate is only applicable for jobs to be performed in Washington, DC. This is the starting rate we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may pay more or less than the posted rate, and the rate may be modified in the future. An employee’s pay position within the pay range will be based on several factors including, but limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, and business or organizational needs.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, 401k, and many other benefits to eligible employees.

You can apply for this role through the link below (or through the internal career site if you are a current employee).

Note: No amount of pay is considered wages or compensation until earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, or any other form of compensation that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law.

We know that to work well, we need to feel well – both inside and outside of work – and through our myWellbeing framework, we are committed to supporting wellbeing in your health, lifestyle, and workplace. So, join us and you’ll become part of our ever-growing global family.
