job.job_description:
Organization- Hyatt Corporate Office

Summary

The Opportunity

Hyatt Hotels Corporation is seeking an enthusiastic Transient Sales Specialist to join our Central Services RFP Assist team, who will focus on establishing and executing transient sales strategy for a portfolio of Essentials hotels. In this role, you will collaborate closely with colleagues across Commercial Services and our Essentials brand hotels, playing an important part in strengthening Hyatt’s position as a leading hospitality company. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list since 2013. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

  • Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on-site fitness center
  • A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption
  • Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

The Role

The Central Services, Transient Sales Specialist role requires a candidate who has demonstrated a thorough understanding and competence in the Transient business segment, Hyatt systems, and the hotel/business travel industry. This individual will be responsible for driving the corporate negotiated and consortia strategy for a portfolio of Essential hotels.

  • Develop strong understanding of Hyatt’s Transient tools and RFP process to guide hotels on execution Manage Transient RFP strategy & response for participating hotels
  • Provide excellent service to hotels while maintaining a positive attitude

Qualifications

Experience Required

  • Expert user of the new user interface of Cvent transient
  • Adept with Excel and basic business use
  • Proficient in general computer knowledge, Microsoft Suite, and Envision
  • Minimum of 2-3 years’ experience in a hotel or related field
  • Knowledge of Amadeus products (Agency360 and Demand360)
  • Must be able to evaluate and select among alternative courses of action quickly and accurately
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills (verbal and written)
  • Ability to manage upward with good debate and consensus skills with objectivity
  • Home office position which requires the need for productive home office space

Experience Preferred

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred

The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all-encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary.

The salary range for this position is $72,000-$75,000. This position is also eligible to earn incentive awards, an annual bonus, monthly or quarterly incentives, etc.

The final pay rate/salary offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level, and other qualifications for the role, as well as the location of the performance of work.Pay for the successful candidate will meet local requirements, including the local minimum wage rate.

We welcome you:

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.

We value our relationships with recruitment partners and require that agencies contact us first before submitting any candidates. Hyatt will not be responsible for any fees and obligations associated with unsolicited submissions unless a formal agreement is in place.

Job Description

La hospitalidad excepcional comienza con usted

Imagínese alegrándole el día a alguien. Cuando se una a nuestro equipo de hoteles, es exactamente eso lo que hará cada vez que acuda a trabajar. Como director de ventas, sino que difunde la luz y la calidez de la hospitalidad al brindar experiencias memorables que hacen que la estadía sea inolvidable para cada huésped.

Responsibilities

Esto es lo que hará durante un día típico:

  • Diseñar y ejecutar la estrategia de ventas: desarrollar e implementar estrategias de ventas orientadas a generar ingresos en los segmentos de grupos, corporativo transitorio, ocio transitorio y catering, de conformidad con los objetivos comerciales y el plan estratégico del hotel.
  • Impulsar el rendimiento de los ingresos y la rentabilidad: contribuir a alcanzar los objetivos de ingresos y rentabilidad optimizando los precios, mejorando el mix de segmentos y guiando la precisión de las previsiones.
  • Liderar revisiones y planificación empresariales: facilitar reuniones periódicas sobre estrategia y rendimiento y, al mismo tiempo, contribuir a la planificación comercial a largo plazo mediante un análisis de tendencias de rendimiento, cambios del mercado y oportunidades de ingresos.
  • Garantizar la alineación comercial: colaborar con los líderes de ingresos y marketing para alinear las tácticas de ventas con las estrategias de precios, distribución y promoción, y respaldar las estrategias de previsión y tarifas.
  • Fomentar las relaciones con las partes interesadas: interactuar con el equipo Hiltonglobal de ventas, y oficinas de convenciones y visitantes (CVB), socios de viajes externos y clientes clave para impulsar la demanda, mejorar la conversión y respaldar visitas a sitios de alto impacto y reuniones previas a la convención.
  • Desarrollar estrategias basadas en datos: realizar un seguimiento de la actividad del mercado y de la competencia para fundamentar la estrategia y mantener el posicionamiento competitivo en los segmentos grupal y transitorio.
  • Cultivar un equipo de alto rendimiento: reclutar nuevos talentos e impulsar al mismo tiempo el crecimiento y compromiso del equipo a través de la gestión del desempeño, el desarrollo profesional y los programas de reconocimiento.

Qualifications

Lo que se necesita para brindar una estadía inolvidable

En Hilton, Nuestros Valores Fundamentales Definen Lo Que Se Necesita Para Alcanzar El Éxito Aquí y Guían Las Cualidades Que Buscamos En Cada Miembro Del Equipo

Sentir pasión por difundir la luz y la calidez de la hospitalidad. Actuar con integridad y hacer siempre lo correcto. Inspirar a otros a través del liderazgo. Creer que el trabajo en equipo genera los mejores resultados. Tener un sentido de propiedad y responsabilidad. Y enfocarse en el ahora, desempeñándose en todo momento con urgencia y disciplina, sabiendo que puede tener un impacto duradero.

About Us

Únete a una cultura laboral galardonada

En Hilton, no solo ofrecemos experiencias excepcionales a nuestros huéspedes, sino que también creamos un lugar de trabajo excepcional para los miembros del equipo que lo hacen posible.

Como líder mundial en hotelería, hemos recibido a más de 3 mil millones de huéspedes en todo el mundo, manteniéndonos fieles a nuestra visión fundacional: llenar la tierra con la luz y la calidez de la hospitalidad.

Nuestra galardonada cultura nos ha hecho merecedores de repetidos reconocimientos en la lista de los Mejores Lugares para Trabajar del Mundo de Great Place to Work y Fortune. Con nuestra colección de marcas de clase mundial y el compromiso de toda la empresa de brindar la mejor estadía a cada huésped, estamos estableciendo nuevos estándares para el futuro de los viajes.

Ya sea que esté comenzando su carrera o explorando algo nuevo, Hilton lo acompaña en cada paso del camino. Venga por el trabajo, quédese por la carrera y ayúdenos a hacer que cada estadía sea un poco más mágica.

¿Le interesa la vida en Hilton? Explore nuestro Blog de Carreras para descubrir por qué somos más que un excelente lugar para hospedarse: somos un excelente lugar para trabajar.

About The Team

Cómo le ayudaremos a prosperar

En Hilton, La Hospitalidad Por La Que Somos Conocidos No Termina Con Nuestros Huéspedes. Invertimos Con Orgullo En El Bienestar De Nuestros Miembros Del Equipo, Brindándoles Apoyo En Todos Los Momentos De La Vida. Cuando Se Une a Hilton, Nuestra Atención Excepcional Se Extiende a Usted Con Ventajas y Beneficios Inigualables, Que Incluyen*

  • Increíbles beneficios de viaje: disfrute de 110 noches de viajes con grandes descuentos, con tarifas de habitación tan bajas como $40 USD/noche en nuestros hoteles de clase mundial a través de nuestro programa de viajes Go Hilton

  • Recursos de salud mental: su bienestar es lo primero. Los miembros del equipo elegibles pueden acceder a asesoramiento y apoyo gratuitos a través de nuestro Programa de Asistencia al Empleado (EAP) líder en su clase
  • Tiempo libre remunerado (PTO): recargue energías, relájese y tómese tiempo para lo que más importa

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know Our Team

The Strategic Partnerships team is responsible for identifying, building, and scaling high-impact partnerships that expand Agoda’s reach, improve customer acquisition, and create long-term business value.

For Japan, Financial Institution (FI) partnerships represent a strategic growth channel. This role will focus on developing and managing relationships with banks, card issuers, digital wallets, and other financial ecosystem partners to drive customer engagement, commercial growth, and win-win partnership outcomes.

You will work cross-functionally with teams across Commercial, Marketing, Product, Finance, Legal, Analytics, and Operations to bring partnership opportunities from idea to execution and optimization.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships to lead Agoda’s Japan FI partnership strategy and execution.

In this role, you will be responsible for identifying new partnership opportunities, managing key strategic accounts, negotiating commercial agreements, and driving performance across Agoda’s financial institution partnerships in Japan. You will help shape Agoda’s local partnership roadmap, unlock joint business opportunities, and ensure excellent execution of campaigns and initiatives with partners.

The ideal candidate brings strong business development and partnership experience, sharp commercial judgment, analytical rigor, and the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders. This role requires someone who is highly strategic but also willing to work hands-on to deliver measurable outcomes.

Why This Role Matters

This role is critical to Agoda’s growth in Japan. Financial institution partnerships are a highly strategic channel that can unlock scalable customer demand, deepen brand presence, and create differentiated value for travelers and partners alike.

As Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships, you will play a central role in shaping Agoda’s FI ecosystem in Japan and delivering high-impact partnerships that drive sustainable business growth.

What You’ll Do

Partnership Strategy & Business Development

  • Define and drive Agoda’s FI partnership strategy for Japan, aligned with market priorities and business growth objectives
  • Identify, evaluate, and prioritize new partnership opportunities with banks, credit card issuers, payment platforms, loyalty programs, and other financial ecosystem players
  • Build compelling partnership value propositions and business cases to secure internal alignment and partner buy-in
  • Lead commercial discussions, negotiations, and contract execution with prospective and existing FI partners

Account Management & Growth

  • Own and grow a portfolio of key FI partners in Japan, ensuring strong relationship management and long-term strategic alignment
  • Develop joint business plans with partners to drive customer acquisition, transaction growth, brand visibility, and partnership profitability
  • Monitor partner performance and proactively identify growth levers, optimization opportunities, and operational improvements
  • Ensure timely execution of campaigns, product integrations, and partner initiatives

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Analytics, Finance, Legal, and Operations to launch and scale partnership initiatives
  • Translate partner needs into clear internal requirements and drive execution across multiple teams
  • Influence decision-making through strong communication, stakeholder management, and data-backed recommendations
  • Support process improvements, reporting frameworks, and operating models to improve scalability and partner experience

Analytics & Optimization

  • Analyze partnership performance, customer behavior, campaign effectiveness, and commercial outcomes to generate actionable insights
  • Use data to identify trends, optimize investment decisions, and improve partnership ROI
  • Build business cases for new initiatives and present recommendations to senior stakeholders
  • Track key success metrics and maintain clear visibility on pipeline, performance, and impact

Experience

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • 7+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, account management, consulting, or a related commercial role
  • Strong experience managing external partners and driving commercial outcomes in a fast-paced, data-driven environment
  • Experience working with or within financial institutions, payment companies, loyalty ecosystems, or digital consumer platforms is highly preferred
  • Experience in e-commerce, travel, fintech, payments, or internet platforms is a strong plus
  • Proven track record of leading cross-functional initiatives from concept through execution

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to structure win-win partnerships and negotiate effectively
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to convert data into clear business insights and actions
  • Strong project management capabilities with high attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience influencing senior internal and external stakeholders
  • Self-starter with a bias for action and ability to operate independently in an ambiguous environment
  • Comfortable working hands-on while also thinking strategically

Technical / Functional

  • Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience with SQL, Tableau, or data visualization tools is a plus
  • Ability to develop business cases, commercial models, and performance reporting frameworks
  • Familiarity with campaign execution, co-marketing partnerships, loyalty mechanics, or payment-related partnership models is beneficial

Language

  • Fluency in English and Japanese is required

job.job_description:
Accor Tech & Digital is the power engine of Accor technology, digital business and transformation. Our 5,000 talents are committed to deliver the best tech and digital experiences to our guests, hotels and staff across 110 countries and to shape the future of hospitality.

Accor Tech & Digital, jobs in the tech field where intelligence is above all human!



Job Description

Accor Tech & Digital is the innovation and technological transformation lab of the world leader in hospitality.

Our teams, known as Heartists®, bring together the best of hospitality with the best of tech and digital. Our ambition is to provide our customers with personalized, memorable, and sustainable experiences.

Here, we create new ways to travel within each of our 5,500 hotels, connecting closely with our 100 million clients in 110 countries.

Here, we are at the heart of an incredible playground for technological transition and the design of digital products and services for our customers and hotel teams.

Here, your scope will know no boundaries;

So join us and dare to make an impact on the world!

Here is where your greatest challenge awaits you:

Accor is accelerating its Digital Workplace transformation and modernizing the employee and hotel team Digital Experience worldwide. We are looking for a Product Manager – Digital Workplace to lead strategic initiatives and shape the tools, platforms, and self-service capabilities that enable secure, seamless, and productive work across the group.

As part of the Product Organization, you will manage the Product Owners (Self Service and Digital Employee Experience) and oversee projects, while driving the evolution of modern endpoint provisioning and collaboration tools across the Microsoft 365 stack. This role is central to delivering a consistent, hotel-centric Digital Workplace experience.

Your mission :

Product Strategy & Vision

  • Define and own the product vision and roadmap for Digital Workplace solutions (self-service, digital employee experience, collaboration suite).
  • Champion an end-user–centric approach, ensuring solutions address employee and hotel team needs.
  • Monitor adoption, performance, service quality, and user satisfaction to guide continuous improvement.

Leadership & Team Management

  • Manage and mentor the Product Owners ensuring clarity on priorities, backlog management, and delivery practices.
  • Build and lead a squad team dedicated to delivering Digital Workplace initiatives, fostering collaboration and agility.
  • Provide support for project execution, ensuring resources, alignment, and coordination across stakeholders.

Project Management

  • Drive strategic and transversal Digital Workplace projects such as Move2Nom, Contact Deflection and Integrations ensuring scope, timelines, and deliverables are met.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams (Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Hospitality Tech, vendors) to deliver projects on time and within budget.

Governance & Stakeholder Alignment

  • Ensure governance, compliance, licensing optimization, and secure-by-design practices across devices and collaboration tools.
  • Collaborate broadly with HR, Cyber, Regional IT teams, hotel operations, and business owners.
  • Serve as the central point of contact for product decisions, roadmap updates, and service evolution.

Qualifications

And you?

  • 7–10+ years of experience in Product Management, Digital Workplace, Collaboration Platforms, or Endpoint Management.
  • Strong understanding of modern device management and provisioning models (Intune Autopilot) and Cloud PC concepts.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 collaboration tools (Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Exchange Online).
  • Experience managing complex projects and coordinating cross-functional teams.
  • Familiarity with identity and access management tools such as Saviynt and/or OneIdentity Active Roles for automating user provisioning and permissions.
  • Demonstrated ability to define product roadmaps, manage backlogs, and deliver user-centric solutions.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills in a global, matrixed environment.

Additional Information

Accor dares to impact:

- the world

  • Accor is committed to the world around us, with a strong employer culture focused on the development of our 300,000 talents.
  • We adopt a continuous improvement approach to reduce the impact of digital on the environment across all our projects.

- your career:

  • We enable all our employees to manage their work-life balance and offer them the means to shape their work environment according to their preferences.
  • Training and career paths are defined both individually and collectively, allowing us to grow together on a daily basis.

- Specifically, at Accor Tech & Digital:

  • Remote work available several days per week from France, with flexible work options: work from home, from our offices, or even from our hotels and coworking spaces through Worklib.
  • Every Wednesday afternoon, dedicate your time to deep work and personal development.
  • Work in a multicultural and English-speaking environment.
  • Continuous improvement & training: hackathons, exceptional technology partnerships, dedicated talent management, certifications and a dedicated learning platform.

and also,

  • ALL - Heartist® Program: unforgettable stays and experiences at all Accor locations and partner venues worldwide.
  • Heartist® for Good Program: commit to supporting an association of your choice from those available on our volunteering platform (1 day offered per year by the Group during your working hours).
  • An Employee Social Committee (CSE) supporting the financing of your cultural and sports activities.
  • Sustainable Mobility Package for the use of eco-friendly transportation or access to a company bike program in partnership with Zenride.
  • Coverage of urban public transport subscriptions between home and workplace, in accordance with the rates set by French law “Loi Finance”.
  • €11 meal vouchers.
  • A mandatory health insurance plan funded at 50% by Accor without additional costs in case of enrollment of your dependents.
  • Attractive working conditions with collaborative workspaces, restaurants, and recreational areas as well as wellness and sports facilities, on-site or through Gymlib.



Your talent and motivation are our only selection criteria.

We value the richness of diverse nationalities, personalities, and professional backgrounds.

We know how to adapt to the specific needs of our employees, including those with disabilities.

We encourage all applications, regardless of gender, so go ahead and apply!

Recruitment is all about people!



Is this mission appealing to you? Apply, and we will offer you:

The Design Strategies Manager supports IHG’s efforts in accelerating guest and owner insight-driven design initiatives in the America’s region. Additionally, this role helps to establish original/innovative designs strategies to include prototype designs and integrate them into the America’s region for New Development hotels, as well as hotels undergoing a renovation. This role reports into Regional Director of Design Strategies, Americas Design and Construction.

Support IHG’s Americas design strategy by advancing hospitality design initiatives that are informed by guest, owner, brand, and operational insights. This role partners with global and regional teams to develop and implement prototype designs, renovation solutions, brand standards, and owner-facing design programs for new development and existing hotel projects. The role provides a clear connection standards, between global design direction and regional execution, ensuring solutions are commercially viable, technically sound, and aligned with brand experience goals.

Your day to day

  • Lead regional hospitality design initiatives from concept through implementation, including prototype design, renovation programs, model rooms, brand guidelines, and owner-facing design solutions.
  • Partner with Brand Management, Architecture & Design, Global Design, Procurement, Legal, owners, consultants, vendors, and project teams to translate brand strategy into commercially viable and buildable design outcomes.
  • Represent the design team in internal and external forums by clearly communicating project priorities, design intent, pipeline status, owner feedback, risks, and recommendations.
  • Apply hospitality design expertise and technical judgment to resolve design, construction, FF&E, supplier, and brand standards issues while balancing guest experience, owner value, operational needs, schedule, and budget.
  • Support the development, refinement, and regional implementation of brand standards, design documentation, SRD programs, FF&E specifications, and design tools that enable consistent execution across the Americas.
  • Build trust and alignment with owners, senior leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders through clear presentations, concise written communication, sound recommendations, and strong executive presence.

What We Need From You

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in interior design, Architecture or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience. AIA or ASID certification preferred. Architectural or Interior Design License preferred.
  • 5+ years of progressive design, architecture, or related experience, with a strong emphasis on hospitality environments, brand implementation, renovation, and new development projects. Experience should include managing design workstreams, coordinating with owners, consultants, vendors, and internal stakeholders, and translating design intent into commercially viable, buildable solutions.
  • Must have proven experience of completing hospitality projects.
  • Ability to work in a high volume, fast-paced, deadline-oriented environment as a member of a collaborative team. Responsive to demands from multiple stakeholder groups and able to understand and balance consumer, managerial and ownership perspectives.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and resources. Ability to effectively prioritize project details and manage time. Must make immediate time available to work with franchisees when problems arise regarding brand design projects, Brand standards or vendor-related issues. Strong problem solving and time management skills required.
  • High degree of personal drive, self-starter and able to work independently without regular direct/local management. Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks required.
  • Inquiring mind with an understanding of innovation, design and guest experience and the challenges involved in implementing successful change within IHGs business model including strong business acumen and strategic thinking ability.
  • Extensive and credible appreciation of brands.
  • Able to assess the scope of implementation of proposed innovation/design proposals quickly and accurately and up-to-date on current trends and innovation in the sector.
  • High level of capability and credibility in influencing peers and senior management across functions and regions. Must be confident, diplomatic and able to work across all levels of the organization with strong analytical and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Commercially astute and able to develop credible ROI`s for design initiatives with a good ‘real world’ sensibility when applying strategic solutions.
  • Demonstrate knowledge of brand standards and full understanding of the differences in the various brand standards. Must maintain a working knowledge of all requirements described in each brand standards manual.
  • Demonstrated ability to read design documentation and construction drawings including architectural, mechanical, plumbing, sprinkler systems and electrical drawings. Demonstrated knowledge of FF&E (furnishings, finishings and equipment)/OS&E (operating supplies and equipment). Ability to interpret design boards and specifications and provide free-hand renderings, layouts, or other drawings to clarify design issues or as the need arises.
  • Ability to remain current with construction trends, code requirements and design through participating in annual continuing education classes. Must have knowledge of national building codes and ADA requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively manage large-scale design projects and budgets with minimal direction. Must have project management experience in organizing, planning, and executing complex projects from conception through implementation.
  • Assist Brand Management Teams in the design and procurement of Brand Design Scheme FF&E needed for the IHG Investor’s Conference.
  • FF&E Spec writing software
  • Strong technical proficiency in 3D modeling and design documentation tools, including Revit, AutoCAD, SketchUp or equivalent 3D software, Adobe Creative Suite, Bluebeam, and Microsoft Office Suite. Ability to clearly communicate design intent through drawings, visual presentations, written narratives, and stakeholder-facing materials.

Travel - 10-20% required

Location - Our hybrid work structure is an expectation of three (3) days in the Atlanta office. This expectation may be adjusted to evolve with the changing needs of the business.

job.job_description:
Organization- Hyatt Corporate Office

Summary

The Opportunity

Hyatt Hotels Corporation seeks an enthusiastic Manager RM & Distribution Analytics to join our Revenue Management Analytics team. In this role, you will partner closely with Global and Regional Revenue Management Leadership teams to advance key analytics and strategic priorities. You will support corporate, regional, and property teams by developing tools, AI capabilities, statistical models, algorithms, insights, and strategies that advance revenue optimization. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list since 2013. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

  • Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on-site fitness center
  • A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption
  • Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

The Role

Responsibilities include partnering with Global and Regional Revenue Management Leadership teams to drive key analytics and strategic priorities. The role supports corporate, regional, and property teams through the development of tools, statistical models, algorithms, AI capabilities, insights, and strategies for revenue optimization.

  • Drive analytics and strategic priorities with Global and Regional Revenue Management Leadership teams.
  • Develop tools, statistical models, algorithms, AI capabilities, insights, and strategies that support revenue optimization.
  • Partner with corporate, regional, and property Revenue Management teams.
  • Communicate clearly with stakeholders at all levels of the organization as a trusted business partner.

Qualifications

Experience Required

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strategic agility.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with all levels of the organization.

Computer Skills Needed To Perform This Job

  • Working knowledge of Python or R for data analysis, modeling, and automation.
  • Proficiency with AI-enabled analytics tools, including generative AI, to support analysis, automation, and data-driven decision-making.
  • Advanced SQL programming skills and extensive experience working with relational databases.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and VBA.

Additional Comments And Requirements

  • Experience developing analytical models and visualizations using Tableau, Power BI, or similar tools is preferred.
  • Experience with Alteryx is preferred.
  • Experience with GitLab or comparable Git-based version-control platforms, with a strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) preferred.
  • Ability and willingness to work effectively in a fast-paced, complex corporate environment.

The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all-encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary.

The salary range for this position is $130,000-$150,000. This position is also eligible to earn incentive awards, an annual bonus, monthly or quarterly incentives, etc.

The final pay rate/salary offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level, and other qualifications for the role, as well as the location of the performance of work.Pay for the successful candidate will meet local requirements, including the local minimum wage rate.

We welcome you:

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.

We value our relationships with recruitment partners and require that agencies contact us first before submitting any candidates. Hyatt will not be responsible for any fees and obligations associated with unsolicited submissions unless a formal agreement is in place.

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Complex Senior Sales Manager, you’re not just generating and managing group sales, you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make every guest stay exceptional. To be successful in this role, candidates must possess a proven track record in group sales within the Government market, with a minimum of three years of tenure and demonstrated success in developing and managing government accounts.

Responsibilities

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:

  • Represent the hotel to prospective clients: Serve as the primary point of contact for customers seeking group rooms, meeting space, and food and beverage services
  • Drive new business opportunities: Respond to inquiries, initiate outreach, qualify leads, and solicit potential clients through proactive sales efforts
  • Manage the full sales cycle: Conduct site visits, entertain clients, prepare proposals, determine rates, negotiate contracts, and service accounts through fulfillment
  • Develop strategic sales plans: Create and execute strategies to achieve or exceed revenue and room night goals, adjusting based on performance and market conditions
  • Analyze sales performance: Evaluate lost business reports and identify opportunities to strengthen conversion and competitiveness
  • Support exceptional service delivery: Collaborate across departments to coordinate the fulfillment of contracted services and uphold the highest standards of client satisfaction
  • Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

About The Team

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
  • Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
  • Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
  • Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
  • Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
  • Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Generous paid time off (PTO) – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters most
  • Health & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family covered
  • Financial security for your future – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what’s next
  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know Our Team

The Strategic Partnerships team is responsible for identifying, building, and scaling high-impact partnerships that expand Agoda’s reach, improve customer acquisition, and create long-term business value.

For Japan, Financial Institution (FI) partnerships represent a strategic growth channel. This role will focus on developing and managing relationships with banks, card issuers, digital wallets, and other financial ecosystem partners to drive customer engagement, commercial growth, and win-win partnership outcomes.

You will work cross-functionally with teams across Commercial, Marketing, Product, Finance, Legal, Analytics, and Operations to bring partnership opportunities from idea to execution and optimization.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships to lead Agoda’s Japan FI partnership strategy and execution.

In this role, you will be responsible for identifying new partnership opportunities, managing key strategic accounts, negotiating commercial agreements, and driving performance across Agoda’s financial institution partnerships in Japan. You will help shape Agoda’s local partnership roadmap, unlock joint business opportunities, and ensure excellent execution of campaigns and initiatives with partners.

The ideal candidate brings strong business development and partnership experience, sharp commercial judgment, analytical rigor, and the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders. This role requires someone who is highly strategic but also willing to work hands-on to deliver measurable outcomes.

Why This Role Matters

This role is critical to Agoda’s growth in Japan. Financial institution partnerships are a highly strategic channel that can unlock scalable customer demand, deepen brand presence, and create differentiated value for travelers and partners alike.

As Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships, you will play a central role in shaping Agoda’s FI ecosystem in Japan and delivering high-impact partnerships that drive sustainable business growth.

What You’ll Do

Partnership Strategy & Business Development

  • Define and drive Agoda’s FI partnership strategy for Japan, aligned with market priorities and business growth objectives
  • Identify, evaluate, and prioritize new partnership opportunities with banks, credit card issuers, payment platforms, loyalty programs, and other financial ecosystem players
  • Build compelling partnership value propositions and business cases to secure internal alignment and partner buy-in
  • Lead commercial discussions, negotiations, and contract execution with prospective and existing FI partners

Account Management & Growth

  • Own and grow a portfolio of key FI partners in Japan, ensuring strong relationship management and long-term strategic alignment
  • Develop joint business plans with partners to drive customer acquisition, transaction growth, brand visibility, and partnership profitability
  • Monitor partner performance and proactively identify growth levers, optimization opportunities, and operational improvements
  • Ensure timely execution of campaigns, product integrations, and partner initiatives

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Analytics, Finance, Legal, and Operations to launch and scale partnership initiatives
  • Translate partner needs into clear internal requirements and drive execution across multiple teams
  • Influence decision-making through strong communication, stakeholder management, and data-backed recommendations
  • Support process improvements, reporting frameworks, and operating models to improve scalability and partner experience

Analytics & Optimization

  • Analyze partnership performance, customer behavior, campaign effectiveness, and commercial outcomes to generate actionable insights
  • Use data to identify trends, optimize investment decisions, and improve partnership ROI
  • Build business cases for new initiatives and present recommendations to senior stakeholders
  • Track key success metrics and maintain clear visibility on pipeline, performance, and impact

Experience

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • 7+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, account management, consulting, or a related commercial role
  • Strong experience managing external partners and driving commercial outcomes in a fast-paced, data-driven environment
  • Experience working with or within financial institutions, payment companies, loyalty ecosystems, or digital consumer platforms is highly preferred
  • Experience in e-commerce, travel, fintech, payments, or internet platforms is a strong plus
  • Proven track record of leading cross-functional initiatives from concept through execution

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to structure win-win partnerships and negotiate effectively
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to convert data into clear business insights and actions
  • Strong project management capabilities with high attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience influencing senior internal and external stakeholders
  • Self-starter with a bias for action and ability to operate independently in an ambiguous environment
  • Comfortable working hands-on while also thinking strategically

Technical / Functional

  • Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience with SQL, Tableau, or data visualization tools is a plus
  • Ability to develop business cases, commercial models, and performance reporting frameworks
  • Familiarity with campaign execution, co-marketing partnerships, loyalty mechanics, or payment-related partnership models is beneficial

Language

  • Fluency in English and Japanese is required

Company Description

 Join Accor – a professional journey at the heart of a committed, international and transforming group

Accor, a global leader in hospitality, present in more than 110 countries with 5,500 hotels, welcomes you to its offices located in Issy-les-Moulineaux.

This is where the Group’s global expertise comes together: strategy, finance, human resources, legal, technology, marketing, sustainability, communication, audit, procurement, and more.

Joining Accor means actively contributing to defining, structuring, and supporting the transformation of an international group, in direct connection with operational teams around the world.

Job Description

This is where your greatest challenge awaits:

Within the Premium Brands division, you will support the President, Premium Brands, a member of Accor’s Executive Committee, in leading a global portfolio of brands, hotels and teams across multiple regions.

The role sits at the heart of an international leadership environment and offers unique exposure to strategic, operational and stakeholder-related topics. You will act as a trusted partner, helping to optimize priorities, coordinate key stakeholders and ensure seamless execution across a complex and fast-moving international business.

Your Mission

  • Manage a demanding and complex international executive calendar, ensuring alignment with business priorities and leadership objectives.
  • Coordinate leadership meetings, business reviews, strategic sessions, executive committees and key events.
  • Prepare executive briefings, meeting materials, stakeholder notes and decision-support documents.
  • Ensure follow-through on key decisions, commitments and action plans.
  • Coordinate interactions with senior leaders, regional teams, owners, partners and external stakeholders.
  • Support communication, collaboration and alignment across the Premium Brands Leadership Team.
  • Organize complex international travel and ensure smooth execution of itineraries and strategic visits.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of Executive Office processes, tools and ways of working.
  • Handle sensitive and confidential information with the highest level of integrity and discretion.

Qualifications

And you?

Desired profile

  • Significant experience supporting a C-suite executive, Executive Committee member or similarly senior international leader.
  • Proven expertise managing complex executive schedules and international travel.
  • Experience operating in a multinational, matrixed and fast-paced environment.
  • Strong experience working with senior stakeholders across functions, geographies and cultures.
  • Previous exposure to hospitality, luxury, premium brands, travel or another international customer-centric industry is a plus.

Key Soft Skills

  • Sound judgment and prioritization skills.
  • Strong anticipation and proactive mindset.
  • Excellent stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Executive presence, diplomacy and discretion.
  • Outstanding organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • High level of adaptability and resilience.
  • Ability to build trusted relationships and work collaboratively across diverse teams.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365 and collaborative tools.
  • Strong ability to prepare executive-level communications and presentations.
  • Excellent planning, coordination and follow-up capabilities.
  • Digital mindset and interest in leveraging AI and productivity tools responsibly.

Languages

  • Professional fluency in English and French, both written and spoken, is essential.

Additional Information

Why join us?

And what are our commitments?

To the world

  • Accor is committed to the world around us, with a strong employer culture focused on the development of our 300,000 talents.
  • We adopt a continuous improvement approach to reduce the environmental impact of digital across all our projects.

To your career

  • We enable all our employees to maintain a healthy work-life balance and give them the means to shape their working environment in their own image.
  • Dedicated Talent Management, continuous improvement, and training and development paths are defined both individually and collectively so that we can grow together, every day.

Concretely, at Accor

  • Remote work possible several days per week from France and flexible working options: work from home, our offices, or even our hotels and coworking spaces thanks to Worklib.

And also,

  • ALL Heartist® program: preferential rates and flash offers for unforgettable stays and experiences across all our Accor locations and with our partners worldwide.
  • Heartist® for Good volunteering program: 1 day offered during your working time to get involved with a non-profit organization.
  • A Social and Economic Committee (CSE) that supports you in financing your cultural and sports activities.
  • Sustainable Mobility Package for using an eco-friendly means of transportation or a company bike program in partnership with Zenride.
  • Coverage of urban public transport subscriptions between home and workplace, up to 75%.
  • Meal vouchers with a face value of €11.
  • A mandatory health insurance plan funded at 50% by Accor.
  • Attractive working conditions with collaborative workspaces, restaurants, game areas, as well as well-being and sports spaces on site or through Gymlib.

Your talent and motivation are our only selection criteria.

We value the richness of diverse nationalities, personalities, and professional backgrounds.

We know how to adapt to the specific needs of our employees, particularly those with disabilities.

We encourage all applications, without distinction of gender, so dare to apply!

For us, recruitment is above all a story of encounters.

Does this role appeal to you? Apply, and we will offer you:

  • An initial discussion with our recruitment team.
  • One or more interviews with managers and team members.
  • For certain roles, you may also be asked to complete a test or case study, as well as a questionnaire about your personality and motivations.
  • A final interview with our Human Resources team to discuss our Group culture, working environment, training program, and career prospects, as well as the different Group benefits.
  • Personalized feedback.

job.job_description:
Job Description

About the Hotel

Be part of the next chapter in Australian luxury hospitality.

The iconic Imperial Hotel Gold Coast, formerly Palazzo Versace, is embarking on an exciting transformation as it becomes Australia's first LXR Hotels & Resorts property. Combining the grandeur and elegance of a globally recognised destination with Hilton's renowned standards of hospitality, this is a rare opportunity to help shape the future of one of Australia's most distinctive luxury hotels.

Situated on a stunning waterfront location, the hotel showcases exceptional Italian craftsmanship, luxury accommodation, award-winning dining experiences, extensive event and conference facilities, a lagoon-style pool, marina access, and an unwavering commitment to personalised guest experiences.

About The Role

An exceptional opportunity exists for an accomplished and visionary hospitality leader to join our Executive Leadership Team as Director of Operations.

Reporting directly to the General Manager, you will provide strategic direction across all operational divisions, including Rooms, Food & Beverage, Security, and Engineering. As a key leader, you will be instrumental in driving operational excellence, commercial performance, guest satisfaction, and team engagement while helping to establish the hotel as a benchmark for luxury hospitality under the LXR brand.

This role requires a dynamic leader who can inspire high-performing teams, elevate service standards, and deliver memorable guest experiences while fostering a culture that reflects Hilton's purpose of spreading the light and warmth of hospitality.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide strategic leadership across all operational departments, ensuring exceptional guest experiences and operational excellence.
  • Drive commercial performance through effective planning, financial management, and revenue optimisation.
  • Embed a culture of luxury service, continuous improvement, and accountability throughout the hotel.
  • Analyse guest feedback, operational data, and market trends to identify opportunities for innovation and enhancement.
  • Lead and develop departmental leaders, building capability, succession pipelines, and future talent.
  • Champion Hilton's values and create an engaged, inclusive, and high-performing workplace culture.
  • Collaborate closely with the Executive Leadership Team to deliver strategic initiatives and business objectives.
  • Ensure compliance with all health, safety, security, quality, and regulatory requirements.
  • Lead transformational projects and operational initiatives that enhance the hotel's competitive position and long-term success.
  • Drive sustainable business practices while maintaining the highest standards of luxury hospitality.

Qualifications

About You

You are a sophisticated, commercially astute hospitality professional with a passion for luxury service, people development, and operational excellence.

You Will Bring

  • Proven senior leadership experience within a luxury hotel or resort environment.
  • Strong operational expertise across Food & Beverage, Rooms Division, Engineering, or multi-department hotel operations.
  • A demonstrated track record of delivering exceptional guest satisfaction, financial performance, and business results.
  • Exceptional leadership, coaching, and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • The ability to translate strategic vision into operational execution and measurable outcomes.
  • Experience leading teams through change, transformation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Strong commercial acumen with sound financial and business management skills.
  • Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills, with a natural ability to inspire and influence others.
  • A genuine appreciation for personalised luxury service and creating memorable guest experiences.
  • Excellent organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Flexibility to work weekends, public holidays, and operationally critical periods as required.

Why Join Us?

This is a unique opportunity to play a pivotal leadership role in one of Australia's most exciting luxury hotel transformations. As part of Hilton's prestigious LXR Hotels & Resorts, you will help shape the future of an iconic property.

Join us and help define the next chapter of the Imperial Hotel Gold Coast.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know Our Team

The Strategic Partnerships team is responsible for identifying, building, and scaling high-impact partnerships that expand Agoda’s reach, improve customer acquisition, and create long-term business value.

For Japan, Financial Institution (FI) partnerships represent a strategic growth channel. This role will focus on developing and managing relationships with banks, card issuers, digital wallets, and other financial ecosystem partners to drive customer engagement, commercial growth, and win-win partnership outcomes.

You will work cross-functionally with teams across Commercial, Marketing, Product, Finance, Legal, Analytics, and Operations to bring partnership opportunities from idea to execution and optimization.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships to lead Agoda’s Japan FI partnership strategy and execution.

In this role, you will be responsible for identifying new partnership opportunities, managing key strategic accounts, negotiating commercial agreements, and driving performance across Agoda’s financial institution partnerships in Japan. You will help shape Agoda’s local partnership roadmap, unlock joint business opportunities, and ensure excellent execution of campaigns and initiatives with partners.

The ideal candidate brings strong business development and partnership experience, sharp commercial judgment, analytical rigor, and the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders. This role requires someone who is highly strategic but also willing to work hands-on to deliver measurable outcomes.

Why This Role Matters

This role is critical to Agoda’s growth in Japan. Financial institution partnerships are a highly strategic channel that can unlock scalable customer demand, deepen brand presence, and create differentiated value for travelers and partners alike.

As Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships, you will play a central role in shaping Agoda’s FI ecosystem in Japan and delivering high-impact partnerships that drive sustainable business growth.

What You’ll Do

Partnership Strategy & Business Development

  • Define and drive Agoda’s FI partnership strategy for Japan, aligned with market priorities and business growth objectives
  • Identify, evaluate, and prioritize new partnership opportunities with banks, credit card issuers, payment platforms, loyalty programs, and other financial ecosystem players
  • Build compelling partnership value propositions and business cases to secure internal alignment and partner buy-in
  • Lead commercial discussions, negotiations, and contract execution with prospective and existing FI partners

Account Management & Growth

  • Own and grow a portfolio of key FI partners in Japan, ensuring strong relationship management and long-term strategic alignment
  • Develop joint business plans with partners to drive customer acquisition, transaction growth, brand visibility, and partnership profitability
  • Monitor partner performance and proactively identify growth levers, optimization opportunities, and operational improvements
  • Ensure timely execution of campaigns, product integrations, and partner initiatives

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Analytics, Finance, Legal, and Operations to launch and scale partnership initiatives
  • Translate partner needs into clear internal requirements and drive execution across multiple teams
  • Influence decision-making through strong communication, stakeholder management, and data-backed recommendations
  • Support process improvements, reporting frameworks, and operating models to improve scalability and partner experience

Analytics & Optimization

  • Analyze partnership performance, customer behavior, campaign effectiveness, and commercial outcomes to generate actionable insights
  • Use data to identify trends, optimize investment decisions, and improve partnership ROI
  • Build business cases for new initiatives and present recommendations to senior stakeholders
  • Track key success metrics and maintain clear visibility on pipeline, performance, and impact

Experience

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • 7+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, account management, consulting, or a related commercial role
  • Strong experience managing external partners and driving commercial outcomes in a fast-paced, data-driven environment
  • Experience working with or within financial institutions, payment companies, loyalty ecosystems, or digital consumer platforms is highly preferred
  • Experience in e-commerce, travel, fintech, payments, or internet platforms is a strong plus
  • Proven track record of leading cross-functional initiatives from concept through execution

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to structure win-win partnerships and negotiate effectively
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to convert data into clear business insights and actions
  • Strong project management capabilities with high attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience influencing senior internal and external stakeholders
  • Self-starter with a bias for action and ability to operate independently in an ambiguous environment
  • Comfortable working hands-on while also thinking strategically

Technical / Functional

  • Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience with SQL, Tableau, or data visualization tools is a plus
  • Ability to develop business cases, commercial models, and performance reporting frameworks
  • Familiarity with campaign execution, co-marketing partnerships, loyalty mechanics, or payment-related partnership models is beneficial

Language

  • Fluency in English and Japanese is required

At Agoda, we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds and orientations. We prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and innovation. Employment at Agoda is based solely on a person’s merit and qualifications. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity regardless of sex, age, race, color, national origin, religion, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, citizenship, veteran or military status, and other legally protected characteristics.

We will keep your application on file so that we can consider you for future vacancies and you can always ask to have your details removed from the file. For more details please read our privacy policy.

Disclaimer

Company Description

We are a collection of 4 exclusive Luxury brands: Sofitel, Sofitel Legend and MGallery, Emblems across 60 countries, unlocking unique memorable moments in connection with the local destination.

Join our Maison to strive for Excellence. It is a place where you live your purpose!

Job Description

A career that lets your passion shine

An international experience for you to grow, learn and enjoy spreading our values and culture . You will contribute to outstanding employer branding projects to build our distinctive culture to attract and retain talents within Sofitel Legend, Sofitel, MGallery & Emblems.

The People & Culture team department is seeking a talented and dynamic Global employer branding & D&I Assistant (6 months internship starting on January/February 2027 to support the VP Talent acquisition & Employer branding & D&I Sofitel Legend, Sofitel, MGallery & Emblems in executing social media policies and enhancing our P&C and D&I campaigns.

Responsibilities:

  • Create employer branding content for social media (Linkedin) and Accor careers brand pages
  • Support the adoption of our Employee Value Proposition tailoring targeted Employer Branding campaigns for diverse audiences, and contributing to Employee Advocacy actions
  • Support the team on creating content creation (caption) with a deep knowledge of the culture and EVP, using innovative approaches to format, structure, and presentation to grow our brand presence and engagement on social media
  • Collaborate closely with the Brand Marketing team and social media team to raise awareness, foster adoption of our initiatives and to ensure consistent and cohesive execution of social media and influence initiatives, reflecting the brand's identity
  • Support on the update of contents (onboarding handbooks, career pages…)
  • Support on communication, prepare internal communication: RiiSE newsletters: success stories interviews, and Participate to the organisation of DEI events.
  • Participate in Talent acquisition projects

In an international and faced pace environment this internship is a great opportunity to work closely with different internal stakeholders (P&C team, different department -Brands, communication, operations) and external stakeholders (schools relationship, social media) while developing your skills in communication, marketing and employer branding.

You will be part of a team where everyone’s contribution is valued.

Qualifications

You are a team player, able to work effectively with transversal teams from across the globe. You have interests in social media and digital platforms and are eager to learn more Employer Branding and Talent Acquisition and Diversity & Inclusion. You have a creative mindset with the ability to propose and execute communication campaigns

Qualifications

Level of studies: + 4 / +5

Fields of Studies: HR, Communication, Digital Marketing

Professional Experience: Previous internship(s) in luxury or luxury hospitality either in HR or Marketing Department.

Languages: Ability to communicate in English both written and spoken, French is a plus.

  • Strong interest in managing social media, digital platform and influence strategy (Organic and paid media) with deep knowledge of the main social platforms
  • Strong sensibility to aesthetics and meticulous attention to detail to produce high-end content
  • Strong organization skills , multi tasking, project management skills and are a team player
  • Creative mindset with the ability to propose and execute communication campaigns.
  • Excellent written communication skills
  • Agility and Flexibility. Curiosity, listening skills, and analytical mindset
  • Fluent in English, French is a plus

Additional Information

Our Commitment To Diversity & Inclusion:

We are an inclusive company and our ambition is to attract, recruit and promote diverse talent.

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You will develop the quality of the Finance function, and provide financial support, advice and expertise to the General Manager and hotel team, to maximize value. As a Finance Operations Manager, you’re not just responsible for all accounting and financial requirements for the hotel – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Financial Controls: Apply best-practice accounting within a strong control framework
  • Reporting: Deliver clear, actionable financial insights
  • Business Support: Provide commercial and financial guidance to operations
  • Technology Use: Improve efficiency through smart IT integration
  • Investment: Drive strong returns on capital projects
  • Planning & Forecasting: Align budgets with strategic goals and accurate forecasts
  • Team Development: Build and grow a capable finance team
  • Cash Management: Safeguard liquidity through tight controls
  • Cost Efficiency: Help optimize operational cost structures

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field
  • Proven experience in a managerial operational accounting role
  • Proficient in English (spoken and written) for business communication
  • Skilled in hotel systems: OnQ, Check SCM, SUN, OPERA/OnQ PMS, MICROS, HRLINK
  • Good communication and analytical skills.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

  • Ability to develop business cases, commercial models, and performance reporting frameworks
  • Familiarity with campaign execution, co-marketing partnerships, loyalty mechanics, or payment-related partnership models is beneficial

Language

  • Fluency in English and Japanese is required

job.job_description:
Description de l'entreprise

Description De L’entreprise

Fondé en 2008 par Serge Trigano et ses fils Jérémie et Benjamin (co-fondateur du Club Med), Mama Shelter est un créateur de lieux de vie et metteur en scène au quotidien !

Ce sont des lieux atypiques, dans lesquels chacun se sent chez soi, des lieux issus d’un métissage d’influences, de libertés, de sensations et d’émotions. Chaque Mama raconte l’histoire de la ville dans laquelle il se trouve, et toutes les influences se mélangent. Nous offrons à nos clients une ambiance joyeuse et un service exceptionnel à un prix abordable.

Plus que des chambres et des restaurants, Mama Shelter c’est une dynamique, une vibration : ils sont de vrais refuges urbains, non seulement esthétiques et modernes mais aussi populaires, accueillants et sexy.

Quel que soit votre rôle, nous sommes tous là pour rendre l’expérience clients la plus inoubliable possible.

Notre mission : apporter des petits moments de bonheur aux gens.

Notre croissance nous permet de donner de beaux parcours à nos équipes en développant les évolutions internes et la mobilité internationale, et ce n’est pas une question de diplôme ou d’années d’expérience.

Mama Shelter fait partie d’Ennismore, un groupe hôtelier créatif ancré dans les cultures et les destinations, avec un portefeuille mondial de marques. Ennismore est une joint-venture avec Accor, fondé en 2021.

Notre engagement en faveur de la diversité et de l’inclusion :

Mama est une entreprise inclusive et notre ambition est de recruter et promouvoir des talents divers. Nos annonces ne ciblent pas de genre, ici l’usage du masculin est utilisé afin d’alléger le texte.

Description du poste

LA MISSION DURANT VOTRE STAGE ?

Prêt à faire rassembler et faire vibrer la communauté Mama Shelter ?

Nous recherchons une personne créative et audacieuse pour occuper le poste de Community Manager en qualité de stagiaire, d’une durée de 6 mois maximum, au sein de notre Mama Gang.

Vous contribuerez au développement et à l’animation de nos communautés pour leur insuffler notre Mama énergie. Si vous êtes passionné par l’animation, les réseaux sociaux et la création d’événements mémorables, ce rôle est fait pour vous !

  • Proposer, participer et aider à la mise en œuvre des événements captivants et inoubliables afin de rassembler nos communautés et l’élargir.
  • Gérer nos réseaux sociaux locaux afin de mettre en avant notre Mama sous toutes ses coutures , y compris lors des événements.
  • Savoir nouer et entretenir de bonnes relations presse & influence pour notre Mama, sans qu’elle n’aille sur le tapis rouge !
  • Dénicher, réserver et chouchouter les artistes, DJs, musiciens et autres partenaires nous permettant de proposer des performances lives qui enflammeront la scène et les espaces F&B de Mama. ❤️‍
  • Être le lien entre le Siège pour orchestrer un contenu inattendu sur les réseaux sociaux (Meta, TikTok), en s'assurant de la rentabilité des initiatives et de leur impact sur le chiffre d'affaires.
  • Aider à la création et la gestion du calendrier de contenu captivant et fidélisant les communautés, en lien avec notre chargée de réservation.
  • S’assurer que l’ADN Mama Shelter brille dans chaque communication digitale.

Qualifications

FAIT POUR VOUS ? UNIQUEMENT SI…

  • Toujours à l’affût des dernières tendances, vous savez comment faire vibrer une foule et créer des moments inoubliables.
  • Un vrai maître dans la gestion des réseaux sociaux , vous savez capter l’attention et engager votre audience avec du contenu créatif et authentique.
  • Gérer plusieurs événements à la fois ne vous fait pas peur…inspirer, expirer, vous savez garder votre calme !
  • Selon les événements planifiés, vous êtes prêt à travailler en soirée ou les week-ends pour en assurer le succès, et la création de contenu pour nos réseaux sociaux et notre communauté.

VOS PETITS + SONT :

  • Vous aimez détecter, anticiper les nouvelles tendances, elles ne vous échappent jamais. ✨
  • Sortir du cadre des animations « classiques » ne vous fait pas peur, au contraire ça vous captive.
  • Vos idées sont toujours surprenantes et innovantes
  • Maîtriser les logiciels de création visuelle et les outils de gestion des réseaux sociaux, un jeu d’enfant pour vous !

Informations supplémentaires

Informations supplémentaires

Ensuite, nous sommes sûrs que vous connaissez la chanson :

Première mélodie : “Chez Mama, pas d’IA ! Nous consultons en personne votre candidature et prenons le temps de comprendre votre parcours.

1er couplet : Nous organisons un premier échange téléphonique avec notre Responsable Rh pour voir si votre candidature s’inscrit dans notre rythme.

Refrain : Une fois l’entretien téléphonique réussi, on vous donne rendez-vous à distance ou au Mama pour rencontrer le Gang !

Dernier couplet : Naturellement, vous aurez une réponse de notre part, dans un délai de 2 à 3 semaines maximum, que cela soit ✔️ ou ✖️.
