job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get To Know Our Team:

As an Operations Specialist you will be responsible for processing and coordinating operational requests and projects to support our B2B partners (Managed and/or Self Serve) during the different parts of their partner journey - from sign-up, on-boarding and payouts to optimizing our internal and external partner Knowledge Center.

You will be responsible for driving innovation and quality improvement projects and are expected to be an expert in one or more of the operations area:

  • Managed partners- contracting, payments, system administration
  • Self Serve - partner analysis & experience, products, system administration

You are expected to lead by example by showing a positive can-do attitude and role modeling the principle of taking ownership.

Excellent communication and organizational skills are required in this role.

Location: This role requires you to be based in Bangkok, Thailand (with relocation support provide)

In this Role, you'll get to:

  • Support: Handling of operations ticket inbound from our Commercial team and Partners and other internal stakeholders" (can include Tech/Product, Finance and CEG teams, etc)
  • Projects: Innovate the existing processes by initiating and driving medium sized* projects to improve efficiency, quality and/or Partner experience
  • Coordinate with the Legal, Privacy and Fraud, Finance and/or Accounts Payables departments to ensure smooth contractual or financial facilitation
  • Apply critical thinking and independently drive improvements across the team
  • Share knowledge and best practices across teams, both centrally and in the regions
  • Creating and documenting the processes to be followed by the commercial teams and operational teams
  • Handling of ticket inbound from Partners (Self Serve)
  • Maintaining high service levels according to set SLAs
  • Provide peer training and support to newly onboarded members of the team

Handles tickets and projects in one or more areas of expertise:

Managed Partners:

Contracting:

  • Draft contracts using guidance & legal playbook for Central teams (ranging from regular to complex requested changes) and approve or reject proposed changes from partners
  • Leading medium sized* projects (eg. on process innovation, legal templates and / or optimizing our tools)
  • Train and support account managers in the processing and coordination of all Contracting requests

Payments:

  • Coordinate creation of credit slips and payment batches for all Partners
  • Investigate payment issues and/or commission errors and come up with innovative, scalable solutions
  • Dispute management
  • Perform pre-emptive account maintenance to prevent failed payments
  • Using SQL queries combining tables, perform commission errors or data discrepancy investigations
  • Train and support account managers and partners on all Financial and Payment requests

Self Serve:

Partner experience:

  • Drive partner profile analysis in efforts to increase positive partner experience through self serve platform (Knowledge base)
  • Analysis of Partner-facing campaigns and surveys
  • Work collaboratively with Business Performance team to align priorities
  • Underlying focus on decreasing inbound and increasing automations while simultaneously increasing the positive self serve partner experience

What you'll Need to Succeed:

  • Operational & project leadership: 3+ years' experience in Global Operations (preferred), with a strong operational mindset and a track record of leading cross-functional initiatives from planning through execution.
  • Analytical and commercially minded: Results-driven, with strong analytical skills, excellent attention to detail, and a critical mindset.
  • Organised and adaptable: Able to manage multiple, competing projects to deadlines and thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment, with a high ability to learn quickly.
  • Excellent communicator and relationship builder: Fluent in spoken and written English, able to explain complex problems simply to senior stakeholders, manage expectations, and secure internal resources, with high integrity and a strong customer service ethos.
  • Proactive owner: Independent, self-motivated, and willing to "Be Brave and Own It", while holding yourself and your colleagues to high standards.

It's Great if you have:

  • Analytical & project skills: Able to build, interpret, and act on reports, with good project management skills.
  • Systems proficiency: Experience with Microsoft Word, Excel, MySQL, and Salesforce or other CRM/ticketing systems.
  • Technical knowledge: SQL knowledge, particularly valuable for Payments and Product roles, plus product or tech experience for Product.
  • Function-specific background: A legal background for Contracting, or commercial and analytical skills for Partner roles.

job.job_description:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Area Director, Franchise Performance, Core Brands is responsible for driving the commercial performance of a portfolio of midscale and upper midscale franchised hotels. Acting as a trusted advisor to hotel owners, operators, and management companies, this role leverages revenue, market, and operational performance data to identify opportunities for growth and profitability.

The Area Director develops and influences execution of strategic commercial action plans that improve RevPAR, market share, ADR, occupancy, revenue growth, and owner profitability. Through a combination of on-site consultations, virtual engagements, business reviews, and cross-functional collaboration, the role aligns hotel performance strategies with company initiatives and available resources.

This position partners closely with Revenue Management, Sales, Marketing, Loyalty, Distribution, Brand, and Operations teams to support commercial excellence and sustained portfolio growth while fostering strong franchisee relationships and driving program adoption.

NOTE: To be considered for this position, candidates must currently reside in Louisiana. Relocation assistance is not available for this role. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates who meet the position requirements and location criteria.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Commercial Performance Management & Strategic Advisory

  • Serve as a strategic commercial advisor to hotel owners and operators, using hotel, portfolio, and market data to identify revenue opportunities and performance improvement initiatives.
  • Conduct property visits, performance reviews, and business consultations that connect revenue strategy, sales activation, marketing, distribution, loyalty participation, guest experience, and operational execution to profitable growth.
  • Influence stakeholder adoption of agreed-upon commercial priorities through clear accountability, performance goals, and follow-through.
  • Evaluate market demand, competitive positioning, business mix, pricing strategy, distribution effectiveness, and sales performance to prioritize the highest-value opportunities.
  • Develop action-oriented recommendations that improve revenue generation, profitability, market share, and long-term owner value.

Revenue & Market Performance Accountability

  • Drive improvement in portfolio and hotel-level commercial metrics, including RevPAR, RevPAR Index, ADR, occupancy, revenue growth, and profitability.
  • Analyze performance trends, pace reports, demand drivers, channel contribution, competitive intelligence, and market dynamics to guide performance strategies.
  • Partner with Revenue Management resources and hotel leadership to align pricing, inventory, forecasting, and segment strategies with evolving market conditions.
  • Monitor commercial dashboards and performance indicators, proactively identifying risks and adjusting strategies to improve outcomes.
  • Escalate performance concerns and recommend corrective actions when business objectives are not being achieved.

Commercial Resource Activation

  • Coordinate targeted support from Revenue Management, Sales, Marketing, Loyalty, Distribution, Brand, and Operations partners based on individual hotel opportunities and needs.
  • Increase engagement and participation in proprietary revenue-generating programs and initiatives.
  • Measure and assess the effectiveness of resource activation by evaluating business impact, program participation, and performance improvements.
  • Ensure hotel teams understand and leverage available corporate resources to maximize commercial results.

Data-Driven Consultation & Business Influence

  • Translate complex operational and financial data into actionable recommendations for owners and hotel leadership teams.
  • Utilize internal and external performance tools, dashboards, benchmarking resources, and business intelligence platforms to quantify opportunities and inform decision-making.
  • Apply trusted-advisor consultation practices to align stakeholders around commercial priorities, investments, and execution commitments.
  • Measure effectiveness through performance improvement, owner engagement, action-plan completion, and program adoption.
  • Maintain expertise in industry trends, market conditions, competitive activity, and company commercial initiatives.

Owner & Stakeholder Relationship Management

  • Lead recurring performance discussions with hotel owners, management companies, and property leadership teams.
  • Build credibility and trust through commercial expertise, responsiveness, and sound business judgment.
  • Document commitments, action items, and strategic decisions while ensuring accountability and follow-through.
  • Provide leadership with insights regarding revenue performance, ownership engagement, competitive threats, and emerging business risks.
  • Serve as a primary relationship holder within the assigned portfolio and territory.

Administration & Organizational Support

  • Maintain accurate documentation of consultations, performance plans, ownership interactions, and commercial initiatives within company systems.
  • Submit timely and accurate expense reporting.
  • Support franchise growth, retention initiatives, and participation in relevant franchise associations and industry activities.
  • Share market intelligence, best practices, and emerging opportunities with franchisees, peers, and corporate stakeholders.
  • Participate in special projects and other organizational initiatives as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Employment Experience

  • Minimum fifteen (15) years of progressive hotel industry experience with significant responsibility for commercial strategy, revenue performance, sales, marketing, revenue management, or multi-property performance improvement.
  • Minimum ten (10) years of hotel leadership experience, preferably including franchise performance, revenue management, commercial leadership, or multi-unit operational responsibility.
  • Demonstrated success improving hotel commercial performance, including revenue growth, RevPAR, market share, and owner profitability.
  • Proven ability to influence business decisions through analytical insights and strategic consultation.
  • Experience working effectively within a matrixed organization and influencing outcomes without direct authority.

Technical Skills

  • Strong analytical, forecasting, and financial acumen.
  • Experience utilizing hotel performance and business intelligence tools, including revenue, financial, market share, and benchmarking platforms.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to analyze and interpret large datasets and translate findings into practical business recommendations.
  • Knowledge of hotel revenue management principles, sales activation strategies, distribution channels, marketing performance, loyalty programs, and profitability metrics.

Additional Skills & Competencies

  • Exceptional consulting, communication, negotiation, and influencing skills.
  • Strong executive presence and ability to communicate effectively with hotel owners and senior leaders.
  • Ability to balance multiple priorities while managing a geographically dispersed portfolio.
  • Strong relationship-building and stakeholder-management capabilities.
  • Demonstrated commercial acumen and strategic thinking.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and adapt priorities within a changing business environment.
  • Commitment to organizational values, integrity, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree in Hotel Management, Business Management, Marketing, Finance, or a related field or equivalent combination of education and work experience.
  • MBA preferred.

OTHER REQUIREMENTS:

  • Regular travel of approximately 70% is required.
  • Participation in conferences, owner meetings, special projects, and organizational initiatives as needed.
  • Ability to travel independently throughout the assigned territory

COMPENSATION & SALARY RANGE:

Salary Range: $99,919 to $117,000 annually

This role is also eligible for an annual bonus under Choice’s Management Incentive Plan (MIP).

Pay ranges listed are what Choice Hotels reasonably expects to pay. Actual pay may be higher or lower and ranges may be adjusted in the future. Pay positioning within the range is influenced by factors including—but not limited to—education, experience, skills, certifications, performance, geographic location, business needs, seniority, and travel requirements.

Choice prioritizes our associate wellbeing by offering a comprehensive benefits program that is both competitive and flexible to help you achieve your wellbeing goals - here are just a few:

  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Leave and paid time-off for holidays, vacation, personal, family, volunteer, sick, jury duty, bereavement, military, and religious observance
  • Financial benefits for retirement and health savings
  • Employee recognition programs
  • Discounts at Choice hotels worldwide

About Choice

Choice Hotels International, Inc. (NYSE: CHH), is one of the largest lodging franchisors in the world. With 7,500 hotels in 45+ countries and territories, we offer a range of high-quality lodging options in the upper upscale, upper midscale, midscale, extended stay, and economy segments. We’re the hotel company for those who choose to bet on themselves — the striver, the dreamer, the entrepreneur — because that’s who we are, too.

At Choice, we are united by the simple belief that tomorrow will be even better than today — for associates, our company, and our franchisees. At our worldwide corporate headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, at our technology center in Scottsdale, Arizona, and through our associates around the globe, every voice is heard and every idea is listened to, no matter what area of the company they come from. We are united in supporting the entrepreneurial dreams of our thousands of franchise owners, which propels us forward — giving our work at Choice a purpose larger than our business.

Our corporate office locations:

North Bethesda, MD — Located at Pike & Rose, our worldwide headquarters is less than 15 miles from Washington, D.C., one block away from the North Bethesda Metro station, with easy access to I-495, complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Scottsdale, AZ — Located at the northwest corner of Loop 101, the Scottsdale office is home to our technology, eCommerce and customer service organizations, with easy access to complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Minneapolis, MN — Select roles are based in our Minneapolis office on Highway 394, near the intersection with Highway 100, only five minutes from downtown.

Field/Remote — Select roles designated as field/remote will require associates to work from a home office, connecting virtually with Choice team members and leadership on Zoom, with possible required travel depending on the role.

Choice’s Cultural Values

Welcome and Respect Everyone | Be Bold | Be Quick | Listen | Be Curious | Show Integrity

Choice’s Leadership Principles

Act with Intention | Lead with Authenticity | Grow & Deliver

The Hyatt Shared Service is seeking is a Senior Analyst- Finance Evolution. This position will help modernize how Finance work gets done across Hyatt. The Senior Analyst, Finance Evolution partners with Finance colleagues and technology teams to understand processes, identify opportunities for improvement, and deliver practical automation and data solutions. This work reduces repetitive effort and helps colleagues focus on analysis that supports business insight, cost efficiency, and hotel-level profitability.

Duties/Responsibilities

  • Partner with Finance stakeholders to map processes, gather requirements, and translate business needs into clear solution designs.
  • Analyze and redesign workflows; identify automation opportunities and recommend practical ways to simplify Finance work.
  • Develop, configure, deploy, and support solutions such as automated workflows, dashboards, scorecards, and data transformations.
  • Coordinate with Financial Systems, Data & Analytics, ServiceNow, and other technology teams to deliver sustainable solutions.
  • Plan project work, estimate effort and resource needs, facilitate design sessions, and communicate progress and risks.
  • Coordinate change management, user acceptance testing, defect triage, and production releases with business and technology partners.
  • Monitor production solution health, respond to incidents, resolve issues, and improve solutions based on feedback and results.
  • Create user guidance and training, support adoption, and share effective practices and solution knowledge across global teams.
  • Stay current on relevant tools and approaches and recommend process improvements that can reduce effort or cost.
  • Encourage adoption of improved processes and tools and help colleagues adapt to changes in how Finance work is performed.

All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

Qualifications

Experience

  • At least 3 years of experience in business process analysis, process redesign, automation, or a related field.
  • Experience gathering requirements, analyzing workflows, and translating business needs into workable solutions.
  • Experience delivering or supporting process improvement or automation initiatives, including testing, rollout, and ongoing support.
  • Ability to collaborate with Finance stakeholders and technology teams to plan and deliver cross-functional work.
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to explain changes, train users, and support adoption.
  • Strong organization and attention to detail, with the ability to meet deadlines, adapt to changing priorities, and work with limited supervision.
  • Strong understanding of finance and accounting processes.
  • Hospitality, shared services, or multi-entity finance experience preferred.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in relevant field
  • Master’s degree a plus

Computer Skills Needed To Perform This Job

  • MS Office
  • Experience with no-code/low-code automation platforms (Alteryx Designer or Server preferred)
  • Experience with enterprise analytics and data visualization tools (e.g. ThoughtSpot, Tableau, or Power BI preferred)
  • Experience with modern data cloud platforms and data warehousing technologies (e.g. Snowflake)
  • Experience with SQL, Python, or other programming languages is an advantage.
  • Experience with ERP and financial systems (e.g. Oracle, Hyperion)

Additional Comments And Requirements

  • Proactive and well organized, with strong attention to detail and the ability to meet project deadlines while managing competing priorities.

job.job_description:
As the world's largest family of luxury hotels, we all take great pride in being genuine ambassadors of the InterContinental® brand.

Shaped by decades of international know-how and local insights, our passion for luxury travel spans cultures and customs. Inspiring us to create warm and sophisticated experiences for those seeking a richer perspective on the world.

If you’d like to embrace a world of opportunities, we’d like to welcome you to the world’s most international luxury hotel brand.

Nestled in the heart of Brisbane’s CBD, InterContinental Hotel Brisbane offers 319 spacious hotel rooms and suites, all day dining restaurant and lobby bar, outdoor pool, fitness centre and Club Lounge, all in a prime location above Queen Street Mall, perfect for exploring the city’s top attractions. With over 1800 square meters of meeting and events spaces, InterContinental Brisbane offers versatile function rooms and a Grand Ballroom catering for up to 1000 guests, making it a great choice for business and leisure events alike.

We are looking for a well-rounded Assistant Night Manager.

Your day to day:

  • You will assist in leading our Front Office overnight team to ensure the night operation runs smoothly, drive team engagement, guest feedback & problem resolution, brand and cleanliness standards.
  • The principal responsibility is safety and security of guests and ensuring the accurate and timely completion of the night audit function during the hours of 11pm – 7am.
  • You will also play a key role in coaching and mentoring your team, providing direction and coaching to achieve an exceptional guest experience.
  • If you are looking to develop your career within a global hotel company in a beautiful brand, then we would love to hear from you!

What we need from you:

  • 2 to 5 years of experience in the hospitality industry, preferably in hotel operations or Front Office leadership.
  • No work restrictions and full eligibility to work in Australia.
  • A genuine commitment to delivering exceptional guest experiences.
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate, support and develop a team during overnight operations.
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
  • A long-term career mindset and a desire to grow within the hospitality industry.
  • Confident in problem handling.

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Complex Director of Sales, you’re not just driving revenue growth across all hotel segments – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:

  • Shape and execute sales strategy: Develop and implement revenue-driving sales strategies across group, business transient, leisure transient, and catering segments, aligned with the hotel’s commercial goals and strategic plan
  • Drive revenue performance and profitability: Contribute to achieving revenue targets and profitability goals by optimizing pricing, improving business mix, and guiding forecasting accuracy
  • Lead business reviews and planning: Facilitate regular strategy and performance meetings while contributing to long-range commercial planning through analysis of performance trends, market shifts, and revenue opportunities
  • Ensure commercial alignment: Collaborate with revenue and marketing leaders to align sales tactics with pricing, distribution, and promotional strategies, and to support forecasting and rate strategies
  • Foster stakeholder relationships: Engage with Hilton Worldwide Sales, Convention and Visitors Bureaus (CVBs), third-party travel partners, and key clients to drive demand, improve conversion, and support high-impact site visits and pre-convention meetings
  • Develop data-informed strategies: Track market and competitor activity to inform strategy and help maintain competitive positioning in group and transient segments

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

About The Team

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

Position Overview

The Senior Director, Property & Operations Analytics is a key leader within Marriott’s Enterprise Data, Analytics & AI (D&AI) organization, responsible for elevating analytics, measurement practices, and decision support across the end‑to‑end property and hotel operations lifecycle. This role partners closely with Global Operations, Brand & Lodging Product, Quality, Owner & Franchise Services and Continent teams to drive performance, improve guest experience, and inform enterprise and owner decisions.

This leader owns analytics that support hotels and above‑property leaders across on‑property execution, quality and standards, renovation and compliance, service delivery, labor and cost efficiency, and operational performance. A core expectation is to bring innovation - introducing modern measurement approaches, strengthening experimentation and pilot measurement, and continuously raising the analytical maturity of the Property & Operations analytics portfolio.

As an Analytics Guild Leader in the D&AI operating model, the role leads multiple agile pods, sets standards across Operations Analytics, and ensures end‑to‑end progress on enterprise priorities, data debt reduction, and flagship initiatives such as ITR Drivers, hotel decisioning tools (e.g., QPower), and the evolution of guest satisfaction measurement.

Key Duties & Responsibilities

  • Strategic & Innovative Leadership – Property & Operations
  • Define and execute the analytics vision for Property & Operations in alignment with enterprise priorities and D&AI strategy.
  • Introduce innovative measurement practices, frameworks, and analytical approaches that elevate how Global Operations decisions are informed.
  • Act as a thought leader on how property condition, service execution, staffing, and operational trade‑offs influence guest experience, brand health, and owner value.
  • Measurement & Decision Support
  • Own measurement strategy for operations pilots, initiatives, and field tests - ensuring clear success metrics, learning agendas, and post‑pilot recommendations.
  • Translate pilot and initiative results into crisp insights and decision guidance for senior leaders, operations forums, and owners.
  • Continuously assess whether current KPIs and scorecards are fit‑for‑purpose, recommending changes where needed to improve decision quality.
  • Operations Analytics (End‑to‑End)
  • Provide Analytics oversight across Global Ops domains, including Rooms, F&B, Spa, Engineering, Staffing/Labor, and Service Operations.
  • Lead development of robust measurement frameworks for complex areas such as Food & Beverage and other operations‑heavy disciplines.
  • Deepen team expertise in relevant systems, data sources, and operational dynamics across Global Operations functions.
  • Ensure analytics reflect real operational realities and are trusted by field, continent, and corporate leaders.
  • Advanced Analytics & Insight Delivery
  • Lead analyses and models assessing hotel performance drivers, including renovation impact, standards compliance, service execution, and operational effectiveness.
  • Synthesize across GuestVoice/ITR, brand standards, quality audits, property attributes, financial signals, and operational KPIs.
  • Deliver executive‑ready insights that clearly communicate what matters, why it matters, and what actions leaders should take.
  • Guild, Pod & Enterprise Leadership (D&AI Model)
  • Serve as Analytics Guild Leader for Property & Operations, setting standards, best practices, and capability roadmaps.
  • Work closely with other guild leaders and pod teams to ensure coordinated progress on shared priorities, enterprise initiatives, and data debt items.
  • Drive alignment and momentum across large cross‑pod efforts, including ITR Drivers, hotel decisioning tools (e.g., QPower), and modernization of guest satisfaction measurement (including assessing how ITR is measured and complemented by other metrics).
  • Cross‑Functional Partnership & Influence
  • Serve as the primary analytics partner to Global Operations, Quality, Asset Management, Brand Operations, Development, and Continent leadership teams.
  • Embed analytics into operational planning, performance reviews, renovation prioritization, and standards governance.
  • Influence leaders through strong relationships, credibility, and clear data‑driven storytelling.
  • Team Leadership & Capability Building
  • Lead, mentor, and inspire a senior team of analytics leaders and practitioners.
  • Elevate team capabilities in measurement design, causal analysis, experimentation, and operational decisioning.
  • Foster a culture of ownership, learning, and continuous improvement.

Requirements & Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Analytics, Data Science, Economics, Engineering, or related field required.
  • Master’s degree or MBA preferred.

Experience

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in analytics, strategy, operations, or related disciplines, with significant leadership responsibility.
  • Proven experience driving measurement and analytics for complex operational environments. This may include KPI frameworks and decisioning for an assigned business domain.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and drive adoption of analytics in business decision‑making.
  • Hospitality, lodging operations, quality, or asset‑focused experience required.

Skills & Knowledge

  • Deep understanding of hotel operations, service delivery, and operational drivers of guest experience.
  • Strong analytical, conceptual, and systems thinking skills.
  • Demonstrated experience communicating with and influencing senior executives and driving enterprise‑level analytics adoption.
  • Experience operating in agile, product‑oriented analytics models.

This role plays a critical part in modernizing how Marriott measures, pilots, and optimizes property‑level execution—translating analytics into stronger guest experiences, better operational decisions, and long‑term value for owners and the enterprise.

Location

  • Must be able to consistently work Eastern or Central time zone business hours, with a strong preference for Eastern time zone alignment.

job.job_description:
職務内容（Responsibilities）

1. 日本市場における商業戦略の策定・実行

· Trip.com Group全体の成長戦略および日本市場特有の市場環境・商習慣を踏まえ、日本市場におけるパートナーシップの事業戦略を策定・実行する。

· 日本を代表する旅行プラットフォーム、アフィリエイトネットワーク、メディア企業、新興デジタルチャネルなどを含む、高い事業価値を持つビジネス機会を特定・優先順位付けし、獲得につなげる。

· グローバルのパートナーシップ戦略を、日本のビジネスパートナーやステークホルダーに響く、現地市場に適した戦略・施策へと落とし込む。

· 日本市場におけるパートナーシップチャネルの収益成長を牽引し、Trip.com Groupの地域全体の業績向上に大きく貢献する。


2. パートナーエコシステムの構築・拡大

· 主要な日本企業とのC-suiteおよび経営層レベルの関係を構築・維持する。対象には、大手旅行プラットフォーム、アフィリエイトネットワーク、メディア企業、航空会社、観光局などが含まれる。

· 日本特有の関係性を重視するビジネス文化を理解し、戦略的パートナーとの間で信頼・信用を構築するとともに、長期的なビジネス上の方向性を一致させる。

· コンテンツパートナーシップ、ロイヤリティプログラム、共同マーケティング、新たな流通・販売チャネルなど、日本市場に適した新しいパートナーシップモデルを特定・開発する。

· 日本市場における競合環境やパートナーエコシステムの変化を継続的に把握し、Trip.com Groupが競合他社との差別化を図り、魅力的なビジネス価値を提供できる状態を維持する。


3. チームのリーダーシップ・能力向上

· 日本のパートナーシップチームを支援・コーチング・育成し、戦略的思考力、ビジネス推進力、パートナーシップマネジメント能力を高める。

· 市場戦略・施策を継続的に検証・改善し、チームに対してパフォーマンス基準に基づく成果創出を求めるとともに、ビジネス上の意思決定の質を向上させる。

· メンタリング、ナレッジ共有、能力開発を通じて、パートナーシップ組織全体の成果創出力を高めるリーダーとして機能する。

· 責任感、協働、継続的な改善を重視する高いパフォーマンス文化を醸成する。


4. オペレーションガバナンス・実行品質の向上

· 日本市場におけるビジネスガバナンス、精度の高い予測・フォーキャスト、計画策定の徹底を推進する。

· ROIの評価フレームワーク、ビジネスガバナンス基準、パフォーマンスレポーティングを一貫性・透明性を持って運用する。

· 定期的な計画・レビューサイクルを強化し、正確かつ信頼性の高いビジネスパイプラインおよびパートナー実績の可視化を実現する。

· 複数部門をまたぐ施策をリードし、実行品質およびオペレーション効率の向上を図る。


5. ステークホルダー・社内各部門との連携

· Marketing、Product、Finance、Legal、Regional Leadershipなどの社内ステークホルダーと強固な関係を構築し、日本市場におけるパートナーシップの優先事項が適切に反映され、必要なリソースが確保されるよう推進する。

· 主要な戦略的パートナーに対するシニアレベルの対外的な窓口として、業界イベント、パートナーサミット、経営層とのミーティングなどにおいてTrip.com Groupを代表する。

· APAC全体におけるパートナーシップチャネルの事業領域・影響力をさらに拡大するため、部門横断的な戦略プロジェクトにも参画する。


応募資格（Requirements）

日本市場に対する深い理解と、独自のビジネス文化・商習慣を踏まえて事業を推進できる能力を持ち、戦略的なビジネスセンスとパートナーシップ構築力を兼ね備えたリーダーを求めています。

本ポジションに適した候補者は、従来型のBD・営業担当者ではなく、「事業戦略を描く人材」「パートナーシップをリードする人材」「長期的な関係を構築できる人材」という3つの要素を兼ね備えた方です。


経験・バックグラウンド（Experience & Background）

· パートナーシップ、アフィリエイトマーケティング、事業戦略、ビジネスディベロップメント等の領域において、8～10年以上の実務経験。旅行、Eコマース、コンシューマーインターネット業界での経験があれば尚可。

· 日本市場における事業成長を実現した実績があり、P&Lまたは売上への具体的なインパクトを生み出した経験。

· 日本の旅行・デジタル業界に関する深い知識。主要OTA、アフィリエイトネットワーク、メディアパートナー、および市場を取り巻く競争環境に関する十分な理解。

· 高いパフォーマンスを発揮するチームのマネジメントまたはコーチング経験。メンバーの成長を促し、チームのビジネス水準を高められる能力。

· クロスファンクショナルかつマトリックス型の組織での業務経験があり、複数の市場・部門にまたがってシニアレベルのステークホルダーを巻き込み、影響力を発揮できる方。

· グローバルまたはリージョナルの旅行プラットフォーム、日本の旅行会社（例：JTB、KNT-CTホールディングス、楽天トラベル）、または日本を代表するデジタル・アフィリエイト企業での経験があれば尚可。


言語（Language）

· 日本語：ネイティブレベル必須

日本のビジネスパートナーとの関係構築、国内チームのリード、日本市場における円滑な業務遂行に必要となります。

· 英語：ビジネスレベル必須

グローバルのリーダーシップチームおよび各国・地域のチームとの連携に必要となります。


スキル・能力（Skills & Capabilities）

· 戦略的思考力

市場全体を俯瞰し、複雑な市場環境の中から事業インパクトの大きい機会を見出し、戦略を実行可能な計画へ落とし込める能力。

· ビジネス・商業感覚

日本のデジタル市場におけるパートナーシップの収益構造、アフィリエイトモデル、収益ドライバー、ROIの考え方について深い理解を有すること。

· リレーション構築力

日本の経営層・シニアビジネスリーダーとの間に強固な信頼関係を構築できる卓越した能力。合意形成、長期的な関係構築、細部への配慮など、日本特有のビジネス文化を理解し、適切に対応できること。

· 組織・リーダーシップ能力

直接的な指示だけでなく、周囲への影響力を通じてチームをリードし、メンバーの能力を高め、マトリックス型の組織において成果に対する責任を促進できる能力。

· オペレーション・マネジメント能力

計画策定、フォーキャスト、パフォーマンス管理などを体系的かつ規律を持って推進できる能力。

· ステークホルダーマネジメント

社内外のシニア層・経営層に対して、自信を持ってコミュニケーションを行い、関係者を巻き込みながらプロジェクトを推進できる能力。

· コーチング能力

メンバーの成長を支援し、チーム全体のビジネス・商業能力を高めることに強い関心と意欲を持っていること。

Job Title

Sales & Account Manager Senior Representative

Position type: Permanent, Full time

Location: USA

Job ID: R35257

Job family: Sales

Summary of the role

As a Sales & Account Manager Senior Representative, you will contribute meaningfully to achieving successful outcomes within agreed timelines. You will define and deliver an ac-count development strategy that supports sustainable growth at regional and global levels.

This includes collaborating closely with Customer Success Managers (CSMs) and Pre-Sales (Solution Consulting) professionals. You will build relationships with senior stakeholders and work across teams to promote high customer satisfaction, effective solution adoption, and value creation. Experience in the travel industry is helpful for understanding customer needs and market context.

Main Responsibilities

Strategy, Planning, and Execution

  • Develop and implement strategies and plans that support key business goals and a re-liable sales pipeline in information technology (IT).
  • Set clear objectives across short-, mid-, and long-term horizons for customer engage-ment, commercial growth, solution adoption, and marketing.
  • Create and maintain an Account Development Plan (ADP) aligned with cross-func-tional partners and synchronized with the Customer Success Plan.
  • Share insights on customer needs, market trends, challenges, and competitive devel-opments with internal teams.
  • Support and guide global team members, including Account Managers and CSMs.

Sales Leadership

  • Provide input to Product Marketing Management (PMM) to help shape customer-fo-cused solutions.
  • Build relationships with senior customer stakeholders to assess new business opportunities.
  • Initiate collaborative pre-sales activities such as solution workshops and product demonstrations.
  • Work with internal teams to update contracts accurately and lead acquisition and re-newal processes.

Commercial Management

  • Coordinate customer requests with timely follow-up and clear communication.
  • Support effective use of Amadeus technology and promote achievement of performance and service goals.
  • Share product and solution updates with customers in partnership with the CSM team.
  • Partner with CSMs and pre-Sales to retain and grow the IT solution portfolio.
  • Facilitate business reviews, executive meetings, and joint marketing engagements to align priorities and encourage value creation.

Internal Collaboration

  • Foster effective collaboration with internal teams to support high-quality service de-livery.
  • Contribute to process improvements and organizational development efforts.
  • Organize regular account team meetings to track ADP progress and align next steps.
  • Manage sales processes and maintain accurate customer data in Salesforce.
  • Escalate customer issues, including billing matters, and contribute to product lifecycle discussions.

Relevant Experience

  • Significant experience in commercial leadership roles, or equivalent capabilities, across IT solution sales, marketing, account management, or project management.
  • Extensive experience in enterprise IT sales environments and complex B2B solution implementation.

This role is based in Bangkok, Thailand, and is open to candidates worldwide. We offer a generous relocation package to ensure a smooth transition to living and working in Bangkok.

Get to Know Our Team:

The Performance Marketing Team of Agoda is a world leader in online marketing. We are highly data-driven and focused on developing at-scale marketing programs that improve the lifetime value of our customers.

Our team is a blend of the bright analysts, marketing strategists, and data scientists in the world. We foster a great learning environment where you will be able to learn and grow by working closely with experts from a variety of backgrounds from all over the world.

With Performance Marketing, MSE is a business development and marketing role within Agoda’s marketing department. It involves working with online vertical search advertisers (Meta Search Engines) to drive hotel booking sales.

In this role, you'll get to:

  • Own and manage marketing spend with large Meta Search Engine (MSE) partners
  • Independently manage your accounts
  • Drive strategic steering across channels by aligning MSE activity with Agoda’s broader marketing, commercial, and customer acquisition objectives.
  • Manage the commercial relationship with MSE partners, including commercial terms, bidding and pricing strategies, and technical implementation
  • Decide in coordination with the Bidding and Pricing teams strategies that deliver expected ROIs and revenue growth
  • Track detailed performance/KPIs and deliver regular data-driven actionable insights to improve results
  • Succinctly communicate the results, ideas, and business statistics with different stakeholders
  • Ensure the advertiser implements the right Agoda APIs and related technological innovations
  • Be immersed and intimately familiar with the entire booking funnel including the user experience and conversion drivers between the advertiser and Agoda
  • Build long term relationships with advertisers that foster new opportunities and continuous growth in return from advertising dollars

What you’ll need to succeed:

  • Bachelor Degree in Computer Science/Statistics/Math or Engineering or Economics and Finance
  • Business development and/or account management track record with experience in online marketing
  • Fluent in English with strong communication skills (both written and verbal)
  • Self-motivated person with “Get it done!” attitude
  • Passionately analytical with strong ability to think logically and excellent problem-solving skills
  • Proficient in business intelligence tools and data warehouse i.e. SQL, Tableau and MS Excel
  • Ability to effectively communicate, influence and persuade with different levels of stakeholders (including Senior Management) with proven strong commercial acumen
  • Ability to represent Agoda with experience in interacting with external senior level executives
  • Strong analytical and statistical analysis skills to extract insights and recommendations

Company Description

Fairmont Hotels & Resorts

Join a dynamic team and be part of a network of 90 spectacular properties, and 34 more in the pipeline, in 30 countries around the globe. Our properties are located from the beaches of Hawaii, to the unspoiled national parks of Canada, to the heart of London, to the deserts of the United Arab Emirates.

Fairmont Chicago, Millennium Park

Rising gracefully above Millennium Park and Chicago's impressive lakefront, Fairmont Chicago, Millennium Park is a leader in Food & Beverage in the city, with the newly launched partnership with Richard Sandoval Hospitality for our multi-million dollar pan Latin restaurant and tequila bar, Toro. With beautifully appointed, extraordinarily spacious guestrooms and spectacular suites, including 84 newly renovated rooms and Fairmont Gold Lounge, Fairmont Chicago, Millennium Park offers a superior and distinctive array of amenities and services, including seasonal pop-ups and luxury event space.

Toro by Richard Sandoval

Across Latin America, food is more than a meal. It’s an event. It’s a celebration that’s shared, savored, and enjoyed with the finest spirits. Join us in this ritual. We welcome you to Toro, Richard Sandoval’s Restaurant and Tequila Bar, which features a casually unique upbeat dining experience. Toro will have a small plate menu along with a Suviche (Sushi & Ceviche combination) bar food offering at the restaurant’s lively and energetic Rum Bar setting. The beverage experience will include a variety of hand-muddled cocktails, a collection of Latin wines, and a variety of sugarcane spirits that will be expertly chosen by our Tequila Experts.

About The Application Process

At Fairmont, we want to bring out your highest potential. Shortly after applying, you will receive an email from our partner AssessFirst prompting you to create a profile and complete a questionnaire. This is a mandatory step for your candidacy to be considered as it enables us to explore your compatibility with this role and our culture of luxury excellence.

Job Description

The Commercial Administrative Coordinator provides administrative, analytical, and operational support to the Director of Sales, Director of Sales & Marketing, and Private Dining Sales Manager. This role supports the Sales & Marketing team through reporting, CRM management, prospecting support, data analysis, departmental administration, and private dining coordination.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, analytical, detail-oriented, and proficient in managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced hospitality environment.

Essential Responsibilities

Administrative Support

Provide administrative support to the Director of Sales and Director of Sales & Marketing.

Coordinate meetings, maintain calendars, and prepare presentations and reports.

Assist with departmental communications, document management, and special projects.

Maintain departmental files, records, and organizational systems.

Sales Intelligence & Prospecting

Manage and maintain CRM databases to ensure data accuracy and integrity.

Serve as the primary administrator for Knowland, Cvent, Topline, and other prospecting platforms.

Generate weekly and monthly prospecting lists for the Sales team.

Track and analyze citywide, self-contained, and non-self-contained business opportunities.

Manage relationships and workflows with third-party prospecting vendors.

Research target accounts and identify new business opportunities.

Reporting & Analytics

Prepare weekly, monthly, and quarterly sales reports and dashboards.

Analyze sales activity, prospecting efforts, and business trends.

Compile data for business reviews, budget planning, and leadership presentations.

Maintain departmental trackers and reporting tools.

Private Dining Support

Provide administrative support to the Private Dining Sales Manager.

Maintain inquiry and activity tracking reports.

Assist with database management, follow-up, and reporting.

Support promotional efforts and administrative needs related to Private Dining.

Marketing Administration

Process guest amenities and VIP requests.

Assist with maintaining sales and marketing collateral.

Support administrative tasks related to marketing initiatives, events, and promotions.

What Is In It For You

  • Employee benefit card offering discounted rates in Accor worldwide
  • Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance, 401K
  • Learning programs through our Academies
  • Opportunity to develop your talent and grow within your property and across the world!
  • Ability to make a difference through our Corporate Social Responsibility activities

Qualifications

Your experience and skills include:

  • Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent work experience. Minimum 2 years of administrative, sales support, marketing support, or hospitality experience.

Hotel Sales And Marketing Experience Preferred.

Experience with OSEM, Knowland, Cvent, Topline, or similar platforms preferred.

Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite.

Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.

Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail.

Additional Information

Compensation Range: $26.00 - $29.00 per hour

Visa Requirements: Successful candidates must be legally eligible to work in the United States.

Employee Benefits

Join our team and enjoy a range of exclusive colleague perks, including complimentary upgrades, extended stays, discounted stays across Fairmont & Raffles properties, special dining and wellness discounts, and added luxuries to enhance your experience. We believe in taking care of our team, ensuring that your hard work is rewarded with exceptional benefits. Add any other benefits relevant to your property.

Our Values

  • Respect: We value the needs, ideas and individuality of others. We treat everyone with fairness and dignity.
  • Excellence: We make genuine connections, and we cherish every opportunity to make the people around us feel special.
  • Belonging: We celebrate our differences. We support each other and we always stand together.
  • Empowerment: We have authority to take initiative and anticipate moments that create unforgettable experiences.
  • Integrity: We build trust through mutual respect and being authentic.

Diversity & Inclusion

Fairmont is committed to creating an inclusive environment where diverse talent thrives. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds to join our team.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Director of Business Travel Sales, you’re not just driving revenue growth through corporate and consortia travel partnerships – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:

  • Deliver strategic sales plans: Develop, implement, and monitor annual sales and marketing plans aligned to revenue goals, market shifts, and evolving customer needs
  • Drive business travel revenue: Identify, pursue, and convert new business travel opportunities across corporate and local segments through proactive outreach, sales calls, and tailored proposals
  • Develop and manage negotiated rate programs: Lead strategy and execution for Corporate and Local Negotiated Rates (CNR & LNR), leveraging data, market trends, and cross-functional collaboration to grow market share
  • Grow luxury consortia partnerships: Build and maintain strong relationships with top consortia (e.g., AMEX FHR, Virtuoso, Signature, Impresario) through personalized service, strategic marketing investments, and compelling digital content across extranet sites
  • Lead account management and client engagement: Provide high-touch service to key accounts and corporate travel planners via email, phone, and in-person meetings; regularly review production and adjust strategies to ensure retention and growth
  • Cultivate key local market relationships: Own and expand presence in the local market (5-block radius) by focusing on vertical markets such as legal and healthcare, networking with local businesses, and partnering with group sales to uncover new opportunities
  • Maximize visibility through targeted marketing: Direct the hotel’s positioning across consortia platforms and marketing programs to drive agent engagement and strengthen brand perception

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

Get To Know Our Team:

As an Operations Specialist you will be responsible for processing and coordinating operational requests and projects to support our B2B partners (Managed and/or Self Serve) during the different parts of their partner journey - from sign-up, on-boarding and payouts to optimizing our internal and external partner Knowledge Center.

You will be responsible for driving innovation and quality improvement projects and are expected to be an expert in one or more of the operations area:

  • Managed partners- contracting, payments, system administration
  • Self Serve - partner analysis & experience, products, system administration

You are expected to lead by example by showing a positive can-do attitude and role modeling the principle of taking ownership.

Excellent communication and organizational skills are required in this role.

Location: This role requires you to be based in Bangkok, Thailand (with relocation support provide)

In this Role, you'll get to:

  • Support: Handling of operations ticket inbound from our Commercial team and Partners and other internal stakeholders" (can include Tech/Product, Finance and CEG teams, etc)
  • Projects: Innovate the existing processes by initiating and driving medium sized* projects to improve efficiency, quality and/or Partner experience
  • Coordinate with the Legal, Privacy and Fraud, Finance and/or Accounts Payables departments to ensure smooth contractual or financial facilitation
  • Apply critical thinking and independently drive improvements across the team
  • Share knowledge and best practices across teams, both centrally and in the regions
  • Creating and documenting the processes to be followed by the commercial teams and operational teams
  • Handling of ticket inbound from Partners (Self Serve)
  • Maintaining high service levels according to set SLAs
  • Provide peer training and support to newly onboarded members of the team

Handles tickets and projects in one or more areas of expertise:

Managed Partners:

Contracting:

  • Draft contracts using guidance & legal playbook for Central teams (ranging from regular to complex requested changes) and approve or reject proposed changes from partners
  • Leading medium sized* projects (eg. on process innovation, legal templates and / or optimizing our tools)
  • Train and support account managers in the processing and coordination of all Contracting requests

Payments:

  • Coordinate creation of credit slips and payment batches for all Partners
  • Investigate payment issues and/or commission errors and come up with innovative, scalable solutions
  • Dispute management
  • Perform pre-emptive account maintenance to prevent failed payments
  • Using SQL queries combining tables, perform commission errors or data discrepancy investigations
  • Train and support account managers and partners on all Financial and Payment requests

Self Serve:

Partner experience:

  • Drive partner profile analysis in efforts to increase positive partner experience through self serve platform (Knowledge base)
  • Analysis of Partner-facing campaigns and surveys
  • Work collaboratively with Business Performance team to align priorities

job.job_description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Position Statement:

The Senior Analyst for Revenue Accounting will assume responsibility for coordinating and delivering the day-to-day processes that will ensure smooth running of the Revenue Accounting function within Hilton’s UK Centre of Excellence. Working with the Manager Revenue Accounting supporting the delivery of the function strategy and goals surrounding the processes involved in the delivery of accurate and timely reporting for the portfolio of hotels.

Position Summary:

Under the guidance of the Manager Revenue Accounting, the post holder will be responsible for the delivery of Revenue Accounting processes to agreed timetables and Service Level Agreements. The Senior Analyst will ensure Hilton’s Centre of Excellence offers a seamless, efficient and customer focused experience, maximizing output without compromising the quality of service. The ability to maximise process efficiency and effectiveness is considered essential.

The post holder will use their analytical skills to work through high volumes of data, identifying items for review and correction whilst working to tight daily deadlines: this will require a meticulous attention to detail, the ability to understand and interpret a high volume of data and make recommendations where appropriate. In addition, all tasks should be approached with a continuous improvement philosophy. The post holder is expected to identify improvements and support process changes as we seek opportunities to drive efficiencies and global standardization.

Key to the success of the role will be the ability to communicate and influence at various levels, both internally and with external stakeholders. Experience in participating in projects, the ability to simultaneously manage multiple tasks and support the team to deliver to tight deadlines are considered essential elements of this role.

Essential Functions:

  • Following direction and guidance from management, carry out and co-ordinate all required tasks demonstrating a strong understanding of the end-to-end process.
  • Assist the management team in driving the successful implementation of project initiatives.
  • Support the management team in evaluating the effectiveness of current processes and implementing actions to streamline the processes and maximise efficiency.
  • Document and maintain standard operating procedures, ensuring end to end process is clearly documented.
  • Monitor and manage own progress towards delivery of tasks and resolve open items; taking corrective action to ensure team goals and own objectives achieved.
  • Participate in the provision of guidance and support to the business of best practice.
  • Proactive management of excel templates ensuring strong controls in place to validate completeness & accuracy of formula to maintain integrity of large volumes of data.
  • Complete financial tasks such as daily revenue review, posting adjustments in OA, journals to Peoplesoft and Balance Sheet Reconciliations, taking ownership for resolving any reconciling items.
  • Review high volumes of data with advanced excel models using judgement to gain confidence that the results are reasonable and accurate flagging differences.
  • Highlight queries to Hotels taking ownership for resolution, or escalation where required
  • Collaboration & relationship building with Hotel teams, including Front Office teams to discuss any posting / process issues whilst demonstrating ownership & knowledge of the subject
  • Strong knowledge of company policies and associated controls ensuring tasks are completed in line with policy and any concerns are raised to Management
  • Preparation & issuance of timely reports to Hotels, demonstrating ownership & understanding of data delivered, following the process through to completion.
  • Perform other duties as assigned for the continued success of department and to meet changing business needs.

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience and Skills:

  • Ability to work with limited supervision, using own initiative with ‘can-do’ approach, thriving under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong coaching skills to support relationships with co-workers with proven ability to provide feedback in a structured and professional manner.
  • Able to handle multiple demands and appropriately prioritise responsibilities.
  • Solid understanding of accounting principles and GAAP
  • Good technical skills and experience of general ledger accounting and reconciliations
  • Advanced excel skills with the ability to support & develop excel models, e.g., with formula, Macros
  • Ability to use multiple systems and understand how they link together, to provide training to other team members and recommendations to management.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment, critical thinking, quantitative & qualitative analytical and decision-making skills to consider the relative costs and benefits of potential actions and provide recommendations for optimal solutions.
  • Strong inter-personal skills and able to maintain effective working relationships with co-workers, managers and clients with well-developed written and verbal communication and comprehension skills.
  • Working knowledge of Power BI tools would be advantageous.

Preferred:

  • Previous experience of working within a Shared Service Centre / Centre of Excellence environment
  • Hospitality industry experience
  • Language skills

Qualifications

Required:

  • Education: High School/GED
  • Proven track record in an accounting/finance or equivalent working environment

Preferred:

  • Education: BA/BS/Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent relevant experience in lieu thereof
  • Commencing studies for a professional accounting qualification/certificate i.e. ACCA or CIMA
  • Supervisory experience

ABOUT US

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

ABOUT THE TEAM

How We’ll Help You Thrive

At Hilton, The Hospitality We’re Known For Doesn’t End With Our Guests. We Proudly Invest In Our Team Members’ Wellbeing, Supporting You Through All Of Life’s Moments. When You Join Hilton, Our Exceptional Care Extends To You With Unmatched Perks And Benefits, Including*:

  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40 USD/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
  • Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
  • Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
  • Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
  • Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
  • Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Through our Care for All hub, we provide resources to help our Team Members to care for themselves, care for members of their team, and care for their loved ones. Eligible Team Members receive free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

This role is based in Bangkok, Thailand, and is open to candidates worldwide. We offer a generous relocation package to ensure a smooth transition to living and working in Bangkok.

Get to Know Our Team:

The Performance Marketing Team of Agoda is a world leader in online marketing. We are highly data-driven and focused on developing at-scale marketing programs that improve the lifetime value of our customers.

Our team is a blend of the bright analysts, marketing strategists, and data scientists in the world. We foster a great learning environment where you will be able to learn and grow by working closely with experts from a variety of backgrounds from all over the world.

With Performance Marketing, MSE is a business development and marketing role within Agoda’s marketing department. It involves working with online vertical search advertisers (Meta Search Engines) to drive hotel booking sales.

In this role, you'll get to:

  • Own and manage marketing spend with large Meta Search Engine (MSE) partners
  • Independently manage your accounts
  • Drive strategic steering across channels by aligning MSE activity with Agoda’s broader marketing, commercial, and customer acquisition objectives.
  • Manage the commercial relationship with MSE partners, including commercial terms, bidding and pricing strategies, and technical implementation
  • Decide in coordination with the Bidding and Pricing teams strategies that deliver expected ROIs and revenue growth
  • Track detailed performance/KPIs and deliver regular data-driven actionable insights to improve results
  • Succinctly communicate the results, ideas, and business statistics with different stakeholders
  • Ensure the advertiser implements the right Agoda APIs and related technological innovations
  • Be immersed and intimately familiar with the entire booking funnel including the user experience and conversion drivers between the advertiser and Agoda
  • Build long term relationships with advertisers that foster new opportunities and continuous growth in return from advertising dollars

What you’ll need to succeed:

  • Bachelor Degree in Computer Science/Statistics/Math or Engineering or Economics and Finance
  • Business development and/or account management track record with experience in online marketing
  • Fluent in English with strong communication skills (both written and verbal)
  • Self-motivated person with “Get it done!” attitude
  • Passionately analytical with strong ability to think logically and excellent problem-solving skills
  • Proficient in business intelligence tools and data warehouse i.e. SQL, Tableau and MS Excel
  • Ability to effectively communicate, influence and persuade with different levels of stakeholders (including Senior Management) with proven strong commercial acumen
  • Ability to represent Agoda with experience in interacting with external senior level executives
  • Strong analytical and statistical analysis skills to extract insights and recommendations

job.job_description:
Organization- Hyatt Corporate Office

Summary

The Opportunity

Hyatt Hotels Corporation seeks an enthusiastic Employee Relations Manager to join our Corporate Human Resources team. This role plays a critical role in fostering a positive, respectful, and high-performing workplace by providing guidance and support on complex employee relations matters. In this role, you will partner with Corporate HR Business Partners, leaders, managers, Legal, and other stakeholders to address workplace concerns, conduct effective investigations, and promote consistent application of policies and practices. The position will also coach managers through performance management and improvement processes, identify employee relations trends, and contribute to special projects and initiatives that support Corporate Human Resources priorities. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list since 2013. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

  • Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on-site fitness center
  • A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption
  • Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

The Role

Employee Relations Manager key responsibilities:

  • Manage employee relations matters from intake through resolution, ensuring timely follow-up, thorough documentation, and appropriate closure.
  • Conduct workplace investigations and address performance concerns, workplace conduct, conflict, attendance, policy interpretation, organizational change, and other employee relations issues.
  • Advise and coach managers on performance management, including feedback, documentation, corrective action, and performance improvement plans.
  • Guide managers through employee separations and other employment actions, including documentation, process, communications, and risk considerations.
  • Develop and deliver practical guidance, resources, and training on employee relations, workplace conduct, and performance management.
  • Identify workplace trends and use employee relations data and exit interview insights to recommend ways to strengthen engagement and reduce risk.
  • Lead or contribute to special projects that support employee relations and organizational priorities.

Qualifications

Experience Required

  • Demonstrated experience conducting workplace investigations and managing complex employee relations matters.

  • Experience advising leaders and managers on workplace conduct, policy interpretation, conflict resolution, and employment practices.

  • Microsoft Office required.
  • Experience with HR information systems and employee relations case management systems preferred.

  • Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Human Resources, Business, Organizational Psychology, or a related field.
  • Professional certification in Human Resources, such as PHR, SPHR, SHRM-CP, or SHRM-SCP, is a plus

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

This role is based in Bangkok, Thailand, and is open to candidates worldwide. We offer a generous relocation package to ensure a smooth transition to living and working in Bangkok.

Get to Know Our Team:

The Performance Marketing Team of Agoda is a world leader in online marketing. We are highly data-driven and focused on developing at-scale marketing programs that improve the lifetime value of our customers.

Our team is a blend of the bright analysts, marketing strategists, and data scientists in the world. We foster a great learning environment where you will be able to learn and grow by working closely with experts from a variety of backgrounds from all over the world.

With Performance Marketing, MSE is a business development and marketing role within Agoda’s marketing department. It involves working with online vertical search advertisers (Meta Search Engines) to drive hotel booking sales.

In this role, you'll get to:

  • Own and manage marketing spend with large Meta Search Engine (MSE) partners
  • Independently manage your accounts
  • Drive strategic steering across channels by aligning MSE activity with Agoda’s broader marketing, commercial, and customer acquisition objectives.
  • Manage the commercial relationship with MSE partners, including commercial terms, bidding and pricing strategies, and technical implementation
  • Decide in coordination with the Bidding and Pricing teams strategies that deliver expected ROIs and revenue growth
  • Track detailed performance/KPIs and deliver regular data-driven actionable insights to improve results
  • Succinctly communicate the results, ideas, and business statistics with different stakeholders
  • Ensure the advertiser implements the right Agoda APIs and related technological innovations
  • Be immersed and intimately familiar with the entire booking funnel including the user experience and conversion drivers between the advertiser and Agoda
  • Build long term relationships with advertisers that foster new opportunities and continuous growth in return from advertising dollars

What you’ll need to succeed:

  • Bachelor Degree in Computer Science/Statistics/Math or Engineering or Economics and Finance
  • Business development and/or account management track record with experience in online marketing
  • Fluent in English with strong communication skills (both written and verbal)
  • Self-motivated person with “Get it done!” attitude
  • Passionately analytical with strong ability to think logically and excellent problem-solving skills
  • Proficient in business intelligence tools and data warehouse i.e. SQL, Tableau and MS Excel
  • Ability to effectively communicate, influence and persuade with different levels of stakeholders (including Senior Management) with proven strong commercial acumen
  • Ability to represent Agoda with experience in interacting with external senior level executives
  • Strong analytical and statistical analysis skills to extract insights and recommendations
