job.job_description:
Job Title

Regional Sales Manager - Destinations

Drive growth at the intersection of travel, data and media

We are looking for an experienced commercial leader to drive the growth of our Destinations business.

Our Destinations business helps tourism boards, destination marketing organizations, cities and regions better understand travelers through travel intelligence and data analytics while expanding their reach through innovative media solutions. We partner with destinations around the world to transform data into actionable insights and marketing strategies that support tourism growth and economic development.

As Regional Sales Manager, Destinations you will be responsible for leading the commercial strategy across the region, managing a team of sales professionals, growing strategic client relationships and identifying new business opportunities. This role combines regional leadership, business development, customer engagement and people management in a fast-paced international environment.

What you'll do

  • Define and execute the commercial strategy for the Destinations business.
  • Lead, coach and develop a team of other sales professionals, fostering collaboration, engagement and performance.
  • Manage and grow a portfolio of destination and tourism clients while ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and long-term partnership success.
  • Develop and close new business opportunities to expand our footprint across the region.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with tourism boards, destination marketing organizations, government entities, media agencies and other industry stakeholders.
  • Translate travel data, market insights and media capabilities into compelling customer propositions and business outcomes.
  • Analyze market trends, customer needs and commercial performance metrics to identify growth opportunities and optimize results.
  • Collaborate closely with Customer Success, Product, Marketing and Solution Consulting teams to deliver value for customers and support business growth.
  • Represent the business externally and build a strong professional network within the travel, tourism, destination marketing and media ecosystem.

About The Team

Our Destinations business supports destination organizations globally, helping them understand traveler behavior, assess market opportunities and engage audiences through data-driven media solutions. We work with national tourism boards, regional tourism authorities, cities and destination marketing organizations around the world.

About You

You are a commercially minded leader who combines strong relationship-building capabilities with a passion for the travel and tourism industry.

You Bring

  • Significant experience in sales, business development, account management or commercial leadership roles.
  • Experience leading and developing high-performing sales or commercial teams.
  • A strong background in media, advertising, digital marketing, travel intelligence, data analytics or related sectors.
  • Hands-on experience within Eastern Europe and a well-established professional network across the region.
  • Experience working with destination marketing organizations, tourism boards, government tourism bodies, travel companies, airlines, media agencies or comparable organizations.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to transform data and insights into impactful commercial opportunities.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management and negotiation skills.
  • The ability to engage senior decision-makers and build trusted, long-term partnerships.
  • A strategic mindset combined with a proactive, hands-on approach to achieving business objectives.
  • Fluency in English. Russian language skills would be a strong advantage.

What We Can Offer You

  • 💰 A complete rewards offer - Amadeus provides attractive remuneration packages, covering all essential components of a competitive reward offer.
  • 🌎 A truly global DNA - Everything at Amadeus is global, from our people to our business, which translates into our footprint, processes, and culture.
  • 🎓 Great opportunities to learn - Learning happens all the time and in many ways at Amadeus, through on-the-job training, formal learning activities, and day-to-day interactions with colleagues.
  • 🤗 A caring environment - Amadeus fosters a caring environment, nurturing both a fulfilling career and personal and family life. We care about our employees and strive to provide a supportive work environment.
  • 🌟 A hybrid working model - We want our employees to do their best work, however the hybrid model works best for them.
  • 🌈 A diverse and inclusive community - We are committed to leveraging our uniquely diverse population to drive innovation, creativity, and collaboration across our organization.
  • 📈 A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental values that drive our actions and shape long-lasting relationships with our customers, partners, and employees.
  • 🎯 A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you will be powering the future of travel and pursuing a critical mission and extraordinary purpose.

Diversity & Inclusion

Amadeus aspires to be a leader in Diversity and Inclusion in the tech industry, enabling every employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment, attracting the best talent from all backgrounds, and as a role model for an inclusive employee experience. 

Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer and committed to an accessible recruitment process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law.

Be aware of recruitment scams

Amadeus Group never charges fees, requests payment, or asks for financial information during recruitment. All legitimate opportunities are communicated solely through official Amadeus channels, including our careers website. Any payment request or outreach via unofficial platforms (e.g., WhatsApp, Telegram) should be treated as fraudulent.

Description de l'entreprise

La Seine à vos pieds, dans un quartier où il fait bon vivre avec de nombreux bars, restaurants et lieux branchés ! Bienvenue au Novotel et à l’Ibis Paris La Défense Esplanade : 566 chambres, 13 salles de réunion, 2 restaurants et 2 bars.

Nos 2 hôtels sont situés dans l'un des quartiers d'affaires les plus dynamiques d'Europe, aux portes de Paris et des Champs Elysées. La clientèle est majoritairement affaires en semaine et loisir le week-end. La ligne de métro 1 aux pieds des 2 hôtels ainsi que le RER A à une station de métro.

Notre promesse : vous faire vivre une expérience collaborateurs tournée vers la qualité de vie au travail : organisation d’ateliers, de sorties et d’actions tout au long de l’année.

Description du poste

Vous êtes un(e) pro de la relation client et vous avez une passion pour l’organisation d’événements ? Rejoignez notre équipe et devenez Chargé(e) de Clientèle dans un environnement dynamique et stimulant !

Vos Missions

Organiser les événements et coordonner l’accueil des clients, de l’arrivée au départ, pour leur faire vivre une expérience unique.

️ Être le/la maître·sse des imprévus, prêt·e à gérer toute demande inattendue avec calme et efficacité.

Garantir une satisfaction client sans faille tout au long de leur séjour en étant l’incarnation vivante de l’esprit Heartist.

Collaborer avec les autres départements pour garantir une expérience fluide et mémorable pour nos clients.

Faire briller nos hôtels en promouvant ses services avec enthousiasme !

Assurer un suivi post-événement pour vérifier la satisfaction après leur passage & les fidéliser.

Traiter les demandes entrantes en vous assurant de bien comprendre les besoins des clients, tout en respectant nos process.

Établir des devis et suivre le processus jusqu'à la signature du contrat, toujours dans les règles de l’art.

Sécuriser notre CA en vérifiant la solvabilité des clients, en contrôlant les acomptes et en suivant la facturation.

Gérer votre portefeuille clients avec les outils internes (Opéra Cloud, Back You, Fols) : suivi des options et relance des dossiers.

Connaître votre marché local pour proposer l'offre parfaite dès le premier contact.

Participer aux actions commerciales (promotions, relances, mise en avant des services pour les clients affaires).

Si vous êtes à la fois rigoureux(se), organisé(e) et aimez relever des défis tout en créant des expériences inoubliables pour nos clients, ce poste est fait pour vous ! ✨

Rejoignez-nous et faites de chaque séjour une expérience exceptionnelle !

Qualités Personnelles

  • Organisation, autonomie, rigueur
  • Esprit d’analyse et sens du détail

Langues

  • Français courant
  • Anglais professionnel indispensable (écrit et oral)
  • Autre langue étrangère (espagnol, allemand) appréciée

Formation Et Expérience

  • Bac + 2 à Bac + 4 : Ecole de commerce, Tourisme, Hôtellerie
  • Expérience dans un poste similaire

Informations supplémentaires

  • Opportunités d’évolution au sein du groupe hôtelier

Who are we looking for?

Choice Hotels, one of the world’s largest lodging franchisors, has an exciting new opportunity as our Product Designer on the Digital Commerce team. Digital Commerce builds and improves the digital experiences our guests use to book and manage their stays, as well as the internal tools our Customer Care team relies on to support them. As a key member of this team, you will design intuitive, accessible experiences that make booking easier for guests and make it easier for our Customer Care agents to help them.

Are you a curious, collaborative designer who enjoys turning complex problems into simple, usable experiences for both guests and the people who support them? We invite you to apply today for our Product Designer IC2 role and #MakeItYourChoice.

Your Responsibilities

  • Design user journeys, task flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs for guest-facing web and mobile products, as well as internal tools used by our Customer Care team.
  • Partner with Customer Care to understand agent needs, call workflows, and service recovery moments, and translate those insights into clearer, more efficient internal tools.
  • Support the integration of AI-powered chat features, guided response tools, and knowledge-support experiences that help agents work faster and more consistently.
  • Apply human-centered design methods to simplify complex workflows, balancing guest needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.
  • Plan and support user research, including stakeholder interviews, usability testing, and journey mapping, and turn findings into clear design recommendations.
  • Design, prototype, and hand off work in Figma using Choice’s established design systems, component libraries, and accessibility standards.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineers, Researchers, Analysts, and other designers throughout discovery, delivery, and optimization.
  • Communicate design rationale, research insights, and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical partners.
  • Contribute to UX audits, heuristic evaluations, and accessibility reviews, and support experimentation and A/B testing tied to measurable outcomes.

Your Experience, Skills & Competencies

  • Bachelor's degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Psychology, Human Factors, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 2-5 years of experience in UX or product design, creating web, mobile, SaaS, or employee-facing digital products.
  • Experience designing internal tools, dashboards, or customer support/service workflows is strongly preferred.
  • Proficient in Figma, FigJam, and modern prototyping and design-handoff workflows.
  • Working knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG), responsive design, and inclusive design practices.
  • Comfortable using AI-assisted tools such as Copilot, ChatGPT, or Claude to support design work, paired with strong human judgment.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain design decisions and research findings to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrates key competencies including customer focus, collaboration, and problem solving.

Your Team

This is an individual contributor role that will report to Todd Bromley. You will have 6 peer teammates and collaborate with cross-functional departments on a regular basis.

**This role is not eligible for sponsorship**

Choice prioritizes our associate wellbeing by offering a comprehensive benefits program that is both competitive and flexible to help you achieve your wellbeing goals - here are just a few:

We are united in supporting the entrepreneurial dreams of our thousands of franchise owners, which propels us forward — giving our work at Choice a purpose larger than our business.

Role Description:

As the Labor Relations Lead (Spain), you will provide strategic leadership for labor relations initiatives across

Spain offices, managing relationships with works councils and unions in countries with varying dialogue intensity, ranging from structured negotiations in France, Spain, and Italy, to lighter consultations in Poland, Norway, Sweden and South Africa. You will engage social bodies early in the design of business changes to ensure continuous compliance, mitigate risk, and prevent procedural bottlenecks. By managing recurring Business-As-Usual (BAU) processes and fostering a constructive social climate, you will successfully implement company decisions, manage various activities related to the establishment of an European Works Council (EWC), and ensure consistency across EMEA and NL Work Councils activities.

Key Job Responsibilities and Duties:

Strategic Strategy & Governance

  • Spain Social Strategy: Develop and execute a regional labor relations strategy that aligns legal requirements with company strategy and cultural contexts to foster a consistent and constructive social climate.
  • Regional Streamlining: Standardize labor relations communications and strategies across EMEA and the European Works Council (EWC) to reduce legal complexity and ensure cross-country consistency.
  • BAU Management: Oversee recurring business-as-usual (BAU) processes, including mandatory annual consultations and regular working groups for regional councils and unions.


Change Management & Consultation

  • Early Engagement Design: Partner with leadership during the initial design phase of company initiatives to incorporate social requirements upfront, preventing late-stage rework of business decisions.
  • Change Navigation: Lead social bodies through required consultation processes for company initiatives, ensuring timely communication and implementation of business decisions.
  • Negotiation Leadership: Provide direct oversight of Works Council negotiations and mandatory consultations, securing buy-in while maintaining management's operational goals.


Compliance & Risk Mitigation

  • Legal Adherence: Ensure strict adherence to labor laws, social dialogue mandates, and collective agreements, serving as the primary advisor to stakeholders on compliance risks.
  • Escalation Prevention: Proactively manage relationships with local representatives to resolve minor issues early, preventing them from escalating into strategic roadblocks.


Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate with Employment Legal, Statutory Directors, and Business HR to navigate complex, country-specific labor laws and close negotiations efficiently.
  • Trust Building: Act as the central liaison between EMEA leadership and social partners, fostering a culture of transparency and constructive dialogue at all organizational levels.


Qualifications & Skills:

  • Core Legal/HR Skills: Expert knowledge of collective labor law and works agreements, and a proven track record managing complex social dialogue projects.
  • Language Requirements: Fluency in both English and Spanish
  • Preferred Experience: Background in HR or an in-house legal department, specific experience with works council negotiations and company agreements, cross-functional project management, investigation and conflict resolution, and exposure to an international business environment.
  • Soft Skills: Proactive, strategic, and highly skilled at building trust across all organizational levels while navigating complex social and legal requirements. Structured approach to organize work effectively. High proficiency in stakeholder management.


Work Arrangement: Regular presence in the Spanish offices is required to maintain effective relationships with social partners and stakeholders. Frequent travels in EMEA countries (max 20% of time).

Benefits & Perks - Global Impact, Personal Relevance:

Booking.com’s Total Rewards Philosophy is not only about compensation but also about benefits. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, as well unique-to-Booking.com benefits which include:

  • Annual paid time off and generous paid leave scheme including: parent, grandparent, bereavement, and care leave
  • Hybrid working including flexible working arrangements, and up to 20 days per year working from abroad (home country)
  • Industry leading product discounts - up to 1400 per year - for yourself, including automatic Genius Level 3 status and Booking.com wallet credit


Inclusion at Booking.com:

Inclusion has been a core part of our company culture since day one. This ongoing journey starts with our very own employees, who represent over 140 nationalities and a wide range of ethnic and social backgrounds, genders and sexual orientations.

Take it from our Chief People Officer, Paulo Pisano: “At Booking.com, the diversity of our people doesn’t just build an outstanding workplace, it also creates a better and more inclusive travel experience for everyone. Inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. It’s a place where you can make your mark and have a real impact in travel and tech.”

We ensure that colleagues with disabilities are provided the adjustments and tools they need to participate in the job application and interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Application Process:

  • Let’s go places together: How we Hire
  • This role does not come with relocation assistance.


Booking.com is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We strive to move well beyond traditional equal opportunity and work to create an environment that allows everyone to thrive.

Pre-Employment Screening

If your application is successful, your personal data may be used for a pre-employment screening check by a third party as permitted by applicable law. Depending on the vacancy and applicable law, a pre-employment screening may include employment history, education and other information (such as media information) that may be necessary for determining your qualifications and suitability for the position.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Disability/Veterans

The Standard, Mexico City arrives in the historic Tabacalera neighborhood with character, color and a signature wink. The hotel will feature 206 rooms and suites, 27 branded residences and a leafy “secret” garden sure to become the city’s favorite hideaway. Our debut in Latin America raises the aesthetic stakes, drawing from sun-washed CDMX architecture and a sensual, organic palette.

A bright café and late-night diner keep the ground floor lively from early mornings to the final nightcap. Above it all, a rooftop pool, signature restaurant and outdoor bar take in striking views of the Monumento a la Revolución. We're looking for a Sales & Events Coordinator who believes the magic is in the details. Someone who thrives behind the scenes, keeps every moving piece in sync, and makes every event feel effortless—even when a hundred things are happening at once.

The Vibe

The best events don't just happen.

They're carefully coordinated by someone who knows how to keep ideas moving, conversations flowing, and every detail exactly where it needs to be.

Because great hospitality isn't just what guests see—it's everything that happens before they arrive.

Come help create experiences that feel effortless—even when they aren't.

job.job_description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours. Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

The Infrastructure Platform team builds, automates, and enhances the cloud and container-based platform and datastores that underpin every product team at GetYourGuide. We are "engineers for the engineers" — designing the abstractions, paved paths, and self-service tooling that let other teams ship safely and quickly without becoming experts in the underlying systems. Our stack is built on AWS, Kubernetes, and Istio. Our aim is to provide a reliable, opinionated platform that lets teams move fast, take risks, and experiment with confidence.

Your mission

  • Be responsible for all hiring and performance management topics on the Engineering side, helping your engineers reach their full potential
  • Partner closely with your peers and stakeholders to shape the roadmap and portfolio allocation, and drive high-impact delivery
  • Build and maintain opinionated paved paths and abstraction layers for mission teams
  • Champion platform engineering principles and operational excellence across the wider engineering organization

Your toolkit

  • You have a strong sense of ownership, ensuring that technical and project plans are aligned with your stakeholders & team members for delivery
  • Enjoy approaching complex topics with an open mind and eye for simplicity.
  • Have a passion for people, supporting and coaching your engineers without going into micromanagement mode.
  • Strong technical experience in a cloud native platform engineering environment

Extras that give you an edge

  • Experience working in a scale-up or high-growth environment, taking projects from zero to one and scaling them across an organization.
  • Experience building platforms for 500+ engineer organizations
  • Experience operating as a technical product manager/owner, particularly for internal platform products serving engineering customers

How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary

  • Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
  • Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
  • A hybrid working approach with three days of in-office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at-home focus time

  • Monthly transportation and fitness budget

And more…

We are an equal opportunities employer

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

  • Opening June 2027 ***

About The Property

Motto by Hilton Indianapolis is a highly anticipated lifestyle hotel scheduled to open in 2027. Located in the historic King Cole Building in the heart of downtown Indianapolis, the 116-room boutique property blends modern, efficient design with the character of one of the city’s most notable architectural landmarks.

Designed to deliver a vibrant, locally connected guest experience, the hotel will feature thoughtfully designed guestrooms, activated social spaces, and a dynamic food and beverage program, including a rooftop bar and restaurant, a street-level café, and a lively ground-floor bar serving both guests and the local community.

Ideally situated near the Indiana Convention Center, Lucas Oil Stadium, and the city’s premier dining, entertainment, and cultural attractions, the hotel is well positioned to become a destination for both travelers and locals while contributing to the continued growth of downtown Indianapolis’ hospitality market.

About The Role

The General Manager – Motto by Hilton Indianapolis will lead all pre-opening activities to deliver an exceptional culture, guest experience, and operational foundation aligned with the Motto brand. Responsibilities include managing the pre-opening budget, overseeing cost controls, procuring operating supplies and equipment (OS&E), recruiting and developing the team, building community relationships, and ensuring a successful, on-time, and on-budget opening.

The General Manager will also foster strong partnerships with ownership, team members, customers, and stakeholders while providing strategic leadership, driving operational excellence, delivering outstanding guest service, and achieving long-term financial success.

What are we looking for?

Basic Qualifications

  • Minimum two years' Hotel Manager or five years Executive Member experience at a similar-sized or larger hotel.
  • Demonstrated ability to oversee operations with an annual revenue of $15M or more.
  • Proven success leading complex F&B operations with a focus on revenue, profitability, service excellence, and talent development.
  • Strong commercial acumen with a solid background in financial management and revenue optimization.
  • Exceptional people leadership, with the ability to build, inspire, and develop high-performing teams while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and empowerment.
  • Strategic and relationship-driven leadership, skilled at cultivating strong community and ownership partnerships and driving long-term commercial success aligned with both brand and ownership goals.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing lifestyle brand properties.
  • Proven track record as an Opening Executive, leading successful pre-opening and launch efforts.
  • Hilton experience.
  • Local market experience.

Responsibilities

Essential attributes for the General Manager, Motto by Hilton Indianapolis also include –

Ownership, Customer, And Stakeholder Relations

  • Expertly manage capital expenses and property requirements by overseeing pre-opening budget and expenditure while ensuring that all property needs are efficiently met and aligned with organizational goals.
  • Proactively engage with the regional team, senior leadership, ownership/asset manager by providing updates, successes, and address challenges with innovative solutions.
  • Cultivate the hotel's service culture by aligning it with Motto brand values, core pillars and principles while building owner and community relations.
  • Balance owner expectations with Hilton standards, effectively aligning both relationships and interests to achieve mutually beneficial outcomes.
  • Be well-versed in compliance, legal, and crisis management matters, while cultivating strong relationships with Hilton's legal and risk management teams.

Strategy

  • Leverage strong commercial acumen to strategically position the hotel and meet financial performance goals, while actively engaging with clients and partners to cultivate and maintain impactful relationships.
  • Develop and implement long-term strategic goals that align with the owner's vision and the needs of the Motto brand. Create a detailed roadmap to achieve key milestones and measurable results from the opening through the first year of operation, leading to stabilization as outlined by the proforma.
  • Elevate Motto’s brand values through dynamic marketing, skillfully managing both tangible and intangible elements to leave a lasting impact.
  • Coordinate property placement within the community to enhance experiences for transient guests, groups, business travelers, and locals, while actively engaging with local organizations and participating in community service initiatives to build strong local relationships.

Leadership

  • Create momentum in workforce planning, with a keen understanding of the talent market, and adept at motivating teams through effective rallies and engagement initiatives.
  • Leverage industry expertise for strategic short- and long-term planning to drive commercial success, optimize financial performance, and ensure optimal market positioning while meeting financial performance expectations.
  • Identify, recruit, and develop top-tier leadership talent while building and leading a cohesive team by setting clear expectations and establishing the tone in collaboration with the Executive Team and department heads.
  • Demonstrate transparent leadership, adaptability, and flexibility in navigating sensitive situations.
  • Constantly strive to improve and adapt, ensuring the hotel evolves year after year, keeping ahead of industry trends and maintaining our leadership in the hospitality sector.

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

About The Team

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
  • Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
  • Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
  • Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
  • Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
  • Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Generous paid time off (PTO) – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters most
  • Health & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family covered
  • Financial security for your future – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what’s next
  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

Job Description

The successful candidate will join the Cabin Crew Business Technology Department in SIA Cabin Crew Division. He/she will own the Cabin Crew products to improve cabin crew operations, aligned to the Cabin Crew digital roadmap and business priorities.

Key Responsibilities

Product vision and roadmap

  • Define and maintain the product vision, strategy and multi release roadmap for Cabin Crew Operations Products aligned to the Cabin Crew digital roadmap and business priorities.

Requirements gathering and backlog management

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to elicit, analyse and document business requirements.
  • Map current workflows, identify pain points, control gaps and automation opportunities to simplify, digitise and improve operational efficiency and compliance.

Testing & Validation

  • Define test strategy, User Acceptance Testing (UAT) plans and entry/exit criteria; manage defect triage to closure and ensure regression coverage.
  • Validate that delivered functionality meets documented requirements, quality and compliance standards.

Data, analytics and reporting

  • Build and enhance comprehensive Tableau dashboards to track cabin crew business Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) and operational metrics.
  • Design intuitive data visualisations that provide actionable insights.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Computer Science, or related field preferred
  • Strong cabin crew domain knowledge and understanding of SIA service procedures
  • Experience in prompt engineering and developing GenAI solutions
  • Strong communication skills and ability to explain complex technologies to non-technical stakeholders
  • Meticulous, Analytical, systematic, and logical in problem definition and solving
  • Self-starter, result oriented, and able to multi-task

• Great opportunity within our Digital team responsible for the Qantas Business Rewards platform (B2B)
  • Opportunity to deliver customer facing digital products for the Qantas Business Rewards Loyalty Program
  • Full-time permanent position based at our new Product and Innovation Centre in Adelaide


Join Qantas in our brand-new Product and Innovation Centre located in Adelaide to help meet evolving consumer needs by enabling agile teams to deliver faster, more adaptive solutions that prioritise customer value, continuous feedback, and innovation at every stage of the product lifecycle.


As the GDS Product Specialist, you will maintain the integrity of Digital Platforms and Products within the Qantas Business Rewards online booking tool and Business Account. You will work with an array of stakeholders, departments and external vendors to provide subject matter expertise on product capability, the wider squads on the delivery of enhancements and manage the day-to-day operations of their respective digital products.


To be successful in this role, you will be analytical and passionate about problem solving, review incoming product queries from business units, external organisations or customers. You will be responsible for developing reports, that provide insights on trends and opportunities which form a part of informing the product development roadmap set by the Product Owner, as well as ensuring newly delivered products work for customers in a production environment.


You’ll have:

  • 5+ years of experience using global distribution systems (GDS) technology (preferably Amadeus). Confident in using cryptic commands within a Global Distribution System (GDS), preferably Amadeus but experience in Sabre or Travelport systems also desirable.
  • 5+ years of experience working in a travel industry, digital or operations support role.
  • 2+ years of experience in digital products and agile ways of working.
  • Experience working in a travel agency, or familiarity with travel management/reservation products, will be highly regarded.
  • Experience in IATA Fares and Ticketing I and II, would be highly regarded.
  • Familiar with fares and ticketing procedures, including fare displays, pricing, availability, PNR creation and management, ticketing and PNR servicing procedures.
  • Operates with autonomy to identify problems and provide recommendations to stakeholders.
  • Investigate, track and resolve technical product and software issues including raising and management of defects and solution documentation.
  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills including the identification of trends for issues and action plans to mitigate.
  • Developed and maintain user-guides, internal knowledge articles and product documentation.
  • Experience with, and comfort using, collaboration tools such as JIRA and Confluence to document and manage stories and other documentation.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and management.
  • Understands and complies with legal, regulatory and corporate stipulations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; can effectively manage customer expectations.


Why Qantas?

At Qantas, your career can take you further than you imagined. You’ll join a team where creativity and passion drives success. Together we dream big and deliver even bigger.

You’ll find diverse opportunities to grow, personally and professionally. From day one, you’ll be supported with hands-on training, coaching, and formal learning programs designed to help you excel. Your development is our priority because we know that when you thrive, so do our customers.

And while this role is your starting point at Qantas, it’s just the beginning. We have a proud history of helping our people explore new paths and reach new heights - the destinations are endless.

  • We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.

  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.
  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.


Qantas is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity and inclusion. We encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, and people of all backgrounds to apply. If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at time of application. Wyndham Hotels & Resorts is now seeking a Director Development Real Estate EMEA to join our team in London, UK.

Shape the Future of Leisure Real Estate Across Europe

At Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, we're transforming the way people travel, live and invest. As we continue to expand our presence across Europe, we're seeking an entrepreneurial and highly connected Director of Development - Leisure Real Estate to identify, originate and secure new growth opportunities across some of the region's most exciting and rapidly evolving real estate sectors.

This is a unique opportunity to play a leading role in expanding Wyndham's footprint across branded residences, vacation rentals, serviced apartments, extended-stay products and emerging leisure real estate concepts, working with some of Europe's most influential developers, investors and owner groups.

If you have a passion for deal-making, a strong industry network, and thrive on creating strategic partnerships that unlock long-term value, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

As a key member of the Strategic Development team, you will lead the sourcing, negotiation and execution of new development opportunities across Europe, managing projects from initial market engagement through contract signing and pre-opening handover.

Drive New Business Growth

  • Develop and execute a targeted development strategy focused on leisure real estate opportunities across Europe.
  • Identify and originate new projects in branded residences, vacation rentals, serviced apartments, extended-stay and mixed-use developments.
  • Build and maintain a robust pipeline of qualified opportunities.
  • Identify emerging markets, destinations, investment trends and development partners.
  • Generate opportunities through networking, market intelligence, conferences and industry relationships.

Build Strategic Relationships

  • Establish trusted partnerships with developers, investors, family offices, private equity funds, institutional investors and strategic partners.
  • Position Wyndham as a leading partner within the leisure real estate sector.
  • Develop relationships with architects, consultants, brokers and advisors who influence investment and development decisions.
  • Represent Wyndham at major hospitality, investment and real estate events across EMEA.

Structure and Close Deals

  • Lead commercial negotiations for management, franchise, branded residence, licensing and strategic partnership agreements.
  • Understand owners' and investors' objectives and develop compelling partnership solutions.
  • Prepare investment cases, commercial proposals and executive presentations.
  • Guide projects through internal approvals, contract execution and handover to operations.

Lead Cross-Functional Development Projects

  • Coordinate internal stakeholders across Development, Operations, Commercial, Finance, Legal, Brand, Marketing and Architecture & Construction teams.
  • Act as the primary bridge between Wyndham and external partners.
  • Manage relationships through the entire development lifecycle, ensuring a seamless transition into opening and operations.

Influence Strategy

  • Recommend priority markets, target partner profiles and growth opportunities to senior leadership.
  • Monitor industry trends within branded residences, mixed-use developments and leisure real estate.
  • Provide market intelligence and competitive insights to support long-term growth strategies.

What Success Looks Like

You will be recognised for:

  • Building a high-quality development pipeline across Europe.
  • Securing new management, franchise, branded residence and partnership agreements.
  • Growing Wyndham's presence in strategically important destinations.
  • Delivering commercially attractive deals that create long-term value.
  • Building lasting relationships across the European real estate and investment community.
  • Driving deal execution with speed, quality and stakeholder alignment.

Experience

What We're Looking For

  • Significant experience within hospitality development, real estate development, investments or leisure real estate.
  • Proven success originating and closing complex commercial transactions.
  • Strong network of developers, investors, owners and industry stakeholders across EMEA.
  • Deep understanding of hotel, resort and leisure real estate investment and development.
  • Experience working with institutional investors, private equity firms, family offices and major developers.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, including feasibility and investment analysis.
  • Outstanding negotiation, presentation and relationship management skills.
  • Experience engaging with senior executives, owners and investors.
  • Willingness to travel extensively throughout EMEA.

Skills & Attributes

  • Highly connected and influential within the real estate and hospitality community.
  • Entrepreneurial, proactive and opportunity-focused.
  • Commercially savvy with strong deal origination capabilities.
  • Strategic in thinking but hands-on in execution.
  • Exceptional at building trust and long-term relationships.
  • Resilient, driven and motivated by results.
  • Comfortable working across multiple countries, cultures and stakeholder groups.
  • Passionate about identifying new sources of growth and innovation.

Why Wyndham?

At Wyndham, you'll be part of a fast-paced, collaborative, and people-focused culture where your ideas are valued, your impact is visible, and no two days are the same.

We offer the opportunity to work alongside talented colleagues across international markets, with the flexibility and autonomy to drive your own success. You'll enjoy a supportive environment that encourages growth, innovation, and strong teamwork, while helping shape the future of some of the world's most recognised hospitality brands.

If you're looking for a dynamic role, flexible ways of working, and a company where people genuinely enjoy what they do, Wyndham is the place for you. Join us and be part of an ambitious team that's creating the next generation of hospitality experiences across EMEA.

Ready to build what's next? Apply today.

Company Overview

Wyndham Hotels & Resorts is one of the largest hotel franchise companies in the world by number of properties with approximately 8,400 hotels across over 95 countries on six continents. Through our network of approximately 869,000 rooms appealing to the everyday traveler, Wyndham commands a leading presence in the hospitality industry. Headquartered in Parsippany, N.J. with offices around the world in London, Shanghai, Buenos Aires, Dubai and more, Wyndham employs more than 2,000 corporate team members worldwide who are dedicated to the Company’s mission of making hotel travel possible for all. Supporting thousands of franchisees and a growing global portfolio of 25 hotel brands—think household names like Wyndham, La Quinta, Ramada, Days Inn and Super 8—Wyndham team members are a widespread group of individuals with diverse interests and backgrounds. Our unique Count on Me culture, commitment to flexibility and core values of Integrity, Accountability, Inclusivity, Caring and Fun are just part of what continues to make Wyndham an award-winning best place to work.

Job Location: London, UK

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.


Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.


Job Description

Introduction to the Team


In B2B division, we bring Expedia Group's innovative technology and distribution solutions to partners across the world. These businesses include global financial institutions, corporate managed travel, offline travel agents, global travel suppliers (like major airlines) and many more.


The TAAP (Travel Agent Affiliate Program) engineering team is at the heart of empowering travel agents worldwide with the tools, platforms, and technology they need to book and manage travel for their clients. Based in Madrid, you will be part of a collaborative, distributed engineering team focused on building reliable, scalable, and modern B2B solutions that make a real difference for our partners and their travelers.


In this role, you will:

  • Design, develop, and deliver high-quality software features and services that power the TAAP platform for travel agent partners globally.
  • Write clean, well-tested, and maintainable code across the full software development lifecycle, primarily using Java and JVM-based technologies.
  • Develop responsive, accessible, and maintainable user interfaces using React.js
  • Participate in architectural discussions and contribute to technical decisions that shape the direction of the platform.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to translate business requirements into scalable solutions.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve production issues, ensuring platform reliability and performance.
  • Review code from peers and provide constructive technical feedback to foster a culture of quality and continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to the improvement of engineering practices, tooling, and processes within the team.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams across Expedia Group to deliver end-to-end B2B experiences for our travel agent partners.


Experience and Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience.

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong background in designing and building scalable, distributed systems.
  • Experience with JVM-based languages such as Java, Kotlin or Scala
  • Experience developing production-quality web applications using React.js
  • Experience designing and building RESTful APIs and microservices architectures.
  • Solid understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and system design principles.
  • Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and modern DevOps practices (CI/CD pipelines, containerisation with Docker/Kubernetes).
  • Proficient communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a distributed, cross-functional team environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to work both collaboratively and autonomously in a fast-paced, agile environment.


The total cash range for this position in Madrid is €43,000.00 to €60,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to €69,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.


Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

job.job_description:
Job Summary

The Senior Director, International Commercial Performance & Brand Operations leads multiple functions within the International division, overseeing the development and execution of commercial initiatives and brand operations across international markets. This role develops and implements international commercial priorities aligned with brand standards and franchise operations to strengthen brand consistency, enhance the guest experience, and drive revenue growth, increasing proprietary contribution to our international franchisees. The Senior Director works closely with regional leaders and departmental stakeholders to translate commercial strategies into market-relevant execution plans, with a decision-making horizon typically spanning 1–3 years. This leader supports strong collaboration between HQ commercial leadership and the international regions to drive commercial performance, identify growth opportunities, and strengthen brand positioning. The role manages the international commercial and brand operations team located in the US, with regional commercial leaders aligned through a dotted-line reporting structure.

The Senior Director collaborates with enterprise Commercial Services functions, Digital, Data and Technology, and regional leadership teams to align on departmental goals and translate them into locally relevant action plans.

Responsibilities

International Commercial Performance

  • Develop and implement commercial strategies across international markets, including sales, revenue management, distribution, and demand generation to drive topline growth and increase proprietary contribution to our international franchisees.
  • Build and maintain alignment across regional and discipline teams to ensure consistent activation of commercial priorities.
  • Serve as a key functional leader supporting international commercial performance at Headquarters.
  • Partner with regional commercial leaders to align on priorities and execute initiatives that improve franchise performance.
  • Translate departmental commercial frameworks into actionable strategies tailored for international regions, balancing consistency with local market dynamics.
  • Identify and support strategic partnerships and distribution channels to advance international growth and customer acquisition.
  • Contribute to the development of commercial systems, tools, and techniques required to support international growth.
  • Execute strategies to enhance international brand presence and competitiveness across key markets.
  • Support the acquisition and engagement of targeted customer segments through regionally tailored commercial and brand initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve franchise performance and scale best practices across the international portfolio.

Strategic Leadership & Brand Operations

  • Provide leadership and direction to the teams managing brands in the international markets and support brand regionalization initiatives as needed.
  • Manage the international brand operations strategy, ensuring consistent execution of brand standards across markets while allowing for meaningful local adaptation.
  • Drive initiatives that strengthen brand differentiation, improve guest experience, and enhance franchisee value proposition across the portfolio.
  • Partner with brand and regional leadership to evolve brand strategies and ensure alignment with international market needs.
  • Serve as a key point of coordination between international regions and corporate teams, supporting alignment on priorities, programs, and execution.
  • Foster cross-functional collaboration with brand teams, marketing, digital, technology, and operations teams to deliver integrated solutions that support international brand and commercial success.
  • Support the rollout of global programs and ensure consistent execution across regions while addressing local market nuances.

Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing international team, including commercial leaders in a dotted-line reporting structure, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and innovation.
  • Responsible for critical team management decisions, including hiring, terminations, and promotions, and develop staffing strategies that align with team objectives and departmental direction.
  • Build strong relationships across departments to foster collaboration and ensure alignment with shared priorities.
  • Develop and implement annual team strategies and objectives in alignment with departmental leadership direction and approval.

Qualifications

Employment Experience

  • 8+ years of progressive leadership experience in strategy, consulting, brand operations, commercial strategy, franchise operations, or hospitality-related fields.
  • Demonstrated experience leading or supporting multi-regional commercial or operational strategies with measurable business impact.
  • Proven experience working in complex, matrixed organizations and coordinating across regions.
  • Track record of developing and executing commercial strategies for global brands, with measurable impact on growth and market performance.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong understanding of global hospitality distribution, sales channels, and customer engagement strategies.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools and familiarity with commercial or operational platforms.
  • Strong leadership with the ability to translate departmental priorities into actionable regional plans.
  • Effective stakeholder management and coordination skills across cultures and geographies.
  • Proven ability to drive commercial performance with measurable impact on growth and market results.
  • Ability to lead operational excellence initiatives and support continuous improvement efforts.
  • Excellent communication skills with strong presence across departmental and cross-functional settings.

Additional Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Hospitality, or related field required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally 20–30% of the time.

SALARY RANGE

The salary range for this position is $188,076 to $221,266 annually. In addition to the annual salary, this role is eligible for an annual bonus based on the terms of Choice's Management Incentive Plan (MIP), as well as annual awards of Choice Hotels International common stock through Choice’s Long-Term Incentive Plan (LTI Plan).

Choice prioritizes our associate wellbeing by offering a comprehensive benefits program that is both competitive and flexible to help you achieve your wellbeing goals - here are just a few:

  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Leave and paid time-off for holidays, vacation, personal, family, volunteer, sick, jury duty, bereavement, military, and religious observance
  • Financial benefits for retirement and health savings
  • Employee recognition programs
  • Discounts at Choice hotels worldwide

About Choice

Choice Hotels International, Inc. (NYSE: CHH), is one of the largest lodging franchisors in the world. With 7,500 hotels in 45+ countries and territories, we offer a range of high-quality lodging options in the upper upscale, upper midscale, midscale, extended stay, and economy segments. We’re the hotel company for those who choose to bet on themselves — the striver, the dreamer, the entrepreneur — because that’s who we are, too.

At Choice, we are united by the simple belief that tomorrow will be even better than today — for associates, our company, and our franchisees. At our worldwide corporate headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, at our technology center in Scottsdale, Arizona, and through our associates around the globe, every voice is heard and every idea is listened to, no matter what area of the company they come from. We are united in supporting the entrepreneurial dreams of our thousands of franchise owners, which propels us forward — giving our work at Choice a purpose larger than our business.

Our corporate office locations:

North Bethesda, MD — Located at Pike & Rose, our worldwide headquarters is less than 15 miles from Washington, D.C., one block away from the North Bethesda Metro station, with easy access to I-495, complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Scottsdale, AZ — Located at the northwest corner of Loop 101, the Scottsdale office is home to our technology, eCommerce and customer service organizations, with easy access to complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Minneapolis, MN — Select roles are based in our Minneapolis office on Highway 394, near the intersection with Highway 100, only five minutes from downtown.

Field/Remote — Select roles designated as field/remote will require associates to work from a home office, connecting virtually with Choice team members and leadership on Zoom, with possible required travel depending on the role.

Choice’s Cultural Values

Welcome and Respect Everyone | Be Bold | Be Quick | Listen | Be Curious | Show Integrity

Choice’s Leadership Principles

Act with Intention | Lead with Authenticity | Grow & Deliver

Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

In this role, you will be the key analytical partner to Customer Care — the team that supports travelers when things don’t go as planned and protects trust in the GetYourGuide experience. You will work closely with Care leadership, Product, and the broader Analytics organization to ensure Care’s biggest decisions are grounded in rigorous measurement and clear trade-offs.

Care is inherently cross-domain: it spans Traveler (On-Trip), Supplier, and Partner Operations. You’ll be embedded enough to build context and influence, while staying anchored in Analytics to uphold standards, peer review, and alignment with company-wide metrics.

Your mission

  • Own the analytical problems that matter most for Care — define and drive the strategic Care analytics backlog and turn it into recommendations that shape priorities, policies, and investments.
  • Build the measurement frameworks Care relies on — create and evolve metrics, models, and dashboards that make efficiency, friction, and outcomes measurable and self-serve.
  • Deliver deep-dive modeling that unlocks step-change decisions — quantify drivers and trade-offs behind contacts, refunds, CSAT, and channel performance, including LTV-aware policy logic.
  • Be Care's analytical voice across the company for Travelers, Suppliers and Partners — turn what Care learns from travelers into insights Product, Marketing, and Operations can act on, aligned with On-Trip and Destination growth strategy.
  • Champion hypothesis-driven decision-making — raise the bar on rigor, evaluation, and impact measurement so Care decisions are consistently defensible and outcome-driven.

Your toolkit

  • 5+ years of relevant experience interpreting data in an analytics or a data science role
  • Production-grade SQL and strong working knowledge of Python (e.g., notebooks, modeling, analysis workflows).
  • Experience with experimentation (statistics, assumptions, and evaluation).
  • Strong statistical background and proficiency with advanced statistical methods (e.g. causal inference methods, difference-in-differences, regression analysis, propensity score matching)
  • Strong stakeholder management and the ability to operate with senior leaders in a high-context, ambiguous environment.
  • Proven ability to turn messy questions into structured analysis, crisp narratives, and decisions with measurable business impact.
  • Strong customer mindset: you understand user behavior and the “why” behind the numbers.
  • Excellent communication skills — you can influence without authority and align teams around shared metrics and priorities.
  • Experience with data visualization and reporting tools (e.g., Looker, Jupyter Notebooks).

Extras that give you an edge

  • Experience working in Customer Care within a marketplace.
  • Familiarity with ETL/orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow) and/or big data tooling (e.g., Spark, Hive).
  • Experience working in agile product teams and cross-functional mission setups.
  • Exposure to LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic), especially for operational tooling or workflow augmentation.
  • Experience mentoring or managing analysts.

How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary

  • Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
  • Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
  • A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.

  • Health and wellness benefits

And more…

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

This role is based at our corporate office in McLean, VA

This is your chance to be part of Marketing team that attracts customers to Hilton through strong storytelling, top-rated rewards, and unique customer experiences and partnerships. As the Manager, Co-brand Acquisition Marketing, you will help drive growth across Hilton's portfolio of co-branded credit cards by leading and executing marketing initiatives that drive new card acquisition. Reporting to the Director of the Co-Brand Marketing team, you will partner with American Express and serve as Hilton's cross-functional leader to deliver integrated, data-driven marketing campaigns and touchpoints that support shared business objectives and portfolio growth.

What You'll Do During a Typical Day

  • Lead acquisition marketing campaigns and touchpoints across owned and paid channels ensuring alignment with co-brand and enterprise growth objectives.
  • Oversee end-to-end campaign planning and execution, guiding team members and agency partners to deliver high-quality marketing deliverables on time and on strategy.
  • Develop and oversee test-and-learn roadmaps, identifying opportunities to optimize audience targeting, messaging, creative, and channel investments.
  • Analyze channel and campaign performance, translating insights into actionable recommendations that improve cost efficiency, acquisition goals, and overall business results.
  • Own reporting socialization and executive readouts, communicating results, insights, risks, and recommendations to leadership and key stakeholders.
  • Support broader co-brand initiatives and enterprise priorities to drive both customer acquisition and long-term Card Member engagement.

How You'll Collaborate With Others

  • Serve as a marketing partner to Hilton's internal co-brand program team, aligning on acquisition priorities, performance optimization, and business objectives.
  • Lead cross-functional marketing teams in developing, executing and optimizing acquisition marketing tactics that drive portfolio growth.
  • Laise with American Express co-brand team to align marketing plans, coordinate dual Amex & Hilton owned initiatives, and ensure legal / compliance approval of all Hilton co-brand activity.

Deliverables You'll Take Ownership Of

  • Campaign and creative briefs that guide campaign development across owned, earned, and paid marketing channels.
  • Delivery and execution of all campaign assets with quality assurance oversight.
  • Campaign reporting and performance tracking to ensure achievement of portfolio growth objectives.
  • Test-and-learn frameworks, optimization plans, and performance measurement approaches.

What It Takes to Make the Stay

You Have These Minimum Qualifications

  • Five (5) years of professional experience
  • Four (4) years of experience in marketing, loyalty, co-brand, financial services, or a related field
  • Proven experience driving data-driven marketing strategies and business results
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing stakeholders
  • This role is based in McLean, VA (onsite)

It Would Be Useful If You Have

  • Knowledge of customer acquisition, audience targeting, testing, and optimization
  • Strategic, customer-focused mindset
  • Experience managing agency and partner relationships
  • Experience in a regulated industry

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we're known for doesn't end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members' wellbeing, supporting you through all of life's moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
  • Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
  • Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
  • Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
  • Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
  • Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Generous paid time off (PTO) – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters most
  • Health & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family covered
  • Financial security for your future – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what's next
  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member's location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

Hilton offers its eligible team members a comprehensive benefits package to support their mental and physical well-being, so they can Thrive personally and professionally. The pay range for this role is $90,000 – $120,000 and is determined based on applicable and specialized experience and location. Subject to plan terms and conditions, you will be eligible to participate in the Hilton Annual Incentive (Bonus) Plan, consistent with other team members at the same level and/or position within the Company.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Tripadvisor is looking for a smart, enthusiastic, and motivated Sales Planner to join the Tripadvisor family to manage and develop our Key Account partnerships in AMER. The Sales Planner will play an integral role developing strategic media plans based on a client’s goals and objectives while ensuring business rules and pricing are adhered to and all revenue associated with the program can be fulfilled and recognized. This position will offer the right person a great opportunity to work in a collaborative team environment and help support our growing media business.

We offer the chance to work with the brightest minds in the travel business in an energetic, dynamic and international work environment focused on innovation, creative problem-solving and collaboration.

Location: New York or Los Angeles- United States

What You’ll Do

Reporting to the Sales Planning Manager, the Sales Planner is responsible for the following critical tasks:

  • Provide best in class service and solutions
  • Collaborate with Sales and Account Managers to understand their client’s objectives and needs in order to develop strategic media plans
  • Maintain and ensure business rules and rates are adhered to while actively presenting solutions when client needs may conflict and require otherwise
  • Build comprehensive media plans within our order management system, working to reserve and book inventory
  • Generate insertion orders and manage final bookings
  • Track delivery pacing on a weekly basis for all campaigns and implement proactive optimizations to ensure all revenue can be recognized and invoiced
  • With guidance from Account Manager, work in order management system to revise and optimize live campaigns for delivery, performance, and other client objectives.
  • Responsible for client monthly Billing Reconciliation in addition to working with the Tripadvisor Accounting Department to resolve billing issues and generate timely invoices.
  • Collaborate alongside Marketing Solutions counterparts to design strategic custom content media plans while maintaining profit margins

Skills & Experience

  • 2-3+ years minimum professional experience in digital media at an agency/client/publisher prefer in an Sales Planner or Client Services role
  • Understands digital concepts and is up to date on emerging ad formats
  • Consistent and proven track record in successfully developing strategic media plans in a B2B environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work with cross-functional teams across all levels including management
  • Proficient in Excel and GSuite with an analytical ability is preferred
  • Systems knowledge with Sales Tech and Digital Platforms (Salesforce, OMS, DFP, Moat, DoubleVerify, IAS etc.)

In addition, the ideal candidate will demonstrate the following competencies:

  • Proficient attention to detail with a high level of organizational skills & communication skills
  • Experience managing complex tasks in a digital environment with a strategic lens
  • Flexible and open to change and new information, changing processes, client direction; adapts behavior and work methods accordingly
  • Grasps the essence of new information; recognizes own strengths and weaknesses; pursues self-development; seeks feedback
  • Exhibits integrity though fair and ethical behavior toward others and a demonstrated sense of corporate responsibility and commitment
  • Ability to work with cross functional teams toward the common goal of driving revenue & client satisfaction
  • Positive attitude and treats colleagues with respect: considers and responds appropriately to the needs, feelings, and capabilities of different people
  • Team player with the ability to manage up and across
  • Can be relied upon to ensure that projects within areas of specific responsibility are completed in an appropriate and timely manner and acknowledges mistakes, learns from those events and is able to move forward productively
  • Identifies and analyzes problems and is comfortable working under pressure to meet deadlines; distinguishes between relevant and irrelevant information
  • Ability to balance time to market with a solution and make the right trade-offs along the way
  • Strong analytical skills: understands and utilizes metrics relevant to role
  • Clear communication (written and oral) through expression of facts and ideas in a clear, convincing and organized manner
  • Acts as an owner navigating internal materials with little to no supervision; Able to surface solutions in addition to questions
  • Good business judgment when making decisions and always considers the relevance/impact of each decision on the business
  • A desire to perform in a fast-paced highly changing marketplace and be driven to meet and exceed the team’s expectations/demands

What We Offer

  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.
