job.job_description:
Organization- Hyatt Corporate Office

Summary

The Opportunity

Hyatt Hotels Corporation is seeking an experienced Commercial Leader to join our Central Services team. This role will lead commercial strategy, proactive sales, and local market activation across a portfolio of Hyatt Studios hotels. Working closely with centralized sales, revenue management, marketing, hotel teams, and the broader Commercial Services organization, the Senior Manager will identify high-value business opportunities, strengthen sales pipelines, guide account and market prioritization, and develop strategies that support portfolio-wide revenue and performance goals. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list since 2013. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

  • Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on-site fitness center
  • A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption
  • Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

The Role

The Studios Commercial Lead – Senior Manager role is ideal for an experienced hospitality sales leader with a strong background in Essentials brands, including Hyatt Place and Hyatt House, and a demonstrated ability to lead people, influence hotel performance, and develop commercial strategies across a portfolio of properties. This position owns the commercial strategy and local market activation for Hyatt Studios hotels, with primary responsibility for proactive sales strategy, high-value account relationships, target account prioritization, pricing direction, and overall commercial performance.

The Senior Manager will evaluate market dynamics, hotel performance, business mix, competitive positioning, and revenue opportunities to establish strategic priorities for each hotel. The role will lead account selection, relationship strategy, local market outreach, and proactive sales planning while ensuring alignment between commercial strategy, revenue management, sales execution, performance reporting, and field marketing.

In partnership with hotel ownership, hotel leadership, Sales Specialists, Revenue Specialists, Performance Hub teams, and Field Marketing, the Commercial Lead will guide the launch, ramp-up, and stabilization of Studios hotels. The Senior Manager will monitor performance, provide commercial recommendations, oversee digital and local market activation, and maintain accountability for results. This role will also lead commercial reviews, support high-value account development, and ensure that proactive sales remains a strategic priority across the portfolio.

The position requires periodic travel to support hotel launches, market activation, commercial reviews, and stakeholder engagement, generally no more than once per month.

Qualifications

Experience Required

  • Proven experience as a sales leader within the hospitality industry, preferably with Select Service hotels.
  • Previous Hyatt experience, including familiarity with Hyatt commercial practices, systems, processes, and brand standards.
  • Demonstrated success leading people, developing talent, setting performance expectations, and driving accountability across sales or commercial teams.
  • Experience developing and executing commercial strategies across multiple hotels, a portfolio of properties, or geographically dispersed markets.
  • Proven ability to lead proactive sales strategy, including target account selection, prioritization, prospecting direction, relationship development, and local market activation.
  • Strong understanding of Group and Business Transient sales, including account development, negotiation, contracting, pipeline management, and business mix optimization.
  • Working knowledge of Revenue Management concepts, including STR reporting, market share index, competitive positioning, demand analysis, pricing methodology, rate strategy, rate parity, and revenue optimization.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate market intelligence, hotel performance, revenue insights, and business objectives into actionable commercial and sales plans.
  • Experience partnering with Revenue Management, Sales, Marketing, hotel leadership, ownership, and other commercial stakeholders to drive financial performance.
  • Ability to evaluate account production, market trends, pace, demand, pricing, and historical performance to inform commercial priorities and recommendations.
  • Experience leading commercial reviews and presenting strategic recommendations, performance insights, and business updates to senior leadership and hotel stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to establish and maintain relationships with high-value accounts, corporate partners, third-party organizations, and local market stakeholders.
  • Experience overseeing Envision activity, sales pipeline development, lead generation, account prioritization, and performance tracking.
  • Proven ability to monitor and evaluate KPIs such as revenue contribution, account production, market share, conversion, pace, pipeline activity, average daily rate, and business mix.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple hotels, priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, presentation, negotiation, and influencing skills.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a centralized commercial model while maintaining clear ownership of strategy, execution, and results.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
  • Willingness and ability to travel periodically.

Experience Preferred:

  • Minimum 5 years experience in hotels
  • Previous Hyatt Selling experience.
  • Experience opening, launching, or stabilizing new-build or newly converted hotels.
  • Experience supporting hotel lifecycle planning, including launch and ramp-up strategies followed by stabilized operations.
  • Experience with Hyatt systems and commercial tools, including Envision, TravelClick, STR, or similar platforms.

The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all-encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary.

The salary range for this position is $105,000-$125,000. This position is also eligible to earn incentive awards, an annual bonus, monthly or quarterly incentives, etc.

The final pay rate/salary offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level, and other qualifications for the role, as well as the location of the performance of work. Pay for the successful candidate will meet local requirements, including the local minimum wage rate.

We welcome you:

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.

We value our relationships with recruitment partners and require that agencies contact us first before submitting any candidates. Hyatt will not be responsible for any fees and obligations associated with unsolicited submissions unless a formal agreement is in place.

IHG is one of the world's leading hotel companies. Present in around 100 countries, with over 7,100 hotels globally.

Your day to day

As Marketing Manager at InterContinental Perth City Centre, you will lead the hotel's marketing strategy, driving brand awareness, revenue growth and market share across accommodation, meetings and events, and our three distinctive food and beverage venues.

Reporting to the Director of Sales & Marketing, you will own the annual marketing plan and budget, delivering integrated campaigns that strengthen the hotel's position as one of Perth's leading luxury hospitality destinations. You'll oversee all marketing channels, including digital, social media, CRM, PR, partnerships, website content, OTAs and online listings, ensuring every initiative delivers measurable commercial results.

Working closely with Sales, Revenue, Operations, Food & Beverage and IHG regional teams, you'll turn business objectives into impactful marketing strategies that enhance guest engagement, drive demand and maximise return on investment.

You will also lead and develop the Marketing Executive, fostering a collaborative, high-performing team culture while identifying new opportunities to elevate the hotel's profile through strategic partnerships, innovative campaigns and memorable guest experiences.

This is an exciting opportunity for a commercially driven marketing leader who thrives on combining strategic thinking with hands-on execution to deliver outstanding business outcomes.

What We Need From You

The successful candidate will have:

  • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing or Communications.
  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience in Marketing, Distribution Marketing, Digital Marketing or Brand Management.
  • Hotel, Advertising Agency, Travel Industry system connectivity or a combination of any of the above are highly desirable related experience.
  • A strong understanding of digital marketing, social media and the content requirements for these channels.
  • Excellent project management and proven senior stakeholder relationship skills.
  • Strong financial, analytical and business acumen with budget management experience.
  • Ability to perform multiple efforts in a fast-paced, challenging & high growth environment.
  • Experience and capability to conduct all leadership involved with managing a small team of others.
  • Unlimited and unrestricted working rights for Australia as visa sponsorship is not available.

What We Offer

Join our extraordinary world and experience a place where you can be yourself, share your ideas, support your personal growth and wellbeing, and be a valued member of an inspirational team. You’ll be rewarded for your hard work with a suite of benefits that supports you and your family’s wellbeing, including:

  • Free duty meal on shift
  • Paid birthday leave - hip hip hooray!
  • Paid parental leave
  • Proactive paid wellness and mental health days
  • Discounted CBD car park access

  • Some of the best colleague discounts across our IHG Hotels for accommodation, food and beverage
  • A massive colleague discounts platform for all your favourite brands and retailers - to help your salary go further
  • Most importantly, your career journey will be supported through our lifelong development programs, IHG career milestone celebrations, and transfer of leave entitlements as you move and grow with IHG.

Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

job.job_description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

We're looking for a driven, analytical, outcome-focused Project Manager to join our Merchandising team. You'll take open-ended quality challenges on our supplier and traveler-facing data, think activity attributes, categories, and location data, and turn them into scoped, measurable projects, using AI to scale your work across our inventory. This is a data and process role: you'll be working with structured content and quality metrics, not copywriting or editorial content.

Your mission

  • Own outcome-driven projects end-to-end: set the scope, timeline, and success metric upfront, then run execution independently (i.e., freelancer content batches, supplier data fixes, or full quality evaluation cycles)
  • Define what "good" means for your domain: build and validate datasets, set precision and recall targets, and keep both current as new failure patterns surface.
  • Build AI-powered quality checks: configure and orchestrate LLM-based workflows that replace manual review at scale.
  • Partner with senior stakeholders to scope ambiguous problems, then own execution independently: prioritize by data-backed impact over ticket volume, close gaps before they turn into blockers, and present your solutions with clarity and conviction.

Your toolkit

  • Experience owning projects end to end, from turning a fuzzy operational problem into a bounded project with a clear scope through to a delivered result
  • Hands-on experience configuring and orchestrating AI and LLM tools (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar APIs) to automate quality checks, build datasets or replace manual review (you don't need have built models from scratch)
  • Comfortable with SQL and notebook-based data tools (Databricks or similar) to query and validate data independently.
  • You use data to prioritize, define success metrics and validate hypotheses
  • You scope work independently with senior stakeholders and resolve alignment issues without being asked.
  • Experience running processes where the output must hold up at volume, such as freelancer operations, quality standards or tooling
  • You are a clear communicator, both written and verbal and are fluent in English

Extras that give you an edge

  • Experience building or fine-tuning LLM prototypes.
  • A background in content quality, supplier operations, or marketplace quality.
  • Familiarity with precision/recall frameworks and quality evaluation methods.

How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary

  • Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
  • Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
  • A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.
  • Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with a quarterly team event budget
  • Access to leading AI tools plus the resources and budget to get the most out of them
  • Monthly transportation and fitness budget
  • Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
  • Language reimbursement program
  • Health and wellness benefits

And more…

How To Apply

Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘how we hire’ and ‘life at GetYourGuide’. If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to get in touch at jobs@getyourguide.com.

We’re an equal opportunities employer

Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with your application.

job.job_description:
Founded in the Queensland outback in 1920, Qantas has grown to be Australia’s largest regional, domestic, and international airline. Qantas has a range of subsidiary businesses that support the overall operations of the Group. The Qantas Group’s main business is the transportation of customers and freight using two complementary airline brands — Qantas and Jetstar — operating regional, domestic, and international services.

Job Description

  • Challenge yourself in a role within a supportive team environment
  • Permanent Full Time position based at our Sydney Distribution Centre, Mascot with a 7-day rotating shift roster
  • The position is covered under Qantas Airways Limited (United Workers Union) Enterprise Agreement 2023-Level 3.1

Embracing the spirit of Australia, Qantas has been bringing travellers together with the people they love – both from around Australia and all over the globe. It’s just part of being the Spirit of Australia.

These days, we’re widely regarded as an airline people can count on – both on the ground and in the air. It’s a reputation that hasn’t just seen us become the world’s leading long-distance airline – but an Australian icon too and we’d love for you to be a part of that.

As a Storeperson you will be responsible for the management and coordination of all-day operations to ensure all aircraft parts are controlled, packed ready for delivery for servicing of aircraft. You’ll be responsible for managing inventory, coordinating daily operations, and preparing parts for timely delivery to support aircraft servicing.

You will be a team player who can assess and monitor inventory levels for distribution and be responsible for quality completion of all routine work activities within controlled areas of the operation. Your ability to operate a forklift confidently and safely will be essential, as this role involves frequent movement of heavy and oversized items within a busy warehouse setting. You’ll also work with RF handheld devices and warehouse management systems to maintain precise stock control and meet operational KPIs.

You’ll have –

  • Valid Forklift Licence and forklift operating experience
  • Current Drivers License (ability to drive manual preferred)
  • Experience in a distribution centre of large-scale warehouse environment
  • RF Handheld scanning experience
  • Proficiency in warehouse/freight management systems
  • Strong commitment to safety and achieving customer service excellence through disciplined warehousing practices
  • Understanding of logistics planning, workflows and operational control
  • Basic computer skills and ability to learn logistics management programs
  • Experience in logistics interactions with customers
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and work effectively under supervision
  • Team-oriented mindset with flexibility to work on a rotating shift roster
  • Eligibility to qualify for and hold a Red ASIC identification card
  • Working knowledge of airport operations (advantageous)

Why Qantas?

You’ll join a team where creativity and passion are encouraged. Our people come together to allow us to dream big and deliver successfully.

There are many different opportunities across our team, which means you’ll be able to grow both personally and professionally at Qantas. Your development is a priority for us – so that you can maintain the high standards our customers have come to expect and can continue to develop over time. You’ll be supported from day 1 with on the job training and coaching as well as our formal training opportunities. While you may start in this role, we’ve got a great track record of supporting our people to take their career in so many different directions, the destinations are endless. 

The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.

  • We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave (plus superannuation payments on all paid and unpaid parental leave until your child turns 1) and additional purchased leave options for eligible employees.
  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.
  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.

The Qantas Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity and inclusion. By coming to work for us, you’ll be part of an organisation that encourages diversity, supports charities and environmental initiatives. We encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, and people of all backgrounds to apply. If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at time of application. Your personal information will be kept confidential in compliance with relevant privacy legislation.

If you’re ready to step into a culture that will challenge and excite you, submit an application and let’s explore how we go places together.

Priceline, part of Booking Holdings Inc., has been a leader in online travel for over 25 years. Through our innovative technology, we make travel affordable and accessible for all, helping millions of travelers each year experience the moments that matter most. Whether it’s a much-needed getaway, wedding, reunion, graduation, or rooting on a favorite team—those are the moments that nobody should miss out on.
We welcome people who are at the top of their game, who want to learn and grow with others and who take their work seriously – but not themselves. We’re building an inclusive and uniquely talented team to make sure our customers can be there for all of life’s important moments. Come join us!
job.job_description:
Vegas- Remote

Whether it’s hotels, rental cars, flights, cruises or packages, our Lines of Business develop the relationships we need to generate great deals and then get them to Priceline customers – so they can experience all the moments that matter to them.

Why This Job’s a Big Deal

As a Senior Market/Account Manager, hotels, your key objective is to maintain and grow Priceline’s network of hotel partnerships and accommodation supply inventory through building, establishing and strengthening account relationships. As an experienced individual contributor, a Senior Market/Account Manager, hotels must demonstrate proven leadership skills and success in sales, while identifying new revenue generating opportunities and spearheading strategic initiatives. The Senior Market/Account Manager, hotels uses their knowledge of the travel industry, and their experience in sales negotiation, revenue management and data analysis, to increase revenue by optimizing Priceline’s hotel partnerships. Additionally, you will identify trends, optimize pricing, ensure content competitiveness, and use data to secure business wins that satisfy consumer demand and maximize hotel bookings on Priceline.com and Agoda.com websites.

In This Role You Will Get To

  • Handle a portfolio of high-value and strategic accounts; build strong hotel supplier relationships and effectively communicate Priceline and Agoda’s value proposition to grow bookings, room nights and revenue in assigned portfolio
  • Evaluate market trends, partner performance, and competitor landscape to ensure the competitiveness of Priceline and Agoda’s products
  • Analyze data to identify business growth opportunities; initiate and drive sound recommendations to optimize hotel partnerships within assigned portfolio
  • Lead projects and strategic growth initiatives to positively impact the overall performance of Priceline and Agoda
  • Conduct ongoing reviews of production with hotel accounts and present strategic recommendations to optimize Priceline and Agoda accommodation availability, content competitiveness and hotel performance, using a consultative approach
  • Prioritize, plan and implement effectively to meet/exceed defined targets and goals
  • Identify, prioritize, negotiate, contract and onboard non-participating hotels, ensuring favorable terms and conditions
  • Research and troubleshoot pricing and availability competitiveness issues preventing hotels from optimizing booking performance
  • Educate and train hotel partners on Priceline and Agoda systems, tools, programs and reporting
  • Build effective internal partnerships by collaborating across business units to implement growth initiatives and drive market strategy
  • Prepare presentations and materials to present at both external and internal meetings
  • Provide regular feedback to internal stakeholders in developing effective and scalable solutions to improve reporting, processes and operational efficiencies
  • Represent Priceline in the local market, participate in industry organizations and events, and build Priceline’s presence by developing relationships with key decision makers at hotels, technology partners and other relevant partners

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s degree or master’s degree or equivalent experience, in any relevant field
  • 5+ years professional sales experience; minimum 1 year in travel industry required
  • Demonstrated success acquiring & building long term customer relationships
  • Proficiency in handling high-level stakeholders and specialized enterprise accounts
  • Strong sales negotiation skills and ability to creatively “think on the fly” when negotiating with hotel partners
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to influence external and internal stakeholders
  • Hungry, determined, motivated, solution-oriented, and results-focused
  • Strong critical thinking, data analysis and data visualization skills
  • Possesses self-awareness, a sense of curiosity and a growth mindset
  • Comfortable in two-way feedback culture and challenging the status quo
  • A great teammate with demonstrated leadership skills, a professional “get it done” attitude, and strong work ethic
  • Ability to multitask effectively, change gears quickly, and thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
  • Flexibility to travel up to 30% for partner/market visits and team meetings
  • Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust.
  • The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics is essential.

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. In addition to a competitive base salary, certain roles may be eligible for an annual bonus and/or equity grant.

The salary range for this position is $85,000-$105,000K USD.

Who We Are

WE ARE PRICELINE.

Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.

Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.

We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.

Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.

If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!

Flexible work at Priceline

Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.

Perks & Benefits At Priceline

Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:

Health & wellness coverage including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources

Generous time off including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days

Work/life support including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)

Financial security programs such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts

Signature travel perks including employee-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits

Additional perks & discounts like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits

A people-first culture with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together

Specific benefits and programs vary by location.

Inclusion is a Big Deal!

To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.

Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.

Applying for this position

We're excited that you are interested in a career with us. For all current employees, please use the internal portal to find jobs and apply.

External candidates are required to have an account before applying. When you click Apply, returning candidates can log in, or new candidates can quickly create an account to save/view applications.

job.job_description:
Principal, Sales Incentive Program Administrator

We are seeking a principal to join our global Sales Operations team, where innovation knows no borders. This team designs commercial frameworks that reward high performance and help sales teams thrive. It connects strategy with financial incentives so teams can deliver value to customers. With an inclusive culture and flexible work environment, we work together with boldness, curiosity and commitment so we can all win together.

As a Principal, Sales Incentive Programs, you will serve as the expert advisor for global compensation strategies. You will own plan administration, guide stakeholders through design cycles and transform metrics into business growth. This role requires analytical precision, sound commercial judgment and the confidence to challenge outdated compensation structures.

What You'll Do

  • Lead global administration of sales compensation plans to ensure accurate performance calculations and timely payouts.
  • Partner with finance and sales leadership to design incentive frameworks aligned with business objectives.
  • Conduct benchmarking studies and feasibility analyses to advise executives on plan adjustments.
  • Evaluate monthly performance variance against budgets to measure plan effectiveness across business units.
  • Use automated modeling tools to accelerate calculations, remove manual errors and improve performance visibility.

What You'll Bring

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in sales compensation administration, revenue operations or financial planning within Software as a Service (SaaS) or travel technology.
  • Deep expertise in incentive plan structures including quotas, accelerators, pay mixes and on-target earnings.
  • Proven success modeling complex commission structures and presenting recommendations to governance boards.
  • Advanced analytical skills using Structured Query Language (SQL), Excel or data visualization platforms to evaluate business performance.
  • Practical experience applying workflow automation tools to scale productivity and optimize compensation planning.

Benefits

Benefits that support you We know support looks different for everyone. That is why Sabre offers benefits beyond medical and financial coverage, with programs designed to support your well-being, growth and life outside work:

  • Competitive pay and performance-based bonuses
  • Flexible work options
  • Comprehensive healthcare coverage
  • Generous PTO and holidays
  • Strong retirement planning support
  • Family-friendly benefits
  • Professional development opportunities

job.job_description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY:

OAG is the essential intelligence partner transforming global travel. For nearly a century, we’ve been the foundation the travel industry builds on, trusted, proven, essential. Today, we’re going beyond.

We combine unmatched data quality, quantity and access with breakthrough technology and deep industry expertise to deliver what the industry truly needs: not just more data, but better answers. From real-time operational intelligence to strategic decision-making, we power the entire travel ecosystem, from airlines and airports to technology companies and financial institutions.

We are actively embedding AI throughout our intelligence layer, combining nearly a century of proprietary data with the latest technology to deliver answers that were simply not possible before.

We exist because travel moves the world, and we move travel. By transforming complexity into clarity and questions into answers, we give our partners the intelligence they need to thrive in an evolving world. For more information visit www.oag.com

ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Corporate Counsel reviews and negotiates a wide range of agreements across all companies in the OAG corporate structure, keeping commercial deals moving at pace, with standard agreements currently turned around within a maximum of three days. Reporting to the Director of Legal, you will act as a trusted advisor to the sales organisation and the wider business, striking a sensible, practical balance between legal risk and sound commercial judgement. You will also maintain corporate filings and registrations, support governance and insurance matters, and deputise for the Director of Legal when required. Success looks like contracts that close quickly and safely, clean and timely corporate filings, and commercial teams who are confident in the contracting process.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

  • Own commercial drafting end-to-end: Draft, review and negotiate contracts and amendments across the OAG group, working to fast turnaround targets for standard agreements.
  • Negotiate supply chain and manufacturing agreements, and technology partnerships including revenue share and other non-standard commercial models
  • Develop and implement legal efficiencies that support and improve contracting processes across the business, including templates, playbooks, guidelines when using AI-assisted contract review tooling.Seek continuous improvement in all areas of responsibility, recommend changes, and manage and lead on commercial or regulatory initiatives to ensure that implementation is successfully achieved
  • Deliver regular training on the sales and contract process for regional sales teams, including during onboarding and whenever Regional Sales Directors need it.
  • Update Salesforce with agreed custom terms and conditions and help ensure signed agreements reach Legal and are filed in the contract management system.
  • Manage, review and submit corporate registrations, ensuring all documentation is submitted on time and without penalties.
  • Support broader Legal department generalist work, including corporate governance compliance and insurance.
  • Assist the Director of Legal and deputise in their absence as required.
  • Be a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Product, Supply Chain, Finance, and the executive team.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

  • Strong commercial transactional experience with enterprises of all sizes, including selling to governmental entities, both domestic and international.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain legal requirements succinctly and simply to non-legal colleagues.
  • The ability to strike a sensible, practical balance between legal risk and sound business judgement.
  • A good working knowledge of data protection, AI, privacy and information security.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and conflicting priorities, with strong organisational skills and experience working with cross-functional teams.
  • Good judgement, attention to detail and discretion in handling sensitive and confidential information.

IF YOU HAVE THE FOLLOWING THAT WOULD BE GREAT:

  • Experience in aviation, travel technology or a data/SaaS business.
  • Experience training or enabling commercial teams on contracting processes.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Deal hub or contract lifecycle management systems.
  • Prior experience managing or mentoring junior legal colleagues.

If you don’t meet every requirement but feel excited about this role, we’d still love to hear from you.

WE WILL OFFER YOU:

🚀 A progressive, non-hierarchical culture where innovation drives everything we build

🏡 Flexible working arrangements that allow remote work or office attendance

💰 An attractive compensation and benefits package, including access to a Simplyhealth cash plan to support your everyday health and wellbeing, a company bonus scheme, Octopus EV salary sacrifice scheme and enhanced pension scheme

🏖️ 25 days holiday plus bank holidays, volunteering days and additional day off during your birthday month

👪 Inclusive family benefits designed to support you through parenthood and fertility journeys

🌍 Work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 1 month per year

📚 Annual learning and development budget.

OAG is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and able to perform at their best.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences. If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know — we’re happy to have an open conversation about how we can support you.

Achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. Grow your career, access top-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network.

Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.

Description

About the Job

The Senior Manager – Sales Information Systems serves as the business owner for the Sales Performance Management and incentive compensation platform supporting travel agency and sales manager incentive programs. The role is responsible for defining, prioritizing, and supporting the delivery of business and digital technology solutions and partners with technology development teams and business stakeholders to drive the implementation of new system capabilities and enhancements to existing platforms. The position leads multiple teams and partners across the organization to maximize technology investments, improve operational effectiveness, and advance platform capabilities. The successful candidate will help shape technology strategies, guide organizational priorities, and ensure solutions deliver measurable business value.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the business owner for the assigned business platform, establishing platform strategy, governance, roadmap priorities, and the long-term operating model.
  • Lead collaboration with business stakeholders and end-users to define, design, implement, and manage enterprise business system solutions and technology projects.
  • Maximize the value of existing business applications and technologies by aligning platform capabilities with evolving business requirements and strategic objectives.
  • Identify, assess, and manage technology risks, including potential system downtime and impacts associated with system changes and enhancements.
  • Partner proactively with stakeholders to improve data structures, business processes, system functionality, and overall technology effectiveness.
  • Identify training and user enablement needs and partner with internal teams and external resources to secure solutions that support successful platform adoption and utilization.
  • Manage functional and user acceptance testing strategies, including resource planning, execution oversight, and performance tracking to ensure successful deployments.
  • Provide leadership and direction to managers, professional staff, and technology partners while executing business, operational, and organizational priorities.
  • Drive strategic roadmaps, digital transformation efforts, process automation opportunities, and governance practices that support long-term technology success.

Note: This position offers a hybrid work arrangement based at Willis Tower in Chicago, IL.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience leading technology, digital product management, business systems, or enterprise application initiatives
  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Experience leading multiple teams, professional staff, and/or external technology vendors while driving organizational priorities and business outcomes
  • Strong expertise in systems design, systems integration, requirements management, business partnering, project/program management, and change management
  • Demonstrated experience collaborating with business and technology stakeholders to translate business objectives and program requirements into system capabilities, roadmap priorities and actionable plans to deliver enterprise technology solutions and digital transformation initiatives
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without sponsorship
  • Successful completion of interview required to meet job qualification
  • Reliable, punctual attendance is an essential function of the position

Preferred Qualifications

  • 8+ years’ experience in sales operations, business systems, product/platform management or related business technology disciplines
  • Experience with incentive compensation programs, sales performance management platforms, or other highly configurable business platforms, such as Oracle Fusion, Oracle Incentive Compensation, or Varicent
  • Experience with digital transformation, process automation, and technology governance initiatives
  • Knowledge of artificial intelligence/machine learning applications in business and technology environments
  • Experience managing software providers, implementation partners, and consultants, including vendor performance, knowledge transfer, documentation, and the transition to sustainable internal support
  • Experience leading business platforms through implementation, stabilization, adoption, governance, and long-term operational maturity
  • Demonstrates an understanding of the capabilities and limitations of generative AI tools and effectively leverages them to support research, analysis, content creation, and problem-solving. Apply critical thinking to validate AI-generated outputs while adhering to organizational policies for responsible AI use, data privacy, and security.

The base pay range for this role is $127,870.00 to $166,492.00.

The base salary range/hourly rate listed is dependent on job-related, factors such as experience, education, and skills. This position is also eligible for bonus and/or long-term incentive compensation awards.

You may be eligible for the following competitive benefits: medical, dental, vision, life, accident & disability, parental leave, employee assistance program, commuter, paid holidays, paid time off, 401(k) and flight privileges.

job.job_description:
Summary of Position

The Event Specialist supports the planning and execution of meetings, conferences, and events by providing event management, registration, venue sourcing, attendee management, and technology solutions to clients. This role serves as a trusted partner throughout the event lifecycle, guiding clients through planning milestones, managing event-related technologies, supporting budgeting activities, and delivering exceptional customer service. The Event Specialist collaborates closely with clients, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to ensure successful event outcomes while identifying opportunities to improve processes, efficiencies, and overall client experience.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead clients through event planning phases using milestone-based planning practices and clearly communicate timelines, deliverables, and expectations.
  • Support the planning and delivery of meetings, conferences, and events, ensuring a high level of client service and operational excellence.
  • Utilize event management tools, templates, and documentation to support planning, execution, and reporting activities.
  • Develop and maintain registration sites, attendee communications, reporting, and other event technology solutions as needed.
  • Conduct technology demonstrations and training sessions to support client understanding and adoption of event management platforms.
  • Support venue sourcing activities and maintain proficiency across various registration and event technology platforms.
  • Assist with attendee management, housing coordination, transportation logistics, audiovisual coordination, food and beverage planning, and virtual meeting support.
  • Maintain and track event budgets, identifying potential risks, opportunities, and cost-saving recommendations.
  • Present approved pricing for additional services and support revenue-generating opportunities.
  • Generate reports and analyze event-related data to support client objectives and business decisions.
  • Follow established sales-to-operations handoff processes to ensure seamless onboarding and delivery of new events.
  • Provide regular status updates to clients regarding milestones, registration activity, budget tracking, and event progress.
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with clients, suppliers, venues, and internal stakeholders.
  • Stay informed on emerging event technology solutions, industry trends, and best practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes, efficiencies, and client outcomes, and share recommendations with leadership.
  • Ensure event records, tracking tools, and reporting systems remain current and accurate.
  • Provide on-site event support and travel as required.

Perform other duties as assigned.

Required of all CTM Positions

  • Embrace CTM’s core values of Connect, Deliver and Evolve.
  • Professional, collaborative & supportive interaction with employees, clients, suppliers or vendors
  • Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
  • Appropriate and professional written and verbal communication.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines, handle and prioritize simultaneous requests.
  • Creative and analytical thinking with strong problem-solving and consultative skills.
  • Demonstrates calm under pressure – is a proactive contributor and eager to learn.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Ability to do basic math.
  • Ability to read and interpret information.
  • Attention to detail.
  • Regular and reliable attendance.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Event Management, Hospitality Management, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field preferred. Equivalent experience may be substituted.
  • Two to five years of experience in event planning, meeting management, hospitality, conference services, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting registration platforms, attendee management systems, or event technology solutions preferred.
  • Experience managing multiple projects and deadlines in a client-facing environment.
  • Knowledge of corporate meetings, conferences, and event operations preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Knowledge of meeting and event planning principles, processes, and industry best practices.
  • Understanding of attendee management, venue sourcing, registration technology, virtual meeting solutions, housing management, and event logistics.
  • Ability to learn and adapt to various event technology and registration platforms.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple events simultaneously.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and client relationship management skills.
  • Ability to analyze event data and prepare accurate reports and recommendations.
  • Knowledge of budget management principles and the ability to identify risks and opportunities.
  • Strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and decision-making abilities.
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively across departments and with external stakeholders.
  • Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering exceptional service.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to a team environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and event-related technology platforms.

job.job_description:
Performance Lead – Booking Assistance | Tripadvisor

About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

Who are we looking for?

We are seeking a Performance Lead – Booking Assistance to drive conversion performance and enhance customer experience across our global outsourced operations. In this role, you will bridge strategy and frontline execution to foster operational excellence across our BPO partner network. By combining strong leadership with sharp commercial acumen, you will establish robust governance, develop agent capabilities, and align vendor partners with our growth and satisfaction goals.

The ideal candidate is a data-driven problem solver skilled at turning operational analytics into actionable insights and product improvements. You will analyse conversion funnels, identify drop-off causes, and partner with Service Excellence, Product, Tech, and Data teams to reduce booking friction. Whether shaping AI roadmaps or leading experiments, your ability to influence stakeholders and champion customer-first innovation will directly boost conversions and improve the booking journey.

Job Location: Hybrid

This role is a hybrid position that requires 1-2 days per week in our London office.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive Booking Conversion: Rigorously track and analyse funnel performance to unlock incremental conversion growth and deliver measurable revenue impact across outsourced channels.
  • Lead Vendor Excellence: Partner with BPO leadership to establish accountability, execute targeted performance improvement plans, and elevate frontline agent capabilities.
  • Diagnose Root Causes: Conduct deep-dive analyses to isolate key conversion blockers across product features, operational processes, supply availability, pricing, and agent execution.
  • Optimize Customer Journeys: Translate frontline customer insights into concrete improvement initiatives, collaborating cross-functionally with Product and Supply to eliminate journey friction.
  • Champion AI & Automation: Co-design and implement next-generation AI tooling with Product and Tech teams, integrating Agent Assist, smart routing, and personalized support capabilities.
  • Pioneer Operational Experiments: Design, launch, and evaluate pilot projects and A/B tests to validate conversion enhancements and scale high-impact strategies across networks.
  • Deliver Strategic Insights: Synthesize complex data into clear, compelling executive narratives that explain drivers, trends, and action plans to key stakeholders.
  • Mobilize Cross-Functional Teams: Champion resolution of complex operational blockers by aligning executive sponsors, product owners, and vendor partners toward common goals.

Minimum Qualifications & Experience

  • Proven track record (5+ years) driving operational execution, sales/conversion growth, or performance management in customer-centric environments.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Economics, or equivalent practical industry experience.
  • Demonstrated expertise in managing outsourced BPO operations, holding vendors accountable, and driving continuous capability improvements.
  • Expert command of conversion funnel metrics, operational SLAs, and customer behavior modeling.
  • Strong analytical capability to perform root-cause analysis and translate raw operational data into actionable strategic programs.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence Product, Engineering, and Supply stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Uncompromising customer-first mindset balanced with sharp commercial awareness.

Skills You Should Bring To The Role

  • Commercial Mindset: Strong understanding of conversion and ability to connect operational performance with booking outcomes.
  • Data Driven: Ability to use data to generate insights, identify root causes and prioritise opportunities.
  • Vendor Leadership: Ability to influence BPO leadership, challenge performance and drive accountability.
  • Strategic Thinking: Able to look beyond agent performance and identify wider customer journey, product and process opportunities.
  • Experimentation: Strong test-and-learn/A-B testing mindset with the ability to measure impact.
  • AI & Technology: Understanding of how AI, automation and Agent Assist can improve customer journeys and frontline performance.
  • Industry: Experience within Travel, e-commerce or a marketplace environment.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!

Job description:

Why Wyndham?

By joining Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, you will play an integral role in our mission to make hotel travel possible for all. At Wyndham, we provide all team members the opportunity to grow through best-in-class training and career development, leadership training, mentorship opportunities and educational support.  Supporting our team members is a top priority, which is why we offer competitive compensation and benefits, vacation, team member appreciation days, workplace flexibility and much more.  At Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, we value and embrace a culture of diversity, equity and inclusion that supports team members of all backgrounds and experiences. We can’t wait to welcome you!

Supporting thousands of franchisees and a growing global portfolio of 25 hotel brands—think household names like Wyndham, La Quinta, Ramada, Days Inn and Super 8—Wyndham team members are a widespread group of individuals with diverse interests and backgrounds. Our unique Count on Me culture, commitment to flexibility and core values of Integrity, Accountability, Inclusivity, Caring and Fun are just part of what continues to make Wyndham an award-winning best place to work.

Wyndham Hotels & Resorts is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

Job Summary

Marriott Bonvoy sits at the center of a global travel ecosystem, creating meaningful connections between members and thousands of hotels worldwide. The Director, Redemption Products will help shape how members experience the value of their points while supporting the financial strength and continued growth of the program. With influence across a large, complex redemption business, the role will use insights into member behavior, hotel performance, market dynamics, and program economics to identify opportunities and guide the evolution of redemption products. This is a highly visible opportunity to improve a defining part of the Bonvoy member experience while balancing the needs of members, hotels, owners, and the broader enterprise.

Reporting to the Senior Director, Redemption Products, the Director will operate at the intersection of strategy, analytics, technology, and execution, working closely with teams across Loyalty, Finance, Revenue Management, Predictive Analytics, Digital, Operations, and the Continents. The position combines forward-looking strategy with hands-on problem solving—from interpreting sophisticated analyses and evaluating business trade-offs to shaping technology-enabled solutions and bringing new concepts into the market. The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker and compelling communicator who is energized by ambiguity, comfortable influencing senior stakeholders, and able to convert complex information into practical direction. Success requires curiosity, sound judgment, financial acumen, and the ability to move seamlessly between long-term opportunities and the day-to-day realities of a global loyalty program.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Required

Education and Experience

  • 8+ years of relevant professional experience in loyalty, finance, revenue management, customer analytics or related function
  • 4-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Economics, or related major
  • Experience analyzing and manipulating large data sets using SQL, SAS, R, or Python, and visualizing outputs in Tableau or Power BI.

Preferred

  • Masters of Business Administration or Economics
  • Revenue Management or Finance experience
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional projects, manage processes across diverse stakeholder groups, and influence outside formal reporting lines.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

  • Lead the strategy, governance, monitoring, and ongoing refinement of Marriott Bonvoy redemption pricing across the global hotel portfolio.
  • Manage program economics for current and emerging award products, balancing member value, owner economics, redemption demand, and the long-term financial sustainability of the program.
  • Partner with Predictive Analytics, Revenue Management, Finance, and Continent teams to define and optimize redemption pricing algorithms, property-level parameters, point ranges, value targets, controls, and deployment strategies.
  • Quantify projected and actual financial and customer impacts of pricing, reimbursement, inventory, and policy decisions, including effects on demand, member value, displacement, and program cost.
  • Monitor redemption performance and emerging trends through recurring analysis and executive reporting on volume, demand, pricing, reimbursement, member behavior, and market performance; recommend strategic actions when needed.
  • Build analytical models, dashboards, scenario analyses, and decision frameworks that translate complex data into clear recommendations for senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Serve as the business lead for technology capabilities supporting redemption pricing by defining business rules, requirements, controls, dependencies, testing, and implementation priorities.
  • Drive cross-functional development and launch of new redemption products including coordinating sequencing, risk mitigation, readiness, communications, and operational pull-through.
  • Engage Owner and Franchisee communities and internal stakeholders to understand concerns, evaluate property-level impacts, resolve escalations, and build support for redemption and reimbursement decisions.
  • Develop executive recommendations, communicate trade-offs, secure alignment, and support governance decisions across senior leadership and key cross-functional partners.
  • Provide functional leadership to analytical resources responsible for redemption operations and analysis by setting priorities, reviewing methodologies and outputs, coordinating workloads, and strengthening team capabilities.

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.  We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

All positions offer a 401(k) plan, stock purchase plan, discounts at Marriott properties, commuter benefits, employee assistance plan, and childcare discounts. Benefits are subject to terms and conditions, which may include rules regarding eligibility, enrollment, waiting period, contribution, benefit limits, election changes, benefit exclusions, and others. Click here to learn more.

Full-time positions also offer coverage for medical, dental, vision, health care flexible spending account, dependent care flexible spending account, life insurance, disability insurance, accident insurance, adoption expense reimbursements, paid parental leave and educational assistance.

Washington Applicants Only: Employees will accrue paid sick leave, 0.077 PTO balance for every hour worked and be eligible to receive a minimum of 9 holidays annually.

Marriott Headquarters (HQ) supports a hybrid work environment that helps associates Be Connected. HQ based roles are generally hybrid and require regular in-office presence at the assigned location, including for candidates who live within commuting distance of HQ for a role listed as remote. Remote roles will be clearly identified in the job posting.

Marriott International is the world’s largest hotel company, with more brands, more hotels and more opportunities for associates to grow and succeed. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction to the Team

The Traveler Business Team builds and drives growth for our global consumer businesses—Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo. This division creates compelling and differentiated traveler value for each brand by setting the strategic vision, operating strategy, and plan. Responsibilities include investment allocation and prioritization, P&L accountability, and leading cross-functional teams across Expedia Group, who are all held accountable to a single scorecard.

Vrbo is seeking an Accountant to join its revenue accounting team in Springfield, Missouri. Reporting to the Director, Accounting, you will support core revenue accounting processes for our global online vacation rental business. This role offers an opportunity to develop expertise in revenue recognition, financial systems, data analysis, and process improvement within a technology-driven travel company.

Key Responsibilities

In This Role, You Will

  • Support monthly and quarterly revenue accounting close activities, including journal entries, close procedures, and account reconciliations.
  • Prepare, maintain, and analyze reconciliations for restricted cash, revenue, deferred revenue, accounts receivable, and related accounts.
  • Assist with applying and documenting revenue recognition policies under U.S. GAAP and applicable accounting standards.
  • Review transactional data, investigate variances and unusual activity, and resolve reconciliation differences.
  • Communicate accounting issues and escalate risks promptly and appropriately.
  • Help maintain effective SOX controls, accounting documentation, and audit-ready support.
  • Support quarterly and year-end audits by gathering schedules, documentation, and evidence.
  • Partner with Sales, FP&A, Product Management, Legal, Tax, and technology teams to address accounting and data questions.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, and improve revenue accounting processes and reporting.
  • Build knowledge of revenue systems, reporting tools, and data sources while contributing to an inclusive and collaborative team environment.

Required

Experience and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience.
  • Up to three years of accounting experience, including internship, public accounting, corporate accounting, or relevant financial reporting experience.
  • Foundational knowledge of accounting principles, including account reconciliations, journal entries, and financial close activities.
  • Experience reviewing transactional data, investigating variances, or analyzing financial information.
  • Proficient Excel skills, with careful attention to detail, organization, confidentiality, and follow-through.
  • Clear communication skills and a collaborative approach to working with teammates and cross-functional partners.

Preferred

  • Interest in developing expertise in revenue recognition and experience with U.S. GAAP.
  • Familiarity with SQL, Power Query, Tableau, financial systems, or similar reporting and data tools.
  • Experience supporting SOX controls, audits, process documentation, or process improvement initiatives.

The total cash range for this position in Springfield is $55,000.00 to $77,000.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $88,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Benefits And Perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. job.job_description:
Overview

Du hast Lust während deines Studiums viele praktische Erfahrung zu sammeln, wichtige Kompetenzen zu erlernen und nützliche Kontakte zu knüpfen, die deiner Karriere weiterhelfen? Dann bist du bei Enterprise genau richtig!

Als weltgrößter Mobilitätsdienstleister triffst du bei Enterprise auf ein wachsendes internationales Unternehmen mit spannenden Herausforderungen und ungeahnten Aufstiegschancen. Stell dir über 1,7 Millionen Fahrzeuge an 9.500 globalen Standorten mit 80.000 Mitarbeitenden vor, die einen Jahresumsatz von 22,5 Milliarden US-Dollar einfahren. Dann hast du einen ersten Eindruck von uns!

Responsibilities

Dein Praktikum wirst du in einer unserer 200 deutschlandweit Teams absolvieren und so unser Unternehmen von der Pike auf kennenlernen. Kaffeekochen und Kopieren steht für unsere Praktikanten nicht auf dem Programm: Vom ersten Arbeitstag an wirst du ins Tagesgeschäft mit einbezogen und erlernst so neue Kenntnisse wie Führungsqualitäten, Flexibilität und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten "on the job". Dabei erwarten dich abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben und spannende Herausforderungen im Kundenservice, im Vertrieb, im Marketing oder im Business-Management. So zum Beispiel:

  • Verkaufsgespräche zu führen
  • Geschäftspartnerschaften aufzubauen und zu pflegen
  • Effektiv mit Kunden, Lieferanten und Kollegen zu kommunizieren und zu interagieren
  • Kostenkontrolle
  • Strategien zur Konfliktlösung
  • Flottenplanung

Bei Enterprise ist kein Tag wie der andere!

Und das Beste: Wenn du dich nach deinem Hochschulabschluss entscheidest, an unserem Management Trainee Programm teilzunehmen, dann werden dir die bereits im Praktikum erworbenen Kenntnisse angerechnet. Das verkürzt deine Zeit als Trainee und einer steilen Karriere bei Enterprise steht nichts mehr im Wege. Selbst wenn du dich nach dem Studium entscheidest, woanders zu arbeiten, so hast du doch durch dein Praktikum bei uns eine erstklassige Berufserfahrung vorzuweisen, die nicht nur auf deinem Lebenslauf gut aussieht, sondern dir in Jobinterviews und in deiner weiteren Karriere helfen wird. Ein Praktikum im Management bei Enterprise lohnt sich also wirklich! Und das auch im wörtlichen Sinne, denn alle unsere Praktika werden vergütet.

Qualifications

Unsere Praktika sind um dich herum konzipiert. Es spielt für uns keine Rolle, in welchem Semester du bist, welchen Studiengang du studierst oder wann du bei uns anfangen willst. Wie lange willst du dein Praktikum bei uns absolvieren? Das hängt ganz von dir ab. Du hast die Wahl zwischen mehrmonatigen Sommerpraktika bis hin zu ganzjährigen Praktika, die du jederzeit beginnen kannst. Und bei der großen Auswahl an unseren Filialen in Deutschland haben wir mit Sicherheit auch einen freien Praktikumsplatz an deinem Wunschort.

Wir freuen uns, wenn du motiviert bist, Eigeninitiative zeigst und Verantwortung übernehmen willst. Alles andere bringen wir dir während deines Praktikums bei. Und es werden sich für dich viele interessante Möglichkeiten und Situationen ergeben, in denen du richtig loslegen und uns zeigen kannst, was in dir steckt – egal wie lange du bei uns bleibst.

Auch Solltest Du In Deinem Gepäck Haben

  • Eine unbegrenzte Arbeitserlaubnis in Deutschland.
  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
  • Einen gültigen deutschen Führerschein und 1 Jahr lang Fahrpraxis.
  • Höchstens 3 Punkt im Fahreignungsregister (FAER) in Flensburg und keine Vermerke in deiner Fahrerakte aus den letzten 5 Jahren aufgrund von Alkohol- oder Drogendelikten.
  • Solltest du aufgrund einer körperlichen Einschränkung nicht Auto fahren können, bewirb dich bitte trotzdem. Gemeinsam werden wir eine Lösung finden.

Bitte bewirb dich nur einmal, und zwar direkt auf die Stelle in der Region, in der du arbeiten möchtest. Bei deinem ersten Gespräch mit unserem Recruiter kannst du aber gerne die möglichen Einsatzgebiete noch im Detail besprechen.
