Legal Counsel – Consumer Law (Hybrid)

As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, " What's the next step?’’ Start your journey with us!

We are looking for Legal Counsel to join our Business Legal team in Barcelona .Your focus will be consumer law across major European jurisdictions, with a focus on Spain, Germany, France, Italy and the UK. However, you will be part of a small but high performing international team of lawyers each working on domestic and global topics, and you will therefore have multi-regional responsibility and be pivotal in the provision of quality cross-border legal advice. If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.

Join the world's leading travel subscription platform

We pioneered Prime, the first and world’s leading travel subscription programme since launching in 2017.

Millions of Prime members every year across multiple markets.

5 brands: eDreams, GO Voyages, Opodo, Travellink, and the metasearch engine Liligo

This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalised service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members.

Diversity is our strength that’s why our eDOers are coming from different nationalities from all continents – 99% permanent contracts

Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a Legal Counsel in the Business Legal team you will be in charge of:

  • Advise on current consumer law and the application of same across our websites in our products, content and services, including in particular our travel subscription programme;
  • Draft, update and maintain terms and conditions of our websites/apps and our products and services;
  • Manage processes and dialogues with relevant public administrations and consumer protection authorities across key European jurisdictions;
  • Liaise with internal stakeholders and business teams to ensure that legal concepts are communicated clearly, and legal frameworks are incorporated into business practices;
  • Contribute to the legal team’s precedent bank in the creation and maintenance of internal Know How and guidance documents;
  • Horizon scan for upcoming regulatory changes that may impact the business and assist in the implementation where needed;
  • Provide training to other team members and business stakeholder
  • Manage outside legal counsel (including working to budget allowances);
  • Provide support to other members of the legal team, and to business teams, on an as-needed basis;


What do you need to succeed:

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:

  • Degree in Law with qualification to practice law in a European jurisdiction (preferrably Spain, Germany, France, or the UK);
  • Fluent in English (working language). Native or professional proficiency in a second European language is a strong preference (e.g. Spanish, German, French, or Italian). The candidate must have excellent communication (written and verbal) skills in English and relevant market languages, with the ability to draft complex legal texts;
  • A minimum of 5+ years’ professional experience practising as a lawyer, with a combination of private practice and in-house with consumer law focus preferred;
  • Strong consumer law knowledge and experience in the digital sector is required, experience in the travel industry an advantage but not essential;
  • Experience managing procedures with public administrations and/or related to Consumers or Travel industry preferred;
  • Excellent communication and influencing skills with strict attention to detail and the ability to manage projects and priorities;
  • Strong work ethic and organisational skills with the desire and motivation to design and implement streamlined procedures and workflows;
  • Versatility is essential as you will be asked to assist in a wide range of matters.


What's in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture.

Here's what we offer:

A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and premium equipment with role-based selection options and device ownership through our equipment lifecycle program when it reaches its refresh cycle.

Your Well-being is our Priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcomes. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.

Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padel tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.

Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.

Wanna take a peek into what it's like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Our people are the key to our success. Each one of them is unique in their own way and the respect for their uniqueness is and will always be a passion and motivation. Don’t meet every requirement? If you’re excited about this role but do not feel your experience aligns perfectly with all the requirements we strongly encourage you to apply nevertheless.

Apply now!

Job Summary:

The Director of Luxury Sales is a dynamic and results-oriented leader responsible for overseeing all leisure sales initiatives for an ultra-luxury property. You'll be instrumental in driving revenue by developing and executing strategic sales plans to attract and retain high-net-worth leisure clients, travel advisors, and luxury travel consortia.

This role demands a passion for exceptional service, a deep understanding of the luxury market, and a proven track record of exceeding sales targets. You will be responsible for managing and expanding a portfolio of key accounts, building and nurturing strong relationships with industry partners, and representing the resort at various industry events. Your expertise in luxury service culture and your commitment to brand standards will be critical in ensuring a seamless and elevated experience for all guests.

A little bit about your day:

Reporting to the Director of Sales & Marketing, every day is different, but you’ll mostly:

  • Strategic Sales Development: Develop and implement comprehensive strategic sales plans to secure new corporate and leisure accounts, while simultaneously nurturing and expanding existing business relationships.

  • Team Leadership:
    • Provide guidance, mentorship, and support to property-level leisure sales teams, ensuring consistency and excellence in execution.
    • Monitor team booking goals and performance, offering coaching and development opportunities.
  • Internal Collaboration: Partner closely with internal teams—including Sales, Marketing, Events, and Operations—to ensure a seamless and exceptional experience for all clients and their guests.
  • Luxury Service Excellence: Demonstrate a deep understanding of luxury service culture and an unwavering commitment to upholding Regent brand standards.

What we need from you:

  • A minimum of 5-8 years of progressive sales experience in luxury hospitality, with at least 3-5 years in a senior leisure sales leadership role.

  • International sales experience and cultural fluency are often a plus.
  • Work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.

What you can expect from us:

The salary pay range for this role is $130,000.00 to $150,000.00. This range is only applicable for jobs to be performed at Regent Santa Monica Beach. This position is eligible for bonus pay.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time-off, wellness and sick time, medical/dental/vision insurance, 401k plan, complimentary parking, employee cafeteria meals, and many other benefits to eligible colleagues. job.job_description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

Landing pages are one of GetYourGuide's most important product surfaces — the moment where acquisition meets experience, and where the quality of what we build directly determines whether a visitor becomes a customer.

Your mission

As Lead Product Manager for Landing Pages, you will own a high-traffic surface that sits at the intersection of growth, acquisition, and user experience. You will work closely with paid search, paid media, and SEO stakeholders to ensure the pages you build perform across channels, while keeping the traveller's needs at the centre of every decision. Your cross-functional team includes engineers, designers, analysts, and researchers.

This is a role for someone who thinks in systems, is energised by the product-marketing boundary, and wants to build something that scales — not just ship features. The work has direct visibility into how GetYourGuide grows, and the decisions made here have a measurable impact on the business from day one.

We are looking for a Lead PM who brings both strategic clarity and executional rigour — someone who can set a vision, bring stakeholders along, and deliver.

What You'll Do

  • Build modular, reusable infrastructure — page templates, content modules, and page logic — that compounds in value over time. You are not optimising individual features; you are building the foundation that makes everything that follows faster and cheaper.
  • Develop and implement a strategy for your product area, set clear measurable goals, and take full responsibility for outcomes. Connect your roadmap to the company's mission, break it into actionable steps, and create genuine excitement for the long-term vision — with your team, across functions, and with executive leadership.
  • Apply your understanding of acquisition channel economics and how landing page content drives channel performance. Partner closely with paid search, paid media, and SEO stakeholders to ensure pages serve channel needs without being built around any single one. Hold user experience and channel performance goals together rather than trading them off.
  • Design and own an experimentation system at scale — not just individual A/B tests, but the architecture and cadence that enables rapid, parallel testing across page types and channels. Build toward a model that increases the speed and independence of experimentation over time.
  • Use customer feedback, market trends, and business metrics to drive decisions. Prioritise ruthlessly, re-evaluate the roadmap as new insights arrive, and make clear calls on sequencing to maximise both impact and learning.
  • Represent customer interests at all levels of the organisation. Act with openness and transparency with your team, peers, and leadership. Coach and mentor team members, foster a culture of continuous improvement, and bring others along on the vision.

Your toolkit

  • 6+ years of experience in product management, with at least 2 years as a Lead or Senior PM owning a product area end-to-end — including strategy, goal-setting, roadmap execution, and KPI accountability.
  • A systems thinker who builds for scale. You have experience building product infrastructure or platforms — not just features — and you understand how foundational work compounds over time.
  • Experience working at the intersection of product and marketing, growth, or acquisition. You have a working understanding of how channels like paid search, paid social, or SEO use product surfaces to drive performance, and you're comfortable holding user experience and channel performance goals together.
  • Strong analytical skills with demonstrated experience in experimentation — designing testing methodology and cadence, not just interpreting results. You know how to build a testing culture and move a team toward data-informed decisions at speed.
  • Proven ability to build alignment across engineering, design, analytics, and marketing stakeholders. You bring people along through clear thinking and strong communication rather than through authority.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. You can translate complex product and technical concepts for executive, marketing, and engineering audiences equally well.
  • Bonus: Experience in a marketplace, e-commerce, or travel business.
  • Bonus: A background in engineering or data science — particularly valuable given the technical architecture nature of this role.

How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary

  • Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
  • Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
  • A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.
  • Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events
  • Monthly transportation and fitness budget
  • Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
  • Language reimbursement program
  • Health and wellness benefits

And more…

How To Apply

Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘how we hire’ and ‘life at GetYourGuide’. If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to get in touch at jobs@getyourguide.com.

Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with your application.

WE ARE PRICELINE.

job.job_description:
Data Science Engineer

We are seeking a Data Science Engineer to join our global Operations Research team, where innovation knows no borders. This team applies advanced statistical analysis, data modeling, and predictive analytics to solve complex strategic and operational challenges in the airline industry. It helps airlines optimize revenue performance, advance retailing and distribution through Offer/Order Management and Continuous Dynamic Pricing, and elevate the traveler experience. With an inclusive culture and flexible work environment, we work together with boldness, curiosity and commitment so we can all win together.

As a Data Science Engineer, you will translate complex business questions into robust statistical models, define critical KPIs, and communicate empirical results to internal and external decision makers. You will source data across diverse platforms, build high-quality data manipulation scripts, and apply machine learning algorithms to drive predictive insights and product development cycles. This role requires expert analytical capability, proactive collaboration with software development teams, and the drive to deliver measurable business outcomes.

What you'll do

  • Partner with airline subject matter experts to turn operational and consumer data into actionable predictions that optimize customer behavior and business performance.
  • Develop, test, and calibrate custom data models, forecasting techniques, and machine learning algorithms, performing proof-of-concept studies and proving value through benchmark demonstrations.
  • Sourced data from multiple data sources and write high-quality data manipulation scripts in R, Python, Perl, and bash.
  • Collaborate with software engineers to write, implement, and test production-quality C++ and Python code for forecasting and data analytics tools.
  • Establish monitoring processes and tools to continuously evaluate data accuracy, assess model performance, and resolve software improvements or customer complaints.

What you'll bring

Required Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in Statistics, Operations Research, Computer Science, Mathematics, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • Advanced programming skills in Python and modern C++, alongside proficiency in R, SQL, PySpark, Perl, bash, Java, or JavaScript.
  • Proven ability to apply advanced statistical concepts (regression, distributions, hypothesis testing) and machine learning techniques (clustering, decision trees, neural networks) to real-world problems.
  • Experience deploying statistical and machine learning models in cloud environments using services like Amazon SageMaker and Amazon Forecast.
  • Strong communication skills with demonstrated experience presenting graphical analytics to clients, sales, and software engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Industry experience or domain knowledge in airline, hospitality, or retailing decision support systems.
  • Hands-on experience developing customer choice models, price elasticity estimations, and market potential estimations.
  • Practical understanding of airline distribution, pricing, revenue management, NDC, and Offer/Order Management concepts.

Benefits That Support You

We know support looks different for everyone. That is why Sabre offers benefits beyond medical and financial coverage, with programs designed to support your well-being, growth and life outside work:

  • Competitive pay and performance-based bonuses
  • Flexible work options
  • Comprehensive healthcare coverage
  • Generous PTO and holidays
  • Strong retirement planning support
  • Family-friendly benefits
  • Professional development opportunities

Achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. Grow your career, access top-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network.

Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.

Description

At United, we have some of the best aircraft in the world. Our Technical Operations team is full of aircraft maintenance technicians, engineers, planners, ground equipment and facilities professionals, and supply chain teams that help make sure they’re well taken care of and ready to get our customers to their desired destinations. If you’re ready to work on our planes, join our Tech Ops experts and help keep our fleet in tip-top shape.

Job Overview And Responsibilities

Assistant Manager – Aircraft Tooling is responsible to manage their portfolio by reviewing, procuring and allocating all aircraft tooling in respect to United’s operational demand and schedule. Additionally, they will provide oversight on their team member’s portfolio maintenance. They create the standard tooling requirements for each fleet type and mission, maintain list of non-standard tools requested by stations. They support tooling logistics systemwide and coordinate the movement of tools. They work closely with customers (station toolrooms) and vendors to foster those relationships. It is also the responsibility of the tooling planning assistant manager to contribute in continuous improvement and cost savings initiatives as they relate to aircraft tooling.

  • Oversight of team members contribution to system support with regards to their portfolios and performs the administrative duties required to manage their team
  • Provide employees with the tools to efficiently and effectively perform their daily activities
  • Assess tooling requirements at each station based on fleet type and maintenance missions
  • Assign Property Control numbers and allocate to the stations in collaboration with the Line and Base teams
  • Ensure Request for Quote (RFQ) are supplied in order to evaluate and negotiate price points / lead times and sense of urgency for purchase from a multitude of external tool vendors
  • Provide coverage and follow up for their team members as needed
  • Lead processes and application improvements, training and coaching to improve the productivity of the Company’s tooling assets.
  • Provide OSV and line maintenance start-ups with the required tooling and review surplus and spare tooling inventory on a continual basis.
  • Act as a single point of contact for all tooling lease opportunities.
  • Coordinate with lease requestor to establish appropriate pricing, documentation and tracking for the lease’s entire life cycle.
  • Support QA / QC audits and perform periodic tooling audits through-out operation
  • Evaluate current environment vs. potential expansion requirements to develop and present operational opportunities for improvement concepts based on thorough research and experiences in order to support the increased demands on the position.

Qualifications

What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):

  • Bachelor's degree or 4 years of relevant work experience
  • BA/BS Degree and/or applicable Line or Base Aircraft Maintenance experience
  • Strong understanding of Continuous Improvement, Lean and Six Sigma principles
  • 3 years in Line or Base Maintenance environments

job.job_description:
Business Development Executive | Bokun

About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

About Bokun

Bókun, a Tripadvisor company, is the market-leading booking and channel management platform for the tours and activities industry. Thousands of Experience Operators around the world run their business on Bókun – from independent tour guides to multi-location attraction groups. We combine the reach and stability of a global leader with the speed and focus of a team that’s still building.

About The Role

We’re creating a new Business Development Executive role to close the gap between how Experience Operators discover Bókun and how they grow with us. Today, customers either self-serve their way in or land with a dedicated Business Development Manager once they’re a Key Account. This role owns everything in between.

You’ll own, grow and retain a portfolio of accounts with real potential – nurturing them over time and helping them get more value from Bókun. Some will grow into Key Accounts. Others will make this tier their long-term home, and need consistent account management and retention through our touchpoint programme – both are equally part of the job. You’ll also go after new business beyond our self-serve ICP: the accounts that need a conversation, not just a sign-up form. And you’ll work alongside our Business Development Managers to help qualify new potential enterprise opportunities.

It’s a role built for someone who’s equally comfortable prospecting cold leads and nurturing warm opportunities – patient enough to play the long game with an account, and driven enough to go and win the next one. Wherever each account is headed, they deserve someone who takes real ownership of getting them there.

Job Location: Hybrid

This role is a hybrid position that requires 2/3 days per week/month in our London office.

What You'll Do

  • Own, grow and retain a portfolio of accounts – driving growth toward Key Account status where the opportunity exists, and providing consistent account management and retention through our touchpoint programme for those that stay in this tier.
  • Win new business beyond our self-serve ICP – proactively identify, prospect and convert Experience Operators whose needs go beyond a self-serve sign-up.
  • Represent Bókun at industry events and trade shows, building pipeline and relationships through in-person prospecting.
  • Work alongside Business Development Managers to help qualify new potential enterprise opportunities – bringing research, discovery and relationship-building to deals as they take shape.
  • Run consultative discovery calls, demos and webinars that show Experience Operators the value of the Bókun platform.
  • Use Salesforce and sales data to track your pipeline, spot trends, and sharpen your approach to outreach, account growth and retention.
  • Consistently meet and exceed targets across new business acquisition, account growth and retention.

What You'll Bring To The Team

  • 3+ years of experience in sales, business development or account management, ideally in SaaS or B2B.
  • A track record that spans both sides of the job: winning new business and growing existing accounts.
  • Comfort working in a role that’s still being defined – you’ll help build the playbook, not just follow one.
  • Confident, consultative communication skills – on the phone, on a webinar, or on a trade show floor.
  • Highly organised, with the ability to juggle a large and varied portfolio – staying on top of many accounts at once and adapting quickly as priorities change.
  • Meticulous CRM discipline – you keep Salesforce accurate and up to date, and use data to guide decisions and track your own performance.
  • Willingness to travel for industry events and in-person prospecting.
  • Self-motivation, resilience and genuine curiosity about what makes growing travel businesses tick.
  • Fluency in English; proficiency in one or more additional European languages (e.g. Spanish, Italian, German) is highly desirable.

Why Bokun

If you’re driven by the challenge of building something new inside a market leader, we’d love to hear from you. At Bókun, we invest in our people, offer competitive compensation, and give you real room to grow.

What We Offer

The how to your wow. Reliable tech. Remarkable experiences.

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!

job.job_description:
Mach mit uns Lust auf Reisen

ltur steht seit über 30 Jahren für spontane Reisen, attraktive Angebote und echte Urlaubsmomente. Als Teil der TUI Group verbinden wir die Dynamik einer bekannten Last-Minute-Marke mit den Möglichkeiten und dem Netzwerk eines internationalen Touristikkonzerns.

Für unser E-Commerce-Team in Rastatt suchen wir ab sofort einen Junior Manager CRM (m/w/d) in Vollzeit (40 Std.). Die Position ist unbefristet.

In dieser Rolle unterstützt Du uns bei der Umsetzung unserer CRM-Aktivitäten und der digitalen Kundenkommunikation. Gemeinsam mit dem Senior Manager CRM bereitest Du Newsletter und CRM-Kampagnen vor, stellst deren Qualität sicher und wirkst bei Maßnahmen zur Leadgenerierung und Kundenaktivierung mit.

 

Deine Mission

Du unterstützt uns dabei, unsere Kundinnen und Kunden mit relevanten, ansprechenden und zielgruppengerechten Inhalten zu erreichen. Dabei begleitest Du unsere Newsletter und CRM-Kampagnen von der operativen Vorbereitung bis zur finalen Abnahme und sorgst gemeinsam mit internen Teams und externen Agenturen für eine zuverlässige Umsetzung.

Mit Deinem Blick fürs Detail trägst Du dazu bei, unsere digitale Kundenkommunikation kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln und echte Lust auf Reisen zu machen.

 

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du bereitest unsere regelmäßigen Newsletter und weiteren CRM-Kampagnen operativ vor.
  • Du stellst die benötigten Inhalte (Texte, Angebote, Bilder und Links) zusammen und übergibst sie inklusive Briefing an unsere E-Mail-Agentur.
  • Du prüfst die von der Agentur erstellten Newsletter-Drafts und stellst die Qualität von Inhalten, Betreffzeilen, Personalisierungen, Links und Tracking-Parametern sicher.
  • Du testest die Darstellung der Newsletter auf unterschiedlichen Endgeräten und in verschiedenen E-Mail-Programmen.
  • Du koordinierst notwendige Korrekturschleifen und bereitest die finale interne Abnahme vor.
  • Du passt bei Bedarf verlinkte Inhalte und Landingpages in unserem Content-Management-System an.
  • Du unterstützt bei Maßnahmen zur Leadgenerierung, zur Gewinnung von Marketing-Opt-ins und zur Steigerung der Kundenregistrierungen, beispielsweise bei unseren ltur Auktionen, Coupon-Kampagnen, Gewinnspielen und weiteren CRM-Aktivitäten.
  • Du hilfst bei der Einrichtung, Pflege und beim Testen von Anmeldeformularen, Landingpages und Registrierungsstrecken.
  • Du bereitest relevante Kampagnen- und Kundenkennzahlen auf und unterstützt bei wiederkehrenden Reportings und A/B-Tests.
  • Du stimmst Dich im Tagesgeschäft mit externen Agenturen und Dienstleistern ab und behältst Aufgaben, Timings und Ergebnisse im Blick.
  • Du beobachtest aktuelle CRM- und Newsletter-Trends und bringst eigene Ideen zur Weiterentwicklung unserer Aktivitäten ein.

 

Zusammenarbeit in der TUI Group

Als Teil der TUI Group profitierst Du vom Austausch mit internationalen CRM-, Data-, Marketing- und Technologie-Teams. Gemeinsam mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus E-Commerce, Marketing, Analytics, IT und weiteren Fachbereichen arbeitest Du an einer modernen und wirkungsvollen digitalen Kundenkommunikation.

 

Das bringst Du mit

  • Du hast ein Studium oder eine kaufmännische bzw. vergleichbare Ausbildung erfolgreich abgeschlossen, idealerweise mit Bezug zu Marketing, Kommunikation, Medien, Tourismus oder Digital Business.
  • Die Position eignet sich ausdrücklich auch für Berufseinsteigerinnen und Berufseinsteiger.
  • Erste praktische Erfahrungen im Online-Marketing, CRM oder E-Mail-Marketing, beispielsweise durch Praktika, eine Werkstudententätigkeit, eine Ausbildung oder erste Berufsjahre, sind von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.
  • Idealerweise hattest Du bereits erste Berührungspunkte mit Newsletter-, CRM- oder E-Mail-Marketing-Tools und Content-Management-Systemen.
  • Du interessierst Dich für digitale Kundenkommunikation, Kampagnen und aktuelle Marketingtrends.
  • Du gehst sicher mit MS Office und KI-Tools wie Microsoft Copilot oder ChatGPT um.
  • Du arbeitest sorgfältig, strukturiert und zuverlässig und hast einen guten Blick für Details und Qualität.
  • Du bringst Lernbereitschaft, Eigeninitiative sowie gute Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten mit.
  • Du verfügst über fließende Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse, idealerweise mindestens auf B2-Niveau.

 

Was Dich erwartet

  • Eine abwechslungsreiche Einstiegsposition in der digitalen Kundenkommunikation.
  • Die Möglichkeit, praktische Erfahrungen in den Bereichen CRM, Newsletter-Marketing und Leadgenerierung zu sammeln.
  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten und kurze Entscheidungswege.
  • Ein motiviertes Team sowie eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit E-Commerce, Marketing, Analytics und IT.
  • Internationale Zusammenarbeit innerhalb der TUI Group.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und attraktive Benefits.
  • Vergünstigte Reisemöglichkeiten und weitere touristische Vorteile.
  • Eine unbefristete Vollzeitposition.

Klingt nach Deinem nächsten Schritt?

Dann bewirb Dich jetzt und entwickle gemeinsam mit uns CRM Kampagnen, die Lust auf Reisen machen.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team: 

Strategy & Analytics is fast growing and dynamic team within Strategic Partnerships department of Agoda. Strategic Partnerships is a team of creative entrepreneurs that develop solutions for Agoda’s non-accommodation partners and promote Agoda’s top and bottom line growth. We design tailored business and product solutions with our partners and help them generate measurable value. Members of our team are empowered and supported to grow their market(s) or accounts. The Strategy & Analytics team’s scope includes profitability optimization, target setting, KPI management, data analytics and business strategy.

  • This role is based in our Bangkok office with a hybrid setup (3 days in office per week). Relocation to Bangkok is required, and we will only consider applicants who are willing to relocate (Relocation support will be provided.)

Key Areas of Focus: 

In this role, you’ll get to:  

Strategy: Conduct analyses to identify growth opportunities and prioritize investment areas in APAC for Strategic Partnerships team based on analytical insights, industry trends, and changing competitive landscape.

Analytics: Leverage data & tools to analyze SP performance and identify appropriate levers to improve performance.  

Cross-functional projects: Work with different teams inside SP (B2B, White Label, Affiliates, Financial Institutions, different markets across APAC, etc.) and outside of SP (product, marketing, supply, finance, etc.) to drive initiatives. 

Performance management: Maintain and optimize a performance management system for the department, including a large team of account managers 

Data & tools: Oversee SP data infrastructure to ensure data accuracy, completeness, and timeliness. Design, manage, and oversee the maintenance of data tools to support decision making.  

Performance reporting: Preparing updates on business performance, proposals, and recommendations to senior management.

Pricing Experiments: Optimize pricing strategy and make decisions based on A/B experiments.  

This is an Individual contributor role, reporting to Associate Director, Strategy & Analytics

What you’ll Need to Succeed:  

  • 5+ years and above of total experience with Consulting, Data Analytics, Strategy, Business Development, Business Intelligence, or other relevant fields. 
  • Proven ability to leverage analytics and quantitative methods to break down ambiguous problems and come up with recommendations. 
  • Growth mindset and excited to work on a variety of functional areas.
  • Entrepreneurial and not afraid to be hands-on on the work. 
  • Experience working in a fast-paced and high growth environment. 
  • Excellent communication skills (both verbal and written in English) with ability to work well across multiple stakeholders. 

It’s Great if you have:   

  • Ability to write in SQL a plus, or willingness to learn 
  • Ability to use Tableau a plus, or willingness to learn 
  • Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Mathematics a plus

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

job.job_description:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Hotel Efficiency, Resource & Operations (HERO) Coordinator supports the engagement, activation, and execution of brand programs and initiatives designed to improve guest satisfaction, franchisee engagement, and operational efficiency across midscale and upper‑midscale hotel portfolios. Reporting to the Lead HERO Coordinator, this role partners closely with Area Directors, Brand Operations teams, and Choice Centers of Excellence (CoEs) to implement hotel action plans and ensure effective utilization of Choice’s programs, tools, and resources.

The HERO Coordinator plays a critical role in supporting franchised hotel owners and operators by driving participation in brand initiatives, connecting hotels to the appropriate CoE resources, and ensuring timely resolution of franchise support issues. Through consistent communication, documentation, and collaboration, this role contributes to improved hotel performance, franchisee satisfaction, and brand consistency.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Franchisee Support

  • Establish and maintain collaborative, professional relationships with franchise hotel owners and operators.
  • Provide timely feedback from owner‑operator engagements to Area Directors in advance of hotel visits.
  • Partner with Area Directors to support the development, execution, and monitoring of hotel action plans stemming from service, profitability, or total business reviews.
  • Maintain working knowledge of Brand Standards and influence effective adoption and implementation.
  • Support Area Directors with planning strategies and communication protocols during crisis or disaster situations.
  • Assist in communicating franchisee value propositions and ensure enabling tools are in place to drive profitability, return on capital (ROC), and guest experience outcomes.
  • Monitor owner and guest satisfaction trends and brand program execution.
  • Listen to, investigate, document, and escalate hotel issues while identifying opportunities for systemwide franchise support enhancements.

Operationalization & Execution of Brand Programs

  • Support the rollout and ongoing execution of new Brand Standards, initiatives, and programs.
  • Collaborate with brand and business implementation teams to ensure consistency and accuracy across program documentation and digital resources.
  • Participate in Voice of Franchisee communication processes by reviewing and providing feedback on hotel‑facing communications.
  • Share trending hotel feedback, challenges, and insights with Brand Operations leadership and Franchise Performance partners.
  • Participate in cross‑functional initiatives, representing the voice of the hotel and franchisee experience.

Application & Technology Support

  • Support midscale and upper‑midscale hotels in the effective use of brand applications, platforms, and operational tools.
  • Partner with Area Directors to ensure new hotels are accurately represented and onboarded within enterprise systems and applications.

Qualifications

Experience

  • Minimum of 3 years of hotel leadership or operational experience, with Choice‑branded hotel experience preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and work experience.

Education

  • Associate degree or bachelor’s degree preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and work experience.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proven ability to build relationships and influence franchise owners and general managers with tact and professionalism.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and collaborate effectively across cross‑functional teams.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Demonstrated ability to model Choice values, including being bold, acting quickly, listening actively, remaining curious, and operating with integrity.
  • Ability to travel up to 5% of the time.

WORK LOCATION:

This position is based at Choice Hotels’ Scottsdale, Arizona office. The selected candidate must be able to commit to this location requirement and adhere to the company’s hybrid work schedule, which consists of four days onsite and one day remote per week.

NOTE:

This position is not eligible for relocation assistance or sponsorship.

Choice prioritizes our associate wellbeing by offering a comprehensive benefits program that is both competitive and flexible to help you achieve your wellbeing goals - here are just a few:

  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Leave and paid time-off for holidays, vacation, personal, family, volunteer, sick, jury duty, bereavement, military, and religious observance
  • Financial benefits for retirement and health savings
  • Employee recognition programs
  • Discounts at Choice hotels worldwide

About Choice

Choice Hotels International, Inc. (NYSE: CHH), is one of the largest lodging franchisors in the world. With 7,500 hotels in 45+ countries and territories, we offer a range of high-quality lodging options in the upper upscale, upper midscale, midscale, extended stay, and economy segments. We’re the hotel company for those who choose to bet on themselves — the striver, the dreamer, the entrepreneur — because that’s who we are, too.

At Choice, we are united by the simple belief that tomorrow will be even better than today — for associates, our company, and our franchisees. At our worldwide corporate headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, at our technology center in Scottsdale, Arizona, and through our associates around the globe, every voice is heard and every idea is listened to, no matter what area of the company they come from. We are united in supporting the entrepreneurial dreams of our thousands of franchise owners, which propels us forward — giving our work at Choice a purpose larger than our business.

Our corporate office locations:

North Bethesda, MD — Located at Pike & Rose, our worldwide headquarters is less than 15 miles from Washington, D.C., one block away from the North Bethesda Metro station, with easy access to I-495, complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Scottsdale, AZ — Located at the northwest corner of Loop 101, the Scottsdale office is home to our technology, eCommerce and customer service organizations, with easy access to complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Minneapolis, MN — Select roles are based in our Minneapolis office on Highway 394, near the intersection with Highway 100, only five minutes from downtown.

Field/Remote — Select roles designated as field/remote will require associates to work from a home office, connecting virtually with Choice team members and leadership on Zoom, with possible required travel depending on the role.

Choice’s Cultural Values

Welcome and Respect Everyone | Be Bold | Be Quick | Listen | Be Curious | Show Integrity

Choice’s Leadership Principles

Act with Intention | Lead with Authenticity | Grow & Deliver

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction to Team

Our Technology Team partners with teams across Expedia Group to create innovative products, services, and tools to deliver high-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction.

The Experience Management Platform team sits within our Core Platform and Traveler Experience organization and is responsible for the systems that power how every traveler experience is assembled, configured, and delivered across Expedia Group's portfolio of brands. Our platform handles billions of requests, serving hundreds of millions of users through tools including Experience Manager (no-code template and content orchestration), URL Platform, Travel Store SDK, Platform Product Catalog, and Platform Configuration. We are the layer that connects design and engineering with business users; enabling scalable, multi-brand experience delivery without code changes.

In This Role, You Will

  • Define and drive technical strategy for the Experience Management Platform
  • Lead a team of engineers and engineering managers building the next generation of experience orchestration, replacing legacy systems with a modern, agentic, self-serve platform
  • Own the technical architecture, roadmap, and non-functional standards (performance, cost, scale) for experience management tools across all EG brands
  • Drive the transformation from legacy services to a modern, scalable architecture with agentic capabilities built-in; reducing technical footprint while increasing business agility
  • Define domain vision tied to measurable business outcomes and establish mechanisms for operational excellence (goals, scorecards, reviews)
  • Use data to set direction, define domain KPIs, and ensure investments deliver measurable ROI
  • Influence peer Directors and VPs across Product, Design, ML, and Engineering to align roadmaps and resourcing for shared outcomes
  • Develop leaders of leaders — shape roles, set promotion standards, identify future leaders, and build a high-performing organization through a period of change
  • Safely integrate and operate AI/ML-enabled solutions that improve outcomes, including familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience
  • 10+ years of software experience and 5+ years of people management experience
  • Prior experience leading technical strategy, architecture, and delivery for domain- or organization-scale platforms.
  • Proven ownership of complex distributed systems spanning multiple services or domains, with strong expertise in software architecture, system design, low-level design, API design, and data modeling.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through engineering managers and senior engineers, driving technical execution, cross-functional alignment, and operational excellence in large-scale environments.
  • Experience working with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts in production-oriented software or platform contexts.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading platform engineering organizations across multiple products or capability areas, including managing multiple engineering managers (leader of leaders) and operating effectively in complex, business-critical environments.
  • Experience operating with a platform mindset, treating internal developers and product teams as customers.
  • Proven experience with experience platforms, commerce platforms, design systems, CMS technologies, configurable platforms, or developer platforms.
  • Experience modernizing platforms within a large-scale technology, commerce, marketplace, media, or travel organization.
  • Experience advancing AI-assisted or agentic workflows within internal platforms, including enabling more intuitive, scalable ways for users to configure and manage experiences through low-code, no-code, or conversational interfaces.
  • Track record of successfully retiring legacy systems while maintaining business continuity
  • Familiarity with modern approaches to no-code tooling, server-driven UI, or configuration-driven platforms

The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $231,000.00 to $323,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $369,500.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Benefits And Perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

Team mission

The Financial Reporting team is part of Group Reporting within GetYourGuide's Finance function. We own the financial statements - the core output that tells GetYourGuide's financial story - as well as the accounting standards and policies that underpin how the company reports. We partner closely with other finance teams and across the wider business to ensure that the output is accurate, complete, and of high quality.

As GetYourGuide continues to grow and evolve, our team plays a critical role in building the technical expertise and reporting frameworks that will support the company's next chapter.

As Financial Reporting Manager, you will own key parts of our financial reporting cycle and serve as a trusted technical accounting authority across the business. You'll bridge accounting policy and business operations - not just applying standards, but actively proposing solutions, advising on reporting implications, and advocating for approaches that work for both the business and its stakeholders.

Your mission

  • Lead the preparation and review of the group’s external financial statements under IFRS and support in the preparation over a broad range of reporting-related documents beyond the IFRS financial statements
  • Prepare technical accounting memos and position papers on complex or judgement-heavy topics; own those positions to be presented to senior management and to the external auditors
  • Collaborate across the business to gather information and produce accurate, complete financial and non-financial disclosures
  • Lead the team's monitoring of IFRS developments, assess their impact on GetYourGuide's reporting, and drive clear recommendations to senior stakeholders
  • Drive continuous improvement in reporting processes, accounting policies, and documentation standards

Your toolkit

  • 8+ years of financial reporting experience, combining a foundation in Big 4 audit with meaningful in-house or industry experience; strong command of IFRS is essential, US GAAP or HGB knowledge is a plus
  • Proven track record preparing and reviewing financial statements and disclosures, with the ability to draft and defend technical accounting positions under scrutiny
  • Skilled at working across functions with teams such as Accounting, FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Legal, and Corporate Development to translate complex financial and non-financial knowledge into easy-to-understand, decision-useful information
  • Rigorous and deadline-driven, with the ability to manage competing priorities without compromising quality or accuracy
  • Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CPA, or equivalent)

Extras that give you an edge

  • Prior exposure to complex, high-stakes reporting projects (e.g. fundraising, M&A, or significant corporate transactions)
  • Experience upskilling teams through training, knowledge-sharing sessions, or building internal guides and frameworks
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g. Claude CoWork, ChatGPT, or similar) to improve reporting workflows, automate routine tasks, or enhance disclosure drafting

How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary

  • Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
  • Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
  • A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.
  • Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events
  • Monthly transportation and fitness budget
  • Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
  • Language reimbursement program
  • Health and wellness benefits

And more…

How To Apply

The position combines supplier relationship management, sourcing execution, market analysis, and data-driven decision-making to improve operational performance and business outcomes. Success in this role requires strong leadership, analytical capability, and the ability to influence stakeholders across a complex organization.

Core Accountabilities/Key Responsibilities

  • Define and execute supplier and category strategies that drive competitive advantage, cost savings, risk mitigation, and long-term value creation.
  • Lead sourcing events, supplier evaluations, negotiations, and contract discussions to secure optimal commercial and operational outcomes.
  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with internal stakeholders and external suppliers while aligning sourcing activities to business needs.
  • Design, maintain, and leverage dashboards, reporting tools, and sourcing KPIs to monitor performance, identify risks, and support sourcing recommendations.

  • Develop and enforce procurement documentation standards, governance processes, and compliance requirements across sourcing activities.
  • Lead process improvement initiatives that standardize sourcing practices, introduce new tools, and enhance operational effectiveness.
  • Support supplier development, demand forecasting, and continuous improvement programs that strengthen supply chain capabilities and business performance.

  • 3+ years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, supply chain, analytics, finance, or a related business function.

What will help you propel from the pack (Preferred Qualifications):

  • Demonstrates an understanding of the capabilities and limitations of generative AI tools and effectively leverages them to support research, analysis, content creation, and problem-solving.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

The team

Agoda's Marketing team operates at the intersection of business strategy, data, and execution. We build and scale programs across growth, pricing, and commercial initiatives that drive customer value and sustainable business performance globally. We're analytical, fast-moving, and deeply cross-functional — partnering closely with Product, Finance, Corporate Strategy, and Supply to shape Agoda's growth agenda.

The opportunity

We're looking for experience Marketing Growth Strategy & Analytics leaders to own high-impact commercial initiatives from strategy through execution. You'll translate business goals into structured plans, lead cross-functional programs, and use data and experimentation to unlock growth. This role sits at the center of key decisions — influencing how we grow, price, and operate across markets — with strong visibility to senior leadership.

In this role, you'll get to

  • Define and execute strategies within your scope — which may span areas like pricing, channel performance, customer acquisition, retention, or go-to-market — translating commercial priorities into testable hypotheses, scalable frameworks, and measurable outcomes.
  • Lead experimentation roadmaps, including A/B tests and other measurement approaches, to evaluate impact and sharpen decision-making.
  • Analyze large, complex datasets to surface trends, opportunities, and risks; build dashboards and executive-ready narratives that communicate performance clearly.
  • Model business impact, evaluate trade-offs, and support planning around P&L, growth, and long-term value creation.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Finance, Corporate Strategy, Supply, and senior leadership to drive alignment and execution.
  • Build playbooks and processes that enable repeatability and scale across markets, channels, or partners.
  • Mentor and develop team members while contributing to a high-performance, test-and-learn culture.

What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in growth, marketing, pricing, strategy, analytics, revenue management, consulting, or related data-driven roles.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills — comfortable turning ambiguity into clear frameworks and action plans.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL, Tableau, or similar BI/analytics tools; proven ability to translate data into commercial recommendations.
  • Practical experience with experimentation, measurement, and performance optimization.
  • Strong business acumen: P&L drivers, unit economics, growth levers, and ROI.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior and cross-functional audiences.
  • High ownership and execution discipline in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Bachelor's degree in Economics, Statistics, Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, Finance, or equivalent practical experience.

It's great if you have

  • Experience in a high-growth digital business (e-commerce, travel, tech, fintech) or an analytically rigorous environment such as management consulting or internal strategy.
  • Familiarity with statistical analysis, forecasting, machine learning, or hypothesis-testing frameworks.
  • Experience using Python or R for analysis, modeling, or automation.
  • People management experience — hiring, coaching, and developing teams.
  • Experience with external partners, affiliates, marketplaces, loyalty programs, or B2B/B2B2C channels.
  • MBA or advanced degree (equivalent hands-on experience equally valued).

Why join Agoda

  • Work on high-impact, global business problems with direct visibility to senior leadership.
  • Shape commercial strategy in an organization that genuinely values analytical rigor, ownership, and experimentation.
  • Build and scale initiatives that influence growth, profitability, and customer experience at a global scale.

job.job_description:
Job Description

至高のおもてなしは、あなたから始まります

誰かの一日を明るく彩っている自分を想像してみてください。ヒルトンのホテルチームに加わるということは、出勤するたびに、まさにそのような瞬間を創り出す役割を担うということです。 ホテルの客室、イベントスペース、その他のサービスを潜在的な顧客に販売する役割を担います。見込み客を特定・開拓し、営業提案を実施し、成約につなげることで、収益の最大化を目指します。セールスエグゼクティブの役割は、すべての滞在を素晴らしいものにする大切なポジションです。

Responsibilities

主に以下の業務をご担当いただきます。

  • 日々のセールスオペレーションの遂行:データ入力、請求書の配布、Salesforceでの活動追跡、記録管理などの事務サポートを提供し、チーム全体が効率的に業務を進められる環境を整えます。
  • セールス資料およびレポート作成のサポート:契約書、提案書、RFPへの回答、商談サマリー、予約およびロイヤルティレポートの作成を補助します。
  • 協力的な関係の構築:ヒルトン・ワールドワイド・セールスの担当者、お客様、ホテルパートナーと連携し、新規案件の発掘、セールス担当者のいない顧客へのヒアリングを行い、ニーズに合わせたソリューションを提示します。
  • 特別プロジェクトやイベントの補助:部署全体の取り組みやカスタマーエンゲージメントの活動をサポートします。また、必要に応じて会議やコンファレンスに参加します。

Qualifications

滞在を特別なものにするために

ヒルトンでは、私たちが日々大切にしている価値観こそが、ここで働く喜びと成功のカギであると信じています。私たちは、すべてのチームメンバーに次のような要素を求めています。

おもてなし（Hospitality）の心で温かく照らし続けたいという情熱。誠実（Integrity）に行動し、常に正しいことを行う強さ。リーダーシップ（Leadership）を発揮し、仲間を勇気づけられること。チームワーク（Teamwork）こそが最良の結果を生むという信念。責任感（Ownership）と主体性。そして、いま（Now）という一瞬がお客様にとって忘れられない思い出になることを理解し、目の前の瞬間に全力で向き合う規律とスピード感。

さらに、本ポジションを担っていただくにあたり、少なくとも以下の条件を満たしていることが求められます。

  • 優れたコミュニケーションスキルと対人スキル
  • クライアントとの関係を築き、維持できる能力
  • 主体性があり、目標達成意識を持ってペースの速い環境で働ける方

About Us

受賞歴のある職場文化に参加しよう

ヒルトンでは、お客様に最高の体験を提供するだけでなく、それを実現するチームメンバーのために、素晴らしい職場環境を築いています。

ホスピタリティ業界のグローバルリーダーとして、私たちは創業時のビジョン「地球という星をおもてなしの心で温かく照らし続ける」を忠実に守りながら、世界中で30億人以上のお客様をお迎えしてきました。

受賞歴のあるヒルトンの企業文化は、Great Place to WorkとFortune誌による「世界で最も働きがいのある職場」リストに繰り返し選出されています。 世界ク https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/ ラスのブランド群と、すべてのお客様に最高の滞在を提供するという全社的なコミットメントにより、旅行の未来の新たな基準を打ち立てています。

キャリアをスタートさせる方も、新しいことに挑戦する方も、ヒルトンはあなたの人生のあらゆる段階をサポートします。仕事のために来て、キャリアのためにとどまり、そしてすべてのお客様の滞在を少しでも魔法に満ちたような滞在にするお手伝いをしてください。

ヒルトンでの仕事に興味がありますか？私たちの キャリアブログ を読んで、私たちが単に素晴らしい滞在場所であるだけでなく、素晴らしい働き場所である理由をご覧ください。

Manager, Strategic Sourcing Americas (Remote)

Full time, Atlanta , United States

In this role, you will lead regional and global sourcing initiatives for products and services, including supplier negotiations, contract management, renewals, and supplier relationship management. You will be responsible for developing and managing procurement documentation such as RFIs, RFPs, and other sourcing-related materials. The role partners closely with stakeholders to gain visibility into suppliers, spending, agreements, and business requirements, while identifying and executing opportunities that deliver measurable commercial value. Additionally, you will support the effective management of supplier relationships to maximize and leverage BCD Travel's sourcing and purchasing power.

As a Manager, Strategic Sourcing Americas, you will

  • Aggressively negotiate terms as required and in accordance with internal policies
  • Establish negotiating strategies to leverage BCD Travel's position and strategic partnerships
  • Manage contract renewal terms and dates ensuring business owners are involved in advance of actionable dates and deadlines are not missed
  • Establish SLA’s based upon BCD stakeholder requirements and industry best practices
  • Establish and maintain relationships with business owners, the Director, Strategic Sourcing, finance and accounting, legal, data privacy, and security departments
  • Measure, track, and report ROI by engagement, providing detailed calculations to the Director, Strategic Sourcing
  • Review a variety of sourcing requirements from cross functional business leaders
  • Lead cross-functional sourcing and supplier-management initiatives

About You

  • Prior Supply Chain Management experience
  • Previous experience working on technology, telecommunications, HR and other types of sourcing engagements
  • Strong business knowledge
  • Effective spoken and written communication skills in English
  • Ability to travel domestically & internationally
  • Will require working Eastern time zone hours to collaborate with global partners

What We Offer You

At BCD Travel, we work with highly motivated and passionate people. We value open communication, collaboration, and a flexible work-life balance. We offer unique, often global, experiences that empower you to develop and grow within the organization. Sustainability and helping others is also high on our list. We make a difference through charitable activities in our communities across the globe.

About Us

BCD Travel helps companies travel smart and achieve more. We drive program adoption, cost savings and talent retention through digital experiences that simplify business travel. Our 15,000+ dedicated team members service clients in 170+ countries as we shape a sustainable future for business travel. BCD’s leading meetings and events management and global consultancy services complete our comprehensive suite of solutions for all aspects of corporate travel. In 2024, BCD achieved US$22.9 billion in sales. For more information, visit www.bcdtravel.com.

You’ll be offered

  • Generous vacation days so you can rest and recharge
  • A compensation package that feels fair to you, including mental, physical, and financial wellbeing tools
  • Travel industry professional perks and discounts
  • An inclusive work environment where diversity is celebrated

At BCD Travel we value you, our culture and success is defined by you. We carefully consider a wide range of compensation factors, including your professional background and experience. job.job_description:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Corporate Sales Executive manages a portfolio of approximately 60-65 corporate accounts within an assigned vertical/industry, including a blend of existing customers and key prospects. They are responsible for growing revenue share by positioning Choice hotels within their customers’ corporate travel programs, identifying and securing project business, and winning RFPs for groups and meetings. Candidates for this client-facing role will be expected to have, or develop, expertise in their assigned vertical/industry, including a deep understanding of its travel trends and buying criteria.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Account Management

  • Manage Choice relationships with approximately 60-65 corporate accounts within an assigned vertical/industry
  • Lead preferred travel program negotiations and bids for groups, events, and project RFPs
  • Develop account plans aligned with client goals and Choice’s corporate strategy
  • Conduct executive-level Quarterly Business Reviews and strategic planning sessions that demonstrate business performance, pipeline opportunities, and incremental revenue strategies

Business Development

  • Identify potential customers through research, networking, and lead generation channels
  • Identify key decision makers within prospective accounts to secure meetings
  • Educate potential accounts about Choice brands and product offerings
  • Convert prospects to high-performing accounts to increase the corporate customer base

Portfolio Planning & Administration

  • Update and maintain customer information in CRM system
  • Participate in sales, brand, product, and system training
  • Develop and document account strategy, detailed action plan and specific activities
  • Prepare and conduct customer Quarterly Business Reviews / Planning Sessions

QUALIFICATIONS:

Employment Experience

  • 3+ years of B2B sales experience, preferably in the hospitality or travel industry
  • Demonstrable experience managing enterprise customers and prospecting for net-new accounts

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency working in a CRM, preferably Salesforce
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Office products (e.g. PowerPoint, Word, Excel)
  • Comfortable analyzing account and market data in platforms like Tableau to create actionable insights and recommendations

Additional Skills & Competencies

  • Ability to travel up to 25-50%
  • Location near major city – within 30 miles of major airport.
  • Independent self-starter with the ability to achieve corporate business objectives
  • Comfort building and presenting customer-facing proposals

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in business administration, marketing, sales or related field preferred

SALARY RANGE:

The salary range for this position is $70,000 - $90,000 annually, plus commission via participation in Choice’s Global Sales Incentive Plan.

Choice prioritizes our associate wellbeing by offering a comprehensive benefits program that is both competitive and flexible to help you achieve your wellbeing goals - here are just a few:

  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Leave and paid time-off for holidays, vacation, personal, family, volunteer, sick, jury duty, bereavement, military, and religious observance
  • Financial benefits for retirement and health savings
  • Employee recognition programs
  • Discounts at Choice hotels worldwide

About Choice

Choice Hotels International, Inc. (NYSE: CHH), is one of the largest lodging franchisors in the world. With 7,500 hotels in 45+ countries and territories, we offer a range of high-quality lodging options in the upper upscale, upper midscale, midscale, extended stay, and economy segments. We’re the hotel company for those who choose to bet on themselves — the striver, the dreamer, the entrepreneur — because that’s who we are, too.

At Choice, we are united by the simple belief that tomorrow will be even better than today — for associates, our company, and our franchisees. At our worldwide corporate headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, at our technology center in Scottsdale, Arizona, and through our associates around the globe, every voice is heard and every idea is listened to, no matter what area of the company they come from. We are united in supporting the entrepreneurial dreams of our thousands of franchise owners, which propels us forward — giving our work at Choice a purpose larger than our business.

Our corporate office locations:

North Bethesda, MD — Located at Pike & Rose, our worldwide headquarters is less than 15 miles from Washington, D.C., one block away from the North Bethesda Metro station, with easy access to I-495, complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Scottsdale, AZ — Located at the northwest corner of Loop 101, the Scottsdale office is home to our technology, eCommerce and customer service organizations, with easy access to complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Minneapolis, MN — Select roles are based in our Minneapolis office on Highway 394, near the intersection with Highway 100, only five minutes from downtown.

Field/Remote — Select roles designated as field/remote will require associates to work from a home office, connecting virtually with Choice team members and leadership on Zoom, with possible required travel depending on the role.

Choice’s Cultural Values

Welcome and Respect Everyone | Be Bold | Be Quick | Listen | Be Curious | Show Integrity

Choice’s Leadership Principles

Act with Intention | Lead with Authenticity | Grow & Deliver
