job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction to the Team

Our Corporate Functions are made up of teams that support Expedia Group, including Employee Communications, Finance, Traveler and Partner Service Platform, Legal, People Team, Inclusion and Diversity, and Global Social Impact and Sustainability.

The Global Stock & Employment / Mobility Tax team supports accurate, compliant, and scalable tax operations across equity compensation, payroll, employment tax, and global mobility programs. In this role, you will partner across HR, Payroll, Finance & Accounting, Corporate Tax, Legal, Stock Administration, Mobility & Immigration, and external providers to deliver seamless experiences for employees and stakeholders worldwide.

Key Responsibilities

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead global employment tax compliance and statutory payroll reporting across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Partner with Payroll, Stock Administration, Mobility & Immigration, Accounting, and external providers to implement taxability, withholding, sourcing, and reporting requirements.
  • Manage country-specific filing activities from data collection and validation through review and submission, including UK ERS, Australia ESS and FBT, Japan Form 9(3), Korea Form 30(5), Malaysia Appendix C, Hong Kong IR56B, Singapore IR8A, UK and Ireland PSA, and UK STBV reporting.
  • Prepare and review Swiss salary certificate and equity annex filings, reconciling grant- and vest-level equity data with payroll and compensation records.
  • Support payroll tax reconciliations, audits, year-end reporting, corrections, statutory filings, and compliance reviews.
  • Manage payroll, equity, mobility, and HR data to support accurate reporting, regulatory filings, internal controls, and audit readiness.
  • Evaluate tax, payroll, social security, treaty, sourcing, shadow payroll, gross-up, and reporting requirements related to relocations, permanent transfers, temporary remote work, and other cross-border assignments.
  • Serve as a primary liaison with mobility tax providers, reviewing deliverables, scopes of work, invoices, tax authorizations, trailing liabilities, and employee eligibility.
  • Maintain country-specific taxability matrices, process documentation, operating procedures, and reporting frameworks.
  • Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and process improvement that strengthen compliance, efficiency, and in-house capabilities.

Required

Experience and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Tax, Business, or a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience.
  • 6–8 or more years of progressive experience in employment tax, global mobility tax, equity compensation, payroll tax, or a related discipline within an international environment.
  • Experience with global equity compensation programs, including RSUs, stock options, ESPP, payroll reporting, and trailing equity taxation.
  • Experience managing cross-border tax matters, payroll tax reporting, reconciliations, audits, year-end reporting, compensation data, and tax clearance activities.
  • Working knowledge of income tax treaties, certificates of coverage, social security agreements, shadow payroll, foreign tax relief, and gross-ups.
  • Proficiency with Workday, equity administration systems, mobility platforms, global payroll systems, Microsoft Office, and advanced Excel functions such as lookups, pivot tables, data validation, and reconciliations.
  • Proficient verbal and written communication, research, analytical, prioritization, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively and autonomously, manage multiple priorities, and make sound recommendations with limited supervision.

Preferred

  • Experience working with a Big Four accounting firm or multinational organization.
  • GMS-T, CPA, EA, CPP, or CEP certification.

The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $110,500.00 to $155,000.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $177,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Benefits And Perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life.

Accommodation requests

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.

About Expedia Group

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Important notice

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/.

Equal Opportunity

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. This employer participates in E-Verify. The employer will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from each new employee's I-9 to confirm work authorization.

job.job_description:
If you’re an experienced Travel Consultant with a knack for making the complex seem simple, you'll fit right in with our Round the World team. Our purpose is to open up the world for those who want to see. Every day, we give people all around the world the opportunity to do something really amazing – travel!

How you’ll be opening up the world for our customers…

As a Travel Consultant in our Round the World team, you will help to plan, book and coordinate your customer’s next amazing travel experience, all built around multi-stop, complex travel itineraries. You'll be curating bespoke airfares and land itineraries that customers cannot find online, with a dedicated complex, multi-stop and round the world enquiry stream - no domestic bookings! But it’s not just airfares – you’ll be the expert for your customer’s every need, including flights, accommodation, cruises, tours, insurance and more! You will be working towards KPI’s and incentive targets, therefore building your customer relationships will be critical to your success in this role.

What it takes to be a Round the World expert…

  • You’re the go-to person in your circle for travel recommendations, tips and tricks, with prior experience as a Travel Consultant
  • You seek out new ways to build on your success and think outside of the box for your customers to find the best travel solution for them
  • You have proven success in achieving your KPIs and sales targets
  • You understand the importance of organisation and managing your time effectively to achieve the best result and stay on top of your work
  • You’re not only good at the people stuff, but at the behind the scenes stuff too. Like building itineraries, doing up invoices, operating our complex booking systems and jumping between different programs with a customer in front of you
  • You’re comfortable with complexity
  • You know your way around GDS and you’re confident to learn complex computer systems

Your First Class Employee Benefits:

  • At FCTG we understand the importance of flexibility while fostering a culture of collaboration through in person iterations – our Round the World team offer hybrid working arrangements
  • Be rewarded with a base wage plus uncapped commission structure - earn a percentage of every sale you make from day one, there’s no limit on what you can earn
  • You'll be working in a high performing team of experts
  • Be gifted the time to provide the support your loyal clientele deserves, and to foster great relationships – you won’t be serving a constant queue, but the organic enquiry is there for you to be able to go above and beyond with your sales targets
  • Unlock your wanderlust! Score incredible travel deals for you & your friends and family, plus the opportunity to qualify for famils!
  • Brightness of Future: Career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses across the globe - we promote from within   
  • Embrace the famous Flight Centre culture at our Reward & Recognition events throughout the year, including our most popular event on the calendar "Global Gathering"
  • Thrive in a workplace that values individualism – come as you are!

Don’t miss your flight! Apply now for one of the best adventures you’ll have.

*Flight Centre is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status*

job.job_description:
The Opportunity

At InterContinental Hayman Great Barrier Reef, every day begins with ocean views and the spirit of true hospitality. Live, work, and thrive on one of the iconic 74 Whitsunday Islands, where a rewarding career meets an extraordinary island lifestyle—delivering and inspiring incredible experiences for our guests and colleagues alike.

Make Your Mark in Paradise

Step into a role where marketing meets one of the world’s most extraordinary destinations. As Marketing Executive at InterContinental Hayman Great Barrier Reef, you’ll help bring the magic of Hayman Island to life through creative campaigns, compelling content and impactful marketing initiatives that connect with guests both locally and around the world.

Working alongside the Digital Marketing & Communications Manager, you’ll play an important role in delivering the resort’s B2C and B2B marketing strategy, supporting campaigns that build brand awareness, drive revenue and inspire guests to experience the very best of the Great Barrier Reef.

From coordinating exciting campaigns and creating engaging marketing content to supporting on-property activations and bringing the InterContinental brand to life, no two days will look quite the same. This is an opportunity for a creative, organised and commercially minded marketing professional to gain hands-on experience within a world-class luxury resort environment — while living and working in one of Australia’s most iconic destinations.

If you’re passionate about marketing, love bringing ideas to life and want your work to be seen against a backdrop of turquoise waters, white sand and the Great Barrier Reef, this could be your next adventure.

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

  • Support and deliver creative B2C, B2B, Food & Beverage, Events and resort marketing campaigns that build brand awareness, drive revenue and keep Hayman Island top of mind.
  • Manage marketing touchpoints across the resort from websites, social media and email campaigns to in-room TV, digital signage, menus and promotional collateral ensuring everything is on-brand and engaging.
  • Develop compelling marketing content and work closely with resort teams, IHG, agencies, media, influencers and external partners to bring exciting experiences and activations to life.
  • Monitor campaign performance, guest and consumer insights, competitor activity and marketing results, using data and learnings to continually improve future campaigns and maximise ROI.
  • Build strong relationships across the resort, champion the InterContinental brand and support teams with marketing opportunities that enhance the guest experience, showcase Hayman Island and turn great ideas into memorable moments.

Salary rate $70,000.00 + super

See Yourself in Our Team

To be successful in this full-time role, you’ll have:

  • Bachelor of Marketing, business or related field
  • Two years experience working in marketing (hospitality industry advantageous)
  • Demonstrated project management experience in organising, planning and executing projects from conception through to implementation
  • Ability to multitask and manage deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Proactive approach with a drive for results and a track record of achievement
  • Resourceful with the ability to work autonomously while being a skillful team player

Live the Island Life

  • Join a vibrant and diverse team, making lifelong friendships, and become part of an unforgettable island community.
  • We make island living convenient and affordable with subsidised staff accommodation and meals. We also offer dedicated staff facilities - pool, beach, gym, bar, diner, laundry, and more.
  • Enjoy swimming, snorkeling, hiking, kayaking, and exploring the Whitsundays after your shift or on your days off.
  • Your commute ends in paradise, with beautiful beaches and breathtaking ocean views just moments away.
  • Grow your career with opportunities for career growth, training, and professional development.
  • Enjoy exclusive employee, friends, and family discount rates across our InterContinental Hotels & Resorts properties worldwide.

At IHG Hotels & Resorts, we believe great hospitality starts with great people. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome, respected and valued. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, religions, genders, gender identities and sexual orientations. We pride ourselves on a diverse and family friendly environment, and welcome applicants with primary school aged children as our island offers a State Primary School.

If you require any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know, we're here to support you.

Ready to Work in Paradise

  • Please visit our Careers Page for all details regarding living and working on Hayman Island at: https://haymanisland.intercontinental.com/careers/ or click the ‘Apply Now’ button.
  • We also invite you to learn more by following our social channels:
    • Facebook via @ICHIRcareers and Instagram via @ihg_australia_careers
Applications close on 25 October 2026. We will be reviewing and contacting candidates throughout the advertising period. The application may close earlier if the position is filled.

Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

job.job_description:
About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

Company: Bókun, A Tripadvisor Company

Location: UK (Hybrid - Commutable to Oxford or London)

Contract: 6-Month Fixed-Term (Performance-based extension and growth path)

Compensation: Competitive Base Salary + Quarterly Sales Incentive Plan

About Bókun

Bókun is the leading reservation system and marketing platform for the global tours and activities industry. Founded in Iceland and now a fast-growing subsidiary of Tripadvisor Inc., we offer the best of both worlds: the high-energy pace and innovation of a startup with the stable backing of the world’s largest travel guidance platform.

We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Sales Development Associate to join our team. This is not a typical cold-calling role; it is a consultative position designed for those who want to master the art of SaaS sales by working with a high percentage of warm and qualified leads.

While this role begins as a 6-month fixed-term contract, we view it as the perfect foot in the door opportunity. For a high-performer, this is a proving ground to demonstrate your ability to grow and potentially take advantage of future openings and long-term career paths within Bókun and the wider Tripadvisor ecosystem.

What You Will Do

  • Consultative Outreach: Conduct high-volume engagement with prospective customers who have already shown interest in our platform, moving beyond scripts to have meaningful business conversations.
  • Value Positioning: Clearly articulate the Bókun value proposition, identifying an operator’s pain points and demonstrating how our suite of tools (Reservation systems, Channel Managers, and Websites) can grow their revenue.
  • Business Discovery: Act as a brand ambassador for both Bókun and Tripadvisor, utilizing a consultative approach to identify business needs and solve real-world challenges for tour providers.
  • Pipeline Management: Manage your activity and lead progression within Salesforce, ensuring every opportunity is nurtured and moved through the funnel with precision to meet key performance indicators (KPIs).
  • Collaborative Growth: Work closely with our Account Executives and Support teams to ensure a seamless transition as high-quality opportunities convert into long-term partners.

What You Will Bring To The Team

  • Communication Mastery: Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to build rapport quickly, tell a compelling story, and handle objections with curiosity and resilience.
  • Sales DNA: A results-driven, execution-focused mindset with a strong desire to exceed targets in a fast-paced environment.
  • Consultative Mindset: A focus on building effective client relationships through positive communication, honesty, and a genuine interest in helping small businesses thrive.
  • Technical Aptitude: Comfortable with technical interactions, including co-browsing with customers online to navigate our software and conduct product demos.
  • Growth Mindset: A proactive self-starter who is coachable, open to feedback, and views this initial contract as a launchpad for a professional sales career.
  • Experience: Prior experience in customer-facing roles (Hospitality, Customer Service, or Retail) is advantageous; a strong interest in travel-tech or SaaS sales is essential.
  • Bonus: Familiarity with Italian, Spanish, French, or other European languages is a significant plus.

If you are proactive, motivated, and eager to prove your ability in a team-oriented and entrepreneurial environment, then this is the perfect role for you. At Bókun, we value and nurture emerging talent, offering a culture that rewards those who take ownership of their results. Join a global team of professionals who are passionate about the future of travel. This is not just a job, but a career opportunity with significant potential for growth based on your results.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!

  • Proficiency in Excel

It’s Great if you Have:

  • Experience in digital marketing
  • Academic research experience

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You will manage designated corporate accounts, develop and solicit new business, drive total hotel revenue from rooms, catering, and F&B outlets, address business needs, explore new opportunities, and expand existing business through promotional efforts and sales channels. As an Assistant Director of Sales, you’re not just generating and managing group sales – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

As Assistant Director of Sales, you are responsible for working closely with Director of Sales to drive accommodation business needs, explore new business and expand existing business through promotional efforts and sales channels. Specifically, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:

Luxury Consortia Management

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with luxury consortia partners
  • Negotiate annual consortia agreements, preferred partnerships, and marketing collaborations.
  • Ensure optimal visibility across advisor platforms, luxury travel portals, and partner campaigns.
  • Execute consortia promotions, advisor engagement initiatives, and luxury sales activations.

Tour & Travel Sales

  • Manage relationships with tour operators, wholesalers, destination management companies (DMCs), and retail travel agencies.
  • Identify and secure new business opportunities within domestic and international leisure markets.
  • Contract and negotiate group series and leisure groups
  • Develop seasonal packages, promotions, and tactical offers for travel partners.
  • Conduct sales calls, presentations, workshops, and product training for travel partners.

Revenue & Business Development

  • Achieve and exceed revenue, room night, and market share targets.
  • Develop and execute annual sales plans and account strategies for consortia and tour & travel segments.
  • Monitor booking trends, production reports, and competitive market intelligence.
  • Analyze account performance and implement corrective action plans when necessary.

Relationship Management

  • Build long-term partnerships with key travel advisors, agency owners, tour operators, and industry stakeholders.
  • Organize and host familiarization (FAM) trips, site inspections, networking events, and client entertainment.
  • Represent the hotel or brand at trade shows, roadshows, sales missions, and industry events.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Revenue Management, Marketing, Reservations, and Operations teams to align business strategies.
  • Coordinate promotional campaigns, digital marketing initiatives, and partner communications.
  • Ensure smooth execution of contracted business and exceptional guest experiences.

Reporting & Administration

  • Maintain accurate account records, sales activities, and pipeline updates within CRM systems.
  • Prepare weekly, monthly, and quarterly sales reports, forecasts, and budget updates.
  • Track ROI on consortia partnerships, travel campaigns, and trade events.
  • Excellent communication skills
  • High level of IT skills, including Excel, PowerPoint, and Word
  • Proactive approach to meeting deadlines
  • Excellent organizational and administration skills
  • Previous experience in a sales role

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • Diploma or degree in Hospitality, Business, or related field
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in hotel Corporate, MICE, or Group room sales
  • Proven track record in driving revenue and managing key accounts
  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills
  • Technical proficiency in hotel systems (e.g., Delphi, Salesforce, OnQ, Market Planner Survey)
  • Ability to analyze sales data and market trends to inform strategy
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills with a collaborative mindset

How We’ll Help You Thrive

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40 USD/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program

Health & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you covered

  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction to the Team

Expedia B2B is the B2B arm of Expedia Group. We bring Expedia Group's innovative technology and distribution solutions to partners across the world. These businesses include global financial institutions, corporate managed travel, offline travel agents, global travel suppliers (like major airlines) and many more.

As a leader on the Analytics team, you'll play a pivotal role in developing data-driven strategies that power our B2B marketplace. You'll lead a talented team of analytics professionals, fostering excellence and innovation while partnering with senior stakeholders across the organization to influence product roadmaps and business outcomes.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead and develop a team of analytics managers and senior analysts, creating an environment of collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning
  • Partner with VP/SVP-level stakeholders within B2B’s Commercial Operations and Partner Experience team to influence organizational strategy, translating complex business challenges into actionable analytics initiatives
  • Oversee the delivery of multi-year analytics roadmaps and programs, ensuring alignment with business objectives and measurable impact
  • Guide teams in applying advanced analytics techniques, machine learning concepts, and statistical methods to create meaningful change for our B2B partners
  • Establish best practices for analytics engineering, model development, and data visualization across the broader analytics organization
  • Develop talent management strategies including recruitment, performance evaluation, succession planning, and cross-functional development opportunities
  • Foster collaboration with Data Engineering, Machine Learning, and Product teams to design scalable solutions and next-generation tooling
  • Champion inclusive design principles and data democratization, empowering stakeholders through automated dashboards, training, and self-service analytics
  • Present insights and recommendations to large audiences, clearly communicating technical concepts to both specialist and non-specialist stakeholders
  • Stay current with industry trends in AI, machine learning, and analytics methodologies, identifying opportunities to apply innovations within our domain

Experience And Qualifications

  • PhD, Master's, or bachelor’s degree in mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience
  • 12+ years of experience in data analytics, data science, or comparable role
  • 4+ years of experience managing analytical teams, including demonstrated experience developing managers who lead teams of analysts
  • Proven track record creating meaningful changes through multi-year roadmaps or programs with measurable business impact
  • Expert-level proficiency in SQL and at least one scripting language (Python, R, or similar)
  • Demonstrated experience applying statistical techniques, experimental design (A/B testing, causal inference), and machine learning concepts to solve business problems
  • Proficient communication and influencing skills, with experience presenting senior leadership and facilitating strategic decision-making
  • Experience recruiting, evaluating talent, and participating in peer and team performance reviews

Accommodation requests

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.

About Expedia Group

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

job.job_description:
Role Purpose

Participate in feasibility and investment analysis for real estate development projects. With direction from project manager or director, conduct financial modeling, market research, and analysis of comparable asset performance. Coordinate with corporate Operations, Technical Services, Brand Management, Tax, Legal, and Finance Departments to ensure all issues relevant to development projects are properly identified, analyzed, and documented in the Company’s capital papers.

Key Accountabilities

  • Financial Modeling/Investment Analysis - Participate in financial modeling to include NPV, IRR, and earnings impact, by using proforma developed for Subject, proposed deal terms provided by VP of Development, and input as appropriate from Technical Services, Tax, and Financial Reporting teams. Review findings with Director or project manager to determine financial viability of project, and assist in developing proposed enhancements/modifications to deal terms to make each project meet the Company’s returns requirements. Revise modeling/analysis/proposal, as necessary, throughout negotiations of deal terms.
  • Market Feasibility Analysis – Participate in determining competitive set for hotel being analyzed (“Subject”) by reviewing existing supply in market place and identifying competitive assets. Obtain historical occupancy and ADR performance for the competitive set from Smith Travel Research and counterparts at other lodging companies. Determine positioning of the Subject within competitive set, review historical supply and demand growth patterns for the competitive set, and identify any known additions to supply in the market. Project occupancy and ADR for the Subject and determine viability of the Subject within the market. Review analysis and findings with VP of Operations and VP of Development to obtain consensus on market feasibility. Projects include small or relatively simple competitive sets.
  • Writing Capital Approval Papers – If the Company decides to pursue the project, participate in writing portions of the necessary approval papers for the Americas Operating Committee and the Executive Committee as directed (approval papers have historically ranged from 5 – 50 pages depending upon the size of the Company’s investment, and include a description of the project, the dynamics of the competitive market, competitive properties, proposed positioning of the Subject, deal structure, S.W.O.T. analysis, and financial implications to the Company).
  • Developing Proforma Income Statements - Obtain historical P&L (profit and loss) statements for comparable assets from within the Company’s estate, or from outside consultants. Review performance of competitive assets and similarities/dissimilarities between competitive assets and the Subject. Utilize most comparable key performance metrics from P&L statements analyzed and occupancy/ADR projections developed during market feasibility analysis to develop proforma P&L for the Subject. Review findings and support with VP of Operations and VP of Business Development, and develop consensus on the Subject’s projected performance.
  • Market/Industry Research – Consult with industry contacts (e.g., consultants, real estate brokers, counterparts at other major lodging companies, etc.) and review industry publications/forecasts to remain knowledgeable of general market/industry trends and to facilitate market/industry research. Provide findings to project manager or director and internal clients to facilitate understanding of competitive fee structures for business segments (e.g., timeshare branding, etc.) which are new to the Company. In addition, provide a framework on the direction of industry trends and performance to assist in projecting hotel performance.
  • Ad Hoc Investment Analysis Projects – May assist the Director of Investment Analysis or project manager with review of financial analysis conducted within other areas of the Finance Department. Assistance may include providing guidance to Finance Department on financial modeling and the Company’s analysis policies or conducting financial analysis for non-hotel specific projects such as the Company’s franchise development plan.

Key Skills & Experiences

Education –

  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Hotel Management, or a relevant field of work, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience.

Experience

  • 1-3 years progressive work-related experience in financial analysis, forecasting, statistical analysis, data mining and interpretation, or similar, with demonstrated understanding of multiple disciplines/processes related to the position.

Technical skills and Knowledge –

  • Demonstrated effective verbal and written communication skills for the purpose of providing information to clients, vendors and/or staff. Must be able to work effectively with senior managers, possess strong relationship management skills, and well-developed negotiating and persuading abilities.
  • Demonstrated financial and business analysis skills, and demonstrated ability to analyze operating, forecast, and budget information. Demonstrated ability to use the results of analysis to make effective strategic decisions.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of financial statements, financial principles and the ability to convert them to use in the hotel industry.
  • Demonstrated PeopleSoft, Hyperion, or similar computer system experience preferred
  • Highly proactive and flexible competency levels with the ability to work with minimal supervision.
  • Demonstrated organizational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks/projects.
  • Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of the relevant labor market, economic conditions, and industry trends. Demonstrated ability to analyze these factors and draw logical conclusions.
  • Demonstrated ability to use statistical mining software and related programs, as well as to generate documents or reports in EXCEL, Word and PowerPoint.

Please note that this is a hybrid position and requires going to the Guadalajara office 3-4 times per week.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team: 

Strategy & Analytics is fast growing and dynamic team within Strategic Partnerships department of Agoda. Strategic Partnerships is a team of creative entrepreneurs that develop solutions for Agoda’s non-accommodation partners and promote Agoda’s top and bottom line growth. We design tailored business and product solutions with our partners and help them generate measurable value. Members of our team are empowered and supported to grow their market(s) or accounts. The Strategy & Analytics team’s scope includes profitability optimization, target setting, KPI management, data analytics and business strategy.

  • This role is based in our Bangkok office with a hybrid setup (3 days in office per week). Relocation to Bangkok is required, and we will only consider applicants who are willing to relocate (Relocation support will be provided.)

Key Areas of Focus: 

In this role, you’ll get to:  

Strategy: Conduct analyses to identify growth opportunities and prioritize investment areas in APAC for Strategic Partnerships team based on analytical insights, industry trends, and changing competitive landscape.

Analytics: Leverage data & tools to analyze SP performance and identify appropriate levers to improve performance.  

Cross-functional projects: Work with different teams inside SP (B2B, White Label, Affiliates, Financial Institutions, different markets across APAC, etc.) and outside of SP (product, marketing, supply, finance, etc.) to drive initiatives. 

Performance management: Maintain and optimize a performance management system for the department, including a large team of account managers 

Data & tools: Oversee SP data infrastructure to ensure data accuracy, completeness, and timeliness. Design, manage, and oversee the maintenance of data tools to support decision making.  

Performance reporting: Preparing updates on business performance, proposals, and recommendations to senior management.

Pricing Experiments: Optimize pricing strategy and make decisions based on A/B experiments.  

This is an Individual contributor role, reporting to Associate Director, Strategy & Analytics

What you’ll Need to Succeed:  

  • 3+ years and above of total experience with Consulting, Data Analytics, Strategy, Business Development, Business Intelligence, or other relevant fields. 
  • Proven ability to leverage analytics and quantitative methods to break down ambiguous problems and come up with recommendations. 
  • Growth mindset and excited to work on a variety of functional areas.
  • Entrepreneurial and not afraid to be hands-on on the work. 
  • Experience working in a fast-paced and high growth environment. 
  • Excellent communication skills (both verbal and written in English) with ability to work well across multiple stakeholders. 

It’s Great if you have:   

  • Ability to write in SQL a plus, or willingness to learn 
  • Ability to use Tableau a plus, or willingness to learn 
  • Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Mathematics a plus

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You will be developing strategic marketing plans for the hotel and then overseeing the implementation and execution of the various efforts associated with the marketing plan. This might include evaluating the results of different marketing campaigns, spearheading market research efforts, or coordinating initiatives across a variety of channels. As a Marketing Communications Manager, you’re not just executing marketing campaigns to drive revenue growth – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Execute hotel marketing strategies: Support the design and rollout of property-specific campaigns across digital channels, social media, and branded platforms to drive visibility and revenue.
  • Stay up to date on industry trends: Monitor emerging marketing tools, technologies, and consumer behaviors relevant to the hotel industry and target audiences
  • Report on campaign performance: Prepare and deliver monthly performance updates and marketing analyses to Sales and Revenue Management teams
  • Support cross-functional initiatives: Partner with department leaders to execute targeted campaigns that drive revenue and guest engagement

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • Degree in Marketing, Communications, Hospitality, or related field
  • Minimum 3–5 years of marketing experience, preferably in hospitality
  • Proven expertise in digital marketing (SEO, SEM, email, social media)
  • Strong content creation and brand management skills
  • Experience in campaign planning, execution, and performance analysis
  • Proficiency in marketing tools and hotel systems (e.g., Salesforce, OnQ)
  • Excellent communication, project management, and analytical skills

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Please include a portfolio link in your application

About The Team

Expedia Group’s Creative Tech Team sits at the intersection of design, marketing, storytelling, automation, and engineering. We are building the next generation of AI-powered creative systems that help our brands show up in ways that are smarter, more personal, more dynamic, and distinctive for travelers around the world.

Working across Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo, the team turns creative ambitions into scalable realities - connecting brand expression with intelligent templates, structured design systems, automation, and emerging generative capabilities.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Creative Assembly Designer who thrives at the intersection of design, automation, and technology. In this highly hands-on role, you will oversee and execute highly crafted brand creative through scalable production systems, helping transform a single creative idea into thousands of high-quality, brand-safe assets across channels, markets, languages, and formats.

You will operate at the assembly layer between creative vision and automated production. Working alongside brand designers, creative technologists, software engineers, machine learning teams, copywriters, and marketing partners, you’ll translate creative intent into intelligent templates, modular systems, and production-ready workflows.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys the precision of production design as much as the craft of visual design - someone who can protect brand quality while increasing speed, experimentation, and creative scale.

In this role, you will

Build and execute creative assembly systems

  • Execute automated assembly systems that produce high-quality brand creative at scale.
  • Transform layered design files and campaign concepts into reusable, production-ready templates.
  • Develop dynamic layouts capable of generating large volumes of high-quality variations.
  • Assemble creative across multiple brands, channels, markets, languages, placements, and screen sizes.
  • Translate briefs and business objectives into channel-native creative for programmatic display, paid and organic social, paid app, app store, and other digital touchpoints.
  • Balance quality, scale, brand expression, and performance requirements across every output.
  • Partner with design teams to evolve one-off assets into durable creative systems.
  • Balance flexibility, creative expression, and production reliability across every output.

Design AI-native templates and systems

  • Test, prototype, and execute modular template systems using agentic AI tools and node-based workflows.
  • Build reusable components optimized for automation, localization, personalization, and rapid iteration.
  • Structure files and design systems to support dynamic content, localized copy, asset swapping, and AI-generated imagery or motion.
  • Explore generative brand components, adaptive layouts, and new ways for identity, motion, and storytelling to respond to context.
  • Help move promising experiments from prototype to repeatable, documented systems that global teams can adopt.

Automate creative production workflows

  • Contribute to and maintain creative assembly workflows using scripting, plugins, APIs, n8n, and other automation tools.
  • Automate repetitive production, versioning, validation, and export tasks across the creative pipeline.
  • Connect creative assets with structured data, content sources, DAMs, APIs, and AI workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers to translate creative requirements into clear technical specifications and production integrations.
  • Improve workflow speed, reliability, and observability while maintaining a high bar for craft.
  • Build systems that support always-on content, rapid-turn production, creative versioning, and high-volume campaign needs.
  • Partner with Growth and campaign teams to support test-and-learn programs, creative optimization, and iterative performance improvement.

Own quality assurance and delivery readiness

  • Create and perform independent quality assurance checks before assets are released.
  • Design automated validations for text overflow, image placement, safe areas, layout integrity, localization, accessibility, and brand compliance.
  • Identify and resolve graphics, copy, data, and template issues proactively.
  • Establish repeatable review and approval workflows that support Brand Studio and marketing partners.
  • Own final delivery readiness, ensuring exports are accurate, complete, on-brand, and fit for channel requirements.
  • Continuously improve template performance, output quality, and the reliability of the overall production system.
  • Validate responsive, mobile-first, and platform-specific behavior across formats, placements, and device experiences.
  • Use data, insights, and performance learnings to inform design decisions and improve the effectiveness of creative systems.

Collaborate, enable, and raise the bar

  • Partner closely with brand designers, copywriters, marketers, creative technologists, engineers, product teams, and machine learning specialists.
  • Act as a bridge between creative, marketing, and technical disciplines, making complex systems practical and approachable.
  • Lead or support workshops, demos, documentation, playbooks, and hands-on enablement for creative and marketing teams.
  • Share best practices across design and engineering communities and help define standards for creative automation.
  • Evaluate emerging models, tools, standards, and responsible-use practices, bringing relevant new thinking into production.
  • Clearly communicate the value, limitations, and opportunities of AI-powered creative workflows to partners and leadership.
  • Present work, system proposals, and creative recommendations clearly to senior creative leadership and cross-functional partners.
  • Help mentor peers and share practical guidance on motion systems, production craft, and emerging creative technologies.

What You Bring

Required qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience across digital design, production design, creative technology, design systems, or related disciplines, including at least 2 years working in template-based or automated production workflows.
  • Exceptional visual design craft and attention to detail, with the ability to protect brand quality at scale.
  • Hands-on experience with After Effects and n8n or comparable workflow-automation tools.
  • Advanced experience with Figma, Weavy, and other node-based creative workflows.
  • Experience creating scalable template systems, modular components, and dynamic layouts.
  • Strong understanding of design systems, production operations, asset structures, and multi-channel delivery.
  • Experience translating creative concepts into clear production logic, technical requirements, and repeatable workflows.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Design, Visual Communication, Computer Science, or a related field - or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong understanding of digital channel and platform best practices, with experience designing for responsive and mobile-first environments.
  • Ability to work fluidly in fast-paced, high-volume production environments while managing priorities and deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience integrating APIs, structured data, DAMs, or content systems into creative workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with generative AI tools, diffusion models, LLMs, prompting for production use, or AI-assisted asset generation.
  • Familiarity with tools and workflows such as Runway, ComfyUI, TensorFlow Magenta, GPT-based systems, StyleGAN, or comparable technologies.
  • Fluency across 2D, motion, and/or 3D workflows, with experience scaling assets across campaigns and product surfaces.
  • Experience with Unity, Unreal Engine, Cinema 4D, or related real-time and 3D tools.
  • Knowledge of DesignOps, creative operations, digital asset management, or marketing technology.
  • Experience supporting global brands and localization workflows across languages, markets, and channels.
  • Familiarity with machine learning-enabled production and responsible AI practices.
  • Working knowledge of HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, Google Web Designer, Animate, or comparable code-based creative production tools.
  • Experience working with external agencies, production partners, or distributed creative teams.
  • Experience defining or evolving brand guidelines, motion systems, design toolkits, or production standards.

Why this role matters

Creative production is evolving from manually creating individual assets to designing intelligent systems that produce them. As a Creative Assembly Designer, you’ll help build and operate the infrastructure that transforms creative concepts into thousands of high-quality, brand-safe assets across channels, markets, and languages.

By bridging design, automation, marketing, and engineering, you’ll help shape the future of AI-powered creative production - enabling faster workflows, greater creative diversity, and scalable content that helps millions of travelers experience Expedia Group brands in more relevant and distinctive ways.

Application

Please include a portfolio link in your application. We’re looking for a compelling showcase of your work in creative technology, systems design, automated production, motion, and/or AI implementation. Please highlight examples that show how you move from creative concept to scalable, production-ready execution.

job.job_description:
DESCRIPTION:

At InterContinental Hotels Group® InterContinental San Antonio Riverwalk we want our guests to feel special, cosmopolitan and In the Know which means we need you to:

  • Be charming by being approachable, having confidence and showing respect.
  • Stay in the moment by understanding and anticipating guests’ needs, being attentive and taking ownership of getting things done.
  • Make it memorable by being knowledgeable, sharing stories and showing your style to create moments that make people feel special.

Purpose:

Under the general guidance and supervision of the Director of Finance/Assistant Director of Finance, prepares, controls and maintains all vouchers, checks and records same in accordance with Policy and Procedures.

Relationships

  • Reports directly to Director of Finance/Assistant Director of Finance.
  • Interacts with other colleagues of the Accounting Office when necessary.
  • Interacts with outside members of the community such as, but not limited to, suppliers and customers.
  • Cooperate, coordinates with Hotel Departments as required.

Duties and Responsibilities for both the Accounts Payable & Receivable:

  • Obtains on daily basis from Cost Control Department, receiving reports together with appropriate purchase request.
  • Obtains on daily basis from Purchasing/Materials Department, various purchase orders.
  • Ensure appropriate signatures appear on receiving stamp report.
  • Prepares payable vouchers with expense distribution for supplier’s invoice appropriately coded.
  • Passes payable vouchers with blank cheque to Secretary for typing.
  • Controls the serial numbers of payable vouchers.
  • Files payable vouchers with cheques paid with relevant notes and documents monthly.
  • Maintains ledger for merchandise in transit, records, charges, credits and balance are adequate.
  • Controls prepaid accounts, updates posting as required and verifies that balances are adequate.
  • Matches invoices with purchase orders, receiving reports and check invoices as to quantity, price and extensions.
  • Checks the coding of all disbursements made by General Cashier.
  • Maintains up-to-date files accounts payable records.
  • Verifies monthly charges of Telephones/Telexes accounts against Hotel sales summary.
  • Assists the Director of Finance/Assistant Director of Finance in the preparation of monthly financial statements.
  • Complies with Hotel’s, Safety and Hygiene policy.
  • Process payment of invoices and strict adherence to all accounting policies and procedures.

ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Prepare all billings for mailing
  • Work directly with the catering and banquet teams to ensure accurate billing of clients
  • Maintain organized files for open and paid invoices
  • Place appropriate calls to clients for collections and maintain detail call logs of all correspondence with client
  • Prepare over 60-day report with detailed descriptions of account balances
  • Post all checks received – i.e. direct bill payments, advanced deposits, misc. checks
  • Prepare advanced deposit log as well as research any outstanding items
  • Assist guests with questions concerning charges on their credit card statements
  • Prepare and maintain monthly aging reports
  • Monthly gift certificate reconciliation log
  • Ensure accurate distribution of gift certificates to hotel personnel
  • Create and maintain client accounts in PMS
  • Post credit card payments from clients when appropriate
  • Help prepare documents for, and participate in, the Monthly Credit Meeting
  • Research and respond to all credit card chargeback’s
  • Maintain all direct bill applications
  • May assist with other duties as assigned
  • Assist in the preparation of credit checks

Performs related duties and special projects as assigned.

This job requires ability to perform the following:

  • Carrying or lifting items weighing up to 25 pounds
  • Standing up and moving about the front office or other designated areas
  • Communicating with other people
  • Handling objects, supplies, boxes of merchandise, etc.
  • Bending, stooping, kneeling, crouching, reaching

Other:

  • Reading abilities are utilized often when reading invoices and work materials.
  • Mathematical skills are used frequently to perform calculations, reconcile account balances, etc.
  • Frequent contact with guests and outside vendors is necessary to resolve billing issues or answer questions. Strong customer service skills are required.
  • May be required to work nights, weekends, and/or holidays.

The hourly pay rate for this role is $18.46-$25.00. We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, 401k, and many other benefits to eligible employees.

As the world’s first and most global luxury hotel brand, InterContinental Hotels & Resorts has pioneered international travel since the 1940s, we are passionate about sharing our renowned international know-how and cultural wisdom in truly impressive surroundings. We all take great pride in being genuine ambassadors of the InterContinental®️ brand and to be part of the brand you will have a thirst for travel, passion for culture and appreciation for diversity. We create inspiring experiences for those seeking a richer perspective on the world. If you’d like to embrace a world of opportunities, we’d like to welcome you to the world’s most international luxury hotel brand.

Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

job.job_description:
Job Description

As the Restaurant Manager of Moody Tongue Sushi, you will lead daily operations at 2025 and 2026 MICHELIN Selection Moody Tongue Sushi at Hilton West Palm Beach, delivering attentive service, developing the team, and driving restaurant performance.

Step into one of South Florida’s most exciting dining experiences as the Moody Tongue Sushi Manager at Hilton West Palm Beach. This role offers the opportunity to lead a refined, guest-focused operation where elevated hospitality and exceptional culinary experiences come together. You'll inspire and develop a talented team, drive service excellence, and create memorable moments for guests while partnering with a world-renowned restaurant concept. Ideal for a hospitality leader who is passionate about food, beverage, and delivering polished service in a dynamic, high-energy environment.

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Bring warm hospitality and a hands-on approach to a dining experience centered on sushi and a thoughtfully paired beer program. As the Moody Tongue Sushi Manager, you will work closely with hotel Food & Beverage leadership, the culinary team, and Moody Tongue representatives to uphold service standards and create memorable experiences for hotel guests and local diners.

Responsibilities

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:

  • Ensure seamless operations: Lead daily restaurant service, including opening and closing, reservations, seating, and service pacing. Coordinate with the culinary team to maintain readiness, presentation, and timely delivery.
  • Enhance guest satisfaction and service excellence: Maintain an active presence on the floor, build guest relationships, and resolve concerns promptly. Monitor guest feedback and reservation preferences to improve service consistency and encourage repeat visits.
  • Drive operational efficiency: Prepare schedules aligned with forecasted business, monitor sales and labor, and manage beverage inventory, ordering, and waste. Maintain accurate POS and cash-handling practices and coordinate food cost controls with the culinary team.
  • Elevate quality and service standards: Uphold Hilton and Moody Tongue Sushi standards in partnership with hotel leadership and Moody Tongue representatives. Support approved promotions, pairing experiences, and private dining opportunities that grow revenue and profitability.
  • Inspire and develop the team: Supervise, coach, and develop team members through pre-shift briefings, ongoing feedback, and recognition. Build knowledge of sushi, ingredients, allergens, craft beer, sake, wine, and beverage pairings to support confident recommendations and attentive service.
  • Uphold regulatory standards: Maintain compliance with health, safety, sanitation, and responsible alcohol service requirements. Reinforce allergy communication, cleanliness, and safe service practices to protect guests and team members.

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

About The Team

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
  • Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
  • Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
  • Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
  • Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
  • Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Generous paid time off (PTO) – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters most
  • Health & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family covered
  • Financial security for your future – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what’s next
  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

Manager, Tax & Compliance Technology

Introduction to the Team

Our Corporate Functions are made up of teams that support Expedia Group, including our Global Finance Organization, Traveler and Partner Service Platform, Legal Team, Strategy and Corporate Development Team, and People and Places Organization.

The Tax & Compliance Technology team supports the tax and compliance capabilities that underpin Expedia Group’s global travel marketplace. The team manages tax content for all jurisdictions and lines of business, coordinates jurisdiction launches and operates tax engine and compliance workflows in partnership with tax, product, engineering, legal, finance, and business operations teams.

Make an impact

As Manager, Tax & Compliance Technology, you will lead a people-focused, technically grounded operations team that keeps critical tax technology accurate, resilient, and ready for change. You will combine day-to-day operational leadership with hands-on expertise in tax content, tax determination platforms, compliance controls, escalations, and continuous improvement. You will help translate regulatory and business needs into reliable operating practices while developing a team that can scale with Expedia Group’s global marketplace.

In this role, you will

  • Lead and develop a tax technology operations team, setting clear goals, managing performance, building capability, and creating a culture of accountability, inclusion, learning, and continuous improvement.
  • Own operational performance across tax content management, jurisdiction launches, tax engine administration, monthly remittance changes, incident and problem management, service queues, and critical escalations.
  • Serve as a player-coach and subject matter expert across tax determination and compliance platforms, partnering with Tax, Regulatory, Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, and frontline operations to resolve complex issues and improve customer outcomes.
  • Plan capacity, prioritize work, and maintain effective coverage across business-as-usual operations, regulatory change, launches, audits, projects, and urgent requests, including work delivered through managed-service or supplier partners.
  • Establish measurable operating controls, documentation, knowledge-management practices, and readiness criteria that improve accuracy, reduce manual workarounds, and support dependable launches.
  • Influence the technology roadmap by identifying operational bottlenecks, automation opportunities, data and reporting needs, and platform improvements; communicate trade-offs and recommendations to technical and non-technical leaders.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Finance, Tax, Accounting, or a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience.
  • 8+ years of relevant professional experience in technology operations, tax technology, tax operations, compliance technology, or a related domain.
  • 3+ years of experience directly managing, coaching, and developing individual contributors, including experience with performance management and capacity planning.
  • Experience operating and improving multiple technology implementations or operational domains, with a track record of resolving escalations and improving service quality.
  • Experience partnering with technical and business stakeholders to define requirements, assess operational readiness, support testing or launches, and deliver measurable proces

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing indirect-tax content, jurisdictional rule changes, tax determination, or tax-engine operations; experience with Vertex, Avalara, or similar platforms is helpful.
  • Experience leading globally distributed teams and coordinating managed-service, vendor, or supplier delivery against service, quality, and control expectations.
  • Familiarity with compliance controls, audit support, regulatory change management, UAT, incident/problem management, and operational readiness practices.
  • Experience using automation, AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows to improve operational accuracy, speed, knowledge access, or reporting.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence product and technology roadmaps, identify cross-team dependencies, and deliver improvements across a complex, multi-stakeholder environment.

Location expectations

Please note that this role is only available in Seattle, in alignment with our flexible work model which requires employees to be in-office at least three days a week.

The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $116,500.00 to $163,000.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $186,500.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction to the Team

Our Corporate Functions teams support Expedia Group through specialized expertise across Finance, Legal, People, communications, and other critical areas. Together, these teams enable the business to operate effectively, make informed decisions, and deliver meaningful experiences for travelers and partners.

Expedia Group’s Tax organization provides strategic guidance and operational partnership across a complex, highly matrixed global business. Reporting to the Director, Global Tax Reporting, the Tax Manager will help calculate and report the U.S. tax effects of Expedia Group’s international operations while partnering with Global Finance and Tax teams to support timely, accurate reporting.

Key Responsibilities

In This Role, You Will

  • Support quarterly and year-end U.S. GAAP tax provisions for international operations.
  • Calculate and analyze foreign tax credits, FDDEI deductions, Subpart F and NCTI inclusions, and Section 987 gains and losses.
  • Review book-to-tax differences related to international operations.
  • Review U.S. international tax forms, including Forms 1118, 5471, 8858, 8865, 8990, and 8992.
  • Support international components of U.S. federal income tax audits and other inquiries.
  • Maintain audit-ready workpapers, documentation, and financial records.
  • Provide tax support for international transactions, including mergers and acquisitions, reorganizations, and other business initiatives.
  • Monitor tax legislation and translate changes into clear recommendations for leadership.
  • Drive AI-enabled process improvements and support adoption of new tax technology tools.
  • Maintain process documentation, strengthen controls, and contribute to tax reporting transformation initiatives.
  • Build effective partnerships across Tax, Finance, and other cross-functional teams.

Required

Experience and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Tax, or a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience, plus 5+ years of experience in a Big Four firm or equivalent environment.
  • Strong technical knowledge of U.S. international tax, ASC 740, and federal income tax concepts.
