job.job_description:
Organization- Hyatt Corporate Office

Summary

The Opportunity

Hyatt Hotels Corporation is looking for a passionate and enthusiastic Corporate Counsel (the “Counsel”) to join its Legal Department. The Counsel will be a part of and report into the transactions team and support transactions for Hyatt-franchised and Hyatt-managed hotels in North America. The Counsel will work on deals both independently and with other lawyers and paralegals in the Legal Department, manage outside counsel, support diverse client groups within the Company, and interact with leaders at all levels of the Company, both in the Chicago headquarters and the field. The position is located at the Company’s headquarters in downtown Chicago, Illinois, with a minimum requirement of 3 days per week in office. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Experience: The successful candidate will have 4-8+ years of experience in a law firm and/or an in-house legal department with experience in commercial transactions, mergers and acquisitions, real estate, or finance. Experience with the hotel industry, hotel management agreements, and franchise agreements is preferred but not required.

Location/Relocation: Chicago, Illinois.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list since 2013. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

  • Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on-site fitness center
  • A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption
  • Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

The Role

Key responsibilities include providing legal support to clients throughout the organization as well as colleagues within the Legal Department. This role involves interaction at all levels of the Company, both in the corporate headquarters and in the field.

This includes, but is not limited to:

  • Advising on and handling a broad range of commercial matters relating to hotel ownership, franchise relationships, and hotel management structures, including structuring, drafting, and negotiating hotel management agreements, hotel franchise agreements, and related commercial arrangements.
  • Supporting Hyatt’s development and asset management teams in connection with new hotel deals, contract renewals, amendments, financings, restructurings, and portfolio transactions.
  • Advising on owner/franchisee relationship matters, including contract renewals, terminations, amendments, owner/franchisee financings, and dispute avoidance/resolution.
  • Structuring, negotiating, and conducting diligence in connection with acquisitions, dispositions, co-ownership, and credit support structures, purchase and sale agreements, and other operative agreements for opening and operating hotels.
  • Negotiating agreements and liaising across legal and other departments related to hotel transitions, including conversions between managed and franchised properties, changes of hotel ownership, openings, and exits.
  • Effectively working with attorneys, paralegals, and outside counsel on matters, as necessary, to accomplish legal and business objectives.

Qualifications

Experience Required

  • 4-8+ years of experience in a transactional practice in a law firm or an in-house legal department.
  • Juris Doctorate degree and licensed to practice in a jurisdiction within the United States.
  • Leadership acumen and a track record of demonstrating these skills.
  • Demonstrated track record of accountability for outcomes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to communicate clearly and concisely.
  • Responsible and proactive self-starter, capable of simultaneously handling multiple, multi-faceted projects and competing deadlines.
  • Ability to work both independently with minimal supervision and collaboratively as part of cross-functional teams.
  • High level of integrity and professional ethics.
  • Superior intellect, with the ability to think critically and make clear and well-reasoned decisions; ability to see and handle more than the legal issues of a project; strong, pragmatic business acumen with the ability to recognize the business consequences of legal advice; a strategic and innovative thinker who can bring value to his or her clients, anticipate issues and find creative solutions to complex legal problems.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to interface effectively and appropriately with individuals at all levels, both within and outside the Company.
  • Enthusiasm, passion, and a down-to-earth attitude with a “roll up your sleeves” approach.

Experience Preferred:

  • Experience with the hotel industry and/or hotel management agreements and franchise agreements.

The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all-encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary.

We welcome you:

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.

The salary range for this position is $160,000 to $190,000. This position is also eligible to earn incentive awards, an annual bonus, monthly or quarterly incentives, etc.

The final pay rate/salary offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level, and other qualifications for the role, as well as the location of the performance of work. Pay for the successful candidate will meet local requirements, including the local minimum wage rate.

We value our relationships with recruitment partners and require that agencies contact us first before submitting any candidates. Hyatt will not be responsible for any fees and obligations associated with unsolicited submissions unless a formal agreement is in place.

Du möchtest eigenverantwortlich arbeiten, ohne auf den Rückhalt eines starken Netzwerks zu verzichten? Du bist ein Macher, hast Freude am Verkauf und begeisterst Menschen mit Deiner Leidenschaft fürs Reisen?

Begeistere Kunden von unvergesslichen Urlaubserlebnissen - und uns von Deiner Persönlichkeit!

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

This role is based at our corporate office in McLean, VA

The Senior Strategic Marketing Program Manager plays a pivotal role in enabling Hilton's Marketing & Loyalty organization to operationalize high priority strategies into coordinated, measurable business outcomes. This role leads complex strategic programs that may include new launches, enterprise partnerships, Hilton Honors experiences, global marketing initiatives, and other business-critical priorities.

Reporting to the Director, Global Marketing Strategy, Operations & Program Management, this role operates with broad influence, partnering closely with executive sponsors and leaders across Hilton's Marketing & Loyalty organization and the broader enterprise. In a highly matrixed global environment spanning functional teams, business units, trading brands, regions, and external partners, this role serves as a senior integrator from program definition through launch, stabilization, and transition. The Senior Strategic Program Manager brings structure to ambiguity, aligns stakeholders around shared outcomes and decisions, and establishes the governance and execution discipline required to deliver with speed, quality, and accountability.

What You'll Do During a Typical Day

  • Lead the end-to-end orchestration of complex, high-priority programs across Marketing & Loyalty and the broader enterprise, including new brand launches, strategic partnerships, Hilton Honors experiences, cross-regional initiatives, and other enterprise priorities.
  • Translate business strategy and leadership direction into clear program charters, objectives, scope, success measures, integrated roadmaps, and executable workplans.
  • Act as a senior integrator across brand, marketing, loyalty, partnerships, regional marketing, commercial, digital, creative, media, analytics, technology, finance and external partners.
  • Establish effective program governance, including roles and responsibilities, decision rights, workstream accountabilities, milestone plans, operating cadences, and escalation paths.
  • Manage critical paths, cross-workstream dependencies, resources, risks, issues, changes, and trade-offs; surface implications early and drive resolution.
  • Lead cross-functional working sessions, leadership reviews, steering committees, and launch-readiness forums that convert discussion into clear decisions, owners, and actions.
  • Balance enterprise objectives and standards with brand, regional, market, and partner needs, ensuring coordinated sequencing, localization, adoption, and execution readiness.
  • Identify systemic gaps in ways of working and lead improvements to program management processes, operating models, playbooks, tools, and collaboration practices.

How You'll Collaborate With Others

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to executive sponsors and senior leaders, providing concise, decision-oriented communication on program health, risks, trade-offs, options, and recommendations.
  • Build alignment and shared accountability across diverse teams and influence outcomes without direct authority.
  • Facilitate high priority and ambiguous conversations with experience to move teams from complexity to clarity.
  • Partner with functional, brand, regional, business, and external partner leaders to ensure plans are integrated, commitments are realistic, and operational plans can be adopted and sustained.

Projects You'll Take Ownership Of

  • A varied portfolio of strategic programs spanning key enterprise priorities. Program framing and mobilization, including charters, stakeholder maps, governance models, workstream structures, success measures, and responsibility matrices.
  • Integrated program roadmaps and detailed plans, including milestones, dependencies, critical paths, resource assumptions, risk and issue logs, decision logs, and change control.
  • Weekly, monthly, and quarterly program updates, executive briefings, steering committee materials, and decision papers tailored to different levels of the organization.
  • Cross-functional kickoffs, operating cadences, workstream reviews, leadership forums, and escalation mechanisms that maintain momentum and accountability.
  • Launch and implementation readiness, including integrated readiness plans, testing and validation, contingency planning, stakeholder communications, and transition to business owners.
  • Post-launch stabilization and program closeout, including outcome measurement, lessons learned, benefit realization, knowledge transfer, and reusable playbooks.
  • Adoption of AI-enabled tools and modern program management methodologies to improve planning, synthesis, risk identification, decision support, and operational effectiveness.

What It Takes to Make the Stay

You Have These Minimum Qualifications

  • Seven (7) years of professional experience in strategic program management, business operations, strategy, consulting, marketing, loyalty, or a related discipline.
  • Four (4) years of experience leading complex, cross-functional programs from strategy through implementation in a large, global, matrixed organization.
  • Demonstrated expertise translating strategy into structured execution and measurable outcomes, with strong command of scope, schedule, governance, risk, issue, decision, and change management.
  • Experience synthesizing complex information into concise updates, decision points, trade-offs, and recommendations.
  • Exceptional stakeholder leadership and influence across functions, brands, regions, partners, and organizational levels.
  • Broad business and marketing acumen, with working knowledge of brand, loyalty and customer experience, partnerships, digital, media, analytics, technology, commercial functions, and regional activation.
  • Travel up to 5%.

It Would Be Useful If You Have

  • Experience in hospitality, travel, consumer services, loyalty programs, new brand launches, or strategic partnerships.
  • Experience in management consulting, enterprise transformation, strategy execution, or a strategic program management office.
  • PMP, Agile, Prosci, or comparable program, project, or change management certification.
  • Experience understanding business cases, managing investment and resource assumptions, and connecting program delivery to business value.
  • Experience leading global programs and navigating regional or market-specific requirements, operating models, and stakeholder dynamics.
  • Demonstrated success building and scaling program governance, operating cadences, playbooks, or enterprise ways of working.
  • Fluency with modern program management and collaboration tools and the use of data to create transparency, accountability, and insight.
  • Experience applying AI tools and methodologies to improve planning, research, synthesis and productivity.

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we're known for doesn't end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members' wellbeing, supporting you through all of life's moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
  • Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
  • Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
  • Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
  • Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
  • Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Generous paid time off (PTO) – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters most
  • Health & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family covered
  • Financial security for your future – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what's next
  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member's location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

Hilton offers its eligible team members a comprehensive benefits package to support their mental and physical well-being, so they can Thrive personally and professionally. The pay range for this role is $100,000 – $145,000 and is determined based on applicable and specialized experience and location. Subject to plan terms and conditions, you will be eligible to participate in the Hilton Annual Incentive (Bonus) Plan, consistent with other team members at the same level and/or position within the Company.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Please include a portfolio link in your application

About The Team

Expedia Group’s Creative Tech Team sits at the intersection of design, marketing, storytelling, automation, and engineering. We are building the next generation of AI-powered creative systems that help our brands show up in ways that are smarter, more personal, more dynamic, and distinctive for travelers around the world.

Working across Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo, the team turns creative ambitions into scalable realities - connecting brand expression with intelligent templates, structured design systems, automation, and emerging generative capabilities.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Creative Assembly Designer who thrives at the intersection of design, automation, and technology. In this highly hands-on role, you will oversee and execute highly crafted brand creative through scalable production systems, helping transform a single creative idea into thousands of high-quality, brand-safe assets across channels, markets, languages, and formats.

You will operate at the assembly layer between creative vision and automated production. Working alongside brand designers, creative technologists, software engineers, machine learning teams, copywriters, and marketing partners, you’ll translate creative intent into intelligent templates, modular systems, and production-ready workflows.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys the precision of production design as much as the craft of visual design - someone who can protect brand quality while increasing speed, experimentation, and creative scale.

In this role, you will

Build and execute creative assembly systems

  • Execute automated assembly systems that produce high-quality brand creative at scale.
  • Transform layered design files and campaign concepts into reusable, production-ready templates.
  • Develop dynamic layouts capable of generating large volumes of high-quality variations.
  • Assemble creative across multiple brands, channels, markets, languages, placements, and screen sizes.
  • Translate briefs and business objectives into channel-native creative for programmatic display, paid and organic social, paid app, app store, and other digital touchpoints.
  • Balance quality, scale, brand expression, and performance requirements across every output.
  • Partner with design teams to evolve one-off assets into durable creative systems.
  • Balance flexibility, creative expression, and production reliability across every output.

Design AI-native templates and systems

  • Test, prototype, and execute modular template systems using agentic AI tools and node-based workflows.
  • Build reusable components optimized for automation, localization, personalization, and rapid iteration.
  • Structure files and design systems to support dynamic content, localized copy, asset swapping, and AI-generated imagery or motion.
  • Explore generative brand components, adaptive layouts, and new ways for identity, motion, and storytelling to respond to context.
  • Help move promising experiments from prototype to repeatable, documented systems that global teams can adopt.

Automate creative production workflows

  • Contribute to and maintain creative assembly workflows using scripting, plugins, APIs, n8n, and other automation tools.
  • Automate repetitive production, versioning, validation, and export tasks across the creative pipeline.
  • Connect creative assets with structured data, content sources, DAMs, APIs, and AI workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers to translate creative requirements into clear technical specifications and production integrations.
  • Improve workflow speed, reliability, and observability while maintaining a high bar for craft.
  • Build systems that support always-on content, rapid-turn production, creative versioning, and high-volume campaign needs.
  • Partner with Growth and campaign teams to support test-and-learn programs, creative optimization, and iterative performance improvement.

Own quality assurance and delivery readiness

  • Create and perform independent quality assurance checks before assets are released.
  • Design automated validations for text overflow, image placement, safe areas, layout integrity, localization, accessibility, and brand compliance.
  • Identify and resolve graphics, copy, data, and template issues proactively.
  • Establish repeatable review and approval workflows that support Brand Studio and marketing partners.
  • Own final delivery readiness, ensuring exports are accurate, complete, on-brand, and fit for channel requirements.
  • Continuously improve template performance, output quality, and the reliability of the overall production system.
  • Validate responsive, mobile-first, and platform-specific behavior across formats, placements, and device experiences.
  • Use data, insights, and performance learnings to inform design decisions and improve the effectiveness of creative systems.

Collaborate, enable, and raise the bar

  • Partner closely with brand designers, copywriters, marketers, creative technologists, engineers, product teams, and machine learning specialists.
  • Act as a bridge between creative, marketing, and technical disciplines, making complex systems practical and approachable.
  • Lead or support workshops, demos, documentation, playbooks, and hands-on enablement for creative and marketing teams.
  • Share best practices across design and engineering communities and help define standards for creative automation.
  • Evaluate emerging models, tools, standards, and responsible-use practices, bringing relevant new thinking into production.
  • Clearly communicate the value, limitations, and opportunities of AI-powered creative workflows to partners and leadership.
  • Present work, system proposals, and creative recommendations clearly to senior creative leadership and cross-functional partners.
  • Help mentor peers and share practical guidance on motion systems, production craft, and emerging creative technologies.

What You Bring

Required qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience across digital design, production design, creative technology, design systems, or related disciplines, including at least 2 years working in template-based or automated production workflows.
  • Exceptional visual design craft and attention to detail, with the ability to protect brand quality at scale.
  • Hands-on experience with After Effects and n8n or comparable workflow-automation tools.
  • Advanced experience with Figma, Weavy, and other node-based creative workflows.
  • Experience creating scalable template systems, modular components, and dynamic layouts.
  • Strong understanding of design systems, production operations, asset structures, and multi-channel delivery.
  • Experience translating creative concepts into clear production logic, technical requirements, and repeatable workflows.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Design, Visual Communication, Computer Science, or a related field - or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong understanding of digital channel and platform best practices, with experience designing for responsive and mobile-first environments.
  • Ability to work fluidly in fast-paced, high-volume production environments while managing priorities and deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience integrating APIs, structured data, DAMs, or content systems into creative workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with generative AI tools, diffusion models, LLMs, prompting for production use, or AI-assisted asset generation.
  • Familiarity with tools and workflows such as Runway, ComfyUI, TensorFlow Magenta, GPT-based systems, StyleGAN, or comparable technologies.
  • Fluency across 2D, motion, and/or 3D workflows, with experience scaling assets across campaigns and product surfaces.
  • Experience with Unity, Unreal Engine, Cinema 4D, or related real-time and 3D tools.
  • Knowledge of DesignOps, creative operations, digital asset management, or marketing technology.
  • Experience supporting global brands and localization workflows across languages, markets, and channels.
  • Familiarity with machine learning-enabled production and responsible AI practices.
  • Working knowledge of HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, Google Web Designer, Animate, or comparable code-based creative production tools.
  • Experience working with external agencies, production partners, or distributed creative teams.
  • Experience defining or evolving brand guidelines, motion systems, design toolkits, or production standards.

Why this role matters

Creative production is evolving from manually creating individual assets to designing intelligent systems that produce them. As a Creative Assembly Designer, you’ll help build and operate the infrastructure that transforms creative concepts into thousands of high-quality, brand-safe assets across channels, markets, and languages.

By bridging design, automation, marketing, and engineering, you’ll help shape the future of AI-powered creative production - enabling faster workflows, greater creative diversity, and scalable content that helps millions of travelers experience Expedia Group brands in more relevant and distinctive ways.

Application

Please include a portfolio link in your application. We’re looking for a compelling showcase of your work in creative technology, systems design, automated production, motion, and/or AI implementation. Please highlight examples that show how you move from creative concept to scalable, production-ready execution.

The Senior Manager, Mobile Engineering leads the teams responsible for Expedia's native iOS and Android platforms, providing both technical and people leadership across mobile engineering. The role is accountable for engineering execution, platform strategy, operational excellence, and talent development, ensuring teams deliver reliable, scalable, and high-quality mobile experiences. Working closely with Product, Design, Architecture, Security, Quality, and Operations partners, this leader will help shape the future of Expedia's mobile ecosystem, driving engineering best practices, modern mobile architecture, release readiness, observability, and the effective adoption of AI-enabled development capabilities.

The team plays a critical role in delivering seamless customer experiences while enabling the business to bring new products and features to market quickly and safely. Current priorities include evolving the next generation of mobile platform architecture, improving app performance and release quality, strengthening observability and operational resilience, and reducing the risk of customer-impacting issues in production. This is an opportunity to lead a highly experienced team and influence technical strategy across a business-critical platform, with direct impact on customer satisfaction, engineering velocity, and Expedia's mobile growth.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead mobile engineering teams delivering reliable, scalable native applications and shared mobile platform capabilities across multiple product domains.
  • Set technical direction for mobile architecture, including system design, low-level design, API design, data modeling, integration patterns, and maintainable implementation practices across iOS and Android.
  • Build and develop a high-performing, distributed engineering organization through hiring, performance management, mentoring, career development, skill planning, and clear alignment to customer and business outcomes.
  • Partner with Product, Design, Architecture, Quality, Operations, App Release, Security, and business teams to shape roadmaps, manage dependencies, and deliver measurable product and platform outcomes.
  • Establish predictable release and operational practices across the App Store and Google Play, improving software quality, observability, release safety, incident response, performance, accessibility, and customer-impacting reliability.
  • Safely integrate and operate AI/ML-enabled solutions that improve engineering and product outcomes, applying AI-driven tools and workflows appropriately within mobile experiences and engineering platforms.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of relevant professional experience and 3+ years of people-management experience, including leadership of mobile engineering teams delivering production applications through the App Store and Google Play.
  • Experience owning engineering outcomes across multiple services or a substantial mobile technology domain, including architecture, roadmap delivery, reliability, operational performance, maintenance, and technical investment.
  • Strong knowledge of mobile software development across iOS, Android, and shared mobile capabilities, including system design, low-level design, API design, data modeling, testing, deployment, release management, and production operations.
  • Experience developing technical strategy, managing capacity and staffing, influencing cross-functional stakeholders, and leading teams through complex engineering and product initiatives.
  • Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products, including safely integrating AI-enabled capabilities into mobile experiences or engineering platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading architecture and engineering strategy for large-scale native mobile platforms serving multiple products or domains, with the ability to apply mobile expertise across varied technical and organizational contexts.
  • Demonstrated success improving operational excellence through observability, incident management, release automation, quality practices, phased rollouts, rollback and hotfix processes, and data-driven engineering decisions.
  • Experience building adaptable, high-performing engineering teams and establishing practices that improve delivery velocity, technical quality, developer effectiveness, and resource utilization.
  • Experience using product, customer, and operational data—including crash-free users, startup and time-to-interactive performance, ANR or freeze rates, adoption, experiment health, and customer-impacting defects—to prioritize investments and guide technical decisions.

job.job_description:
Organization- Hyatt Corporate Office

Summary

The Opportunity

Hyatt Hotels Corporation seeks an enthusiastic Product Manager of Customer Data Platform (CDP) to join our Marketing Technology team. In this role, you will be collaborating closely with the broader Data Product, Marketing, World of Hyatt Loyalty, CRM, Paid Media and Digital teams, where you’ll be instrumental in continuing to make Hyatt a leading hospitality company. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list since 2013. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

  • Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on-site fitness center
  • A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption
  • Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

The Role

As the Product Manager for the Customer Data Platform, you will guide important programs from creation through execution. You will be in a unique position of having multiple teams as your core customers (Global Marketing, The Hyatt Personalization, World of Hyatt Loyalty, Paid Media, Data Product). You will lean on and partner with an accomplished engineering team to ensure that our products meet customer requirements and promote Hyatt’s growth. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in data integration, customer data management, and marketing technology, with the ability to translate business needs into scalable product solutions that enhance customer insights and drive data-driven marketing and sales efforts.

  • Work in cross-functional and agile product pods alongside Data Engineers, Data Stewards, Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, other Product Managers, and executives to improve the experience of guests and customers worldwide
  • Own and manage the end-to-end product lifecycle of the Customer Data Platform, including strategy, roadmap, feature definition, and delivery
  • Lead the planning, scoping, and prioritization of projects to achieve all of our goals and outcomes
  • Gather requirements, determine features and their priority, write product specs, refine feedback, help write test plans, manage the backlog, and ship products quickly
  • Ensure data quality definition, monitoring, alerts and recourse is built into roadmap plans and engineering requirements of each data initiative/product
  • Ensure new data or product requirements are in compliance with Hyatt policies and/or corresponding contracts before being passed to engineers
  • Define and ensure products meet business SLAs
  • Represent the team with partners and senior company leaders to align resources and prioritization
  • Promote enterprise-wide adoption of the Customer Data Platform
  • Educate teams on the Customer Data Platform and use cases
  • Foster an environment that enables the Customer Data Platform to grow and advance quickly while maintaining a high standard for quality
  • Some travel may be required

Qualifications

Experience Required:

  • 4+ years of experience as a Product Manager with a record of successfully managing, building or launching enterprise or consumer software, applications or business intelligence tools
  • 2+ years of experience working with Customer Data Platforms utilizing 1st party data to create customer profiles and building audiences
  • Proven experience working in an agile environment
  • Proven experience shipping products
  • Knowledge of modern data Infrastructure, data governance and related processes
  • Proven ability to navigate difficult situations with competing stakeholder needs and across multiple audiences (individual contributors, managers, executives)
  • Experience with customer empathy and experience shaping product direction and execution based on customer needs
  • Excellent organization, communication, and presentation skills

Experience Preferred:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Experience working with Customer Data Platforms, preferably Amperity
  • Experience using Jira, ThoughtSpot, Confluence

The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all-encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary.

We welcome you:

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.

We value our relationships with recruitment partners and require that agencies contact us first before submitting any candidates. Hyatt will not be responsible for any fees and obligations associated with unsolicited submissions unless a formal agreement is in place.

The salary range for this position is $115,000 -125,000. This position is also eligible to earn an annual bonus.

The final pay rate/salary offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level and other qualifications for the role, as well as the location of the performance of work. Pay for the successful candidate will meet local requirements, including the local minimum wage rate.

Introduction to the Team

Expedia Technology teams partner with our Product teams to create innovative products, services, and tools that deliver high-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction.

The Software Development Engineer III position is part of the Consumer Payments team within Expedia Global Payments, under the Travel foundations org. This team builds and maintains critical systems that power backend APIs for consumer and B2B payment processing, administrative tools for payment configuration, and support for a variety of payment methods across the platform.

Our services are designed with security, scalability, and availability in mind, supporting credit card processing and payment routing at global scale. As an engineer on this team, you'll apply your passion for backend development, cloud computing, and modern engineering practices to solve real-world challenges that impact millions of travelers and partners worldwide. We are looking for an engineer who demonstrates strong ownership, follows through on commitments, and takes pride in building reliable systems that perform well in production.

In This Role, You Will

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend payment services that support Expedia’s global travel platform
  • Apply software design principles, data structures and/or design patterns and computer science fundamentals to write code that is clean, maintainable, optimized, modular with good naming conventions
  • Implement secure data handling practices to protect payment information and meet compliance standards
  • Recommend and apply architectural patterns or GenAI capabilities to improve system design and innovation
  • Enhance service reliability through observability, automation, and continuous operational improvements
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact features aligned with Expedia’s strategic goals

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or Master's in a related technical field, or equivalent related professional experience
  • 5+ years of experience in backend software development, working with cloud-based and distributed systems at scale
  • Proficiency in Java or Kotlin, with hands-on experience integrating services with relational and NoSQL databases
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure/test automation, and delivering features in Agile development environments

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working on payment platforms or implementing backend services leveraging GenAI technologies
  • Experience contributing to multiple multi-quarter, cross-team projects
  • Experience supporting complex distributed systems in production through monitoring, debugging, incident resolution, and root-cause analysis
  • Demonstrated experience designing and deploying scalable services on AWS
  • A Master's degree in a related technical field

Please note that this role is only available in Austin, TX, in alignment with our flexible work model, which requires employees to be in the office at least three days a week. We are unable to offer relocation assistance for this role.

The total cash range for this position in Austin is $146,000.00 to $204,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $233,500.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Benefits And Perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life.

Accommodation requests

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Important notice

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Objetivo

Garantizar la correcta puesta en marcha de instalaciones, equipos y sistemas del hotel, estableciendo una operación de Ingeniería segura, eficiente y alineada con los estándares de la marca.


Principales funciones:

  • Reclutar, capacitar y desarrollar al equipo.

  • Garantizar el cumplimiento de estándares de seguridad y normativas aplicables.
  • Impulsar iniciativas de eficiencia energética y sustentabilidad.

job.job_description:
Job Title

FinCrime Specialist

Summary

Join our FinCrime team as a FinCrime Operations Specialist, where you’ll play a key role in protecting our business and customers by executing day-to-day controls across AML, Fraud, Sanctions, Transaction Monitoring, and KYC/KYB. You’ll investigate alerts, conduct onboarding and due diligence checks, make risk-based decisions, and contribute to building a robust, efficient, and continuously improving Financial Crime operating model.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute FinCrime controls: Conduct KYC/KYB onboarding and refresh checks, review and investigate AML, Fraud, Sanctions and Transaction Monitoring alerts, and ensure accurate, well-documented decisions within agreed SLAs and quality standards.
  • Support risk management & improvement: Identify risks, recurring issues and process inefficiencies, escalate complex or high-risk cases, and contribute to process improvements, workflow tuning, SOP updates and ad-hoc FinCrime projects.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders: Work closely with Product, Customer Support, Technology, partners and other internal teams, providing operational guidance and leading discussions where required.
  • Maintain strong operational standards: Keep up to date with relevant FinCrime typologies, risk indicators, policies and procedures, ensuring consistent and compliant application of controls.

About The Ideal Candidate

  • Relevant experience, ideally within a regulated business or Financial Crime environment, with a Bachelor’s degree.
  • Strong KYC/KYB knowledge and experience with AML, Fraud, Sanctions or Transaction Monitoring processes.
  • Analytical, proactive and solution-oriented, with strong attention to detail and excellent workload/time-management skills.
  • Comfortable using Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, and working with operational systems and databases.
  • Fluent in English and Spanish, with strong communication skills and confidence engaging with customers, stakeholders and partners.
  • Passionate about technology and AI-driven innovation, with a continuous-learning mindset and genuine drive to improve processes and ways of working.

Diversity & Inclusion

Amadeus aspires to be a leader in Diversity and Inclusion in the tech industry, enabling every employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment, attracting the best talent from all backgrounds, and as a role model for an inclusive employee experience. 

Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer and committed to an accessible recruitment process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law.

Be aware of recruitment scams

Amadeus Group never charges fees, requests payment, or asks for financial information during recruitment. All legitimate opportunities are communicated solely through official Amadeus channels, including our careers website. Any payment request or outreach via unofficial platforms (e.g., WhatsApp, Telegram) should be treated as fraudulent.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About The Team  

Agoda’s Customer Experience Group delivers critical support to customers and partners across markets, channels, and business lines. As our operations scale in complexity, Senior Regional Managers play a pivotal role in ensuring regional resiliency, standardization, and sustained performance across multiple sites and partners.  

 

About The Role  

The Senior Regional Manager is accountable for end-to-end performance of a regional customer/partner operations area, typically spanning multiple countries, sites, or vendor partners. This role translates company strategy into a cohesive regional roadmap, balances cross site tradeoffs, and ensures consistent, high quality service delivery at scale.  

You will act as the regional authority on customer operations performance, risks, and improvement initiatives, while developing strong leadership benches and resilient operating models.  

Key Responsibilities  

Regional & Operational Ownership 

  • Lead multi-site, multi-country customer operations (including inhouse and BPO partners where applicable) 
  • Own end to end regional outcomes, including service quality, efficiency, resiliency, and cost to serve 
  • Balance cross site tradeoffs across capacity, language coverage, channel mix, routing, and vendor strategy   

Strategy & Roadmap  

  • Translate CEG strategy into a 12–18 month regional roadmap, prioritizing initiatives that deliver measurable customer and business impact 
  • Anticipate demand shifts (seasonality, launches, policy or regulatory changes) and lead proactive regional adjustments 
  • Sponsor and govern cross site initiatives to ensure consistency and scalability  

Improvement, Innovation & Resiliency  

  • Scale adoption of tools, technologies, and best practices across sites 
  • Institutionalize experimentation standards, operational rigor, and learning across the regional leadership team 
  • Strengthen regional resiliency through standardized playbooks (e.g. surge, BCP, knowledge governance)  

Stakeholder Leadership  

  • Serve as the regional “go to” for customer operations performance, risks, and initiatives 
  • Bring together WFM, QA, Training, Analytics, Product/Tech, Policy, and Commercial partners to land regionwide solutions 
  • Communicate regional performance, scenarios, and recommendations to senior stakeholders with minimal supervision  

People & Organization Leadership  

  • Lead through Regional Managers and/or Vendor Managers, setting a high bar for performance management and leadership capability 
  • Design and evolve regional org structures, language pools, and shift strategies to meet KPIs 
  • Build successor ready pipelines, enable cross site talent mobility, and develop future senior leaders 
  • Address underperformance decisively, fairly, and in line with Agoda values  

What You’ll Bring  

  • Must have excellent spoken and written Korean skills, and Business level of English
  • Extensive demonstrated experience leading largescale, multisite or multi-country operations 
  • Proven ability to own regional outcomes and manage complexity across markets and partners 
  • Strategic thinking combined with operational execution excellence with strong analytical and experimentation mindset   
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to dive into detail to understand issue complexity, propose actionable plans, and collaborate effectively with stakeholders
  • Advanced stakeholder management and influencing skills, including Senior Leadership exposure 
  • A track record of developing leaders and building resilient organizations  

Nice to Have  

  • Experience managing outsourced/vendor operations at scale
  • Deep exposure to regulatory-complex or high-growth markets

Why Agoda 

  • Hybrid Work 
  • Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives
  • Annual discretionary performance bonus
  • Health insurance and other locally competitive benefits
  • Agoda travel discounts and special rates on accommodation and related products
  • Work from anywhere for up to 30 days per year
  • An inclusive, international work environment where your ideas and feedback are valued
  • Agoda choice(welfare points)
  • $400 USD allowance to set up your home office(one time payment)

Company Description

Accor Tech & Digital is the driving force behind technology, digital solutions, and transformation across the Group. Our 5,000 talented professionals are committed to delivering the best digital and technology experiences to our customers, hotels, and teams in 110 countries, while helping shape the future of hospitality.

Accor Tech & Digital: where intelligence is human first.

Job Description

The OTA Account Executive aims to implement a strategic action plan with a focus on driving sustainable growth for Accor and Hotels. To do so, the action plan should contribute to diversification of the channel mix, increased visibility on OTAS, control of the distribution cost and protect the value of our web direct & loyalty program.

He/ She is working closely with the different Accor Business Units, and in particular with the local e-commerce or account managers who are his/her relays in their dedicated regions.

OTA Action Plan Execution

  • Construction of a clear action plan to reach targets
  • Regular follow-up of the KPIs to challenge stakeholders
  • Work closely with the hubs/divisions in their local account management & action plan implementation
  • Negotiate strong and relevant marketing plans with the objective to increase Accor brand awareness
  • Organize regular quarterly business review with Sales & technical teams

Coordination with local OTA Teams (E-commerce & Sales)

  • Co-design of action plans to support the business development strategy
  • Exchange with local account managers on the identification of opportunities with local players
  • Regular communication regarding OTA partnership updates
  • Training on tools & new processes

360° expertise

  • Build business case for technology evolution
  • Project management on technology-related improvements with digital experts
  • Regular meetings with legal department (existing and new partners contracting, tax management)
  • Provide feedback on performance toward sales performance & BI teams
  • Conduct transversal project with loyalty and web direct teams
  • Ad-Hoc project management

Qualifications

  • Master degree
  • Past experience on Online Travel Agencies, E-Commerce, or travel-related industry
  • Past experience in multi-interlocutor and multi-cultural contracts

  • Execute an action plan for a portfolio of strategic accounts
  • Strong analytical skills and mindset
  • Fluent in English & French
  • Curious about other cultures
  • Have a strong team spirit
  • Ability to federate internally with the different departments
  • High Conviction approach
  • Ability to establish a strong partnership relationship with customers
  • Embody the group's values
  • Multi topic knowledge and interest (negotiation, commercial, legal, connectivity)

Additional Information

And what about our commitments?

  • To the world
  • Accor is committed to the world around us, with a strong employer culture focused on developing our 300,000 talents.
  • We take a continuous improvement approach to reducing the environmental impact of digital technology across all our projects.
  • To your career
  • We empower all our employees to manage their work-life balance and give them the means to shape their work environment in their own image.
  • Training and career paths are defined both individually and collectively, so that we grow together, every day.
  • In practice, at Accor Tech & Digital:
  • Remote work in France and flexible working options: work from home, from our offices, or even from our hotels and coworking spaces.
  • Every Wednesday afternoon, dedicate your time to deep work and your personal development.

  • Continuous improvement & training: hackathons, outstanding technology partnerships, dedicated talent management, and our dedicated learning platform, Digitech Academy, with certifications.

and also,

job.job_description:
Job Summary

The Learning Facilitator is responsible for delivering engaging, high-quality learning experiences that support franchisees, hotel associates, and contact center associates. This role facilitates instructor-led training in both virtual and in-person environments, develops and maintains learning content across multiple platforms, and understands stakeholder needs to help them drive adoption of operational programs, systems, and strategic initiatives. The position serves as a subject matter expert in learning delivery methodologies and hospitality operations, helping hotels to perform at their best with guest service, revenue generation, and operations, while promoting a culture of continuous development and professional growth.

Responsibilities

Facilitation and Delivery of Learning Programs

  • Facilitate live virtual and in-person learning programs for franchisees, hotel staff, and contact center associates.
  • Lead or assist in the delivery of Hotel Operations Certification programs and related workshops for owners and General Managers.
  • Facilitate virtual and in-person workshop topics and ensure a high-quality learning experience.
  • Deliver interactive webinars, workshops, coaching sessions, and educational programming at the Choice annual convention.
  • Utilize virtual learning technologies, including Zoom and related platforms, to support engaging and effective instruction.

Content Development and Program Maintenance

  • Create, update, and maintain learning content across multiple delivery methods, including:
    • Instructor-led training materials
    • Virtual workshops
    • eLearning courses
    • Videos
    • Reference guides and job aids
  • Evaluate learning materials regularly to ensure content remains accurate, relevant, compliant, and aligned with business priorities.
  • Support instructional design efforts and collaborate with learning partners to improve program effectiveness.

Stakeholder Engagement and Collaboration

  • Support initiatives that enhance guest satisfaction, operational excellence, revenue generation, and brand performance.
  • Collaborate with department representatives, franchisees, owner associations, and area directors to develop and deliver learning that support organizational objective.

Coaching and Subject Matter Expertise

  • Provide guidance and consultation on learning best practices and operational training requirements.
  • Promote certification programs and continuous learning opportunities across hotel and contact center operations.

Meeting and Event Participation

  • Deliver educational content at annual conventions, regional workshops, onboarding programs, owner association events, and other company-sponsored learning events.
  • Support preparation, logistics, and facilitation for learning events and conferences for Choice and owner association learning events.

Qualifications

Employment Experience

  • Minimum of 3 years of hospitality, hotel operations, learning and development, training, facilitation, or related experience.
  • Demonstrated experience facilitating instructor-led training programs in both virtual and in-person environments.
  • Experience supporting operational excellence, guest service initiatives, brand standards, revenue management, or contact center operations preferred.
  • Experience in instructional design, curriculum development, or learning content creation preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency with Zoom and virtual learning technologies.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Experience with learning management systems and content development tools preferred.
  • Ability to develop and maintain digital learning resources and training materials.

Additional Skills & Competencies

  • Excellent facilitation, presentation, and communication skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication abilities.
  • Ability to engage diverse learner audiences and adapt delivery methods to learning needs.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively within a matrixed organization.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to service excellence.
  • Ability to model organizational values, integrity, curiosity, inclusiveness, respect, responsiveness, and accountability.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Hospitality Management, Education, Learning and Development, Organizational Development, Communications, or a related field or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.

SALARY RANGE

The salary range for this position is $75,553- $88,886.

Choice prioritizes our associate wellbeing by offering a comprehensive benefits program that is both competitive and flexible to help you achieve your wellbeing goals - here are just a few:

  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Leave and paid time-off for holidays, vacation, personal, family, volunteer, sick, jury duty, bereavement, military, and religious observance
  • Financial benefits for retirement and health savings
  • Employee recognition programs
  • Discounts at Choice hotels worldwide

About Choice

Choice Hotels International, Inc. (NYSE: CHH), is one of the largest lodging franchisors in the world. With 7,500 hotels in 45+ countries and territories, we offer a range of high-quality lodging options in the upper upscale, upper midscale, midscale, extended stay, and economy segments. We’re the hotel company for those who choose to bet on themselves — the striver, the dreamer, the entrepreneur — because that’s who we are, too.

At Choice, we are united by the simple belief that tomorrow will be even better than today — for associates, our company, and our franchisees. At our worldwide corporate headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, at our technology center in Scottsdale, Arizona, and through our associates around the globe, every voice is heard and every idea is listened to, no matter what area of the company they come from. We are united in supporting the entrepreneurial dreams of our thousands of franchise owners, which propels us forward — giving our work at Choice a purpose larger than our business.

Our corporate office locations:

North Bethesda, MD — Located at Pike & Rose, our worldwide headquarters is less than 15 miles from Washington, D.C., one block away from the North Bethesda Metro station, with easy access to I-495, complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Scottsdale, AZ — Located at the northwest corner of Loop 101, the Scottsdale office is home to our technology, eCommerce and customer service organizations, with easy access to complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Minneapolis, MN — Select roles are based in our Minneapolis office on Highway 394, near the intersection with Highway 100, only five minutes from downtown.

Field/Remote — Select roles designated as field/remote will require associates to work from a home office, connecting virtually with Choice team members and leadership on Zoom, with possible required travel depending on the role.

Choice’s Cultural Values

Welcome and Respect Everyone | Be Bold | Be Quick | Listen | Be Curious | Show Integrity

Choice’s Leadership Principles

Act with Intention | Lead with Authenticity | Grow & Deliver

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction to the Team

Expedia Group B2B is the business-to-business arm of Expedia Group. We bring Expedia Group’s innovative technology and distribution solutions to partners across the world. These businesses include global financial institutions, corporate managed travel, offline travel agents, global travel suppliers (like major airlines) and many more.

An exciting opportunity has arisen to join the Global Commercial Finance team within B2B. This is a key role, reporting to the Senior Manager, Commercial Finance.

The successful candidate will be a business partner with the regional Sales and Finance teams, providing key reporting & insights, and helping the team to unlock operational efficiencies that translate to better business performance. In addition, they will consolidate operational reporting for B2B, including preparing divisional and leadership MBRs & QBRs, materials for the Board of Directors/Investor Relations, and materials to assist with the review and presentation of B2B forecasts to leadership.

Core responsibilities include gathering and consolidating financial and business inputs across all of B2B’s regional divisions, preparing slides and summary documents of the key B2B story for executive reporting, financial modelling, competitive analysis, business case development, forecasting, and identifying and implementing strategies to drive operational efficiencies and automation.

In This Role, You Will

  • Ensure delivery of monthly and quarterly business performance metrics and insights for distribution to B2B Sales and Finance management
  • Assist with the preparation and delivery of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial management information and high-level commentary for distribution at an Executive level
  • Assist with the modelling of the long-range financial plan (3+ years), by building and enhancing the financial model, partnering closely with Finance, Strategy, and Sales leadership to gather key insights and divisional growth drivers, and translating these into clear financial targets and growth ambitions for the organization
  • Work with the Senior Commercial Finance Manager, Finance team, and Sales leadership to drive improvements in operational reporting, focused on delivering greater insight to business performance
  • Perform ad-hoc analysis to support cross-regional commercial projects and initiatives as well as deep-dives into specific topics to support the growth of the business and mitigate risk
  • Support the Senior Commercial Finance Manager to enhance, develop and implement improved processes and controls, to facilitate sustainable, profitable scaling of the B2B business
  • Leverage AI and automation to increase efficiency across all applicable responsibilities

Experience And Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field; or equivalent professional experience
  • Highly fluent in English (written and spoken)
  • Confirmed commercial finance experience
  • Validated ability to analyze data to solve business problems and provide strong business insight and recommendations
  • Proven ability to interpret and present data in a visually compelling format to financial and non-financial audiences
  • Strong Excel skills, including model building, formula optimization, data validation and error troubleshooting
  • Experience leveraging AI agents, Power Pivot, and Power BI is a plus
  • Proven ability to deep-dive into large data sets and identify key drivers or unusual variances
  • Proven ability to operate autonomously and to juggle multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize effectively and meet deadlines
  • Proven ability to think “outside the box” as required and identify alternative solutions
  • A relationship builder, exceptional listener and team player
  • Experienced and enthusiastic working in dynamic, entrepreneurial environments
  • Someone who thrives in large, global, fast-moving organizations
  • Please note that this role is only available in the following location: Spain, in alignment with our flexible work model which requires employees to be in-office atleast three days a week

The total cash range for this position in Madrid is €43,000.00 to €60,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to €69,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Benefits And Perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life.

You can find the benefits for this location and any collective agreement that may apply here.

Accommodation requests

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.

About Expedia Group

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Important notice

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/.

Equal Opportunity

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

job.job_description:
There is nothing quite like the buzz of the Airport and as a leading ground handling business dnata operates across all major airports in Australia, so we get to feel the buzz every day. Providing services to our customers for Ramp, Baggage, Cargo and Passenger Services. We operate 24/7 rain, hail and shine and we love it!

We have an opportunity for an all-rounder admin superstar to join our Sydney Airport team and elevate our administrative operations. In this fast-paced role, as our Port Based Administrator, you’ll manage a wide range of office and finance processes, liaise with internal and external stakeholders, and resolve day-to-day admin matters across ground services and/or cargo operations—bringing structure, efficiency and a continuous improvement mindset to everything you do.

About you and the role:

  • Provide daily updates on the actual hours used versus forecast, while reviewing revenue generated and ‘clock in’ hours
  • Provide timely reports compiled from various sources to ensure management are kept fully informed of the labour utilisation across the respective port
  • Reviewing the Payroll exceptions report
  • Perform office administrative support such as uniforms and ordering stationery (ensuring receipts are available for all purchases)
  • Arranging repairs and service call outs as required
  • Perform general finance support such as billing, invoice processing adhering to company GL codes and authority matrix, purchase orders etc
  • Ensure queries are dealt with in a professional and effective manner through either personally handling them or delegating to the appropriate channel, ensuring that they are resolved.
  • Data management functions including paper and electronic records management, producing reports, compiling information etc
  • Any other duties as required by the business

Key Requirements that you bring with you:

  • Strong computer acumen with sound knowledge of Microsoft Office suite
  • Sound organisational skills and experience in undertaking and completing several tasks concurrently, and meeting deadlines
  • Positive attitude that is reflected in interactions within the business
  • Knowledge of resource planning and rostering principles
  • Good operational understanding of the airport operation
  • Exposure / understanding of payroll systems (Zambion)
  • Sound interpersonal and communication skills; be able to communicate with a variety of people within the organisation.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • Exceptional attention to detail, multi-tasking skills. High standards of performance and quality
  • Ability to work collaboratively and independently as well as a team member in both natural work teams and project teams
  • Ability to perform duties in pressured and stressful job situation successfully i.e. competing demands and priorities, including working any extra hours required

So... does this sound like you? If so, Apply Now!

This position is located at 321 Link Road, Mascot (Terminal 1 Cargo), working hours Monday to Friday.
