Mission Statement

To create experience by embracing and empowering a diverse collective of team members, collaborators, and guests, who choose to call The Standard home.


Our Purpose

The Standard’s commitment is to being an anchor for each neighbourhood in which we reside as well as a platform for culture and creativity. Bringing people together in its spaces to interact with each other in genuine ways.

Our promise is to ensure that a stay is an experience and that a memory means making friends and having stories to tell. To understand why it exists, is to understand that The Standard, is a platform for people to meet, to engage, to learn, to dine, to sleep, to dance, to hideaway, to make believe and to do so whilst being yourself and having fun doing it.

We think of ourselves as a stage, not just a hotel. Here, you can become whomever you like, even if for just a night. Here, you will meet new friends, find new challenges, eat new food, stay up late, sleep in later, and at times, never even leave the property. We are unapologetically comfortable with disrupting expectations. It’s WHO WE ARE!

#StandardFamily


Job Title: Controller

Department: Finance

Location: The Standard, High Line

Reporting to: VP of Finance


Responsible for: Staff Accountant, AR/Income Auditor, Accounting Manager/Accounting Department


Job Purpose: The Controller is to safeguard the property's financial integrity by managing daily accounting workflows, enforcing internal controls, and delivering accurate financial reporting. Key relationships include all departments as well as hotel guests/visitors, vendors, suppliers, and auditors.


BRAND AMBASSADOR: Throughout the hotel we actively seek to employ a unique, diverse and thoughtful group of people that are committed to delivering our unconventional brand of hospitality while also growing with us.

  • They are committed to and fully comprehend the idea of being of service;
  • They do not just delight guests, but excite them–by creating unique, unexpected & memorable experiences;
  • They are ambitious, vibrant and social/friendly individuals;
  • They genuinely embrace diversity in all forms, interested to have people from all race and gender to be their friend;
  • They encourage genuine relationships with guests that enable them to not only preempt needs but foresee desires;
  • They have personality and depth;
  • They have a desire and unyielding appetite for learning & knowledge—being in-the-know with what is happening in the city and around the world;
  • They are creative in areas like music, cinema, art, performance, fashion, design, tech and business;
  • They are engaging, socially adept and solution-based individuals able to navigate the scene with confidence and ease;
  • They are able to entertain guests in a compassionate, respectful and meaningful manner;
  • They are authentically themselves;
  • They want to play a role in constructing a kinder and better world.


QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, or related field (CPA/MBA preferred)
  • 3+ years of progressive accounting/finance experience in hospitality or adjacent industry in a management capacity
  • Deep knowledge of hotel financial operations, USALI, GAAP
  • Strong expertise in financial systems, reporting, and data governance
  • Mastery of Microsoft Excel
  • Preferred experience using Opera Cloud, Birchstreet, Dataplus, Toast, Paycom


KEY COMPETENCIES:

  • Strategic thinking and financial acumen
  • Executive communication and stakeholder management
  • Operational and commercial insight
  • Risk management and compliance leadership
  • Data-driven decision-making


DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Maintain complete knowledge of and comply with all departmental, hotel, and corporate policies/service procedures/standards/operational guidelines. Comply with all statutory requirements.
  • Maintain complete knowledge of property management system and manual procedures.
  • Update the books and records in an accurate and timely manner.
  • Oversee the daily income audit and the review of the Daily Revenue Report. Make sure all revenue (rooms, F&B, events, outlets) is posted accurately and reconciled across the PMS, POS and GL.
  • Oversee credit card processing, chargebacks and disputes, and maintain PCI compliance.
  • Oversee accounts payable, including invoice approval workflows, vendor setup and W-9 collection, payment runs and year-end 1099 reporting.
  • Enforce purchasing and procurement controls: purchase order approval limits, contract review and sign-off authority.
  • Oversee cash handling procedures, house banks, safe counts, surprise cashier audits and petty cash.
  • Oversee monthly inventory counts for F&B, retail and operating supplies. Reconcile cost of sales and investigate variances.
  • Maintain the fixed asset register, depreciation schedules, CapEx project tracking and the FF&E reserve.
  • Maintain segregation of duties and system access controls across the finance and operating systems (PMS, POS, procurement, payroll).
  • Prepare and present month end financial statements and all related reporting accurately, on time, and in accordance with corporate standards.
  • Liaise with corporate office and ownership group on all accounting related matters.
  • Complete timely and accurate balance sheet and bank reconciliations, cash flow reports.
  • Complete accurate and timely NYC and NYS tax filings.
  • Assist with all sales tax, insurance, internal, and regulatory audits as applicable.
  • Assist with weekly bank reconciliations, cash flow reports, and monthly fund requests.
  • Ensure payroll is processed weekly and all subsequent reports are recorded accurately.
  • Make sure gratuities and service charges are distributed and reported in line with the NYS Hospitality Wage Order.
  • Manage NYS unclaimed property (escheatment) reporting.
  • Work with department heads to ensure comprehension and compliance with internal audits as well as NYC and NYS tax codes across revenue and expenses.
  • Oversee all monetary assets of the Hotel.
  • Work closely with operational managers, department heads, and executive committee members to ensure maximum utilization of the company’s financial resources in accordance with the budgetary guidelines.
  • Analyze departmental profitability, labor productivity and flow-through. Recommend corrective actions to department heads.
  • Advise Management of the financial impacts for various strategic plans and ad hoc projects.
  • Establish and implement financial management and internal control standards to safeguard the Hotel’s assets from any possible losses in accordance with corporate standards.
  • The ability to compile, submit and monitor operating budgets, capital budgets, and business plans.
  • Control all Hotel costs, expenses and labor.
  • Directly supervise and lead the accounting team and monitor all areas of responsibility of the Finance department
  • Ensure Accounting staff meetings are productive, contain great 2-way communication, and promote teamwork and high morale standards within the department.
  • Develop and maintain staff structure. Hire, schedule, train, discipline, and conduct performance evaluations of direct reports.
  • Communicate effectively and provide leadership within the Department & throughout the organization.
  • Provide financial input for future projects, strategies, innovative plans and direction and monitor its progress.
  • Anticipate guests’ needs, respond promptly and acknowledge all guests, and always maintain positive guest relations. Assist staff in resolving guest complaints, ensuring guest satisfaction.
  • Perform other tasks or projects as assigned by VP, Finance, Managing Director, or corporate/ownership leaders.


COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

  • $150k - $175k per year
  • Excellent and Affordable Health Care coverage
  • Life Insurance, Disability Insurance, Pet Insurance
  • Up to 104 hours PTO, 56 hours - Paid Protected Time Off (Sick), 32 hours - Unpaid Protected Time Off, 20 hours Paid Prenatal Leave
  • 401k- Company matching 2% after 1 year
  • Employee Discounts on Rooms, F&B, Retail, and The Standard Marketplace
  • Employee Meals, Employee Referral Program, Commuter Discounts
  • Regular fun staff events and celebrations!

KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is a leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. At KAYAK for Business, we're building the future of corporate travel technology — and the engineering teams behind it are at the heart of that mission. As a Senior Engineering Manager, you'll lead one or more agile engineering teams delivering software that helps companies and their travelers move smarter and with less friction, while playing a key role in shaping our growing engineering hub!

Note, this position is required to work from our Concord or Cambridge, MA office 3 days per week.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead a cross functional agile team with both frontend and backend engineers, delivering a world class onboarding solution for customers, account management and integration management together with a designer and a product owner
  • Mentor a team by providing technical guidance, performance feedback, and career development support.
  • Own the team’s technical roadmap, aligning priorities with engineering leadership to support the broader platform strategy.
  • Champion backend architecture decisions by leading design reviews and collaborating with technical leaders across engineering.
  • Set and enforce engineering best practices for coding, testing, code coverage, and deployment quality.
  • Manage day-to-day team operations by removing blockers, balancing the backlog, and maintaining high standards for reliability and security.
  • Collaborate with engineering managers from other teams and cross-functional stakeholders to resolve dependencies and support product teams across the company.
  • Monitor team health and delivery metrics, identifying risks early and adjusting priorities as needed.
  • Champion agile practices and high impact engineering culture within the team
  • Recruit and onboard frontend/backend engineering talent to support the platform roadmap.

Please Apply If You Have

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 5 years in an engineering leadership or management role directly managing software engineers, and a proven track record of leading productive teams and shipping high-quality software in a fast-paced environment; equivalent experience, training, or transferable skills considered.
  • Proven track record of managing teams for 3+ years within B2B SaaS applications, focusing on successfully onboarding enterprise and SMB clients with measurable outcomes.
  • Ownership and innovation within a data-driven, results-oriented environment, along with the ability to rapidly learn and master new business domains.
  • Experience steering organizational transformation, maximizing gains from agile methodologies, and fostering process optimization and innovation
  • Strong technical fundamentals in distributed systems, API design, and backend service architecture, with the ability to credibly guide architectural decisions and participate meaningfully in design reviews.
  • Demonstrated experience owning the full people management lifecycle, including hiring, onboarding, performance management, career development, and promotions, with a strong track record of coaching and developing engineers at multiple levels through structured feedback, regular 1:1s, and deliberate career conversations.
  • Solid understanding of agile delivery methodologies and the software development lifecycle, including CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and observability practices; comfortable driving process improvements within a sprint-based team.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to articulate a clear technical vision to both technical and non-technical audiences and collaborate effectively across product, design, and engineering functions.
  • Hands-on experience with modern software development tooling — including version control systems (e.g., GitHub), issue tracking (e.g., Jira), and logging or observability platforms — and a demonstrated openness to adopting AI-assisted development tools to improve team productivity.
  • Comfort working in a global engineering organization with teams across time zones and office locations.
  • A degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience; no specific certification is required.

Benefits And Perks

  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year
  • Focus on mental health and well-being:
    • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
    • Company-paid subscription to HeadSpace
    • Company-wide week off a year – the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)
    • No meeting Fridays
  • Paid parental leave
  • Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday
  • Paid volunteer time
  • Focus on your career growth:
    • Development Dollars
    • Leadership development
    • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings
  • Travel Discounts
  • Employee Resource Groups
  • Competitive retirement and health plans
  • Free lunch 2 days per week
  • Fun quarterly events such as boat trips, arcades, ski trips, Thursday happy hours, and more
There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. The range for this Massachusetts based role is $190,000 - 235,000.00, not inclusive of annual bonus and recurring RSU grants.

We offer a competitive base salary and benefits including: health benefits; flexible spending account; retirement benefits; life insurance; paid time off (including PTO, paid sick leave, medical leave, bereavement leave, floating holidays and paid holidays); and parental leave benefits.

Inclusion

At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That's why we're focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here.

job.job_description:
Are you ready to turn your love of travel into a career that takes you further than you ever imagined personally and professionally? Your Flight Centre journey is uniquely yours - and we’re here to champion it, celebrate it, and help it take flight. As a Flightie you’re not just building a career - you’re shaping a life filled with purpose, connection, and discovery. If you’re looking for the next stamp in careers passport - we’re looking for Sales Travel Consultants across Australia who are keen to dazzle, discover and delight our customers! Navigate your career. Explore the world.

What you’ll be doing - where your passion will meet purpose!

  • Work full-time, on-site in one of our retail stores on a rotating roster across a 7-day trade
  • Plan itineraries, book travel and convert enquiries into bookings in person, over the phone and via email for our customers
  • Work towards individual KPIs and sales targets where you’ll sell the whole holiday including flights, accommodation, car hire, tours, travel insurance, cruises, transfers and more
  • Build a customer base of new and returning customers from regular domestic bookings to lavish international holidays and everything in between
  • Be the expert! Assist our customers with their travel related questions including visas, best time of year to travel, what to pack, where to eat, what to avoid, you name it!
  • Enjoy a base wage plus an uncapped incentive payment structure where you earn a percentage of every sale, your pay is completely uncapped!

What we’re looking for - do you have the travel bug?

  • You’re a seasoned traveller with a history of international destinations (and even more on your bucket list!) and you’re the go-to person in your circle for travel recommendations, tips and tricks
  • Great organisational skills - you’re the type to take notes, manage your calendar well and are quick to respond to your customer’s phone calls and emails
  • Determination to meet your sales targets and KPIs while balancing your workload in a high-pressure environment (think customers lining up, phones ringing, email inbox filling!)
  • Enthusiasm, passion and a warmth that makes our customers want to book with you every time!
  • A savviness with computers, ready to toggle between various complex systems when finding the right flight and package options for your customer

What you will gain from a career with Flight Centre - let’s unpack the benefits!

💲 We'll boost your wage to $65K equivalent for your first 90 days while you learn the ropes! Average earnings for a Travel Consultant in their first year are $70K, while Senior Consultants average $100K and Team Leaders average $138K annually - including superannuation and penalty rates.

🌏 Become a true expert – access industry travel discounts and qualify for sponsored ‘Familiarisation Trips’ to explore new destinations and products around the world 

💎 Brightness of Future: Career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses across the globe - we promote from within   

🎉 Social: Embrace the famous Flight Centre culture at our Reward & Recognition events throughout the year including our most popular events on the calendar Global Gathering and EOFY Celebration

🎓 Get qualified for free with a Certificate 3 & 4 in Travel & Tourism (worth 20k!) through Australian Apprentice Training - you may also be eligible to receive direct financial support while you study 

🌈 Thrive in a workplace that embraces individualism – come as you are!  

💛 Be part of a workplace committed to reconciliation through our Reconciliation Action Plan - we proudly support Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander inclusion, cultural safety, and dedicated cultural leave

Okay, I’m in!

job.job_description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

At the AI Platform team, our mission is to empower Mission Teams across GetYourGuide to build and operate production-grade ML/AI features independently, democratizing AI development while maintaining the product quality our users deserve and expect.

As the Manager of our AI Platform team, you will lead the vision, strategy, and execution to enable and scale AI-powered features across all product areas. You will be responsible for building and evolving the centralized AI infrastructure that makes AI development systematic, trustworthy, and accessible at scale. Your team will establish the evaluation systems, abstraction layers, and safety guardrails that allow Mission Teams to ship AI features with confidence and speed, ensuring GetYourGuide delivers reliable, high-quality AI experiences to travelers worldwide.

Your mission

  • Lead all hiring and performance management processes for your Engineering team, helping your engineers reach their full potential in this emerging and rapidly evolving domain.
  • Drive high-impact projects and outcomes by managing the team's roadmap and portfolio allocation.
  • Find and deliver solutions to complex technical challenges that span across multiple services and business domains, ensuring Mission Teams can build production-grade ML/LLM features with confidence.
  • Establish and evangelize best practices for LLM development across Tech.
  • Balance rapid innovation with production standards to ensure the platform enables speed without compromising quality, security, or reliability.
  • Build strategic partnerships with key stakeholders across product, data science, engineering leadership, and vendor relationships to align platform capabilities with business needs.

Your toolkit

  • You have a strong sense of ownership, ensuring technical and product plans are aligned with your stakeholders, your team, and organizational and company goals.
  • You approach complex topics with an open mind and a focus on simplicity, particularly when navigating the rapidly evolving AI landscape.
  • You bring a strong engineering background in platform engineering, machine learning infrastructure, or developer tooling, enabling you to evaluate complex technical decisions related to abstractions, evaluation systems, and safety mechanisms.
  • You actively lead and contribute to technical, design, and product discussions within your team's domain, balancing innovation velocity with production reliability standards.
  • You are passionate about building and developing a high-performing engineering team, mentoring, coaching, and empowering engineers to tackle novel challenges in the AI space.
  • You excel at evangelism and education, building confidence and capability across technical teams through documentation, workshops, and hands-on collaboration.

Extras that give you an edge

  • Experience building platform infrastructure or developer tooling that enables other engineering teams to ship faster and more reliably.
  • Experience working with LLMs in production environments, including prompt engineering, evaluation systems, or AI safety mechanisms.
  • Experience developing and operating ML algorithms at scale, working with Data Scientists and MLOps engineers.
  • Experience working in a startup or high-growth environment, taking projects from zero to one and scaling them across an organization.
  • Experience operating as a technical product manager/owner, particularly for internal platform products serving engineering customers.
  • Track record of successful technical evangelism and education initiatives that drove adoption and capability-building across engineering organizations.

How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary

  • Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
  • Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
  • A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.

And more…

Job Description

As part of the Hilton Direct EMEA team, the Account Executive will play a crucial role in driving business growth and client satisfaction within the HWS office. This dual-focused position involves managing meeting opportunities for an assigned portfolio of clients, enhancing productivity and business outcomes with strategic support from the Manager. Additionally, the Account Executive will focus on new account development, identifying and securing new business opportunities, building robust client relationships, and contributing to revenue growth through the acquisition of new accounts. This role is integral to the success of Hilton Direct's overall strategy and requires a proactive, results-driven approach to both client management and business development.

Responsibilities

What are we looking for?

The individual must possess the following knowledge, skills, and abilities and be able to perform the essential functions of the job.

  • Client Relationship Management: Develop strong relationships and partnerships with key accounts, enhancing client awareness of key regions and hotels.
  • Establish Meeting Needs: Identify and qualify client meeting needs, presenting suitable solutions and proposals to convert opportunities into transactions.
  • Communication: Act as a liaison between accounts and hotels, sharing brand knowledge with clients and client insights with hotels.
  • Documentation: Document business opportunity developments within relevant systems, with support from the Group Sales Support role.
  • Professional Representation: Present Hilton Worldwide hotels professionally to negotiating partners, in line with Hilton’s values.
  • Revenue Goals: Achieve agreed goals and deliver incremental revenue for all Hilton Worldwide hotels.
  • Performance Assessment: Assess actual performance against targets.
  • Policy Enforcement: Enforce policies and procedures to improve overall operations and effectiveness.
  • Proposal and Contract Validation: Ensure proposals and contracts negotiated with customers are checked and validated.
  • Sales Promotion Communication: Support accurate communication of sales promotions and information to relevant stakeholders.
  • Administrative Coordination: Coordinate required administrative work, including reporting figures.
  • Industry Participation: Participate in industry events and represent Hilton Worldwide at trade fairs and workshops, as agreed by the line manager.
  • Documentation and Training: Update manuals and other department-related documents; support training for new team members.
  • ROI Measurement: Adhere to ROI measurements to ensure overall effectiveness.
  • Compliance: Comply with all policies, systems, and procedures as laid down by Hilton Direct.
  • Business Development: Identify and target potential new accounts with business for international markets.
  • Venue Sourcing: Provide venue sourcing and convert group opportunities from un-managed accounts referred by hotels or HWS colleagues.
  • Market Research: Conduct market research to identify trends and opportunities for new business.
  • Contract Negotiation: Negotiate contracts and close deals with new clients.
  • Onboarding and Integration: Collaborate with internal teams to ensure seamless onboarding and integration of new accounts.
  • Performance Tracking: Track and report on sales performance and new account acquisition metrics.
  • Account Nurturing: Monitor and nurture accounts to grow revenues and share through virtual account management.
  • Account Research: Research and qualify new accounts across all B2B customer types, aiming to add them to HWS managed rosters.
  • Industry Events: Attend industry events as required to identify new customers for Hilton.

Qualifications

Specific Job Knowledge, Skill & Ability:

  • Effective collaborative skills to build positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders
  • Strong administrative and organizational focus to work in a highly structured way
  • Persuading and influencing skills
  • High level of verbal and written communication skills
  • Willingness to develop and take responsibilities while working within a team but also self-dependent
  • Good knowledge of market segments
  • Understanding of competition and marketing strategies
  • Able to manage conflict
  • Good in interpreting and analysing data
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications
  • Usage and knowledge of other Sales Systems, e.g. Salesforce
  • Understanding of sales process; tools, measurements and systems

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum Education: High School/ GED
  • Proven Sales experience
  • Fluency in spoken Turkish

Preferred Qualifications

  • Education: BA/BSc bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

About The Team

How We’ll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40 USD/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
  • Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
  • Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
  • Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
  • Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
  • Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Through our Care for All hub, we provide resources to help our Team Members to care for themselves, care for members of their team, and care for their loved ones. Eligible Team Members receive free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

Singapore Airlines is recruiting Direct Entry Captains on fixed-term contracts. To apply, you will need to meet the following requirements:

  • Possess a valid Class 1 Medical Certificate that is recognised by, or can be validated by, the Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore (CAAS).
  • Hold a valid Air Transport Pilot Licence (ATPL) with an Airbus A350 (A350) or Airbus A380 (A380) aircraft type rating that is recognised by, or can be validated by, CAAS. If you hold a foreign licence, you may check your eligibility using this document.

  • Have a minimum of two years’ flying experience as a Captain on either the A350 or A380, prior to the application date.
  • Able to speak and understand English with ICAO English Level 5 or above for inflight radio-telephony communications.
  • Minimum height requirement of 1.58m to ensure full reach and the safe operation of all flight deck controls

Applicants will undergo various stages of assessment, which may include (but not limited to) interviews, simulator assessment and medical examinations.

Successful candidates will be placed on either the A350 or A380 fleet.

Training

Successful candidates will receive the relevant training.

Tenure of Service

Successful candidates will be offered a fixed-term contract of up to 12 months.

job.job_description:
This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in-office.

Why This Job’s a Big Deal

We are looking for a strategic, highly versatile communicator to support our Head of Communications in advancing Priceline’s reputation, business priorities and industry profile. Priceline has a strong legacy and a clear ambition to be America’s definitive travel deals brand. Communications is central to making that ambition visible and credible: defining the narratives, earning sustained, high-quality coverage, elevating executive thought leadership and growing Priceline’s share of voice across media and the broader travel industry. In this role, you will help shape and execute that strategy, connecting our deal-maker heritage and consumer purpose with the technology and AI reshaping how travel is planned and booked.

In This Role You Will Get To

  • Support development and implementation of strategic, integrated B2C and B2B communications plans to meet Priceline’s key business goals.
  • Turn consumer, marketplace, product and industry data into newsworthy insights, compelling narratives and proactive pitch opportunities.
  • Develop impactful communications content aligned with Priceline’s technology, consumer and business narratives. Apply GEO best practices to improve how Priceline is discovered and represented across search and AI-powered platforms, while maintaining editorial integrity.
  • Build and maintain media relationships and manage select opportunities.
  • Drive growth in both the quality and quantity of Priceline’s earned-media coverage, increasing media share of voice and LLM editorial citation share of voice.
  • Build thought leadership strategies and materials for key executives, including messaging, talking points, media preparation and social content.
  • Recommend and manage broader industry-relations opportunities, including executive visibility, speaking engagements, partner co-marketing initiatives and related materials.
  • Co-manage PR agency to drive strong execution against the communications strategy.
  • Support internal communications across Priceline and its participation in Booking Holdings-wide communications.
  • Build strong cross-functional relationships and support communications for integrated programming from planning through execution.
  • Establish objectives and KPIs, analyze performance and provide actionable recommendations. Oversee monthly reports and initiative recaps.

Who You Are

  • 8+ years of related experience in communications, public relations or industry relations.
  • Experience in travel or technology preferred. Agency experience welcome.
  • Bachelor's degree in Communications, Marketing, or a related field.
  • A creative, resourceful and scrappy communicator with experience developing and executing integrated go-to-market communications strategies for new products, technologies, partnerships and business initiatives.
  • Exceptional written, verbal and presentation skills, with the ability to simplify complex technology into clear, compelling narratives for different audiences and channels.
  • A confident self-starter who can influence, prioritize and move projects forward across a complex, matrixed organization while meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • AI-literate and actively curious about how generative AI, LLMs, agents and GEO can improve communications strategy, productivity and results. Comfortable experimenting with AI-enabled workflows, building lightweight agents and using new tools to create repeatable team practices.
  • A passionate communicator with a strong pulse on culture, trends and industry news and a track record of securing headline coverage across multiple media verticals.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data, identify newsworthy opportunities and translate findings into communications opportunities.
  • Equally comfortable with high-level strategic development and tactical daily execution, with the operational discipline and follow-through to deliver results.
  • You sweat the details, have excellent organizational skills and can manage multiple priorities without losing momentum or quality.
  • Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust.
  • The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics are essential

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. In addition to a competitive base salary, certain roles may be eligible for an annual bonus and/or equity grant.

The salary range for this position is $130,000 – $165,000 USD.

Who We Are

WE ARE PRICELINE.

Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.

Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.

We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.

Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.

If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!

Flexible work at Priceline

Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.

Perks & Benefits At Priceline

Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:

Health & wellness coverage including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources

Generous time off including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days

Work/life support including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)

Financial security programs such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts

Signature travel perks including employee-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits

Additional perks & discounts like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits

A people-first culture with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together

Specific benefits and programs vary by location.

Inclusion is a Big Deal!

To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.

Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.

Applying for this position

We're excited that you are interested in a career with us. For all current employees, please use the internal portal to find jobs and apply.

External candidates are required to have an account before applying. When you click Apply, returning candidates can log in, or new candidates can quickly create an account to save/view applications.

Sr Business Analyst - Coupa

We are seeking a Sr Business Analyst - Coupa to join our global Global Business Systems team, where innovation knows no borders. This team powers our global workforce and enterprise operations by delivering, configuring, and optimizing critical finance and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) solutions. It bridges business needs with modern technology to drive efficiency and operational excellence. With an inclusive culture and flexible work environment, we work together with boldness, curiosity and commitment so we can all win together.

As a Sr Business Analyst - Coupa, you will serve as the primary functional and technical bridge connecting our Procurement, Finance, and Accounts Payable teams with our enterprise IT ecosystem. You will drive technical strategy, system configuration, integration, and continuous improvement across core P2P platforms, focusing on Coupa and SAP. This role requires strong business process acumen across the entire P2P lifecycle, practical technical configuration capabilities, and expertise in system integration and middleware.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with Procurement, Finance, and Accounts Payable stakeholders to elicit requirements, map end-to-end P2P processes, and support Travel & Incidental Expense management.
  • Perform hands-on functional configuration and administration in Coupa, SAP, and supporting applications to translate business requirements into scalable technical designs with minimal custom code.
  • Serve as the functional and technical SME for integrations between SAP, Coupa, expense systems, banking networks, and third-party vendor platforms, diagnosing and resolving complex integration and middleware errors.
  • Provide Tier 3 application support to resolve complex production issues and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, system architecture maps, training materials, and SOPs.
  • Proactively identify process bottlenecks and leverage automation, modern integration architectures, and analytics to streamline procurement workflows, improve auto-reconciliation, and maximize adoption.

What You'll Bring

Required qualifications

  • Minimum 5 years of experience as an IT Business Analyst or Functional Consultant specializing in Procure-to-Pay (P2P) solutions within an enterprise Global Business Systems or Enterprise IT environment.
  • Hands-on experience configuring and supporting SAP (ECC or S/4HANA) P2P/MM module and/or Coupa (Procurement, Invoicing, Expenses, or Pay).
  • Deep understanding of the end-to-end P2P lifecycle, corporate travel and incidental expense policies, tax management, three-way matching, and general ledger accounting.
  • Knowledge of enterprise integration architecture, middleware concepts (REST/SOAP APIs, flat files, sFTP, ETL, webhooks), and data flows between ERPs and cloud P2P platforms.
  • Strong background in SDLC methodologies (Agile/Scrum, Waterfall) writing detailed User Stories, Technical Specs, and Acceptance Criteria, with experience managing testing strategies (UAT, Integration, Regression) and deployment cutovers.

Role will Require the candidate to interview in person and work onsite in our Southlake office 3 days a week.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Finance, or a related field.
  • Relevant professional certifications in Coupa, SAP S/4HANA, or SAP Ariba.
  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform, Google AI Studio, or supporting P2P/T&E tools such as SAP Concur.

Benefits That Support You

We know support looks different for everyone. That is why Sabre offers benefits beyond medical and financial coverage, with programs designed to support your well-being, growth and life outside work:

  • Competitive pay and performance-based bonuses
  • Flexible work options
  • Comprehensive healthcare coverage
  • Generous PTO and holidays
  • Strong retirement planning support
  • Family-friendly benefits
  • Professional development opportunities

About The Role

As Group Indirect Tax Manager, you will report directly to the Global Head of Tax and play a key role in managing the tax affairs of the CTM Group.

You will help the business identify and manage indirect tax risks by leveraging your technical knowledge to provide high-quality, timely advice to Group and Regional Finance teams. You will also help manage the Group’s global indirect tax compliance obligations.

Working closely with Group and Regional Finance teams, the broader business, and our onshore and offshore support functions, you will understand key business activities and new initiatives and translate that understanding into practical indirect tax opportunities that improve compliance, efficiency and value.

CTM currently operates in more than 20 tax jurisdictions globally, with approximately 70% of the Group’s business offshore. This role offers significant exposure to international tax matters, in addition to local Australian ASX-listed tax requirements.

About The Team

Led by the Global Head of Tax, CTM’s Group Tax team has developed an industry-leading, highly innovative, technology-driven tax operating model.

The team has an established track record of developing and maintaining its own internal tax technology products and is constantly looking for opportunities for continuous improvement that align with its goal of working smarter to achieve high-quality outcomes across the business.

Led by the Global Chief Financial Officer, CTM’s Group Finance team is a globally focused team responsible for managing financial accounting, tax, treasury, and financial planning & analysis at a global group level.

We are proud to be building a finance function of the future by recruiting team members with varying qualifications and skills that extend well beyond traditional finance. We take a genuine interest in the growth and success of all team members.

About You

  • 6+ years’ experience in a Big 4 or large CA firm, or internal tax function of a large business (revenue >$250m)
  • CA/CPA qualification or other relevant higher education
  • Experience managing indirect tax compliance processes for a large business
  • In-depth knowledge of indirect tax laws and regulations in key operating jurisdictions
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and interpersonal skills
  • Excellent organisation, prioritisation and time management skills, with the ability to manage competing deadlines
  • Experience leading and developing high-performing tax teams
  • Proactive, self-motivated approach with a strong work ethic and focus on team and business outcomes
  • Interest in leveraging technology, challenging the status quo, and improving and simplifying processes
  • Collaborative approach and commitment to working in a diverse and inclusive organisation
  • Passion for developing tax technical skills and commercial acumen
  • Ability to take ownership and deliver great outcomes

About CTM

Corporate Travel Management (CTM) is a global award-winning provider of innovative and cost-effective travel management solutions across the corporate, events, leisure and loyalty travel markets. We combine personalised service excellence with client-facing technology solutions, with offices across Australia, New Zealand, Asia, North America and Europe and more than 3,000 employees globally. CTM is listed on the Australian Securities Exchange (ASX: CTD).

At CTM, our people are our greatest asset. We are a team of collaborative, innovative and future-focused professionals who work with our company values in mind: Connect, Deliver and Evolve.

Why CTM?

As a global organisation, CTM offers a range of employee benefits, including:

  • Flexible hybrid working
  • Travel discounts
  • Perkbox – retail, lifestyle, entertainment, health and wellbeing discounts
  • Learning and development – including LinkedIn Learning
  • Annual Volunteer Day
  • Chillout Days – additional flexible leave days
  • Purchase up to 2 weeks of additional annual leave
  • Paid parental leave

CTM offers a strong, established and sustainable work environment that supports your career development and wellbeing.

Come and work for a global award-winning company that values its people, community and technological innovation.

CTM is committed to recognising the unique contributions of all our people and actively encourages candidates of all abilities and diverse backgrounds to apply.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About The Team  

Agoda’s Customer Experience Group delivers critical support to customers and partners across markets, channels, and business lines. As our operations scale in complexity, Senior Regional Managers play a pivotal role in ensuring regional resiliency, standardization, and sustained performance across multiple sites and partners.  

 

About The Role  

The Senior Regional Manager is accountable for end-to-end performance of a regional customer/partner operations area, typically spanning multiple countries, sites, or vendor partners. This role translates company strategy into a cohesive regional roadmap, balances cross site tradeoffs, and ensures consistent, high quality service delivery at scale.  

You will act as the regional authority on customer operations performance, risks, and improvement initiatives, while developing strong leadership benches and resilient operating models.  

Key Responsibilities  

Regional & Operational Ownership 

  • Lead multi-site, multi-country customer operations (including inhouse and BPO partners where applicable) 
  • Own end to end regional outcomes, including service quality, efficiency, resiliency, and cost to serve 
  • Balance cross site tradeoffs across capacity, language coverage, channel mix, routing, and vendor strategy   

Strategy & Roadmap  

  • Translate CEG strategy into a 12–18 month regional roadmap, prioritizing initiatives that deliver measurable customer and business impact 
  • Anticipate demand shifts (seasonality, launches, policy or regulatory changes) and lead proactive regional adjustments 
  • Sponsor and govern cross site initiatives to ensure consistency and scalability  

Improvement, Innovation & Resiliency  

  • Scale adoption of tools, technologies, and best practices across sites 
  • Institutionalize experimentation standards, operational rigor, and learning across the regional leadership team 
  • Strengthen regional resiliency through standardized playbooks (e.g. surge, BCP, knowledge governance)  

Stakeholder Leadership  

  • Serve as the regional “go to” for customer operations performance, risks, and initiatives 
  • Bring together WFM, QA, Training, Analytics, Product/Tech, Policy, and Commercial partners to land regionwide solutions 
  • Communicate regional performance, scenarios, and recommendations to senior stakeholders with minimal supervision  

People & Organization Leadership  

  • Lead through Regional Managers and/or Vendor Managers, setting a high bar for performance management and leadership capability 
  • Design and evolve regional org structures, language pools, and shift strategies to meet KPIs 
  • Build successor ready pipelines, enable cross site talent mobility, and develop future senior leaders 
  • Address underperformance decisively, fairly, and in line with Agoda values  

What You’ll Bring  

  • Must have excellent spoken and written Korean skills, and Business level of English
  • Extensive demonstrated experience leading largescale, multisite or multi-country operations 
  • Proven ability to own regional outcomes and manage complexity across markets and partners 
  • Strategic thinking combined with operational execution excellence with strong analytical and experimentation mindset   
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to dive into detail to understand issue complexity, propose actionable plans, and collaborate effectively with stakeholders
  • Advanced stakeholder management and influencing skills, including Senior Leadership exposure 
  • A track record of developing leaders and building resilient organizations  

Nice to Have  

  • Experience managing outsourced/vendor operations at scale
  • Deep exposure to regulatory-complex or high-growth markets

Why Agoda 

  • Hybrid Work 
  • Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives
  • Annual discretionary performance bonus
  • Health insurance and other locally competitive benefits
  • Agoda travel discounts and special rates on accommodation and related products
  • Work from anywhere for up to 30 days per year
  • An inclusive, international work environment where your ideas and feedback are valued
  • Agoda choice(welfare points)
  • $400 USD allowance to set up your home office(one time payment)

job.job_description:
Choice Hotels International is looking for an Analytics and Visualization Manager with a passion for turning data into decisions, not just dashboards. This role operates at the intersection of business intelligence, AI tooling, and analytical storytelling, and plays a central role in shaping how our franchise network, commercial teams, and senior leaders interact with data at the business unit and company level.

You will serve as a senior contributor within a high-performing Analytics team that builds everything from predictive models to generative AI products. Your focus will be on building the intelligence layer end-to-end: architecting and delivering analytics data products that surface strategic insights, enable conversational exploration, and close the gap between data and action — with direct implications for business unit revenue, cost, and performance outcomes.

For years, analytics teams have largely operated on a request-and-report model: someone needs an answer, submits a request, and a manual analysis or report is built. This role is part of a broader effort to build data products that proactively surface meaningful insights, provide AI-generated summaries, and enable business users to explore data independently. The objective is to reduce one-off reporting requests by delivering scalable, self-service data products with continuously available insights.

Choice Hotels operates as a franchisor, which means data products must serve a wide range of users — from a hotel owner reviewing nightly performance to a segment executive evaluating portfolio strategy. This role is responsible for designing analytics experiences that are intelligent, proactive, and scalable: surfacing the right insight, in the right context, before the user has to ask for it. The opportunity here is not just to build dashboards, but to shape the analytics product vision and influence how the entire organization thinks about data-driven decision-making.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Strategic Analytics Product Design & Insight Generation

  • Lead the end-to-end design and delivery of Tableau dashboards that pair advanced visualizations with AI-generated narrative commentary, surfacing key drivers, anomalies, and recommended actions for both operational and executive audiences
  • Serve as the internal authority on Tableau Pulse, Ask Data, and Einstein Discovery integrations, driving the adoption of automated insight surfaces that proactively deliver intelligence to business users without requiring manual requests
  • Develop and own a forward-looking roadmap for analytics data products aligned with mid to short-term business unit strategy, recommending approaches and prioritizing investments based on business impact
  • Collaborate with data scientists to translate model outputs and predictions into clear, actionable visual narratives that inform high-stakes business decisions across franchise operations, revenue management, and marketing
  • Define and govern the standards for analytics product design across the team, ensuring consistency, quality, and alignment with company strategy and governed data definitions

Conversational Analytics & AI-Augmented Intelligence

  • Architect and maintain sophisticated analytics experiences that enable across multiple business units to query data using natural language, reducing dependency on ad hoc report requests at scale
  • Lead prototyping and iterative development of LLM-integrated workflows — including connecting large language models with Redshift data sources to auto-generate performance summaries, anomaly explanations, and strategic narratives
  • Drive the strategic vision for self-service analytics across the organization, identifying opportunities to eliminate bottlenecks, improve data literacy, and empower business users to answer their own questions
  • Evaluate emerging AI and agentic development tools and recommend adoption strategies that accelerate the team's analytics delivery capabilities and align with enterprise technology standards
  • Contribute to cross-functional initiatives that integrate conversational analytics into broader enterprise data products and digital experiences

Data Architecture & Analytical Infrastructure

  • Architect and maintain robust, scalable data sources, flows, and published extracts that power both traditional dashboards and AI-augmented analytics experiences, ensuring performance, reliability, and governance at the business unit level
  • Write, optimize, and review complex SQL against AWS Redshift and S3 tables to source, validate, and structure data for Tableau dashboards, automated reporting workflows, and AI-generated outputs — ensuring accuracy, performance, and strict alignment with governed definitions
  • Design and deliver sophisticated user-friendly data products beyond dashboards, including Python-generated Excel reports, automated workbooks, and lightweight analytical tools that connect directly to governed data sources, reduce reliance on manual data pulls, and enable end-user data manipulation in familiar formats
  • Lead strategic partnerships with the Data Engineering team to ensure data readiness, platform scalability, and infrastructure alignment for current and future analytics product needs
  • Establish and enforce data quality standards, semantic layer governance, and documentation practices that ensure trusted, consistent use of analytics products across all stakeholder groups

Stakeholder Engagement, Influence & Communication

  • Translate highly ambiguous and strategically significant business questions from franchise operations, revenue management, marketing, and other business unit stakeholders into structured analytical frameworks and user-ready data products that drive measurable outcomes
  • Serve as a primary analytics thought partner and internal resource for business unit heads and department leaders, advising on data strategy, analytics product capabilities, and the interpretation of complex analytical outputs
  • Drive adoption and governance of Tableau dashboards and automated reporting workflows at scale by establishing enterprise usage standards, maintaining comprehensive documentation, enabling stakeholder communities, and monitoring adoption and data quality metrics to ensure consistent, trusted use across the organization
  • Influence departmental analytics strategies by identifying gaps, championing best practices, and recommending new approaches that align analytics capabilities with broader business unit and company objectives
  • Lead the development and delivery of compelling analytical narratives that address mixed audiences — from individual franchisees to segment executives — with clear, data-grounded storytelling that drives strategic alignment and action
  • May direct analytics workstreams or activities in a matrixed environment, coordinating across data science, engineering, and business teams to ensure integrated, high-quality delivery
  • Engage with external vendors, technology partners, and analytics platform providers to evaluate tools, negotiate capabilities, and integrate solutions that advance the team's strategic objectives

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in analytics, data, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • 5–7 years of progressive experience building Tableau dashboards and analytics data products, including ownership of semantic layers, governed metrics, reusable data models, and enterprise-scale reporting infrastructure.
  • 5–7 years of experience writing advanced SQL queries, with deep experience in Redshift or other columnar databases; ability to design, optimize, and review complex analytical queries in a production environment.
  • Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering analytics products that directly support business unit revenue, cost, or performance outcomes.
  • Experience with query tools such as DBVisualizer, DBeaver, or similar; ability to evaluate and recommend tooling upgrades aligned with team needs.
  • Advanced knowledge of data modeling concepts, joins, aggregation logic, performance optimization, and semantic layer design principles.
  • Experience with Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint), with demonstrated ability to create executive-ready deliverables.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, or other Atlassian products for project tracking, documentation, and cross-functional coordination in agile delivery environments.
  • Proven experience using AI-assisted and agentic development tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex, or similar) to accelerate code development, automate reporting workflows, generate data-driven outputs, and prototype LLM-integrated analytics experiences.
  • Recognized internally as a primary resource for analytics best practices, Tableau governance, and AI-augmented BI capabilities, with the ability to translate functional concepts into strategies aligned with company goals.
  • Exceptional attention to detail with full accountability for data accuracy, consistency, and governance across dashboards, semantic layers, AI-generated outputs, and reporting workflows
  • Advanced analytical mindset with a demonstrated track record of independently identifying, investigating, and resolving complex and novel data, modeling, and reporting challenges with limited precedent.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple complex priorities simultaneously while maintaining data quality, delivery timelines, and strategic alignment across stakeholder groups.
  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data concepts into business strategies, influence senior stakeholders, and drive alignment on definitions, methodologies, and analytical outputs.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate with autonomy, take full ownership of strategic deliverables, and proactively navigate ambiguity in complex, cross-functional problem spaces.
  • Ability to influence departmental strategy in a matrixed environment, building credibility and driving adoption across business unit and analytics communities without formal authority.

Salary Range

The salary range for this position is $114,000.00 to $135,000.00.

About Choice

Choice Hotels International, Inc. (NYSE: CHH), is one of the largest lodging franchisors in the world.   • Serve as a primary point of contact for IHG Ignite hotel support, providing timely, accurate, and service-oriented guidance through email and, when needed, one-to-one calls with hotels, owners, operators, and internal colleagues.
  • Manage hotel inquiries submitted through the IHG Ignite Inquiry Form and shared support channels, including reviewing requests, researching issues, coordinating with subject-matter experts, and communicating clear resolutions.

  • Host and facilitate large-scale IHG Ignite webinars, office hours, and educational sessions for hotels and internal audiences, including preparing presentation content, coordinating speakers, managing live questions, and communicating follow-up resources.
  • Develop and maintain hotel-facing and internal educational materials, including webinar presentations, FAQs, program guides, best practices, talking points, and other resources that improve understanding of IHG Ignite.
  • Serve as a central point of contact for IHG Ignite communications distributed through official IHG channels, ensuring messaging is accurate, timely, audience appropriate, and aligned across stakeholders.
  • Translate complex program information related to participation, billing, reporting, digital marketing channels, and operational processes into clear guidance that hotels and colleagues can readily understand and act upon.
  • Manage ongoing IHG Ignite operational processes, including inquiry intake, Salesforce case management, case routing and categorization, opt-in and opt-out logistics, participation tracking, escalation management, and regional support coordination.
  • Monitor inquiry volumes, recurring questions, hotel feedback, and support trends to identify opportunities for proactive communications, additional education, improved resources, and operational enhancements.
  • Partner with global and regional Paid Media teams, Field Marketing, Salesforce Support, Martech, Data Engineering, Billing, Legal, Communications, hotel-support teams, and external vendors to resolve issues and deliver program initiatives.
  • Define and document business requirements for Salesforce enhancements, reporting improvements, workflow automation, support tools, and other technology changes affecting IHG Ignite operations.
  • Establish and maintain operating procedures, response templates, support documentation, coverage plans, and escalation paths that promote consistent and efficient service across the IHG Ignite support network.
  • Support the planning and execution of program enhancements, pilots, hotel onboarding efforts, participation changes, and other initiatives requiring coordinated operations, education, and communications.
  • Represent the hotel and support-team perspective in cross-functional discussions, ensuring that program decisions account for operational feasibility, hotel understanding, and the overall support experience.
  • Provide clear status updates, recommendations, risks, and proposed next steps to leadership and key stakeholders.
  • Promote a service-oriented team culture that balances strategic problem-solving with timely, accurate, and dependable execution.

What We Need From You

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Digital Marketing, Hospitality, Business, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience.
  • Five or more years of progressive experience in marketing operations, digital marketing, hotel support, program management, stakeholder communications, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience providing direct support to customers, clients, hotels, owners, operators, or other external stakeholders through email and live conversations.
  • Strong experience leading webinars, office hours, training sessions, or presentations for large audiences.
  • Ability to communicate confidently in a live setting, facilitate audience questions, explain complex topics clearly, and adapt messaging based on audience needs.
  • Excellent written communication skills, with experience developing polished, accurate, and audience-specific emails, presentations, FAQs, guidance, and program materials.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage sensitive, escalated, or high-impact stakeholder issues with professionalism, sound judgment, and appropriate urgency.
  • Experience using Salesforce or another CRM or case-management platform to manage inquiries, workflows, documentation, and reporting.
  • Strong project-management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional work within a complex, global organization.
  • Ability to translate technical, operational, reporting, billing, or marketing information into clear and actionable stakeholder guidance.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work through ambiguous issues, identify the appropriate stakeholders, and develop practical recommendations.
  • Ability to identify themes within stakeholder feedback or inquiry data and translate those insights into communication, education, process, or program improvements.
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, accountability, and follow-through.
  • Working knowledge of digital marketing and performance-marketing concepts is preferred, including paid search, metasearch, sponsored placements, affiliate marketing, campaign reporting, and media performance.
  • Ability to maintain a service-oriented mindset while balancing hotel needs, program objectives, operational requirements, and business priorities.

Location

job.job_description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

The Internal Controls team acts as a strategic partner to the business, designing effective, automated controls and streamlined operations rather than policies that ask someone to remember a step. The Internal Controls sits within Finance and acts as the second line of defense in GetYourGuide's Three Lines Model, and collaborates with stakeholders across the organization. You will build and run GetYourGuide's internal control over financial reporting (ICOFR) program from the ground up to reach a steady evidenced operating cadence.

Your mission

  • Design, implement, and run GetYourGuide's Internal Controls framework, focusing both on Financial Reporting and IT General Controls.
  • Lead the creation and execution of risk assessment methodologies to identify critical areas in financial reporting and IT processes.
  • Design and oversee the implementation of control activities across the company to mitigate identified risks.
  • Build and lead the Internal Controls team, setting the standard for how the business assesses, documents, and communicates control and risk information.
  • Partner with the business to design automated controls into new systems, markets, and processes as they're built, rather than retrofitting them afterward, consistently reducing reliance on manual, evidence-heavy controls.
  • Own the relationship with external auditors, coordinating scoping, walkthroughs, and testing, and driving remediation plans through to closure.
  • Translate technical findings and control gaps into clear, actionable decisions for senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders and provide regular training and updates on best practices in internal controls and changes in regulations.
  • Benchmark, monitor and report on the effectiveness of the internal control systems, and provide strategic recommendations to senior management.

Your toolkit

  • 8+ years of experience in internal controls, internal audit, external audit at a Big Four firm or equivalent, including experience building or scaling a controls function.
  • Strong working knowledge of financial reporting, ITGC, and risk management. and hands-on experience running ICOFR programs.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • A professional qualification such as CPA, ACCA, CIA, or equivalent.
  • Experience with GRC or control management platforms, such as Workiva or equivalent, and a genuine passion for automating manual control activities.
  • A track record of partnering across the business beyond Finance, to design controls that hold up operationally, not just on paper.
  • Proven experience building a high-performing team in an agile environment.
  • You use AI tools consistently and effectively in your work, with concrete examples of how AI has improved the efficiency, quality, or coverage of your control testing and reporting.
  • Excellent communication skills, equally credible with external auditors, and non-technical business leaders as executives.

Extras that give you an edge

  • Experience with control automation tooling, such as Vanta or equivalent.
  • Experience building or scaling an enterprise risk management program alongside a financial controls function.

How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary

  • Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
  • Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
  • A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.
  • Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with a quarterly team event budget
  • Access to leading AI tools plus the resources and budget to get the most out of them
  • Monthly transportation and fitness budget
  • Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
  • Language reimbursement program
  • Health and wellness benefits

And more…
