Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You will manage designated corporate accounts, develop and solicit new business, drive total hotel revenue from rooms, catering, and F&B outlets, address business needs, explore new opportunities, and expand existing business through promotional efforts and sales channels. As a Senior Sales Manager, you’re not just generating and managing group sales – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

As Senior Sales Manager, you are responsible for working closely with Director of Sales to drive accommodation business needs, explore new business and expand existing business through promotional efforts and sales channels. Specifically, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:

Luxury Consortia Management

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with luxury consortia partners
  • Negotiate annual consortia agreements, preferred partnerships, and marketing collaborations.
  • Ensure optimal visibility across advisor platforms, luxury travel portals, and partner campaigns.
  • Execute consortia promotions, advisor engagement initiatives, and luxury sales activations.

Tour & Travel Sales

  • Manage relationships with tour operators, wholesalers, destination management companies (DMCs), and retail travel agencies.
  • Identify and secure new business opportunities within domestic and international leisure markets.
  • Contract and negotiate group series and leisure groups
  • Develop seasonal packages, promotions, and tactical offers for travel partners.
  • Conduct sales calls, presentations, workshops, and product training for travel partners.

Revenue & Business Development

  • Achieve and exceed revenue, room night, and market share targets.
  • Develop and execute annual sales plans and account strategies for consortia and tour & travel segments.
  • Monitor booking trends, production reports, and competitive market intelligence.
  • Analyze account performance and implement corrective action plans when necessary.

Relationship Management

  • Build long-term partnerships with key travel advisors, agency owners, tour operators, and industry stakeholders.
  • Organize and host familiarization (FAM) trips, site inspections, networking events, and client entertainment.
  • Represent the hotel or brand at trade shows, roadshows, sales missions, and industry events.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Revenue Management, Marketing, Reservations, and Operations teams to align business strategies.
  • Coordinate promotional campaigns, digital marketing initiatives, and partner communications.
  • Ensure smooth execution of contracted business and exceptional guest experiences.

Reporting & Administration

  • Maintain accurate account records, sales activities, and pipeline updates within CRM systems.
  • Prepare weekly, monthly, and quarterly sales reports, forecasts, and budget updates.
  • Track ROI on consortia partnerships, travel campaigns, and trade events.
  • Excellent communication skills
  • High level of IT skills, including Excel, PowerPoint, and Word
  • Proactive approach to meeting deadlines
  • Excellent organizational and administration skills
  • Previous experience in a sales role

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • Diploma or degree in Hospitality, Business, or related field
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in hotel Corporate, MICE, or Group room sales
  • Proven track record in driving revenue and managing key accounts
  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills
  • Technical proficiency in hotel systems (e.g., Delphi, Salesforce, OnQ, Market Planner Survey)
  • Ability to analyze sales data and market trends to inform strategy
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills with a collaborative mindset

How We’ll Help You Thrive

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40 USD/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program

Health & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you covered

  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About The Team  

Agoda’s Customer Experience Group delivers critical support to customers and partners across markets, channels, and business lines. As our operations scale in complexity, Senior Regional Managers play a pivotal role in ensuring regional resiliency, standardization, and sustained performance across multiple sites and partners.  

 

About The Role  

The Senior Regional Manager is accountable for end-to-end performance of a regional customer/partner operations area, typically spanning multiple countries, sites, or vendor partners. This role translates company strategy into a cohesive regional roadmap, balances cross site tradeoffs, and ensures consistent, high quality service delivery at scale.  

You will act as the regional authority on customer operations performance, risks, and improvement initiatives, while developing strong leadership benches and resilient operating models.  

Key Responsibilities  

Regional & Operational Ownership 

  • Lead multi-site, multi-country customer operations (including inhouse and BPO partners where applicable) 
  • Own end to end regional outcomes, including service quality, efficiency, resiliency, and cost to serve 
  • Balance cross site tradeoffs across capacity, language coverage, channel mix, routing, and vendor strategy   

Strategy & Roadmap  

  • Translate CEG strategy into a 12–18 month regional roadmap, prioritizing initiatives that deliver measurable customer and business impact 
  • Anticipate demand shifts (seasonality, launches, policy or regulatory changes) and lead proactive regional adjustments 
  • Sponsor and govern cross site initiatives to ensure consistency and scalability  

Improvement, Innovation & Resiliency  

  • Scale adoption of tools, technologies, and best practices across sites 
  • Institutionalize experimentation standards, operational rigor, and learning across the regional leadership team 
  • Strengthen regional resiliency through standardized playbooks (e.g. surge, BCP, knowledge governance)  

Stakeholder Leadership  

  • Serve as the regional “go to” for customer operations performance, risks, and initiatives 
  • Bring together WFM, QA, Training, Analytics, Product/Tech, Policy, and Commercial partners to land regionwide solutions 
  • Communicate regional performance, scenarios, and recommendations to senior stakeholders with minimal supervision  

People & Organization Leadership  

  • Lead through Regional Managers and/or Vendor Managers, setting a high bar for performance management and leadership capability 
  • Design and evolve regional org structures, language pools, and shift strategies to meet KPIs 
  • Build successor ready pipelines, enable cross site talent mobility, and develop future senior leaders 
  • Address underperformance decisively, fairly, and in line with Agoda values  

What You’ll Bring  

  • Must have excellent spoken and written Korean skills, and Business level of English
  • Extensive demonstrated experience leading largescale, multisite or multi-country operations 
  • Proven ability to own regional outcomes and manage complexity across markets and partners 
  • Strategic thinking combined with operational execution excellence with strong analytical and experimentation mindset   
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to dive into detail to understand issue complexity, propose actionable plans, and collaborate effectively with stakeholders
  • Advanced stakeholder management and influencing skills, including Senior Leadership exposure 
  • A track record of developing leaders and building resilient organizations  

Nice to Have  

  • Experience managing outsourced/vendor operations at scale
  • Deep exposure to regulatory-complex or high-growth markets

Why Agoda 

  • Hybrid Work 
  • Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives
  • Annual discretionary performance bonus
  • Health insurance and other locally competitive benefits
  • Agoda travel discounts and special rates on accommodation and related products
  • Work from anywhere for up to 30 days per year
  • An inclusive, international work environment where your ideas and feedback are valued
  • Agoda choice(welfare points)
  • $400 USD allowance to set up your home office(one time payment)

job.job_description:
• This role is not eligible for sponsorship AND is four days onsite hybrid at our N. Scottsdale office **

Digital Product Manager, Digital Guest Services

Who are we looking for?

Choice Hotels, one of the world's largest lodging franchisors, has an exciting new opportunity as our Digital Product Manager, Digital Guest Services on our Digital Commerce Product Team. The Digital Commerce Product Team is the team that builds the mobile app, mobile web, and desktop experiences our Guests use to plan, book, and manage their trips — before they arrive, while they're on property, and after they check out. As a key member of our Digital Commerce Product Team, you will define and launch guest-facing capabilities — like mobile check-in/check-out, mobile key, and mobile ordering — that will evolve our guest-facing experiences by simplifying and enhancing the travel experience for our Guests pre-arrival, on-property, and after departure.

As a Digital Product Manager, Digital Guest Services, you will take the lead in defining and launching an expanding set of guest-facing iOS and Android capabilities. You will partner closely with UX research, design, engineering, and other teams across the company to plan and deliver a set of guest-facing planning, shopping, booking, pre-arrival, in-stay, and post-stay features that streamline the travel experience. These include capabilities such as mobile check-in/check-out, mobile key, mobile ordering, connected room and entertainment technologies, and more. Your ability to effectively collaborate, generate an understanding and empathy with guests, and fluency with consumer mobile apps will unlock new capabilities that both delight our guests and grow our business.

We invite you to apply today for our Digital Product Manager, Digital Guest Services role and #MakeItYourChoice.

Your Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of app-based products, ensuring each one delivers against Choice Hotels' enterprise-wide strategic objectives.
  • Drive product development within an agile software development process, representing the business and the voice of the customer in daily stand-ups, sprint planning sessions, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Translate product strategies and corporate objectives into product concepts, user stories, and prioritized product backlogs for our suite of mobile products.
  • Partner with user experience (UX) designers and leverage our usability and testing resources to build experiences that meet guest needs, support our business goals, and deliver measurable results.
  • Help shape the long-term strategy and roadmap for Choice Hotels' guest-facing apps, drawing insights and inspiration from the travel industry and other industries that use mobile and web technology to reduce friction for customers.
  • Conduct regular competitive and industry analysis, including assessments of competitor apps and websites and emerging consumer trends.
  • Measure performance against key performance indicators (KPIs) and targets, and build and maintain mobile scorecards and data visualizations for senior leadership.
  • Share findings and recommendations with internal stakeholders, championing the current and future needs of our guests across every department.
  • Work with our finance team on business cases and financial modeling, and partner with our hotel brand teams and other groups to develop go-to-market plans that bring new capabilities to our franchisees.

Your Experience, Skills & Competencies

  • Bachelor's degree in related field required or equivalent experience
  • At least 3 years' experience as a product manager, product owner, business analyst, or similar role within an e-commerce organization
  • Demonstrated experience building app-based guest service or e-commerce features, ideally in the travel, transportation, or hospitality sector
  • Experience building pre-stay and in-stay capabilities such as mobile check-in/check-out, mobile key, and mobile ordering preferred
  • Solid understanding of how to evaluate and measure the success of digital products
  • Strong technical fluency and a solid understanding of web technologies, with the ability to collaborate closely with engineering teams and “walk the talk”
  • Proficient in Microsoft Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint and Word
  • Proficient in Agile/Scrum methodologies and associated tools (Rally, Jira, Confluence)
  • Able to manage multiple high-priority efforts while maintaining a sense of urgency
  • Able to make decisions in the face of ambiguity, knowing when to analyze further and instinctively balancing speed with the need to support decisions with data
  • High degree of business and technical acumen and curiosity
  • Ability to travel up to 25% of the time to test new capabilities on-property
  • Demonstrates key competencies to include customer focus, decision quality, and collaboration

Your Team

  • This is an individual contributor role that will report to the Sr. Director, Product Management. You will be part of a dedicated agile team alongside peer product managers, UX researchers, designers, and engineers, and collaborate with cross functional departments on a regular basis.

** This role is not eligible for sponsorship **

Choice prioritizes our associate wellbeing by offering a comprehensive benefits program that is both competitive and flexible to help you achieve your wellbeing goals - here are just a few:

  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Leave and paid time-off for holidays, vacation, personal, family, volunteer, sick, jury duty, bereavement, military, and religious observance
  • Financial benefits for retirement and health savings
  • Employee recognition programs
  • Discounts at Choice hotels worldwide

About Choice

Choice Hotels International, Inc. (NYSE: CHH), is one of the largest lodging franchisors in the world. With 7,500 hotels in 45+ countries and territories, we offer a range of high-quality lodging options in the upper upscale, upper midscale, midscale, extended stay, and economy segments. We’re the hotel company for those who choose to bet on themselves — the striver, the dreamer, the entrepreneur — because that’s who we are, too.

At Choice, we are united by the simple belief that tomorrow will be even better than today — for associates, our company, and our franchisees. At our worldwide corporate headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, at our technology center in Scottsdale, Arizona, and through our associates around the globe, every voice is heard and every idea is listened to, no matter what area of the company they come from. We are united in supporting the entrepreneurial dreams of our thousands of franchise owners, which propels us forward — giving our work at Choice a purpose larger than our business.

Our corporate office locations:

North Bethesda, MD — Located at Pike & Rose, our worldwide headquarters is less than 15 miles from Washington, D.C., one block away from the North Bethesda Metro station, with easy access to I-495, complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Scottsdale, AZ — Located at the northwest corner of Loop 101, the Scottsdale office is home to our technology, eCommerce and customer service organizations, with easy access to complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Minneapolis, MN — Select roles are based in our Minneapolis office on Highway 394, near the intersection with Highway 100, only five minutes from downtown.

Field/Remote — Select roles designated as field/remote will require associates to work from a home office, connecting virtually with Choice team members and leadership on Zoom, with possible required travel depending on the role.

Welcome and Respect Everyone | Be Bold | Be Quick | Listen | Be Curious | Show Integrity

Choice’s Leadership Principles

Act with Intention | Lead with Authenticity | Grow & Deliver

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction to the Team

Expedia Group B2B is the business-to-business arm of Expedia Group. We bring Expedia Group’s innovative technology and distribution solutions to partners across the world. These businesses include global financial institutions, corporate managed travel, offline travel agents, global travel suppliers (like major airlines) and many more.

An exciting opportunity has arisen to join the Global Commercial Finance team within B2B. This is a key role, reporting to the Senior Manager, Commercial Finance.

The successful candidate will be a business partner with the regional Sales and Finance teams, providing key reporting & insights, and helping the team to unlock operational efficiencies that translate to better business performance. In addition, they will consolidate operational reporting for B2B, including preparing divisional and leadership MBRs & QBRs, materials for the Board of Directors/Investor Relations, and materials to assist with the review and presentation of B2B forecasts to leadership.

Core responsibilities include gathering and consolidating financial and business inputs across all of B2B’s regional divisions, preparing slides and summary documents of the key B2B story for executive reporting, financial modelling, competitive analysis, business case development, forecasting, and identifying and implementing strategies to drive operational efficiencies and automation.

In This Role, You Will

  • Ensure delivery of monthly and quarterly business performance metrics and insights for distribution to B2B Sales and Finance management
  • Assist with the preparation and delivery of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial management information and high-level commentary for distribution at an Executive level
  • Assist with the modelling of the long-range financial plan (3+ years), by building and enhancing the financial model, partnering closely with Finance, Strategy, and Sales leadership to gather key insights and divisional growth drivers, and translating these into clear financial targets and growth ambitions for the organization
  • Work with the Senior Commercial Finance Manager, Finance team, and Sales leadership to drive improvements in operational reporting, focused on delivering greater insight to business performance
  • Perform ad-hoc analysis to support cross-regional commercial projects and initiatives as well as deep-dives into specific topics to support the growth of the business and mitigate risk
  • Support the Senior Commercial Finance Manager to enhance, develop and implement improved processes and controls, to facilitate sustainable, profitable scaling of the B2B business
  • Leverage AI and automation to increase efficiency across all applicable responsibilities

Experience And Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field; or equivalent professional experience
  • Highly fluent in English (written and spoken)
  • Confirmed commercial finance experience
  • Validated ability to analyze data to solve business problems and provide strong business insight and recommendations
  • Proven ability to interpret and present data in a visually compelling format to financial and non-financial audiences
  • Strong Excel skills, including model building, formula optimization, data validation and error troubleshooting
  • Experience leveraging AI agents, Power Pivot, and Power BI is a plus
  • Proven ability to deep-dive into large data sets and identify key drivers or unusual variances
  • Proven ability to operate autonomously and to juggle multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize effectively and meet deadlines
  • Proven ability to think “outside the box” as required and identify alternative solutions
  • A relationship builder, exceptional listener and team player
  • Experienced and enthusiastic working in dynamic, entrepreneurial environments
  • Someone who thrives in large, global, fast-moving organizations
  • Please note that this role is only available in the following location: Spain, in alignment with our flexible work model which requires employees to be in-office atleast three days a week

The total cash range for this position in Madrid is €43,000.00 to €60,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to €69,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Benefits And Perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life.

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Equal Opportunity

Job Summary

The Distribution Account Manager is responsible for the day-to-day management of assigned distribution partners across the AMER region. This role serves as the primary owner of distribution relationships from contracting through operational and commercial execution, ensuring partners are correctly onboarded, configured, and operating in line with IHG standards while delivering value to hotels. The role owns the ongoing health, performance, and governance of OTA and distribution partners by monitoring KPIs, supporting regular business reviews, resolving operational and compliance issues, and coordinating cross-functionally to drive sustainable results for hotels. The role will also focus on business development, to support the region, and establish new opportunities and connectivity with OTAs and Tour Operators.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary Distribution owner for assigned partners, acting as the central point of contact for account management activities
  • Support and participate in regular account reviews, including MBRs and QBRs, with partners and internal stakeholders
  • Support regional and commercial teams by addressing partner-related questions, issues, and opportunities
  • New business development
  • Partner with the Commercial organization to align account enablement and identify high‑value opportunities

Contracting and Commercial Governance

  • Lead or support partner contracting and contract renewals within defined Distribution guardrails
  • Ensure partner contracts align with IHG distribution standards, onward distribution principles, and rate parity requirements

Operational Management and Execution

  • Own partner onboarding, setup, and ongoing maintenance across Distribution systems and tools
  • Manage and maintain accurate partner information in Merlin, ensuring ongoing data integrity
  • Support the onboarding and integration of new brands into partner portfolios

Connectivity and Channel Support

  • Act as the first point of escalation for partner connectivity and channel support issues
  • Coordinate with internal technical teams and external connectivity providers to resolve issues efficiently
  • Rate Parity and Compliance Support

Experience

  • 8+ years of progressive work-related experience as a Product Manager or Sr. Product Manager with demonstrated proficiency in one or multiple disciplines/technologies/processes related to the position including product and/or project management, travel technology systems (GDS, OTAs, PMS and other distribution technology), or vendor relationship management.

Skills & Technical Experience

  • Experience leading medium‑to‑large partner integration initiatives, including requirements gathering, stakeholder communication, change management, and delivery, with hands‑on experience testing APIs and working with XML/JSON messaging.
  • Proven success operating as a Product Manager in modern, cross‑functional software environments, overseeing multiple products and collaborating effectively with engineering, design, and business stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, project management, and communication skills, including the ability to define product goals and success metrics, provide in‑depth technical analysis and feedback to engineering and leadership, manage competing priorities, and adapt quickly within complex travel distribution ecosystems.

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself creating memorable events and experiences while driving the commercial success of one of Perth’s iconic hotels. When you join our team, that’s exactly what you’ll have the opportunity to do.

As our Groups, Meetings & Events Sales Manager, you will lead the GM&E Sales team and drive revenue performance across groups, meetings and events. You’ll develop and execute commercial strategies, identify new business opportunities, build strong client relationships, maximise total hotel revenue and work closely with the wider Commercial, Marketing and Food & Beverage teams.

You’re not just driving event sales, you’re inspiring and developing your team, creating exceptional experiences for our clients and guests, and bringing Hilton’s vision of being the most hospitable company in the world to life every day.

Discover Your Next Destination

Located in the heart of Perth's CBD, Parmelia Hilton Perth combines contemporary elegance with warm hospitality. Just moments from Elizabeth Quay, Brookfield Place, and the city's premier business and entertainment precincts, the hotel offers exceptional dining experiences, stylish accommodation, and outstanding service. As part of Hilton's flagship hotel in Western Australia, you'll have the opportunity to build a rewarding career while creating memorable experiences for our guests every day.

A World of Rewards

  • Enjoy complimentary laundering of your work uniform
  • Complimentary fresh and healthy meals while on duty
  • Personalised development with support from our on-site Learning & Development Manager, plus global career opportunities across Hilton.
  • Make a meaningful impact through our award-winning Corporate Responsibility programmes – learn more ( Responsible Business | Travel with Purpose | Hilton TWP )
  • Go Hilton Team Member Travel Program – enjoy heavily discounted hotel stays from as little as $70 per night across the globe
  • Fitness Passport - access a wide network of gyms and fitness centres
  • Up to 25% off Food & Beverage across participating outlets
  • Year-round recognition programmes celebrating your contributions and achievements
  • Wellbeing initiatives to support your mental and physical health

Responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Lead the Groups, Meetings & Events Sales Team: Inspire, coach and develop the team to achieve and surpass annual revenue targets while building on individual strengths and development opportunities.
  • Drive revenue performance: Achieve revenue targets through proactive daily yield management, identifying new business opportunities and maximising total revenue spend across the hotel.
  • Develop and execute commercial strategies: Work closely with the Commercial Director, Sales Team, Revenue and Director of Finance to formulate revenue plans, sales strategies and action plans across key market segments .
  • Build strong client relationships: Take personal responsibility for key accounts, understand client needs and decision-making processes, and identify opportunities to secure new and repeat business.
  • Identify new business opportunities: Continuously review the customer base, conduct market and industry research, monitor competitor activity and build relationships with key industry partners to generate future business.
  • Monitor performance and forecasting: Review and report on revenue streams, sales activities and forecasts, using data and market intelligence to identify opportunities and guide future activities.
  • Maximise event opportunities: Use effective upselling techniques and innovative ideas to help clients create memorable events within their budget while maximising revenue opportunities for the hotel.
  • Collaborate across the hotel: Partner closely with Marketing, Food & Beverage and the wider Commercial team to develop sales, marketing and promotional opportunities and ensure a seamless client experience.

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • Have a minimum of 12 months of full Australian Working rights (sponsorship is not offered)
  • Physically based in the Perth Metropolitan Area or willing to relocate (no relocation allowance is offered
  • Previous experience in Groups, Meetings & Events Sales, Hotel Sales, or a similar commercial role
  • Proven experience in leading and developing a high-performing sales team
  • Strong commercial acumen with experience in driving revenue, forecasting and achieving sales targets
  • Strong client relationship management, negotiation and communication skills
  • Ability to identify new business opportunities and analyse market and competitor trends
  • Experience with Delphi or similar hotel sales and event management systems
  • A collaborative leadership style with a passion for hospitality and delivering exceptional experiences

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

Job Description

The successful candidate will be part of Procurement Department in Corporate Planning Division. He/she will lead the development and implementation of enterprise-wide supply chain governance, standards, performance management and continuous improvement initiatives. The role will strengthen supply chain resilience, data quality, process compliance and operational efficiency across Singapore Airlines by working closely with Procurement, Supply Chain, business units and other corporate functions.

Responsibilities

  • Supply Chain, Inventory and Data Governance
  • Develop and maintain inventory policies, procedures, controls and operating guidelines covering demand planning, replenishment, inventory holding, stock movements, ageing, write-offs and disposal
  • Lead standardisation of supply chain processes, roles, responsibilities and controls across Business Units, Procurement, Finance, Warehousing, Logistics and other relevant functions.
  • Analyse inventory levels, consumption trends, demand patterns, lead times and supply risks to identify opportunities for optimisation and cost reduction.
  • Improve inventory visibility across locations, categories and business units through standardised reporting, dashboards and supply chain control-tower capabilities.
  • Establish appropriate escalation, root-cause analysis and corrective-action processes for recurring supply chain and inventory issues.
  • Partner with Business Units, Supply Chain and IT teams to drive cross-functional initiatives to improve supply chain planning, inventory management and materials availability for commercial and corporate requirements.
  • Develop, implement and monitor supply chain and inventory KPIs, including demand and supply alignment, inventory availability, inventory turns, excess and obsolete inventory, stock-outs, service levels, lead times, order fulfilment and supplier performance.
  • Contribute to supply risk assessments, business continuity planning and mitigation strategies for critical materials and services.
  • Master Data Governance
  • Design, document and maintain the master data governance policy, framework, standards, procedures and operating guidelines for procurement, material and service master data.
  • Establish data quality standards, validation rules, naming conventions, classification structures and approval workflows.
  • Ensure approved master data governance policies, business rules, controls and workflows are appropriately incorporated and configured in the Enterprise Data Governance tool.
  • Monitor the effectiveness of master data controls and MDG processes, including data accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, duplication and compliance.
  • Risk, Sustainability and Corporate Governance
  • Lead the department’s risk management agenda, overseeing departmental risk identification, assessment, mitigation, monitoring and reporting.
  • Drive the department’s sustainability agenda, embedding sustainability, ESG and responsible procurement requirements into relevant policies, processes and performance reporting.
  • Lead the department’s IPT governance and compliance requirements, ensuring timely submission of information, accurate reporting and closure of follow-up. actions
  • Strengthen enterprise risk and control effectiveness across procurement processes, master data, systems, compliance and operational continuity by identifying control gaps, implementing mitigating measures and monitoring their sustained effectiveness.

Requirements

  • Degree in Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Business, Finance, Operations Management, Information Systems or a related discipline.
  • At least five years’ relevant experience in supply chain, procurement, operations, transformation or governance.
  • Experience in supply chain governance, process improvement, performance and risk management.
  • Knowledge of procurement transformation, Source-to-Pay, automation, digitalisation, controls and reporting.
  • Experience developing master data governance policies, workflows and controls.
  • Proficiency in ERP, procurement, inventory management or Master Data Governance systems.
  • Strong skills in data analysis, dashboard development, process mapping and root-cause analysis.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint; Power BI, SAP or SAP MDG experience is an advantage.
  • Strong analytical, project management, communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders, manage priorities and work independently.
  • Relevant professional certification is an advantage.

We thank all candidates for your interest in Singapore Airlines, and regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to know our team

In Product, ideas come alive. The world moves fast, and our culture is built on ownership, speed, and minimal bureaucracy. This is the environment that empowers you to make decisions, move quickly, and do what you believe is right. Our Product Managers move fast, learn from failure, and continuously iterate.

As a product-centric organization, we work cross-functionally to build products from conception to launch, bringing together engineering, design, data, and business teams. Agoda Product Managers work closely with executive leadership and have high visibility across the organization, with direct impact on the company’s growth and strategy. We put travelers first and aim to create exceptional travel experiences through innovative product thinking.

The opportunity

This role is based in Bangkok/Seoul based. Our Senior Product Managers are analytical, hands-on, and highly data-driven. They are responsible for building products end-to-end, using analysis, experimentation, and rapid iteration to create solutions that are tailored to traveler needs.

As our next Senior Product Manager, Localization (Korea Market), you will define product strategy and drive execution for experiences serving Korean travelers. You will partner closely with senior cross-functional stakeholders to identify opportunities, build impactful products, and deliver high-quality solutions for the Korea market.

You will work with dedicated engineering resources that you help prioritize and allocate. We expect you to be hands-on, spend meaningful time with your SCRUM teams, and bring strong product judgment, experimentation mindset, and execution rigor. This role offers the opportunity to shape localized experiences at scale and influence how Agoda serves one of its key markets. This is an Individual Contributor role.

In this role, you’ll get to

  • Develop a deep understanding of the online travel ecosystem, market dynamics, competitive landscape, and user needs in the Korea market
  • Define, build, launch, and optimize products and features through testing, experimentation, and rapid iteration
  • Drive localization initiatives that improve the experience for Korean travelers across the product journey
  • Partner closely with Engineering, Marketing, Legal, Design, Analytics, and other cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact solutions
  • Translate market insights, customer needs, and business priorities into clear product strategies and roadmaps
  • Use data and quantitative analysis to identify opportunities, prioritize effectively, and measure product performance
  • Collaborate across regions, product areas, and functions to solve complex problems and drive meaningful business impact

What you’ll need to succeed

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical or quantitative field such as Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related discipline
  • Proven ability to use analytics and quantitative methods to inform strategy, prioritization, and decision-making
  • Strong data skills, with the ability to independently analyze performance and generate actionable insights
  • Excellent communication skills in either Korean with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and influence a wide range of stakeholders
  • Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and influence a wide range of stakeholders
  • Proven experience in Korea market localization, with a deep understanding of Korean consumers, market dynamics, and local product requirements
  • Experience developing, launching, and optimizing products in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience leading product strategy, go-to-market thinking, and cross-functional product development discussions
  • Strong entrepreneurial mindset and analytical problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down complexity and drive change
  • Hands-on approach with a strong sense of ownership and execution

It’s great if you have

  • MBA or Master’s degree in Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field
  • Experience with data tools such as SQL, Python, R, or equivalent

Please review our Hiring Process Guidelines before your interview — click here to learn how interviewing at Agoda works.

Discover More About Working At Agoda

  • Agoda Careers https://careersatagoda.com
  • Facebook https://www.facebook.com/agodacareers/
  • LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/agoda
  • YouTube https://www.youtube.com/agodalife

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Agoda, we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds and orientations. We prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and innovation. Employment at Agoda is based solely on a person’s merit and qualifications. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity regardless of sex, age, race, color, national origin, religion, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, citizenship, veteran or military status, and other legally protected characteristics.

We will keep your application on file so that we can consider you for future vacancies and you can always ask to have your details removed from the file. For more details please read our privacy policy.

Disclaimer

If we receive unsolicited or speculative CVs, we reserve the right to contact and hire the candidate directly without any obligation to pay a recruitment fee.

job.job_description:
Company Description

At Accor we believe that there is a place for everyone in the same way that our brands cater to all of our guests. That’s why we offer the greatest career opportunities, industry training and the chance to work in the most diverse locations in the hotel, resort and hospitality industry.

Who We Are…

A sanctuary of style, Hotel Chadstone Melbourne MGallery offers the perfect luxury escape nestled close to the city of Melbourne and on the doorstep of Chadstone - The Fashion Capital. Our unique design marries both exclusivity and comfort allowing guests to feel a sense of home during their stay, whilst transporting them into a world of glamour and style. Five star luxury and opulence creates the perfect setting for our team to create special moments that our guests will remember forever. Join us at Hotel Chadstone Melbourne MGallery, where we create stories that stay.

Job Description

We are looking for a Meetings & Events Coordinator to join our Sales team and provide essential coordination and administrative support across our Meetings & Events function.

This is a key support role, working closely with the Conference & Events Sales team to ensure confirmed events are accurately planned, communicated and coordinated with the hotel’s operational teams.

The role is primarily administration and coordination focused. You will manage event documentation, client communication, Event Orders, quotations, invoicing and event administration, while ensuring all relevant details are captured and communicated clearly. You will also support the Sales team with client site inspections, familiarisations and other activities throughout the event lifecycle.

You will be organised, detail focused and comfortable managing multiple events and deadlines at the same time. While the role is based within Sales, you will work closely with Food & Beverage and other hotel departments to help ensure our clients’ expectations are delivered.

What you’ll be doing

  • Provide day-to-day administrative and coordination support to the Meetings & Events Sales team.
  • Liaise with clients to gather and confirm all details relating to their confirmed meetings and events.
  • Prepare and maintain detailed Event Orders in Delphi, ensuring information is accurate, complete and clearly communicated to the operational teams.
  • Prepare event checklists and ensure all relevant event documentation is completed and up to date.
  • Assist the Meetings & Events Sales Manager with conference proposals and quotations, including venue, function, menu and accommodation requirements.
  • Coordinate the administration of events from confirmation through to post-event follow-up.
  • Assist with revenue postings, payment charges and invoicing, including following up with clients regarding prepayment requirements.
  • Respond to client enquiries by phone and email in a timely and professional manner.
  • Coordinate and assist with familiarisations and client site inspections.
  • Prepare and coordinate event collateral including menus, signage, conference kits and other materials.
  • Attend weekly Banquets Event Order meetings and relevant Sales meetings, ensuring information is accurately communicated and followed up.
  • Maintain accurate conference databases and client contact information.
  • Assist with reporting and other general administrative requirements for the Meetings & Events team.
  • Work closely with Food & Beverage, Maintenance and other hotel departments to ensure event requirements are communicated and actioned.
  • Assist the operational team with conferencing and outside catering requirements when required.
  • Follow up with clients after events to gather feedback and support ongoing client relationships.

Qualifications

We’re looking for someone who enjoys being organised, keeping things on track and making sure the details are taken care of.

You Will Have

  • Previous experience in hospitality, hotels, events, administration or a similar coordination role.
  • Strong administrative and organisational skills, with excellent attention to detail.
  • Confident written and verbal communication skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple tasks, deadlines and event requirements at the same time.
  • A professional and friendly approach when communicating with clients and colleagues.
  • Strong computer skills and confidence working with systems and databases. Experience with Delphi or a similar event management system will be highly regarded.
  • A team focused approach and the ability to work effectively with Sales, Food & Beverage and other hotel departments.
  • A willingness to learn and support the wider Conference & Events team.

Additional Information

What’s In It For You...

  • The opportunity to join a luxury MGallery hotel in one of Melbourne’s leading lifestyle and retail destinations.
  • A supportive and collaborative Sales and Events team.
  • Career pathways within Accor, Australia’s largest hospitality group
  • Worldwide accommodation and food & beverage discounts from your first day
  • Industry-leading training and development opportunities
  • A supportive, collaborative culture where your creativity and ideas are valued
  • The opportunity to work across a diverse range of corporate meetings, conferences and events.

Apply now to become part of the story at Hotel Chadstone Melbourne MGallery. We can’t wait to welcome you!

job.job_description:
Job Summary

The VP and Segment Lead, Upscale Brands, is responsible for the strategy, health, performance, and growth of Choice Hotels’ seven-brand Upscale portfolio. This leader has accountability for key commercial, growth, financial, and guest experience outcomes and develops long-term portfolio and individual brand strategies that support enterprise objectives and five-year growth goals. The Vice President leads through a highly matrixed organization, partnering across commercial, marketing, development, operations, loyalty, technology, and franchise services while building strong relationships with current and prospective owners. The role serves as a visible champion for the Upscale portfolio, strengthening brand value propositions, driving hotel performance, expanding the portfolio, and attracting and retaining owners and operators. The position is based in Pike & Rose and requires travel as business needs dictate.

Responsibilities

Brand Strategy, Performance and Growth

  • Own the long-term strategy and performance of the Upscale brand portfolio, aligning brand priorities, investment decisions, and growth plans with corporate objectives and five-year targets.
  • Establish clear strategic direction for the Upscale segment and individual brands, identifying opportunities to strengthen competitive positioning, owner value, guest experience, and long-term growth.
  • Maintain competitive franchisee, consumer, and developer value propositions, focusing on brand segmentation, guest satisfaction, unit growth, central reservation system contribution, RevPAR performance, total cost of ownership, and net operating income.
  • Monitor portfolio performance, competitive dynamics, consumer trends, owner economics, and broader industry developments to identify opportunities and make strategic adjustments.
  • Establish performance expectations and use financial, commercial, operational, and brand-compliance metrics to evaluate initiative effectiveness and direct changes when needed.
  • Partner with Marketing and Commercial teams to develop and execute integrated brand, commercial, and marketing strategies.
  • Define and scale a segment-level strategy to attract prospective owners and operators and support portfolio growth.
  • Partner with Franchise Development, Openings, Commercial, Loyalty, Global Sales, and Portfolio Optimization to support hotel ramp-up, performance, and net room growth goals.
  • Represent Choice Hotels and the Upscale brands with current and prospective franchisees, at industry events, franchise advisory forums, development discussions, conventions, and appropriate media opportunities.
  • Serve as a strategic brand champion, clearly communicating the positioning, value proposition, priorities, and growth opportunities of the Upscale portfolio.

Organizational and Enterprise Leadership

  • Develop compelling, data-supported business cases for significant brand initiatives and build internal and external support for implementation.
  • Lead execution of multi-year strategic brand plans through partnership across Franchise Development, Marketing and Distribution, Loyalty, E-commerce, Technology, Brand Compliance, Training, Owner and Portfolio Management, Franchise Services, and other functions.
  • Set a clear strategic vision and translate long-term objectives into actionable priorities, resource decisions, and measurable outcomes.
  • Build collaborative relationships across functions to solve complex business issues and advance shared enterprise objectives.
  • Partner directly with franchisees on strategic brand initiatives and provide the insight and support needed for successful operational implementation.
  • Create scalable learning and engagement opportunities that strengthen owner knowledge and execution.
  • Promote organizational agility by establishing clear priorities, responding effectively to evolving business conditions, and communicating strategic changes and their implications.
  • Exercise sound business judgment in complex and ambiguous situations, balancing brand, owner, guest, growth, and financial considerations.

People and Talent Leadership

  • Build, lead, develop, and engage a high-performing team capable of delivering the strategic priorities of the Upscale portfolio.
  • Establish clear goals and accountability, ensuring the team achieves or exceeds business and departmental objectives.
  • Develop internal and external talent pipelines and maintain meaningful succession plans for critical positions.
  • Coach and develop leaders and team members to strengthen capabilities, increase organizational effectiveness, and prepare talent for expanded responsibilities.
  • Foster a growth mindset and culture of agility, accountability, collaboration, inclusion, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Engage with relevant industry associations and external networks to strengthen Choice Hotels’ position as an employer of choice.
  • Inspire and mobilize teams, matrixed partners, owners, and other stakeholders around a common vision and shared business objectives.
  • Model a strong sense of urgency, thoughtful risk-taking, and consistent focus on measurable business results.

Qualifications

Employment Experience

  • Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible operational experience with a major hotel group and/or hotel management company, including on-property General Manager and above-property leadership experience.
  • Minimum of 5 years of upscale hotel management and operational experience.
  • Demonstrated success developing and implementing strategies that drive business change, growth, and improved profitability.
  • Experience with P&L accountability for a multi-unit portfolio.
  • Demonstrated experience developing, implementing, and measuring business processes and strategic initiatives.
  • Significant experience leading and influencing in a complex, matrixed organization, including collaboration with senior leaders and external stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and develop teams, build succession pipelines, and drive organizational performance.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced financial and analytical skills, including budgeting, forecasting, portfolio performance analysis, and data-supported decision-making.
  • Ability to interpret commercial, operational, guest experience, brand compliance, and financial performance measures and translate insights into strategic action.
  • Strong working knowledge of hotel operations, brand strategy, franchise business models, owner economics, and portfolio performance.
  • Ability to effectively apply technology and business tools to analysis, communication, and decision-making.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

Additional Skills & Competencies

  • Strategic Leadership: Ability to establish a compelling long-term vision and translate strategy into measurable priorities and results.
  • Business and Financial Acumen: Strong understanding of business drivers and the ability to balance owner economics, brand performance, growth, guest outcomes, and profitability.
  • Influence and Collaboration: Exceptional ability to establish credibility, build relationships, and influence across organizational boundaries and external stakeholder groups.
  • Executive Communication: Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with executives, associates, franchisees, prospective owners, industry audiences, and other stakeholders.
  • Agility and Results Orientation: Ability to navigate ambiguity, adapt priorities as conditions change, take thoughtful risks, and maintain accountability for outcomes.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Hotel Management, Business Management, or a related field or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.
  • Master’s or postgraduate degree preferred.

SALARY RANGE

The salary range for this position is $250,000 to $300,000 annually. In addition to the annual salary, this role is eligible for an annual bonus based on the terms of Choice's Management Incentive Plan (MIP), as well as annual awards of Choice Hotels International common stock through Choice’s Long-Term Incentive Plan (LTI Plan).

Choice prioritizes our associate wellbeing by offering a comprehensive benefits program that is both competitive and flexible to help you achieve your wellbeing goals - here are just a few:

  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Leave and paid time-off for holidays, vacation, personal, family, volunteer, sick, jury duty, bereavement, military, and religious observance
  • Financial benefits for retirement and health savings
  • Employee recognition programs
  • Discounts at Choice hotels worldwide

About Choice

Choice Hotels International, Inc. (NYSE: CHH), is one of the largest lodging franchisors in the world. With 7,500 hotels in 45+ countries and territories, we offer a range of high-quality lodging options in the upper upscale, upper midscale, midscale, extended stay, and economy segments. We’re the hotel company for those who choose to bet on themselves — the striver, the dreamer, the entrepreneur — because that’s who we are, too.

At Choice, we are united by the simple belief that tomorrow will be even better than today — for associates, our company, and our franchisees. At our worldwide corporate headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, at our technology center in Scottsdale, Arizona, and through our associates around the globe, every voice is heard and every idea is listened to, no matter what area of the company they come from. We are united in supporting the entrepreneurial dreams of our thousands of franchise owners, which propels us forward — giving our work at Choice a purpose larger than our business.

Our corporate office locations:

job.job_description:
About Us

IHG Hotels & Resorts is one of the world's leading hotel companies, present in around 100 countries, with more than 7,100 hotels operating. You'll know some or all of our 21 hotel brands. They are some of the best known and most popular in the world, including InterContinental, Holiday Inn, Crowne Plaza, Regent, Six Senses, and Hotel Indigo.

At InterContinental, the world's largest family of luxury hotels, we all take great pride in being genuine ambassadors of the our brand. Each of our hotels cultivates a distinctive style and ambience where we embrace every opportunity to give our guests a personal and enriching experience.

InterContinental Perth City Centre opened in October 2017 after an extensive refurbishment and is a 240-room modern, design orientated hotel in the heart of Perth's CBD. At the core of our events offering are the Gallery Meeting Suites — a truly distinctive collection of inner‑city event spaces that redefine the traditional hotel event space environment. Designed with a refined, residential aesthetic, these spaces deliver a boutique, elevated experience ideal for bespoke and highly personalised events. Comprising four beautifully appointed rooms, the suites can be booked individually or exclusively as a full‑floor buyout, accommodating cocktail receptions for up to 180 guests. This is a premium, city‑centre offering unlike any other in Perth, and we are seeking a passionate professional to join our team and drive the continued growth of our groups and events business.

We are seeking a full time Sales Executive working across Groups, MICE, Meetings & Events to join our team. If you want to professionally grow, then this is the opportunity you've been waiting for!

https://perth.intercontinental.com/meetings-events/

Your day to day

As Sales Executive, you are responsible for converting and business proactive relationship management of existing key clients to achieve & exceed the annual budget for designated segments.

In this role you will be required to convert business primarily in the Groups, MICE, Meetings & Events segments. You will form external alliances and partners to support the Hotel’s positioning and represent the Hotel and brand.

Day to day, you'll be responsible for building relationships with new, existing and prospective clients with a focus on securing business in line with the goals set forth in the sales strategy. This role involves negotiating rates for the benefit of the business through managing existing client account list, monitoring competitor activities using market intelligence tools and proactively developing and maintaining regular sales calls. Based on the nature of our clientele, you will manage these groups and events for the full sales cycle, including handover to operations for delivery of the program.

Your days will be varied and will require attention to detail, creativity and a proactive approach to support team and the hotel’s sales and meetings initiatives.

What We Need From You

The successful candidate will have a strong drive for results and experience in sales and conversion, ideally within a similar style of hotel environment. You will have an understanding of industry dynamics and trends, with a passion to grow your network and establish yourself as a recognised ambassador for one of Perth's most distinctive hotel offerings . You will have the ability to work alongside a close-knit team and have strong communication that allows you to collaborate with key stakeholders. Proven ability to work with guests and champion a brand is also a must.

To be successful in this role you'll have demonstrated excellence in these fields at a similar level as well as outstanding internal stakeholder communication, and an understanding of brand delivery and the ability to impact and influence the overall business agenda.

  • Knowledge and experience of Sales Systems (i.e. Delphi; Opera; etc.) is highly advantageous.
  • Candidates must have unlimited and unrestricted working rights for Australia.

What We Offer

Join our extraordinary world and experience a place where you can be yourself, share your ideas, support your personal growth and wellbeing, and be a valued member of an inspirational team.

You’ll be rewarded for your hard work with a suite of benefits that supports you and your family’s wellbeing, including

  • Free duty meal on shift
  • Discounted CBD carparking
  • Paid birthday leave - hip hip hooray!
  • Paid parental leave
  • Proactive paid wellness and mental health days
  • Support if interstate relocation is required (flight to Perth and 2 weeks accommodation)
  • Some of the best colleague discounts across our IHG Hotels for accommodation, food and beverage
  • A massive colleague discounts platform for all your favorite brands and retailers - to help your salary go further
  • Most importantly, your career journey will be supported through our lifelong development programs, IHG career milestone celebrations, and transfer of leave entitlements as you move and grow with IHG.

Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Complex Director of Leisure Sales, you’re not just building travel partner relationships to drive revenue – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Signia by Hilton Orlando Bonnet Creek

An expansive meetings‑focused destination, Signia Orlando Bonnet Creek features:

  • Features 1,009 stylish and newly renovated guest rooms
  • Family-friendly pool complex with 3- acre resort-style lazy river, zero entry pool, water slide and private cabanas
  • Rees Jones-designed championship 18- hole golf course and Waldorf Astoria Spa
  • Official Walt Disney World ® Hotel, offering special Disney benefits,
  • Seven distinctive dining venues, including La Luce, Zeta Asia, Harvest, Beech, Myth, and Muse

This property blends elevated business travel with resort‑style amenities, creating a vibrant environment for both guests and team members.

Waldorf Astoria Orlando

A hallmark of timeless luxury, the Waldorf Astoria Orlando offers:

  • 502 elegantly appointed deluxe rooms and suites
  • 12 unique restaurants and lounges, including the famed Bull & Bear®
  • Two tranquil pools featuring private luxury cabanas and poolside fire pits
  • Rees Jones-designed 18-hole golf course and clubhouse
  • Waldorf Astoria® Spa & Fitness Center
  • Waldorf Astoria Kids Club
  • Access to amenities at the adjoining Signia by Hilton Orlando Bonnet Creek, featuring a 3-acre lazy river and water slide
  • Continuous luxury motorcoach transportation to Walt Disney World® theme parks and Disney Springs

The Waldorf Astoria Orlando embodies effortless luxury, rooted in refined service and unforgettable guest experiences.

Responsibilities

The Director of Leisure Sales leads the resort’s leisure and transient sales strategy, with primary focus on luxury travel advisors/consortia, wholesale/FIT, and other high‑yield leisure segments. This role drives profitable room revenue through strong partnerships and close collaboration with Revenue Management, Marketing, and Operations to deliver exceptional guest experiences and achieve commercial objectives. Here's what you'll do during a typical day:

  • Lead the identification, solicitation, and management of leisure and business travel accounts, including luxury retail travel advisors, consortia, wholesalers, FIT, entertainment, and select corporate travel segments.
  • Develop and execute Leisure and Business Travel Sales & Marketing Action Plans aligned with overall resort and multi-resort strategy.
  • Establish and manage target account lists for wholesale, retail, consortia, and business travel segments, ensuring achievement of annual room night and revenue goals.
  • Integrate individual property leisure initiatives into the broader resort or complex leisure sales strategy.
  • Proactively prospect new leisure and business travel accounts through qualified sales calls, market visits, and direct outreach; conduct regular and strategic sales trips.
  • Represent the resort at key travel industry trade shows, conferences, sales missions, and professional meetings.
  • Maintain strong relationships with travel industry partners by communicating updates on programs, promotions, and events, serving as a primary liaison and brand ambassador.
  • Review account production, booking patterns, and market mix to determine appropriate segmentation, negotiation strategy, and pricing recommendations.
  • Collaborate closely with Revenue Management on pricing, demand, forecasting, and negotiated leisure and business travel agreements.
  • Direct the collection and analysis of competitive intelligence to inform market positioning and sales strategy.
  • Ensure all travel industry policies, wholesale agreements, and sales guidelines are clearly communicated and adhered to by Sales and Operations teams.
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Operations to ensure alignment on new programs, packages, promotions, and travel industry initiatives that support revenue growth and positive brand exposure.
  • Maintain active relationships with competitive properties at both regional and national levels through professional associations and industry networks.
  • Host and lead travel partner FAM trips, educational tours, and site inspections, ensuring consistent execution of luxury brand standards.

What are we looking for?

Qualifications

  • Proven success in luxury hospitality leisure sales with a strong record of revenue growth and relationship building.
  • Experience leading sales strategy across teams and cross-functional partners.
  • Excellent negotiation, presentation, and relationship‑management skills.
  • Strong analytical capability and comfort using sales systems and market data.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience preferred.

Preferred Experience

  • Established relationships within luxury consortia, leisure agency networks, and/or wholesale/FIT segments.
  • Luxury resort or multi-property experience with diverse amenities.

Travel

  • Frequent domestic and international travel for sales calls, trade shows, and partner engagement.

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

About The Team

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
  • Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
  • Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
  • Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
  • Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
  • Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Generous paid time off (PTO) – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters most
  • Health & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family covered
  • Financial security for your future – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what’s next
