Senior Product Manager, Customer Data Platform: Identity & User Keychain

Introduction to the Team

Customer Data Platform (CDP) is the team responsible for resolving, structuring, and governing the traveler data that powers personalization, targeting, and measurement across every Expedia Group brand. Our identity graph — the User Keychain — links registered and anonymous activity across brands and devices for 460M+ EG travelers, underpinning more than 5B stitched identity keys. It is one of the most foundational and highest-leverage data products in the company: nearly every downstream product team, from onsite personalization to marketing activation to fraud and servicing, depends on the accuracy and completeness of identity resolution we provide.

We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to own User Keychain end-to-end and set its go-forward strategy. This is a strategic, executive-visible role: you will define what “identity” means at Expedia Group for the next several years, decide how aggressively we invest in resolving the ~90% of traveler traffic that is anonymous today, and represent that vision directly to senior leadership. You'll spend as much time in rooms with data engineering, brand and experience teams, advertising, marketing, legal, and fellow Data PMs as you spend with your own roadmap — this role exists at the intersection of technical depth and cross-functional influence, and it requires both in equal measure.

In This Role, You Will

  • Own the go-forward vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for User Keychain, Expedia Group's customer identity graph, setting the direction for how the company resolves travelers across authenticated and unauthenticated (anonymous) states.
  • Think at the level of company-wide identity resolution strategy — not just the current Keychain implementation — evaluating build vs. buy vs. partner options, deterministic vs. probabilistic matching, and how identity should evolve as authentication, privacy regulation, and device/browser tracking continue to shift.
  • Audit the existing identity resolution logic and related customer data products within CDP against industry best practices in identity graphs and identity resolution, identifying where we lag, quantifying the gap, and driving the roadmap to close it.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for User Keychain with executives and senior stakeholders, translating technical identity concepts (linkage methods, confidence scoring, match rates, provenance) into business terms and building the case for investment.
  • Partner directly with data engineering to shape the technical roadmap — schemas, matching/linkage logic, confidence scoring, latency and freshness — and to sequence platform investment against business priorities.
  • Build and manage shared roadmaps and explicit dependency mappings with brand and experience teams, Advertising, Marketing, Legal, and other Data Product Managers, aligning on what each partner needs from identity resolution and by when.
  • Drive buy-in and formal development partnerships across these groups — negotiating priority, sequencing, and resourcing trade-offs so that User Keychain's roadmap reflects real, committed cross-functional demand rather than a single team's view.
  • Identify, evaluate, and develop partnerships with third-party identity and data providers, scoping each partnership around a specific business problem sponsored jointly with a brand or experience team, and owning the resulting build vs. buy vs. partner recommendation.
  • Define and track the success metrics for identity resolution (match rate, identity confidence/precision, coverage of anonymous traffic, downstream activation lift) and report progress against them to leadership.
  • Ensure legal, privacy, and governance requirements (consent, RTBF, cross-border data use, vendor data-sharing terms) are embedded in identity resolution design from the start, in partnership with Legal and data governance.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 6+ years of product management experience, including significant, direct experience building data products and identity graphs (identity resolution, customer master/golden record, or identity stitching across channels or devices).
  • Demonstrated ownership of a go-forward product strategy and roadmap for a platform or data product with company-wide dependencies, including the executive communication to sponsor and defend that strategy.
  • Working technical fluency in identity resolution concepts — deterministic and probabilistic matching, identity graphs, confidence/quality scoring, data provenance — sufficient to challenge and shape engineering design decisions.
  • Track record of building shared roadmaps and dependency alignment across multiple functions (e.g., engineering, marketing, advertising, legal, other product teams), including navigating competing priorities to reach a committed, cross-team plan.
  • Experience evaluating, negotiating, or managing third-party data or identity vendor partnerships, including framing partnerships around a specific business problem rather than a general capability.
  • Comfort operating in a large, matrixed organization, identifying the right stakeholders and building consensus where the org chart alone does not indicate who needs to be aligned.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience owning or contributing to an identity resolution or identity graph product at consumer scale (hundreds of millions of profiles, majority-anonymous traffic), including decisions about authenticated vs. unauthenticated identity strategy.
  • Experience auditing an existing data product or platform against industry or competitive best practices and using that audit to build the case for a step-change investment.
  • Background partnering with Advertising and/or Marketing teams on identity-dependent use cases (audience activation, attribution, targeting) and understanding of how identity quality affects those outcomes downstream.
  • Familiarity with data privacy and compliance requirements affecting identity resolution (consent management, Right to Be Forgotten, cross-border data transfer, cookie/device ID deprecation) and experience embedding these into product design.
  • Experience integrating third-party demographic, graph, or identity-resolution vendors (e.g., Experian-style data, identity graph providers, clean rooms) into a first-party data platform.
  • Prior experience in travel, e-commerce, or another high-scale, multi-brand consumer business where identity resolution directly affects personalization and marketing performance.

The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $173,000.00 to $242,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $277,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

job.job_description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

As Learning Excellence Manager, you will report to the Senior Manager, Care: Knowledge, Process, Quality & Learning, and lead a team of five Learning Specialists. This is a full-time role based in our Berlin office.

Team mission

You'll join the Process Improvement, Quality Assurance and Learning Excellence team within Care, the group that defines how GetYourGuide serves customers, suppliers and partners across both human and AI-supported service channels. The Learning Excellence team owns how knowledge becomes capability: setting learning standards across our in-house teams and BPO partners, and ensuring service quality holds as the operation evolves.

Care is in the middle of a genuine transformation. As AI absorbs more routine contact handling, the work left for people becomes more complex, and how we segment, prioritise and deliver learning has to change with it. This role exists to lead that evolution, not to maintain the current model.

You'll own the strategic direction of learning for Care. That means stepping back from individual training requests and asking the bigger questions: what does our demand actually look like, how should learning be segmented across audiences and skill levels, and how do we structure delivery effectively across a distributed footprint of BPO partners and an in-house team?

Your mission

  • Define and own the learning strategy for Care, covering segmentation of learning demand, prioritisation, and the delivery model across in-house and BPO teams
  • Lead, coach and develop a team of five Learning Specialists, setting direction and standards for how the team plans and delivers work
  • Build, report and maintain the data foundation for learning: use training and operational KPIs (CSAT, QA scores, time-to-proficiency, error rates) to diagnose capability gaps, target investment, and prove impact
  • Partner with Quality Assurance and Knowledge & Process to close the loop between quality insight, process change and learning design
  • Own the learning relationship with our BPO partners: set standards, audit delivery, and drive consistent capability across sites
  • Reshape learning for an AI-supported operation, redesigning what agents need to learn and how as automation changes the mix of human-handled work
  • Bring an AI and data mindset to your own work, using AI tools to analyse, build and iterate faster

Your toolkit

  • 5+ years in learning & development or operational capability roles, with demonstrable ownership of learning strategy, not only delivery
  • Experience leading a team of learning or training professionals
  • A strong data orientation: comfortable defining KPIs, interpreting operational data, and making the case for learning investment in numbers
  • Experience working with or managing BPO / outsourced operations
  • Ability to think in systems (audience segmentation, capability frameworks, delivery models), not just courses
  • Comfort using AI tools day-to-day, and genuine curiosity about how AI reshapes both service operations and learning itself
  • Strong stakeholder skills, with the ability to influence senior operational leaders and external partners
  • Fluent English

Extras that give you an edge

  • Experience in a customer service, marketplace or high-volume operations environment
  • Instructional design or LMS/e-learning background (useful context, not the core of the role)
  • Experience leading learning through an automation or major operating-model transition

How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary

  • Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
  • Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
  • A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.
  • Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events
  • Monthly transportation and fitness budget
  • Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
  • Language reimbursement program
  • Health and wellness benefits

And more…

How To Apply

Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘how we hire’ and ‘life at GetYourGuide’. If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to get in touch at jobs@getyourguide.com.

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Senior Sales Manager, you’re not just generating and managing group sales – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About The Team  

Agoda’s Customer Experience Group delivers critical support to customers and partners across markets, channels, and business lines. As our operations scale in complexity, Senior Regional Managers play a pivotal role in ensuring regional resiliency, standardization, and sustained performance across multiple sites and partners.  

 

About The Role  

The Senior Regional Manager is accountable for end-to-end performance of a regional customer/partner operations area, typically spanning multiple countries, sites, or vendor partners. This role translates company strategy into a cohesive regional roadmap, balances cross site tradeoffs, and ensures consistent, high quality service delivery at scale.  

You will act as the regional authority on customer operations performance, risks, and improvement initiatives, while developing strong leadership benches and resilient operating models.  

Key Responsibilities  

Regional & Operational Ownership 

  • Lead multi-site, multi-country customer operations (including inhouse and BPO partners where applicable) 
  • Own end to end regional outcomes, including service quality, efficiency, resiliency, and cost to serve 
  • Balance cross site tradeoffs across capacity, language coverage, channel mix, routing, and vendor strategy   

Strategy & Roadmap  

  • Translate CEG strategy into a 12–18 month regional roadmap, prioritizing initiatives that deliver measurable customer and business impact 
  • Anticipate demand shifts (seasonality, launches, policy or regulatory changes) and lead proactive regional adjustments 
  • Sponsor and govern cross site initiatives to ensure consistency and scalability  

Improvement, Innovation & Resiliency  

  • Scale adoption of tools, technologies, and best practices across sites 
  • Institutionalize experimentation standards, operational rigor, and learning across the regional leadership team 
  • Strengthen regional resiliency through standardized playbooks (e.g. surge, BCP, knowledge governance)  

Stakeholder Leadership  

  • Serve as the regional “go to” for customer operations performance, risks, and initiatives 
  • Bring together WFM, QA, Training, Analytics, Product/Tech, Policy, and Commercial partners to land regionwide solutions 
  • Communicate regional performance, scenarios, and recommendations to senior stakeholders with minimal supervision  

People & Organization Leadership  

  • Lead through Regional Managers and/or Vendor Managers, setting a high bar for performance management and leadership capability 
  • Design and evolve regional org structures, language pools, and shift strategies to meet KPIs 
  • Build successor ready pipelines, enable cross site talent mobility, and develop future senior leaders 
  • Address underperformance decisively, fairly, and in line with Agoda values  

What You’ll Bring  

  • Must have excellent spoken and written Korean skills, and Business level of English
  • Extensive demonstrated experience leading largescale, multisite or multi-country operations 
  • Proven ability to own regional outcomes and manage complexity across markets and partners 
  • Strategic thinking combined with operational execution excellence with strong analytical and experimentation mindset   
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to dive into detail to understand issue complexity, propose actionable plans, and collaborate effectively with stakeholders
  • Advanced stakeholder management and influencing skills, including Senior Leadership exposure 
  • A track record of developing leaders and building resilient organizations  

Nice to Have  

  • Experience managing outsourced/vendor operations at scale
  • Deep exposure to regulatory-complex or high-growth markets

Why Agoda 

  • Hybrid Work 
  • Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives
  • Annual discretionary performance bonus
  • Health insurance and other locally competitive benefits
  • Agoda travel discounts and special rates on accommodation and related products
  • Work from anywhere for up to 30 days per year
  • An inclusive, international work environment where your ideas and feedback are valued
  • Agoda choice(welfare points)
  • $400 USD allowance to set up your home office(one time payment)

job.job_description:
Job Description

The Senior Director, Regional Marketing & eCommerce – Asia Pacific (APACx) is the regional business strategist for Marketing and eCommerce performance across Hilton’s Asia Pacific markets outside Greater China. This leader sets the discipline strategy, operating model, growth priorities and performance standards that help markets, hotels and ownership groups capture demand, grow direct and digital revenue, and improve the return on marketing investment.

You will be the voice of the business, the region and the customer—turning consumer insight, market context and business performance into clear priorities across multiple markets. In partnership with Marketing, Loyalty and other regional teams, you will ensure local needs and market nuances inform integrated, omnichannel strategies that strengthen demand, revenue, market share, customer engagement and loyalty. You will connect the right audiences to the right channels and experiences, while enabling markets to make faster, more effective and commercially accountable decisions.

As the primary regional marketing and digital performance expert, you will build trusted relationships across Operations, Commercial, Brand Support, Development and other enterprise functions. You will represent the discipline with senior stakeholders, strengthen collaboration across markets and establish a culture of accountability, learning and continuous improvement—ultimately driving stronger revenue and channel performance across the region.

Responsibilities

HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT

Your role is important, and below are some of the fundamental job duties that make your work unique.

What Your Day-to-day Will Be Like

  • Own the APACx Marketing and eCommerce performance strategy, translating enterprise and area priorities into market-level growth plans, targets, investment choices and clear accountability.
  • Lead regional performance management across direct, digital and other demand-capture channels, using revenue, conversion, acquisition, cost, contribution and channel-shift metrics to identify opportunities and remove barriers to growth.
  • Build multi-year capability and operating-model roadmaps covering planning, measurement, consulting, media effectiveness, channel optimization, test-and-learn practices, automation and market enablement.
  • Set the regional approach to scenario planning, budget phasing and business cases, balancing near-term commercial delivery with sustainable customer and channel growth.
  • Engage regularly with Regional Commercial, Revenue Management, Distribution and on-property commercial leaders to review performance, identify demand and conversion opportunities, align marketing investments to business needs, and translate insights into measurable revenue, channel and share outcomes.
  • Lead, coach and develop a distributed team of regional Marketing and eCommerce strategists and consultants, creating a culture of commercial ownership, curiosity, pace and high-quality decision-making.

How You Will Collaborate With Others

  • Partner with APAC Commercial, Revenue Management, Distribution, Loyalty, Operations, Finance and Development leaders to align channel strategy with hotel, portfolio and market business priorities.
  • Work with Global Marketing, eCommerce, Media, CRM, Analytics, Technology and Product teams to translate global platforms, playbooks and capabilities into practical regional adoption; provide performance requirements and feedback without owning product roadmaps.
  • Build trusted relationships with market leaders, hotel executive committees, owners, management companies, agencies, media partners and commerce platforms, including regular business reviews and performance escalations.

What Deliverables You Will Take Ownership Of

  • The APACx Marketing and eCommerce discipline strategy, annual operating plan and multi-year capability roadmap, including priorities, service levels, governance and investment recommendations.
  • A regional performance-management system with scorecards, forecasts, channel and market diagnostics, test-and-learn readouts, quarterly business reviews and clear actions for markets and enterprise partners.
  • Scalable consulting tools, playbooks, training and automation that raise the performance maturity of markets, hotels and ownership groups and improve the speed and consistency of execution.

Qualifications

WHY YOU’LL BE A GREAT FIT

You Have These Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Economics, Analytics or a related field.
  • 12+ years of progressive experience in regional, international or global marketing, digital commerce, eCommerce, revenue growth or a closely related commercial discipline.
  • At least 5 years leading multi-market teams, cross-functional teams or complex regional programs in a matrixed multinational organization.
  • Proven experience setting strategy and improving business performance across multiple markets, brands, channels or customer segments.
  • Strong understanding of eCommerce and digital performance levers, including demand generation, conversion, acquisition efficiency, channel mix, marketplaces or direct-to-consumer models.
  • Demonstrated financial and analytical capability, including forecasting, investment prioritization, performance measurement, business cases and translating data into decisions.
  • Experience influencing senior leaders, owners, franchisees, agencies and market teams without relying solely on direct authority.
  • Ability to travel approximately 25% across APAC and internationally.

It Would Be Useful If You Have

  • Experience in hospitality, travel, consumer, retail, marketplace or another multi-brand, multi-market business.
  • Experience operating across a franchise, owner, partner or distributed-market model.
  • Experience with experimentation, incrementality, marketing mix, media effectiveness, CRM performance or advanced commercial analytics.
  • An MBA or advanced degree in Marketing, Business, Analytics or a related discipline.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About The Team  

Agoda’s Customer Experience Group delivers critical support to customers and partners across markets, channels, and business lines. As our operations scale in complexity, Senior Regional Managers play a pivotal role in ensuring regional resiliency, standardization, and sustained performance across multiple sites and partners.  

 

About The Role  

The Senior Regional Manager is accountable for end-to-end performance of a regional customer/partner operations area, typically spanning multiple countries, sites, or vendor partners. This role translates company strategy into a cohesive regional roadmap, balances cross site tradeoffs, and ensures consistent, high quality service delivery at scale.  

You will act as the regional authority on customer operations performance, risks, and improvement initiatives, while developing strong leadership benches and resilient operating models.  

Key Responsibilities  

Regional & Operational Ownership 

  • Lead multi-site, multi-country customer operations (including inhouse and BPO partners where applicable) 
  • Own end to end regional outcomes, including service quality, efficiency, resiliency, and cost to serve 
  • Balance cross site tradeoffs across capacity, language coverage, channel mix, routing, and vendor strategy   

Strategy & Roadmap  

  • Translate CEG strategy into a 12–18 month regional roadmap, prioritizing initiatives that deliver measurable customer and business impact 
  • Anticipate demand shifts (seasonality, launches, policy or regulatory changes) and lead proactive regional adjustments 
  • Sponsor and govern cross site initiatives to ensure consistency and scalability  

Improvement, Innovation & Resiliency  

  • Scale adoption of tools, technologies, and best practices across sites 
  • Institutionalize experimentation standards, operational rigor, and learning across the regional leadership team 
  • Strengthen regional resiliency through standardized playbooks (e.g. surge, BCP, knowledge governance)  

Stakeholder Leadership  

  • Serve as the regional “go to” for customer operations performance, risks, and initiatives 
  • Bring together WFM, QA, Training, Analytics, Product/Tech, Policy, and Commercial partners to land regionwide solutions 
  • Communicate regional performance, scenarios, and recommendations to senior stakeholders with minimal supervision  

People & Organization Leadership  

  • Lead through Regional Managers and/or Vendor Managers, setting a high bar for performance management and leadership capability 
  • Design and evolve regional org structures, language pools, and shift strategies to meet KPIs 
  • Build successor ready pipelines, enable cross site talent mobility, and develop future senior leaders 
  • Address underperformance decisively, fairly, and in line with Agoda values  

What You’ll Bring  

  • Must have excellent spoken and written Korean skills, and Business level of English
  • Extensive demonstrated experience leading largescale, multisite or multi-country operations 
  • Proven ability to own regional outcomes and manage complexity across markets and partners 
  • Strategic thinking combined with operational execution excellence with strong analytical and experimentation mindset   
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to dive into detail to understand issue complexity, propose actionable plans, and collaborate effectively with stakeholders
  • Advanced stakeholder management and influencing skills, including Senior Leadership exposure 
  • A track record of developing leaders and building resilient organizations  

Nice to Have  

  • Experience managing outsourced/vendor operations at scale
  • Deep exposure to regulatory-complex or high-growth markets

Why Agoda 

  • Hybrid Work 
  • Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives
  • Annual discretionary performance bonus
  • Health insurance and other locally competitive benefits
  • Agoda travel discounts and special rates on accommodation and related products
  • Work from anywhere for up to 30 days per year
  • An inclusive, international work environment where your ideas and feedback are valued
  • Agoda choice(welfare points)
  • $400 USD allowance to set up your home office(one time payment)

job.job_description:
Organization- Hyatt Corporate Office

Summary

The Opportunity

Hyatt Hotels Corporation seeks an enthusiastic Manager to join our Technical Accounting team. In this role, you will be collaborating closely with the broader finance team, where you’ll be instrumental in continuing to make Hyatt a leading hospitality company. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list since 2013. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

  • Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on-site fitness center
  • A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption
  • Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

The Role

The Manager of Technical Accounting will play a key role in evaluating complex transactions and leading Hyatt’s quarterly and annual impairment process. They will partner with key stakeholders to ensure non-routine transactions are properly accounted for and disclosed. They will be responsible for the preparation and/or review of certain disclosures included in Hyatt’s 10-Q and 10-K filings. A successful candidate for this role will be strong in technical accounting, financial reporting, and analytical skills and have strong communication skills. They will be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Perform complex accounting research, most notably under U.S. GAAP and SEC regulations, and prepare or review technical accounting memos to support conclusions
  • Partner with Corporate Accounting, Financial Reporting, Finance teams, and other stakeholders to understand, analyze, and report complex accounting matters
  • Review quarterly and annual impairment and CECL analyses
  • Oversee and review certain quarterly fair value updates
  • Prepare and/or review certain quarterly and annual disclosures within Hyatt’s 10-Q and 10-K filings
  • Prepare and/or review disclosure checklists to ensure compliance with U.S. GAAP and SEC reporting requirements
  • Prepare materials for Hyatt’s Audit Committee of the Board of Directors’ meetings
  • Review new or amended contracts and provide feedback on accounting implications
  • Review new accounting pronouncements issued quarterly to determine applicability and assist with implementation as needed
  • Coach, supervise, and mentor senior accountants
  • Demonstrate a commitment to Hyatt core values

Hybrid in-office 3 days a week, flexibility on days

Qualifications

Experience Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • Certified Public Accountant (CPA)
  • 6+ years of experience in accounting and/or public accounting

Experience Preferred:

  • Experience working in technical accounting
  • SEC and financial reporting experience
  • Financial ERP / Reporting system knowledge (Hyperion preferred)

The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all-encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary.

We welcome you:

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.

The salary range for this position is $98,000 - $135,000. This position is also eligible to earn incentive awards, an annual bonus, monthly or quarterly incentives, etc.

The final pay rate/salary offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level, and other qualifications for the role, as well as the location of the performance of work. Pay for the successful candidate will meet local requirements, including the local minimum wage rate.

We value our relationships with recruitment partners and require that agencies contact us first before submitting any candidates. Hyatt will not be responsible for any fees and obligations associated with unsolicited submissions unless a formal agreement is in place.

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

As a participant in our EMEA Finance Leadership Graduate Programme (Finesse), you’re not just gaining immersive experience across core hotel finance functions and accelerating readiness for a senior finance role – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by contributing to memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Here’s what you can look forward to as a programme participant:

  • Accelerate your future in finance leadership through immersive experience: Embark on a dynamic 36-month development journey comprised of two 12-month placements in different countries within the EMEA region followed by a third year in a hands-on finance role, all designed to fast-track your path to a finance leadership role within 5–7 years
  • Broaden your business acumen: In addition to building your finance expertise, you’ll gain valuable insight into core business functions like Operations, Commercial, and Human Resources
  • Earn a globally recognized finance qualification: Alongside your placements, you’ll work towards earning the prestigious CIMA professional finance qualification, with full funding (subject to conditions) and dedicated learning support provided by Hilton
  • Develop your skills through world-class training and support: Access Hilton University’s e-learning modules, and business library, while building knowledge through on-the-job and project-based learning; participate in tailored finance and leadership programmes and follow a flexible personal development plan designed to grow your technical and leadership capabilities
  • Grow with personalised guidance and mentoring: Benefit from regular feedback and coaching, while working closely with a dedicated mentor and peer buddy to ensure your progress is supported at every stage of the programme

Click here to learn more about the Finesse Programme

What We’re Looking For

With our major global presence and ambitious growth plans, Hilton is developing a strong team of future finance leaders. We are seeking curious, driven, and flexible individuals who embody the Hilton Values and are ready to grow their careers across borders.

  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Mathematics, Hospitality, Business, or a related field (completed by the 1st September 2027)
  • Fluency in English (spoken and written)
  • Eligibility to work in the EMEA region
  • Full mobility across the EMEA region and a willingness to relocate for both placements as required
  • Aspiration to become a future financial leader
  • Commitment to managing a full-time role while studying towards your CIMA qualification
  • Availability to begin full-time employment on 1st September 2027

Selection Process

Applications are now open—don’t miss your chance to apply! Submissions close on Sunday 13th December 2026.

Our selection process is designed to bring out your best and help us get to know you. It includes:

  • Online assessments
  • One-way video interview
  • A competency-based interview with a Hilton Finance Leader
  • A Virtual Assessment Centre (March 2027)

While the process is rigorous, it’s also the first step in your personal growth journey with Hilton. If selected, you’ll begin developing the skills, connections, and confidence to thrive in your career.

Due to the high number of applications, our screening process may take a little longer than usual. Every application is carefully reviewed by a member of our recruitment team, without the use of AI. To ensure every application receives fair consideration, invitations to final stages of selection will be issued after applications have closed. Thank you for your patience, we’ll be in touch as soon as there’s an update. Please keep an eye on your inbox and junk folder too, so you don’t miss any messages from us.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing reasonable adjustments for applicants and employees with disabilities. If you require any support or adjustments during the recruitment process or to carry out the essential requirements of the role, please contact us.

Salary is determined by the country of placement. For placements within the EU, starting salaries range from €30,000 to €40,000, with separate locally determined salaries applying in the Czech Republic and Poland. The salary for each placement location is fixed and is not subject to individual negotiation. If a participant moves to a placement in another country during the programme, the salary applicable to that location will apply.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know Our Team

The Strategic Partnerships team is responsible for identifying, building, and scaling high-impact partnerships that expand Agoda’s reach, improve customer acquisition, and create long-term business value.

For Japan, Financial Institution (FI) partnerships represent a strategic growth channel. This role will focus on developing and managing relationships with banks, card issuers, digital wallets, and other financial ecosystem partners to drive customer engagement, commercial growth, and win-win partnership outcomes.

You will work cross-functionally with teams across Commercial, Marketing, Product, Finance, Legal, Analytics, and Operations to bring partnership opportunities from idea to execution and optimization.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships to lead Agoda’s Japan FI partnership strategy and execution.

In this role, you will be responsible for identifying new partnership opportunities, managing key strategic accounts, negotiating commercial agreements, and driving performance across Agoda’s financial institution partnerships in Japan. You will help shape Agoda’s local partnership roadmap, unlock joint business opportunities, and ensure excellent execution of campaigns and initiatives with partners.

The ideal candidate brings strong business development and partnership experience, sharp commercial judgment, analytical rigor, and the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders. This role requires someone who is highly strategic but also willing to work hands-on to deliver measurable outcomes.

Why This Role Matters

This role is critical to Agoda’s growth in Japan. Financial institution partnerships are a highly strategic channel that can unlock scalable customer demand, deepen brand presence, and create differentiated value for travelers and partners alike.

As Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships, you will play a central role in shaping Agoda’s FI ecosystem in Japan and delivering high-impact partnerships that drive sustainable business growth.

What You’ll Do

Partnership Strategy & Business Development

  • Define and drive Agoda’s FI partnership strategy for Japan, aligned with market priorities and business growth objectives
  • Identify, evaluate, and prioritize new partnership opportunities with banks, credit card issuers, payment platforms, loyalty programs, and other financial ecosystem players
  • Build compelling partnership value propositions and business cases to secure internal alignment and partner buy-in
  • Lead commercial discussions, negotiations, and contract execution with prospective and existing FI partners

Account Management & Growth

  • Own and grow a portfolio of key FI partners in Japan, ensuring strong relationship management and long-term strategic alignment
  • Develop joint business plans with partners to drive customer acquisition, transaction growth, brand visibility, and partnership profitability
  • Monitor partner performance and proactively identify growth levers, optimization opportunities, and operational improvements
  • Ensure timely execution of campaigns, product integrations, and partner initiatives

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Analytics, Finance, Legal, and Operations to launch and scale partnership initiatives
  • Translate partner needs into clear internal requirements and drive execution across multiple teams
  • Influence decision-making through strong communication, stakeholder management, and data-backed recommendations
  • Support process improvements, reporting frameworks, and operating models to improve scalability and partner experience

Analytics & Optimization

  • Analyze partnership performance, customer behavior, campaign effectiveness, and commercial outcomes to generate actionable insights
  • Use data to identify trends, optimize investment decisions, and improve partnership ROI
  • Build business cases for new initiatives and present recommendations to senior stakeholders
  • Track key success metrics and maintain clear visibility on pipeline, performance, and impact

Experience

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • 7+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, account management, consulting, or a related commercial role
  • Strong experience managing external partners and driving commercial outcomes in a fast-paced, data-driven environment
  • Experience working with or within financial institutions, payment companies, loyalty ecosystems, or digital consumer platforms is highly preferred
  • Experience in e-commerce, travel, fintech, payments, or internet platforms is a strong plus
  • Proven track record of leading cross-functional initiatives from concept through execution

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to structure win-win partnerships and negotiate effectively
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to convert data into clear business insights and actions
  • Strong project management capabilities with high attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience influencing senior internal and external stakeholders
  • Self-starter with a bias for action and ability to operate independently in an ambiguous environment
  • Comfortable working hands-on while also thinking strategically

Technical / Functional

  • Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience with SQL, Tableau, or data visualization tools is a plus
  • Ability to develop business cases, commercial models, and performance reporting frameworks
  • Familiarity with campaign execution, co-marketing partnerships, loyalty mechanics, or payment-related partnership models is beneficial

Language

  • Fluency in English and Japanese is required

Company Description

Located in Melbourne’s vibrant inner-north, we are a leading conference venue and leisure destination offering contemporary accommodation, stylish dining, and versatile event spaces in the heart of Preston. With 383 guest rooms, 13 conference and event venues, and two on-site dining outlets, our property caters to both corporate and leisure clients.

Easily accessible via the 86 tram and Mernda train line—both within walking distance—and with over 400 on-site parking spaces, our property is ideally positioned. We pride ourselves on delivering professional service, memorable experiences, and flexible solutions to meet the evolving needs of our diverse clientele.

Job Description

About the Role

We’re looking for a creative, digitally savvy and commercially minded Marketing Executive who can bring our hotel brand to life, connect with our guests and turn great ideas into marketing activity that delivers results.

Working closely with the Director of Sales & Marketing and our hotel teams, you’ll play an important role in shaping how the hotel is seen, experienced and talked about from social media and digital campaigns to content, events, promotions and partnerships.

This is a hands on role for someone who loves creating compelling content, spotting opportunities, trying new ideas and seeing their work make a real difference. You’ll help build awareness, increase engagement, support revenue generating initiatives and strengthen our position in the local market, while ensuring everything we do is consistent with our brand standards.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Bring the hotel brand to life through creative campaigns, promotions, storytelling, content and communications.
  • Own day-to-day digital content across social media, website, email and other channels, ensuring our presence is fresh, relevant and engaging.
  • Develop content that showcases our rooms, restaurant, bar, meetings and events, people and local experiences, giving guests compelling reasons to choose us.
  • Keep hotel information, offers, imagery and content accurate and engaging across OTAs, third-party websites and digital platforms.
  • Support the planning and delivery of the annual marketing strategy, campaigns and promotional calendar, bringing fresh ideas and a commercial mindset.
  • Create campaigns that build awareness, drive engagement and support room nights, F&B and Conference & Events revenue.
  • Work closely with Conference & Events, Food & Beverage, Sales and Operations to promote events, functions, packages and special offers.
  • Develop and coordinate marketing collateral, presentations, digital assets and promotional materials.
  • Coordinate photography, video and other content creation, maintaining an organised and inspiring marketing asset library.
  • Monitor campaign, social and digital performance, using insights and data to continually improve what we do.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage local partnerships, influencers, media and community connections to extend our reach.
  • Stay ahead of hospitality, digital, social media and content trends, bringing new ideas, inspiration and opportunities to the team.
  • Work with hotel teams, corporate office, agencies, suppliers and external partners to bring campaigns from concept to execution.
  • Keep marketing calendars, campaign plans, reports and project timelines organised, measurable and on track.

Qualifications

What We’re Looking For

  • A creative, enthusiastic and commercially minded marketer with a genuine passion for hospitality, content and digital marketing.
  • Demonstrated experience across social media, website content, email marketing and digital platforms.
  • A strong eye for content, storytelling, visual presentation and brand consistency.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong attention to detail.
  • Someone who is ideas-driven but also organised and delivery-focused you enjoy turning concepts into action.
  • A collaborative team player who is confident working with multiple departments, stakeholders and external partners.
  • A curious marketer who enjoys learning, testing new ideas and understanding what works and why.
  • Commercial awareness and an understanding that great marketing should ultimately help grow awareness, engagement and revenue.
  • Experience in hospitality, tourism, hotels, events or a consumer-facing environment would be highly regarded.
  • Full Australian work rights.

Additional Information

What We Offer

  • Free on-site car park
  • Employee benefit card offering discounted rates at Accor hotels worldwide.
  • Develop your talent through Accor’s learning programs.
  • Opportunity to grow within your property and across the world!
  • Ability to contribute to the community and make a difference through our Corporate Social Responsibility and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) activities.

Our Commitment To Diversity & Inclusion

We are an inclusive company and our ambition is to attract, recruit and promote diverse talent. Any opportunity within our community to adapt and develop our processes to embrace others is encouraged.

"Why work for Accor?

We are far more than a worldwide leader. We welcome you as you are and you can find a job and brand that matches your personality. We support you to grow and learn every day, making sure that work brings purpose to your life, so that during your journey with us, you can continue to explore Accor’s limitless possibilities.

By joining Accor, every chapter of your story is yours to write and together we can imagine tomorrow's hospitality. Discover the life that awaits you at Accor, visit https://careers.accor.com/

Do what you love, care for the world, dare to challenge the status quo! #BELIMITLESS"

job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

The Controllership Innovation team is seeking a curious, analytically strong professional to help design and deliver process and technology solutions in a controlled finance environment. This role will work across stakeholders to understand current-state processes, identify business value, gather and translate requirements, and support project design through delivery.

The right person will bring a blend of consulting-style problem solving, finance or accounting experience, and technical fluency. They should be energized by understanding how things work, why they work that way, and how to improve them in a scalable, well-controlled way.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with stakeholders across the business to understand current-state processes, pain points, and desired outcomes
  • Lead stakeholder interviews, discovery sessions, and requirements gathering for innovation and transformation initiatives
  • Support project design by translating business needs into practical process, data, and technology solutions
  • Evaluate opportunities through the lens of business value, control considerations, and long-term scalability
  • Work within a SOX-controlled environment, ensuring solutions align with governance, risk, and compliance expectations
  • Contribute across the solution lifecycle, including design, documentation, testing, and implementation support
  • Apply knowledge of SDLC standards and testing practices to help deliver high-quality solutions
  • Use data and analytics to inform decisions, identify trends, and support process improvement opportunities
  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners in finance, accounting, technology, and operations to move initiatives forward

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Business, or a related field
  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in consulting, finance, accounting, process improvement, transformation, or a related field
  • Experience working in a SOX-controlled environment and ITGCs
  • Experience in stakeholder interviewing, requirements gathering, and process or project design
  • Familiarity with software development lifecycle standards and testing practices
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to understand business processes, identify value drivers, and translate needs into practical solutions
  • Experience working with data and analytics tools or languages such as SQL or Python
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency.
  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience in both consulting and finance or accounting environments
  • CPA designation
  • Experience with Power Platform
  • Experience with Power BI or Microsoft Fabric
  • Experience administering Blackline automations (journals, matching, data sources, etc.)
  • Experience supporting cross-functional transformation, automation, or innovation initiatives
  • Experience working across business and technical teams to deliver scalable solutions

Benefits And Perks To Help You Keep Climbing

Our culture is rooted in a shared dedication to living our values – Care, Integrity, Resilience, Servant Leadership, and Teamwork – every day, in everything we do. At Delta, our people are our success. At the heart of what we offer is our focus on Sharing Success with Delta employees.

Benefits

Exploring a career at Delta gives you a chance to see the world while earning great compensation and benefits to help you keep climbing along the way:

  • Competitive salary, industry-leading proﬁt sharing program, and performance incentives
  • 401(k) with generous company contributions up to 9%
  • Paid time off including vacation, holidays, paid personal time, maternity and parental leave
  • Comprehensive health beneﬁts including medical, dental, vision, short/long term disability and life beneﬁts
  • Family care assistance through fertility support, surrogacy and adoption assistance, lactation support, subsidized back-up care, and programs that help with loved ones in all stages
  • Holistic Wellbeing programs to support physical, emotional, social, and financial health, including access to an employee assistance program offering support for you and anyone in your household, free financial coaching, and extensive resources supporting mental health
  • Domestic and International space-available flight privileges for employees and eligible family members
  • Career development programs to achieve your long-term career goals
  • World-wide partnerships to engage in community service and innovative goals created to focus on sustainability and reducing our carbon footprint
  • Business Resource Groups created to connect employees with common interests to promote inclusion, provide perspective and help implement strategies
  • Recognition rewards and awards through the platform Unstoppable Together
  • Access to over 500 discounts, specialty savings and voluntary benefits through Deltaperks such as car and hotel rentals and auto, home, and pet insurance, legal services, and childcare

job.job_description:
Booking.com is seeking a Fintech Commercial Lead to support the execution of our US Fintech strategy across the US brand portfolio of Booking Holdings (BKNG), which includes Booking.com, Priceline, and OpenTable. The role will focus on driving commercial margin contribution through Fintech commercial solutions and products.

This role will focus on translating complex priorities into tangible commercial impact, including incremental financial contribution, cost savings, improved payment economics, and financially accretive initiatives. Reporting directly to the Head of Fintech US Commercial, you will work closely with Fintech senior stakeholders, US brand teams, Product, Legal, Finance, Treasury, Fraud, Operations, and external partners to identify, prioritize, and execute opportunities that improve performance across the US market.

The ideal candidate brings strong experience in strategy, commercial partnerships, business growth, and payments, with the ability to move from analysis and business cases to cross-functional execution.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Execute the US Fintech Strategy: Support the execution of the US Fintech strategy across BKNG US brands, translating priorities into clear workstreams, business cases, and delivery plans.
  • Drive Commercial Margin Contribution: Identify and support initiatives that deliver incremental financial contribution, unlock cost savings, and improve payment economics for BKNG’s financial results in the US market.
  • Scale Fintech Commercial Solutions: Help assess, and execute Fintech solutions and products that deliver value for BKNG brands, customers, partners, and suppliers.
  • Unlock Value Through Partnerships: Identify and support commercial opportunities with strategic partners, including card networks, PSPs, and Fintech providers, with a focus on value beyond core payments where relevant.
  • Align Stakeholders and Drive Execution: Collaborate with Product, Legal, Finance, Treasury, Fraud, Operations, and US brand teams to align priorities, remove blockers, and deliver measurable outcomes.
  • Deliver Executive Communication: Prepare concise executive updates, business cases, and strategic recommendations that translate complex Fintech and payments topics into clear commercial decisions.


What You'll Bring:

  • 6+ years of experience in Strategy, Commercial Partnerships, and Business Development, ideally within Fintech or adjacent tech sectors.
  • Payments experience strongly preferred, with understanding of the payment lifecycle across pay-in, pay-out, acceptance, fraud, chargebacks, authorization, and payment economics.
  • An MBA or equivalent advanced exec education, and/or prior experience in consulting and strategy roles, is a strong plus.
  • Proven ability to shape and execute market-specific strategy & planning, with a track record of sizing, prioritizing, and delivering financially material opportunities in the US market, preferably in the FinTech space.
  • Deep understanding of the US FinTech landscape, including industry trends, compliance regulatory frameworks, and consumer behavior.
  • Expertise in unlocking value beyond core payments through collaborations in Marketing & Brand activation, Distribution, Sponsorships, Data Insights, Personalization, etc. initiatives.
  • Strong cross-functional stakeholder coordination skills, with the ability to drive execution in partnership with Product, Legal, Operations, Treasury, Fraud, etc.
  • Strong analytical mindset, capable of assessing market opportunities, producing business cases, and identifying risks.
  • Skilled in executive communication, with the ability to distill complex information into concise updates and strategic recommendations.
  • Exceptional storytelling ability, crafting presentations that clearly communicate business value and direction.


Why Booking.com?

We’re a fast-moving, tech-driven global travel technology company. As part of our Fintech team, you will help shape and execute high-priority US initiatives that improve our commercial performance, strengthen our payment and Fintech capabilities, and deliver measurable impact for Booking Holdings US customers, partners, brands, and financial results.

What We'll Provide:

Booking.com’s Total Rewards Philosophy is not only about compensation but also about benefits. Our Total Rewards are aimed to make it easier for you to experience all that life has to offer on your terms, so you can focus on what really matters. We offer competitive compensation as well as thoughtful, valuable, and even fun benefits which include:

  • Medical, life, and disability insurance*
  • Annual paid time off and generous paid leave scheme including: parent, grandparent, bereavement, sick, and care leave
  • Industry leading product discounts for yourself, friends, and family
  • Free access to online learning platforms, mentorship programs, and a complimentary Headspace membership
  • Collaborative, friendly and diverse culture
  • Referral Program
  • This role doesn’t come with relocation assistance
  • This role doesn’t come with visa assistance

Guided by an experienced and passionate global team, Expedia Group helps millions of travelers in more than 70 countries explore the world with confidence and ease.
We’re committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience for candidates with disabilities, or other physical or mental health conditions. If you require an accommodation or adjustment for any part of the application or recruitment process, please let us know by completing our Accommodation Request Form or contacting your recruiter.

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Location: Seattle HQ

Introduction To Team

The Product Team creates high-quality end-to-end experiences for travelers, partners, and Expedia Group. Our focus on customer-centric innovation enables us to develop products that build loyalty and repeat business. We partner closely with teams across Expedia Group to drive growth and achieve results for our customers and the company.

We connect Travelers to new experiences, through trusted relationships. We use the power of Expedia Group brands to empower strategic partners to nurture and grow the existing relationship with their audience. Strategic Partnerships and Affiliates breadth of solutions which include cashback, travel offers, loyalty exchange, co-branded sites, Affiliate APIs and EG’s Affiliate Program, bring a partners’ audience onto EG sites, thereby increasing EG’s traffic and exposure.

Strategic Partnerships & Affiliates (SPA) is one of Expedia Group’s fastest-growing businesses, powered by a start-up mindset, rapid experimentation, and a clear purpose: to build partnerships and products that meet travelers wherever they choose to discover and book travel. Whether it’s landing pages that give travelers cash back, frictionless coupon redemption or optimized Buy Now Pay Later experiences, in this role, you’ll help travelers save on travel in deeply integrated ways.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead collaborative efforts to define and frame complex product concepts or needs with peer roles and generate multiple potential compelling solutions to advance the product direction.
  • Negotiate for XDs priorities considering both long-term strategy and direction and contributes to building experience roadmaps for team.
  • Contribute to the development of both business metrics and experience success metrics, promoting harmony and alignment between them.
  • Analyze and synthesize complex research and test findings to identify novel insights, considering multiple sources of information before drawing conclusions.
  • Appropriately weigh research and test findings against other data points (e.g., technical, business) to make informed design decisions and determine the right solution.
  • Convincingly communicate vision and crisp narratives to a range of internal and external stakeholders, through effective visual storytelling.
  • Partner effectively with a range of external Business, Product and Engineering stakeholders, collaborating on requirements, concepts and deliverables where appropriate.
  • Thoughtfully leverage emergent agentic design and prototyping tools to streamline design processes without compromising quality.
  • Envision and propose agentic tactics and features in your designs, to drive the prioritization of cross-functional investments in a modern user experience.
  • Design user interactions that optimize user engagement, product performance, and business impact.
  • Define simple, elegant, trustworthy experiences and hold the team accountable to a high quality bar.
  • Collaborate strategically with developers to ensure seamless implementation and understand the nuance between hard tech-constraints and opportunities to challenge conventions.
  • Comprehensively evaluate the system of connections and the library of tools and methodologies available to arrive at the optimal solution.
  • Establish processes and facilitate rituals for both giving and receiving feedback within the XD group and across peer groups, and actively celebrate team successes.
  • Work successfully through high levels of ambiguity.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelors or Masters degree in User Experience Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field; or equivalent professional experience.
  • 8+ years of professional experience working in User Experience Design or a related professional field.
  • Experience translating product requirements into design strategy and then acting on that strategy to deliver proposed design solutions which meet those requirements.
  • Experience mapping customer journeys and leveraging user stories and personas to inform design strategy.
  • Experience crafting design deliverables at various fidelities, including wireframes, mockups, and prototypes.
  • Experience leveraging design systems and shared component libraries to ensure consistency and velocity.
  • Experience thoughtfully leveraging emergent AI tools to streamline design processes without compromising quality.
  • Experience collaborating with a range of diverse stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Content and Research.
  • Ability to work successfully through high levels of ambiguity.
  • Strong attention to design and visual detail.
  • Knowledge of current design tools and software.
  • A portfolio showcasing design skills representative of your work at each stage of a product life cycle, from conception to release, that details the team, thought processes, successes, and pivots along the way.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working across multiple devices, webviews and browsers.
  • Experience in designing for human diversity (internationalization, localization, accessibility, etc.)
  • Experience designing for agentic platforms and tools.
  • Experience working on strategic partnerships.
  • Experience presenting to executive audiences.

Expedia Group is proud to offer a wide range of benefits to support employees and their families, including medical/dental/vision, paid time off, and an Employee Assistance Program. To fuel each employee’s passion for travel, we offer a wellness & travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and an International Airlines Travel Agent (IATAN) membership. View our full list of benefits.

The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $173,000.00 to $242,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $277,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Benefits And Perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life.

Accommodation requests

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.

About Expedia Group

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Important notice

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/.

Equal Opportunity

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. This employer participates in E-Verify. The employer will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from each new employee's I-9 to confirm work authorization.
