job.company_description:
At Enterprise Mobility™ we are paving a new way forward by creating better experiences for how we move. We give people around the world the ability to connect in ways that suit their unique needs. It’s a bold idea that has defined our purpose-led, people-first organization for over 65 years, and it’s one that we continue to strive toward with every journey.
Through our trusted brands and our portfolio of offerings, we aim to reach the highest levels of customer service with each interaction. And we invest in — and care about — each other, our communities and every journey. It’s a point of pride and distinction, rooted in our origins. It’s how we grew from a pioneer with a fleet of seven cars to a global mobility leader with more than 90,000 team members around the world. And it’s what will continue to drive the future of the organization and mobility itself.
Over the years, we’ve learned moving forward isn’t a simple matter of going from point A to B. Today, mobility is the movement of people and goods. It goes beyond the vehicles we drive to encompass an integrated way of travel that meets every individual’s unique needs and preferences.
That is why it’s our vision to be the world’s best and most trusted mobility company. As mobility continues to evolve, we'll continue to innovate to work toward a reimagined mobility future that is more accessible, efficient and sustainable for all.
job.job_description:
Overview

As we continue to build a team who drives us forward, Enterprise's Global Marketing Department is excited to announce the opening of a Digital Product Manager II!

The Digital Product Manager II is responsible for complex solutions which achieve the company's strategies and objectives. This role is responsible for the success of one or more products and/or capabilities within the Digital Product Portfolio, overseeing them through design, build, launch, growth, enhancement and eventual sunset. The Digital Product Manager II must work cross-functionally, unifying and motivating peers and stakeholders from different teams (e.g. MarTech, iX, IT, Brand and other marketing teams) to deliver a solution to meet business needs. This role may lead one, or many, product managers and/or product owners and ensure they are delivering against their assigned responsibilities including product road map management, documentation, communication, support, analysis and more. The Digital Product Manager II position manages strategy for their portfolio of product and family(ies) of capabilities, adapts the product road map, monitors product performance, and provides direction for product requirements.

This position is located at our Corporate Headquarters in Clayton, MO.

Enterprise offers an excellent benefits package with market-competitive pay, comprehensive healthcare packages, 401k matching & profit sharing, schedule flexibility, paid time off, and organizational growth potential.

Compensation decisions will be made based on factors that include, but are not limited to experience, education, location and skill level

Enterprise Mobility is a leading provider of mobility solutions, owning and operating the Enterprise Rent-A-Car, National Car Rental and Alamo Rent A Car brands through its integrated global network of independent regional subsidiaries. Enterprise Mobility and its affiliates offer extensive car rental, carsharing, truck rental, fleet management, retail car sales, as well as travel management and other transportation services, to make travel easier and more convenient for customers.

Privately held by the Taylor family of St. Louis, Enterprise Mobility together with its affiliate Enterprise Fleet Management manages a diverse fleet of 2.4 million vehicles and accounted for nearly $39 billion in revenue through a network of more than 9,500 fully-staffed neighborhood and airport rental locations in more than 90 countries and territories.

Responsibilities

We are hiring now for immediate openings. Responsibilities include:

  • Thoroughly understand and advocate for solutions to customers' problems as well as marketing and company goals and objectives, representing that point of view on a day-to-day basis
  • Own definition of the problem that is to be solved and the determination of its value within our digital products
  • Develop vision and strategy of a family(ies) of Capabilities and/or portfolio of products, ensuring alignment with company strategies and goals and communicate them with relevant internal teams (including MarTech, iX, IT, Brand and other Marketing teams, and Senior Leadership)
  • Collaborate with iX, Marketing leadership, and stakeholders to define and prioritize the product road map
  • Monitor key performance indicators for the product against industry leading benchmarks and other company and Marketing goals
  • Maintain professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops, reviewing professional publications, establishing personal networks and participating in professional societies
  • Manage one or more products and/or capabilities within the Digital Product Portfolio through the entire product life cycle
  • Partner with internal teams and third-party vendors to ensure successful completion within appropriate budget guidelines and project timeline on the implementation and launch of multiple digital product projects
  • Develop and curate new ideas and determine which ideas will achieve critical objectives and should be promoted into features; Communicate the status back to stakeholders
  • Understand and evaluate new and existing product specifications across a portfolio of products to ensure the scope of the current and future product(s) meets marketing and business objectives
  • Ensure requests and appropriate feedback are seamlessly integrated into the product road map and development processes by playing a key role in development efforts including planning, refinement, user acceptance testing, retrospectives, sprints and scrums
  • Identify needs by monitoring feedback from various listening tools, working with IX on usability testing, and collaborating with cross-functional business partners
  • Confirm completion of product development and determine readiness for release/launch, ensuring delivery of well aligned, high value solutions through use of product life cycle and agile development methodologies
  • Manage the product strategy for one or more products and/or capabilities within the Digital Product Portfolio

In addition to these job functions, candidates will also need to display proficiency in the following Competencies:

  • Building Relationships
  • Communication
  • Ethics and Values
  • Forward-Thinking
  • Managing and Developing People
  • Planning and Organizing
  • Problem Solving
  • Resilience

Equal Opportunity Employer/Disability/Veterans

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • Must have five (5+) years or more of experience as a Product Owner or Manager, Technical Project Manager or Business Analyst
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States and not require work authorization sponsorship by our company for this position now or in the future

Preferred

  • Experience working in an Agile environment
  • Experience working with Mobile Apps

As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, what's the next step? Start your journey with us!

We're seeking an Accommodation Market Intern to join our Accommodation Account Management team in Barcelona (Hybrid), to support the Account Management team and help us maintain our leading position and support our current partners. If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.

Why eDreams ODIGEO

Join the world's leading travel subscription platform.

  • We pioneered Prime, the first and world’s leading travel subscription programme since launching in 2017.
  • Millions of Prime members every year across multiple markets.
  • 5 brands: eDreams, GO Voyages, Opodo, Travellink, and the metasearch engine Liligo
  • This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalised service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members.
  • Diversity is our strength that’s why our eDOers are coming from different nationalities from all continents – 99% permanent contracts


Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

  • Respond to general questions related to the partnership by email

What you need to succeed:

Job Requirements

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:

  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree student - University Agreement required (MUST)
  • Availability to work as an intern in the company for at least 6 months (MUST)
  • Multilingual profile: fluent English + any other European language
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Client-focused and empathetic
  • Ability to adapt fast to continuous changes
  • Computer savvy: comfortable with Google Workspace tools
  • Experience in the Hotel or Tourism Industry is a plus
  • Self-motivation and teamwork are expected.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Applied AI Tools: Demonstrated comfort using practical AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or other AI-powered coding assistants.
  • Experimentation Mindset: Curiosity and eagerness to explore, experiment with, and integrate emerging AI-driven solutions into software development workflows.
  • AI-Enhanced Problem Solving: Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to debug code, streamline development processes, and enhance productivity.
  • Adaptability and Learning Agility: Enthusiastic about continuously learning and quickly adapting to new AI features and capabilities.
  • Collaboration with AI: Experience or interest in collaborating closely with AI tools as “pair programmers” to complement traditional software development practices.


What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture.

Here's what we offer:

  • Your Well-being is our Priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcome, not time-in-seat. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.

Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
  • Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile Mindset environment with recognition at our core.


Wanna take a peek into what it's like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

Apply now!

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. job.job_description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

Supply Marketing turns suppliers into long-term partners by owning the B2B marketing funnel from first touch to loyalty — exciting, engaging, and enabling them to grow with us. For example, we run joint campaigns with top suppliers and promote them across a mix of internal and external marketing channels. By providing exposure and helping suppliers with their business needs, these campaigns are a powerful way for GetYourGuide to strengthen strategic relationships and can be leveraged to negotiate better commercial terms.

We’re looking for a Partnerships Lead, NEA with a strong emphasis on Japan (and surrounding markets such as China, South Korea, and Taiwan depending on scope). This role sits at the intersection of B2B partner marketing, strategic supplier growth, and cross-functional execution, with a focus on building high-impact programs for priority suppliers and navigating the unique needs of the Japanese market.

A core part of the role is owning the destination / DMO partnership motion in Japan: securing external sponsorship funding and translating destination partnerships into measurable growth (GMV uplift and accelerated supply onboarding), leveraging tourism boards and public-sector stakeholders as strategic multipliers for GetYourGuide.

This is a senior individual contributor role with high ownership, visibility, and partner-facing responsibility.

Your mission

  • Own the NEA supply marketing strategy with a strong focus on Japan — adapting global supply marketing strategy to local market dynamics, partner needs, and growth priorities.
  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with top attractions, tour operators, and key ecosystem stakeholders — including government agencies / destination bodies / tourism boards where relevant.
  • Develop and manage a destination/DMO partnership pipeline to secure external sponsorship support that subsidizes customer acquisition and drives GMV volume for GetYourGuide.
  • Create, pitch, negotiate, and execute joint marketing initiatives (e.g., co-marketing campaigns, seasonal demand pushes, product launches, always-on visibility packages), ensuring win-win outcomes for GetYourGuide and partners.
  • Partner closely with Sales / Supply leadership to support supplier acquisition and development efforts — using marketing and destination partnerships as levers to unlock strategic relationships, improved commercial terms, and faster onboarding pathways.
  • Convert destination partner relationships into scalable supply acceleration (e.g., one-to-many onboarding initiatives, warm introductions, whitelists, and partner-enabled lead generation).
  • Lead end-to-end program execution by working cross-functionally with campaign managers and internal marketing teams to deliver initiatives on time and to a high quality bar.
  • Develop high-impact narratives and presentations — translating partner goals into compelling proposals supported by clear value propositions and measurable outcomes.
  • Track performance and iterate: define success metrics, report on results, and continuously improve programs based on insights and partner feedback.

Your toolkit

  • 7+ years of experience in B2B marketing, partnerships, business development, sales, supplier/account management, or strategic programs (agency experience considered if you’ve led complex partner programs).
  • Fluent in Japanese and English. You can confidently present, negotiate, and build trust in Japanese business settings.
  • Critical: hands-on experience working with Japanese businesses in Japan (not only with overseas branches). You understand local business norms, relationship-building, decision-making processes, and the nuances/unspoken rules—especially in public-sector contexts.
  • Demonstrated experience building and scaling partner marketing programs (co-marketing, joint business plans, go-to-market initiatives, partner enablement, etc.).
  • Highly preferred: experience working with government agencies, tourism boards, municipalities, public-sector bodies, or similar — ideally involving procurement processes, formal partnerships, tenders, or multi-stakeholder governance.
  • Commercially sharp and outcome-driven: comfortable building a pipeline, negotiating funding/value exchange with senior stakeholders, and translating partnerships into measurable growth outcomes.
  • Strong stakeholder management: you can align Sales, Marketing, Product, and Ops around shared outcomes.
  • Strategic (think 6+ months ahead) but hands-on and execution-oriented.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and storytelling skills; comfortable influencing without authority.
  • Analytical and impact-driven: you care about measurable outcomes and can translate insights into action.
  • Familiarity with the Japan travel / attractions / tours landscape is a strong advantage.

Extras that give you an edge

  • Experience in digital marketing (paid, CRM, onsite merchandising, performance measurement) and/or brand marketing.
  • Experience with enterprise-level attractions (museums, observation decks, theme parks), transportation-linked experiences, or large tour operators.
  • Experience operating across multiple NEA markets beyond Japan.

How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary

  • Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
  • Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
  • A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.
  • Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events
  • Monthly transportation and fitness budget
  • Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
  • Language reimbursement program
  • Health and wellness benefits

And more…

How To Apply

Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘how we hire’ and ‘life at GetYourGuide’. If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to get in touch at jobs@getyourguide.com.

We’re an equal opportunities employer

Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with your application.

世界の旅のあり方を変えよう

GetYourGuideの一員として、世界中の人々を忘れられない旅行体験へとつなぐ旅に参加しませんか。何百万人ものユーザーが、信頼できるユニークなアクティビティを求めて私たちを利用しています。それを支えているのは、すべての旅を特別なものにするという私たちのコミットメントです――それはあなた自身の旅も含まれます。

探究心あふれる仲間たちとともに、自分の可能性を広げる準備はできていますか？ベルリン本社、またはニューヨークからバンコクまで世界各地の拠点で、あなたにぴったりのポジションを見つけてください。最初の一歩は getyourguide.careers から。

チームのミッション

サプライマーケティングは、サプライヤーを長期的なパートナーへと変えることを目的とし、最初の接点からロイヤルティに至るまでのB2Bマーケティングファネル全体を担います。魅力的で、エンゲージメントを高め、サプライヤーが当社とともに成長できるよう支援します。

例えば、主要サプライヤーとの共同キャンペーンを実施し、社内外の多様なマーケティングチャネルを通じてプロモーションを行っています。サプライヤーに露出機会を提供し、ビジネスニーズを支援することで、これらのキャンペーンは戦略的関係を強化し、より良い商業条件の交渉にもつながる重要な手段となります。

現在、日本を含む北東アジア地域のパートナーシップリードを募集しています。特に日本市場（および必要に応じて中国、韓国、台湾など周辺市場）に重点を置いたポジションです。本ポジションは、B2Bパートナーマーケティング、戦略的サプライヤー獲得、部門横断的な実行の交差点に位置し、戦略的なパートナー向けのプログラム構築と、日本市場特有のニーズへの対応に注力します。

本ポジションの重要な役割の一つは、日本におけるDMO（観光局）パートナーシップの推進です。外部スポンサー資金の確保や、観光局・公共機関との連携を通じて、GMV（流通総額）の向上や掲載商品の拡充といった測定可能な成長へとつなげます。

本ポジションは、高いオーナーシップと重要度が高い、パートナー対応を担うシニアレベルポジションです。

ミッション（職務内容）

  • 日本を中心とした北東アジア地域のサプライマーケティング戦略を策定・推進し、グローバル戦略を現地市場に適応させる

Líder de Reclutamiento | Pre-opening

Grand Hyatt Cancún Beach Resort se encuentra en proceso de integración de su equipo de apertura y busca un(a) Líder de Reclutamiento apasionado(a) por atraer, identificar y conectar con el mejor talento de la industria hotelera.

job.job_description:
About The Opportunity

Join our Commercial Finance team as a Commercial Finance Analyst supporting the Commercial Software function. You’ll partner directly with the Global CTO and leadership team, turning financial, investment, and performance data into actionable insights that shape business decisions. This is a highly visible role where you'll influence investment priorities, drive financial performance, and help create greater transparency across a growing technology environment. If you enjoy combining commercial thinking, financial analysis, and stakeholder partnership, this is an exceptional opportunity to make a real impact.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with the Global CTO and leadership team as the primary finance contact, translating financial information into actionable business insights.
  • Own budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning processes for the Commercial Software teams.
  • Deliver month-end reporting, variance analysis, and commentary on actual versus budget and forecast performance.
  • Monitor and report on key software commercial KPIs, including headcount, cloud spend, SaaS licensing, and project profitability.
  • Develop financial models, investment appraisals, and business cases to support strategic decision-making.
  • Support capital expenditure and operating expenditure classification and development cost capitalisation activities.
  • Constructively challenge cost and investment decisions to maximise business value and returns.
  • Improve reporting processes, data quality, and operational efficiency through the use of BI tools and best practices.
  • Provide ad hoc analysis and commercial support for initiatives, contracts, and pricing decisions.
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive.


Experience & Qualifications

  • Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or CIMA).
  • 3+ years PQE.
  • Proven experience in Commercial Finance, FP&A, or business partnering roles.
  • Strong stakeholder management and business partnering skills.
  • Advanced Excel skills including complex formulas, lookups, and pivot tables.
  • Strong financial modelling capability.
  • Experience with budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.
  • Commercially minded with strong analytical capability.
  • Experience supporting Commercial Software, Product, Engineering teams, or senior technology leaders.
  • Understanding of development cost capitalisation and SaaS revenue/cost metrics.
  • Experience in a technology or SaaS business preferred.
  • Power BI or similar BI/reporting tool experience preferred.
  • Comfortable using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT.

Employment Type: Permanent

Contract Duration

 Why you will love working here

At IATA, we represent over 350 airlines worldwide, striving to make aviation safer, smarter, more sustainable, and inclusive.

  • Our Values are not just words on a page - they are the energy behind everything we do: ONE IATA - We collaborate across teams, TRUSTED - We do the right thing, INNOVATIVE - We make tomorrow better, INCLUSIVE - We embrace diverse perspectives.
  • With over 30,000 courses available, we believe in continuous learning and support your growth in an ever-changing industry.
  • Diversity, equity, and inclusion are our priorities. We are certified by the Equal Salary Foundation, offering equal pay and family-friendly policies.
  • We encourage community involvement through volunteering and strive to make tomorrow better for aviation and our communities. We offer time off so you can support causes important to you.
  • We promote work-life balance with flexible work options, including remote and hybrid work, a generous 'work from abroad' policy, and you get your birthday off!

About The Team You Are Joining

IATA’s Business Intelligence Services are the focal point and driving force for data management and global BI services for the aviation industry. The team is comprised of aviation industry experts, data management and analytic professionals. One of the four verticals within the IATA BIS department focused on Passenger Traffic & Sales.

This unit places a strong emphasis on managing end-to-end delivery of products, Vendor managements and acting as IATA in-house business expert in direct liaison with external providers and partners.

The Senior Manager, Operations reports to Head, Pax Traffic & Sales BI.

Responsibilities

Take Charge of the technical and operations aspects of DDS cloud-based industry data solution.

Serve as the in-house business specialist and lead in direct liaison with external providers, partners, and internal IT stakeholders.

Guiding end-to-end ETL processes in collaboration with the Ingestion team, in coordination with ARC and external vendors.

Oversee the client end to end delivery processes, this includes both Flat file and webtool deliveries and in coordination with ARC.

Identify opportunities to improve and optimize operational processes and performance through data-driven insights.

Monitor, measure, and report SLAs for different vendors in coordination with IT and create an early warning mechanism related to Vendors quality, through creation and distribution of regular reports and dashboards to support decision making and early warnings.

Oversees the processes of – but not limited to - developing Statement of Work on change requests and sign-off on the deliverables and aid in grooming stories and making sure it’s a reflection of the business needs.

Budget management: Monitor, manage and optimize the bank of days and costing related with enhancement and other out-of-pocket expenses.

Managing in coordination with IT all maintenance and development processes and ensuring compliance with ISO27001 / ISO 9001 standards.

Manage a team responsible for both product delivery and solution technology by mentoring and developing a team of BI experts.

Training other colleagues on data management framework, processes, tools and functions, which promote database standards and best practices.

We would love to hear from you if

M.Sc. or B.Sc. in Computer Science or Aviation Information Systems, or equivalent experience.

Must have solid aviation business expertise with 10+ years working experience managing global scale operations job. preferably in aviation commercial data

7+ years’ experience in data management lead role.

Must have broad and sufficient knowledge of various aspects of data Management including data governance, data quality, master data management, data integration, information life cycle. Also is familiar with AWS & Snowflake solutions for data management, metadata management, business intelligence and reporting (MS Power BI), integration and systems architecture. Familiarity with Ticket management System, particularly JIRA / JSM.

Proven experience working closely with business owners and subject matter experts to document, design, develop, and deliver high-quality data and analytics solutions is required.

Requires solid knowledge of business planning, resource/financial planning and reporting, proven project management skills.

Good interpersonal communication: the ability to communicate complex issues in a simple manner.

Fluent reading, writing, and speaking abilities in English.

Team player and strong sense of ownership. Familiar with complex matrix structure

Ability to work under pressure with strict deadlines.

Travel Required: 10

Learn more about IATA’s role in the industry, our benefits, and the team at iata/careers/ . We are looking forward to hearing from you!

job.company_description:
Priceline, part of Booking Holdings Inc., has been a leader in online travel for over 25 years. Through our innovative technology, we make travel affordable and accessible for all, helping millions of travelers each year experience the moments that matter most. Whether it’s a much-needed getaway, wedding, reunion, graduation, or rooting on a favorite team—those are the moments that nobody should miss out on.
We welcome people who are at the top of their game, who want to learn and grow with others and who take their work seriously – but not themselves. We’re building an inclusive and uniquely talented team to make sure our customers can be there for all of life’s important moments. Come join us!
job.job_description:
This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in-office

Director, Strategic Partnerships

Whether it’s hotels, rental cars, flights, cruises, or packages, our Lines of Business develop the relationships and partnerships that allow us to deliver exceptional value and experiences to Priceline customers—helping them enjoy the moments that matter most.

Why This Job’s a Big Deal

As a Director, Strategic Partnerships, you will play a critical leadership role in shaping the future growth of Priceline’s B2B distribution business within the highly competitive travel marketplace. You will define and execute strategic partnership initiatives that unlock new revenue opportunities, expand market presence, and strengthen relationships with many influential travel businesses.

You’ll serve as a senior representative of the Priceline brand, cultivating executive-level relationships across the travel ecosystem. This role requires a strategic operator who can balance big-picture market opportunities with disciplined execution. You’ll oversee complex partnerships from strategy through negotiation, implementation, optimization, and expansion—working closely with Product, Technology, Finance, Marketing, Operations, and Customer teams to deliver measurable outcomes.

Leveraging your industry expertise, analytical mindset, and leadership skills, you’ll identify emerging opportunities, solve complex commercial challenges, and build scalable partnerships that deliver exceptional value for Priceline, our partners, and our customers.

In This Role You Will Get To

  • Define and execute the strategic partnership roadmap, identifying growth opportunities, market trends, and innovative partnership models that strengthen Priceline’s competitive position.
  • Build, nurture, and expand executive-level relationships with high-value strategic partners across the travel ecosystem, particularly focused on the loyalty and corporate travel segments,.
  • Be a leader, acting as a manager, advocate, mentor, and peer. Engage with direct reports, guide priorities, and provide detailed support when needed to communicate partnership direction and strategy across the company
  • Lead complex commercial negotiations, including partnership agreements regarding growth initiatives, and long-term strategic commitments.
  • Own portfolio performance, developing strategies to accelerate revenue growth, improve partner engagement, and maximize business outcomes.
  • Identify and pursue new partnership opportunities that expand distribution, enhance customer value, and create competitive differentiation.
  • Represent Priceline externally at industry events, conferences, and executive forums, strengthening brand presence and marketplace influence.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Technology, Finance, Marketing, Legal, Operations, and Customer teams to align partner strategies with company priorities.
  • Influence product capabilities and roadmap decisions by translating partner insights, industry trends, and commercial opportunities into actionable strategies.
  • Develop scalable frameworks, processes, and operating models that improve partnership effectiveness and long-term growth.
  • Provide leadership, mentorship, and guidance across teams to elevate commercial thinking, partnership strategy, and execution excellence.

Who You Are

  • A strategic commercial leader with 10+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, account management, or commercial strategy, ideally within travel, hospitality, marketplace, e-commerce, or technology environments.
  • Proven track record building and scaling high-value enterprise partnerships that drive significant revenue growth and business impact.
  • Deep understanding of the travel ecosystem, including supplier relationships, distribution models, connectivity, and evolving market dynamics.
  • Experienced leading complex commercial negotiations and influencing executive stakeholders across partner organizations.
  • Able to identify market opportunities, develop strategic plans, and translate vision into measurable execution.
  • Strong analytical and financial acumen with experience using data, business cases, and performance metrics to guide decisions.
  • Comfortable operating across strategy and execution—equally effective setting direction and diving into details to remove barriers.
  • Exceptional communicator with the ability to influence senior leaders, align diverse stakeholders, and represent the company externally.
  • Skilled at navigating ambiguity, solving complex problems, and driving outcomes in a fast-paced, competitive environment. We’re a small team and often wear many hats. Some projects may not be completely defined. This individual will take a resourceful approach to what’s needed and drive results
  • Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability, and Trust.
  • The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics are essential.

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. In addition to a competitive base salary, certain roles may be eligible for an annual bonus and/or equity grant.

The salary range for this position is $155,000- $195,000K USD

Who We Are

WE ARE PRICELINE.

Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.

Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.

We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.

Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.

If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!

Flexible work at Priceline

Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.

Perks & Benefits At Priceline

Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:

Health & wellness coverage including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources

Generous time off including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days

Work/life support including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)

Financial security programs such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts

Signature travel perks including employee-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits

Additional perks & discounts like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits

A people-first culture with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together

Specific benefits and programs vary by location.

Inclusion is a Big Deal!

To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.

Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.

Job Summary

The Managing Vice President, Global Risk Management leads Marriott International’s global risk management strategy and operations, with responsibility for Insurance, Claims and Occupational Health Services, Fire & Life Safety, and Operational Resilience. The role has oversight and accountability for minimizing risk and reducing financial loss through the effective management and execution of these disciplines as it relates to associate injuries, guest liabilities, property losses, business interruptions, and other insurable exposures worldwide.

This position sets the strategic direction for the Risk Management organization and serves as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on enterprise risk, insurance program design, captive insurance operations, and risk financing strategies. Working closely with corporate and continent leaders, the Managing Vice President drives organizational effectiveness, fosters cross-functional partnerships, and ensures compliance with its legal, regulatory and contractual obligations while supporting Marriott’s long-term business objectives, brand integrity, and growth strategy.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Required

Education and Experience

  • 15+ years’ experience as a Risk Management leader, including a minimum of 10+ years of demonstrated success as a senior Risk Management professional.
  • Baccalaureate degree in Finance or related discipline.
  • Experience leading global insurance strategy across multiple lines of coverage, including engagement with global markets and brokers across multiple insurance lines.
  • Proven ability to structure, negotiate and place traditional insurance and alternative risk transfer solutions and other risk financing arrangements, while maintaining strong market relationships.
  • Experience with the structure and operation of captive insurance companies, including governance, capitalization, regulatory requirements, and alignment with broader risk financing strategy.
  • Strong qualitative and quantitative analytical skills; ability to take large volumes of complex information and present it in a clear and concise manner to senior management, owners and franchisees; uses data and a cogent problem- solving methodology in decision making and impact assessment.
  • Skillful negotiator in tough situations; sells ideas persuasively; settles differences and wins concessions without damaging relationships; can be both direct and forceful while remaining diplomatic.
  • Strong leader of people – ability to create compelling vision, demonstrate flexibility in approach, and motivates others (who may, oftentimes, not be direct reports) to achieve desired results; ability to work in a matrix organization and make things happen without having to own all of the resources; leverages shared resources to achieve results.

Preferred

  • MBA or Master of Science/Graduate Degree in Risk Management
  • Senior leadership experience with a global hospitality company
  • ARM and CPCU designation

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

  • Sets the strategic direction for Marriott’s Risk Management organization. Ensures that the teams leverage and analyze data from market research, vendor relations and business performance to develop cost savings strategies to Marriott International in the procure of services from third party providers.
  • Drives strategic, proactive risk management efforts to ensure the appropriate focus and resources are applied to maximize value and reduce exposure for the Company’s existing and future assets worldwide.
  • Leads the strategic utilization of the company’s captive insurance company, ensuring its long-term financial health and alignment with enterprise risk management objectives.
  • Provides transformational leadership as a change champion, aligning the Risk Management organizational structure with the company’s strategic direction while leading and integrating four core areas: Insurance, Claims, Fire Life Safety (FLS), and Operational Resilience.
  • Serves as an advisor to senior leadership on acceptable risk levels, risk transfer, financial structure of insurance plans and cost allocations.
  • In partnership with Continent Presidents and other senior executives, establishes processes and controls to proactively identify brand integrity risks and creatively resolves them.
  • Collaborates with Legal, Human Resources, Global Design, Development, Internal Audit and other key stakeholders on cross functional, large scale projects/initiatives. Serves as a thought leader related to expert knowledge of business risk.
  • Oversees global insurance programs, including policy placement, broker management, premium negotiations, and alternative risk transfer strategies, delivering significant cost savings for the Company.
  • Provide strategic oversight of claims operations, including high-exposure and reputational risk cases.
  • Partners closely with the Global Safety & Security (GS&S) organization to ensure Risk Management considerations—including Insurance, Claims, Fire & Life Safety, and Operational Resilience—are reflected in organizational priorities and that key data, insights, and information are shared across all Risk Management disciplines.
  • Ensures competitiveness of risk management programs and services through appropriate measurements and benchmarking. Responsible for all aspects of performance, including planning, developing, and measuring the performance of the discipline and evaluating its quality and making changes where appropriate
  • Represents Risk Management in a wide range of internal and external forums and selected insurer advisory boards to ensure Marriott International keeps pace with industry changes.
  • Fosters excellence in business ethics and integrity, social responsibility, cross-cultural effectiveness, and associate engagement.
  • Provides strategic counsel on decisions involving significant enterprise risk, leveraging data, industry trends and lessons learned to influence decisions that support long-term enterprise objectives.  
  • Participates in key talent management activities such as interviewing and hiring, performance management, human capital reviews; ensures talent development occurs throughout the entire department.
  • Identifies talents of direct reports and their teams and assists with their growth and development to ensure a steady talent pipeline for key positions.
  • Champions excellence in business ethics and integrity, social responsibility, cross-cultural effectiveness, and associate engagement.

job.company_description: 🌎 We're here to help every traveller explore the world effortlessly, with a vision to become the world's number one travel ally.
job.job_description:
About Skyscanner

Everyone loves travelling, but planning is not without its challenges ✈️. That's why we've spent 20 years building tools that turn travel-planning chaos into a breeze. Today, around 160 million travellers count on us every month to skip the whole “47 browser tabs open” phase and find flights, cars, and hotels quickly and easily 💻.

Joining Skyscanner means becoming part of a global brand that's striving to become the planet's go-to travel hack accessible for all 🌍.

Our vision? To be the world's number one travel ally. (Ambitious? 💪 Yes, but, hey, that's what got us here).

Now, we’re on the lookout for a Creator Manager to help us bring that vision to even more travellers.

About The Role

(Hybrid)

This is your chance to be part of something big. As our first social Creator Manager in APAC, you’ll shape a creator programme that doesn’t just rack up views - it helps people travel smarter. 

We’re after a sharp strategist with serious creative instincts and a sixth sense for what works on social. Someone who gets that influence starts with trust and builds it through relevance, resonance and bold moves that pay off.

You’ll shape our influencer strategy across partnering with creators to craft content that’s helpful, saveable, scroll-stopping and platform-perfect. Not rinse-and-repeat brand deals, but thoughtful collaborations that feel true to each creator and genuinely useful to their communities. 

Working closely with our Regional APAC and Global Social & Community Leads (plus your counterparts across EMEA and AMER), you’ll help build a world-class creator model - one that earns trust, drives performance and turns Skyscanner into the travel brand people love. 

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Building standout creator collaboration: You’ll develop meaningful relationships with creators across key APAC markets, turning successful collaborations into long-term partnerships delivering sustained value for both them and us. 
  • Designing purposeful creator strategies: You’ll work hand-in-hand with our regional and global Social & Community team to ensure creator content isn’t just an aesthetic, it’s purposeful and aligns with our broader brand and marketing strategies and activities.
  • Manage multi-market creator programmes and campaigns:  You’ll manage our rolling organic advocate programmes across APAC markets alongside splash campaign activities, in collaboration with agencies, freelancers and partners to deliver stories that people genuinely want to watch, save and share.
  • Localising with insight: You’ll provide sharp APAC market expertise, ensuring our global creator strategy lands authentically in every region without losing its local flavour. 
  • Spotting relevant trends: You’ll identify the right cultural moment and social media trends to develop bold creator activations that land with meaning and momentum.
  • Scaling our commission-led model: You’ll work in collaboration with our Senior Affiliate Marketing Manager, building a creator affiliate programme that works for emerging voices and established names alike. 
  • Optimising for performance: You’ll use analytics platforms, such as insights tools for creator vetting, social dashboards for metrics tracking and performance reporting frameworks, to drive decision, measure impact and improve results.
  • Contracting negotiations and budget management: You’ll manage the end-to-end creator process from budget planning and negotiating contracts through to the creative process and invoice management.

About You

  • Creator ecosystem expert: You know the creator world inside and out, with experience from agencies, in-house teams, or both. You’ve ran campaigns across APAC (including South Korea, India, Japan, Taiwan, Australia), understand how each market differs and aren’t afraid to get hands-on with creator tooling. And when it comes to local regulations and disclosure rules, you’ve got them covered.
  • Strategic operator: You know how to plan, launch, measure and optimise creator campaigns that don’t just go live, they go far. 
  • Platform fluent: Across Instagram, TikTok and YouTube you speak their language, understand platform quirks and instinctively know what plays where. Plus, you will test new platform opportunities for creator activities.
  • Relationship builder: You’re the kind of person who turns introductions into long-term partnerships. From spotting rising talent early to nurturing trusted collaborators over time, you build relationships that can last well beyond a single campaign.
  • Cross-functional connector:  You’re confident working with agencies and freelancers - crafting sharp briefs, giving thoughtful feedback and pushing for best-in-class creative while protecting the creator’s voice. You know standout work happens when collaboration is built on trust and clarity. 
  • Comms expert: Internally, you’re the glue. You keep freelancers, agencies and internal stakeholders and channels aligned, informed and moving in the same direction whilst balancing creative ambition with commercial reality and making it all feel seamless. You're also a clear communicator with an internal radar for timelines, to-do lists and the tiny details that keep everything running like clockwork. 
  • Trend spotter: You’ve got a sixth sense for emerging travel creators and cultural shifts before the algorithm catches on. 
  • Commercially savvy: You’re confident managing contracts, invoices and budgets. You know how to negotiate fairly and effectively. 
  • Data-driven decision maker: You love getting into the numbers, using insights to improve performance and guide smarter creative bets. You will be curious about the role of creators in the emerging world of LLMs and AI.

What It’s Like Here

We are the real deal — no corporate gloss, no empty promises. Just a team of genuinely curious, caring humans ❤️, building things that help travellers explore the world a little easier 🧭.

Skyscanner is made up of brilliant humans from every corner of the world. We believe travel makes the world better — and that the same is true of our diverse teams. We're proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and products that are accessible to all ✨.

Sound like your kind of adventure? 🚀 Apply now and help us shape the future of travel.

We're committed to ensuring our application and recruitment processes are inclusive and accessible to everyone. If you require any reasonable adjustments or accommodations for interviews, and/or wish to apply under the Disability Confident scheme, please let your recruiter know. If you’d like more information on any of our policies, such as hybrid working or Parental Leave policies (typically we pay a minimum of 24 weeks birth parent/maternity leave globally), our recruitment team can provide more information on these.

job.job_description:
We are seeking a Senior Principal, Sales & Account Management to join our global Airline Tech team, where innovation knows no borders. This team drives go-to-market strategies for modern airline software like the Sabre Mosaic offer and order platform across Japan. By helping carriers modernize legacy systems, we enable airlines to deliver personalized passenger experiences and grow high-margin revenue. With an inclusive culture and flexible work environment, we work together with boldness, curiosity and commitment so we can all win together.


As Senior Principal, Sales & Account Management, you will lead commercial strategy and executive growth across key Japanese airline accounts. You will operate with broad autonomy to guide carriers through retail transformations, challenge traditional distribution models and align local market needs with global technology roadmaps. This role requires executive presence, sharp business judgment and deep domain expertise.


What you'll do

  • Lead commercial negotiations and deal strategies for Sabre Mosaic offer and order solutions across top-tier Japanese airlines.
  • Drive software adoption to help carriers modernize commercial operations and increase profitability.
  • Guide executive stakeholders through complex retail transformations to align platform capabilities with long-term commercial goals.
  • Collaborate with global product and engineering teams to ensure Japanese market requirements shape technology roadmaps.
  • Build long-term commercial relationships with senior airline leaders across the Japanese market.
  • Use generative artificial intelligence and workflow automation to streamline deal modeling, accelerate account planning and sharpen decision-making.


What you'll bring

  • Minimum 10 years of commercial sales or account management experience in travel technology, airline IT or software as a service (SaaS).
  • Deep expertise in airline technology solutions like Passenger Service Systems (PSS) or proven success selling complex enterprise software solutions to airlines in Japan.
  • Good understanding of modern airline retailing concepts, including offer and order management, New Distribution Capability (NDC) and Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) is preferred.
  • Native-level Japanese and business-level English communication skills to influence senior airline executives and cross-functional global teams.
  • Proven ability to lead high-value commercial discussions, navigate complex organizational structures and build executive alignment.
  • Practical experience using generative artificial intelligence, automation or analytics tools to increase productivity and elevate commercial strategy.
  • Located in the Tokyo Metropolitan area due to the proximity to key customer’s headquarters.


Benefits that support you

We know support looks different for everyone. That is why Sabre offers benefits beyond medical and financial coverage, with programs designed to support your well-being, growth and life outside work:

  • Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives, where applicable
  • Remote working arrangements for employees in Japan, based on current company policy and business needs
  • Health insurance, pension and other social insurance coverage in line with Japanese requirements
  • Paid annual leave, public holidays and other statutory leave
  • Childcare, family care and parental leave support


シニアプリンシパル

営業・アカウントマネジメント

航空業界向けテクノロジーソリューション（日本担当）

募集概要

Sabreのグローバル航空テクノロジーチームでは、日本市場を担当する**シニアプリンシパル（営業・アカウントマネジメント）**を募集しています。

本ポジションは、シニアレベルの個人貢献職として、日本の主要航空会社との戦略的な関係構築、事業拡大、ならびに大規模な商談の推進を担います。

当チームは、次世代航空リテーリングプラットフォーム「Sabre Mosaic」をはじめとするソフトウェアソリューションを通じて、航空会社のデジタルトランスフォーメーションを支援しています。レガシーシステムの刷新、リテーリング機能の高度化、顧客体験の向上、収益性の改善に向けて、グローバル規模で取り組んでいます。

日本市場における顧客ニーズを深く理解し、地域の事業戦略とグローバルの製品戦略を結びつける、重要なポジションです。


ポジション概要

本ポジションでは、日本の主要航空会社に対するアカウント戦略を策定し、中長期的な事業成長と顧客価値の最大化をリードしていただきます。

顧客企業の経営層や意思決定者と信頼関係を構築し、航空会社の事業課題や変革方針を理解したうえで、Sabreの製品・サービスを活用した提案を行います。

また、日本市場特有の要件や商習慣を、アジア太平洋地域およびグローバルの製品、営業、エンジニアリング、デリバリーチームへ共有し、製品戦略や開発ロードマップにも影響を与えていただきます。

高い裁量のもと、以下の領域を中心に業務を推進していただきます。

  • 日本市場における主要顧客のアカウント戦略
  • 大規模かつ複雑な商談および契約交渉
  • 既存顧客との関係強化および事業拡大
  • 航空会社のリテーリング変革およびシステム刷新
  • 日本市場とグローバル組織との連携


主な業務内容

  • 日本の主要航空会社に対する中長期的な営業戦略およびアカウントプランを策定する。
  • Sabre Mosaicを含むOffer & Orderソリューションの提案活動を推進する。
  • 顧客企業の経営層、事業責任者、IT部門、調達部門などとの商談を主導する。
  • 大規模案件における提案、価格交渉、契約条件の調整、社内承認プロセスをリードする。
  • 顧客の商業戦略、業務課題、システム環境を理解し、最適なソリューションを提案する。
  • 航空会社のデジタルトランスフォーメーション、リテーリング改革、収益改善に向けた取り組みを支援する。
  • 既存顧客との関係を深め、追加提案や新たな事業機会の創出を推進する。
  • 日本市場の要件や顧客からのフィードバックを、グローバルの製品およびエンジニアリングチームへ共有する。
  • 製品戦略、開発ロードマップ、導入方針の検討に、日本市場の視点を反映する。
  • アジア太平洋地域およびグローバルの営業、製品、法務、財務、デリバリーチームと連携する。
  • 必要に応じて、生成AI、業務自動化、データ分析などの新しいテクノロジーを活用し、アカウント戦略や案件管理の高度化を図る。


応募資格

必須要件

  • 旅行テクノロジー、航空IT、エンタープライズソフトウェア、またはSaaS業界における、10年以上の営業もしくはアカウントマネジメント経験。
  • 日本の航空会社向け営業経験、または航空・旅行業界におけるエンタープライズソフトウェア販売の実績。
  • 大手法人顧客に対する中長期的なアカウント戦略の策定および実行経験。
  • 顧客企業の経営層や意思決定者との関係構築および商談経験。
  • 高額かつ複雑な案件における提案、交渉、契約締結の経験。
  • 複雑な組織環境において、複数の社内外ステークホルダーを巻き込みながら案件やプロジェクトを推進した経験。
  • 日本語ネイティブレベルのコミュニケーション能力。
  • 英語によるビジネスコミュニケーション能力。
  • 東京都市圏に居住している方、または居住可能な方。


歓迎要件

  • Passenger Service Systems（PSS）などの航空会社向け基幹システムに関する知識または経験。
  • Offer & Order Managementに関する知識。
  • NDC（New Distribution Capability）に関する知識。
  • API連携やクラウド型ソリューションに関する理解。
  • 航空会社の予約、発券、在庫、収益管理、顧客管理、販売流通などの業務知識。
  • 航空会社のシステム刷新または大規模な変革プロジェクトに関与した経験。
  • 生成AI、業務自動化、データ分析ツールなど、新しいテクノロジーを業務へ取り入れる意欲。


求める人物像

  • 顧客との長期的な信頼関係を重視できる方。
  • 日本の商習慣を理解しながら、グローバルな組織環境で業務を推進できる方。
  • 複雑な課題を整理し、実行可能な提案へ落とし込める方。
  • 社内外の異なる意見を調整し、合意形成を進められる方。
  • 高い当事者意識を持ち、自律的に業務を進められる方。
  • 市場やテクノロジーの変化に関心を持ち、継続的に学ぶ姿勢を持つ方。


勤務形態

  • 日本国内でのリモートワークを基本とします。
  • 顧客訪問、商談、社内会議などのため、必要に応じて東京都内への出張があります。
  • 業務上の必要に応じて、日本国内および海外への出張が発生する場合があります。
  • 勤務形態は、会社方針および事業状況に基づき変更となる場合があります。


福利厚生

Sabreでは、一人ひとりに最適なサポートが異なると考えています。社員の健康、キャリア形成、そして仕事以外の生活も含めて支援する充実した福利厚生制度をご用意しています。

  • 業績に応じたインセンティブを含む競争力の高い報酬制度。
  • 日本国内におけるリモートワーク制度（会社方針および事業状況に基づく）。
  • 健康保険、厚生年金を含む各種社会保険完備。
  • 年次有給休暇および法定休暇制度。
  • 育児休業、介護休業、家族支援制度。

job.job_description:
THE COMPANY


IDILIQ Group, a Wyndham Hotels & Resorts partner, are pioneers of the resort-based residence concept with over 40 years’ experience. IDILIQ Group design, develop and manage residences, and sell resort-based properties in some of the most sought-after holiday destinations around the world.

IDILIQ Group is rapidly growing as a business which makes this an interesting career move for anyone who wants to be part of their journey.


THE ROLE


The Resort Systems Specialist is a member of the ICT team based at the IDILIQ Head Office in Mijas Costa (Málaga), on the Costa del Sol and reports to the Head of Resort & Payment Systems. The role is responsible for supporting, administering, and enhancing the hospitality technology platforms that underpin resort operations across the IDILIQ portfolio.

The initial focus of the role will be Food & Beverage systems, including taking over day-to-day ownership of Oracle Micros Simphony POS, ResDiary and related F&B reservation systems as part of a planned internal handover. Over time, the role will broaden to include OPERA Cloud PMS and the other hospitality systems supported by the Resort Systems team.

Working closely with Front Office, Food & Beverage, Kitchen, Housekeeping, Finance, and other operational departments, as well as third-party vendors and technology partners, the Resort Systems Specialist plays a critical role in ensuring that hospitality systems remain reliable, secure, well-configured, integrated, and user-friendly.

The successful candidate will support the ongoing optimization of resort technology solutions, contribute to system implementations and upgrades, troubleshoot technical issues, and help drive operational efficiencies that enhance both the guest and employee experience across all properties.


Duties & Responsibilities:


Primary focus will be to support and optimise Food & Beverage systems (principally Oracle Micros Simphony POS) and the wider hospitality technology environment, ensuring critical resort systems are effectively configured, maintained and continuously improved across the IDILIQ Group. The Resort Systems Specialist will assist operational teams in delivering a seamless guest experience by supporting point-of-sale, property management, payment and reporting systems.


System Administration & Support


  • Support, administer and configure Oracle Micros Simphony POS across all F&B outlets (restaurants, bars, kitchens and retail), and assist with OPERA Cloud PMS administration and support
  • Manage menus, revenue centres, promotions, user accounts, permissions, operational settings and other system configurations.
  • Support POS workstations and peripherals, including printers, workstations and handheld devices
  • Administer ResDiary and other F&B reservation and listing systems.
  • Support POS integrations with the PMS, inventory, finance and reporting systems, including accurate revenue posting and month-end support.
  • Monitor system performance and proactively identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Maintain accurate system documentation, procedures and user guides.
  • Ensure system configurations adhere to company standards and operational requirements.


Incident Management & Troubleshooting

  • Troubleshoot POS, PMS, payment, reporting, hardware and integration issues.
  • Investigate and resolve user-reported problems in a timely and professional manner.
  • Coordinate with Oracle and third-party vendors to escalate and resolve technical issues when required.
  • Assist with root cause analysis and recommend preventative measures to reduce recurring issues.


Projects & Continuous Improvement

  • Support system implementations, upgrades, testing and deployment activities.
  • Participate in new venue openings, system rollouts and hospitality technology projects.
  • Assist with integration initiatives involving payment gateways, reporting solutions and guest-facing technologies.
  • Identify opportunities to enhance operational efficiency through improved system processes and functionality.
  • Support user acceptance testing and validation of system changes.
  • Contribute to the evaluation and adoption of other F&B and hospitality platforms as the portfolio grows, including non-Oracle solutions.


Training & Stakeholder Support

  • Provide guidance and support to Food & Beverage, Finance and resort operational teams.
  • Deliver system training and knowledge-sharing sessions where required including to restaurant managers, supervisors and F&B staff.
  • Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external technology partners.
  • Communicate technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical users.


Reporting & Compliance

  • Assist with generating and maintaining reports from hospitality systems and associated platforms.
  • Support data integrity, security and compliance across hospitality technology systems.
  • Ensure accurate maintenance of user access and permissions.


THE PERSON

Abilities/Key Competencies/Skills

Alongside the professional competencies outlined below, the successful candidate will demonstrate the fundamentals of WHR's Count on Me! Service Culture by being responsive, respectful, and committed to delivering exceptional service. This approach should be reflected in all aspects of their work through the Count on Me! Building Blocks: Compassionate, Engaged, Dependable, Courteous, Inclusive, Hospitable, Prepared, and Personalized.


  • Exceptional service orientation with a passion for delivering an outstanding guest and stakeholder experience.
  • Ability to communicate professionally and effectively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
  • Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills.
  • Accountability and ownership, with a proactive approach to delivering results.
  • Self-motivated, dependable, and capable of working independently with minimal supervision.
  • Strong teamwork and collaboration skills, with the ability to support cross-functional departments.
  • High standards of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Excellent planning, organizational, and time-management skills.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to investigate technical issues methodically and implement effective solutions.
  • Proactive, adaptable, and flexible approach to changing business needs and priorities.
  • Passion for technology, innovation, and continuous learning.
  • Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering high-quality support and service.
  • Professional verbal and written communication skills.
  • High degree of confidentiality, integrity, and professionalism.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Professional presentation and demeanor.
  • Comfortable working with both technical and non-technical users, translating complex concepts into practical solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify opportunities for process improvement and operational efficiency.


BACKGROUND

Required Experience

  • Minimum of 2 years' experience supporting hospitality technology systems within a hotel, resort, hospitality, or leisure environment.
  • Hands-on experience configuring and supporting Oracle Micros Simphony POS or a comparable enterprise POS platform
  • Good understanding of Food & Beverage operations (restaurants, bars and kitchens) in a hotel or resort environment
  • Experience configuring, administering, and troubleshooting hospitality technology systems.
  • Experience supporting end users within Food & Beverage, Finance, and Operational departments.

  • Experience maintaining system documentation, user procedures, and training materials.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Outlook, Word, and other Microsoft 365 applications.
  • Fluent Spanish (written and verbal) is essential; professional-level English is strongly desirable.
  • Must live within commuting distance of Mijas Costa (Málaga) and be able to work from the office.


Preferred Experience

  • Understanding of hotel or resort administrative functions, including Finance and Revenue Management.
  • Experience with hospitality technology integrations, payment gateways, and guest-facing technologies.
  • Knowledge of Oracle Hospitality products and related technology platforms.
  • Experience with OPERA Cloud PMS or other property management systems.
  • Experience with ResDiary or other restaurant reservation and inventory systems
  • Experience using SQL, reporting tools, or business intelligence solutions.

  • Ongoing commitment to professional development and staying current with emerging hospitality technologies and best practices.


Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Hospitality Management, Business Information Systems, or a related field; or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. Desirable but not essential.


Certificates

  • ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent IT Service Management qualification is advantageous.

job.job_description:
About CTM


Corporate Travel Management (CTM) is a global leader in innovative and cost-effective travel solutions, spanning corporate, events, leisure, loyalty and wholesale travel. We drive savings, efficiency, safety and sustainability to businesses and their travellers in every corner of the world. Our proven business strategy combines personalised service excellence with client-facing technology solutions to deliver a measurable return on investment to clients.

Founded in 1994, CTM has grown from a two-person start-up into one of the world’s most successful travel management companies.


Summary of Position

The operational specialist role within the Partnerships Team is critical to align supplier strategy with operational execution across the business. While currently a regional role, the role is expected to evolve as part of the global supplier relations proposed restructure. This role will serve as the key link between Supplier Relations, operations, technology and marketing ensuring that supplier strategies both regional and global are effectively translated into scalable solutions that drive revenue growth, operational efficiencies and enhanced partner value. The successful candidate will bring a strong operations background within the travel industry, coupled with a comprehensive understanding of CTM’s technology and systems. Working closely with the Partnership Management Team and the Chief Partnership Officer they will align with CTM Partners, Project Management, Operations, Product and marketing teams to deliver end to end solutions that support strategic initiatives including preferencing, NDC, Sleep Space and other supplier driven opportunities.


What we need:


Knowledge, Skills and Abilities


  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities
  • Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively across regional and global teams.
  • Strong excel, project management and presentation skills
  • Strategic mindset with the ability to balance client needs and commercial objectives
  • Commercial mindset with a proven ability to identify opportunities for revenue growth and operational efficiencies
  • A desire to progress within the Supplier Relations Team ( preferred )
  • Engaged and energic individual with a desire to succeed and ‘Run it like your own it’
  • Strong excel, project management and presentation skills


Experience

  • Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively across regional and global teams.
  • Experience working with supplier Programmes, NDC, distribution technologies, or related travel industry initiatives.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities
  • Engaged and energic individual with a desire to succeed and ‘Run it like your own it’
  • Commercial mindset with a proven ability to identify opportunities for revenue growth and operational efficiency.


What you will be responsible for:

  • Commercial Performance
  • Strategic Programme Delivery
  • Operational Excellence
  • Supplier Communications and Reporting


Join our crew and help CTM take flight. Apply now and pack your skills for a business travel journey that promises growth, discovery and plenty of first-class moments.


What to expect from the recruitment process

  • Every hire starts with a chat with our Talent Acquisition team, if your profile is selected you will be contacted by phone or email (please check your spam folder);
  • Then, if you are progressing, the hiring manager will invite you to an interview, usually on Teams;
  • If you are successful we will invite you to our office for a final stage interview.


Wherever possible we will provide you with feedback, however we are a small team and often we won't be able to do so until after we fill the vacancy.

Our learning platform CTM Learning, our annual conference the All Stars, our High-Performance programme and a global leadership programme.


Employee Wellbeing and Flexibility

Our wellbeing platform Vitality, our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP), our new private healthcare Medicash + our mental health first aiders.

Most of our roles offer a hybrid working pattern, with 3 days per week in the office. Where permitted and depending on the role, we can offer flexible start and finish times to suit your other commitments and support a healthy work-life balance. We are committed to finding a setup that works for you and the business.


Sustainability Focus

Principles of Governance, People, Planet, and Prosperity, CTM’s Sustainability Strategy identifies material issues and outlines initiatives to achieve this.


CTM is the Data Controller with respect to the personal information you provide during your application. We will use this information solely to process your application, and our legal basis is that you are considering taking up an employment contract with us. We may share this information with our parent company in Australia, but otherwise we will not disclose it to any other organisation. If you take up employment with us, we will keep the information for the duration of your employment, otherwise we will destroy it 2 months after the post is filled.

All the information that we ask for in application forms has to be completed for your application to go ahead. Our Data Protection Officer may be contacted at EU.DPO@travelctm.com

job.job_description:
About Us

Founded in 1999 and listed on NASDAQ in 2003 and HKEX in 2021, Trip.com Group is a leading global travel service provider comprising of Trip.com, Ctrip, Skyscanner, and Qunar.


Across its platforms, Trip.com Group integrates travel resources from industry partners and helps travellers worldwide pursue the perfect trip with exceptional travel products and services.


We have four Customer Service Centres for Trip.com established in Japan, Korea, the UK, and the Philippines, providing 24/7 customer service in 19 different languages.


We have more than 30,000 employees scattered across 30 countries in Asia, Europe, the Americas, and Oceania, striving to expand our global markets and aiming to be the world’s leading and most trusted family of online travel brands that aspire to deliver the perfect trip at the best price for every traveller.


This role sits within the Group's Information Security Department, focusing on the practical implementation of data privacy compliance across our global business. Working in a flat, international and cross-border team, you will act as the central hub for cross-regional, cross-functional compliance work — independently driving complex compliance projects to delivery and advancing the standardization of our overseas privacy compliance framework.


In this Role, you’ll get to

  • Lead cross-jurisdiction compliance projects: independently own multi-jurisdiction personal data protection initiatives — mapping delivery paths and coordinating stakeholders, working with product and engineering teams to turn compliance requirements into implementable technical solutions, and driving execution, iteration and full-cycle delivery.
  • Support regulatory response: work alongside local Legal and Government Relations teams in responding to regulatory inquiries, inspections and official notifications — delivering risk verification, impact assessment and remediation proposals from an information-security and technical perspective.
  • Drive compliance incident closure: own the investigation and remediation of data security incidents, user privacy complaints and data subject requests, forming a complete risk-management loop.
  • Build the global compliance framework: collaborate with overseas teams to continuously refine standardized compliance processes and governance mechanisms, strengthening the Group's global data compliance capabilities.


What you'll Need to Succeed

  • 5+ years of experience in data privacy, data compliance, or information security.
  • Solid knowledge of international personal data protection laws and regulations, with multi-jurisdiction compliance understanding and hands-on implementation experience.
  • Proven ability to independently drive complex compliance projects: coordinating product, engineering, legal and business stakeholders to deliver solutions from planning through to live implementation — practical delivery experience, not just report output.
  • Strong technical understanding: able to read business system architectures and data flows, and to align efficiently with engineering teams to break down and resolve compliance issues.
  • Risk-oriented and structured thinker: able to decompose ambiguous compliance issues and prioritize by risk level, with excellent verbal and written communication.


Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience in overseas regulatory inspections, data security incident handling, or user privacy complaint resolution.
  • Experience building compliance frameworks or cross-border compliance programmes for companies expanding internationally.
  • Prior compliance experience in the internet, OTA, or tech industry.
  • Professional certifications such as CIPP/E, CIPM, or CISSP.
  • Adept at using AI tools and AI agents to optimize compliance workflows and project execution, with demonstrable efficiency gains.


Why Trip.com Group

We offer a stage to unleash your full potential and drive global impact. As an international team, we embrace an open and inclusive culture that supports and respect team members in and out of the workplace. Everyone is on a trip, whether it's a career trip or a life trip. At Trip.com Group, you can define your own trip by setting a goal and celebrate your success by recognizing the progress you have made.


What’s more?

  • Our rapid business growth in global offers abundant career opportunities at various levels and in multiple functions
  • Internal transfer is encouraged, and global job rotation program enable you to pursue a global career path and make global impact
  • We provide learning opportunities to further your career in areas of leadership capability, soft skill and professional expertise.
  • We encourage flexible work arrangement
  • Have fun with company-sponsored greetings and activities at holidays, birthdays, and colorful team events.


Click the link to learn more about What makes Trip.com Group a leading global travel service provider?


Click the link to learn more about This is a Trip Where Both Your Career and Life Can Flourish!


Find out more job opportunities at https://careers.trip.com


Have a good trip, and see you soon!
