Sojern made Deloitte’s Technology Fast 500 list 6 years in a row, was recognized on the Top Company Cultures list by Entrepreneur Magazine and named a Best Place to Work by AdAge. The company is headquartered in San Francisco, with teams based in Dubai, Dublin, London, Omaha, San Francisco and Singapore.

Need more convincing that Sojern is a great place to work? Check out our Glassdoor reviews!


The Role:


The Snr Sales Director role drives/leads business to business sales and is responsible for developing, growing, and managing a digital advertising book business across APAC. The Snr Sales Director will define and work closely with the International Destinations Managing Director. Managing a book of business across Sojern’s existing strategic client base while also developing and acquiring new strategic travel clients across the region. Clients will include DMO’s, Attractions, airports, and Tourism Shopping outlets. Either direct or managed by media agencies.


The Candidate

Sojern is seeking an experienced online advertising sales director with demonstrated success developing, managing, and growing a book of business across the Media Agencies & Travel Direct clients. The Snr Sales Director will primarily manage Sojern’s development and monetization across our multi-channel advertising and measurement solutions, utilizing unique data from our multitude of travel partners. The candidate will have a track record of selling across multiple ad products (Video, Display, Video, Mobile, Paid Social, CTV etc.) for a range of campaign objectives and demonstrate the ability to build strategic partnerships with direct clients, media agencies as well as lead APAC strategic relationships with leading DMO’s. The ideal candidate will be a strategic, creative thinker with the ability to work cross-functionally to develop scalable advertising solutions for their clients and assist in bringing these solutions to market. They must have exceptional presentation skills and a strong understanding of the digital advertising landscape within the DMO vertical. Prior experience in key travel advertiser and DMO categories will be an asset.


The team:

INTL Destinations is a team of 8 salespeople covering a range of commercial responsibilities for the EMEA and APAC regions. The team possesses core skills across ad tech, travel and multi-channel digital advertising.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead in developing, acquiring and growing an advertising book of business predominantly made up of DMO’s, Attractions, Airports and Tourism Shopping outlets
  • Experience in managing a sales pipeline from start to finish
  • Handle a book of business in excess of $2 million on an annual basis
  • Work closely with APAC-based DMOs, attractions, airports, etc.
  • Independently able to maintain and grow a multi-million-dollar book of business and have deep sales strategy conversations with any of Sojern’s clients
  • Demonstrate thought leadership and influence Go-To-Market in APAC
  • Independently create and deliver persuasive presentations that educate the market and demonstrate Sojern’s value proposition
  • Effectively collaborate cross-functionally with vertical sales, account management, and product teams to develop relevant advertising programs for key clients, targets, and their agencies
  • Cross-sell and aid in cross-selling Sojern solutions
  • Meet and exceed growing sales targets every quarter
  • Maintain Salesforce and keep client activity organized
  • Travel Required


What you bring to the table:

  • +15 years overall sales experience in travel, and/or digital advertising
  • A thorough understanding of the DMO landscape
  • Experience in working with travel brands across the region.
  • Experience selling self-serve (SAAS/DAAS), measurement, and managed IO advertising solutions
  • Proficiency in standard business and sales software, including Salesforce, Gsuite, and Office products
  • Ability to build sales plans and respond to large RFP’s
  • A foundational understanding of the programmatic ecosystem
  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university

job.job_description:
We’re looking for a Multimedia Designer to join the global in-house creative team at IHG Hotels & Resorts. This is a hands-on, multidisciplinary design role for a designer who is comfortable moving across digital, print, video, and emerging AI-powered tools.

Working closely with the art director and creative leadership on the team, you’ll help bring ideas to life—from developing concepts and visual approaches to creating polished, final deliverables. The scope of your work will include a variety of marketing projects and formats, adapting creative for different audiences, channels, and brands while maintaining a high standard of craft.

Your Day to Day

  • Take creative direction and develop concepts, visual directions, layouts, and design explorations that bring campaign ideas to life.
  • Create and adapt creative across digital, print, paid media, social, OOH, trade shows, events, and other marketing channels, maintaining consistency across formats and environments.
  • Produce and prepare final digital and print assets for launch or vendor delivery, ensuring files are accurate, production-ready, and meet required technical specifications.
  • Apply strong color theory and production knowledge to prepare work for digital, print, and large-format applications, including color profiles, resolution, scale, bleeds, and file specifications.
  • Develop creative for OOH, environmental graphics, trade shows, events, signage, and displays, understanding how design translates across different scales and physical environments.
  • Create and edit video, motion, and imagery, including animation, retouching, compositing, color correction, and image enhancement.
  • Use generative AI and AI-powered tools to explore concepts, create and enhance assets, and accelerate creative workflows within Adobe Creative Cloud and other platforms.
  • Collaborate with Art Directors, Designers, Copywriters, Marketers, vendors, and production partners to take creative from concept through final delivery.
  • Manage multiple projects and deadlines while delivering polished, on-brand work that meets creative, technical, print, and production requirements.

What We Need From You

  • 3+ years of professional design experience in an agency, in-house creative, marketing, or similar environment, with a portfolio demonstrating multidisciplinary work across digital, print, social, and video.
  • Strong conceptual and visual design skills, with a solid foundation in typography, composition, layout, color, imagery, and visual hierarchy. Able to take creative direction while bringing your own ideas and point of view.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), Figma, and Celtra.
  • Experience producing print, digital, OOH, trade show, and event creative, with a strong understanding of color theory, production specifications, file preparation, and how creative translates across physical and digital formats.
  • Strong image-making and retouching skills, including compositing, color correction, image enhancement, and manipulation, plus experience creating or editing video and motion content.
  • Hands-on experience with generative AI and AI-powered creative tools, including AI capabilities within Adobe Creative Cloud. Comfortable using AI to explore ideas, enhance imagery, create assets, and accelerate creative workflows.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines while delivering polished, production-ready work.
  • A collaborative, curious mindset with the ability to work effectively with creative and cross-functional partners and adapt to new tools, technologies, and ways of working. Fluent in English and/or Spanish.

At IHG Hotels & Resorts, we work together to deliver True Hospitality for Good on a global scale. With corporate offices and over 6,000 hotel destinations worldwide, a career at IHG is the perfect way to broaden your horizons. You’ll experience our unique culture and brilliant colleagues who will support and inspire you. With a host of corporate opportunities to choose from, wherever you are on your career journey, and whatever you want to achieve there’s Room for You at IHG.

We are a hospitality business at our core and value connections and being together helps us foster a unique sense of belonging that also supports productivity. We recognise that every role is different, that’s why leaders work with teams to determine how and when they collaborate.

We provide a wide range of benefits designed to help you live your best work life. These include impressive room discounts across our many properties, recharge days and volunteering days throughout the year. Through our myWellbeing framework, we are committed to supporting wellbeing in your health, lifestyle, and workplace. We offer a unique and inclusive culture, where there is always Room for You to belong, grow and make a difference.

Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams where we celebrate difference and encourage colleagues to bring their whole selves to work. job.job_description:
AI Quality Assurance Program Manager I Tripadvisor

About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

The AI Quality Assurance Program Manager ensures that all artificial intelligence systems across Tripadvisor’s Travel Experiences execute reliably, accurately, and aligned with business goals. Positioning yourself at the intersection of AI performance, traveler satisfaction, and product development, you will establish testing frameworks, audit AI outputs, and turn quality findings into actionable operational insights. You will drive performance tracking, unblock cross-functional teams, and regularly report AI accuracy, success metrics, and enhancement roadmaps to executive leadership.

Job Location: Hybrid

This role is a hybrid position that requires 2/3 days per week/month in our London Office.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define the AI-Era Quality Strategy: Establish the end-to-end quality framework across human agents and AI agents, evolving QA from traditional sample-based auditing toward continuous, AI-enabled quality management.
  • Establish AI Quality & Testing Frameworks: Design and maintain comprehensive evaluation benchmarks, testing protocols, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows to verify AI agents, support bots, and recommendation engines operate as intended.
  • Audit AI Outputs & Traveler Interactions: Continuously evaluate AI-generated outputs (e.g., automated support chats, tour recommendation accuracy, and booking updates) for intent fulfillment, safety, tone, and hallucination prevention.
  • Drive Business Updates & Insights: Deliver executive-ready reporting that translates complex QA evaluation data, model accuracy rates, and error trends into strategic recommendations for business leaders.
  • Lead Cross-Functional AI Improvements: Partner closely with Data Science, AI Engineering, Product, and CX teams to turn QA findings into prompt refinements, model fine-tuning, and updated knowledge base inputs.
  • Maintain Release Momentum: Track project timelines for new AI deployments, manage QA regression testing schedules, and hold technical teams accountable to quality standards before full traveler rollout.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 4–6 years in technical program management, QA management, or AI/ML product operations focused on system reliability and evaluation.
  • AI Evaluation Expertise: Strong operational knowledge of AI/LLM testing methodologies, prompt evaluation, intent recognition accuracy, and AI safety guardrails.
  • Data-Driven Insight Delivery: Proven ability to analyze AI logs, leverage analytics tools, and turn quality metrics into clear, executive-ready presentations and dashboards.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Exceptional track record of bridging technical AI engineering teams with business stakeholders and front-line traveler support operations.
  • Domain Empathy: Deep interest in online travel, traveler behavior, and maintaining high trust across consumer-facing AI interactions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with modern LLM evaluation tools, annotation platforms, or customer service AI tools (e.g., Zendesk AI, Intercom, Salesforce).
  • Background in travel tech, e-commerce marketplaces, or fast-scaling consumer platforms.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About The Team  

Agoda’s Customer Experience Group delivers critical support to customers and partners across markets, channels, and business lines. As our operations scale in complexity, Senior Regional Managers play a pivotal role in ensuring regional resiliency, standardization, and sustained performance across multiple sites and partners.  

 

About The Role  

The Senior Regional Manager is accountable for end-to-end performance of a regional customer/partner operations area, typically spanning multiple countries, sites, or vendor partners. This role translates company strategy into a cohesive regional roadmap, balances cross site tradeoffs, and ensures consistent, high quality service delivery at scale.  

You will act as the regional authority on customer operations performance, risks, and improvement initiatives, while developing strong leadership benches and resilient operating models.  

Key Responsibilities  

Regional & Operational Ownership 

  • Lead multi-site, multi-country customer operations (including inhouse and BPO partners where applicable) 
  • Own end to end regional outcomes, including service quality, efficiency, resiliency, and cost to serve 
  • Balance cross site tradeoffs across capacity, language coverage, channel mix, routing, and vendor strategy   

Strategy & Roadmap  

  • Translate CEG strategy into a 12–18 month regional roadmap, prioritizing initiatives that deliver measurable customer and business impact 
  • Anticipate demand shifts (seasonality, launches, policy or regulatory changes) and lead proactive regional adjustments 
  • Sponsor and govern cross site initiatives to ensure consistency and scalability  

Improvement, Innovation & Resiliency  

  • Scale adoption of tools, technologies, and best practices across sites 
  • Institutionalize experimentation standards, operational rigor, and learning across the regional leadership team 
  • Strengthen regional resiliency through standardized playbooks (e.g. surge, BCP, knowledge governance)  

Stakeholder Leadership  

  • Serve as the regional “go to” for customer operations performance, risks, and initiatives 
  • Bring together WFM, QA, Training, Analytics, Product/Tech, Policy, and Commercial partners to land regionwide solutions 
  • Communicate regional performance, scenarios, and recommendations to senior stakeholders with minimal supervision  

People & Organization Leadership  

  • Lead through Regional Managers and/or Vendor Managers, setting a high bar for performance management and leadership capability 
  • Design and evolve regional org structures, language pools, and shift strategies to meet KPIs 
  • Build successor ready pipelines, enable cross site talent mobility, and develop future senior leaders 
  • Address underperformance decisively, fairly, and in line with Agoda values  

What You’ll Bring  

  • Must have excellent spoken and written Korean skills, and Business level of English
  • Extensive demonstrated experience leading largescale, multisite or multi-country operations 
  • Proven ability to own regional outcomes and manage complexity across markets and partners 
  • Strategic thinking combined with operational execution excellence with strong analytical and experimentation mindset   
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to dive into detail to understand issue complexity, propose actionable plans, and collaborate effectively with stakeholders
  • Advanced stakeholder management and influencing skills, including Senior Leadership exposure 
  • A track record of developing leaders and building resilient organizations  

Nice to Have  

  • Experience managing outsourced/vendor operations at scale
  • Deep exposure to regulatory-complex or high-growth markets

Why Agoda 

  • Hybrid Work 
  • Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives
  • Annual discretionary performance bonus
  • Health insurance and other locally competitive benefits
  • Agoda travel discounts and special rates on accommodation and related products
  • Work from anywhere for up to 30 days per year
  • An inclusive, international work environment where your ideas and feedback are valued
  • Agoda choice(welfare points)
  • $400 USD allowance to set up your home office(one time payment)

Description de l'entreprise

Prêt(e) à donner du sens aux chiffres dans un lieu d'exception ?

Entre la plage, les embruns et l'effervescence d'un complexe hôtelier où chaque journée est différente, nous recherchons notre futur(e) Contrôleur(se) de Gestion.

Au sein du site Novotel / Ibis / Institut Thalassa Le Touquet, vous ne serez pas simplement derrière des tableaux Excel. Vous serez un véritable partenaire de terrain, au cœur de la performance de nos activités hôtelières, de restauration et de bien-être.

Description du poste

Si vous aimez comprendre, analyser, proposer, accompagner et voir concrètement l'impact de votre travail, alors vous pourriez bien être la personne que nous attendons.

Rattaché(e) Au Directeur Administratif Et Financier, Vous Accompagnez Les Équipes Dans Le Pilotage De La Performance De L'établissement. Concrètement, Vous Serez Amené(e) à

  • Suivre la performance du site (hôtellerie, restauration, institut) : analyse des P&L par points de ventes,
  • Assurer le suivi et l'analyse de la cohérence entre achats, stocks et consommations restauration,
  • Suivre et analyser la cohérence des outils de restauration (logiciels INFRASYS et FUTURELOG),
  • Proposer des plans d'actions en fonction de l'évolution des indicateurs des performances site,
  • Analyser et suivre les déchets alimentaires,
  • Assurer le suivi des fiches techniques en collaboration avec le service restauration,
  • Suivre et accompagner les chefs de service pour les procédures d'audit interne,
  • Être le support au service comptabilité notamment en période de clôture, bilan et budget,

  • Remplacer ponctuellement l'économe,
  • Collaborer avec les équipes terrain,
  • Respecter les normes HACCP,
  • Être référent des demandes transversales à l'établissement (clé verte, RGPD, audit, .).

Cette liste n'est pas exhaustive. Parce qu'un complexe vit toute l'année. et évolue sans cesse.

Qualifications

Vous aimez les chiffres, mais vous appréciez surtout les faire parler.

Vous êtes curieux(se), rigoureux(se), organisé(e) et vous aimez aller sur le terrain pour comprendre le fonctionnement d'une activité.

Vous savez travailler en équipe, dialoguer avec des interlocuteurs variés et proposer des solutions concrètes.

Une première expérience en contrôle de gestion, idéalement dans l'hôtellerie, la restauration ou les services, sera naturellement un atout.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Vous évoluez dans un environnement dynamique où l'hôtellerie, la restauration et le bien-être se rencontrent, au sein d'un établissement reconnu et d'un grand groupe international.

  • Prime carburant

  • Avantages du Comité Social et Économique

Et si c'était vous ?

Vous aimez être proche du terrain autant que des chiffres ?

job.job_description:
About The Role

Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) is the world leader in online travel and related services, supporting the entire travel journey. Our platforms, including Booking.com, Priceline, and Agoda, use advanced technology, AI, and machine learning to simplify and personalize travel for consumers and partners in more than 220 countries and territories. Our mission is to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

The Partnerships team drives BKNG’s B2B and B2B2C growth through strategic distribution, business development, and commercial partnerships. In North America, the team manages a diverse portfolio of demand partners across airlines, online travel companies, banks and fintechs, technology platforms, loyalty programs, and other enterprise businesses.

These partnerships help extend the reach of BKNG’s travel products through APIs, branded solutions, template solutions, and other distribution models. The team is responsible for developing, launching, and growing partnerships that generate sustainable BKNG transactions, revenue, margin, and partner and traveler value.

We are seeking a Senior Account Manager to own and grow a portfolio of complex, high-value strategic partners. This person will combine commercial judgment, analytical rigor, partner management, and cross-functional leadership to identify opportunities, solve problems, and deliver measurable business results.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the end-to-end Account Management strategy for a portfolio of complex B2B and B2B2C partners, from onboarding and launch through ongoing optimization and long-term growth.
  • Develop and execute account plans that increase partner production, transactions, revenue, margin, product adoption, and sustainable traveler growth.
  • Lead recurring, data-driven assessments of partner health and performance. Identify risks, growth opportunities, and clear actions to improve results.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders at partner organizations and lead quarterly business reviews and strategic planning discussions.
  • Manage global, multi-market, or otherwise complex partners that require coordination across regions, business models, products, and internal teams.
  • Expand partner adoption of Connected Trip products, including accommodations, flights, rental cars, ground transportation, activities, and rides.
  • Develop a strong understanding of BKNG’s products, integration models, commercial tools, and partner solutions in order to optimize performance and identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities.
  • Create commercially creative partnership structures and customized solutions, including opportunities that fall outside standard models.

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Senior Financial Operations Analyst, B2B Finance Operations

Introduction to the Team

Expedia Group B2B connects partners across the travel industry to our leading technology, supply, and services, helping them deliver seamless travel experiences to their customers. From airlines and hotels to financial institutions and other travel platforms, we power smarter, faster, and more impactful travel solutions through the most connected marketplace in the world.

The B2B Finance Operations team supports the accurate and efficient movement of partner-related financial transactions across our marketplace. This role sits within the Financial Operations job family, which supports transactional commission payments, partner payment operations, and the resolution of financial transaction and system issues across teams and lines of business.

Make an Impact

As a Senior Financial Operations Analyst, you will play a key role in ensuring our B2B partner commission payment operations run smoothly, accurately, and at scale. You will work across internal teams and external partners to resolve complex payment issues, improve operational processes, and strengthen financial controls in support of a fast-moving global business.

In This Role, You Will

  • Manage and optimize day-to-day B2B finance operations activities related to partner payments and transaction processing
  • Investigate and resolve complex payment, reconciliation, and settlement issues across systems, teams, and external partners
  • Analyze operational and financial data to identify trends, root causes, control gaps, and improvement opportunities
  • Partner with stakeholders across Accounting, Finance, Partner Operations, Product, Technology, and commercial teams to improve processes and reduce friction in the partner payment experience
  • Support escalations, reporting, and operational controls to help ensure accuracy, timeliness, and compliance in financial transactions
  • Contribute to process documentation, automation opportunities, and continuous improvement initiatives that improve scale, quality, and partner experience

Experience And Qualifications

  • You have 5+ years of experience in finance operations or accounting
  • You have experience working with high-volume transactional processes, journal entries, reconciliations, exception management, and issue resolution
  • You have experience with general ledger accounting and SOX compliance
  • You have strong analytical skills and are comfortable using data to investigate issues, identify patterns, and recommend practical solutions
  • You communicate clearly and effectively with both internal stakeholders and external partners, including when managing escalations
  • You are highly organized, detail oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • You have experience improving operational processes, strengthening controls, and helping teams work more efficiently
  • You have a bachelor’s degree in Accounting (preferred) or Finance

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior Public Accounting experience
  • You have experience supporting B2B partner payment operations in a travel, marketplace, ecommerce, or global payments environment
  • You have experience working with financial systems, reporting tools, or large transactional datasets
  • You are comfortable working across global teams and navigating ambiguity while maintaining strong judgment and accountability
  • You have experience participating in cross-functional projects involving operational change, systems enhancement, or automation

What Makes This Opportunity Exciting

This role offers the chance to work at the intersection of finance operations, partner experience, and global travel commerce. You will help power the financial operations behind Expedia Group’s B2B marketplace while influencing how we scale partner payments, solve operational challenges, and deliver a better experience for our partners around the world.

The total cash range for this position in Chicago is $76,500.00 to $107,000.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $122,500.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Benefits And Perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life.

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.

About Expedia Group

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

job.job_description:
As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, what's the next step? Start your journey with us!

We're seeking a Senior Product Data Analyst to join our Experiments & Insights team in Barcelona (hybrid) to help different teams across the organization to succeed in their mission by providing insights generation and data analysis support in a healthy data-informed environment. If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.

Why eDreams ODIGEO

We’re the world's leading travel subscription platform.

  • We pioneered Prime, the first and largest travel subscription programme, which has topped over 7.8 million Prime members since launching in 2017.
  • Millions of customers every year across 44 markets – 5 brands: eDreams, GO Voyages, Opodo, Travellink, and the metasearch engine Liligo
  • More than 100 million searches per day on our websites - more than 6 billion AI daily predictions
  • Over 1,700 employees – More than 60 different nationalities from all continents – 99% permanent contracts


Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits. This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalised service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. Our Experiments and Insights team is the centre of excellence for Online (AB) Experimentation and for providing best practices to generate insights and learning from and for the experiments.

In this role, you would be performing as a product data analyst (tasks are described below) to support a set of product teams, but you will be also part of the next experimentation generation at eDreams Odigeo. The team is constantly investigating best in class methodologies and processes to implement in our business/analysis and tests, which means you will be required to apply your mathematical knowledge in some strategic projects that are focused on taking more accurate decisions maintaining a strong statistical confidence level. Your will be working with multi-disciplinary teams - Qualitative Researchers, Designers, Product Owners, Developers, and Pricing Managers - to blend different statistical and data analytics techniques to generate a holistic understanding of the users and markets.

As a Product Data Analyst inside the team, you will be in charge of:

  • Analyse performance and identify behaviours in our different websites and interfaces related to our products;
  • Analyse performance and user behaviours in the A/B Tests experiments or Pre-Post run by the product teams;
  • Help the product teams to generate their testing hypotheses by providing exploratory analysis about our products, past tests, etc,
  • Data cleaning and validation,
  • Definition of new tracking that will all mostly be added in Google Analytics (to be able to answer different kinds of research/product questions);
  • Build and maintain dashboards (mostly using LookerStudio) and/or reports (mostly in Google Sheets) to share performance information with senior management and C-level stakeholders;
  • Lead data-driven initiatives to improve company decision making and business knowledge;
  • Responsible for one or more team’s projects such as the investigation and implementation of new methodologies, new data analysis techniques or the usage of new tools;
  • Collaborate with user researchers and designers to detect gaps in knowledge about our user; identify research opportunities to fill those gaps.
  • NOTE: Data you will be using could come from Google Analytics API or Google Analytics tables in BigQuery, other sources of data stored in BigQuery such as internal databases, customer service database, etc., as well as our data stored and accessible in Microstrategy.


What you need to succeed:

Good to have

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline is a requirement (Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, etc.),
  • Minimum of 6 years experience in a role with strong analytical component,
  • Previous experience in user behavior analysis (product performance) using data from any of the following: Google
  • Analytics/Adobe Analytics/Mix Panel/ Amplitude/Matomo.
  • Strong knowledge of the math and statistical concepts behind A/B testing,
  • Strong knowledge of SQL is a requirement, as well as experience in working with databases and large sets of data,
  • Advanced Office skills. Strong experience with analytical tools, ideally with the Google toolset (spreadsheets, google docs, etc),
  • Knowledge of visualisation tools like LookerStudio, Tableau, Looker or Qlikview,
  • Business Proficiency in English,
  • A self-starter and team player, who also enjoys having fun!


It would be a plus if you have:

  • R or Python programming skills (mostly for data extraction and data manipulation),
  • Google Analytics knowledge (as well as Google Analytics API, googleAnalyticsR library for R, GA4, etc.),
  • Previous experience in programming,
  • Knowledge on data structure and data sets management in Google Cloud Platform.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Applied AI Tools: Demonstrated comfort using practical AI tools such as Gemini, or other AI-powered assistants.
  • Experimentation Mindset: Curiosity and eagerness to explore, experiment with, and integrate emerging AI-driven solutions into workflows.
  • AI-Enhanced Problem Solving: Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to streamline processes, and enhance productivity.
  • Adaptability and Learning Agility: Enthusiastic about continuously learning and quickly adapting to new AI features and capabilities.


What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture. Here's what we offer:

  • A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and premium equipment with role-based selection options and device ownership through our equipment lifecycle program when it reaches its refresh cycle.
  • Continuous learning to fuel your growth and explore new horizons! 📚 Learn and grow with free Coursera access, soft skills workshops, tech training, leadership development, and more. Plus, enjoy a great onboarding program.
  • Grow opportunities to empower your career, and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.
  • Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcome, not time-in-seat. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
  • Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padel tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
  • Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.


Wanna take a peek into what it's like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

Apply now!

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Our people are the key to our success. Each one of them is unique in their own way and the respect for their uniqueness is and will always be a passion and motivation. Don’t meet every requirement? job.job_description:
If you’re looking for the next stamp in your career passport, we’re looking for Sales Travel Consultants across Northern Gold Coast - Southport who are keen to dazzle, discover, and delight our customers!

Are you ready to turn your love of travel into a career that takes you further than you ever imagined personally and professionally? Your Flight Centre journey is uniquely yours - and we’re here to champion it, celebrate it, and help it take flight. As a Flightie you’re not just building a career - you’re shaping a life filled with purpose, connection, and discovery. If you’re looking for the next stamp in careers passport - we’re looking for Sales Travel Consultants across Australia who are keen to dazzle, discover and delight our customers! Navigate your career. Explore the world.

What you’ll be doing - where your passion will meet purpose!

  • Work full-time, on-site in one of our retail stores on a rotating roster across a 7-day trade
  • Plan itineraries, book travel and convert enquiries into bookings in person, over the phone and via email for our customers
  • Work towards individual KPIs and sales targets where you’ll sell the whole holiday including flights, accommodation, car hire, tours, travel insurance, cruises, transfers and more
  • Build a customer base of new and returning customers from regular domestic bookings to lavish international holidays and everything in between
  • Be the expert! Assist our customers with their travel related questions including visas, best time of year to travel, what to pack, where to eat, what to avoid, you name it!
  • Enjoy a base wage plus an uncapped incentive payment structure where you earn a percentage of every sale, your pay is completely uncapped!

What we’re looking for - do you have the travel bug?

  • You’re a seasoned traveller with a history of international destinations (and even more on your bucket list!) and you’re the go-to person in your circle for travel recommendations, tips and tricks
  • Great organisational skills - you’re the type to take notes, manage your calendar well and are quick to respond to your customer’s phone calls and emails
  • Determination to meet your sales targets and KPIs while balancing your workload in a high-pressure environment (think customers lining up, phones ringing, email inbox filling!)
  • Enthusiasm, passion and a warmth that makes our customers want to book with you every time!

job.job_description:
Job Description

最高のホスピタリティは、あなたから始まります。

誰かの1日を明るくする姿を想像してみてください。当ホテルチームの一員になれば、まさに毎日、そんな体験ができるのです！担当する法人顧客の管理、新規事業の開拓、客室、ケータリング、飲食部門からのホテル全体の収益向上、ビジネスニーズへの対応、新たなビジネスチャンスの開拓、そしてプロモーション活動や販売チャネルを通じた既存事業の拡大など、多岐にわたる業務を担当していただきます。セールスマネージャー／アシスタントセールスマネージャー／シニアセールスマネージャーとして、単に団体客の売上を創出し管理するだけでなく、すべてのお客様に忘れられない滞在体験を提供することで、ホスピタリティの温かさと輝きを広げていくのです。

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You will manage designated corporate accounts, develop and solicit new business, drive total hotel revenue from rooms, catering, and F&B outlets, address business needs, explore new opportunities, and expand existing business through promotional efforts and sales channels. As a Sales Manager/Assistant Sales Manager/Senior Sales Manager, you’re not just generating and managing group sales – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

典型的な一日の業務内容は以下のとおりです。

  • 見込み顧客へのホテル代表としての対応：グループルーム、会議室、飲食サービスをお探しの顧客にとって、主要な窓口となります。
  • 新規ビジネス機会の創出：問い合わせへの対応、新規顧客へのアプローチ、見込み客の選定、積極的な営業活動による潜在顧客の獲得を行います。
  • 販売サイクル全体の管理：施設訪問、顧客接待、提案書の作成、料金設定、契約交渉、そして契約履行までのアカウント管理を行います。
  • 戦略的な販売計画の策定：収益目標と客室稼働率目標を達成または上回るための戦略を策定・実行し、業績と市場状況に応じて調整します。
  • 販売実績の分析：失注レポートを評価し、コンバージョン率と競争力を強化する機会を特定します。
  • 卓越したサービス提供のサポート：各部門と連携し、契約サービスの履行を調整し、最高水準の顧客満足度を維持します。
  • チームの育成とモチベーション向上：チームメンバーの監督とサポート、業績のモニタリング、コーチング、そして前向きで生産的な職場環境の醸成を行います。

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Represent the hotel to prospective clients: Serve as the primary point of contact for customers seeking group rooms, meeting space, and food and beverage services
  • Drive new business opportunities: Respond to inquiries, initiate outreach, qualify leads, and solicit potential clients through proactive sales efforts
  • Manage the full sales cycle: Conduct site visits, entertain clients, prepare proposals, determine rates, negotiate contracts, and service accounts through fulfillment
  • Develop strategic sales plans: Create and execute strategies to achieve or exceed revenue and room night goals, adjusting based on performance and market conditions
  • Analyze sales performance: Evaluate lost business reports and identify opportunities to strengthen conversion and competitiveness
  • Support exceptional service delivery: Collaborate across departments to coordinate the fulfillment of contracted services and uphold the highest standards of client satisfaction
  • Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

Qualifications

ヒルトンでは、コアバリューが成功に必要な要素を明確にし、すべてのチームメンバーに求める資質を導きます。

ホスピタリティの光と温かさを広める情熱。誠実に行動し、常に正しいことを行うこと。リーダーシップを通して他者を鼓舞すること。チームワークこそが最良の結果を生み出すという信念。オーナーシップと責任感。そして、今この瞬間に集中し、あらゆる瞬間に迅速さと規律をもって取り組み、それが永続的な影響を与えることを理解すること。

さらに、この職 務には以下の最低限の資格が必要です。

  • ホスピタリティ、ビジネス、または関連分野の学位または卒業証書
  • ホテルにおける法人、MICE、または団体客室販売の実務経験3年以上
  • 収益向上と主要顧客管理における実績
  • 優れた交渉力、プレゼンテーション能力、および関係構築能力
  • ホテルシステム（例：Delphi、Salesforce、OnQ、Market Planner Survey）に関する高度な技術スキル
  • 販売データと市場動向を分析し、戦略策定に役立てる能力
  • 優れたコミュニケーション能力とリーダーシップ、そして協調性

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • Diploma or degree in Hospitality, Business, or related field
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in hotel Corporate, MICE, or Group room sales
  • Proven track record in driving revenue and managing key accounts
  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills
  • Technical proficiency in hotel systems (e.g., Delphi, Salesforce, OnQ, Market Planner Survey)
  • Ability to analyze sales data and market trends to inform strategy
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills with a collaborative mindset

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

Additional Information

Job Number26124521

Location1200 S. Pine Island Road, Suite 500, PLANTATION FL 33324, United States VIEW ON MAP

Job Summary

The Senior Director, Talent – Caribbean & Latin America (CALA) is Marriott’s senior Talent Acquisition leader for the region, responsible for defining and delivering the talent strategy that supports portfolio growth and business success.

This leader serves as a strategic talent advisor to continent leadership, hotel leaders, HR, and business stakeholders, balancing recruiting at scale with proactive pipeline building, leadership capability, and future talent planning.

With a talent advisor mentality, the Senior Director builds external networks, maps critical markets and leadership talent, develops relationships before roles open, personally leads key executive and hard-to-fill searches, and strengthens recruiting capability across diverse markets and cultures.

Beyond Talent Acquisition, this role offers the opportunity to shape CALA’s broader talent agenda, with potential impact across Talent Management, Talent Strategy, workforce planning, and leadership development.

CANDIDATE PROFILE  

Education And Experience

Required Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, HR, Organizational Design, or related field; master’s degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive Talent Acquisition/recruiting experience, with significant experience leading recruiting teams and strategies.
  • Demonstrated experience leading Talent Acquisition across multiple countries, markets, or regions.
  • Proven success recruiting both senior/executive talent and high-volume operational talent.
  • Significant experience with executive search, headhunting, proactive sourcing, and talent mapping.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and business leaders and operate effectively in a complex, matrixed organization.
  • Strong understanding of Talent Acquisition technology, analytics, sourcing tools, and emerging recruiting practices.
  • Experience building or transforming recruiting organizations, processes, capabilities, or operating models.
  • Fluency in English and Spanish.

Preferred Experience

  • Talent Acquisition leadership experience within hospitality, luxury, travel, consumer, retail, or another service-intensive industry.
  • Experience recruiting across both Latin America and the Caribbean.
  • Previous experience with an executive search firm, recruiting agency, or search practice serving hospitality or consumer-facing organizations, combined with in-house corporate Talent Acquisition experience.
  • Experience supporting hotel openings, rapid growth, large-scale hiring, or geographically dispersed operations.
  • Experience partnering with global Talent Acquisition organizations and implementing global recruiting strategies across local markets.
  • Portuguese language proficiency.
  • Experience extending beyond Talent Acquisition into Talent Strategy, Talent Management, workforce planning, or leadership development.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Talent Strategy & Business Partnership

  • Develop and execute a CALA Talent Acquisition strategy aligned with global talent strategy, business priorities, growth, and workforce needs.
  • Serve as senior TA advisor to CALA leadership and senior business and HR leaders.
  • Translate strategy, market conditions, growth, openings, organizational changes, and workforce plans into proactive talent strategies.
  • Anticipate future talent needs and build pipelines before demand emerges.
  • Provide leaders with market intelligence on talent availability, compensation, competitive practices, and workforce trends.
  • Partner with HR and business leaders on workforce planning and critical talent priorities.

Executive Search & Talent Mapping

  • Lead and personally engage in critical executive, senior leadership, GM, and hard-to-fill searches across CALA.
  • Build external talent networks across hospitality and adjacent industries, including luxury, travel, consumer, retail, and service-intensive businesses.
  • Build proactive talent maps and pipelines for critical leadership and high-demand roles in priority markets.
  • Develop sourcing strategies beyond traditional postings and applicant-driven recruiting.
  • Build relationships with passive talent and long-term talent communities for future needs.
  • Determine when to use internal recruiting, search firms, agencies, or other external talent partners.
  • Build strong relationships with search firms and recruiting partners to secure high-quality, market-informed support when needed.

Recruiting Leadership & Delivery

  • Lead and develop the CALA TA organization with clear priorities, expectations, operating rhythms, and accountability.
  • Ensure recruiting supports both high-volume hiring and targeted leadership and professional recruitment.
  • Create a culture of speed, quality, proactive sourcing, candidate engagement, partnership, and continuous improvement.
  • Coach recruiting leaders and recruiters to strengthen consultative, sourcing, assessment, and stakeholder-management capabilities.
  • Tailor recruiting strategies by market, business need, talent segment, and role criticality.
  • Equip teams to support openings, growth, transitions, critical vacancies, and other business priorities.
  • Monitor recruiting performance and act quickly when outcomes, quality, or service levels fall short.

Global TA Partnership & Transformation

  • Partner with Global TA to implement and scale global strategies, programs, processes, and capabilities across CALA.
  • Represent CALA in shaping global recruiting solutions that fit local cultural, regulatory, and market dynamics.
  • Drive adoption of global recruiting technology, AI capabilities, sourcing tools, assessments, and processes across the continent.
  • Simplify, automate, standardize, and improve recruiting processes while preserving local-market flexibility.
  • Partner with Global TA Technology, Operations, Strategy, and Experience to improve the end-to-end recruiting experience.
  • Champion recruiting innovation and emerging practices that create competitive advantage for Marriott.

Data, Analytics & Operational Excellence

  • Set clear TA performance measures and use data to guide decisions, resources, and outcomes.
  • Track time to fill, quality of hire, source effectiveness, conversion, pipeline health, satisfaction, productivity, and cost effectiveness.
  • Use market data and analytics to identify risks, skill shortages, geographic talent challenges, and opportunities.
  • Build fact-based insights on CALA talent markets to influence business and workforce decisions.
  • Drive continuous improvement in processes, operating models, sourcing strategies, and resource allocation.

Candidate & Stakeholder Experience

  • Champion a high-quality candidate experience that reflects Marriott’s brand and resonates in CALA markets.
  • Partner with Employer Brand and Global TA to strengthen Marriott’s reputation as an employer of choice across CALA.
  • Build trusted relationships with GMs, senior leaders, HR leaders, and hiring managers throughout the hiring process.
  • Set consistent expectations for intake, assessment, communication, selection, and offers, with appropriate local flexibility.
  • Ensure candidates see Marriott as a compelling destination, especially for senior and hard-to-attract talent.

Compliance, Governance & Risk

  • Ensure TA practices comply with country employment laws, Marriott policies, and global recruiting standards.
  • Partner with HR, Legal, and stakeholders to manage country-specific recruiting requirements and risks.
  • Establish governance for search firms, vendors, assessments, candidate data, and recruiting practices.
  • Maintain controls and consistency across markets while recognizing CALA’s regulatory and cultural differences.

Leading Talent Acquisition

  • Build a high-performing, inclusive, collaborative CALA Talent Acquisition organization.
  • Attract, retain, and develop strong recruiting talent and future Talent leaders.
  • Develop recruiters beyond transactional recruiting into strategic sourcing, advisory, executive recruiting, and business partnership.
  • Build a strong leadership bench and succession pipeline within CALA Talent.
  • Model Marriott leadership principles and empower teams to take ownership, challenge convention, and deliver results.

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Marriott International is the world’s largest hotel company, with more brands, more hotels and more opportunities for associates to grow and succeed. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.

job.job_description:
Wyndham Frankfurt Niederrad is looking for a Sales Manager!


SUMMARY


The Sales Manager is responsible for generating room, meeting, event, and ancillary revenue by identifying new business opportunities, developing client relationships, and maintaining existing accounts. The role focuses on driving corporate, group, MICE, leisure, and local business through proactive sales activities and implementing sales initiatives that support the hotel's commercial objectives.


Working closely with the General Manager, Revenue Management, Operations, and Wyndham commercial teams, the Sales Manager contributes to delivering revenue growth, market share, occupancy, guest satisfaction, and loyalty objectives.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Business Development & Sales Activities

  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities within the corporate, leisure, group, MICE, and local market segments.
  • Conduct regular sales calls, client meetings, presentations, and site inspections.
  • Develop and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective business opportunities.
  • Build relationships with local companies, associations, event planners, and travel partners.
  • Actively seek opportunities to increase market share and hotel visibility within the local market.
  • Participate in networking events, trade shows, and sales missions as required.


Account Management

  • Maintain and develop relationships with existing corporate and agency accounts.
  • Conduct regular business reviews with key clients.
  • Respond promptly to sales enquiries, RFPs, and lead opportunities.
  • Prepare proposals, quotations, and contracts in line with company guidelines.
  • Negotiate rates and business opportunities within approved parameters.
  • Ensure accurate account information and sales activities are maintained within CRM systems and Wyndham platforms.


Revenue Generation

  • Drive transient, corporate, group, conference, and leisure business.
  • Support achievement of hotel occupancy, ADR, and revenue targets.
  • Work closely with Revenue Management to maximise revenue opportunities.
  • Track account production and identify opportunities for growth.
  • Promote all hotel facilities, including guest rooms, meeting space, food and beverage outlets, and special packages.


Commercial Collaboration

  • Participate in weekly commercial and forecast meetings.
  • Work closely with Operations teams to ensure successful delivery of contracted business.
  • Coordinate with Revenue Management regarding pricing strategies, market opportunities, and demand trends.
  • Collaborate with Marketing on local promotions, events, and lead-generation activities.


Client & Community Relations

  • Represent the hotel professionally within the local business community.
  • Develop relationships with:
  • Corporate clients
  • Travel management companies
  • Local businesses
  • Event organisers
  • Tourism organisations
  • Chambers of commerce
  • Sports and social associations
  • Promote awareness of the hotel and Wyndham brand within the region.


Reporting & Administration

  • Maintain accurate sales records and account plans.
  • Produce weekly and monthly sales activity reports.
  • Monitor key performance indicators including:
  • Revenue production
  • Account performance
  • Sales calls
  • Lead conversion
  • Business mix
  • Provide market intelligence and competitor feedback to management.
  • Ensure timely completion of all administrative and reporting requirements.


Brand Compliance

  • Ensure all sales activities align with Wyndham brand standards and commercial strategies.
  • Support Wyndham Rewards and other brand initiatives.
  • Maintain compliance with company policies, procedures, and reporting requirements.
  • Represent Wyndham Hotels & Resorts professionally at all times.


It is not the intent of this Job Description to cover all aspects of the position but to highlight the most important areas of responsibility.


KEY COMPETENCIES


Alongside the fundamentals of the brand service culture, the incumbent will be required to demonstrate the competencies below:


  • Commercial Awareness
  • Business Development
  • Communication & Influencing
  • Negotiation Skills
  • Presentation skills
  • Relationship Management
  • Service Excellence
  • Building Trust
  • Planning & Organisation
  • Customer Focus
  • Driving Results
  • Strategic Thinking
  • Flexibility & Adaptability
  • Teamwork & Collaboration
  • Agility
  • Accountability


BACKGROUND


  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Hospitality Management, Marketing, or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in hotel sales, business development, or a similar commercial role.
  • Experience within an international branded hotel environment is highly desirable.
  • Experience handling corporate, group, MICE, and leisure segments preferred.
  • Sound understanding of hotel sales principles and market dynamics.
  • Experience using CRM systems and sales tracking tools.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
  • Fluent German and professional English language skills are required.
  • Eligibility to work in Germany.

Job Overview And Responsibilities

This role is crucial in translating complex data into actionable insights that inform business strategy, optimize operations, and drive growth. The Data Analytics Manager will be responsible for overseeing the entire analytics lifecycle, from data collection and processing to analysis, reporting, and presentation of findings to stakeholders across various departments.

  • Responsible for the prioritization and planning efforts for the data engineering team spanning across multiple domains
  • Partner with key stakeholders to understand their data needs, define key performance indicators (KPIs), and translate business questions into analytical problems
  • Design, develop, and implement analytical frameworks, models, and dashboards to extract meaningful insights from large, complex datasets
  • Manage dependencies and set priorities across multiple domains to maintain alignment to the Product release vision and roadmap
  • Conduct in-depth analyses to identify trends, patterns, and root causes, providing data-driven recommendations to improve business performance
  • Collaborate with data governance and application development teams to ensure data quality, integrity, and accessibility
  • Responsible for tasks related to development/production readiness, product demo and user acceptance
  • Develop and present clear, concise, and compelling reports, visualizations, and presentations to various audiences, including senior leadership

Qualifications

What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):

  • Bachelor's degree in Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Technology, or equivalent in computer science or related STEM field
  • 3+ years of total IT experience as either a Product Owner/Business Data Analyst or as a Software Engineer
  • 3+ years of overall Data Analytics / Engineering experience in either AWS or Azure Cloud environments
  • 3+ years of experience with Big Data technologies like PySpark, DataBricks, Palantir Foundry, Kafka, Redshift, etc.
  • 3+ years of experience with relational database systems like MS SQL Server, Oracle, Teradata
  • Experience with Visualization tools such as Power-BI, Spotfire, OBIEE, BO, Cognos, Quicksight etc
  • Knowledge of data analysis and big data
  • Requirements gathering and stakeholder collaboration skills
  • Ability to create product roadmaps and prioritize features
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum-based development methodologies
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to work in fast-paced, iterative development environments
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without sponsorship
  • Successful completion of interview required to meet job qualification
  • Reliable, punctual attendance is an essential function of the position

What will help you propel from the pack (Preferred Qualifications):

  • AWS Certification
  • 5+ years of total IT experience as either a Product Owner/Business Data Analyst or as a Software Engineer
  • Strong experience with continuous integration & delivery using Agile methodologies
  • Experience with transportation/airline industry

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About The Team  

Agoda’s Customer Experience Group delivers critical support to customers and partners across markets, channels, and business lines. As our operations scale in complexity, Senior Regional Managers play a pivotal role in ensuring regional resiliency, standardization, and sustained performance across multiple sites and partners.  

 

About The Role  

The Senior Regional Manager is accountable for end-to-end performance of a regional customer/partner operations area, typically spanning multiple countries, sites, or vendor partners. This role translates company strategy into a cohesive regional roadmap, balances cross site tradeoffs, and ensures consistent, high quality service delivery at scale.  

You will act as the regional authority on customer operations performance, risks, and improvement initiatives, while developing strong leadership benches and resilient operating models.  

Key Responsibilities  

Regional & Operational Ownership 

  • Lead multi-site, multi-country customer operations (including inhouse and BPO partners where applicable) 
  • Own end to end regional outcomes, including service quality, efficiency, resiliency, and cost to serve 
  • Balance cross site tradeoffs across capacity, language coverage, channel mix, routing, and vendor strategy   

Strategy & Roadmap  

  • Translate CEG strategy into a 12–18 month regional roadmap, prioritizing initiatives that deliver measurable customer and business impact 
  • Anticipate demand shifts (seasonality, launches, policy or regulatory changes) and lead proactive regional adjustments 
  • Sponsor and govern cross site initiatives to ensure consistency and scalability  

Improvement, Innovation & Resiliency  

  • Scale adoption of tools, technologies, and best practices across sites 
  • Institutionalize experimentation standards, operational rigor, and learning across the regional leadership team 
  • Strengthen regional resiliency through standardized playbooks (e.g. surge, BCP, knowledge governance)  

Stakeholder Leadership  

  • Serve as the regional “go to” for customer operations performance, risks, and initiatives 
  • Bring together WFM, QA, Training, Analytics, Product/Tech, Policy, and Commercial partners to land regionwide solutions 
  • Communicate regional performance, scenarios, and recommendations to senior stakeholders with minimal supervision  

People & Organization Leadership  

  • Lead through Regional Managers and/or Vendor Managers, setting a high bar for performance management and leadership capability 
  • Design and evolve regional org structures, language pools, and shift strategies to meet KPIs 
  • Build successor ready pipelines, enable cross site talent mobility, and develop future senior leaders 
  • Address underperformance decisively, fairly, and in line with Agoda values  

What You’ll Bring  

  • Must have excellent spoken and written Korean skills, and Business level of English
  • Extensive demonstrated experience leading largescale, multisite or multi-country operations 
  • Proven ability to own regional outcomes and manage complexity across markets and partners 
  • Strategic thinking combined with operational execution excellence with strong analytical and experimentation mindset   
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to dive into detail to understand issue complexity, propose actionable plans, and collaborate effectively with stakeholders
  • Advanced stakeholder management and influencing skills, including Senior Leadership exposure 
  • A track record of developing leaders and building resilient organizations  

Nice to Have  

  • Experience managing outsourced/vendor operations at scale
  • Deep exposure to regulatory-complex or high-growth markets

Why Agoda 

  • Hybrid Work 
  • Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives
  • Annual discretionary performance bonus
  • Health insurance and other locally competitive benefits
  • Agoda travel discounts and special rates on accommodation and related products
  • Work from anywhere for up to 30 days per year
  • An inclusive, international work environment where your ideas and feedback are valued
  • Agoda choice(welfare points)
  • $400 USD allowance to set up your home office(one time payment)

job.job_description:
Booking.com is seeking a Fintech Commercial Lead to support the execution of our US Fintech strategy across the US brand portfolio of Booking Holdings (BKNG), which includes Booking.com, Priceline, and OpenTable. The role will focus on driving commercial margin contribution through Fintech commercial solutions and products.

This role will focus on translating complex priorities into tangible commercial impact, including incremental financial contribution, cost savings, improved payment economics, and financially accretive initiatives. Reporting directly to the Head of Fintech US Commercial, you will work closely with Fintech senior stakeholders, US brand teams, Product, Legal, Finance, Treasury, Fraud, Operations, and external partners to identify, prioritize, and execute opportunities that improve performance across the US market.

The ideal candidate brings strong experience in strategy, commercial partnerships, business growth, and payments, with the ability to move from analysis and business cases to cross-functional execution.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Execute the US Fintech Strategy: Support the execution of the US Fintech strategy across BKNG US brands, translating priorities into clear workstreams, business cases, and delivery plans.
  • Drive Commercial Margin Contribution: Identify and support initiatives that deliver incremental financial contribution, unlock cost savings, and improve payment economics for BKNG’s financial results in the US market.
  • Scale Fintech Commercial Solutions: Help assess, and execute Fintech solutions and products that deliver value for BKNG brands, customers, partners, and suppliers.
  • Unlock Value Through Partnerships: Identify and support commercial opportunities with strategic partners, including card networks, PSPs, and Fintech providers, with a focus on value beyond core payments where relevant.
  • Align Stakeholders and Drive Execution: Collaborate with Product, Legal, Finance, Treasury, Fraud, Operations, and US brand teams to align priorities, remove blockers, and deliver measurable outcomes.
  • Deliver Executive Communication: Prepare concise executive updates, business cases, and strategic recommendations that translate complex Fintech and payments topics into clear commercial decisions.


What You'll Bring:

job.job_description:
Are you ready to turn your love of travel into a career that takes you further than you ever imagined personally and professionally? Your Flight Centre journey is uniquely yours - and we’re here to champion it, celebrate it, and help it take flight. As a Flightie you’re not just building a career - you’re shaping a life filled with purpose, connection, and discovery. If you’re looking for the next stamp in careers passport - we’re looking for Sales Travel Consultants across Australia who are keen to dazzle, discover and delight our customers! Navigate your career. Explore the world.

What you’ll be doing - where your passion will meet purpose!

  • Work full-time, on-site in one of our retail stores on a rotating roster across a 7-day trade
  • Plan itineraries, book travel and convert enquiries into bookings in person, over the phone and via email for our customers
  • Work towards individual KPIs and sales targets where you’ll sell the whole holiday including flights, accommodation, car hire, tours, travel insurance, cruises, transfers and more
  • Build a customer base of new and returning customers from regular domestic bookings to lavish international holidays and everything in between
  • Be the expert! Assist our customers with their travel related questions including visas, best time of year to travel, what to pack, where to eat, what to avoid, you name it!
  • Enjoy a base wage plus an uncapped incentive payment structure where you earn a percentage of every sale, your pay is completely uncapped!

What we’re looking for - do you have the travel bug?

  • You’re a seasoned traveller with a history of international destinations (and even more on your bucket list!) and you’re the go-to person in your circle for travel recommendations, tips and tricks
  • Great organisational skills - you’re the type to take notes, manage your calendar well and are quick to respond to your customer’s phone calls and emails
  • Determination to meet your sales targets and KPIs while balancing your workload in a high-pressure environment (think customers lining up, phones ringing, email inbox filling!)
  • Enthusiasm, passion and a warmth that makes our customers want to book with you every time!
  • A savviness with computers, ready to toggle between various complex systems when finding the right flight and package options for your customer

What you will gain from a career with Flight Centre - let’s unpack the benefits!

💲 We'll boost your wage to $65K equivalent for your first 90 days while you learn the ropes! Average earnings for a Travel Consultant in their first year are $70K, while Senior Consultants average $100K and Team Leaders average $138K annually - including superannuation and penalty rates.

🌏 Become a true expert – access industry travel discounts and qualify for sponsored ‘Familiarisation Trips’ to explore new destinations and products around the world 

💎 Brightness of Future: Career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses across the globe - we promote from within   

🎉 Social: Embrace the famous Flight Centre culture at our Reward & Recognition events throughout the year including our most popular events on the calendar Global Gathering and EOFY Celebration

🎓 Get qualified for free with a Certificate 3 & 4 in Travel & Tourism (worth 20k!) through Australian Apprentice Training - you may also be eligible to receive direct financial support while you study 

🌈 Thrive in a workplace that embraces individualism – come as you are!  

💛 Be part of a workplace committed to reconciliation through our Reconciliation Action Plan - we proudly support Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander inclusion, cultural safety, and dedicated cultural leave

Okay, I’m in!

Are you keen to join our team of Flighties? Hit apply now for your application to be read by a real human, no AI here! If your application is successful, you’ll be invited to have a 15-minute phone interview with one of our dedicated team of recruiters. Get ready to work, travel and grow.

Why is Flight Centre such a great place to work?

We are devoted to being a global employer of choice by nurturing our legendary culture - focused on our people and infused with adventure and accountability. We uplift and support our team through a compelling Employee Value Proposition that offers exciting career and travel opportunities, fantastic benefits, a meaningful sense of purpose and well-deserved recognition. Explore us on LinkedIn or check out our careers page at www.fctgcareers.com
