About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About The Team  

Agoda’s Customer Experience Group delivers critical support to customers and partners across markets, channels, and business lines. As our operations scale in complexity, Senior Regional Managers play a pivotal role in ensuring regional resiliency, standardization, and sustained performance across multiple sites and partners.  

 

About The Role  

The Senior Regional Manager is accountable for end-to-end performance of a regional customer/partner operations area, typically spanning multiple countries, sites, or vendor partners. This role translates company strategy into a cohesive regional roadmap, balances cross site tradeoffs, and ensures consistent, high quality service delivery at scale.  

You will act as the regional authority on customer operations performance, risks, and improvement initiatives, while developing strong leadership benches and resilient operating models.  

Key Responsibilities  

Regional & Operational Ownership 

  • Lead multi-site, multi-country customer operations (including inhouse and BPO partners where applicable) 
  • Own end to end regional outcomes, including service quality, efficiency, resiliency, and cost to serve 
  • Balance cross site tradeoffs across capacity, language coverage, channel mix, routing, and vendor strategy   

Strategy & Roadmap  

  • Translate CEG strategy into a 12–18 month regional roadmap, prioritizing initiatives that deliver measurable customer and business impact 
  • Anticipate demand shifts (seasonality, launches, policy or regulatory changes) and lead proactive regional adjustments 
  • Sponsor and govern cross site initiatives to ensure consistency and scalability  

Improvement, Innovation & Resiliency  

  • Scale adoption of tools, technologies, and best practices across sites 
  • Institutionalize experimentation standards, operational rigor, and learning across the regional leadership team 
  • Strengthen regional resiliency through standardized playbooks (e.g. surge, BCP, knowledge governance)  

Stakeholder Leadership  

  • Serve as the regional “go to” for customer operations performance, risks, and initiatives 
  • Bring together WFM, QA, Training, Analytics, Product/Tech, Policy, and Commercial partners to land regionwide solutions 
  • Communicate regional performance, scenarios, and recommendations to senior stakeholders with minimal supervision  

People & Organization Leadership  

  • Lead through Regional Managers and/or Vendor Managers, setting a high bar for performance management and leadership capability 
  • Design and evolve regional org structures, language pools, and shift strategies to meet KPIs 
  • Build successor ready pipelines, enable cross site talent mobility, and develop future senior leaders 
  • Address underperformance decisively, fairly, and in line with Agoda values  

What You’ll Bring  

  • Must have excellent spoken and written Korean skills, and Business level of English
  • Extensive demonstrated experience leading largescale, multisite or multi-country operations 
  • Proven ability to own regional outcomes and manage complexity across markets and partners 
  • Strategic thinking combined with operational execution excellence with strong analytical and experimentation mindset   
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to dive into detail to understand issue complexity, propose actionable plans, and collaborate effectively with stakeholders
  • Advanced stakeholder management and influencing skills, including Senior Leadership exposure 
  • A track record of developing leaders and building resilient organizations  

Nice to Have  

  • Experience managing outsourced/vendor operations at scale
  • Deep exposure to regulatory-complex or high-growth markets

Why Agoda 

  • Hybrid Work 
  • Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives
  • Annual discretionary performance bonus
  • Health insurance and other locally competitive benefits
  • Agoda travel discounts and special rates on accommodation and related products
  • Work from anywhere for up to 30 days per year
  • An inclusive, international work environment where your ideas and feedback are valued
  • Agoda choice(welfare points)
  • $400 USD allowance to set up your home office(one time payment)

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know Our Team

The Strategic Partnerships team is responsible for identifying, building, and scaling high-impact partnerships that expand Agoda’s reach, improve customer acquisition, and create long-term business value.

For Japan, Financial Institution (FI) partnerships represent a strategic growth channel. This role will focus on developing and managing relationships with banks, card issuers, digital wallets, and other financial ecosystem partners to drive customer engagement, commercial growth, and win-win partnership outcomes.

You will work cross-functionally with teams across Commercial, Marketing, Product, Finance, Legal, Analytics, and Operations to bring partnership opportunities from idea to execution and optimization.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships to lead Agoda’s Japan FI partnership strategy and execution.

In this role, you will be responsible for identifying new partnership opportunities, managing key strategic accounts, negotiating commercial agreements, and driving performance across Agoda’s financial institution partnerships in Japan. You will help shape Agoda’s local partnership roadmap, unlock joint business opportunities, and ensure excellent execution of campaigns and initiatives with partners.

The ideal candidate brings strong business development and partnership experience, sharp commercial judgment, analytical rigor, and the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders. This role requires someone who is highly strategic but also willing to work hands-on to deliver measurable outcomes.

Why This Role Matters

This role is critical to Agoda’s growth in Japan. Financial institution partnerships are a highly strategic channel that can unlock scalable customer demand, deepen brand presence, and create differentiated value for travelers and partners alike.

As Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships, you will play a central role in shaping Agoda’s FI ecosystem in Japan and delivering high-impact partnerships that drive sustainable business growth.

What You’ll Do

Partnership Strategy & Business Development

  • Define and drive Agoda’s FI partnership strategy for Japan, aligned with market priorities and business growth objectives
  • Identify, evaluate, and prioritize new partnership opportunities with banks, credit card issuers, payment platforms, loyalty programs, and other financial ecosystem players
  • Build compelling partnership value propositions and business cases to secure internal alignment and partner buy-in
  • Lead commercial discussions, negotiations, and contract execution with prospective and existing FI partners

Account Management & Growth

  • Own and grow a portfolio of key FI partners in Japan, ensuring strong relationship management and long-term strategic alignment
  • Develop joint business plans with partners to drive customer acquisition, transaction growth, brand visibility, and partnership profitability
  • Monitor partner performance and proactively identify growth levers, optimization opportunities, and operational improvements
  • Ensure timely execution of campaigns, product integrations, and partner initiatives

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Analytics, Finance, Legal, and Operations to launch and scale partnership initiatives
  • Translate partner needs into clear internal requirements and drive execution across multiple teams
  • Influence decision-making through strong communication, stakeholder management, and data-backed recommendations
  • Support process improvements, reporting frameworks, and operating models to improve scalability and partner experience

Analytics & Optimization

  • Analyze partnership performance, customer behavior, campaign effectiveness, and commercial outcomes to generate actionable insights
  • Use data to identify trends, optimize investment decisions, and improve partnership ROI
  • Build business cases for new initiatives and present recommendations to senior stakeholders
  • Track key success metrics and maintain clear visibility on pipeline, performance, and impact

Experience

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • 7+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, account management, consulting, or a related commercial role
  • Strong experience managing external partners and driving commercial outcomes in a fast-paced, data-driven environment
  • Experience working with or within financial institutions, payment companies, loyalty ecosystems, or digital consumer platforms is highly preferred
  • Experience in e-commerce, travel, fintech, payments, or internet platforms is a strong plus
  • Proven track record of leading cross-functional initiatives from concept through execution

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to structure win-win partnerships and negotiate effectively
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to convert data into clear business insights and actions
  • Strong project management capabilities with high attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience influencing senior internal and external stakeholders
  • Self-starter with a bias for action and ability to operate independently in an ambiguous environment
  • Comfortable working hands-on while also thinking strategically

Technical / Functional

  • Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience with SQL, Tableau, or data visualization tools is a plus
  • Ability to develop business cases, commercial models, and performance reporting frameworks
  • Familiarity with campaign execution, co-marketing partnerships, loyalty mechanics, or payment-related partnership models is beneficial

Language

  • Fluency in English and Japanese is required

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team:

Supply is a team of creative entrepreneurs that develop solutions for Agoda’s accommodation partners and promote Agoda’s top and bottom-line growth. We design tailored business and product solutions with our partners and help them generate measurable value. Members of our team are empowered and supported to grow their market(s) or accounts. We develop win-win relationships and leverage Agoda’s unique accommodations portfolio and tech solutions to bring our partners the advantages they seek. Utilizing our strong brand and resources, we roll out new product to increase the visibility of Agoda, introduce more travelers to our great products and service and deliver significant revenues to the overall business.

The Opportunity:

As a Strategic Account Manager your key objective is to grow the coverage and quality of Agoda’s supply network by remotely managing a portfolio of hotel partners in Japan. You will be responsible for maximizing partner engagement, driving portfolio performance, and improving supply metrics through digital-first account management at scale.

In this role, you’ll get to:

  • Identify, pitch and build new supplier relationships for Agoda focusing on the B2B and wholesale market
  • Introduce and explain the strategic benefits of the new B2B solution product
  • Grow bookings, revenues and gross profit of assigned hotel partners
  • Using data to develop business solutions and maximize Agoda’s accommodation availability, content competitiveness and business growth for the hotel partners
  • Evaluate existing partnerships and determine if any actions needed to optimize the performance. Identify, prioritize, negotiate, contract and onboard non-participatory hotels, ensuring favorable terms and conditions.
  • Formulate project ideas, determine where opportunity exists and implement new approaches.
  • Work in a data-driven environment
  • Research and troubleshoot rate and availability issues to help hotels maximize their booking performance; e.g., problems with connectivity, rate mapping, extranet management, etc.
  • Prepare pitch presentations and materials
  • Manage regular weekly/monthly supplier and internal reports

What you’ll need to succeed:

  • Minimum 5 years’ experience in account management, business development, or supply/e-commerce role.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to influence external/internal stakeholders.
  • Think out-of-the-box to develop and implement solutions for unique challenges when negotiating with hotel partners
  • Ability to drive insights out of data and articulate the findings
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint
  • A team player with a professional “get it done” attitude and work ethic.
  • Strong prioritization and planning skills; must be comfortable with making trade-offs.
  • Curiosity to learn and willingness to try new approaches. Comfortable in a two-way feedback culture.
  • Adapts well to and is energized by change

It’s Great if you Have:

  • B2B and wholesale markets experience preferred
  • Experience in hotel or travel industry, especially OTA channels preferred, but not necessary

#Japan #Tokyo

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About The Team  

Agoda’s Customer Experience Group delivers critical support to customers and partners across markets, channels, and business lines. As our operations scale in complexity, Senior Regional Managers play a pivotal role in ensuring regional resiliency, standardization, and sustained performance across multiple sites and partners.  

 

About The Role  

The Senior Regional Manager is accountable for end-to-end performance of a regional customer/partner operations area, typically spanning multiple countries, sites, or vendor partners. This role translates company strategy into a cohesive regional roadmap, balances cross site tradeoffs, and ensures consistent, high quality service delivery at scale.  

You will act as the regional authority on customer operations performance, risks, and improvement initiatives, while developing strong leadership benches and resilient operating models.  

Key Responsibilities  

Regional & Operational Ownership 

  • Lead multi-site, multi-country customer operations (including inhouse and BPO partners where applicable) 
  • Own end to end regional outcomes, including service quality, efficiency, resiliency, and cost to serve 
  • Balance cross site tradeoffs across capacity, language coverage, channel mix, routing, and vendor strategy   

Strategy & Roadmap  

  • Translate CEG strategy into a 12–18 month regional roadmap, prioritizing initiatives that deliver measurable customer and business impact 
  • Anticipate demand shifts (seasonality, launches, policy or regulatory changes) and lead proactive regional adjustments 
  • Sponsor and govern cross site initiatives to ensure consistency and scalability  

Improvement, Innovation & Resiliency  

  • Scale adoption of tools, technologies, and best practices across sites 
  • Institutionalize experimentation standards, operational rigor, and learning across the regional leadership team 
  • Strengthen regional resiliency through standardized playbooks (e.g. surge, BCP, knowledge governance)  

Stakeholder Leadership  

  • Serve as the regional “go to” for customer operations performance, risks, and initiatives 
  • Bring together WFM, QA, Training, Analytics, Product/Tech, Policy, and Commercial partners to land regionwide solutions 
  • Communicate regional performance, scenarios, and recommendations to senior stakeholders with minimal supervision  

People & Organization Leadership  

  • Lead through Regional Managers and/or Vendor Managers, setting a high bar for performance management and leadership capability 
  • Design and evolve regional org structures, language pools, and shift strategies to meet KPIs 
  • Build successor ready pipelines, enable cross site talent mobility, and develop future senior leaders 
  • Address underperformance decisively, fairly, and in line with Agoda values  

What You’ll Bring  

  • Must have excellent spoken and written Korean skills, and Business level of English
  • Extensive demonstrated experience leading largescale, multisite or multi-country operations 
  • Proven ability to own regional outcomes and manage complexity across markets and partners 
  • Strategic thinking combined with operational execution excellence with strong analytical and experimentation mindset   
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to dive into detail to understand issue complexity, propose actionable plans, and collaborate effectively with stakeholders
  • Advanced stakeholder management and influencing skills, including Senior Leadership exposure 
  • A track record of developing leaders and building resilient organizations  

Nice to Have  

  • Experience managing outsourced/vendor operations at scale
  • Deep exposure to regulatory-complex or high-growth markets

Why Agoda 

  • Hybrid Work 
  • Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives
  • Annual discretionary performance bonus
  • Health insurance and other locally competitive benefits
  • Agoda travel discounts and special rates on accommodation and related products
  • Work from anywhere for up to 30 days per year
  • An inclusive, international work environment where your ideas and feedback are valued
  • Agoda choice(welfare points)
  • $400 USD allowance to set up your home office(one time payment)

Résumé

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About The Team  

Agoda’s Customer Experience Group delivers critical support to customers and partners across markets, channels, and business lines. As our operations scale in complexity, Senior Regional Managers play a pivotal role in ensuring regional resiliency, standardization, and sustained performance across multiple sites and partners.  

 

About The Role  

The Senior Regional Manager is accountable for end-to-end performance of a regional customer/partner operations area, typically spanning multiple countries, sites, or vendor partners. This role translates company strategy into a cohesive regional roadmap, balances cross site tradeoffs, and ensures consistent, high quality service delivery at scale.  

You will act as the regional authority on customer operations performance, risks, and improvement initiatives, while developing strong leadership benches and resilient operating models.  

Key Responsibilities  

Regional & Operational Ownership 

  • Lead multi-site, multi-country customer operations (including inhouse and BPO partners where applicable) 
  • Own end to end regional outcomes, including service quality, efficiency, resiliency, and cost to serve 
  • Balance cross site tradeoffs across capacity, language coverage, channel mix, routing, and vendor strategy   

Strategy & Roadmap  

  • Translate CEG strategy into a 12–18 month regional roadmap, prioritizing initiatives that deliver measurable customer and business impact 
  • Anticipate demand shifts (seasonality, launches, policy or regulatory changes) and lead proactive regional adjustments 
  • Sponsor and govern cross site initiatives to ensure consistency and scalability  

Improvement, Innovation & Resiliency  

  • Scale adoption of tools, technologies, and best practices across sites 
  • Institutionalize experimentation standards, operational rigor, and learning across the regional leadership team 
  • Strengthen regional resiliency through standardized playbooks (e.g. surge, BCP, knowledge governance)  

Stakeholder Leadership  

  • Serve as the regional “go to” for customer operations performance, risks, and initiatives 
  • Bring together WFM, QA, Training, Analytics, Product/Tech, Policy, and Commercial partners to land regionwide solutions 
  • Communicate regional performance, scenarios, and recommendations to senior stakeholders with minimal supervision  

People & Organization Leadership  

  • Lead through Regional Managers and/or Vendor Managers, setting a high bar for performance management and leadership capability 
  • Design and evolve regional org structures, language pools, and shift strategies to meet KPIs 
  • Build successor ready pipelines, enable cross site talent mobility, and develop future senior leaders 
  • Address underperformance decisively, fairly, and in line with Agoda values  

What You’ll Bring  

  • Must have excellent spoken and written Korean skills, and Business level of English
  • Extensive demonstrated experience leading largescale, multisite or multi-country operations 
  • Proven ability to own regional outcomes and manage complexity across markets and partners 
  • Strategic thinking combined with operational execution excellence with strong analytical and experimentation mindset   
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to dive into detail to understand issue complexity, propose actionable plans, and collaborate effectively with stakeholders
  • Advanced stakeholder management and influencing skills, including Senior Leadership exposure 
  • A track record of developing leaders and building resilient organizations  

Nice to Have  

  • Experience managing outsourced/vendor operations at scale
  • Deep exposure to regulatory-complex or high-growth markets

Why Agoda 

  • Hybrid Work 
  • Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives
  • Annual discretionary performance bonus
  • Health insurance and other locally competitive benefits
  • Agoda travel discounts and special rates on accommodation and related products
  • Work from anywhere for up to 30 days per year
  • An inclusive, international work environment where your ideas and feedback are valued
  • Agoda choice(welfare points)
  • $400 USD allowance to set up your home office(one time payment)

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team:

Supply is a team of creative entrepreneurs that develop solutions for Agoda’s accommodation partners and promote Agoda’s top and bottom-line growth. We design tailored business and product solutions with our partners and help them generate measurable value. Members of our team are empowered and supported to grow their market(s) or accounts. We develop win-win relationships and leverage Agoda’s unique accommodations portfolio and tech solutions to bring our partners the advantages they seek. Utilizing our strong brand and resources, we roll out new product to increase the visibility of Agoda, introduce more travelers to our great products and service and deliver significant revenues to the overall business.

The Opportunity:

As a Strategic Account Manager your key objective is to grow the coverage and quality of Agoda’s supply network by remotely managing a portfolio of hotel partners in Japan. You will be responsible for maximizing partner engagement, driving portfolio performance, and improving supply metrics through digital-first account management at scale.

In this role, you’ll get to:

  • Identify, pitch and build new supplier relationships for Agoda focusing on the B2B and wholesale market
  • Introduce and explain the strategic benefits of the new B2B solution product
  • Grow bookings, revenues and gross profit of assigned hotel partners
  • Using data to develop business solutions and maximize Agoda’s accommodation availability, content competitiveness and business growth for the hotel partners
  • Evaluate existing partnerships and determine if any actions needed to optimize the performance. Identify, prioritize, negotiate, contract and onboard non-participatory hotels, ensuring favorable terms and conditions.
  • Formulate project ideas, determine where opportunity exists and implement new approaches.
  • Work in a data-driven environment
  • Research and troubleshoot rate and availability issues to help hotels maximize their booking performance; e.g., problems with connectivity, rate mapping, extranet management, etc.
  • Prepare pitch presentations and materials
  • Manage regular weekly/monthly supplier and internal reports

What you’ll need to succeed:

  • Minimum 5 years’ experience in account management, business development, or supply/e-commerce role.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to influence external/internal stakeholders.
  • Think out-of-the-box to develop and implement solutions for unique challenges when negotiating with hotel partners
  • Ability to drive insights out of data and articulate the findings
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint
  • A team player with a professional “get it done” attitude and work ethic.
  • Strong prioritization and planning skills; must be comfortable with making trade-offs.
  • Curiosity to learn and willingness to try new approaches. Comfortable in a two-way feedback culture.
  • Adapts well to and is energized by change

It’s Great if you Have:

  • B2B and wholesale markets experience preferred
  • Experience in hotel or travel industry, especially OTA channels preferred, but not necessary

About the Team:

The North Asia Regional Management Office partners closely with Agoda’s regional leadership to deliver actionable insights, align cross-functional objectives, and drive high-impact strategic initiatives. Our mandate is to translate top-level priorities into operational excellence, transforming early-stage concepts into scalable business opportunities that accelerate local and regional growth. 

Why Join Us? 

This is a unique opportunity to drive strategic impact at scale, working at the intersection of analytics, strategy, and operations in one of the most dynamic regions for Agoda. If you are passionate about solving complex business problems and thrive in a collaborative, high-performance environment, we invite you to join our team and shape the future of travel in North Asia. 

The Opportunity:

As Senior Manager / Business Owner of Strategy & Operations, North Asia, you will play a pivotal role in shaping Agoda’s strategic direction across the region. You will lead critical partnership projects, working alongside senior leaders in product, supply, marketing, and finance to deliver on our most important business objectives. Your expertise in market and data analysis will inform executive decision-making and unlock new avenues for growth. 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Planning: Design and implement long-term strategies that drive sustainable business growth and competitive advantage. 
  • Performance Management: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the impact of strategic initiatives and ensure accountability. 
  • Program Execution: Lead the end-to-end delivery of strategic programs, ensuring alignment with business goals, timely execution, and continuous improvement. 
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, facilitating clear communication and cross-functional collaboration to advance shared objectives.
  • Data-Driven Insights: Leverage advanced analytics to evaluate business performance and guide data-driven decision-making. 

What We’re Looking For:

  • Experience: Experience in strategy, management consulting, or a related discipline, with a proven record of leading complex, high-impact initiatives.
  • Analytical Acumen: Exceptional quantitative and analytical skills, with the ability to distill complex data into actionable insights.
  • Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive projects to successful outcomes in a fast-paced environment.
  • Communication: Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence and engage senior stakeholders.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong strategic and creative problem-solving capabilities, with a track record of addressing complex business challenges.
  • Project Management: Advanced project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results under tight deadlines.
  • Stakeholder Management: Experience building and maintaining relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.
  • Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in data analysis tools (e.g., Excel, SQL, Tableau) and financial modeling.

*Japanese is Mandatory for this role*

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know Our Team

The Strategic Partnerships team is responsible for identifying, building, and scaling high-impact partnerships that expand Agoda’s reach, improve customer acquisition, and create long-term business value.

For Japan, Financial Institution (FI) partnerships represent a strategic growth channel. This role will focus on developing and managing relationships with banks, card issuers, digital wallets, and other financial ecosystem partners to drive customer engagement, commercial growth, and win-win partnership outcomes.

You will work cross-functionally with teams across Commercial, Marketing, Product, Finance, Legal, Analytics, and Operations to bring partnership opportunities from idea to execution and optimization.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships to lead Agoda’s Japan FI partnership strategy and execution.

In this role, you will be responsible for identifying new partnership opportunities, managing key strategic accounts, negotiating commercial agreements, and driving performance across Agoda’s financial institution partnerships in Japan. You will help shape Agoda’s local partnership roadmap, unlock joint business opportunities, and ensure excellent execution of campaigns and initiatives with partners.

The ideal candidate brings strong business development and partnership experience, sharp commercial judgment, analytical rigor, and the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders. This role requires someone who is highly strategic but also willing to work hands-on to deliver measurable outcomes.

Why This Role Matters

This role is critical to Agoda’s growth in Japan. Financial institution partnerships are a highly strategic channel that can unlock scalable customer demand, deepen brand presence, and create differentiated value for travelers and partners alike.

As Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships, you will play a central role in shaping Agoda’s FI ecosystem in Japan and delivering high-impact partnerships that drive sustainable business growth.

What You’ll Do

Partnership Strategy & Business Development

  • Define and drive Agoda’s FI partnership strategy for Japan, aligned with market priorities and business growth objectives
  • Identify, evaluate, and prioritize new partnership opportunities with banks, credit card issuers, payment platforms, loyalty programs, and other financial ecosystem players
  • Build compelling partnership value propositions and business cases to secure internal alignment and partner buy-in
  • Lead commercial discussions, negotiations, and contract execution with prospective and existing FI partners

Account Management & Growth

  • Own and grow a portfolio of key FI partners in Japan, ensuring strong relationship management and long-term strategic alignment
  • Develop joint business plans with partners to drive customer acquisition, transaction growth, brand visibility, and partnership profitability
  • Monitor partner performance and proactively identify growth levers, optimization opportunities, and operational improvements
  • Ensure timely execution of campaigns, product integrations, and partner initiatives

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Analytics, Finance, Legal, and Operations to launch and scale partnership initiatives
  • Translate partner needs into clear internal requirements and drive execution across multiple teams
  • Influence decision-making through strong communication, stakeholder management, and data-backed recommendations
  • Support process improvements, reporting frameworks, and operating models to improve scalability and partner experience

Analytics & Optimization

  • Analyze partnership performance, customer behavior, campaign effectiveness, and commercial outcomes to generate actionable insights
  • Use data to identify trends, optimize investment decisions, and improve partnership ROI
  • Build business cases for new initiatives and present recommendations to senior stakeholders
  • Track key success metrics and maintain clear visibility on pipeline, performance, and impact

Experience

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • 7+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, account management, consulting, or a related commercial role
  • Strong experience managing external partners and driving commercial outcomes in a fast-paced, data-driven environment
  • Experience working with or within financial institutions, payment companies, loyalty ecosystems, or digital consumer platforms is highly preferred
  • Experience in e-commerce, travel, fintech, payments, or internet platforms is a strong plus
  • Proven track record of leading cross-functional initiatives from concept through execution

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to structure win-win partnerships and negotiate effectively
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to convert data into clear business insights and actions
  • Strong project management capabilities with high attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience influencing senior internal and external stakeholders
  • Self-starter with a bias for action and ability to operate independently in an ambiguous environment
  • Comfortable working hands-on while also thinking strategically

Technical / Functional

  • Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience with SQL, Tableau, or data visualization tools is a plus
  • Ability to develop business cases, commercial models, and performance reporting frameworks
  • Familiarity with campaign execution, co-marketing partnerships, loyalty mechanics, or payment-related partnership models is beneficial

Language

  • Fluency in English and Japanese is required

Gerente de Capacitación | Pre-opening

Grand Hyatt Cancún Beach Resort busca un(a) Gerente de Capacitación para desarrollar y preparar al equipo que dará vida a la operación del resort.

Diseñar e implementar programas de capacitación que permitan a cada colaborador desempeñar su función con excelencia y ofrecer una experiencia de servicio consistente desde el primer día.

  • Facilitar cursos y talleres para equipos operativos, administrativos y de liderazgo.
  • Coordinar capacitaciones técnicas, de seguridad, higiene y cumplimiento.

  • Administrar calendarios, registros de asistencia y expedientes de capacitación.
  • Medir la efectividad de los programas y generar reportes.
  • Impulsar iniciativas de desarrollo, reconocimiento y crecimiento interno.
  • Apoyar la construcción de una cultura de servicio, colaboración y alto desempeño.

Experiencia y aptitudes deseadas

  • Licenciatura en Recursos Humanos, Psicología, Educación, Administración o carrera afín.

job.job_description:
Organization- The Standard, Mexico City

Summary

The Standard, Mexico City arrives in the historic Tabacalera neighborhood with character, color, and a signature wink. With 206 guestrooms, 27 branded residences, vibrant dining destinations, and a rooftop overlooking the Monumento a la Revolución, we're bringing our unmistakable energy to Latin America.

We're looking for a Head Mixologist to shape the cocktail experience across one of Mexico City's most exciting hospitality destinations. We're searching for someone who blends creativity with precision, embraces innovation, and understands that every great cocktail begins with a great story.

The Opportunity

At The Standard, the bar is more than a place to order a drink—it's where conversations begin, celebrations unfold, and unforgettable nights take shape.

As our Head Mixologist, you'll lead the creative vision of our beverage program, developing signature cocktails that reflect our bold personality while inspiring a team that shares your passion for exceptional hospitality. Your influence will be felt in every menu, every interaction, and every perfectly crafted drink.

What You'll Do

The Key Account Manager maintains and expands relationships with important clients and will work closely with various business departments in order to maintain and further develop the relationships. The Key Account Manager supports the business in achievement of the sales quota and is assigned key objectives/metrics relevant to key accounts. The Key Accounts Manager represents the entire range of company solutions to the assigned partners. job.job_description:
Overview

Enterprise Mobility is a leading provider of mobility solutions, owning and operating the Enterprise Rent-A-Car, National Car Rental and Alamo Rent A Car brands through its integrated global network of independent regional subsidiaries. Enterprise Mobility and its affiliates offer extensive car rental, carsharing, truck rental, fleet management, retail car sales, as well as travel management and other transportation services, to make travel easier and more convenient for customers.

Privately held by the Taylor family of St. Louis, Enterprise Mobility together with its affiliate Enterprise Fleet Management manages a diverse fleet of 2.4 million vehicles and accounted for nearly $39 billion in revenue through a network of more than 9,500 fully-staffed neighborhood and airport rental locations in more than 90 countries and territories.

At the center of it all, our dedicated IT teams innovate, design and develop the technology that is redefining how customers rent, buy and share vehicles from our family of brands. Here, you will be part of a diverse and talented team that creates and delivers powerful technology solutions for our customers and employees across the world with the resources and support to develop in a variety of career paths.

As an Enterprise Mobility team member, we offer an excellent package with market-competitive pay, comprehensive healthcare packages, 401k matching & profit sharing, schedule flexibility, work from home opportunities, paid time off, and organizational growth potential.

This position is eligible for a hybrid work schedule, which includes the ability to work from home, while also requiring to be in person as needed at our Lakeside and/or Clayton Corporate HQ campus locations in St. Louis, Missouri.

We are committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. Candidates should expect identity verification, video interviews, technical validation of skills, and verification of employment, education, and work authorization. Falsification of information, proxy interviewing, or misrepresentation of experience or location will result in disqualification.

Responsibilities

The Senior Manager, IT Organizational Reporting & Data Management, leads the team responsible for delivering financial, labor, operational, and portfolio insights that enable strategic decision-making across the IT organization. This role serves as a trusted partner providing governance, analytics, and reporting capabilities that support organizational planning, investment decisions, workforce optimization, and operational performance. The successful candidate will combine strong business acumen, data-driven decision making, and people leadership to build scalable solutions that improve transparency, accountability, and organizational effectiveness.

Key Responsibilities

  • Financial & Labor Analytics: Define and evolve financial and labor reporting frameworks, governance processes, and forecasting models that inform technology investment decisions, labor planning, budget management, and operational performance optimization.

job.job_description:
Organization- Hyatt Corporate Office

Summary

The Opportunity

Hyatt Hotels Corporation seeks a Senior Manager, Growth & Owners Communications to join the Hyatt Inclusive Collection Communications team. In this role, you will serve as a strategic communications partner to Hyatt Inclusive Collection’s Growth and Owner Relations function, helping shape the narratives, materials and engagement strategies that support the continued expansion of the world’s leading all-inclusive resort portfolio.

This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of communications, development and owner engagement. You will support executive visibility, industry events, owner-facing communications, pitch materials and thought leadership that help articulate Hyatt Inclusive Collection’s value proposition to current and prospective owners. You will collaborate closely with Brand, Marketing, Legal and other cross-functional partners to ensure Hyatt Inclusive Collection shows up with a consistent, compelling and differentiated voice across key audiences and touchpoints. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list since 2013. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

  • Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on-site fitness center
  • A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption
  • Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

The Role

Responsibilities include:

  • Develop and execute communications strategies that support Hyatt Inclusive Collection’s Growth, Development and Owner Relations priorities.
  • Lead the development of press releases announcing signings and development milestones and executive messaging for speaking engagements and strategic events.
  • Own Hyatt Inclusive Collection’s communications strategy for Growth and Development conferences and industry events, including sponsorship negotiations and activation; exhibition booth strategy and collateral development; executive speaking opportunities; media engagement; and on-site communications support at priority events.
  • Develop and maintain a comprehensive suite of owner-facing presentation materials that support Hyatt Inclusive Collection’s Growth efforts, enabling the team to consistently deliver compelling and differentiated value propositions to existing and prospective owners.
  • Lead the design, development and execution of owner engagement communications, including newsletters, executive memos, briefing materials and other recurring touchpoints that foster stronger, two-way relationships with Hyatt Inclusive Collection owners.
  • Support the creation and execution of new owner engagement platforms.

Qualifications

Experience Required:

  • 5+ years of experience in corporate communications, public relations, strategic communications or a related field.
  • Full professional proficiency in both English and Spanish.
  • Demonstrated experience developing executive messaging, presentations, collateral and strategic communications materials.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with senior leaders and partners across multiple teams or regions.

Experience Preferred:

  • Experience in hospitality, travel, real estate or a similarly owner- or partnership-driven industry.
  • Experience managing stakeholder communications, particularly with owners, investors, franchisees, commercial partners or strategic partners.
  • Experience supporting executive communications, including speeches, presentations, interviews, media engagements and thought leadership.
  • Experience planning or supporting conferences, trade shows, owner meetings or executive events, including sponsorship activation.
  • Experience working in a matrixed, global organization

Ideal candidate will be located in EST or CST time zone; can also be located in Mexico City

The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all-encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary.

We welcome you:

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.

The salary range for this position is $120,000 -$140,000 . This position is also eligible to earn incentive awards, an annual bonus, monthly or quarterly incentives, etc.

The final pay rate/salary offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level, and other qualifications for the role, as well as the location of the performance of work. Pay for the successful candidate will meet local requirements, including the local minimum wage rate.

We value our relationships with recruitment partners and require that agencies contact us first before submitting any candidates. Hyatt will not be responsible for any fees and obligations associated with unsolicited submissions unless a formal agreement is in place.

Reporting to Executive Director, BSP & CASS, the Head Billing Operations & Data Processing will lead the Global Delivery Center (GDC) Data Reporting, Data processing and Billing Operations, whilst providing business systems support for the BSP and CASS. The incumbent will work directly with the Head, IATA Data Processing Center, the Assistant Director Billing Reporting and the Senior Manager Standardization Data Processing to develop data processing strategies as well as business and operational processes.

What Your Day Would Be Like

  • You will be responsible for the overall performance of the department with the following functions:

Lead the development and execution of the DPC strategy in partnership with the GDC team, the I&D team, and the Regional Process Managers. Ensure the timely delivery of the DPC roadmap and the successful implementation of approved projects, including IBSPs, NFE, ADM, and IDPC initiatives.

  • Responsible for the operational management of BSP and CASS data processing systems (for ticketing and orders), ensuring achievement of the 99.98% on-time settlement KPI and the timely delivery of all critical ISS reporting.
  • Responsible for ensuring the production and availability of dashboards and reports for ISS stakeholders, both internally and, where applicable, externally through BSPLink
  • Ensure systems effectively interface with dependent and interdependent systems to meet end-to-end operational and business requirements, in close collaboration with the I&D team.
  • Contribute to, facilitate, and coordinate the implementation of new BSP and CASS operations, as well as the enhancement and expansion of existing services and functionalities. When required, support the suspension or withdrawal of facilities within existing BSPs and CASS operations.
  • Provide input into vendor contracting and service definitions for providers supporting ISS data processing and sales reporting activities, working closely with the I&D team.
  • Attend industry group meetings and lead the team in influencing discussions and outcomes in alignment with IATA's strategic objectives and agenda items
  • Prioritize and coordinate system enhancements and change requests in collaboration with the I&D team
  • Act as an interface between other business stakeholders, I&D, GPOs, and regional teams working on all data processing and collection of sales from ISS participants.
  • Actively support the Executive Director, BSP & CASS in identifying and implementing business and vendor solutions that enhance system efficiency and help maintain or reduce ISS unit costs, thereby preserving the free-of-charge nature of BSP and CASS services for participants
  • Play a key role in reviewing financial services projects, assessing their impact on DPC operations and initiatives, and prioritizing the required system developments in collaboration with key stakeholders.
  • Support the team and industry initiatives related to Agency Debit Memos (ADM) by contributing to the development and implementation of business solutions.
  • Ensure a high level of service in support of billing operations, providing assistance to third-party partners, including GDSs, acquiring partners, and other service providers.
  • Lead, recruit, coach, and manage the Data Operations and Reporting team, with a strong focus on data governance, operational excellence, and the promotion of best practices across the GDC.
  • Oversee NDC operations, support compliance among participating airlines and agents, and collaborate with stakeholders to develop strategies and capabilities for reporting sales from carriers transitioning to NDC and modern retailing models, including order-based transactions.
  • Ensure the team provides top level support on several key applications such as BSPLINK, CASSLINK, IBSPS, servicing APIs such as the ones in NDC and eventually Settlement with Orders.
  • Oversee and ensure the timely capture of sales records within ISS to enable settlement services, including maintaining the continuity and integrity of data feeds from airlines, GDSs, and other sources, as well as the delivery of data to settlement service consumers and their financial partners.
  • Develop and drive the strategy for sales processing and data enrichment services, including commission calculation and validation, tax reporting, and other value-added reporting requirements, ensuring these services continue to differentiate ISS and support its long-term sustainability within the collection and settlement landscape.

We would love to hear from you if

  • Significant experience (minimum 10 years) managing systems operations and reporting within an airline or another aviation industry organization operating in financial, settlement, distribution, or data-processing environments;
  • Strong people management skills, with experience leading teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) responsible for Data Processing Center operations;
  • Proven track record of successfully delivering global projects and implementing business system solutions supporting airline distribution, settlement, and supply chain processes:
  • Experience engaging with C-level stakeholders, coupled with the leadership skills required to manage industry working groups and drive consensus;
  • Excellent teamwork, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work effectively in international and cross-cultural environments;
  • Ability to perform effectively under pressure and manage multiple priorities within tight deadlines;
  • Ability to think innovatively, challenge existing ways of working, and drive continuous process improvement.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and logical-thinking skills.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills in English.

Travel Required: Y

job.job_description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

The Team Mission

Strategic Partnerships is GetYourGuide's partner distribution channel. It generates a significant share of the company's revenue, with a team of 30 people across EMEA, the Americas and APAC. A dedicated partnership tech team sits in Product and Engineering; the Partnerships Director sets its product strategy.

Partners include online travel platforms, banks and loyalty programs, affiliate networks, travel agents and more. The ambition is to triple the channel within three years. That means changing how the channel operates, not optimizing the current momentum.

Your Mission

We are hiring a director-level leader to run the Partnerships function. You will set the strategy for growing the partner channel, set the product direction for the partner platform, and directly lead teams across sales, account management, and strategy and operations. The function was brought together in 2026 from two teams and is being rebuilt around partner segments. You get to shape it from close to the ground up, with the COO as your sponsor, and you run it end to end from day one.

This is a highly visible role based in Berlin, working in a hybrid model. We offer a competitive relocation package to support your move—successful candidates will be expected to be based in Berlin or happy to relocate.

What You Will Own

  • A high-revenue channel and its P&L. You set targets, own the forecast and partner economics, and run execution across EMEA, the Americas and APAC.
  • The strategy for how GetYourGuide wins through partners. You decide where we play and how we win in each segment, from global OTAs and loyalty programs to affiliate and travel-agent programs, and you make the calls on what we will not do.
  • The largest partnerships in travel. You personally lead negotiations with our largest partners and set terms that hold as volume scales.
  • The supply story. GetYourGuide has one of the largest experiences inventories in the market. You decide how we use it commercially with partners: what we offer exclusively, where, and on what terms.
  • The product direction for the partner platform. Partner technology is built in Product, but you set what it builds: the segment problems worth solving, the research behind them, and the roadmap they add up to.
  • A team of about 30, and its next shape. Regional leads, segment owners and a central RevOps team. You design the org, decide your leadership bench and raise the bar.
  • The operating rhythm. QBRs, metrics and prioritization that turn strategy into quarters of growth.

Must-haves

  • 15+ years of experience, ideally at VP or Director level, within a B2B SaaS or marketplace environment. Experience in Business Development and/or Revenue Operations (RevOps) is a plus
  • Business unit leadership, not only sales leadership. You have run a commercial P&L that combined several go-to-market motions (enterprise business development, account management, programmatic long-tail programs) and a team of 20 or more.
  • Strategy authorship. You have written a channel or segment strategy with clear choices and trade-offs, and then executed it.
  • Dealmaking. You have personally negotiated complex commercial agreements with large partners and can point to the terms.
  • People leadership. A track record of recruiting, developing and retaining strong commercial talent, including managing managers.
  • Product fluency. You can translate partner needs into problem statements a product team can prioritize, and you have worked closely with product and engineering leaders before.
  • Analytical rigor. You read the data yourself, challenge inconsistencies, and diagnose funnel and unit-economics problems.
  • Execution discipline. A high say-do ratio, sustained through an operating cadence rather than heroics.
  • Communication. You negotiate, influence and build relationships at C-level with partners and internally.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience at scale ups or B2B Saas
  • Marketplace or two-sided business experience.
  • Experience with affiliate, loyalty or fintech partnerships.

How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary

  • Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
  • Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
  • A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.
  • Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events
  • Monthly transportation and fitness budget
  • Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
  • Language reimbursement program
  • Health and wellness benefits

And more…

job.job_description:
Job Description

Welcome to The Rawai Phuket LXR Hotels & Resorts

The Rawai Phuket LXR Hotels & Resorts is a new luxury hotel set to debut on the southern tip of Phuket, offering a secluded beachfront retreat with easy access to the island’s natural attractions and excursions. The 275-room hotel will further strengthen Hilton’s luxury presence in Phuket, combining a tranquil coastal setting with elevated hospitality and thoughtfully curated experiences for discerning travelers.

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You are responsible for developing a commercial strategy covering all segments and channels to maximize total revenue and profit performance, as well as market share penetration of the hotel. As a Commercial Director, you’re not just leading commercial strategy across multiple segments and revenue streams – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Own commercial strategy and execution: Develop and implement integrated commercial strategies across all revenue streams — including Group, Conference, and Events (GCE), Rooms, Food and Beverage, Leisure, and Spa — to drive top-line performance and market share growth
  • Maximize revenue and profitability: Partner with General Managers and Finance to ensure commercial decisions support revenue goals, optimize cost of sales, and deliver profit and margin targets
  • Lead pricing and forecasting strategy: Oversee revenue management practices, including pricing, rate strategies, demand forecasting, and business reviews, to optimize revenue across all segments
  • Align sales and marketing efforts: Coordinate on-property and regional sales, marketing, eCommerce, and public relations activities to support brand positioning and drive demand
  • Adapt to market dynamics: Monitor trends, assess competitive landscape, and adjust commercial strategies to stay ahead in evolving market conditions
  • Strengthen stakeholder relationships: Build trusted relationships with owners, operators, Hilton corporate teams, and external partners to align goals and create long-term commercial value
  • Cultivate a high-performing team: Drive engagement and retention through performance management, professional development, and recognition programs

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • Minimum 3 years of experience leading and managing sales or commercial teams.
  • Strong experience in managing pre-opening luxury hotels.
  • Luxury international hotel chain experience, preferably with a strong resort background.
  • Proven experience presenting strategic plans to senior executives and stakeholder groups.
  • Strong background in cross-functional collaboration within matrixed environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze financial data to inform strategic and tactical decisions.
  • Track record of identifying and evaluating new business opportunities.
  • Experience in multi-complex hotel or travel industry operations.
  • Cross-disciplinary exposure to Marketing, E-commerce, and Finance functions.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

job.job_description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY:

OAG is the essential intelligence partner transforming global travel. For nearly a century, we've been the foundation the travel industry builds on, trusted, proven, essential. Today, we're going beyond.

We combine unmatched data quality, quantity and access with breakthrough technology and deep industry expertise to deliver what the industry truly needs: not just more data, but better answers. From real-time operational intelligence to strategic decision-making, we power the entire travel ecosystem, from airlines and airports to technology companies and financial institutions.

We are actively embedding AI throughout our intelligence layer, combining nearly a century of proprietary data with the latest technology to deliver answers that were simply not possible before.

We exist because travel moves the world, and we move travel. By transforming complexity into clarity and questions into answers, we give our partners the intelligence they need to thrive in an evolving world. For more information visit www.oag.com

ABOUT THE ROLE:

OAG Digital is the team turning our world-class data into a product-led growth engine. A unified experience where customers can sign up, explore, and extract value on their own.

You'll work across two areas. Core is the platform backbone - identity, auth, entitlements, billing, and the infrastructure everything else depends on. Intelligence is the layer above the data - AI-powered insights, predictive models built on Databricks and Snowflake, anomaly detection, and agentic features.

This is a full-stack role. You'll own features from the data layer to the customer-facing interface. We care about UX as much as throughput, and we're AI-native - tooling is part of how we develop, not an afterthought.

This role can be worked remotely from anywhere in the UK only. Please note that we're unable to offer visa sponsorship, so applicants will need the existing right to work in the UK.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Own features end-to-end - from problem-shaping with Product and Design through implementation, testing, production releases and future enhancements
  • Build customer-facing experiences and the backend systems and data models behind them
  • Evolve platform architecture across Core and Intelligence for scalability, reliability, and sustainability
  • Lead technical decisions and engineering strategy, balancing innovation with pragmatism
  • Build core platform capabilities: auth, entitlements, billing integrations, and usage management
  • Integrate AI models, data pipelines, and event-driven systems on Databricks and Snowflake into the Intelligence layer
  • Maintain the quality bar through code reviews, automated testing, observability, and CI/CD
  • Support junior and mid-level engineers and help them grow

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Extensive full-stack experience building and shipping production-grade systems
  • Strong front-end skills (React, TypeScript, or equivalent) with genuine care for great web interfaces
  • A builder’s mindset. You understand the who and the why, and you own what ships.
  • Strong C# (or comparable OO language) and confidence across the full stack
  • Solid system-design knowledge (scalability, reliability, security) and the ability to defend architectural trade-offs
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing strategies, and DevOps practices
  • Familiarity with relational and NoSQL databases, and comfort working with data at scale
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and lead - not just contribute to - technical decisions
  • Clear communicator who works directly with Product and Design and can shape problems as well as solve them
  • AI-native in how you develop - you use AI tooling daily and expect the same from your team

IT WOULD BE GREAT IF YOU ALSO HAD

  • Experience with Databricks or Snowflake, particularly in analytical or data-intensive contexts
  • Familiarity with AI/ML in production: model serving, prompt pipelines, or agentic patterns
  • Experience with consumption-based and subscription billing
  • Experience with self-serve billing platform integrations
  • Exposure to aviation, travel, or data-as-a-service businesses
  • Experience standing up or significantly improving engineering foundations for a new product or team
  • A portfolio showing you've raised the bar on UX, performance, or product craft

If you don't meet every requirement but feel excited about this role, we'd still love to hear from you.

WE WILL OFFER YOU:

💡 You will proactively explore and adopt AI tools and automation in your day-to-day work, keeping the customer at the centre of everything you do. You will share learnings with your team and approach new technologies with curiosity and an open mind. At OAG, finding better ways to work and putting customers first is everyone's responsibility.

🚀 Real responsibility on hard problems, with the autonomy to own decisions and act on them, in an open culture built on trust.

🏡 Flexible working arrangements that allow remote work or office attendance 

💰 An attractive compensation and benefits package, including private health insurance, a company bonus scheme and enhanced pension scheme 

🏖️ 25 days holiday plus bank holidays, and a day off during your birthday month  

⚡ Octopus EV salary sacrifice scheme 

🌍 Work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 1 month per year 

📚 Annual learning and development budget. 

OAG is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and able to perform at their best.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences. If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know — we’re happy to have an open conversation about how we can support you.

We are seeking a Senior Commercial Contracts Manager to join our global Commercial Contracts team, where innovation knows no borders. This team supports Travel Solutions by partnering with Sales, Product, Finance, Tax and Legal teams to shape commercial agreements that help travel agency customers grow with Sabre. With an inclusive culture and flexible work environment, we work together with boldness, curiosity and commitment so we can all win together.

As Senior Commercial Contracts Manager, you will support complex travel agency commercial agreements across the APAC region. You will partner closely with commercial teams, lead contract negotiations and help improve contracting processes at scale. This role requires sound judgment, regional business insight and the ability to turn complex commercial terms into clear contract outcomes.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the drafting, negotiation and review of complex commercial agreements for travel agency customers across APAC.
  • Partner with Sales, Legal, Finance, Tax, Operations and Product teams to structure contract terms that support business goals and manage risk.
  • Serve as a key point of contact for commercial teams, customer legal teams and internal counsel on contract matters.
  • Advise on post-signature contract questions, escalation paths and regional contracting practices across global matrix teams.
  • Drive process improvements, template updates and automation initiatives that improve speed, consistency and commercial impact.

What You'll Bring

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in commercial contracts, legal operations, paralegal work or contract negotiation in a high-volume business environment.
  • Diploma in legal studies, paralegal certification or equivalent qualification, with a strong background in paralegal and contract management functions.
  • Strong experience supporting technology, travel technology, software, SaaS or travel agency commercial agreements.
  • Proven ability to negotiate complex customer agreements and influence stakeholders across a matrixed global organization.
  • Strong understanding of commercial terms, risk allocation, financial models and contract governance.
  • Excellent communication, analytical and problem-solving skills, with the capability to review, interpret and process Chinese legal documents and contracts.

Benefits That Support You

We know support looks different for everyone. That is why Sabre offers benefits beyond medical and financial coverage, with programs designed to support your well-being, growth and life outside work:

  • Competitive pay and performance-based bonuses
  • Flexible work options
