  • セグメント別、チャネル別、客室タイプ別、曜日別、リードタイム別に業績分析を行い、最も収益性の高い顧客構成を構築する。
  • 年間予算、中長期計画、月次予測の策定を主導し、差異、リスク、機会、および改善策を説明する。
  • 団体案件、契約料金、プロモーション、宿泊パッケージ、アップセル施策の収益性を評価する。

Responsible Business（事業運営責任）

  • 市場動向、競合情報、イベント情報、検索データ、予約動向を分析し、短期・長期の収益改善施策へと結び付ける。
  • RMS（レベニューマネジメントシステム）、PMS、CRS、チャネルマネージャー、BIツールのデータ品質と設定を管理する。
  • 全販売チャネルにおいて料金、在庫、客室タイプ、販売制限、コンテンツの正確性を維持する。
  • 需要、価格戦略、在庫状況、団体案件、リスク、機会に関する週次レベニューミーティングを主導する。
  • 重要な収益機会、コンプライアンス上の懸念事項、予測リスクを経営陣へ報告し、提言を行う。
  • 客室収益戦略、価格設定、需要予測、在庫管理、流通チャネル戦略に対する責任を負い、予算達成と市場シェア拡大を推進する。

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You will manage designated corporate accounts, develop and solicit new business, drive total hotel revenue from rooms, catering, and F&B outlets, address business needs, explore new opportunities, and expand existing business through promotional efforts and sales channels. As a Sales Manager/Assistant Sales Manager/Senior Sales Manager, you’re not just generating and managing group sales – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Represent the hotel to prospective clients: Serve as the primary point of contact for customers seeking group rooms, meeting space, and food and beverage services
  • Drive new business opportunities: Respond to inquiries, initiate outreach, qualify leads, and solicit potential clients through proactive sales efforts
  • Manage the full sales cycle: Conduct site visits, entertain clients, prepare proposals, determine rates, negotiate contracts, and service accounts through fulfillment
  • Develop strategic sales plans: Create and execute strategies to achieve or exceed revenue and room night goals, adjusting based on performance and market conditions
  • Analyze sales performance: Evaluate lost business reports and identify opportunities to strengthen conversion and competitiveness
  • Support exceptional service delivery: Collaborate across departments to coordinate the fulfillment of contracted services and uphold the highest standards of client satisfaction
  • Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • Diploma or degree in Hospitality, Business, or related field
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in hotel Corporate, MICE, or Group room sales
  • Proven track record in driving revenue and managing key accounts
  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills
  • Technical proficiency in hotel systems (e.g., Delphi, Salesforce, OnQ, Market Planner Survey)
  • Ability to analyze sales data and market trends to inform strategy
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills with a collaborative mindset

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

job.job_description:
About Us

Founded in 1999 and listed on NASDAQ in 2003 and HKEX in 2021, Trip.com Group is a leading global travel service provider comprising of Trip.com, Ctrip, Skyscanner, and Qunar.


Across its platforms, Trip.com Group integrates travel resources from industry partners and helps travellers worldwide pursue the perfect trip with exceptional travel products and services.


We have six Customer Service Centres for Trip.com, established in Japan, Korea, the UK, Thailand, Malaysia, and the Philippines, providing 24/7 customer service in 35 different languages.


We have more than 30,000 employees scattered across 50 countries in Asia, Europe, the Americas, and Oceania, striving to expand our global markets and aiming to be the world’s leading and most trusted family of online travel brands that aspires to deliver the perfect trip at the best price for every traveller.


Build Trip.com's B2B integrated on-site ticketing solutions business in the assigned market (Spain or Italy) with tourism venues. The role owns commercial development from first contact through contract, integration, ticket kiosk deployment, on-site launch, and account growth, helping venues shift offline counter sales into connected digital channels, increase online ticketing penetration and digital transaction share, reduce queues, and improve the venue customer experience.


Why This Role:

  • Build a new B2B growth engine in one of Europe's priority attractions markets, with the autonomy to shape the local go-to-market model.
  • Work at the intersection of venue commerce, ticketing technology, payments, and digital distribution, with direct exposure to leading attractions and system partners.
  • Create a repeatable solution playbook that can scale from the assigned market to other European markets.


In this Role, you’ll get to:

Market Development and Direct Attraction Sales

  • Own the assigned-market pipeline and close integrated on-site ticketing solution projects with priority attractions, including theme parks, zoos, aquariums, museums, cultural venues, cable cars and activities operators.
  • Diagnose venue pain points and online-ticketing gaps across queuing, walk-up capacity, digital payment acceptance, ticket issuance, distribution, and visitor service; convert them into clear commercial proposals and business cases.
  • Develop direct venue partnerships using commercially sustainable models, negotiate pricing, inventory, service levels, marketing support, and renewal terms.

Booking System and Channel Partnerships

  • Build strategic relationships with leading booking and ticketing system providers, integrators, and local service partners in the designated market.
  • Use Trip.com's device support, distribution reach, digital payment capability, and demand-generation expertise to help venues migrate offline sales into online and self-service channels, increase digital sales penetration, and create scalable joint acquisition programs.
  • Lead partnership structure, commercial negotiation, contract execution, governance, and performance reviews with both system partners and venues.

Solution Delivery and On-site Operations

  • Coordinate Product, Technology, Payments, Operations, Legal, Finance, and local vendors to deliver hardware installation, booking-system or API integration, digital payments, testing, launch, and ongoing support.
  • Translate venue requirements into a practical implementation scope, manage dependencies and risks, and remain accountable for a reliable on-site customer experience after go-live.

Account Growth and Market Scaling

  • Manage senior stakeholder relationships through regular reporting and business reviews; improve GMV, online ticketing penetration, digital transaction share, conversion, uptime, product coverage, pricing, inventory, and marketing performance.
  • Capture implementation learnings and build a repeatable playbook for equipment, payments, systems, and site operations, supporting replication in the other priority market and future European expansion.


What you'll Need to Succeed:

  • At least 5 years of B2B sales, business development, channel sales, or strategic partnership experience in attractions, tours and tickets, travel technology, ticketing/booking systems, venue SaaS, payment/POS hardware, or a related field.
  • Existing relationships with major Spanish or Italian attractions, tourism boards, booking-system providers, integrators, or attraction-service suppliers.
  • Proven success selling to institutional venues through long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, together with the ability to develop platform, system-provider, or channel partnerships.
  • Fluency in English and native-level proficiency in the local language are required.
  • Strong commercial judgment and contract-negotiation skills, with sufficient technical aptitude to discuss APIs, booking-system connectivity, payment flows, hardware deployment, and operational service levels.
  • Hands-on, resilient, and highly organized; comfortable owning both the sale and the on-site delivery details in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.
  • Able to travel frequently within the assigned market and work on-site during venue discovery, installation, testing, launch, and issue resolution.
  • Experience with self-service ticketing kiosks, unattended payment terminals, POS hardware, QR-code ticketing, or complex venue integrations is an added bonus.
  • Experience improving digital conversion and the on-site customer journey for domestic and international visitor segments is an added bonus.
  • Experience scaling a proven commercial model from one European market into additional countries is an added bonus.


Why Trip.com Group

As a world leading company in travel industry, we provide a platform for our talent to unleash their power, make a global impact, and achieve a successful career. As an international team, we're dedicated to create a space where open communication and mutual respect is encouraged. Introduction

Turn data and market insights into revenue strategies that make a measurable difference across a portfolio of hotels in Australasia and the Pacific (AUPAC). This role gives you the opportunity to take ownership of pricing, forecasting and revenue performance while partnering closely with hotel and commercial teams to identify opportunities and drive results. If you’re analytical, commercially minded and enjoy influencing business decisions, this is an exciting opportunity to grow your revenue management career.

Your day to day

  • Manage revenue strategy across a portfolio of hotels, developing short, medium and long-term approaches to maximise revenue, market performance and delivery against hotel targets.
  • Analyse competitor activity, market trends, demand and pricing by segment to identify opportunities and recommend strategies that strengthen hotel performance.
  • Lead revenue forecasting and annual budgeting across revenue streams, proactively identifying risks, opportunities and changes required to improve performance.
  • Lead regular revenue and business performance discussions with hotel teams and owners, turning insights into clear actions that support stronger commercial outcomes.
  • Monitor revenue systems and distribution performance, ensuring pricing and system set-up remain effective while supporting new hotel openings and conversions when required.

What We Need From You

  • A minimum of 3 years' experience in Revenue Management, with hands-on experience in pricing, forecasting and developing revenue strategies.
  • Strong analytical and commercial capability, with the ability to interpret market and performance data and translate insights into practical revenue opportunities.
  • Experience using revenue management tools and systems, combined with strong Excel skills and confidence working with technology and data.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and confidently guide commercial decision-making in a remote environment.
  • A relevant university degree or diploma, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience

We are a hospitality business at our core and value connections and being together helps us foster a unique sense of belonging that also supports productivity. job.job_description:
About Us

Founded in 1999 and listed on NASDAQ in 2003 and HKEX in 2021, Trip.com Group is a leading global travel service provider comprising of Trip.com, Ctrip, Skyscanner, and Qunar.


Across its platforms, Trip.com Group integrates travel resources from industry partners and helps travellers worldwide pursue the perfect trip with exceptional travel products and services.


We have six Customer Service Centres for Trip.com, established in Japan, Korea, the UK, Thailand, Malaysia, and the Philippines, providing 24/7 customer service in 35 different languages.


We have more than 30,000 employees scattered across 50 countries in Asia, Europe, the Americas, and Oceania, striving to expand our global markets and aiming to be the world’s leading and most trusted family of online travel brands that aspires to deliver the perfect trip at the best price for every traveller.


We are looking for a commercially driven and strategic Marketplace Growth Manager to own the business performance of Trip.com's Attractions & Tours business across key ANT Europe Locales, particularly GB, Italy, Spain, and France.


This role goes beyond campaign execution. As the business owner of your assigned ANT Europe Locales, you will translate business objectives into actionable operating plans, drive execution across Operation, BD, IBU (International Marketing), and cross-business-line teams, and continuously optimize site performance to achieve sustainable revenue growth.


The ideal candidate combines strong commercial acumen, analytical thinking, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to independently drive complex initiatives across Operation, Product, Train, Hotel, and Flight teams in a fast-paced international environment.


In this Role, you’ll get to:

  • Own commercial performance across key European markets, particularly the UK, Italy, Spain and France, with accountability for GMV, traffic, conversion and margin. 
  • Build alignment and influence priorities across Business Development, Marketing, Product, Operations and other Trip.com teams, securing the cross-functional support needed to achieve commercial goals.
  • Translate regional objectives into focused market plans with clear priorities and measurable outcomes. 
  • Use customer, competitor and performance insights to identify growth opportunities and operational bottlenecks.
  • Lead seasonal promotions, major sales moments and Attractions & Tours campaigns across the Trip.com app and website. 
  • Coordinate on-site merchandising, search visibility, push notifications, email and other marketing channels. 
  • Manage campaigns end to end, from commercial planning and product readiness through to launch, analysis and optimisation. 
  • Partner with Business Development teams to define sourcing priorities based on customer demand, market trends and commercial potential. 
  • Improve product assortment, pricing, availability and merchandising across priority destinations. 
  • Identify supply and inventory gaps that could limit customer choice or commercial growth. 
  • Develop opportunities to cross-sell Attractions & Tours to customers booking flights, hotels and rail. 
  • Align Business Development, Marketing, Operations and other Trip.com teams around shared commercial priorities. 
  • Establish clear plans, timelines, ownership and success measures for cross-functional initiatives. 
  • Monitor performance through dashboards and regular business reviews, translating data into practical recommendations. 
  • Track competitor activity, customer behaviour and market trends to identify new growth opportunities. 
  • Continuously improve operating processes and remove barriers to effective execution. 


What you'll Need to Succeed:

  • 4+ years of experience in commercial operations, marketplace operations, category management, e-commerce, growth, revenue management or digital marketing.
  • Experience owning commercial KPIs such as GMV, revenue, conversion, traffic or margin.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn data into clear commercial actions.
  • Experience delivering multi-market campaigns or initiatives across several functions.
  • Good understanding of e-commerce merchandising, pricing, customer journeys and digital marketing channels.
  • Strong project management, prioritisation and stakeholder influencing skills.
  • Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, international environment.
  • Experience within an OTA, tours and activities marketplace, attraction, ticketing platform or consumer marketplace would be beneficial.
  • Experience with CMS, merchandising, campaign management or analytics tools would be an advantage.
  • Fluent English; French, Spanish, Italian or German would be advantageous.


Why Trip.com Group

As a world leading company in travel industry, we provide a platform for our talent to unleash their power, make a global impact, and achieve a successful career. As an international team, we're dedicated to create a space where open communication and mutual respect is encouraged. At Trip.com Group, we are here to support you in and out of the workplace, enabling you to explore and embrace more possibilities and pursue a dream life.


What’s more?

  • A fast-growing enviroment that offers strong potential for career growth and encourages bold ideas.

  • We encourage internal talent movement and provide global opportunities across functions, business units or regions for you to accelerate your career advancement.

job.job_description:
Agile Coach - (Hybrid)

As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, what's the next step? Start your journey with us!

  • We're seeking an experienced Agile Coach to join our Agile Team in Barcelona, Madrid, Alicante,Milan, Porto (hybrid) to collaborate with, and influence the leaders, stakeholders, and teams within the company. Together, we will drive increased agility, faster learning, more innovation, better products, and increased collaboration within the organisation. You will use your passion and expertise to help turn teams into high performing units, plus you will have a deep understanding of and experience in deploying new Agile methods, and an ability to learn and embrace new ways of helping drive increased team performance. Your success will come from your ability to help teams achieve their goals and deliver on commitments to their customers. If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.


Why eDreams ODIGEO

We’re the world's leading travel subscription platform.

  • We pioneered Prime, the first and largest travel subscription programme, which has topped over 7.8 million Prime members since launching in 2017.
  • Millions of customers every year across 44 markets – 5 brands: eDreams, GO Voyages, Opodo, Travellink, and the metasearch engine Liligo
  • More than 100 million searches per day on our websites - more than 6 billion AI daily predictions
  • Over 1,700 employees – More than 60 different nationalities from all continents – 99% permanent contracts


Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits. This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalised service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As an Agile Coach in the Agile Team you will be in charge of:

  • Collaborate with other Agile Coaches to develop a unified agile strategy, create cross-area collaboration frameworks, share best practices, and ensure consistent agile evolution and collaboration across the organization.
  • Guide executives, business units, and technology teams on change management and implementing Agile principles & values, helping them to build, grow, and continuously improve a thriving agile organization at scale;
  • Empower teams to make data-driven decisions, fostering cross-collaborations, reducing complexity, improving communication to ensure clear prioritisation of initiatives to maximise impact and reach eDOs strategic goals.
  • Design and support teams in the deployment of the eDOs development approach to optimise resource allocation, development of customer-centric products and services, and ultimately deliver value;
  • Provide Agile coaching and training to Product Owners, Dev Teams, and the wider business, coaching teams in all aspects of Kanban;
  • Expose our product and technology teams to the latest innovative thinking and ideas from the Lean and Agile community to increase agility, using Lean, Kanban, and other agile thinking to encourage a culture of experimentation, learning and continuous improvement;
  • Create, build, and facilitate or deliver customized workshops and training sessions.


What you need to succeed:

Good to have

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:

  • 3+ years’ experience in technology organizations with Agile/Kanban coaching experience;
  • Deep knowledge of Agile principles and practices and the ability to transfer that understanding at all levels of the organization;
  • Results driven ability to execute and embed
  • Consulting and facilitation skills in coaching technical and business teams in the adoption and improvement of Agile methodologies;
  • Conflict management skills
  • High degree of emotional intelligence and the ability to build strong relationships across various levels of the organisation
  • Excellent presentation and training skills;
  • Fluency in English is a requirement


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Applied AI Tools: Demonstrated comfort using practical AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or other AI-powered coding assistants.
  • Experimentation Mindset: Curiosity and eagerness to explore, experiment with, and integrate emerging AI-driven solutions into software development workflows.
  • AI-Enhanced Problem Solving: Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to debug code, streamline development processes, and enhance productivity.
  • Adaptability and Learning Agility: Enthusiastic about continuously learning and quickly adapting to new AI features and capabilities.
  • Collaboration with AI: Experience or interest in collaborating closely with AI tools as “pair programmers” to complement traditional software development practices.


What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture.

Here's what we offer:

  • A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and the possibility of choosing your equipment and, even better, keeping it for free after 3 years.
  • Continuous learning to fuel your growth and explore new horizons! 📚 Learn and grow with free Coursera access, soft skills workshops, tech training, leadership development, and more. Plus, enjoy a great onboarding program.
  • Grow opportunities to empower your career, and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.
  • Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcome, not time-in-seat. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
  • Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padel tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
  • Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.


Wanna take a peek into what it's like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

Apply now!

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Our people are the key to our success. Each one of them is unique in their own way and the respect for their uniqueness is and will always be a passion and motivation. Don’t meet every requirement? If you’re excited about this role but do not feel your experience aligns perfectly with all the requirements we strongly encourage you to apply nevertheless.

job.job_description:
Bei der TUI Deutschland GmbH bieten wir ab August 2027 eine äußerst interessante und vielseitige Ausbildung Tourismuskaufleute (m/w/d) mit dem Schwerpunkt Reisevermittlung in unserem Reisebüro in Aschaffenburg an.

Die TUI Deutschland GmbH ist der führende Reiseveranstalter auf dem deutschen Markt und eine Tochtergesellschaft der TUI Group. Sie steuert von Hannover aus nicht nur die Entwicklung, sondern auch den Vertrieb und die Vermarktung von TUI-Reisen in Deutschland. Neben der Kernmarke TUI gehören auch Spezialisten wie airtours, ltur und Gebeco zur Unternehmensgruppe. TUI Deutschland verantwortet außerdem die Geschäfte in Österreich und der Schweiz, um das zentraleuropäische Geschäft zu bündeln.

UNSER ANGEBOT

Deine Entwicklung

  • strukturiertes Onboarding
  • Schulungen, Seminare und Workshops
  • Seminarreise und ein mehrwöchiger Auslandseinsatz
  • umfangreiche Unterstützung bei deiner Prüfungsvorbereitung

Deine Vorteile

  • 30 Urlaubstage
  • Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld
  • attraktive Ausbildungsvergütung (1.082 € / 1.193 € / 1.337 € / Monat)
  • Reisevergünstigungen
  • Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket/Jobticket
  • Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft

Deine Perspektiven

  • Netzwerkaufbau
  • internationale Zusammenarbeit
  • Übernahmemöglichkeiten in der gesamten TUI Welt, bei herausragenden Leistungen eine Übernahmegarantie

ZUR POSITION

Du liebst Reisen, bist kommunikativ und möchtest anderen zu unvergesslichen Urlaubserlebnissen verhelfen? Dann starte deine Ausbildung bei TUI! Im Reisebüro bist du die erste Anlaufstelle für unsere Kund*innen und unterstützt sie dabei, genau die Reise zu finden, die zu ihren Wünschen passt. Du berätst zu Reisezielen weltweit, vergleichst Angebote, organisierst individuelle Urlaubserlebnisse und stehst vor, während und nach der Reise als Ansprechpartner*in zur Seite. So wirst du Schritt für Schritt zum Reiseprofi und machst aus Reiseträumen echte Erlebnisse.

Freu Dich Auf

  • Einblicke in die Abläufe eines Reisebüros
  • Planung und Verkauf von Reiseerlebnissen
  • Kleine Teams und Zusammenarbeit mit tollen Kolleg*innen
  • Kennenlernen unserer unterschiedlichen Hotelkonzepte, Marken und Reiseprodukte
  • Übernahme eigener Verantwortung und aktive Mitgestaltung
  • Verständnis dafür, wie aus einer Idee ein unvergessliches Urlaubserlebnis entsteht

Bei uns bekommst du vielfältige Einblicke, übernimmst Verantwortung und entwickelst dich Schritt für Schritt zum Profi der Touristikbranche.

ZU DIR

Du passt zu uns, wenn...

  • du Reiseträume wahr werden lassen möchtest.
  • du gerne mit Menschen arbeitest und Kommunikation zu deinen Stärken zählt. 
  • du offen für Neues bist und Veränderungen eher spannend als anstrengend findest. 
  • du digital unterwegs bist und moderne Tools selbstverständlich nutzt. 
  • du im Team aufblühst und Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest. 
  • du (Fach)Abitur oder einen erweiterten Realschulabschluss mitbringst.

Noten sind wichtig. Noch wichtiger ist uns aber deine Persönlichkeit, deine Motivation und deine Begeisterung für die Touristik.

Lade deine Bewerbung einfach online hoch: 

  • Anschreiben (oder erzähl uns auf kreative Weise, warum du zu uns passt) 
  • Lebenslauf 
  • Deine letzten zwei Schulzeugnisse bzw. dein Abschlusszeugnis 
  • Optional: Praktikumsnachweise, Zertifikate oder weitere Unterlagen, die zeigen, wer du bist 

Bereit für deinen Start bei TUI? ️✈️

  • Bewirb dich online und sende uns deine Unterlagen. 
  • Zeig uns, wer du bist – im Auswahlprozess möchten wir dich und deine Stärken kennenlernen.
  • Lerne uns persönlich kennen – ab November laden wir dich zu unserem Bewerberauswahlverfahren ein.
  • Willkommen an Bord! Wenn alles passt, erhältst du dein Vertragsangebot und startest im August 2027 deine Reise bei TUI. 

Von einem Arbeitsplatz zu einem Ort, an dem man dazugehört. Bei TUI schätzen wir Vielfalt, Gleichberechtigung und Inklusion und ermutigen alle, so zu sein, wie sie sind. „Come as you are“ – das ist unsere Vision, denn nur durch Vielfalt ist unser Potenzial grenzenlos. Wir ermuntern Menschen mit Behinderung, sich zu bewerben.

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Principal AI Forward Deployed Engineer

Introduction To The Team

Within CTO Enablement, the AI Enablement and Culture Office is helping Expedia Group become AI-native by turning AI experimentation into measurable business impact—creating capacity, improving speed and quality, and building AI fluency across the enterprise. As a Principal AI Forward Deployed Engineer, you will embed with teams in Business Units/Enterprise functions across EG to identify high-value opportunities, translate ambiguous business challenges into measurable outcomes, and rapidly prototype, productionize, and scale AI-powered solutions.

You will be a highly influential technical leader who coaches senior individual contributors in leadership and engineering practices, partners with executive leaders, and turns emerging AI capabilities into reusable patterns, tools, and ways of working that teams can adopt. Combining deep hands-on engineering with strong partnership and change leadership, you will help teams adopt AI responsibly and at scale while keeping meaningful outcomes for travelers, partners, and employees at the center.

In This Role, You Will

  • Partner with business-unit and functional leaders, domain experts, end users, and technologists across Expedia Group to discover high-value AI opportunities, define measurable outcomes, and establish pragmatic delivery plans.
  • Operate as a forward-deployed technical leader, partnering directly with business units and their teams to understand workflows, constraints, data, and systems, and owning engagements through delivery, adoption, and value realization.
  • Own the full lifecycle of AI initiatives—from discovery to use-case framing to technical design to rapid prototyping, production deployment, adoption, measurement, value realization and continuous improvement.
  • Translate ambiguous business problems into measurable outcomes, explicit assumptions, data requirements, and scalable, resilient, maintainable AI-enabled systems.
  • Define and communicate a north star technology vision for AI capabilities within a business-unit domain, workflow, or capability area with multiple teams, balancing speed to value with reliability, security, privacy, cost, and long-term maintainability.
  • Design highly complex systems that interact across a business unit, applying sound system design, API design, data modeling, observability, evaluation, and testability practices across multiple technologies and languages.
  • Evaluate and select models, platforms, tools, and architectural patterns for AI use cases, including retrieval, orchestration, agentic workflows, human-in-the-loop controls, and integration with enterprise systems.
  • Establish and evangelize software and AI engineering standards across multiple teams, including architecture, data contracts, evaluation, testing, observability, operational excellence, security, privacy, cost management, and responsible AI.
  • Convert lessons from individual deployments into reusable reference implementations, frameworks, prompts, evaluation approaches, engineering standards, and enablement materials.
  • Define success measures before implementation and communicate impact across adoption, quality, productivity, capacity created, cycle time, cost, ROI, risk, and sustained business outcomes.
  • Influence technical direction across multiple teams and stakeholder groups, aligning senior leaders and partners around domain strategy, trade-offs, and measurable outcomes.
  • Develop engineers, senior individual contributors, and emerging technical leaders; coach senior talent to operate independently and extend engineering practices across the organization.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree with 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, or a master’s degree with 10+ years of professional software engineering experience or equivalent professional experience.
  • Demonstrated ownership of complex systems, workflows or platforms that support a business unit or function, and integrate with broader Expedia Group systems and cross-domain capabilities.
  • Deep expertise in professional software engineering practices across the full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, operations, system design, API design, data modeling, and observability.
  • Experience making technology and architecture choices across teams and multiple technologies or languages, while guiding others toward well-defined solutions for complex systems.
  • Hands-on experience building, deploying, or operating AI-enabled systems, tools, agents, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real-world products or business processes.
  • Experience working directly within partner business units and their teams to understand ambiguous needs, deliver usable technical solutions quickly, and drive adoption beyond the initial prototype or pilot.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience defining AI engineering, software engineering, or architecture best practices at a department or organizational level and establishing standards for operational excellence, code quality, scalability, resilience, observability, testability, evaluation, and responsible AI across multiple projects.
  • Proven ability to shape product and technology direction, develop business-unit and domain-level AI architecture vision, while creating reusable patterns that can scale across Expedia Group.
  • Experience designing and productionizing LLM, generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic, conversational, or AI-assisted workflow solutions.
  • Experience establishing AI evaluation and governance practices, including quality measurement, hallucination mitigation, confidence scoring, human oversight, security, privacy, auditability, and monitoring.
  • Experience serving as a trusted technical partner to executive and cross-organizational leaders, influencing domain strategy and enabling decisions across cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated success mentoring engineers across multiple levels, coaching senior individual contributors in leadership skills, identifying rising talent, and supporting engineering-management priorities through technical partnership when needed.
  • Experience evaluating industry trends pragmatically, distinguishing durable opportunities from disruptive or short-lived technologies, and applying AI/ML-enabled approaches selectively to improve engineering, product, or operational outcomes.

The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $231,000.00 to $323,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $369,500.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role. The total cash range for this position in San Jose is $249,000.00 to $348,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $398,500.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Benefits And Perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life.

Accommodation requests

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.

About Expedia Group

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Important notice

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/.

Equal Opportunity

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. This employer participates in E-Verify. The employer will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from each new employee's I-9 to confirm work authorization.

job.company_description:
We’re adventure seekers. Smile givers. Impact makers.
We believe in the power of travel. It broadens horizons for our customers, and for our people too. New places to live, new roles to explore, new communities to join. It’s yours for the taking.
We’re TUI, a leading global travel and leisure experience company that makes holiday dreams come true for people around the world.
We are one of the world’s leading tourism groups counting 1200 travel agencies and online portals, five airlines with around 130 aircraft, over 400 hotels, 16 cruise liners, digital platforms for tours and activities and most importantly over 60 000 colleagues around the world. What unites us is creating moments that enrich the lives of our 21 million customers.
Beside the unforgettable experience we provide our customers, we also believe in the good that tourism can bring and we care deeply about our environmental impact. The TUI Care foundation has projects in over 30 countries worldwide, building on the potential of tourism as a global force for development. The Foundation opens up new perspectives through education and training, empowers local communities to benefit from the success of tourism and engages in the protection of nature and the environment.
At TUI we simply say “Let’s TUI it”. For us, that means creating happiness. Tackling challenges every day together, with a positive, can-do attitude, and finding solutions even for the most unexpected situations. Our teams across TUI are just as diverse as our destinations. So whether you have lots of experience or none at all. If you want to work in an office or feel best in the field. No matter if you’re an accomplished tech whizz, an aspiring entertainer, or simply in love with flying.
There’s a place for you here.
job.job_description:
Here at TUI, you’ll find we’re an inclusive company with a culture of care and by joining the Retail Team as a Store Manager at our Swindon Orbital store, you’ll lead a team to become destination experts to recommend and sell holidays, Cruise, UK Breaks and additional products whilst delivering exceptional sales and service results. You’ll put all customers at the heart of our business by creating unforgettable holiday experiences that make us the best-loved holiday company.

As part of our dedication to delivering exceptional customer service and flexibility for our customers, you’ll enjoy a varied shift pattern each week including weekends and bank holidays, and evenings at some of our busier stores.

About Our Offer

  • TUI offers much more than just a starting salary of £15.34 per hour
  • Be rewarded for exceeding your targets with our commission and discretionary bonus schemes
  • Enjoy fantastic holiday benefits, discounts, special offers and the ability to purchase additional TUI time off
  • Benefit from our Health and Wellbeing across key areas – Financial, Health, Social, Community and Career
  • Investment in your development and career progression
  • Pension scheme and life assurance.

About The Job

  • Lead by example and role model our company values to inspire and coach your team whilst embracing change and rising to the demands that this role brings
  • Develop your team to be proactive and investigate and resolve every question or complaint. If things don’t go quite right, you’ll be confident to step in and take ownership
  • You’ll use customer feedback and insights to spot trends and find new ways to improve customer satisfaction and loyalty to grow our business
  • As technology advances so does TUI, you’ll work with a variety of systems empowering you to enhance your knowledge to improve our customer digital journey
  • Drive your team to exceed company sales and service goals, in Retail we call it ‘Smashing your Targets’
  • Recruit and retain talent, maintaining high levels of engagement and low levels of attrition.

About You

  • Proven passion for leading by example and delivering excellent customer service
  • Confident and fun motivator with a strong drive to achieve goals and sales targets
  • Comfortable to handle and prioritise multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment and bounce back from challenges
  • Able to embrace change easily and adapt quickly to new ways of working
  • Fair and inclusive management style who recognises people are our most valued asset
  • Skilled mentor who communicates effectively, leads and develops your team and retains talent
  • Able to work a varied shift pattern each week in-line with shop opening and closing times.

From a workplace to a place to belong. At TUI we embrace diversity, equity and inclusion, encouraging everyone to come as you are, because together, our potential is limitless.

We're committed to supporting candidates with disabilities and impairments so if you require any support, please let us know.

Please note, if you've been interviewed for this role within the last 6 months, we're unable to consider a further application at this time.

Additional Information

Job Number 26118635

Job Category Sales & Marketing

Location 800 N. Harwood St, DALLAS TX 75201, United States VIEW ON MAP

Schedule Full Time

Located Remotely? N

Position Type Management

Pay Range: $148,000 - $180,800 Annually

Bonus Eligible: Y

Job Summary

Functions as the leader of the property’s sales department for properties with bookings over 300 peak rooms and significant local catering revenue. Manages the property's reactive and proactive sales efforts. CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education And Experience

Managing Sales Activities

job.job_description:
Description de l'entreprise

Au PULLMAN CANNES MANDELIEU, vous vivez la Côte d’Azur en grand : un panorama unique sur la mer, les pieds dans l’eau et du soleil pour vous ressourcer, des équipes attentives et chaleureuses pour vous accueillir et vous faire partager l’expérience Pullman.

Description du poste

Nous recherchons un(e) Attaché(e) Commercial(e) Interne en CDD de 5 mois, dans le cadre d’un remplacement de congé maternité.

Votre mission ? Transformer les demandes de nos clients en belles expériences… et en belles opportunités commerciales pour l’hôtel !

Au quotidien, vous serez au cœur de l’activité commerciale et aurez notamment pour missions de :

  • Prendre en main les demandes entrantes Groupes, MICE et Loisirs, de la première prise de contact jusqu’à la concrétisation du projet.
  • Comprendre les envies et besoins de chaque client pour imaginer et proposer l’offre la plus adaptée.
  • Construire des propositions commerciales attractives, préparer les devis et contrats, tout en veillant à la stratégie tarifaire de l’hôtel.
  • Garder le contact ! Relancer les clients, suivre vos propositions et mettre toutes les chances de votre côté pour transformer les demandes en réservations.
  • Participer activement au développement du chiffre d’affaires en identifiant les meilleures opportunités commerciales.
  • Faire vivre et évoluer notre offre Groupes & Séminaires : vos idées et votre sens de l’initiative seront les bienvenus !
  • Travailler main dans la main avec les équipes de l’hôtel pour garantir à nos clients une expérience fluide, réactive et de qualité.
  • Et bien sûr, être un véritable ambassadeur de notre marque, de ses valeurs et de son état d’esprit, aussi bien auprès de nos clients qu’au sein de l’équipe.

Vous l’aurez compris : ici, on cherche quelqu’un qui aime le contact, le challenge commercial, les projets qui bougent et la satisfaction de voir une demande se transformer en événement réussi !

Qualifications

Vous connaissez l’univers de l’hôtellerie et êtes à l’aise avec les segments Groupes et MICE ? Vous aimez le contact client et les challenges commerciaux ? Alors vous devriez vous sentir chez vous parmi nous !

Ce Qui Fera La Différence

  • Vous avez la fibre commerciale et aimez créer une relation de confiance avec vos clients.
  • Vous avez le sens du résultat, sans jamais perdre de vue la qualité de service et la satisfaction client.
  • À l’aise à l’oral comme à l’écrit, vous savez trouver les mots justes pour convaincre et donner envie.
  • Plusieurs demandes arrivent en même temps ? Pas de panique : vous savez jongler entre les dossiers, organiser vos priorités et rester réactif(ve).
  • Vous êtes curieux(se), force de proposition et n’hésitez pas à partager vos idées pour faire avancer les choses.
  • Anticipation, rigueur et organisation font partie de votre quotidien, tout comme la souplesse nécessaire pour vous adapter aux imprévus.
  • Vous êtes à l’aise en anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, pour échanger avec notre clientèle internationale.
  • Côté outils, vous maîtrisez le Pack Office et connaissez Opera et DELPHI.

Vous vous reconnaissez ? Vous avez envie de rejoindre une équipe dynamique, de relever un nouveau challenge et de contribuer directement à la performance de l’hôtel ? Nous avons envie de vous rencontrer !

Vivez en ACCOR avec vos talents, rejoignez-nous dès maintenant !

#BeALLYouAre

Informations supplémentaires

  • Une indemnité repas de 191 € bruts par mois, pour vos pauses gourmandes.
  • ☕️ Une cafétéria à disposition, parce qu’une vraie pause dans la journée, ça compte aussi !
  • Une prime de transport de 25 € nets par mois si vous résidez hors Mandelieu et Cannes La Bocca, pour vous accompagner dans vos trajets du quotidien.
  • ️ Une mutuelle et une prévoyance avantageuses, prises en charge à 70% par l’entreprise, avec la possibilité de couvrir également votre famille.
  • ️ Un parking public gratuit à proximité : un souci de moins pour commencer la journée !
  • Et surtout… un cadre de travail face à la mer ! Parce commencer sa journée avec la Méditerranée en toile de fond, c’est quand même un sacré plus.

job.job_description:
Here at TUI, you’ll find we’re an inclusive company with a culture of care and by joining the Retail Team as a Travel Advisor in our Shrewsbury store, we’ll support you to become a destination expert so that you can recommend and sell holidays, Cruise, UK Breaks and additional products. You’ll put all customers at the heart of our business by creating unforgettable holiday experiences that make us the best-loved holiday company.

As part of our dedication to delivering exceptional customer service and flexibility for our customers, you’ll enjoy a varied shift pattern each week including weekends and bank holidays, and evenings at some of our busier stores.

About Our Offer

  • TUI offers much more than just starting salary of £13.09 per hour
  • Be rewarded for exceeding your targets with our commission scheme
  • Enjoy fantastic holiday benefits, discounts, special offers and the ability to purchase additional TUI time off
  • Benefit from our Health and Wellbeing across key areas – Financial, Health, Social, Community and Career
  • Investment in your development and career progression
  • Pension scheme and life assurance

About The Job

  • Use your passion to inspire our customers and colleagues whilst enjoying a great amount of fun
  • Your drive to achieve will lead you to exceed your sales objectives, in Retail we call it ‘Smashing your Targets’
  • You’ll embrace change and rise to the challenges of a customer engaged role both face to face and virtually
  • If things don’t go to plan, you’ll need to be confident to actively investigate and resolve any question or complaint
  • As technology advances so does TUI, you’ll receive training on a variety of systems empowering you to enhance your knowledge whilst bringing memorable holidays to life for our customers.

About You

  • Excellent customer service skills with a genuine passion to go above and beyond
  • A strong dedication to achieve goals and sales targets
  • Able to prioritise multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment and bounce back from challenges
  • Ability to embrace change and adapt to new ways of working
  • A team player who engages and collaborates with our customers and colleagues
  • An organised individual who takes pride in their work and communicates effectively
  • Able to work a varied shift pattern each week in-line with shop opening and closing times.

From a workplace to a place to belong. At TUI we embrace diversity, equity and inclusion, encouraging everyone to come as you are, because together, our potential is limitless.

job.job_description:
Company Description

Are you a strategic marketing leader ready to shape the future of a diverse portfolio of iconic Australian hotels?

Accor Shakespeare Portfolio is seeking an experienced Portfolio Director of Marketing & Digital to lead the marketing vision, strategy and growth initiatives across five unique properties spanning Australia.

Based at the beautiful Novotel Sunshine Coast Resort, this senior leadership opportunity will see you driving brand strategy, customer engagement, digital performance, and commercial outcomes across a diverse collection of hotels including resort, luxury, lifestyle and CBD destinations.

This is an opportunity to make a genuine impact - partnering with General Managers, Sales, Revenue and Accor teams to deliver innovative marketing strategies that connect with both corporate and leisure audiences.

Job Description

Reporting to the Portfolio General Manager, the Portfolio Director of Marketing & Digital will lead the development and execution of strategic marketing initiatives across the Shakespeare portfolio.

Overseeing two Portfolio Marketing Executives, you will provide leadership, direction and expertise across brand positioning, integrated campaigns, digital strategy, content, partnerships and customer acquisition.

This role is ideal for a commercially minded marketing leader who understands the power of storytelling, brand experience and data-led decision making to drive business performance.

You will have the opportunity to influence strategy across a portfolio including:

  • Novotel Sunshine Coast Resort – a stunning resort destination nestled around a picturesque lagoon, offering an exceptional lifestyle location and unique guest experience.
  • Pullman Cairns International – a premium city hotel located in the heart of tropical Cairns.
  • Novotel Cairns Oasis Resort – a relaxed tropical resort experience in one of Australia’s most sought-after destinations.
  • Hotel Woolstore 1888 – a distinctive heritage-inspired Sydney property with strong lifestyle appeal.
  • Peppers Marysville – a beautiful regional retreat offering memorable leisure experiences.

Key Responsibilities

This senior leadership role will see you working closely with stakeholders across the portfolio to deliver strategic outcomes. Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Develop and lead the portfolio marketing strategy aligned with commercial objectives.
  • Drive brand positioning and market presence across multiple hotel brands and locations.
  • Lead integrated marketing campaigns targeting corporate, leisure and tourism markets.
  • Oversee digital strategy, performance marketing and customer acquisition initiatives.
  • Partner with Sales, Revenue, General Managers and Accor stakeholders to maximise opportunities.
  • Support the development of annual marketing plans and budget strategies.
  • Lead and mentor the Portfolio Marketing Executive team.
  • Identify opportunities to enhance guest engagement, brand loyalty and revenue growth.

Qualifications

You are a senior marketing professional who combines strategic thinking with commercial outcomes. You understand how powerful brands are built and how effective marketing translates into business performance.

You Will Bring

  • Significant experience in senior marketing leadership roles.
  • Strong background in traditional marketing, brand strategy and campaign development.
  • Digital marketing expertise with the ability to lead strategy and performance outcomes.
  • Experience within hospitality, tourism, travel or a customer-focused industry.
  • Proven ability to influence stakeholders and collaborate across multiple business units.
  • Experience leading teams and developing high-performing marketing professionals.
  • A passion for creating memorable customer experiences.

Additional Information

Why Join Us?

This is more than a marketing role - it is an opportunity to shape the direction of a unique hospitality portfolio within one of the world’s largest hotel groups.

Based at Novotel Sunshine Coast Resort, you will enjoy the opportunity to work in an inspiring resort environment surrounded by natural beauty, while having national portfolio exposure and access to career opportunities across the global Accor network.

Located on Queensland’s stunning Sunshine Coast, the resort offers an enviable lifestyle with beautiful beaches, a relaxed coastal atmosphere and a destination lifestyle that balances career opportunity with quality of life.

Whether you are looking to take the next step as a senior marketing leader or broaden your impact across multiple brands and destinations, this role offers the scope, visibility and opportunity to make your mark.

Why work for Accor?

Accor is one of the largest global hospitality businesses, with over 5400 Hotels across 110+ countries, the career development opportunities are endless.

Benefits Your Way

  • Access to global accommodation and F&B discounts
  • #LearnYourWay with a sophisticated modern training platform, which offers a constantly expanding database of free, industry focused training.
  • Recognition of service anniversaries and Accor Tenure Milestones.

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion.

  • We are an inclusive employer, and our ambition is to attract, recruit, and develop diverse talent. We offer reasonable adjustments to support you. If you require an adjustment to be made during the recruitment process, you are most welcome to let us know.

job.job_description:
Description de l'entreprise

Join Accor — a professional journey at the heart of a committed, international group

Accor, a global leader in hospitality, present in more than 110 countries with 5,500 hotels, welcomes you to its offices located in Issy-les-Moulineaux.

This is where the Group's global expertise comes together: strategy, finance, human resources, legal, technology, marketing, sustainability, communication, audit, procurement, etc.

Joining Accor as an intern means contributing to real projects and building your experience alongside engaged, international teams.

Description du poste

The context

Within the Finance Department, the Group Consolidation team brings together 10 people at the core of Accor's financial reporting.

Its mission: prepare the Group's consolidated financial statements under IFRS, on both a monthly and an annual basis, all the way to the externally published consolidated financial statements.

New IFRS standards, integration of acquisitions, evolution of the finance information system: the team supports the Group's major financial transformations.

Your mission

This is where your greatest challenge awaits: after training in consolidation techniques, you will become a full contributor to the consolidated accounts of a group present in more than 110 countries.

Annual Consolidation

  • Help define the scope of consolidation
  • Review restatements of Group companies' financial statements in line with Group standards (IFRS)
  • Perform analytical reviews of subsidiaries' consolidation packages
  • Review intercompany accounts
  • Analyze the consolidated financial statements: fixed assets, working capital requirements, provisions for risks and charges, impairment tests, etc.
  • Prepare internal reporting statements and the consolidated financial statements booklet for external publication

Monthly Consolidation

  • Help define the scope, review intercompany accounts and analyze the consolidated financial statements

Ad Hoc Assignments

  • Contribute to cross-functional projects: implementation of new IFRS standards, integration of new acquisitions, net income and cash-flow estimates, requests from the Finance Department, development of the finance information system

Qualifications

Your profile:

  • Degree program: business school or university, final-year Master's student (end-of-studies internship) or on a gap year, with a genuine interest in finance
  • Internship duration: 6 months — Preferred dates: starting January 2027

Appreciated Skills

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)

Soft Skills

job.job_description:
Description de l'entreprise

Rejoignez Accor – une aventure professionnelle au cœur d’un groupe engagé, international et en transformation

Accor, leader mondial de l’hospitalité, présent dans plus de 110 pays avec 5 500 hôtels, vous ouvre ses portes, situées à Issy-les-Moulineaux.

C’est ici que convergent les expertises globales du Groupe : stratégie, finance, ressources humaines, juridique, technologies, marketing, développement durable, communication, audit, achats, etc.

Rejoindre Accor, c’est participer activement à la définition, à la structuration et à l’accompagnement de la transformation d’un groupe international, en lien direct avec les équipes opérationnelles dans le monde entier.

Description du poste

Le contexte

Au sein de la Direction Financière, la Direction Consolidation Groupe réunit une équipe de 10 personnes au cœur de la production de l'information financière d'Accor.

Sa mission : élaborer les comptes consolidés du Groupe selon les normes IFRS, en mensuel comme en annuel, jusqu'à la plaquette des états financiers publiée à l'externe.

Nouvelles normes IFRS, intégration d'acquisitions, évolution du système d'information finance : l'équipe accompagne les grandes transformations financières du Groupe.

Votre mission

C'est ici que vous attend votre plus grand défi : après une formation aux techniques de consolidation, vous devenez un maillon à part entière de la production des comptes consolidés d'un groupe présent dans plus de 110 pays.

Consolidation Annuelle

  • Participer à la détermination du périmètre de consolidation
  • Contrôler les retraitements des états financiers des sociétés du Groupe selon les normes Groupe (IFRS)
  • Réaliser la revue analytique des liasses de consolidation des filiales
  • Contrôler les comptes inter-sociétés
  • Analyser les états financiers consolidés : immobilisations, besoin en fonds de roulement, provisions pour risques et charges, tests de dépréciation…
  • Préparer les états de restitution internes et la plaquette des états financiers consolidés destinée à l'externe

Consolidation Mensuelle

  • Participer à la détermination du périmètre, contrôler les comptes inter-sociétés et analyser les états financiers consolidés

Missions Ponctuelles

  • Contribuer à des projets transverses : mise en place de nouvelles normes IFRS, intégration des nouvelles acquisitions, estimés de résultat net et de cash-flow, demandes de la Direction Financière, développement du système d'information finance

Qualifications

Votre profil :

  • Formation suivie : école de commerce ou université, en Master 2 (stage de fin d'études) ou en année de césure, avec une vraie appétence pour les fonctions financières
  • Durée du stage : 6 mois — Dates souhaitées : à partir de janvier 2027

Compétences Appréciées

  • Maîtrise du pack Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)

Qualités Humaines

  • Rigueur, curiosité et sens de l'organisation
  • Bon relationnel, esprit d'équipe et qualité d'écoute

Langue(s)

  • Français — langue d'usage
  • Anglais — courant (C1)

Informations supplémentaires

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Vos avantages en alternance

  • Rémunération selon la grille Accor, en fonction du niveau d'études et de l'ancienneté en alternance
  • Remboursement de l'abonnement Navigo à hauteur de 75 %
  • Remboursement de l'abonnement SNCF à hauteur de 50 % (cumulable avec le Navigo)
  • Tickets restaurant
  • Indemnité mobilité douce (vélo, trottinette…)
  • Congés payés
  • Accès au CSE (comité social et économique)
  • Enveloppe de 250 € pour l'équipement télétravail (sur présentation de facture)
  • Accès aux espaces de travail collaboratifs, restaurants et espaces bien-être sur site

Nos engagements

— Sur le monde

  • Accor s'engage pour le monde qui nous entoure, avec une culture employeur forte centrée sur le développement de nos 300 000 talents.
  • Nous adoptons une approche d'amélioration continue pour réduire l'impact du digital sur l'environnement dans l'ensemble de nos projets.

— Sur votre carrière

  • Un encadrement de qualité avec un tuteur dédié et des missions responsabilisantes.
  • Des perspectives d'évolution au sein du Groupe à l'issue de votre alternance.
  • Un Talent Management dédié et des parcours de formation pour grandir ensemble, au quotidien.

Votre talent et votre motivation sont nos seuls critères de sélection.

Nous valorisons la richesse des diverses nationalités, personnalités et parcours.

Nous nous adaptons aux besoins spécifiques de nos collaborateurs, notamment ceux en situation de handicap.

Pour nous, le recrutement est avant tout une histoire de rencontres.

Notre processus de recrutement

Ce poste vous attire ? Postulez et nous vous proposerons :

  • Un ou deux échanges avec le manager et les membres de l'équipe,
  • Un feedback personnalisé.

Contrat d'apprentissage ou de professionnalisation — convention tripartite école/entreprise/alternant requise.

job.job_description:
Senior Director, Cloud Engineering


Travel obsessed? Big tech fan? Hey, you’re in good company. If you want to be part of the industry that makes the world go round, then look no further.

Travelport is the brains behind lots of your travel bookings- plane, car or hotel. Our technology is used to book that magical holiday, infamous bachelorette party or long overdue school reunion. While we can’t solve mosquito bites or lost luggage, we can simplify a lot of the technical parts of travel, and we’re looking for the best thinkers to help us do it.

We’re hiring right now for a Senior Director, Cloud Engineering! Search for #Travelport on LinkedIn and hear from our amazing team.


How you’ll make an impact:

We’re hiring a Senior Director, Cloud Engineering to lead the cloud engineering capability behind Travelport’s next-generation platform. This role needs someone who has built and operated serious AWS environments, understands large-scale systems, and can create the platform conditions for frontier AI products to work in production.

You’ll lead the team that defines the engineering approach for AWS, builds our production AWS platform, and onboards development teams and products to this platform. You’ll be responsible for driving the move to infrastructure as code, account management, automated pipelines, observability, resilience, operating coverage and cost control.

You’ll also help define how the platform supports AI, data engineering and high-scale product demand, including where AWS Bedrock and other AI services can be used responsibly in production.

The role is about making the platform stronger, simpler and ready for what comes next while managing the pipeline of new products that are moving to or being created in AWS.


Your role in action

  • Lead the cloud engineering strategy for the Travelport platform, with a focus on AWS, automation, resilience, security and cost.
  • Build stronger engineering standards for infrastructure as code, CI/CD, AWS account management, platform guardrails and developer enablement.
  • Improve the operational model for the platform, including observability, incident response, reliability and 24/7 support coverage.
  • Partner with Product and Commercial teams to get ahead of major demand changes, customer commitments and platform capacity decisions.
  • Work closely with Data Strategy, Architecture, Infrastructure and Cyber teams to support AI, data lakes, data engineering, identity, security and production GenAI use cases.
  • Help define how Travelport scales AI workloads in a cost-aware, secure and reliable way.
  • Lead cloud cost management and capacity planning, including the engineering decisions that drive AWS spend.
  • Challenge platform norms and simplify where complexity is slowing delivery, increasing risk or adding cost.


Could this be you?

  • You’ve led cloud engineering, platform engineering or infrastructure engineering teams running high-scale production systems on AWS.
  • You have strong practical knowledge of distributed systems, infrastructure as code, automated deployment pipelines, cloud security, observability and operational reliability.
  • You have managed cloud cost, budget and capacity at scale.
  • You understand the engineering choices that drive AWS spend.
  • You have enough exposure to AI/ML platform needs, data engineering and cloud data platforms to guide real architecture decisions.
  • AWS Bedrock or production GenAI experience would be valuable
  • You can operate at senior leadership level while staying close enough to the technology to challenge decisions properly.
  • You know how to build strong engineering teams, create clear standards and improve delivery without adding unnecessary process.


Discover why our teams love working here:

Where do we start! Our benefits package includes:

We offer a package that includes 25 days annual leave per annum, hybrid working model, pension contribution, private medical, life assurance and personal travel insurance.

Search for #lifeattravelport & for our employee stories on LinkedIn!

Your journey at Travelport starts here- apply now!

We are an equal opportunities employer and will consider all qualified applicants purely on their skills and abilities. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation, if needed.

job.job_description:
About Us

Founded in 1999 and listed on NASDAQ in 2003 and HKEX in 2021, Trip.com Group is a leading global travel service provider comprising of Trip.com, Ctrip, Skyscanner, and Qunar.


Across its platforms, Trip.com Group integrates travel resources from industry partners and helps travellers worldwide pursue the perfect trip with exceptional travel products and services.


We have four Customer Service Centres for Trip.com established in Japan, Korea, the UK, and the Philippines, providing 24/7 customer service in 19 different languages.


We have more than 30,000 employees scattered across 30 countries in Asia, Europe, the Americas, and Oceania, striving to expand our global markets and aiming to be the world’s leading and most trusted family of online travel brands that aspire to deliver the perfect trip at the best price for every traveller.


About the Role

We are looking for a London-based Senior Product Designer to create rail-booking experiences that feel genuinely designed for the EU market.

You will combine strong product-design skills with first-hand knowledge of EU rail travel, helping international teams understand local passenger needs, behaviours and expectations.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead end-to-end product design across mobile and web, from user flows and concepts to polished interfaces and prototypes.
  • Simplify complex rail journeys involving fares, Railcards, ticket restrictions, disruptions, cancellations and refunds.
  • Apply EU-specific terminology, content patterns, visual conventions and accessibility standards.
  • Use research, customer feedback and product data to validate and improve designs.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineers and international stakeholders while contributing to our design system.
  • Share EU-market insights with international stakeholders and help the wider team make informed localisation decisions.


Qualifications:

  • Significant experience in product, UX/UI or interaction design.
  • At least 3 years and above of relevant experience in the travel and tech industry.
  • Based in London, or committed to relocating before starting.
  • Experience localising global products for the EU market.
  • Strong interaction and visual-design skills, with the ability to simplify complex information.
  • Advanced Figma skills, including components, auto layout, design tokens and prototyping.
  • A polished portfolio showing your process, ownership and product impact.


Why Trip.com Group

We are an inclusive team of multi-lingual, goal-driven, friendly, and supportive colleagues who will help you gain valuable experience in a dynamic business setting.

Our teams are passionate about making every trip the perfect trip for over 400 million customers around the globe. You will be part of a journey of globalization and have a world-class stage to unleash your talent.



What’s more?

  • Our rapid business growth in global offers abundant career opportunities at various levels and in multiple functions
  • Internal transfer is encouraged, and global job rotation program enable you to pursue a global career path and make global impact
  • We provide learning opportunities to further your career in areas of leadership capability, soft skill and professional expertise.
  • We encourage flexible work arrangement
  • Have fun with company-sponsored greetings and activities at holidays, birthdays, and colorful team events.


Have a good trip, and see you soon!

job.job_description:
Key Responsibilities

Reporting & Operational Support

  • Support recurring and ad hoc reporting and analytical requests across the Americas Operations organization.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to clarify requirements, understand business needs, define expected outputs, and deliver timely reporting support.
  • Prioritize and complete requests accurately and in alignment with business priorities and established timelines.
  • Translate data into clear findings and effectively communicate updates and insights to leadership and non-technical stakeholders.

Reporting Maintenance & Data Quality

  • Maintain existing operational reports, dashboards, queries, and recurring data outputs to ensure continued accuracy, reliability, and usability.
  • Monitor reporting outputs and identify potential data quality, functionality, or performance issues.
  • Troubleshoot reporting issues, query errors, and data discrepancies, partnering with stakeholders and technical teams as needed to determine root causes and support resolution.
  • Perform routine data validation and quality checks to ensure reporting outputs are complete and accurate.

Reporting & Analytics Development

  • Develop new reports, dashboards, queries, and analytical outputs with guidance based on defined business requirements.
  • Use SQL, Tableau, Tableau Prep, Google Cloud Platform, and Microsoft Excel to support reporting, data preparation, visualization, and operational analysis.
  • Translate business questions into clear, actionable reporting and analytical deliverables.
  • Analyze operational data to identify trends, opportunities, and insights that support leadership decision-making and business performance.
  • Incorporate stakeholder feedback to refine reporting solutions and improve usability.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to simplify reporting processes, automate recurring outputs, and improve reporting efficiency.
  • Support enhancements to existing reports and dashboards based on evolving stakeholder and business needs.
  • Contribute to reporting documentation, process consistency, and the adoption of analytics tools and resources across the organization.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high level of attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, organize work effectively, and meet established deadlines.
  • Ability to communicate data, findings, and technical information clearly to leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with business stakeholders and technical partners.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including advanced Microsoft Excel capabilities such as pivot tables, XLOOKUPs, formulas, and data analysis.
  • Experience with Tableau and Tableau Prep.

Preferred Qualifications
