job.job_description:
Description de l'entreprise

Join Accor – a professional journey at the heart of a committed, international and transforming group

Accor, a global leader in hospitality, present in more than 110 countries with 5,500 hotels, welcomes you to its offices located in Issy-les-Moulineaux.

This is where the Group’s global expertise comes together: strategy, finance, human resources, legal, technology, marketing, sustainability, communication, audit, procurement, etc.

Joining Accor means actively contributing to defining, structuring, and supporting the transformation of an international group, in direct connection with operational teams around the world.

Description du poste

This Is Where Your Greatest Challenge Awaits

Within Accor Group Purchasing Organization (GPO) – Astore, Accor’s fast-growing and innovative Procurement department revolutionizing the hospitality sector by offering the responsible products and services necessary to ensure the proper functioning of all hospitality businesses, you join the Strategy & Transformation Office.

Collaborating with ~4,500 suppliers across the world, Accor GPO – Astore covers most of hospitality needs, with a team of ~260 experts serving ~8,000 customers in 30 countries. To support its scale and accelerate its global transformation, the Strategy & Transformation Office helps the GPO SteerCo define its strategic priorities, monitors execution of transversal projects, and ensures tools, data and governance effectively support this ambition.

Your Mission

Reporting to the Procurement Strategy & Transformation Executive Director within the Strategy, Finance and Digital team, you will be a key contributor to strategic initiatives shaping the Procurement operating model.

As part of the Strategy & Transformation Office, you are at the heart of GPO’s transformation, working alongside Procurement leadership and across regions worldwide. In a truly international environment, you gain broad exposure across markets, tackle complex challenges, influence key decisions and help shape the future of Procurement at scale.

Your Main Responsibilities

  • Transformation Strategy and Prioritization
  • Partner with the GPO SteerCo to define, prioritize and sequence transformation initiatives, keeping them tightly connected to GPO’s strategic ambition and business realities.
  • Shape strategic recommendations and drive decision-making on key transformation topics, ensuring effective governance, clear communication and alignment across senior stakeholders.
  • End-to-End Transformation Project Delivery
  • Lead and deliver high-impact transformation projects across the Procurement organization, spanning operating model design, process improvement, and organizational alignment.
  • Own project delivery end-to-end, driving milestone discipline across global and regional teams.
  • Facilitate workshops and governance forums to align stakeholders, unblock decisions, and keep projects moving.
  • Translate complex analyses into sharp, actionable executive presentations that drive top management decisions.
  • Change Management & Adoption
  • Drive adoption of new ways of working across communication, training, and rollout activities.
  • Align senior stakeholders (Global & Regional CPOs, Finance...) around a shared transformation direction, navigating different cultures, priorities and expectations across hubs.
  • Team Leadership & Development
  • Manage, coach and develop a Transformation Project Manager, providing clear direction, regular feedback, and growth opportunities to maximise individual and collective impact.

Qualifications

And you?

Your Profile

  • Academic background: Master’s Degree or MBA
  • 6-to-8-year experience ideally combining a background in Management Consulting (Procurement / Operating Model Transformation) and Corporate Procurement/Corporate roles within complex, international environments
  • Strong understanding of procurement processes, operating models, and organizational design

Your Skills

  • Project Management: proven track record in leading large-scale corporate transformations, process optimization, and governance design
  • Strategic & Analytical Thinking: ability to synthesize complex business challenges, design strategic roadmaps, and propose structured, data-driven solutions
  • Process Mapping & Operational Efficiency: skilled in optimizing processes to enhance efficiency and support organizational alignment
  • Leadership & Influence: strong assertiveness, resilience, and capability to influence and guide senior executives and diverse stakeholders through major organizational shifts

Languages

  • Fluent in English and French (written and spoken), with excellent communication skills for senior executive audiences

Informations supplémentaires

Why join us?

And what are our commitments?

To the world

  • Accor is committed to the world around us, with a strong employer culture focused on the development of our 300,000 talents.
  • We adopt a continuous improvement approach to reduce the environmental impact of digital across all our projects.

To your career

  • We enable all our employees to maintain a healthy work-life balance and give them the means to shape their working environment in their own image.
  • Dedicated Talent Management, continuous improvement, and training and development paths are defined both individually and collectively so that we can grow together, every day.

Concretely, At Accor

  • Remote work possible several days per week from France and flexible working options: work from home, our offices, or even our hotels and coworking spaces thanks to Worklib.

And also,

  • ALL - Heartist® program: preferential rates and flash offers for unforgettable stays and experiences across all our Accor locations and with our partners worldwide.
  • Heartist® for Good volunteering program: 1 day offered during your working time to get involved with a non-profit organization.
  • A Social and Economic Committee (CSE) that supports you in financing your cultural and sports activities.
  • Sustainable Mobility Package for using an eco-friendly means of transportation or a “company bike” program in partnership with Zenride.
  • Coverage of urban public transport subscriptions between home and workplace, up to 75%.
  • Meal vouchers with a face value of €11.
  • A mandatory health insurance plan funded at 50% by Accor, at no additional cost in case of enrollment of your dependents.
  • Not to mention attractive working conditions with collaborative workspaces, restaurants, game areas, as well as well-being and sports spaces on site or through Gymlib.

Your talent and motivation are our only selection criteria.

We value the richness of diverse nationalities, personalities, and professional backgrounds.

We know how to adapt to the specific needs of our employees, particularly those with disabilities.

We encourage all applications, without distinction of gender, so dare to apply!

For us, recruitment is above all a story of encounters.

Does this role appeal to you? Apply, and we will offer you:

  • An initial discussion with our recruitment team to present the key elements of the role or guide you toward a position that may better suit you,
  • One or more interviews with managers and team members,
  • For certain roles, you may also be asked to complete a test or case study, as well as a questionnaire about your personality and motivations.
  • A final interview with our Human Resources team to discuss our Group culture, working environment, training program, and career prospects, as well as the different Group benefits.
  • Personalized feedback.

Perform entry-level human resources and administrative duties in support of the hotel’s Human Resources programs and philosophies. Provide basic employee assistance, often serving as initial point of contact for human resources-related matters.

At Holiday Inn® we want our guests to relax and be themselves which means we need team members to:

Duties And Responsibilities

FINANCIAL RETURNS:

  • Assist director and manager in the creation of and work within the established Human Resources department budget and control expenses.
  • Assist manager in monitoring staffing to manage costs.

PEOPLE:

  • Interview Line Associates
  • Liaison with recruitment agencies and hotel schools
  • Co-ordinate work experience programs
  • Manage the on-line recruitment through the Hotel Web Site
  • Site inspections for schools, colleges, and universities
  • Correct and timely placement of internal and external advertisements
  • Conduct exit interviews and provide feedback on reasons for turnover
  • Adherence to pre, during and post employment checklists
  • Ensure Staff and Manager awareness of HR Policies and procedures

  • Assist managers in developing work practices that are in line with OH &S policies
  • Manage performance management system and cycle of recruitment, induction, training, development, and succession for Levels 10 - 8 and ensure process is adhered to for other positions
  • Assist with line staff counseling and career management
  • Assist line managers in the recruitment, induction, training, development, and succession for levels 3- 6.
  • Works with Training Manager or designate to Co-ordinate training such as:
  • First Aid Courses, OH&S, Workplace Rehabilitation courses.
  • Issue invitations to attend internal and external programs
  • Maintain records of training attendance
  • Implement Orientation
  • Promote and facilitate cross training, job rotation, and multi skilling
  • Conduct training for line Associates
  • Conduct departmental skills audits
  • Initiate programs which foster good work relations such as social club and consultative committees
  • Maintenance of employee files
  • Maintenance and administration of OH&S work place cases, as well as the management of rehabilitation programs
  • Manage standardized responses to correspondence

  • Regularly communicates with staff and maintains good relations
  • Interacts with guests and individuals outside the hotel including, but not limited to, current and potential clients, owning company representatives, suppliers, competitors and other members of the local community.

GUEST EXPERIENCE:

  • Assists in maintaining a comprehensive, current and guest focused set of departmental standards and procedures and oversees their implementation through ongoing training

RESPONSIBLE BUSINESS:

  • Adhere to time frames established by Head Office
  • Data Base Management
  • Provides input for probation and formal performance appraisal discussions in line with company guidelines
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

ACCOUNTABILITY

To implement HR policies and HR systems framework as directed by your superior whilst maintaining good employee relations. You will also help to create a desired work culture around our Winning Ways of the InterContinental Hotels Group and embrace the IHG Commitment.

Qualifications And Requirements

Diploma in Human Resources, Training or Business Administration plus 1 year of relevant experience or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience. Description de l'entreprise

Orfea, qui sommes-nous ?

Orfea est un acteur spécialisé dans l'hébergement hôtelier, dédié aux déplacements professionnels du personnel ferroviaire. Filiale des groupes SNCF et Accor, l'entreprise s'appuie sur une double expertise - connaissance des besoins opérationnels et savoir-faire hôtelier - pour proposer des solutions d'hébergement adaptées, fiables et de qualité aux personnels SNCF en déplacement professionnel.

Son activité repose sur l'exploitation de résidences hôtelières situées à proximité des gares, ainsi que sur un réseau élargi d'hôtels partenaires à l'échelle nationale.

L'objectif est de garantir aux collaborateurs SNCF en mobilité des conditions d'accueil et d'hébergement optimales, alliant confort, proximité et continuité de service, tout en proposant une offre flexible répondant aux contraintes opérationnelles des déplacements professionnels.

Orfea, quelles sont nos missions ?

Proposer un hébergement sur-mesure au sein du réseau des résidences Orfea et des prestataires hôteliers pour une activité d'1.6 millions de nuitées/an.

Offrir des solutions clef en main pour l'organisation de réunions et de séminaires.

Orfea, quelles sont nos valeurs ?

Engagement, coopération, satisfaction client, sens de l'hospitalité.

Au-delà de l'exigence sur les fondamentaux de la relation client en hôtellerie, Orfea s'assure du développement des compétences de ses collaborateurs, en proposant des parcours formation adaptés et sur-mesure aux besoins des équipes.

La Société fonde ses recrutements sur les seules compétences, expériences professionnelles, formations et qualifications des candidats.

Description du poste

Rejoindre Orfea, c’est…

Intégrer un acteur reconnu de l’hébergement hôtelier dédié aux professionnels de la mobilité, et contribuer à une ambition forte : offrir une expérience client de qualité, homogène et performante sur l’ensemble du réseau (80 sites sur le territoire national, soit environ 2.700 chambres).

Dans le cadre d’un remplacement, nous recherchons un(e) Adjoint(e) de Direction, en CDI, 39h/semaine, pour notre résidence ORFEA Lyon Perrache (156 chambres), et ses sites rattachés de St André Le Gaz (10 chambres) et le local de coupure de Lyon Part Dieu.

Sous la responsabilité de la Directrice de Résidence et en binôme avec une Adjointe de Direction, vous jouez un rôle clé dans le pilotage de la résidence et l’atteinte de ses objectifs de qualité et de performance. Manager de proximité, vous accompagnez les équipes au quotidien et collaborez étroitement avec votre binôme pour garantir une expérience client de qualité et contribuer au développement de la résidence.

Pour Cela, Vos Principales Missions Seront

  • Relation et satisfaction Client, basées sur la convivialité : accueil des clients, fidélisation, développement de l'image de marque Orfea au travers d’un concept sur-mesure et basé sur la convivialité
  • Management et animation d'équipe, permettant l'épanouissement de chacun (H/F) : recrutement, intégration, formation, planification et animation du personnel
  • Gestion opérationnelle de la résidence, reposant sur la qualité et la performance : respect des normes d'hygiène et de sécurité, organisation des services, exécution des contrats de sous-traitance, maintenance technique, pérennité des matériels
  • Résultats économiques et développement commercial : ambassadeur de la marque, suivi commercial et financier des objectifs définis par la direction (TO, plannings, budget, compte d'exploitation...)

Qualifications

Vous êtes un(e) manager de terrain, reconnu(e) pour votre sens du service, votre leadership et votre capacité à fédérer les équipes autour d'objectifs communs ? Rejoignez ORFEA Lyon Perrache et contribuez activement à la réussite de notre résidence !

Pour réussir dans ce poste, vous disposez des atouts suivants :

  • Formation Bac+2 à Bac+3 en hôtellerie ou services
  • Expérience réussie dans l'hôtellerie, les résidences services ou un environnement orienté service client
  • Expérience significative en management et animation d'équipe
  • Orienté(e) 100 % satisfaction client
  • Excellentes qualités relationnelles et sens de la communication
  • Organisation, rigueur et autonomie dans la gestion des priorités
  • Esprit d'initiative et force de proposition
  • Maîtrise des normes HACCP

Vous aimez relever des défis, accompagner les équipes vers la réussite et garantir une expérience client de qualité ? Alors ce poste est fait pour vous !

Informations supplémentaires

Ce que nous vous proposons

  • Un parcours d'intégration et de formation personnalisé
  • Un accompagnement de proximité pour réussir votre prise de poste
  • Des opportunités de développement et d'évolution au sein d'Orfea

Participez à Une Aventure Humaine Et Dynamique

Nous rejoindre, c'est aussi rejoindre la famille Orfea qui prône 4 grandes valeurs : l'implication, la fierté d'appartenance, le sens de l'hospitalité et l'esprit d'équipe. Il est donc essentiel que chacun puisse progresser et s'épanouir au sein d'Orfea et en être l'ambassadeur.

Profitez De Nombreux Avantages Sociaux

  • 13ème mois à partir d'un an d'ancienneté
  • Prime variable sur objectifs

Job Description

Advertisement date: 24/09/2026

Target start date: 26/10/2026

Salary Range: $90,000-$95,000 AUD per annum + superannuation

The Senior Hotel Accountant is a key finance leadership role supporting the Precinct Director of Finance in the day-to-day operation of the Finance Department. The position provides a higher level of ownership and technical accounting oversight than the Hotel Accountant role, while supporting the Finance Manager across month-end close, financial reporting, payroll, reconciliations, internal controls, audit readiness and continuous improvement. The role acts as a key point of contact for operational leaders and provides guidance and coaching to finance team members.

Key Duties For The Role Include

  • Support the Precinct Finance Manager in overseeing accurate and timely day-to-day financial operations.
  • Take ownership of assigned accounting functions, including general ledger reconciliations, journals, accruals, cost allocations and balance sheet reconciliations.
  • Review financial transactions for accuracy, appropriate coding, approvals and compliance with Accor policies and hotel procedures.
  • Provide technical accounting support and guidance to the Hotel Accountant and wider Finance team.
  • Investigate and resolve discrepancies, unusual transactions and reconciliation variances, escalating material issues as appropriate.
  • Support effective internal controls and financial processes across the hotel/precinct.

Sponsorship may be considered for the ideal candidate.

Qualifications

  • Tertiary qualification in Finance, Accounting, Business or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 3 years’ relevant hotel accounting or general accounting experience, with demonstrated experience at Hotel Accountant or equivalent level.
  • Demonstrated experience with month-end accounting, reconciliations, journals, accruals and financial reporting.
  • Previous experience with hotel payroll processing and knowledge of relevant awards, agreements and statutory requirements.
  • Working knowledge of Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, cash handling and internal financial controls.
  • Experience supporting audits, budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis.
  • Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel.

Additional Information

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a collaborative, multi-brand precinct team in a dynamic location.
  • Access extensive career development opportunities within Accor Hotels.
  • Enjoy exclusive staff benefits, worldwide discounts, and wellbeing programs.
  • Play a pivotal role in shaping guest experiences and loyalty in one of Sydney’s most exciting hospitality precincts.

Description de l'entreprise

Position to be filled from January 2027

 Join Accor – a professional journey at the heart of a committed, international and transforming group

Accor, a global leader in hospitality, present in more than 110 countries with 5,500 hotels, welcomes you to its offices located in Issy-les-Moulineaux.

This is where the Group’s global expertise comes together: strategy, finance, human resources, legal, technology, marketing, sustainability, communication, audit, procurement, etc.

Joining Accor means actively contributing to defining, structuring, and supporting the transformation of an international group, in direct connection with operational teams around the world.

Description du poste

This Is Where Your Greatest Challenge Awaits

Within the Group Tax department, you will join the Global Tax Projects team: a dynamic, high-impact team responsible for managing complex and transversal tax matters across Accor’s worldwide footprint, with a particular focus on M&A operations, tax forecast and transfer pricing.

Reporting to the VP Global Tax Projects, you will work with all of Accor’s regional tax specialists and the Transfer Pricing Director, as well as other Finance teams (accounting, FP&A, treasury…), the M&A team and external advisors.

Your Mission

Oversee the tax dimension of Accor’s M&A and strategic projects worldwide, and play an active role in the Group’s tax forecast. A true playground to put your expertise at the service of high-stakes decisions.

M&A and strategic projects

  • Lead tax due diligence processes on acquisitions and disposals across all geographies
  • Advise on deal structuring from a tax perspective, including holding and financing structures and exit strategies
  • Draft and review tax-related provisions in transaction documents (SPA, SHA, JV agreements)
  • Advise on post-deal integration and restructurings
  • Coordinate with regional tax managers and external advisors across multiple jurisdictions

Tax forecast

  • Oversee the Group’s tax forecast process throughout the year (monthly monitoring, bi-annual tax forecast, annual budget and multi-year business plan), in close collaboration with local finance teams and regional tax managers

France

  • Support the tax team in charge of French entities on strategic projects and yearly CIT compliance

Qualifications

And you?

  • Master’s degree in Tax Law or equivalent
  • 5+ years of experience in corporate tax and M&A tax, within a leading law firm or in-house
  • Strong knowledge of French corporate tax and international tax law
  • Excellent analytical skills
  • Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, multicultural and evolving environment
  • Fluent in English and French

Informations supplémentaires

Why join us?

And what are our commitments?

To the world

  • Accor is committed to the world around us, with a strong employer culture focused on the development of our 300,000 talents.
  • We adopt a continuous improvement approach to reduce the environmental impact of digital across all our projects.

To your career

  • We enable all our employees to maintain a healthy work-life balance and give them the means to shape their working environment in their own image.
  • Dedicated Talent Management, continuous improvement, and training and development paths are defined both individually and collectively so that we can grow together, every day.

Concretely, At Accor

  • Remote work possible several days per week from France and flexible working options: work from home, our offices, or even our hotels and coworking spaces thanks to Worklib.

And also,

  • ALL - Heartist® program: preferential rates and flash offers for unforgettable stays and experiences across all our Accor locations and with our partners worldwide.
  • Heartist® for Good volunteering program: 1 day offered during your working time to get involved with a non-profit organization.
  • A Social and Economic Committee (CSE) that supports you in financing your cultural and sports activities.
  • Sustainable Mobility Package for using an eco-friendly means of transportation or a “company bike” program in partnership with Zenride.
  • Coverage of urban public transport subscriptions between home and workplace, up to 75%.
  • Meal vouchers with a face value of €11.
  • A mandatory health insurance plan funded at 50% by Accor, at no additional cost in case of enrollment of your dependents.
  • Not to mention attractive working conditions with collaborative workspaces, restaurants, game areas, as well as well-being and sports spaces on site or through Gymlib.

Your talent and motivation are our only selection criteria.

We value the richness of diverse nationalities, personalities, and professional backgrounds.

We know how to adapt to the specific needs of our employees, particularly those with disabilities.

We encourage all applications, without distinction of gender, so dare to apply!

For us, recruitment is above all a story of encounters.

Does this role appeal to you? Apply, and we will offer you:

  • An initial discussion with our recruitment team to present the key elements of the role or guide you toward a position that may better suit you,
  • One or more interviews with managers and team members,
  • For certain roles, you may also be asked to complete a test or case study, as well as a questionnaire about your personality and motivations.
  • A final interview with our Human Resources team to discuss our Group culture, working environment, training program, and career prospects, as well as the different Group benefits.
  • Personalized feedback.

job.job_description:
Job Title

Travel Unit Services Operations Lead (Budget & Resource)

The Travel Unit Services Operations Lead (Budget & Resource) is responsible for strengthening how Travel Unit Professional Services Engineering plans, monitors and steers its budget, capacity and resource needs.

The role serves as a cross-functional operations lead for Services Engineering, ensuring financial indicators, demand trends, capacity planning and workforce requirements are connected through a reliable operating framework. By bringing structure, transparency and coordination to complex topics across multiple organizations, the role enables informed decision-making, effective prioritization and predictable delivery capacity.

The position will operationalize and continuously improve the Services resource and budget management model across Travel Unit, with a particular focus on the AIR-SEE organization and its interfaces with other Travel Unit organizations. The role leads the Travel Unit Services capacity management program, supports budget and resource governance, acts as a key Engineering interface with Business Operations Planning (BOP), and coordinates the end-to-end lifecycle of resource and recruitment requests.

Key Responsibilities

Capacity Planning and Resource Management

  • Lead the Travel Unit Services capacity management program, aligning budget, workforce capacity, skills, recruitment plans and demand forecasts through the R.A.D.A.R. (Resource Allocation, Demand and Recruitment) framework.
  • Develop and maintain an operating model that connects budget allocation, Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) capacity, workforce footprint and recruitment activities with portfolio priorities and anticipated demand.
  • Coordinate resource planning, hiring needs, workload visibility and capacity monitoring across Services Engineering and relevant stakeholder groups.
  • Establish reporting, governance routines and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) that provide visibility into capacity, recruitment progress, workload and demand gaps.
  • Drive continuous improvements to workforce planning processes, data quality, reporting and decision-making practices.

Budget Management and Financial Steering

  • Manage assigned transversal budget lines, ensuring accurate planning, forecasting, monitoring and reporting.
  • Support budget owners by facilitating collaboration across Engineering, Finance, Business Operations Planning (BOP) and business stakeholders.
  • Consolidate budget inputs, identify risks and variances, and recommend corrective actions to support financial objectives.
  • Prepare business cases and arbitration requests with clear rationale, quantified impacts and decision options.
  • Promote fact-based decision-making through meaningful financial and operational reporting.

Stakeholder Coordination and Governance

  • Partner with Engineering, Finance, People & Culture (P&C), Lean Portfolio Management (LPM), delivery teams and business stakeholders to align priorities, governance and decision-making.
  • Act as the primary Engineering contact for budget and resource topics with Business Operations Planning (BOP).
  • Translate Engineering priorities and constraints into operational and financial insights to support planning and arbitration discussions.
  • Facilitate governance forums, escalation paths and recurring reviews to ensure timely visibility and resolution of capacity or budget challenges.
  • Foster alignment, transparency and shared understanding across stakeholders by making assumptions, dependencies and risks visible.

Resource Demand and Recruitment Follow-up

  • Collect, structure and monitor resource and recruitment requests, ensuring clarity of scope, timing, location, funding and approval status.
  • Coordinate approval processes with Engineering leadership, People & Culture (P&C), Business Operations Planning (BOP) and governance forums.
  • Maintain end-to-end visibility of resource requests from demand identification through approval, recruitment and staffing progress.
  • Report on recruitment status, pending decisions, bottlenecks, workforce ratios and delivery risks.
  • Support proactive workforce planning by identifying opportunities to improve predictability, simplify processes and reduce lead times.

Key Interfaces

  • Services Engineering leadership teams.
  • Business Operations Planning (BOP), Finance and People & Culture (P&C) stakeholders.
  • Lean Portfolio Management (LPM) and delivery organizations.
  • Budget line owners and recruitment stakeholders across Travel Unit.
  • Portfolio, business and operational governance forums.

Success Measures

  • Capacity management governance, reporting and planning processes are established, understood and consistently followed.
  • Budget monitoring is accurate, timely and actionable, enabling effective decision-making and prioritization.
  • Engineering requirements and constraints are clearly reflected in budget planning and business discussions.
  • Resource and recruitment requests are managed with improved visibility, transparency and follow-through.
  • Stakeholders recognize the role as a trusted coordination point for budget, capacity and workforce planning topics.
  • Continuous improvements reduce manual effort, increase efficiency and improve operational predictability.

Ideal Candidate

  • Experience in operations management, program management, financial planning, workforce planning, portfolio management or Engineering delivery coordination.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholders, priorities and decision-makers in a matrix environment.
  • Strong understanding of capacity planning, resource management, budget management and operational performance monitoring.
  • Ability to translate complex operational and financial information into clear reporting, recommendations and actionable decisions.
  • Effective stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills, with the ability to build alignment across diverse teams.
  • Data-driven and structured approach, with experience using reporting, dashboards and KPIs to support decision-making.
  • Continuous improvement mindset, with a focus on simplifying processes, enhancing transparency and improving operational efficiency.

What we can offer you ?

🎯 A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you will be powering the future of travel and pursuing a critical mission and extraordinary purpose.

🌎 A truly global DNA - Everything at Amadeus is global, from our people to our business, which translates into our footprint, processes, and culture.

🎓 Great opportunities to learn - Learning happens all the time and in many ways at Amadeus, through on-the-job training, formal learning activities, and day-to-day interactions with colleagues.

🤗 A caring environment - Amadeus fosters a caring environment, nurturing both a fulfilling career and personal and family life. We care about our employees and strive to provide a supportive work environment.

💰 A complete rewards offer - Amadeus provides attractive remuneration packages, covering all essential components of a competitive reward offer, including salary, bonus, equity, and benefits.

🌟 A flexible working model - We want our employees to do their best work, wherever and however it works best for them.

🌈 A diverse and inclusive community - We are committed to leveraging our uniquely diverse population to drive innovation, creativity, and collaboration across our organization.

📈 A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental values that drive our actions and shape long-lasting relationships with our customers, partners, and employees.

Diversity & Inclusion

Amadeus aspires to be a leader in Diversity and Inclusion in the tech industry, enabling every employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment, attracting the best talent from all backgrounds, and as a role model for an inclusive employee experience. 

Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer and committed to an accessible recruitment process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law.

Be aware of recruitment scams

Amadeus Group never charges fees, requests payment, or asks for financial information during recruitment. All legitimate opportunities are communicated solely through official Amadeus channels, including our careers website. Any payment request or outreach via unofficial platforms (e.g., WhatsApp, Telegram) should be treated as fraudulent.

job.job_description:
About Us:


Sojern is the leading AI-powered marketing platform built for hospitality, designed to boost growth and profitability for the travel industry. The Sojern marketing platform is a set of easy-to-use software and services that delivers unrivaled traveler insight, intelligent audiences, multichannel activation and optimization, and a connected guest experience—all in one place. More than 10,000 travel marketers rely on our platform annually to find, attract, convert and engage travelers. Sojern, founded in 2007 and acquired by RateGain in 2025, is headquartered in San Francisco, California with teams in the Americas, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and Asia Pacific.


The Role:


As a Senior Client Success Manager, you’ll have the opportunity to work with major travel and brand advertisers in the fast-paced, online travel-advertising environment. You will play a critical role within the company through hands-on management of advertiser campaigns while developing and maintaining our partner relationships.

We are looking for someone who wants to work in a fast-paced, innovative company and is passionate about putting the customer first.

As a Senior Client Success Manager at Sojern, you will be responsible for managing all aspects of the advertiser campaign post-launch, including but not limited to, driving further growth and retention of top-tier customers by ensuring campaign success and client satisfaction.

This role requires a strong focus on delivering world-class service to our Sojern Customers and consistently thinking of ways we can add value, whether it be in our products, support, or engagement activities.

To succeed, you must work well with people, be comfortable multitasking, making data-driven decisions, and have a drive to learn!


Responsibilities:


  • Demonstrate excellent customer communication skills over the phone, email, web conferencing, and in person
  • Quick learner of different technologies and platforms
  • Lead the day-to-day, post-sales relationship with a portfolio of digital advertising clients, with a focus on our top-tier Property clients
  • Take ownership of your book of business to drive relationships with your clients leading to renewals and upsells, ensuring campaign success and client satisfaction
  • Grow revenue through pitching new products and channels
  • Coordinate with AdOps, analyze campaign performance, and provide recommendations to ensure client satisfaction
  • Meet client KPIs, goals, and objectives
  • Lead post-campaign analysis and review
  • Coordinate billing for clients on a monthly basis
  • Partner closely with internal teams on day-to-day operational processes and larger, high-impact strategic improvements
  • Present campaign results and insights, as well as Business Reviews to clients on a regular basis
  • Monitor and influence campaign delivery, troubleshoot issues and provide optimization and/or upsell opportunities across products
  • Responsible for larger revenue accounts or more strategic accounts
  • Responsible for training and/or mentoring new team members
  • Leads both team and cross-functional efforts as needed


Success Criteria:


  • Prioritizing Sales Opportunities - Systematically identifies and evaluates sales opportunities within the account and targets those with the greatest potential for producing positive results; prioritizes sales opportunities based on a firm understanding of the customer’s business priorities and anticipated business changes, decision-making processes, and buying history
  • Business Acumen - Using one’s knowledge of economic, financial, market, and industry trends to understand and improve individual, work group, and/or organizational results; using one’s understanding of major business functions, industry trends, and own organization’s position to contribute to effective business strategies and/or tactics.
  • Sustaining Customer Satisfaction - Supporting customers during the implementation of sales contracts and throughout the relationship; seeking and taking appropriate actions on customer feedback; resolving difficult issues in a timely and professional manner; taking responsibility for customer satisfaction and loyalty.
  • High Impact Communication - Clearly and succinctly conveying information and ideas to individuals and groups in a variety of situations; communicating in a focused and compelling way that drives others’ thoughts and actions.
  • Operational Decision Making - Securing and comparing information from multiple sources to identify business issues; committing to an action after weighing alternative solutions against important decision criteria.
  • Continuous Improvement - Originating action to improve existing conditions and processes; identifying improvement opportunities, generating ideas, and implementing solutions.


What you bring to the table:


  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university
  • 5+ years overall experience, with at least 2 years in digital and programmatic advertising and/or hotel vertical
  • Proficiency in standard business and sales software, including Salesforce, Gsuite, and Office products
  • Ability to handle multiple clients & campaigns on any given day
  • Great time management and organizational skills
  • Must be flexible in working with global clients
  • Experience working with a DSP (Appnexus/Xander, DV360 The Trade Desk) and/or Adphorus or other Social Media platforms
  • Understanding of the online advertising industry


Perks:


  • Opportunities: Be part of a growing team with training and support to help you grow
  • Ownership: Lead creative and challenging projects
  • Give Back: We give 20 hours a year to volunteer and organize office volunteer programs with local organizations
  • Culture: Strong core business values, focus on teamwork, vibrant, social and fun environment
  • Competitive Localized Benefits
  • Time Off: Flexible vacation days


Equal Opportunity Employer

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

job.job_description:
The Opportunity

At InterContinental Hayman Great Barrier Reef, every day begins with ocean views and the spirit of true hospitality. Live, work, and thrive on one of the iconic 74 Whitsunday Islands, where a rewarding career meets an extraordinary island lifestyle - delivering and inspiring incredible experiences for our guests and colleagues alike.

Love the ocean, thrive on adventure, and know what it takes to create unforgettable guest experiences? This is your opportunity to take your career to the next level in one of Australia’s most spectacular island destinations.

As Marine Activities - Assistant Guest Experience Manager, you’ll be at the heart of Hayman Island’s incredible experiences on the water. From welcoming guests aboard private charters and coordinating unforgettable marine adventures to supporting motorised water sports and working alongside our marine team and external tour operators, you’ll help bring the magic of the Whitsundays to life.

Reporting to the Guest Experience Manager and working with the broader Guest Experience team, you’ll lead from the front - inspiring your team, creating seamless guest journeys and ensuring every experience is delivered safely, professionally and with genuine warmth. You’ll have the opportunity to turn a day on the water into a “wow” moment, whether that’s a private island adventure, an exhilarating water sports experience or simply helping a guest discover the beauty of the Great Barrier Reef.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who loves being around people, thrives in a fast-paced environment and understands that the little details make a big difference. You’ll support operational excellence, champion safety and compliance, build strong relationships with our partners and continuously look for new ways to elevate our marine experiences.

If you’re ready to swap the ordinary life for island life, lead a passionate team and create experiences guests will remember long after they leave Hayman, we’d love to hear from you.

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

  • Lead the action on the water, oversee the daily marina and water sports operation, from guest arrivals and vessel movements to charters, berthing and motorised activities.
  • Create unforgettable guest experiences, deliver a polished VIP marina arrival and work closely with Concierge, Front Office and other teams to make every guest’s journey seamless.
  • Keep everything ship-shape, ensure our vessels, pontoons, equipment and guest areas are beautifully presented, safe, clean and ready for the day ahead.
  • Lead and inspire your team, coach, develop and support your people while coordinating rosters, briefings, training and day-to-day operations across a busy island environment.
  • Balance safety, service and performance, stay ahead of weather and operational changes, maintain maritime compliance, work with Engineering and partners, and identify opportunities to grow our marine experiences and revenue.

See Yourself in Our Team

To be successful in this full-time role, you’ll have:

  • Demonstrated leadership experience in marine, marina, vessel or watersports operations within a commercial environment.
  • Coxswain Grade 1 (minimum requirement)
  • Current First Aid, CPR or role-appropriate equivalents.
  • Strong working knowledge of AMSA, DETSI, GBRMPA, Maritime Safety Queensland, marine safety management systems, Work Health and Safety and vessel compliance.
  • Experience managing vessel documentation, team certifications, maintenance planning, risk assessments and emergency procedures.
  • Strong leadership, communication and guest-service skills within a luxury or high-service environment.
  • Financial acumen with experience in managing budgets, revenue and labour.
  • Ability to build effective relationships with regulators, contractors, tour operators, vessel owners and internal stakeholders.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and confidence making operational decisions in changing weather and marine conditions.

Live the Island Life

  • Join a vibrant and diverse team, making lifelong friendships, and become part of an unforgettable island community.
  • We make island living convenient and affordable with subsidised staff accommodation and meals. We also offer dedicated staff facilities - pool, beach, gym, bar, diner, laundry, and more.
  • Enjoy swimming, snorkeling, hiking, kayaking, and exploring the Whitsundays after your shift or on your days off.
  • Your commute ends in paradise, with beautiful beaches and breathtaking ocean views just moments away.
  • Grow your career with opportunities for career growth, training, and professional development.
  • Enjoy exclusive employee, friends, and family discount rates across our InterContinental Hotels & Resorts properties worldwide.

At IHG Hotels & Resorts, we believe great hospitality starts with great people. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome, respected and valued. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, religions, genders, gender identities and sexual orientations. We pride ourselves on a diverse and family friendly environment, and welcome applicants with primary school aged children as our island offers a State Primary School.

If you require any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know, we're here to support you.

Ready to Work in Paradise

  • Please visit our Careers Page for all details regarding living and working on Hayman Island at: https://haymanisland.intercontinental.com/careers/ or click the ‘Apply Now’ button.
  • We also invite you to learn more by following our social channels:
    • Facebook via @ICHIRcareers and Instagram via @ihg_australia_careers
Applications close on 24 October 2026. We will be reviewing and contacting candidates throughout the advertising period. This application will close earlier if candidate is found and the position is filled.

Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

job.job_description:
Description de l'entreprise

Orfea, qui sommes-nous ?

Orfea est un acteur spécialisé dans l'hébergement hôtelier, dédié aux déplacements professionnels du personnel ferroviaire. Filiale des groupes SNCF et Accor, l'entreprise s'appuie sur une double expertise - connaissance des besoins opérationnels et savoir-faire hôtelier - pour proposer des solutions d'hébergement adaptées, fiables et de qualité aux personnels SNCF en déplacement professionnel.

Son activité repose sur l'exploitation de résidences hôtelières situées à proximité des gares, ainsi que sur un réseau élargi d'hôtels partenaires à l'échelle nationale.

L'objectif est de garantir aux collaborateurs SNCF en mobilité des conditions d'accueil et d'hébergement optimales, alliant confort, proximité et continuité de service, tout en proposant une offre flexible répondant aux contraintes opérationnelles des déplacements professionnels.

Orfea, quelles sont nos missions ?

Proposer un hébergement sur-mesure au sein du réseau des résidences Orfea et des prestataires hôteliers pour une activité d'1.5 millions de nuitées/an.

Offrir des solutions clef en main pour l'organisation de réunions et de séminaires.

Orfea, quelles sont nos valeurs ?

Engagement, coopération, satisfaction client, sens de l'hospitalité.

Au-delà de l'exigence sur les fondamentaux de la relation client en hôtellerie, Orfea s'assure du développement des compétences de ses collaborateurs, en proposant des parcours formation adaptés et sur-mesure aux besoins des équipes.

Description du poste

Le Gestionnaire de réservations (H/F) gère les demandes de réservations des clients, en veillant à leur satisfaction par une relation personnalisée, une prestation d'hébergement de qualité et le bon déroulement de leur séjour.

Son rôle principal est d'assister les clients dans le processus de réservation en leur fournissant des informations précises et en répondant à leurs demandes.

Missions Principales

  • Suivre les réservations (départ et arrivée) et coordonner l'affectation des réservations auprès des partenaires hôteliers ;
  • Administrer la relation avec les partenaires hôteliers et traiter les réservations dans le respect des contrats et des tarifs négociés ;
  • Vérifier la disponibilité auprès des partenaires hôteliers et effectuer l'affectation des réservations correspondantes ;
  • Collaborer avec le pôle hôtelier, les résidences du réseau Orfea et les partenaires externes pour assurer la bonne exécution des réservations ;
  • Veiller à la qualité des prestations et à l'application des normes et procédures;
  • Assurer le suivi des réservations, notamment en effectuant les modifications ou les annulations demandées par les clients ;
  • Gérer les éventuels problèmes ou les litiges / réclamations des clients liés aux réservations ;
  • Contribuer au respect des standards hébergements et contribuer à l'atteinte des objectifs qualitatifs et quantitatifs du service ;
  • Participer à l'optimisation du taux d'occupation des résidences du réseau Orfea ;
  • Participer à la maîtrise du prix moyen hôtelier sur la zone géographique ;
  • Assurer le contrôle et le traitement des factures en cohérence avec la réservation et les informations de l'hôtel et participer à la recherche d'informations dans le cadre de litige de 1erniveau sous la supervision et la validation de son N+1.

Qualifications

Profil organisé et rigoureux, avec une 1ère expérience réussie en centrale de réservation, centre d'appels et relation client. Capable de gérer les réservations, le suivi administratif et les demandes clients avec réactivité et professionnalisme. À l'aise dans un environnement dynamique, avec un bon sens de l'organisation, du service client et du travail en équipe.

La Société fonde ses recrutements sur les seules compétences, expériences professionnelles, formations et qualifications des candidats H/F.

Informations supplémentaires

Nos Avantages

  • 13ème mois sous condition d'ancienneté
  • Prime de participation sous condition d'ancienneté
  • Ticket restaurant et Indemnités Compensatrices de Nourriture
  • Remboursement du titre de transport à 75%
  • Mutuelle prévoyance avantageuse

job.job_description:
About Us

Since 2014, Trip.com 's Customer Support Centre has expanded to include 15 global customer support centres worldwide. By collaborating across all our global sites, we are able to provide customer support in more than 20 languages and across 13 product lines, catering to the diverse needs of travellers around the world.


With over 30,000 employees in 30 countries, and Customer Service Centres in Japan, Korea, the UK, and the Philippines, we provide 24/7 support in 19 languages. Our mission is simple: to make every journey the best it can be, at the best possible price.


The Role

As a Customer Service Advisor, you’ll be the voice of Trip.com - helping travellers with everything from hotel bookings to flight queries while delivering exceptional service across phone, chat, and email.


Location: 1 Lochrin Square, Edinburgh

Hours: Full-time, 37.5 hours per week


What You’ll Do:

  • Deliver outstanding customer service with empathy and professionalism via phone, chat, and email, across English and another EMEA language lines.
  • Take ownership of customer concerns, resolving travel-related issues end-to-end.
  • Communicate clearly and confidently across multiple channels.
  • Collaborate within a supportive team to achieve KPIs and service targets.
  • Share ideas to improve customer experience and internal processes.
  • Represent the Trip.com culture in every interaction.

What You’ll Bring

  • Previous customer service experience, ideally in a contact centre environment.
  • Fluent in English and another EMEA language (written and verbal).
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with resilience under pressure.
  • Ability to handle multiple web chats with fast, accurate typing.
  • Confident working towards and achieving KPIs / Targets.
  • Motivated, adaptable, with eagerness to learn and grow.
  • Comfortable navigating multiple systems to resolve queries efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Travel & Tourism industry experience – desirable but not essential


Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • 33 days annual leave (including bank holidays)
  • 3 extra days for parents/guardians, plus long service leave after 10+ years
  • $600 USD in Trip Coins annually to spend on your next adventure
  • Monthly performance bonuses & $450 USD refer-a-friend scheme
  • Health cash back plan for dental, optical, physiotherapy, massages & more
  • Employee Assistance Program, wellbeing support & enhanced sick pay
  • Enhanced family policies (maternity, paternity & adoption)
  • Life insurance worth 4x your annual salary
  • Hybrid working options (based on performance)
  • Free on-site gym and discounted memberships at Nuffield Health & PureGym
  • Continuous learning & genuine career development opportunities
  • Birthday & service anniversary celebrations with gift cards and cake
  • Regular team events, social activities, and recognition programmes.
  • Fun team days with seasonal and cultural celebrations, work anniversaries, games, prizes, awards, free lunches and sweet treats!


Culture

At Trip.com, our culture is all about people, we're a truly global and multicultural workforce with team members from over 30 countries. We strive to foster a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and inspired to grow. We enable you to unleash your full potential and make impact. With a real commitment to internal progression and promotion, your Trip.com journey could take you anywhere, many of our senior leaders started with us in this very role!


Find out more job opportunities at https://careers.trip.com


Have a good trip, and see you soon!

Objetivo del puesto

Planificar, coordinar y supervisar la operación integral de grupos, convenciones y eventos, asegurando el cumplimiento de los acuerdos comerciales, los estándares de servicio, la rentabilidad y la satisfacción del cliente.

  • Coordinar la planeación y ejecución de grupos, convenciones, bodas, reuniones y eventos corporativos.

  • Elaborar reportes de resultados, satisfacción del cliente y oportunidades de mejora.
  • Capacitar y coordinar al equipo involucrado en la operación de grupos y convenciones.
  • Garantizar el cumplimiento de los estándares de servicio y políticas de la compañía.

  • Licenciatura en Hotelería, Turismo, Administración o carrera afín.

  • Conocimiento de operación de grupos, eventos corporativos, bodas y reuniones.
  • Habilidades de negociación, organización, comunicación y seguimiento.
  • Capacidad para coordinar equipos multidisciplinarios y trabajar bajo presión.
  • Orientación al servicio y atención al detalle.
  • Manejo de presupuestos, contratos, órdenes de servicio y reportes operativos.
  • Dominio de inglés; otros idiomas serán considerados una ventaja.
  • Disponibilidad para trabajar con horarios flexibles, incluyendo fines de semana y eventos especiales.

We have four Customer Service Centres for Trip.com established in Japan, Korea, the UK, and the Philippines, providing 24/7 customer service in 19 different languages.


We have more than 30,000 employees scattered across 30 countries in Asia, Europe, the Americas, and Oceania, striving to expand our global markets and aiming to be the world’s leading and most trusted family of online travel brands that aspire to deliver the perfect trip at the best price for every traveller.


Introduction

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Senior Compliance Advisor to support in maintaining and strengthening the Company's global AML/CFT and sanctions compliance framework for TripLink’s licensed payment institutions. The role sits within the AML Compliance team, responsible for performing independent quality assurance reviews on AML operations and financial crime controls, providing regulatory advisory to business and operational

stakeholders, supporting payments licensing and governance initiatives, and contributing to the continuous enhancement of AML systems and controls.


The successful candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams, including AML Operations, Product, Legal, Risk, and Technology, to ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements across multiple jurisdictions, including Hong Kong, Singapore, and the European Union. This role also supports regulatory engagements, financial crime investigations, policy governance, corporate secretariat activities, and enterprise-wide AML/CFT initiatives, while promoting a strong culture of compliance throughout the organisation.


In this Role, you’ll get to

  • Conduct ongoing Quality Assurance (“QA”) reviews on AML Operations work (e.g. customer due diligence, transaction monitoring and name screening alerts) to ensure adherence to HKMA, MAS, and EU regulatory standards.
  • Prepare QA review metrics for periodic reporting to Senior Management.
  • Provide regulatory advisory to internal stakeholders (e.g. AML Operations, Business) to address AML/Sanctions risks and new product risk assessments.
  • Review internal suspicious activity escalations and prepare SAR/STR reports for MLRO’s review.
  • Participate in the enhancement of transaction monitoring rules.
  • Coordinate global AML training roll out to all employees and prepare training materials.
  • Collaborate with Compliance, Product and other stakeholders to support new regulatory license applications external audits, and global policy governance.
  • Support the MLRO with the implementation of the company’s AML/CFT framework.
  • Manage corporate registers for the TripLink entities and act as Committee Secretary for board and compliance risk meetings.


What you'll Need to Succeed

  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance or Business, with at least 3years of financial crime compliance working experience in licensed payment institutions, corporate banking or audit/regulatory environment; CAMS (Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist) certification is a plus.
  • Familiar with Singapore Payment Services Act and financial crime regulatory requirements, including MAS Notice PSN01, Sanctions regulations Knowledge of HK and EU regulatory requirements is a plus.
  • Good understanding of controls on transaction monitoring, sanctions/PEP/adverse media screenings and corporate customer due diligence.
  • Fluent in both written and verbal English. Mandarin speaking is a plus due to business need for communication with stakeholders based in different jurisdictions.
  • Highly organised and analytical, with the ability to interpret complex transaction patterns and able to make sound judgement.
  • Capable of managing multiple workstreams independently in a fast-paced environment. Proficient Excel, SQL or Data Visualization skills will be an added advantage to work with technology teams to drive implementation and optimisation of system controls.


Why Trip.com Group

We offer a stage to unleash your full potential and drive global impact. As an international team, we embrace an open and inclusive culture that supports and respect team members in and out of the workplace. Everyone is on a trip, whether it's a career trip or a life trip. At Trip.com Group, you can define your own trip by setting a goal and celebrate your success by recognizing the progress you have made.


What’s more?

  • Our rapid business growth in global offers abundant career opportunities at various levels and in multiple functions
  • Internal transfer is encouraged, and global job rotation program enable you to pursue a global career path and make global impact
  • We provide learning opportunities to further your career in areas of leadership capability, soft skill and professional expertise.
  • We encourage flexible work arrangement
  • Have fun with company-sponsored greetings and activities at holidays, birthdays, and colorful team events.

job.job_description:
Description de l'entreprise

Reconnu dans le monde entier pour l’excellence de ses services de conciergerie haut de gamme, et aujourd’hui salué pour ses programmes de marketing sur mesure, John Paul accompagne les marques qui lui confient leurs meilleurs clients afin de développer avec eux une relation émotionnelle forte et engageante.

John Paul est une entreprise internationale (4 hubs à travers le monde) dont le siège, situé au cœur du Marais à Paris, accueille plus de 150 passionnés animés par une quête permanente de la satisfaction de ses Clients et de ses Membres. Cette entreprise française, qui appartient au groupe Accor depuis 2016, défend des valeurs d’excellence du service et d’engagement irréprochable.

Chez John Paul, l’humain est au cœur des priorités, qu’il s’agisse de servir ses nombreux Clients, ses Membres prestigieux ou ses précieux Collaborateurs.

Description du poste

Dans le cadre de notre activité de conciergerie et de la montée en compétences de nos concierges, nous recrutons un.e Responsable de formation.

Missions Opérationnelles

Rattaché.e au Responsable Qualité et Formation Paris, vous assurerez le pilotage global des actions de formation, de la conception à la mise en œuvre de ces dernières. Vos missions seront les suivantes :

  • Préparer et animer des formations initiales et continues (books, plannings, salles, mails de bienvenue, fiche IT…) ;
  • Créer des nouveaux contenus « présentiel » et « en ligne »
  • Concevoir et coordonner des parcours de formation groupés ou individualisés adaptés aux besoins des concierges et managers
  • Mettre en place un dispositif d’évaluation des salariés formés et de l’impact des actions de formation.
  • Mesurer l’évolution des performances de l’entreprise à court et moyen terme.
  • Communiquer auprès de la direction et des salariés sur les résultats des actions de formation.
  • Conseiller et soutenir les managers et les concierges sur l’ensemble des questions relatives à la formation.
  • Réaliser les audits qualités

Missions Stratégiques

  • Identifier et analyser les besoins en formation au sein de la conciergerie
  • Contribuer à la définition de la stratégie de formation en lien avec les enjeux de l’entreprise et les attentes de nos clients, en collaboration avec les équipes Opérations et le COO EMEA
  • Élaborer un projet pédagogique cohérent avec le recensement des besoins et du budget disponible
  • Soumettre le plan de formation à la direction
  • Participer à l’amélioration continue des dispositifs existants et à la promotion de l’innovation pédagogiqu

Qualifications

Titulaire d’une formation de niveau Bac+3 minimum (Licence, Master ou équivalent), vous pouvez justifier d’au moins trois années d’expérience dans une fonction similaire, idéalement dans le domaine de l’ingénierie de formation, de la coordination pédagogique ou de la gestion de projet.

  • Vous disposez d’une solide expertise du secteur de la formation professionnelle.
  • Vous êtes doté d’excellentes compétences techniques et organisationnelles, vous savez concevoir et utiliser des supports pédagogiques numériques (suite bureautique, plateformes e-learning, outils audiovisuels et visioconférences).
  • Vous êtes rigoureux(se), méthodique et discret(e), vous faites preuve d’un réel sens de l’organisation, d’une grande polyvalence et d’un excellent relationnel.
  • Vous êtes à l’aise dans la gestion de projet, la planification
  • Vous savez travailler aussi bien en équipe qu’en autonomie.
  • Vous aimez : partager vos connaissances, votre expertise, votre savoir-faire
  • Vous êtes à l’aise sur PPT, Excel
  • Vous parlez anglais couramment
  • Vous avez le sens du respect des procédures

Informations supplémentaires

Poste basé au siège dans le quartier du Marais à Paris (75003).

  • Évoluer dans une entreprise innovante et un secteur dynamique en pleine croissance ;
  • Intégrer une entreprise et un Groupe international qui offrent des opportunités d’évolution ;
  • Bénéficier de formations métier complètes tout au long de votre parcours professionnel ;
  • Rejoindre une équipe soudée, bienveillante et conviviale ;
  • Travailler dans un environnement idéal : bureaux neufs au cœur de Paris, vue rooftop à 360°… ;
  • Tickets Restaurants pris en charge à 60%
  • Remboursement Navigo à 75% et pack mobilité durable.
  • Deux jours de télétravail par semaine (à l’issue de la période d’essai).
  • Entreprise Handi-friendly, John Paul promeut la diversité et l’inclusion et se réjouit d’accueillir des personnes en situation de handicap.

Live the InterContinental Life.

心を震わせる美しい自然と、最高のおもてなしが融合するこのホテルで、あなたのキャリアにラグジュアリーな1ページを刻んでみませんか？

【職務について】

ANAインターコンチネンタル万座ビーチリゾートのクラブラウンジマネジャーは、クラブフロアにご滞在のお客様に、快適で心地よい時間をお過ごしいただけるよう、クラブラウンジチームをまとめ、質の高いサービスを提供します。またお客様の満足を常に最優先に考え、キッチンやシェフと連携しながら、季節やニーズに合わせたメニューの見直しや改善を行い、上質な飲食体験をお届けします。また、ラウンジを小規模な高級リゾートホテルとして捉え、日々の運営全体に責任を持ち、サービスの細部にまで気を配りながら、クラブInterContinentalラウンジの価値向上に努めて頂きます。

【日常業務内容】

スタッフ対応

  • 日々の人員配置業務の管理、仕事の計画と割り当て、チームメンバーのパフォーマンス・スキルアップ目標の策定を行う。
  • チームメンバーのパフォーマンス改善のためのメンタリング、コーチング、定期的なフィードバックを行う。
  • 国や地域の法律と安全規制に従ってチームメンバーに指導や研修を実施。またスタッフが適切な研修を受けていること、業務の遂行に必要なツールや知識を備えていることを随時確認。
  • チームメンバーがシステム・セキュリティ・サービス・クオリティのスタンダードに関する適切な研修を受けているかどうか確認を行う。

お客様への対応

  • チームメンバーがお客様に対して迅速な対応やプロフェッショナルな気配りを行い、一人ひとりのお客様を個人として認識するよう徹底してください。
  • お客様が到着されたら、ご挨拶の後、個別にやり取りする時間を設けて頂き、お客様からの苦情に真摯に対応し、ご意見を求め、継続的に顧客満足度を改善できる関係を構築を進めて頂きます。
  • クラブラウンジホールエリア、バックエリアの定期点検を実施し、欠陥のある場合はすぐに対策案を提案し解決に導く姿勢を心掛けて頂きます。

財務

  • 年間部門運営予算・財務計画の準備を支援してください。在庫管理体制およびイニシアチブを築き上げ、料金戦略に重点を置いた予算の監視と人件費と経費の管理を行います。
  • ウォークインのお客様獲得とアップセルによる客室稼働率と平均客室単価（ADR）の向上計画を作成＆実行

job.company_description: Trip.com Group is a leading one-stop travel service provider comprising of Trip.com, Ctrip, Skyscanner, and Qunar. Founded in 1999, listed on Nasdaq in 2003 and HKEX in 2021, Trip.com Group has become one of the largest travel companies in the world in terms of gross merchandise value.
job.job_description:
About the Role

Trip.com Group is one of the world's leading online travel platforms, connecting hundreds of millions of travellers with partners across accommodation, transport, and experiences. Japan represents one of our most strategically important markets - a mature, high-value travel ecosystem with deeply rooted commercial relationships and significant growth potential in both inbound and outbound travel.

We are seeking a Japan Partnership Lead to own and elevate our partnerships and affiliate strategy across the Japanese market. This is a high-impact strategic leadership role — not a country manager or sales executor position. You will shape the commercial growth agenda for Japan, build and deepen relationships with key local partners, and drive the strategic direction of our partnerships channel in one of the most competitive and nuanced travel markets in the world.

You will work closely with the Senior Marketing Partnerships & Affiliate Director and serve as a key leadership voice for Japan.


Key Responsibilities

Japan Market Commercial Strategy

  • Define and execute the Japan partnerships commercial strategy, aligned to Trip.com Group's broader growth priorities and the unique dynamics of the Japanese market.
  • Identify, prioritise, and capture high-value commercial opportunities — including strategic partnerships with leading Japanese travel platforms, affiliate networks, media companies, and emerging digital channels.
  • Translate global partnerships strategy into locally compelling, culturally attuned market plans that resonate with Japanese business partners and stakeholders.
  • Drive revenue growth across Japan's partnerships channel, contributing materially to Trip.com Group's regional financial performance.

Partner Ecosystem Development

  • Build and maintain C-suite and senior-level relationships with key Japanese partners — including major travel platforms (e.g. Rakuten Travel, Yahoo! Travel / LINE Yahoo), affiliate networks (e.g. A8.net, ValueCommerce), media houses, airlines, and tourism boards.
  • Navigate Japan's relationship-driven business culture to establish trust, credibility, and long-term commercial alignment with strategic partners.
  • Identify and develop new partnership models suited to the Japanese market — exploring opportunities in content partnerships, loyalty programmes, co-marketing, and emerging distribution channels.
  • Monitor the competitive landscape and evolving partner ecosystem in Japan, ensuring Trip.com Group maintains a differentiated and commercially compelling value proposition.

Leadership & Team Elevation

  • Support, coach, and develop the Japan partnership team, elevating their strategic thinking, commercial execution, and partnership management capabilities.
  • Challenge and refine market plans, hold the team accountable to performance standards, and raise the quality of commercial decisions.
  • Act as a leadership multiplier — scaling the effectiveness of the partnerships organisation through mentorship, knowledge sharing, and capability building.
  • Foster a high-performance culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Operational Governance & Execution Quality

  • Drive commercial governance, forecasting discipline, and planning rigour within the Japan market.
  • Ensure ROI frameworks, commercial governance standards, and performance reporting are applied consistently and transparently.
  • Strengthen the planning cadence, ensuring reliable, accurate commercial pipelines and partner performance visibility.
  • Coordinate cross-functional initiatives that enhance execution quality and operational efficiency.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders - including marketing, product, finance, legal, and regional leadership - to ensure Japan partnership priorities are well-represented and resourced.
  • Serve as a senior external-facing presence with key strategic partners, representing Trip.com Group at industry events, partner summits, and executive meetings.
  • Contribute to cross-functional strategic initiatives that extend the commercial reach and influence of the Partnerships channel across APAC.


Profile Requirements

We are looking for a leader who combines strategic commercial acumen with deep expertise in the Japanese market and a proven ability to navigate its unique business culture. The right candidate will be a hybrid of commercial strategist, partnerships leader, and relationship builder — not a traditional BD or sales profile.

Experience & Background

  • 8~10+ years of experience in partnerships, affiliate marketing, commercial strategy, or business development — ideally within travel, e-commerce, or consumer internet.
  • Demonstrated track record of driving commercial growth within the Japanese market, with measurable P&L or revenue impact.
  • Deep familiarity with Japan's travel and digital ecosystem — including major OTA players, affiliate networks, media partners, and the competitive dynamics shaping the market.
  • Experience leading or coaching high-performing teams, with strong capability in developing others and raising commercial standards.
  • Exposure to cross-functional, matrixed organisations and the ability to influence at senior levels across markets and functions.
  • Prior experience at a global or regional travel platform, Japanese travel company (e.g. JTB, KNT-CT Holdings, Rakuten Travel), or leading digital/affiliate company in Japan is highly desirable.

Language

  • Native Japanese - essential for building partner relationships, leading local teams, and operating effectively within the Japanese market.
  • Fluent English — required for collaboration with global leadership and cross-market teams.

Skills & Capabilities

  • Strategic thinking — ability to see the bigger picture, identify high-leverage opportunities in a complex market, and translate strategy into executable plans.
  • Commercial understanding — strong grasp of partnership economics, affiliate models, revenue drivers, and ROI frameworks within the Japanese digital landscape.
  • Relationship mastery — exceptional ability to build trust and credibility with senior Japanese business leaders, navigating the nuances of Japanese business culture (consensus-building, long-term relationship orientation, attention to detail).
  • Organisational leadership — ability to lead through influence, elevate teams, and drive accountability in a matrixed environment.
  • Operational discipline — structured approach to planning, forecasting, and performance governance.
  • Stakeholder management — confident communicator at senior and C-suite level, both internally and externally.
  • Coaching capability — genuine interest in developing others and raising the commercial capability of the team.


What We Offer

  • A strategic leadership role with direct impact on one of Trip.com Group's most important markets.
  • Exposure to a global, fast-growing travel platform with opportunities to shape the future of travel partnerships in Japan.
  • Competitive compensation package including performance-based incentives.
  • A collaborative, high-performance culture that values strategic thinking, initiative, and continuous learning.
  • Tokyo-based position with opportunities for regional and global collaboration.

Période : De Janvier à Juin 2027.

Description du poste

Conduite d’études quantitatives (analyses statistiques, segmentation…) et qualitatives en réponse à des problématiques business variées (nouveaux services/produits, business développement, innovation…)

  • Gestion de projets d’études (élaboration du brief, mise en place de l’approche pour chaque projet, suivi du projet, analyse des résultats et recommandations)
  • Planning stratégique (recherche de tendances, market sizing, benchmarking, recommandations)
  • Vous serez en charge aux côtés des managers d’un portefeuille de projets comme :
    • Travail sur les marques hôtelières du groupe Accor (réflexion et recherche autour du Brand Equity, de l’architecture et du positionnement des marques, par exemple ibis, Novotel, Mercure, Pullman)
