job.job_description:
Company Description

 Join Accor – a professional journey at the heart of a committed, international and transforming group

ALL Accor is the Group's loyalty and lifestyle programme, bringing together over 100 million members worldwide and offering a rich ecosystem of benefits across hospitality, travel, dining, entertainment, and partner rewards. Delivering truly memorable, differentiated experiences is at the heart of making ALL Accor more experiential and less transactional — strengthening emotional connection with members and deepening their engagement with the programme.

Job Description

Within the Loyalty ENA team, the Senior Manager ALL Accor Member Experiences is responsible for maximising Accor's sponsorship assets to create unique, exclusive experiences for ALL Accor members across ENA. By transforming assets such as Accor Arena, OVO Wembley Arena, and SailGP into curated member experiences — including Limitless Experiences, "money can't buy" moments unavailable through any other channel — this role directly enriches the ALL Accor value proposition and drives programme burn. The role also leads the ENA deployment of the new ALL Accor experience platform, encourages hotels to create in-hotel experiences in collaboration with the Go-to-Market ENA team, and works closely with Global Loyalty, Global Sponsoring, and the Brand Content & Social Media team to showcase and amplify these experiences.

Member Experience Strategy & Limitless Experiences

  • Define and lead the ALL Accor Member Experiences strategy for ENA, positioning experiences as a core pillar of the programme's value proposition
  • Maximise Accor's sponsorship assets to design and curate Limitless Experiences — exclusive "money can't buy" moments that elevate ALL Accor beyond a transactional loyalty programme
  • Deploy engagement mechanics such as auctions and prize draws to maximise member participation, reach, and points burn

Experience Platform & Event Agency Management

  • Lead the ENA deployment of the new ALL Accor experience platform, coordinating with global and technical teams
  • Work with the Go-to-Market ENA team to encourage hotels to create and list exclusive in-hotel experiences on the platform
  • Drive the group event agency and the consultants working for the ENA region

Global Collaboration — Sponsoring & Loyalty

  • Work closely with the Global Sponsoring team to access and maximise sponsorship assets for member experience purposes
  • Collaborate with the Global Loyalty team to ensure ENA initiatives are consistent with global strategy
  • Represent ENA in global workstreams related to experiential loyalty and sponsorship activation

Communication & Amplification

  • Lead the monthly CRM newsletter dedicated to member experiences, curating the portfolio and briefing the CRM team
  • Collaborate with the Senior Manager and Manager ALL Accor Brand Content & Social Media to amplify experiences through influencer campaigns and social media
  • Ensure experiences are compellingly showcased across all relevant touchpoints
  • Improve their awareness working on the overall strategy and audience targeting to market them better

Performance Monitoring

  • Own performance tracking of ALL Accor member experiences in ENA, with points burned as the primary KPI
  • Monitor platform engagement, auction and prize draw participation, and newsletter performance
  • Prepare regular reports for the VP and contribute to broader loyalty programme reporting

Qualifications

  • Experience in experiential marketing, loyalty, events, or sponsorship activation
  • Experience deploying or managing a consumer-facing digital platform is a strong plus
  • Good understanding of CRM, influencer marketing, and social media amplification
  • Familiarity with loyalty burn mechanics and points-based reward structures
  • Professional experience: 5–7 years in experiential marketing, loyalty, events, or sponsorship
  • Education: Master's degree (Bac +5) in Marketing, Communications, Events, or Business
  • International exposure: Multi-country experience is a plus
  • Languages: French and English mandatory

Additional Information

Why join us?

And what are our commitments?

To the world

  • Accor is committed to the world around us, with a strong employer culture focused on the development of our 300,000 talents.
  • We adopt a continuous improvement approach to reduce the environmental impact of digital across all our projects.

To your career

  • We enable all our employees to maintain a healthy work-life balance and give them the means to shape their working environment in their own image.
  • Dedicated Talent Management, continuous improvement, and training and development paths are defined both individually and collectively so that we can grow together, every day.

Concretely, At Accor

  • Remote work possible several days per week from France and flexible working options: work from home, our offices, or even our hotels and coworking spaces thanks to Worklib.

And also,

  • ALL - Heartist® program: preferential rates and flash offers for unforgettable stays and experiences across all our Accor locations and with our partners worldwide.
  • Heartist® for Good volunteering program: 1 day offered during your working time to get involved with a non-profit organization.
  • A Social and Economic Committee (CSE) that supports you in financing your cultural and sports activities.
  • Sustainable Mobility Package for using an eco-friendly means of transportation or a “company bike” program in partnership with Zenride.
  • Coverage of urban public transport subscriptions between home and workplace, in accordance with the French Finance Law scale.
  • Meal vouchers with a face value of €11.
  • A mandatory health insurance plan funded at 50% by Accor, at no additional cost in case of enrollment of your dependents.
  • Not to mention attractive working conditions with collaborative workspaces, restaurants, game areas, as well as well-being and sports spaces on site or through Gymlib.

Your talent and motivation are our only selection criteria.

We value the richness of diverse nationalities, personalities, and professional backgrounds.

We know how to adapt to the specific needs of our employees, particularly those with disabilities.

We encourage all applications, without distinction of gender, so dare to apply!

For us, recruitment is above all a story of encounters.

Does this role appeal to you? Apply, and we will offer you:

  • An initial discussion with our recruitment team to present the key elements of the role or guide you toward a position that may better suit you,
  • One or more interviews with managers and team members,
  • For certain roles, you may also be asked to complete a test or case study, as well as a questionnaire about your personality and motivations.
  • A final interview with our Human Resources team to discuss our Group culture, working environment, training program, and career prospects, as well as the different Group benefits.
  • Personalized feedback.

job.job_description:
Description de l'entreprise

Reconnu dans le monde entier pour l’excellence de ses services de conciergerie haut de gamme, et aujourd’hui salué pour ses programmes de marketing sur mesure, John Paul accompagne les marques qui lui confient leurs meilleurs clients afin de développer avec eux une relation émotionnelle forte et engageante.

John Paul est une entreprise internationale (4 hubs à travers le monde) dont le siège, situé au cœur du Marais à Paris, accueille plus de 150 passionnés animés par une quête permanente de la satisfaction de ses Clients et de ses Membres. Cette entreprise française, qui appartient au groupe Accor depuis 2016, défend des valeurs d’excellence du service et d’engagement irréprochable.

Chez John Paul, l’humain est au cœur des priorités, qu’il s’agisse de servir ses nombreux Clients, ses Membres prestigieux ou ses précieux Collaborateurs.

Description du poste

Dans le cadre de notre activité de conciergerie et de l’accompagnement de nos concierges dans le développement de leurs compétences, nous recrutons un(e) Chargé(e) Formation et qualité.

Tu as un sens aigu de la satisfaction client et tu souhaites contribuer à l’amélioration continue ?

Tu es proactif(ve), analytique, impartial(e) et tu aimes partager, collaborer et innover ?

Le pôle Qualité & Formation est fait pour toi !

Quelles seront tes missions ?

  • Évaluer la qualité produite en s’appuyant sur la grille d’audit de chaque pôle
  • Etudier et analyser les échanges écrits et les appels téléphoniques pour garantir une qualité de service premium
  • Coordonner la prise en compte et le traitement des retours d’expérience des membres
  • Assurer un suivi des insatisfactions en contactant les membres mécontents
  • Participer aux projets d’amélioration de la satisfaction des membres
  • Contribuer au déploiement des formations continues en présentiel et en E-Learning
  • Animer la formation initiale et accompagner les nouveaux arrivants dans leur montée en compétence
  • Assurer l’accompagnement sur le plateau des nouveaux concierges en sortie de formation initiale. Une réponse directe au décalage théorie/pratique
  • Réaliser un diagnostic individuel et assurer un suivi personnalisé des concierges à l’issue de leur parcours d’intégration (audits, écoutes, double écoute, tests)
  • Identifier les besoins de formation des collaborateurs de la conciergerie (concierges et concierge managers)
  • Réaliser des formations quotidiennes auprès des concierges sur le plateau sur les fondamentaux de la relation client : décroché des appels, qualification d’appel, reformulation, argumentation, personnalisation des propositions, recommandation, qualité des propositions, remplissage du CRM
  • Réaliser des débriefs à chaud avec les concierges pour favoriser l’amélioration immédiate des bonnes pratiques
  • Former les équipes aux nouvelles procédures ainsi qu’aux évolutions des comptes clients existants.
  • Réaliser des comptes-rendus mensuels à destination des Concierges Managers et au Responsable Formation

Liste non exhaustive susceptible d’évoluer.

Qualifications

Quelles sont les qualités requises ?

  • Être titulaire d’un diplôme Bac+4/+5
  • Adopter la philosophie Customer Centric et avoir à cœur d’obtenir la satisfaction des membres
  • Faire preuve d’empathie, d’écoute et de compréhension pour accompagner les équipes
  • Être perfectionniste en cherchant en permanence à s’améliorer, et à réaliser chaque mission de façon optimale
  • Être persévérant(e) et minutieux(se) dans la réalisation des études et analyses, afin de formuler un avis et des recommandations factuels et justes
  • Avoir à cœur de transmettre les connaissances métier en faisant preuve de pédagogie et de bienveillance
  • Faire preuve d’excellentes qualités rédactionnelles afin de communiquer de manière claire, structurée et adaptée à chaque interlocuteur
  • Avoir le goût du travail en équipe et contribuer activement à une collaboration fluide, constructive et bienveillante
  • Maîtriser parfaitement le français et l’anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, afin d’évoluer avec aisance dans un environnement international.

Informations supplémentaires

Poste basé au siège dans le quartier du Marais à Paris (75003).

Contrat en CDI - à pourvoir dès à présent

  • Évoluer dans une entreprise innovante et un secteur dynamique en pleine croissance
  • Intégrer une entreprise et un Groupe international qui offrent des opportunités d’évolution
  • Bénéficier de formations métier complètes tout au long de votre parcours professionnel
  • Rejoindre une équipe soudée, bienveillante et conviviale
  • Travailler dans un environnement idéal : bureaux neufs au cœur de Paris, vue rooftop à 360°…
  • Tickets Restaurants pris en charge à 60%
  • Remboursement Navigo à 75% et pack mobilité durable
  • 2 jours de télétravail par semaine au bout de 3 mois d’ancienneté
  • Entreprise Handi-friendly, John Paul promeut la diversité et l’inclusion et se réjouit d’accueillir des personnes en situation de handicap.

job.job_description:
Company Description

Why Work for Accor?

At Accor, we believe that hospitality is a work of heart. We understand the ways in which individual passion for our work and a shared sense of accomplishment create a more rewarding experience for our guests. We foster this culture through a diverse and inclusive workplace that values the contribution of each and every member of our team. We are committed to taking positive action in terms of business ethics and integrity, responsible tourism, sustainable development, community outreach, and diversity and inclusion.

Join a team where you can create your path, work with purpose, and enjoy and feel valued. Make it your next move.

Our Hotel

Located just minutes from Busselton’s town centre and nestled on 27 acres of peaceful beachfront land, Bayview Geographe Resort provides an ideal coastal retreat along the shores of Geographe Bay. Offering direct access to the beach and a variety of accommodation options—from studios to 1, 2, and 3 bedroom villas—it’s a popular choice for families and holidaymakers discovering the beauty of Western Australia’s southwest.

We are a fun, friendly and inclusive team. We pride ourselves in putting our team members first, always looking for ways to recognise their hard work and offer opportunities for ongoing training as well as career progression.

Job Description

This is a Permanent Part-time position, offering 2-3 days a week. As the Accounts Assistant, you are responsible for Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable functions of the resort, working closely with the Group Financial Controller and General Manager. In addition to this, the role also covers and is responsible for all aspects of the Accounts Receivable, Debtor Management and providing support to the Companies’ Departmental Managers in their operational day-to-day deliverables.

You will possess exceptional communication skills, strong organizational qualities and be an exceptional team player.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide crucial support to the Financial Controller and General Manager, in all areas of finance & administrative operations.
  • Responsible for all aspects of Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable.
  • Responsible for the Hotel’s debtor function i.e.: monitoring debtor payments, processing credit applications, debt collection, invoicing, banking, reconciliations and month end requirements.
  • Routine book-keeping, including maintenance of the general ledger and reconciliation of accounts.
  • Perform stock take process with other relevant personnel where required
  • Responsible for the matching of authorised Purchase Orders and delivery dockets to supplier’s invoices and accuracy of calculations and extensions.
  • Review accuracy in coding of expenses/invoices.
  • Perform Supplier’s Statement reconciliation.
  • Preparing payments to suppliers on a timely basis ensuring credit facility is optimally utilised and entitled discounts are taken.
  • Responsible for the maintenance of Accounts Payable Ledger.
  • Monthly reconciliation of Vendor statements.
  • Assist with day-to-day payroll processing and related administrative functions.
  • Support other departments and other areas of the hotel within your skill set and training.
  • Daily processing of all revenue transactions in the corporate accounts.
  • Daily, weekly and monthly reporting of revenue and cash balances, as well as Debtor balances.
  • Assist Departmental Managers with their daily operational deliverables with regards to sourcing of goods, reviewing vendors, collection of assets and purchase order creation and management.
  • Assume the responsibilities of the other member of the finance team when in their absence. This included assistance to the finance team at our sister property, The Sydney Boulevard Hotel.
  • Carry out any other tasks within your scope of training and experience as directed by the Group Financial Controller or General Manager.

Qualifications

  • At least 2 years’ experience in a similar role, preferably within the hospitality sector.
  • A degree in relevant fields or equivalent experience is advantageous but not mandatory.
  • Solid understanding of accounts payable and accounts receivable processes and general accounting functions.
  • Great attention to detail, a solid grasp of mathematics, alongside excellent organisational and communication skills.
  • Committed to delivering a high level of customer service.
  • Proficient in MS Office (especially Excel).
  • Experience with Sun Systems and PurchasePlus is highly regarded
  • Proficient computer skills.
  • Exceptional organisational and multitasking abilities.
  • Attention to detail and focus on quality output.
  • Willingness to proactively problem solve where possible.
  • Full working rights to work in Australia
  • Current Drivers Licence preferred due to regional location of role

Additional Information

Benefits/ What's in it for you?

  • Learning programs through our “Learn your Way” Academy & Typsy platforms, ongoing training and development opportunities (self-paced, virtual webinars, face-to-face)
  • ALL Heartist, Employee benefit card, offering discounted accommodation, food and beverage at Accor properties worldwide.
  • Mental health and well-being support initiatives, including Access to our Employee Assistance Program.

If you are passionate about the hospitality industry, meet the above criteria, and are eager to contribute to an evolving hotel, we want to hear from you!

The Bayview Geographe Resort is an unbranded property Managed by Accor.

Only candidates with current and ongoing Australian work Rights will be considered.

Must be willing to undergo a police check.

Mantra Esplanade Cairns sits within a prime location, walking distance to the swimming lagoon, pier and marina and a variety of restaurants, bars and cafes right at its door. Enjoy a truly tropical lifestyle where on your days off you ca explore neighbouring islands, take a trip out to the Great Barrier Reef or enjoy the slower pace of a local market or two.

Purpose

As a Reservations Agent, you play a crucial role in assisting our hotel guests from their initial inquiry to their arrival. Think of yourself as the go-to expert for room availability, rates, and the wonderful experiences our hotel offers. You bring a touch of excitement by suggesting enticing upgrades; all while working seamlessly with our outstanding teams to ensure a smooth and enjoyable guest experience.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Manage reservations made via phone, email, and online platforms, providing guests with accurate information on room availability, rates, and special offers
  • Be the first point of contact for our guests, addressing inquiries, answering questions, and assisting with reservation modifications and cancellations
  • Allocate rooms based on guest preferences, availability and business demands, ensuring a comfortable and enjoyable stay
  • Safely and securely handle payment transactions, verifying billing details for accuracy
  • Suggest room upgrades, offer special amenities, and fulfil specific guest requests to elevate their stay
  • Maintain meticulous reservation records to monitor room availability and ensure smooth check-ins and check-outs
  • Assist in resolving guest complaints or issues related to reservations, billing, or room assignments

Skills And Experience

  • Customer service-oriented with exceptional communication skills
  • Previous experience in a similar role in the hospitality industry is preferred
  • Proficiency in using reservation and property management systems is a plus
  • Problem-solving skills and the ability to remain calm under pressure
  • Team player with a positive attitude and willingness to go the extra mile

Accor Benefits

  • ALL Heartist Membership - Take advantage of discounts on accommodation and food & beverage worldwide!
  • Family & Friends Discounts - Available on a range of accommodation, services and events for those who mean the most to you
  • Accor Live Limitless (ALL) Loyalty Program - Earn status & reward points on your worldwide stays
  • Learn Your Way - Support your career development with access to Accor’s industry leading training platforms, Accor Academy and Typsy
  • Build Your Network - With more than 300,000 Accor professionals globally sharing the same guest passion, you have the ability to grow your hospitality network worldwide
  • Worldwide Opportunities - We are a world leading hotel operator! With over 400 hotels in the Pacific and more than 5,000 across 110 countries, offering limitless opportunities to grow your career

At Accor, we welcome you as you are. We help you grow and learn, so that work brings purpose to your life. By joining Accor, every chapter of your story is yours to write, and together we can imagine tomorrow's hospitality. Accor is an inclusive company, building diverse teams across the globe.

Everyone has a story and we want to learn yours. We invite you to APPLY NOW.

The Benefits Specialist is responsible for the administration, compliance, communication, and continuous improvement of dnata Catering USA’s employee benefits programs across multiple operating locations, including New York, New Jersey, Massachusetts (Boston), Tennessee (Nashville), Texas (Houston), California (Los Angeles and San Francisco).


Reporting directly to the Vice President of Human Resources, this corporate position serves as the subject matter expert for employee benefits, acting as the primary liaison between employees, Human Resources, vendors, brokers, and insurance carriers. The Benefits Specialist ensures the accurate administration of health and welfare plans, retirement programs, leave administration, wellness initiatives, and regulatory compliance while delivering a high level of customer service to employees and business leaders.


This role plays a critical part in maintaining compliance with ERISA, ACA, COBRA, HIPAA, IRS, DOL, and other federal and state regulations while supporting strategic initiatives that enhance the overall employee experience.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES


Benefits Administration

  • Administer all employee benefit programs including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability, voluntary benefits, flexible spending accounts (FSA), health savings accounts (HSA), and 401(k) retirement plans.
  • Manage employee benefit enrollments, qualifying life events, status changes, and benefit terminations in accordance with plan guidelines.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for employee benefit inquiries, resolving complex benefit issues in a timely and professional manner.
  • Partner with Payroll and HRIS teams to ensure benefit deductions, eligibility, and payroll integrations are accurate.
  • Audit benefit enrollments and deductions regularly to ensure data integrity.

Compliance & Regulatory Administration

  • Review Summary Plan Descriptions (SPDs), plan documents, employee communications, and required notices for regulatory compliance.
  • Coordinate annual compliance reporting and required filings with external vendors and legal counsel.
  • Maintain accurate benefits documentation and audit records.


Vendor & Broker Management

  • Serve as the primary liaison with insurance carriers, brokers, third-party administrators, retirement plan providers, and wellness vendors.
  • Monitor vendor performance and service level agreements.
  • Resolve escalated benefit issues with carriers and third-party administrators.
  • Assist with vendor renewals, contract administration, and benefit implementation projects.


Open Enrollment & Employee Communications

  • Lead the annual Open Enrollment process from planning through implementation.
  • Develop employee communication materials, benefit guides, presentations, FAQs, and educational resources.
  • Conduct virtual and onsite Open Enrollment meetings across assigned locations.
  • Educate employees regarding benefit eligibility, plan changes, and enrollment options.
  • Support benefit orientation for newly hired employees.


Leave Administration & Employee Support

  • Coordinate benefit administration associated with:
  • Family Medical Leave (FMLA)
  • ADA accommodations
  • Workers’ Compensation benefit coordination
  • Short-Term Disability
  • Long-Term Disability
  • Paid Leave Programs
  • Partner closely with Human Resources Business Partners and local HR teams to ensure consistent administration across all locations.

Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Prepare monthly benefits reports and workforce analytics.
  • Monitor benefit utilization, enrollment trends, and vendor performance metrics.
  • Recommend process improvements that enhance operational efficiency and employee experience.
  • Support mergers, acquisitions, organizational changes, and benefit integration projects as required.

NONESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Perform other duties as assigned by the Vice President of Human Resources.
  • Support Payroll Specialist as required.


EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum of 3–5 years of progressive Benefits Administration experience.
  • Multi-state benefits administration experience required.


QUALIFICATIONS

  • Ensure compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local regulations, including:
  • ERISA
  • ACA
  • COBRA
  • HIPAA
  • IRS regulations
  • Department of Labor (DOL) requirements
  • FMLA
  • Retirement plans (401(k))
  • Health & Welfare Benefits
  • Experience administering multi-state employee benefit programs.
  • Experience leading annual Open Enrollment.
  • Strong vendor management experience.
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills.
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with executives, managers, employees, vendors, and external partners.
  • High degree of professionalism and confidentiality.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
  • Experience with HRIS systems such as Dayforce, Workday, UKG, ADP, or similar platforms preferred.


Intellectual / Social Demands


  • While performing the essential functions of this position, the employee is continuously required to multitask under strict deadlines while maintaining a high degree of confidentiality and accuracy. This position requires strong analytical thinking, sound judgment, and exceptional attention to detail while managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • The employee must consistently demonstrate professionalism, accountability, and exceptional customer service while supporting employees and leadership across multiple operating locations.


Physical Demands


  • While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to sit, stand, walk, reach with hands and arms, and occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds.

Safety & Security

  • Observes company safety and security procedures.
  • Protects confidential employee information.
  • Uses office equipment and technology appropriately.


Work Environment


  • This is a full-time, corporate office-based position located in White Plains, New York.

job.job_description:
Si lideras equipos de ventas con datos en una mano y estrategia en la otra, este rol es para ti. ✈️


Despegar es la empresa de tecnología de viajes líder en América Latina, parte de Prosus — uno de los grupos de tecnología e inversión más grandes del mundo, que también integra iFood en el ecosistema travel + delivery + fintech de la región. Desde Cancún, uno de los mercados turísticos más activos de México, nuestro equipo de telesales mueve resultados reales todos los días. Y necesitamos a alguien que los lleve al siguiente nivel.


El Operations Manager de Ventas no administra: construye. Diseña estrategia, potencia supervisores y convierte datos en decisiones que impactan directamente en conversión, ticket promedio y rentabilidad. Es una figura clave en nuestra operación de telesales y canales white label en Cancún. Reporta al Sr. Telesales Manager y tiene un impacto directo en los resultados comerciales del Call Center B2B2C de Turismo.


Su misión es clara: liderar y potenciar la gestión comercial, asegurar el cumplimiento de los objetivos de ventas y acompañar al equipo de supervisión en el diseño y ejecución de estrategias que impulsen la conversión, el ticket promedio y la rentabilidad por canal. Es un rol que combina visión estratégica con ejecución operativa, y que requiere alguien que sepa leer datos, moverse con agilidad en entornos cambiantes y construir resultados con y a través de otros.


 


RESPONSABILIDADES




  • Diseñar e implementar acciones estratégicas comerciales, asegurando su ejecución a través del equipo de supervisión con foco en el logro de resultados.




  • Acompañar y orientar a los sales leads en su gestión diaria, fortaleciendo sus capacidades y alineándolos a los objetivos del negocio.




  • Identificar herramientas y oportunidades cross-área para incrementar ventas, ganancias y eficiencia operativa.




  • Participar activamente en sesiones con áreas de apoyo (Marketing, Training, IT, Soporte Regional, entre otras) para generar nuevas iniciativas que mejoren el negocio.




  • Analizar reportes y KPIs de forma sistemática para tomar decisiones basadas en datos de impacto real.




  • Supervisar y optimizar los indicadores de conversión, cierre, ticket promedio y productividad del equipo (llamadas, contactos, citas).




  • Gestionar y dar seguimiento al forecast de ventas, asegurando precisión y alineación con los targets del negocio.




  • Coordinar briefings regulares con sales leads para alinear prioridades, compartir aprendizajes y ajustar estrategia.




  • Realizar tareas administrativas asociadas a la operación (reportes de gestión, seguimiento de acuerdos, documentación de procesos).




  • Colaborar con áreas internas (Sales B2C, B2B2C, Sourcing, Legales, Compliance) y partners externos (hoteles, aerolíneas, operadores) para asegurar la calidad del portafolio de productos comercializados.





 


QUÉ BUSCAMOS


Educación

Job Summary

Functions as the property’s strategic financial business leader. The position champions, develops and implements property-wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand’s target customer and property employees. The position provides the financial expertise to enable the successful implementation of the brand service strategy and brand initiatives while maximizing the return on investment. In addition, creates and executes a business plan that is aligned with the property and brand’s business strategy and focuses on the execution of financial and accounting activities and the delivery of desirable financial results.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education And Experience

  • 4-year bachelor's degree in Finance and Accounting or related major; 2 years experience in the finance and accounting or related professional area.

OR

  • Master's degree in Finance and Accounting or related major; no work experience required.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Engaging in Strategic Planning and Decision Making

  • Develops means to improve profit, including estimating cost and benefit, exploring new business opportunities, etc.
  • Analyzes information, forecasts sales against expenses and creates annual budget plans.
  • Compiles information, analyzes and monitors actual sales against projected sales.
  • Analyzes differences between actual budget wages and forecasted wages for more efficient budget planning.
  • Identifies the underlying principles, reasons, or facts of information by breaking down information or data into separate parts.
  • Thinks creatively and practically to develop, execute and implement new business plans
  • Creates the annual operating budget for the property.
  • Provides analytical support during budget reviews to identify cost saving and productivity opportunities for property managers.
  • Implements a system of appropriate controls to manage business risks.
  • Ensures a strong accounting and operational control environment to safeguard assets, improve operations and profitability.
  • Analyzes financial data and market trends.
  • Leads the development and implementation of a comprehensive annual business plan which is aligned with the company’s and brand’s strategic direction.
  • Provides on going analytical support by monitoring the operating department’s actual and projected sales.
  • Produces accurate forecasts that enable operations to react to changes in the business.

Leading Finance & Accounting Teams

  • Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
  • Communicates the strategic goals, the focus and the owner priorities to subordinates in a clear and precise manner.
  • Leverages strong functional leadership and communication skills to influence the executive team, the property's strategies and to lead own team.
  • Oversees internal, external and regulatory audit processes.
  • Provides excellent leadership by assigning team members and other departments managers' clear accountability backed by appropriate authority.
  • Conducts annual performance appraisals with direct reports according to Standard Operating Procedures.

Anticipating and Delivering on the Needs of Key Stakeholders

  • Attends meetings and communicating with the owners, understanding the priorities and strategic focus.
  • Understands and meets the needs of key stakeholders (owners, corporate, guests, etc.).
  • Advises the GM and executive committee on existing and evolving operating/financial issues.
  • Communicates financial concepts in a clear and persuasive manner that is easy to understand and drives desired behaviors.
  • Demonstrates an understanding of cash flow and owner priorities.
  • Manages communication with owners in an effective manner.
  • Manages property working capital and cash flow in accordance with brand SOPs and owner requirements.
  • Facilitates critique meetings to review information with management team.

Developing and Maintaining Finance and Accounting Goals

  • Ensures Profits and Losses are documented accurately.
  • Monitors all taxes that apply, ensuring that taxes are current, collected and/or accrued.
  • Submits reports in a timely manner, ensuring delivery deadlines.
  • Develops and supports achievement of performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc.
  • Improves profit growth in operating departments.
  • Reviews audit issues to ensure accuracy.

Managing Projects and Policies

  • Generates and provides accurate and timely results in the form of reports, presentations, etc.
  • Reconciles balance sheet to ensure account balances are supported by appropriate documentation in accordance with SOPs.
  • Ensures that the P&L is accurate (e.g., costs are properly matched to revenue, costs are recorded in the proper accounts).
  • Ensures compliance with management contract and reporting requirements.
  • Ensures compliance with standard and local operating procedures (SOPs and LSOPs).
  • Ensures compliance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities

  • Ensures team members are cross-trained to support successful daily operations.
  • Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently.
  • Ensures new hires participate in the department’s orientation program.
  • Ensures new hires receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
  • Creates appropriate development plans which develop team members based on their individual strengths, development needs, career aspirations and abilities.
  • Conduct performance review process for employees.
  • Participates in hiring activities as appropriate.

As Director of Wellness, I will fully comprehend the vision of Six Senses to help people reconnect with themselves, others and the world around them and our values of local sensitivity and global sensibility, crafted experiences, emotional hospitality, responsible and caring, fun and quirky and pioneering wellness.

Sustainability, Wellness and Out of the Ordinary experiences are at the core of everything we do at Six Senses. I will safeguard these pillars and its strategic planning and development and ensure all directives, practices and initiatives are implemented, embraced, adopted within the hotel.

Duties And Responsibilities

As Director of Wellness, I will assume full responsibility for the efficient and effective implementation of Wellness throughout the hotel, working side by side with HOD’s, especially on the offerings in the Spa and Fitness facilities to provide exceptional product and service within brand operating standards.

The duties and responsibilities will include:

  • Keeping abreast of industry trends and practices and updating knowledge and skills to improve the product and service offering.
  • Continually focus on the rejuvenation of the health and wellness experience.
  • Wellness offerings, Spa treatments, exercise classes and fitness facilities and equipment will be constantly assessed to remain relevant and in keeping with Six Senses wellness and sustainability practices.
  • Arrange and conduct workshops and lectures for both hosts and guests on relevant health and wellness topics.
  • Constant interaction with and provision of support to and communication with other departments is intrinsic to the smooth functioning of the operation.
  • Lead a team of engaged and experienced hosts to provide the Six Senses exceptional standards of operation and service.

Qualifications

To execute the position of Director of Wellness, I must have the required qualifications, technical skills and experience in a similar role in luxury hotels with proven results and includes the following:

  • Possess a minimum of a bachelor’s degree in Wellness or Hotel Management, or closely related field. I also have the technical skills and at least five years’ experience in a luxury spas and wellness role within hospitality with proven results.
  • Good administrative and organizational skills, with attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint)
  • Excellent spoken and written English; knowledge of additional languages is an advantage.
  • Positive attitude, adaptability, and passion for wellness and sustainability.

All candidates must hold the right to work in the UK to be considered. Sponsorship is not available for this role.

The above is intended to provide an overview of the role and responsibilities for a Director of Wellness at Six Senses London. It is not and does not infer that the above is an inclusive and/or exhaustive list of the duties and responsibilities inherent to the position.

As Human Resources Manager, I will fully comprehend the vision of Six Senses to help people reconnect with themselves, others and the world around them and our values of local sensitivity and global sensibility, crafted experiences, emotional hospitality, responsible and caring, fun and quirky and pioneering wellness.

Sustainability, Wellness and Out of the Ordinary experiences are at the core of everything we do at Six Senses. I will safeguard these pillars and its strategic planning and development and ensure all directives, practices and initiatives are implemented, embraced, adopted within the resort.

Duties and responsibilities will include:

Support and oversee recruitment and host ratios, succession planning and individual career development plans (IDPs), conduct host satisfaction surveys and formulation of corrective action, arrange periodic host meetings and awards, champion the performance management system (G&O), analyze host turnover statistics and trends, ensure job descriptions are up-to-date and relevant and maintain confidential host files.

  • Support and conduct periodic salary and benefits surveys and make recommendations to remain competitive and in line with local prevailing statutes.
  • Be responsible for Host accommodation and facilities, along with the host restaurant and the host committee, career fairs and various other host activities.
  • Champion the social and environmental activities in coordination with the Sustainability Director and coordinate with the identified organizations to carry out all planned social responsibility initiatives.
  • Continually focus on talent management for teh resort.
  • Constantly assess human resources practices to remain relevant and effective.
  • Operate the property consistent with all legal, statutory and financial requirements and documentation, reporting systems, contractual obligations, security and safety protocols, communications, product and service standards, host management practices and budgetary controls are implemented, reviewed and maintained to ensure the successful operation of the hotel.

Qualifications

To execute the position of Human Resources Manager, I must have the required qualifications, technical skills and experience in a similar role in luxury hotels with proven results and includes the following:

  • Experience: Minimum 5 years of HR management experience, specifically within 5-star luxury resorts or high-end hospitality environments.
  • Language Skills: Business-fluent Thai and English language skills (both written and spoken) to effectively communicate with local staff, expat management, and government officials.
  • Legal & Compliance Expertise: Deep, up-to-date knowledge of Thai Labor Law, employment regulations, and the legal processes for securing expat visas and work permits.
  • Remote Operations Adaptability: Proven experience managing large-scale staff housing (up to 300 residents), employee welfare, and the unique logistics of a remote island location.
  • Interpersonal & Leadership Skills: Strong emotional intelligence and conflict-resolution skills, with a track record of building tight-knit, positive community cultures.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Eligibility: This position is open only for Thai Nationals due to work visa restrictions

The above is intended to provide an overview of the role and responsibilities for a Human Resources Manager at Six Senses Yao Noi. It is not and does not infer that the above is an inclusive and/or exhaustive list of the duties and responsibilities inherent in the position.

Description de l'entreprise

Orfea, qui sommes-nous ?

Orfea est un acteur spécialisé dans l'hébergement hôtelier, dédié aux déplacements professionnels du personnel ferroviaire. Filiale des groupes SNCF et Accor, l'entreprise s'appuie sur une double expertise - connaissance des besoins opérationnels et savoir-faire hôtelier - pour proposer des solutions d'hébergement adaptées, fiables et de qualité aux personnels SNCF en déplacement professionnel.

Son activité repose sur l'exploitation de résidences hôtelières situées à proximité des gares, ainsi que sur un réseau élargi d'hôtels partenaires à l'échelle nationale.

L'objectif est de garantir aux collaborateurs SNCF en mobilité des conditions d'accueil et d'hébergement optimales, alliant confort, proximité et continuité de service, tout en proposant une offre flexible répondant aux contraintes opérationnelles des déplacements professionnels.

Orfea, quelles sont nos missions ?

Proposer un hébergement sur-mesure au sein du réseau des résidences Orfea et des prestataires hôteliers pour une activité d'1.5 millions de nuitées/an.

Offrir des solutions clef en main pour l'organisation de réunions et de séminaires.

Orfea, quelles sont nos valeurs ?

Engagement, coopération, satisfaction client, sens de l'hospitalité.

Au-delà de l'exigence sur les fondamentaux de la relation client en hôtellerie, Orfea s'assure du développement des compétences de ses collaborateurs, en proposant des parcours formation adaptés et sur-mesure aux besoins des équipes.

Description du poste

Nous recherchons un(e) Adjoint(e) de Direction pour nos résidences ORFEA Dijon, ORFEA Culmont Chalindrey et la maison ORFEA Les Laumes (113 chambres au total) ainsi que la centrale de réservations dédiée en CDI, 39h/semaine.

Le poste est à pourvoir dès que possible.

Sous la responsabilité de la Directrice de Résidence, vous serez en charge, en tant que manager de proximité, de l'atteinte des objectifs qualitatifs, économiques et d'animation des résidences du périmètre.

Pour Cela, Vous Avez Pour Principales Missions

  • Relation et satisfaction Client, basées sur la convivialité : accueil des clients, fidélisation, développement de l'image de marque Orfea
  • Management et animation d'équipe, permettant l'épanouissement de chacun (H/F) : recrutement, intégration, formation, planification et animation du personnel
  • Gestion opérationnelle de la résidence, reposant sur la qualité et la performance : respect des normes d'hygiène et de sécurité, organisation des services, exécution des contrats de sous-traitance, maintenance technique, pérennité des matériels
  • Résultats économiques et développement commercial : ambassadeur de la marque, suivi commercial et financier des objectifs définis par la direction (TO, plannings, budget, compte d'exploitation...)
  • Centrale de réservation dédiée : pilotage et organisation des réservations en hôtels et hébergements alternatifs sur une zone géographique donnée en France et à l'international (plus de 90 000 nuitées/an), recherche de solutions d'hébergements courte durée, relations et négociations avec les partenaires référencés et/ou à référencer, suivi et traitement des factures hôtels
  • Gestion à distance de la résidence déportée (17 chambres) et de la maison (6 chambres)

Qualifications

Issu d'une formation Bac +2 ou Bac +3 en hôtellerie, vous avez :

  • Une connaissance approfondie du secteur hôtelier.
  • Une maîtrise de l'encadrement et de l'animation d'équipes.
  • Une maîtrise de l'anglais
  • Une expérience managériale réussie de 2 ans minimum

Sur le terrain et en proximité, vous impliquez votre équipe dans l'atteinte des objectifs de votre résidence et favorisez l'échange dans une courbe d'amélioration permanente !

Orienté 100% satisfaction client, vous parlez couramment anglais, vous êtes prêt à relever un nouveau challenge au service d'une clientèle exigeante, alors rejoignez-nous !

Informations supplémentaires

Nos Avantages

  • 13ème mois sous condition d'ancienneté
  • Prime de participation sous condition d'ancienneté
  • Ticket restaurant et Indemnités Compensatrices de Nourriture
  • Remboursement du titre de transport à 75%
  • Mutuelle prévoyance avantageuse

Company Description

We are looking for a passionate Head Host to be part of our team for Ennismore Restaurants Limited in our Llama Inn, Il Bambini Club and House of Louie Restaurants.

Llama Inn is a warm open space with natural wood furniture, tall ceilings, and steel beams. Our cuisine encompasses all things Peru, including ceviche, our famous lomo Saltado, Cancha and other unique Peruvian fair. Our cocktail and spirit list hail from Peru with none other than pisco being the star of the show and a creative cocktail menu with unique takes on the classics from around the globe. While the wine lists breaths Spain and Latin America with options by the glass and bottle to titillate any palate. Whether early or late, Llama Inn is a full dining experience for any celebration/occasion.

Born in Paris and inspired by the sunny, generous soul of Italy, Il Bambini Club is a lively trattoria known for its colourful dishes, shared feasts, and playful spirit.

Set within a 19th-century townhouse on West Street, House of Louie brings together three distinctive destinations under one roof: Wani Tzuki, a modern Japanese izakaya restaurant, Louie, an elegant French restaurant with a jazz soul, and Alligator Bar, a late-night cocktail and live music hideaway.

Job Description

  • You’ll add that extra special touch to our guests’ experience by creating a culture of recognising and delighting our guests throughout the whole team; you’ll turn every guest into a regular!
  • Both guest and team experience will be at the heart of all you do. You’ll lead your team of hosts by example, keeping them involved and motivated; making feel empowered and supported, confident in providing top experiences for our guests and comfortable turning to you with questions
  • Have a firm grip of the CRM bookings system, keeping our data up to date and closely managing the Restaurant book across the day and for the weeks ahead
  • Work closely with the Restaurant General Managers and Head Chefs to deliver a consistently excellent experience in our spaces

Qualifications

  • A shining personality who has a genuine passion for hospitality and guest experience. You will be the face of the Hotel for our guests!
  • 2+ years’ experience in a similar hospitality Host/Front of House/ Maître’D management role in a busy, bustling environment. You’re a natural at inspiring trust and bringing others along on a journey
  • Experience using CRM bookings systems and table management
  • Exceptional attention to detail in a fast-paced environment, juggling many things at once, but always dotting the i’s and crossing the t’s
  • You’re looking for a place where you can be you; no clones in suits here
  • You’re not precious. We leave our egos at the door and help get things done
  • You’re up for doing things differently and trying (almost) everything once
  • You want to be part of a team that works hard, supports each other and has fun along the way

Additional Information

  • Competitive salary including TRONC
  • Up to 28 days holidays (inclusive of bank holidays), pension, and life insurance.
  • A Medicash Plan to claim money back and get access to lots of ways to support your physical & mental wellbeing
  • Goes without saying, but we’ll feed you during your shift

The Senior Manager, Travel Insurance and Financial Protection Program will lead the day-to-day management, performance, and growth of Marriott’s Travel Insurance and Financial Protection Programs. The role will also support the evaluation, integration, and commercialization of new financial protection products and services, including insurance, warranty, guarantee, assistance, and other offerings.

The ideal candidate is a strategic, highly organized problem solver who can manage multiple priorities simultaneously, influence stakeholders, and independently drive complex initiatives from strategy through execution.

Company Description

Avista Hideaway Phuket Patong – M Gallery Collection

Discover a sanctuary of serenity with forest and sea views at this boutique Accor luxury resort in Phuket. Nestled among lush hills above Patong Beach, Avista Hideaway Phuket Patong – MGallery Collection is designed for couples and families seeking serenity in nature.

Resort Overview

  • Style: The resort offers Pool Villas and Pool Access Rooms among 150 Thai-inspired accommodations cascading through landscaped gardens.
  • Location: 39/9 Muen Ngern Road, Patong District, Amphur Kathu, 83150 Phuket, Thailand
  • Rooms: 150 spaces with mountain, pool, or sea views; select suites include direct pool access or private terrace whirlpools.

Amenities & Highlights

  • Experience one of the best Phuket hotels featuring three pools, each with a swim-up bar,
  • A spa with outdoor cabanas,
  • Complimentary wellness activities, rooftop mini-golf, games room, kids club, a 24-hour gym
  • A complimentary shuttle bus to Patong Beach, just a five-minute drive.

Job Description

This position is responsible for maximizing room revenue contribution through a thorough understanding of all booking channels and management of inventory and rate therein.

  • Pricing & Revenue Strategy Develop and optimize hotel pricing strategies, including BAR levels, restrictions, packages, and rate offers, ensuring alignment with market demand and distribution channels.
  • Forecasting & Demand Management Monitor booking pace, market demand, and historical trends to prepare accurate room and revenue forecasts and optimize availability and inventory controls.
  • Distribution & Channel Management Analyze distribution channels and consumer booking trends, ensuring rate integrity and the right offers are delivered to the right customer through the right channel.
  • Market & Competitive Analysis Monitor competitor pricing, market trends, and yield strategies to identify opportunities and support strategic decisions that maximize revenue performance.
  • Revenue Planning & Performance Reporting Collaborate with Sales & Marketing and relevant teams on strategic planning, budgeting, and business decisions; lead weekly Revenue Management Meetings and provide regular revenue updates and performance reports.

Qualifications

  • Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field, with relevant experience in hotel Revenue Management, preferably in an international or multi-property environment.
  • Revenue Management Expertise: Strong knowledge of hotel pricing, forecasting, demand management, inventory control, BAR strategies, distribution channels, and revenue optimization.
  • Analytical & Commercial Skills: Strong analytical and numerical skills with the ability to interpret market trends, competitor pricing, booking patterns, and performance data to support revenue decisions.
  • Systems & Digital Skills: Proficient in Revenue Management Systems, PMS, CRS, Channel Manager, and other hotel commercial systems; strong Microsoft Excel and reporting skills.
  • Communication & Leadership: Strong communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively with Sales, Marketing, Reservations, and Operations teams and lead Revenue Management meetings.
  • Language: Good command of written and spoken English. Knowledge of additional languages is an advantage.

Additional Information

  • Supervise daily reception, check-in, check-out, and guest service workflows.
  • Resolve guest concerns quickly, professionally, and with care.
  • Train, coach, and schedule front office team members.
  • Monitor room inventory, occupancy, and yield management to help drive revenue.
  • Act as the shift leader or hotel representative when the manager is away.
  • Coordinate with housekeeping and maintenance to ensure clean and ready rooms.

job.job_description:
Designation: Associate Director - Operations

Location: Pune, India


Company Overview


Fareportal is a travel technology company powering a next-generation travel concierge service. Utilizing its innovative technology and company owned and operated global contact centers, Fareportal has built strong industry partnerships providing customers access to over 600 airlines, a million lodgings, and hundreds of car rental companies around the globe. With a portfolio of consumer travel brands including CheapOair and OneTravel, Fareportal enables consumers to book-online, on mobile apps for iOS and Android, by phone, or live chat. Fareportal provides its airline partners with access to a broad customer base that books high-yielding international travel and add-on ancillaries.

Fareportal is one of the leading sellers of airline tickets in the United States.We are a progressive company that leverages technology and expertise to deliver optimal solutions for our suppliers, customers, and partners.


FAREPORTAL HIGHLIGHTS:


  • Fareportal is the number 1 privately held online travel company in flight volume.
  • Fareportal partners with over 600 airlines, 1 million lodgings, and hundreds of car rental companies worldwide.
  • 2019 annual sales exceeded $5 billion.
  • Fareportal sees over 150 million unique visitors annually to our desktop and mobile sites.


Fareportal, with its global workforce of over 2,600 employees, is strategically positioned with 9 offices in 6 countries and headquartered in New York City.


Role Overview

People are at the core of Fareportal. Product innovation and Engineering are what drive Fareportal. We are one of the fastest growing travel technology companies in the world; our portfolio of travel brands, including flagship products CheapOair and OneTravel, receive over 200 million visitors annually.


Fareportal is hiring a highly talented and motivated Associate Director- Operations. The leader will drive innovation by leading teams across Customer satisfaction, revenue generation and Quality assurance for Fareportal's brands. You will be responsible for not only developing industry leading ideas, but also working cross functionally to turn these ideas. You and your team will be responsible for crafting the vision, defining and defending customer satisfaction.


Responsibilities

  • Ensuring successful delivery of the service.
  • Ensuring that the right level of competency is available in order to deliver best in class service delivery.
  • Conducting Drive CS and Sales Strategies to meet established goals and targets.
  • Analyze and present findings on daily MIS report if there is a shortfall or overage in actual compared to target in CS, Sales, Attendance and other areas.
  • Provide leadership to operations management team (direct reports).
  • Take ownership and accountability for the performance of direct reports while acting as a mentor encouraging career growth and opportunity in a professional environment.
  • Serve as a point of contact for India operations to all global stakeholders.
  • Play a significant role in long term planning geared towards operational excellence.
  • Provide quantitative analysis to help drive profitability.
  • Effectively Manage and create a highly motivated and focused CS, Sales and Exchange workforce.
  • Set clear targets for the teams and monitor performance.
  • Reduce Customer Complaints by proactively training and enforcing a strong commitment to customer satisfaction.
  • Formulate proposals, present findings and roll out corporate initiatives.
  • Assist in developing and implementation of incentive strategy and program to drive revenue goals and improve CSAT.
  • Make sure all Company policies and Company terms and Conditions are complied, fees structure is followed, no circumvention of Airlines inventory is done.
  • Coordinate closely with the Training Team to analyze training efforts and ensure successful implementation of same.
  • Create and Manage Specialized Teams to maximize revenue opportunities and conversions (phone sales, email sales, Web chat, Product Sales, etc.)
  • Coordinate closely with the Marketing and Web Design Team for lead generation.
  • Introduce, implement and successfully manage outbound process to ensure maximum utilization during lean period and / or for cross sell sales campaigns.
  • Ensure effective knowledge and promotion of In-house / Consolidator deals by the Sales Team.
  • Analyze various reports to monitor Top O&Ds, Top Airlines, Sales Per Hour (SPH), Conversion Reports, etc. and plan improvement strategies accordingly.
  • Prepare periodic dashboards showing Actual Vs Goals performance for Senior Management review.
  • Identify areas of Missed Sales Opportunities and implement strategies to successfully redeem these.
  • Ensure set Quality Parameters are met in compliance with DOT guidelines. Create guidelines and strict adherence for agent coaching, counselling or strong actions including penalty based on Quality Coaching teams feedback.
  • Ensure staffing levels meet targets set by WFM Team.
  • Participate in periodic call monitoring sessions for quality purposes and understanding user experience and gaps in sales strategies if any.
  • Initiate projects to enhance Sales Tools, reduce AHT and improve Conversion Rate and champion those projects through to the live release.
  • Support and Enforce First Call Resolution strategy across the Team.
  • Achieve customer service excellence including measurement and continuous improvement by actively capturing and reviewing Voice of Customer.
  • Conduct appraisals, reviews, incentives, salaries, raises, rewards and recognition for direct reports.
  • Ensure compliance with standard practices and processes across the call center.
  • Implement best practices and continuous process improvement in Sales Processes.
  • Perform other related duties as necessary.


Requirement

  • Post Graduate degree preferred.
  • Must be fluent in written and spoken English.
  • Deep domain expertise in Voice/ contact center
  • Excellent Analytical skills, expertise in analyzing data, creating models using excel and other tools.
  • Minimum 10 years relevant industry experience.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience working in a Senior Management Role.
  • Experience in a multinational travel environment with direct call center / service delivery experience.
  • Working knowledge and experience with GDS (Sabre/Amadeus) booking, Exchanges and ticketing formats, processes and procedures.
  • Leadership and People Management Experience: must have managed a span of control for over 500 people.
  • Ability to work in a 24x7x365 days environment.


Disclaimer

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Fareportal reserves the right to change the job duties, responsibilities, expectations or requirements posted here at any time at the Company’s sole discretion, with or without notice.

The CTM Group is a leading global provider of travel management solutions spanning corporate, events, leisure, loyalty and wholesale travel. Our family of travel brands provide award-winning travel services and tools that transform the way people travel in every corner of the world.
When you travel with CTM or any of our travel brands, you can rest assured you’re supported by a team of passionate and accomplished travel professionals, leveraging extensive global buying power for the best deals in travel, and backed by award-winning tools that deliver exceptional travel experiences and outcomes.
The CTM Group today is estimated to be the fourth* largest travel management company in the world, with offices spanning four continents and supported by an extensive global network of agency partners with servicing capabilities in more than 130 countries - providing the scale and global reach to deliver expert travel support wherever your travels take you. Our goal has never been to be the biggest, but always to be the best at what we do.
As a publicly listed company on the Australian Securities Exchanges (ASX: CTD), CTM conducts its business in accordance with stringent corporate governance requirements and with complete transparency of financial performance and viability which, in turn, provides our customers, employees, partners and shareholders with maximum confidence in their partnership with CTM. More information on CTM’s Corporate Governance and financial performance can be found at https://investor.travelctm.com.au/
*Based on publicly available financial performance data.
job.job_description:
About the Company


Corporate Travel Management (CTM) is an award-winning global provider of innovative and cost-effective travel solutions spanning corporate, events, leisure, loyalty and wholesale travel. The company’s proven business strategy is underpinned by personalised service excellence supported by market leading technology solutions which deliver a return on investment to our customers. Headquartered in Australia with its Asia head office in Hong Kong, the company provides local service solutions to customers of all sizes across the world including Hong Kong, Singapore, China, Taiwan and Japan in Asia. CTM is an award-winning provider of innovative and cost-effective travel management solutions to the corporate, events, leisure and loyalty travel markets. Its proven business strategy combines personalized service excellence with client-facing technology solutions to deliver a return on investment to clients.


About the Role


  • Act as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for assigned corporate clients
  • Build and maintain strong, long-term client relationships to ensure satisfaction and retention
  • Partner with clients to understand business goals and translate them into actionable travel program strategies
  • Leverage data, reporting and insights to guide client decision-making
  • Lead and support strategic travel initiatives focused on cost optimization, compliance, and traveller experience
  • Identify and pursue opportunities to grow client revenue through upselling and cross-selling of products, services, and solutions
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver consistent, high-quality service and experience
  • Manage service escalations and ensure timely, effective resolution
  • Participate in ad-hoc projects as assigned by the reporting manager.


Requirements


  • Minimum five (5) years of experience in account management or client servicing, including at least two (2) years within the travel or a related industry.
  • Sound knowledge of business travel management principles and familiarity with travel industry technologies and systems is preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience in client and account relationship management, with a proven ability to maintain and strengthen long-term partnerships.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to engage effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Strong negotiation and influencing skills, with the capability to achieve favourable outcomes.
  • Highly developed organisational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritise and manage multiple tasks efficiently.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and results-oriented, with the ability to perform effectively under pressure.
  • Positive attitude and strong team player, contributing to a collaborative and supportive work environment.
  • Proficient in written and spoken English; additional language skills will be an advantage.
  • Candidates with less experience may be considered for an Executive role.

Lufthansa is one of the world’s leading airlines, connecting passengers to over 200 destinations across 74 countries from our hubs in Frankfurt and Munich.
As an industry pioneer, we are committed to shaping the future of sustainable aviation, investing in next-generation aircraft, cutting-edge technology, and digital solutions. Our goal is to drive excellence: not just in the sky, but across every touchpoint of the travel experience.
With Lufthansa Allegris, our new long-haul experience, we are setting a new standard in premium travel, introducing a completely redesigned First, Business, Premium Economy, and Economy Class for ultimate comfort and choice. We continue to enhance the travel experience with state-of-the-art lounges, award-winning service, and onboard broadband Wi-Fi (FlyNet) across our entire long-haul fleet. Follow us for updates on how we're shaping the future of aviation.
For more information, reservations or customer service, visit lufthansa.com or follow us on Facebook, X and Instagram. We look forward to welcoming you onboard.

job.job_description:
Are you interested in project management and finance, and would you like to help shape the future of Deutsche Lufthansa AG’s finance function? Are you open-minded, solution-oriented, and looking to gain broad insight into the finance departments of a major international corporation? Then apply for an internship in the Finance Transformation Program!

Tasks

The Project Management Office (PMO) plays a central role in managing the entire program. Working closely with others, you will assist with the planning, coordination, and monitoring of all project activities, taking on personal responsibility and actively contributing to the program’s success.

You will be part of the central Project Management Office (PMO). Your responsibilities will include:

  • Acquiring practical skills with a focus on cross-functional coordination and program management
  • Project-specific reporting and controlling activities
  • Planning and managing workshops, presentations, and meetings
  • Collaboration and coordination with other finance departments within the Group
  • Preparation and development of project plans, status reports, and other project documentation
  • Participation in meetings, workshops, and other events related to the project

Benefits

  • Cafeteria
  • Employee events
  • Free parking

Requirements

We are looking for ambitious students with a strong drive to succeed who are eager to contribute their individual skills and actively drive projects forward. Ideally, you should be willing to take on responsibility independently.

  • At the time of the internship, you must be in at least your third semester of a degree program in business administration, mathematics, economics, business informatics, or industrial engineering, ideally with a focus on finance
  • Proof of enrollment for the entire duration of the internship (a current certificate of enrollment and a written proof of mandatory internship must be included with the application) or the internship must take place between your bachelor’s and master’s programs (gap year)
  • Fluency in spoken and written English and German
  • Very good knowledge of Microsoft Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint
  • Analytical, organizational, and communication skills, as well as the ability to work in a team

Further information is also available in our FAQs.

job.job_description:
Start your journey with BCD: Grow, connect, collaborate and celebrate with our global team

Director, Program Management (Hybrid)

Full time, Tokyo, Japan

For this role, you will be responsible for managing a team of program managers or a major account. You will be accountable for achieving the company's goals related to client retention, quality service delivery, client and BCD Travel profitability, preferred vendor maximization, and technology implementation.

As a Director, Program Management, you will

  • Provide oversight and direction of the team, including performance/activity updates with stakeholders
  • Ensure multi-level, strategic client relationships are being established
  • Support the development of clients and department budget
  • Evaluate and analyze the department budget and provide improvement recommendations to department leadership
  • Lead the account management team to develop strategic client business plans to achieve the client and BCD Travel's objectives
  • Explore opportunities to expand client servicing relationships through (regional or global) expansion
  • Lead or support the negotiation process for the development of Service Level Agreements
  • Negotiate all client contract terms consistent with company approval processes and commercial policy in a timely manner
  • Manage the performance of direct reports and downline employees

About You

  • Extensive relevant management work experience
  • Experience as an account manager in a corporate environment
  • Business travel industry experience is preferred
  • Computer literate in business software applications
  • Excellent written and communication skills in English and Japanese
  • Ability and willingness to travel domestically

What We Offer You

At BCD Travel, we work with highly motivated and passionate people. We value open communication, collaboration, and a flexible work-life balance. We offer unique, often global, experiences that empower you to develop and grow within the organization. Sustainability and helping others is also high on our list. We make a difference through charitable activities in our communities across the globe.

About Us

BCD Travel helps companies travel smart and achieve more. We drive program adoption, cost savings and talent retention through digital experiences that simplify business travel. Our 15,000+ dedicated team members service clients in 170+ countries as we shape a sustainable future for business travel. BCD’s leading meetings and events management and global consultancy services complete our comprehensive suite of solutions for all aspects of corporate travel. In 2024, BCD achieved US$22.9 billion in sales. For more information, visit www.bcdtravel.com.

Get to know us by reading our blog and checking out our social media:

  • https://www.bcdtravel.com/blog/
  • https://www.linkedin.com/company/bcd-travel/
  • https://www.instagram.com/bcdtravel/
  • https://www.facebook.com/bcdtravel/

You’ll be offered

  • Flexible working hours and work-from-home or remote opportunities
  • Opportunities to grow your skillset and career
  • Generous vacation days so you can rest and recharge
  • A compensation package that feels fair to you, including mental, physical, and financial wellbeing tools
  • Travel industry professional perks and discounts
  • An inclusive work environment where diversity is celebrated

Ready to join the journey? Apply now!

We’re dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If you’re excited about a role, but your experience doesn’t align perfectly, we still encourage you to apply.

We are committed to providing reasonable and necessary accommodations to ensure all employees can perform their roles effectively. For accommodation requests or further information, contact our Talent Acquisition department at careers@bcdtravel.com.
